FILE: nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_handler_arena.h
================================================
// glcpu3: completed handlers copied into a per-command-buffer arena instead of _Block_copy's malloc.
//
// Apple's OpenGL renderer adds one completed handler to the command buffer for every draw
// (GLDContextRec::drawCore, a stack block capturing two C pointers). -addCompletedHandler: must keep a copy of
// that block until the command buffer completes; _Block_copy mallocs 48 bytes on the app's render thread and the
// block is freed later on the callback thread. That producer/consumer pattern makes nanov2's allocation miss on
// slots another core just freed: in prod6/prod7 Minecraft profiles _Block_copy -> nanov2_malloc_type was
// 5.8-6.0% of the render thread (~160 ns per draw at ~2150 draws/frame), with no free on that thread at all.
//
// A block literal without copy/dispose helpers captures only plain bytes, and _Block_copy of such a block is a
// memmove of descriptor->size bytes plus heap isa/flags (Block ABI, libclosure runtime.cpp). The copy here is the
// same memmove into memory owned by the command buffer, invoked through the same invoke pointer with the copy as
// its block argument, in the order added, on the same callback queue. Anything else (global, heap, helpers,
// noescape, small/relative descriptor, ptrauth) is still copied with Block_copy, as before.
//
// NVMTL_HANDLER_ARENA=0 restores the prod7 path (every handler Block_copy'd, an NSArray built at completion).
#include <Block.h>
#include <os/lock.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct nvmtl_hchunk { struct nvmtl_hchunk *next; uint32_t used, cap; uint64_t pad; unsigned char data[]; } nvmtl_hchunk;
typedef struct { void *isa; int32_t flags; int32_t reserved; void (*invoke)(void *, ...);
                 const struct { unsigned long reserved, size; } *descriptor; } nvmtl_block_layout;
enum { NVMTL_BLK_SMALL_DESCRIPTOR = 1 << 22, NVMTL_BLK_IS_NOESCAPE = 1 << 23, NVMTL_BLK_NEEDS_FREE = 1 << 24,
       NVMTL_BLK_HAS_COPY_DISPOSE = 1 << 25, NVMTL_BLK_HAS_CTOR = 1 << 26, NVMTL_BLK_IS_GC = 1 << 27,
       NVMTL_BLK_IS_GLOBAL = 1 << 28, NVMTL_BLK_USE_STRET = 1 << 29 };
#define NVMTL_HCHUNK_BYTES (32u << 10)
#define NVMTL_HPOOL_MAX 32u            // 1 MB of chunks kept for reuse, the rest freed
#define NVMTL_HBLOCK_MAX 512u          // larger literals are left to Block_copy
#define NVMTL_HTAG ((uintptr_t)1)      // low bit of an _hv entry: an arena copy (no reference to drop)

static int nvmtl_handler_arena_on(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("NVMTL_HANDLER_ARENA"), *m = getenv("NVMTL_GLCPU4");   // glcpu4: unset follows NVMTL_GLCPU4
        int v = (e && *e) ? e[0] != '0' : !(m && m[0] == '0');
#if __has_feature(ptrauth_calls)
        v = 0;                          // arm64e signs invoke with the block's address: a moved copy would not verify
#endif
        on = v;
        nvlog("glcpu3: completed handlers %s (NVMTL_HANDLER_ARENA=%s)",
              v ? "without helpers are copied into the command buffer's arena" : "are Block_copy'd (prod7)", e ? e : "default");
    }
    return on;
}
static os_unfair_lock g_hpool_lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;
static nvmtl_hchunk *g_hpool; static unsigned g_hpool_n;
// census only: relaxed load + store, not a read-modify-write. A locked RMW per draw would drain the render thread's
// pending (write-combined batch) stores on x86; a lost count between racing threads does not matter here.
static _Atomic unsigned long long g_harena_copies, g_harena_fallbacks;
static inline unsigned long long nvmtl_census_bump(_Atomic unsigned long long *c) {
    const unsigned long long k = atomic_load_explicit(c, memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
    atomic_store_explicit(c, k, memory_order_relaxed); return k;
}

static nvmtl_hchunk *nvmtl_hchunk_get(void) {
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_hpool_lock);
    nvmtl_hchunk *c = g_hpool;
    if (c) { g_hpool = c->next; g_hpool_n--; }
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_hpool_lock);
    if (!c) { c = (nvmtl_hchunk *)malloc(NVMTL_HCHUNK_BYTES); if (!c) return NULL; c->cap = NVMTL_HCHUNK_BYTES - (uint32_t)sizeof *c; }
    c->next = NULL; c->used = 0; return c;
}
// all of a command buffer's chunks, after its handlers ran (or it died without completing)
static void nvmtl_hchunks_put(nvmtl_hchunk *c) {
    while (c) {
        nvmtl_hchunk *n = c->next; int keep;
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_hpool_lock);
        keep = g_hpool_n < NVMTL_HPOOL_MAX;
        if (keep) { c->next = g_hpool; g_hpool = c; g_hpool_n++; }
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_hpool_lock);
        if (!keep) free(c);
        c = n;
    }
}
// a stack block whose copy is a plain byte copy: no helpers to run, nothing it captures needs a reference
static size_t nvmtl_block_plain_size(const void *blk) {
    const nvmtl_block_layout *b = (const nvmtl_block_layout *)blk;
    if (b->isa != (void *)_NSConcreteStackBlock) return 0;
    if (b->flags & (NVMTL_BLK_SMALL_DESCRIPTOR | NVMTL_BLK_IS_NOESCAPE | NVMTL_BLK_NEEDS_FREE | NVMTL_BLK_HAS_COPY_DISPOSE |
                    NVMTL_BLK_HAS_CTOR | NVMTL_BLK_IS_GC | NVMTL_BLK_IS_GLOBAL | NVMTL_BLK_USE_STRET)) return 0;
    if (!b->invoke || !b->descriptor) return 0;
    const size_t n = b->descriptor->size;
    return n >= sizeof *b && n <= NVMTL_HBLOCK_MAX ? n : 0;
}
// caller holds the command buffer's lock; returns the tagged entry, or NULL to fall back to Block_copy
static void *nvmtl_harena_copy(nvmtl_hchunk **head, const void *blk) {
    const size_t n = nvmtl_block_plain_size(blk);
    if (!n) { (void)nvmtl_census_bump(&g_harena_fallbacks); return NULL; }
    const uint32_t need = (uint32_t)((n + 15u) & ~(size_t)15u);
    nvmtl_hchunk *c = *head;
    if (!c || c->cap - c->used < need) {
        nvmtl_hchunk *f = nvmtl_hchunk_get();
        if (!f) return NULL;
        f->next = c; *head = c = f;
    }
    void *dst = c->data + c->used; c->used += need;
    memcpy(dst, blk, n);
    const unsigned long long k = nvmtl_census_bump(&g_harena_copies);
    if (!(k & (k - 1)) && k >= 1024)
        nvlog("glcpu3: %llu completed handlers copied into arenas, %llu left to Block_copy", k,
              (unsigned long long)atomic_load_explicit(&g_harena_fallbacks, memory_order_relaxed));
    return (void *)((uintptr_t)dst | NVMTL_HTAG);
}
static inline void nvmtl_handler_entry_call(void *e, id cb) {
    if ((uintptr_t)e & NVMTL_HTAG) {
        nvmtl_block_layout *b = (nvmtl_block_layout *)((uintptr_t)e & ~NVMTL_HTAG);
        ((void (*)(void *, id))b->invoke)(b, cb);
    } else {
        ((__bridge MTLCommandBufferHandler)e)(cb);
    }
}
// drop an entry's reference (arena copies have none; their chunk goes back to the pool with the batch)
static inline void nvmtl_handler_entry_drop(void *e) { if (!((uintptr_t)e & NVMTL_HTAG)) CFRelease(e); }

/* NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1: GPU-encoded indirect command buffers executed through VK_EXT_device_generated_commands
   (docs/design/DESIGN-icb-dgc.md, nvmtl_icb_dgc.c, the record layout in nvmtl_icb_layout.h). With the knob off none of
   this is called and nvmtl_vk_icb_dgc_probe adds nothing to the device. */
#ifndef NVMTL_ICB_DGC_H
#define NVMTL_ICB_DGC_H
#include <stdint.h>
#include "nvmtl_icb_layout.h"

/* What the execute of one pipeline can take from the records. ok: an indirect commands layout exists (DGC can run
   this pipeline); vmask / smask: the vertex and fragment (or kernel) buffer indices a shader may set, the bits the
   CPU writes into words 21 / 22; vtok: the vertex bindings fed by vertex buffer tokens (0: the CPU binds them). */
typedef struct nvmtl_dgc_plan nvmtl_dgc_plan;
struct nvmtl_dgc_plan_info { int ok; uint32_t vmask, smask, vtok; };
/* scratch (preprocess) buffers taken for one command buffer, given back when it completes */
typedef struct nvmtl_dgc_arena nvmtl_dgc_arena;

/* nvmtl_vk.c, device creation: before vkCreateDevice (adds the extensions to exts and the features to *chain, with the
   knob only) and after it (the entry points) */
void nvmtl_vk_icb_dgc_probe(const char **exts, uint32_t *next, uint32_t cap, void **chain);
void nvmtl_vk_icb_dgc_device_ready(void);
/* 1 when the knob is on and the device has VK_EXT_device_generated_commands enabled (after vkCreateDevice) */
int  nvmtl_vk_icb_dgc_ready(void);
/* the identity index buffer (uint32 0..n-1) the records point plain draws at; 0 when it could not be made */
uint64_t nvmtl_vk_icb_dgc_iota(uint32_t *n);
/* the device address unbound buffer entries hold (the plugin's dummy buffer) */
uint64_t nvmtl_vk_icb_dgc_dummy(void);
/* the plan of the graphics pipeline p as bound in c (buffers: the ICB does not inherit buffers, so the records hold them;
   alt: the draw token reads the other-topology draw at word 235 instead of word 2, nvmtl_icb_layout.h) */
const nvmtl_dgc_plan *nvmtl_vk_icb_dgc_plan_gfx(nvk_cmdbuf *c, const nvk_pipeline *p, int buffers, int alt, struct nvmtl_dgc_plan_info *info);
/* the plan of compute pipeline p (kernel buffers through its pushed address table); NULL when DGC cannot run it */
const nvmtl_dgc_plan *nvmtl_vk_icb_dgc_plan_cs(const nvk_pipeline *p, int buffers, struct nvmtl_dgc_plan_info *info);
/* n sequences (draws) from the records at rec + off, stride bytes apart, with the state bound in c. 0 ok, -1 refused. */
int  nvmtl_vk_cmd_icb_dgc_draw(nvk_cmdbuf *c, const nvmtl_dgc_plan *pl, nvk_buffer *rec, size_t off, uint32_t n, uint32_t stride,
                               nvmtl_dgc_arena **arena);
/* one dispatch from the record at rec + off with threadgroup tg (the binding of nvmtl_vk_cmd_dispatch_indirect_tg). */
int  nvmtl_vk_cmd_icb_dgc_dispatch(nvk_cmdbuf *c, nvk_pipeline *p, const nvmtl_dgc_plan *pl, nvk_buffer *rec, size_t off,
                                   const uint32_t tg[3], nvmtl_dgc_arena **arena);
/* gives the arena's scratch buffers back (call when the command buffer has completed) */
void nvmtl_vk_icb_dgc_arena_release(nvmtl_dgc_arena *a);

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
/* GPU-encoded indirect command buffers: the slot record layout shared with the translator
   (translator/translator/src/native/render_command.rs, which lowers air.draw_primitives_render_command,
   air.draw_indexed_primitives_render_command.p1i16/.p1i32 and air.reset_render_command to stores into it).

   An MTLIndirectCommandBuffer whose gpuResourceID is taken (an argument encoder's setIndirectCommandBuffer:atIndex:
   or the app itself) gets a record buffer (VRAM through the BAR when it can, else system RAM; the CPU keeps its own copy
   of what it wrote and never reads the buffer back): one 64-byte record per slot. Its device address is the
   gpuResourceID, which is what a shader's `command_buffer` holds. The CPU writes a record when the app encodes a draw
   through indirectRenderCommandAtIndex:, the GPU when a shader encodes one; executeCommandsInBuffer:withRange: then
   draws every slot from its record with vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect (a slot with an index buffer) or vkCmdDrawIndirect,
   so the last writer wins on either side, as on Apple's GPUs.

   Words (uint32):
     0      kind: NVMTL_ICB_EMPTY / _DRAW / _INDEXED / _REFUSED                                      CPU + GPU
     1      Metal primitive type of the last draw written                                            CPU + GPU
     2..6   VkDrawIndexedIndirectCommand                                                             CPU + GPU
     7..10  VkDrawIndirectCommand                                                                    CPU + GPU
     11     primitive type the execute draws the slot with (NVMTL_ICB_NO_PRIM: none chosen yet)       CPU
     12,13  device address bound as the slot's index buffer (0: none)                                CPU
     14     bytes from that address to the end of the index buffer                                   CPU
     15     log2 of the index size (1 uint16, 2 uint32, 0 none)                                      CPU
   A write zeroes the counts of the form it does not use. The execute draws a run of consecutive slots that replay the
   same state as one vkCmdDraw*Indirect with drawCount = the run's length and stride 64 (multiDrawIndirect; ~0.03 us per
   slot, as direct draws) and every other slot alone (~2 us): the indexed form when word 15 is non-zero, else the plain
   form (both, until 11 Nov 2026: Xe2 ANV loads each indirect parameter with its
   own MI_LOAD_REGISTER_MEM, ~2.2 us per indirect draw from VRAM and ~5 us from system RAM, user/tests/metal/
   mtl_icb_cost.m). Topology and index buffer are bound by the CPU (core Vulkan takes neither from GPU memory), so a GPU
   draw with another primitive type than word 11, another index type than word 15, an index pointer outside
   [word 12/13, + word 14], or a plain draw into a slot with an index buffer is written with zero counts and kind
   NVMTL_ICB_REFUSED. */
#ifndef NVMTL_ICB_LAYOUT_H
#define NVMTL_ICB_LAYOUT_H
#include <stdint.h>

enum {
    NVMTL_ICB_RECORD_BYTES = 64,
    NVMTL_ICB_W_KIND = 0, NVMTL_ICB_W_PRIM = 1, NVMTL_ICB_W_IDX = 2, NVMTL_ICB_W_DRAW = 7,
    NVMTL_ICB_W_EXEC_PRIM = 11, NVMTL_ICB_W_IB_LO = 12, NVMTL_ICB_W_IB_HI = 13, NVMTL_ICB_W_IB_LIMIT = 14, NVMTL_ICB_W_IB_SHIFT = 15,
    NVMTL_ICB_EMPTY = 0, NVMTL_ICB_DRAW = 1, NVMTL_ICB_INDEXED = 2, NVMTL_ICB_REFUSED = 3,
};
#define NVMTL_ICB_NO_PRIM 0xffffffffu

typedef struct {
    uint32_t kind, prim;
    uint32_t idx[5];    /* indexCount, instanceCount, firstIndex, vertexOffset, firstInstance */
    uint32_t draw[4];   /* vertexCount, instanceCount, firstVertex, firstInstance */
    uint32_t execPrim, ibLo, ibHi, ibLimit, ibShift;
} nvmtl_icb_record;
_Static_assert(sizeof(nvmtl_icb_record) == NVMTL_ICB_RECORD_BYTES, "the translator addresses a slot as 16 words");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_record, idx) == NVMTL_ICB_W_IDX * 4, "indexed draw at word 2");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_record, draw) == NVMTL_ICB_W_DRAW * 4, "plain draw at word 7");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_record, execPrim) == NVMTL_ICB_W_EXEC_PRIM * 4, "execute topology at word 11");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_record, ibShift) == NVMTL_ICB_W_IB_SHIFT * 4, "index shift at word 15");

/* The pipeline's topology class gives the primitive type of a slot that has no CPU-encoded draw:
   MTLPrimitiveTopologyClass Point 1 -> point (0), Line 2 -> line (1), Triangle 3 / Unspecified 0 -> triangle (3). */
static inline uint32_t nvmtl_icb_prim_for_class(unsigned long cls) { return cls == 1 ? 0u : cls == 2 ? 1u : 3u; }

/* NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 (docs/design/DESIGN-icb-dgc.md; the translator's render_command/dgc.rs keeps the same words): every
   GPU-encodable ICB gets 1024-byte records. Words 0..15 are the record above; the rest hold what
   VK_EXT_device_generated_commands reads per sequence (index buffer token, vertex buffer tokens, the buffer addresses its
   push-constant tokens copy), the compute words, and CPU-written words that tell a shader what the execute can express.
   The translator lowers the state commands (set_vertex_buffer, set_fragment_buffer, set_kernel_buffer, set_pipeline_state,
   barriers, concurrent_dispatch_*, compute reset) only with the knob; both sides read the same variable. */
enum {
    NVMTL_ICB_DGC_RECORD_BYTES = 1024,
    NVMTL_ICB_W_IBT = 16,        /* VkBindIndexBufferIndirectCommandEXT                                   CPU + GPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_MODE = 20,       /* bit 0: this ICB's render executes run through DGC                     CPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_VMASK = 21,      /* vertex buffer indices a shader may set                                CPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_SMASK = 22,      /* fragment (render) / kernel (compute) buffer indices a shader may set  CPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_STICKY = 23,     /* a state command the execute cannot express was encoded here           GPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_EXEC_PIPE = 24,  /* resource ID of the pipeline the execute binds (0 not known)           CPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_GPU_PIPE = 26,   /* the resource ID a shader set                                          GPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_IOTA = 28, NVMTL_ICB_W_IOTA_N = 30,   /* the identity index buffer (uint32 0..n-1)       CPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_BARRIER = 31,    /* 1 after set_barrier                                                   GPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_DISPATCH = 32,   /* VkDispatchIndirectCommand                                             CPU + GPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_TG = 35,         /* threads per threadgroup a shader asked for                            GPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_EXEC_TG = 38,    /* threads per threadgroup the execute dispatches with (0 none yet)      CPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_VB = 48,         /* vertex buffer m: VkBindVertexBufferIndirectCommandEXT at 48 + 4m      CPU + GPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_SB = 172,        /* fragment / kernel buffer m: its address at 172 + 2m                   CPU + GPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_ALT_PRIM = 234,  /* the other topology of the class a slot without a CPU draw may draw  CPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_W_ALT_IDX = 235,   /* VkDrawIndexedIndirectCommand of a draw of that topology               GPU */
    NVMTL_ICB_MAX_BUFFERS = 31,
    NVMTL_ICB_DISPATCH = 4,      /* kind: a dispatch                                                      */
    NVMTL_ICB_MODE_DGC_DRAW = 1,
};
typedef struct {
    nvmtl_icb_record head;                          /* 0..15 */
    uint32_t ibt[4];                                /* 16..19: address lo, hi, size, VkIndexType */
    uint32_t mode, vmask, smask, sticky;            /* 20..23 */
    uint32_t execPipe[2], gpuPipe[2];               /* 24..27 */
    uint32_t iota[2], iotaN, barrier;               /* 28..31 */
    uint32_t dispatch[3], tg[3], execTg[3];         /* 32..40 */
    uint32_t scratch[7];                            /* 41..47 */
    uint32_t vb[NVMTL_ICB_MAX_BUFFERS][4];          /* 48..171: address lo, hi, size, stride */
    uint32_t sb[NVMTL_ICB_MAX_BUFFERS][2];          /* 172..233 */
    uint32_t altPrim, altIdx[5];                    /* 234..239 */
    uint32_t spare[16];
} nvmtl_icb_dgc_record;
_Static_assert(sizeof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record) == NVMTL_ICB_DGC_RECORD_BYTES, "the translator addresses a slot as 256 words with the knob");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record, ibt) == NVMTL_ICB_W_IBT * 4, "index buffer token at word 16");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record, sticky) == NVMTL_ICB_W_STICKY * 4, "sticky refusal at word 23");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record, iotaN) == NVMTL_ICB_W_IOTA_N * 4, "identity count at word 30");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record, dispatch) == NVMTL_ICB_W_DISPATCH * 4, "dispatch at word 32");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record, execTg) == NVMTL_ICB_W_EXEC_TG * 4, "execute threadgroup at word 38");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record, vb) == NVMTL_ICB_W_VB * 4, "vertex buffers at word 48");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record, sb) == NVMTL_ICB_W_SB * 4, "stage buffers at word 172");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record, altPrim) == NVMTL_ICB_W_ALT_PRIM * 4, "the other topology at word 234");
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(nvmtl_icb_dgc_record, altIdx) == NVMTL_ICB_W_ALT_IDX * 4, "its draw at word 235");

/* A slot with no CPU-encoded draw executes with its pipeline's class as a list (word 11); a shader may draw the class's
   strip instead (WebKit's vsICBIndirect* encode a draw of the render bundle's own topology into such slots). In DGC mode
   the translator accepts the type in word 234 too and puts that draw's counts at words 235..239 (the main area's are
   zero). The execute draws the slot with the strip once a completed execute has shown one there (nvmtlExecuteDGC; with
   NVMTL_ICB_DGC_STRIPS=1 both topologies every time): core Vulkan and the extension take no topology from GPU memory. */
static inline uint32_t nvmtl_icb_strip_of(uint32_t prim) { return prim == 1 ? 2u : prim == 3 ? 4u : NVMTL_ICB_NO_PRIM; }
/* NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 (exactly 1), read once. With it off nothing above is used and every record is 64 bytes, as before. */
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
static inline int nvmtl_icb_dgc_knob(void)
{
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("NVMTL_ICB_DGC"); on = e && !strcmp(e, "1"); }
    return on;
}
#endif

static BOOL nvmtl_helpers_independent(NSData *input) {
    if (!input || input.length < 20 || input.length % 4) return NO;
    const uint32_t *w=input.bytes; size_t count=input.length/4;
    if (w[0]!=0x07230203 || w[3]>0xffffff00u) return NO;
    uint32_t glsl=0,entries=0; BOOL physical=NO;
    for(size_t i=5;i<count;) {
        uint32_t n=w[i]>>16,op=w[i]&65535;
        if(!n || n>count-i) return NO;
        if(op==15) { if(n<4 || n>=0xffff || w[i+1]!=4 || ++entries!=1) return NO; }
        if(op==32 && n==4 && w[i+2]==5349) physical=YES;
        if(op==71 && n>=4 && w[i+2]==11 && w[i+3]==23) return NO;
        if(op==11) {
            if(n!=6 || memcmp(w+i+2,"GLSL.std.450",13)) return NO;
            glsl=w[i+1];
        }
        if(op==12) {
            if(n<5 || !glsl || w[i+3]!=glsl) return NO;
            uint32_t ext=w[i+4];
            if(!((ext>=1 && ext<=75)||(ext>=79 && ext<=81))) return NO;
        } else {
            BOOL safe = op<=8 || op==10 || op==11 || (op>=14 && op<=17)
                || (op>=19 && op<=24) || (op>=28 && op<=33) || op==39
                || (op>=41 && op<=44) || op==46 || (op>=48 && op<=52)
                || (op>=54 && op<=57) || op==59 || (op>=61 && op<=68)
                || (op>=70 && op<=75) || (op>=77 && op<=84)
                || (op>=109 && op<=124) || (op>=126 && op<=152)
                || (op>=154 && op<=191) || (op>=194 && op<=205)
                || (op>=245 && op<=257) || op==317 || op==330;
            if(!safe) return NO;
        }
        i+=n;
    }
    return entries==1 && physical;
}

static NSData *nvmtl_independent_helpers(NSData *input) {
    if (!nvmtl_helpers_independent(input)) return input;
    const uint32_t *w=input.bytes;size_t count=input.length/4;
    uint32_t entry=0,boolean=0,pointer=0,helper=0;
    for(size_t i=5;i<count;){uint32_t n=w[i]>>16,op=w[i]&65535;if(!n||n>count-i){nvlog("fragment helpers: malformed rewrite input; retaining original");return input;}
        if(op==15 && n>=4 && w[i+1]==4)entry=w[i+2];
        if(op==20 && n==2)boolean=w[i+1];
        if(op==71 && n==4 && w[i+2]==11 && w[i+3]==23)helper=w[i+1];
        i+=n;
    }
    if(!entry)return input;
    for(size_t i=5;i<count;i+=w[i]>>16)if((w[i]&65535)==32 && (w[i]>>16)==4 && w[i+2]==1 && w[i+3]==boolean)pointer=w[i+1];
    uint32_t next=w[3];BOOL addbool=!boolean,addptr=!pointer,addhelper=!helper;
    if(addbool)boolean=next++;if(addptr)pointer=next++;if(addhelper)helper=next++;
    uint32_t newentry=next++,loaded=next++,retblock=next++;
    NSMutableData *out=[NSMutableData data];uint32_t header[5];memcpy(header,w,20);header[3]=next;[out appendBytes:header length:20];
#define DIAG_WORDS(...) do{uint32_t words[]={__VA_ARGS__};[out appendBytes:words length:sizeof(words)];}while(0)
    BOOL decorated=NO,declared=NO,inmain=NO,injected=NO;
    for(size_t i=5;i<count;){uint32_t n=w[i]>>16,op=w[i]&65535;
        if(!decorated && op>=19 && op<=39){if(addhelper)DIAG_WORDS((4u<<16)|71,helper,11,23);decorated=YES;}
        if(!declared && op==54){
            if(addbool)DIAG_WORDS((2u<<16)|20,boolean);
            if(addptr)DIAG_WORDS((4u<<16)|32,pointer,1,boolean);
            if(addhelper)DIAG_WORDS((4u<<16)|59,pointer,helper,1);
            declared=YES;
        }
        if(op==54)inmain=w[i+2]==entry;
        if(op==15 && w[i+1]==4 && addhelper){uint32_t head=((n+1)<<16)|15;[out appendBytes:&head length:4];[out appendBytes:w+i+1 length:(n-1)*4];[out appendBytes:&helper length:4];i+=n;continue;}
        if(inmain && !injected && op==248){
            uint32_t oldentry=w[i+1];DIAG_WORDS((2u<<16)|248,newentry);i+=n;
            while(i<count && ((w[i]&65535)==59 || (w[i]&65535)==8 || (w[i]&65535)==317)){uint32_t k=w[i]>>16;[out appendBytes:w+i length:k*4];i+=k;}
            DIAG_WORDS((4u<<16)|61,boolean,loaded,helper);
            DIAG_WORDS((3u<<16)|247,oldentry,0);
            DIAG_WORDS((4u<<16)|250,loaded,retblock,oldentry);
            DIAG_WORDS((2u<<16)|248,retblock);DIAG_WORDS((1u<<16)|253);
            DIAG_WORDS((2u<<16)|248,oldentry);injected=YES;continue;
        }
        if(inmain && injected && op==59) {
            nvlog("fragment helpers: variable outside relocated entry prefix; retaining original");
            return input;
        }
        [out appendBytes:w+i length:n*4];i+=n;
    }
#undef DIAG_WORDS
    if(!injected||!declared||!decorated){nvlog("fragment helpers: incomplete rewrite; retaining original");return input;}
    uint32_t fingerprint=2166136261u;
    for(size_t j=0;j<count;j++){fingerprint^=w[j];fingerprint*=16777619u;}
    nvlog("fragment helpers: invocation-independent physical-buffer module guarded (%zu words, bound %u, hash %08x)", count, w[3], fingerprint);return out;
}

#ifndef NVMTL_LOG_FAILURE_H
#define NVMTL_LOG_FAILURE_H
#include <string.h>
#include <ctype.h>

static inline int nvmtl_log_fault_word(const char *text, const char *word)
{
    const char *p = text;
    while ((p = strstr(p, word))) {
        if ((p == text || !isalnum((unsigned char)p[-1])) &&
            !isalnum((unsigned char)p[5])) return 1;
        p += 5;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* Keep device/feature failures in release syslog. In particular, Vulkan errors
 * such as "vkCreateDevice -> -8" do not contain the word FAIL. */
static inline int nvmtl_log_failure(const char *text)
{
    return text && (strstr(text, "FAIL") || strstr(text, "REFUS") ||
                    nvmtl_log_fault_word(text, "fault") ||
                    nvmtl_log_fault_word(text, "FAULT") || strstr(text, "-> -") ||
                    strstr(text, "missing") || strstr(text, "cannot") ||
                    strstr(text, "unsupported") || strstr(text, "refused") ||
                    /* a draw the plugin dropped leaves the window blank or garbled with nothing else in the log
                     * (GTX 16 Terminal text on 2.2.0 was framebuffer fetch draws dropped this way) */
                    strstr(text, "draw is skipped") || strstr(text, "draw skipped") ||
                    strstr(text, "draws are being skipped") ||
                    /* a process denied a device: for WindowServer that is the "Failed to create MetalDevice" abort,
                     * and /tmp/nvmtl.log is gone after the reboot that rescues the machine */
                    strstr(text, "no device"));
}
#endif

/* nvmtl_loss.h - what the log says when the Vulkan device is lost. Pure text, so tools/test_loss.c proves it on the host.
   A lost device used to leave one line ("fence wait -> -4"), and WindowServer's later abort said nothing about why. */
#ifndef NVMTL_LOSS_H
#define NVMTL_LOSS_H
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static inline const char *nvmtl_vk_result_name(int r)
{
    switch (r) {
    case 0: return "VK_SUCCESS";
    case 2: return "VK_TIMEOUT";
    case -1: return "VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY";
    case -2: return "VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY";
    case -3: return "VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED";
    case -4: return "VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST";
    case -5: return "VK_ERROR_MEMORY_MAP_FAILED";
    default: return "an unknown VkResult";
    }
}
/* One sentence naming what ended the device: where it was noticed, the result, how long the wait ran, which caller was
   submitting, how long the device had been up, and what that combination means. `where` is "submit" or "fence". */
static inline void nvmtl_loss_cause(char *out, size_t cap, const char *where, int vkresult, long waited_ms, const char *who,
                                    long up_seconds, const char *process)
{
    const int submit = where && !strcmp(where, "submit");
    const char *meaning =
        vkresult == -4 && submit ? "the GPU channel was already dead when work was queued (an earlier fault or reset; see the fault-context lines above)" :
        vkresult == -4 ? "the GPU faulted or was reset while this work ran (see the fault-context lines above)" :
        vkresult == 2 ? "the fence neither signalled nor reported an error for the whole give-up time: a stalled channel" :
        (vkresult == -1 || vkresult == -2) ? "the driver ran out of memory while submitting, not a GPU fault" :
        "an unexpected result from the Vulkan driver";
    snprintf(out, cap, "device lost in %s: %s -> %s (%d) after %ld ms, submitted for %s, device up %ld s: %s",
             process ? process : "?", submit ? "queue submit" : "fence wait", nvmtl_vk_result_name(vkresult),
             vkresult, waited_ms, who ? who : "?", up_seconds, meaning);
}
#endif

/*
 * NullMoth NVIDIA driver for macOS
 * Copyright (c) 2026 NullMoth Systems.
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0

#ifndef NVMTL_PHYSICAL_BOUNDS_H
#define NVMTL_PHYSICAL_BOUNDS_H
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stddef.h>

static int nvmtl_relax_physical_bounds(uint32_t *w, size_t count) {
    if (!w || count < 5 || w[0] != 0x07230203u || !w[3] || w[3] > 0x1000000u) return -1;
    unsigned char *physical = calloc(w[3], 1);
    if (!physical) return -1;
    for (size_t i=5; i<count;) {
        uint32_t n=w[i]>>16, op=w[i]&0xffffu;
        if (!n || n>count-i) { free(physical); return -1; }
        if (op==32) {
            if(n!=4 || w[i+1]>=w[3]) { free(physical); return -1; }
            if(w[i+2]==5349) physical[w[i+1]]=1;
        }
        if ((op==66 || op==70) && (n<4 || w[i+1]>=w[3])) { free(physical); return -1; }
        i+=n;
    }
    int changed=0;
    for (size_t i=5; i<count;) {
        uint32_t n=w[i]>>16, op=w[i]&0xffffu;
        if ((op==66 || op==70) && physical[w[i+1]]) {
            w[i]=(n<<16)|(op==66 ? 65u : 67u);
            changed++;
        }
        i+=n;
    }
    free(physical); return changed;
}
#endif

FILE: nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_plock.h

/* nvmtl_plock.h - NVMTL_LOCK_V2: commit and the execution worker without the process-wide command-buffer class lock.

   The old path (NVMTLEventSync.m) holds @synchronized ([NVMTLCommandBuffer class]) across the commit-time submit-ahead
   pass, i.e. across vkQueueSubmit and its exec ioctl, and the execution worker takes the same lock four to six times per
   command buffer (eligibility, the part claim, the surface-writer map in nvmtlFinishExecution, completion, -dealloc's
   pump, the generation check). With one tiny dispatch per command buffer both threads spent a third of their time
   handing that lock to each other (cbcost back to back: 18-21 us per command buffer, sample 2026-11-09).

   V2 splits what the lock protected:
     state lock    (os_unfair_lock, short, leaf)   the pending list, the pumping flag and generation, every queue's
                                                    reservations; nothing is submitted, waited for or released to zero
                                                    under it
     ahead lock    (os_unfair_lock, trylock only)   one submit-ahead pass at a time (pass order = GPU order per queue,
                                                    the evfold promise map, _nextSubmit); a thread that finds it held
                                                    marks the pass dirty and the holder runs it again (a combiner), so
                                                    nobody ever blocks on it
     part state    (atomic per part)               the hand-off of a part between the pass and the worker that was the
                                                    `claimed` flag under the class lock
     cb gate       (two atomics per command buffer) the pass touches a command buffer's _parts only between enter and
                                                    leave; nvmtlFinishExecution sets fin and waits for leave first
     surface lock  (os_unfair_lock, leaf)          the pending surface-write map (was the class lock too)

   Everything here is plain C so tools can test it without the plugin (user/tests/metal/plock_model.c). */
#ifndef NVMTL_PLOCK_H
#define NVMTL_PLOCK_H
#include <os/lock.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

/* the build default; NVMTL_LOCK_V2=0/1 in a process's own environment overrides it for that process. -1: by process,
   V2 for applications and the class lock for WindowServer and the system's own interface (nvmtl_plock_system_ui), the
   default since 9 Nov 2026 (B580: back to back 18.2 -> 11.1 us per command buffer, Geekbench 7 Metal 89.0k -> 95.4k,
   OpenCL 81.8k -> 85.5k; the ordering stress tests pass) */
#ifndef NVMTL_LOCK_V2_DEFAULT
#define NVMTL_LOCK_V2_DEFAULT (-1)
#endif

/* WindowServer and the processes that draw the system's interface: they keep the class lock, as they keep the GuC
   low-latency hint off (nvmtl_guc_hint_env): a deadlock there is a black screen, not a hung app */
static inline int nvmtl_plock_system_ui(const char *me)
{
    static const char *const ui[] = { "WindowServer", "loginwindow", "Dock", "com.apple.dock.extra", "SystemUIServer",
        "ControlCenter", "NotificationCenter", "WindowManager", "ScreenSaverEngine", "legacyScreenSaver" };
    for (size_t i = 0; me && i < sizeof ui / sizeof *ui; i++) if (!strcmp(me, ui[i])) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* Pure rule, testable: e is getenv("NVMTL_LOCK_V2"), confset getenv("NVMTL_CONF_SET") (the keys the conf file put into
   this process's environment, nvmtl_conf_knobs). Only the process's own environment counts: a conf line must not switch
   WindowServer (and every other Metal process) onto the new locking at once. */
int nvmtl_lock_v2(void);   /* the process's answer (NVMTLEventSync.m), read once */
static inline int nvmtl_plock_rule(const char *e, const char *confset)
{
    if (e && confset) {
        for (const char *p = strstr(confset, "NVMTL_LOCK_V2="); p; p = strstr(p + 1, "NVMTL_LOCK_V2="))
            if (p == confset || p[-1] == ';') { e = NULL; break; }   /* the value came from the conf file */
    }
    if (e && (e[0] == '0' || e[0] == '1') && !e[1]) return e[0] == '1';
    return NVMTL_LOCK_V2_DEFAULT;
}

static inline void nvmtl_plock_backoff(unsigned spin)
{
    if (spin < 64) {
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
        __builtin_ia32_pause();
#elif defined(__arm64__) || defined(__aarch64__)
        __asm__ __volatile__("yield");
#endif
    } else if (spin < 2048) sched_yield();
    else usleep(50);
}

/* The state lock's sections are a few hundred nanoseconds: a short spin on trylock first, so a brush between the
   committing thread and the worker does not become a kernel wait and wake (each a syscall: __ulock_wait2 /
   __ulock_wake were most of the class lock's cost in the cbcost sample). */
static inline void nvmtl_plock_lock(os_unfair_lock *l)
{
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
        if (os_unfair_lock_trylock(l)) return;
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
        __builtin_ia32_pause();
#elif defined(__arm64__) || defined(__aarch64__)
        __asm__ __volatile__("yield");
#endif
    }
    os_unfair_lock_lock(l);
}

/* Part hand-off. FREE: nobody has it. SUBMITTING: the submit-ahead pass is working on it (submit, empty retire, event
   fold). AHEAD: the pass is done with it (inflight / aheadFailed / aheadEmpty / waitFolded say what it did). WORKER: the
   execution worker took it to run it itself; the pass stops at it. Every field the pass writes is written before the
   release store of AHEAD, and the worker reads them after its acquire. */
enum { NVMTL_PART_FREE = 0, NVMTL_PART_SUBMITTING = 1, NVMTL_PART_AHEAD = 2, NVMTL_PART_WORKER = 3 };

/* the pass: FREE -> SUBMITTING. Returns the state it found (FREE: the part is the caller's until nvmtl_part_release). */
static inline int nvmtl_part_take(int *st)
{
    int s = NVMTL_PART_FREE;
    if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(st, &s, NVMTL_PART_SUBMITTING, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return NVMTL_PART_FREE;
    return s;
}
/* the pass lets go: AHEAD when it did something with the part, FREE when it left it as it was */
static inline void nvmtl_part_release(int *st, int to) { __atomic_store_n(st, to, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }
/* the worker: WORKER when it took a free part (it runs it), AHEAD when the pass dealt with it first. A part the pass is
   in the middle of (one vkQueueSubmit) is waited for: the pass never waits for the worker, so this cannot deadlock. */
static inline int nvmtl_part_claim(int *st)
{
    for (unsigned spin = 0;; spin++) {
        int s = __atomic_load_n(st, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
        if (s == NVMTL_PART_FREE) {
            if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(st, &s, NVMTL_PART_WORKER, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) return NVMTL_PART_WORKER;
            continue;
        }
        if (s == NVMTL_PART_SUBMITTING) { nvmtl_plock_backoff(spin); continue; }
        return s;
    }
}
/* the worker gives a part back (an event wait not yet signalled): the pass may fold it later */
static inline void nvmtl_part_unclaim(int *st) { __atomic_store_n(st, NVMTL_PART_FREE, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }

/* Command-buffer gate (Dekker, both sides sequentially consistent): either the pass sees fin and keeps out, or the
   finishing worker sees busy and waits for leave. Only one pass runs at a time (the ahead lock), so busy is 0 or 1. */
static inline int nvmtl_cb_enter(int *busy, const int *fin)
{
    __atomic_store_n(busy, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    if (__atomic_load_n(fin, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)) { __atomic_store_n(busy, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); return 0; }
    return 1;
}
static inline void nvmtl_cb_leave(int *busy) { __atomic_store_n(busy, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE); }
static inline void nvmtl_cb_finish_gate(const int *busy, int *fin)
{
    __atomic_store_n(fin, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    for (unsigned spin = 0; __atomic_load_n(busy, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); spin++) nvmtl_plock_backoff(spin);
}

/* Combiner: whoever gets the lock runs the pass, again while someone asked for it in the meantime (at most max_rounds
   passes per call); whoever finds it held only asks. The holder re-checks after unlocking, so no request is lost
   between its last check and the unlock. A pass that asks for itself (a commit from inside a pass) only marks dirty. */
typedef struct { os_unfair_lock lock; int dirty; } nvmtl_combiner;
#define NVMTL_COMBINER_INIT { OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT, 0 }
static __thread const nvmtl_combiner *nvmtl_comb_running;
/* returns the passes this call ran */
static inline unsigned nvmtl_combine(nvmtl_combiner *c, void (*pass)(void *), void *ctx, unsigned max_rounds)
{
    __atomic_store_n(&c->dirty, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    if (nvmtl_comb_running == c) return 0;
    unsigned rounds = 0;
    while (rounds < max_rounds) {
        if (!os_unfair_lock_trylock(&c->lock)) return rounds;   /* the holder sees dirty and runs again */
        nvmtl_comb_running = c;
        while (rounds < max_rounds && __atomic_exchange_n(&c->dirty, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)) { pass(ctx); rounds++; }
        nvmtl_comb_running = NULL;
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&c->lock);
        if (!__atomic_load_n(&c->dirty, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)) break;
    }
    return rounds;
}
#endif

/*
 * NullMoth NVIDIA driver for macOS
 * Copyright (c) 2026 NullMoth Systems.
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0
 */

static NSData *nvmtl_preserve_readonly_metadata(NSData *input) {
    const uint32_t *w=input.bytes; size_t n=input.length/4;
    if(input.length%4||n<5||w[0]!=0x07230203||!w[3]||w[3]>4194304)return input;
    uint32_t bound=w[3],next=bound; size_t firsttype=0,firstfn=0;
    uint32_t *typeoff=calloc(bound,4),*readonly=calloc(bound,4),*replacement=calloc(bound,4);
    if(!typeoff||!readonly||!replacement){free(typeoff);free(readonly);free(replacement);return input;}
    BOOL valid=YES,logical=NO;
    for(size_t i=5;i<n;){uint32_t c=w[i]>>16,op=w[i]&65535;
        if(!c||i+c>n){valid=NO;break;}
        if(op==14&&c==3)logical=w[i+1]==0;
        if(op>=19&&op<=39&&c>=2&&w[i+1]<bound){typeoff[w[i+1]]=(uint32_t)i;if(!firsttype)firsttype=i;}
        if(op==54&&!firstfn)firstfn=i;
        if(op==71&&c==3&&w[i+1]<bound&&w[i+2]==24)readonly[w[i+1]]=1;
        i+=c;
    }
    NSMutableData *ann=[NSMutableData data];NSMutableDictionary<NSNumber*,NSData*> *insert=[NSMutableDictionary new];
    unsigned changed=0;
    if(valid&&logical&&firsttype&&firstfn)for(size_t i=firsttype;i<firstfn;){uint32_t c=w[i]>>16,op=w[i]&65535;
        if(op==59&&c>=4&&w[i+2]<bound&&readonly[w[i+2]]&&w[i+3]==12&&w[i+1]<bound){
            uint32_t root=w[i+2],po=typeoff[w[i+1]],st=0,so=0;
            if(po&&(w[po]&65535)==32&&(w[po]>>16)==4&&w[po+2]==12&&w[po+3]<bound){st=w[po+3];so=typeoff[st];}
            BOOL safe=so&&(w[so]&65535)==30;
            for(size_t j=5;safe&&j<firsttype;){uint32_t jc=w[j]>>16,jo=w[j]&65535;
                if(jo==74)for(uint32_t k=2;k<jc;k++)if(w[j+k]==st)safe=NO;
                if(jo==75)for(uint32_t k=2;k+1<jc;k+=2)if(w[j+k]==st)safe=NO;
                if((jo==332||jo==5632||jo==5633)&&jc>=3&&w[j+1]==st)safe=NO;
                j+=jc;
            }
            for(size_t j=firstfn;safe&&j<n;){uint32_t jc=w[j]>>16,jo=w[j]&65535;
                for(uint32_t k=1;k<jc;k++)if(w[j+k]==root&&!((jo==65||jo==66)&&k==3)){safe=NO;break;}
                j+=jc;
            }
            for(size_t j=firsttype;safe&&j<firstfn;){uint32_t jc=w[j]>>16,jo=w[j]&65535;
                if(jo==59&&j!=i&&jc>4&&w[j+4]==root)safe=NO;j+=jc;
            }
            if(safe){uint32_t ns=next++,np=next++,members=(w[so]>>16)-2;
                NSMutableData *decl=[NSMutableData dataWithBytes:w+so length:(w[so]>>16)*4];((uint32_t*)decl.mutableBytes)[1]=ns;
                uint32_t pt[]={ (4u<<16)|32,np,12,ns };[decl appendBytes:pt length:sizeof pt];insert[@(i)]=decl;replacement[root]=np;
                NSMutableIndexSet *marked=[NSMutableIndexSet indexSet];
                for(size_t j=5;j<firsttype;){uint32_t jc=w[j]>>16,jo=w[j]&65535;
                    if((jo==71||jo==72)&&jc>=3&&w[j+1]==st){NSMutableData *a=[NSMutableData dataWithBytes:w+j length:jc*4];((uint32_t*)a.mutableBytes)[1]=ns;[ann appendData:a];
                        if(jo==72&&jc==4&&w[j+3]==24)[marked addIndex:w[j+2]];}
                    j+=jc;
                }
                for(uint32_t member=0;member<members;member++)if(![marked containsIndex:member]){uint32_t a[]={ (4u<<16)|72,ns,member,24 };[ann appendBytes:a length:sizeof a];}
                changed++;
            }
        }i+=c;
    }
    NSMutableData *out=nil;
    if(changed){out=[NSMutableData dataWithBytes:w length:firsttype*4];[out appendData:ann];
        for(size_t i=firsttype;i<n;){uint32_t c=w[i]>>16,op=w[i]&65535;NSData *extra=insert[@(i)];if(extra)[out appendData:extra];
            if(op==59&&c>=4&&w[i+2]<bound&&replacement[w[i+2]]){NSMutableData *v=[NSMutableData dataWithBytes:w+i length:c*4];((uint32_t*)v.mutableBytes)[1]=replacement[w[i+2]];[out appendData:v];}
            else [out appendBytes:w+i length:c*4];i+=c;}
        ((uint32_t*)out.mutableBytes)[3]=next;nvlog("read-only metadata: preserved %u descriptor guarantees",changed);
    }
    free(typeoff);free(readonly);free(replacement);return out?:input;
}

/*
 * GPU reset recovery of the Metal plugin's Vulkan backend (nvmtl_vk.c includes this once, after g_state and g_dev).
 * Kept apart so tests/recover_unit.c can run the state machine on the host against a mock Mesa entry point.
 * Needs, from the includer: g_state, g_dev, nvlog, and later definitions of nvmtl_submit_mutex (recursive) and
 * nvmtl_sub_done.
 */
#ifndef NVMTL_RECOVER_H
#define NVMTL_RECOVER_H
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
static pthread_mutex_t nvmtl_submit_mutex;
static void nvmtl_sub_done(uint64_t s);
/* GPU reset recovery (nvmtl_vk_recover, after nvmtl_vk_submit_begin_at): the device generation, +1 each time the banned
   exec queue was replaced; a submission remembers the generation it went to the GPU in. While a recovery swaps the
   queue, fence waits hold off (nvmtl_wait_enter): anv asks the kernel about each queue's ban after every wait, and a
   waiter that asked about the old queue just after it was destroyed would mark the device lost again. */
static _Atomic unsigned g_loss_gen;
static _Atomic int g_recovering, g_fence_waiters;
static void nvmtl_wait_enter(void)
{
    for (;;) {
        while (atomic_load(&g_recovering)) usleep(200);
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_fence_waiters, 1);
        if (!atomic_load(&g_recovering)) return;
        atomic_fetch_sub(&g_fence_waiters, 1);
    }
}
static void nvmtl_wait_leave(void) { atomic_fetch_sub(&g_fence_waiters, 1); }

/* GPU reset recovery (Mesa anv_nvmtl_recover.c): a banned exec queue replaced by a fresh one on the same VM */
struct nvmtl_anv_recover_info { uint32_t size, was_lost, queues_banned, queues_replaced; int32_t error; uint32_t failed_step; };
#define NVMTL_ANV_RECOVER_FORCE (1u << 0)
#define NVMTL_ANV_RECOVER_QUERY (1u << 1)
static VkResult (*panv_recover)(VkDevice, uint32_t, struct nvmtl_anv_recover_info *);

/* ---- GPU reset recovery ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   IntelXe.kext follows xe: a hang resets the guilty context, the kernel bans that exec queue and signals every fence it
   handed out; a GT reset bans the queues whose work had started and replays the rest. The VM, every BO and every GPU
   address survive, and Linux userspace goes on with a new exec queue on the same VM. anv reports the ban as
   VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST, final for a VkDevice; this plugin used to switch its backend off for the rest of the process
   (g_state -1), after which -[MTLCommandQueue commandBuffer] returned nil and WindowServer died on CoreDisplay's "Failed
   to get a MTLCommandBuffer" assert: a GPU hang logged the user out.
   Now, as on Apple's drivers after a GPU restart: the command buffers that were on the GPU end with an error (the one
   whose wait saw the loss "Caused GPU Hang Error", the others "Discarded (victim of GPU error/recovery)"), their
   completion handlers run, and the device keeps working. Mesa's nvmtl_anv_device_recover_v1 replaces the banned exec
   queue on the same VkDevice (same VM), so every Vulkan handle, GPU address and CPU mapping the plugin and its
   applications hold stays valid; nothing is re-created or re-imported. A new VkDevice is no option: it would be a new
   VM (no dma-buf on macOS), and Metal applications keep gpuAddress values and contents pointers into the old one.
   Bounded: at most NVMTL_RECOVER_MAX recoveries (default 3) in 60 s and 16 per process; past that, or when Mesa has no
   entry point or the replacement fails three times, the backend goes down as before. NVMTL_GPU_RECOVERY=0: as before.
   Tests (never in WindowServer): NVMTL_FAKE_DEVICE_LOST=N[:M] reports the N-th successful fence wait (then every M-th)
   as VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST, NVMTL_FAKE_SUBMIT_LOST=N[:M] the N-th vkQueueSubmit (not made); a faked loss replaces the
   queue for real (NVMTL_ANV_RECOVER_FORCE, after the old queue went idle). */
static pthread_mutex_t g_recover_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static unsigned g_recoveries, g_recover_window_n; static uint64_t g_recover_window_t0;
static _Atomic unsigned long long g_lost_hang, g_lost_victim;
static int nvmtl_recover_on(void)
{
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("NVMTL_GPU_RECOVERY"); on = !(e && e[0] == '0'); }
    return on;
}
static unsigned nvmtl_recover_max(void)
{
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("NVMTL_RECOVER_MAX"); v = e && *e ? atoi(e) : 3; if (v < 0) v = 0; if (v > 16) v = 16; }
    return (unsigned)v;
}
/* NVMTL_FAKE_DEVICE_LOST / NVMTL_FAKE_SUBMIT_LOST: "N" or "N:M" - fires at the N-th event, then every M-th */
typedef struct { const char *env; int parsed; unsigned long long first, every; _Atomic unsigned long long n; } nvmtl_fake;
static nvmtl_fake g_fake_wait = { "NVMTL_FAKE_DEVICE_LOST" }, g_fake_submit = { "NVMTL_FAKE_SUBMIT_LOST" };
static int nvmtl_fake_fire(nvmtl_fake *k)
{
    if (!k->parsed) {
        const char *e = getenv(k->env); char *end = NULL;
        const char *me = getprogname();
        if (me && !strcmp(me, "WindowServer")) e = NULL;   // never in WindowServer
        if (e && *e) { k->first = strtoull(e, &end, 10); if (end && *end == ':') k->every = strtoull(end + 1, NULL, 10); }
        if (k->first) nvlog("vk: GPU recovery TEST: %s=%s - a VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST is faked at event %llu%s", k->env, e,
                            k->first, k->every ? " and periodically after it" : "");
        k->parsed = 1;
    }
    if (!k->first) return 0;
    const unsigned long long i = atomic_fetch_add(&k->n, 1) + 1;
    return i == k->first || (k->every && i > k->first && (i - k->first) % k->every == 0);
}
/* Tests (in-process, staged bundle): fake a loss at the `after`-th next successful fence wait (submit 0) or vkQueueSubmit
   (submit 1). Looked up with dlsym by tests/mtl_recover.m; does nothing in WindowServer. */
void nvmtl_vk_fake_lost_arm(int submit, unsigned long long after)
{
    const char *me = getprogname();
    if (me && !strcmp(me, "WindowServer")) return;
    nvmtl_fake *k = submit ? &g_fake_submit : &g_fake_wait;
    k->parsed = 1; k->every = 0; atomic_store(&k->n, 0); k->first = after;
    nvlog("vk: GPU recovery TEST: a VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST is faked at the %llu-th next %s", after, submit ? "vkQueueSubmit" : "successful fence wait");
}
/* The device was seen lost (or a fence gave up) by a submission of generation `gen`. Returns 2 when this call replaced
   the queue, 1 when it is usable without that (another thread recovered it, or nothing was lost), 0 when it is not: the
   backend is then down (g_state -1), as before recovery existed. Takes nvmtl_submit_mutex (recursive: a submitter may
   hold it) so no submission runs while the queue is swapped, then drains the fence waiters (2 s at most). */
static int nvmtl_vk_recover(unsigned gen, int injected, const char *where, VkResult why)
{
    if (!nvmtl_recover_on() || !panv_recover) {
        static int said; if (!said++) nvlog("vk: GPU recovery unavailable (%s) - a lost device disables the backend", !panv_recover
            ? "the Vulkan driver has no nvmtl_anv_device_recover_v1" : "NVMTL_GPU_RECOVERY=0");
        return 0;
    }
    int ok = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&nvmtl_submit_mutex);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_recover_lock);
    if (atomic_load(&g_loss_gen) != gen) { ok = g_state == 1; goto out; }   // recovered since that submission
    if (g_state != 1) goto out;
    const uint64_t now = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    if (!g_recover_window_t0 || now - g_recover_window_t0 > 60000000000ull) { g_recover_window_t0 = now; g_recover_window_n = 0; }
    if (g_recover_window_n >= nvmtl_recover_max() || g_recoveries >= 16) {
        nvlog("vk: GPU RECOVERY REFUSED in %s: %u recoveries in the last %llu s, %u in all (limit %u per minute, 16 in all) - "
              "disabling backend (%s -> %d)", getprogname(), g_recover_window_n, (unsigned long long)((now - g_recover_window_t0) / 1000000000ull),
              g_recoveries, nvmtl_recover_max(), where, why);
        g_state = -1; goto out;
    }
    atomic_store(&g_recovering, 1);
    const uint64_t d0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    while (atomic_load(&g_fence_waiters) > 0 && clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - d0 < 2000000000ull) usleep(500);
    const int still = atomic_load(&g_fence_waiters);
    struct nvmtl_anv_recover_info info; VkResult r = VK_ERROR_UNKNOWN; int attempt = 0;
    for (; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
        memset(&info, 0, sizeof info); info.size = sizeof info;
        r = panv_recover(g_dev, injected ? NVMTL_ANV_RECOVER_FORCE : 0, &info);
        if (r == VK_SUCCESS) break;
        usleep(100000);
    }
    const uint64_t d1 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    if (r == VK_SUCCESS && (info.queues_replaced || info.was_lost)) {
        g_recoveries++; g_recover_window_n++;
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_loss_gen, 1);
        ok = 2;
        nvlog("vk: GPU RECOVERY #%u in %s after %s -> %d%s: device was %s, %u exec queue(s) banned, %u queue(s) replaced on the same VM "
              "in %.1f ms (%d attempt(s), %d fence waiter(s) still in the driver); in-flight command buffers end with an error, new ones run",
              g_recoveries, getprogname(), where, why, injected ? " (FAKED by NVMTL_FAKE_*)" : "", info.was_lost ? "lost" : "not lost",
              info.queues_banned, info.queues_replaced, (d1 - d0) / 1e6, attempt + 1, still);
    } else if (r == VK_SUCCESS) {
        ok = 1;   // nothing lost and nothing banned (a fence that gave up): the command buffer fails, the device goes on
        nvlog("vk: GPU recovery check in %s after %s -> %d: device not lost, no queue banned - only that command buffer fails", getprogname(), where, why);
    } else {
        g_state = -1;
        nvlog("vk: GPU RECOVERY FAILED in %s after %s -> %d: nvmtl_anv_device_recover_v1 -> %d (step %u, errno %d, %u banned) %d times - "
              "disabling backend", getprogname(), where, why, r, info.failed_step, info.error, info.queues_banned, attempt);
    }
    atomic_store(&g_recovering, 0);
out:
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_recover_lock);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&nvmtl_submit_mutex);
    return ok;
}
/* What a lost submission reports: -3 its wait saw the loss and recovered the device (Metal: GPU hang error), -4 it was
   in flight when another submission's loss was recovered (innocent victim), -5 its fence gave up while the device
   reports neither a loss nor a ban (Metal: GPU timeout error; the job may still run), -2 the backend is down. A lost
   submission is over for the GPU (banned: dropped by the kernel; faked: waited for), so its number is marked done and
   the descriptor and buffer reuse watermark moves on; a timed-out one is not. Resources stay quarantined by the caller. */
static int nvmtl_vk_lost(uint64_t subseq, unsigned gen, int injected, const char *where, VkResult why)
{
    const int timed_out = why == VK_TIMEOUT;
    const int rec = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen) != gen ? (g_state == 1 ? 1 : 0) : nvmtl_vk_recover(gen, injected, where, why);
    if (!rec) return -2;
    if (timed_out && rec == 1 && atomic_load(&g_loss_gen) == gen) return -5;
    nvmtl_sub_done(subseq);
    if (rec == 2) { atomic_fetch_add(&g_lost_hang, 1); return -3; }
    const unsigned long long n = atomic_fetch_add(&g_lost_victim, 1) + 1;
    if (n <= 8 || !(n & (n - 1))) nvlog("vk: a command buffer in flight across a GPU recovery ends with an error (%s -> %d; %llu so far)", where, why, n);
    return -4;
}
int nvmtl_vk_recover_counts(unsigned *recoveries, unsigned *gen, unsigned long long *hang, unsigned long long *victim)
{
    if (recoveries) *recoveries = g_recoveries;
    if (gen) *gen = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen);
    if (hang) *hang = atomic_load(&g_lost_hang);
    if (victim) *victim = atomic_load(&g_lost_victim);
    return g_state == 1 ? 0 : -1;
}

#version 460
// Metal curve geometry -> one VkAabbPositionsKHR per segment, on the GPU (nvmtl_vk_cmd_curve_aabbs), recorded right
// before the build that takes the curve as bounding-box geometry (rtopt4; the shaders intersect the segment with the
// translator's runtime, nvmtl_rt_runtime.metal). Reads the control points, radii and indices when the build runs.
//   glslangValidator -V --target-env vulkan1.2 nvmtl_rt_curves.comp -o nvmtl_rt_curves.spv
// Segment s: first = index[s] (UInt16 / UInt32), clamped to cp_count - seg_cp; its control points and radii in the
// basis' Bezier form (as nvmtl_curves.metal: B-spline, uniform Catmull-Rom, Bezier, linear), the box = their bounds
// padded by the largest |radius| (round: the tube, disks and sphere caps lie within it of the curve) or twice it
// (flat: the ribbon's joints reach past the chord ends), plus a relative epsilon.
// Formats (MTLAttributeFormat): points Half2 25, Half3 26, Half4 27, Float2 29, Float3 30, Float4 31; radii Float 28,
// Half 53. Float data is 4-byte aligned, half data 2-byte aligned (the plugin refuses other layouts).
#extension GL_EXT_buffer_reference : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 : require
layout(local_size_x = 64) in;
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) readonly buffer Words { uint w[]; };
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) writeonly buffer OutWords { uint w[]; };
layout(push_constant) uniform Args {
    uint64_t cp, radius, index, dst;
    uint cp_stride, cp_format, r_stride, r_format;
    uint index_type, seg_cp, basis, ctype;
    uint seg_count, cp_count, pad0, pad1;
} a;

uint ld32(uint64_t addr) { return Words(addr).w[0]; }
uint ld16(uint64_t addr) { const uint w = Words(addr & ~3ul).w[0]; return (addr & 2ul) != 0ul ? (w >> 16) : (w & 0xFFFFu); }
float ldh(uint64_t addr) { return unpackHalf2x16(ld16(addr)).x; }
float ldf(uint64_t addr) { return uintBitsToFloat(ld32(addr)); }
vec3 point(uint64_t p) {
    const uint f = a.cp_format;
    if (f == 25u || f == 26u || f == 27u) return vec3(ldh(p), ldh(p + 2ul), f == 25u ? 0.0 : ldh(p + 4ul));
    return vec3(ldf(p), ldf(p + 4ul), f == 29u ? 0.0 : ldf(p + 8ul));
}
float rad(uint64_t p) { return a.r_format == 53u ? ldh(p) : ldf(p); }

void main()
{
    const uint s = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
    if (s >= a.seg_count) return;
    const uint ncp = clamp(a.seg_cp, 2u, 4u);
    uint first = a.index_type == 0u ? ld16(a.index + 2ul * uint64_t(s)) : ld32(a.index + 4ul * uint64_t(s));
    if (a.cp_count >= ncp) first = min(first, a.cp_count - ncp); else first = 0u;
    vec3 P[4]; float R[4];
    for (uint k = 0u; k < 4u; k++) {
        const uint c = first + min(k, ncp - 1u);
        P[k] = point(a.cp + uint64_t(c) * uint64_t(a.cp_stride));
        R[k] = rad(a.radius + uint64_t(c) * uint64_t(a.r_stride));
    }
    vec3 B[4]; float RB[4];
    if (a.basis == 0u && ncp == 4u) {
        B[0] = (P[0] + 4.0 * P[1] + P[2]) / 6.0; B[1] = (2.0 * P[1] + P[2]) / 3.0; B[2] = (P[1] + 2.0 * P[2]) / 3.0; B[3] = (P[1] + 4.0 * P[2] + P[3]) / 6.0;
        RB[0] = (R[0] + 4.0 * R[1] + R[2]) / 6.0; RB[1] = (2.0 * R[1] + R[2]) / 3.0; RB[2] = (R[1] + 2.0 * R[2]) / 3.0; RB[3] = (R[1] + 4.0 * R[2] + R[3]) / 6.0;
    } else if (a.basis == 0u && ncp == 3u) {
        B[0] = (P[0] + P[1]) / 2.0; B[1] = P[1]; B[2] = (P[1] + P[2]) / 2.0; B[3] = B[2];
        RB[0] = (R[0] + R[1]) / 2.0; RB[1] = R[1]; RB[2] = (R[1] + R[2]) / 2.0; RB[3] = RB[2];
    } else if (a.basis == 1u) {
        B[0] = P[1]; B[1] = P[1] + (P[2] - P[0]) / 6.0; B[2] = P[2] - (P[3] - P[1]) / 6.0; B[3] = P[2];
        RB[0] = R[1]; RB[1] = R[1] + (R[2] - R[0]) / 6.0; RB[2] = R[2] - (R[3] - R[1]) / 6.0; RB[3] = R[2];
    } else {
        for (uint k = 0u; k < 4u; k++) { B[k] = P[min(k, ncp - 1u)]; RB[k] = R[min(k, ncp - 1u)]; }
    }
    vec3 lo = B[0], hi = B[0]; float r = 0.0;
    for (uint k = 0u; k < 4u; k++) { lo = min(lo, B[k]); hi = max(hi, B[k]); r = max(r, abs(RB[k])); }
    for (uint k = 0u; k < 4u; k++) r = max(r, abs(R[k]));
    const float pad = (a.ctype == 1u ? 2.0 : 1.0) * r * 1.001 + 1e-6 * max(max(abs(lo.x), abs(hi.x)), max(max(abs(lo.y), abs(hi.y)), max(abs(lo.z), abs(hi.z)))) + 1e-7;
    lo -= pad; hi += pad;
    OutWords d = OutWords(a.dst + 24ul * uint64_t(s));
    d.w[0] = floatBitsToUint(lo.x); d.w[1] = floatBitsToUint(lo.y); d.w[2] = floatBitsToUint(lo.z);
    d.w[3] = floatBitsToUint(hi.x); d.w[4] = floatBitsToUint(hi.y); d.w[5] = floatBitsToUint(hi.z);
}

#version 460
// Metal instance descriptors -> VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR, on the GPU (nvmtl_vk_cmd_convert_instances).
// Recorded in the command buffer right before the instance acceleration structure build, so it reads the Metal
// descriptors when the build runs (private, managed, shared or GPU-written buffers alike) and, with a count address,
// the instance count Metal's indirect instance descriptor keeps in a buffer.
//   glslangValidator -V --target-env vulkan1.2 nvmtl_rt_instances.comp -o nvmtl_rt_instances.spv
// Per instance i < max_count:
//   i >= count (count read from count_addr when set, clamped to max_count): an inactive instance (all zero: reference 0
//   and mask 0, both inactive in Vulkan) and user ID 0.
//   else, as nvmtl_vk_convert_instances on the CPU (rtopt1), word for word:
//     transform: Metal MTLPackedFloat4x3 (4 columns of 3 floats, column-major) -> Vulkan 3x4 row-major; flags bit 0
//                (MTLMatrixLayoutRowMajor) means the 12 floats already are 3 rows of 4
//     custom index = user ID & 0xFFFFFF, mask & 0xFF, flags = options & 0xF
//     SBT offset = intersection function table offset + the instanced structure's base (table word 2, bit 23 kept as
//                  the per-geometry marker); past 0x7FFFFF the offset alone
//     reference = table[accelerationStructureIndex] (0 past n_as), or the 64-bit MTLResourceID of the Indirect type
//                 (rtopt4: the Metal structure's address, its header; the Vulkan structure is NVMTL_AS_HEADER after it;
//                 rtopt5: + wrap, the bottom-level structure after its one-instance top-level wrapper)
//   rtopt4: rec (16 B per instance, nvmtl_inst_rec): the instanced structure's Metal address, the 32-bit user ID and
//           the instance's intersection function table offset (all 0 for an inactive instance)
// Metal layouts (words): Default 0-11 matrix, 12 options, 13 mask, 14 IFT offset, 15 structure index;
//   UserID: + 16 user ID; Indirect (type 3): 14 IFT offset, 15 user ID, 16-17 structure resource ID.
// table: per accelerationStructureIndex 8 words: Vulkan address low, high, IFT base, 0, Metal address low, high, 0, 0.
#extension GL_EXT_buffer_reference : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 : require
layout(local_size_x = 64) in;
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) readonly buffer Words { uint w[]; };
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) writeonly buffer OutWords { uint w[]; };
layout(push_constant) uniform Args {
    uint64_t src;        // first Metal descriptor
    uint64_t dst;        // first VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR (64 B each)
    uint64_t uid;        // user ID side table (one word per instance), 0 = none
    uint64_t table;      // instanced structures, 16 B each
    uint64_t count_addr; // uint32 instance count, 0 = max_count
    uint64_t rec;        // instance records (nvmtl_inst_rec, 16 B each), 0 = none
    uint stride;         // bytes between Metal descriptors (multiple of 4)
    uint max_count;
    uint type;           // 0 Default, 1 UserID, 3 Indirect
    uint n_as;
    uint flags;          // bit 0: row-major transforms
    uint wrap;           // rtopt5: NVMTL_AS_WRAP when primitive structures carry their top-level wrapper (0: rtopt4 layout)
} a;

void main()
{
    const uint i = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
    if (i >= a.max_count) return;
    uint count = a.max_count;
    if (a.count_addr != 0ul) count = min(Words(a.count_addr).w[0], a.max_count);
    OutWords d = OutWords(a.dst + uint64_t(i) * 64ul);
    if (i >= count) {
        for (uint k = 0u; k < 16u; k++) d.w[k] = 0u;
        if (a.uid != 0ul) OutWords(a.uid).w[i] = 0u;
        if (a.rec != 0ul) { OutWords r = OutWords(a.rec + uint64_t(i) * 16ul); r.w[0] = 0u; r.w[1] = 0u; r.w[2] = 0u; r.w[3] = 0u; }
        return;
    }
    Words s = Words(a.src + uint64_t(i) * uint64_t(a.stride));
    for (uint r = 0u; r < 3u; r++)
        for (uint c = 0u; c < 4u; c++)
            d.w[r * 4u + c] = (a.flags & 1u) != 0u ? s.w[r * 4u + c] : s.w[c * 3u + r];
    const uint options = s.w[12], mask = s.w[13], ift = s.w[14], as_index = s.w[15];
    const uint user = a.type == 1u ? s.w[16] : a.type == 3u ? s.w[15] : 0u;
    uint add = 0u;
    uint lo = 0u, hi = 0u, mlo = 0u, mhi = 0u;
    if (a.type == 3u) {
        mlo = s.w[16]; mhi = s.w[17];
        // NVMTL_AS_HEADER (+ NVMTL_AS_WRAP, rtopt5: the bottom-level structure after the primitive structure's wrapper)
        const uint64_t m = packUint2x32(uvec2(mlo, mhi)), v = m != 0ul ? m + 256ul + uint64_t(a.wrap) : 0ul;
        const uvec2 vv = unpackUint2x32(v); lo = vv.x; hi = vv.y;
    } else if (as_index < a.n_as) {
        Words t = Words(a.table + uint64_t(as_index) * 32ul);
        lo = t.w[0]; hi = t.w[1]; add = t.w[2]; mlo = t.w[4]; mhi = t.w[5];
    }
    uint slot = ift + (add & 0x7FFFFFu);
    if (slot < ift || slot > 0x7FFFFFu) slot = ift & 0x7FFFFFu;   // (slot < ift: the 32-bit sum wrapped)
    d.w[12] = (user & 0xFFFFFFu) | ((mask & 0xFFu) << 24);
    d.w[13] = slot | (add & 0x800000u) | ((options & 0xFu) << 24);
    d.w[14] = lo;
    d.w[15] = hi;
    if (a.uid != 0ul) OutWords(a.uid).w[i] = user;
    if (a.rec != 0ul) {
        OutWords r = OutWords(a.rec + uint64_t(i) * 16ul);
        r.w[0] = (lo | hi) != 0u ? mlo : 0u; r.w[1] = (lo | hi) != 0u ? mhi : 0u; r.w[2] = user; r.w[3] = ift;
    }
}



================================================
FILE: nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_rt_layout.h
================================================
/* nvmtl_rt_layout.h: what a Metal acceleration structure holds besides the Vulkan one (rtopt4). Shared by the plugin
   (writes it at build time), nvmtl_rt_instances.comp / nvmtl_rt_curves.comp (GPU passes) and the translator's ray
   tracing runtime (nvmtl_rt_runtime.metal, embedded as LLVM text: reads it from shaders through the structure's address).

   A Metal acceleration structure's buffer: [NVMTL_AS_HEADER bytes: header][the Vulkan acceleration structure]. Its
   address (gpuResourceID, argument buffers, setAccelerationStructure bindings) is the header's; the Vulkan structure
   (ray queries, instance references) is at + NVMTL_AS_HEADER. Metal-visible sizes are the Vulkan ones (the header is
   allocated on top).
   primitive structure: table = one nvmtl_geom_rec per geometry (geometry_id order)
   instance structure:  table = one nvmtl_inst_rec per instance (instance_id order)

   rtopt5: what shaders trace at + NVMTL_AS_HEADER is a TOP-level structure for both kinds. A primitive structure's
   buffer is [header][NVMTL_AS_WRAP: a one-instance top-level structure (identity transform, mask 0xFF, flags 0,
   custom index 0) over the bottom-level one][the bottom-level structure]; its Metal-visible size (sizes, compacted
   size) includes NVMTL_AS_WRAP. Vulkan ray queries start at a top-level structure; ANV's ray query code continues
   traversal, generates hits and reads the candidate's object-space ray at the instance (object) level only, so a
   bottom-level root worked only while every hit was an opaque triangle (no candidate returned to the shader).
   Instances reference the bottom-level structure (Metal address + NVMTL_AS_HEADER + NVMTL_AS_WRAP); the header's vk
   is its address. NVMTL_RT_WRAP=0 (environment) keeps the rtopt4 layout (bottom-level structure at + NVMTL_AS_HEADER). */
#ifndef NVMTL_RT_LAYOUT_H
#define NVMTL_RT_LAYOUT_H
#include <stdint.h>
#define NVMTL_AS_HEADER 256u
#define NVMTL_AS_WRAP 1024u              /* ANV: a one-instance top-level structure is 512 bytes (checked at init) */
#define NVMTL_AS_MAGIC 0x5341564eu            /* 'NVAS' */
#define NVMTL_AS_FLAG_CURVES 1u
#define NVMTL_AS_FLAG_PRIMITIVE_DATA 2u
typedef struct { uint32_t magic, kind, count, flags; uint64_t table, vk; uint32_t rec_bytes, pad[7]; } nvmtl_as_header;   /* kind 0 primitive, 1 instance */
/* kind: 0 triangle, 1 bounding box, 2 curve. ift: the geometry's intersectionFunctionTableOffset. pd: primitive data
   (buffer address + offset, 0 none), element of primitive p at pd + p * pd_stride. Curve: cp / radius / index buffer
   addresses (+ offsets), Metal's MTLAttributeFormat of control points and radii, index_type MTLIndexType (0 UInt16,
   1 UInt32): segment s starts at control point index[s]; seg_cp segmentControlPointCount, basis MTLCurveBasis, ctype
   MTLCurveType, caps MTLCurveEndCaps, cp_count controlPointCount (a segment's first index is clamped to
   cp_count - seg_cp: no read past the control points). */
typedef struct { uint32_t kind, ift, pd_stride, pd_size; uint64_t pd, cp, radius, index;
                 uint32_t cp_stride, cp_format, r_stride, r_format, index_type, seg_cp, basis, ctype, caps, seg_count, cp_count, pad; } nvmtl_geom_rec;
/* blas: the instanced primitive structure's address (its header; 0 = none / inactive), user: Metal's 32-bit user ID,
   ift: the instance's intersectionFunctionTableOffset */
typedef struct { uint64_t blas; uint32_t user, ift; } nvmtl_inst_rec;
#if defined(__STDC_VERSION__) || defined(__cplusplus)
_Static_assert(sizeof(nvmtl_as_header) == 64, "header");
_Static_assert(sizeof(nvmtl_geom_rec) == 96, "geometry record");
_Static_assert(sizeof(nvmtl_inst_rec) == 16, "instance record");
#endif
#endif



================================================
FILE: nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_rt_sizeadd.comp
================================================
#version 460
// rtopt5: a primitive structure's compacted size as Metal sees it: the Vulkan compacted size (an 8-byte query result
// at src) + add (NVMTL_AS_WRAP: the structure's top-level wrapper, nvmtl_rt_layout.h), as 4 or 8 little-endian bytes
// at dst (4-aligned). One invocation, recorded right after the query result copy (nvmtl_vk_cmd_write_compacted_size).
//   glslangValidator -V --target-env vulkan1.2 nvmtl_rt_sizeadd.comp -o nvmtl_rt_sizeadd.spv
#extension GL_EXT_buffer_reference : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 : require
layout(local_size_x = 1) in;
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) readonly buffer Words { uint w[]; };
layout(buffer_reference, std430, buffer_reference_align = 4) writeonly buffer OutWords { uint w[]; };
layout(push_constant) uniform Args {
    uint64_t src;   // the 64-bit query result
    uint64_t dst;   // Metal's destination (4-aligned)
    uint add;
    uint bytes;     // 4 or 8
} a;

void main()
{
    Words s = Words(a.src);
    const uvec2 v = unpackUint2x32(packUint2x32(uvec2(s.w[0], s.w[1])) + uint64_t(a.add));
    OutWords d = OutWords(a.dst);
    d.w[0] = v.x;
    if (a.bytes == 8u) d.w[1] = v.y;
}

FILE: nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_sample_positions.h

/*
 * NullMoth NVIDIA driver for macOS
 * Copyright (c) 2026 NullMoth Systems.
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0
 */

#ifndef NVMTL_SAMPLE_POSITIONS_H
#define NVMTL_SAMPLE_POSITIONS_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <float.h>
#include <string.h>

#define NVMTL_MAX_SAMPLE_POSITIONS 8u
#define NVMTL_SAMPLE_POSITION_BYTES 64u
#define NVMTL_SAMPLE_POSITION_OFFSET 96u
typedef struct { float x, y; } nvmtl_sample_position;
typedef struct {
    uint32_t count;
    nvmtl_sample_position position[NVMTL_MAX_SAMPLE_POSITIONS];
} nvmtl_sample_pattern;
_Static_assert(FLT_RADIX == 2 && FLT_MANT_DIG == 24 && FLT_MAX_EXP == 128, "sample coordinates require IEEE binary32");
_Static_assert(sizeof(nvmtl_sample_position) == 8, "float2 sample-position ABI");
_Static_assert(sizeof(((nvmtl_sample_pattern *)0)->position) == NVMTL_SAMPLE_POSITION_BYTES,
               "fragment sample-position push ABI");

static inline int nvmtl_sample_default(uint32_t count, nvmtl_sample_pattern *out)
{
    static const uint8_t p1[][2] = {{8,8}};
    static const uint8_t p2[][2] = {{12,12},{4,4}};
    static const uint8_t p4[][2] = {{6,2},{14,6},{2,10},{10,14}};
    static const uint8_t p8[][2] = {{9,5},{7,11},{13,9},{5,3},{3,13},{1,7},{11,15},{15,1}};
    const uint8_t (*p)[2] = count == 1 ? p1 : count == 2 ? p2 : count == 4 ? p4 : count == 8 ? p8 : NULL;
    if (!p || !out) return -1;
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out); out->count = count;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        out->position[i].x = p[i][0] / 16.0f;
        out->position[i].y = p[i][1] / 16.0f;
    }
    return 0;
}

static inline int nvmtl_sample_pattern_valid(const nvmtl_sample_pattern *p)
{
    if (!p || (p->count != 1 && p->count != 2 && p->count != 4 && p->count != 8)) return 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->count; ++i) {
        const float x = p->position[i].x, y = p->position[i].y;
        if (!isfinite(x) || !isfinite(y) || x < 0 || x >= 1 || y < 0 || y >= 1) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static inline int nvmtl_sample_pattern_quantize(const nvmtl_sample_pattern *requested,
                                               nvmtl_sample_pattern *canonical)
{
    if (!canonical || !nvmtl_sample_pattern_valid(requested)) return -1;
    nvmtl_sample_pattern result = {0}; result.count = requested->count;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < result.count; ++i) {
        result.position[i].x = floorf(requested->position[i].x * 16.0f + 0.5f) / 16.0f;
        result.position[i].y = floorf(requested->position[i].y * 16.0f + 0.5f) / 16.0f;
    }
    *canonical = result; return 0;
}
static inline float nvmtl_sample_raster_coordinate(float canonical)
{
    return canonical == 1.0f ? 0.0f : canonical;
}

#endif

/*
 * NullMoth NVIDIA driver for macOS
 * Copyright (c) 2026 NullMoth Systems.
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0
 */

#ifndef NVMTL_SAMPLER_STATE_H
#define NVMTL_SAMPLER_STATE_H
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "nvmtl_sampler_desc.h"
typedef struct { int anisotropy, mirror_clamp; float max_anisotropy; } nvmtl_sampler_caps;
static inline int nvmtl_sampler_address(uint32_t mode, int mirror, VkSamplerAddressMode *out)
{
    switch (mode) {
    case 0: *out = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_EDGE; break;
    case 1: if (!mirror) return -1; *out = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_MIRROR_CLAMP_TO_EDGE; break;
    case 2: *out = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT; break;
    case 3: *out = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_MIRRORED_REPEAT; break;
    case 4: case 5: *out = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP_TO_BORDER; break;
    default: return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}
static inline int nvmtl_sampler_info(const nvmtl_sampler_desc *d,
                                    const nvmtl_sampler_caps *caps, VkSamplerCreateInfo *out)
{
    if (!out) return -1;
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    if (!d || !caps || d->min_filter > 1 || d->mag_filter > 1 || d->mip_filter > 2 ||
        d->compare_function > 7 || d->border_color > 2 || d->max_anisotropy < 1 ||
        d->max_anisotropy > 16 || !isfinite(d->lod_min) || !isfinite(d->lod_max) ||
        d->lod_max < d->lod_min) return -1;
    VkSamplerCreateInfo s = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO };
    s.minFilter = d->min_filter ? VK_FILTER_LINEAR : VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
    s.magFilter = d->mag_filter ? VK_FILTER_LINEAR : VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
    s.mipmapMode = d->mip_filter == 2 ? VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_LINEAR : VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST;
    if (nvmtl_sampler_address(d->address_s, caps->mirror_clamp, &s.addressModeU) ||
        nvmtl_sampler_address(d->address_t, caps->mirror_clamp, &s.addressModeV) ||
        nvmtl_sampler_address(d->address_r, caps->mirror_clamp, &s.addressModeW)) return -1;
    int zero = d->address_s == 4 || d->address_t == 4 || d->address_r == 4;
    int border = d->address_s == 5 || d->address_t == 5 || d->address_r == 5;

    if (zero && border && d->border_color != 0) return -1;
    s.borderColor = zero || d->border_color == 0 ? VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_TRANSPARENT_BLACK :
                    d->border_color == 1 ? VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_OPAQUE_BLACK : VK_BORDER_COLOR_FLOAT_OPAQUE_WHITE;
    /* Metal takes any lodMinClamp; a negative one means "no lower clamp" (Blender 4.2 sets -1000 on every sampler).
       WAS refused - every Blender sampler failed and the UI drew without them. LOD 0 is the same floor in Vulkan. */
    s.minLod = d->lod_min < 0 ? 0.0f : d->lod_min; s.maxLod = d->lod_max < s.minLod ? s.minLod : d->lod_max;
    if (d->mip_filter == 0) {

        s.minLod = 0; s.maxLod = d->min_filter == d->mag_filter ? 0 : 0.25f;
    }
    s.compareEnable = d->compare_function != 0;

    s.compareOp = (VkCompareOp)d->compare_function;
    s.maxAnisotropy = 1.0f;
    if (d->max_anisotropy > 1) {
        if (!caps->anisotropy || !isfinite(caps->max_anisotropy) ||
            caps->max_anisotropy < (float)d->max_anisotropy) return -1;
        s.anisotropyEnable = VK_TRUE; s.maxAnisotropy = (float)d->max_anisotropy;
    }
    s.unnormalizedCoordinates = VK_FALSE;
    *out = s; return 0;
}
#endif

#ifndef NVMTL_SASS_GATE_H
#define NVMTL_SASS_GATE_H
/*
 * Which GPUs may run the shipped compiled kernels. The machine code is sm_120, which among the cards
 * this driver supports means the GeForce RTX 50 series only, read from the name NVK reports
 * ("NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU"). The model number must be exactly four digits starting with
 * 50: "RTX 5000 Ada Generation" is an Ada workstation card and must not match. NVK checks the
 * architecture again before it records a dispatch.
 */
#include <string.h>

static inline int nvmtl_sass_device_name_ok(const char *name)
{
    const char *p = name ? strstr(name, "GeForce RTX 50") : NULL;
    if (!p) return 0;
    p += strlen("GeForce RTX ");
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (p[i] < '0' || p[i] > '9') return 0;
    return p[4] == 0 || p[4] == ' ';
}
