//! Storage images used by an atomic get an atomic-capable format.
//!
//! Metal allows texture atomics only on R32Uint / R32Sint (and R32Float for exchange), so a texture an atomic touches is
//! one of those formats whatever its declaration says. Vulkan requires the `OpTypeImage` an `OpImageTexelPointer`
//! addresses to be declared R32ui, R32i, R32f, R64ui or R64i. The storage format of a texture parameter is inferred from
//! the calls in the entry function; an atomic inside a helper the texture reaches through a struct (Blender's Eevee
//! shadow pass: `MTLShaderFragmentImpl::main` doing `atomic_fetch_min` on `shadow_atlas_img`) is not seen there, so the
//! image kept a write-inferred Rgba8ui and the module was refused, which left Blender with no pipeline and crashed it.
//!
//! This rewrite runs on the finished module: for every `OpImageTexelPointer` whose image is declared in a format atomics
//! cannot use, the variable it addresses (through access chains and copies) gets its own image type in the 32-bit format
//! matching the image's sampled type, and every pointer and loaded value derived from that variable is retyped. Other
//! variables that shared the old image type keep it.

use crate::spirv_module::{Instruction, Module, Operand};
use spirv::{ImageFormat, Op, StorageClass, Word};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};

fn atomic_capable(format: ImageFormat) -> bool {
    matches!(
        format,
        ImageFormat::R32ui | ImageFormat::R32i | ImageFormat::R32f | ImageFormat::R64ui | ImageFormat::R64i
    )
}

/// The atomic format for an image whose sampled type is `sampled`: unsigned/signed 32 or 64-bit integer, or 32-bit float.
fn atomic_format_for(defs: &HashMap<Word, Instruction>, sampled: Word) -> Option<ImageFormat> {
    let def = defs.get(&sampled)?;
    match (def.class.opcode, def.operands.as_slice()) {
        (Op::TypeInt, [Operand::LiteralBit32(32), Operand::LiteralBit32(0)]) => Some(ImageFormat::R32ui),
        (Op::TypeInt, [Operand::LiteralBit32(32), Operand::LiteralBit32(1)]) => Some(ImageFormat::R32i),
        (Op::TypeInt, [Operand::LiteralBit32(64), Operand::LiteralBit32(0)]) => Some(ImageFormat::R64ui),
        (Op::TypeInt, [Operand::LiteralBit32(64), Operand::LiteralBit32(1)]) => Some(ImageFormat::R64i),
        (Op::TypeFloat, [Operand::LiteralBit32(32)]) => Some(ImageFormat::R32f),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn first_id(inst: &Instruction) -> Option<Word> {
    match inst.operands.first() {
        Some(Operand::IdRef(id)) => Some(*id),
        _ => None,
    }
}

pub(super) fn construct_atomic_storage_image_formats(module: &mut Module) -> bool {
    let defs: HashMap<Word, Instruction> = module
        .types_global_values
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|i| i.result_id.map(|id| (id, i.clone())))
        .collect();
    // every function-level instruction by result id, to walk an image pointer back to its variable
    let mut producers: HashMap<Word, Instruction> = HashMap::new();
    for function in &module.functions {
        for block in &function.blocks {
            for inst in &block.instructions {
                if let Some(id) = inst.result_id {
                    producers.insert(id, inst.clone());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let pointee_of = |ptr_ty: Word| -> Option<(StorageClass, Word)> {
        let def = defs.get(&ptr_ty)?;
        match (def.class.opcode, def.operands.as_slice()) {
            (Op::TypePointer, [Operand::StorageClass(sc), Operand::IdRef(p)]) => Some((*sc, *p)),
            _ => None,
        }
    };

    // variables addressed by an OpImageTexelPointer whose image format atomics cannot use -> the format to give them
    let mut targets: Vec<(Word, ImageFormat)> = Vec::new();
    for function in &module.functions {
        for block in &function.blocks {
            for inst in &block.instructions {
                if inst.class.opcode != Op::ImageTexelPointer {
                    continue;
                }
                let Some(mut cur) = first_id(inst) else { continue };
                let mut var = None;
                for _ in 0..16 {
                    if let Some(p) = producers.get(&cur) {
                        match p.class.opcode {
                            Op::AccessChain | Op::InBoundsAccessChain | Op::CopyObject => {
                                let Some(base) = first_id(p) else { break };
                                cur = base;
                                continue;
                            }
                            Op::Variable => {
                                var = Some(cur);
                            }
                            _ => {}
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                    if defs.get(&cur).is_some_and(|d| d.class.opcode == Op::Variable) {
                        var = Some(cur);
                    }
                    break;
                }
                let Some(var) = var else { continue };
                let Some(var_ty) = defs.get(&var).and_then(|d| d.result_type).or_else(|| producers.get(&var).and_then(|d| d.result_type)) else {
                    continue;
                };
                let Some((_, mut image)) = pointee_of(var_ty) else { continue };
                while let Some(d) = defs.get(&image) {
                    if matches!(d.class.opcode, Op::TypeArray | Op::TypeRuntimeArray) {
                        let Some(elem) = first_id(d) else { break };
                        image = elem;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                let Some(img) = defs.get(&image) else { continue };
                if img.class.opcode != Op::TypeImage {
                    continue;
                }
                let (Some(Operand::IdRef(sampled)), Some(Operand::ImageFormat(fmt))) = (img.operands.first(), img.operands.get(6)) else {
                    continue;
                };
                if atomic_capable(*fmt) {
                    continue;
                }
                let Some(want) = atomic_format_for(&defs, *sampled) else { continue };
                if !targets.iter().any(|(v, _)| *v == var) {
                    targets.push((var, want));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if targets.is_empty() {
        return false;
    }

    let mut changed = false;
    for (var, want) in targets {
        // the variable's type chain: pointer -> (array ->)* image
        let Some(var_def_ty) = defs.get(&var).and_then(|d| d.result_type) else { continue };
        let Some((sc, top)) = pointee_of(var_def_ty) else { continue };
        let mut chain = vec![top];
        while let Some(d) = defs.get(&chain.last().copied().unwrap_or(0)) {
            if matches!(d.class.opcode, Op::TypeArray | Op::TypeRuntimeArray) {
                if let Some(elem) = first_id(d) {
                    chain.push(elem);
                    continue;
                }
            }
            break;
        }
        let image = *chain.last().unwrap_or(&0);
        let Some(img) = defs.get(&image) else { continue };
        let mut new_types: Vec<Instruction> = Vec::new();
        // remap old type id -> new type id, innermost first
        let mut remap: HashMap<Word, Word> = HashMap::new();
        let new_image = module.fresh_id();
        let mut ops = img.operands.clone();
        ops[6] = Operand::ImageFormat(want);
        new_types.push(Instruction::new(Op::TypeImage, None, Some(new_image), ops));
        remap.insert(image, new_image);
        for &outer in chain.iter().rev().skip(1) {
            let d = &defs[&outer];
            let mut ops = d.operands.clone();
            if let Some(Operand::IdRef(e)) = ops.first_mut() {
                *e = remap[e];
            }
            let id = module.fresh_id();
            new_types.push(Instruction::new(d.class.opcode, None, Some(id), ops));
            remap.insert(outer, id);
        }
        // a pointer of the variable's storage class to every remapped type (access chains may stop at any level)
        let mut ptr_to: HashMap<Word, Word> = HashMap::new();
        for (&old, &new) in &remap {
            let id = module.fresh_id();
            new_types.push(Instruction::new(
                Op::TypePointer,
                None,
                Some(id),
                vec![Operand::StorageClass(sc), Operand::IdRef(new)],
            ));
            ptr_to.insert(old, id);
        }
        // every id derived from the variable: pointers keep their level, loads become the new value type
        let mut derived: HashSet<Word> = HashSet::from([var]);
        loop {
            let before = derived.len();
            for p in producers.values() {
                if matches!(p.class.opcode, Op::AccessChain | Op::InBoundsAccessChain | Op::CopyObject | Op::Load)
                    && first_id(p).is_some_and(|b| derived.contains(&b))
                {
                    if let Some(id) = p.result_id {
                        derived.insert(id);
                    }
                }
            }
            if derived.len() == before {
                break;
            }
        }
        let Some(var_pos) = module
            .types_global_values
            .iter()
            .position(|i| i.class.opcode == Op::Variable && i.result_id == Some(var))
        else {
            continue;
        };
        module.types_global_values[var_pos].result_type = Some(ptr_to[&top]);
        let tail = module.types_global_values.split_off(var_pos);
        module.types_global_values.extend(new_types);
        module.types_global_values.extend(tail);
        for function in module.functions.iter_mut() {
            for block in function.blocks.iter_mut() {
                for inst in block.instructions.iter_mut() {
                    let Some(id) = inst.result_id else { continue };
                    if id == var || !derived.contains(&id) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let Some(old_ty) = inst.result_type else { continue };
                    if inst.class.opcode == Op::Load {
                        if let Some(&n) = remap.get(&old_ty) {
                            inst.result_type = Some(n);
                        }
                    } else if let Some((_, old_pointee)) = pointee_of(old_ty) {
                        if let Some(&n) = ptr_to.get(&old_pointee) {
                            inst.result_type = Some(n);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        changed = true;
    }
    changed
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::spirv_module::{Block, Function, ModuleHeader};
    use spirv::Dim;

    fn ins(op: Op, ty: Option<Word>, id: Option<Word>, ops: Vec<Operand>) -> Instruction {
        Instruction::new(op, ty, id, ops)
    }

    // %1 uint, %2 image(uint, 2D, arrayed, Rgba8ui), %3 ptr UniformConstant %2, %4 var, %5 uint3 coord, %6 ptr Image uint,
    // a second variable %9 of the same image type that no atomic touches.
    fn module(fmt: ImageFormat) -> Module {
        let mut m = Module::default();
        m.header = Some(ModuleHeader::new(20));
        m.types_global_values = vec![
            ins(Op::TypeInt, None, Some(1), vec![Operand::LiteralBit32(32), Operand::LiteralBit32(0)]),
            ins(Op::TypeImage, None, Some(2), vec![
                Operand::IdRef(1), Operand::Dim(Dim::Dim2D), Operand::LiteralBit32(0), Operand::LiteralBit32(1),
                Operand::LiteralBit32(0), Operand::LiteralBit32(2), Operand::ImageFormat(fmt)]),
            ins(Op::TypePointer, None, Some(3), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::UniformConstant), Operand::IdRef(2)]),
            ins(Op::Variable, Some(3), Some(4), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::UniformConstant)]),
            ins(Op::Variable, Some(3), Some(9), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::UniformConstant)]),
            ins(Op::TypePointer, None, Some(6), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::Image), Operand::IdRef(1)]),
        ];
        let mut block = Block::new();
        block.instructions = vec![
                ins(Op::CopyObject, Some(3), Some(7), vec![Operand::IdRef(4)]),
                ins(Op::ImageTexelPointer, Some(6), Some(8), vec![Operand::IdRef(7), Operand::IdRef(5), Operand::IdRef(5)]),
                ins(Op::Load, Some(2), Some(10), vec![Operand::IdRef(9)]),
        ];
        let mut f = Function::new();
        f.blocks = vec![block];
        m.functions = vec![f];
        m
    }

    fn format_of_var(m: &Module, var: Word) -> Option<ImageFormat> {
        let defs: HashMap<Word, &Instruction> =
            m.types_global_values.iter().filter_map(|i| i.result_id.map(|id| (id, i))).collect();
        let ptr = defs.get(&var)?.result_type?;
        let Some(Operand::IdRef(img)) = defs.get(&ptr)?.operands.get(1) else { return None };
        match defs.get(img)?.operands.get(6) {
            Some(Operand::ImageFormat(f)) => Some(*f),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_image_an_atomic_addresses_becomes_r32ui_and_its_sibling_keeps_rgba8ui() {
        let mut m = module(ImageFormat::Rgba8ui);
        assert!(construct_atomic_storage_image_formats(&mut m), "the rewrite must fire on a Rgba8ui atomic image");
        assert_eq!(format_of_var(&m, 4), Some(ImageFormat::R32ui));
        assert_eq!(format_of_var(&m, 9), Some(ImageFormat::Rgba8ui), "a variable no atomic touches keeps its type");
        let copy = &m.functions[0].blocks[0].instructions[0];
        assert_eq!(copy.result_type, m.types_global_values.iter().find(|i| i.result_id == Some(4)).and_then(|v| v.result_type),
                   "the copied pointer follows the variable's new type");
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_image_already_r32ui_is_left_alone() {
        let mut m = module(ImageFormat::R32ui);
        assert!(!construct_atomic_storage_image_formats(&mut m));
        assert_eq!(format_of_var(&m, 4), Some(ImageFormat::R32ui));
    }
}

use std::borrow::Cow;

fn air_op(op: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
    Some(match op {
        "add" => "add.u",
        "sub" => "sub.u",
        "and" => "and.u",
        "or" => "or.u",
        "xor" => "xor.u",
        "xchg" => "xchg",
        "max" => "max.s",
        "min" => "min.s",
        "umax" => "max.u",
        "umin" => "min.u",
        _ => return None,
    })
}

fn rewrite_line(line: &str) -> Option<(String, String, String)> {
    let indent = &line[..line.len() - line.trim_start().len()];
    let (result, rhs) = line.trim().split_once(" = atomicrmw ")?;
    if !result.starts_with('%') || result.contains(' ') {
        return None;
    }
    let rhs = rhs.strip_prefix("volatile ").unwrap_or(rhs);
    let (op, rest) = rhs.split_once(' ')?;
    let op = air_op(op)?;
    let (pty, space, rest) = if let Some(r) = rest.strip_prefix("i32 addrspace(3)* ") {
        ("i32 addrspace(3)*", "local", r)
    } else if let Some(r) = rest.strip_prefix("i32 addrspace(1)* ") {
        ("i32 addrspace(1)*", "global", r)
    } else if let Some(r) = rest.strip_prefix("ptr addrspace(3) ") {
        ("ptr addrspace(3)", "local", r)
    } else {
        let r = rest.strip_prefix("ptr addrspace(1) ")?;
        ("ptr addrspace(1)", "global", r)
    };
    let (ptr, rest) = rest.split_once(", i32 ")?;
    if ptr.contains(' ') && !ptr.starts_with("@\"") {
        return None;
    }
    let (value, tail) = rest.split_once(' ')?;
    let tail = tail.split(", align").next()?.trim();
    let order = tail.rsplit(' ').next()?;
    if !matches!(
        order,
        "monotonic" | "acquire" | "release" | "acq_rel" | "seq_cst"
    ) {
        return None;
    }
    if tail != order && !tail.starts_with("syncscope(") {
        return None;
    }
    let callee = format!("air.atomic.{space}.{op}.i32");
    Some((
        format!("{indent}{result} = call i32 @{callee}({pty} {ptr}, i32 {value}, i32 0, i32 2, i1 true)"),
        callee,
        pty.to_string(),
    ))
}

pub(crate) fn lower_raw_atomicrmw(san_ll: &str) -> Cow<'_, str> {
    if !san_ll.contains(" = atomicrmw ") {
        return Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    }
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(san_ll.len() + 256);
    let mut declares: Vec<(String, String)> = Vec::new();
    let mut changed = false;
    for line in san_ll.split_inclusive('\n') {
        let (body, nl) = match line.strip_suffix('\n') {
            Some(b) => (b, "\n"),
            None => (line, ""),
        };
        match rewrite_line(body) {
            Some((rewritten, callee, pty)) => {
                out.push_str(&rewritten);
                out.push_str(nl);
                if !declares.iter().any(|(c, _)| *c == callee) {
                    declares.push((callee, pty));
                }
                changed = true;
            }
            None => out.push_str(line),
        }
    }
    if !changed {
        return Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    }
    for (callee, pty) in declares {
        if !san_ll.contains(&format!("@{callee}(")) {
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "\ndeclare i32 @{callee}({pty}, i32, i32, i32, i1)\n"
            ));
        }
    }
    Cow::Owned(out)
}

pub(crate) fn lower_raw_atomicrmw_owned(san_ll: String) -> String {
    match lower_raw_atomicrmw(&san_ll) {
        Cow::Borrowed(_) => san_ll,
        Cow::Owned(owned) => owned,
    }
}

    #[test]
    fn a_device_memory_atomic_takes_the_global_abi() {
        let out = lower_raw_atomicrmw("%r = atomicrmw or ptr addrspace(1) %p, i32 %v monotonic\n");
        assert!(
            out.contains("@air.atomic.global.or.u.i32(ptr addrspace(1) %p, i32 %v,"),
            "{out}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_64_bit_atomic_is_left_untouched() {
        let src = "  %5 = atomicrmw add i64 addrspace(3)* %4, i64 1 seq_cst\n";
        assert!(matches!(lower_raw_atomicrmw(src), Cow::Borrowed(_)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_float_atomic_is_left_untouched() {
        let src = "  %5 = atomicrmw fadd float addrspace(3)* %4, float 1.0 seq_cst\n";
        assert!(matches!(lower_raw_atomicrmw(src), Cow::Borrowed(_)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_threadgroup_atomic_in_another_address_space_is_left_untouched() {
        let src = "  %5 = atomicrmw add i32* %4, i32 1 seq_cst\n";
        assert!(matches!(lower_raw_atomicrmw(src), Cow::Borrowed(_)));
    }
}

const ROLE: &str = ", !\"air.constant\", !\"air.location_index\", i32 ";

pub(crate) fn lower_cl_constant_args(san_ll: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    match lower_cl_constant_nodes(san_ll) {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(borrowed) => lower_cl_int24(borrowed),
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned) => match lower_cl_int24(&owned) {
            std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned),
            std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lowered) => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lowered),
        },
    }
}

fn lower_cl_constant_nodes(san_ll: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    if !san_ll.contains(ROLE) {
        return std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    }
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(san_ll.len() + 256);
    for line in san_ll.split_inclusive('\n') {
        match rewrite_node(line) {
            Some(rewritten) => out.push_str(&rewritten),
            None => out.push_str(line),
        }
    }
    std::borrow::Cow::Owned(out)
}

fn rewrite_node(line: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if !line.trim_start().starts_with('!') {
        return None;
    }
    let at = line.find(ROLE)?;
    let after = &line[at + ROLE.len()..];
    let (index, rest) = after.split_once(", ")?;
    if index.is_empty() || !index.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {
        return None;
    }
    let rest = rest.strip_prefix("i32 1")?;
    Some(format!(
        "{}, !\"air.buffer\", !\"air.location_index\", i32 {index}, i32 1, !\"air.read\", !\"air.address_space\", i32 2{rest}",
        &line[..at]
    ))
}

pub(crate) fn lower_cl_int24(san_ll: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    if !san_ll.contains("@air.mul24.") && !san_ll.contains("@air.mad24.") {
        return std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    }
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(san_ll.len());
    for line in san_ll.split_inclusive('\n') {
        match rewrite_int24(line) {
            Some(rewritten) => out.push_str(&rewritten),
            None => out.push_str(line),
        }
    }
    std::borrow::Cow::Owned(out)
}

fn rewrite_int24(line: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let (mad, at) = match (line.find("@air.mul24."), line.find("@air.mad24.")) {
        (Some(at), _) => (false, at),
        (None, Some(at)) => (true, at),
        _ => return None,
    };
    let (lhs, rhs) = line.split_once(" = ")?;
    let indent: String = lhs.chars().take_while(|c| c.is_whitespace()).collect();
    let res = lhs.trim();
    let call = rhs.find("call ")?;
    let ty = rhs[call + 5..at - (line.len() - rhs.len())].trim();
    let open = line[at..].find('(')? + at;
    let close = line.rfind(')')?;
    let args: Vec<String> = line[open + 1..close]
        .split(',')
        .map(|arg| arg.split_whitespace().last().unwrap_or("").to_string())
        .collect();
    let nl = if line.ends_with('\n') { "\n" } else { "" };
    match (mad, args.as_slice()) {
        (false, [a, b]) => Some(format!("{indent}{res} = mul {ty} {a}, {b}{nl}")),
        (true, [a, b, c]) => Some(format!(
            "{indent}{res}.m24 = mul {ty} {a}, {b}\n{indent}{res} = add {ty} {res}.m24, {c}{nl}"
        )),
        _ => None,
    }
}

//! `OpCopyMemory` between two pointee types that are the same aggregate laid out differently becomes load + `OpCopyLogical`
//! + store.
//!
//! A storage-buffer struct carries explicit layout decorations and so is a different SPIR-V type from the function-local
//! struct of the same shape, and `OpCopyMemory` requires one pointee type on both sides. Element-wise copies of a buffer
//! struct into a local (Blender's Eevee compute shaders: a light or shadow record copied out of a buffer array) emitted it
//! anyway and the module was refused. SPIR-V 1.4 added `OpCopyLogical` for exactly this: types whose members match one for
//! one, ignoring decorations. A pair that does not match logically is left alone and still refused by the module check.

use crate::spirv_module::{Instruction, Module, Operand};
use spirv::{Op, Word};
use std::collections::HashMap;

fn logical_match(defs: &HashMap<Word, Instruction>, a: Word, b: Word, depth: u32) -> bool {
    if a == b {
        return true;
    }
    if depth > 32 {
        return false;
    }
    let (Some(da), Some(db)) = (defs.get(&a), defs.get(&b)) else { return false };
    if da.class.opcode != db.class.opcode {
        return false;
    }
    match da.class.opcode {
        Op::TypeStruct => {
            da.operands.len() == db.operands.len()
                && da.operands.iter().zip(&db.operands).all(|(x, y)| match (x, y) {
                    (Operand::IdRef(x), Operand::IdRef(y)) => logical_match(defs, *x, *y, depth + 1),
                    _ => false,
                })
        }
        Op::TypeArray => match (da.operands.as_slice(), db.operands.as_slice()) {
            ([Operand::IdRef(ea), Operand::IdRef(la)], [Operand::IdRef(eb), Operand::IdRef(lb)]) => {
                let len = |id: &Word| defs.get(id).map(|d| (d.class.opcode, d.operands.clone()));
                len(la).is_some() && len(la) == len(lb) && logical_match(defs, *ea, *eb, depth + 1)
            }
            _ => false,
        },
        // scalars, vectors and matrices: the same declaration under two ids
        Op::TypeInt | Op::TypeFloat | Op::TypeBool | Op::TypeVector | Op::TypeMatrix => da.operands == db.operands,
        _ => false,
    }
}

pub(super) fn split_mismatched_copy_memory(module: &mut Module) -> bool {
    let defs: HashMap<Word, Instruction> = module
        .types_global_values
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|i| i.result_id.map(|id| (id, i.clone())))
        .collect();
    let mut value_type: HashMap<Word, Word> = HashMap::new();
    for inst in module.types_global_values.iter().chain(module.functions.iter().flat_map(|f| f.all_inst_iter())) {
        if let (Some(id), Some(ty)) = (inst.result_id, inst.result_type) {
            value_type.insert(id, ty);
        }
    }
    let pointee = |ptr: Word| -> Option<Word> {
        let d = defs.get(value_type.get(&ptr)?)?;
        match (d.class.opcode, d.operands.get(1)) {
            (Op::TypePointer, Some(Operand::IdRef(p))) => Some(*p),
            _ => None,
        }
    };
    // (function, block, index) -> (target, source, target pointee, source pointee)
    let mut sites = Vec::new();
    for (fi, f) in module.functions.iter().enumerate() {
        for (bi, b) in f.blocks.iter().enumerate() {
            for (ii, inst) in b.instructions.iter().enumerate() {
                if inst.class.opcode != Op::CopyMemory {
                    continue;
                }
                let (Some(Operand::IdRef(dst)), Some(Operand::IdRef(src))) = (inst.operands.first(), inst.operands.get(1)) else {
                    continue;
                };
                let (Some(dt), Some(st)) = (pointee(*dst), pointee(*src)) else { continue };
                if dt != st && logical_match(&defs, dt, st, 0) {
                    sites.push((fi, bi, ii, *dst, *src, dt, st));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if sites.is_empty() {
        return false;
    }
    // back to front, so the indices of earlier sites in the same block stay valid
    for &(fi, bi, ii, dst, src, dt, st) in sites.iter().rev() {
        let loaded = module.fresh_id();
        let copied = module.fresh_id();
        let replacement = [
            Instruction::new(Op::Load, Some(st), Some(loaded), vec![Operand::IdRef(src)]),
            Instruction::new(Op::CopyLogical, Some(dt), Some(copied), vec![Operand::IdRef(loaded)]),
            Instruction::new(Op::Store, None, None, vec![Operand::IdRef(dst), Operand::IdRef(copied)]),
        ];
        let instructions = &mut module.functions[fi].blocks[bi].instructions;
        instructions.splice(ii..ii + 1, replacement);
    }
    true
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::spirv_module::{Block, Function, ModuleHeader};
    use spirv::StorageClass;

    fn ins(op: Op, ty: Option<Word>, id: Option<Word>, ops: Vec<Operand>) -> Instruction {
        Instruction::new(op, ty, id, ops)
    }

    // %1 uint, %2 struct{uint} (buffer), %3 struct{uint} (local), %4 ptr SB %2, %5 ptr Function %3, %6/%7 vars,
    // %8 struct{uint, uint} (a different shape), %9 ptr Function %8, %10 var
    fn module() -> Module {
        let mut m = Module::default();
        m.header = Some(ModuleHeader::new(30));
        m.types_global_values = vec![
            ins(Op::TypeInt, None, Some(1), vec![Operand::LiteralBit32(32), Operand::LiteralBit32(0)]),
            ins(Op::TypeStruct, None, Some(2), vec![Operand::IdRef(1)]),
            ins(Op::TypeStruct, None, Some(3), vec![Operand::IdRef(1)]),
            ins(Op::TypePointer, None, Some(4), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::StorageBuffer), Operand::IdRef(2)]),
            ins(Op::TypePointer, None, Some(5), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::Function), Operand::IdRef(3)]),
            ins(Op::Variable, Some(4), Some(6), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::StorageBuffer)]),
            ins(Op::TypeStruct, None, Some(8), vec![Operand::IdRef(1), Operand::IdRef(1)]),
            ins(Op::TypePointer, None, Some(9), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::Function), Operand::IdRef(8)]),
        ];
        let mut b = Block::new();
        b.instructions = vec![
            ins(Op::Variable, Some(5), Some(7), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::Function)]),
            ins(Op::Variable, Some(9), Some(10), vec![Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::Function)]),
            ins(Op::CopyMemory, None, None, vec![Operand::IdRef(7), Operand::IdRef(6)]),
            ins(Op::CopyMemory, None, None, vec![Operand::IdRef(10), Operand::IdRef(6)]),
        ];
        let mut f = Function::new();
        f.blocks = vec![b];
        m.functions = vec![f];
        m
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_buffer_struct_copied_to_a_local_struct_of_the_same_shape_becomes_copy_logical() {
        let mut m = module();
        assert!(split_mismatched_copy_memory(&mut m));
        let ops: Vec<Op> = m.functions[0].blocks[0].instructions.iter().map(|i| i.class.opcode).collect();
        assert_eq!(ops, vec![Op::Variable, Op::Variable, Op::Load, Op::CopyLogical, Op::Store, Op::CopyMemory],
                   "the matching copy is split; the copy into a two-member struct is left for the module check to refuse");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_copy_between_the_same_type_is_left_alone() {
        let mut m = module();
        m.functions[0].blocks[0].instructions.truncate(2);
        m.functions[0].blocks[0].instructions.push(ins(Op::CopyMemory, None, None, vec![Operand::IdRef(7), Operand::IdRef(7)]));
        assert!(!split_mismatched_copy_memory(&mut m));
    }
}

FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/src/native/dynamic_memcpy.rs

use super::air_text::{call_arguments, last_token, split_args, LineBuffer};
use crate::fxhash::HashMap;
use std::borrow::Cow;

struct DynamicMemcpy {
    dst_ty: String,
    src_ty: String,
    len_ty: String,
    dst: String,
    src: String,
    len: String,
}

pub(crate) fn lower_dynamic_length_memcpy(san_ll: &str) -> Cow<'_, str> {
    let splits = plan_splits(san_ll);
    if splits.is_empty() {
        return Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    }
    let mut out = LineBuffer::with_capacity(san_ll.len().saturating_add(san_ll.len() / 8));
    let mut label: Option<String> = None;
    let mut next = 0usize;
    for line in san_ll.lines() {
        if let Some(block) = block_label(line) {
            label = Some(block.to_string());
            out.push(line);
            continue;
        }
        let trimmed = line.trim_start();
        let Some(call) = parse_dynamic_memcpy(trimmed) else {
            out.push(&rewrite_phi_predecessors(line, &splits));
            continue;
        };
        let Some(predecessor) = label.clone() else {
            out.push(line);
            continue;
        };
        let indent = &line[..line.len() - trimmed.len()];
        emit_copy_loop(&mut out, indent, &call, &predecessor, next);
        label = Some(format!("__dmc_done{next}"));
        next += 1;
    }
    if san_ll.ends_with('\n') {
        out.text.push('\n');
    }
    Cow::Owned(out.text)
}

pub(crate) fn lower_dynamic_length_memcpy_owned(san_ll: String) -> String {
    match lower_dynamic_length_memcpy(&san_ll) {
        Cow::Borrowed(_) => san_ll,
        Cow::Owned(lowered) => lowered,
    }
}

fn plan_splits(san_ll: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {
    let mut splits = HashMap::default();
    let mut label: Option<&str> = None;
    let mut original: Option<String> = None;
    let mut next = 0usize;
    for line in san_ll.lines() {
        if let Some(block) = block_label(line) {
            label = Some(block);
            original = None;
            continue;
        }
        if parse_dynamic_memcpy(line.trim_start()).is_none() {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(block) = label else { continue };
        let start = original.get_or_insert_with(|| block.to_string()).clone();
        splits.insert(start, format!("__dmc_done{next}"));
        next += 1;
    }
    splits
}

fn block_label(line: &str) -> Option<&str> {
    if line.starts_with(char::is_whitespace) {
        return None;
    }
    let name = line.split(':').next()?;
    (!name.is_empty()
        && name
            .chars()
            .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, '_' | '.' | '$'))
        && line[name.len()..].starts_with(':'))
    .then_some(name)
}

fn rewrite_phi_predecessors(line: &str, splits: &HashMap<String, String>) -> String {
    if !line.contains(" phi ") {
        return line.to_string();
    }
    let mut rewritten = line.to_string();
    for (from, to) in splits {
        rewritten = rewritten.replace(&format!(", %{from} ]"), &format!(", %{to} ]"));
    }
    rewritten
}

fn emit_copy_loop(
    out: &mut LineBuffer,
    indent: &str,
    call: &DynamicMemcpy,
    predecessor: &str,
    n: usize,
) {
    let (dst_ty, src_ty, len_ty) = (&call.dst_ty, &call.src_ty, &call.len_ty);
    let (dst, src, len) = (&call.dst, &call.src, &call.len);
    out.push_fmt(format_args!("{indent}br label %__dmc_head{n}"));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!("__dmc_head{n}:"));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!(
        "{indent}%__dmc_i{n} = phi {len_ty} [ 0, %{predecessor} ], [ %__dmc_next{n}, %__dmc_body{n} ]"
    ));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!(
        "{indent}%__dmc_more{n} = icmp ult {len_ty} %__dmc_i{n}, {len}"
    ));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!(
        "{indent}br i1 %__dmc_more{n}, label %__dmc_body{n}, label %__dmc_done{n}"
    ));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!("__dmc_body{n}:"));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!(
        "{indent}%__dmc_src{n} = getelementptr i8, {src_ty} {src}, {len_ty} %__dmc_i{n}"
    ));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!(
        "{indent}%__dmc_byte{n} = load i8, {src_ty} %__dmc_src{n}, align 1"
    ));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!(
        "{indent}%__dmc_dst{n} = getelementptr i8, {dst_ty} {dst}, {len_ty} %__dmc_i{n}"
    ));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!(
        "{indent}store i8 %__dmc_byte{n}, {dst_ty} %__dmc_dst{n}, align 1"
    ));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!(
        "{indent}%__dmc_next{n} = add {len_ty} %__dmc_i{n}, 1"
    ));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!("{indent}br label %__dmc_head{n}"));
    out.push_fmt(format_args!("__dmc_done{n}:"));
}

fn parse_dynamic_memcpy(line: &str) -> Option<DynamicMemcpy> {
    if !line.contains("call") || line.starts_with("declare") {
        return None;
    }
    let suffix = line.split("@llvm.memcpy.").nth(1)?;
    let mut spaces = suffix.split('(').next()?.split('.');
    let dst_ty = pointer_type(spaces.next()?)?;
    let src_ty = pointer_type(spaces.next()?)?;
    let len_ty = spaces.next()?.to_string();
    if !len_ty.starts_with('i') || len_ty[1..].parse::<u32>().is_err() {
        return None;
    }
    let args = split_args(call_arguments(line)?);
    if args.len() != 4 || last_token(&args[3]) != "false" {
        return None;
    }
    let len = last_token(&args[2]).to_string();
    if !len.starts_with('%') {
        return None;
    }
    Some(DynamicMemcpy {
        dst_ty,
        src_ty,
        len_ty,
        dst: last_token(&args[0]).to_string(),
        src: last_token(&args[1]).to_string(),
        len,
    })
}

fn pointer_type(space: &str) -> Option<String> {
    match space.strip_prefix('p')?.parse::<u32>().ok()? {
        0 => Some("ptr".to_string()),
        n => Some(format!("ptr addrspace({n})")),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::lower_dynamic_length_memcpy;
    use std::borrow::Cow;

    fn module(body: &str) -> String {
        format!("define void @k() {{\nentry:\n  br label %19\n19:\n{body}  br label %24\n24:\n  ret void\n}}\n")
    }

    const DYNAMIC: &str = "  tail call void @llvm.memcpy.p1.p1.i64(ptr addrspace(1) align 1 %21, \
                           ptr addrspace(1) align 1 %22, i64 %23, i1 false) #2, !alias.scope !30\n";

    #[test]
    fn a_constant_length_copy_is_left_for_the_emitter_to_unroll() {
        let ll = module(
            "  tail call void @llvm.memcpy.p1.p1.i64(ptr addrspace(1) %a, ptr addrspace(1) %b, \
             i64 48, i1 false)\n",
        );
        assert!(matches!(
            lower_dynamic_length_memcpy(&ll),
            Cow::Borrowed(value) if std::ptr::eq(value, ll.as_str())
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_volatile_copy_is_not_rewritten_into_a_plain_loop() {
        let ll = module(&DYNAMIC.replace("i1 false", "i1 true"));
        assert!(matches!(
            lower_dynamic_length_memcpy(&ll),
            Cow::Borrowed(value) if std::ptr::eq(value, ll.as_str())
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_lone_declaration_is_not_a_call() {
        let ll =
            "declare void @llvm.memcpy.p1.p1.i64(ptr addrspace(1), ptr addrspace(1), i64, i1)\n";
        assert!(matches!(
            lower_dynamic_length_memcpy(ll),
            Cow::Borrowed(value) if std::ptr::eq(value, ll)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_dynamic_length_copy_becomes_a_byte_loop_in_the_calling_block() {
        let ll = module(DYNAMIC);
        let lowered = lower_dynamic_length_memcpy(&ll);
        assert!(!lowered.contains("@llvm.memcpy.p1.p1.i64(ptr"), "{lowered}");
        assert!(!lowered.contains("call void @__"), "{lowered}");
        assert!(
            lowered.contains("%__dmc_i0 = phi i64 [ 0, %19 ], [ %__dmc_next0, %__dmc_body0 ]"),
            "{lowered}"
        );
        assert!(lowered.contains("icmp ult i64 %__dmc_i0, %23"), "{lowered}");
        assert!(
            lowered.contains("%__dmc_src0 = getelementptr i8, ptr addrspace(1) %22, i64 %__dmc_i0"),
            "{lowered}"
        );
        assert!(
            lowered.contains("store i8 %__dmc_byte0, ptr addrspace(1) %__dmc_dst0, align 1"),
            "{lowered}"
        );
        assert!(lowered.contains("__dmc_done0:"), "{lowered}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_successor_phi_follows_the_split_block_to_its_loop_exit() {
        let ll = format!(
            "define void @k() {{\nentry:\n  br label %19\n19:\n{DYNAMIC}  br label %24\n24:\n  \
             %26 = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ 1, %19 ]\n  ret void\n}}\n"
        );
        let lowered = lower_dynamic_length_memcpy(&ll);
        assert!(
            lowered.contains("%26 = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ 1, %__dmc_done0 ]"),
            "{lowered}"
        );
        assert!(lowered.contains("  br label %19\n"), "{lowered}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_implicit_entry_block_is_left_alone() {
        let ll = format!("define void @k() {{\n{DYNAMIC}  ret void\n}}\n");
        assert!(matches!(
            lower_dynamic_length_memcpy(&ll),
            Cow::Borrowed(value) if std::ptr::eq(value, ll.as_str())
        ));
    }
}

const MAX_THREADS_PER_THREADGROUP: u32 = 1024;

const TILE_BYTE_BUDGET: u32 = 16384;

pub(super) fn cell_capacity(cell_bytes: u32, cell_scale: u32) -> u32 {
    MAX_THREADS_PER_THREADGROUP
        .saturating_mul(cell_scale.saturating_mul(cell_scale))
        .min(TILE_BYTE_BUDGET / cell_bytes.max(1))
        .max(1)
}

//! Samplers written into a call as an integer constant.
//!
//! Current Metal toolchains give every `constexpr sampler` a module-level constant (`@__air_sampler_state.N`) and list it
//! in the `!air.sampler_states` metadata; reflection and the sampler pass both start from that list. Older toolchains
//! (seen: "Apple LLVM version 902.14", SDK 10.15.4, Machinarium) write the same packed state word straight into the
//! call instead:
//!
//! ```llvm
//! call <4 x half> @air.sample_texture_2d.v4f16(ptr addrspace(1) %tex,
//!     ptr addrspace(2) inttoptr (i64 -9223372036854248814 to ptr addrspace(2)), <2 x float> %uv, ...)
//! ```
//!
//! Nothing downstream recognises that operand, so the whole fragment function was refused with "sampler operand is a
//! pointer whose exact sampler state was not recovered". The word has the same layout as the current one (bit 63 set,
//! address modes in bits 0-8, filters in 9-12, ...; the LOD clamp field is empty, which `StaticSamplerState` reads as a
//! maximum LOD of 0 -- harmless for a sampler without a mip filter, and the only reading of an unspecified field).
//!
//! This rewrites such a call into the current form -- a global per distinct word plus its metadata node -- so every
//! later step (reflection, binding allocation, the sampler pass, the plugin's sampler creation) sees an ordinary static
//! sampler and nothing else needs to know the old spelling. Modules that already carry `!air.sampler_states`, and
//! integers whose bit 63 is clear, are left exactly as they were.

use std::borrow::Cow;

const GLOBAL_PREFIX: &str = "__air_sampler_state";
const CONST_OPEN: &str = "inttoptr (i64 ";
const CONST_CLOSE: &str = " to ptr addrspace(2))";

pub(crate) fn lower_inline_sampler_constants(san_ll: &str) -> Cow<'_, str> {
    if !san_ll.contains(CONST_OPEN)
        || san_ll.contains("!air.sampler_states")
        || san_ll.contains(GLOBAL_PREFIX)
    {
        return Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    }
    let mut words: Vec<i64> = Vec::new();
    let mut body = String::with_capacity(san_ll.len() + 512);
    for line in san_ll.split_inclusive('\n') {
        match rewrite_call_line(line, &mut words) {
            Some(rewritten) => body.push_str(&rewritten),
            None => body.push_str(line),
        }
        // stop scanning as soon as the cap below is passed: the word search is linear in the words seen
        if words.len() > 16 {
            return Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
        }
    }
    // a stage has 16 sampler indices; more distinct words than that is not a shader this rewrite is for
    if words.is_empty() || words.len() > 16 {
        return Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    }
    let Some(globals_at) = first_function_line_offset(&body) else {
        return Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    };

    let mut globals = String::new();
    for (index, word) in words.iter().enumerate() {
        globals.push_str(&format!(
            "@{GLOBAL_PREFIX}.{index} = internal addrspace(2) constant i64 {word}, align 8\n"
        ));
    }
    body.insert_str(globals_at, &globals);

    if !body.ends_with('\n') {
        body.push('\n');
    }
    let Some(mut node) = next_metadata_id(&body) else {
        return Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    };
    if node.checked_add(words.len() as u64).is_none() {
        return Cow::Borrowed(san_ll);
    }
    let mut refs = Vec::with_capacity(words.len());
    let mut nodes = String::new();
    for index in 0..words.len() {
        nodes.push_str(&format!(
            "!{node} = !{{!\"air.sampler_state\", ptr addrspace(2) @{GLOBAL_PREFIX}.{index}}}\n"
        ));
        refs.push(format!("!{node}"));
        node += 1;
    }
    body.push_str(&format!("!air.sampler_states = !{{{}}}\n", refs.join(", ")));
    body.push_str(&nodes);
    Cow::Owned(body)
}

/// Only the sampling and gathering intrinsics take a sampler, and in all of them it is the one `ptr addrspace(2)`
/// operand, so the constant is replaced only on a call line to one of them.
fn is_sampling_call(line: &str) -> bool {
    line.contains("call ")
        && (line.contains("@air.sample_")
            || line.contains("@air.gather_")
            || line.contains("@air.calculate_clamped_lod")
            || line.contains("@air.calculate_unclamped_lod"))
}

fn rewrite_call_line(line: &str, words: &mut Vec<i64>) -> Option<String> {
    if !line.contains(CONST_OPEN) || !is_sampling_call(line) {
        return None;
    }
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len());
    let mut rest = line;
    let mut changed = false;
    while let Some(at) = rest.find(CONST_OPEN) {
        let after = &rest[at + CONST_OPEN.len()..];
        let Some(end) = after.find(CONST_CLOSE) else {
            break;
        };
        match after[..end].parse::<i64>() {
            // bit 63 is the marker every packed sampler state carries; any other integer is not one
            Ok(word) if (word as u64) >> 63 == 1 => {
                let index = match words.iter().position(|seen| *seen == word) {
                    Some(index) => index,
                    None => {
                        words.push(word);
                        words.len() - 1
                    }
                };
                out.push_str(&rest[..at]);
                out.push_str(&format!("@{GLOBAL_PREFIX}.{index}"));
                rest = &after[end + CONST_CLOSE.len()..];
                changed = true;
            }
            _ => {
                out.push_str(&rest[..at + CONST_OPEN.len()]);
                rest = after;
            }
        }
    }
    out.push_str(rest);
    changed.then_some(out)
}

/// Byte offset of the first top-level `define`/`declare`: module-level constants are written before the functions.
fn first_function_line_offset(ll: &str) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut offset = 0;
    for line in ll.split_inclusive('\n') {
        if line.starts_with("define ") || line.starts_with("declare ") {
            return Some(offset);
        }
        offset += line.len();
    }
    None
}

/// One past the highest numbered metadata node; None when that would not fit (the module is left as it was).
fn next_metadata_id(ll: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    ll.lines()
        .filter_map(|line| {
            let node = line.trim_start().strip_prefix('!')?;
            let digits: String = node.chars().take_while(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()).collect();
            if digits.is_empty() || !node[digits.len()..].starts_with(" = ") {
                return None;
            }
            digits.parse::<u64>().ok()
        })
        .max()
        .map_or(Some(0), |max| max.checked_add(1))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const GAME_WORD: i64 = -9223372036854248814;

    fn legacy_module(call_sampler: &str) -> String {
        format!(
            "target triple = \"air64-apple-macosx10.12.0\"\n\
             \n\
             define <4 x float> @frag(<2 x float> %uv, ptr addrspace(1) %tex) {{\n\
             \x20 %s = tail call <4 x half> @air.sample_texture_2d.v4f16(ptr addrspace(1) readonly captures(none) %tex, ptr addrspace(2) readonly captures(none) {call_sampler}, <2 x float> %uv, i1 true, <2 x i32> zeroinitializer, i1 false, float 0.000000e+00)\n\
             \x20 %c = tail call <4 x float> @air.convert.f.v4f32.f.v4f16(<4 x half> %s)\n\
             \x20 ret <4 x float> %c\n\
             }}\n\
             \n\
             declare <4 x half> @air.sample_texture_2d.v4f16(ptr addrspace(1), ptr addrspace(2), <2 x float>, i1, <2 x i32>, i1, float)\n\
             \n\
             !air.fragment = !{{!0}}\n\
             !0 = !{{ptr @frag, !1, !1}}\n\
             !1 = !{{}}\n"
        )
    }

    fn inline_constant(word: i64) -> String {
        format!("inttoptr (i64 {word} to ptr addrspace(2))")
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_inline_sampler_word_becomes_a_global_and_a_metadata_entry() {
        let ll = legacy_module(&inline_constant(GAME_WORD));
        let lowered = lower_inline_sampler_constants(&ll);
        let lowered = lowered.as_ref();
        assert!(!lowered.contains("inttoptr"), "{lowered}");
        assert!(
            lowered.contains(&format!(
                "@__air_sampler_state.0 = internal addrspace(2) constant i64 {GAME_WORD}, align 8"
            )),
            "{lowered}"
        );
        assert!(
            lowered.contains("ptr addrspace(2) readonly captures(none) @__air_sampler_state.0,"),
            "{lowered}"
        );
        // the new node takes the next free id (the module's highest is !1)
        assert!(lowered.contains("!air.sampler_states = !{!2}"), "{lowered}");
        assert!(
            lowered.contains(
                "!2 = !{!\"air.sampler_state\", ptr addrspace(2) @__air_sampler_state.0}"
            ),
            "{lowered}"
        );
        // constants go before the first function
        let global_at = lowered.find("@__air_sampler_state.0 =").unwrap();
        assert!(global_at < lowered.find("define ").unwrap(), "{lowered}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_rewrite_is_idempotent() {
        let ll = legacy_module(&inline_constant(GAME_WORD));
        let once = lower_inline_sampler_constants(&ll).into_owned();
        assert!(matches!(
            lower_inline_sampler_constants(&once),
            Cow::Borrowed(_)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn equal_words_share_one_global_and_distinct_words_are_numbered_in_order() {
        let other: i64 = -9223372036854248887;
        let mut ll = legacy_module(&inline_constant(GAME_WORD));
        let extra = format!(
            "  %t = tail call <4 x half> @air.sample_texture_2d.v4f16(ptr addrspace(1) %tex, ptr addrspace(2) {}, <2 x float> %uv, i1 true, <2 x i32> zeroinitializer, i1 false, float 0.000000e+00)\n  %u = tail call <4 x half> @air.sample_texture_2d.v4f16(ptr addrspace(1) %tex, ptr addrspace(2) {}, <2 x float> %uv, i1 true, <2 x i32> zeroinitializer, i1 false, float 0.000000e+00)\n",
            inline_constant(other),
            inline_constant(GAME_WORD)
        );
        ll = ll.replace(
            "  ret <4 x float> %c\n",
            &format!("{extra}  ret <4 x float> %c\n"),
        );
        let lowered = lower_inline_sampler_constants(&ll).into_owned();
        assert_eq!(
            lowered
                .matches("internal addrspace(2) constant i64")
                .count(),
            2,
            "{lowered}"
        );
        assert!(
            lowered.contains("constant i64 -9223372036854248887, align 8"),
            "{lowered}"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            lowered.matches("@__air_sampler_state.0,").count(),
            2,
            "{lowered}"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            lowered.matches("@__air_sampler_state.1,").count(),
            1,
            "{lowered}"
        );
        assert!(
            lowered.contains("!air.sampler_states = !{!2, !3}"),
            "{lowered}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_module_with_sampler_metadata_is_left_alone() {
        let mut ll = legacy_module(&inline_constant(GAME_WORD));
        ll.push_str("!air.sampler_states = !{}\n");
        assert!(matches!(
            lower_inline_sampler_constants(&ll),
            Cow::Borrowed(_)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn integers_that_are_not_sampler_words_are_left_alone() {
        // bit 63 clear
        let ll = legacy_module(&inline_constant(0x1234));
        assert!(matches!(
            lower_inline_sampler_constants(&ll),
            Cow::Borrowed(_)
        ));
        // an address constant in a call that takes no sampler
        let ll = "define void @f() {\n  call void @other(ptr addrspace(2) inttoptr (i64 -9223372036854248814 to ptr addrspace(2)))\n  ret void\n}\n";
        assert!(matches!(
            lower_inline_sampler_constants(ll),
            Cow::Borrowed(_)
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_module_without_inline_constants_is_returned_borrowed() {
        let ll = "define void @f() {\n  ret void\n}\n";
        assert!(matches!(
            lower_inline_sampler_constants(ll),
            Cow::Borrowed(_)
        ));
    }
}

/// `str::trim`, without decoding characters when both ends are ASCII: the only whitespace outside ASCII is
/// multi-byte, so it is left to `str::trim`.
#[inline]
pub(super) fn trim_fast(s: &str) -> &str {
    let bytes = s.as_bytes();
    let (mut start, mut end) = (0, bytes.len());
    while start < end && bytes[start].is_ascii_whitespace() {
        start += 1;
    }
    while end > start && bytes[end - 1].is_ascii_whitespace() {
        end -= 1;
    }
    // is_ascii_whitespace does not include the vertical tab, which char::is_whitespace does.
    let plain = |byte: u8| byte > b' ' && byte < 0x80;
    if start == end || (plain(bytes[start]) && plain(bytes[end - 1])) {
        return &s[start..end];
    }
    s.trim()
}

pub(super) fn split_top_level(s: &str, sep: char) -> Vec<&str> {
    // Every separator here is ASCII, and no byte of a multi-byte character can equal an ASCII one.
    debug_assert!(sep.is_ascii());
    let sep = sep as u8;
    let bytes = s.as_bytes();
    let mut depth = 0i32;
    let mut start = 0usize;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(4);
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < bytes.len() {
        let c = bytes[i];
        if c == b'"' {
            i += 1;
            while i < bytes.len() {
                match bytes[i] {
                    b'\\' => i += 1,
                    b'"' => break,
                    _ => {}
                }
                i += 1;
            }
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        match c {
            b'<' | b'[' | b'{' | b'(' => depth += 1,
            b'>' | b']' | b'}' | b')' => depth -= 1,
            _ if c == sep && depth == 0 => {
                out.push(trim_fast(&s[start..i]));
                start = i + 1;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    out.push(trim_fast(&s[start..]));
    out
}

// Attachments are not operands. Leave the original instruction and all module
// metadata intact; only skip attachments in comma-separated operand parsers.
pub(super) fn split_instruction_operands(s: &str) -> Vec<&str> {
    split_top_level(instruction_without_attachments(s), ',')
}

pub(super) fn instruction_without_attachments(s: &str) -> &str {
    let s = strip_comment(s);
    if !s.as_bytes().contains(&b'!') {
        return s;
    }
    for part in split_top_level(s, ',') {
        let Some((kind, node)) = part.split_once(char::is_whitespace) else {
            continue;
        };
        if kind.starts_with('!')
            && kind.len() > 1
            && kind[1..].chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, '_' | '.' | '-'))
            && node.trim_start().starts_with('!')
        {
            let offset = part.as_ptr() as usize - s.as_ptr() as usize;
            let prefix = s[..offset].trim_end();
            return prefix.strip_suffix(',').unwrap_or(prefix).trim_end();
        }
    }
    s
}

pub(super) fn split_top_level_whitespace(s: &str) -> Vec<&str> {
    let mut depth = 0i32;
    let mut start = None;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(4);
    let mut in_string = false;
    let mut escaped = false;
    let ascii = s.is_ascii();
    let mut chars = s.char_indices();
    let mut bytes = s.bytes().enumerate();
    while let Some((i, c)) = if ascii {
        bytes.next().map(|(i, byte)| (i, byte as char))
    } else {
        chars.next()
    } {
        if in_string {
            if escaped {
                escaped = false;
            } else if c == '\\' {
                escaped = true;
            } else if c == '"' {
                in_string = false;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if c == '"' {
            if start.is_none() {
                start = Some(i);
            }
            in_string = true;
            continue;
        }
        match c {
            '<' | '[' | '{' | '(' => {
                if start.is_none() {
                    start = Some(i);
                }
                depth += 1;
            }
            '>' | ']' | '}' | ')' => depth -= 1,
            c if c.is_whitespace() && depth == 0 => {
                if let Some(st) = start.take() {
                    out.push(&s[st..i]);
                }
            }
            _ => {
                if start.is_none() {
                    start = Some(i);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(st) = start {
        out.push(&s[st..]);
    }
    out
}

pub(super) fn strip_comment(s: &str) -> &str {
    // Most lines have no ';' at all; a ';' inside a string is the only reason to walk the characters.
    if !s.as_bytes().contains(&b';') {
        return s;
    }
    let mut in_string = false;
    let mut escaped = false;
    for (i, c) in s.char_indices() {
        if in_string {
            if escaped {
                escaped = false;
            } else if c == '\\' {
                escaped = true;
            } else if c == '"' {
                in_string = false;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if c == '"' {
            in_string = true;
            continue;
        }
        if c == ';' {
            return &s[..i];
        }
    }
    s
}

pub(super) fn matching_paren(s: &str, open: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    matching_delim(s, open, '(', ')')
}

pub(super) fn matching_angle(s: &str, open: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    matching_delim(s, open, '<', '>')
}

pub(super) fn matching_delim(s: &str, open: usize, left: char, right: char) -> Option<usize> {
    if s[open..].chars().next()? != left {
        return None;
    }
    let mut depth = 0i32;
    for (i, c) in s[open..].char_indices().map(|(i, c)| (i + open, c)) {
        if c == left {
            depth += 1;
        } else if c == right {
            depth -= 1;
            if depth == 0 {
                return Some(i);
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

pub(super) fn parse_u32(s: &str) -> Result<u32, String> {
    s.parse()
        .map_err(|e| format!("native emitter: expected u32 integer `{s}`: {e}"))
}

pub(super) fn parse_float_literal(s: &str) -> Result<f64, String> {
    let looks_float = s.contains('.') || s.contains('e') || s.contains('E');
    if !looks_float {
        return Err(format!("native emitter: not a decimal float literal `{s}`"));
    }
    s.parse()
        .map_err(|e| format!("native emitter: expected float `{s}`: {e}"))
}

pub(super) fn parse_float32_hex_literal(s: &str) -> Option<u32> {
    let hex = s.strip_prefix("f0x")?;
    if hex.len() != 8 {
        return None;
    }
    u32::from_str_radix(hex, 16).ok()
}

pub(super) fn parse_half_literal(s: &str) -> Option<u16> {
    let hex = s.strip_prefix("0xH")?;
    u16::from_str_radix(hex, 16).ok()
}

pub(super) fn parse_bfloat_literal(s: &str) -> Option<u16> {
    let hex = s.strip_prefix("0xR")?;
    u16::from_str_radix(hex, 16).ok()
}

pub(super) fn parse_hex_literal(s: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    let hex = s.strip_prefix("0x")?;
    u64::from_str_radix(hex, 16).ok()
}

pub(super) fn parse_i64_literal(s: &str) -> Result<i64, String> {
    if !s.starts_with('-') {
        return Err(format!("native emitter: not a signed integer `{s}`"));
    }
    s.parse()
        .map_err(|e| format!("native emitter: expected signed integer `{s}`: {e}"))
}

pub(super) fn parse_u64_literal(s: &str) -> Result<u64, String> {
    if let Some(hex) = s.strip_prefix("0x") {
        u64::from_str_radix(hex, 16)
            .map_err(|e| format!("native emitter: expected hex integer `{s}`: {e}"))
    } else {
        s.parse()
            .map_err(|e| format!("native emitter: expected integer `{s}`: {e}"))
    }
}

pub(super) fn parse_float_special_literal(s: &str) -> Option<u32> {
    let s = s.trim();
    let s = s.strip_prefix('+').unwrap_or(s);
    match s {
        "qnan" => Some(0x7FC0_0000),
        "-qnan" => Some(0xFFC0_0000),
        "snan" => Some(0x7F80_0001),
        "-snan" => Some(0xFF80_0001),
        "inf" => Some(0x7F80_0000),
        "-inf" => Some(0xFF80_0000),
        "nan" => Some(0x7FC0_0000),
        "-nan" => Some(0xFFC0_0000),
        _ => None,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn float32_bit_literal_requires_exact_width() {
        assert_eq!(parse_float32_hex_literal("f0x358637BD"), Some(0x3586_37bd));
        assert_eq!(parse_float32_hex_literal("f0x00000000"), Some(0));
        assert_eq!(parse_float32_hex_literal("f0x1234567"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_float32_hex_literal("f0x123456789"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_float32_hex_literal("f0x1234567g"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn instruction_operands_exclude_only_top_level_attachments() {
        assert_eq!(
            split_instruction_operands("[ %a, %entry ], [ %b, %loop ], !dbg !41, !custom !{i32 1}"),
            vec!["[ %a, %entry ]", "[ %b, %loop ]"]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            split_instruction_operands(r#"{ i32, i8 } %"v, !dbg !41", 1, !dbg !42 ; note"#),
            vec![r#"{ i32, i8 } %"v, !dbg !41""#, "1"]
        );
        assert_eq!(split_instruction_operands("i32 %v, not_an_index"), vec!["i32 %v", "not_an_index"]);
        assert_eq!(split_instruction_operands("i32 %v, !malformed"), vec!["i32 %v", "!malformed"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn split_top_level_respects_nesting_and_strings() {
        assert_eq!(split_top_level("a, b, c", ','), vec!["a", "b", "c"]);
        assert_eq!(
            split_top_level("<2 x i32>, i8, [4 x i8]", ','),
            vec!["<2 x i32>", "i8", "[4 x i8]"]
        );
        assert_eq!(split_top_level("f(a, b), c", ','), vec!["f(a, b)", "c"]);
        assert_eq!(
            split_top_level(r#"%"a,b", i8"#, ','),
            vec![r#"%"a,b""#, "i8"]
        );
        assert_eq!(split_top_level(r#""a\",b""#, ','), vec![r#""a\",b""#]);
        assert_eq!(split_top_level("", ','), vec![""]);
        assert_eq!(split_top_level("  x  ", ','), vec!["x"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn split_top_level_whitespace_groups_bracketed_and_quoted() {
        assert_eq!(split_top_level_whitespace("i32 %0"), vec!["i32", "%0"]);
        assert_eq!(
            split_top_level_whitespace("<2 x i32> %v"),
            vec!["<2 x i32>", "%v"]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            split_top_level_whitespace(r#"%"a b" %c"#),
            vec![r#"%"a b""#, "%c"]
        );
        assert_eq!(split_top_level_whitespace("   a   b   "), vec!["a", "b"]);
        assert!(split_top_level_whitespace("").is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn strip_comment_ignores_semicolons_in_strings() {
        assert_eq!(strip_comment("add i32 %a ; a comment").trim(), "add i32 %a");
        assert_eq!(strip_comment(r#"call @"a;b"()"#), r#"call @"a;b"()"#);
        assert_eq!(strip_comment(r#""x\";y""#), r#""x\";y""#);
        assert_eq!(strip_comment("plain text"), "plain text");
    }

    #[test]
    fn matching_delim_finds_balanced_close_or_none() {
        assert_eq!(matching_paren("(a (b) c)", 0), Some(8));
        assert_eq!(matching_angle("<2 x <4 x i8>>", 0), Some(13));
        assert_eq!(matching_paren("(a (b)", 0), None);
        assert_eq!(matching_paren("[a]", 0), None);
        assert_eq!(matching_paren("ptr (x)", 4), Some(6));
    }

    #[test]
    fn literal_parsers_cover_prefixes_and_errors() {
        assert_eq!(parse_half_literal("0xH3C00"), Some(0x3C00));
        assert_eq!(parse_half_literal("3.0"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_bfloat_literal("0xR3F80"), Some(0x3F80));
        assert_eq!(parse_bfloat_literal("0xH3C00"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_hex_literal("0xFF"), Some(255));
        assert_eq!(parse_hex_literal("255"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_u32("42").unwrap(), 42);
        assert!(parse_u32("-1").is_err());
        assert!(parse_u32("4.0").is_err());
        assert_eq!(parse_i64_literal("-7").unwrap(), -7);
        assert!(parse_i64_literal("7").is_err());
        assert_eq!(parse_u64_literal("0x10").unwrap(), 16);
        assert_eq!(parse_u64_literal("16").unwrap(), 16);
        assert!(parse_u64_literal("nope").is_err());
        assert_eq!(parse_float_literal("1.5").unwrap(), 1.5);
        assert_eq!(parse_float_literal("1e3").unwrap(), 1000.0);
        assert!(parse_float_literal("10").is_err());
    }
}

/// OpenCL's native_* math (`@air.native_sin.f32` ...) as AIR's fast_* forms, which the emitter implements: the same
/// relaxed-precision functions under the names Metal uses. (Was a regular expression in the Metal plugin, run on every
/// module it handed over.)
const AIR_NATIVE_MATH: [&str; 12] = ["powr", "exp2", "exp10", "exp", "log2", "log10", "log", "sin", "cos", "tan", "rsqrt", "sqrt"];
fn air_native_math_as_fast(text: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    if !text.contains("@air.native_") {
        return std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(text);
    }
    let mut out = text.to_string();
    for name in AIR_NATIVE_MATH {
        let from = format!("@air.native_{name}.");
        if out.contains(&from) {
            out = out.replace(&from, &format!("@air.fast_{name}."));
        }
    }
    std::borrow::Cow::Owned(out)
}
pub(crate) fn lower_air_text(san_ll: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    module_reuse::lowered(san_ll, lower_air_text_uncached)
}

fn lower_air_text_uncached(san_ll: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    // rtopt4: curves, user IDs and primitive data through the acceleration structure header (rt_runtime)
    if let Some(rt) = crate::rt_runtime::rewrite_text(san_ll) {
        return std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lower_air_text_owned(rt));
    }
    // nm29 (839327f): program-scope sampler tables become constexpr samplers chosen by index; a module without one is
    // not copied
    if let std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lowered) = sampler_table::lower_global_sampler_tables(san_ll) {
        return std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lower_air_text_owned(lowered));
    }
    // then (nm266, before every other text step): older toolchains write a constexpr sampler as an integer in the call, which reflection and the sampler pass
    // only know in the metadata form
    match inline_sampler::lower_inline_sampler_constants(san_ll) {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(borrowed) => lower_air_text_rest(borrowed),
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned) => {
            std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lower_air_text_rest(&owned).into_owned())
        }
    }
}

fn lower_air_text_rest(san_ll: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<'_, str> {
    // GPU-encoded indirect command buffers: render_command writes become stores into the plugin's slot records
    if let std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lowered) = render_command::lower_render_commands(san_ll) {
        return std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lower_air_text_owned(lowered));
    }
    let native = air_native_math_as_fast(san_ll);
    if let std::borrow::Cow::Owned(rewritten) = native {
        // (lower_air_text_owned's inline-sampler step finds the metadata form here and leaves the text as it is)
        return std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lower_air_text_owned(rewritten));
    }
    let lowered = match cl_constant::lower_cl_constant_args(san_ll) {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(borrowed) => async_copy::lower_simdgroup_async_copy(borrowed),
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned) => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(async_copy::lower_simdgroup_async_copy_owned(owned)),
    };
    let lowered = match lowered {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(borrowed) => {
            dynamic_memcpy::lower_dynamic_length_memcpy(borrowed)
        }
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned) => {
            std::borrow::Cow::Owned(dynamic_memcpy::lower_dynamic_length_memcpy_owned(owned))
        }
    };
    let lowered = match lowered {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(borrowed) => atomicrmw_text::lower_raw_atomicrmw(borrowed),
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned) => {
            std::borrow::Cow::Owned(atomicrmw_text::lower_raw_atomicrmw_owned(owned))
        }
    };
    // a private table of pointers into one buffer cannot live in Function memory, so it keeps indices
    let lowered = match lowered {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(borrowed) => ptr_table_offsets::offset_pointer_tables(borrowed),
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned) => {
            std::borrow::Cow::Owned(ptr_table_offsets::offset_pointer_tables_owned(owned))
        }
    };
    // a Function-storage pointer phi has no legal form under Logical addressing, so the input is rewritten
    // instead: the phi's single load is hoisted into each predecessor and the phi carries the VALUES
    // NVMTL_NO_PTR_PHI_LOAD=1 skips this rewrite (diagnostic: it changes 46 Cyberpunk material shaders against the
    // translator that renders the game correctly).
    let lowered = if std::env::var_os("NVMTL_NO_PTR_PHI_LOAD").is_some() {
        lowered
    } else { match lowered {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(borrowed) => ptr_phi_load::sink_pointer_phi_loads(borrowed),
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned) => {
            std::borrow::Cow::Owned(ptr_phi_load::sink_pointer_phi_loads_owned(owned))
        }
    } };
    let lowered = match lowered {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(borrowed) => inline::forward_builder_pointer_fields(borrowed),
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned) => match inline::forward_builder_pointer_fields(&owned) {
            std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned),
            std::borrow::Cow::Owned(forwarded) => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(forwarded),
        },
    };
    // a texture or sampler loaded as its 64-bit resource ID (WebKit's WGSL) is loaded as the handle Metal's own
    // compiler loads, the form reflection and the emitter know
    match lowered {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(borrowed) => texture_handle_loads::fold_texture_handle_loads(borrowed),
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned) => match texture_handle_loads::fold_texture_handle_loads(&owned) {
            std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(owned),
            std::borrow::Cow::Owned(folded) => std::borrow::Cow::Owned(folded),
        },
    }
}

pub(crate) fn lower_air_text_owned(san_ll: String) -> String {
    let san_ll = crate::rt_runtime::rewrite_text(&san_ll).unwrap_or(san_ll);
    let san_ll = render_command::lower_render_commands_owned(san_ll);
    // nm29 (839327f): program-scope sampler tables become constexpr samplers chosen by index
    let san_ll = match sampler_table::lower_global_sampler_tables(&san_ll) {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => san_ll,
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lowered) => lowered,
    };
    let san_ll = match inline_sampler::lower_inline_sampler_constants(&san_ll) {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => san_ll,
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lowered) => lowered,
    };
    let san_ll = match air_native_math_as_fast(&san_ll) {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => san_ll,
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(rewritten) => rewritten,
    };
    let lowered = ptr_phi_load::sink_pointer_phi_loads_owned(ptr_table_offsets::offset_pointer_tables_owned(atomicrmw_text::lower_raw_atomicrmw_owned(
        dynamic_memcpy::lower_dynamic_length_memcpy_owned(async_copy::lower_simdgroup_async_copy_owned(
            match cl_constant::lower_cl_constant_args(&san_ll) {
                std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => san_ll,
                std::borrow::Cow::Owned(lowered) => lowered,
            },
        )),
    )));
    let lowered = match inline::forward_builder_pointer_fields(&lowered) {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => lowered,
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(forwarded) => forwarded,
    };
    match texture_handle_loads::fold_texture_handle_loads(&lowered) {
        std::borrow::Cow::Borrowed(_) => lowered,
        std::borrow::Cow::Owned(folded) => folded,
    }
}

fn add_native_module_capabilities(module: &mut Module) {
    crate::spirv_variable_ptr::lower_storage_buffer_pointer_phis(module);
    crate::spirv_variable_ptr::lower_zero_base_storage_buffer_ptr_access_chains(module);
    let (has_storage_buffer_pointer_merge, has_other_pointer_merge) =
        crate::spirv_variable_ptr::variable_pointer_requirement(module);
    module
        .capabilities
        .retain(|inst| match inst.operands.as_slice() {
            [Operand::Capability(Capability::VariablePointersStorageBuffer)] => {
                has_storage_buffer_pointer_merge
            }
            [Operand::Capability(Capability::VariablePointers)] => has_other_pointer_merge,
            _ => true,
        });
    if has_storage_buffer_pointer_merge {
        require_capability(module, Capability::VariablePointersStorageBuffer);
    }
    if has_other_pointer_merge {
        require_capability(module, Capability::VariablePointers);
    }
}

fn require_capability(module: &mut Module, capability: Capability) {
    if module.capabilities.iter().any(|inst| {
        matches!(
            inst.operands.as_slice(),
            [Operand::Capability(existing)] if *existing == capability
        )
    }) {
        return;
    }
    module.capabilities.push(Instruction::new(
        Op::Capability,
        None,
        None,
        vec![Operand::Capability(capability)],
    ));
}

pub(crate) fn requires_device_address_model_for_source(
    san_ll: &str,
    kern: Option<&crate::meta::KernMeta>,
    entry: Option<&str>,
) -> bool {
    let lowered = lower_air_text(san_ll);
    let merged = vec_scalar_merge::lower_vector_scalar_pointer_merge(&lowered);
    let consumers = inline::inline_pointer_select_consumers(&merged, entry);
    let parsed = ir::LlModule::parse_with_stage_meta(&consumers.source, kern, entry).ok();
    let requires = parsed
        .as_ref()
        .is_some_and(emit_tiers::requires_device_address_model);
    module_reuse::store(san_ll, entry, consumers.source, consumers.requires_relooper, parsed, kern);
    requires
}

    }

//! Reflection asks whether a kernel needs the device-address model, and answers it from the same normalized
//! text and typed module the translation that follows builds again: on a large compute kernel the two passes
//! were about 45% of the whole translation. Within a `with_module_reuse` scope the first result is kept and
//! the translation takes it.
//!
//! The key is the full input, not a hash: the source text, the entry name, the kernel metadata, and the one
//! thread-local flag that reaches the parser (function constants taken as unknown). The parsed module is moved
//! out by the one consumer, so nothing shares a module that the emitter then changes. Outside a scope nothing is
//! stored, and leaving the outermost scope frees the entry, so a long-lived process keeps nothing.
use super::inline::PointerConsumerInlining;
use super::ir::LlModule;
use crate::meta;
use std::any::Any;
use std::borrow::Cow;
use std::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use std::mem::Discriminant;

/// `lower_air_text` from one text to its result: None when the text came back unchanged.
type LoweredMemo = (String, Option<String>);

struct StageMetaMemo {
    input: String,
    stage: Discriminant<crate::passes::Stage>,
    function_constants_unknown: bool,
    value: Box<dyn Any>,
}

struct Entry {
    input: String,
    entry_name: Option<String>,
    function_constants_unknown: bool,
    normalized: String,
    requires_relooper: bool,
    parsed: Option<(LlModule, String)>,
}

thread_local! {
    static DEPTH: Cell<usize> = const { Cell::new(0) };
    static ENTRY: RefCell<Option<Entry>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
    static LOWERED: RefCell<Vec<LoweredMemo>> = const { RefCell::new(Vec::new()) };
    static STAGE_META: RefCell<Option<StageMetaMemo>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
}

/// `compute(san_ll)`, remembered per text. Reflection and translation lower the same text, and reflection's check
/// lowers that result once more, hence two texts.
pub(super) fn lowered<'a>(
    san_ll: &'a str,
    compute: impl FnOnce(&'a str) -> Cow<'a, str>,
) -> Cow<'a, str> {
    if !active() {
        return compute(san_ll);
    }
    let known = LOWERED.with(|memo| {
        memo.borrow()
            .iter()
            .find(|(input, _)| input == san_ll)
            .map(|(_, output)| output.clone())
    });
    if let Some(output) = known {
        return output.map_or(Cow::Borrowed(san_ll), Cow::Owned);
    }
    let output = compute(san_ll);
    let kept = match &output {
        Cow::Borrowed(_) => None,
        Cow::Owned(text) => Some(text.clone()),
    };
    LOWERED.with(|memo| {
        let mut memo = memo.borrow_mut();
        if memo.len() == 2 {
            memo.remove(0);
        }
        memo.push((san_ll.to_string(), kept));
    });
    output
}

/// `compute()`, remembered for this text and stage.
pub fn stage_meta<T: Clone + 'static>(
    san_ll: &str,
    stage: crate::passes::Stage,
    compute: impl FnOnce() -> T,
) -> T {
    if !active() {
        return compute();
    }
    let stage = std::mem::discriminant(&stage);
    let unknown = meta::function_constants_are_unknown();
    let known = STAGE_META.with(|memo| {
        let memo = memo.borrow();
        let memo = memo.as_ref()?;
        (memo.stage == stage && memo.function_constants_unknown == unknown && memo.input == san_ll)
            .then(|| memo.value.downcast_ref::<T>().cloned())
            .flatten()
    });
    if let Some(value) = known {
        return value;
    }
    let value = compute();
    STAGE_META.with(|memo| {
        *memo.borrow_mut() = Some(StageMetaMemo {
            input: san_ll.to_string(),
            stage,
            function_constants_unknown: unknown,
            value: Box::new(value.clone()),
        });
    });
    value
}

/// Runs `f` with the reuse on; the entry lives until the outermost scope ends.
pub fn with_module_reuse<R>(f: impl FnOnce() -> R) -> R {
    struct Scope;
    impl Drop for Scope {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            let depth = DEPTH.with(|depth| {
                depth.set(depth.get() - 1);
                depth.get()
            });
            if depth == 0 {
                ENTRY.with(|entry| *entry.borrow_mut() = None);
                LOWERED.with(|memo| memo.borrow_mut().clear());
                STAGE_META.with(|memo| *memo.borrow_mut() = None);
            }
        }
    }
    DEPTH.with(|depth| depth.set(depth.get() + 1));
    let _scope = Scope;
    f()
}

fn active() -> bool {
    DEPTH.with(|depth| depth.get() > 0)
}

fn kern_key(kern: Option<&meta::KernMeta>) -> String {
    format!("{kern:?}")
}

fn matches_input(entry: &Entry, san_ll: &str, entry_name: Option<&str>) -> bool {
    entry.function_constants_unknown == meta::function_constants_are_unknown()
        && entry.entry_name.as_deref() == entry_name
        && entry.input == san_ll
}

/// Keeps what `requires_device_address_model_for_source` built from `san_ll`.
pub(super) fn store(
    san_ll: &str,
    entry_name: Option<&str>,
    normalized: String,
    requires_relooper: bool,
    parsed: Option<LlModule>,
    kern: Option<&meta::KernMeta>,
) {
    if !active() {
        return;
    }
    let parsed = parsed.map(|parsed| (parsed, kern_key(kern)));
    ENTRY.with(|entry| {
        *entry.borrow_mut() = Some(Entry {
            input: san_ll.to_string(),
            entry_name: entry_name.map(str::to_string),
            function_constants_unknown: meta::function_constants_are_unknown(),
            normalized,
            requires_relooper,
            parsed,
        });
    });
}

/// The normalized form of `san_ll`, when it is the text kept in this scope. It stays in the entry, because a second
/// attempt at the same input (the wrapper's fallback without formatless storage images) needs it as well.
pub(super) fn normalized(san_ll: &str, entry_name: Option<&str>) -> Option<PointerConsumerInlining> {
    ENTRY.with(|entry| {
        let entry = entry.borrow();
        let entry = entry.as_ref()?;
        matches_input(entry, san_ll, entry_name).then(|| PointerConsumerInlining {
            source: entry.normalized.clone(),
            requires_relooper: entry.requires_relooper,
        })
    })
}

/// Moves out the module parsed from exactly `source` with this metadata. A later attempt parses again.
pub(super) fn take_parsed(
    source: &str,
    kern: Option<&meta::KernMeta>,
    entry_name: Option<&str>,
) -> Option<LlModule> {
    ENTRY.with(|entry| {
        let mut entry = entry.borrow_mut();
        let entry = entry.as_mut()?;
        if entry.function_constants_unknown != meta::function_constants_are_unknown()
            || entry.entry_name.as_deref() != entry_name
            || entry.normalized != source
            || entry.parsed.as_ref()?.1 != kern_key(kern)
        {
            return None;
        }
        entry.parsed.take().map(|(parsed, _)| parsed)
    })
}
