FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/fragment_sample_mask.rs
================================================
use metal2vulkan::passes::Stage;
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_sanitized_native};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn tmp() -> PathBuf {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_fragment_sample_mask_{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&d);
    d
}

const MASK_WITH_COLOR: &str = r#"target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.5.0"

define <{ <4 x float>, i32 }> @frag(<4 x float> %pos, i32 %mask) {
entry:
  %r0 = insertvalue <{ <4 x float>, i32 }> undef, <4 x float> %pos, 0
  %r1 = insertvalue <{ <4 x float>, i32 }> %r0, i32 %mask, 1
  ret <{ <4 x float>, i32 }> %r1
}

!air.fragment = !{!0}
!0 = !{ptr @frag, !1, !4}
!1 = !{!2, !3}
!2 = !{!"air.render_target", i32 0, i32 0, !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"color"}
!3 = !{!"air.sample_mask", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"coverage"}
!4 = !{!5, !6}
!5 = !{i32 0, !"air.position", !"air.center", !"air.no_perspective", !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"pos"}
!6 = !{i32 1, !"air.fragment_input", !"generated(m)", !"air.flat", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"mask"}
"#;

const MASK_IN_AND_OUT: &str = r#"target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.5.0"

define <{ <4 x float>, i32 }> @frag(<4 x float> %pos, i32 %covin) {
entry:
  %r0 = insertvalue <{ <4 x float>, i32 }> undef, <4 x float> %pos, 0
  %r1 = insertvalue <{ <4 x float>, i32 }> %r0, i32 %covin, 1
  ret <{ <4 x float>, i32 }> %r1
}

!air.fragment = !{!0}
!0 = !{ptr @frag, !1, !4}
!1 = !{!2, !3}
!2 = !{!"air.render_target", i32 0, i32 0, !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"color"}
!3 = !{!"air.sample_mask", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"coverage"}
!4 = !{!5, !6}
!5 = !{i32 0, !"air.position", !"air.center", !"air.no_perspective", !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"pos"}
!6 = !{i32 1, !"air.sample_mask_in", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"covin"}

const MASK_ALONE: &str = r#"target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.5.0"

define i32 @frag(<4 x float> %pos, i32 %mask) {
entry:
  ret i32 %mask
}

!air.fragment = !{!0}
!0 = !{ptr @frag, !1, !4}
!1 = !{!3}
!3 = !{!"air.sample_mask", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"coverage"}
!4 = !{!5, !6}
!5 = !{i32 0, !"air.position", !"air.center", !"air.no_perspective", !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"pos"}
!6 = !{i32 1, !"air.fragment_input", !"generated(m)", !"air.flat", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"mask"}
"#;

fn translate_to_asm(ll: &str) -> String {
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, Stage::Fragment, &tmp()).expect("translate");
    disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble")
}

fn definitions(asm: &str) -> HashMap<String, Vec<String>> {
    asm.lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter_map(|line| {
            let (result, rhs) = line.split_once(" = ")?;
            result.starts_with('%').then(|| {
                (
                    result.to_string(),
                    rhs.split_whitespace().map(str::to_string).collect(),
                )
            })
        })
        .collect()
}

fn sample_mask_var(asm: &str) -> Option<String> {
    asm.lines().map(str::trim).find_map(|line| {
        let rest = line.strip_prefix("OpDecorate ")?;
        let (id, tail) = rest.split_once(' ')?;
        (tail == "BuiltIn SampleMask").then(|| id.to_string())
    })
}

#[test]
fn a_sample_mask_return_member_reaches_the_builtin() {
    for source in [MASK_WITH_COLOR, MASK_ALONE] {
        let asm = translate_to_asm(source);
        let var = sample_mask_var(&asm)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no variable decorated BuiltIn SampleMask:\n{asm}"));
        assert!(
            asm.lines()
                .any(|line| line.contains("OpEntryPoint") && line.contains(&var)),
            "the mask variable must be part of the entry point interface:\n{asm}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_mask_is_stored_through_element_zero_of_the_array() {
    for source in [MASK_WITH_COLOR, MASK_ALONE] {
        let asm = translate_to_asm(source);
        let defs = definitions(&asm);
        let var = sample_mask_var(&asm).expect("SampleMask variable");

        let variable = &defs[&var];
        assert_eq!(variable.first().map(String::as_str), Some("OpVariable"));
        let pointer = &defs[&variable[1]];
        assert_eq!(
            pointer.first().map(String::as_str),
            Some("OpTypePointer"),
            "{asm}"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            defs[&pointer[2]].first().map(String::as_str),
            Some("OpTypeArray"),
            "SampleMask must be an array-typed Output variable:\n{asm}"
        );

        let (chain, index) = defs
            .iter()
            .find_map(|(result, rhs)| {
                (rhs.first().map(String::as_str) == Some("OpAccessChain")
                    && rhs.get(2) == Some(&var))
                .then(|| (result.clone(), rhs[3].clone()))
            })
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no OpAccessChain into {var}:\n{asm}"));
        let constant = &defs[&index];
        assert_eq!(constant.first().map(String::as_str), Some("OpConstant"));
        assert_eq!(
            constant.last().map(String::as_str),
            Some("0"),
            "the mask covers samples 0..31, which is element 0:\n{asm}"
        );
        assert!(
            asm.lines()
                .map(str::trim)
                .any(|line| line.starts_with(&format!("OpStore {chain} "))),
            "the mask must be stored through the access chain:\n{asm}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_incoming_and_outgoing_masks_are_separate_variables() {
    let asm = translate_to_asm(MASK_IN_AND_OUT);
    let defs = definitions(&asm);
    let masks: Vec<String> = asm
        .lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter_map(|line| {
            let rest = line.strip_prefix("OpDecorate ")?;
            let (id, tail) = rest.split_once(' ')?;
            (tail == "BuiltIn SampleMask").then(|| id.to_string())
        })
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        masks.len(),
        2,
        "an incoming and an outgoing mask are two variables:\n{asm}"
    );

    let storage_class = |id: &String| defs[id].last().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    let mut classes: Vec<String> = masks.iter().map(storage_class).collect();
    classes.sort();
    assert_eq!(
        classes,
        vec!["Input".to_string(), "Output".to_string()],
        "one of each storage class:\n{asm}"
    );

    let input = masks
        .iter()
        .find(|id| storage_class(id) == "Input")
        .expect("Input mask");
    assert!(
        asm.lines()
            .map(str::trim)
            .any(|line| line.contains("OpLoad") && line.ends_with(input.as_str())),
        "the incoming mask must be loaded:\n{asm}"
    );
    for mask in &masks {
        assert!(
            asm.lines()
                .any(|line| line.contains("OpEntryPoint") && line.contains(mask.as_str())),
            "{mask} must be in the entry point interface:\n{asm}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_fragment_without_a_mask_declares_no_sample_mask_output() {
    let plain = MASK_WITH_COLOR.replace("air.sample_mask", "air.render_target");
    assert_ne!(plain, MASK_WITH_COLOR);
    let asm = translate_to_asm(&plain);
    assert!(
        sample_mask_var(&asm).is_none(),
        "no SampleMask builtin should appear:\n{asm}"
    );
}

use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, passes::Stage, translate_sanitized_native_reflected};

const AIR: &str = r#"
target triple = "air64_v29-apple-macosx27.0.0"
define <2 x float> @positions(i32 %sample) {
entry:
  %p = call <2 x float> @air.get_sample_position.v2f32(i32 %sample, i32 0)
  %q = call <2 x float> @air.get_sample_position.v2f32(i32 0, i32 0)
  %sum = fadd <2 x float> %p, %q
  ret <2 x float> %sum
}
declare <2 x float> @air.get_sample_position.v2f32(i32, i32)
!air.fragment = !{!0}
!0 = !{ptr @positions, !1, !3}
!1 = !{!2}
!2 = !{!"air.render_target", i32 0, i32 0, !"air.arg_type_name", !"float2", !"air.arg_name", !"color"}
!3 = !{!4}
!4 = !{i32 0, !"air.sample_id", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"sample"}
"#;

#[test]
fn fragment_sample_positions_use_one_runtime_indexed_payload() {
    let tmp = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("sample_position_{}", std::process::id()));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&tmp).unwrap();
    let (bytes, reflection) =
        translate_sanitized_native_reflected(AIR, Stage::Fragment, &tmp, Default::default())
            .unwrap();
    let text = disassemble(&bytes).unwrap();
    assert_bounded_dynamic_index_dataflow(&bytes);
    let range = reflection
        .fragment_sample_positions
        .expect("runtime consumer contract");
    assert_eq!(
        (range.offset, range.size, range.positions, range.stride),
        (96, 64, 8, 8)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        text.lines()
            .filter(|l| l.contains("OpVariable") && l.contains("PushConstant"))
            .count(),
        1,
        "{text}"
    );
    assert!(text.contains("ArrayStride 8"), "{text}");
    assert!(text.contains("Offset 96"), "{text}");
    assert!(text.contains("BuiltIn SampleId"), "{text}");
    assert!(!text.contains("OpFunctionCall"), "{text}");
    assert!(
        text.lines().filter(|l| l.contains("OpAccessChain")).count() >= 2,
        "{text}"
    );
    let spv = tmp.join("positions.spv");
    std::fs::write(&spv, bytes).unwrap();
    let output = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val")
        .args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2"])
        .arg(spv)
        .output()
        .expect("required SPIR-V validator");
    assert!(
        output.status.success(),
        "{}",
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
    );
}

fn assert_bounded_dynamic_index_dataflow(bytes: &[u8]) {
    use spirv::Op;
    struct Inst {
        opcode: u16,
        result_id: u32,
        operands: Vec<u32>,
    }
    let words: Vec<u32> = bytes
        .chunks_exact(4)
        .map(|b| u32::from_le_bytes(b.try_into().unwrap()))
        .collect();
    let mut instructions = Vec::new();
    let mut offset = 5;
    while offset < words.len() {
        let len = (words[offset] >> 16) as usize;
        let opcode = (words[offset] & 0xffff) as u16;
        assert!(len > 0 && offset + len <= words.len());
        if [
            Op::Constant,
            Op::ConstantComposite,
            Op::ULessThan,
            Op::Select,
            Op::AccessChain,
            Op::Load,
            Op::CompositeConstruct,
        ]
        .iter()
        .any(|op| *op as u16 == opcode)
        {
            assert!(len >= 3);
            instructions.push(Inst {
                opcode,
                result_id: words[offset + 2],
                operands: words[offset + 3..offset + len].to_vec(),
            });
        }
        offset += len;
    }
    let id = |o: &u32| *o;
    let constant = |word: u32| -> Option<u32> {
        instructions
            .iter()
            .find(|i| i.result_id == word && i.opcode == Op::Constant as u16)
            .and_then(|i| i.operands.first().copied())
    };
    let guard = instructions
        .iter()
        .find(|i| {
            i.opcode == Op::ULessThan as u16
                && constant(id(&i.operands[0])).is_none()
                && constant(id(&i.operands[1])) == Some(8)
        })
        .unwrap();
    let argument = id(&guard.operands[0]);
    let guard_id = guard.result_id;
    let safe = instructions
        .iter()
        .find(|i| {
            i.opcode == Op::Select as u16
                && i.operands.len() == 3
                && id(&i.operands[0]) == guard_id
                && id(&i.operands[1]) == argument
                && constant(id(&i.operands[2])) == Some(0)
        })
        .unwrap();
    let pointer = instructions
        .iter()
        .find(|i| {
            i.opcode == Op::AccessChain as u16
                && i.operands.last().is_some_and(|o| id(o) == safe.result_id)
        })
        .unwrap();
    let loaded = instructions
        .iter()
        .find(|i| i.opcode == Op::Load as u16 && id(&i.operands[0]) == pointer.result_id)
        .unwrap();
    let condition = instructions
        .iter()
        .find(|i| {
            i.opcode == Op::CompositeConstruct as u16 && i.operands == vec![guard_id, guard_id]
        })
        .unwrap();
    let selected = instructions
        .iter()
        .find(|i| {
            i.opcode == Op::Select as u16
                && id(&i.operands[0]) == condition.result_id
                && id(&i.operands[1]) == loaded.result_id
        })
        .unwrap();
    let fallback = instructions
        .iter()
        .find(|i| {
            i.result_id == id(&selected.operands[2]) && i.opcode == Op::ConstantComposite as u16
        })
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fallback.operands.len(), 2);
    assert!(fallback.operands.iter().all(|o| constant(id(o)) == Some(0)));
    let bound = constant(id(&guard.operands[1])).unwrap();
    let false_index = constant(id(&safe.operands[2])).unwrap();
    let values: [[f32; 2]; 8] = std::array::from_fn(|i| [i as f32 + 0.125, i as f32 + 0.375]);
    for index in [0u32, 7, 8, u32::MAX] {
        let valid = index < bound;
        let address = if valid { index } else { false_index };
        assert!(address < 8);
        let result = if valid {
            values[address as usize]
        } else {
            [0.0, 0.0]
        };
        assert_eq!(
            result,
            if index < 8 {
                values[index as usize]
            } else {
                [0.0, 0.0]
            }
        );
    }
}

//! A fragment shader that zeroes the padding tail of a local output struct through a byte pointer (wgpu's `fs_fill`,
//! issue #330). The struct is modelled as a byte array once a byte GEP reaches into it; the memset that clears the
//! tail failed to translate because it was lowered as if the array were a buffer of words.
use metal2vulkan::passes::Stage;
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_sanitized_native};
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn tmp() -> PathBuf {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_function_local_padding_memset_{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&d);
    d
}

fn shader(tail: &str) -> String {
    format!(
        r#"target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.5.0"
%struct.FillOut = type <{{ <4 x float>, [12 x i8] }}>
declare void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr, i8, i64, i1)
define <4 x float> @fs_fill(<4 x float> %pos, <4 x float> %c) {{
entry:
  %a = alloca %struct.FillOut, align 16
  %f0 = getelementptr inbounds %struct.FillOut, ptr %a, i32 0, i32 0
  store <4 x float> %c, ptr %f0, align 16
  %p = getelementptr inbounds i8, ptr %a, i64 16
{tail}
  %v = load <4 x float>, ptr %f0, align 16
  ret <4 x float> %v
}}
!air.fragment = !{{!0}}
!0 = !{{ptr @fs_fill, !1, !4}}
!1 = !{{!2}}
!2 = !{{!"air.render_target", i32 0, i32 0, !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"color"}}
!4 = !{{!5, !6}}
!5 = !{{i32 0, !"air.position", !"air.center", !"air.no_perspective", !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"pos"}}
!6 = !{{i32 1, !"air.fragment_input", !"user(locn0)", !"air.center", !"air.perspective", !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"c"}}
"#
    )
}

fn translates(tail: &str) -> String {
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(&shader(tail), Stage::Fragment, &tmp()).expect("translate");
    disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble")
}

#[test]
fn memset_of_a_local_struct_padding_tail_translates() {
    let asm = translates("  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %p, i8 0, i64 12, i1 false)");
    assert!(asm.contains("OpStore"), "the cleared tail and the output colour are stored:\n{asm}");
}

#[test]
fn one_byte_memset_into_the_tail_translates() {
    translates("  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %p, i8 0, i64 1, i1 false)");
}

#[test]
fn a_plain_byte_store_into_the_tail_still_translates() {
    translates("  store i8 0, ptr %p, align 1");
}

use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};
use metal2vulkan::reflect::ResourceKind;
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_sanitized_native, translate_sanitized_native_reflected};
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn tmp() -> PathBuf {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_gated_buffer_bindings_{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&d);
    d

const GATED_BUFFER: &str = r#"target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.5.0"

@pred = internal addrspace(2) global i8 undef, align 1
@enabled.MTL_FC_INIT_0_b = internal addrspace(2) externally_initialized constant i8 undef, section "air.fc_initializer", align 1

CTOR
define void @k(ptr addrspace(1) %gated, ptr addrspace(1) %always, i32 %gid) {
entry:
  %slot = zext i32 %gid to i64
  %p = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr addrspace(1) %gated, i64 %slot
  store float 1.000000e+00, ptr addrspace(1) %p, align 4
  %q = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr addrspace(1) %always, i64 %slot
  store float 2.000000e+00, ptr addrspace(1) %q, align 4
  ret void
}

!air.kernel = !{!0}
!air.function_constants = !{!7}
!0 = !{ptr @k, !1, !2}
!1 = !{}
!2 = !{!3, !5, !6}
!3 = !{i32 0, !"air.function_constant", !4, !"air.buffer", !"air.location_index", i32 3, i32 1, !"air.read_write", !"air.address_space", i32 1, !"air.arg_type_size", i32 4, !"air.arg_type_align_size", i32 4, !"air.arg_type_name", !"float", !"air.arg_name", !"gated"}
!4 = !{ptr addrspace(2) @pred, !"bool", !"kEnabled"}
!5 = !{i32 1, !"air.buffer", !"air.location_index", i32 1, i32 1, !"air.read_write", !"air.address_space", i32 1, !"air.arg_type_size", i32 4, !"air.arg_type_align_size", i32 4, !"air.arg_type_name", !"float", !"air.arg_name", !"always"}
!6 = !{i32 2, !"air.thread_position_in_grid", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"gid"}
!7 = !{ptr addrspace(2) @enabled.MTL_FC_INIT_0_b, !"bool", !"enabled", i32 0, i1 false}
"#;

fn constructor(value: &str) -> String {
    format!(
        r#"define internal void @ctor() section "air.static_init" {{
  store i8 {value}, ptr addrspace(2) @pred, align 1
  ret void
}}
"#
    )
}

fn source(ctor: &str) -> String {
    let ll = GATED_BUFFER.replace("CTOR", ctor);
    assert_ne!(
        ll, GATED_BUFFER,
        "the constructor placeholder must be substituted"
    );
    ll
}

fn storage_buffer_stores(asm: &str) -> usize {
    let mut storage_buffer_types = Vec::new();
    for line in asm.lines() {
        let line = line.trim();
        let Some((result, rest)) = line.split_once(" = ") else {
            continue;
        };
        if rest.starts_with("OpTypePointer StorageBuffer ") {
            storage_buffer_types.push(result.to_string());
        }
    }
    let mut storage_buffer_pointers = Vec::new();
    for line in asm.lines() {
        let line = line.trim();
        let Some((result, rest)) = line.split_once(" = ") else {
            continue;
        };
        let mut words = rest.split_whitespace();
        let Some(_opcode) = words.next() else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(result_type) = words.next() else {
            continue;
        };
        if storage_buffer_types.iter().any(|t| t == result_type) {
            storage_buffer_pointers.push(result.to_string());
        }
    }
    asm.lines()
        .filter(|line| {
            line.trim()
                .strip_prefix("OpStore ")
                .and_then(|rest| rest.split_whitespace().next())
                .is_some_and(|pointer| storage_buffer_pointers.iter().any(|p| p == pointer))
        })
        .count()
}

fn buffer_bindings(ll: &str) -> Vec<u32> {
    let (_, reflection) = translate_sanitized_native_reflected(
        ll,
        Stage::Kernel,
        &tmp(),
        TransformOptions::default(),
    )
    .expect("translate");
    reflection
        .bindings
        .iter()
        .filter(|binding| binding.kind == ResourceKind::Buffer)
        .filter_map(|binding| binding.descriptor.map(|d| d.binding))
        .collect::<std::collections::BTreeSet<_>>()
        .into_iter()
        .collect()
}

fn asm_for(ll: &str) -> String {
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, Stage::Kernel, &tmp()).expect("translate");
    disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble")
}

#[test]
fn a_gate_the_module_drives_on_binds_the_buffer_and_keeps_its_store() {
    let ll = source(&constructor("1"));
    let asm = asm_for(&ll);
    assert_eq!(
        storage_buffer_stores(&asm),
        2,
        "a buffer this module's own initializers switch on must carry its store beside the \
         ungated one:\n{asm}"
    );
    assert_eq!(buffer_bindings(&ll), vec![1, 3]);
}

#[test]
fn a_gate_the_module_drives_off_leaves_the_buffer_absent() {
    let ll = source(&constructor("0"));
    let asm = asm_for(&ll);
    assert_eq!(
        storage_buffer_stores(&asm),
        1,
        "only the ungated store may survive a gate driven off:\n{asm}"
    );
    assert_eq!(buffer_bindings(&ll), vec![1]);
}

#[test]
fn a_gate_the_module_cannot_resolve_keeps_the_possibly_absent_placeholder() {
    let ll = source("");
    let asm = asm_for(&ll);
    assert_eq!(
        storage_buffer_stores(&asm),
        1,
        "an unresolved gate must keep the conservative placeholder:\n{asm}"
    );
    assert_eq!(buffer_bindings(&ll), vec![1]);
}

const GATE: &str = r#"
@enabled.MTL_FC_INIT_0_b = internal addrspace(2) externally_initialized constant i8 undef, section "air.fc_initializer", align 1
!air.function_constants = !{!20}

  %v1 = insertelement <4 x float> %v0, float 0.000000e+00, i32 1
  %v2 = insertelement <4 x float> %v1, float 0.000000e+00, i32 2
  %v3 = insertelement <4 x float> %v2, float 1.000000e+00, i32 3

const KERNEL: &str = r#"target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.5.0"

  %sum = fadd <3 x float> %position, %normal

!air.kernel = !{!0}
!0 = !{ptr @skin, !1, !2}
!1 = !{}
!2 = !{!3, !4, !5, !6}
!3 = !{i32 0, !"air.thread_position_in_grid", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"index"}

!6 = !{i32 3, !"air.buffer", !"air.location_index", i32 0, i32 1, !"air.write", !"air.address_space", i32 1, !"air.arg_type_name", !"packed_float3", !"air.arg_name", !"out"}
"#;

fn pair(template: &str) -> (String, String) {
    (
        format!("{}{GATE}", template.replace("WRAP", "")),
        format!(
            "{}{GATE}",
            template.replace("WRAP", "!\"air.function_constant\", !20, ")
        ),
    )
}

fn asm(ll: &str, stage: Stage) -> String {
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, stage, &tmp()).expect("translate");
    disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble")
}

#[test]
fn a_gated_vertex_attribute_declares_the_same_interface_as_an_ungated_one() {
    let (bare, gated) = pair(VERTEX);
    assert_eq!(
        asm(&gated, Stage::Vertex),
        asm(&bare, Stage::Vertex),
        "the wrapper is when the attribute is live, not whether it exists"
    );

    let reflect = |ll: &str| {
        reflect_sanitized(ll, Stage::Vertex, TransformOptions::default())
            .expect("reflect")
            .vertex_attributes
    };
    let attributes = reflect(&gated);
    assert_eq!(attributes, reflect(&bare));
    assert_eq!(
        attributes.iter().map(|a| a.location).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        vec![0, 1],
        "both attributes are reported, so an application binds a vertex buffer for both"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_gated_fragment_varying_declares_the_same_interface_as_an_ungated_one() {
    let (bare, gated) = pair(FRAGMENT);
    assert_eq!(
        asm(&gated, Stage::Fragment),
        asm(&bare, Stage::Fragment),
        "the fragment decode has always read the wrapped role, and still must"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_gated_kernel_stage_input_declares_the_same_interface_as_an_ungated_one() {
    let (bare, gated) = pair(KERNEL);
    assert_eq!(
        asm(&gated, Stage::Kernel),
        asm(&bare, Stage::Kernel),
        "the wrapper is when the stream is live, not whether it exists"
    );

    let streams = |ll: &str| {
        reflect_sanitized(ll, Stage::Kernel, TransformOptions::default())
            .expect("reflect")
            .bindings
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|binding| binding.kind == ResourceKind::KernelStageInput)
            .count()
    };
    assert_eq!(streams(&gated), streams(&bare));
    assert_eq!(streams(&gated), 2, "both declared streams are descriptors");
}

fn translate_to_asm(gate: &str) -> String {
    let ll = GATED_VIEWPORT.replace("GATE", gate);
    assert_ne!(
        ll, GATED_VIEWPORT,
        "the gate placeholder must be substituted"
    );
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(&ll, Stage::Fragment, &tmp()).expect("translate");
    disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble")
}

fn mentions(asm: &str, needle: &str) -> bool {
    asm.lines().any(|line| line.contains(needle))
}

#[test]
fn a_gated_off_system_value_declares_no_builtin_and_no_capability() {
    let asm = translate_to_asm(r#"!"air.function_constant", !7, "#);
    assert!(
        !mentions(&asm, "BuiltIn ViewportIndex"),
        "an absent parameter must not claim its builtin:\n{asm}"
    );
    assert!(
        !mentions(&asm, "ShaderViewportIndex"),
        "and must not make the module require the device feature:\n{asm}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn the_same_system_value_ungated_is_still_wired() {
    let asm = translate_to_asm("");
    assert!(
        mentions(&asm, "BuiltIn ViewportIndex"),
        "a present parameter must be wired to its builtin:\n{asm}"
    );
    assert!(
        mentions(&asm, "OpCapability ShaderViewportIndex"),
        "and the module must declare what reading it needs:\n{asm}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_gated_sampler_is_a_descriptor_in_every_stage() {
    const SAMPLE_CALL: &str = r#"  %s = call { <4 x float>, i8 } @air.sample_texture_2d.v4f32(ptr addrspace(1) %tex, ptr addrspace(2) %smp, <2 x float> zeroinitializer, i1 true, <2 x i32> zeroinitializer, i1 false, float 0.000000e+00, float 0.000000e+00, i32 0)
  %c = extractvalue { <4 x float>, i8 } %s, 0
"#;
    const DECLARE: &str = r#"declare { <4 x float>, i8 } @air.sample_texture_2d.v4f32(ptr addrspace(1), ptr addrspace(2), <2 x float>, i1, <2 x i32>, i1, float, float, i32)
"#;
    const GATED_PAIR: &str = r#"!8 = !{i32 IDX, !"air.function_constant", !9, !"air.texture", !"air.location_index", i32 2, i32 1, !"air.sample", !"air.arg_type_name", !"texture2d<float, sample>", !"air.arg_name", !"tex"}
!9 = !{ptr addrspace(2) @enabled.MTL_FC_INIT_0_b, !"bool", !"enabled", i32 0, i1 false}
!10 = !{i32 IDX1, !"air.function_constant", !9, !"air.sampler", !"air.location_index", i32 3, i32 1, !"air.arg_type_name", !"sampler", !"air.arg_name", !"smp"}
"#;
    const PROLOGUE: &str = r#"target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.5.0"

@enabled.MTL_FC_INIT_0_b = internal addrspace(2) externally_initialized constant i8 undef, section "air.fc_initializer", align 1

"#;

    let fragment = format!(
        "{PROLOGUE}define <4 x float> @frag(<4 x float> %pos, ptr addrspace(1) %tex, ptr addrspace(2) %smp) {{\nentry:\n{SAMPLE_CALL}  ret <4 x float> %c\n}}\n{DECLARE}\n!air.fragment = !{{!0}}\n!air.function_constants = !{{!9}}\n!0 = !{{ptr @frag, !1, !3}}\n!1 = !{{!2}}\n!2 = !{{!\"air.render_target\", i32 0, i32 0, !\"air.arg_type_name\", !\"float4\"}}\n!3 = !{{!4, !8, !10}}\n!4 = !{{i32 0, !\"air.position\", !\"air.center\", !\"air.arg_type_name\", !\"float4\", !\"air.arg_name\", !\"pos\"}}\n{}",
        GATED_PAIR.replace("IDX1", "2").replace("IDX", "1")
    );
    let vertex = format!(
        "{PROLOGUE}define <4 x float> @vert(ptr addrspace(1) %tex, ptr addrspace(2) %smp) {{\nentry:\n{SAMPLE_CALL}  ret <4 x float> %c\n}}\n{DECLARE}\n!air.vertex = !{{!0}}\n!air.function_constants = !{{!9}}\n!0 = !{{ptr @vert, !1, !3}}\n!1 = !{{!2}}\n!2 = !{{!\"air.position\", !\"air.arg_type_name\", !\"float4\"}}\n!3 = !{{!8, !10}}\n{}",
        GATED_PAIR.replace("IDX1", "1").replace("IDX", "0")
    );
    let kernel = format!(
        "{PROLOGUE}define void @k(ptr addrspace(1) %tex, ptr addrspace(2) %smp, ptr addrspace(1) %out) {{\nentry:\n{SAMPLE_CALL}  store <4 x float> %c, ptr addrspace(1) %out, align 16\n  ret void\n}}\n{DECLARE}\n!air.kernel = !{{!0}}\n!air.function_constants = !{{!9}}\n!0 = !{{ptr @k, !1, !3}}\n!1 = !{{}}\n!3 = !{{!8, !10, !11}}\n!11 = !{{i32 2, !\"air.buffer\", !\"air.location_index\", i32 0, i32 1, !\"air.write\", !\"air.address_space\", i32 1, !\"air.arg_type_size\", i32 16, !\"air.arg_type_align_size\", i32 16, !\"air.arg_type_name\", !\"float4\", !\"air.arg_name\", !\"out\"}}\n{}",
        GATED_PAIR.replace("IDX1", "1").replace("IDX", "0")
    );

    for (stage, ll) in [
        (Stage::Fragment, &fragment),
        (Stage::Vertex, &vertex),
        (Stage::Kernel, &kernel),
    ] {
        let (_, reflection) = translate_sanitized_native_reflected(
            ll,
            stage,
            &tmp(),
            TransformOptions {
                descriptor_layout: DEFAULT_DESCRIPTOR_LAYOUT,
                ..TransformOptions::default()
            },
        )
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{stage:?}: translate: {error}\n{ll}"));
        let samplers = reflection
            .bindings
            .iter()
            .filter(|binding| binding.kind == ResourceKind::Sampler)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        assert_eq!(
            samplers.len(),
            1,
            "{stage:?}: the gated sampler argument is one descriptor; got {:?}",
            reflection.bindings
        );
        assert_eq!(
            samplers[0].metal_index, 3,
            "{stage:?}: at the Metal slot AIR declared"
        );
        let location = samplers[0]
            .descriptor
            .expect("a reported sampler binds a descriptor");
        assert!(
            SAMPLER_BINDING_RANGE.contains(location.binding),
            "{stage:?}: in the sampler band; got {location:?}"
        );
        assert!(
            !reflection
                .bindings
                .iter()
                .any(|binding| binding.kind == ResourceKind::SynthesizedReadSampler),
            "{stage:?}: the declared sampler is the one the sample takes, so the translator has no \
             reason to invent one: {:?}",
            reflection.bindings
        );
    }
}

const LOADED_HANDLE: &str = r#"target triple = "spirv-unknown-vulkan1.2"

@live_enabled = internal addrspace(2) global i8 1, align 1
@gated_enabled = internal addrspace(2) global i8 0, align 1
@live_location = internal addrspace(2) global i32 0, align 4

@gated_location = internal addrspace(2) global i32 0, align 4

define internal void @_GLOBAL__sub_I_alternatives.metal() section "air.static_init" {
  store i32 0, ptr addrspace(2) @live_location, align 4
  store i32 0, ptr addrspace(2) @gated_location, align 4
  store i32 0, ptr addrspace(2) @gated_count, align 4
  ret void
}

define void @probe(ptr addrspace(1) %live, ptr %gated, ptr addrspace(1) %out) {
entry:
  %handle = load ptr addrspace(1), ptr %gated, align 8
  %layers = tail call i32 @air.get_array_size_texture_2d_array(ptr addrspace(1) %handle)
  %w = tail call i32 @air.get_width_texture_2d(ptr addrspace(1) %live, i32 0)
  %sum = add i32 %layers, %w
  %f = sitofp i32 %sum to float
  %v = insertelement <4 x float> zeroinitializer, float %f, i32 0
  tail call void @air.write_texture_2d.v4f32(ptr addrspace(1) %out, <2 x i32> zeroinitializer, <4 x float> %v, i32 0, i32 2)
  ret void
}

declare i32 @air.get_array_size_texture_2d_array(ptr addrspace(1))
declare i32 @air.get_width_texture_2d(ptr addrspace(1), i32)
declare void @air.write_texture_2d.v4f32(ptr addrspace(1), <2 x i32>, <4 x float>, i32, i32)

!air.kernel = !{!0}
!0 = !{ptr @probe, !1, !2}
!1 = !{}
!2 = !{!3, !4, !7}
!3 = !{i32 0, !"air.function_constant", !5, !"air.texture", !"air.location_index", ptr addrspace(2) @live_location, i32 1, !"air.sample", !"air.arg_type_name", !"texture2d<float, sample>", !"air.arg_name", !"live"}
!4 = !{i32 1, !"air.function_constant", !6, !"air.texture", !"air.location_index", ptr addrspace(2) @gated_location, ptr addrspace(2) @gated_count, !"air.sample", !"air.arg_type_name", !"array_ref<texture2d_array<float, sample>>", !"air.arg_name", !"gated"}
!5 = !{ptr addrspace(2) @live_enabled, !"bool", !"live_enabled"}
!6 = !{ptr addrspace(2) @gated_enabled, !"bool", !"gated_enabled"}
!7 = !{i32 2, !"air.texture", !"air.location_index", i32 0, i32 1, !"air.write", !"air.arg_type_name", !"texture2d<float, write>", !"air.arg_name", !"out"}
"#;

define internal void @_GLOBAL__sub_I_absent.metal() section "air.static_init" {

  store i32 0, ptr addrspace(2) @absent_write_location, align 4
  ret void

define void @copy(ptr addrspace(1) %absent_source, ptr addrspace(1) %absent_sink, ptr addrspace(1) %present, ptr addrspace(1) %dest) {
entry:
  %sampler = tail call ptr addrspace(2) @air.get_read_sampler()
  %gone = tail call { <4 x float>, i8 } @air.read_texture_2d.v4f32(ptr addrspace(1) %absent_source, ptr addrspace(2) %sampler, <2 x i32> zeroinitializer, <2 x i32> zeroinitializer, i32 0, i32 1)
  %gone_color = extractvalue { <4 x float>, i8 } %gone, 0

  %live_color = extractvalue { <4 x float>, i8 } %live, 0

}

fn scratch(label: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let directory = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
        "m2v_gated_slots_{}_{}",
        std::process::id(),
        label.replace(['/', '.'], "_")
    ));
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&directory).expect("scratch directory");
    directory
}

fn descriptor_slots(spirv: &[u8]) -> Vec<(String, (u32, u32))> {
    let text = disassemble(spirv).expect("disassemble the translated module");
    let mut set = Vec::new();
    let mut binding = Vec::new();
    let mut uniform_constants = Vec::new();
    for line in text.lines() {
        let tokens = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
        match tokens.as_slice() {
            ["OpDecorate", id, "DescriptorSet", value] => {
                set.push(((*id).to_string(), value.parse::<u32>().expect("set")));
            }
            ["OpDecorate", id, "Binding", value] => {
                binding.push(((*id).to_string(), value.parse::<u32>().expect("binding")));
            }
            [id, "=", "OpVariable", _, "UniformConstant"] => {
                uniform_constants.push((*id).to_string());
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    uniform_constants
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|id| {
            let set = set.iter().find(|(decorated, _)| *decorated == id)?.1;
            let binding = binding.iter().find(|(decorated, _)| *decorated == id)?.1;
            Some((id, (set, binding)))
        })
        .collect()
}

fn aliased_slots(spirv: &[u8]) -> Vec<(u32, u32)> {
    let slots = descriptor_slots(spirv);
    let mut aliased = Vec::new();
    for (index, (_, slot)) in slots.iter().enumerate() {
        if slots[..index].iter().any(|(_, earlier)| earlier == slot) && !aliased.contains(slot) {
            aliased.push(*slot);
        }
    }
    aliased
}

fn opcode_count(spirv: &[u8], opcode: &str) -> usize {
    disassemble(spirv)
        .expect("disassemble the translated module")
        .lines()
        .filter(|line| line.split_whitespace().any(|token| token == opcode))
        .count()
}

#[test]
fn an_absent_texture_operand_does_not_take_the_only_live_texture() {
    for (label, air) in [
        ("summed", ABSENT_BESIDE_ONE_LIVE),
        ("specialized", ABSENT_BESIDE_ONE_LIVE_SPECIALIZED),
    ] {
        let (spirv, _) = translate_sanitized_native_reflected(
            air,
            Stage::Kernel,
            &scratch(&format!("absent_{label}")),
            TransformOptions::default(),
        )
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("the {label} absent-texture kernel translates: {error}"));

        assert_eq!(
            opcode_count(&spirv, "OpImageFetch"),
            1,
            "{label}: the absent read was answered by an image instead of zero:\n{}",
            disassemble(&spirv).expect("disassemble")
        );
        assert_eq!(
            opcode_count(&spirv, "OpImageWrite"),
            1,
            "{label}: the absent store landed on an image instead of nowhere:\n{}",
            disassemble(&spirv).expect("disassemble")
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_summed_slot_the_variant_does_not_reach_takes_no_descriptor() {
    let (spirv, reflection) = translate_sanitized_native_reflected(
        SUMMED_SLOTS,
        Stage::Kernel,
        &scratch("summed"),
        TransformOptions::default(),
    )
    .expect("the summed-slot kernel translates");

    assert_eq!(
        aliased_slots(&spirv),
        Vec::new(),
        "two resources share a descriptor slot: {:?}",
        descriptor_slots(&spirv)
    );
    let images = reflection
        .bindings
        .iter()
        .filter(|resource| {
            matches!(
                resource.kind,
                ResourceKind::Texture | ResourceKind::TextureArray | ResourceKind::StorageImage
            )
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    assert_eq!(
        images.len(),
        1,
        "only the enabled alternative is a descriptor, got {images:?}"
    );
    assert_eq!(images[0].metal_index, 0);
}

#[test]
fn a_store_through_a_texture_the_variant_lacks_is_dropped() {
    let (spirv, _reflection) = translate_sanitized_native_reflected(
        SUMMED_SLOTS,
        Stage::Kernel,
        &scratch("summed_write"),
        TransformOptions::default(),
    )
    .expect("the summed-slot kernel translates");

    assert_eq!(
        opcode_count(&spirv, "OpImageWrite"),
        1,
        "the enabled alternative's store is the only one left:\n{}",
        disassemble(&spirv).expect("disassemble")
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_literal_slot_keeps_its_descriptor_when_the_gate_is_off() {
    let (spirv, reflection) = translate_sanitized_native_reflected(
        LITERAL_SLOTS,
        Stage::Kernel,
        &scratch("literal"),
        TransformOptions::default(),
    )
    .expect("the literal-slot kernel translates");

    let images = reflection
        .bindings
        .iter()
        .filter(|resource| {
            matches!(
                resource.kind,
                ResourceKind::Texture | ResourceKind::TextureArray | ResourceKind::StorageImage
            )
        })
        .count();
    assert_eq!(
        images, 2,
        "both stated alternatives are descriptors, got {:?}",
        reflection.bindings
    );
    assert_eq!(
        aliased_slots(&spirv).len(),
        1,
        "the two alternatives share the slot Metal gave them: {:?}",
        descriptor_slots(&spirv)
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_query_on_a_loaded_handle_the_variant_lacks_answers_for_an_absent_resource() {
    let (spirv, _reflection) = translate_sanitized_native_reflected(
        LOADED_HANDLE,
        Stage::Kernel,
        &scratch("loaded_handle"),
        TransformOptions::default(),
    )
    .expect("the loaded-handle kernel translates");

    assert_eq!(
        opcode_count(&spirv, "OpImageQuerySizeLod"),

    );
    assert_eq!(
        aliased_slots(&spirv),
        Vec::new(),
        "two resources share a descriptor slot: {:?}",

    );
}

use metal2vulkan::passes::Stage;
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_sanitized_native};
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn tmp() -> PathBuf {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_gated_varying_{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&d);
    d
}

const GATE: &str = r#"@enabled.MTL_FC_INIT_0_b = internal addrspace(2) externally_initialized constant i8 undef, section "air.fc_initializer", align 1
"#;

const VERTEX: &str = r#"target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.5.0"

define <{ <4 x float>, <2 x float>, <2 x float> }> @vert(<4 x float> %p, <2 x float> %a, <2 x float> %b) {
entry:
  %r0 = insertvalue <{ <4 x float>, <2 x float>, <2 x float> }> undef, <4 x float> %p, 0
  %r1 = insertvalue <{ <4 x float>, <2 x float>, <2 x float> }> %r0, <2 x float> %a, 1
  %r2 = insertvalue <{ <4 x float>, <2 x float>, <2 x float> }> %r1, <2 x float> %b, 2
  ret <{ <4 x float>, <2 x float>, <2 x float> }> %r2
}

!air.vertex = !{!0}
!air.function_constants = !{!10}
!0 = !{ptr @vert, !1, !5}
!1 = !{!2, !3, !4}
!2 = !{!"air.position", !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"position"}
!3 = !{!"air.function_constant", !10, !"air.vertex_output", !"generated(a)", !"air.arg_type_name", !"float2", !"air.arg_name", !"a"}
!4 = !{!"air.vertex_output", !"generated(b)", !"air.arg_type_name", !"float2", !"air.arg_name", !"b"}

!7 = !{i32 1, !"air.vertex_input", !"air.location_index", i32 1, !"air.arg_type_name", !"float2", !"air.arg_name", !"a"}
!8 = !{i32 2, !"air.vertex_input", !"air.location_index", i32 2, !"air.arg_type_name", !"float2", !"air.arg_name", !"b"}

entry:

fn interface_locations(asm: &str, storage_class: &str) -> Vec<u32> {
    let ids: Vec<&str> = asm
        .lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter_map(|line| {
            let (id, rest) = line.split_once(" = OpVariable ")?;
            rest.split_whitespace()
                .last()
                .filter(|class| *class == storage_class)
                .map(|_| id)
        })
        .collect();
    let mut out: Vec<u32> = asm
        .lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter_map(|line| {
            let rest = line.strip_prefix("OpDecorate ")?;
            let (id, rest) = rest.split_once(' ')?;
            let location = rest.strip_prefix("Location ")?;
            ids.contains(&id).then(|| location.trim().parse().ok())?
        })
        .collect();
    out.sort_unstable();
    out
}

fn asm(ll: &str, stage: Stage) -> String {
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, stage, &tmp()).expect("translate");
    disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble")
}

#[test]
fn a_gated_varying_occupies_the_same_location_in_both_stages() {
    let vertex = asm(&format!("{VERTEX}{GATE}"), Stage::Vertex);
    let fragment = asm(&format!("{FRAGMENT}{GATE}"), Stage::Fragment);

    let written = interface_locations(&vertex, "Output");
    let read = interface_locations(&fragment, "Input");
    assert_eq!(
        written, read,
        "the vertex writes {written:?} and the fragment reads {read:?} for the same varying \
         struct\n--- vertex ---\n{vertex}\n--- fragment ---\n{fragment}"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        written,
        vec![0, 1],
        "both varyings are declared, the gated one first:\n{vertex}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn the_varying_behind_a_gated_one_keeps_its_declared_slot() {
    let vertex = asm(&format!("{VERTEX}{GATE}"), Stage::Vertex);
    let fragment = asm(&format!("{FRAGMENT}{GATE}"), Stage::Fragment);
    for (stage, asm, class) in [
        ("vertex", &vertex, "Output"),
        ("fragment", &fragment, "Input"),
    ] {
        assert!(
            interface_locations(asm, class).contains(&1),
            "{stage}: `b` is the second varying of the struct and keeps Location 1:\n{asm}"
        );
    }
}

//! `depth2d::gather_compare(sampler, coord, reference, offset)` (AIR `air.gather_compare_depth_2d.f32`) is the usual way a
//! Metal shader takes four depth comparisons in one fetch for a shadow filter. The translator once did not know the family
//! ("unrecognized AIR intrinsic family"), so every shader using it was refused. With a runtime sampler the call is
//! `OpImageDrefGather` (the Vulkan sampler carries the compare function), the constant offset as `ConstOffset`.
//! The fixture is compiled from `fixtures/shadow_pcf/shadow_pcf_gather_compare.metal`, a shader written for this test.
use metal2vulkan::passes::Stage;
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options};
use metal2vulkan::passes::TransformOptions;

fn spirv_val(spv: &[u8]) {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val").args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2", "-"]).stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped()).stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped()).spawn().and_then(|mut c| {
            use std::io::Write; c.stdin.take().unwrap().write_all(spv)?; c.wait_with_output() });
    if let Ok(out) = out { assert!(out.status.success(), "spirv-val: {}{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr)); }
}

#[test]
fn a_depth2d_gather_compare_with_offsets_is_a_dref_gather_on_the_first_attempt() {
    let ll = include_str!("fixtures/shadow_pcf/shadow_pcf_gather_compare.ll");
    // The plugin's first attempt (as written, no pointer retry): a plain shadow filter must not need the retry.
    let spv = translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(ll, Stage::Fragment, TransformOptions::default())
        .expect("the gather_compare shadow taps must translate");
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble");
    if std::env::var_os("M2V_SHOW_ASM").is_some() { eprintln!("{asm}"); }
    let gathers: Vec<&str> = asm.lines().filter(|l| l.contains("OpImageDrefGather")).collect();
    assert_eq!(gathers.len(), 4, "{asm}");
    assert!(gathers.iter().all(|l| l.contains("ConstOffset")), "every tap keeps its offset:\n{asm}");
    assert!(!asm.contains("OpImageGather "), "no plain gather:\n{asm}");
    // The four offsets, in the order of the calls.
    let def = |id: &str| asm.lines().find(|l| l.trim_start().starts_with(&format!("{id} = "))).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let int = |id: &str| def(id).split_whitespace().last().and_then(|v| v.parse::<i32>().ok());
    let offsets: Vec<(i32, i32)> = gathers.iter().map(|l| {
        let c = def(l.split_whitespace().last().unwrap());
        let w: Vec<&str> = c.split_whitespace().collect();
        (int(w[w.len() - 2]).unwrap(), int(w[w.len() - 1]).unwrap())
    }).collect();
    assert_eq!(offsets, vec![(-1, -1), (1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, 1)], "{asm}");
    spirv_val(&spv);
}

use metal2vulkan::inline_and_forward_object_fields;
use std::collections::HashSet;

#[test]
fn named_helper_entry_is_the_branch_target() {
    let source = "\
define internal float @pick(i32 %mode, float %a, float %b) {
allocaBlock:
  br label %block
block:
  switch i32 %mode, label %after [
    i32 4, label %case
  ]
case:
  br label %after
after:
  %value = phi float [ %a, %block ], [ %b, %case ]
  ret float %value
}
define float @main(i32 %mode, float %a, float %b) {
  %result = call float @pick(i32 %mode, float %a, float %b)
  ret float %result
}
";
    let output = inline_and_forward_object_fields(source).expect("helper is inlined");
    assert!(!output.contains("call float @pick"));
    let labels: HashSet<_> = output.lines().filter_map(|line| line.trim().strip_suffix(':')).collect();
    for (_, rest) in output.match_indices("label %").map(|(at, _)| (at, &output[at + 7..])) {
        let target: String = rest.chars().take_while(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || "._-$".contains(*c)).collect();
        assert!(labels.contains(target.as_str()), "undefined target %{target}:\n{output}");
    }
    assert!(output.contains("br label %.inl0.allocaBlock"));
}

fn sampler_phi(intrinsic: &str) -> String {
    format!("\
define {{ float, i8 }} @main(ptr addrspace(1) %tex, ptr addrspace(2) %s0, ptr addrspace(2) %s1, i1 %mode) {{
entry:
  br i1 %mode, label %other, label %after
other:
  br label %after
after:
  %sampler = phi ptr addrspace(2) [ %s0, %entry ], [ %s1, %other ]
  %result = call {{ float, i8 }} @{intrinsic}(ptr addrspace(1) %tex, ptr addrspace(2) %sampler, i32 1)
  ret {{ float, i8 }} %result
}}
")
}

#[test]
fn compare_samples_are_split_by_sampler_state() {
    let source = sampler_phi("air.sample_compare_depth_2d.f32");
    let output = inline_and_forward_object_fields(&source).expect("sampler phi is split");
    assert!(!output.contains("phi ptr addrspace(2)"));
    assert!(output.contains("phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ 1, %other ]"));
    assert!(output.contains("ptr addrspace(2) %s0, i32 1)"));
    assert!(output.contains("ptr addrspace(2) %s1, i32 1)"));
    assert_eq!(output.matches("@air.sample_compare_depth_2d.f32(").count(), 2);
    assert!(output.contains("%result = select i1 "));
}

#[test]
fn unrelated_air_calls_are_not_duplicated() {
    let source = sampler_phi("air.unrelated_side_effect");
    let output = inline_and_forward_object_fields(&source).unwrap_or(source);
    assert!(output.contains("phi ptr addrspace(2)"));
    assert_eq!(output.matches("@air.unrelated_side_effect(").count(), 1);
}

#[test]
fn edge_local_sampler_does_not_become_an_unconditional_read() {
    let source = sampler_phi("air.sample_compare_depth_2d.f32")
        .replace("other:\n", "other:\n  %local = load ptr addrspace(2), ptr null, align 8\n")
        .replace("[ %s1, %other ]", "[ %local, %other ]");
    let output = inline_and_forward_object_fields(&source).unwrap_or(source);
    assert!(output.contains("phi ptr addrspace(2)"));
    assert_eq!(output.matches("@air.sample_compare_depth_2d.f32(").count(), 1);
}

// #449: one field of a local object, written through a bitcast of one GEP and read back through a GEP of another.
fn env_field(read_ty: &str) -> String {
    format!("\
%Envs = type {{ {{ ptr, ptr }}, [2 x {{ ptr, ptr }}] }}
define ptr addrspace(2) @main(ptr byval([2 x ptr addrspace(2)]) %samplers) {{
  %envs = alloca %Envs, align 8
  %array = getelementptr inbounds %Envs, ptr %envs, i64 0, i32 1
  %slot = getelementptr inbounds %Envs, ptr %envs, i64 0, i32 1, i64 1, i32 1
  %slot.cast = bitcast ptr %slot to ptr
  %element = getelementptr inbounds [2 x ptr addrspace(2)], ptr %samplers, i64 0, i64 1
  store ptr %element, ptr %slot.cast, align 8
  %env = getelementptr inbounds [2 x {{ ptr, ptr }}], ptr %array, i64 0, i64 1
  %field = getelementptr inbounds {read_ty}, ptr %env, i64 0, i32 1
  %sampler.ptr = load ptr, ptr %field, align 8
  %wrapped = getelementptr inbounds {{ ptr addrspace(2) }}, ptr %sampler.ptr, i64 0, i32 0
  %sampler = load ptr addrspace(2), ptr %wrapped, align 8
  ret ptr addrspace(2) %sampler
}}
")
}

#[test]
fn a_field_read_through_another_spelling_of_its_address_is_forwarded() {
    let output = inline_and_forward_object_fields(&env_field("{ ptr, ptr }")).expect("the field is forwarded");
    assert!(!output.contains("%sampler.ptr = load"), "the env read must take the stored element:\n{output}");
    assert!(
        output.contains("%wrapped = getelementptr inbounds [2 x ptr addrspace(2)], ptr %samplers, i64 0, i64 1"),
        "the element is one GEP on the byval array, through its wrapper:\n{output}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_read_whose_type_is_not_the_field_layout_is_not_forwarded() {
    // member 1 of `{ i32, i32, ptr }` is at byte 4, member 1 of `{ ptr, ptr }` at byte 8: the same index path, another
    // field, so it must not meet the store
    let output = inline_and_forward_object_fields(&env_field("{ i32, i32, ptr }")).unwrap_or_default();
    assert!(
        output.is_empty() || output.contains("%sampler.ptr = load ptr, ptr %field"),
        "a differently laid out read must keep its load:\n{output}"
    );
}

FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/gl_uniform_vector_loads.rs
================================================
//! Apple's GL compiles a uniform block member as a GEP over float slots of the block's byte buffer and loads the
//! member's own type through it: an ivec3 at offset 0 is `getelementptr float, ptr %ubo, i32 0` then
//! `load <3 x i32>`. Minecraft's chunk vertex shaders read their chunk offset (ivec3) this way; the translator took
//! the zero-offset GEP for the buffer itself and failed "reinterpret load bit width mismatch Float (32) vs
//! Vector(Int(32), 3) (96)", so Apple's GL ran those shaders on the CPU.
//!
//! The same shaders sample the lightmap through a GLSL function taking a sampler2D: Apple's GL passes every
//! texture/sampler pair with the index of the one meant, a constant the caller stores, and picks with a switch whose
//! phis have pointer type over loaded images and samplers ("sampler operand is a pointer whose exact sampler state
//! was not recovered").
use metal2vulkan::passes::Stage;
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_sanitized_native};
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn tmp() -> PathBuf {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_gl_uniform_vector_loads_{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&d);
    d
}

fn spirv_val(spv: &[u8]) {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val").args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2", "-"]).stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped()).stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped()).spawn().and_then(|mut c| {
            use std::io::Write; c.stdin.take().unwrap().write_all(spv)?; c.wait_with_output() });
    if let Ok(out) = out { assert!(out.status.success(), "spirv-val: {}{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr)); }
}

#[test]
fn an_ivec3_uniform_at_offset_zero_of_a_float_gep_translates() {
    let ll = include_str!("fixtures/gl/ivec3_uniform_through_float_gep.ll");
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, Stage::Vertex, &tmp()).expect("the ivec3 uniform load must translate");
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble");
    assert!(asm.contains("OpConvertSToF"), "the ivec3 difference is converted to float:\n{asm}");
    spirv_val(&spv);
}

#[test]
fn a_sampler2d_parameter_chosen_by_a_constant_index_samples_that_pair() {
    let ll = include_str!("fixtures/gl/sampler2d_param_chosen_by_constant.ll");
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, Stage::Vertex, &tmp()).expect("the lightmap lookup must translate");
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble");
    if std::env::var_os("M2V_SHOW_ASM").is_some() { eprintln!("{asm}"); }
    assert!(asm.contains("OpImageSampleExplicitLod"), "{asm}");
    assert!(!asm.lines().any(|l| l.contains("OpPhi") && (l.contains("Image") || l.contains("Sampler"))), "no image/sampler phi left:\n{asm}");
    spirv_val(&spv);
}


// Dome Keeper (Godot's GL compatibility renderer): the helper is called twice, the caller stores the same unit before
// each call, and the emitter lowers the switch over units to a chain of compares (one header per case, the last cases
// joined by an inner phi). The sample must use the pair for unit 3, the third (texture/sampler index 2).
#[test]
fn a_sampler2d_parameter_stored_before_each_of_two_calls_samples_that_pair() {
    let ll = include_str!("fixtures/gl/sampler2d_param_two_calls_switch_chain.ll");
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, Stage::Fragment, &tmp()).expect("the outline lookups must translate");
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble");
    if std::env::var_os("M2V_SHOW_ASM").is_some() { eprintln!("{asm}"); }
    assert!(!asm.lines().any(|l| l.contains("OpPhi") && (l.contains("Image") || l.contains("Sampler"))), "no image/sampler phi left:\n{asm}");
    // Both OpSampledImage combine the third sampler (its variable is bound right after the first two) and the third
    // texture (read from the descriptor heap at the third of the texture slots the shader reads).
    let lines: Vec<Vec<&str>> = asm.lines().map(|l| l.split_whitespace().collect()).collect();
    let def = |id: &str| lines.iter().find(|w| w.len() > 2 && w[0] == id && w[1] == "=").cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    let binding = |var: &str| lines.iter().find(|w| w.len() == 4 && w[0] == "OpDecorate" && w[1] == var && w[2] == "Binding")
        .and_then(|w| w[3].parse::<u32>().ok());
    let constant = |id: &str| { let d = def(id); (d.get(2) == Some(&"OpConstant")).then(|| d.last().and_then(|v| v.parse::<u32>().ok())).flatten() };
    // image = OpLoad (OpAccessChain heap ([OpBitwiseAnd] (OpLoad (OpAccessChain table 0 <slot> 0)) [mask])) -> slot
    let image_slot = |image: &str| -> Option<u32> {
        let load = def(image);
        let chain = def(load.last()?);
        let mut index = def(chain.last()?);
        if index.get(2) == Some(&"OpBitwiseAnd") { index = def(index.get(4)?); }
        if index.get(2) != Some(&"OpLoad") { return None; }
        let table = def(index.last()?);
        constant(table.get(table.len().checked_sub(2)?)?)
    };
    let image_slots: Vec<u32> = lines.iter().filter(|w| w.len() == 5 && w[2] == "OpLoad").filter_map(|w| image_slot(w[0])).collect();
    let sampler_bindings: Vec<u32> = lines.iter().filter(|w| w.len() == 5 && w[2] == "OpLoad").filter_map(|w| binding(w[4])).collect();
    assert_eq!((image_slots.len(), sampler_bindings.len()), (4, 4), "four textures and four samplers are read:\n{asm}");
    let (mut image_slots, mut sampler_bindings) = (image_slots, sampler_bindings);
    image_slots.sort(); sampler_bindings.sort();
    let samples: Vec<&Vec<&str>> = lines.iter().filter(|w| w.contains(&"OpSampledImage")).collect();
    assert_eq!(samples.len(), 2, "{asm}");
    for s in samples {
        let (image, sampler) = (s[s.len() - 2], s[s.len() - 1]);
        assert_eq!(image_slot(image), Some(image_slots[2]), "{image} is not the third texture:\n{asm}");
        assert_eq!(def(sampler).last().and_then(|v| binding(v)), Some(sampler_bindings[2]), "{sampler} is not the third sampler:\n{asm}");
    }
    spirv_val(&spv);
}

FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/global_sampler_table.rs
================================================
//! A program-scope array of samplers (`constexpr constant sampler table[N]`) is a module constant with one struct per
//! element. The emitter refused it ("unsupported global initializer"), so an application that builds such a render shader
//! at start-up (Goodnotes) crashed when it opened any document.
use metal2vulkan::passes::Stage;
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_sanitized_native};

fn tmp() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_global_sampler_table_{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&d);
    d
}

fn sampler_bindings_used(asm: &str) -> Vec<u32> {
    // OpSampledImage %t %image %sampler where the sampler is an OpLoad of a decorated variable
    let mut bindings = Vec::new();
    for line in asm.lines() {
        let Some(rest) = line.trim().strip_prefix("OpDecorate ") else { continue };
        let mut it = rest.split_whitespace();
        let (_var, kind) = (it.next(), it.next());
        if kind == Some("Binding") {
            if let Some(n) = it.next().and_then(|n| n.parse::<u32>().ok()) {
                if n >= 160 && n < 176 {
                    bindings.push(n);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    bindings.sort();
    bindings
}

#[test]
fn a_table_of_static_samplers_indexed_by_constants_samples_with_each_element() {
    let ll = include_str!("fixtures/gl/global_sampler_table_constant_index.ll");
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, Stage::Fragment, &tmp()).expect("the table must translate");
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble");
    assert_eq!(asm.matches("OpImageSampleImplicitLod").count(), 2, "{asm}");
    assert_eq!(sampler_bindings_used(&asm), vec![160, 161], "one sampler per element:\n{asm}");
}

#[test]
fn a_table_of_static_samplers_indexed_at_run_time_samples_once_per_element_and_picks_by_index() {
    let ll = include_str!("fixtures/gl/global_sampler_table_dynamic_index.ll");
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, Stage::Fragment, &tmp()).expect("the table must translate");
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble");
    // table[k] is sampled once per element (2) and table[1] once
    assert_eq!(asm.matches("OpImageSampleImplicitLod").count(), 3, "{asm}");
    assert!(asm.contains("OpSelect"), "the element is picked by the index:\n{asm}");
    assert_eq!(sampler_bindings_used(&asm), vec![160, 161], "{asm}");
}

FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/hwrt_rt_stages.rs

use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};
use metal2vulkan::reflect::{ResourceKind, ShaderReflection};
use metal2vulkan::{
    disassemble, reflect_sanitized, tools, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options,
};
use std::path::PathBuf;

const V_RT: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3-v_rt.ll");
const F_RT: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3-f_rt.ll");
const RQ_ARG: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3-rq_arg.ll");
const RQ: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3-rq.ll");
const V_PLAIN: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3-v_plain.ll");
const RQ_DEV: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3b-rq_dev.ll");
const RQ_OFF: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3b-rq_off.ll");
const RQ_AOS: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3b-rq_aos.ll");
const RQ_SEL: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3b-rq_sel.ll");
const RQ_UNQ: &str = include_str!("fixtures/hwrt/rt3b-rq_unq.ll");

fn tmp(name: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_hwrt_{name}_{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&d);
    d
}

fn translate(ll: &str, stage: Stage) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(ll, stage, TransformOptions::default())
}

fn reflect(ll: &str, stage: Stage) -> ShaderReflection {
    reflect_sanitized(ll, stage, TransformOptions::default()).expect("reflect")
}

fn asm_of(spv: &[u8]) -> String {
    disassemble(spv)
        .expect("disassemble")
        .lines()
        .map(|l| l.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" "))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join("\n")
}

/// A structure passed as `[[buffer(location)]]` is an address, never a descriptor: binding it as one made the driver read
/// a surface state as the BVH address (every Metal RT shader would fault). Its Metal address (the 256-byte header
/// nvmtl_rt_layout.h puts before the Vulkan structure) comes from the buffer-address table, words 0 and 1 of entry
/// `location`, and the Vulkan structure is that address plus 256 (ray_query.rs, load_structure_with_base).
fn assert_structure_from_address_table(asm: &str, location: u32) {
    let structure = asm
        .lines()
        .find(|l| l.ends_with("= OpTypeAccelerationStructureKHR"))
        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().next())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no OpTypeAccelerationStructureKHR in\n{asm}"));
    assert!(
        !asm.lines()
            .any(|l| l.ends_with(&format!("= OpTypePointer UniformConstant {structure}"))),
        "the structure must not be a descriptor\n{asm}"
    );
    let table = asm
        .lines()
        .find(|l| l.starts_with("OpDecorate ") && l.ends_with(" Binding 640"))
        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no buffer-address table (binding 640) in\n{asm}"))
        .to_string();
    let c0 = uint_constant(asm, 0).expect("uint 0");
    let c1 = uint_constant(asm, 1).expect("uint 1");
    let cl = uint_constant(asm, location).expect("uint location");
    for word in [&c0, &c1] {
        assert!(
            asm.lines().any(|l| l.contains("= OpAccessChain ")
                && l.ends_with(&format!(" {table} {c0} {cl} {word}"))),
            "entry {location} of the address table is not read\n{asm}"
        );
    }
    let ulong = asm
        .lines()
        .find(|l| l.ends_with("= OpTypeInt 64 0"))
        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().next())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no ulong type in\n{asm}"))
        .to_string();
    let header = asm
        .lines()
        .find(|l| l.ends_with(&format!("= OpConstant {ulong} 256")))
        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().next())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no 256-byte header offset in\n{asm}"))
        .to_string();
    assert!(
        asm.lines()
            .any(|l| l.contains("= OpIAdd ") && l.ends_with(&format!(" {header}"))),
        "{asm}"
    );
    assert!(asm.contains("OpConvertUToAccelerationStructureKHR"), "{asm}");
}

fn uint_constant(asm: &str, value: u32) -> Option<String> {
    let uint_ty = asm
        .lines()
        .find(|l| l.ends_with("= OpTypeInt 32 0"))
        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().next())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no uint type in\n{asm}"))
        .to_string();
    asm.lines()
        .find(|l| l.ends_with(&format!("= OpConstant {uint_ty} {value}")))
        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().next())
        .map(str::to_string)
}

fn has_word_chain(asm: &str, word: u32) -> bool {
    let (Some(c0), Some(cw)) = (uint_constant(asm, 0), uint_constant(asm, word)) else {
        return false;
    };
    asm.lines()
        .any(|l| l.contains("= OpAccessChain ") && l.ends_with(&format!(" {c0} {cw}")))
}

fn shadow_binding(r: &ShaderReflection, metal_index: u32) -> (Option<u32>, Option<(u32, u32)>) {
    let b = r
        .bindings
        .iter()
        .find(|b| {
            b.kind == ResourceKind::AccelerationStructureShadow && b.metal_index == metal_index
        })
        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
            panic!(
                "no AccelerationStructureShadow at buffer {metal_index} in {:?}",
                r.bindings
            )
        });
    (
        b.param_index,
        b.descriptor.as_ref().map(|d| (d.set, d.binding)),
    )
}

#[test]
fn v_rt_vertex_acceleration_structure_at_buffer_0_translates_and_binds_like_a_buffer() {
    let t = tmp("v_rt");
    let result = translate(V_RT, Stage::Vertex);
    assert!(result.is_ok(), "v_rt must translate: {:?}", result.err());
    let spv = result.unwrap();
    let asm = asm_of(&spv);
    // the structure is `as [[buffer(0)]]`
    assert_structure_from_address_table(&asm, 0);
    assert!(asm.contains("OpRayQueryInitializeKHR"), "{asm}");
    let r = reflect(V_RT, Stage::Vertex);
    let (param, descriptor) = shadow_binding(&r, 0);
    assert_eq!(param, Some(1));
    assert_eq!(descriptor, Some((0, 0)));
    let rk = reflect(RQ, Stage::Kernel);
    assert_eq!(shadow_binding(&rk, 0).1, descriptor);
    tools::spirv_val_bytes(&spv, &t).expect("spirv-val v_rt");
}

#[test]
fn f_rt_fragment_acceleration_structure_at_buffer_0_translates_and_binds_like_a_buffer() {
    let t = tmp("f_rt");
    let result = translate(F_RT, Stage::Fragment);
    assert!(result.is_ok(), "f_rt must translate: {:?}", result.err());
    let spv = result.unwrap();
    let asm = asm_of(&spv);
    // the structure is `as [[buffer(0)]]`
    assert_structure_from_address_table(&asm, 0);
    assert!(asm.contains("OpRayQueryInitializeKHR"), "{asm}");
    let r = reflect(F_RT, Stage::Fragment);
    let (param, descriptor) = shadow_binding(&r, 0);
    assert_eq!(param, Some(4));
    assert_eq!(descriptor, Some((0, 0)));
    tools::spirv_val_bytes(&spv, &t).expect("spirv-val f_rt");
}

#[test]
fn v_plain_vertex_without_a_structure_mints_no_structure() {
    let t = tmp("v_plain");
    let spv = translate(V_PLAIN, Stage::Vertex).expect("v_plain translates");
    let asm = asm_of(&spv);
    assert!(!asm.contains("OpTypeAccelerationStructureKHR"), "{asm}");
    let r = reflect(V_PLAIN, Stage::Vertex);
    assert!(
        !r.bindings
            .iter()
            .any(|b| b.kind == ResourceKind::AccelerationStructureShadow),
        "{:?}",
        r.bindings
    );
    tools::spirv_val_bytes(&spv, &t).expect("spirv-val v_plain");
}

fn assert_converts_the_address(name: &str, ll: &str) -> String {
    let t = tmp(name);
    let result = translate(ll, Stage::Kernel);
    assert!(result.is_ok(), "{name} must translate: {:?}", result.err());
    let spv = result.unwrap();
    let asm = asm_of(&spv);
    assert!(
        asm.contains("OpConvertUToAccelerationStructureKHR"),
        "{name}: {asm}"
    );
    assert!(asm.contains("OpRayQueryInitializeKHR"), "{name}: {asm}");
    tools::spirv_val_bytes(&spv, &t).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("spirv-val {name}: {e}"));
    asm
}

#[test]
fn rq_arg_structure_in_a_constant_argument_buffer_converts_the_loaded_address() {
    let asm = assert_converts_the_address("rq_arg", RQ_ARG);
    assert!(has_word_chain(&asm, 0), "{asm}");
    assert!(has_word_chain(&asm, 1), "{asm}");
}

#[test]
fn rq_dev_structure_in_a_device_argument_buffer_converts_the_loaded_address() {
    assert_converts_the_address("rq_dev", RQ_DEV);
}

#[test]
fn rq_off_structure_field_at_byte_16_reads_words_4_and_5() {
    let asm = assert_converts_the_address("rq_off", RQ_OFF);
    assert!(has_word_chain(&asm, 4), "{asm}");
    assert!(has_word_chain(&asm, 5), "{asm}");
    assert!(
        !has_word_chain(&asm, 2) && !has_word_chain(&asm, 3),
        "field `a` (words 2, 3) must not be read\n{asm}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn rq_sel_select_of_two_structures_is_refused_by_name() {

fn assert_keeps_pointer_load(input: &str, name: &str) {
    let output = inline_and_forward_object_fields(input).unwrap_or_else(|| input.to_string());
    assert!(output.contains(name), "a possibly clobbered or uninitialized field must remain a load:\n{output}");

#[test]
fn a_nonentry_store_dominating_both_loop_loads_preserves_the_local_root() {
    let output = inline_and_forward_object_fields(DOMINATING).expect("the immutable field must forward");
    for load in ["%first = load ptr", "%later = load ptr"] {
        assert!(!output.contains(load), "{output}");
    }
    let bytes = translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(&output, Stage::Kernel, TransformOptions::default())
        .expect("the two loop-edge pointers now have the same real alloca source");
    let scratch = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_immutable_fields_{}", std::process::id()));
    let verdict = metal2vulkan::tools::spirv_val_bytes(&bytes, &scratch);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(scratch);
    verdict.expect("the forwarded kernel must validate as Vulkan 1.2 SPIR-V");
}

FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/instruction_metadata.rs

use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options};

const KERNEL: &str = r#"
target triple = "air64-apple-macosx11.0.0"
define void @metadata_probe(ptr addrspace(1) %out) {
entry:
  %input = load i32, ptr addrspace(1) %out
  %condition = icmp eq i32 %input, 0
  br i1 %condition, label %left, label %right
left:
  br label %merge
right:
  br label %merge
merge:
  %value = phi i32 [ 7, %left ], [ %input, %right ]ATTACHMENT
  %pair = insertvalue { i32, i32 } undef, i32 %value, 0ATTACHMENT
  %result = extractvalue { i32, i32 } %pair, 0ATTACHMENT
  %wide = zext i32 %result to i64ATTACHMENT
  %narrow = trunc i64 %wide to i32ATTACHMENT
  %vector = insertelement <2 x i32> undef, i32 %narrow, i32 0ATTACHMENT
  %splat = shufflevector <2 x i32> %vector, <2 x i32> undef, <2 x i32> zeroinitializerATTACHMENT
  %scalar = extractelement <2 x i32> %splat, i32 1ATTACHMENT
  store i32 %scalar, ptr addrspace(1) %out
  ret voidATTACHMENT
}
!air.kernel = !{!0}
!0 = !{ptr @metadata_probe, !1, !2}
!1 = !{}
!2 = !{!3}
!3 = !{i32 0, !"air.buffer", !"air.buffer_size", i32 4, !"air.location_index", i32 0, i32 1, !"air.read_write", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"out"}
!20 = !{}
!21 = !{i32 1}
"#;

#[test]
fn phi_and_aggregate_metadata_preserve_translated_instructions() {
    let translate = |attachment| {
        let source = KERNEL.replace("ATTACHMENT", attachment);
        let spv = translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(
            &source, Stage::Kernel, TransformOptions::default(),
        ).expect("instruction metadata must not become an operand");
        disassemble(&spv).expect("SPIR-V disassembles")
    };
    let baseline = translate("");
    assert!(baseline.contains("OpStore"));
    assert!(baseline.contains("OpPhi"));
    assert_eq!(translate(", !dbg !20"), baseline);
    assert_eq!(translate(", !dbg !20, !custom !21"), baseline);
}



================================================
FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/kernel_stage_in_layout.rs
================================================
//! A compute pipeline's `[[stage_in]]` attributes are read from the buffer by the stride, offset and format of its stage-input
//! descriptor. The translator used to read each member as an array of its own type at its natural size, so a float3 attribute
//! in a 12-byte stride came out misaligned from the second element on (189 of 192 components wrong in a copy test), and a
//! struct with several attributes needed one buffer per member instead of the one the application bound.
use metal2vulkan::passes::{
    KernelStageIn, StageInAttribute, StageInFormat, StageInLayout, StageInStep, Stage, TransformOptions,
};
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options};

const KERNEL: &str = include_str!("fixtures/gl/kernel_stage_in_three_attributes.ll");

fn layout(stride: u32, offsets: [u32; 3]) -> KernelStageIn {
    let mut s = KernelStageIn::default();
    s.attributes[0] = Some(StageInAttribute { attribute: 0, buffer_index: 1, offset: offsets[0], format: StageInFormat::Float3 });
    s.attributes[1] = Some(StageInAttribute { attribute: 1, buffer_index: 1, offset: offsets[1], format: StageInFormat::UChar4Normalized });
    s.attributes[2] = Some(StageInAttribute { attribute: 2, buffer_index: 1, offset: offsets[2], format: StageInFormat::Float2 });
    s.layouts[0] = Some(StageInLayout { buffer_index: 1, stride, step: StageInStep::GridX, rate: 1 });
    s
}

fn translate(stage_in: KernelStageIn) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(
        KERNEL,
        Stage::Kernel,
        TransformOptions { kernel_stage_in: stage_in, ..TransformOptions::default() },
    )
}

fn spirv_val(spv: &[u8]) {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val")
        .args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2", "-"])
        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .spawn()
        .and_then(|mut c| {
            use std::io::Write;
            c.stdin.take().unwrap().write_all(spv)?;
            c.wait_with_output()
        });
    if let Ok(out) = out {
        assert!(out.status.success(), "spirv-val: {}{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr));
    }
}

#[test]
fn three_attributes_in_one_24_byte_stride_are_read_from_one_buffer_by_the_descriptor() {
    let spv = translate(layout(24, [0, 12, 16])).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("the layout must translate: {e}"));
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble");
    // the kernel's own output array, and one runtime array of 32-bit words for all three attributes
    assert_eq!(asm.matches("OpTypeRuntimeArray").count(), 2, "{asm}");
    assert!(asm.lines().any(|l| l.trim_end().ends_with("OpConstant  %7  6") || l.contains("OpIMul") && asm.contains("  6\n")), "the element stride is six words:\n{asm}");
    // 3 + 1 + 2 words are loaded, and the packed bytes are unpacked as unorm
    assert!(asm.contains("UnpackUnorm4x8"), "{asm}");
    assert!(asm.matches("OpAccessChain").count() >= 6, "{asm}");
    spirv_val(&spv);
}

#[test]
fn a_12_byte_stride_changes_the_element_step_and_nothing_else() {
    let wide = translate(layout(24, [0, 12, 16])).unwrap();
    let narrow = translate(layout(12, [0, 0, 0])).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}"));
    assert_ne!(wide, narrow, "the stride is part of the module");
    let asm = disassemble(&narrow).unwrap();
    assert!(asm.contains("  3\n") && asm.contains("OpIMul"), "a 12-byte stride steps three words per element:\n{asm}");
    spirv_val(&narrow);
}

#[test]
fn a_stride_that_is_not_a_whole_number_of_words_is_refused_not_misread() {
    match translate(layout(22, [0, 12, 16])) {
        Ok(spv) => panic!("a 22-byte stride translated ({} bytes)", spv.len()),
        Err(e) => assert!(e.contains("4-byte aligned"), "{e}"),
    }
}

#[test]
fn without_a_descriptor_the_old_layout_stays() {
    let spv = translate(KernelStageIn::default()).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}"));
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).unwrap();
    assert!(asm.matches("OpTypeRuntimeArray").count() >= 4, "one array per member and the output as before:\n{asm}");
}
