FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/sparse_access_counters.rs
================================================
//! Metal sparse textures, tier 2: per-tile access counters (`TransformOptions::sparse_access_counters`, the plugin's
//! NVMTL_SPARSE_TIER2; src/sparse_counters.rs). Every texel read of a texture the module loads from the bindless heap
//! calls one helper, which reads the heap slot's directory element and adds to the tile's counter. The fixtures are the
//! sparse probes of `fixtures/sparse/probe.metal` (AIR from Apple's compiler) and, for "nothing else changes", every
//! `.ll` fixture of this crate.
use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};
use metal2vulkan::sparse_counters::{COUNTER_HEAP_SLOT, HELPER_NAME};
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options};

fn spirv_val(spv: &[u8]) {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val")
        .args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2", "-"])
        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .spawn()
        .and_then(|mut c| {
            use std::io::Write;
            c.stdin.take().unwrap().write_all(spv)?;
            c.wait_with_output()
        });
    if let Ok(out) = out {
        assert!(out.status.success(), "spirv-val: {}{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr));
    }
}

fn options(residency: bool, counters: bool) -> TransformOptions {
    TransformOptions { sparse_residency: residency, sparse_access_counters: counters, ..TransformOptions::default() }
}

fn translate(ll: &str, stage: Stage, o: TransformOptions) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(ll, stage, o)
}

fn name(ll: &str) -> &str {
    ll.lines().find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("source_filename = ")).unwrap_or("?")
}

fn count(asm: &str, word: &str) -> usize {
    asm.split_whitespace().filter(|w| *w == word).count()
}

/// The helper's id (from its OpName)
fn helper(asm: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let tail = format!("\"{HELPER_NAME}\"");
    asm.lines().find_map(|l| {
        let w: Vec<&str> = l.split_whitespace().collect();
        (w.first() == Some(&"OpName") && w.get(2) == Some(&tail.as_str())).then(|| w[1].to_string())
    })
}

/// The ids of the helper's calls' arguments: (slot, level, slice, coordinates, normalized)
fn calls(asm: &str) -> Vec<Vec<String>> {
    let Some(callee) = helper(asm) else { return Vec::new() };
    asm.lines()
        .filter(|l| l.contains("OpFunctionCall") && l.split_whitespace().any(|w| w == callee))
        .map(|l| l.split_whitespace().skip_while(|w| *w != callee).skip(1).map(str::to_string).collect())
        .collect()
}

/// The instruction that defines `id` (its words after `=`)
fn def(asm: &str, id: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    asm.lines()
        .find_map(|l| l.trim().strip_prefix(&format!("{id} = ")).map(|r| r.split_whitespace().map(str::to_string).collect()))
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

/// The heap reads each fixture makes, all counted: (fixture, the level argument's kind)
const COUNTED: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_2d.ll"), "querylod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_level_2d.ll"), "lod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_grad_2d.ll"), "grad"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_minlod_2d.ll"), "querylod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_read_2d.ll"), "fetch"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_gather_2d.ll"), "zero"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_2da_half.ll"), "querylod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_read_3d_uint.ll"), "fetch"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_cube.ll"), "querylod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_depth_read.ll"), "fetch"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_value_only.ll"), "querylod"),
];

#[test]
fn every_heap_texel_read_counts_its_tile() {
    for residency in [true, false] {
        for (ll, level) in COUNTED {
            let n = name(ll);
            let spv = translate(ll, Stage::Fragment, options(residency, true)).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{n}: {e}"));
            spirv_val(&spv);
            let asm = disassemble(&spv).unwrap();
            let c = calls(&asm);
            assert_eq!(c.len(), 1, "{n}: one counted read\n{asm}");
            let h = helper(&asm).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(def(&asm, &h).first().map(String::as_str), Some("OpFunction"), "{n}: one helper\n{asm}");
            assert_eq!(count(&asm, "OpAtomicIAdd"), 1, "{n}: one atomic, in the helper\n{asm}");
            assert_eq!(count(&asm, "OpGroupNonUniformBallot"), 1, "{n}: the subgroup's lanes on one tile add once\n{asm}");
            assert!(asm.contains("BuiltIn HelperInvocation"), "{n}: helper invocations count nothing\n{asm}");
            // the directory (binding 3) and counters (binding 4) of the reserved slot of the heap set
            for binding in [3, 4] {
                let var = asm.lines().find_map(|l| {
                    let w: Vec<&str> = l.split_whitespace().collect();
                    (w.len() == 4 && w[0] == "OpDecorate" && w[2] == "Binding" && w[3] == binding.to_string()).then(|| w[1].to_string())
                });
                let var = var.unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{n}: heap binding {binding}\n{asm}"));
                assert!(asm.lines().any(|l| l.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>() == ["OpDecorate", var.as_str(), "DescriptorSet", "2"]),
                        "{n}: binding {binding} in the heap set\n{asm}");
            }
            let uint = asm.lines().find_map(|l| l.trim().strip_suffix(" = OpTypeInt 32 0").map(str::to_string)).unwrap();
            let slot = COUNTER_HEAP_SLOT.to_string();
            assert!(asm.lines().any(|l| l.split_whitespace().skip(2).collect::<Vec<_>>() == ["OpConstant", uint.as_str(), slot.as_str()]),
                    "{n}: the reserved slot {COUNTER_HEAP_SLOT}\n{asm}");
            assert!(asm.contains(&format!("OpTypeImage {uint} Buffer 0 0 0 2 R32ui")) && asm.contains(&format!("OpTypeImage {uint} Buffer 0 0 0 1 Unknown")),
                    "{n}: the counter and directory views\n{asm}");
            let args = &c[0];
            let level_arg = args[1].as_str();
            match *level {
                "querylod" => assert!(count(&asm, "OpImageQueryLod") == 1 && asm.contains("OpCapability ImageQuery"),
                                      "{n}: the implicit LOD of the fragment\n{asm}"),
                "grad" => assert!(count(&asm, "OpImageQuerySizeLod") == 1 && asm.contains("Log2") && count(&asm, "OpImageQueryLod") == 0,
                                  "{n}: log2 of the scaled gradient\n{asm}"),
                "lod" => assert!(count(&asm, "OpImageQueryLod") == 0 && count(&asm, "OpImageQuerySizeLod") == 0, "{n}: the level() argument\n{asm}"),
                "fetch" => assert!(asm.lines().any(|l| l.contains("Fetch") && l.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().windows(2).any(|w| w == ["Lod", level_arg]))
                                   || def(&asm, level_arg).first().map(String::as_str) == Some("OpBitcast"),
                                   "{n}: the fetch's LOD is the level ({level_arg})\n{asm}"),
                "zero" => assert_eq!(def(&asm, level_arg), ["OpConstant", uint.as_str(), "0"], "{n}: a gather reads level 0\n{asm}"),
                _ => unreachable!(),
            }
            // normalized coordinates for samples and gathers, texels for reads
            let want = if *level == "fetch" { "OpConstantFalse" } else { "OpConstantTrue" };
            assert_eq!(def(&asm, &args[4]).first().map(String::as_str), Some(want), "{n}\n{asm}");
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn reads_that_cannot_be_of_a_sparse_texture_are_not_counted() {
    // depth compares (a depth texture is never sparse here) and a read-write texture bound directly (no heap slot)
    for ll in [
        include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_depth_compare.ll"),
        include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_depth_gather_compare.ll"),
        include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_rw_read.ll"),
    ] {
        let n = name(ll);
        for residency in [true, false] {
            let off = translate(ll, Stage::Fragment, options(residency, false)).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{n}: {e}"));
            let on = translate(ll, Stage::Fragment, options(residency, true)).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{n}: {e}"));
            assert_eq!(on, off, "{n}: nothing to count, the module is unchanged");
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_count_is_off_by_default() {

fn fixtures(dir: &std::path::Path, out: &mut Vec<std::path::PathBuf>) {
    let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else { return };
    for e in rd.flatten() {
        let p = e.path();
        if p.is_dir() {
            fixtures(&p, out);
        } else if p.extension().is_some_and(|x| x == "ll") {
            out.push(p);
        }
    }
}

/// The corpus: with the counters off every module is what the default options give, and with them on a module changes
/// only when it reads a heap texture, and then it validates.
#[test]
fn the_corpus_changes_only_where_a_heap_texture_is_read() {
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    fixtures(&std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures"), &mut files);
    fixtures(&std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("src/testdata"), &mut files);
    files.sort();
    let (mut units, mut counted, mut stages_counted) = (0, 0, std::collections::BTreeSet::new());
    for f in &files {
        let ll = std::fs::read_to_string(f).unwrap();
        for (tag, st) in [("!air.vertex =", Stage::Vertex), ("!air.fragment =", Stage::Fragment), ("!air.kernel =", Stage::Kernel)] {
            if !ll.contains(tag) {
                continue;
            }
            let Ok(default) = translate(&ll, st, TransformOptions::default()) else { continue };
            units += 1;
            let off = translate(&ll, st, options(false, false)).expect("translates as with the default options");
            assert_eq!(off, default, "{}: counters off must be byte-identical", f.display());
            let on = translate(&ll, st, options(false, true)).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{}: {e}", f.display()));
            if on == off {
                continue;
            }
            let asm = disassemble(&on).unwrap();
            assert!(helper(&asm).is_some() && !calls(&asm).is_empty(), "{}: changed without counting\n{asm}", f.display());
            spirv_val(&on);
            counted += 1;
            stages_counted.insert(format!("{st:?}"));
        }
    }
    eprintln!("corpus: {units} modules, {counted} count heap texel reads, stages {stages_counted:?}");
    assert!(units > 50, "the corpus translated only {units} modules");
    assert!(counted > 0, "no module of the corpus reads a heap texture");
}



================================================
FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/sparse_residency.rs
================================================
//! Sparse-texture residency: `sparse_color<T>` from `sparse_sample`, `sparse_read`, `sparse_gather`,
//! `sparse_sample_compare` and `sparse_gather_compare`. Apple's frontend emits the same intrinsic as the plain call, whose
//! `{ T, i8 }` result carries the residency in member 1 (nonzero: not resident); the sparse form only extracts it. The
//! fixtures are the AIR Apple's compiler (Metal 4.1, AIR 2.9) made of `fixtures/sparse/probe.metal`.
//!
//! With `TransformOptions::sparse_residency` (the plugin's NVMTL_SPARSE_TEXTURES) a read residency becomes the call's
//! OpImageSparse* twin and OpImageSparseTexelsResident; without it every texture is resident and the flag is 0. Before
//! this the flag was OpUndef: a shader branching on `resident()` took either side.
use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options};

fn spirv_val(spv: &[u8]) {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val")
        .args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2", "-"])
        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .spawn()
        .and_then(|mut c| {
            use std::io::Write;
            c.stdin.take().unwrap().write_all(spv)?;
            c.wait_with_output()
        });
    if let Ok(out) = out {
        assert!(out.status.success(), "spirv-val: {}{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr));
    }
}

fn translate(ll: &str, sparse: bool) -> Result<String, String> {
    let options = TransformOptions { sparse_residency: sparse, ..TransformOptions::default() };
    let spv = translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(ll, Stage::Fragment, options)?;
    spirv_val(&spv);
    disassemble(&spv)
}

/// (fixture, the sparse instruction it must become, the plain instruction it must no longer use)
const RESIDENT: &[(&str, &str, &str)] = &[
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_2d.ll"), "OpImageSparseSampleImplicitLod", "OpImageSampleImplicitLod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_level_2d.ll"), "OpImageSparseSampleExplicitLod", "OpImageSampleExplicitLod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_grad_2d.ll"), "OpImageSparseSampleExplicitLod", "OpImageSampleExplicitLod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_minlod_2d.ll"), "OpImageSparseSampleImplicitLod", "OpImageSampleImplicitLod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_read_2d.ll"), "OpImageSparseFetch", "OpImageFetch"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_gather_2d.ll"), "OpImageSparseGather", "OpImageGather"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_2da_half.ll"), "OpImageSparseSampleImplicitLod", "OpImageSampleImplicitLod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_read_3d_uint.ll"), "OpImageSparseFetch", "OpImageFetch"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_sample_cube.ll"), "OpImageSparseSampleImplicitLod", "OpImageSampleImplicitLod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_depth_compare.ll"), "OpImageSparseSampleDrefImplicitLod", "OpImageSampleDrefImplicitLod"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_depth_gather_compare.ll"), "OpImageSparseDrefGather", "OpImageDrefGather"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_depth_read.ll"), "OpImageSparseFetch", "OpImageFetch"),
    (include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_rw_read.ll"), "OpImageSparseRead", "OpImageRead"),
];

fn count(asm: &str, op: &str) -> usize {
    asm.split_whitespace().filter(|w| *w == op).count()
}

#[test]
fn residency_reads_become_sparse_image_instructions() {
    for (ll, sparse_op, plain_op) in RESIDENT {
        let name = ll.lines().find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("source_filename = ")).unwrap_or("?");
        let asm = translate(ll, true).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{name}: must translate: {e}"));
        assert_eq!(count(&asm, sparse_op), 1, "{name}: one {sparse_op}\n{asm}");
        assert_eq!(count(&asm, plain_op), 0, "{name}: the plain {plain_op} is replaced\n{asm}");
        assert_eq!(count(&asm, "OpImageSparseTexelsResident"), 1, "{name}: one residency query\n{asm}");
        assert!(asm.contains("OpCapability SparseResidency"), "{name}: SparseResidency declared\n{asm}");
        // the flag Metal reads is 0 when resident: a select of the residency between 0 and 1
        let resident = asm.lines().find_map(|l| l.split_once(" = OpImageSparseTexelsResident").map(|(id, _)| id.trim().to_string()))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        assert!(asm.lines().any(|l| l.contains("OpSelect") && l.split_whitespace().nth(4) == Some(resident.as_str())),
                "{name}: the AIR flag is selected by the residency {resident}\n{asm}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn without_sparse_textures_every_texture_reads_resident() {
    for (ll, sparse_op, plain_op) in RESIDENT {
        let name = ll.lines().find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("source_filename = ")).unwrap_or("?");
        let asm = translate(ll, false).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{name}: must translate: {e}"));
        assert_eq!(count(&asm, sparse_op), 0, "{name}: no {sparse_op} without sparse textures\n{asm}");
        assert_eq!(count(&asm, plain_op), 1, "{name}: the plain {plain_op}\n{asm}");
        assert!(!asm.contains("SparseResidency") && !asm.contains("OpImageSparseTexelsResident"), "{name}\n{asm}");
        // the flag is the constant 0 (resident), not an undefined value a branch on resident() could take either way
        let uchar = asm.lines().find_map(|l| l.split_once(" = OpTypeInt").filter(|(_, r)| r.split_whitespace().next() == Some("8"))
            .map(|(id, _)| id.trim().to_string()));
        if let Some(uchar) = uchar {
            assert!(!asm.lines().any(|l| { let w: Vec<&str> = l.split_whitespace().collect(); w.get(2) == Some(&"OpUndef") && w.get(3) == Some(&uchar.as_str()) }),
                    "{name}: no undefined residency\n{asm}");
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_call_whose_residency_is_not_read_stays_plain() {
    let asm = translate(include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_value_only.ll"), true).expect("must translate");
    assert!(!asm.contains("OpImageSparse") && !asm.contains("SparseResidency"), "{asm}");
    assert_eq!(count(&asm, "OpImageSampleImplicitLod"), 1, "{asm}");
}

#[test]
fn a_residency_the_lowering_computes_from_several_texels_is_refused() {
    let ll = include_str!("fixtures/sparse/sp_pixel_array_refused.ll");
    let err = translate(ll, true).expect_err("a filtered pixel-coordinate sample has no single residency");
    assert!(err.contains("sparse_color::resident() is read") && err.contains("cannot be expressed"), "{err}");
    // without sparse textures the same shader translates: every texture is resident
    translate(ll, false).expect("resident without sparse textures");
}

use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};

#[test]
fn vertex_outputs_survive_a_buffer_layout_type_alias() {

        )), "{decoration} output is never written");
    }

fn with_attribute(template: &str, attr: &str) -> String {
    let spliced = template.replace("ATTR", attr);
    assert_ne!(spliced, template, "template has no ATTR splice point");
    spliced
}

fn translate(template: &str, attr: &str, stage: Stage) -> Result<String, String> {
    let ll = with_attribute(template, attr);
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(&ll, stage, &tmp()).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
    Ok(disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble"))
}

fn dispatch(template: &str, attr: &str, local_size: [u32; 3]) -> Result<String, String> {
    let ll = with_attribute(template, attr);
    let options = TransformOptions {
        kernel_local_size: local_size,
        kernel_dispatch: Some(KernelDispatch::Workgroups),
        ..TransformOptions::default()
    };
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native_with_options(&ll, Stage::Kernel, &tmp(), options)?;
    Ok(disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble"))
}

fn execution_modes(asm: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    asm.lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("OpExecutionMode "))
        .filter_map(|rest| rest.split_once(' ').map(|(_, mode)| mode.to_string()))
        .collect()
}

#[test]
fn early_fragment_tests_reaches_the_execution_mode() {
    let declared = translate(FRAGMENT, ", !\"early_fragment_tests\"", Stage::Fragment)
        .expect("fragment declaring early_fragment_tests translates");
    assert!(
        execution_modes(&declared)
            .iter()
            .any(|mode| mode == "EarlyFragmentTests"),
        "a fragment declaring early_fragment_tests must say so in SPIR-V:\n{declared}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_fragment_that_did_not_ask_for_early_tests_does_not_get_them() {
    let plain = translate(FRAGMENT, "", Stage::Fragment).expect("plain fragment translates");
    assert!(
        !execution_modes(&plain)
            .iter()
            .any(|mode| mode == "EarlyFragmentTests"),
        "nothing declared early_fragment_tests:\n{plain}"
    );
    assert!(
        execution_modes(&plain)
            .iter()
            .any(|mode| mode == "OriginUpperLeft"),
        "the fragment's ordinary modes must survive:\n{plain}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn early_fragment_tests_and_a_written_test_value_are_refused() {
    for (template, role) in [
        (FRAGMENT_WITH_DEPTH, "air.depth"),
        (FRAGMENT_WITH_STENCIL, "air.stencil"),
    ] {
        let error = translate(template, ", !\"early_fragment_tests\"", Stage::Fragment)
            .expect_err("a fragment cannot write a test value and demand the test run first");
        assert!(
            error.contains("early_fragment_tests") && error.contains(role),
            "the refusal must name both halves of the contradiction: {error}"
        );

        translate(template, "", Stage::Fragment)
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("writing {role} alone must translate: {error}"));
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_dispatch_past_the_declared_threadgroup_ceiling_is_refused() {
    let ceiling =
        |threads: u32| format!(", !6}}\n!6 = !{{!\"air.max_work_group_size\", i32 {threads}");

    let error =
        dispatch(KERNEL, &ceiling(32), [64, 1, 1]).expect_err("64 threads is past a ceiling of 32");
    assert!(
        error.contains("air.max_work_group_size") && error.contains("32"),
        "the refusal must name the ceiling it read: {error}"
    );

    for (attr, local_size) in [
        (ceiling(32), [8u32, 2, 2]),
        (ceiling(64), [64, 1, 1]),
        (ceiling(729), [9, 9, 9]),
    ] {
        let [x, y, z] = local_size;
        let asm = dispatch(KERNEL, &attr, local_size)
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{x}x{y}x{z} must fit `{attr}`: {error}"));
        assert!(
            execution_modes(&asm)
                .iter()
                .any(|mode| mode == &format!("LocalSize {x} {y} {z}")),
            "the requested local size must still be emitted:\n{asm}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn the_reflected_threadgroup_ceiling_is_the_one_translation_enforces() {
    let declared = with_attribute(KERNEL, ", !6}\n!6 = !{!\"air.max_work_group_size\", i32 64");
    let reflection = reflect_sanitized(&declared, Stage::Kernel, TransformOptions::default())
        .expect("reflection reports the ceiling rather than enforcing it");
    let ceiling = reflection
        .max_work_group_size
        .expect("the kernel declares a ceiling");
    assert_eq!(ceiling, 64);

    let at = [8, ceiling / 8, 1];
    let past = [8, ceiling / 8, 2];
    dispatch(
        KERNEL,
        ", !6}\n!6 = !{!\"air.max_work_group_size\", i32 64",
        at,
    )
    .expect("a dispatch of exactly the reported ceiling translates");
    let error = dispatch(
        KERNEL,
        ", !6}\n!6 = !{!\"air.max_work_group_size\", i32 64",
        past,
    )
    .expect_err("a dispatch past the reported ceiling is refused");
    assert!(
        error.contains(&ceiling.to_string()),
        "the refusal must cite the ceiling reflection reported: {error}"
    );

    let plain = with_attribute(KERNEL, "");
    let plain_reflection = reflect_sanitized(&plain, Stage::Kernel, TransformOptions::default())
        .expect("a kernel with no ceiling still reflects");
    assert_eq!(plain_reflection.max_work_group_size, None);
    dispatch(KERNEL, "", [16, 16, 4]).expect("an undeclared ceiling bounds nothing");
}

#[test]
fn an_attribute_no_stage_models_is_refused_by_name() {
    let cases = [
        (FRAGMENT, Stage::Fragment, "fragment"),
        (KERNEL, Stage::Kernel, "kernel"),
        (VERTEX, Stage::Vertex, "vertex"),
    ];
    for (template, stage, label) in cases {
        translate(template, "", stage)
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{label} must translate with a bare root: {error}"));

        let error = match translate(template, ", !\"air.invented_stage_attribute\"", stage) {
            Ok(asm) => panic!("{label} accepted an unmodelled attribute:\n{asm}"),
            Err(error) => error,
        };
        assert!(
            error.contains("air.invented_stage_attribute"),
            "the {label} refusal must name the attribute it could not read: {error}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn an_attribute_belonging_to_another_stage_is_not_silently_accepted() {
    let error = translate(KERNEL, ", !\"early_fragment_tests\"", Stage::Kernel)
        .expect_err("a kernel has no fragment tests to run early");
    assert!(
        error.contains("early_fragment_tests"),
        "the refusal must name the attribute: {error}"
    );
}



================================================
FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/struct_wrapped_array_vector_loads.rs
================================================
//! A vector read through a pointer to a struct whose first member is a scalar array of the vector's size.
//!
//! DaVinci Resolve's viewer vertex shader takes a buffer of `struct Slot { packed_uint4 words; }` (LLVM
//! `{ { [4 x i32] } }`) and, after the compiler's scalar replacement, reads a slot as one `load <4 x float>` through the
//! slot struct. The emitter lowered a vector read of a bare scalar array but refused one behind struct wrappers
//! ("cannot reinterpret load ... with non-bitcastable pointee"), the pipeline never built, and the viewer drew nothing.
use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options};

const WRAPPED: &str = r#"target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.7.0"

%struct.Slot = type { { [4 x i32] } }

define <{ <4 x float> }> @vs(ptr addrspace(2) readonly %slots, i32 %vid) {
entry:
  %n = zext i32 %vid to i64
  %slot = getelementptr inbounds %struct.Slot, ptr addrspace(2) %slots, i64 %n
  %v = load <4 x float>, ptr addrspace(2) %slot, align 16
  %next = getelementptr inbounds %struct.Slot, ptr addrspace(2) %slots, i64 1
  %w = load <4 x float>, ptr addrspace(2) %next, align 16
  %sum = fadd fast <4 x float> %v, %w
  %ret = insertvalue <{ <4 x float> }> undef, <4 x float> %sum, 0
  ret <{ <4 x float> }> %ret
}

!air.vertex = !{!0}
!air.version = !{!7}
!air.language_version = !{!8}

!0 = !{ptr @vs, !1, !3}
!1 = !{!2}
!2 = !{!"air.position", !"air.arg_type_name", !"float4", !"air.arg_name", !"position"}
!3 = !{!4, !6}
!4 = !{i32 0, !"air.buffer", !"air.location_index", i32 0, i32 1, !"air.read", !"air.address_space", i32 2, !"air.struct_type_info", !5, !"air.arg_type_size", i32 16, !"air.arg_type_align_size", i32 4, !"air.arg_type_name", !"Slot", !"air.arg_name", !"slots"}
!5 = !{i32 0, i32 16, i32 0, !"packed_uint4", !"words"}
!6 = !{i32 1, !"air.vertex_id", !"air.arg_type_name", !"uint", !"air.arg_name", !"vid"}
!7 = !{i32 2, i32 8, i32 0}
!8 = !{!"Metal", i32 2, i32 0, i32 0}
"#;

fn translate(ll: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(ll, Stage::Vertex, TransformOptions::default())
}

fn spirv_val(spv: &[u8]) {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val")
        .args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2", "-"])
        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .spawn()
        .and_then(|mut c| {
            use std::io::Write;
            c.stdin.take().unwrap().write_all(spv)?;
            c.wait_with_output()
        });
    if let Ok(out) = out {
        assert!(
            out.status.success(),
            "spirv-val: {}{}",
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout),
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr)
        );
    }
}

fn lanes_are_bitcast_words(spv: &[u8]) {
    let asm = disassemble(spv).expect("disassemble");
    let count = |op: &str| asm.lines().filter(|l| l.contains(op)).count();
    assert_eq!(count("OpCompositeConstruct"), 2, "one vector built per load:\n{asm}");
    assert_eq!(count("OpBitcast"), 8, "four int lanes per load become float lanes:\n{asm}");
}

#[test]
fn a_float4_read_of_a_slot_struct_wrapping_four_ints_loads_the_four_words() {
    let spv = translate(WRAPPED).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("the read must translate: {e}"));
    lanes_are_bitcast_words(&spv);
    spirv_val(&spv);
}

#[test]
fn a_float4_read_of_a_slot_struct_holding_the_array_one_level_down_loads_the_four_words() {
    let flat = WRAPPED.replace("type { { [4 x i32] } }", "type { [4 x i32] }");
    assert_ne!(flat, WRAPPED);
    let spv = translate(&flat).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("the read must translate: {e}"));
    lanes_are_bitcast_words(&spv);
    spirv_val(&spv);
}

#[test]
fn a_float4_read_of_a_slot_struct_whose_array_is_one_lane_short_is_still_refused() {
    // three words cannot supply four lanes: translating this would invent the fourth
    let short = WRAPPED.replace("type { { [4 x i32] } }", "type { { [3 x i32] } }");
    assert_ne!(short, WRAPPED);
    if let Ok(spv) = translate(&short) {
        panic!("a 3-word slot read as float4 translated ({} bytes)", spv.len());
    }
}

use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};

const POOL_SHAPE: &str = r#"target triple = "air64_v27-apple-macosx15.7.0"

@_Z6kDest1.MTL_FC_INIT_118_j = internal local_unnamed_addr addrspace(2) externally_initialized constant i32 undef, section "air.fc_initializer", align 4
@_Z6kDest0.MTL_FC_INIT_119_j = internal local_unnamed_addr addrspace(2) externally_initialized constant i32 undef, section "air.fc_initializer", align 4
@_ZL5multi = internal unnamed_addr addrspace(2) global i8 0, align 1

declare i1 @air.is_function_constant_defined(ptr addrspace(2))
declare void @postfixPrimary_i.MTL_UNRESOLVED_VISIBLE_FN(ptr addrspace(1)) local_unnamed_addr section "air.externally_defined"

define internal void @_GLOBAL__sub_I_pool() section "air.static_init" {
  %1 = tail call i1 @air.is_function_constant_defined(ptr addrspace(2) @_Z6kDest0.MTL_FC_INIT_119_j)
  %2 = tail call i1 @air.is_function_constant_defined(ptr addrspace(2) @_Z6kDest1.MTL_FC_INIT_118_j)
  %3 = select i1 %1, i1 %2, i1 false
  %4 = zext i1 %3 to i8
  store i8 %4, ptr addrspace(2) @_ZL5multi, align 1
  ret void
}

define void @k(ptr addrspace(1) %out) {
entry:
  %m = load i8, ptr addrspace(2) @_ZL5multi, align 1
  %single = icmp eq i8 %m, 0
  br i1 %single, label %post, label %multi

post:
  call void @postfixPrimary_i.MTL_UNRESOLVED_VISIBLE_FN(ptr addrspace(1) %out)
  br label %done

multi:
  store i32 1, ptr addrspace(1) %out, align 4
  br label %done

done:
  ret void
}

!air.kernel = !{!0}
!air.function_constants = !{!5, !6}
!0 = !{ptr @k, !1, !2}
!1 = !{}
!2 = !{!3}
!3 = !{i32 0, !"air.buffer", !"air.location_index", i32 0, i32 1, !"air.read_write", !"air.address_space", i32 1, !"air.arg_type_size", i32 4, !"air.arg_type_align_size", i32 4, !"air.arg_type_name", !"int", !"air.arg_name", !"out"}
!5 = !{ptr addrspace(2) @_Z6kDest1.MTL_FC_INIT_118_j, !"uint", !"kDest1", i32 118, i1 false}
!6 = !{ptr addrspace(2) @_Z6kDest0.MTL_FC_INIT_119_j, !"uint", !"kDest0", i32 119, i1 false}

fn translate(values: &[(u32, Vec<u8>)]) -> Result<usize, String> {
    let sp = metal2vulkan::specialize_air_function_constants(POOL_SHAPE, values)?;
    metal2vulkan::translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(
        sp.as_ref(),
        Stage::Kernel,
        TransformOptions::default(),
    )
    .map(|spv| spv.len())
}

const LIVE: &str = "is called on a live path";

#[test]
fn both_supplied_optional_constants_fold_the_guarded_visible_call_away() {
    let r = translate(&[(118, vec![0x0b, 0, 0, 0]), (119, vec![0x0b, 0, 0, 1])]);
    assert!(
        matches!(r, Ok(n) if n > 0),
        "both constants supplied => multi = 1 => the postfix call is dead and must fold: {r:?}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn unsupplied_optional_constants_keep_the_visible_call_live_and_refused() {
    let r = translate(&[]);
    assert!(
        matches!(&r, Err(e) if e.contains(LIVE)),
        "no constant supplied must keep the unresolved call live and refused, got {r:?}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn one_supplied_constant_keeps_the_conjunction_false_and_the_call_refused() {
    let r = translate(&[(119, vec![0x0b, 0, 0, 1])]);
    assert!(
        matches!(&r, Err(e) if e.contains(LIVE)),
        "half the conjunction supplied must not fold the call away, got {r:?}"
    );
}

FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/texture_handle_phi.rs
================================================
//! Two argument-buffer textures merged by a `phi` or a `select` before a texture operation
//! (`%t = phi ptr addrspace(1) [ %albedo, %a ], [ %depth, %b ]`). Each handle alone is read from the bindless heap by
//! the slot its argument-buffer field holds; the merged handle had no slot, so the read fell back to another image the
//! entry bound (here the buffer's unused first texture) or read zero. The merge now selects between the heap slots,
//! for Metal's own pointer load and for WebKit's `load i64` + `inttoptr` form alike.
use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options};

fn spirv_val(spv: &[u8]) {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val").args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.3", "-"]).stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped()).stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped()).spawn().and_then(|mut c| {
            use std::io::Write; c.stdin.take().unwrap().write_all(spv)?; c.wait_with_output() });
    if let Ok(out) = out { assert!(out.status.success(), "spirv-val: {}{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr)); }
}

fn translate(ll: &str) -> String {
    let spv = translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(ll, Stage::Fragment, TransformOptions::default())
        .expect("merged argument-buffer textures must translate");
    spirv_val(&spv);
    disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble")
}

/// The instruction defining `%id`, as its opcode and operands.
fn def<'a>(asm: &'a str, id: &str) -> (&'a str, Vec<&'a str>) {
    let prefix = format!("{id} = ");
    let line = asm.lines().find(|line| line.trim_start().starts_with(&prefix)).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{id} undefined\n{asm}"));
    let mut words = line.trim_start()[prefix.len()..].split_whitespace();
    (words.next().unwrap(), words.collect())
}

/// The single texel fetch reads `heap[slot]` where the slot is merged by `merge` (OpPhi or OpSelect).
fn assert_reads_merged_heap_slot(asm: &str, merge: &str) {
    let fetches: Vec<_> = asm.lines().filter(|line| line.contains("OpImageFetch")).collect();
    assert_eq!(fetches.len(), 1, "{asm}");
    let image = fetches[0].split_whitespace().nth(4).unwrap();
    let (op, operands) = def(asm, image);
    assert_eq!(op, "OpLoad", "the fetched image is loaded\n{asm}");
    let (op, chain) = def(asm, operands[1]);
    assert_eq!(op, "OpAccessChain", "the image comes from the heap\n{asm}");
    assert_eq!(def(asm, chain[1]).0, "OpVariable", "{asm}");
    let (op, slots) = def(asm, chain[2]);
    assert_eq!(op, merge, "the heap index is the merge of both slots\n{asm}");
    // the incoming slots are two different argument-buffer fields, each masked to a heap slot
    let incoming = if merge == "OpPhi" { [slots[1], slots[3]] } else { [slots[2], slots[3]] };
    let words: Vec<_> = incoming
        .iter()
        .map(|slot| {
            let (op, operands) = def(asm, slot);
            assert_eq!(op, "OpBitwiseAnd", "{asm}");
            operands[1]
        })
        .collect();
    assert_ne!(words[0], words[1], "{asm}");
    assert!(!asm.contains("OpConstantNull %22"), "{asm}");
}

#[test]
fn a_phi_of_argument_buffer_textures_reads_the_chosen_heap_slot() {
    assert_reads_merged_heap_slot(&translate(include_str!("fixtures/texhandle_phi/phi_load.ll")), "OpPhi");
}

#[test]
fn a_phi_of_resource_id_textures_reads_the_chosen_heap_slot() {
    assert_reads_merged_heap_slot(&translate(include_str!("fixtures/texhandle_phi/phi_inttoptr.ll")), "OpPhi");
}

#[test]
fn a_select_of_argument_buffer_textures_reads_the_chosen_heap_slot() {
    assert_reads_merged_heap_slot(&translate(include_str!("fixtures/texhandle_phi/select_load.ll")), "OpSelect");
}

fn interface_locations(asm: &str, storage_class: &str) -> Vec<u32> {
    let ids: Vec<&str> = asm
        .lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter_map(|line| {
            let (id, rest) = line.split_once(" = OpVariable ")?;
            rest.split_whitespace()
                .last()
                .filter(|class| *class == storage_class)
                .map(|_| id)
        })
        .collect();
    let mut out: Vec<u32> = asm
        .lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter_map(|line| {
            let rest = line.strip_prefix("OpDecorate ")?;
            let (id, rest) = rest.split_once(' ')?;
            let location = rest.strip_prefix("Location ")?;
            ids.contains(&id).then(|| location.trim().parse().ok())?
        })
        .collect();
    out.sort_unstable();
    out
}

fn asm(ll: &str, stage: Stage) -> String {
    let spv = translate_sanitized_native(ll, stage, &tmp()).expect("translate");
    disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble")
}

#[test]
fn an_unwritten_vertex_varying_still_reaches_the_module() {
    let vertex = asm(VERTEX, Stage::Vertex);
    assert_eq!(
        interface_locations(&vertex, "Output"),
        vec![0, 1],
        "both declared varyings are Output variables, `unwritten` included:\n{vertex}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn the_fragment_reading_an_unwritten_varying_has_a_producer_for_it() {
    let vertex = asm(VERTEX, Stage::Vertex);
    let fragment = asm(FRAGMENT, Stage::Fragment);
    let written = interface_locations(&vertex, "Output");
    let read = interface_locations(&fragment, "Input");
    assert_eq!(
        written, read,
        "the vertex writes {written:?} and the fragment reads {read:?} for the same varying \
         struct\n--- vertex ---\n{vertex}\n--- fragment ---\n{fragment}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn an_unwritten_fragment_render_target_stays_unwritten() {
    let fragment = asm(FRAGMENT_TWO_TARGETS, Stage::Fragment);
    assert_eq!(
        interface_locations(&fragment, "Output"),
        vec![0],
        "only the render target the shader writes is emitted:\n{fragment}"
    );
}

fn position_is_invariant(asm: &str) -> bool {
    let position = asm
        .lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .find_map(|line| {
            let rest = line.strip_prefix("OpDecorate ")?;
            let (id, tail) = rest.split_once(' ')?;
            (tail == "BuiltIn Position").then(|| id.to_string())
        })
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no variable decorated BuiltIn Position:\n{asm}"));
    asm.lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .any(|line| line == format!("OpDecorate {position} Invariant"))
}

#[test]
fn an_invariant_position_is_decorated_invariant() {
    assert!(
        position_is_invariant(&translate_to_asm(INVARIANT_VERTEX)),
        "`air.invariant` on a struct member must reach the Position variable"
    );
    assert!(
        position_is_invariant(&translate_to_asm(BARE_INVARIANT_VERTEX)),
        "`air.invariant` on a bare position return must reach it too"
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_position_metal_did_not_declare_invariant_is_not_decorated() {
    for source in [INVARIANT_VERTEX, BARE_INVARIANT_VERTEX] {
        let plain = source.replace(r#", !"air.invariant""#, "");
        assert_ne!(plain, source, "the marker must be removed");
        assert!(
            !position_is_invariant(&translate_to_asm(&plain)),
            "a position without `air.invariant` must not be decorated:\n{plain}"
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn invariance_does_not_leak_to_the_other_outputs() {
    let asm = translate_to_asm(INVARIANT_VERTEX);
    let invariant_ids = asm
        .lines()
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter_map(|line| line.strip_suffix(" Invariant")?.strip_prefix("OpDecorate "))
        .count();
    assert_eq!(
        invariant_ids, 1,
        "only the position is invariant; the `uv` varying is not:\n{asm}"
    );
}

FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/webgpu_resource_id_textures.rs
================================================
//! WebKit's WGSL compiler (Safari's WebGPU) puts each texture of a bind group into an argument buffer as its 64-bit
//! resource ID and reads it back as an integer: `%id = load i64, ptr addrspace(2) %field` then
//! `%texture = inttoptr i64 %id to ptr addrspace(1)`, where Metal's own compiler loads the handle as a pointer. The
//! translator knew only the pointer form. Under the device-address model (taken here because the second argument
//! buffer holds a constant-buffer pointer) the conversion defined no value, so the texture's use after the
//! `discard_fragment` branch failed: "native emitter: unknown SSA value %9" in the webgpu-samples deferredRendering
//! lighting pass ("Fragment function failed creation"). Without that model the conversion made an unmodeled (null)
//! pointer: the shader translated, but its texture reads were zero and its size queries 0 (the same sample's G-buffer
//! view). Both now load the handle as Metal's compiler does.
use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options};

fn spirv_val(spv: &[u8]) {
    let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val").args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2", "-"]).stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped()).stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped()).spawn().and_then(|mut c| {
            use std::io::Write; c.stdin.take().unwrap().write_all(spv)?; c.wait_with_output() });
    if let Ok(out) = out { assert!(out.status.success(), "spirv-val: {}{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr)); }
}

fn translate(ll: &str) -> String {
    // the plugin's first attempt (as written, no retry)
    let spv = translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(ll, Stage::Fragment, TransformOptions::default())
        .expect("a texture read by its resource ID must translate");
    spirv_val(&spv);
    disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble")
}

fn count(asm: &str, op: &str) -> usize {
    asm.lines().filter(|line| line.contains(op)).count()
}

#[test]
fn a_resource_id_texture_used_after_a_discard_branch_translates() {
    let asm = translate(include_str!("fixtures/webgpu/resource_id_texture_after_discard.ll"));
    // the read in the entry block and both size queries after the branch use the texture
    assert_eq!(count(&asm, "OpImageFetch"), 1, "{asm}");
    assert_eq!(count(&asm, "OpImageQuerySizeLod"), 2, "{asm}");
}

#[test]
fn resource_id_textures_in_a_bound_argument_buffer_are_read() {
    let asm = translate(include_str!("fixtures/webgpu/resource_id_textures_bound_buffer.ll"));
    // two reads and a size query, none folded to a null texture
    assert_eq!(count(&asm, "OpImageFetch"), 2, "{asm}");
    assert_eq!(count(&asm, "OpImageQuerySizeLod"), 1, "{asm}");
}



================================================
FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/workgroup_zeroing.rs
================================================
//! Workgroup memory zeroed the ways Metal shaders do it.
//!
//! A threadgroup parameter zeroed whole (`threadgroup S &s [[threadgroup(0)]]`, `s = S{}`), as WebKit zero-initialises a
//! WGSL `var<workgroup>`.
//!
//! The parameter becomes a Workgroup array whose element is the layout type the kernel metadata describes, and the
//! `llvm.memset` of the whole S is emitted as a Store of S's null straight through the parameter. When S was not on the
//! array's member-0 path (a different id of the same shape), nothing routed that Store to element 0 and the module broke
//! the Store contract, so the kernel was refused: in Safari on the B580 every WGSL compute shader with a workgroup
//! variable failed createComputePipeline (tools/regress/pages/sweep.html).
use metal2vulkan::passes::{Stage, TransformOptions};
use metal2vulkan::{disassemble, translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options};

const ZEROED: &str = include_str!("fixtures/webgpu/threadgroup_struct_param_zeroed.ll");
const BYTEWISE: &str = include_str!("fixtures/webgpu/workgroup_zeroed_bytewise.ll");

fn spirv_val(spv: &[u8], name: &str) {
    if std::process::Command::new("spirv-val").arg("--version").output().is_err() {
        return;
    }
    let p = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_{name}_{}.spv", std::process::id()));
    std::fs::write(&p, spv).unwrap();
    let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val").args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2"]).arg(&p).output().unwrap();
    assert!(out.status.success(), "spirv-val: {}{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr));
}

/// WebKit's `__wgslZeroWorkgroupVar`: a byte loop storing 0 through a uchar pointer into each u32 word of a
/// `var<workgroup> array<u32, 64>`. Each byte store is a read-modify-write of its word (passes/access/workgroup_bytes.rs).
#[test]
fn webkit_bytewise_workgroup_zeroing_translates_as_word_read_modify_write() {
    let spv = translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(BYTEWISE, Stage::Kernel, TransformOptions::default())
        .expect("WebKit's workgroup zeroing must translate");
    spirv_val(&spv, "wg_bytewise");
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble");
    assert!(!asm.contains("_ptr_Workgroup_uchar"), "no byte pointer into Workgroup memory remains\n{asm}");
    assert!(asm.contains("OpNot"), "the byte's mask\n{asm}");
    assert!(asm.contains("OpBitwiseOr"), "the merged word\n{asm}");
}

#[test]
fn a_threadgroup_struct_parameter_zeroed_whole_translates() {
    let tmp = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("m2v_tg_zeroed_{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&tmp);
    // the plugin's path (nvmtl_translate): the native construction on the AIR text as Metal's compiler wrote it
    let spv = translate_native_no_retry_constructed_with_options(ZEROED, Stage::Kernel, TransformOptions::default())
        .expect("the zeroed threadgroup struct must translate");
    let asm = disassemble(&spv).expect("disassemble");
    assert!(asm.contains("Workgroup"), "{asm}");
    // the zero is stored through element 0 of the Workgroup array, as the element type's null
    let store = asm.lines().find(|l| l.contains("OpStore") && {
        let v = l.split_whitespace().last().unwrap();
        asm.lines().any(|d| d.trim_start().starts_with(&format!("{v} = OpConstantNull")))
    });
    assert!(store.is_some(), "no null store\n{asm}");
    if std::process::Command::new("spirv-val").arg("--version").output().is_ok() {
        let p = tmp.join("tg_zeroed.spv");
        std::fs::write(&p, &spv).unwrap();
        let out = std::process::Command::new("spirv-val").args(["--target-env", "vulkan1.2"]).arg(&p).output().unwrap();
        assert!(out.status.success(), "spirv-val: {}{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout), String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr));
    }
}

; ANGLE's texture environments, as Metal compiles them for a shadowed WebGL2 material (three.js, two lights, #449).
; Every sampler of the shader lives in one local `ANGLE_TextureEnvs` object; the shadow maps are an array<depth2d, 2>
; and an array<sampler, 2>, and each element's environment is handed by reference to a helper that is not inlined.
; The entry stores the element addresses through bitcasts of field GEPs, the helper reads them back through a GEP of
; the env it was handed, and it reaches the element itself through the one-member `metal::sampler`/`metal::depth2d`
; wrappers: the three spellings the inline retry has to see as one field.

FILE: nullmoth/translator/translator/tests/fixtures/sampler_phi/phi_load.ll

; Two samplers of one WebKit-style argument buffer (their addresses, as WebKit passes a sampler) merged by a phi (the fragment's x picks the branch), then sampled: the
; merged sampler must read the chosen sampler-heap slot (an OpPhi of the two slots), not fall back or be refused.
target datalayout = "e-p:64:64:64-i1:8:8-i8:8:8-i16:16:16-i32:32:32-i64:64:64-f32:32:32-f64:64:64-v16:16:16-v24:32:32-v32:32:32-v48:64:64-v64:64:64-v96:128:128-v128:128:128-v192:256:256-v256:256:256-v512:512:512-v1024:1024:1024-n8:16:32"
target triple = "air64_v28-apple-macosx26.7.0"

%ArgumentBuffer = type { %"struct.metal::sampler", %"struct.metal::texture2d", ptr addrspace(2), %"struct.metal::sampler" }
%"struct.metal::sampler" = type { ptr addrspace(2) }
%"struct.metal::texture2d" = type { ptr addrspace(1) }

define <{ <4 x float> }> @fs(<4 x float> noundef %position, ptr addrspace(2) noundef readonly align 8 dereferenceable(32) "air-buffer-no-alias" %group) local_unnamed_addr #0 {
entry:
  %texture.field = getelementptr inbounds %ArgumentBuffer, ptr addrspace(2) %group, i64 0, i32 1
  %texture.id = load i64, ptr addrspace(2) %texture.field, align 8
  %texture = inttoptr i64 %texture.id to ptr addrspace(1)
  %s0.field = getelementptr inbounds %ArgumentBuffer, ptr addrspace(2) %group, i64 0, i32 0, i32 0
  %s1.field = getelementptr inbounds %ArgumentBuffer, ptr addrspace(2) %group, i64 0, i32 3, i32 0
  %xy = shufflevector <4 x float> %position, <4 x float> poison, <2 x i32> <i32 0, i32 1>
  %x = extractelement <4 x float> %position, i64 0
  %left = fcmp olt float %x, 5.120000e+02
  br i1 %left, label %a, label %b
a:
  br label %join
b:
  br label %join
join:
  %sampler = phi ptr addrspace(2) [ %s0.field, %a ], [ %s1.field, %b ]
  %sample = tail call { <4 x float>, i8 } @air.sample_texture_2d.v4f32(ptr addrspace(1) %texture, ptr addrspace(2) %sampler, <2 x float> %xy, i1 true, <2 x i32> zeroinitializer, i1 false, float 0.000000e+00, float 0.000000e+00, i32 0)
  %color = extractvalue { <4 x float>, i8 } %sample, 0
  %out = insertvalue <{ <4 x float> }> undef, <4 x float> %color, 0
  ret <{ <4 x float> }> %out
}

// Four-tap shadow filter written for this test: depth2d::gather_compare with constant offsets, averaged.
// Exercises the translator path for AIR air.gather_compare_depth_2d.f32 (a runtime sampler, constant texel offsets).
// Regenerate the IR next to this file with:
//   xcrun metal -std=metal3.1 -O2 -S -emit-llvm -target air64-apple-macos26.0 shadow_pcf_gather_compare.metal -o shadow_pcf_gather_compare.ll
//   (then drop the build directory from the source_file_name metadata line)
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;

struct In {
    float4 position [[position]];
    float4 shadow_uv_ref;      // xy = shadow map coordinate, z = reference depth
};

fragment float4 fs_main_gather_compare(In in [[stage_in]],
                                       depth2d<float> shadow_map [[texture(9)]],
                                       sampler shadow_sampler [[sampler(8)]])
{
    float2 uv = in.shadow_uv_ref.xy;
    float ref = in.shadow_uv_ref.z;
    float4 a = shadow_map.gather_compare(shadow_sampler, uv, ref, int2(-1, -1));
    float4 b = shadow_map.gather_compare(shadow_sampler, uv, ref, int2(1, -1));
    float4 c = shadow_map.gather_compare(shadow_sampler, uv, ref, int2(-1, 1));
    float4 d = shadow_map.gather_compare(shadow_sampler, uv, ref, int2(1, 1));
    return (a + b + c + d) * 0.0625;
}

#include <metal_stdlib>

struct VO { float4 p [[position]]; float2 uv; float3 d; };
static float4 mark(bool r) { return r ? float4(0) : float4(1, 0, 1, 1); }

; A private table of pointers into two different buffers, copied from another table and advanced in place (the shape
; of MPS's LSTM kernels). The emitter has no model for the loaded row pointer; the read through it was a constant
; zero (OpCopyObject of OpConstantNull feeding the sum) and is refused now.

define void @pick(ptr addrspace(1) noundef readonly "air-buffer-no-alias" %a, ptr addrspace(1) noundef readonly "air-buffer-no-alias" %b, ptr addrspace(1) noundef "air-buffer-no-alias" %out, i32 noundef %gid) local_unnamed_addr #0 {
entry:
  %first = alloca [2 x ptr addrspace(1)], align 8
  %table = alloca [2 x ptr addrspace(1)], align 8
  %f0 = getelementptr inbounds [2 x ptr addrspace(1)], ptr %first, i64 0, i64 0
  store ptr addrspace(1) %a, ptr %f0, align 8
  %f1 = getelementptr inbounds [2 x ptr addrspace(1)], ptr %first, i64 0, i64 1
  store ptr addrspace(1) %b, ptr %f1, align 8
  br label %copy

copy:
  %c = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ %cn, %copy ]
  %c64 = zext i32 %c to i64
  %from = getelementptr inbounds [2 x ptr addrspace(1)], ptr %first, i64 0, i64 %c64
  %p = load ptr addrspace(1), ptr %from, align 8
  %to = getelementptr inbounds [2 x ptr addrspace(1)], ptr %table, i64 0, i64 %c64
  store ptr addrspace(1) %p, ptr %to, align 8
  %cn = add nuw nsw i32 %c, 1
  %cd = icmp eq i32 %cn, 2
  br i1 %cd, label %loop, label %copy

loop:
  %i = phi i32 [ 0, %copy ], [ %next, %loop ]
  %sum = phi float [ 0.000000e+00, %copy ], [ %acc, %loop ]
  %bit = and i32 %i, 1
  %index = zext i32 %bit to i64
  %slot = getelementptr inbounds [2 x ptr addrspace(1)], ptr %table, i64 0, i64 %index
  %row = load ptr addrspace(1), ptr %slot, align 8
  %value = load float, ptr addrspace(1) %row, align 4
  %step = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr addrspace(1) %row, i64 1
  store ptr addrspace(1) %step, ptr %slot, align 8
  %acc = fadd float %sum, %value
  %next = add nuw nsw i32 %i, 1
  %done = icmp eq i32 %next, 4
  br i1 %done, label %exit, label %loop

exit:
  %gid64 = zext i32 %gid to i64
  %dst = getelementptr inbounds float, ptr addrspace(1) %out, i64 %gid64
  store float %acc, ptr addrspace(1) %dst, align 4
  ret void
}

}

use crate::buffer_addresses::TABLE_BINDING;
use rspirv::{binary::Assemble, dr::{Instruction, Operand}, spirv::*};
use std::collections::HashMap;

fn id(o: &Operand) -> Option<u32> { if let Operand::IdRef(v) = o { Some(*v) } else { None } }
fn lit(o: &Operand) -> Option<u32> { if let Operand::LiteralBit32(v) = o { Some(*v) } else { None } }

fn scalar_align(ty: u32, defs: &HashMap<u32, Instruction>, depth: usize) -> Option<u32> {
    if depth > 32 { return None; }
    let t = defs.get(&ty)?;
    match t.class.opcode {
        Op::TypeInt | Op::TypeFloat => Some(lit(t.operands.first()?)? / 8),
        Op::TypePointer => Some(8),
        Op::TypeVector | Op::TypeMatrix | Op::TypeArray | Op::TypeRuntimeArray => scalar_align(id(t.operands.first()?)?, defs, depth + 1),
        Op::TypeStruct => t.operands.iter().try_fold(1, |a, o| Some(a.max(scalar_align(id(o)?, defs, depth + 1)?))),
        _ => None,
    }
}

#[derive(Default, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Report { pub mask: u32, pub req: u32, pub untraceable: bool, pub accesses: u32, pub clamped: u32 }

fn root_binding(mut p: u32, local: &HashMap<u32, Instruction>, table: u32, consts: &HashMap<u32, u32>) -> Option<u32> {
    for _ in 0..64 {
        let d = local.get(&p)?;
        let ops: Vec<u32> = d.operands.iter().filter_map(id).collect();
        match d.class.opcode {
            Op::AccessChain | Op::InBoundsAccessChain | Op::PtrAccessChain | Op::CopyObject | Op::Bitcast => p = *ops.first()?,
            Op::ConvertUToPtr => {
                let x = local.get(ops.first()?)?;
                let xo: Vec<u32> = x.operands.iter().filter_map(id).collect();
                match x.class.opcode {
                    Op::Load => {
                        let ac = local.get(xo.first()?)?;
                        let ao: Vec<u32> = ac.operands.iter().filter_map(id).collect();
                        return match (ac.class.opcode, ao.as_slice()) {
                            (Op::AccessChain | Op::InBoundsAccessChain, [t, z, b]) if *t == table && consts.get(z) == Some(&0) =>
                                consts.get(b).copied().filter(|b| *b < 32),
                            _ => None,
                        };
                    }
                    Op::ConvertPtrToU => p = *xo.first()?,
                    Op::IAdd => {
                        let base = xo.iter().find(|v| local.get(v).is_some_and(|d| d.class.opcode == Op::ConvertPtrToU))?;
                        p = local.get(base)?.operands.iter().find_map(id)?;
                    }
                    _ => return None,
                }
            }
            _ => return None,
        }
    }
    None
}

pub fn guard(bytes: &[u8], safe: bool) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Report), String> {
    let mut m = rspirv::dr::load_bytes(bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let defs: HashMap<u32, Instruction> = m.types_global_values.iter().filter_map(|i| Some((i.result_id?, i.clone()))).collect();
    let consts: HashMap<u32, u32> = m.types_global_values.iter().filter(|i| i.class.opcode == Op::Constant)
        .filter_map(|i| Some((i.result_id?, lit(i.operands.first()?)?))).collect();
    let table = m.annotations.iter().find_map(|a| match a.operands.as_slice() {
        [Operand::IdRef(n), Operand::Decoration(Decoration::Binding), Operand::LiteralBit32(b)] if *b == TABLE_BINDING => Some(*n),
        _ => None,
    }).unwrap_or(u32::MAX);
    let mut value_types = HashMap::new();
    for i in m.all_inst_iter() { if let (Some(n), Some(t)) = (i.result_id, i.result_type) { value_types.insert(n, t); } }
    let psb_pointee = |ptr: u32| -> Option<u32> {
        let t = defs.get(value_types.get(&ptr)?)?;
        (t.class.opcode == Op::TypePointer && t.operands.first() == Some(&Operand::StorageClass(StorageClass::PhysicalStorageBuffer)))
            .then(|| id(t.operands.get(1)?)).flatten()
    };
    let mut r = Report::default();
    for f in &mut m.functions {
        let local: HashMap<u32, Instruction> = f.blocks.iter().flat_map(|b| b.instructions.iter()).filter_map(|i| Some((i.result_id?, i.clone()))).collect();
        for b in &mut f.blocks {
            for i in &mut b.instructions {
                let at = match i.class.opcode { Op::Load => 1, Op::Store => 2, _ => continue };
                let Some(ptr) = i.operands.first().and_then(id) else { continue };
                let Some(pointee) = psb_pointee(ptr) else { continue };
                let (Some(Operand::MemoryAccess(flags)), Some(a)) = (i.operands.get(at), i.operands.get(at + 1).and_then(lit)) else { continue };
                if !flags.contains(MemoryAccess::ALIGNED) { continue; }
                let scalar = scalar_align(pointee, &defs, 0);
                if scalar.is_some_and(|s| a <= s) { continue; }
                r.accesses += 1;
                r.req = r.req.max(a);
                match root_binding(ptr, &local, table, &consts) {
                    Some(bnd) => r.mask |= 1 << bnd,
                    None => r.untraceable = true,
                }
                if safe {
                    if let Some(s) = scalar { i.operands[at + 1] = Operand::LiteralBit32(s); r.clamped += 1; }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if safe && r.clamped > 0 {
        return Ok((m.assemble().iter().flat_map(|w| w.to_le_bytes()).collect(), r));
    }
    Ok((bytes.to_vec(), r))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::buffer_addresses::lower;
    use spirv_tools::{assembler::Assembler, val::Validator};
    const PAIR: &str = r#"
OpCapability Shader
OpCapability Int64
OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450
OpEntryPoint GLCompute %main "main" %buf %out %gid
OpExecutionMode %main LocalSize 1 1 1
OpDecorate %gid BuiltIn GlobalInvocationId
OpDecorate %arr ArrayStride 4

OpDecorate %out Binding 1
%void = OpTypeVoid
%uint = OpTypeInt 32 0
%ulong = OpTypeInt 64 0
%v3 = OpTypeVector %uint 3
%pin = OpTypePointer Input %v3
%gid = OpVariable %pin Input
%zero = OpConstant %uint 0
%one = OpConstant %uint 1
%two = OpConstant %uint 2

%block = OpTypeStruct %arr

OpStore %po %s
OpReturn
OpFunctionEnd
"#;
    fn lowered(text: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
        let b = spirv_tools::assembler::create(Some(spirv_tools::TargetEnv::Vulkan_1_2)).assemble(text, Default::default()).unwrap().as_bytes().to_vec();
        lower(&b).unwrap()
    }
    fn validate(b: &[u8]) {
        let w: Vec<u32> = b.chunks_exact(4).map(|w| u32::from_le_bytes(w.try_into().unwrap())).collect();
        spirv_tools::val::create(Some(spirv_tools::TargetEnv::Vulkan_1_2)).validate(&w, None).unwrap();
    }
    #[test] fn a_fused_pair_reports_its_binding_and_8_and_nothing_else() {
        let (_, r) = guard(&lowered(PAIR), false).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((r.mask, r.req, r.untraceable), (1, 8, false), "binding 0 needs 8; binding 1's Aligned-4 word is no promise: {r:?}");
    }
    #[test] fn the_safe_module_keeps_no_promise_and_validates() {
        let (safe, r) = guard(&lowered(PAIR), true).unwrap();
        validate(&safe);
        assert!(r.clamped >= 1);
        let (_, again) = guard(&safe, false).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((again.mask, again.accesses), (0, 0), "a safe module must report nothing: {again:?}");
    }
    #[test] fn an_unhinted_module_reports_no_promise() {
        let (bytes, r) = guard(&lowered(&PAIR.replace("%p0 Aligned 8", "%p0")), true).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((r.mask, r.accesses, r.clamped), (0, 0, 0));
        assert_eq!(bytes, lowered(&PAIR.replace("%p0 Aligned 8", "%p0")), "nothing to withdraw = the same bytes");
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
//! The allocator of this library. A translation makes millions of small allocations and frees nearly all of them by
//! its end, so inside `scope` small blocks come from thread-owned chunks with one free list per size, which is what
//! made it 9-21% faster than the system allocator with 14% less memory. Outside a scope, and for anything large, it
//! is the system allocator.
//!
//! The library is loaded into long-lived processes (WindowServer, the Dock), so nothing may stay behind: leaving the
//! outermost scope gives back every chunk whose blocks have all been freed, and a block that outlives its scope (an
//! error string, a small result, a lazily built table) gives its chunk back when it is freed. At most KEEP_DIRTY
//! chunks stay touched for the next translation; the others go back to the kernel at once.
//!
//! A chunk counts its own blocks without atomics while its thread is in a scope. Frees from elsewhere, and all frees
//! after the scope, go through `pending`: it goes negative while the owner still works, the owner adds its count when
//! it leaves, and whoever brings it to zero after that gives the chunk back.
use std::alloc::{GlobalAlloc, Layout, System};
use std::cell::UnsafeCell;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::ptr::null_mut;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicI64, AtomicUsize, Ordering};

const GRANULE: usize = 16;
const CLASSES: usize = 64;
const MAX_SMALL: usize = CLASSES * GRANULE;
const CHUNK: usize = 1 << 20;
const REGION: usize = 1 << 33;
const CHUNKS: usize = REGION / CHUNK;
const KEEP_DIRTY: usize = 4;
const REGION_UNSET: usize = 0;
const REGION_FAILED: usize = 1;

const PROT_READ_WRITE: i32 = 1 | 2;
const MAP_PRIVATE_ANON: i32 = 0x0002 | 0x1000;
const MAP_FIXED: i32 = 0x0010;
const MAP_FAILED: *mut c_void = !0usize as *mut c_void;

unsafe extern "C" {
    fn mmap(addr: *mut c_void, len: usize, prot: i32, flags: i32, fd: i32, off: i64) -> *mut c_void;
    fn munmap(addr: *mut c_void, len: usize) -> i32;
}

#[repr(C, align(64))]
struct Chunk {
    owner: AtomicUsize,
    pending: AtomicI64,
    /// The owner's count of its live blocks: only the owner touches it, and only in its scope.
    live: UnsafeCell<i64>,
    /// The next chunk of the owner's list, or of the free list.
    next: UnsafeCell<*mut Chunk>,
    /// A chunk on the free list with its pages still touched.
    dirty: UnsafeCell<bool>,
}

const HEADER: usize = std::mem::size_of::<Chunk>();

struct Heap {
    depth: usize,
    free: [*mut u8; CLASSES],
    bump: *mut u8,
    bump_end: *mut u8,
    chunks: *mut Chunk,
}

thread_local! {
    // Const and without Drop: no lazy initialization and no destructor, so any allocation may use it at any time.
    static HEAP: UnsafeCell<Heap> = const {
        UnsafeCell::new(Heap {
            depth: 0,
            free: [null_mut(); CLASSES],
            bump: null_mut(),
            bump_end: null_mut(),
            chunks: null_mut(),
        })
    };
}

static REGION_BASE: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(REGION_UNSET);
static NEXT_FRESH: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static LOCK: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
struct FreeList {
    head: *mut Chunk,
    dirty: usize,
}
struct Shared(UnsafeCell<FreeList>);
unsafe impl Sync for Shared {}
static FREE_LIST: Shared = Shared(UnsafeCell::new(FreeList { head: null_mut(), dirty: 0 }));

fn locked<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut FreeList) -> R) -> R {
    while LOCK.swap(true, Ordering::Acquire) {
        std::hint::spin_loop();
    }
    let result = f(unsafe { &mut *FREE_LIST.0.get() });
    LOCK.store(false, Ordering::Release);
    result
}

/// The reserved address range, made once. Untouched pages cost nothing; without it everything is the system allocator.
fn region() -> usize {
    let base = REGION_BASE.load(Ordering::Acquire);
    if base != REGION_UNSET {
        return base;
    }
    // One chunk more than needed, to start at the first address aligned to a chunk.
    let mapped = unsafe { mmap(null_mut(), REGION + CHUNK, PROT_READ_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE_ANON, -1, 0) };
    let aligned = if mapped == MAP_FAILED {
        REGION_FAILED
    } else {
        (mapped as usize + CHUNK - 1) & !(CHUNK - 1)
    };
    match REGION_BASE.compare_exchange(REGION_UNSET, aligned, Ordering::AcqRel, Ordering::Acquire) {
        Ok(_) => aligned,
        Err(existing) => {
            if mapped != MAP_FAILED {
                unsafe { munmap(mapped, REGION + CHUNK) };
            }
            existing
        }
    }
}

#[inline]
fn in_region(pointer: *mut u8) -> bool {
    let base = REGION_BASE.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    (pointer as usize).wrapping_sub(base) < REGION && base != REGION_FAILED && base != REGION_UNSET
}

#[inline]
fn chunk_of(pointer: *mut u8) -> *mut Chunk {
    (pointer as usize & !(CHUNK - 1)) as *mut Chunk
}

fn take_chunk(heap: *mut Heap) -> *mut Chunk {
    let reused = locked(|list| {
        let chunk = list.head;
        if !chunk.is_null() {
            unsafe {
                list.head = *(*chunk).next.get();
                if *(*chunk).dirty.get() {
                    list.dirty -= 1;
                }
            }
        }
        chunk
    });
    let chunk = if !reused.is_null() {
        reused
    } else {
        let base = REGION_BASE.load(Ordering::Acquire);
        let index = NEXT_FRESH.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if index >= CHUNKS {
            return null_mut();
        }
        (base + index * CHUNK) as *mut Chunk
    };
    unsafe {
        (*chunk).owner.store(heap as usize, Ordering::Relaxed);
        (*chunk).pending.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        *(*chunk).live.get() = 0;
        *(*chunk).next.get() = (*heap).chunks;
        (*heap).chunks = chunk;
    }
    chunk
}

/// All of the chunk's blocks are gone.
fn give_back(chunk: *mut Chunk) {
    let keep = locked(|list| {
        let keep = list.dirty < KEEP_DIRTY;
        if keep {
            list.dirty += 1;
            unsafe {
                *(*chunk).dirty.get() = true;
                *(*chunk).next.get() = list.head;
            }
            list.head = chunk;
        }
        keep
    });
    if keep {
        return;
    }
    // Fresh pages over the old ones: the memory goes back to the kernel now, and the header reads as zero.
    let mapped = unsafe {
        mmap(chunk as *mut c_void, CHUNK, PROT_READ_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE_ANON | MAP_FIXED, -1, 0)
    };
    locked(|list| unsafe {
        let dirty = mapped == MAP_FAILED;
        *(*chunk).dirty.get() = dirty;
        list.dirty += usize::from(dirty);
        *(*chunk).next.get() = list.head;
        list.head = chunk;
    });
}

#[inline]
fn foreign_free(chunk: *mut Chunk) {
    if unsafe { (*chunk).pending.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel) } == 1 {
        give_back(chunk);
    }
}

fn leave(heap: &mut Heap) {
    let mut chunk = heap.chunks;
    heap.chunks = null_mut();
    heap.free = [null_mut(); CLASSES];
    heap.bump = null_mut();
    heap.bump_end = null_mut();
    while !chunk.is_null() {
        unsafe {
            let next = *(*chunk).next.get();
            let live = *(*chunk).live.get();
            (*chunk).owner.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
            if (*chunk).pending.fetch_add(live, Ordering::AcqRel) + live == 0 {
                give_back(chunk);
            }
            chunk = next;
        }
    }
}

/// Runs `f` with small allocations of this thread in chunks.
pub fn scope<R>(f: impl FnOnce() -> R) -> R {
    struct Guard;
    impl Drop for Guard {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            HEAP.with(|heap| {
                let heap = unsafe { &mut *heap.get() };
                heap.depth -= 1;
                if heap.depth == 0 {
                    leave(heap);
                }
            });
        }
    }
    if region() == REGION_FAILED {
        return f();
    }
    HEAP.with(|heap| unsafe { (*heap.get()).depth += 1 });
    let _guard = Guard;
    f()
}

#[inline]
fn is_small(layout: &Layout) -> bool {
    layout.size() <= MAX_SMALL && layout.align() <= GRANULE && layout.size() != 0
}

#[inline]
unsafe fn small_alloc(heap: *mut Heap, class: usize) -> *mut u8 {
    unsafe {
        let head = (*heap).free[class];
        if !head.is_null() {
            (*heap).free[class] = *(head as *mut *mut u8);
            *(*chunk_of(head)).live.get() += 1;
            return head;
        }
        let size = (class + 1) * GRANULE;
        if ((*heap).bump_end as usize) - ((*heap).bump as usize) < size {
            let chunk = take_chunk(heap);
            if chunk.is_null() {
                return null_mut();
            }
            (*heap).bump = (chunk as *mut u8).add(HEADER);
            (*heap).bump_end = (chunk as *mut u8).add(CHUNK);
        }
        let block = (*heap).bump;
        (*heap).bump = block.add(size);
        *(*chunk_of(block)).live.get() += 1;
        block
    }
}

pub struct Allocator;

unsafe impl GlobalAlloc for Allocator {
    #[inline]
    unsafe fn alloc(&self, layout: Layout) -> *mut u8 {
        if is_small(&layout) {
            let block = HEAP.with(|heap| {
                let heap = heap.get();
                if unsafe { (*heap).depth } == 0 {
                    return null_mut();
                }
                unsafe { small_alloc(heap, (layout.size() - 1) / GRANULE) }
            });
            if !block.is_null() {
                return block;
            }
        }
        unsafe { System.alloc(layout) }
    }

    #[inline]
    unsafe fn dealloc(&self, block: *mut u8, layout: Layout) {
        if !in_region(block) {
            return unsafe { System.dealloc(block, layout) };
        }
        let chunk = chunk_of(block);
        HEAP.with(|heap| unsafe {
            let heap = heap.get();
            if (*heap).depth > 0 && (*chunk).owner.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == heap as usize {
                let class = (layout.size() - 1) / GRANULE;
                *(block as *mut *mut u8) = (*heap).free[class];
                (*heap).free[class] = block;
                *(*chunk).live.get() -= 1;
            } else {
                foreign_free(chunk);
            }
        });
    }

    #[inline]
    unsafe fn alloc_zeroed(&self, layout: Layout) -> *mut u8 {
        let in_scope = HEAP.with(|heap| unsafe { (*heap.get()).depth > 0 });
        if !in_scope || !is_small(&layout) {
            return unsafe { System.alloc_zeroed(layout) };
        }
        let block = unsafe { self.alloc(layout) };
        if !block.is_null() {
            unsafe { block.write_bytes(0, layout.size()) };
        }
        block
    }

    #[inline]
    unsafe fn realloc(&self, block: *mut u8, layout: Layout, new_size: usize) -> *mut u8 {
        if !in_region(block) {
            return unsafe { System.realloc(block, layout, new_size) };
        }
        if new_size != 0 && new_size <= MAX_SMALL && (new_size - 1) / GRANULE == (layout.size() - 1) / GRANULE {
            return block;
        }
        let new_layout = unsafe { Layout::from_size_align_unchecked(new_size, layout.align()) };
        let moved = unsafe { self.alloc(new_layout) };
        if !moved.is_null() {
            unsafe {
                block.copy_to_nonoverlapping(moved, layout.size().min(new_size));
                self.dealloc(block, layout);
            }
        }
        moved
    }
}
