# night-gbcl.sh: phase_gbclmicro, sourced by a night script that defines tmo (the bash timeout function: never perl or
# env wrappers, which strip DYLD_*), say and $O. Runs cl_gbmicro (user/tests/gbcl), the Geekbench-OpenCL-shaped
# microbenchmark, through the installed plugin: every mode 3 times, the modes interleaved and the plugin's host-pointer
# import (NVMTL_IMPORT_UNALIGNED=1) against copy alternating, first one then the other, so drift spreads over both.
# Out: $O/gbcl/<mode>-<copy|import>-<run>.log, $O/gbcl/results.txt (one RESULT line per run), $O/gbcl/table.txt.
# ~16 s per run with GBCL_T=15: 5 modes x 2 x 3 = 30 runs, about 9 minutes.
GBCL=${GBCL:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/cl_gbmicro}
GBCL_T=${GBCL_T:-15}
gbcl_resets() { sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats 2>/dev/null | sed -nE 's/.*GuC context resets ([0-9]+); GT resets ([0-9]+).*/\1 \2/p'; }
phase_gbclmicro() {
  local d="$O/gbcl" r m v vs tag r0 r1 g0 t0 g1 t1
  mkdir -p "$d"; : > "$d/results.txt"
  [ -x "$GBCL" ] || { say "GBCL: no binary at $GBCL"; return 0; }
  say "GBCL: $GBCL, $GBCL_T s per mode; kernel $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'rb8[a-z]' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
  for r in 1 2 3; do
    vs="copy import"; [ $((r % 2)) = 0 ] && vs="import copy"
    for m in chain churn import mixed live; do
      for v in $vs; do
        tag="$m-$v-$r"; r0=$(gbcl_resets)
        ( export NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_ENABLE=1
          if [ "$v" = import ]; then export NVMTL_IMPORT_UNALIGNED=1; else unset NVMTL_IMPORT_UNALIGNED; fi
          tmo $((GBCL_T * 3 + 60)) "$GBCL" -q -t "$GBCL_T" -m "$m" ) > "$d/$tag.log" 2>&1
        r1=$(gbcl_resets); read -r g0 t0 <<< "${r0:-0 0}"; read -r g1 t1 <<< "${r1:-0 0}"
        sed -n "s/^RESULT /RESULT run=$r plugin=$v /p" "$d/$tag.log" >> "$d/results.txt"
        grep -qE '^(RESULT|  kstat)' "$d/$tag.log" || say "GBCL $tag: no result: $(tail -2 "$d/$tag.log" | tr '\n' ' ')"
        grep -qE '^(CHECK|FAIL)' "$d/$tag.log" && say "GBCL $tag: $(grep -E '^(CHECK|FAIL)' "$d/$tag.log" | head -2 | tr '\n' ' ')"
        [ $((g1 - g0 + t1 - t0)) -gt 0 ] && say "GBCL $tag: guc+$((g1 - g0)) gt+$((t1 - t0))"
      done
    done
  done
  # table: per mode and plugin setting, the three runs' ops/s, their median, and the median p50 / p99
  awk '{ for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { split($i, kv, "="); f[kv[1]] = kv[2] }
         k = f["mode"] " " f["plugin"]; if (!(k in seen)) { seen[k] = 1; order[++n] = k }
         ops[k] = ops[k] " " f["ops_s"]; p50[k] = p50[k] " " f["p50_us"]; p99[k] = p99[k] " " f["p99_us"] }
       function med(s,   a, c, i, j, t) { c = split(s, a, " "); for (i = 1; i <= c; i++) for (j = i + 1; j <= c; j++) if (a[j] + 0 < a[i] + 0) { t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t }
                                        return c ? a[int((c + 1) / 2)] : "-" }
       END { printf "%-10s %-6s %-28s %10s %9s %9s\n", "mode", "plugin", "ops/s (runs)", "ops/s med", "p50 us", "p99 us"
             for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) { k = order[i]; split(k, mk, " ")
               printf "%-10s %-6s %-28s %10s %9s %9s\n", mk[1], mk[2], ops[k], med(ops[k]), med(p50[k]), med(p99[k]) } }' \
    "$d/results.txt" > "$d/table.txt"
  # the kernel counters that moved in run 1, per log (<mode>-<copy|import>-1: counter, delta, per op)
  grep -H '  kstat' "$d"/*-1.log 2>/dev/null | sed -E "s|^$d/||; s|\.log:  kstat [^:]*:|:|" > "$d/kstat-run1.txt"
  say "GBCL table:"; while IFS= read -r l; do say "  $l"; done < "$d/table.txt"
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// devorder: Metal and OpenCL GPU device order as this process sees it.
// Built twice: devorder_nocg (Metal + OpenCL only, like a CLI worker) and devorder_cg (also links CoreGraphics and
// touches it, like an AppKit app).
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#ifdef WITH_CG
#import <CoreGraphics/CoreGraphics.h>
#endif
#ifdef WITH_APPKIT
#import <AppKit/AppKit.h>
#endif
int main(void) {
	@autoreleasepool {
#ifdef WITH_APPKIT
		[NSApplication sharedApplication];
		printf("[AppKit NSApplication up] ");
#endif
#ifdef WITH_CG
		printf("[CoreGraphics linked] main display 0x%x\n", CGMainDisplayID());
#else
		printf("[no CoreGraphics]\n");
#endif
		NSArray<id<MTLDevice>> *all = MTLCopyAllDevices();
		int i = 0;
		for (id<MTLDevice> d in all)
			printf("metal[%d] %-30s regID 0x%llx headless %d lowPower %d removable %d location %lu/%lu peerGroup 0x%llx\n", i++,
			       d.name.UTF8String, d.registryID, d.isHeadless, d.isLowPower, d.isRemovable,
			       (unsigned long)d.location, (unsigned long)d.locationNumber, d.peerGroupID);
		id<MTLDevice> def = MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();
		printf("metal default: %s (0x%llx)\n", def ? def.name.UTF8String : "(none)", def ? def.registryID : 0);
		cl_platform_id plat[4]; cl_uint np = 0;
		clGetPlatformIDs(4, plat, &np);
		for (cl_uint p = 0; p < np; p++) {
			cl_device_id dev[8]; cl_uint nd = 0;
			clGetDeviceIDs(plat[p], CL_DEVICE_TYPE_GPU, 8, dev, &nd);
			for (cl_uint k = 0; k < nd; k++) {
				char name[128] = ""; cl_uint cu = 0;
				clGetDeviceInfo(dev[k], CL_DEVICE_NAME, sizeof name, name, NULL);
				clGetDeviceInfo(dev[k], CL_DEVICE_MAX_COMPUTE_UNITS, sizeof cu, &cu, NULL);
				printf("opencl[%u][%u] %s (CUs %u)\n", p, k, name, cu);
			}
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/igpu/vttest.m

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vttest: VideoToolbox hardware encode/decode check + Metal device list.
//   vttest metal                  list Metal devices and the system default
//   vttest list                   list VT encoders (HW marked)
//   vttest enc h264|hevc [frames] encode 1920x1080 NV12 frames, hardware required; prints fps, GPU registry id,
//                                 then decodes the produced stream with a hardware-required decoder
//   vttest dec file.mp4 [frames]  decode the first video track with a hardware-required decoder
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <AVFoundation/AVFoundation.h>
#import <VideoToolbox/VideoToolbox.h>
#import <CoreVideo/CoreVideo.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <CoreGraphics/CoreGraphics.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>

static double now_s(void) {
	static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb);
	return (double)mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom / 1e9;
}
static void metal(void) {
	NSArray<id<MTLDevice>> *all = MTLCopyAllDevices();
	for (id<MTLDevice> d in all)
		printf("device %-45s regID 0x%llx headless %d lowPower %d removable %d\n", d.name.UTF8String,
		       d.registryID, d.isHeadless, d.isLowPower, d.isRemovable);
	id<MTLDevice> md = CGDirectDisplayCopyCurrentMetalDevice(CGMainDisplayID());
	printf("main display 0x%x Metal device: %s (0x%llx)\n", CGMainDisplayID(), md ? md.name.UTF8String : "(none)", md ? md.registryID : 0);
	id<MTLDevice> def = MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();
	printf("default: %s (0x%llx)\n", def ? def.name.UTF8String : "(none)", def ? def.registryID : 0);
}
static void list(void) {
	CFArrayRef l = NULL;
	if (VTCopyVideoEncoderList(NULL, &l) || !l) { printf("no encoder list\n"); return; }
	for (CFIndex i = 0; i < CFArrayGetCount(l); i++) {
		NSDictionary *d = (__bridge NSDictionary *)CFArrayGetValueAtIndex(l, i);
		printf("%s %-45s %s\n", [d[@"IsHardwareAccelerated"] boolValue] ? "HW" : "  ",
		       [d[(__bridge NSString *)kVTVideoEncoderList_EncoderID] UTF8String],
		       [d[(__bridge NSString *)kVTVideoEncoderList_DisplayName] UTF8String]);
	}
	CFRelease(l);
}

static NSMutableArray *gSamples; static atomic_int gOut, gErr;
static void encCB(void *r, void *s, OSStatus st, VTEncodeInfoFlags f, CMSampleBufferRef sb) {
	if (st || !sb) { atomic_fetch_add(&gErr, 1); return; }
	@synchronized (gSamples) { [gSamples addObject:(__bridge id)sb]; }
	atomic_fetch_add(&gOut, 1);
}
static atomic_int gDec, gDecErr; static OSType gDecFmt;
static void decCB(void *r, void *s, OSStatus st, VTDecodeInfoFlags f, CVImageBufferRef img, CMTime pts, CMTime dur) {
	if (st || !img) { if (atomic_fetch_add(&gDecErr, 1) < 3) printf("  decode frame error %d\n", (int)st); return; }
	gDecFmt = CVPixelBufferGetPixelFormatType(img);
	atomic_fetch_add(&gDec, 1);
}
static int decode(CMFormatDescriptionRef fmt, NSArray *samples, const char *what) {
	NSDictionary *spec = @{(__bridge NSString *)kVTVideoDecoderSpecification_RequireHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder: @YES};
	NSDictionary *attrs = @{(__bridge NSString *)kCVPixelBufferPixelFormatTypeKey: @(kCVPixelFormatType_420YpCbCr8BiPlanarVideoRange),
	                        (__bridge NSString *)kCVPixelBufferIOSurfacePropertiesKey: @{}};
	VTDecompressionOutputCallbackRecord cb = {decCB, NULL};
	VTDecompressionSessionRef ds = NULL;
	OSStatus st = VTDecompressionSessionCreate(NULL, fmt, (__bridge CFDictionaryRef)spec, (__bridge CFDictionaryRef)attrs, &cb, &ds);
	if (st) { printf("%s decode: hardware decoder session failed %d\n", what, (int)st); return 1; }
	CFBooleanRef hw = NULL; CFNumberRef gpu = NULL;
	VTSessionCopyProperty(ds, kVTDecompressionPropertyKey_UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder, NULL, &hw);
	VTSessionCopyProperty(ds, kVTDecompressionPropertyKey_UsingGPURegistryID, NULL, &gpu);
	long long gid = 0; if (gpu) CFNumberGetValue(gpu, kCFNumberLongLongType, &gid);
	atomic_store(&gDec, 0); atomic_store(&gDecErr, 0);
	double t0 = now_s();
	for (id s in samples) {
		VTDecodeFrameFlags fl = kVTDecodeFrame_EnableAsynchronousDecompression; VTDecodeInfoFlags inf = 0;
		st = VTDecompressionSessionDecodeFrame(ds, (__bridge CMSampleBufferRef)s, fl, NULL, &inf);
		if (st) { printf("  DecodeFrame %d\n", (int)st); break; }
	}
	VTDecompressionSessionWaitForAsynchronousFrames(ds);
	double t = now_s() - t0;
	printf("%s decode: %d/%lu frames in %.3f s = %.0f fps, errors %d, hardware %s, GPU regID 0x%llx, out %.4s\n", what,
	       atomic_load(&gDec), (unsigned long)samples.count, t, atomic_load(&gDec) / t, atomic_load(&gDecErr),
	       hw == kCFBooleanTrue ? "YES" : "no", gid, (char *)&(OSType){CFSwapInt32HostToBig(gDecFmt)});
	VTDecompressionSessionInvalidate(ds); CFRelease(ds);
	return atomic_load(&gDec) == (int)samples.count ? 0 : 1;
}
static int enc(const char *codec, int frames) {
	const int W = 1920, H = 1080;
	CMVideoCodecType ct = !strcmp(codec, "hevc") ? kCMVideoCodecType_HEVC : kCMVideoCodecType_H264;
	NSDictionary *spec = @{(__bridge NSString *)kVTVideoEncoderSpecification_RequireHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder: @YES};
	VTCompressionSessionRef cs = NULL;
	gSamples = [NSMutableArray array];
	OSStatus st = VTCompressionSessionCreate(NULL, W, H, ct, (__bridge CFDictionaryRef)spec, NULL, NULL, encCB, NULL, &cs);
	if (st) { printf("%s encode: hardware encoder session failed %d\n", codec, (int)st); return 1; }
	VTSessionSetProperty(cs, kVTCompressionPropertyKey_RealTime, kCFBooleanFalse);
	VTSessionSetProperty(cs, kVTCompressionPropertyKey_AllowFrameReordering, kCFBooleanFalse);
	VTSessionSetProperty(cs, kVTCompressionPropertyKey_AverageBitRate, (__bridge CFTypeRef)@(8000000));
	VTSessionSetProperty(cs, kVTCompressionPropertyKey_MaxKeyFrameInterval, (__bridge CFTypeRef)@(60));
	CFBooleanRef hw = NULL; CFNumberRef gpu = NULL; CFStringRef eid = NULL;
	VTSessionCopyProperty(cs, kVTCompressionPropertyKey_UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder, NULL, &hw);
	VTSessionCopyProperty(cs, kVTCompressionPropertyKey_UsingGPURegistryID, NULL, &gpu);
	VTSessionCopyProperty(cs, CFSTR("EncoderID"), NULL, &eid);
	long long gid = 0; if (gpu) CFNumberGetValue(gpu, kCFNumberLongLongType, &gid);
	CVPixelBufferPoolRef pool = VTCompressionSessionGetPixelBufferPool(cs);
	if (!pool) { printf("no pixel buffer pool\n"); return 1; }
	double t0 = now_s();
	for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
		CVPixelBufferRef pb = NULL;
		if (CVPixelBufferPoolCreatePixelBuffer(NULL, pool, &pb)) { printf("pool alloc failed\n"); break; }
		CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress(pb, 0);
		for (size_t p = 0; p < CVPixelBufferGetPlaneCount(pb); p++) {   // moving gradient
			uint8_t *b = CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddressOfPlane(pb, p); size_t bpr = CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRowOfPlane(pb, p);
			size_t h = CVPixelBufferGetHeightOfPlane(pb, p), w = CVPixelBufferGetWidthOfPlane(pb, p) * (p ? 2 : 1);
			for (size_t y = 0; y < h; y++) for (size_t x = 0; x < w; x += 4) *(uint32_t *)(b + y * bpr + x) = (uint32_t)((x + y + i * 4) * 0x01010101u);
		}
		CVPixelBufferUnlockBaseAddress(pb, 0);
		st = VTCompressionSessionEncodeFrame(cs, pb, CMTimeMake(i, 60), CMTimeMake(1, 60), NULL, NULL, NULL);
		CVPixelBufferRelease(pb);
		if (st) { printf("EncodeFrame %d\n", (int)st); break; }
	}
	VTCompressionSessionCompleteFrames(cs, kCMTimeInvalid);
	double t = now_s() - t0;
	size_t bytes = 0; for (id s in gSamples) bytes += CMSampleBufferGetTotalSampleSize((__bridge CMSampleBufferRef)s);
	printf("%s encode: %d/%d frames 1920x1080 in %.3f s = %.0f fps (incl. CPU frame fill), %zu KB, errors %d, hardware %s, "
	       "encoder %s, GPU regID 0x%llx\n", codec, atomic_load(&gOut), frames, t, atomic_load(&gOut) / t, bytes / 1024,
	       atomic_load(&gErr), hw == kCFBooleanTrue ? "YES" : "no", eid ? CFStringGetCStringPtr(eid, kCFStringEncodingUTF8) : "?", gid);
	VTCompressionSessionInvalidate(cs); CFRelease(cs);
	if (!gSamples.count) return 1;
	return decode(CMSampleBufferGetFormatDescription((__bridge CMSampleBufferRef)gSamples[0]), gSamples, codec);
}
static int decfile(const char *path, int frames) {
	AVAsset *a = [AVURLAsset URLAssetWithURL:[NSURL fileURLWithPath:@(path)] options:nil];
	__block NSArray *tracks = nil; dispatch_semaphore_t sem = dispatch_semaphore_create(0);
	[a loadTracksWithMediaType:AVMediaTypeVideo completionHandler:^(NSArray *t, NSError *e) { tracks = t; dispatch_semaphore_signal(sem); }];
	dispatch_semaphore_wait(sem, dispatch_time(DISPATCH_TIME_NOW, 10 * NSEC_PER_SEC));
	if (!tracks.count) { printf("no video track\n"); return 1; }
	NSError *err = nil; AVAssetReader *rd = [AVAssetReader assetReaderWithAsset:a error:&err];
	AVAssetReaderTrackOutput *o = [AVAssetReaderTrackOutput assetReaderTrackOutputWithTrack:tracks[0] outputSettings:nil];
	[rd addOutput:o]; [rd startReading];
	NSMutableArray *s = [NSMutableArray array]; CMFormatDescriptionRef fmt = NULL;
	CMSampleBufferRef sb;
	while ((int)s.count < frames && (sb = [o copyNextSampleBuffer])) {
		if (CMSampleBufferGetNumSamples(sb)) { if (!fmt) fmt = CMSampleBufferGetFormatDescription(sb); [s addObject:(__bridge_transfer id)sb]; }
		else CFRelease(sb);
	}
	if (!fmt) { printf("no samples\n"); return 1; }
	FourCharCode c = CFSwapInt32HostToBig(CMFormatDescriptionGetMediaSubType(fmt));
	char what[64]; snprintf(what, sizeof what, "%.4s %s", (char *)&c, path);
	return decode(fmt, s, what);
}
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	@autoreleasepool {
		const char *m = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "metal";
		if (!strcmp(m, "metal")) { metal(); return 0; }
		if (!strcmp(m, "list")) { list(); return 0; }
		if (!strcmp(m, "enc") && argc > 2) return enc(argv[2], argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : 600);
		if (!strcmp(m, "dec") && argc > 2) return decfile(argv[2], argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : 100000);
		fprintf(stderr, "usage: vttest metal | list | enc h264|hevc [frames] | dec file.mp4 [frames]\n");
		return 2;
	}
}

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
cd ~/b580
export NVMTL_ENABLE=1 NVMTL_ICD_LIB=$HOME/b580/prof/mesa-rel/libvulkan_intel.dylib
for B in fix18 fix19; do
  export NVMTL_BUNDLE=$HOME/b580/$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle
  echo "== $B"
  echo "cpu reader at completion: $(inv/burstpresent frames 200 seed 7 2>&1 | tail -1)"
  echo "gpu reader at completion: $(inv/burstpresent frames 200 gpu seed 7 2>&1 | tail -1)"
  echo "gpu reader at scheduled:  $(inv/burstpresent frames 200 gpu sched seed 7 2>&1 | grep -v 'implemented in both' | tail -4 | tr '\n' '|')"
  echo "cpu reader at scheduled:  $(inv/burstpresent frames 200 sched seed 7 2>&1 | grep -v 'implemented in both' | tail -3 | tr '\n' '|')"
  echo "gpu sched, SCHEDULE_AFTER_SURFACE_WRITES=1: $(NVMTL_SCHEDULE_AFTER_SURFACE_WRITES=1 inv/burstpresent frames 200 gpu sched seed 7 2>&1 | tail -2 | tr '\n' '|')"
done

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;
kernel void rd(texture2d<float, access::read> t [[texture(0)]], device uint *o [[buffer(0)]], constant uint &w [[buffer(1)]], uint2 g [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {
  if (g.x >= t.get_width() || g.y >= t.get_height()) return;
  float4 c = t.read(g); o[g.y * w + g.x] = pack_float_to_unorm4x8(float4(c.b, c.g, c.r, c.a)); }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// bt: newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow: on MTLBuffers of each storage mode (Geekbench's MPS blur input,
// 1920x1080 RGBA8/BGRA8, bytesPerRow 7680): the texture must exist and sample the buffer's bytes
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#import <objc/message.h>
static id<MTLDevice> bundleDevice(const char *path) {
	NSBundle *b = [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(path)]; NSError *e = nil;
	if (![b loadAndReturnError:&e]) return nil;
	Class cls = [b classNamed:@"NVMTLDevice"]; io_iterator_t it = 0;
	IOServiceGetMatchingServices(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("IOAccelerator"), &it);
	id<MTLDevice> dev = nil;
	for (io_service_t svc; !dev && (svc = IOIteratorNext(it)); IOObjectRelease(svc)) {
		CFTypeRef name = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(svc, CFSTR("MetalPluginClassName"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
		if (name && CFEqual(name, CFSTR("NVMTLDevice"))) dev = ((id (*)(id, SEL, mach_port_t))objc_msgSend)([cls alloc], sel_registerName("initWithAcceleratorPort:"), svc);
		if (name) CFRelease(name); }
	return dev;
}
int main(void) { @autoreleasepool {
	const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE"); id<MTLDevice> dev = bp ? bundleDevice(bp) : nil;
	if (!dev) for (id<MTLDevice> d in MTLCopyAllDevices()) if ([NSStringFromClass([d class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"]) dev = d;
	if (!dev) { printf("no device\n"); return 2; }
	id<MTLCommandQueue> q = [dev newCommandQueue]; int fails = 0;
	const MTLStorageMode modes[3] = { MTLStorageModeShared, MTLStorageModeManaged, MTLStorageModePrivate };
	const MTLPixelFormat fmts[2] = { MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm, MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm };
	const NSUInteger W = 1920, H = 1080, row = 7680;
	for (int f = 0; f < 2; f++) for (int m = 0; m < 3; m++) @autoreleasepool {
		id<MTLBuffer> b = [dev newBufferWithLength:row * H options:(MTLResourceOptions)(modes[m] << MTLResourceStorageModeShift)];
		uint32_t *src = malloc(row * H); for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < W * H; i++) src[i] = 0xff000000u | (uint32_t)(i * 2654435761u >> 8);
		if (modes[m] == MTLStorageModePrivate) {
			id<MTLBuffer> up = [dev newBufferWithBytes:src length:row * H options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
			id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> e = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
			[e copyFromBuffer:up sourceOffset:0 toBuffer:b destinationOffset:0 size:row * H]; [e endEncoding]; [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
		} else { memcpy(b.contents, src, row * H); if (modes[m] == MTLStorageModeManaged) [b didModifyRange:NSMakeRange(0, row * H)]; }
		MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:fmts[f] width:W height:H mipmapped:NO];
		td.storageMode = modes[m]; td.usage = MTLTextureUsageShaderRead | MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite;
		id<MTLTexture> t = [b newTextureWithDescriptor:td offset:0 bytesPerRow:row];
		int bad = -1;
		if (t) {   // read it back through a texture-to-buffer blit and compare
			id<MTLBuffer> rb = [dev newBufferWithLength:row * H options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
			id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> e = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
			[e copyFromTexture:t sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(W, H, 1) toBuffer:rb destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:row destinationBytesPerImage:row * H];
			[e endEncoding]; [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
			bad = memcmp(rb.contents, src, row * H) != 0;
		}
		printf("  %s storage %d: texture %s%s\n", f ? "BGRA8" : "RGBA8", (int)modes[m], t ? "made" : "NIL", bad < 0 ? "" : bad ? ", contents WRONG" : ", contents match");
		fails += !t || bad; free(src);
	}
	printf("%s (%d)\n", fails ? "FAILED" : "PASSED", fails);
	return fails != 0;
} }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// burstpresent: a game's swapchain under irregular present timing, against a reader in another process (WindowServer's
// role). A pool of IOSurfaces is reused as soon as the reader hands one back (race A: seed/reuse); each frame writes its
// surface in two parts (a render-pass clear of the whole surface, an event signal that seals the part, then a copy into
// the bottom half), so a frame's surface-out spans two submission parts. Frames are committed in bursts of 1-8
// back-to-back with random gaps of 0-25 ms between bursts, sometimes from a second queue, some with
// commitAndWaitUntilSubmitted (SkyLight's capture shape). At completion the surface goes to the reader process, which
// locks it and checks every row: top half = frame k's colour, bottom half = its second colour. A row from another frame
// is a stale or reused surface-out. In "race" mode (with NVMTL_CAPTURE_WAIT=1) the reader also gets every 4th frame
// right after commitAndWaitUntilSubmitted, before completion, as a capture does.
// "gpu": the reader samples the surface with its own GPU (a texture over the IOSurface, blitted to a buffer: the plugin's
// surface-in, as WindowServer composites a game's frame) instead of locking it. "sched": the surface goes to the reader
// when the writer's command buffer is scheduled, not completed: CoreAnimation and Apple's GL hand a surface to
// WindowServer after waitUntilScheduled and rely on the driver to order the reader's GPU work after the writer's. The slot
// is reused once the reader is done and the writer has completed.
//   NVMTL_BUNDLE=<bundle> NVMTL_ENABLE=1 ./burstpresent [frames N] [pool P] [race] [gpu] [sched] [seed S]
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#import <IOSurface/IOSurface.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <objc/message.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>

static id<MTLDevice> bundleDevice(const char *path) {
	NSBundle *b = [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(path)];
	NSError *e = nil;
	if (![b loadAndReturnError:&e]) { printf("bundle: %s\n", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return nil; }
	Class cls = [b classNamed:@"NVMTLDevice"];
	io_iterator_t it = 0;
	IOServiceGetMatchingServices(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("IOAccelerator"), &it);
	id<MTLDevice> dev = nil;
	for (io_service_t svc; !dev && (svc = IOIteratorNext(it)); IOObjectRelease(svc)) {
		CFTypeRef name = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(svc, CFSTR("MetalPluginClassName"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
		if (name && CFEqual(name, CFSTR("NVMTLDevice")))
			dev = ((id (*)(id, SEL, mach_port_t))objc_msgSend)([cls alloc], sel_registerName("initWithAcceleratorPort:"), svc);
		if (name) CFRelease(name);
	}
	return dev;
}

// BGRA in memory, A = ff; frame k's two colours differ from every other frame's in the low 24 bits
static uint32_t top_col(uint32_t k) { return 0xff000000u | ((k * 2654435761u) & 0xffffffu) | 1u; }
static uint32_t bot_col(uint32_t k) { return 0xff000000u | ((k * 2246822519u + 0x5a5a5au) & 0xffffffu) | 2u; }

typedef struct { uint32_t sid, frame, slot, capture; } msg_t;   // capture: read before completion (race mode)
typedef struct { uint32_t slot, bad, frame; } ack_t;

// the reader: locks the surface read-only, checks first/middle/last pixel of every row
static id<MTLDevice> bundleDevice(const char *path);
static int reader(int in, int out, int w, int h, int gpu, int war) {
	msg_t m; int fails = 0, n = 0;
	NSMutableDictionary *surfs = [NSMutableDictionary new], *texs = [NSMutableDictionary new];
	id<MTLDevice> dev = nil; id<MTLCommandQueue> q = nil; id<MTLBuffer> out_buf = nil; id<MTLComputePipelineState> pso = nil;
	if (gpu) {
		const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
		dev = bp ? bundleDevice(bp) : nil;
		if (!dev) { printf("  reader: no device\n"); return 2; }
		q = [dev newCommandQueue]; out_buf = [dev newBufferWithLength:(size_t)w * 4 * h options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
		// a shader samples the surface (as a compositor's draw does), so nothing on the reader's side forces its upload
		// of the surface to land early (a blit readback would)
		NSError *e = nil;
		id<MTLLibrary> lib = [dev newLibraryWithSource:@"#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\n"
			"kernel void rd(texture2d<float, access::read> t [[texture(0)]], device uint *o [[buffer(0)]], constant uint &w [[buffer(1)]], uint2 g [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
			"  if (g.x >= t.get_width() || g.y >= t.get_height()) return;\n"
			"  float4 c = t.read(g); o[g.y * w + g.x] = pack_float_to_unorm4x8(float4(c.b, c.g, c.r, c.a)); }\n" options:nil error:&e];
		pso = lib ? [dev newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:[lib newFunctionWithName:@"rd"] error:&e] : nil;
		if (!pso) { fprintf(stderr, "  reader: no compute pipeline: %s\n", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
	}
	while (read(in, &m, sizeof m) == sizeof m) @autoreleasepool {
		IOSurfaceRef s = (__bridge IOSurfaceRef)surfs[@(m.sid)];
		if (!s) { s = IOSurfaceLookup(m.sid); if (!s) { printf("  reader: no surface %u\n", m.sid); return 2; } surfs[@(m.sid)] = CFBridgingRelease(s); }
		const uint8_t *b; size_t row;
		if (gpu) {   // a texture over the surface, copied out on the GPU: what the reader's compositor would sample
			id<MTLTexture> t = texs[@(m.sid)];
			if (!t) {
				MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm width:w height:h mipmapped:NO];
				td.usage = MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; td.storageMode = MTLStorageModeManaged;
				texs[@(m.sid)] = t = [dev newTextureWithDescriptor:td iosurface:s plane:0];
			}
			id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLComputeCommandEncoder> ce = [cb computeCommandEncoder];
			const uint32_t wu = (uint32_t)w;
			[ce setComputePipelineState:pso]; [ce setTexture:t atIndex:0]; [ce setBuffer:out_buf offset:0 atIndex:0]; [ce setBytes:&wu length:4 atIndex:1];
			[ce dispatchThreads:MTLSizeMake(w, h, 1) threadsPerThreadgroup:MTLSizeMake(16, 16, 1)];
			[ce endEncoding]; [cb commit];
			if (war && !m.capture) {   // hand the surface back as soon as the read is submitted: the writer may reuse it now
				ack_t a = { m.slot, 0, m.frame };
				if (write(out, &a, sizeof a) != sizeof a) return 2;
			}
			[cb waitUntilCompleted];
			b = out_buf.contents; row = (size_t)w * 4;
		} else {
			IOSurfaceLock(s, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
			b = IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(s); row = IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRow(s);
		}
		const uint32_t t = top_col(m.frame), z = bot_col(m.frame);
		int bad = 0, first = -1; uint32_t seen = 0;
		for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) {
			const uint32_t want = y < h / 2 ? t : z;
			const uint32_t *r = (const uint32_t *)(b + y * row);
			if (r[0] != want || r[w / 2] != want || r[w - 1] != want) { if (first < 0) { first = y; seen = r[w / 2]; } bad++; }
		}
		if (!gpu) IOSurfaceUnlock(s, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
		if (bad) {
			fails++;
			if (fails <= 12) printf("  reader: frame %u (surface %u, %s): %d rows wrong, first row %d holds %08x (want %08x)\n", m.frame, m.sid,
			                        m.capture ? "captured after submit" : m.capture == 0 && getenv("BP_SCHED") ? "at scheduled" : "at completion", bad, first, seen, first < h / 2 ? t : z);
		}
		n++;
		ack_t a = { m.slot, (uint32_t)bad, m.frame };
		if (!m.capture && !(gpu && war) && write(out, &a, sizeof a) != sizeof a) return 2;
	}
	printf("  reader: %d frames read, %d wrong\n", n, fails);
	return fails ? 1 : 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	@autoreleasepool {
		if (argc == 8 && !strcmp(argv[1], "reader")) {
			const int r = reader(atoi(argv[2]), atoi(argv[3]), atoi(argv[4]), atoi(argv[5]), atoi(argv[6]), atoi(argv[7]));
			fflush(stdout); return r;
		}
		int frames = 600, pool = 3, race = 0, gpu = 0, sched = 0, war = 0, w = 1920, h = 1080; unsigned seed = (unsigned)time(NULL);
		for (int a = 1; a < argc; a++) {
			if (!strcmp(argv[a], "race")) race = 1;
			if (!strcmp(argv[a], "gpu")) gpu = 1;
			if (!strcmp(argv[a], "war")) war = 1;   // with gpu: the reader returns the surface once its GPU read is submitted
			if (!strcmp(argv[a], "sched")) { sched = 1; setenv("BP_SCHED", "1", 1); }
			if (!strcmp(argv[a], "frames") && a + 1 < argc) frames = atoi(argv[++a]);
			if (!strcmp(argv[a], "pool") && a + 1 < argc) pool = atoi(argv[++a]);
			if (!strcmp(argv[a], "seed") && a + 1 < argc) seed = (unsigned)strtoul(argv[++a], NULL, 0);
		}
		if (pool < 2 || pool > 32) pool = 3;
		int toR[2], fromR[2];
		if (pipe(toR) || pipe(fromR)) return 2;
		pid_t p = fork();
		if (!p) { close(toR[1]); close(fromR[0]); // a fresh process (exec): Metal's compiler service is not usable in a forked child
			char a0[16], a1[16], a2[16], a3[16], a4[16], a5[16];
			snprintf(a0, 16, "%d", toR[0]); snprintf(a1, 16, "%d", fromR[1]); snprintf(a2, 16, "%d", w); snprintf(a3, 16, "%d", h);
			snprintf(a4, 16, "%d", gpu); snprintf(a5, 16, "%d", war);
			execl(argv[0], argv[0], "reader", a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, (char *)NULL); _exit(3); }
		close(toR[0]); close(fromR[1]);
		const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
		id<MTLDevice> dev = nil;
		if (bp) dev = bundleDevice(bp);
		else for (id<MTLDevice> d in MTLCopyAllDevices()) if ([NSStringFromClass([d class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"]) dev = d;
		if (!dev) { printf("no device\n"); return 2; }
		printf("device %s, %d frames, pool %d, %dx%d, seed %u%s%s%s\n", dev.name.UTF8String, frames, pool, w, h, seed, race ? ", race" : "",
		       gpu ? (war ? ", GPU reader returning surfaces at submit (WAR)" : ", GPU reader") : "", sched ? ", handed over at scheduled" : "");
		srandom(seed);
		id<MTLCommandQueue> q[2] = { [dev newCommandQueue], [dev newCommandQueue] };
		id<MTLSharedEvent> ev = [dev newSharedEvent]; uint64_t evv = 0;
		IOSurfaceRef surf[32]; id<MTLTexture> tex[32]; int busy[32] = { 0 }; static _Atomic int done[32];
		for (int i = 0; i < pool; i++) {
			surf[i] = IOSurfaceCreate((__bridge CFDictionaryRef)@{ (id)kIOSurfaceWidth: @(w), (id)kIOSurfaceHeight: @(h),
				(id)kIOSurfaceBytesPerElement: @4, (id)kIOSurfaceBytesPerRow: @(w * 4), (id)kIOSurfacePixelFormat: @((uint32_t)'BGRA'),
				(id)kIOSurfaceIsGlobal: @YES });
			MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm width:w height:h mipmapped:NO];
			td.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; td.storageMode = MTLStorageModeManaged;
			tex[i] = [dev newTextureWithDescriptor:td iosurface:surf[i] plane:0];
		}
		// the completion handlers queue their slot here; the main thread sends it to the reader in completion order
		NSMutableArray *landed = [NSMutableArray new]; NSCondition *cv = [NSCondition new];
		__block _Atomic int inflight = 0; int sent = 0, acked = 0, captures = 0, waits = 0, wrong = 0;
		uint64_t gapSum = 0; const uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
		int f = 0;
		while (f < frames || acked < sent || atomic_load(&inflight) || ({ [cv lock]; const NSUInteger nl = landed.count; [cv unlock]; nl; })) @autoreleasepool {
			// hand landed frames to the reader, take its acks back
			[cv lock]; NSArray *ready = [landed copy]; [landed removeAllObjects]; [cv unlock];
			for (NSArray *e in ready) {
				msg_t m = { IOSurfaceGetID(surf[[e[0] intValue]]), [e[1] unsignedIntValue], [e[0] unsignedIntValue], 0 };
				if (write(toR[1], &m, sizeof m) != sizeof m) { printf("reader gone\n"); return 2; }
				sent++;
			}
			while (acked < sent) {
				fd_set rs; FD_ZERO(&rs); FD_SET(fromR[0], &rs); struct timeval tv = { 0, 0 };
				if (select(fromR[0] + 1, &rs, NULL, NULL, &tv) <= 0) break;
				ack_t a; if (read(fromR[0], &a, sizeof a) != sizeof a) { printf("reader gone\n"); return 2; }
				busy[a.slot] = 2; acked++; wrong += a.bad != 0;   // read; free once the writer has completed too
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < pool; i++) if (busy[i] == 2 && atomic_load(&done[i])) busy[i] = 0;
			if (f >= frames) { usleep(200); continue; }
			// a burst of 1-8 frames into whichever surfaces are free, then a gap of 0-25 ms (sometimes none)
			const int burst = 1 + (int)(random() % 8);
			for (int b = 0; b < burst && f < frames; b++) {
				int slot = -1;
				for (int i = 0; i < pool; i++) if (!busy[i]) { slot = i; break; }
				if (slot < 0) break;   // every surface is with the GPU or the reader: the burst ends early, as a blocked nextDrawable
				busy[slot] = 1; atomic_store(&done[slot], 0);
				const uint32_t k = (uint32_t)f++;
				id<MTLCommandQueue> qq = q[(random() % 5) == 0];
				id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [qq commandBuffer];
				MTLRenderPassDescriptor *rp = [MTLRenderPassDescriptor renderPassDescriptor];
				rp.colorAttachments[0].texture = tex[slot]; rp.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear;
				rp.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
				const uint32_t tc = top_col(k);
				rp.colorAttachments[0].clearColor = MTLClearColorMake(((tc >> 16) & 0xff) / 255.0, ((tc >> 8) & 0xff) / 255.0, (tc & 0xff) / 255.0, 1);
				[[cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:rp] endEncoding];
				if (random() & 1) [cb encodeSignalEvent:ev value:++evv];   // seals the first part: the frame spans two
				const size_t bytes = (size_t)w * 4 * (h - h / 2);
				id<MTLBuffer> src = [dev newBufferWithLength:bytes options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
				const uint32_t bc = bot_col(k); uint32_t *px = src.contents; for (size_t i = 0; i < bytes / 4; i++) px[i] = bc;
				id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> bl = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
				[bl copyFromBuffer:src sourceOffset:0 sourceBytesPerRow:w * 4 sourceBytesPerImage:bytes sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(w, h - h / 2, 1)
				         toTexture:tex[slot] destinationSlice:0 destinationLevel:0 destinationOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, h / 2, 0)];
				[bl endEncoding];
				atomic_fetch_add(&inflight, 1);
				if (sched) [cb addScheduledHandler:^(id<MTLCommandBuffer> c) { [cv lock]; [landed addObject:@[ @(slot), @(k) ]]; [cv unlock]; }];
				[cb addCompletedHandler:^(id<MTLCommandBuffer> c) {
					if (!sched) { [cv lock]; [landed addObject:@[ @(slot), @(k) ]]; [cv unlock]; }
					atomic_store(&done[slot], 1);
					atomic_fetch_sub(&inflight, 1);
				}];
				if (race && (k % 4) == 0) {
					((BOOL (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(cb, sel_registerName("commitAndWaitUntilSubmitted"));
					msg_t m = { IOSurfaceGetID(surf[slot]), k, (uint32_t)slot, 1 };
					if (write(toR[1], &m, sizeof m) != sizeof m) { printf("reader gone\n"); return 2; }
					captures++;
				} else if ((random() % 6) == 0) {
					((BOOL (*)(id, SEL))objc_msgSend)(cb, sel_registerName("commitAndWaitUntilSubmitted"));
				} else [cb commit];
				if ((random() % 10) == 0) { [cb waitUntilScheduled]; waits++; }
			}
			const long r = random() % 10;
			const useconds_t gap = r < 3 ? 0 : r < 8 ? (useconds_t)(random() % 8000) : (useconds_t)(8000 + random() % 17000);
			gapSum += gap; if (gap) usleep(gap);
		}
		close(toR[1]);
		int st = 0; waitpid(p, &st, 0);
		const double secs = (clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - t0) / 1e9;
		const int rfail = !WIFEXITED(st) || WEXITSTATUS(st) != 0;
		printf("%d frames in %.1f s (%.0f fps, mean gap %.1f ms), %d read at completion (%d wrong), %d captures, %d scheduled waits\n",
		       frames, secs, frames / secs, gapSum / 1000.0 / frames, sent, wrong, captures, waits);
		for (int i = 0; i < pool; i++) CFRelease(surf[i]);
		printf("%s\n", (wrong || rfail) ? "FAILED" : "PASSED");
		return (wrong || rfail) ? 1 : 0;
	}
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <CoreGraphics/CoreGraphics.h>
int main(int argc, char **argv) { @autoreleasepool {
	FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb"); int w, h; fread(&w, 4, 1, f); fread(&h, 4, 1, f); uint8_t *p = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4); fread(p, 4, (size_t)w * h, f); fclose(f);
	CGColorSpaceRef cs = CGColorSpaceCreateWithName(kCGColorSpaceSRGB);
	CGContextRef s = CGBitmapContextCreate(p, w, h, 8, w * 4, cs, kCGImageAlphaPremultipliedLast | kCGBitmapByteOrder32Big);
	CGImageRef img = CGBitmapContextCreateImage(s);
	const int q[5] = { kCGInterpolationDefault, kCGInterpolationNone, kCGInterpolationLow, kCGInterpolationMedium, kCGInterpolationHigh };
	const char *nm[5] = { "default", "none", "low", "medium", "high" };
	for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
		int o = 64; uint8_t *d = calloc(o * o, 4);
		CGContextRef c = CGBitmapContextCreate(d, o, o, 8, o * 4, cs, kCGImageAlphaPremultipliedLast | kCGBitmapByteOrder32Big);
		CGContextSetInterpolationQuality(c, q[i]); CGContextDrawImage(c, CGRectMake(0, 0, o, o), img);
		char fn[64]; snprintf(fn, sizeof fn, "cg_%s.rgba", nm[i]); FILE *g = fopen(fn, "wb"); fwrite(&o, 4, 1, g); fwrite(&o, 4, 1, g); fwrite(d, 4, o * o, g); fclose(g);
	}
	return 0; } }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// churn: OpenCL-style buffer churn - create, use once, release - at sizes that vary a little (1-80 MB), per storage mode
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#import <objc/message.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
static id<MTLDevice> bundleDevice(const char *path) {
	NSBundle *b = [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(path)]; NSError *e = nil;
	if (![b loadAndReturnError:&e]) return nil;
	Class cls = [b classNamed:@"NVMTLDevice"]; io_iterator_t it = 0;
	IOServiceGetMatchingServices(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("IOAccelerator"), &it);
	id<MTLDevice> d = nil;
	for (io_service_t svc; !d && (svc = IOIteratorNext(it)); IOObjectRelease(svc)) {
		CFTypeRef name = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(svc, CFSTR("MetalPluginClassName"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
		if (name && CFEqual(name, CFSTR("NVMTLDevice"))) d = ((id (*)(id, SEL, mach_port_t))objc_msgSend)([cls alloc], sel_registerName("initWithAcceleratorPort:"), svc);
		if (name) CFRelease(name); }
	return d;
}
static double now_us(void) { static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb); return mach_absolute_time() * (double)tb.numer / tb.denom / 1000.0; }
int main(void) { @autoreleasepool {
	id<MTLDevice> dev = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE") ? bundleDevice(getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE")) : nil;
	if (!dev) for (id<MTLDevice> d in MTLCopyAllDevices()) if ([NSStringFromClass([d class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"]) dev = d;
	id<MTLCommandQueue> q = [dev newCommandQueue];
	const MTLResourceOptions modes[2] = { MTLResourceStorageModePrivate, MTLResourceStorageModeShared };
	for (int m = 0; m < 2; m++) {
		unsigned seed = 1; double t0 = now_us(); int n = 300;
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) @autoreleasepool {
			seed = seed * 1103515245u + 12345u; const size_t base = (size_t)1 << (20 + (seed >> 16) % 7);   // 1-64 MB
			const size_t len = base + (seed >> 8) % (base / 8);                                               // + up to 12%
			id<MTLBuffer> b = [dev newBufferWithLength:len options:modes[m]];
			id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> e = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
			[e fillBuffer:b range:NSMakeRange(0, 4096) value:1]; [e endEncoding]; [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
		}
		printf("%s: %.0f us per create + fill + release (%d buffers, 1-72 MB)\n", m ? "Shared " : "Private", (now_us() - t0) / n, n);
	}
	return 0;
} }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// citest <icon.rgba> : CoreImage 2:1 downscales of the icon on the plugin device (and on the CPU renderer), written out
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <CoreImage/CoreImage.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#import <objc/message.h>
static id<MTLDevice> bundleDevice(const char *path) {
	NSBundle *b = [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(path)]; NSError *e = nil;
	if (![b loadAndReturnError:&e]) return nil;
	Class cls = [b classNamed:@"NVMTLDevice"]; io_iterator_t it = 0;
	IOServiceGetMatchingServices(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("IOAccelerator"), &it);
	id<MTLDevice> dev = nil;
	for (io_service_t svc; !dev && (svc = IOIteratorNext(it)); IOObjectRelease(svc)) {
		CFTypeRef name = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(svc, CFSTR("MetalPluginClassName"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
		if (name && CFEqual(name, CFSTR("NVMTLDevice"))) dev = ((id (*)(id, SEL, mach_port_t))objc_msgSend)([cls alloc], sel_registerName("initWithAcceleratorPort:"), svc);
		if (name) CFRelease(name); }
	return dev;
}
static void out(CIContext *c, CIImage *im, const char *path, int s) {
	uint8_t *p = calloc(s * s, 4);
	[c render:im toBitmap:p rowBytes:s * 4 bounds:CGRectMake(0, 0, s, s) format:kCIFormatRGBA8 colorSpace:CGColorSpaceCreateWithName(kCGColorSpaceSRGB)];
	FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb"); fwrite(&s, 4, 1, f); fwrite(&s, 4, 1, f); fwrite(p, 4, (size_t)s * s, f); fclose(f); free(p);
}
int main(int argc, char **argv) { @autoreleasepool {
	FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb"); int w, h; fread(&w, 4, 1, f); fread(&h, 4, 1, f); uint8_t *p = malloc((size_t)w * h * 4); fread(p, 4, (size_t)w * h, f); fclose(f);
	CIImage *src = [CIImage imageWithBitmapData:[NSData dataWithBytes:p length:(size_t)w * h * 4] bytesPerRow:w * 4 size:CGSizeMake(w, h)
		format:kCIFormatRGBA8 colorSpace:CGColorSpaceCreateWithName(kCGColorSpaceSRGB)];
	const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE"); id<MTLDevice> dev = bp ? bundleDevice(bp) : nil;
	if (!dev) for (id<MTLDevice> d in MTLCopyAllDevices()) if ([NSStringFromClass([d class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"]) dev = d;
	CIContext *g = [CIContext contextWithMTLDevice:dev], *c = [CIContext contextWithOptions:@{ kCIContextUseSoftwareRenderer: @YES }];
	CIImage *aff = [src imageByApplyingTransform:CGAffineTransformMakeScale(.5, .5)];
	CIImage *lan = [src imageByApplyingFilter:@"CILanczosScaleTransform" withInputParameters:@{ @"inputScale": @.5, @"inputAspectRatio": @1 }];
	out(g, aff, "ci_gpu_affine.rgba", w / 2); out(c, aff, "ci_cpu_affine.rgba", w / 2);
	out(g, lan, "ci_gpu_lanczos.rgba", w / 2); out(c, lan, "ci_cpu_lanczos.rgba", w / 2);
	printf("device %s\n", dev.name.UTF8String);
	return 0;
} }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// clatom: the atomic shapes of Geekbench's find_min_and_max and build_histograms on the plugin, timed per dispatch
// (best of 5, clFinish), with a reduction written without per-item global atomics as the achievable reference.
#include <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#include "pickdev.h"
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define CK(x) do { cl_int e_ = (x); if (e_) { printf("%s -> %d\n", #x, e_); return 1; } } while (0)
static double now_ms(void) { static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb); return (double)mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom / 1e6; }
static const char *src =
"__kernel void minmax_global(__global const float *in, __global int *mm) { size_t i = get_global_id(0); int v = as_int(in[i]);\n"
"  atomic_min(&mm[0], v); atomic_max(&mm[1], v); }\n"
"__kernel void minmax_local(__global const float *in, __global int *mm) { __local int lmin, lmax; size_t i = get_global_id(0); int v = as_int(in[i]);\n"
"  if (get_local_id(0) == 0) { lmin = 0x7fffffff; lmax = 0; } barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n"
"  atomic_min(&lmin, v); atomic_max(&lmax, v); barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n"
"  if (get_local_id(0) == 0) { atomic_min(&mm[0], lmin); atomic_max(&mm[1], lmax); } }\n"
"__kernel void minmax_tree(__global const float *in, __global int *mm) { __local int a[256], b[256]; size_t l = get_local_id(0); int v = as_int(in[get_global_id(0)]);\n"
"  a[l] = v; b[l] = v; barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n"
"  for (int s = 128; s > 0; s >>= 1) { if (l < s) { a[l] = min(a[l], a[l + s]); b[l] = max(b[l], b[l + s]); } barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE); }\n"
"  if (l == 0) { atomic_min(&mm[0], a[0]); atomic_max(&mm[1], b[0]); } }\n"
"__kernel void hist_local(__global const uchar *in, __global uint *h, uint n) { __local uint lh[256]; size_t l = get_local_id(0);\n"
"  lh[l] = 0; barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n"
"  for (size_t i = get_global_id(0); i < n; i += get_global_size(0)) atomic_inc(&lh[in[i]]);\n"
"  barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE); atomic_add(&h[l], lh[l]); }\n"
"__kernel void hist_global(__global const uchar *in, __global uint *h) { atomic_inc(&h[in[get_global_id(0)]]); }\n";
int main(void) {
	const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
	if (bp) { CFURLRef u = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)bp, strlen(bp), true); CFBundleRef b = CFBundleCreate(NULL, u);
	  printf("preload %s: %s\n", bp, b && CFBundleLoadExecutable(b) ? "loaded" : "FAILED"); }
	cl_platform_id plat; CK(clGetPlatformIDs(1, &plat, NULL));
	cl_device_id dev; CK(cl_pick_intelxe(plat, &dev));
	cl_int err; cl_context ctx = clCreateContext(NULL, 1, &dev, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	cl_command_queue q = clCreateCommandQueue(ctx, dev, 0, &err); CK(err);
	cl_program p = clCreateProgramWithSource(ctx, 1, &src, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	if (clBuildProgram(p, 1, &dev, "", NULL, NULL)) { char log[8192] = ""; clGetProgramBuildInfo(p, dev, CL_PROGRAM_BUILD_LOG, sizeof log, log, NULL); printf("build: %s\n", log); return 1; }
	const size_t N = 16u << 20;
	float *f = malloc(N * 4); unsigned char *u = malloc(N);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < N; i++) { f[i] = (float)((i * 2654435761u) >> 8) / 16777216.0f + 0.001f; u[i] = (unsigned char)((i * 2654435761u) >> 24); }
	cl_mem bf = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_ONLY | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, N * 4, f, &err); CK(err);
	cl_mem bu = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_ONLY | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, N, u, &err); CK(err);
	cl_mem bmm = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE, 8, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	cl_mem bh = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE, 1024, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	const char *names[5] = { "minmax_global", "minmax_local", "minmax_tree", "hist_local", "hist_global" };
	for (int kk = 0; kk < 5; kk++) {
		cl_kernel k = clCreateKernel(p, names[kk], &err); CK(err);
		size_t g = N, l = 256; cl_uint n = (cl_uint)N;
		if (kk < 3) { CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof bf, &bf)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 1, sizeof bmm, &bmm)); }
		else { CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof bu, &bu)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 1, sizeof bh, &bh)); if (kk == 3) { CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 2, sizeof n, &n)); g = 256 * 160; } }
		double best = 1e9; int mm[2] = { 0, 0 }; unsigned h[256];
		for (int r = 0; r < 5; r++) {
			int init[2] = { 0x7fffffff, 0 }; CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, bmm, CL_TRUE, 0, 8, init, 0, NULL, NULL));
			unsigned z[256] = { 0 }; CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, bh, CL_TRUE, 0, 1024, z, 0, NULL, NULL));
			const double t0 = now_ms(); CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL)); CK(clFinish(q));
			const double t = now_ms() - t0; if (t < best) best = t;
			CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, bmm, CL_TRUE, 0, 8, mm, 0, NULL, NULL)); CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, bh, CL_TRUE, 0, 1024, h, 0, NULL, NULL));
		}
		unsigned long long hs = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) hs += h[i];
		if (kk < 3) printf("%-14s %8.2f ms  min %g max %g\n", names[kk], best, *(float *)&mm[0], *(float *)&mm[1]);
		else printf("%-14s %8.2f ms  histogram total %llu of %zu\n", names[kk], best, hs, N);
		clReleaseKernel(k);
	}
	return 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// clbw: OpenCL buffer bandwidth on the B580 plugin - a plain copy kernel and clEnqueueCopyBuffer over 64 MB buffers,
// timed with clFinish. Tells whether Apple's OpenCL buffers sit in VRAM or in system RAM behind PCIe.
#include <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#include "pickdev.h"
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define CK(x) do { cl_int e_ = (x); if (e_) { printf("%s -> %d\n", #x, e_); return 1; } } while (0)
static const char *src =
	"__kernel void cp(__global const int4 *a, __global int4 *b) { size_t i = get_global_id(0); b[i] = a[i]; }\n";
static double now_ms(void) { static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb); return (double)mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom / 1e6; }
int main(void) {
	const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
	if (bp) { CFURLRef u = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)bp, strlen(bp), true); CFBundleRef b = CFBundleCreate(NULL, u);
	  printf("preload %s: %s\n", bp, b && CFBundleLoadExecutable(b) ? "loaded" : "FAILED"); }
	cl_platform_id plat; CK(clGetPlatformIDs(1, &plat, NULL));
	cl_device_id dev; CK(cl_pick_intelxe(plat, &dev));
	cl_int err; cl_context ctx = clCreateContext(NULL, 1, &dev, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	cl_command_queue q = clCreateCommandQueue(ctx, dev, 0, &err); CK(err);
	cl_program p = clCreateProgramWithSource(ctx, 1, &src, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	CK(clBuildProgram(p, 1, &dev, "", NULL, NULL));
	cl_kernel k = clCreateKernel(p, "cp", &err); CK(err);
	const size_t n = 64u << 20; void *h = malloc(n); memset(h, 1, n);
	// CLBW_FLAGS=use: CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR (page-aligned host memory), alloc: CL_MEM_ALLOC_HOST_PTR, else device buffers
	const char *fl = getenv("CLBW_FLAGS"); void *ha = NULL, *hb = NULL; posix_memalign(&ha, 16384, n); posix_memalign(&hb, 16384, n); memset(ha, 1, n);
	cl_mem_flags f = fl && !strcmp(fl, "use") ? CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR : fl && !strcmp(fl, "alloc") ? CL_MEM_ALLOC_HOST_PTR : 0;
	cl_mem a = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | (f ? f : CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR), n, f == CL_MEM_ALLOC_HOST_PTR ? NULL : (f ? ha : h), &err); CK(err);
	cl_mem b = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | f, n, f == CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR ? hb : NULL, &err); CK(err);
	CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof a, &a)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 1, sizeof b, &b));
	size_t g = n / 16, l = 256;
	for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
		CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL)); CK(clFinish(q));
		double t0 = now_ms();
		for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL));
		CK(clFinish(q)); double t1 = now_ms();
		for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) CK(clEnqueueCopyBuffer(q, a, b, 0, 0, n, 0, NULL, NULL));
		CK(clFinish(q)); double t2 = now_ms();
		CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, n, h, 0, NULL, NULL)); double t3 = now_ms();
		if (pass) printf("copy kernel %.1f GB/s (read+write), clEnqueueCopyBuffer %.1f GB/s, readback %.1f GB/s\n",
		                 2.0 * n * 20 / ((t1 - t0) / 1e3) / 1e9, 2.0 * n * 20 / ((t2 - t1) / 1e3) / 1e9, n / ((t3 - t2) / 1e3) / 1e9);
	}
	return 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/inv/clchurn.m
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// clchurn: Geekbench-like OpenCL buffer churn on the plugin - buffers of mixed sizes and kinds (device, COPY_HOST_PTR,
// USE_HOST_PTR, ALLOC_HOST_PTR) created, used by a copy kernel, read back and released, with up to 48 kept alive at a
// time. Every 500 iterations it prints the plugin's VkDeviceMemory total (MTLDevice currentAllocatedSize, the same
// counter as the "holding MB" census) against the bytes the live buffers need; FAILS if the total exceeds live + 1.5 GB.
//   clchurn [iterations] [seconds]
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#include <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#include "pickdev.h"
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#define CK(x) do { cl_int e_ = (x); if (e_) { printf("%s -> %d (iteration %d)\n", #x, e_, it); return 1; } } while (0)
static double now_s(void) { static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb); return (double)mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom / 1e9; }
static const char *src = "__kernel void cp(__global const uchar *a, __global uchar *b, uint n) { size_t i = get_global_id(0); if (i < n) b[i] = a[i] + 1; }\n";
typedef struct { cl_mem m; size_t n; void *host; } live_t;
int main(int argc, char **argv) { @autoreleasepool {
    int it = 0;
    const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
    if (bp) { CFURLRef u = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)bp, strlen(bp), true); CFBundleRef b = CFBundleCreate(NULL, u);
              printf("preload %s: %s\n", bp, b && CFBundleLoadExecutable(b) ? "loaded" : "FAILED"); }
    id<MTLDevice> dev = mtl_pick_intelxe();
    const int iters = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 20000; const double secs = argc > 2 ? atof(argv[2]) : 1e9;
    cl_platform_id plat; CK(clGetPlatformIDs(1, &plat, NULL));
    cl_device_id cd; CK(cl_pick_intelxe(plat, &cd));
    cl_int err; cl_context ctx = clCreateContext(NULL, 1, &cd, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
    cl_command_queue q = clCreateCommandQueue(ctx, cd, 0, &err); CK(err);
    cl_program p = clCreateProgramWithSource(ctx, 1, &src, NULL, &err); CK(err); CK(clBuildProgram(p, 1, &cd, "", NULL, NULL));
    cl_kernel k = clCreateKernel(p, "cp", &err); CK(err);
    live_t live[48]; memset(live, 0, sizeof live);
    static const size_t sizes[] = { 4096, 16384, 65536, 200000, 1u << 20, (1u << 20) + 4096, 3u << 20, 9u << 20, 24u << 20, 64u << 20 };
    unsigned seed = 12345; size_t peak = 0, worst_over = 0; const double t0 = now_s();
    uint8_t *scratch = malloc(64u << 20); memset(scratch, 7, 64u << 20);
    for (it = 0; it < iters && now_s() - t0 < secs; it++) {
        seed = seed * 1103515245u + 12345u; const size_t n = sizes[(seed >> 16) % 10];
        const int kind = (int)((seed >> 8) % 4);
        void *host = NULL; cl_mem_flags f = CL_MEM_READ_WRITE;
        if (kind == 1) f |= CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR;
        if (kind == 2) { posix_memalign(&host, 16384, (n + 16383) & ~(size_t)16383); memset(host, 3, n); f |= CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR; }
        if (kind == 3) f |= CL_MEM_ALLOC_HOST_PTR;
        cl_mem a = clCreateBuffer(ctx, f, n, kind == 1 ? scratch : host, &err); CK(err);
        cl_mem b = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE, n, NULL, &err); CK(err);
        cl_uint nn = (cl_uint)n; CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof a, &a)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 1, sizeof b, &b)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 2, sizeof nn, &nn));
        size_t g = (n + 255) / 256 * 256, l = 256; CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL));
        if (it % 8 == 0) { uint8_t r[16]; CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, n - 16, 16, r, 0, NULL, NULL)); }
        clReleaseMemObject(a);
        // keep b alive in a random slot; the one it displaces is released
        const int s = (int)((seed >> 4) % 48);
        if (live[s].m) { clReleaseMemObject(live[s].m); free(live[s].host); }
        live[s] = (live_t){ b, n, host };
        const int every = getenv("CHURN_EVERY") ? atoi(getenv("CHURN_EVERY")) : 500;
        if (it % every == every - 1) {
            CK(clFinish(q));
            size_t need = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 48; i++) if (live[i].m) need += live[i].n;
            const size_t held = (size_t)dev.currentAllocatedSize; if (held > peak) peak = held;
            const size_t over = held > need ? held - need : 0; if (over > worst_over) worst_over = over;
            printf("iteration %d: holding %zu MB of VkDeviceMemory, live buffers need %zu MB, over by %zu MB\n", it + 1, held >> 20, need >> 20, over >> 20);
            fflush(stdout);
        }
    }
    CK(clFinish(q));
    for (int i = 0; i < 48; i++) if (live[i].m) { clReleaseMemObject(live[i].m); free(live[i].host); }
    clFinish(q);
    const size_t end = (size_t)dev.currentAllocatedSize;
    const int ok = worst_over < ((size_t)1536 << 20);
    printf("%s: %d iterations in %.0f s, peak %zu MB held, worst %zu MB over the live buffers, %zu MB held after release\n",
           ok ? "PASSED" : "FAILED", it, now_s() - t0, peak >> 20, worst_over >> 20, end >> 20);
    return ok ? 0 : 1;
} }

FILE: user/tests/inv/clcoh.c
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// clcoh: OpenCL host/device coherence on the plugin, for every buffer kind (device, COPY_HOST_PTR, USE_HOST_PTR,
// ALLOC_HOST_PTR) and several sizes (64 B .. 8 MB):
//   1. host data in at creation -> kernel adds 1 -> clEnqueueReadBuffer sees it
//   2. clEnqueueWriteBuffer of a partial range (at a 256-byte offset: unaligned offsets are a known bug, see clpw) -> kernel
//   3. map for write, host writes a partial range, unmap -> kernel -> map for read sees it
//   4. USE_HOST_PTR: after clFinish + map, the host pointer itself holds the kernel's result
//   5. atomics on a small buffer from many work-items (a counter) -> exact total
#include <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#include "pickdev.h"
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define CK(x) do { cl_int e_ = (x); if (e_) { printf("%s -> %d\n", #x, e_); return 1; } } while (0)
static const char *src =
"__kernel void inc(__global uint *a, uint n) { size_t i = get_global_id(0); if (i < n) a[i] += 1u; }\n"
"__kernel void count(__global uint *c) { atomic_inc(&c[get_global_id(0) & 7]); }\n";
static int fails;
static void check(const char *what, const char *kind, size_t n, const unsigned *got, unsigned (*want)(size_t)) {
	size_t bad = 0, first = (size_t)-1;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (got[i] != want(i)) { if (first == (size_t)-1) first = i; bad++; }
	if (bad) { fails++; printf("FAIL %-6s %-22s %8zu words: %zu wrong (first at %zu: %u, want %u)\n", kind, what, n, bad, first, got[first], want(first)); }
}
static unsigned w1(size_t i) { return (unsigned)i * 3u + 1u; }
static unsigned w2(size_t i) { return (i >= 64 && i < 64 + 100) ? 1000u + (unsigned)i + 1u : (unsigned)i * 3u + 2u; }
static unsigned w3(size_t i) { return (i % 5 == 0) ? 77u + 1u : w2(i) + 1u; }
int main(void) {
	const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
	if (bp) { CFURLRef u = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)bp, strlen(bp), true); CFBundleRef b = CFBundleCreate(NULL, u);
	  printf("preload %s: %s\n", bp, b && CFBundleLoadExecutable(b) ? "loaded" : "FAILED"); }
	cl_platform_id plat; CK(clGetPlatformIDs(1, &plat, NULL));
	cl_device_id dev; CK(cl_pick_intelxe(plat, &dev));
	cl_int err; cl_context ctx = clCreateContext(NULL, 1, &dev, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	cl_command_queue q = clCreateCommandQueue(ctx, dev, 0, &err); CK(err);
	cl_program p = clCreateProgramWithSource(ctx, 1, &src, NULL, &err); CK(err); CK(clBuildProgram(p, 1, &dev, "", NULL, NULL));
	cl_kernel kinc = clCreateKernel(p, "inc", &err); CK(err); cl_kernel kcnt = clCreateKernel(p, "count", &err); CK(err);
	static const size_t words[] = { 16, 1024, 16384, 262144, 2u << 20 };
	const char *kinds[4] = { "device", "copy", "use", "alloc" };
	for (int kd = 0; kd < 4; kd++) for (int si = 0; si < 5; si++) {
		const size_t n = words[si], bytes = n * 4;
		unsigned *init = malloc(bytes); for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) init[i] = (unsigned)i * 3u;
		void *host = NULL; posix_memalign(&host, 16384, (bytes + 16383) & ~(size_t)16383); memcpy(host, init, bytes);
		cl_mem_flags f = CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | (kd == 1 ? CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR : kd == 2 ? CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR : kd == 3 ? CL_MEM_ALLOC_HOST_PTR : 0);
		cl_mem b = clCreateBuffer(ctx, f, bytes, kd == 1 ? init : kd == 2 ? host : NULL, &err); CK(err);
		if (kd == 0 || kd == 3) CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, bytes, init, 0, NULL, NULL));
		cl_uint nn = (cl_uint)n; size_t g = (n + 63) / 64 * 64, l = 64;
		CK(clSetKernelArg(kinc, 0, sizeof b, &b)); CK(clSetKernelArg(kinc, 1, sizeof nn, &nn));
		unsigned *got = malloc(bytes);
		// 1
		CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, kinc, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL)); CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, bytes, got, 0, NULL, NULL));
		check("kernel -> read", kinds[kd], n, got, w1);
		// 2: partial write between enqueues
		const size_t pn = n > 164 ? 100 : 0; unsigned part[100]; for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) part[i] = 1000u + 64u + (unsigned)i;
		if (pn) CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, b, getenv("CLCOH_BLOCK") ? CL_TRUE : CL_FALSE, 64 * 4, pn * 4, part, 0, NULL, NULL));
		CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, kinc, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL)); CK(clFinish(q));
		CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, bytes, got, 0, NULL, NULL));
		if (pn) check("partial write -> kernel", kinds[kd], n, got, w2);
		// 3: map, host writes every 5th word, unmap, kernel, map for read
		unsigned *m = clEnqueueMapBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, CL_MAP_READ | CL_MAP_WRITE, 0, bytes, 0, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
		for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i += 5) m[i] = 77u;
		CK(clEnqueueUnmapMemObject(q, b, m, 0, NULL, NULL));
		CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, kinc, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL)); CK(clFinish(q));
		m = clEnqueueMapBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, CL_MAP_READ, 0, bytes, 0, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
		if (pn) check("map write -> kernel -> map", kinds[kd], n, m, w3);
		CK(clEnqueueUnmapMemObject(q, b, m, 0, NULL, NULL)); CK(clFinish(q));
		// 4: USE_HOST_PTR: the host pointer holds the result once mapped
		if (kd == 2 && pn) { m = clEnqueueMapBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, CL_MAP_READ, 0, bytes, 0, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
			check("use_host_ptr pointer", kinds[kd], n, (unsigned *)host, w3); CK(clEnqueueUnmapMemObject(q, b, m, 0, NULL, NULL)); CK(clFinish(q)); }
		clReleaseMemObject(b); free(init); free(got); free(host);
	}
	// 5: a small counter buffer of each kind under 1M atomic increments
	for (int kd = 0; kd < 4; kd++) {
		unsigned z[8] = { 0 }; void *host = NULL; posix_memalign(&host, 16384, 16384); memset(host, 0, 16384);
		cl_mem_flags f = CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | (kd == 1 ? CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR : kd == 2 ? CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR : kd == 3 ? CL_MEM_ALLOC_HOST_PTR : 0);
		cl_mem c = clCreateBuffer(ctx, f, 32, kd == 1 ? z : kd == 2 ? host : NULL, &err); CK(err);
		if (kd == 0 || kd == 3) CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, c, CL_TRUE, 0, 32, z, 0, NULL, NULL));
		CK(clSetKernelArg(kcnt, 0, sizeof c, &c)); size_t g = 1u << 20, l = 256;
		CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, kcnt, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL));
		unsigned r[8]; CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, c, CL_TRUE, 0, 32, r, 0, NULL, NULL));
		for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (r[i] != (1u << 17)) { fails++; printf("FAIL %-6s counter[%d] = %u, want %u\n", kinds[kd], i, r[i], 1u << 17); break; }
		clReleaseMemObject(c); free(host);
	}
	printf("%s (%d failures)\n", fails ? "FAILED" : "PASSED", fails);
	return fails != 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// clpw: a partial clEnqueueWriteBuffer (offset 28, 400 bytes) read straight back, per buffer kind
#include <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#include "pickdev.h"
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define CK(x) do { cl_int e_ = (x); if (e_) { printf("%s -> %d\n", #x, e_); return 1; } } while (0)
static int fails;
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
	if (bp) { CFURLRef u = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)bp, strlen(bp), true); CFBundleRef b = CFBundleCreate(NULL, u); if (b) CFBundleLoadExecutable(b); }
	cl_platform_id plat; CK(clGetPlatformIDs(1, &plat, NULL));
	cl_device_id dev; CK(cl_pick_intelxe(plat, &dev));
	cl_int err; cl_context ctx = clCreateContext(NULL, 1, &dev, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	cl_command_queue q = clCreateCommandQueue(ctx, dev, 0, &err); CK(err);
	const size_t n = 4096; unsigned init[4096], got[4096], part[100];
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) init[i] = (unsigned)i; for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) part[i] = 5000u + (unsigned)i;
	const size_t offs[4] = { 0, 28, 256, 4 };
	for (int oi = 0; oi < 4; oi++) {
		cl_mem b = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, n * 4, init, &err); CK(err);
		CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, offs[oi], 400, part, 0, NULL, NULL));
		CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, n * 4, got, 0, NULL, NULL));
		int bad = 0; for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { unsigned w = (i >= offs[oi] / 4 && i < offs[oi] / 4 + 100) ? 5000u + (unsigned)(i - offs[oi] / 4) : (unsigned)i; bad += got[i] != w; }
		printf("offset %3zu: %d wrong (word %zu = %u)\n", offs[oi], bad, offs[oi] / 4, got[offs[oi] / 4]); fails += bad != 0;
		clReleaseMemObject(b);
	}
	// GPU-side copies: dst offset 28 from src 0, and src offset 28 to dst 0
	for (int v = 0; v < 2; v++) {
		cl_mem a = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, n * 4, init, &err); CK(err);
		unsigned pat[4096]; for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) pat[i] = 9000u + (unsigned)i;
		cl_mem s2 = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, n * 4, pat, &err); CK(err);
		CK(clEnqueueCopyBuffer(q, s2, a, v ? 28 : 0, v ? 0 : 28, 400, 0, NULL, NULL));
		CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, a, CL_TRUE, 0, n * 4, got, 0, NULL, NULL));
		const size_t d = v ? 0 : 7, so = v ? 7 : 0; int bad = 0;
		for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { unsigned w = (i >= d && i < d + 100) ? 9000u + (unsigned)(i - d + so) : (unsigned)i; bad += got[i] != w; }
		printf("copy %s: %d wrong (word %zu = %u)\n", v ? "src+28 -> dst+0" : "src+0 -> dst+28", bad, d, got[d]); fails += bad != 0;
	}
	printf("%s (%d failures)\n", fails ? "FAILED" : "PASSED", fails);
	return fails != 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// clpwb: byte-offset OpenCL writes and copies (offsets 1, 2, 3, 5): do they land, and does the plugin need the twin
#include <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#include "pickdev.h"
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define CK(x) do { cl_int e_ = (x); if (e_) { printf("%s -> %d\n", #x, e_); return 1; } } while (0)
int main(void) {
	const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
	if (bp) { CFURLRef u = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)bp, strlen(bp), true); CFBundleRef b = CFBundleCreate(NULL, u); if (b) CFBundleLoadExecutable(b); }
	cl_platform_id plat; CK(clGetPlatformIDs(1, &plat, NULL));
	cl_device_id dev; CK(cl_pick_intelxe(plat, &dev));
	cl_int err; cl_context ctx = clCreateContext(NULL, 1, &dev, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	cl_command_queue q = clCreateCommandQueue(ctx, dev, 0, &err); CK(err);
	const size_t n = 16384; unsigned char init[16384], got[16384], part[333];
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) init[i] = (unsigned char)i; for (int i = 0; i < 333; i++) part[i] = (unsigned char)(200 + i);
	static const size_t offs[4] = { 1, 2, 3, 5 }; int fails = 0;
	for (int v = 0; v < 2; v++) for (int oi = 0; oi < 4; oi++) {
		const size_t o = offs[oi];
		cl_mem b = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, n, init, &err); CK(err);
		if (!v) CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, o, 333, part, 0, NULL, NULL));
		else { cl_mem s = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, 333, part, &err); CK(err);
		       CK(clEnqueueCopyBuffer(q, s, b, 0, o, 333, 0, NULL, NULL)); clFinish(q); clReleaseMemObject(s); }
		CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, n, got, 0, NULL, NULL));
		int bad = 0; for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { unsigned char w = (i >= o && i < o + 333) ? (unsigned char)(200 + (i - o)) : (unsigned char)i; bad += got[i] != w; }
		printf("%s at byte offset %zu: %d wrong\n", v ? "copy" : "write", o, bad); fails += bad != 0;
		clReleaseMemObject(b);
	}
	printf("%s (%d failures)\n", fails ? "FAILED" : "PASSED", fails);
	return fails != 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// clrw: per-enqueue host transfers: a loop of clEnqueueWriteBuffer (8 MB from a malloc'd host array) -> kernel ->
// clEnqueueReadBuffer (8 MB back), for a device buffer and an ALLOC_HOST_PTR one mapped instead; prints ms per round.
//   clrw [seconds]
#include <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#include "pickdev.h"
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define CK(x) do { cl_int e_ = (x); if (e_) { printf("%s -> %d\n", #x, e_); return 1; } } while (0)
static double now_ms(void) { static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb); return (double)mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom / 1e6; }
static const char *src = "__kernel void inc(__global uint *a) { a[get_global_id(0)] += 1u; }\n";
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
	if (bp) { CFURLRef u = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)bp, strlen(bp), true); CFBundleRef b = CFBundleCreate(NULL, u); if (b) CFBundleLoadExecutable(b); }
	const double secs = argc > 1 ? atof(argv[1]) : 6;
	cl_platform_id plat; CK(clGetPlatformIDs(1, &plat, NULL));
	cl_device_id dev; CK(cl_pick_intelxe(plat, &dev));
	cl_int err; cl_context ctx = clCreateContext(NULL, 1, &dev, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	cl_command_queue q = clCreateCommandQueue(ctx, dev, 0, &err); CK(err);
	cl_program p = clCreateProgramWithSource(ctx, 1, &src, NULL, &err); CK(err); CK(clBuildProgram(p, 1, &dev, "", NULL, NULL));
	cl_kernel k = clCreateKernel(p, "inc", &err); CK(err);
	const size_t n = 2u << 20, bytes = n * 4; unsigned *h = malloc(bytes); for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) h[i] = (unsigned)i;
	for (int mode = 0; mode < 2; mode++) {
		cl_mem b = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | (mode ? CL_MEM_ALLOC_HOST_PTR : 0), bytes, NULL, &err); CK(err);
		CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof b, &b)); size_t g = n, l = 256; int rounds = 0; unsigned bad = 0;
		const double t0 = now_ms();
		while (now_ms() - t0 < secs * 500) {
			if (!mode) CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, b, CL_FALSE, 0, bytes, h, 0, NULL, NULL));
			else { unsigned *m = clEnqueueMapBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, CL_MAP_WRITE, 0, bytes, 0, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err); memcpy(m, h, bytes); CK(clEnqueueUnmapMemObject(q, b, m, 0, NULL, NULL)); }
			CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL));
			if (!mode) CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, bytes, h, 0, NULL, NULL));
			else { unsigned *m = clEnqueueMapBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, CL_MAP_READ, 0, bytes, 0, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err); memcpy(h, m, bytes); CK(clEnqueueUnmapMemObject(q, b, m, 0, NULL, NULL)); }
			rounds++;
		}
		CK(clFinish(q)); const double t = now_ms() - t0;
		for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i += 4099) bad += h[i] != (unsigned)i + (unsigned)rounds * (mode + 1) - (mode ? 0 : 0) && 0;
		printf("%-12s 8 MB write + kernel + read: %.2f ms per round (%d rounds)\n", mode ? "alloc_host" : "device", t / rounds, rounds);
		clReleaseMemObject(b);
	}
	return 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// cltr: OpenCL kernels that failed AIR->SPIR-V translation on the B580 plugin - a uchar4 buffer box filter and
// native_powr (Geekbench's HDR workloads) - run once each and checked against the CPU.
#include <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#include "pickdev.h"
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define CK(x) do { cl_int e_ = (x); if (e_) { printf("%s -> %d\n", #x, e_); return 1; } } while (0)
static const char *src =
	"__kernel void boxu(__global const uchar4 *in, __global uchar4 *out, int w, int h) { int x = get_global_id(0), y = get_global_id(1);\n"
	"  float4 a = 0; for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) { int xx = clamp(x + dx, 0, w - 1), yy = clamp(y + dy, 0, h - 1);\n"
	"  a += convert_float4(in[yy * w + xx]); } out[y * w + x] = convert_uchar4_sat_rte(a / 9.0f); }\n"
	"__kernel void amax(__global const float *in, __global int *m) { __local int lm; int i = get_global_id(0); if (get_local_id(0) == 0) lm = 0; barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n"
	"  atomic_max(&lm, as_int(in[i])); barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE); if (get_local_id(0) == 0) atomic_max(m, lm); }\n"
	"__kernel void amaxf(__global const float *in, __global float *m) { int i = get_global_id(0); atomic_max((volatile __global int *)m, as_int(in[i])); }\n"
	"__kernel void amaxl(__global const float *in, __global float *m) { __local float lf[4]; int i = get_global_id(0), l = get_local_id(0); if (l < 4) lf[l] = 0; barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n"
	"  atomic_max((volatile __local int *)&lf[l & 3], as_int(in[i])); barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE); if (l < 4) atomic_max((volatile __global int *)m, as_int(lf[l])); }\n"
	"__kernel void amaxarg(__global const float *in, __global int *m, __local int *lm) { int i = get_global_id(0), l = get_local_id(0);\n"
	"  if (l == 0) lm[0] = 0; barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE); atomic_max(lm, (int)(in[i] * 1000.0f)); barrier(CLK_LOCAL_MEM_FENCE);\n"
	"  if (l == 0) atomic_max(m, convert_int(lm[0])); }\n"
	"__kernel void npow(__global const float4 *in, __global float4 *out) { int i = get_global_id(0); out[i] = native_powr(in[i], (float4)(2.2f)); }\n";
int main(void) {
	// NVMTL_BUNDLE: preload that plugin build so its classes are the ones Metal instantiates for OpenCL (a test hook)
	const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
	if (bp) { CFURLRef u = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)bp, strlen(bp), true); CFBundleRef b = CFBundleCreate(NULL, u);
	  printf("preload %s: %s\n", bp, b && CFBundleLoadExecutable(b) ? "loaded" : "FAILED"); }
	cl_platform_id plat; CK(clGetPlatformIDs(1, &plat, NULL));
	cl_device_id dev; CK(cl_pick_intelxe(plat, &dev));
	cl_int err; cl_context ctx = clCreateContext(NULL, 1, &dev, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	cl_command_queue q = clCreateCommandQueue(ctx, dev, 0, &err); CK(err);
	cl_program p = clCreateProgramWithSource(ctx, 1, &src, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	if (clBuildProgram(p, 1, &dev, "", NULL, NULL)) { char log[8192] = ""; clGetProgramBuildInfo(p, dev, CL_PROGRAM_BUILD_LOG, sizeof log, log, NULL); printf("build: %s\n", log); return 1; }
	int fails = 0;
	{ const int W = 256, H = 256; size_t n = (size_t)W * H * 4; unsigned char *in = malloc(n), *out = calloc(n, 1);
	  for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) in[i] = (unsigned char)(i * 2654435761u >> 24);
	  cl_kernel k = clCreateKernel(p, "boxu", &err);
	  if (err) { printf("uchar4 box: clCreateKernel -> %d (translation failed)\n", err); fails++; } else {
	  cl_mem bi = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_ONLY | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, n, in, &err); CK(err);
	  cl_mem bo = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_WRITE_ONLY, n, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	  CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof bi, &bi)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 1, sizeof bo, &bo)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 2, 4, &W)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 3, 4, &H));
	  size_t g[2] = {W, H}; err = clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 2, NULL, g, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL);
	  if (err) { printf("uchar4 box: enqueue -> %d\n", err); fails++; }
	  else { CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, bo, CL_TRUE, 0, n, out, 0, NULL, NULL)); int bad = 0;
	    for (int y = 0; y < H; y++) for (int x = 0; x < W; x++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { float a = 0;
	      for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) { int xx = x + dx < 0 ? 0 : x + dx >= W ? W - 1 : x + dx, yy = y + dy < 0 ? 0 : y + dy >= H ? H - 1 : y + dy; a += in[((size_t)yy * W + xx) * 4 + c]; }
	      int ref = (int)lrintf(a / 9.0f); if (abs(ref - out[((size_t)y * W + x) * 4 + c]) > 1) bad++; }
	    printf("uchar4 box: %d of %zu values wrong\n", bad, n); fails += bad != 0; } } }
	{ const int N = 4096; float *in = malloc(N * 16), *out = calloc(N, 16); for (int i = 0; i < 4 * N; i++) in[i] = (i % 1000) / 1000.0f;
	  cl_kernel k = clCreateKernel(p, "npow", &err);
	  if (err) { printf("native_powr: clCreateKernel -> %d (translation failed)\n", err); fails++; } else {
	  cl_mem bi = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_ONLY | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, N * 16, in, &err); CK(err);
	  cl_mem bo = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_WRITE_ONLY, N * 16, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	  CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof bi, &bi)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 1, sizeof bo, &bo));
	  size_t g = N; err = clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 1, NULL, &g, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL);
	  if (err) { printf("native_powr: enqueue -> %d\n", err); fails++; }
	  else { CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, bo, CL_TRUE, 0, N * 16, out, 0, NULL, NULL)); int bad = 0;
	    for (int i = 0; i < 4 * N; i++) if (fabsf(out[i] - powf(in[i], 2.2f)) > 1e-3f + 1e-3f * powf(in[i], 2.2f)) bad++;
	    printf("native_powr: %d of %d values wrong\n", bad, 4 * N); fails += bad != 0; } } }
	{ const int N = 1 << 16; float *in = malloc(N * 4); float mx = 0; for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { in[i] = (float)((i * 2654435761u) >> 8) / 65536.0f; if (in[i] > mx) mx = in[i]; }
	  cl_kernel k = clCreateKernel(p, "amax", &err);
	  if (err) { printf("atomic_max: clCreateKernel -> %d (translation failed)\n", err); fails++; } else {
	  int zero = 0; cl_mem bi = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_ONLY | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, N * 4, in, &err); CK(err);
	  cl_mem bm = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, 4, &zero, &err); CK(err);
	  CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof bi, &bi)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 1, sizeof bm, &bm));
	  size_t g = N, l = 256; CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL));
	  int got = 0; CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, bm, CL_TRUE, 0, 4, &got, 0, NULL, NULL)); float gf; memcpy(&gf, &got, 4);
	  printf("atomic_max: %g (CPU %g) %s\n", gf, mx, gf == mx ? "ok" : "WRONG"); fails += gf != mx; } }
	{ const int N = 1 << 16; float *in = malloc(N * 4); float mx = 0; for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { in[i] = (float)((i * 2654435761u) >> 8) / 65536.0f; if (in[i] > mx) mx = in[i]; }
	  for (int kk = 0; kk < 2; kk++) {
	  cl_kernel k = clCreateKernel(p, kk ? "amaxl" : "amaxf", &err);
	  if (err) { printf("atomic_max via a float buffer: clCreateKernel -> %d (translation failed)\n", err); fails++; } else {
	  float zero = 0; cl_mem bi = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_ONLY | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, N * 4, in, &err); CK(err);
	  cl_mem bm = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, 4, &zero, &err); CK(err);
	  CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof bi, &bi)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 1, sizeof bm, &bm));
	  size_t g = N; size_t lsz = 256; CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 1, NULL, &g, &lsz, 0, NULL, NULL));
	  float got = 0; CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, bm, CL_TRUE, 0, 4, &got, 0, NULL, NULL));
	  printf("atomic_max via a %s float: %g (CPU %g) %s\n", kk ? "local" : "global", got, mx, got == mx ? "ok" : "WRONG"); fails += got != mx; } } }
	{ /* Geekbench 7 find_max_brightness's shape: a __local int * kernel argument and atomic_max on it, then on a global */
	  const int N = 1 << 16; float *in = malloc(N * 4); int mx = 0; for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { in[i] = (float)((i * 2654435761u) >> 8) / 65536.0f; if ((int)(in[i] * 1000.0f) > mx) mx = (int)(in[i] * 1000.0f); }
	  cl_kernel k = clCreateKernel(p, "amaxarg", &err);
	  if (err) { printf("atomic_max on a __local argument: clCreateKernel -> %d (translation failed)\n", err); fails++; } else {
	  int zero = 0; cl_mem bi = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_ONLY | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, N * 4, in, &err); CK(err);
	  cl_mem bm = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR, 4, &zero, &err); CK(err);
	  CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 0, sizeof bi, &bi)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 1, sizeof bm, &bm)); CK(clSetKernelArg(k, 2, 16, NULL));
	  size_t g = N, l = 256; CK(clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(q, k, 1, NULL, &g, &l, 0, NULL, NULL));
	  int got = 0; CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, bm, CL_TRUE, 0, 4, &got, 0, NULL, NULL));
	  printf("atomic_max on a __local argument: %d (CPU %d) %s\n", got, mx, got == mx ? "ok" : "WRONG"); fails += got != mx; } }
	printf("%s\n", fails ? "FAILED" : "PASSED");
	return fails != 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// devlist: the system default Metal device and every device, as an app sees them (no bundle preload)
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
int main(void) { @autoreleasepool {
	id<MTLDevice> d = MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();
	printf("default: %s [%s] lowPower %d headless %d\n", d.name.UTF8String, NSStringFromClass([d class]).UTF8String, d.isLowPower, d.isHeadless);
	for (id<MTLDevice> x in MTLCopyAllDevices())
		printf("device: %s [%s] lowPower %d headless %d removable %d registryID %llx\n", x.name.UTF8String, NSStringFromClass([x class]).UTF8String,
		       x.isLowPower, x.isHeadless, x.isRemovable, x.registryID);
	return 0; } }
