// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// cl_xfer: steady-state blocking clEnqueueWriteBuffer / clEnqueueReadBuffer / clEnqueueMapBuffer cost by size on the B580
// (Apple's CL over our Metal plugin). Measurement only.
//   clang -arch x86_64 -mmacosx-version-min=15.0 -O2 -Wno-deprecated-declarations -o cl_xfer cl_xfer.c -framework OpenCL
#include <OpenCL/opencl.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb;
static double now_us(void) { return (double)mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom / 1e3; }
static int dcmp(const void *a, const void *b) { double x = *(const double *)a, y = *(const double *)b; return x < y ? -1 : x > y; }
#define CK(x) do { cl_int e_ = (x); if (e_) { printf("%s -> %d\n", #x, e_); exit(1); } } while (0)
int main(void) {
	mach_timebase_info(&tb);
	cl_platform_id plat; CK(clGetPlatformIDs(1, &plat, NULL));
	cl_device_id dev; CK(clGetDeviceIDs(plat, CL_DEVICE_TYPE_GPU, 1, &dev, NULL));
	cl_int err;
	cl_context ctx = clCreateContext(NULL, 1, &dev, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
	cl_command_queue q = clCreateCommandQueue(ctx, dev, 0, &err); CK(err);
	size_t sizes[] = {64, 4096, 65536, 1 << 20, 16 << 20};
	void *host; posix_memalign(&host, 4096, 16 << 20); memset(host, 3, 16 << 20);
	for (int si = 0; si < 5; si++) {
		size_t S = sizes[si]; int N = S >= (1 << 20) ? 20 : 200;
		cl_mem b = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE, S, NULL, &err); CK(err);
		double w[200], r[200], m[200];
		for (int i = 0; i < N + 3; i++) {
			double t = now_us(); CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, S, host, 0, NULL, NULL)); double a = now_us() - t;
			t = now_us(); CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, S, host, 0, NULL, NULL)); double c = now_us() - t;
			t = now_us(); void *p = clEnqueueMapBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, CL_MAP_READ | CL_MAP_WRITE, 0, S, 0, NULL, NULL, &err); CK(err);
			((volatile char *)p)[0] = 1; CK(clEnqueueUnmapMemObject(q, b, p, 0, NULL, NULL)); CK(clFinish(q)); double d = now_us() - t;
			if (i >= 3) { w[i - 3] = a; r[i - 3] = c; m[i - 3] = d; }
		}
		qsort(w, N, 8, dcmp); qsort(r, N, 8, dcmp); qsort(m, N, 8, dcmp);
		printf("%8zu B: write p50 %7.1f us (%6.2f GB/s) | read p50 %7.1f us (%6.2f GB/s) | map+unmap+finish p50 %7.1f us\n",
		       S, w[N / 2], S / (w[N / 2] * 1e3), r[N / 2], S / (r[N / 2] * 1e3), m[N / 2]);
		clReleaseMemObject(b);
	}
	{   // 64 B out of a 64 MB buffer: does a small read move the whole buffer?
		size_t S = 64 << 20; cl_mem b = clCreateBuffer(ctx, CL_MEM_READ_WRITE, S, NULL, &err); CK(err);
		void *big; posix_memalign(&big, 4096, S); memset(big, 5, S);
		CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, S, big, 0, NULL, NULL));
		double r[50], w[50];
		for (int i = 0; i < 53; i++) {
			double t = now_us(); CK(clEnqueueReadBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, 64, host, 0, NULL, NULL)); double a = now_us() - t;
			t = now_us(); CK(clEnqueueWriteBuffer(q, b, CL_TRUE, 0, 64, host, 0, NULL, NULL)); double c = now_us() - t;
			if (i >= 3) { r[i - 3] = a; w[i - 3] = c; }
		}
		qsort(r, 50, 8, dcmp); qsort(w, 50, 8, dcmp);
		printf("64 B of a 64 MB buffer: read p50 %.1f us, write p50 %.1f us\n", r[25], w[25]);
	}
	return 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/metal/dirty_model.c

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// dirty_model: a host model of the Metal plugin's dirty-only descriptor sets (nvmtl_snapshot_set_c in nvmtl_vk.c) that runs
// the plugin's own decision functions (nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_dirty.h) without Vulkan or a GPU, on any Mac.
//
// Modelled: binding slots by (kind, pointer, offset) as nvmtl_bind_slot compares them; objects that live at an address,
// destroyed and made again at the same address (what the allocator does, and what a slot comparison cannot see); the
// object generation the plugin bumps on every view / sampler destroy; descriptor sets taken from a recycled pool with old
// contents; nvmtl_snapshot_set_md's writes and copies; the address table that a reused set keeps and the "was" path
// renews; pipelines with random binding masks (buffer descriptors or table-only, storage textures up to 127).
// Checked after every draw: each binding the pipeline reads holds the descriptor of the object its slot names now, and
// a table-reading pipeline sees every buffer's current address.
//
//   clang -O2 -Wall -o dirty_model dirty_model.c && ./dirty_model [steps=2000000] [seed=1]
//   ./dirty_model 200000 1 old     the logic before 2026-11-10 (expected to FAIL: shows what the model catches);
//                                  1, 2 or 4 instead of old: only one of its three holes (no object generation, lastw
//                                  kept on the was path, the 4-word copy mask)
//   ./dirty_model 200000 1 old 0   the same with NVMTL_NO_DIRTYONLY=1 (no copies; reuse and the was path stay)
//   clang -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -o dirty_model_asan dirty_model.c && ./dirty_model_asan 200000
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

/* nvmtl_vk.c's binding space */
#define NVMTL_NBUF 32
#define NVMTL_NTEX 128
#define NVMTL_NSAMP 32
#define NVMTL_ADDRESS_BINDING (NVMTL_NBUF + NVMTL_NTEX + NVMTL_NSAMP)
#define NVMTL_NSTEX 128
#define NVMTL_STEX_BASE (NVMTL_ADDRESS_BINDING + 1)
#define NVMTL_NBIND (NVMTL_STEX_BASE + NVMTL_NSTEX)
#define NVMTL_CHG_WORDS ((NVMTL_NBIND + 63) / 64)
#include "../../../nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_dirty.h"

enum { NONE = 0, BUF, TEX, SAMP };
enum { NADDR = 6, NPIPE = 12, NSETS = 4096, DUMMY = -1 };

static uint64_t rng = 1;
static uint32_t rnd(void) { rng ^= rng << 13; rng ^= rng >> 7; rng ^= rng << 17; return (uint32_t)rng; }
static uint32_t below(uint32_t n) { return rnd() % n; }

/* objects: per kind, NADDR addresses, each with the id of the object living there (ids never repeat) */
static int64_t live_at[4][NADDR];
static int64_t next_id = 1;
static uint64_t objgen = 1;
static int dirty_only = 1;   /* argv[4] = 0: as NVMTL_NO_DIRTYONLY=1 */
static int old_logic;   /* bits of the logic before 2026-11-10: 1 no object generation, 2 lastw kept on the was path,
                           4 a 4-word copy mask (md read two words past it) */

typedef struct { uint8_t kind; uint8_t addr; uint32_t off; } slot_t;
static slot_t slots[NVMTL_NBIND];

/* what nvmtl_snapshot_set_md writes for a slot, as the object it names now */
static int64_t desc_of(uint32_t i)
{
    const slot_t *s = &slots[i];
    const int want = i < NVMTL_NBUF ? BUF : i < NVMTL_NBUF + NVMTL_NTEX ? TEX : i < NVMTL_ADDRESS_BINDING ? SAMP : TEX;
    if (s->kind != want) return DUMMY;
    const int64_t id = live_at[s->kind][s->addr];
    return s->kind == BUF ? id * 4096 + s->off : id;
}

typedef struct { int64_t d[NVMTL_NBIND]; } set_t;
static set_t sets[NSETS];
static int nused;   /* sets of this command buffer: 0..nused-1; the rest hold whatever an earlier command buffer left */

typedef struct { uint64_t pm[4]; uint32_t hi; int table; } pipe_t;
static pipe_t pipes[NPIPE];

/* the binding table's per-stage state (one stage is enough: the two never mix) */
static struct {
    int last; uint64_t lastw[4]; uint64_t chg[NVMTL_CHG_WORDS]; int dirty; uint32_t last_hi; uint64_t lastgen;
    int64_t lasttab[NVMTL_NBUF]; int tabok;
} T;

static void mark(uint32_t i) { T.dirty = 1; T.chg[i >> 6] |= 1ull << (i & 63); }
/* nvmtl_bind_slot: the slot changed when its kind, pointer or offset did */
static void bind(uint32_t i, uint8_t kind, uint8_t addr, uint32_t off)
{
    slot_t *s = &slots[i];
    if (s->kind != kind || s->addr != addr || s->off != off) mark(i);
    s->kind = kind; s->addr = addr; s->off = off;
}

static void new_cb(void)
{
    memset(&T, 0, sizeof T); T.last = -1;
    memset(slots, 0, sizeof slots);   /* a pooled table is all zero */
    /* the sets of the last command buffer go back to the pool with their contents; scramble a few as other users would */
    for (int k = 0; k < nused; k++) if (below(4) == 0) for (uint32_t i = 0; i < NVMTL_NBIND; i++) sets[k].d[i] = -2 - (int64_t)below(1000000);
    nused = 0;
}

/* --- the logic before 2026-11-10, for "old": no generation, lastw kept on the was path, a 4-word copy mask --- */
static void old_was_taken(uint64_t *lastw, uint64_t *chg) { (void)lastw; memset(chg, 0, NVMTL_CHG_WORDS * sizeof *chg); }
static int old_new(const nvmtl_ds_in *in, uint64_t m[4], uint32_t *hi, uint64_t cm[NVMTL_CHG_WORDS])
{
    const int live = nvmtl_ds_live(in);
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) m[k] = in->pm[k] | (live ? in->lastw[k] : 0);
    if (live && in->last_hi > *hi) *hi = in->last_hi;
    memset(cm, 0, NVMTL_CHG_WORDS * sizeof *cm);
    if (!live || !in->dirty_only) return 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) cm[k] = in->lastw[k];
    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < NVMTL_NSTEX && NVMTL_STEX_BASE + j < 256; j++) {
        const uint32_t i = NVMTL_STEX_BASE + j;
        if (j < in->last_hi) cm[i >> 6] |= 1ull << (i & 63); else cm[i >> 6] &= ~(1ull << (i & 63));
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) cm[k] &= ~in->chg[k];
    cm[4] = ((uint64_t)rnd() << 32) | rnd(); cm[5] = ((uint64_t)rnd() << 32) | rnd();   /* what md read past the array */
    return 1;
}

static long failures, draws, reuses, wases, copies;
static int64_t drawtab[NVMTL_NBUF];

static void check(const pipe_t *p, const set_t *s, const int64_t *tab, long step)
{
    long bad = 0; uint32_t first = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < NVMTL_STEX_BASE; i++) {
        if (i == NVMTL_ADDRESS_BINDING || !((p->pm[i >> 6] >> (i & 63)) & 1)) continue;
        if (s->d[i] != desc_of(i)) { if (!bad++) first = i; }
    }
    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < p->hi; j++) if (s->d[NVMTL_STEX_BASE + j] != desc_of(NVMTL_STEX_BASE + j)) { if (!bad++) first = NVMTL_STEX_BASE + j; }
    if (p->table) for (uint32_t b = 0; b < NVMTL_NBUF; b++) if (tab[b] != desc_of(b)) { if (!bad++) first = 1000 + b; }
    if (!bad) return;
    if (failures < 10) fprintf(stderr, "step %ld: %ld stale binding(s), first %u%s\n", step, bad, first >= 1000 ? first - 1000 : first,
                               first >= 1000 ? " (address table)" : "");
    failures++;
}

static void draw(const pipe_t *p, long step)
{
    draws++;
    for (uint32_t b = 0; b < NVMTL_NBUF; b++) drawtab[b] = desc_of(b);   /* a table snapshot as the slots stand */
    const nvmtl_ds_in in = { p->pm, T.lastw, T.chg, p->hi, T.last_hi, T.last >= 0, T.dirty, T.tabok,
                             (old_logic & 1) ? 1 : T.lastgen == objgen, dirty_only };
    if (nvmtl_ds_reuse(&in)) { reuses++; check(p, &sets[T.last], T.lasttab, step); return; }
    if (nvmtl_ds_was(&in, 1)) {
        wases++;
        if (p->table) { memcpy(T.lasttab, drawtab, sizeof drawtab); T.tabok = 1; }
        T.dirty = 0; ((old_logic & 2) ? old_was_taken : nvmtl_ds_was_taken)(T.lastw, T.chg);
        check(p, &sets[T.last], p->table ? T.lasttab : drawtab, step);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t m[4], cm[NVMTL_CHG_WORDS]; uint32_t hi = p->hi;
    const int copy = ((old_logic & 4) ? old_new : nvmtl_ds_new)(&in, m, &hi, cm);
    if (nused == NSETS) { fprintf(stderr, "out of sets\n"); exit(2); }
    set_t *s = &sets[nused]; const set_t *from = copy ? &sets[T.last] : NULL;
    if (copy) copies++;
    /* nvmtl_snapshot_set_md: every binding in m is written or copied; buffers are always written */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < NVMTL_STEX_BASE; i++) {
        if (i == NVMTL_ADDRESS_BINDING || !((m[i >> 6] >> (i & 63)) & 1)) continue;
        if (i >= NVMTL_NBUF && from && ((cm[i >> 6] >> (i & 63)) & 1)) s->d[i] = from->d[i];
        else s->d[i] = desc_of(i);
    }
    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < hi && j < NVMTL_NSTEX; j++) {
        const uint32_t i = NVMTL_STEX_BASE + j;
        if (from && ((cm[i >> 6] >> (i & 63)) & 1)) s->d[i] = from->d[i]; else s->d[i] = desc_of(i);
    }
    T.last = nused++; memcpy(T.lastw, m, sizeof m); T.last_hi = hi; T.dirty = 0; memset(T.chg, 0, sizeof T.chg);
    T.lastgen = objgen; memcpy(T.lasttab, drawtab, sizeof drawtab); T.tabok = 1;
    check(p, s, T.lasttab, step);
}

static void make_pipes(void)
{
    for (int k = 0; k < NPIPE; k++) {
        pipe_t *p = &pipes[k]; memset(p, 0, sizeof *p);
        const int tableOnly = below(3) == 0;   /* reaches every buffer through the address table: the was path */
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < NVMTL_STEX_BASE; i++) {
            if (i < NVMTL_NBUF && tableOnly) continue;
            if (i == NVMTL_ADDRESS_BINDING || below(i < NVMTL_NBUF ? 8 : 20) == 0) p->pm[i >> 6] |= 1ull << (i & 63);
        }
        p->table = 1;
        const uint32_t r = below(10);
        p->hi = r < 5 ? 0 : r < 8 ? below(8) : below(NVMTL_NSTEX + 1);   /* now and then past 63 (bindings 256..320) */
    }
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    const long steps = argc > 1 ? atol(argv[1]) : 2000000;
    rng = argc > 2 ? strtoull(argv[2], NULL, 10) * 2654435761ull + 1 : 1;
    old_logic = argc > 3 ? (!strcmp(argv[3], "old") ? 7 : atoi(argv[3]) & 7) : 0;
    dirty_only = argc > 4 ? atoi(argv[4]) != 0 : 1;
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) for (int a = 0; a < NADDR; a++) live_at[k][a] = next_id++;
    for (long i = 0; i < NSETS; i++) for (uint32_t b = 0; b < NVMTL_NBIND; b++) sets[i].d[b] = -2 - (int64_t)below(1000000);
    make_pipes(); new_cb();
    long aba = 0;
    for (long step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
        const uint32_t op = below(100);
        if (op < 8) bind(below(NVMTL_NBUF), BUF, (uint8_t)below(NADDR), below(4) * 256);
        else if (op < 20) bind(NVMTL_NBUF + below(16), below(10) ? TEX : NONE, (uint8_t)below(NADDR), 0);
        else if (op < 24) bind(NVMTL_NBUF + NVMTL_NTEX + below(8), below(10) ? SAMP : NONE, (uint8_t)below(NADDR), 0);
        else if (op < 28) { const uint32_t j = below(4) == 0 ? 60 + below(68) : below(8); bind(NVMTL_STEX_BASE + j, below(10) ? TEX : NONE, (uint8_t)below(NADDR), 0); }
        else if (op < 31) {
            /* a texture or sampler destroyed and another made at its address, then bound where the first was:
               the slot comparison sees the same pointer */
            const int kind = below(4) ? TEX : SAMP; const uint8_t a = (uint8_t)below(NADDR);
            objgen++; live_at[kind][a] = next_id++; aba++;
            for (uint32_t i = NVMTL_NBUF; i < NVMTL_NBIND; i++) if (slots[i].kind == kind && slots[i].addr == a) bind(i, (uint8_t)kind, a, 0);
        } else if (op < 32) {
            /* a buffer made again at its address and bound again: nvmtl_vk_bind_buffer compares the device address too */
            const uint8_t a = (uint8_t)below(NADDR); live_at[BUF][a] = next_id++;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < NVMTL_NBUF; i++) if (slots[i].kind == BUF && slots[i].addr == a) mark(i);
        } else if (op < 33) { if (T.last >= 0) T.tabok = 0; }   /* a stage that reads more table entries than the last held */
        else if (op < 34 || nused > NSETS - 8) new_cb();
        else draw(&pipes[below(NPIPE)], step);
    }
    printf("dirty_model%s%s: %ld draws (%ld set reuses, %ld table-only renewals, %ld new sets copying unchanged descriptors), "
           "%ld destroy+remake at the same address: %ld FAILED\n", old_logic ? " (old logic)" : "", dirty_only ? "" : " (no dirty-only)", draws, reuses, wases, copies, aba, failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/metal/gpt_bench.m

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// gpt_bench: a synthetic frame loop with known GPU work, to validate GPUTIME (/tmp/nvmtl-gputime) and to time fixes.
// Run on the hackintosh (game closed): NVMTL_ENABLE=1 NVMTL_BUNDLE=<staged>/NVMTLDriver.bundle ./gpt_bench [secs] [iters] [mode]
//   mode "gt": GPUTIME off for the first half, on for the second half (overhead + the GPUTIME lines in $TMPDIR/nvmtl.log)
//   mode "off": never on. Frame: CB1 = pass A 2560x1440 BGRA8 + D32F (fullscreen triangle, fragment loop of `iters`),
//   pass B 1280x720 RGBA16F sampling A (light); CB2 = blit A -> shared buffer (14.75 MB to system memory) + a compute
//   dispatch over 4M floats. The frame ends at CB2's completion (waitUntilCompleted), then nvmtl_hitch_frame("present").
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#import <objc/message.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <IOSurface/IOSurface.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static NSString *const kSrc = @"#include <metal_stdlib>\n"
"using namespace metal;\n"
"struct V { float4 p [[position]]; float2 uv; };\n"
"vertex V vtri(uint id [[vertex_id]]) { V o; float2 q = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2); o.p = float4(q * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.5, 1); o.uv = q; return o; }\n"
"fragment float4 fheavy(V i [[stage_in]], constant uint &n [[buffer(0)]]) {\n"
"  float2 z = i.uv; float a = 0;\n"
"  for (uint k = 0; k < n; k++) { z = float2(z.x * z.x - z.y * z.y, 2 * z.x * z.y) * 0.5 + i.uv; a += fract(z.x * 3.1 + z.y); }\n"
"  return float4(fract(a), z.x, z.y, 1); }\n"
"fragment half4 flight(V i [[stage_in]], texture2d<float> t [[texture(0)]], sampler s [[sampler(0)]]) { return half4(t.sample(s, i.uv)); }\n"
"kernel void kadd(device float *a [[buffer(0)]], uint id [[thread_position_in_grid]]) { a[id] = a[id] * 1.0001f + 1.0f; }\n";

static id<MTLDevice> bundleDevice(const char *path) {
	NSBundle *b = [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(path)]; NSError *e = nil;
	if (![b loadAndReturnError:&e]) { printf("bundle %s: %s\n", path, e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return nil; }
	Class cls = [b classNamed:@"NVMTLDevice"]; if (!cls) return nil;
	io_iterator_t it = 0; if (IOServiceGetMatchingServices(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("IOAccelerator"), &it) != KERN_SUCCESS) return nil;
	id<MTLDevice> dev = nil;
	for (io_service_t svc; !dev && (svc = IOIteratorNext(it)); IOObjectRelease(svc)) {
		CFTypeRef name = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(svc, CFSTR("MetalPluginClassName"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
		if (name && CFEqual(name, CFSTR("NVMTLDevice"))) dev = ((id (*)(id, SEL, mach_port_t))objc_msgSend)([cls alloc], sel_registerName("initWithAcceleratorPort:"), svc);
		if (name) CFRelease(name);
	}
	IOObjectRelease(it); return dev;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	@autoreleasepool {
		const double secs = argc > 1 ? atof(argv[1]) : 8; const uint32_t iters = argc > 2 ? (uint32_t)atoi(argv[2]) : 64;
		const char *mode = argc > 3 ? argv[3] : "gt";
		const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE"); id<MTLDevice> d = nil;
		if (bp) d = bundleDevice(bp); else for (id<MTLDevice> x in MTLCopyAllDevices()) if ([NSStringFromClass([x class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"]) d = x;
		if (!d) { printf("no B580 device\n"); return 2; }
		void (*frame)(const char *) = (void (*)(const char *))dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "nvmtl_hitch_frame");
		if (!frame && bp) { char ex[1024]; snprintf(ex, sizeof ex, "%s/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver", bp); void *h = dlopen(ex, RTLD_NOLOAD | RTLD_LAZY);
			if (h) frame = (void (*)(const char *))dlsym(h, "nvmtl_hitch_frame"); }
		printf("device %s, frame hook %s, %.0f s, iters %u, mode %s\n", d.name.UTF8String, frame ? "found" : "MISSING", secs, iters, mode);
		NSError *e = nil; id<MTLLibrary> lib = [d newLibraryWithSource:kSrc options:nil error:&e];
		if (!lib) { printf("library: %s\n", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 1; }
		MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *pa = [MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor new];
		pa.vertexFunction = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"vtri"]; pa.fragmentFunction = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"fheavy"];
		pa.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm; pa.depthAttachmentPixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float;
		id<MTLRenderPipelineState> psa = [d newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:pa error:&e]; if (!psa) { printf("pso A: %s\n", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 1; }
		MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *pb = [MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor new];
		pb.vertexFunction = pa.vertexFunction; pb.fragmentFunction = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"flight"];
		pb.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float;
		id<MTLRenderPipelineState> psb = [d newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:pb error:&e]; if (!psb) { printf("pso B: %s\n", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 1; }
		id<MTLComputePipelineState> cps = [d newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:[lib newFunctionWithName:@"kadd"] error:&e];
		if (!cps) { printf("cps: %s\n", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 1; }
		MTLTextureDescriptor *ta = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm width:2560 height:1440 mipmapped:NO];
		ta.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; ta.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;
		id<MTLTexture> A = [d newTextureWithDescriptor:ta];
		MTLTextureDescriptor *tz = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float width:2560 height:1440 mipmapped:NO];
		tz.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget; tz.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;
		id<MTLTexture> Z = [d newTextureWithDescriptor:tz];
		MTLTextureDescriptor *tb = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float width:1280 height:720 mipmapped:NO];
		tb.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget; tb.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;
		id<MTLTexture> B = [d newTextureWithDescriptor:tb];
		id<MTLBuffer> rb = [d newBufferWithLength:2560 * 1440 * 4 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
		id<MTLBuffer> cb = [d newBufferWithLength:4u << 22 options:MTLResourceStorageModePrivate];
		MTLSamplerDescriptor *sd = [MTLSamplerDescriptor new]; sd.minFilter = sd.magFilter = MTLSamplerMinMagFilterLinear;
		id<MTLSamplerState> smp = [d newSamplerStateWithDescriptor:sd];
		id<MTLCommandQueue> q = [d newCommandQueue];
		if (!strcmp(mode, "surf")) {   // IOSurface out/in correctness + timing (the staged host copies)
			NSDictionary *sp = @{ (id)kIOSurfaceWidth: @2560, (id)kIOSurfaceHeight: @1440, (id)kIOSurfaceBytesPerElement: @4,
			                      (id)kIOSurfaceBytesPerRow: @(10240), (id)kIOSurfacePixelFormat: @(0x42475241) };
			IOSurfaceRef sf = IOSurfaceCreate((__bridge CFDictionaryRef)sp); if (!sf) { printf("no IOSurface\n"); return 1; }
			MTLTextureDescriptor *sd2 = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm width:2560 height:1440 mipmapped:NO];
			sd2.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; sd2.storageMode = MTLStorageModeShared;
			id<MTLTexture> ST = [d newTextureWithDescriptor:sd2 iosurface:sf plane:0];
			if (!ST) { printf("no IOSurface texture\n"); return 1; }
			int bad = 0; double tout = 0, tin = 0; int nout = 0, nin = 0;
			for (int it = 0; it < 6; it++) { @autoreleasepool {
				const uint32_t k = it == 0 ? 64 : 64 + it * 7;
				// out: render into the IOSurface texture and into A (private), read both, compare
				for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
					id<MTLCommandBuffer> c = [q commandBuffer];
					MTLRenderPassDescriptor *r = [MTLRenderPassDescriptor renderPassDescriptor];
					r.colorAttachments[0].texture = pass ? A : ST; r.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear; r.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
					r.depthAttachment.texture = Z; r.depthAttachment.loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear; r.depthAttachment.storeAction = MTLStoreActionDontCare;
					id<MTLRenderCommandEncoder> e = [c renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:r];
					[e setRenderPipelineState:psa]; [e setFragmentBytes:&k length:4 atIndex:0]; [e drawPrimitives:MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle vertexStart:0 vertexCount:3]; [e endEncoding];
					if (pass) { id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> bl = [c blitCommandEncoder];
						[bl copyFromTexture:A sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(2560, 1440, 1) toBuffer:rb destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:10240 destinationBytesPerImage:10240 * 1440]; [bl endEncoding]; }
					[c commit]; [c waitUntilCompleted];
					if (!pass) { tout += c.GPUEndTime - c.GPUStartTime; nout++; }
				}
				IOSurfaceLock(sf, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
				if (memcmp(IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(sf), rb.contents, 10240 * 1440)) { bad++; printf("OUT MISMATCH at iteration %d\n", it); }
				IOSurfaceUnlock(sf, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
				// in: CPU writes a pattern into the IOSurface, the GPU copies the texture to rb, compare
				IOSurfaceLock(sf, 0, NULL); uint32_t *px = IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(sf);
				for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 2560u * 1440u; i++) px[i] = (i * 2654435761u) ^ (uint32_t)(it * 0x01010101u);
				IOSurfaceUnlock(sf, 0, NULL);
				id<MTLCommandBuffer> c = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> bl = [c blitCommandEncoder];
				[bl copyFromTexture:ST sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(2560, 1440, 1) toBuffer:rb destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:10240 destinationBytesPerImage:10240 * 1440];
				[bl endEncoding]; [c commit]; [c waitUntilCompleted];
				IOSurfaceLock(sf, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
				if (memcmp(IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(sf), rb.contents, 10240 * 1440)) { bad++; printf("IN MISMATCH at iteration %d\n", it); }
				IOSurfaceUnlock(sf, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
				nin++; (void)tin;
			} }
			uint32_t h = 2166136261u; IOSurfaceLock(sf, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL); const uint8_t *pb = IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(sf);
			for (size_t i = 0; i < 10240u * 1440u; i++) { h ^= pb[i]; h *= 16777619u; } IOSurfaceUnlock(sf, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
			printf("surf: %d iterations, %d mismatches, render+surface-out cb %.3f ms GPU avg, final pages fnv %08x\n", nout, bad, tout * 1e3 / nout, h);
			CFRelease(sf); return bad ? 1 : 0;
		}
		if (!strncmp(mode, "xfer", 4)) {
			id<MTLBuffer> vb = [d newBufferWithLength:2560 * 1440 * 4 options:MTLResourceStorageModePrivate];
			id<MTLBuffer> mb = [d newBufferWithLength:2560 * 1440 * 4 options:MTLResourceStorageModeManaged];
			MTLTextureDescriptor *tc = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm width:2560 height:1440 mipmapped:NO];
			tc.usage = MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; tc.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;
			id<MTLTexture> C = [d newTextureWithDescriptor:tc];
			if (!strcmp(mode, "xfer2")) {   // two-step copies through a linear VRAM buffer, one command buffer each
				double t2[2] = {0, 0}; int n2 = 0; const double y0 = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent();
				while (CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - y0 < secs) { @autoreleasepool {
					MTLOrigin o = MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0); MTLSize sz = MTLSizeMake(2560, 1440, 1);
					id<MTLCommandBuffer> a1 = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> b1 = [a1 blitCommandEncoder];
					[b1 copyFromTexture:A sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:o sourceSize:sz toBuffer:vb destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:10240 destinationBytesPerImage:10240 * 1440];
					[b1 copyFromBuffer:vb sourceOffset:0 toBuffer:rb destinationOffset:0 size:10240 * 1440]; [b1 endEncoding]; [a1 commit];
					id<MTLCommandBuffer> a2 = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> b2 = [a2 blitCommandEncoder];
					[b2 copyFromBuffer:rb sourceOffset:0 toBuffer:vb destinationOffset:0 size:10240 * 1440];
					[b2 copyFromBuffer:vb sourceOffset:0 sourceBytesPerRow:10240 sourceBytesPerImage:10240 * 1440 sourceSize:sz toTexture:C destinationSlice:0 destinationLevel:0 destinationOrigin:o];
					[b2 endEncoding]; [a2 commit]; [a2 waitUntilCompleted];
					t2[0] += a1.GPUEndTime - a1.GPUStartTime; t2[1] += a2.GPUEndTime - a2.GPUStartTime; n2++; if (frame) frame("present"); } }
				printf("xfer2 tex->VRAM buf->sysmem buf   %.3f ms GPU\nxfer2 sysmem buf->VRAM buf->tex   %.3f ms GPU\n", t2[0] * 1e3 / n2, t2[1] * 1e3 / n2);
				return 0;
			}
			const char *nm[6] = { "tex->shared buf (VRAM->sysmem)", "tex->private buf (VRAM->VRAM)", "shared buf->tex (sysmem->VRAM)", "private buf->tex (VRAM->VRAM)", "tex->tex copy", "shared->private buf" };
			double tot[6] = {0}; int n = 0;
			const double x0 = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent();
			while (CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - x0 < secs) {
				@autoreleasepool {
					id<MTLCommandBuffer> cbs[6];
					for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
						cbs[k] = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> bl = [cbs[k] blitCommandEncoder];
						MTLOrigin o = MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0); MTLSize sz = MTLSizeMake(2560, 1440, 1);
						switch (k) {
						case 0: [bl copyFromTexture:A sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:o sourceSize:sz toBuffer:rb destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:10240 destinationBytesPerImage:10240 * 1440]; break;
						case 1: [bl copyFromTexture:A sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:o sourceSize:sz toBuffer:vb destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:10240 destinationBytesPerImage:10240 * 1440]; break;
						case 2: [bl copyFromBuffer:rb sourceOffset:0 sourceBytesPerRow:10240 sourceBytesPerImage:10240 * 1440 sourceSize:sz toTexture:C destinationSlice:0 destinationLevel:0 destinationOrigin:o]; break;
						case 3: [bl copyFromBuffer:vb sourceOffset:0 sourceBytesPerRow:10240 sourceBytesPerImage:10240 * 1440 sourceSize:sz toTexture:C destinationSlice:0 destinationLevel:0 destinationOrigin:o]; break;
						case 4: [bl copyFromTexture:A toTexture:C]; break;
						case 5: [bl copyFromBuffer:rb sourceOffset:0 toBuffer:vb destinationOffset:0 size:10240 * 1440]; break;
						}
						[bl endEncoding]; [cbs[k] commit];
					}
					[cbs[5] waitUntilCompleted];
					for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) tot[k] += cbs[k].GPUEndTime - cbs[k].GPUStartTime;
					n++; if (frame) frame("present");
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) printf("xfer %-34s %.3f ms GPU, %.1f GB/s\n", nm[k], tot[k] * 1e3 / n, 14.7456e-3 / (tot[k] / n));
			(void)mb; return 0;
		}
		unlink("/tmp/nvmtl-gputime");
		const double t0 = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent(); int on = 0; unsigned frames[2] = {0, 0}; double gpu[2][2] = {{0, 0}, {0, 0}}, wall[2] = {0, 0};
		double tl = t0;
		for (;;) {
			const double now = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent(); if (now - t0 >= secs) break;
			if (!on && !strcmp(mode, "gt") && now - t0 >= secs / 2) { int fd = open("/tmp/nvmtl-gputime", O_CREAT | O_WRONLY, 0644); if (fd >= 0) close(fd); on = 1; usleep(300000); tl = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent(); continue; }
			@autoreleasepool {
				id<MTLCommandBuffer> c1 = [q commandBuffer];
				MTLRenderPassDescriptor *ra = [MTLRenderPassDescriptor renderPassDescriptor];
				ra.colorAttachments[0].texture = A; ra.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear; ra.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
				ra.depthAttachment.texture = Z; ra.depthAttachment.loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear; ra.depthAttachment.storeAction = MTLStoreActionDontCare;
				id<MTLRenderCommandEncoder> ea = [c1 renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:ra];
				[ea setRenderPipelineState:psa]; [ea setFragmentBytes:&iters length:4 atIndex:0];
				[ea drawPrimitives:MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle vertexStart:0 vertexCount:3]; [ea endEncoding];
				MTLRenderPassDescriptor *rbd = [MTLRenderPassDescriptor renderPassDescriptor];
				rbd.colorAttachments[0].texture = B; rbd.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionDontCare; rbd.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
				id<MTLRenderCommandEncoder> eb = [c1 renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:rbd];
				[eb setRenderPipelineState:psb]; [eb setFragmentTexture:A atIndex:0]; [eb setFragmentSamplerState:smp atIndex:0];
				[eb drawPrimitives:MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle vertexStart:0 vertexCount:3]; [eb endEncoding];
				[c1 commit];
				id<MTLCommandBuffer> c2 = [q commandBuffer];
				id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> bl = [c2 blitCommandEncoder];
				[bl copyFromTexture:A sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(2560, 1440, 1)
				          toBuffer:rb destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:2560 * 4 destinationBytesPerImage:2560 * 1440 * 4];
				[bl endEncoding];
				id<MTLComputeCommandEncoder> ce = [c2 computeCommandEncoder];
				[ce setComputePipelineState:cps]; [ce setBuffer:cb offset:0 atIndex:0];
				[ce dispatchThreads:MTLSizeMake(4u << 20, 1, 1) threadsPerThreadgroup:MTLSizeMake(256, 1, 1)]; [ce endEncoding];
				[c2 commit]; [c2 waitUntilCompleted];
				if (c1.status != MTLCommandBufferStatusCompleted || c2.status != MTLCommandBufferStatusCompleted) { printf("command buffer failed\n"); return 1; }
				gpu[on][0] += c1.GPUEndTime - c1.GPUStartTime; gpu[on][1] += c2.GPUEndTime - c2.GPUStartTime; frames[on]++;
				if (frame) frame("present");
			}
			wall[on] = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - (on ? tl : t0);
		}
		unlink("/tmp/nvmtl-gputime");
		for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) if (frames[k])
			printf("GPUTIME %s: %u frames, %.1f fps, Metal GPU time per frame: cb1 (passes A+B) %.3f ms, cb2 (blit+compute) %.3f ms\n", k ? "ON " : "off",
			       frames[k], frames[k] / wall[k], gpu[k][0] * 1e3 / frames[k], gpu[k][1] * 1e3 / frames[k]);
		uint32_t px = 0; memcpy(&px, (char *)rb.contents + (720 * 2560 + 1280) * 4, 4);
		printf("centre pixel 0x%08x\n", px);
		return 0;
	}
}

FILE: user/tests/metal/icb_lower_check.m
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// icb_lower_check: the kernels of mtl_gpu_icb2 / mtl_icb_kept the way nvmtl_vk_compute_pipeline_create builds them, off the
// GPU (docs/design/DESIGN-icb-dgc.md section 10). The Mac's Metal front end makes the AIR, the built plugin translates it
// (nvmtl_translate_metallib / nvmtl_compile_library_entry, as xlate_check), the built translator lowers buffer addresses
// (nvmtl_lower_buffer_addresses_ex with the flags the plugin passes on ANV: Uniform table, 4-byte alignment) without and
// with NVMTL_LOWER_PUSH_NOT_DATA (what NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 asks for a pipeline with supportIndirectCommandBuffers), then
// cs-table-pc (classic model) as the plugin runs it. Printed per kernel and mode: the buffers still read through
// descriptors (nvmtl_desc_bufs.h, the plan's guard) and the pushed table entries; and the buffer indices the DGC plan
// offers for a shader to set (pushed, or not read at all; nvmtl_icb_dgc.c nvmtl_dgc_takes).
//
// Expected: w and kt (o[thread_position_in_grid]): o kept as a descriptor without the flag (the 13 Nov night's C0..C2:
// the kernel wrote the CPU's buffer), reached by address with it, index 0 offered; ki (o[idx[t]]): o stays a descriptor
// in both modes and index 0 is never offered; kc (constant index): by address in both modes.
//
//   NVMTL_LOG_PATH=<log> ./icb_lower_check <NVMTLDriver.bundle/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver> <libnvmtl_translate.dylib>
// x86_64 (Rosetta is fine). Exit: 0 as expected, 1 setup, 4 a kernel not as expected.
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include "nvmtl_table_pc.h"
#include "nvmtl_desc_bufs.h"

#define LOWER_PUSH_NOT_DATA 0x10u   /* nvmtl_vk.h NVMTL_LOWER_PUSH_NOT_DATA */

static NSString *const kSource =
    @"#include <metal_stdlib>\n"
     "using namespace metal;\n"
     "kernel void w(device uint *o [[buffer(0)]], constant uint &tag [[buffer(1)]], uint t [[thread_position_in_grid]]) { o[t] = tag * 1000 + t; }\n"
     "kernel void kt(device uint *o [[buffer(0)]], constant uint &tag [[buffer(1)]], uint t [[thread_position_in_grid]]) { o[t] = tag * 1000 + t; }\n"
     "kernel void ki(device uint *o [[buffer(0)]], const device uint *idx [[buffer(1)]], uint t [[thread_position_in_grid]]) { o[idx[t]] = 7000 + t; }\n"
     "kernel void kc(device uint *o [[buffer(0)]], constant uint &tag [[buffer(1)]]) { o[3] = tag; }\n";

typedef NSDictionary<NSString *, NSData *> *(*translate_fn)(NSData *, NSDictionary **, NSDictionary **);
typedef NSData *(*compile_fn)(NSData *air, NSString *ll, NSString *stage, NSString *name, NSString **error);
typedef int (*lower_ex_fn)(const uint8_t *, size_t, uint32_t, uint8_t **, size_t *, uint32_t *, char *, size_t);
typedef void (*free_fn)(uint8_t *, size_t);

static void bits(char *s, size_t n, uint32_t m)
{
    if (m == 0xffffffffu) { snprintf(s, n, "ALL"); return; }
    size_t k = 0; s[0] = 0;
    for (uint32_t b = 0; b < 32 && k + 4 < n; b++) if (m >> b & 1u) k += (size_t)snprintf(s + k, n - k, "%s%u", k ? "," : "", b);
    if (!k) snprintf(s, n, "-");
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
    @autoreleasepool {
        if (argc < 3) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s NVMTLDriver libnvmtl_translate.dylib\n", argv[0]); return 1; }
        id<MTLDevice> dev = MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();
        if (!dev) { fprintf(stderr, "no Metal device to run the front end\n"); return 1; }
        NSError *err = nil;
        id<MTLLibrary> lib = [dev newLibraryWithSource:kSource options:[MTLCompileOptions new] error:&err];
        if (!lib) { fprintf(stderr, "front end: %s\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 1; }
        NSData *mtlb = [(id)lib valueForKey:@"libraryDataContents"];
        if (![mtlb isKindOfClass:[NSData class]]) { fprintf(stderr, "no libraryDataContents\n"); return 1; }
        void *h = dlopen(argv[1], RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL), *x = dlopen(argv[2], RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
        if (!h || !x) { fprintf(stderr, "dlopen: %s\n", dlerror()); return 1; }
        translate_fn tr = (translate_fn)dlsym(h, "nvmtl_translate_metallib");
        compile_fn compile = (compile_fn)dlsym(h, "nvmtl_compile_library_entry");
        lower_ex_fn lower = (lower_ex_fn)dlsym(x, "nvmtl_lower_buffer_addresses_ex");
        free_fn xfree = (free_fn)dlsym(x, "nvmtl_translate_free");
        if (!tr || !compile || !lower || !xfree) { fprintf(stderr, "missing entry points\n"); return 1; }
        NSDictionary *stages = nil, *airs = nil;
        NSDictionary<NSString *, NSData *> *fns = tr(mtlb, &stages, &airs);
        int bad = 0;
        for (NSString *name in @[ @"w", @"kt", @"ki", @"kc" ]) {
            NSString *why = nil;
            NSData *spv = fns[name] ? compile(fns[name], airs[name], stages[name], name, &why) : nil;
            if (!spv) { printf("FAIL %-3s no SPIR-V: %s\n", name.UTF8String, why.UTF8String ?: "not in the library"); bad++; continue; }
            uint32_t got[2] = { 0, 0 }, offered[2] = { 0, 0 };
            for (int mode = 0; mode < 2; mode++) {
                uint8_t *o = NULL; size_t on = 0; uint32_t info[4] = { 0 }; char e[512] = { 0 };
                const uint32_t flags = 2u | (2u << 8) | (mode ? LOWER_PUSH_NOT_DATA : 0u);
                if (lower(spv.bytes, spv.length, flags, &o, &on, info, e, sizeof e)) {
                    printf("     %-3s %-13s lowering REFUSED (%s): every buffer stays a descriptor\n", name.UTF8String, mode ? "icb-lower" : "default", e);
                    got[mode] = 0xffffffffu; continue;
                }
                nvmtl_pc_table pc = { 0 }; size_t pn = 0;
                uint32_t *p = nvmtl_spirv_table_pc_ex(o, on, 5, NVMTL_PC_TABLE_CS_OFFSET, NVMTL_PC_TABLE_MAX, NVMTL_PC_MERGE | NVMTL_PC_SET0, &pc, &pn);
                const void *fin = p ? (const void *)p : (const void *)o; const size_t fn = p ? pn : on;
                got[mode] = nvmtl_spirv_desc_bufs(fin, fn);
                // nvmtl_dgc_takes' first rule: an index the kernel reads through a descriptor is never offered (the others
                // depend on the table plan: a pushed entry is, as is an index the kernel does not read)
                uint32_t pushed = 0; for (uint32_t k = 0; k < pc.count; k++) pushed |= 1u << pc.index[k];
                offered[mode] = ~got[mode] & 0x7fffffffu;
                char d[96], q[96], f[96]; bits(d, sizeof d, got[mode]); bits(q, sizeof q, pushed); bits(f, sizeof f, offered[mode] & 3u);
                printf("     %-3s %-13s descriptors {%s}  pushed table entries {%s}  offered of {0,1}: {%s}\n", name.UTF8String,
                       mode ? "icb-lower" : "default", d, q, f);
                free(p); xfree(o, on);
            }
            int ok;
            if ([name isEqualToString:@"ki"]) ok = (got[0] & 1u) && (got[1] & 1u) && !(offered[1] & 1u);
            else if ([name isEqualToString:@"kc"]) ok = !(got[0] & 1u) && !(got[1] & 1u) && (offered[1] & 1u);
            else ok = (got[0] & 1u) && !(got[1] & 1u) && (offered[1] & 1u);
            printf("%s %-3s %s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name.UTF8String,
                   [name isEqualToString:@"ki"] ? "o[idx[t]] keeps its descriptor either way; index 0 is never offered" :
                   [name isEqualToString:@"kc"] ? "o[3] by address either way" :
                   "o[thread_position_in_grid]: a descriptor before, by address with the ICB lowering; index 0 offered");
            bad += !ok;
        }
        printf("icb_lower_check: %s\n", bad ? "FAIL" : "PASS");
        return bad ? 4 : 0;
    }
}

FILE: user/tests/metal/mtl4_compiler.m

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// mtl4_compiler: Metal 4's MTL4Compiler on the Arc B580 (nullmoth/plugin/NVMTLMetal4.m, NVMTL_METAL4=1).
//
// Pipelines made by the compiler run on an ordinary Metal command queue, so each case checks what the pipeline computes
// or draws, not only that it was made:
//   1. a library from source (MTL4LibraryDescriptor) and a compute pipeline from a library function descriptor;
//   2. a specialized function (function constants) through MTL4SpecializedFunctionDescriptor;
//   3. maxTotalThreadsPerThreadgroup and requiredThreadsPerThreadgroup of the descriptor;
//   4. the asynchronous form: a compiler task, its status and the completion handler;
//   5. static linking (MTL4StaticLinkingDescriptor): a kernel calling a [[visible]] function declared only, defined in
//      another library;
//   6. a render pipeline (vertex + fragment, a specialized fragment) drawing into a 4x4 texture, and a pipeline made by
//      specialization from one with unspecialized blending;
//   7. archives: a pipeline data set serializer records the pipelines a compiler builds, the archive it writes is read
//      back, and a lookup of a pipeline in it works while one that is not there fails; a missing archive is an error.
// Expected answers are Apple's (run with --any on an Apple GPU Mac as the reference). Each check prints PASS or FAIL.
//
//   NVMTL_ENABLE=1 NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_METAL4=1 ./mtl4_compiler   (B580)
//   ./mtl4_compiler --any                                                the first Metal device when no B580 is present
//
// Exit: 0 pass, 1 no B580 device, 2 setup/compile failure, 3 GPU error, 4 wrong results, 5 no MTL4Compiler (Metal 4 off).
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static NSString *const kSource =
    @"#include <metal_stdlib>\n"
     "using namespace metal;\n"
     "kernel void add(device float *o [[buffer(0)]], const device float *a [[buffer(1)]], const device float *b [[buffer(2)]],\n"
     "                uint i [[thread_position_in_grid]]) { o[i] = a[i] + b[i]; }\n"
     "constant float K [[function_constant(0)]];\n"
     "kernel void axpy(device float *o [[buffer(0)]], const device float *a [[buffer(1)]], const device float *b [[buffer(2)]],\n"
     "                 uint i [[thread_position_in_grid]]) { o[i] = a[i] + b[i] * K; }\n"
     "kernel void ids(device uint *o [[buffer(0)]], uint i [[thread_position_in_grid]], uint n [[threads_per_threadgroup]]) { o[i] = i * 1000 + n; }\n"
     "[[visible]] float twice(float x);\n"
     "kernel void linked(device float *o [[buffer(0)]], uint i [[thread_position_in_grid]]) { o[i] = twice(o[i]); }\n"
     "struct V { float4 p [[position]]; };\n"
     "vertex V vs(uint vid [[vertex_id]]) { float2 q = float2((vid << 1) & 2, vid & 2); V o; o.p = float4(q * 2 - 1, 0, 1); return o; }\n"
     "constant float4 COLOR [[function_constant(1)]];\n"
     "fragment float4 fs() { return COLOR; }\n";
static NSString *const kHelper =
    @"#include <metal_stdlib>\n"
     "using namespace metal;\n"
     "[[visible]] float twice(float x) { return 2.0f * x + 0.5f; }\n";

static uint64_t nmx_registry_id(void)
{
    io_service_t s = IOServiceGetMatchingService(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("NMXAccel"));
    if (!s) return 0;
    uint64_t id = 0;
    IORegistryEntryGetRegistryEntryID(s, &id);
    IOObjectRelease(s);
    return id;
}

static int npass, nfail;
static void check(int ok, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
static void check(int ok, const char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
    printf("%s ", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL"); vprintf(fmt, ap); printf("\n");
    va_end(ap);
    if (ok) npass++; else nfail++;
}

enum { N = 256 };
static id<MTLDevice> dev;
static id<MTLCommandQueue> queue;
static int gpu_error;

// Runs `ps` over N threads (threadgroups of tg) with buffers bound at 0.., and waits.
static void run(id<MTLComputePipelineState> ps, NSArray<id<MTLBuffer>> *bufs, NSUInteger tg)
{
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [queue commandBuffer];
    id<MTLComputeCommandEncoder> e = [cb computeCommandEncoder];
    [e setComputePipelineState:ps];
    for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < bufs.count; i++) [e setBuffer:bufs[i] offset:0 atIndex:i];
    [e dispatchThreads:MTLSizeMake(N, 1, 1) threadsPerThreadgroup:MTLSizeMake(tg, 1, 1)];
    [e endEncoding];
    [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
    if (cb.status != MTLCommandBufferStatusCompleted) { fprintf(stderr, "GPU error: %s\n", cb.error.localizedDescription.UTF8String ?: "?"); gpu_error = 1; }
}
static id<MTLBuffer> floats(float (^f)(int))
{
    id<MTLBuffer> b = [dev newBufferWithLength:N * sizeof(float) options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    float *p = b.contents; for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) p[i] = f ? f(i) : 0;
    return b;
}
// o == a + b * k for every element
static int axpy_ok(id<MTLBuffer> o, float k, int *firstBad)
{
    const float *p = o.contents;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) if (p[i] != (float)i + (float)(N - i) * k) { *firstBad = i; return 0; }
    return 1;
}

API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.0))
static MTL4LibraryFunctionDescriptor *fn(id<MTLLibrary> lib, NSString *name)
{
    MTL4LibraryFunctionDescriptor *d = [MTL4LibraryFunctionDescriptor new]; d.library = lib; d.name = name; return d;
}
API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.0))
static MTL4ComputePipelineDescriptor *compute(MTL4FunctionDescriptor *f)
{
    MTL4ComputePipelineDescriptor *d = [MTL4ComputePipelineDescriptor new]; d.computeFunctionDescriptor = f; return d;
}

API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.0))
static int body(void)
{
    NSError *err = nil;
    if (![dev supportsFamily:MTLGPUFamilyMetal4]) { printf("SKIP: no MTLGPUFamilyMetal4 (B580: NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_METAL4=1)\n"); return 5; }
    id<MTL4Compiler> comp = [dev newCompilerWithDescriptor:[MTL4CompilerDescriptor new] error:&err];
    if (!comp) { printf("SKIP: no MTL4Compiler (%s; B580: NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_METAL4=1)\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String ?: "nil"); return 5; }
    check(comp.device == dev, "MTL4Compiler %s, device is the one that made it", NSStringFromClass([(id)comp class]).UTF8String);

    // 1. library and compute pipeline
    MTL4LibraryDescriptor *ld = [MTL4LibraryDescriptor new]; ld.source = kSource; ld.name = @"mtl4_compiler";
    id<MTLLibrary> lib = [comp newLibraryWithDescriptor:ld error:&err];
    if (!lib) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: newLibraryWithDescriptor: %s\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
    check([lib.functionNames containsObject:@"add"] && [lib.functionNames containsObject:@"fs"], "library from a MTL4LibraryDescriptor: %lu functions",
          (unsigned long)lib.functionNames.count);
    id<MTLBuffer> a = floats(^float(int i) { return (float)i; }), b = floats(^float(int i) { return (float)(N - i); }), o = floats(nil);
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> p1 = [comp newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:compute(fn(lib, @"add")) compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
    int bad = -1;
    if (p1) run(p1, @[o, a, b], 64);
    check(p1 && axpy_ok(o, 1.0f, &bad), "compute pipeline (library function): o = a + b%s", p1 ? "" : err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);

    // 2. specialized function
    MTL4SpecializedFunctionDescriptor *sf = [MTL4SpecializedFunctionDescriptor new];
    sf.functionDescriptor = fn(lib, @"axpy");
    MTLFunctionConstantValues *cv = [MTLFunctionConstantValues new]; const float k = 3.0f;
    [cv setConstantValue:&k type:MTLDataTypeFloat atIndex:0];
    sf.constantValues = cv;
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> p2 = [comp newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:compute(sf) compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
    if (p2) run(p2, @[o, a, b], 64);
    check(p2 && axpy_ok(o, 3.0f, &bad), "compute pipeline (specialized, K = 3): o = a + 3b%s%s", p2 ? "" : " - ", p2 ? "" : err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);

    // 3. threadgroup limits of the descriptor
    MTL4ComputePipelineDescriptor *cd = compute(fn(lib, @"ids"));
    cd.maxTotalThreadsPerThreadgroup = 64;
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> p3 = [comp newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:cd compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
    check(p3 && p3.maxTotalThreadsPerThreadgroup >= 1 && p3.maxTotalThreadsPerThreadgroup <= 64, "maxTotalThreadsPerThreadgroup 64 -> the pipeline answers %lu",
          (unsigned long)p3.maxTotalThreadsPerThreadgroup);
    cd = compute(fn(lib, @"ids"));
    cd.requiredThreadsPerThreadgroup = MTLSizeMake(32, 1, 1);
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> p3b = [comp newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:cd compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
    id<MTLBuffer> u = [dev newBufferWithLength:N * 4 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    if (p3b) run(p3b, @[u], 32);
    const uint32_t *up = u.contents;
    check(p3b && up[0] == 32 && up[N - 1] == (N - 1) * 1000 + 32, "requiredThreadsPerThreadgroup 32: pipeline %p, ids[0] %u, ids[%d] %u",
          (__bridge void *)p3b, up[0], N - 1, up[N - 1]);

    // 4. asynchronous build
    __block id<MTLComputePipelineState> p4 = nil; __block NSError *e4 = nil; __block int called = 0;
    id<MTL4CompilerTask> task = [comp newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:compute(fn(lib, @"add")) compilerTaskOptions:nil
                                                        completionHandler:^(id<MTLComputePipelineState> ps, NSError *e) { p4 = ps; e4 = e; called++; }];
    [task waitUntilCompleted];
    for (int t = 0; t < 200 && !called; t++) usleep(10000);   // the handler may run just after the task completes
    check(task && task.compiler == comp && task.status == MTL4CompilerTaskStatusFinished && called == 1 && p4,
          "asynchronous compute pipeline: task status %ld, handler called %d time(s), pipeline %p %s", (long)task.status, called, (__bridge void *)p4,
          e4 ? e4.localizedDescription.UTF8String : "");

    // 5. static linking of an extern function from another library
    id<MTLLibrary> helper = [comp newLibraryWithDescriptor:({ MTL4LibraryDescriptor *h = [MTL4LibraryDescriptor new]; h.source = kHelper; h; }) error:&err];
    if (!helper) check(0, "helper library: %s", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    else {
        cd = compute(fn(lib, @"linked"));
        MTL4StaticLinkingDescriptor *sl = [MTL4StaticLinkingDescriptor new]; sl.functionDescriptors = @[fn(helper, @"twice")];
        cd.staticLinkingDescriptor = sl;
        id<MTLComputePipelineState> p5 = [comp newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:cd compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
        id<MTLBuffer> l = floats(^float(int i) { return (float)i; });
        if (p5) run(p5, @[l], 64);
        const float *lp = l.contents;
        check(p5 && lp[0] == 0.5f && lp[10] == 20.5f && lp[N - 1] == 2.0f * (N - 1) + 0.5f, "static linking: twice() from a second library: o[10] = %g (want 20.5)%s%s",
              lp[10], p5 ? "" : " - ", p5 ? "" : err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    }

    // 6. render pipeline: a specialized fragment colour into a 4x4 texture
    MTL4SpecializedFunctionDescriptor *sfs = [MTL4SpecializedFunctionDescriptor new];
    sfs.functionDescriptor = fn(lib, @"fs");
    MTLFunctionConstantValues *fcv = [MTLFunctionConstantValues new]; const float col[4] = { 1.0f, 0.5f, 0.25f, 1.0f };
    [fcv setConstantValue:col type:MTLDataTypeFloat4 atIndex:1];
    sfs.constantValues = fcv;
    MTL4RenderPipelineDescriptor *rd = [MTL4RenderPipelineDescriptor new];
    rd.vertexFunctionDescriptor = fn(lib, @"vs"); rd.fragmentFunctionDescriptor = sfs;
    rd.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm;
    id<MTLRenderPipelineState> rp = [comp newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:rd compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
    MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm width:4 height:4 mipmapped:NO];
    td.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget; td.storageMode = MTLStorageModeShared;
    id<MTLTexture> rt = [dev newTextureWithDescriptor:td];
    uint32_t px[16] = { 0 };
    if (rp) {
        MTLRenderPassDescriptor *pass = [MTLRenderPassDescriptor renderPassDescriptor];
        pass.colorAttachments[0].texture = rt; pass.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear;
        pass.colorAttachments[0].clearColor = MTLClearColorMake(0, 0, 0, 0); pass.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
        id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [queue commandBuffer];
        id<MTLRenderCommandEncoder> re = [cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:pass];
        [re setRenderPipelineState:rp]; [re drawPrimitives:MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle vertexStart:0 vertexCount:3]; [re endEncoding];
        [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
        if (cb.status != MTLCommandBufferStatusCompleted) gpu_error = 1;
        [rt getBytes:px bytesPerRow:16 fromRegion:MTLRegionMake2D(0, 0, 4, 4) mipmapLevel:0];
    }
    int same = 1; for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) same &= px[i] == px[0];
    // 0.5 and 0.25 round to 0x80 and 0x40 on every GPU we know of; accept one step either way
    const uint32_t r = px[0] & 0xff, g = (px[0] >> 8) & 0xff, bl = (px[0] >> 16) & 0xff, al = px[0] >> 24;
    check(rp && same && r == 0xff && (g == 0x7f || g == 0x80) && (bl == 0x3f || bl == 0x40) && al == 0xff,
          "render pipeline (specialized fragment colour) draws 0x%08x everywhere (want ~0xff4080ff)%s%s", px[0], rp ? "" : " - ", rp ? "" : err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    rd.colorAttachments[0].blendingState = MTL4BlendStateUnspecialized;
    id<MTLRenderPipelineState> un = [comp newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:rd compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
    rd.colorAttachments[0].blendingState = MTL4BlendStateEnabled;
    id<MTLRenderPipelineState> sp = un ? [comp newRenderPipelineStateBySpecializationWithDescriptor:rd pipeline:un error:&err] : nil;
    check(un && sp, "render pipeline by specialization (unspecialized blending, then enabled): %p -> %p", (__bridge void *)un, (__bridge void *)sp);

    // 7. archives
    NSURL *missing = [NSURL fileURLWithPath:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@/mtl4_compiler-missing-%d.mtl4archive", NSTemporaryDirectory(), getpid()]];
    err = nil;
    id<MTL4Archive> none = [dev newArchiveWithURL:missing error:&err];
    check(!none && err, "newArchiveWithURL on a missing file: nil, error \"%s\"", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String ?: "(none)");
    MTL4PipelineDataSetSerializerDescriptor *sd = [MTL4PipelineDataSetSerializerDescriptor new];
    sd.configuration = MTL4PipelineDataSetSerializerConfigurationCaptureBinaries;
    id<MTL4PipelineDataSetSerializer> ser = [dev newPipelineDataSetSerializerWithDescriptor:sd];
    MTL4CompilerDescriptor *ccd = [MTL4CompilerDescriptor new]; ccd.pipelineDataSetSerializer = ser;
    id<MTL4Compiler> rec = ser ? [dev newCompilerWithDescriptor:ccd error:&err] : nil;
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> pr = rec ? [rec newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:compute(fn(lib, @"add")) compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err] : nil;
    NSURL *url = [NSURL fileURLWithPath:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@/mtl4_compiler-%d.mtl4archive", NSTemporaryDirectory(), getpid()]];
    BOOL wrote = pr && [ser serializeAsArchiveAndFlushToURL:url error:&err];
    check(ser && rec && pr && wrote, "serializer %p, recording compiler %p, pipeline %p, archive written %d%s%s", (__bridge void *)ser, (__bridge void *)rec,
          (__bridge void *)pr, wrote, wrote ? "" : " - ", wrote ? "" : err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    id<MTL4Archive> ar = wrote ? [dev newArchiveWithURL:url error:&err] : nil;
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> hit = ar ? [ar newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:compute(fn(lib, @"add")) error:&err] : nil;
    if (hit) { o = floats(nil); run(hit, @[o, a, b], 64); }
    check(ar && hit && axpy_ok(o, 1.0f, &bad), "archive read back (%p): the recorded pipeline is found and computes o = a + b", (__bridge void *)ar);
    NSError *me = nil;
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> miss = ar ? [ar newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:compute(fn(lib, @"ids")) error:&me] : nil;
    check(ar && !miss, "archive lookup of a pipeline it does not hold: %p, error \"%s\"", (__bridge void *)miss, me.localizedDescription.UTF8String ?: "(none)");
    if (wrote) [[NSFileManager defaultManager] removeItemAtURL:url error:NULL];
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    @autoreleasepool {
        setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
        const BOOL any = argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--any");
        const uint64_t nmx = nmx_registry_id();
        for (id<MTLDevice> d in MTLCopyAllDevices()) {
            const BOOL b580 = (nmx && d.registryID == nmx) || [NSStringFromClass([d class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"];
            if (b580 || (any && !dev)) dev = d;
            if (b580) break;
        }
        if (!dev) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: no B580 Metal device (--any runs on the first device)\n"); return 1; }
        printf("device: %s (%s)\n", dev.name.UTF8String, NSStringFromClass([dev class]).UTF8String);
        queue = [dev newCommandQueue];
        int rc = 0;
        if (@available(macOS 26.0, *)) rc = body();
        else { printf("SKIP: MTL4Compiler needs macOS 26\n"); return 5; }
        if (rc) return rc;
        printf("%d PASS, %d FAIL\n", npass, nfail);
        return gpu_error ? 3 : nfail ? 4 : 0;
    }
}

FILE: user/tests/metal/mtl_cube_read.m
