// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// mtl_reflection: pipeline reflection on the Arc B580 (nullmoth/plugin: nvmtl_arguments_for_function, NVMTLMetal4.m).
//
// One kernel with every kind of binding Metal reflects (a device pointer, a constant struct with a scalar and an array
// member, a buffer the kernel never touches, a read texture, a write-only uint texture, a depth texture, a sampler and
// two [[threadgroup(N)]] pointers), and a vertex/fragment pair with a stage-in vertex buffer:
//   1. Metal 3: newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:options:(BindingInfo | BufferTypeInfo):reflection: - every binding
//      by type and index, with its name, access, used flag, data type, size and alignment, struct members, texture
//      type, component type and depth flag, and the threadgroup memory size and alignment;
//   2. Metal 3: the render pipeline's vertex and fragment bindings (the stage-in buffer is no argument);
//   3. a Metal 3 pipeline's -reflection is nil (macOS 26: only MTL4PipelineOptions.shaderReflection fills it);
//   4. Metal 4 (when the device has a Metal 4 compiler): MTL4Compiler pipelines carry -reflection exactly when
//      shaderReflection asks, with the same bindings as 1 and 2.
// The expected answers are what Apple's driver gives (run with --any on an Apple GPU Mac as the reference).
// Each check prints PASS or FAIL (SKIP: not offered); the last line counts them.
//
//   NVMTL_ENABLE=1 NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_METAL4=1 ./mtl_reflection   (B580; without NVMTL_METAL4 part 4 is skipped)
//   ./mtl_reflection --any                                                the first Metal device when no B580 is present
//
// Exit: 0 pass, 1 no B580 device, 2 setup/compile failure, 4 wrong results.
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "mtl_reflection_expect.h"

#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wdeprecated-declarations"   // MTLArgument-era names some drivers still answer through

static NSString *const kSource =
    @"#include <metal_stdlib>\n"
     "using namespace metal;\n"
     "struct Params { float4 scale; uint count; float pad[3]; };\n"
     "kernel void kref(device float4 *out [[buffer(0)]], constant Params &p [[buffer(1)]], const device uint *unused [[buffer(5)]],\n"
     "                 texture2d<float, access::read> src [[texture(0)]], texture2d<uint, access::write> dst [[texture(3)]],\n"
     "                 depth2d<float> dep [[texture(4)]], sampler s [[sampler(2)]], threadgroup float4 *tg [[threadgroup(0)]],\n"
     "                 threadgroup uint *tg2 [[threadgroup(1)]], uint i [[thread_position_in_grid]], uint l [[thread_index_in_threadgroup]]) {\n"
     "    tg[l] = src.read(uint2(i, 0)) * p.scale + dep.sample(s, float2(0.5));\n"
     "    tg2[l] = i;\n"
     "    threadgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup);\n"
     "    out[i] = tg[(l + 1) % p.count] + float(tg2[0]);\n"
     "    dst.write(uint4(i), uint2(i, 0));\n"
     "}\n"
     "struct VO { float4 pos [[position]]; float2 uv; };\n"
     "struct VIn { float2 pos [[attribute(0)]]; float2 uv [[attribute(1)]]; };\n"
     "vertex VO vs(VIn in [[stage_in]], constant float4x4 &mvp [[buffer(1)]]) {\n"
     "    VO o; o.pos = mvp * float4(in.pos, 0, 1); o.uv = in.uv; return o;\n"
     "}\n"
     "fragment float4 fs(VO in [[stage_in]], texture2d<half> t [[texture(1)]], sampler s [[sampler(0)]], constant float4 &tint [[buffer(2)]]) {\n"
     "    return float4(t.sample(s, in.uv)) * tint;\n"
     "}\n";

static uint64_t nmx_registry_id(void)
{
    io_service_t s = IOServiceGetMatchingService(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("NMXAccel"));
    if (!s) return 0;
    uint64_t id = 0;
    IORegistryEntryGetRegistryEntryID(s, &id);
    IOObjectRelease(s);
    return id;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    @autoreleasepool {
        setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
        const BOOL any = argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--any");
        const uint64_t nmx = nmx_registry_id();
        id<MTLDevice> dev = nil;
        for (id<MTLDevice> d in MTLCopyAllDevices()) {
            const BOOL b580 = (nmx && d.registryID == nmx) || [NSStringFromClass([d class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"];
            if (b580 || (any && !dev)) dev = d;
            if (b580) break;
        }
        if (!dev) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: no B580 Metal device (--any runs on the first device)\n"); return 1; }
        printf("device: %s (%s)\n", dev.name.UTF8String, NSStringFromClass([dev class]).UTF8String);

        NSError *err = nil;
        id<MTLLibrary> lib = [dev newLibraryWithSource:kSource options:nil error:&err];
        if (!lib) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: newLibraryWithSource: %s\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
        id<MTLFunction> kf = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"kref"], vf = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"vs"], ff = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"fs"];
        if (!kf || !vf || !ff) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: functions kref %p vs %p fs %p\n", (__bridge void *)kf, (__bridge void *)vf, (__bridge void *)ff); return 2; }
        const MTLPipelineOption opts = MTLPipelineOptionBindingInfo | MTLPipelineOptionBufferTypeInfo;

        // 1. Metal 3 compute
        MTLAutoreleasedComputePipelineReflection cr = nil;
        id<MTLComputePipelineState> cps = [dev newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:kf options:opts reflection:&cr error:&err];
        if (!cps) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: compute pipeline: %s\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
        check(cr != nil, "Metal 3 compute: reflection with BindingInfo | BufferTypeInfo (%s)", cr ? NSStringFromClass([cr class]).UTF8String : "nil");
        if (cr) check_bindings("Metal 3 compute", cr.bindings, kKernel, sizeof kKernel / sizeof kKernel[0]);

        // 2. Metal 3 render, with a vertex descriptor (the stage-in buffer is reflected as vertexBuffer.0)
        MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *rd = [MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor new];
        rd.vertexFunction = vf; rd.fragmentFunction = ff; rd.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm;
        MTLVertexDescriptor *vd = [MTLVertexDescriptor new];
        vd.attributes[0].format = MTLVertexFormatFloat2; vd.attributes[0].bufferIndex = 0;
        vd.attributes[1].format = MTLVertexFormatFloat2; vd.attributes[1].offset = 8; vd.attributes[1].bufferIndex = 0;
        vd.layouts[0].stride = 16; rd.vertexDescriptor = vd;
        MTLAutoreleasedRenderPipelineReflection rr = nil;
        id<MTLRenderPipelineState> rps = [dev newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:rd options:opts reflection:&rr error:&err];
        if (!rps) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: render pipeline: %s\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
        check(rr != nil, "Metal 3 render: reflection with BindingInfo | BufferTypeInfo");
        if (rr) {
            check_bindings("Metal 3 vertex", rr.vertexBindings, kVertex, sizeof kVertex / sizeof kVertex[0]);
            check_bindings("Metal 3 fragment", rr.fragmentBindings, kFragment, sizeof kFragment / sizeof kFragment[0]);
        }

        // 3. and 4.
        if (@available(macOS 26.0, *)) {
            check(cps.reflection == nil && rps.reflection == nil, "a Metal 3 pipeline's -reflection is nil (compute %p, render %p)",
                  (__bridge void *)cps.reflection, (__bridge void *)rps.reflection);
            // a device without the Metal 4 family (the B580 without NVMTL_METAL4=1) is not asked for a compiler: apps check first
            id<MTL4Compiler> comp = [dev supportsFamily:MTLGPUFamilyMetal4] ? [dev newCompilerWithDescriptor:[MTL4CompilerDescriptor new] error:&err] : nil;
            if (!comp) skip("Metal 4: no MTLGPUFamilyMetal4 or no MTL4Compiler (B580: NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_METAL4=1)");
            else {
                MTL4LibraryFunctionDescriptor *kd = [MTL4LibraryFunctionDescriptor new]; kd.library = lib; kd.name = @"kref";
                MTL4ComputePipelineDescriptor *cd = [MTL4ComputePipelineDescriptor new]; cd.computeFunctionDescriptor = kd;
                cd.options = [MTL4PipelineOptions new];
                cd.options.shaderReflection = MTL4ShaderReflectionNone;
                id<MTLComputePipelineState> p0 = [comp newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:cd compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
                check(p0 && !p0.reflection, "Metal 4 compute, shaderReflection None: pipeline %p, reflection %p", (__bridge void *)p0, (__bridge void *)p0.reflection);
                cd.options.shaderReflection = MTL4ShaderReflectionBindingInfo | MTL4ShaderReflectionBufferTypeInfo;
                id<MTLComputePipelineState> p1 = [comp newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:cd compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
                check(p1 && p1.reflection, "Metal 4 compute, shaderReflection BindingInfo | BufferTypeInfo: pipeline %p, reflection %p",
                      (__bridge void *)p1, (__bridge void *)p1.reflection);
                if (p1.reflection) check_bindings("Metal 4 compute", p1.reflection.bindings, kKernel, sizeof kKernel / sizeof kKernel[0]);

                MTL4LibraryFunctionDescriptor *v4 = [MTL4LibraryFunctionDescriptor new]; v4.library = lib; v4.name = @"vs";
                MTL4LibraryFunctionDescriptor *f4 = [MTL4LibraryFunctionDescriptor new]; f4.library = lib; f4.name = @"fs";
                MTL4RenderPipelineDescriptor *r4 = [MTL4RenderPipelineDescriptor new];
                r4.vertexFunctionDescriptor = v4; r4.fragmentFunctionDescriptor = f4; r4.vertexDescriptor = vd;
                r4.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm;
                r4.options = [MTL4PipelineOptions new]; r4.options.shaderReflection = MTL4ShaderReflectionBindingInfo;
                id<MTLRenderPipelineState> q = [comp newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:r4 compilerTaskOptions:nil error:&err];
                check(q && q.reflection, "Metal 4 render, shaderReflection BindingInfo: pipeline %p, reflection %p (%s)", (__bridge void *)q,
                      (__bridge void *)q.reflection, q ? "" : err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
                if (q.reflection) {
                    check_bindings("Metal 4 vertex", q.reflection.vertexBindings, kVertex, sizeof kVertex / sizeof kVertex[0]);
                    check_bindings("Metal 4 fragment", q.reflection.fragmentBindings, kFragment, sizeof kFragment / sizeof kFragment[0]);
                }
            }
        } else skip("macOS 26 pipeline -reflection and MTL4Compiler (older OS)");

        printf("%d PASS, %d FAIL, %d SKIP\n", npass, nfail, nskip);
        return nfail ? 4 : 0;
    }
}

FILE: user/tests/metal/mtl_reflection_expect.h
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// mtl_reflection_expect.h: the bindings Apple's driver reflects for mtl_reflection's shaders (kSource there; the same
// shaders' AIR is user/tests/plugin/refl/), and the check that compares a reflection with them. Shared by
// mtl_reflection.m (any Metal device) and user/tests/plugin/refl_host.m (the plugin's reflection code, no GPU).
#ifndef MTL_REFLECTION_EXPECT_H
#define MTL_REFLECTION_EXPECT_H
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdarg.h>

static int npass, nfail, nskip;
static void check(int ok, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
static void check(int ok, const char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
    printf("%s ", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL"); vprintf(fmt, ap); printf("\n");
    va_end(ap);
    if (ok) npass++; else nfail++;
}
static inline void skip(const char *what) { printf("SKIP %s\n", what); nskip++; }

// One expected binding. size/align: buffer data size and alignment, or threadgroup memory size and alignment.
// dtype: buffer data type, or texture component type. ttype: texture type. stagein: a stage-in buffer (no argument).
typedef struct {
    MTLBindingType type; NSUInteger index; const char *name; MTLBindingAccess access; BOOL used;
    MTLDataType dtype; NSUInteger size, align; MTLTextureType ttype; BOOL depth, stagein;
} expect_t;

static const expect_t kKernel[] = {
    { MTLBindingTypeBuffer, 0, "out", MTLBindingAccessReadWrite, YES, MTLDataTypeFloat4, 16, 16, 0, NO, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeBuffer, 1, "p", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, YES, MTLDataTypeStruct, 32, 16, 0, NO, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeBuffer, 5, "unused", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, NO, MTLDataTypeUInt, 4, 4, 0, NO, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeTexture, 0, "src", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, YES, MTLDataTypeFloat, 0, 0, MTLTextureType2D, NO, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeTexture, 3, "dst", MTLBindingAccessWriteOnly, YES, MTLDataTypeUInt, 0, 0, MTLTextureType2D, NO, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeTexture, 4, "dep", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, YES, MTLDataTypeFloat, 0, 0, MTLTextureType2D, YES, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeSampler, 2, "s", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, YES, 0, 0, 0, 0, NO, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeThreadgroupMemory, 0, "tg", MTLBindingAccessReadWrite, YES, 0, 16, 16, 0, NO, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeThreadgroupMemory, 1, "tg2", MTLBindingAccessReadWrite, YES, 0, 4, 4, 0, NO, NO },
};
static const expect_t kVertex[] = {
    { MTLBindingTypeBuffer, 0, "vertexBuffer.0", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, YES, MTLDataTypeStruct, 16, 4, 0, NO, YES },
    { MTLBindingTypeBuffer, 1, "mvp", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, YES, MTLDataTypeFloat4x4, 64, 16, 0, NO, NO },
};
static const expect_t kFragment[] = {
    { MTLBindingTypeTexture, 1, "t", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, YES, MTLDataTypeHalf, 0, 0, MTLTextureType2D, NO, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeSampler, 0, "s", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, YES, 0, 0, 0, 0, NO, NO },
    { MTLBindingTypeBuffer, 2, "tint", MTLBindingAccessReadOnly, YES, MTLDataTypeFloat4, 16, 16, 0, NO, NO },
};

static const char *tname(MTLBindingType t)
{
    switch (t) {
    case MTLBindingTypeBuffer: return "buffer";
    case MTLBindingTypeTexture: return "texture";
    case MTLBindingTypeSampler: return "sampler";
    case MTLBindingTypeThreadgroupMemory: return "threadgroup";
    default: return "other";
    }
}

// Every binding of `bs` against `ex` (found by type and index, in any order: Apple lists them in declaration order).
static void check_bindings(const char *what, NSArray<id<MTLBinding>> *bs, const expect_t *ex, size_t n)
{
    check(bs.count == n, "%s: %lu bindings (want %zu)", what, (unsigned long)bs.count, n);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const expect_t *e = &ex[i];
        id<MTLBinding> b = nil;
        for (id<MTLBinding> x in bs) if (x.type == e->type && x.index == e->index) { b = x; break; }
        if (!b) { check(0, "%s: %s %lu '%s' is listed", what, tname(e->type), (unsigned long)e->index, e->name); continue; }
        BOOL ok = [b.name isEqualToString:@(e->name)] && b.access == e->access && b.used == e->used && b.argument == !e->stagein;
        NSMutableString *got = [NSMutableString stringWithFormat:@"name '%@' access %lu used %d argument %d", b.name, (unsigned long)b.access, b.used, b.argument];
        if (e->type == MTLBindingTypeBuffer) {
            id<MTLBufferBinding> bb = (id<MTLBufferBinding>)b;
            ok = ok && bb.bufferDataType == e->dtype && bb.bufferDataSize == e->size && bb.bufferAlignment == e->align;
            [got appendFormat:@", data type %lu size %lu alignment %lu", (unsigned long)bb.bufferDataType, (unsigned long)bb.bufferDataSize,
                              (unsigned long)bb.bufferAlignment];
        } else if (e->type == MTLBindingTypeTexture) {
            id<MTLTextureBinding> tb = (id<MTLTextureBinding>)b;
            ok = ok && tb.textureType == e->ttype && tb.textureDataType == e->dtype && tb.depthTexture == e->depth && tb.arrayLength == 1;
            [got appendFormat:@", texture type %lu component %lu depth %d array length %lu", (unsigned long)tb.textureType,
                              (unsigned long)tb.textureDataType, tb.depthTexture, (unsigned long)tb.arrayLength];
        } else if (e->type == MTLBindingTypeThreadgroupMemory) {
            id<MTLThreadgroupBinding> tg = (id<MTLThreadgroupBinding>)b;
            ok = ok && tg.threadgroupMemoryDataSize == e->size && tg.threadgroupMemoryAlignment == e->align;
            [got appendFormat:@", size %lu alignment %lu", (unsigned long)tg.threadgroupMemoryDataSize, (unsigned long)tg.threadgroupMemoryAlignment];
        }
        check(ok, "%s: %s %lu '%s': %s", what, tname(e->type), (unsigned long)e->index, e->name, got.UTF8String);
    }
    // the constant struct: its members by name, offset and type (pad is a float[3])
    for (id<MTLBinding> x in bs) {
        if (x.type != MTLBindingTypeBuffer || ![x.name isEqualToString:@"p"]) continue;
        MTLStructType *st = ((id<MTLBufferBinding>)x).bufferStructType;
        MTLStructMember *sc = [st memberByName:@"scale"], *ct = [st memberByName:@"count"], *pd = [st memberByName:@"pad"];
        check(st.members.count == 3 && sc.offset == 0 && sc.dataType == MTLDataTypeFloat4 && ct.offset == 16 && ct.dataType == MTLDataTypeUInt
              && pd.offset == 20 && pd.dataType == MTLDataTypeArray && pd.arrayType.arrayLength == 3 && pd.arrayType.elementType == MTLDataTypeFloat,
              "%s: struct Params: %lu members, scale @%lu type %lu, count @%lu type %lu, pad @%lu type %lu [%lu x %lu]", what,
              (unsigned long)st.members.count, (unsigned long)sc.offset, (unsigned long)sc.dataType, (unsigned long)ct.offset,
              (unsigned long)ct.dataType, (unsigned long)pd.offset, (unsigned long)pd.dataType, (unsigned long)pd.arrayType.arrayLength,
              (unsigned long)pd.arrayType.elementType);
    }
}

#endif

FILE: user/tests/metal/mtl_smoke.m
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// mtl_smoke: first Metal test on the Arc B580 (NMXAccel + NVMTLDriver.bundle + ANV over IntelXe.kext).
//
// Picks the B580's MTLDevice explicitly (never MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice: that is the UHD 770 WindowServer runs on),
// compiles a compute kernel from source at runtime, writes 64 Ki uints into a shared buffer and checks every value.
//
//   NVMTL_ENABLE=1 ./mtl_smoke           (NVMTL_ENABLE passes the plugin's allow-list, NVMTLDevice.m:543)
//   ./mtl_smoke --list                   only list the Metal devices this process sees
//
// Exit: 0 pass, 1 no B580 device, 2 compile/pipeline failure, 3 GPU error, 4 wrong values.
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

static NSString *const kSource =
    @"#include <metal_stdlib>\n"
     "using namespace metal;\n"
     "kernel void fill(device uint *out [[buffer(0)]], constant uint &k [[buffer(1)]],\n"
     "                 uint gid [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
     "    out[gid] = gid * 3u + k;\n"
     "}\n";

// The registry ID of the NMXAccel accelerator (0 if none). An MTLIOAccelDevice reports its accelerator's ID.
static uint64_t nmx_registry_id(void)
{
    io_service_t s = IOServiceGetMatchingService(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("NMXAccel"));
    if (!s) return 0;
    uint64_t id = 0;
    IORegistryEntryGetRegistryEntryID(s, &id);
    IOObjectRelease(s);
    return id;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    @autoreleasepool {
        const BOOL listOnly = argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--list");
        const uint64_t nmx = nmx_registry_id();
        printf("NMXAccel registry id: 0x%llx%s\n", (unsigned long long)nmx, nmx ? "" : " (NMXAccel is not running)");

        NSArray<id<MTLDevice>> *all = MTLCopyAllDevices();
        id<MTLDevice> dev = nil;
        for (id<MTLDevice> d in all) {
            const BOOL ours = (nmx && d.registryID == nmx) || [NSStringFromClass([d class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"];
            printf("  %s  %-40s class %-24s registryID 0x%llx headless %d lowPower %d\n", ours ? "*" : " ",
                   d.name.UTF8String, NSStringFromClass([d class]).UTF8String, (unsigned long long)d.registryID,
                   d.isHeadless, d.isLowPower);
            if (ours && !dev) dev = d;
        }
        if (listOnly) return dev ? 0 : 1;
        if (!dev) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: no B580 Metal device among %lu\n", (unsigned long)all.count); return 1; }

        NSError *err = nil;
        MTLCompileOptions *opt = [MTLCompileOptions new];
        id<MTLLibrary> lib = [dev newLibraryWithSource:kSource options:opt error:&err];
        if (!lib) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: newLibraryWithSource: %s\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
        id<MTLFunction> fn = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"fill"];
        if (!fn) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: no function 'fill' (library %s)\n", NSStringFromClass([lib class]).UTF8String); return 2; }
        id<MTLComputePipelineState> pso = [dev newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:fn error:&err];
        if (!pso) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: pipeline: %s\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }

        const NSUInteger n = 65536;
        const uint32_t k = 0x1234;
        id<MTLBuffer> out = [dev newBufferWithLength:n * sizeof(uint32_t) options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
        if (!out) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: newBufferWithLength\n"); return 3; }
        memset(out.contents, 0xA5, n * sizeof(uint32_t));

        id<MTLCommandQueue> q = [dev newCommandQueue];
        id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer];
        id<MTLComputeCommandEncoder> enc = [cb computeCommandEncoder];
        [enc setComputePipelineState:pso];
        [enc setBuffer:out offset:0 atIndex:0];
        [enc setBytes:&k length:sizeof k atIndex:1];
        NSUInteger tg = MIN((NSUInteger)64, pso.maxTotalThreadsPerThreadgroup);
        [enc dispatchThreads:MTLSizeMake(n, 1, 1) threadsPerThreadgroup:MTLSizeMake(tg, 1, 1)];
        [enc endEncoding];
        [cb commit];
        [cb waitUntilCompleted];
        if (cb.status != MTLCommandBufferStatusCompleted) {
            fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: command buffer status %ld: %s\n", (long)cb.status, cb.error.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
            return 3;
        }

        const uint32_t *v = out.contents;
        NSUInteger bad = 0;
        for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < n; i++)
            if (v[i] != (uint32_t)i * 3u + k) { if (bad++ < 8) fprintf(stderr, "  [%lu] = 0x%08x, want 0x%08x\n", (unsigned long)i, v[i], (uint32_t)i * 3u + k); }
        printf("%s: %lu of %lu values wrong on %s (threadgroup %lu)\n", bad ? "FAIL" : "PASS", (unsigned long)bad,
               (unsigned long)n, dev.name.UTF8String, (unsigned long)tg);
        return bad ? 4 : 0;
    }
}

FILE: user/tests/metal/mtl_sparse_buffer.m
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// mtl_sparse_buffer: Metal placement sparse buffers on the Arc B580 (NVMTL_SPARSE_TEXTURES=1 and NVMTL_METAL4=1;
// nullmoth/plugin/NVMTLSparse.m, docs/design/DESIGN-sparse-textures.md "Sparse buffers").
//
// A placement heap of 4 tiles and a sparse buffer of 8 tiles (newBufferWithLength:options:placementSparsePageSize:):
//   1. the buffer answers sparseBufferTier Tier1 (an ordinary buffer None), its length and a GPU address;
//   2. MTL4CommandQueue updateBufferMappings maps buffer tiles 0, 1 and 5 to heap tiles 0, 1 and 2; a kernel writes a
//      pattern over the whole buffer and a second kernel reads every tile's first and last word back: mapped tiles
//      hold the pattern, unmapped tiles read zero (their writes vanished); a blit of the whole buffer agrees;
//   3. a second update unmaps tile 1 and maps tile 3 to heap tile 1: tile 3 now shows what tile 1 held (the heap
//      tile kept its contents), tile 1 reads zero;
//   4. copyBufferMappingsFromBuffer gives a second sparse buffer's tile 2 the first buffer's tile 0: it reads the
//      first buffer's data there.
// Mapping updates go through a Metal 4 queue, which signals an event the Metal 3 command buffers wait for.
// Each check prints PASS or FAIL; the last line counts them.
//
//   NVMTL_ENABLE=1 NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_SPARSE_TEXTURES=1 NVMTL_METAL4=1 ./mtl_sparse_buffer    (B580)
//   ./mtl_sparse_buffer --any                         the first Metal device when no B580 is present (reference run)
//
// Exit: 0 pass, 1 no B580 device, 2 setup/compile failure, 3 GPU error, 4 wrong results, 5 sparse buffers not offered.
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <string.h>

static NSString *const kSource =
    @"#include <metal_stdlib>\n"
     "using namespace metal;\n"
     // word i of the buffer = i * 2654435761 + salt (never 0 for the words read back)
     "kernel void fill(device uint *b [[buffer(0)]], constant uint &salt [[buffer(1)]], uint i [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
     "    b[i] = i * 2654435761u + salt;\n"
     "}\n"
     // per tile t: its first and last word
     "kernel void probe(const device uint *b [[buffer(0)]], device uint2 *o [[buffer(1)]], constant uint &words [[buffer(2)]],\n"
     "                  uint t [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
     "    o[t] = uint2(b[t * words], b[t * words + words - 1]);\n"
     "}\n";

static uint64_t nmx_registry_id(void)
{
    io_service_t s = IOServiceGetMatchingService(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("NMXAccel"));
    if (!s) return 0;
    uint64_t id = 0;
    IORegistryEntryGetRegistryEntryID(s, &id);
    IOObjectRelease(s);
    return id;
}

static int npass, nfail, gpu_error;
static void check(int ok, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
static void check(int ok, const char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
    printf("%s ", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL"); vprintf(fmt, ap); printf("\n");
    va_end(ap);
    if (ok) npass++; else nfail++;
}

enum { TILES = 8, HEAP_TILES = 4 };
static id<MTLDevice> dev;
static id<MTLCommandQueue> queue;
static id<MTLComputePipelineState> fillPS, probePS;
static id<MTLSharedEvent> event;
static uint64_t eventValue;
static NSUInteger tileBytes;

static uint32_t pattern(uint32_t word, uint32_t salt) { return word * 2654435761u + salt; }

static void finish(id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb, const char *what)
{
    [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
    if (cb.status != MTLCommandBufferStatusCompleted) {
        fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: %s: command buffer status %ld: %s\n", what, (long)cb.status, cb.error.localizedDescription.UTF8String ?: "");
        gpu_error = 1;
    }
}
// a Metal 3 command buffer ordered after the Metal 4 queue's last mapping update
static id<MTLCommandBuffer> after_mappings(void)
{
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [queue commandBuffer];
    [cb encodeWaitForEvent:event value:eventValue];
    return cb;
}
static void fill(id<MTLBuffer> b, uint32_t salt)
{
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = after_mappings();
    id<MTLComputeCommandEncoder> e = [cb computeCommandEncoder];
    [e setComputePipelineState:fillPS]; [e setBuffer:b offset:0 atIndex:0]; [e setBytes:&salt length:4 atIndex:1];
    [e dispatchThreads:MTLSizeMake(b.length / 4, 1, 1) threadsPerThreadgroup:MTLSizeMake(64, 1, 1)];
    [e endEncoding];
    finish(cb, "fill");
}
// first and last word of every tile, by a kernel (out[2t], out[2t+1]) and by a blit of the whole buffer (copy)
static void probe(id<MTLBuffer> b, uint32_t *out, id<MTLBuffer> copy)
{
    id<MTLBuffer> o = [dev newBufferWithLength:TILES * 8 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    const uint32_t words = (uint32_t)(tileBytes / 4);
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = after_mappings();
    id<MTLComputeCommandEncoder> e = [cb computeCommandEncoder];
    [e setComputePipelineState:probePS]; [e setBuffer:b offset:0 atIndex:0]; [e setBuffer:o offset:0 atIndex:1]; [e setBytes:&words length:4 atIndex:2];
    [e dispatchThreads:MTLSizeMake(TILES, 1, 1) threadsPerThreadgroup:MTLSizeMake(TILES, 1, 1)];
    [e endEncoding];
    if (copy) { id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> bl = [cb blitCommandEncoder]; [bl copyFromBuffer:b sourceOffset:0 toBuffer:copy destinationOffset:0 size:b.length]; [bl endEncoding]; }
    finish(cb, "probe");
    memcpy(out, o.contents, TILES * 8);
}
// every tile's first and last word: `src[t]` is the tile whose words tile t holds (its pattern), -1 for zero
static void expect(const char *what, const uint32_t *got, const int *src, uint32_t salt, id<MTLBuffer> copy)
{
    const uint32_t words = (uint32_t)(tileBytes / 4);
    for (int t = 0; t < TILES; t++) {
        const uint32_t w0 = src[t] < 0 ? 0 : pattern((uint32_t)src[t] * words, salt), w1 = src[t] < 0 ? 0 : pattern((uint32_t)src[t] * words + words - 1, salt);
        int ok = got[2 * t] == w0 && got[2 * t + 1] == w1;
        uint32_t c0 = 0, c1 = 0;
        if (copy) { const uint32_t *c = copy.contents; c0 = c[t * words]; c1 = c[t * words + words - 1]; ok = ok && c0 == w0 && c1 == w1; }
        if (src[t] < 0) check(ok, "%s: tile %d is unmapped and reads 0 (kernel 0x%08x 0x%08x%s)", what, t, got[2 * t], got[2 * t + 1], copy ? ", blit too" : "");
        else if (copy) check(ok, "%s: tile %d holds tile %d's pattern (kernel 0x%08x 0x%08x, blit 0x%08x 0x%08x, want 0x%08x 0x%08x)", what, t,
                             src[t], got[2 * t], got[2 * t + 1], c0, c1, w0, w1);
        else check(ok, "%s: tile %d holds tile %d's pattern (kernel 0x%08x 0x%08x, want 0x%08x 0x%08x)", what, t, src[t], got[2 * t], got[2 * t + 1], w0, w1);
    }
}

API_AVAILABLE(macos(26.0))
static int body(void)
{
    BOOL placement = NO;
    if (@available(macOS 26.4, *)) placement = dev.supportsPlacementSparse;
    else placement = [(id)dev respondsToSelector:@selector(supportsPlacementSparse)] && [[(id)dev valueForKey:@"supportsPlacementSparse"] boolValue];
    if (!placement) { printf("SKIP: supportsPlacementSparse NO (B580: NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_SPARSE_TEXTURES=1)\n"); return 5; }
    id<MTL4CommandQueue> q4 = [dev supportsFamily:MTLGPUFamilyMetal4] ? [dev newMTL4CommandQueue] : nil;
    if (!q4) { printf("SKIP: no MTL4CommandQueue (B580: NVMTL_METAL4=1)\n"); return 5; }
    tileBytes = [dev sparseTileSizeInBytesForSparsePageSize:MTLSparsePageSize64];
    printf("tile: %lu bytes for 64 KiB pages\n", (unsigned long)tileBytes);
    if (!tileBytes) { printf("SKIP: no sparse tile size\n"); return 5; }

    NSError *err = nil;
    id<MTLLibrary> lib = [dev newLibraryWithSource:kSource options:nil error:&err];
    if (!lib) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: newLibraryWithSource: %s\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
    fillPS = [dev newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:[lib newFunctionWithName:@"fill"] error:&err];
    probePS = [dev newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:[lib newFunctionWithName:@"probe"] error:&err];
    if (!fillPS || !probePS) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: pipelines: %s\n", err.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
    event = [dev newSharedEvent];

    MTLHeapDescriptor *hd = [MTLHeapDescriptor new];
    hd.type = MTLHeapTypePlacement; hd.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate; hd.size = tileBytes * HEAP_TILES;
    hd.maxCompatiblePlacementSparsePageSize = MTLSparsePageSize64;
    id<MTLHeap> heap = [dev newHeapWithDescriptor:hd];
    if (!heap) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: placement heap of %u tiles -> nil\n", HEAP_TILES); return 2; }

    // 1.
    id<MTLBuffer> sb = [dev newBufferWithLength:tileBytes * TILES options:MTLResourceStorageModePrivate placementSparsePageSize:MTLSparsePageSize64];
    check(sb != nil, "newBufferWithLength:%lu options:private placementSparsePageSize:64 KiB -> %p", (unsigned long)(tileBytes * TILES), (__bridge void *)sb);
    if (!sb) return 4;
    id<MTLBuffer> plain = [dev newBufferWithLength:4096 options:MTLResourceStorageModePrivate];
    check(sb.sparseBufferTier == MTLBufferSparseTier1 && plain.sparseBufferTier == MTLBufferSparseTierNone,
          "sparseBufferTier: sparse buffer %ld (want Tier1 = 1), ordinary buffer %ld (want None)", (long)sb.sparseBufferTier, (long)plain.sparseBufferTier);
    check(sb.length == tileBytes * TILES && sb.gpuAddress != 0, "length %lu, gpuAddress 0x%llx", (unsigned long)sb.length, (unsigned long long)sb.gpuAddress);

    // 2.
    const MTL4UpdateSparseBufferMappingOperation m1[2] = {
        { MTLSparseTextureMappingModeMap, NSMakeRange(0, 2), 0 },
        { MTLSparseTextureMappingModeMap, NSMakeRange(5, 1), 2 },
    };
    [q4 updateBufferMappings:sb heap:heap operations:m1 count:2];
    [q4 signalEvent:event value:++eventValue];
    id<MTLBuffer> copy = [dev newBufferWithLength:tileBytes * TILES options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    uint32_t got[TILES * 2];
    fill(sb, 0x1234);
    probe(sb, got, copy);
    { const int src[TILES] = { 0, 1, -1, -1, -1, 5, -1, -1 }; expect("tiles 0,1,5 mapped", got, src, 0x1234, copy); }

    // 3. tile 1's heap tile moves to tile 3
    const MTL4UpdateSparseBufferMappingOperation m2[2] = {
        { MTLSparseTextureMappingModeUnmap, NSMakeRange(1, 1), 0 },
        { MTLSparseTextureMappingModeMap, NSMakeRange(3, 1), 1 },
    };
    [q4 updateBufferMappings:sb heap:heap operations:m2 count:2];
    [q4 signalEvent:event value:++eventValue];
    probe(sb, got, nil);
    { const int src[TILES] = { 0, -1, -1, 1, -1, 5, -1, -1 }; expect("tile 1 unmapped, tile 3 mapped to its heap tile", got, src, 0x1234, nil); }

    // 4. a second buffer's tile 2 aliases the first buffer's tile 0
    id<MTLBuffer> sb2 = [dev newBufferWithLength:tileBytes * TILES options:MTLResourceStorageModePrivate placementSparsePageSize:MTLSparsePageSize64];
    if (!sb2) check(0, "a second sparse buffer -> nil");
    else {
        const MTL4CopySparseBufferMappingOperation c1 = { NSMakeRange(0, 1), 2 };
        [q4 copyBufferMappingsFromBuffer:sb toBuffer:sb2 operations:&c1 count:1];
        [q4 signalEvent:event value:++eventValue];
        probe(sb2, got, nil);
        const int src[TILES] = { -1, -1, 0, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1 };
        expect("copyBufferMappings: second buffer's tile 2 = first buffer's tile 0", got, src, 0x1234, nil);
    }
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    @autoreleasepool {
        setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
        const BOOL any = argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--any");
        const uint64_t nmx = nmx_registry_id();
        for (id<MTLDevice> d in MTLCopyAllDevices()) {
            const BOOL b580 = (nmx && d.registryID == nmx) || [NSStringFromClass([d class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"];
            if (b580 || (any && !dev)) dev = d;
            if (b580) break;
        }
        if (!dev) { fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: no B580 Metal device (--any runs on the first device)\n"); return 1; }
        printf("device: %s (%s)\n", dev.name.UTF8String, NSStringFromClass([dev class]).UTF8String);
        queue = [dev newCommandQueue];
        int rc;
        if (@available(macOS 26.0, *)) rc = body();
        else { printf("SKIP: placement sparse buffers need macOS 26\n"); return 5; }
        if (rc) return rc;
        printf("%d PASS, %d FAIL\n", npass, nfail);
        return gpu_error ? 3 : nfail ? 4 : 0;
    }
}

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# night_icbc.sh: night phase C (branch icbc) - compute ICBs whose kernels' buffers a shader sets, through
# VK_EXT_device_generated_commands on the B580 (docs/design/DESIGN-icb-dgc.md section 10: the kernel read buffer 0 through
# the CPU's descriptor; fixed by lowering ICB pipelines with push constants as driver values, and a plan guard).
#
#   source night_icbc.sh; phase_icbc [stage dir]     from a night script that defines O (output dir) and say
#   bash night_icbc.sh [stage dir]                   alone: O=~/night-icbc-<time>, say = echo with the time
#
# Stage dir (default ~/b580/icbc): NVMTLDriver.bundle, nvmtl_interpose.dylib and the x86_64 tests mtl_gpu_icb2,
# mtl_icb_kept, mtl_gpu_icb3, mtl_gpu_icb. The staged plugin is loaded by the test processes only
# (NVMTL_BUNDLE + DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, exported inside a subshell); nothing is installed.
#
# Expected (B580):
#   C1 mtl_gpu_icb2 NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1: 12 PASS, exit=0; diagnostic scratch[0]=0
#   C2 mtl_icb_kept NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1: K0 K1 K2 PASS (K1 is the refusal: out 0 and scratch1 0), exit=0
#   C3 the same with NVMTL_ICB_DGC_LOWER=0 (the old lowering, with the new guard): mtl_gpu_icb2 C0-C2 FAIL as refusals
#      (scratch 0, "NOT run" lines), mtl_icb_kept K0 FAIL (refused, scratch0 0), K1 K2 PASS
#   C4 regressions: mtl_gpu_icb3 knob on 16 PASS; mtl_gpu_icb off / on 6/6; mtl_gpu_icb2 and mtl_icb_kept knob off:
#      REFUSED, exit=2
#
# Timeouts come from tmo, a bash function (a perl or env wrapper would be a protected binary that strips the DYLD_*
# variables, and the test would quietly run the installed plugin). Each run is time-boxed to 60 s.

type tmo >/dev/null 2>&1 || tmo() {   # tmo <seconds> <command...>: run it, kill it after <seconds>; its exit code (137 = killed)
    local s=$1; shift
    "$@" & local p=$!
    ( sleep "$s"; kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null ) & local w=$!
    wait "$p"; local rc=$?
    pkill -P "$w" sleep 2>/dev/null; kill "$w" 2>/dev/null; wait "$w" 2>/dev/null   # the watcher and its sleep
    return $rc
}
type resets >/dev/null 2>&1 || resets() { sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats 2>/dev/null | sed -nE 's/.*GuC context resets ([0-9]+); GT resets ([0-9]+).*/\1 \2/p'; }

phase_icbc() {
    local D=${1:-${ICBC_STAGE:-$HOME/b580/icbc}} R="$O/icbc"
    mkdir -p "$R"
    local B="$D/NVMTLDriver.bundle" I="$D/nvmtl_interpose.dylib"
    [ -x "$B/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" ] && [ -f "$I" ] || { say "C: no staged plugin in $D - phase skipped"; return 0; }
    csay() { say "$@"; echo "$*" >> "$R/summary.txt"; }
    csay "C: compute ICBs through DGC on $(shasum -a 256 "$B/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" | cut -c1-12), resets before: $(resets)"
    # run <tag> <env...> -- <command...>: in a subshell with the staged plugin and the given knobs
    run() {
        local tag=$1; shift; local envs=()
        while [ "$1" != "--" ]; do envs+=("$1"); shift; done; shift
        mkdir -p "$R/$tag"
        ( export NVMTL_ENABLE=1 NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_BUNDLE="$B" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$I" NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$R/$tag/nvmtl.log" "${envs[@]}"
          cd "$D" && tmo 60 "$@" ) > "$R/$tag/out.txt" 2>&1
        echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/$tag/out.txt"
    }
    res() { printf '%s PASS; FAIL: %s %s' "$(grep -c '^PASS' "$R/$1/out.txt")" "$(grep '^FAIL' "$R/$1/out.txt" | cut -c6-8 | tr '\n' ' ')" "$(tail -1 "$R/$1/out.txt")"; }
    notes() { grep -hE 'kernels of GPU-encodable ICBs|compute token layout|NOT run|after the execute|cannot express' "$R/$1/nvmtl.log" 2>/dev/null \
              | sed 's/^pid [0-9]* NVMTL: //' | cut -c1-200 | head -${2:-6} | tr '\n' ';'; }

    run icb2-on NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 -- ./mtl_gpu_icb2
    csay "C1 mtl_gpu_icb2 NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 (want 12 PASS, exit=0, scratch 0): $(res icb2-on) | $(grep -m1 '^diagnostic' "$R/icb2-on/out.txt" | cut -c13-50)"
    csay "C1   $(grep -E '^(PASS|FAIL) C' "$R/icb2-on/out.txt" | cut -c1-7 | tr '\n' ';')"
    csay "C1   log: $(notes icb2-on 8)"
    run kept-on NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 -- ./mtl_icb_kept
    csay "C2 mtl_icb_kept NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 (want K0 K1 K2 PASS, K1 refused): $(res kept-on)"
    csay "C2   $(grep -E '^pass 1' "$R/kept-on/out.txt")"
    csay "C2   log: $(notes kept-on 6)"
    run icb2-oldlower NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 NVMTL_ICB_DGC_LOWER=0 -- ./mtl_gpu_icb2
    csay "C3 mtl_gpu_icb2 NVMTL_ICB_DGC_LOWER=0 (want C0-C2 FAIL as refusals, scratch 0): $(res icb2-oldlower) | $(grep -m1 '^diagnostic' "$R/icb2-oldlower/out.txt" | cut -c13-50)"
    run kept-oldlower NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 NVMTL_ICB_DGC_LOWER=0 -- ./mtl_icb_kept
    csay "C3 mtl_icb_kept NVMTL_ICB_DGC_LOWER=0 (want K0 FAIL refused, K1 K2 PASS): $(res kept-oldlower) | $(grep -E '^pass 1' "$R/kept-oldlower/out.txt")"
    csay "C3   log: $(notes kept-oldlower 4)"
    run icb3-on NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 -- ./mtl_gpu_icb3
    csay "C4 mtl_gpu_icb3 NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 (want 16 PASS): $(res icb3-on)"
    run icb-off -- ./mtl_gpu_icb
    run icb-on NVMTL_ICB_DGC=1 -- ./mtl_gpu_icb
    csay "C4 mtl_gpu_icb off / on (want 6/6 each): $(grep -c '^PASS' "$R/icb-off/out.txt") / $(grep -c '^PASS' "$R/icb-on/out.txt") PASS"
    run icb2-off -- ./mtl_gpu_icb2
    run kept-off -- ./mtl_icb_kept
    csay "C4 knob off (want REFUSED exit=2 each): mtl_gpu_icb2 $(tail -1 "$R/icb2-off/out.txt"), mtl_icb_kept $(tail -1 "$R/kept-off/out.txt")"
    csay "C: after: resets $(resets)"
}

if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]; then
    O=${O:-$HOME/night-icbc-$(date +%m%d-%H%M)}; mkdir -p "$O"
    type say >/dev/null 2>&1 || say() { echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) $*" | tee -a "$O/say.txt"; }
    phase_icbc "$@"
fi

FILE: user/tests/metal/night-meshobj.sh

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# night phase M (sourced by the night script, which defines tmo, say and $O; branch fix016): Metal mesh pipelines with an
# object stage, built again after the translator fix (mesh_lower.rs rebase_handle: the mesh handle spelled "captures(none)"
# by macOS 26's Metal compiler; docs/design/DESIGN-mesh-object.md). ~/b580/fix016 (or $MESHOBJ_STAGE): the staged
# NVMTLDriver.bundle, nvmtl_interpose.dylib and the x86_64 tests mtl_mesh_object, mtl_desc_paths, mtl_smoke. The plugin is
# used by the test processes only; nothing is installed.
#   source night-meshobj.sh; phase_meshobj [stage dir]    from a night script that defines O, say and tmo
#   bash night-meshobj.sh [stage dir]                     alone: O=~/night-meshobj-<time>, say = echo with the time
# Expected:
#   M1 mtl_mesh_object (default model): 4 PASS, exit=0; no "GPU RECOVERY", no "slowest submit" past a second
#   M2 mtl_mesh_object NVMTL_DESC_MODEL=classic and =buffer: 4 PASS, exit=0 each
#   M3 mtl_desc_paths mesh, both models: PASS mesh (it was SKIP: refused in 0.1.5)
#   M4 mtl_mesh_object NVMTL_MESH_OBJECT=0: object-rows and object-redraw FAIL "REFUSED ... (NVMTL_MESH_OBJECT=0)",
#      mesh-grid and mesh-indirect PASS, exit=5 (the 0.1.5 behaviour, kept as the switch)
#   M5 mtl_smoke as on main
#   GuC context resets / GT resets unchanged before and after (13 Nov: the old path took a GuC context reset).
# The log lines to read when a case fails: "mesh pipeline:" (mode, layout, cap), "mesh:" (per draw: threadgroups, scratch).
# A FAIL with an image map ("drawn ##../") says which cells came out: all in one cell = the threadgroups share one block.
# tmo is the night script's bash timeout function: the DYLD_* variables are exported in the subshell and reach the test
# binary directly (no perl/env/sh wrapper, which a protected binary strips them through).
type tmo >/dev/null 2>&1 || tmo() {   # tmo <seconds> <command...>: run it, kill it after <seconds>; its exit code (137 = killed)
    local s=$1; shift
    "$@" & local p=$!
    ( sleep "$s"; kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null ) & local w=$!
    wait "$p"; local rc=$?
    pkill -P "$w" sleep 2>/dev/null; kill "$w" 2>/dev/null; wait "$w" 2>/dev/null
    return $rc
}
type say >/dev/null 2>&1 || say() { echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) $*" | tee -a "$O/summary.txt"; }

meshobj_st() { sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'GuC context resets [0-9]+; GT resets [0-9]+'; }
meshobj_notes() { grep -hE 'mesh pipeline:|mesh: |REFUSED|GPU RECOVERY|slowest submit' "$1" 2>/dev/null | head -8 | cut -c1-200 | tr '\n' ';'; }

phase_meshobj() {
  local D=${1:-${MESHOBJ_STAGE:-$HOME/b580/fix016}} R="$O/meshobj"; mkdir -p "$R"
  local S="NVMTL_ENABLE=1 NVMTL_BUNDLE=$D/NVMTLDriver.bundle DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=$D/nvmtl_interpose.dylib"
  say "M: mesh object stage ($D) - $(meshobj_st)"
  ( cd "$D" && export $S NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$R/1.log"; tmo 60 ./mtl_mesh_object > "$R/1-mesh.txt" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/1-mesh.txt" )
  say "M1 mtl_mesh_object (want 4 PASS, exit=0): $(tail -2 "$R/1-mesh.txt" | tr '\n' ' ') FAIL: $(grep '^FAIL' "$R/1-mesh.txt" | cut -c1-260 | tr '\n' ';')"
  say "M1 notes: $(meshobj_notes "$R/1.log") - $(meshobj_st)"
  local m
  for m in classic buffer; do
    ( cd "$D" && export $S NVMTL_DESC_MODEL=$m NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$R/2-$m.log"; tmo 60 ./mtl_mesh_object > "$R/2-mesh-$m.txt" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/2-mesh-$m.txt" )
    say "M2 mtl_mesh_object $m (want 4 PASS, exit=0): $(tail -2 "$R/2-mesh-$m.txt" | tr '\n' ' ') FAIL: $(grep '^FAIL' "$R/2-mesh-$m.txt" | cut -c1-200 | tr '\n' ';')"
    ( cd "$D" && export $S NVMTL_DESC_MODEL=$m NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$R/3-$m.log"; tmo 60 ./mtl_desc_paths mesh > "$R/3-paths-$m.txt" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/3-paths-$m.txt" )
    say "M3 mtl_desc_paths mesh $m (want PASS mesh): $(grep -E '^(PASS|FAIL|SKIP) mesh' "$R/3-paths-$m.txt" | cut -c1-200) $(tail -1 "$R/3-paths-$m.txt")"
  done
  say "M2/M3 notes: $(meshobj_notes "$R/2-buffer.log") - $(meshobj_st)"
  ( cd "$D" && export $S NVMTL_MESH_OBJECT=0 NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$R/4.log"; tmo 60 ./mtl_mesh_object > "$R/4-off.txt" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/4-off.txt" )
  say "M4 NVMTL_MESH_OBJECT=0 (want 2 PASS 2 FAIL REFUSED, exit=5): $(tail -2 "$R/4-off.txt" | tr '\n' ' ') $(grep -c 'NVMTL_MESH_OBJECT=0' "$R/4-off.txt") refusal(s)"
  ( cd "$D" && export $S NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$R/5.log"; tmo 60 ./mtl_smoke > "$R/5-smoke.txt" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/5-smoke.txt" )
  say "M5 mtl_smoke: $(tail -2 "$R/5-smoke.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  say "M: after: $(meshobj_st)"
}

if [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]; then
  set -uo pipefail
  O=${O:-$HOME/night-meshobj-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}; mkdir -p "$O"
  phase_meshobj "$@"
fi

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# night phase S2 (sourced by the night script, which defines tmo, say and $O): sparse textures tier 2, the per-tile access
# counters (branch sparse2; NVMTL_SPARSE_TIER2=1 with NVMTL_SPARSE_TEXTURES=1), and tier 1 with tier 2 on and off.
# The stage (~/hackintosh/work/night1214/sparse2 on the build Mac) is copied to ~/b580/sparse2 (SPARSE2_STAGE overrides):
# the branch's NVMTLDriver.bundle and nvmtl_interpose.dylib, and mtl_sparse_tier2, mtl_sparse, mtl_sparse_buffer
# (nullmoth/build/build-intelxe.sh plugin tests). The plugin is used by the test processes only; nothing is installed.
# Expected: S2.1 SKIP, exit=5 (no knobs: no sparse tile); S2.2 SKIP, exit=5 (sparse on, tier 2 off: Tier1);
# S2.3 21 PASS, exit=0 (tier 2: an M1 Pro passes the same 21); S2.4/S2.5 mtl_sparse 106/106 with tier 2 off and on;
# S2.6/S2.7 mtl_sparse_buffer 27/27 with tier 2 off and on (NVMTL_METAL4=1 for its queue).
# tmo is the night script's bash timeout function: the DYLD_* variables are exported in the subshell and reach the test
# binary (no perl/env wrapper, which a protected binary would strip them through).
phase_sparse2() {
  local D=${SPARSE2_STAGE:-~/b580/sparse2} R="$O/sparse2"; mkdir -p "$R"

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# night phase T (sourced by the night script, which defines tmo, say and $O; branches mtl4tile, tilemsaa): tile pipelines by render-pass
# splitting (nullmoth/plugin/NVMTLTile.m, docs/design/DESIGN-tile-shading.md). ~/b580/tilemsaa (or $TILE_STAGE): the staged
# NVMTLDriver.bundle, nvmtl_interpose.dylib and its tests (build-intelxe.sh plugin tests: tile_host + tile/, link_host +
# link/, mtl_tile, mtl4_linking, mtl4_compiler, mtl_smoke). The plugin is used by the test processes only; nothing is
# installed.
# Expected:
#   T1 tile_host 12 PASS, exit=0 (no GPU)         T2 link_host 19 PASS, exit=0 (no GPU)
#   T3 mtl_tile: cases 1-6 PASS, 7 SKIP (Metal 4 off), exit=0
#   T4 mtl_tile NVMTL_METAL4=1: 7 PASS, exit=0     T5 mtl4_linking NVMTL_METAL4=1: 18 PASS (cases 5 and 12 made and run)
#   T6 mtl_smoke and mtl4_compiler NVMTL_METAL4=1 as on main (no render or compute change outside tile dispatches)
#   GuC context resets / GT resets unchanged before and after.
# The log lines to read when a case fails: "tile pipeline:" (made, masks), "dispatchThreadsPerTile" (tiles, planes),
# "tile dispatch:" / "tile pipelines:" (copy shaders, copy back).
# tmo is the night script's bash timeout function: the DYLD_* variables are exported in the subshell and reach the test
# binary directly (no perl/env/sh wrapper, which a protected binary strips them through).

  ( cd "$D" && export $S NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$R/2.log"; tmo 60 ./link_host "$D/NVMTLDriver.bundle" "$D/link" > "$R/2-link-host.txt" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/2-link-host.txt" )
  say "T2 link_host (no GPU; want 19 PASS, exit=0): $(tail -2 "$R/2-link-host.txt" | tr '\n' ' ') FAIL: $(grep '^FAIL' "$R/2-link-host.txt" | cut -c1-160 | head -3 | tr '\n' ';')"
  ( cd "$D" && export $S NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$R/3.log"; tmo 60 ./mtl_tile > "$R/3-tile.txt" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/3-tile.txt" )
  say "T3 mtl_tile (want 6 PASS 1 SKIP, exit=0): $(tail -2 "$R/3-tile.txt" | tr '\n' ' ') FAIL: $(grep '^FAIL' "$R/3-tile.txt" | cut -c1-220 | tr '\n' ';')"
  say "T3 notes: $(grep -hE 'tile pipeline:|dispatchThreadsPerTile|tile dispatch:|tile pipelines:|REFUSED' "$R/3.log" 2>/dev/null | head -10 | cut -c1-220 | tr '\n' ';')"
  ( cd "$D" && export $S $M4 NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$R/4.log"; tmo 60 ./mtl_tile > "$R/4-tile-m4.txt" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/4-tile-m4.txt" )

FILE: user/tests/metal/plock_model.c
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// plock_model: a stress test of the NVMTL_LOCK_V2 hand-off primitives (nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_plock.h) in a model of the
// plugin's commit / submit-ahead / execution-worker structure, without Metal or a GPU (runs on any Mac).
//
// What is the plugin's own code: nvmtl_plock.h (part take/release/claim/unclaim, the command-buffer gate, the combiner,
// the env rule). What is modelled after NVMTLEventSync.m: the state lock over queues / pending / generation / pumping,
// the pass (per queue, in commit order, stop at the first command buffer that holds the queue back), the worker (queue
// heads only, finish gate, completion under the state lock, stop on no progress with an unchanged generation).
//
// Checked: every part reaches the "GPU" exactly once; per queue, parts reach it in commit order (cb, part); completions
// per queue in commit order; the pass never works inside a finished command buffer; nothing hangs (watchdog); all
// command buffers complete. Build and run (here, or anywhere):
//   clang -O2 -Wall -o plock_model plock_model.c && ./plock_model [seconds]
//   clang -O1 -g -fsanitize=thread -o plock_model_tsan plock_model.c && ./plock_model_tsan 5
//   clang -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -o plock_model_asan plock_model.c && ./plock_model_asan 5
#include <dispatch/dispatch.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "../../../nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_plock.h"

int nvmtl_lock_v2(void) { return 1; }

enum { NQ = 4, NPROD = 6, MAXPARTS = 4, CAP = 48, PERQ = 48 };

typedef struct cb {
    int q; uint64_t seq; int nparts;
    int pstate[MAXPARTS];            // NVMTL_PART_*
    int submitted[MAXPARTS];         // times this part reached the "GPU"
    int unclaimed[MAXPARTS];         // the worker gave it back once (an event wait not yet signalled)
    int busy, fin;                   // the gate
    _Atomic int finished;            // set by the worker after the gate: the pass must never see it inside
    unsigned nextSubmit;             // the pass's (one pass at a time: the combiner)
    unsigned nextPart;               // the worker's, read by the pass (acquire)
    int allAhead;
    int marking;                     // between the two commit sections: the pass refuses it (acquire/release)
    int pending;                     // in the pending list (state lock): the worker may advance it
    _Atomic int refs;
    struct cb *next;                 // queue list (state lock)
} cb_t;

static os_unfair_lock gState = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;   // queues' lists, pending count, generation, pumping
static nvmtl_combiner gAhead = NVMTL_COMBINER_INIT;
static struct { cb_t *head, *tail; uint64_t committed; uint64_t completed; } gQ[NQ];
static uint64_t gGeneration; static int gPumping; static unsigned gPending;
static dispatch_queue_t gWorkerQ;
static dispatch_semaphore_t gCap[NQ];
static pthread_mutex_t gCommitLock[NQ];                // the order of commits into one queue from several threads

static pthread_mutex_t gGpuLock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;   // nvmtl_submit_mutex + the one VkQueue
static struct { uint64_t seq; int part, nparts; } gGpuLast[NQ];  // the last part submitted per queue
static _Atomic uint64_t gErrors, gSubmits, gAheadSubmits, gWorkerSubmits, gCompleted, gPasses, gUnclaims;
static _Atomic int gStop;
static _Atomic uint64_t gProgressTick;

#define FAIL(...) do { atomic_fetch_add(&gErrors, 1); fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: " __VA_ARGS__); fputc('\n', stderr); } while (0)

static unsigned rnd(unsigned *s) { *s = *s * 1103515245u + 12345u; return (*s >> 16) & 0x7fff; }
static void cb_release(cb_t *c) { if (atomic_fetch_sub(&c->refs, 1) == 1) { memset(c, 0xdb, sizeof *c); free(c); } }

static void gpu_submit(cb_t *c, unsigned part, int ahead) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&gGpuLock);
    // exactly the next part of the queue in commit order: (seq, part + 1) or (seq + 1, 0)
    __typeof__(gGpuLast[0]) *last = &gGpuLast[c->q];
    const int want_next_cb = last->part + 1 >= last->nparts;
    if (want_next_cb ? (c->seq != last->seq + 1 || part != 0) : (c->seq != last->seq || (int)part != last->part + 1))
        FAIL("queue %d: part (%llu,%u) submitted after (%llu,%d of %d)", c->q, (unsigned long long)c->seq, part,
             (unsigned long long)last->seq, last->part, last->nparts);
    last->seq = c->seq; last->part = (int)part; last->nparts = c->nparts;
    const int times = ++c->submitted[part];
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&gGpuLock);
    if (times != 1) FAIL("queue %d cb %llu part %u submitted %d times", c->q, (unsigned long long)c->seq, part, c->submitted[part]);
    atomic_fetch_add(&gSubmits, 1); atomic_fetch_add(ahead ? &gAheadSubmits : &gWorkerSubmits, 1);
}

// the pass for one command buffer (nvmtlSubmitAheadV2): YES when nothing of it holds the queue back
static int cb_submit_ahead(cb_t *c, unsigned *seed) {
    if (!nvmtl_cb_enter(&c->busy, &c->fin)) return 1;
    int all = 1;
    if (__atomic_load_n(&c->marking, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) { nvmtl_cb_leave(&c->busy); return 0; }
    const unsigned done = __atomic_load_n(&c->nextPart, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (c->nextSubmit < done) c->nextSubmit = done;
    while (c->nextSubmit < (unsigned)c->nparts) {
        if (atomic_load(&c->finished)) FAIL("pass inside a finished command buffer");
        if (rnd(seed) % 10 == 0) { all = 0; break; }   // the in-flight cap, host copies, an unpromised event wait
        const unsigned k = c->nextSubmit;
        const int was = nvmtl_part_take(&c->pstate[k]);
        if (was == NVMTL_PART_AHEAD) { c->nextSubmit++; continue; }
        if (was != NVMTL_PART_FREE) { all = 0; break; }   // the worker runs it
        if (rnd(seed) % 4 == 0) sched_yield();            // a slow vkQueueSubmit: the worker spins on SUBMITTING
        gpu_submit(c, k, 1);
        nvmtl_part_release(&c->pstate[k], NVMTL_PART_AHEAD);
        c->nextSubmit++;
    }
    if (all) __atomic_store_n(&c->allAhead, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    nvmtl_cb_leave(&c->busy);
    return all;
}
static void pass(void *ctx) {
    (void)ctx;
    static __thread unsigned seed = 1;
    if (seed == 1) seed = (unsigned)(uintptr_t)pthread_self();
    cb_t *list[NQ * PERQ + NQ]; unsigned n = 0;
    nvmtl_plock_lock(&gState);
    for (int q = 0; q < NQ; q++) {
        unsigned per = 0;
        for (cb_t *c = gQ[q].head; c && per < PERQ; c = c->next) {
            if (__atomic_load_n(&c->allAhead, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) continue;
            atomic_fetch_add(&c->refs, 1); list[n++] = c; per++;
        }
        list[n++] = NULL;
    }
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&gState);
    int stop = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!list[i]) { stop = 0; continue; }
        if (!stop && !cb_submit_ahead(list[i], &seed)) stop = 1;
        cb_release(list[i]);
    }
    atomic_fetch_add(&gPasses, 1);
}

// the worker: nvmtlAdvancePart for a queue head; returns progress
static int advance(cb_t *c, unsigned *seed) {
    const unsigned k = c->nextPart;
    if (k < (unsigned)c->nparts) {
        const int how = nvmtl_part_claim(&c->pstate[k]);
        if (how == NVMTL_PART_WORKER) {
            if (!c->unclaimed[k] && rnd(seed) % 8 == 0) { c->unclaimed[k] = 1; atomic_fetch_add(&gUnclaims, 1); nvmtl_part_unclaim(&c->pstate[k]); return 0; }
            gpu_submit(c, k, 0);
        } else if (how != NVMTL_PART_AHEAD) FAIL("claim returned %d", how);
        if (c->submitted[k] != 1) FAIL("queue %d cb %llu part %u completed with %d submissions", c->q, (unsigned long long)c->seq, k, c->submitted[k]);
        __atomic_store_n(&c->nextPart, k + 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        if (k + 1 < (unsigned)c->nparts) return 1;
    }
    nvmtl_cb_finish_gate(&c->busy, &c->fin);
    atomic_store(&c->finished, 1);
    return 2;   // done
}
static void worker(void *ctx) {
    (void)ctx;
    unsigned seed = 7;
    for (;;) {
        nvmtl_combine(&gAhead, pass, NULL, 8);
        cb_t *heads[NQ]; unsigned nh = 0; uint64_t generation;
        nvmtl_plock_lock(&gState);
        generation = gGeneration;
        for (int q = 0; q < NQ; q++) if (gQ[q].head && gQ[q].head->pending) { atomic_fetch_add(&gQ[q].head->refs, 1); heads[nh++] = gQ[q].head; }
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&gState);
        int progress = 0;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < nh; i++) {
            cb_t *c = heads[i];
            const int r = advance(c, &seed);
            if (r) progress = 1;
            if (r == 2) {
                nvmtl_plock_lock(&gState);
                if (gQ[c->q].head != c) FAIL("queue %d: completed cb %llu is not the head", c->q, (unsigned long long)c->seq);
                gQ[c->q].head = c->next; if (!gQ[c->q].head) gQ[c->q].tail = NULL;
                if (c->seq != gQ[c->q].completed + 1) FAIL("queue %d: completion %llu after %llu", c->q, (unsigned long long)c->seq, (unsigned long long)gQ[c->q].completed);
                gQ[c->q].completed = c->seq; gPending--;
                os_unfair_lock_unlock(&gState);
                dispatch_semaphore_signal(gCap[c->q]);
                atomic_fetch_add(&gCompleted, 1); atomic_store(&gProgressTick, atomic_load(&gCompleted));
                cb_release(c);   // the list's reference
            }
            cb_release(c);
        }
        if (progress) continue;
        nvmtl_plock_lock(&gState);
        const int quit = generation == gGeneration;
        if (quit) gPumping = 0;
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&gState);
        if (quit) return;
    }
}
static void pump(void) {
    nvmtl_plock_lock(&gState);
    if (!gPending) { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&gState); return; }
    ++gGeneration;
    const int start = !gPumping; if (start) gPumping = 1;
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&gState);
    nvmtl_combine(&gAhead, pass, NULL, 8);
    if (start) dispatch_async_f(gWorkerQ, NULL, worker);
}
static void *producer(void *arg) {
    const int id = (int)(intptr_t)arg; unsigned seed = 1234u + (unsigned)id * 7919u;
    while (!atomic_load(&gStop)) {
        const int q = id < NQ ? id : (int)(rnd(&seed) % NQ);   // the first NQ producers own a queue, the rest share
        dispatch_semaphore_wait(gCap[q], DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER);
        cb_t *c = calloc(1, sizeof *c);
        c->q = q; c->nparts = 1 + (int)(rnd(&seed) % MAXPARTS); atomic_store(&c->refs, 1);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&gCommitLock[q]);   // commit section 1: the queue's place, committed, marking on
        nvmtl_plock_lock(&gState);
        c->seq = ++gQ[q].committed;
        if (gQ[q].tail) gQ[q].tail->next = c; else gQ[q].head = c;
        gQ[q].tail = c;
        __atomic_store_n(&c->marking, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&gState);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&gCommitLock[q]);
        if (rnd(&seed) % 4 == 0) sched_yield();   // the seal and the kernel marks, outside any lock
        nvmtl_plock_lock(&gState);            // section 2: pending, marking off
        c->pending = 1; gPending++;
        __atomic_store_n(&c->marking, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&gState);
        pump();
        if (rnd(&seed) % 16 == 0) usleep(rnd(&seed) % 50);
    }
    return NULL;
}
static void rule_tests(void) {
    struct { const char *e, *conf; int want; } t[] = {
        { NULL, NULL, NVMTL_LOCK_V2_DEFAULT }, { "1", NULL, 1 }, { "0", NULL, 0 }, { "1", "NVMTL_FOO=1", 1 },
        { "1", "NVMTL_LOCK_V2=1", NVMTL_LOCK_V2_DEFAULT }, { "1", "NVMTL_X=2;NVMTL_LOCK_V2=1", NVMTL_LOCK_V2_DEFAULT },
        { "1", "XNVMTL_LOCK_V2=1", 1 }, { "yes", NULL, NVMTL_LOCK_V2_DEFAULT }, { "", NULL, NVMTL_LOCK_V2_DEFAULT },
    };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof t / sizeof *t; i++)
        if (nvmtl_plock_rule(t[i].e, t[i].conf) != t[i].want) FAIL("env rule %u (%s, %s)", i, t[i].e ? t[i].e : "unset", t[i].conf ? t[i].conf : "unset");
}
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    const int secs = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 10;
    rule_tests();
    for (int q = 0; q < NQ; q++) gGpuLast[q].nparts = 0, gGpuLast[q].part = -1;
    gWorkerQ = dispatch_queue_create("model.execution", DISPATCH_QUEUE_SERIAL);
    for (int q = 0; q < NQ; q++) { gCap[q] = dispatch_semaphore_create(CAP); pthread_mutex_init(&gCommitLock[q], NULL); }
    pthread_t th[NPROD];
    for (int i = 0; i < NPROD; i++) pthread_create(&th[i], NULL, producer, (void *)(intptr_t)i);
    uint64_t last = 0; int still = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < secs * 10; s++) {
        usleep(100000);
        const uint64_t now = atomic_load(&gProgressTick);
        if (now == last) { if (++still >= 30) { FAIL("no completion for 3 s - a hang"); break; } } else still = 0;
        last = now;
    }
    atomic_store(&gStop, 1);
    for (int q = 0; q < NQ; q++) for (int k = 0; k < NPROD; k++) dispatch_semaphore_signal(gCap[q]);   // unblock producers
    for (int i = 0; i < NPROD; i++) pthread_join(th[i], NULL);
    for (int w = 0; w < 300; w++) {   // drain: everything committed must complete
        nvmtl_plock_lock(&gState); const unsigned p = gPending; os_unfair_lock_unlock(&gState);
        if (!p) break;
        pump(); usleep(10000);
        if (w == 299) FAIL("%u command buffers never completed", p);
    }
    uint64_t committed = 0; for (int q = 0; q < NQ; q++) committed += gQ[q].committed;
    if (committed != atomic_load(&gCompleted)) FAIL("committed %llu, completed %llu", (unsigned long long)committed, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&gCompleted));
    printf("plock_model: %llu command buffers, %llu parts (%llu ahead, %llu by the worker), %llu passes, %llu unclaims: %s (%llu errors)\n",
           (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&gCompleted), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&gSubmits), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&gAheadSubmits),
           (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&gWorkerSubmits), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&gPasses), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&gUnclaims),
           atomic_load(&gErrors) ? "FAILED" : "PASS", (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&gErrors));
    return atomic_load(&gErrors) ? 1 : 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// plugin_image.h: for the tests that load an NVMTLDriver build into their own process with no GPU (refl_host,
// mtl_m4_inherit). They must check that build, not the installed plugin. Metal loads the installed plugin (the
// /Library/GPUBundles copy or the system volume's) as soon as a device is made in the process; two images then define
// NVMTLDevice, NVMTLFunction and the rest ("Class ... is implemented in both"), and NSClassFromString and
// dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT) answer with whichever loaded first. On 13 Dec refl_host made a device before loading the staged
// bundle and scored the installed plugin (12/19) instead of the staged build (20/20). So the tests make no device,
// take classes and symbols from the build's own image, and check with plugin_image_foreign() after loading it and
// again at the end.
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <mach-o/dyld.h>
#include <objc/runtime.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

// The NVMTLDriver binary of <path>: the bundle's executable if <path> is a bundle directory, else <path> itself.
__attribute__((unused)) static NSString *plugin_image_binary(const char *path)
{
    BOOL isDir = NO;
    if ([[NSFileManager defaultManager] fileExistsAtPath:@(path) isDirectory:&isDir] && isDir)
        return [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(path)].executablePath;
    return @(path);
}

// Class <name> of the loaded binary <bin> itself (its exported OBJC_CLASS_$_ symbol), whatever else defines that name;
// NSClassFromString's answer if the binary does not export it (plugin_image_foreign then checks where it came from).
__attribute__((unused)) static Class plugin_image_class(const char *bin, const char *name)
{
    void *h = bin ? dlopen(bin, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_NOLOAD) : NULL;
    char sym[256];
    snprintf(sym, sizeof sym, "OBJC_CLASS_$_%s", name);
    void *c = h ? dlsym(h, sym) : NULL;
    return c ? (__bridge Class)c : NSClassFromString(@(name));
}

// 0 when the only NVMTLDriver image in the process is <want> (the binary under test) and <sym> and <cls> (either may be
// NULL) come from it; otherwise prints why ("<tag>: ...") and returns 1.
static int plugin_image_foreign(const char *want, const void *sym, Class cls, const char *tag)
{
    char w[PATH_MAX], p[PATH_MAX];
    if (!want || !realpath(want, w)) { printf("%s: cannot resolve the plugin binary %s\n", tag, want ? want : "(none)"); return 1; }
    int bad = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < _dyld_image_count(); i++) {
        const char *n = _dyld_get_image_name(i), *b = n ? strrchr(n, '/') : NULL;
        if (!b || strcmp(b + 1, "NVMTLDriver") != 0 || (realpath(n, p) && !strcmp(p, w))) continue;
        printf("%s: another NVMTLDriver is loaded in this process: %s (Metal loads the installed plugin when a device is made)\n", tag, n);
        bad = 1;
    }
    Dl_info di;
    if (sym && (!dladdr(sym, &di) || !realpath(di.dli_fname, p) || strcmp(p, w))) {
        printf("%s: the plugin's entry point comes from %s, not %s\n", tag, dladdr(sym, &di) ? di.dli_fname : "(unknown)", w);
        bad = 1;
    }
    const char *im = cls ? class_getImageName(cls) : NULL;
    if (cls && (!im || !realpath(im, p) || strcmp(p, w))) {
        printf("%s: class %s comes from %s, not %s\n", tag, class_getName(cls), im ? im : "(unknown)", w);
        bad = 1;
    }
    if (bad)
        printf("%s: the results would not be the build under test's. Make no Metal device before loading it, or run with "
               "NVMTL_BUNDLE=<that bundle> DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=nvmtl_interpose.dylib so a device comes from it\n", tag);
    return bad;
}
