// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// present: minimal CAMetalLayer present loop (clear + present), to see whether presentation is paced by the display.
//   ./present [-t sec] [-w W] [-h H] [-n maxDrawableCount] [-sync 0|1] [-nopresent] [-wait]
// displaySyncEnabled = NO (default here) lets presents run past the refresh rate on a real Mac. NVMTL_BUNDLE=<bundle>
// loads a staged plugin build (layer.device is that device). Prints fps per second and, at the end, where the time went:
// nextDrawable (waiting for a free drawable), encode+commit, and the wait for the GPU when -wait is given.
#import <Cocoa/Cocoa.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <QuartzCore/CAMetalLayer.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#import <objc/message.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>

static double now_s(void) { static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb); return (double)mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom / 1e9; }
static id<MTLDevice> bundleDevice(const char *path) {
    NSBundle *b = [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(path)]; NSError *e = nil;
    if (![b loadAndReturnError:&e]) { printf("bundle %s: %s\n", path, e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return nil; }
    Class cls = [b classNamed:@"NVMTLDevice"]; if (!cls) return nil;
    io_iterator_t it = 0; id<MTLDevice> dev = nil;
    if (IOServiceGetMatchingServices(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("IOAccelerator"), &it) != KERN_SUCCESS) return nil;
    for (io_service_t svc; !dev && (svc = IOIteratorNext(it)); IOObjectRelease(svc)) {
        CFTypeRef name = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(svc, CFSTR("MetalPluginClassName"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
        if (name && CFEqual(name, CFSTR("NVMTLDevice")))
            dev = ((id (*)(id, SEL, mach_port_t))objc_msgSend)([cls alloc], sel_registerName("initWithAcceleratorPort:"), svc);
        if (name) CFRelease(name);
    }
    IOObjectRelease(it);
    return dev;
}
int main(int argc, char **argv) { @autoreleasepool {
    double T = 6; int W = 1920, H = 1080, N = 3, sync = 0, present = 1, wait = 0, fs = 0, vis = 0; double px = 40, py = 40;
    for (int a = 1; a < argc; a++) {
        if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-t") && a + 1 < argc) T = atof(argv[++a]);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-w") && a + 1 < argc) W = atoi(argv[++a]);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-h") && a + 1 < argc) H = atoi(argv[++a]);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-n") && a + 1 < argc) N = atoi(argv[++a]);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-sync") && a + 1 < argc) sync = atoi(argv[++a]);
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-nopresent")) present = 0;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-wait")) wait = 1;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-fs")) fs = 1;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-alpha0")) vis = 1;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-mini")) vis = 2;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-orderout")) vis = 3;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-behind")) vis = 4;
        else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "-pos") && a + 2 < argc) { px = atof(argv[++a]); py = atof(argv[++a]); }
    }
    const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
    id<MTLDevice> dev = bp ? bundleDevice(bp) : MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();
    if (!dev) { printf("no device\n"); return 2; }
    [NSApplication sharedApplication]; [NSApp setActivationPolicy:NSApplicationActivationPolicyRegular]; [NSApp finishLaunching];
    NSScreen *scr = [NSScreen mainScreen];
    NSRect fr = fs ? scr.frame : NSMakeRect(px, py, W / scr.backingScaleFactor, H / scr.backingScaleFactor);
    if (fs) { W = (int)(fr.size.width * scr.backingScaleFactor); H = (int)(fr.size.height * scr.backingScaleFactor); }
    NSWindow *win = [[NSWindow alloc] initWithContentRect:fr styleMask:fs ? NSWindowStyleMaskBorderless : NSWindowStyleMaskTitled backing:NSBackingStoreBuffered defer:NO];
    if (fs) win.level = NSMainMenuWindowLevel + 1;
    win.title = @"present"; win.releasedWhenClosed = NO;
    CAMetalLayer *L = [CAMetalLayer layer];
    L.device = dev; L.pixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm; L.framebufferOnly = YES;
    L.displaySyncEnabled = sync; L.maximumDrawableCount = (NSUInteger)N; L.drawableSize = CGSizeMake(W, H);
    win.contentView.wantsLayer = YES; win.contentView.layer = L;
    [win makeKeyAndOrderFront:nil]; [NSApp activateIgnoringOtherApps:YES];
    if (vis == 1) win.alphaValue = 0; else if (vis == 2) [win miniaturize:nil]; else if (vis == 3) [win orderOut:nil]; else if (vis == 4) [win orderBack:nil];
    printf("window state %d\n", vis);
    double refresh = 0; if (@available(macOS 12.0, *)) refresh = scr.maximumFramesPerSecond;
    printf("device %s (%s) | %dx%d drawables %d displaySync %d present %d wait %d fs %d | screen %.0f Hz scale %.0f\n", dev.name.UTF8String,
           NSStringFromClass([dev class]).UTF8String, W, H, N, sync, present, wait, fs, refresh, scr.backingScaleFactor);
    id<MTLCommandQueue> q = [dev newCommandQueue];
    id<MTLTexture> off = present ? nil : [dev newTextureWithDescriptor:({ MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm width:W height:H mipmapped:NO]; d.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget; d.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate; d; })];
    double t0 = now_s(), last = t0, tNext = 0, tEnc = 0, tWait = 0, nextMax = 0; long n = 0, nl = 0, nilDrawables = 0;
    while (now_s() - t0 < T) @autoreleasepool {
        NSEvent *ev; while ((ev = [NSApp nextEventMatchingMask:NSEventMaskAny untilDate:nil inMode:NSDefaultRunLoopMode dequeue:YES])) [NSApp sendEvent:ev];
        double a = now_s();
        id<CAMetalDrawable> dr = present ? [L nextDrawable] : nil;
        double b = now_s(); tNext += b - a; if (b - a > nextMax) nextMax = b - a;
        if (present && !dr) { nilDrawables++; continue; }
        id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer];
        MTLRenderPassDescriptor *rp = [MTLRenderPassDescriptor renderPassDescriptor];
        rp.colorAttachments[0].texture = present ? dr.texture : off; rp.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear;
        rp.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
        rp.colorAttachments[0].clearColor = MTLClearColorMake((n % 120) / 120.0, 0.3, 0.6, 1);
        [[cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:rp] endEncoding];
        if (present) [cb presentDrawable:dr];
        [cb commit];
        double c = now_s(); tEnc += c - b;
        if (wait) { [cb waitUntilCompleted]; tWait += now_s() - c; }
        n++; nl++;
        if (c - last >= 1.0) { printf("  %.0f fps\n", nl / (c - last)); fflush(stdout); last = c; nl = 0; }
    }
    double el = now_s() - t0;
    printf("total %ld frames in %.2f s = %.0f fps | per frame: nextDrawable %.0f us (max %.1f ms), encode+commit %.0f us, gpu wait %.0f us | nil drawables %ld\n",
           n, el, n / el, tNext / n * 1e6, nextMax * 1e3, tEnc / n * 1e6, wait ? tWait / n * 1e6 : 0, nilDrawables);
    [win orderOut:nil];
} return 0; }

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# prof.sh <bundle> <classic|buffer> <out.txt> <prog> [args...]: run <prog> -loop 14 under the staged bundle (interposed for GL) and
# sample it 8 s. Guarded like g.sh.
B=$1; M=$2; O=$3; shift 3
H=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
"$H/g.sh" /usr/bin/true >/dev/null || { "$H/g.sh" /usr/bin/true; exit 3; }
if [ "$M" = buffer ]; then export NVMTL_DESC_MODEL=buffer; else export NVMTL_DESC_MODEL=classic; fi
export NVMTL_ENABLE=1 NVMTL_BUNDLE="$B" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$H/nvmtl_interpose.dylib"
P=$1; shift
/usr/bin/perl -e 'alarm 30; exec @ARGV' "$P" -loop 14 "$@" > "$O.run" 2>&1 &
sleep 3
unset DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES
/usr/bin/sample $(pgrep -n "$(basename "$P")") 8 1 -mayDie -file "$O" >/dev/null 2>&1
wait; tail -1 "$O.run"

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# recover_run.sh <--fake|--fsubmit|--hang> [mtl_recover args]: one in-process GPU recovery test of the STAGED plugin
# (./NVMTLDriver.bundle) on the STAGED Mesa (./libvulkan_intel.dylib) next to this script; B580 counters before and after.
# Never touches WindowServer or installed files. Time-boxed to 50 s. Aborts when a game or benchmark runs.
#   NVMTL_ICD_LIB=installed  run on the installed Mesa instead (no recovery entry point: the old behaviour, backend down)
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
set -u
H=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
if b=$("$INTELXE_HOME/wsitest/gpu_busy.sh"); then echo "ABORT: $b"; exit 9; fi
s() { sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | grep -E "^jobs|^TDR|^queues"; }
L=$H/log-$(date +%H%M%S)-${1#--}; mkdir -p "$L"
ICD=$H/libvulkan_intel.dylib; [ "${NVMTL_ICD_LIB:-}" = installed ] && ICD=/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib
echo "== before"; s
NVMTL_ENABLE=1 NVMTL_BUNDLE="$H/NVMTLDriver.bundle" NVMTL_ICD_LIB="$ICD" NVMTL_LOG_PATH="$L/nvmtl.log" \
  /usr/bin/perl -e 'alarm 50; exec @ARGV' "$H/mtl_recover" "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$L/out.txt"; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
sleep 1
echo "== after (mtl_recover rc $rc)"; s
grep -E "GPU RECOVERY|GPU recovery|recovery TEST|in flight across|submitted again|disabling backend|reset recovery" "$L/nvmtl.log" | cut -c1-260 | tail -20
pgrep -x WindowServer > /dev/null && echo "WindowServer pid $(pgrep -x WindowServer) running" || echo "WindowServer NOT running"
echo "log: $L"

FILE: user/tests/plugin/recover_unit.c
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// recover_unit.c: host-side unit test of the plugin's GPU reset recovery state machine (nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_recover.h)
// against a mock of Mesa's nvmtl_anv_device_recover_v1. No GPU, no Metal: the generation logic (hang vs. victim), the
// one-recovery-per-loss rule under concurrent losers, the fence-waiter drain, the submit lock being held during the
// swap, the bounds (per-minute limit, failing Mesa), the timeout case and the NVMTL_FAKE_* parser.
//   build+run: tests/recover_unit.sh
#define VK_NO_PROTOTYPES 1
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <time.h>

static int g_quiet;
void nvlog(const char *fmt, ...)
{
	if (g_quiet) return;
	va_list a; va_start(a, fmt); printf("    log: "); vprintf(fmt, a); printf("\n"); va_end(a);
}
static VkDevice g_dev = (VkDevice)(uintptr_t)0x1234;
static _Atomic int g_state = 1;
#include "../../../nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_recover.h"
static pthread_mutex_t nvmtl_submit_mutex = PTHREAD_RECURSIVE_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_done_mask;   // bit s: nvmtl_sub_done(s) was called
static void nvmtl_sub_done(uint64_t s) { if (s && s < 64) atomic_fetch_or(&g_done_mask, 1ull << s); }

// ---- the mock Mesa entry point ----
static _Atomic int m_calls, m_fail_left, m_lost = 1, m_banned = 1, m_sleep_ms, m_waiters_seen = -1, m_lock_free = -1;
static _Atomic uint32_t m_flags;
static void *trylock_thread(void *p) {
	int r = pthread_mutex_trylock(&nvmtl_submit_mutex);
	if (!r) pthread_mutex_unlock(&nvmtl_submit_mutex);
	*(int *)p = r == 0;
	return NULL;
}
static VkResult mock_recover(VkDevice d, uint32_t flags, struct nvmtl_anv_recover_info *info)
{
	atomic_fetch_add(&m_calls, 1);
	atomic_store(&m_flags, flags);
	atomic_store(&m_waiters_seen, atomic_load(&g_fence_waiters));
	int free_ = -1; pthread_t t; pthread_create(&t, NULL, trylock_thread, &free_); pthread_join(t, NULL);
	atomic_store(&m_lock_free, free_);
	if (atomic_load(&m_sleep_ms)) usleep(1000 * atomic_load(&m_sleep_ms));
	if (d != g_dev || !info || info->size != sizeof *info) return VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;
	if (atomic_load(&m_fail_left) > 0) { atomic_fetch_sub(&m_fail_left, 1); info->failed_step = 2; info->error = ENOMEM; return VK_ERROR_UNKNOWN; }
	info->was_lost = atomic_load(&m_lost) || (flags & NVMTL_ANV_RECOVER_FORCE);
	info->queues_banned = atomic_load(&m_banned);
	info->queues_replaced = info->was_lost ? 1 : 0;
	return VK_SUCCESS;
}

static int fails;
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { if (cond) printf("  ok   " __VA_ARGS__); else { printf("  FAIL " __VA_ARGS__); fails++; } printf("\n"); } while (0)
static void reset_window(void) { g_recover_window_t0 = 0; g_recover_window_n = 0; }

typedef struct { unsigned gen; uint64_t seq; int r; } loser;
static void *lose_thread(void *p) { loser *l = p; l->r = nvmtl_vk_lost(l->seq, l->gen, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST); return NULL; }
static void *waiter_thread(void *p) {
	nvmtl_wait_enter(); usleep(1000 * *(int *)p); nvmtl_wait_leave(); return NULL;
}
static double now_ms(void) { struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts); return ts.tv_sec * 1e3 + ts.tv_nsec / 1e6; }

int main(void)
{
	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
	unsetenv("NVMTL_RECOVER_MAX"); unsetenv("NVMTL_GPU_RECOVERY");

	printf("1. no Mesa entry point: the old behaviour\n");
	CHECK(nvmtl_vk_lost(1, 0, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST) == -2, "lost without nvmtl_anv_device_recover_v1 -> -2 (backend down)");
	CHECK(!(g_done_mask & 2), "its submission is not marked done");
	panv_recover = mock_recover;

	printf("2. one loss: the loser recovers (-3), the device generation moves, the submission is done\n");
	int r = nvmtl_vk_lost(2, 0, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST);
	CHECK(r == -3, "first loser -> %d (want -3, hang)", r);
	CHECK(atomic_load(&g_loss_gen) == 1, "generation %u (want 1)", atomic_load(&g_loss_gen));
	CHECK(g_done_mask & 4, "submission 2 marked done");
	CHECK(m_calls == 1 && m_flags == 0, "Mesa called once without FORCE (calls %d flags %u)", m_calls, m_flags);
	CHECK(m_lock_free == 0, "the submit lock was held during the queue swap");
	CHECK(g_state == 1, "backend still up");

	printf("3. an older submission seen lost afterwards is a victim, no second recovery\n");
	r = nvmtl_vk_lost(3, 0, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST);
	CHECK(r == -4 && m_calls == 1 && (g_done_mask & 8), "-> %d, Mesa calls %d (want -4, 1)", r, m_calls);

	printf("4. eight threads lose the same generation at once: one recovery\n");
	loser L[8]; pthread_t T[8];
	for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { L[i] = (loser){ 1, 10 + i, 0 }; pthread_create(&T[i], NULL, lose_thread, &L[i]); }
	int hang = 0, victim = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { pthread_join(T[i], NULL); hang += L[i].r == -3; victim += L[i].r == -4; }
	CHECK(hang == 1 && victim == 7 && m_calls == 2, "hang %d victim %d Mesa calls %d (want 1, 7, 2)", hang, victim, m_calls);
	CHECK(atomic_load(&g_loss_gen) == 2, "generation %u (want 2)", atomic_load(&g_loss_gen));
	reset_window();

	printf("5. fence waiters are drained before the swap, new ones wait for it\n");
	int hold = 300; pthread_t w; pthread_create(&w, NULL, waiter_thread, &hold);
	usleep(50000);
	atomic_store(&m_sleep_ms, 200);
	double t0 = now_ms();
	pthread_t w2; int hold2 = 1;
	loser l2 = { 2, 20, 0 }; pthread_t lt;
	pthread_create(&lt, NULL, lose_thread, &l2);
	usleep(100000);   // recovery is now draining (the first waiter still holds for ~150 ms)
	double tw = now_ms(); pthread_create(&w2, NULL, waiter_thread, &hold2);
	pthread_join(lt, NULL); double t1 = now_ms(); pthread_join(w2, NULL); double t2 = now_ms(); pthread_join(w, NULL);
	atomic_store(&m_sleep_ms, 0);
	CHECK(m_waiters_seen == 0, "no fence waiter inside the driver during the swap (saw %d)", m_waiters_seen);
	CHECK(t1 - t0 >= 240, "recovery waited for the waiter (%.0f ms)", t1 - t0);
	CHECK(t2 >= t1 - 5 && t2 - tw >= 100, "a waiter arriving during the recovery entered after it (%.0f ms after arriving)", t2 - tw);
	CHECK(l2.r == -3, "-> %d (want -3)", l2.r);

	printf("6. a stuck waiter does not block recovery for more than 2 s\n");
	hold = 4000; pthread_create(&w, NULL, waiter_thread, &hold); usleep(50000);
	t0 = now_ms(); r = nvmtl_vk_lost(21, 3, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST); t1 = now_ms();
	CHECK(r == -3 && t1 - t0 >= 1900 && t1 - t0 < 2600, "-> %d after %.0f ms (want -3 after ~2000)", r, t1 - t0);
	CHECK(m_waiters_seen == 1, "the swap went ahead with the stuck waiter (saw %d)", m_waiters_seen);
	pthread_join(w, NULL);
	reset_window();

	printf("7. a fence that gave up with nothing lost: only that command buffer fails (-5), not marked done\n");
	atomic_store(&m_lost, 0); atomic_store(&m_banned, 0);
	unsigned g = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen);
	r = nvmtl_vk_lost(30, g, 0, "unit", VK_TIMEOUT);
	CHECK(r == -5 && !(g_done_mask & (1ull << 30)) && atomic_load(&g_loss_gen) == g && g_state == 1, "-> %d, gen %u->%u, state %d", r, g, atomic_load(&g_loss_gen), g_state);
	atomic_store(&m_lost, 1); atomic_store(&m_banned, 1);

	printf("8. a faked loss replaces the queue with FORCE\n");
	g = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen);
	r = nvmtl_vk_lost(31, g, 1, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST);
	CHECK(r == -3 && (m_flags & NVMTL_ANV_RECOVER_FORCE), "-> %d flags %u", r, m_flags);

	printf("9. the per-minute bound (NVMTL_RECOVER_MAX default 3)\n");
	reset_window(); g_quiet = 1;
	for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { g = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen); r = nvmtl_vk_lost(40 + i, g, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST); }
	CHECK(r == -3 && g_state == 1, "three recoveries in a minute pass");
	g_quiet = 0;
	g = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen); int calls = m_calls;
	r = nvmtl_vk_lost(50, g, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST);
	CHECK(r == -2 && g_state == -1 && m_calls == calls, "the fourth -> %d, backend down (state %d), Mesa not called", r, g_state);
	r = nvmtl_vk_lost(51, g + 1, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST);
	CHECK(r == -2, "once down, everything after -> %d (-2)", r);

	printf("10. Mesa fails three times: backend down\n");
	g_state = 1; reset_window(); atomic_store(&m_fail_left, 5); calls = m_calls;
	g = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen);
	r = nvmtl_vk_lost(52, g, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST);
	CHECK(r == -2 && g_state == -1 && m_calls - calls == 3, "-> %d, state %d, attempts %d (want -2, -1, 3)", r, g_state, m_calls - calls);
	atomic_store(&m_fail_left, 0);

	printf("11. Mesa fails once, then works\n");
	g_state = 1; reset_window(); atomic_store(&m_fail_left, 1); calls = m_calls;
	g = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen);
	r = nvmtl_vk_lost(53, g, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST);
	CHECK(r == -3 && g_state == 1 && m_calls - calls == 2, "-> %d, attempts %d", r, m_calls - calls);

	printf("12. the 16-per-process cap\n");
	g_quiet = 1;
	while (g_recoveries < 16) { reset_window(); g = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen); nvmtl_vk_lost(54, g, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST); }
	g_quiet = 0; reset_window(); g = atomic_load(&g_loss_gen);
	r = nvmtl_vk_lost(55, g, 0, "unit", VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST);
	CHECK(r == -2 && g_state == -1, "recovery 17 -> %d (backend down)", r);

	printf("13. NVMTL_FAKE_* parser\n");
	setenv("NVMTL_FAKE_DEVICE_LOST", "3:2", 1);
	char got[64] = ""; for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) if (nvmtl_fake_fire(&g_fake_wait)) { char b[8]; snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%d ", i); strcat(got, b); }
	CHECK(!strcmp(got, "3 5 7 9 "), "3:2 fires at %s(want 3 5 7 9)", got);
	setenv("NVMTL_FAKE_SUBMIT_LOST", "4", 1);
	got[0] = 0; for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) if (nvmtl_fake_fire(&g_fake_submit)) { char b[8]; snprintf(b, sizeof b, "%d ", i); strcat(got, b); }
	CHECK(!strcmp(got, "4 "), "4 fires at %s(want 4)", got);

	printf("%s: %d failure(s)\n", fails ? "FAILED" : "PASSED", fails);
	return fails ? 1 : 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// refl_host: the plugin's pipeline reflection (nvmtl_compute_reflection, nvmtl_render_reflection: the argument lists
// built from the translator's reflection and the AIR's argument metadata) checked against Apple's answers for the same
// shaders, without a GPU. The plugin binary is loaded into this process (x86_64; under Rosetta on an Apple silicon
// Mac); its functions are fed the AIR text and the translator reflection of user/tests/plugin/refl/ (the shaders of
// user/tests/metal/mtl_reflection.m), and the reflection objects they return are checked with
// user/tests/metal/mtl_reflection_expect.h, the expectations mtl_reflection checks on a GPU.
//
//   refl_host <NVMTLDriver.bundle or its NVMTLDriver binary> <user/tests/plugin/refl>
//   build: clang -arch x86_64 -fobjc-arc -I user/tests/metal user/tests/plugin/refl_host.m -framework Foundation -framework Metal
// It makes no Metal device: on a machine with the plugin installed, a device would load the installed plugin into the
// process too, and its classes and symbols could answer instead of the build's (plugin_image.h). A second NVMTLDriver
// image is a setup failure, not a score. Exit: 0 pass, 2 setup failure, 4 wrong results.
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <objc/runtime.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "mtl_reflection_expect.h"
#include "plugin_image.h"

// An NVMTLFunction of the loaded plugin, with the AIR text and the translator reflection a library load would give it.
static id plugin_function(Class cls, NSString *dir, NSString *name, NSString *stage)
{
    NSString *ll = [NSString stringWithContentsOfFile:[dir stringByAppendingPathComponent:[name stringByAppendingString:@".ll"]] encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:NULL];
    NSData *js = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:[dir stringByAppendingPathComponent:[name stringByAppendingString:@".json"]]];
    NSDictionary *refl = js ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:js options:0 error:NULL] : nil;
    if (!ll.length || ![refl isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) { printf("setup: %s.ll / %s.json missing or unreadable in %s\n", name.UTF8String, name.UTF8String, dir.UTF8String); return nil; }
    id f = [cls new];
    const struct { const char *ivar; id value; } set[] = { { "_air", ll }, { "_fname", name }, { "_stage", stage }, { "_refl", refl } };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof set / sizeof set[0]; i++) {
        Ivar iv = class_getInstanceVariable(cls, set[i].ivar);
        if (!iv) { printf("setup: NVMTLFunction has no %s\n", set[i].ivar); return nil; }
        object_setIvarWithStrongDefault(f, iv, set[i].value);
    }
    return f;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    @autoreleasepool {
        setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
        if (argc < 3) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <NVMTLDriver.bundle | NVMTLDriver> <fixture dir>\n", argv[0]); return 2; }
        // no MTLCopyAllDevices() or other device here (see above); Metal.framework, linked, has the classes the plugin's subclass
        NSString *bin = plugin_image_binary(argv[1]);
        BOOL isDir = NO;
        [[NSFileManager defaultManager] fileExistsAtPath:@(argv[1]) isDirectory:&isDir];
        NSBundle *bundle = isDir ? [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(argv[1])] : nil;
        if (bundle) {
            NSError *e = nil;
            if (![bundle loadAndReturnError:&e]) { printf("setup: cannot load %s: %s\n", argv[1], e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
        } else if (!dlopen(argv[1], RTLD_NOW | RTLD_GLOBAL)) { printf("setup: dlopen %s: %s\n", argv[1], dlerror()); return 2; }
        void *h = bin ? dlopen(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_NOLOAD) : NULL;   // the build's own image
        if (!h) { printf("setup: %s is not loaded as %s\n", argv[1], bin ? bin.UTF8String : "(no executable)"); return 2; }
        id (*compute_reflection)(id) = (id (*)(id))dlsym(h, "nvmtl_compute_reflection");
        id (*render_reflection)(id) = (id (*)(id))dlsym(h, "nvmtl_render_reflection");
        Class fcls = plugin_image_class(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, "NVMTLFunction");
        if (!compute_reflection || !render_reflection || !fcls) {
            printf("setup: the plugin does not export nvmtl_compute_reflection (%p) / nvmtl_render_reflection (%p) / NVMTLFunction (%p)\n",
                   (void *)compute_reflection, (void *)render_reflection, (__bridge void *)fcls);
            return 2; }
        if (plugin_image_foreign(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, (const void *)compute_reflection, fcls, "setup")) return 2;
        NSString *dir = @(argv[2]);
        id kf = plugin_function(fcls, dir, @"kref", @"kernel"), vf = plugin_function(fcls, dir, @"vs", @"vertex"), ff = plugin_function(fcls, dir, @"fs", @"fragment");
        if (!kf || !vf || !ff) return 2;

        MTLComputePipelineReflection *cr = compute_reflection(kf);
        check(cr != nil, "plugin compute reflection (%s)", cr ? NSStringFromClass([cr class]).UTF8String : "nil");
        if (cr) check_bindings("plugin compute", cr.bindings, kKernel, sizeof kKernel / sizeof kKernel[0]);

        MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *rd = [MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor new];
        rd.vertexFunction = vf; rd.fragmentFunction = ff; rd.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm;
        MTLVertexDescriptor *vd = [MTLVertexDescriptor new];
        vd.attributes[0].format = MTLVertexFormatFloat2; vd.attributes[0].bufferIndex = 0;
        vd.attributes[1].format = MTLVertexFormatFloat2; vd.attributes[1].offset = 8; vd.attributes[1].bufferIndex = 0;
        vd.layouts[0].stride = 16; rd.vertexDescriptor = vd;
        MTLRenderPipelineReflection *rr = render_reflection(rd);
        check(rr != nil, "plugin render reflection");
        if (rr) {
            check_bindings("plugin vertex", rr.vertexBindings, kVertex, sizeof kVertex / sizeof kVertex[0]);
            check_bindings("plugin fragment", rr.fragmentBindings, kFragment, sizeof kFragment / sizeof kFragment[0]);
        }
        if (plugin_image_foreign(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, NULL, Nil, "setup")) {   // something made a device meanwhile
            printf("%d PASS, %d FAIL (not counted: another NVMTLDriver was loaded during the checks)\n", npass, nfail); return 2; }
        printf("%d PASS, %d FAIL\n", npass, nfail);
        return nfail ? 4 : 0;
    }
}

FILE: user/tests/plugin/scanout_p4_unit.c

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// scanout_p4_unit.c: host-side unit test of gpuperf phase 4's per-frame decision (nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_scanout_p4.h):
// which bound WindowServer composites skip their system-memory readback, the readback modes and their parser, the
// safety rule (the pages are left stale only in phase 4, which marks them, or in the explicit off mode), and real
// IOSurfaces of the B580 test displays' sizes (2560x1440, 3440x1440) made the way WindowServer's composites are.
// No GPU, no plugin. build+run: user/tests/plugin/scanout_p4_unit.sh
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "../../../nullmoth/plugin/nvmtl_scanout_p4.h"
#ifdef __APPLE__
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <IOSurface/IOSurfaceRef.h>
#endif

static int fails, checks;
#define CHECK(c, ...) do { checks++; if (!(c)) { fails++; printf("FAIL %s:%d: ", __FILE__, __LINE__); printf(__VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); } } while (0)

static uint32_t scanout_pitch(uint32_t w) { return (w * 4 + 63) & ~63u; }   // NMXAccel / IntelXeFB's scan-out pitch (nvmtl_scanout_get)
static uint64_t pages4k(uint64_t n) { return (n + 0xfff) & ~0xfffull; }

static void test_parse(void)
{
    CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_parse(NULL) == NVMTL_SORB_P4, "unset -> p4");
    CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_parse("") == NVMTL_SORB_P4, "empty -> p4");
    CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_parse("p4") == NVMTL_SORB_P4 && nvmtl_sorb_parse("4") == NVMTL_SORB_P4 && nvmtl_sorb_parse("auto") == NVMTL_SORB_P4, "p4 names");
    CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_parse("1") == NVMTL_SORB_FULL && nvmtl_sorb_parse("full") == NVMTL_SORB_FULL && nvmtl_sorb_parse("on") == NVMTL_SORB_FULL, "full names");
    CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_parse("0") == NVMTL_SORB_OFF && nvmtl_sorb_parse("off") == NVMTL_SORB_OFF, "off names");
    CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_parse("yes please") == NVMTL_SORB_P4, "unknown -> p4");
    for (int m = 0; m < 3; m++) {
        CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_effective((nvmtl_sorb_mode)m, 0, 0) == (nvmtl_sorb_mode)m, "no flags keep env %d", m);
        CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_effective((nvmtl_sorb_mode)m, 1, 0) == NVMTL_SORB_FULL, "full flag over env %d", m);
        CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_effective((nvmtl_sorb_mode)m, 0, 1) == NVMTL_SORB_OFF, "off flag over env %d", m);
        CHECK(nvmtl_sorb_effective((nvmtl_sorb_mode)m, 1, 1) == NVMTL_SORB_OFF, "off flag wins over full flag (env %d)", m);
    }
}

// the B580 test displays: WindowServer's composite has the scan-out pitch (td512's log: 13760 at 3440 wide)
static void test_modes(void)
{
    static const uint32_t dims[][2] = { { 2560, 1440 }, { 3440, 1440 }, { 1920, 1080 }, { 3840, 2160 }, { 1366, 768 } };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof dims / sizeof dims[0]; i++) {
        const uint32_t w = dims[i][0], h = dims[i][1], pitch = scanout_pitch(w);
        const size_t alloc = (size_t)pages4k((uint64_t)pitch * h);
        nvmtl_p4_decision d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_P4, 1, pitch, h, pitch, 0, alloc, 0);
        CHECK(d.p4 && !d.readback && d.why == NVMTL_P4_YES, "%ux%u pitch %u: phase 4 engages (why %s)", w, h, pitch, nvmtl_p4_why_name(d.why));
        d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_FULL, 1, pitch, h, pitch, 0, alloc, 0);
        CHECK(!d.p4 && d.readback && d.why == NVMTL_P4_MODE_FULL, "%ux%u full mode reads back", w, h);
        d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_OFF, 1, pitch, h, pitch, 0, alloc, 0);
        CHECK(!d.p4 && !d.readback && d.why == NVMTL_P4_MODE_OFF, "%ux%u off mode: scan-out only, no mark", w, h);
        d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_P4, 0, pitch, h, pitch, 0, alloc, 0);
        CHECK(!d.p4 && d.readback && d.why == NVMTL_P4_UNBOUND, "%ux%u unbound reads back", w, h);
    }
    // 3440x1440 is 4837.5 pages: the allocation must hold the page-rounded frame, or the kernel's whole-page page-off
    // would stop half a page short (19814400 bytes vs 19816448)
    const uint32_t w = 3440, h = 1440, pitch = scanout_pitch(w);
    CHECK(pitch == 13760, "3440 pitch 13760 (got %u)", pitch);
    CHECK(nvmtl_p4_frame_pages_bytes(pitch, h) == 19816448ull, "3440x1440 page-rounded frame 19816448 (got %llu)", (unsigned long long)nvmtl_p4_frame_pages_bytes(pitch, h));
    nvmtl_p4_decision d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_P4, 1, pitch, h, pitch, 0, (size_t)pitch * h, 0);
    CHECK(!d.p4 && d.readback && d.why == NVMTL_P4_ALLOC_SHORT, "unrounded allocation reads back (why %s)", nvmtl_p4_why_name(d.why));
    d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_P4, 1, pitch, h, 13824, 0, 19906560, 0);   // Apple silicon's default 256-byte row
    CHECK(!d.p4 && d.readback && d.why == NVMTL_P4_PITCH, "other row pitch reads back");
    d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_P4, 1, pitch, h, pitch, 4096, 19820544, 0);
    CHECK(!d.p4 && d.readback && d.why == NVMTL_P4_PLANE_OFFSET, "plane offset reads back");
    d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_P4, 1, pitch, h, pitch, 0, 19816448, 1);
    CHECK(!d.p4 && d.readback && d.why == NVMTL_P4_REFUSED, "refusal hold-off reads back");
    d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_P4, 1, 0, h, 0, 0, 19816448, 0);
    CHECK(!d.p4 && d.readback, "zero pitch never phase 4");
}

// The rule that keeps CPU readers correct: a frame leaves the pages stale only under phase 4 (marked newer: a CPU lock
// pages it off) or in the explicit off mode. Every combination of inputs.
static void test_safety(void)
{
    static const uint32_t pitches[] = { 0, 10240, 13760, 13824 };
    static const size_t rows[] = { 0, 10240, 13760, 13824 }, offs[] = { 0, 64, 4096 };
    static const size_t allocs[] = { 0, 19814400, 19816448, 19906560, 14745600 };
    unsigned n = 0;
    for (int m = 0; m < 3; m++) for (int b = 0; b < 2; b++) for (unsigned p = 0; p < 4; p++) for (unsigned r = 0; r < 4; r++)
    for (unsigned o = 0; o < 3; o++) for (unsigned a = 0; a < 5; a++) for (int rf = 0; rf < 2; rf++) {
        const nvmtl_p4_decision d = nvmtl_p4_decide((nvmtl_sorb_mode)m, b, pitches[p], 1440, rows[r], offs[o], allocs[a], rf);
        n++;
        CHECK(d.why > 0 && d.why < NVMTL_P4_NWHY, "why in range");
        CHECK(!(d.p4 && d.readback), "phase 4 never also reads back");
        if (!d.readback) CHECK(d.p4 || (m == NVMTL_SORB_OFF && b), "pages left stale only by phase 4 or the off mode (mode %d bound %d)", m, b);
        if (d.p4) CHECK(b && m == NVMTL_SORB_P4 && pitches[p] && (size_t)pitches[p] == rows[r] && !offs[o] && !rf &&
                        allocs[a] >= nvmtl_p4_frame_pages_bytes(pitches[p], 1440), "phase 4 only with the scan-out layout");
        if (!b) CHECK(d.readback && d.why == NVMTL_P4_UNBOUND, "unbound always reads back");
    }
    printf("  safety: %u combinations\n", n);
}

// The old condition (until 2026-11-14): phase 4 also needed the readback switch on and debug.intelxe.surfvram >= 2.
static void test_regression(void)
{
    const uint32_t pitch = 13760, h = 1440; const size_t alloc = 19816448;
    for (int level = 0; level <= 3; level++) for (int rbon = 0; rbon <= 1; rbon++) {
        const int old = rbon && level >= 2;   // so && readback && pitch == row && base == imp->base && level >= 2
        const nvmtl_p4_decision d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_P4, 1, pitch, h, pitch, 0, alloc, 0);
        CHECK(d.p4, "level %d readback switch %d: phase 4 engages now (old condition: %d)", level, rbon, old);
        if (!old) printf("  surfvram %d, readback switch %d: old condition refused phase 4, new engages\n", level, rbon);
    }
}

#ifdef __APPLE__
static void test_iosurface(void)
{
    static const uint32_t dims[][2] = { { 2560, 1440 }, { 3440, 1440 } };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        const uint32_t w = dims[i][0], h = dims[i][1], pitch = scanout_pitch(w);
        int vw = (int)w, vh = (int)h, bpe = 4, bpr = (int)pitch, fmt = 0x42475241;
        const void *k[] = { kIOSurfaceWidth, kIOSurfaceHeight, kIOSurfaceBytesPerElement, kIOSurfaceBytesPerRow, kIOSurfacePixelFormat };
        CFNumberRef v[] = { CFNumberCreate(NULL, kCFNumberIntType, &vw), CFNumberCreate(NULL, kCFNumberIntType, &vh), CFNumberCreate(NULL, kCFNumberIntType, &bpe),
                            CFNumberCreate(NULL, kCFNumberIntType, &bpr), CFNumberCreate(NULL, kCFNumberIntType, &fmt) };
        CFDictionaryRef props = CFDictionaryCreate(NULL, k, (const void **)v, 5, &kCFTypeDictionaryKeyCallBacks, &kCFTypeDictionaryValueCallBacks);
        IOSurfaceRef s = IOSurfaceCreate(props);
        CHECK(s != NULL, "IOSurfaceCreate %ux%u", w, h);
        if (s) {
            const size_t row = IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRowOfPlane(s, 0), alloc = IOSurfaceGetAllocSize(s);
            void *base = IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(s), *plane = IOSurfaceGetBaseAddressOfPlane(s, 0);
            CHECK(plane == base, "%ux%u: plane 0 of a planeless surface is its base (%p %p)", w, h, plane, base);
            const nvmtl_p4_decision d = nvmtl_p4_decide(NVMTL_SORB_P4, 1, pitch, h, row, (size_t)((char *)plane - (char *)base), alloc, 0);
            printf("  IOSurface %ux%u: row %zu, %zu bytes (page-rounded frame %llu): %s\n", w, h, row, alloc,
                   (unsigned long long)nvmtl_p4_frame_pages_bytes(pitch, h), nvmtl_p4_why_name(d.why));
            CHECK(d.p4, "%ux%u IOSurface with the scan-out row: phase 4 engages (why %s)", w, h, nvmtl_p4_why_name(d.why));
            CFRelease(s);
        }
        CFRelease(props); for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) CFRelease(v[j]);
    }
}
#endif

int main(void)
{
    test_parse(); test_modes(); test_safety(); test_regression();
#ifdef __APPLE__
    test_iosurface();
#endif
    printf("%s: %d checks, %d failed\n", fails ? "FAILED" : "PASSED", checks, fails);
    return fails ? 1 : 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/plugin/t4import.m

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// t4import: a reader's import of a Tile4 VRAM backing, as WindowServer does it, in this process with a staged plugin.
//   NVMTL_BUNDLE=<bundle> NVMTL_LOG_PATH=<log> ./t4import [W H]
// 1. an IOSurface W x H BGRA (default 1280x720, bytesPerRow W*4) with a known pattern in its pages
// 2. IntelXe.kext SURFACE_VRAM2 CREATE: a Tile4 backing (pitch = align128(W*4), the layout Mesa's WSI renders with); its first
//    page-on tiles the pattern into it (or the backing is read as it is: both views below see the same bytes)
// 3. the plugin wraps the surface as a READER (MTLTextureUsageShaderRead): its import learns Tile4 and must alias it
//    (log: "Tile4 backing imported at ..." and "-> the family's VRAM"), not fall back to a private image
// 4. the GPU reads the texture through that alias (blit into a buffer) and the CPU reads the pages after a CPU lock (the
//    kernel's Tile4 -> linear page-off): the two must be byte-identical
// Prints PASS/FAIL. Build: clang -arch x86_64 -fobjc-arc -I<b580-tile4>/uapi ...
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#import <IOSurface/IOSurface.h>
#import <objc/message.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include "xe_drm.h"
#include "intelxe_drm.h"

static io_connect_t conn;
static int xioctl(unsigned long req, void *arg) {
    uint64_t in[2] = { req, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)arg }, out = 0; uint32_t n = 1;
    if (IOConnectCallScalarMethod(conn, 0, in, 2, &out, &n)) { errno = ENXIO; return -1; }
    errno = (int)out; return out ? -1 : 0;
}
static id<MTLDevice> bundleDevice(const char *path) {
    NSBundle *b = [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(path)]; NSError *e = nil;
    if (![b loadAndReturnError:&e]) { printf("bundle %s: %s\n", path, e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return nil; }
    Class cls = [b classNamed:@"NVMTLDevice"]; if (!cls) return nil;
    io_iterator_t it = 0; id<MTLDevice> dev = nil;
    if (IOServiceGetMatchingServices(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("IOAccelerator"), &it) != KERN_SUCCESS) return nil;
    for (io_service_t svc; !dev && (svc = IOIteratorNext(it)); IOObjectRelease(svc)) {
        CFTypeRef name = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(svc, CFSTR("MetalPluginClassName"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
        if (name && CFEqual(name, CFSTR("NVMTLDevice")))
            dev = ((id (*)(id, SEL, mach_port_t))objc_msgSend)([cls alloc], sel_registerName("initWithAcceleratorPort:"), svc);
        if (name) CFRelease(name);
    }
    IOObjectRelease(it);
    return dev;
}
static uint64_t fnv(const uint8_t *p, size_t n, uint64_t h) { for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { h ^= p[i]; h *= 1099511628211ull; } return h; }
int main(int argc, char **argv) { @autoreleasepool {
    const uint32_t W = argc > 2 ? (uint32_t)atoi(argv[1]) : 1280, H = argc > 2 ? (uint32_t)atoi(argv[2]) : 720;
    const char *bp = getenv("NVMTL_BUNDLE");
    if (!bp) { printf("FAIL: NVMTL_BUNDLE not set\n"); return 2; }
    io_service_t svc = IOServiceGetMatchingService(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("IntelXe"));
    if (!svc || IOServiceOpen(svc, mach_task_self(), 0, &conn)) { printf("FAIL: no IntelXe service\n"); return 2; }
    struct drm_get_cap cap = { .capability = INTELXE_CAP_SURFACE_VRAM_LAYOUT };
    int capok = xioctl(DRM_IOCTL_GET_CAP, &cap) == 0;
    printf("INTELXE_CAP_SURFACE_VRAM_LAYOUT: %s %llu\n", capok ? "ok" : "ioctl failed", (unsigned long long)cap.value);
    const size_t bpr = (size_t)W * 4;
    NSDictionary *props = @{ (id)kIOSurfaceWidth: @(W), (id)kIOSurfaceHeight: @(H), (id)kIOSurfaceBytesPerElement: @4,
                             (id)kIOSurfaceBytesPerRow: @(bpr), (id)kIOSurfacePixelFormat: @((uint32_t)'BGRA') };
    IOSurfaceRef s = IOSurfaceCreate((__bridge CFDictionaryRef)props);
    if (!s || IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRow(s) != bpr) { printf("FAIL: IOSurfaceCreate (row %zu)\n", s ? IOSurfaceGetBytesPerRow(s) : 0); return 2; }
    IOSurfaceLock(s, 0, NULL);
    uint8_t *px = IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(s);
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < H; y++) for (uint32_t x = 0; x < W; x++) {
        uint8_t *p = px + y * bpr + x * 4; p[0] = (uint8_t)(x * 7 + y); p[1] = (uint8_t)(y * 3); p[2] = (uint8_t)(x ^ y); p[3] = 255; }
    IOSurfaceUnlock(s, 0, NULL);
    const uint32_t pitch = (uint32_t)((bpr + 127) & ~(size_t)127), rows32 = (H + 31) & ~31u;
    struct drm_intelxe_surface_vram2 v = { .surface_id = IOSurfaceGetID(s), .plane = 0, .size = (uint64_t)pitch * rows32,
                                        .flags = INTELXE_SURFACE_VRAM_CREATE, .modifier = I915_FORMAT_MOD_4_TILED, .pitch = pitch,
                                        .cpp = 4, .width = W, .height = H, .linear_pitch = (uint32_t)bpr };
    if (xioctl(DRM_IOCTL_INTELXE_SURFACE_VRAM2, &v)) { printf("FAIL: SURFACE_VRAM2 CREATE errno %d\n", errno); return 2; }
    printf("Tile4 backing: surface %u %ux%u pitch %u, %llu B (linear need %zu), gen %u, modifier 0x%llx\n", IOSurfaceGetID(s), W, H, v.pitch,
           (unsigned long long)v.size_out, bpr * H, v.gen, (unsigned long long)v.modifier);
    id<MTLDevice> dev = bundleDevice(bp);
    if (!dev) { printf("FAIL: no device from %s\n", bp); return 2; }
    MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm width:W height:H mipmapped:NO];
    d.usage = MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; d.storageMode = MTLStorageModeShared;
    id<MTLTexture> t = [dev newTextureWithDescriptor:d iosurface:s plane:0];
    if (!t) { printf("FAIL: newTextureWithDescriptor:iosurface: nil\n"); return 2; }
    // the GPU's view: blit the texture (through whatever the plugin built) into a linear buffer
    id<MTLBuffer> out = [dev newBufferWithLength:bpr * H options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    id<MTLCommandQueue> q = [dev newCommandQueue]; id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer];
    id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> be = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
    [be copyFromTexture:t sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(W, H, 1)
               toBuffer:out destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:bpr destinationBytesPerImage:bpr * H];
    [be endEncoding]; [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
    if (cb.status != MTLCommandBufferStatusCompleted) { printf("FAIL: blit status %ld\n", (long)cb.status); return 2; }
    // the CPU's view: a lock pages the backing off (Tile4 -> linear on the copy engine)
    IOSurfaceLock(s, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
    const uint8_t *cpu = IOSurfaceGetBaseAddress(s);
    uint64_t hg = 1469598103934665603ull, hc = hg; size_t diff = 0, first = (size_t)-1;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < H; y++) {
        const uint8_t *a = (const uint8_t *)out.contents + y * bpr, *b = cpu + y * bpr;
        hg = fnv(a, bpr, hg); hc = fnv(b, bpr, hc);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < bpr; i++) if (a[i] != b[i]) { if (first == (size_t)-1) first = y * bpr + i; diff++; }
    }
    // and the pattern written in step 1 (the backing's first page-on tiled it in, if the kernel does that at CREATE)
    size_t pat = 0;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < H; y++) for (uint32_t x = 0; x < W; x++) {
        const uint8_t *p = cpu + y * bpr + x * 4;
        if (p[0] != (uint8_t)(x * 7 + y) || p[1] != (uint8_t)(y * 3) || p[2] != (uint8_t)(x ^ y) || p[3] != 255) pat++; }
    IOSurfaceUnlock(s, kIOSurfaceLockReadOnly, NULL);
    printf("GPU view %016llx, CPU view %016llx: %zu bytes differ (first at %zd); CPU view vs the pattern: %zu texels differ\n",
           (unsigned long long)hg, (unsigned long long)hc, diff, first == (size_t)-1 ? (ssize_t)-1 : (ssize_t)first, pat);
    printf("%s\n", diff == 0 ? "PASS: the GPU reads the Tile4 backing as the CPU sees it" : "FAIL: GPU and CPU views differ");
    CFRelease(s);
    IOServiceClose(conn);
    return diff ? 1 : 0;
} }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// tile_host: the plugin's tile pipelines (nullmoth/plugin/NVMTLTile.m) without a GPU. The plugin binary is loaded into
// this process (x86_64; under Rosetta on an Apple silicon Mac) and fed the AIR of user/tests/plugin/tile/ (tile functions
// compiled by Metal's compiler and read by the plugin's metallib reader, the same modules the translator's tile_lower tests
// use). For each, nvmtl_tile_pipeline lowers the function into a kernel with the plugin's translator and asks a stand-in
// device for the compute pipeline; the test checks what the stand-in was handed:
//   - the lowered AIR has no implicit imageblock access left and binds each attachment's plane at texture 120 + n and the
//     tile parameters at buffer 30;
//   - its SPIR-V (the real translator, with the plugin's capabilities) binds a storage image per plane at 480 + 120 + n;
//   - the pipeline's read and written attachment masks;
//   - the library hands out every tile function, also one whose MSAA forms do not translate as a plain kernel (tile_ms:
//     get_num_colors, coverage-mask writes; on the B580 the library answered nil for it and the tile pipeline had no
//     function), with and without constant values, and the tile pipeline is made from that function;
//   - refusals: an attachment the function uses with no pixel format, an integer value on a float attachment, linked
//     functions; each MTLDeviceErrorDomain code 1 naming the tile function.
//
//   tile_host <NVMTLDriver.bundle or its NVMTLDriver binary> <user/tests/plugin/tile>
//   build: clang -arch x86_64 -fobjc-arc -I user/tests/metal user/tests/plugin/tile_host.m -framework Foundation -framework Metal
// It makes no Metal device (plugin_image.h). Exit: 0 pass, 2 setup failure, 4 wrong results.
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <objc/runtime.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include "plugin_image.h"

static int npass, nfail;
static void check(int ok, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
static void check(int ok, const char *fmt, ...)
{
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
    printf("%s ", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL"); vprintf(fmt, ap); printf("\n");
    va_end(ap);
    if (ok) npass++; else nfail++;
}
static void set_ivar(id o, const char *name, id v)
{
    Ivar iv = class_getInstanceVariable(object_getClass(o), name);
    if (!iv) { printf("setup: %s has no ivar %s\n", object_getClassName(o), name); exit(2); }
    object_setIvarWithStrongDefault(o, iv, v);
}
static id get_ivar(id o, const char *name)
{
    Ivar iv = o ? class_getInstanceVariable(object_getClass(o), name) : NULL;
    return iv ? object_getIvar(o, iv) : nil;
}
static uint32_t get_u32(id o, const char *name)
{
    Ivar iv = o ? class_getInstanceVariable(object_getClass(o), name) : NULL;
    return iv ? *(uint32_t *)((uint8_t *)(__bridge void *)o + ivar_getOffset(iv)) : 0xffffffffu;
}

// A stand-in for the device: it keeps the function it is asked to make a compute pipeline of and answers an object.
@interface THDevice : NSObject { @public id last; } @end
@implementation THDevice
- (id)newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:(id)f error:(NSError **)e { last = f; return [NSObject new]; }
@end

// descriptor bindings of a SPIR-V module in the storage-texture band at the planes' texture indices (480 + 120 + n);
// -1 if it is not SPIR-V
static int storage_arrays(NSData *spv)
{
    const uint32_t *w = spv.bytes; size_t n = spv.length / 4; int k = 0;
    if (n < 5 || w[0] != 0x07230203u) return -1;
    for (size_t i = 5; i < n;) {
        const uint32_t wc = w[i] >> 16, op = w[i] & 0xffff;
        if (!wc || i + wc > n) break;
        if (op == 71 && wc == 4 && w[i + 2] == 33 && w[i + 3] >= 600 && w[i + 3] < 608) k++;   // OpDecorate Binding
        i += wc;
    }
    return k;
}

typedef id (*tile_fn)(id, MTLTileRenderPipelineDescriptor *, MTLPipelineOption, id *, NSError **);

static id make(tile_fn tp, THDevice *dev, id f, const MTLPixelFormat *fmts, NSUInteger n, NSUInteger samples, NSError **e)
{
    MTLTileRenderPipelineDescriptor *d = [MTLTileRenderPipelineDescriptor new];
    d.tileFunction = f; d.rasterSampleCount = samples; d.threadgroupSizeMatchesTileSize = YES;
    for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < n; i++) d.colorAttachments[i].pixelFormat = fmts[i];
    dev->last = nil;
    return tp((id)dev, d, MTLPipelineOptionNone, NULL, e);
}
static BOOL refusal(id obj, NSError *e, NSString *word)
{
    return !obj && [e.domain isEqualToString:@"MTLDeviceErrorDomain"] && e.code == 1 && [e.localizedDescription rangeOfString:word].location != NSNotFound;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    @autoreleasepool {
        setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
        if (argc < 3) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <NVMTLDriver.bundle | NVMTLDriver> <fixture dir>\n", argv[0]); return 2; }
        NSString *bin = plugin_image_binary(argv[1]);
        BOOL isDir = NO;
        [[NSFileManager defaultManager] fileExistsAtPath:@(argv[1]) isDirectory:&isDir];
        NSBundle *bundle = isDir ? [NSBundle bundleWithPath:@(argv[1])] : nil;
        if (bundle) {
            NSError *e = nil;
            if (![bundle loadAndReturnError:&e]) { printf("setup: cannot load %s: %s\n", argv[1], e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return 2; }
        } else if (!dlopen(argv[1], RTLD_NOW | RTLD_GLOBAL)) { printf("setup: dlopen %s: %s\n", argv[1], dlerror()); return 2; }
        void *h = bin ? dlopen(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_NOLOAD) : NULL;
        tile_fn tp = h ? (tile_fn)dlsym(h, "nvmtl_tile_pipeline") : NULL;
        Class fcls = plugin_image_class(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, "NVMTLFunction");
        Class tcls = plugin_image_class(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, "NVMTLTileRenderPipelineState");
        if (!tp || !fcls || !tcls) { printf("setup: the plugin does not export nvmtl_tile_pipeline (%p) or its classes\n", (void *)tp); return 2; }
        if (plugin_image_foreign(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, (const void *)tp, fcls, "setup")) return 2;

        NSString *dir = @(argv[2]);
        id (^fn)(NSString *) = ^id(NSString *name) {
            NSString *ll = [NSString stringWithContentsOfFile:[dir stringByAppendingPathComponent:[name stringByAppendingString:@".ll"]] encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:NULL];
            if (!ll.length) { printf("setup: %s.ll missing in %s\n", name.UTF8String, dir.UTF8String); exit(2); }
            id f = [fcls new];
            set_ivar(f, "_air", ll); set_ivar(f, "_fname", name); set_ivar(f, "_stage", @"kernel");
            return f;
        };
        THDevice *dev = [THDevice new];
        const MTLPixelFormat F8 = MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm, F16 = MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float, F32 = MTLPixelFormatRGBA32Float, U32 = MTLPixelFormatR32Uint;
        struct { const char *name; MTLPixelFormat f[3]; NSUInteger n, samples; uint32_t reads, writes; int planes; } cases[] = {
            { "tile_light", { F8, F16, MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm_sRGB }, 3, 1, 0x3, 0x7, 3 },
            { "tile_ms", { F8 }, 1, 4, 0x1, 0x1, 1 },
            { "tile_f32", { F32, U32 }, 2, 1, 0x3, 0x3, 2 },
            { "tile_tg", { F8 }, 1, 1, 0x1, 0x1, 1 },
            { "tile_explicit", { F8 }, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0 },
            { "t_misc", { F16, MTLPixelFormatRG32Float, MTLPixelFormatR16Sint }, 3, 2, 0x7, 0x7, 3 },
        };
        for (size_t c = 0; c < sizeof cases / sizeof cases[0]; c++) {
            NSError *e = nil;
            id ps = make(tp, dev, fn(@(cases[c].name)), cases[c].f, cases[c].n, cases[c].samples, &e);
            id kf = dev->last;
            NSString *kll = get_ivar(kf, "_air"); NSData *spv = get_ivar(kf, "_spirv");
            const uint32_t rd = get_u32(ps, "_reads"), wr = get_u32(ps, "_writes");
            int planeMeta = 0;
            for (int a = 0; a < 8; a++) if ([kll containsString:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"!\"air.location_index\", i32 %d, i32 1, !\"air.read_write\"", 120 + a]]) planeMeta++;
            const int ok = ps && [ps isKindOfClass:tcls] && kll && ![kll containsString:@"implicit_imageblock"] &&
                           [kll containsString:@"!\"air.location_index\", i32 30, i32 1, !\"air.read\""] && planeMeta == cases[c].planes &&
                           storage_arrays(spv) == cases[c].planes && rd == cases[c].reads && wr == cases[c].writes;
            check(ok, "%s: %lu attachment(s), %lu sample(s) -> %s, %lu B SPIR-V with %d plane image(s) (want %d), reads 0x%x writes 0x%x (want 0x%x 0x%x)%s%s",
                  cases[c].name, (unsigned long)cases[c].n, (unsigned long)cases[c].samples, ps ? object_getClassName(ps) : "nil",
                  (unsigned long)spv.length, storage_arrays(spv), cases[c].planes, rd, wr, cases[c].reads, cases[c].writes,
                  ps ? "" : " - ", ps ? "" : e.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
        }
        // the library path: functions as a library made from a metallib hands them out (AIR bitcode slot and AIR text)
        Class lcls = plugin_image_class(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, "NVMTLLibrary");
        if (!lcls) { printf("setup: no NVMTLLibrary class\n"); return 2; }
        {
            NSArray *names = @[ @"tile_light", @"tile_ms", @"tile_f32", @"tile_tg", @"tile_explicit", @"t_misc" ];
            NSMutableDictionary *airs = [NSMutableDictionary new], *fdata = [NSMutableDictionary new], *stages = [NSMutableDictionary new];
            for (NSString *n in names) {
                NSString *ll = [NSString stringWithContentsOfFile:[dir stringByAppendingPathComponent:[n stringByAppendingString:@".ll"]] encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:NULL];
                if (!ll.length) { printf("setup: %s.ll missing\n", n.UTF8String); return 2; }
                airs[n] = ll; fdata[n] = [ll dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]; stages[n] = @"kernel";
            }
            id lib = [lcls new]; set_ivar(lib, "_airs", airs); set_ivar(lib, "_stages", stages); set_ivar(lib, "_fns", fdata);
            int got = 0; NSMutableString *missing = [NSMutableString new];
            for (NSString *n in names) {
                id f = [(id<MTLLibrary>)lib newFunctionWithName:n];
                if (f && [get_ivar(f, "_air") length]) got++; else [missing appendFormat:@" %@", n];
            }
            check(got == (int)names.count, "library: newFunctionWithName: hands out %d of %lu tile functions (missing:%s)", got,
                  (unsigned long)names.count, missing.length ? missing.UTF8String : " none");
            id ms = [(id<MTLLibrary>)lib newFunctionWithName:@"tile_ms"];
            const MTLPixelFormat f1[1] = { F8 };
            NSError *e1 = nil; id p1 = ms ? make(tp, dev, ms, f1, 1, 4, &e1) : nil;
            check(p1 && [p1 isKindOfClass:tcls] && get_u32(p1, "_samples") == 4,
                  "library: tile_ms (MSAA forms, no plain-kernel translation) -> function %p, 4-sample tile pipeline %s%s%s",
                  (__bridge void *)ms, p1 ? object_getClassName(p1) : "nil", p1 ? "" : " - ", p1 ? "" : e1.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
            MTLFunctionConstantValues *cv = [MTLFunctionConstantValues new];
            NSError *e2 = nil; id mc = [(id<MTLLibrary>)lib newFunctionWithName:@"tile_ms" constantValues:cv error:&e2];
            check(mc && [get_ivar(mc, "_air") length], "library: tile_ms through newFunctionWithName:constantValues:error: -> %p %s",
                  (__bridge void *)mc, e2 ? e2.localizedDescription.UTF8String : "");
        }
        // refusals
        NSError *e = nil;
        const MTLPixelFormat one[1] = { F32 };
        id r1 = make(tp, dev, fn(@"tile_f32"), one, 1, 1, &e);
        check(refusal(r1, e, @"colour attachment 1") && !dev->last, "tile_f32 without a format for colour 1: refused: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String ?: "(no error)");
        e = nil; const MTLPixelFormat ints[2] = { MTLPixelFormatRGBA32Uint, U32 };
        id r2 = make(tp, dev, fn(@"tile_f32"), ints, 2, 1, &e);
        check(refusal(r2, e, @"tile_f32"), "tile_f32 with a float value on an integer attachment: refused: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String ?: "(no error)");
        e = nil;
        MTLTileRenderPipelineDescriptor *d = [MTLTileRenderPipelineDescriptor new];
        d.tileFunction = fn(@"tile_tg"); d.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat = F8;
        MTLLinkedFunctions *lf = [MTLLinkedFunctions linkedFunctions]; lf.functions = @[fn(@"tile_ms")]; d.linkedFunctions = lf;
        id r3 = tp((id)dev, d, MTLPipelineOptionNone, NULL, &e);
        check(refusal(r3, e, @"linking"), "tile_tg with linked functions: refused: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String ?: "(no error)");
        if (plugin_image_foreign(bin.fileSystemRepresentation, (const void *)tp, fcls, "end")) return 2;
        printf("%d PASS, %d FAIL\n", npass, nfail);
        return nfail ? 4 : 0;
    }
}

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# ws_gtreset.sh [attempts]: AFTER install.sh and a new login - proof that WindowServer survives a ban of its OWN queue.
# WindowServer is kept busy by a full-rate Vulkan window (wsitest.app, IMMEDIATE present: one composite per refresh);
# then debug.intelxe.gt_reset=1 (root) resets the GT, which bans every queue with a job running at that moment. When
# WindowServer's queue is among them (IntelXe g2h log "GT reset: queue guc_id N of WindowServer ... was running ...: banned"),
# its plugin must log "GPU RECOVERY #k in WindowServer" and WindowServer must keep its pid. Attempts that miss
# WindowServer cost it nothing; one that hits costs one of its 3 recoveries per minute, so the loop stops at the first
# hit and attempts are >= 8 s apart. Time-boxed to ~50 s (default 5 attempts). Needs sudo -n.
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
set -u
A=${1:-5}
L=/tmp/nvmtl.log
WS=$(pgrep -x WindowServer) || { echo "no WindowServer"; exit 1; }
grep -q "pid $WS NVMTL: vk: GPU reset recovery ON" $L || { echo "WindowServer $WS does not run the recovery plugin + Mesa (install.sh, then log out and in)"; exit 1; }
if "$INTELXE_HOME/wsitest/gpu_busy.sh"; then echo "ABORT: GPU busy"; exit 9; fi
sudo -n true 2>/dev/null || { echo "needs sudo -n"; exit 1; }
s() { sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | grep -E "^jobs|^TDR"; }
hits() { sudo -n sysctl -n debug.intelxe.g2h | grep -c "GT reset: queue guc_id [0-9]* of WindowServer (pid $WS,"; }
echo "== before (WindowServer pid $WS)"; s
r0=$(grep -c "pid $WS NVMTL: vk: GPU RECOVERY #" $L); h0=$(hits); M=$(mktemp /tmp/ws_gtreset.XXXXXX)
open -n "$INTELXE_HOME/wsitest/wsitest.app" --args --icd /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/intel_icd.json --mode immediate --seconds 45 --images 3 --out /tmp/wsitest-gtreset.txt
sleep 3
hit=0
for i in $(seq 1 "$A"); do
    sudo -n sysctl debug.intelxe.gt_reset=1 > /dev/null || { echo "gt_reset write failed"; break; }
    sleep 2
    if [ "$(hits)" -gt "$h0" ]; then hit=1; echo "attempt $i: WindowServer's queue was running and is banned"; break; fi
    echo "attempt $i: WindowServer had no job running at the reset (no cost to it)"; sleep 6
done
sleep 2; pkill -x wsitest 2>/dev/null
echo "== after"; s
echo "== IntelXe g2h (GT reset lines)"; sudo -n sysctl -n debug.intelxe.g2h | grep "GT reset" | tail -8
echo "== WindowServer plugin log"; grep "pid $WS NVMTL: vk: \(GPU RECOVERY\|GPU recovery\|a command buffer in flight\|.*submitted again\|.*disabling backend\|command buffer refused\)" $L | tail -8 | cut -c1-260
r1=$(grep -c "pid $WS NVMTL: vk: GPU RECOVERY #" $L)
ws=$(pgrep -x WindowServer)
new=$(find /Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports -name 'WindowServer*' -newer "$M" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); rm -f "$M"
echo "WindowServer now pid ${ws:-NONE} (was $WS); recoveries in it $r0 -> $r1; new WindowServer crash reports $new; console user $(stat -f %Su /dev/console)"
if [ "$ws" = "$WS" ] && [ "$new" = 0 ] && grep -q "pid $WS NVMTL: vk: \(GPU RECOVERY REFUSED\|GPU RECOVERY FAILED\)" $L; then echo "RESULT: FAIL - recovery refused or failed"; exit 1; fi
if [ "$ws" != "$WS" ] || [ "$new" != 0 ]; then echo "RESULT: FAIL - WindowServer restarted"; exit 1; fi
if [ $hit = 1 ] && [ "$r1" -gt "$r0" ]; then echo "RESULT: PASS - WindowServer's own queue was banned, it recovered and kept running"; exit 0; fi
if [ $hit = 1 ]; then echo "RESULT: UNCLEAR - banned, but no GPU RECOVERY line yet (WindowServer submits again at its next frame: move the mouse, re-check $L)"; exit 2; fi
echo "RESULT: NOT HIT - no reset caught WindowServer running; run again in >= 10 s"; exit 3

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# chrome_run.sh <tag> <seconds> [extra chrome args...]: Chrome on scroll.html in the GUI session with its own profile
# (/tmp/d3/chrome-prof), console to /tmp/d3/<tag>.txt; the instance (only processes with that profile) is closed after.
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
T=$1; S=$2; shift 2; H=$INTELXE_HOME/d3work
CH="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"; P=/tmp/d3/chrome-prof
"$H/g.sh" /usr/bin/true >/dev/null || { "$H/g.sh" /usr/bin/true; exit 3; }
mkdir -p $P
( "$H/gui.sh" chrome-$T ${CHROME_ENV:-X=1} -- "$CH" --user-data-dir=$P --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --disable-sync --enable-logging=stderr --v=0 \
     --window-size=1600,1000 --window-position=60,60 "$@" "file://$H/scroll.html?t=$S${PAGE_ARGS:-}" > /dev/null 2>&1 & )
for i in $(seq 1 20); do sleep 0.5; grep -q "SCROLLTEST fps" /tmp/d3/chrome-$T.txt 2>/dev/null && break; done
sleep 1; f0=$(sysctl -n debug.nmxaccel_flips); t0=$(date +%s); sleep 6; f1=$(sysctl -n debug.nmxaccel_flips); t1=$(date +%s)
echo "FLIPS: $(( (f1 - f0) / (t1 - t0) ))/s on the panel while scrolling ($((f1 - f0)) in $((t1 - t0)) s); Chrome CPU %: $(ps -axo pcpu,command | grep -- "--user-data-dir=$P" | grep -v grep | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}')"
for i in $(seq 1 $((S + 12))); do sleep 1; grep -q "SCROLLTEST done" /tmp/d3/chrome-$T.txt 2>/dev/null && break; done
pkill -f -- "--user-data-dir=$P" ; sleep 1; pkill -9 -f -- "--user-data-dir=$P" 2>/dev/null
grep -a "SCROLLTEST" /tmp/d3/chrome-$T.txt | sed 's/.*SCROLLTEST/SCROLLTEST/; s/", source.*//' | cut -c1-160
grep -a -i "gpu process\|GPU access\|software\|blocklist\|disabled" /tmp/d3/chrome-$T.txt | cut -c1-200 | head -5

let last=performance.now(),t0=last,n=0,nsec=0,secStart=last,long=0,worst=0,hist=[];
function f(now){const dt=now-last;last=now;n++;nsec++;if(dt>1000/50){long++;}if(dt>worst)worst=dt;
 window.scrollBy(0,P.get('real')?14:6);
 if(now-secStart>=1000){const fps=nsec*1000/(now-secStart);hist.push(fps.toFixed(0));document.getElementById('hud').textContent=fps.toFixed(0)+' fps';console.log('SCROLLTEST fps '+fps.toFixed(1)+' long '+long+' worst '+worst.toFixed(1));secStart=now;nsec=0;long=0;worst=0;}
 if(now-t0<T*1000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else console.log('SCROLLTEST done '+(n*1000/(now-t0)).toFixed(1)+' fps avg; per-second '+hist.join(','));}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The shaders of user/tests/plugin/link_host.m (kSource; the ones of user/tests/metal/mtl4_linking.m that link_host
// links). apply.ll, fs_tab.ll, op_add.ll, op_mul.ll, op_neg.ll, col_red.ll and col_green.ll are their AIR as this Mac's
// Metal compiler made it, read out of the library container by the plugin's own metallib reader
// (link_host --make <NVMTLDriver.bundle> <dir>, on an M1 Pro); stages.json is the stage the reader gave each.
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;
[[visible]] float op_add(float x) { return x + 1.0f; }
[[visible]] float op_mul(float x) { return x * 3.0f; }
[[visible]] float op_neg(float x) { return -x; }
kernel void apply(device float *o [[buffer(0)]], visible_function_table<float(float)> t [[buffer(1)]], constant uint &n [[buffer(2)]],
                  uint i [[thread_position_in_grid]]) { o[i] = t[i % n](o[i]); }
[[visible]] float4 col_red(float2 p) { return float4(1, 0, 0, 1); }
[[visible]] float4 col_green(float2 p) { return float4(0, 1, 0, 1); }
struct V { float4 p [[position]]; };
fragment float4 fs_tab(V in [[stage_in]], visible_function_table<float4(float2)> t [[buffer(0)]], constant uint &slot [[buffer(1)]]) {
    return t[slot](in.p.xy); }

FILE: user/tests/plugin/refl/refl.metal

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The shaders of user/tests/metal/mtl_reflection.m (kSource). kref.ll, vs.ll and fs.ll are their AIR as this Mac's Metal
// compiler made it (newLibraryWithSource, serializeToURL, nvmtl-air-dis); kref.json, vs.json and fs.json the
// translator's reflection of that AIR (metal2vulkan --emit-meta). refl_host feeds both to the plugin.
#include <metal_stdlib>
using namespace metal;
struct Params { float4 scale; uint count; float pad[3]; };
kernel void kref(device float4 *out [[buffer(0)]], constant Params &p [[buffer(1)]], const device uint *unused [[buffer(5)]],
                 texture2d<float, access::read> src [[texture(0)]], texture2d<uint, access::write> dst [[texture(3)]],
                 depth2d<float> dep [[texture(4)]], sampler s [[sampler(2)]], threadgroup float4 *tg [[threadgroup(0)]],
                 threadgroup uint *tg2 [[threadgroup(1)]], uint i [[thread_position_in_grid]], uint l [[thread_index_in_threadgroup]]) {
    tg[l] = src.read(uint2(i, 0)) * p.scale + dep.sample(s, float2(0.5));
    tg2[l] = i;
    threadgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup);
    out[i] = tg[(l + 1) % p.count] + float(tg2[0]);
    dst.write(uint4(i), uint2(i, 0));
}
struct VO { float4 pos [[position]]; float2 uv; };
struct VIn { float2 pos [[attribute(0)]]; float2 uv [[attribute(1)]]; };
vertex VO vs(VIn in [[stage_in]], constant float4x4 &mvp [[buffer(1)]]) {
    VO o; o.pos = mvp * float4(in.pos, 0, 1); o.uv = in.uv; return o;
}
fragment float4 fs(VO in [[stage_in]], texture2d<half> t [[texture(1)]], sampler s [[sampler(0)]], constant float4 &tint [[buffer(2)]]) {
    return float4(t.sample(s, in.uv)) * tint;
}

FILE: user/tests/stability/ctscase.sh

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# ctscase.sh [case]: one deqp-vk case on the B580 with the kernel's view of it, under 60 s (killed after 40 s).
# Default case: the r8g8b8_srgb multi-layer clear that came back DEVICE_LOST. In the G2H log:
#   "CONTEXT_RESET for guc_id N" (+ rb4: "guc_id N reset by the GuC: deqp-vk") = a GPU hang the GuC reset (the batch)
#   "MEMORY_CAT_ERROR for guc_id N (type)"                              = a translation fault (an address problem)
#   "job timeout: ..."                                                   = the watchdog (no reset by the GuC)
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
set -u
CASE=${1:-dEQP-VK.api.image_clearing.core.clear_color_image.2d.optimal.multiple_layers.r8g8b8_srgb_33x128_multiple_subresourcerange}
B=$HOME/vk-cts; Q=/tmp/ctscase.qpa
if b=$("$INTELXE_HOME/wsitest/gpu_busy.sh"); then echo "ABORT: $b"; exit 9; fi
pgrep -l deqp-vk && { echo "ABORT: deqp-vk already running"; exit 9; }
c() { sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | grep -E "^jobs|^TDR"; }
WS0=$(pgrep -x WindowServer); echo "== $(date +%T) $CASE"; c
cd "$B" && rm -f $Q && "$B/deqp-vk" --deqp-case="$CASE" --deqp-log-filename=$Q --deqp-vk-library-path=/usr/local/lib/libvulkan.1.dylib \
	--deqp-archive-dir="$B" --deqp-log-images=disable --deqp-log-shader-sources=disable > /tmp/ctscase.out 2>&1 & P=$!
for i in $(seq 1 40); do kill -0 $P 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 1; done
kill -0 $P 2>/dev/null && { echo "still running after 40 s: killed"; kill -9 $P; }
echo "== result: $(grep -o 'StatusCode="[A-Za-z]*"' $Q 2>/dev/null | tail -1) $(grep -o '<Result StatusCode="[A-Za-z]*">[^<]*' $Q 2>/dev/null | tail -1)"
tail -3 /tmp/ctscase.out
WS1=$(pgrep -x WindowServer); echo "== after: WindowServer $WS0 -> $WS1"; c
echo "== G2H log (last 10)"; sudo -n sysctl -n debug.intelxe.g2h 2>/dev/null | tail -10

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# gpu_busy.sh: exit 0 (and say why) when a GPU test must not run: java (Minecraft), geekbench_avx2, or a Geekbench GUI
# using more than 20% CPU.
if pgrep -q java; then echo "busy: java"; exit 0; fi
if pgrep -q geekbench_avx2; then echo "busy: geekbench_avx2"; exit 0; fi
for p in $(pgrep -i geekbench); do c=$(ps -o %cpu= -p $p | tr -d ' ' | cut -d. -f1); [ "${c:-0}" -gt 20 ] && { echo "busy: geekbench pid $p at ${c}% CPU"; exit 0; }; done
exit 1

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# hangsuite.sh t0|t1|t3 : one GPU hang-recovery step (rb3+), each under 60 s. Aborts when a game/benchmark runs.
#   t0  bounded job (65536 iterations): rc 0, no counter changes
#   t1  REAL compute-engine hang: the kernel must end it (GuC engine reset or job watchdog), rc 2 = VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST
#   t3  real hang, vkhang killed with -9 after 2 s: the process must be gone within a few seconds (queue teardown)
# Prints the B580 counters before/after, the WindowServer pid before/after and the kernel's G2H log tail.
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
set -u
H=$INTELXE_HOME/rb1; STEP=${1:-t0}
if b=$("$INTELXE_HOME/wsitest/gpu_busy.sh"); then echo "ABORT: $b"; exit 9; fi
c() { sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | grep -E "^jobs|^TDR|^queues"; }
WS0=$(pgrep -x WindowServer); echo "== $STEP $(date +%T) WindowServer $WS0"; c
case $STEP in
t0) "$H/vkhang" --iters 65536 --wait-s 5; rc=$? ;;
t1) "$H/vkhang" --wait-s 25; rc=$? ;;
t3) "$H/vkhang" --wait-s 25 > /tmp/vkhang-t3.txt 2>&1 & P=$!
    sleep 2; t=$(date +%s); kill -9 $P
    for i in $(seq 1 150); do kill -0 $P 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.1; done
    if kill -0 $P 2>/dev/null; then echo "vkhang STILL ALIVE 15 s after kill -9: $(ps -o stat=,time= -p $P)"; rc=99
    else echo "vkhang gone $(( $(date +%s) - t )) s after kill -9"; rc=0; fi
    cat /tmp/vkhang-t3.txt ;;
*) echo "usage: $0 t0|t1|t3"; exit 1 ;;
esac
sleep 2
WS1=$(pgrep -x WindowServer); echo "== after (rc $rc) WindowServer $WS1$( [ "$WS0" != "$WS1" ] && echo '  <-- WINDOWSERVER CHANGED')"; c
echo "== G2H log (last 10)"; sudo -n sysctl -n debug.intelxe.g2h 2>/dev/null | tail -10

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# leakloop.sh [seconds=600]: vk_smoke, mtl_tests and (every 5th round) a 2 s wsitest window in a loop, with the B580
# counters sampled every 30 s into $INTELXE_HOME/rb1/leak-HHMMSS/ (snap-N.txt, run.log). Pauses while gpu_busy.sh says a
# game or benchmark runs. Non-hanging work only. Start it with nohup in the background; it ends by itself.
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
set -u
B=$INTELXE_HOME; T=${1:-600}
D=$B/rb1/leak-$(date +%H%M%S); mkdir -p "$D"; L=$D/run.log
end=$(( $(date +%s) + T )); next=0; k=0; round=0; ok=0; fail=0
snap() {
	{ echo "t $(date +%s) round $round ok $ok fail $fail"; sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats; sysctl -n debug.intelxe.vram | head -2
	  sysctl -n debug.intelxe.surfvram_stats; ioclasscount IOAccelIntelXeClient IOBufferMemoryDescriptor IOGeneralMemoryDescriptor \
	  IOMemoryMap IOSubMemoryDescriptor IOMultiMemoryDescriptor IOSurface 2>/dev/null; vm_stat | grep -E "wired|free"
	} > "$D/snap-$k.txt" 2>&1
	k=$((k + 1))
}
echo "start $(date) for $T s" > "$L"
while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do
	now=$(date +%s)
	[ "$now" -ge "$next" ] && { snap; next=$((now + 30)); }
	if b=$("$B/wsitest/gpu_busy.sh"); then echo "$(date +%T) paused: $b" >> "$L"; sleep 5; continue; fi
	round=$((round + 1))
	if "$B/vk_smoke" /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib 1 > "$D/last-vk.txt" 2>&1 && grep -q "EXECUTED" "$D/last-vk.txt"; then
		ok=$((ok + 1)); else fail=$((fail + 1)); echo "$(date +%T) round $round vk_smoke FAILED" >> "$L"; cp "$D/last-vk.txt" "$D/fail-vk-$round.txt"; fi
	if "$B/mtl_tests" > "$D/last-mtl.txt" 2>&1 && grep -q "ALL PASSED" "$D/last-mtl.txt"; then
		ok=$((ok + 1)); else fail=$((fail + 1)); echo "$(date +%T) round $round mtl_tests FAILED" >> "$L"; cp "$D/last-mtl.txt" "$D/fail-mtl-$round.txt"; fi
	if [ $((round % 5)) -eq 0 ]; then
		if "$B/wsitest/run_wsitest.sh" immediate 2 3 > "$D/last-wsi.txt" 2>&1 && grep -q "^done" "$D/last-wsi.txt"; then
			ok=$((ok + 1)); else fail=$((fail + 1)); echo "$(date +%T) round $round wsitest FAILED" >> "$L"; cp "$D/last-wsi.txt" "$D/fail-wsi-$round.txt"; fi
	fi
done
snap
echo "end $(date): rounds $round ok $ok fail $fail" >> "$L"

FILE: user/tests/stability/sleeptest.sh

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# sleeptest.sh (v2, rb6b+): system sleep/wake on an idle desktop. Each step under 60 s. Run in this order:
#   pre        state before: counters, VRAM, WindowServer, power settings, screenshot /tmp/sleep-pre.jpg, and the engine
#              registers that must survive (step 20 reads, render forcewake from rb6: RCS RING_CMD_CCTL 0x20c4 = 0x306,
#              HALF_SLICE_CHICKEN7 0xe194 bit 6, RCU_MODE 0x14800 bit 0, RCS GFX_MODE 0x229c bit 3)
#   video-on   optional: a looping hardware H.264 decode in the background (media queue alive across the sleep: rb4
#              registers media queues again at resume instead of banning them); log /tmp/sleep-video.txt
#   go N       RTC wake in N minutes (default 5; WEX-era sleep entry took up to ~2 min), sleep 3 s later; returns at once
#   post       after wake: the B580 report (resume, both ADS save/restore lists, media GuC/HuC), sleep/wake log, counters,
#              WindowServer pid, screenshot /tmp/sleep-post.jpg, the same registers, the decode (still running, frames
#              advancing, no error), vk_smoke and mtl_tests; kernel log to $INTELXE_HOME/rb6c/sleep/kernel.txt in the background
#   video-off  stop the background decode
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
set -u
S=${1:-pre}; O=$INTELXE_HOME/rb6c/sleep; mkdir -p "$O"
V=$INTELXE_HOME/video
ANV=/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib; [ -f "$ANV" ] || ANV=$V/libvulkan_intel.dylib
snap() {
	echo "date $(date) waketime $(sysctl -n kern.waketime 2>/dev/null) sleeptime $(sysctl -n kern.sleeptime 2>/dev/null)"
	echo "WindowServer $(pgrep -x WindowServer) loginwindow $(pgrep -x loginwindow) console user $(stat -f %Su /dev/console)"
	sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats; sysctl -n debug.intelxe.vram | head -2; sysctl -n debug.intelxe.surfvram_stats
}
regs() {   # step 20 rewrites debug.intelxe.state: read the report first
	for a in 0x20c4 0xe194 0x14800 0x229c; do
		sudo -n sysctl -w debug.intelxe.mmio_addr=$((a)) >/dev/null && sudo -n sysctl -w debug.intelxe.step=20 >/dev/null &&
			echo "reg $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.state | tail -1)"
	done
	echo "expected: 0x20c4 = 0x00000306, 0xe194 bit 6 (0x40), 0x14800 bit 0, 0x229c bit 3 (0x8) -- the 'with forcewake' value"
}
vframes() { tr '\r' '\n' < /tmp/sleep-video.txt 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'frame= *[0-9]*' | tail -1 | tr -dc 0-9; }
case $S in
pre)  { snap; pmset -g; pmset -g sched; pmset -g assertions | head -30; } > "$O/pre.txt" 2>&1
      /usr/sbin/screencapture -x -t jpg /tmp/sleep-pre.jpg 2>/dev/null
      sudo -n true 2>/dev/null && echo "sudo ok" || echo "sudo NEEDS A PASSWORD (pmset schedule/sleepnow and the register reads need root)"
      grep -E "^date|^WindowServer|sleep |displaysleep|womp|darkwakes|standby|hibernatemode|autopoweroff|powernap|tcpkeepalive" "$O/pre.txt"
      regs | tee "$O/regs-pre.txt" ;;
video-on)
      pgrep -f "sleep-video-loop" >/dev/null && { echo "already running"; exit 0; }
      cd "$V" && nohup env INTELXE_ANV="$ANV" DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$V" ./ffmpeg -nostdin -hide_banner -stream_loop -1 -re \
          -init_hw_device vulkan=vk:0 -hwaccel vulkan -hwaccel_output_format vulkan -i h264_1080.mp4 \
          -metadata comment=sleep-video-loop -f null - > /tmp/sleep-video.txt 2>&1 &
      sleep 5; echo "decode pid $(pgrep -f sleep-video-loop | head -1), frames $(vframes) after 5 s (real time: ~150 expected)" ;;
go)   M=${2:-5}; W=$(date -v+${M}M "+%m/%d/%y %H:%M:%S")
      sudo -n pmset schedule wake "$W" && echo "RTC wake scheduled for $W" || { echo "schedule failed"; exit 1; }
      pmset -g sched | tail -3
      [ -f /tmp/sleep-video.txt ] && echo "decode frames before sleep: $(vframes)" > "$O/video-before.txt"
      nohup sh -c 'sleep 3; sudo -n pmset sleepnow' > "$O/sleepnow.txt" 2>&1 &
      echo "sleeping in 3 s ($(date +%T))" ;;
post) sysctl -n debug.intelxe.state > "$O/state-post.txt" 2>&1
      { snap; pmset -g log | grep -E " Sleep | Wake | DarkWake |Wake Requests|Failure" | tail -20; } > "$O/post.txt" 2>&1
      /usr/sbin/screencapture -x -t jpg /tmp/sleep-post.jpg 2>/dev/null
      head -40 "$O/post.txt"
      echo "== IntelXe report"; grep -E "resume|suspend|ADS register|media GuC|HuC|forcewake|wedged|GT reset" "$O/state-post.txt" | tail -20
      echo "== registers"; regs | tee "$O/regs-post.txt"
      if pgrep -f sleep-video-loop >/dev/null; then
          f1=$(vframes); sleep 4; f2=$(vframes)
          echo "== decode: alive, frames $f1 -> $f2 in 4 s ($(cat "$O/video-before.txt" 2>/dev/null)); errors: $(grep -ciE 'error|lost|fail' /tmp/sleep-video.txt)"
      elif [ -f /tmp/sleep-video.txt ]; then echo "== decode: NOT running any more; last lines:"; tail -5 /tmp/sleep-video.txt; fi
      nohup sh -c "log show --last 20m --style compact --predicate 'process == \"kernel\" AND (eventMessage CONTAINS \"IntelXe\" OR eventMessage CONTAINS \"intelxe\" OR eventMessage CONTAINS \"suspend\" OR eventMessage CONTAINS \"resume\" OR eventMessage CONTAINS \"NMX\")' > $O/kernel.txt 2>&1" > /dev/null 2>&1 &
      if b=$("$INTELXE_HOME/wsitest/gpu_busy.sh"); then echo "GPU tests skipped: $b"; exit 0; fi
      "$INTELXE_HOME/vk_smoke" /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib 1 2>&1 | tail -1
      "$INTELXE_HOME/mtl_tests" 2>&1 | tail -1 ;;
video-off) pkill -f sleep-video-loop && echo "decode stopped" || echo "no decode running"; tail -2 /tmp/sleep-video.txt ;;
*) echo "usage: $0 pre|video-on|go [minutes]|post|video-off"; exit 1 ;;
esac
