#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# svqa.sh <test> [seconds]: surfvram=3 default QA (DESIGN-iosurface-vram.md §11), short automated checks, each under
# 60 s. Every test prints the counters that matter before/after (surfvram copy failures/timeouts, page-offs, dirty
# failures; NMXAccel p4 page-offs/failed/busy and flips), the WindowServer pid (must not change) and takes a picture:
# screencapture if this session may (over ssh TCC often refuses it), else the kernel's scan-out thumbnail
# (debug.intelxefb_thumb, 320x180 PPM). Pictures: $INTELXE_HOME/rb6c/svqa/<test>-<time>.{jpg,ppm}
#   base           counters + picture only
#   record [N]     screencapture -v -V N (default 8 s) video recording (ScreenCaptureKit); one frame extracted with
#                  ffmpeg to a jpg. Expect p4 page-offs to grow by about one per captured frame, failures 0
#   expose         Mission Control on (open -a "Mission Control"), 3 s, off again: window thumbnails composited
#   flip0 [N]      copy-instead-of-flip for N s (debug.nmxaccel_flip=0, then back to 1; §11 item 5): frames are
#                  copied, and must be current (pictures during and after)
#   watch [N]      samples the counters every 2 s for N s (default 50) while the user does something by hand
#                  (Screen Sharing/VNC session, QuickTime recording, Dock/genie, Mission Control, display settings)
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
set -u
T=${1:-base}; N=${2:-}; O=$INTELXE_HOME/rb6c/svqa; mkdir -p "$O"; TS=$(date +%H%M%S)
if [ "$T" != base ] && [ "$T" != watch ]; then
	if b=$("$INTELXE_HOME/wsitest/gpu_busy.sh"); then echo "ABORT: $b"; exit 9; fi
fi
k() { sysctl -n "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
counters() {
	local s; s=$(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.surfvram_stats | head -1)
	echo "surfvram $(echo "$s" | grep -oE '^surfvram [0-9]+|[0-9]+ backings|page-offs [0-9]+|page-ons [0-9]+|dirty [0-9]+ \(failed [0-9]+\)|copy failures [0-9]+ \(timeouts [0-9]+\)' | tr '\n' ';')"
	echo "nmx p4 pageoffs $(k debug.nmxaccel_p4_pageoffs) failed $(k debug.nmxaccel_p4_failed) busy $(k debug.nmxaccel_p4_busy); flips $(k debug.nmxaccel_flips) refused $(k debug.nmxaccel_flip_refused) late $(k debug.nmxaccel_flip_late) l2fail $(k debug.nmxaccel_flip_l2fail); copies $(k debug.nmxaccel_scanout_copies)"
	echo "WindowServer $(pgrep -x WindowServer); intelxe bans $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | sed -n 's/.* bans \([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1)"
}
picture() {   # $1 tag
	local f="$O/$T-$TS-$1"
	if /usr/sbin/screencapture -x -t jpg "$f.jpg" 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$f.jpg" ]; then echo "picture $f.jpg"
	elif sudo -n "$INTELXE_HOME/thumb" "$f.ppm" 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$f.ppm" ]; then echo "picture $f.ppm (scan-out thumbnail; screencapture refused here)"
	else echo "picture: none (screencapture refused, thumb needs root)"; fi
}
WS0=$(pgrep -x WindowServer); echo "== $T $(date +%T) before"; counters
case $T in
base) picture now ;;
record) S=${N:-8}; M="$O/record-$TS.mov"
	/usr/sbin/screencapture -x -v -V "$S" "$M" > "$O/record-$TS.log" 2>&1; rc=$?
	echo "screencapture -v rc $rc, $(stat -f %z "$M" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) bytes; $(head -2 "$O/record-$TS.log")"
	[ -s "$M" ] && "$INTELXE_HOME/video/ffmpeg" -nostdin -loglevel error -ss 2 -i "$M" -frames:v 1 -y "$O/record-$TS-frame.jpg" && echo "frame $O/record-$TS-frame.jpg" ;;
expose) open -a "Mission Control"; sleep 3; picture expose; open -a "Mission Control"; sleep 2; picture after ;;
flip0) S=${N:-10}
	sudo -n sysctl -w debug.nmxaccel_flip=0 >/dev/null || { echo "need root for debug.nmxaccel_flip"; exit 1; }
	sleep $((S / 2)); picture copying; sleep $((S - S / 2))
	sudo -n sysctl -w debug.nmxaccel_flip=1 >/dev/null; echo "flip back to $(k debug.nmxaccel_flip)"; sleep 2; picture after ;;
watch) S=${N:-50}
	for i in $(seq 1 $((S / 2))); do echo "$(date +%T) $(counters | tr '\n' ' ')"; sleep 2; done; picture end ;;
*) echo "usage: $0 base|record [s]|expose|flip0 [s]|watch [s]"; exit 1 ;;
esac
WS1=$(pgrep -x WindowServer); echo "== after"; counters
[ "$WS0" != "$WS1" ] && echo "WINDOWSERVER CHANGED ($WS0 -> $WS1)"

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# hangtest.sh [vkhang options]: one vkhang run with the B580 counters around it. Finishes in under 60 s with the
# default --wait-s 25. Aborts when a game or benchmark runs.
#   hangtest.sh --iters 1000000             a bounded GPU job (no hang; checks the tool)
#   hangtest.sh                             a REAL HANG on the compute engine (CCS): only the kernel can end it
#   hangtest.sh --family render ...         the same on the render engine (RCS), where WindowServer works
# Expected for a real hang with the rb1 kernel: within ~10.5 s (debug.intelxe.job_timeout_ms) the fence wait ends with
# VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST (rc 2), "TDR: checks 1" or "GuC context resets 1" and "bans +1" in the stats, no GT reset,
# WindowServer keeps drawing, and a second run of vk_smoke/mtl_tests passes.
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
set -u
H=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
if b=$("$INTELXE_HOME/wsitest/gpu_busy.sh"); then echo "ABORT: $b"; exit 9; fi
s() { sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | grep -E "^jobs|^TDR|^queues"; }
echo "== before"; s
"$H/vkhang" --wait-s 25 "$@"; rc=$?
sleep 1
echo "== after (vkhang rc $rc)"; s
echo "== G2H log (root)"; sudo -n sysctl -n debug.intelxe.g2h 2>/dev/null | tail -12
pgrep -x WindowServer > /dev/null && echo "WindowServer pid $(pgrep -x WindowServer) running" || echo "WindowServer NOT running"

FILE: user/tests/stability/vkhang/spin.comp
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#version 450
// vkhang's spin: loops until the host writes stop != 0 or, if maxIter is not 0, after maxIter iterations. Only
// maxIter bounds it for sure: on Xe2 a volatile load is L1-uncached but L3-cached (brw_lower_logical_sends.cpp), so the
// host's stop flag may never be seen. maxIter 0 = a real hang that only the kernel can end.
layout(local_size_x = 1) in;
layout(push_constant) uniform P { uint maxIter; } pc;
layout(std430, set = 0, binding = 0) coherent volatile buffer B { uint stop; uint iters; uint started; } b;
void main() {
	b.started = 1u;
	uint n = 0u;
	while (b.stop == 0u && (pc.maxIter == 0u || n < pc.maxIter)) {
		n++;
		if ((n & 0xffffu) == 0u) b.iters = n;
	}
	b.iters = n;
}

FILE: user/tests/stability/vkhang/vkhang.c

// vkhang: fault injection for the B580 hang recovery (job watchdog, GuC engine reset, ban, VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST).
// Loads Mesa's ANV directly (no loader), creates a device on one queue family and dispatches spin.comp, a compute
// shader that loops until the host writes a stop flag into a host-coherent buffer. Then it waits on the fence and
// reports how the wait ended (success, timeout, device lost) and what a second submit on the same queue returns.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
//
//   build: ./build.sh
//   run:   vkhang [--family compute|render] [--iters N] [--release-ms N] [--wait-s S] [--icd path/to/libvulkan_intel.dylib]
//
//   --iters N       the shader stops by itself after N loop iterations: a bounded job, never a hang (the only stop
//                   that is certain: the host's flag below may sit unseen behind the GPU's L3). 0 (default) = no bound.
//   --release-ms N  the host also writes the stop flag after N ms (best effort, see --iters). With --iters 0 and
//                   --release-ms 0 the job is a real hang that only the kernel can end (watchdog / GuC reset / ban).
//   --wait-s S      how long to wait on the fence (default 30). Still not signaled after that: the host writes the
//                   stop flag (rescue) and waits 5 s more.
// Exit code: 0 fence signaled and the next submit worked, 2 the device was lost (the expected end of a hang),
// 3 the fence timed out, 1 a setup error.

#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

#include "spin_spv.h"

static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa;

#define CHECK(call)                                                             \
	do {                                                                    \
		VkResult r_ = (call);                                           \
		if (r_ != VK_SUCCESS) {                                         \
			printf("%s -> VkResult %d\n", #call, r_);               \
			exit(1);                                                \
		}                                                               \
	} while (0)
#define IFN(name) PFN_##name name = (PFN_##name)gipa(instance, #name)
#define DFN(name) PFN_##name name = (PFN_##name)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(device, #name)

static double now_s(void)
{
	struct timespec ts;
	clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
	return ts.tv_sec + ts.tv_nsec / 1e9;
}

static const char *res_name(VkResult r)
{
	switch (r) {
	case VK_SUCCESS: return "VK_SUCCESS";
	case VK_TIMEOUT: return "VK_TIMEOUT";
	case VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST: return "VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST";
	case VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY: return "VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_HOST_MEMORY";
	case VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY: return "VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY";
	default: return "other";
	}
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	const char *icd = "/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib", *family = "compute";
	int release_ms = 0, wait_s = 30;
	uint32_t max_iter = 0;
	for (int i = 1; i + 1 < argc; i += 2) {
		if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--family")) family = argv[i + 1];
		else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--release-ms")) release_ms = atoi(argv[i + 1]);
		else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--iters")) max_iter = (uint32_t)strtoul(argv[i + 1], NULL, 0);
		else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--wait-s")) wait_s = atoi(argv[i + 1]);
		else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--icd")) icd = argv[i + 1];
		else {
			printf("unknown option %s\n", argv[i]);
			return 1;
		}
	}
	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
	void *lib = dlopen(icd, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
	if (!lib || !(gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(lib, "vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr"))) {
		printf("cannot load %s: %s\n", icd, dlerror());
		return 1;
	}
	VkInstance instance = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
	IFN(vkCreateInstance);
	VkApplicationInfo app = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, .pApplicationName = "vkhang",
		.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_2};
	VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, .pApplicationInfo = &app};
	CHECK(vkCreateInstance(&ici, NULL, &instance));
	IFN(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices);
	IFN(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties);
	IFN(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties);
	IFN(vkCreateDevice);
	IFN(vkGetDeviceProcAddr);
	uint32_t n = 1;
	VkPhysicalDevice pd;
	CHECK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &n, &pd));
	VkQueueFamilyProperties qf[16];
	uint32_t nq = 16, fam = ~0u;
	vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(pd, &nq, qf);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nq && fam == ~0u; i++) {
		const VkQueueFlags f = qf[i].queueFlags;
		if (!strcmp(family, "render") ? (f & VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT) != 0
					      : (f & VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT) && !(f & VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT))
			fam = i;
	}
	if (fam == ~0u) {
		printf("no %s queue family\n", family);
		return 1;
	}
	float prio = 1.0f;
	VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO, .queueFamilyIndex = fam,
		.queueCount = 1, .pQueuePriorities = &prio};
	VkDeviceCreateInfo dci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO, .queueCreateInfoCount = 1,
		.pQueueCreateInfos = &qci};
	VkDevice device;
	CHECK(vkCreateDevice(pd, &dci, NULL, &device));
	DFN(vkGetDeviceQueue);
	DFN(vkCreateBuffer);
	DFN(vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements);
	DFN(vkAllocateMemory);
	DFN(vkBindBufferMemory);
	DFN(vkMapMemory);
	DFN(vkCreateShaderModule);
	DFN(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout);
	DFN(vkCreatePipelineLayout);
	DFN(vkCreateComputePipelines);
	DFN(vkCreateDescriptorPool);
	DFN(vkAllocateDescriptorSets);
	DFN(vkUpdateDescriptorSets);
	DFN(vkCreateCommandPool);
	DFN(vkAllocateCommandBuffers);
	DFN(vkBeginCommandBuffer);
	DFN(vkCmdBindPipeline);
	DFN(vkCmdBindDescriptorSets);
	DFN(vkCmdDispatch);
	DFN(vkCmdPushConstants);
	DFN(vkEndCommandBuffer);
	DFN(vkCreateFence);
	DFN(vkResetFences);
	DFN(vkQueueSubmit);
	DFN(vkWaitForFences);
	DFN(vkDestroyDevice);
	VkQueue queue;
	vkGetDeviceQueue(device, fam, 0, &queue);

	VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = 4096,
		.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT};
	VkBuffer buf;
	CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(device, &bci, NULL, &buf));
	VkMemoryRequirements mr;
	vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(device, buf, &mr);
	VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp;
	vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(pd, &mp);
	const VkMemoryPropertyFlags want = VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT;
	uint32_t type = ~0u;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryTypeCount && type == ~0u; i++)
		if ((mr.memoryTypeBits & 1u << i) && (mp.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & want) == want) type = i;
	if (type == ~0u) {
		printf("no host-coherent memory type\n");
		return 1;
	}
	VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size,
		.memoryTypeIndex = type};
	VkDeviceMemory mem;
	CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(device, &mai, NULL, &mem));
	CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(device, buf, mem, 0));
	volatile uint32_t *flag;
	CHECK(vkMapMemory(device, mem, 0, 4096, 0, (void **)&flag));
	flag[0] = flag[1] = flag[2] = 0;

	VkShaderModuleCreateInfo smci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = spin_spv_len,
		.pCode = (const uint32_t *)spin_spv};
	VkShaderModule sm;
	CHECK(vkCreateShaderModule(device, &smci, NULL, &sm));
	VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b0 = {.binding = 0, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER,
		.descriptorCount = 1, .stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT};
	VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo dslci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
		.bindingCount = 1, .pBindings = &b0};
	VkDescriptorSetLayout dsl;
	CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(device, &dslci, NULL, &dsl));
	VkPushConstantRange pcr = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, 4};
	VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo plci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .setLayoutCount = 1,
		.pSetLayouts = &dsl, .pushConstantRangeCount = 1, .pPushConstantRanges = &pcr};
	VkPipelineLayout pl;
	CHECK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(device, &plci, NULL, &pl));
	VkComputePipelineCreateInfo cpci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO,
		.stage = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT,
			.module = sm, .pName = "main"},
		.layout = pl};
	VkPipeline pipe;
	CHECK(vkCreateComputePipelines(device, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &cpci, NULL, &pipe));
	VkDescriptorPoolSize ps = {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1};
	VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo dpci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .maxSets = 1,
		.poolSizeCount = 1, .pPoolSizes = &ps};
	VkDescriptorPool dp;
	CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorPool(device, &dpci, NULL, &dp));
	VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo dsai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO, .descriptorPool = dp,
		.descriptorSetCount = 1, .pSetLayouts = &dsl};
	VkDescriptorSet ds;
	CHECK(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(device, &dsai, &ds));
	VkDescriptorBufferInfo dbi = {buf, 0, 4096};
	VkWriteDescriptorSet w = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = ds, .descriptorCount = 1,
		.descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, .pBufferInfo = &dbi};
	vkUpdateDescriptorSets(device, 1, &w, 0, NULL);
	VkCommandPoolCreateInfo cpi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .queueFamilyIndex = fam};
	VkCommandPool pool;
	CHECK(vkCreateCommandPool(device, &cpi, NULL, &pool));
	VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo cbai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO, .commandPool = pool,
		.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY, .commandBufferCount = 2};
	VkCommandBuffer cbs[2], cb;
	CHECK(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device, &cbai, cbs));
	// cbs[0] the spin, cbs[1] the follow-up: the same shader bounded to one iteration, so it never hangs
	const uint32_t bounds[2] = {max_iter, 1};
	for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
		VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbbi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO};
		CHECK(vkBeginCommandBuffer(cbs[i], &cbbi));
		vkCmdBindPipeline(cbs[i], VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pipe);
		vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cbs[i], VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pl, 0, 1, &ds, 0, NULL);
		vkCmdPushConstants(cbs[i], pl, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, 4, &bounds[i]);
		vkCmdDispatch(cbs[i], 1, 1, 1);
		CHECK(vkEndCommandBuffer(cbs[i]));
	}
	cb = cbs[0];
	VkFenceCreateInfo fci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO};
	VkFence fence;
	CHECK(vkCreateFence(device, &fci, NULL, &fence));

	printf("family %u (%s), iteration bound %u, release after %d ms, fence wait %d s%s\n", fam, family, max_iter,
		release_ms, wait_s, max_iter || release_ms ? "" : " - A REAL HANG");
	VkSubmitInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO, .commandBufferCount = 1, .pCommandBuffers = &cb};
	const double t0 = now_s();
	CHECK(vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &si, fence));
	while (!flag[2] && now_s() - t0 < 3) usleep(1000);
	printf("shader %s after %.3f s\n", flag[2] ? "started" : "NOT started", now_s() - t0);
	if (release_ms) {
		while ((now_s() - t0) * 1000 < release_ms) usleep(1000);
		flag[0] = 1;
		printf("stop flag written at %.3f s (iterations so far %u)\n", now_s() - t0, flag[1]);
	}
	VkResult r = VK_TIMEOUT;
	for (int s = 0; s < wait_s && r == VK_TIMEOUT; s++) {
		r = vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, 1000000000ull);
		printf("  %.1f s: %s, iterations %u\n", now_s() - t0, res_name(r), flag[1]);
	}
	const double tf = now_s() - t0;
	int rc;
	if (r == VK_TIMEOUT) {
		flag[0] = 1;   // rescue: let the shader end by itself
		r = vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull);
		printf("fence still unsignaled after %.1f s: stop flag written, then %s\n", tf, res_name(r));
		rc = 3;
	} else {
		printf("fence wait ended after %.3f s: %s\n", tf, res_name(r));
		// what the queue does now: a lost device (banned queue) refuses the submit
		vkResetFences(device, 1, &fence);
		flag[0] = 1;
		si.pCommandBuffers = &cbs[1];
		VkResult r2 = vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &si, fence);
		VkResult r3 = r2 == VK_SUCCESS ? vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull) : r2;
		printf("second submit: %s, its fence: %s\n", res_name(r2), res_name(r3));
		rc = r == VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST || r2 == VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST || r3 == VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST ? 2 : 0;
	}
	vkDestroyDevice(device, NULL);   // resources go with the process
	printf("done rc %d\n", rc);
	return rc;
}

FILE: user/tests/sycl/darwin_abi.cpp

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// darwin_abi: do two compilers pass C++ records by value the same way on macOS? Built twice: the callee by Apple's
// clang (the compiler of libsycl, libc++ and every other C++ library of the platform), the caller by the DPC++ clang
// (the compiler of SYCL programs). Each record holds 4 and 2 and the callee returns 42 when it reads them where the
// caller put them. The records are the cases where clang's C++11 rule and its Clang 4 rule (Apple's clang on Darwin)
// differ, and one where both pass by address. 13 Nov: the DPC++ clang without intel-llvm patch 0006 gave "BAD" for the
// first five (DESIGN-sycl.md section 3.1: sycl::detail::type_erased_cgfo_ty is the first kind).
//   xcrun clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -arch x86_64 -DCALLEE -c darwin_abi.cpp -o callee.o
//   $SYCL_WORK/build/bin/clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -mmacosx-version-min=15.0 --ld-path=$(xcrun -f ld) darwin_abi.cpp \
//     callee.o -o darwin_abi && ./darwin_abi     # six "ok", exit 0
#define F                                                                                                              \
	long a, b;
struct A1 { // copy and move deleted (type_erased_cgfo_ty)
	F A1(long x, long y) : a(x), b(y) {}
	A1(const A1 &) = delete;
	A1(A1 &&) = delete;
};
struct A4 { // copy deleted, move user-provided
	F A4(long x, long y) : a(x), b(y) {}
	A4(const A4 &) = delete;
	A4(A4 &&);
};
struct A8 { // copy deleted, move not declared
	F A8(long x, long y) : a(x), b(y) {}
	A8(const A8 &) = delete;
};
struct A9 { // move deleted (copy implicitly deleted)
	F A9(long x, long y) : a(x), b(y) {}
	A9(A9 &&) = delete;
};
struct A10 { // trivial copy, move user-provided
	F A10(long x, long y) : a(x), b(y) {}
	A10(const A10 &) = default;
	A10(A10 &&);
};
struct A5 { // copy user-provided: by address under both rules
	F A5(long x, long y) : a(x), b(y) {}
	A5(const A5 &);
	A5(A5 &&) = default;
};
long f1(int, A1);
long f4(int, A4);
long f8(int, A8);
long f9(int, A9);
long f10(int, A10);
long f5(int, A5);

#ifdef CALLEE
A4::A4(A4 &&o) : a(o.a), b(o.b) {}
A10::A10(A10 &&o) : a(o.a), b(o.b) {}
A5::A5(const A5 &o) : a(o.a), b(o.b) {}
long f1(int, A1 r) { return r.a * 10 + r.b; }
long f4(int, A4 r) { return r.a * 10 + r.b; }
long f8(int, A8 r) { return r.a * 10 + r.b; }
long f9(int, A9 r) { return r.a * 10 + r.b; }
long f10(int, A10 r) { return r.a * 10 + r.b; }
long f5(int, A5 r) { return r.a * 10 + r.b; }
#else
#include <cstdio>
int main()
{
	const long r[] = {f1(0, A1(4, 2)), f4(0, A4(4, 2)), f8(0, A8(4, 2)), f9(0, A9(4, 2)), f10(0, A10(4, 2)), f5(0, A5(4, 2))};
	const char *n[] = {"copy and move deleted", "copy deleted, user move", "copy deleted, no move", "move deleted",
			   "trivial copy, user move", "user copy"};
	int bad = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
		printf("%s %s (%ld)\n", r[i] == 42 ? "ok " : "BAD", n[i], r[i]);
		bad += r[i] != 42;
	}
	return bad;
}
#endif

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# night phase Y (sourced by the night script, which defines tmo, say and $O): SYCL on the B580 - Intel's DPC++ runtime
# (libsycl, the Unified Runtime loader, its Level Zero adapters v1 and v2, UMF; compute/build-sycl.sh) over our Level
# Zero (compute-runtime/NEO on xemac). Nothing is installed.
# Stage: compute/build-sycl.sh stage on the build Mac (13 Nov: ~/hackintosh/work/syclred/stage), copied to ~/b580/sycl
# (SYCL_STAGE overrides): lib/ (libsycl and the UR/UMF dylibs), bin/sycl_hello (SPIR-V + an ahead-of-time Battlemage
# binary), bin/sycl_hello_jit (SPIR-V only), bin/sycl-ls, SHA256SUMS. The Level Zero driver comes from the L0 stages:
# ~/l0 (no compiler: the AOT binary is used, and NEO's built-ins from ~/l0/builtins, so it runs in that directory) and
# ~/l0igc (IGC in the driver: SPIR-V compiled at run time; SYCL_L0 and SYCL_L0IGC override the two). Each run is a
# subshell with the variables exported (no env/perl wrapper: they would strip DYLD_*).
# Expected: Y0 nothing listed; Y1 one "[level_zero:gpu]" Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics; Y2 "sycl_hello build": PASS
# device query, PASS free memory, PASS sysman (SKIP over an L0 stage without NEO patch 0013: zesInit fails there), PASS
# kernel build with 10 kernels (no GPU work: the program's kernels created from the native image); Y3/Y4 (the v2
# adapter, the default for Battlemage, and v1) "PASS: 0 failure(s)", exit=0, eight PASS lines (seven when sysman is
# SKIP); Y5 the same through IGC (SPIR-V JIT, ~/l0igc). The first B580 run (13 Nov, the stage before intel-llvm patch
# 0006) stopped Y3-Y5 with a null call in the reduction (DESIGN-sycl.md section 3.1). sycl_hello's source is
# user/tests/sycl/sycl_hello.cpp (13 Nov: the first one was never committed; this one was written again from
# DESIGN-sycl.md section 4 and adds the free-memory and sysman steps).
# Since 14 Nov (stage with sycl_libs, sycl-jit and XPTI; DESIGN-sycl.md section 7): Y6 "sycl_libs dpl", oneDPL with a
# device policy over ~/l0 (AOT image): seven PASS lines (sort, sort with a comparator, reduce, transform_reduce,
# inclusive_scan, count_if/find_if, copy_if) and "PASS: 0 failure(s)"; Y7 "sycl_libs rtc" over ~/l0igc: can_build
# "spirv 1, opencl 1, sycl 1", then PASS for the SPIR-V module, the OpenCL C source (ocloc) and the SYCL source
# (sycl-jit, host headers from the stage's rtc-sysroot), each run on the GPU; Y8 sycl-trace around "sycl_hello vector":
# "[UR]" call lines (about 100), "[SYCL]" queue events and the vector add's PASS; Y9 sycl-prof: a non-empty Chrome
# trace (9-prof.json.gz, about 200 events); Y10 (when the stage has oneDNN) onednn_hello over ~/l0igc: four PASS (the
# GPU engine, ReLU, matmul, convolution against host references), the implementations oneDNN chose, exit=0.
# On the build Mac the same phase ran against xemac's canned device (XEMAC_FAKE=1): Y1 and Y2 pass there, Y3-Y5 pass the
# device query and then wait for a completion that never comes (fake mode executes nothing) until tmo kills them.
phase_sycl() {
  local D=${SYCL_STAGE:-~/b580/sycl} L0=${SYCL_L0:-~/l0} L0IGC=${SYCL_L0IGC:-~/l0igc} R="$O/sycl"; mkdir -p "$R"
  local t='tmo 60'
  say "Y: SYCL (DPC++ over our Level Zero) - $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | grep -oE 'GuC context resets [0-9]+; GT resets [0-9]+')"
  ( cd "$D" && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS 2>&1 | grep -v ': OK$' > "$R/0-sums.txt" ); say "Y0 sums: $(grep -c . "$R/0-sums.txt") not OK"
  # $1 result name, $2 L0 stage, $3 directory to run in, $4... command (relative to $D/bin); extra variables in $YX
  yrun() {
    local n=$1 l0=$2 dir=$3; shift 3
    ( cd "$dir" && export ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:gpu DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$D/lib:$l0/lib" ${YX:-}
      $t "$D/bin/$@" > "$R/$n.txt" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/$n.txt" )
  }
  # the same run again with the runtime's, UR's and NEO's logs on, when it failed
  ydebug() {
    local n=$1 l0=$2 dir=$3; shift 3
    grep -q "exit=0" "$R/$n.txt" && return 0
    ( cd "$dir" && export ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:gpu DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$D/lib:$l0/lib" ${YX:-} \
        SYCL_UR_TRACE=2 UR_LOG_LEVEL_ZERO="level:debug;flush:debug;output:stdout" UR_LOG_LOADER="level:debug;output:stdout" \
        NEOReadDebugKeys=1 PrintDebugMessages=1 PrintXeLogs=1
      $t "$D/bin/$@" > "$R/$n-debug.full" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> "$R/$n-debug.full"
      tail -120 "$R/$n-debug.full" > "$R/$n-debug.txt"; gzip -f "$R/$n-debug.full" )
  }
  yrun 1-sycl-ls $L0 $L0/builtins sycl-ls --verbose
  say "Y1 sycl-ls: $(grep -m2 -E '^\[level_zero|exit=' "$R/1-sycl-ls.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  ydebug 1-sycl-ls $L0 $L0/builtins sycl-ls --verbose
  yrun 2-build $L0 $L0/builtins sycl_hello build
  say "Y2 sycl_hello build (kernels from the AOT bmg image, no GPU work): $(grep -E '^(PASS|FAIL)' "$R/2-build.txt" | tr '\n' ' ') $(tail -1 "$R/2-build.txt")"
  ydebug 2-build $L0 $L0/builtins sycl_hello build
  yrun 3-hello-v2 $L0 $L0/builtins sycl_hello
  say "Y3 sycl_hello (L0 v2 adapter, AOT bmg): $(grep -cE '^PASS ' "$R/3-hello-v2.txt") PASS, $(grep -m1 -E '^FAIL' "$R/3-hello-v2.txt") $(tail -2 "$R/3-hello-v2.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  ydebug 3-hello-v2 $L0 $L0/builtins sycl_hello
  YX="UR_LOADER_USE_LEVEL_ZERO_V2=0" yrun 4-hello-v1 $L0 $L0/builtins sycl_hello
  say "Y4 sycl_hello (L0 v1 adapter, AOT bmg): $(grep -cE '^PASS ' "$R/4-hello-v1.txt") PASS, $(grep -m1 -E '^FAIL' "$R/4-hello-v1.txt") $(tail -2 "$R/4-hello-v1.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  YX="UR_LOADER_USE_LEVEL_ZERO_V2=0" ydebug 4-hello-v1 $L0 $L0/builtins sycl_hello
  if [ -d "$L0IGC/lib" ]; then
    yrun 5-hello-jit $L0IGC $L0IGC sycl_hello_jit
    say "Y5 sycl_hello_jit (SPIR-V through IGC): $(grep -cE '^PASS ' "$R/5-hello-jit.txt") PASS, $(grep -m1 -E '^FAIL' "$R/5-hello-jit.txt") $(tail -2 "$R/5-hello-jit.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')"
    ydebug 5-hello-jit $L0IGC $L0IGC sycl_hello_jit
  else
    say "Y5 skipped: no $L0IGC (the IGC stage)"
  fi
  # what sits on top (14 Nov stage, DESIGN-sycl.md section 6): oneDPL with a device policy (AOT image, no IGC needed)
  if [ -x "$D/bin/sycl_libs" ]; then
    yrun 6-dpl $L0 $L0/builtins sycl_libs dpl
    say "Y6 oneDPL (device policy, AOT bmg): $(grep -cE '^PASS ' "$R/6-dpl.txt") PASS, $(grep -m1 -E '^FAIL' "$R/6-dpl.txt") $(tail -2 "$R/6-dpl.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')"
    ydebug 6-dpl $L0 $L0/builtins sycl_libs dpl
    # run-time compilation: SPIR-V and OpenCL C (ocloc) and SYCL source (sycl-jit), all through IGC; the SYCL source
    # takes its host headers from the stage's rtc-sysroot (the test machine has no SDK)
    if [ -d "$L0IGC/lib" ]; then
      YX="SYCL_RTC_SYSROOT=$D/rtc-sysroot" yrun 7-rtc $L0IGC $L0IGC sycl_libs rtc
      say "Y7 kernel_compiler (SPIR-V, OpenCL C, SYCL source; IGC): $(grep -E '^(PASS|FAIL|SKIP) rtc|can_build' "$R/7-rtc.txt" | tr '\n' ' ') $(tail -1 "$R/7-rtc.txt")"
      YX="SYCL_RTC_SYSROOT=$D/rtc-sysroot" ydebug 7-rtc $L0IGC $L0IGC sycl_libs rtc
    else
      say "Y7 skipped: no $L0IGC (the IGC stage)"
    fi
  else
    say "Y6/Y7 skipped: no sycl_libs in $D (a stage before 14 Nov)"
  fi
  # XPTI: sycl-trace (SYCL events and UR calls) and sycl-prof (a Chrome trace file) around the vector add
  if [ -x "$D/bin/sycl-trace" ]; then
    yrun 8-trace $L0 $L0/builtins sycl-trace --sycl --ur.call "$D/bin/sycl_hello" vector
    say "Y8 sycl-trace: $(grep -c '^\[UR\]' "$R/8-trace.txt") UR calls, $(grep -c '^\[SYCL\]' "$R/8-trace.txt") SYCL events, $(grep -E '^(PASS|FAIL) vector' "$R/8-trace.txt") $(tail -1 "$R/8-trace.txt")"
    ydebug 8-trace $L0 $L0/builtins sycl-trace --sycl --ur.call "$D/bin/sycl_hello" vector
    yrun 9-prof $L0 $L0/builtins sycl-prof -o "$R/9-prof.json" "$D/bin/sycl_hello" vector
    say "Y9 sycl-prof: $(wc -c < "$R/9-prof.json" 2>/dev/null || echo no) bytes of trace, $(grep -o '"name"' "$R/9-prof.json" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') events, $(tail -1 "$R/9-prof.txt")"
    [ -f "$R/9-prof.json" ] && gzip -f "$R/9-prof.json"
  else
    say "Y8/Y9 skipped: no sycl-trace in $D"
  fi
  # oneDNN's SYCL GPU engine: ReLU, matmul, convolution; nGEN's Xe2 kernels and OpenCL C ones compiled through NEO's
  # OpenCL (the device with the same UUID), so over ~/l0igc with its OpenCL ICD
  if [ -x "$D/bin/onednn_hello" ] && [ -d "$L0IGC/lib" ]; then
    YX="OCL_ICD_FILENAMES=$L0IGC/lib/libigdrcl.dylib" yrun 10-onednn $L0IGC $L0IGC onednn_hello
    say "Y10 oneDNN (GPU engine, ReLU, matmul, conv; IGC): $(grep -cE '^PASS ' "$R/10-onednn.txt") PASS, $(grep -m1 -E '^FAIL' "$R/10-onednn.txt") $(grep -m2 'implementation:' "$R/10-onednn.txt" | tr '\n' ' ') $(tail -2 "$R/10-onednn.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')"
    YX="OCL_ICD_FILENAMES=$L0IGC/lib/libigdrcl.dylib ONEDNN_VERBOSE=all" ydebug 10-onednn $L0IGC $L0IGC onednn_hello
  else
    say "Y10 skipped: no onednn_hello in $D or no $L0IGC"
  fi
  say "Y: after: $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | grep -oE 'GuC context resets [0-9]+; GT resets [0-9]+')"
}

FILE: user/tests/sycl/onednn_hello.cpp
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// onednn_hello: oneDNN (oneAPI's deep-learning primitives, v3.14.2, compute/build-sycl.sh onednn) on the B580 through
// its SYCL GPU engine (DPC++ over our Level Zero; DESIGN-sycl.md section 7.5). oneDNN generates most kernels directly
// (nGEN, Xe2 binaries loaded with zeModuleCreate) and compiles its OpenCL C kernels at run time through the OpenCL
// device with the same UUID (NEO's OpenCL through the Khronos loader: OCL_ICD_FILENAMES=<l0igc>/lib/libigdrcl.dylib),
// so it runs over the IGC stage. Each step printed with PASS/FAIL:
//   1. a GPU engine on the SYCL queue's device and context (dnnl::sycl_interop::make_engine), its stream
//   2. eltwise ReLU forward on 1M floats (USM device memory through dnnl::sycl_interop::make_memory)
//   3. matmul f32 192x160 * 160x224 against a host reference (tolerance 1e-3 relative)
//   4. convolution f32 forward, 1x16x32x32 input, 32 3x3 filters, padding 1, against a host reference
// "build": step 1, then the three primitives created (their kernels compiled for the device), no execution, so it also
// runs against xemac's canned device (XEMAC_FAKE=1). Exit status 0 when every step passed.
//
// Build (compute/build-sycl.sh stage, when the onednn step was run): $SYCL_WORK/build/bin/clang++ -fsycl -O2
//   -I<oneDNN>/include -I<oneDNN build>/include onednn_hello.cpp -L<oneDNN build>/src -ldnnl -o onednn_hello
// Run: export ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:gpu DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=<sycl stage>/lib:<l0igc>/lib
//   OCL_ICD_FILENAMES=<l0igc>/lib/libigdrcl.dylib; ./onednn_hello
#include <oneapi/dnnl/dnnl.hpp>
#include <oneapi/dnnl/dnnl_sycl.hpp>

#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

using namespace dnnl;
using tag = memory::format_tag;
using dt = memory::data_type;

static int failures;

static void step(const char *name, bool ok)
{
	printf("%s %s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
	fflush(stdout);
	if (!ok)
		failures++;
}

static void announce(const char *name)
{
	printf("%s ...\n", name);
	fflush(stdout);
}

static memory usm_memory(const memory::desc &md, const engine &eng, sycl::queue &q, const std::vector<float> *init)
{
	memory m = sycl_interop::make_memory(md, eng, sycl_interop::memory_kind::usm);
	if (init)
		q.memcpy(m.get_data_handle(), init->data(), init->size() * sizeof(float)).wait();
	return m;
}

static std::vector<float> to_host(const memory &m, sycl::queue &q, size_t n)
{
	std::vector<float> h(n);
	q.memcpy(h.data(), m.get_data_handle(), n * sizeof(float)).wait();
	return h;
}

static bool close(const std::vector<float> &a, const std::vector<float> &b, const char *what)
{
	for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
		const float tol = 1e-3f * std::max(1.0f, std::fabs(b[i]));
		if (!(std::fabs(a[i] - b[i]) <= tol)) {
			printf("  %s: [%zu] = %g, expected %g\n", what, i, a[i], b[i]);
			return false;
		}
	}
	return true;
}

static float val(size_t i, int k) { return (float)((int)((i * 2654435761u + k) % 17) - 8) / 8.0f; }

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	const bool build_only = argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "build");
	try {
		sycl::queue q{sycl::gpu_selector_v};
		announce("engine");
		engine eng = sycl_interop::make_engine(q.get_device(), q.get_context());
		stream strm = sycl_interop::make_stream(eng, q);
		printf("  oneDNN %d.%d.%d, engine kind %s on %s\n", dnnl_version()->major, dnnl_version()->minor,
		       dnnl_version()->patch, eng.get_kind() == engine::kind::gpu ? "gpu" : "other",
		       q.get_device().get_info<sycl::info::device::name>().c_str());
		step("oneDNN GPU engine on the SYCL device", eng.get_kind() == engine::kind::gpu);

		// ReLU
		const memory::dim n = 1 << 20;
		memory::desc rmd({n}, dt::f32, tag::a);
		announce("eltwise ReLU");
		eltwise_forward::primitive_desc relu_pd(eng, prop_kind::forward_inference, algorithm::eltwise_relu, rmd, rmd,
							0.0f);
		eltwise_forward relu(relu_pd);
		if (build_only) {
			step("eltwise ReLU created", true);
		} else {
			std::vector<float> src(n);
			for (size_t i = 0; i < (size_t)n; i++)
				src[i] = val(i, 1);
			memory s = usm_memory(rmd, eng, q, &src), d = usm_memory(rmd, eng, q, nullptr);
			relu.execute(strm, {{DNNL_ARG_SRC, s}, {DNNL_ARG_DST, d}});
			strm.wait();
			std::vector<float> e(n);
			for (size_t i = 0; i < (size_t)n; i++)
				e[i] = src[i] > 0 ? src[i] : 0;
			step("eltwise ReLU (1M floats)", close(to_host(d, q, n), e, "relu"));
		}

		// matmul
		const memory::dim M = 192, K = 160, N = 224;
		memory::desc amd({M, K}, dt::f32, tag::ab), bmd({K, N}, dt::f32, tag::ab), cmd({M, N}, dt::f32, tag::ab);
		announce("matmul");
		matmul::primitive_desc mm_pd(eng, amd, bmd, cmd);
		matmul mm(mm_pd);
		printf("  matmul implementation: %s\n", mm_pd.impl_info_str());
		if (build_only) {
			step("matmul created", true);
		} else {
			std::vector<float> a(M * K), b(K * N), e(M * N, 0.0f);
			for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); i++)
				a[i] = val(i, 2);
			for (size_t i = 0; i < b.size(); i++)
				b[i] = val(i, 3);
			for (memory::dim i = 0; i < M; i++)
				for (memory::dim k = 0; k < K; k++)
					for (memory::dim j = 0; j < N; j++)
						e[i * N + j] += a[i * K + k] * b[k * N + j];
			memory ma = usm_memory(amd, eng, q, &a), mb = usm_memory(bmd, eng, q, &b), mc = usm_memory(cmd, eng, q, nullptr);
			mm.execute(strm, {{DNNL_ARG_SRC, ma}, {DNNL_ARG_WEIGHTS, mb}, {DNNL_ARG_DST, mc}});
			strm.wait();
			step("matmul f32 192x160x224", close(to_host(mc, q, M * N), e, "matmul"));
		}

		// convolution
		const memory::dim C = 16, H = 32, W = 32, OC = 32, R = 3;
		memory::desc xmd({1, C, H, W}, dt::f32, tag::nchw), wmd({OC, C, R, R}, dt::f32, tag::oihw),
			ymd({1, OC, H, W}, dt::f32, tag::nchw);
		announce("convolution");
		convolution_forward::primitive_desc cv_pd(eng, prop_kind::forward_inference, algorithm::convolution_direct, xmd,
							  wmd, ymd, {1, 1}, {1, 1}, {1, 1});
		convolution_forward cv(cv_pd);
		printf("  convolution implementation: %s\n", cv_pd.impl_info_str());
		if (build_only) {
			step("convolution created", true);
		} else {
			std::vector<float> x(C * H * W), w(OC * C * R * R), e(OC * H * W, 0.0f);
			for (size_t i = 0; i < x.size(); i++)
				x[i] = val(i, 4);
			for (size_t i = 0; i < w.size(); i++)
				w[i] = val(i, 5);
			for (memory::dim o = 0; o < OC; o++)
				for (memory::dim y = 0; y < H; y++)
					for (memory::dim xx = 0; xx < W; xx++) {
						float acc = 0;
						for (memory::dim c = 0; c < C; c++)
							for (memory::dim r = 0; r < R; r++)
								for (memory::dim s = 0; s < R; s++) {
									const memory::dim iy = y + r - 1, ix = xx + s - 1;
									if (iy < 0 || iy >= H || ix < 0 || ix >= W)
										continue;
									acc += x[(c * H + iy) * W + ix] * w[((o * C + c) * R + r) * R + s];
								}
						e[(o * H + y) * W + xx] = acc;
					}
			memory mx = usm_memory(xmd, eng, q, &x), mw = usm_memory(wmd, eng, q, &w), my = usm_memory(ymd, eng, q, nullptr);
			cv.execute(strm, {{DNNL_ARG_SRC, mx}, {DNNL_ARG_WEIGHTS, mw}, {DNNL_ARG_DST, my}});
			strm.wait();
			step("convolution f32 3x3 (1x16x32x32 -> 32 channels)", close(to_host(my, q, OC * H * W), e, "conv"));
		}
	} catch (const dnnl::error &e) {
		printf("FAIL oneDNN error: %s (status %d)\n", e.what(), (int)e.status);
		failures++;
	} catch (const sycl::exception &e) {
		printf("FAIL SYCL exception: %s\n", e.what());
		failures++;
	}
	printf("%s: %d failure(s)\n", failures ? "FAIL" : "PASS", failures);
	return failures ? 1 : 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/sycl/sycl_hello.cpp
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// sycl_hello: SYCL 2020 on a Level Zero GPU through Intel's DPC++ runtime (libsycl, the Unified Runtime's Level Zero
// adapters) over our Level Zero (compute-runtime/NEO on xemac). Each step printed with PASS/FAIL:
//   1. platforms and devices; the queue's device: backend, compute units, sub-group sizes, memory, USM aspects; and
//      Intel's device queries the runtime answers from Level Zero (the max clock, memory clock and bus width, and the
//      free memory: the core's usable-memory extension when NEO offers it, else sysman's zesMemoryGetState):
//      "PASS free memory" when it is known and within the device's memory, "SKIP free memory" without
//      ext_intel_free_memory; then the queries the runtime answers only through Level Zero sysman (zesInit, the card
//      power domain, the GPU frequency domain's throttle reasons): "PASS sysman" when the device offers
//      ext_intel_power_limits and both answer, "SKIP sysman" without it (a driver whose zesInit fails)
//   2. vector add of 1M floats through buffers and accessors
//   3. sycl::reduction (plus, 64-bit) of 1..262144
//   4. USM shared: a kernel writes, the host reads
//   5. USM device: host -> device, device -> device and device -> host memcpy around a kernel
//   6. fill and memset on device memory
// "build": step 1, then every kernel of the program built for the device (get_kernel_bundle<executable>), no GPU work
// (also against xemac's canned device, XEMAC_FAKE=1, where nothing executes).
// "vector", "reduction", "usm_shared", "usm_device", "fill" (one or more): step 1, then only those steps. Against the
// canned device "reduction" is a host-side check of the reduction's submission (13 Nov: libsycl and the program
// disagreed on how a type_erased_cgfo_ty is passed and the submission called a null pointer; intel-llvm patch 0006):
// it must get as far as waiting for the GPU, which fake mode never answers.
// Exit status 0 when every step passed.
//
// Build (compute/build-sycl.sh stage): $SYCL_WORK/build/bin/clang++ -fsycl -fsycl-targets=spir64_gen,spir64
//   -Xsycl-target-backend=spir64_gen "-device bmg" -O2 sycl_hello.cpp -o sycl_hello  (spir64 only: sycl_hello_jit)
// Run: export ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:gpu DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=<sycl stage>/lib:<l0 stage>/lib; ./sycl_hello
#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <numeric>
#include <vector>

static int failures;

static void step(const char *name, bool ok)
{
	printf("%s %s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
	fflush(stdout);
	if (!ok)
		failures++;
}

static const char *backend_name(sycl::backend b)
{
	switch (b) {
	case sycl::backend::ext_oneapi_level_zero: return "level_zero";
	case sycl::backend::opencl: return "opencl";
	default: return "other";
	}
}

static bool device_query(const sycl::queue &q)
{
	for (const auto &p : sycl::platform::get_platforms()) {
		printf("platform: %s (%s, %s)\n", p.get_info<sycl::info::platform::name>().c_str(),
		       p.get_info<sycl::info::platform::version>().c_str(), backend_name(p.get_backend()));
		for (const auto &d : p.get_devices())
			printf("  device: %s (%s)\n", d.get_info<sycl::info::device::name>().c_str(), d.is_gpu() ? "gpu" : "other");
	}
	const sycl::device d = q.get_device();
	printf("queue device: %s\n", d.get_info<sycl::info::device::name>().c_str());
	printf("  vendor %s, driver %s, backend %s\n", d.get_info<sycl::info::device::vendor>().c_str(),
	       d.get_info<sycl::info::device::driver_version>().c_str(), backend_name(d.get_backend()));
	const uint64_t global = d.get_info<sycl::info::device::global_mem_size>();
	printf("  compute units %u, max work-group %zu, global memory %llu MB, local memory %llu KB\n",
	       d.get_info<sycl::info::device::max_compute_units>(), d.get_info<sycl::info::device::max_work_group_size>(),
	       (unsigned long long)(global >> 20),
	       (unsigned long long)(d.get_info<sycl::info::device::local_mem_size>() >> 10));
	printf("  sub-group sizes:");
	for (size_t s : d.get_info<sycl::info::device::sub_group_sizes>())
		printf(" %zu", s);
	printf("\n  usm: device %d, host %d, shared %d; fp64 %d\n", d.has(sycl::aspect::usm_device_allocations),
	       d.has(sycl::aspect::usm_host_allocations), d.has(sycl::aspect::usm_shared_allocations),
	       d.has(sycl::aspect::fp64));
	return d.is_gpu() && d.get_backend() == sycl::backend::ext_oneapi_level_zero;
}

// Intel's device queries (sycl::ext::intel::info::device). Returns -1 (skip) when the device does not offer the
// free-memory query.
static int intel_query(const sycl::queue &q)
{
	const sycl::device d = q.get_device();
	printf("  max clock %u MHz", d.get_info<sycl::info::device::max_clock_frequency>());
	if (d.has(sycl::aspect::ext_intel_memory_clock_rate))
		printf(", memory clock %u MHz", d.get_info<sycl::ext::intel::info::device::memory_clock_rate>());
	if (d.has(sycl::aspect::ext_intel_memory_bus_width))
		printf(", memory bus %u bits", d.get_info<sycl::ext::intel::info::device::memory_bus_width>());
	if (!d.has(sycl::aspect::ext_intel_free_memory)) {
		printf("; no free-memory query (ext_intel_free_memory)\n");
		return -1;
	}
	const uint64_t free = d.get_info<sycl::ext::intel::info::device::free_memory>();
	const uint64_t global = d.get_info<sycl::info::device::global_mem_size>();
	printf("; free memory %llu MB of %llu MB\n", (unsigned long long)(free >> 20), (unsigned long long)(global >> 20));
	return free > 0 && free <= global;
}

// The runtime asks these of sysman only (urDeviceGetInfo: zesDeviceGetCardPowerDomain + zesPowerGetProperties, and
// zesFrequencyGetState of the GPU domain). Returns -1 (skip) without ext_intel_power_limits.
static int sysman_query(const sycl::queue &q)
{
	const sycl::device d = q.get_device();
	if (!d.has(sycl::aspect::ext_intel_power_limits)) {
		printf("  no sysman power limits (ext_intel_power_limits)\n");
		return -1;
	}
	try {
		const int32_t mn = d.get_info<sycl::ext::intel::info::device::min_power_limit>();
		const int32_t mx = d.get_info<sycl::ext::intel::info::device::max_power_limit>();
		printf("  sysman: card power limits min %d, max %d mW", mn, mx);
		if (d.has(sycl::aspect::ext_intel_current_clock_throttle_reasons)) {
			const auto r = d.get_info<sycl::ext::intel::info::device::current_clock_throttle_reasons>();
			printf("; %zu throttle reason(s)", r.size());
		}
		printf("\n");
		return 1;
	} catch (const sycl::exception &e) {
		printf("  sysman query failed: %s\n", e.what());
		return 0;
	}
}

static bool vector_add(sycl::queue &q)
{
	constexpr size_t n = 1 << 20;
	std::vector<float> a(n), b(n), c(n, -1.0f);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		a[i] = (float)i;
		b[i] = 2.0f * (float)i;
	}
	{
		sycl::buffer<float> ba(a.data(), sycl::range<1>(n)), bb(b.data(), sycl::range<1>(n)),
			bc(c.data(), sycl::range<1>(n));
		q.submit([&](sycl::handler &h) {
			sycl::accessor x(ba, h, sycl::read_only), y(bb, h, sycl::read_only);
			sycl::accessor z(bc, h, sycl::write_only, sycl::no_init);
			h.parallel_for(sycl::range<1>(n), [=](sycl::id<1> i) { z[i] = x[i] + y[i]; });
		});
	}
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
		if (c[i] != 3.0f * (float)i)
			return false;
	return true;
}

static bool reduction(sycl::queue &q)
{
	constexpr size_t n = 262144;
	uint64_t sum = 0;
	{
		sycl::buffer<uint64_t> bs(&sum, 1);
		q.submit([&](sycl::handler &h) {
			auto r = sycl::reduction(bs, h, sycl::plus<uint64_t>());
			h.parallel_for(sycl::range<1>(n), r, [=](sycl::id<1> i, auto &acc) { acc += (uint64_t)i[0] + 1; });
		});
	}
	return sum == (uint64_t)n * (n + 1) / 2;
}

static bool usm_shared(sycl::queue &q)
{
	constexpr size_t n = 65536;
	uint32_t *p = sycl::malloc_shared<uint32_t>(n, q);
	if (!p)
		return false;
	q.parallel_for(sycl::range<1>(n), [=](sycl::id<1> i) { p[i] = (uint32_t)i[0] * 7 + 3; }).wait();
	bool ok = true;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n && ok; i++)
		ok = p[i] == (uint32_t)i * 7 + 3;
	sycl::free(p, q);
	return ok;
}

static bool usm_device(sycl::queue &q)
{
	constexpr size_t n = 1 << 18;
	std::vector<int32_t> host(n), back(n, 0);
	std::iota(host.begin(), host.end(), 0);
	int32_t *d0 = sycl::malloc_device<int32_t>(n, q), *d1 = sycl::malloc_device<int32_t>(n, q);
	if (!d0 || !d1)
		return false;
	q.memcpy(d0, host.data(), n * sizeof(int32_t)).wait();
	q.parallel_for(sycl::range<1>(n), [=](sycl::id<1> i) { d0[i] = d0[i] * 2 + 1; }).wait();
	q.memcpy(d1, d0, n * sizeof(int32_t)).wait();
	q.memcpy(back.data(), d1, n * sizeof(int32_t)).wait();
	sycl::free(d0, q);
	sycl::free(d1, q);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
		if (back[i] != (int32_t)i * 2 + 1)
			return false;
	return true;
}

static bool fill_memset(sycl::queue &q)
{
	constexpr size_t n = 1 << 16;
	uint32_t *d = sycl::malloc_device<uint32_t>(n, q);
	uint8_t *m = sycl::malloc_device<uint8_t>(n, q);
	if (!d || !m)
		return false;
	std::vector<uint32_t> back(n, 0);
	std::vector<uint8_t> mback(n, 0);
	q.fill(d, 0xdeadbeefu, n).wait();
	q.memset(m, 0x5a, n).wait();
	q.memcpy(back.data(), d, n * sizeof(uint32_t)).wait();
	q.memcpy(mback.data(), m, n).wait();
	sycl::free(d, q);
	sycl::free(m, q);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
		if (back[i] != 0xdeadbeefu || mback[i] != 0x5a)
			return false;
	return true;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	const bool build_only = argc > 1 && !strcmp(argv[1], "build");
	try {
		sycl::queue q{sycl::gpu_selector_v};
		step("device query (a Level Zero GPU)", device_query(q));
		const int fm = intel_query(q);
		if (fm < 0)
			printf("SKIP free memory (no ext_intel_free_memory)\n");
		else
			step("free memory (within the device's memory)", fm == 1);
		const int sm = sysman_query(q);
		if (sm < 0)
			printf("SKIP sysman (no ext_intel_power_limits)\n");
		else
			step("sysman (power limits and throttle reasons through zesInit)", sm == 1);
		static const struct {
			const char *arg, *name;
			bool (*run)(sycl::queue &);
		} steps[] = {
			{"vector", "vector add (buffers, accessors)", vector_add},
			{"reduction", "reduction (plus, 64-bit)", reduction},
			{"usm_shared", "USM shared (kernel writes, host reads)", usm_shared},
			{"usm_device", "USM device (copies around a kernel)", usm_device},
			{"fill", "fill and memset", fill_memset},
		};
		if (build_only) {
			auto bundle = sycl::get_kernel_bundle<sycl::bundle_state::executable>(q.get_context(), {q.get_device()});
			const size_t kernels = bundle.get_kernel_ids().size();
			printf("%zu kernels\n", kernels);
			step("kernel build (every kernel of the program for the device)", kernels > 0);
		} else {
			for (const auto &st : steps) {
				bool chosen = argc < 2;
				for (int a = 1; a < argc && !chosen; a++)
					chosen = !strcmp(argv[a], st.arg);
				if (chosen) {
					printf("%s ...\n", st.name);
					fflush(stdout);
					step(st.name, st.run(q));
				}
			}
		}
	} catch (const sycl::exception &e) {
		printf("FAIL exception: %s\n", e.what());
		failures++;
	}
	printf("%s: %d failure(s)\n", failures ? "FAIL" : "PASS", failures);
	return failures ? 1 : 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/sycl/sycl_libs.cpp

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// sycl_libs: what sits on top of the SYCL runtime (compute/build-sycl.sh, DESIGN-sycl.md section 6) on a Level Zero GPU
// through Intel's DPC++ runtime over our Level Zero (compute-runtime/NEO on xemac). Each step printed with PASS/FAIL:
//   rtc  run-time compilation (sycl_ext_oneapi_kernel_compiler): device::ext_oneapi_can_build for SPIR-V, OpenCL C
//        and SYCL; then one kernel from each, built (syclex::build) and run on USM:
//          spirv   a SPIR-V module read from <exe dir>/../share/rtc_kernels.spv (OpenCL C compiled offline by the
//                  DPC++ clang + llvm-spirv at stage time): the driver's IGC compiles it
//          opencl  OpenCL C source: libsycl hands it to ocloc (libocloc.dylib from the IGC stage, intel-llvm 0007)
//          sycl    SYCL source (a free-function kernel): libsycl-jit.dylib compiles it in the process (clang, the
//                  SYCL headers and libdevice embedded in it; intel-llvm 0008), then IGC. The host C++ headers
//                  (libc++, the C library) come from a macOS SDK: the compiler's default one, or the directory in
//                  SYCL_RTC_SYSROOT (passed as -isysroot; the stage carries the headers this kernel includes)
//   dpl  oneDPL (oneAPI's parallel algorithms) with a device policy on the queue, USM device memory: sort (int32),
//        sort with a comparator (descending floats), reduce (int64), transform_reduce (a dot product), inclusive_scan,
//        count_if, find_if, copy_if
// "rtc-build" / "dpl-build": the same without GPU work (the SPIR-V/OpenCL/SYCL bundles built and their kernels
// found; every oneDPL kernel of the program built for the device), so they also run against xemac's canned device
// (XEMAC_FAKE=1). No argument: rtc and dpl. Exit status 0 when every step passed (a SKIP is not a failure).
//
// Build (compute/build-sycl.sh stage): $SYCL_WORK/build/bin/clang++ -fsycl -fsycl-targets=spir64_gen,spir64
//   -Xsycl-target-backend=spir64_gen "-device bmg" -O2 -I<oneDPL>/include sycl_libs.cpp -o sycl_libs
// Run: export ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR=level_zero:gpu DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=<sycl stage>/lib:<l0 stage>/lib; ./sycl_libs dpl
#include <oneapi/dpl/algorithm>
#include <oneapi/dpl/execution>
#include <oneapi/dpl/numeric>

#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <functional>
#include <iterator>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace syclex = sycl::ext::oneapi::experimental;

static int failures;

static void step(const char *name, bool ok)
{
	printf("%s %s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL", name);
	fflush(stdout);
	if (!ok)
		failures++;
}

static void announce(const char *name)
{
	printf("%s ...\n", name);
	fflush(stdout);
}

// ---- rtc ----

static std::string exe_dir;

static const char *opencl_source = R"CL(
__kernel void rtc_cl_scale(__global const int *in, __global int *out, int k)
{
	size_t i = get_global_id(0);
	out[i] = in[i] * k + 1;
}
)CL";

static const char *sycl_source = R"SYCL(
#include <sycl/sycl.hpp>
namespace syclext = sycl::ext::oneapi;
namespace syclexp = sycl::ext::oneapi::experimental;

extern "C" SYCL_EXT_ONEAPI_FUNCTION_PROPERTY((syclexp::nd_range_kernel<1>))
void rtc_sycl_iota(int start, int *out)
{
	size_t id = syclext::this_work_item::get_nd_item<1>().get_global_linear_id();
	out[id] = start + static_cast<int>(id) * 2;
}
)SYCL";

static std::vector<std::byte> read_file(const std::string &path)
{
	std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
	if (!f)
		return {};
	std::vector<char> c((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
	std::vector<std::byte> b(c.size());
	memcpy(b.data(), c.data(), c.size());
	return b;
}

static bool can_build(sycl::device d)
{
	const bool spv = d.ext_oneapi_can_build(syclex::source_language::spirv);
	const bool cl = d.ext_oneapi_can_build(syclex::source_language::opencl);
	const bool sy = d.ext_oneapi_can_build(syclex::source_language::sycl);
	printf("  can_build: spirv %d, opencl %d, sycl %d; can_compile sycl %d\n", spv, cl, sy,
	       d.ext_oneapi_can_compile(syclex::source_language::sycl));
	return spv && cl && sy;
}

constexpr size_t rtc_n = 4096;

// in[i] = i; a kernel taking (in, out, k) must give out[i] = i * k + 1
static bool run_scale(sycl::queue &q, sycl::kernel k, const char *what)
{
	int32_t *in = sycl::malloc_device<int32_t>(rtc_n, q), *out = sycl::malloc_device<int32_t>(rtc_n, q);
	std::vector<int32_t> h(rtc_n), back(rtc_n, -1);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < rtc_n; i++)
		h[i] = (int32_t)i;
	q.memcpy(in, h.data(), rtc_n * sizeof(int32_t)).wait();
	q.submit([&](sycl::handler &cgh) {
		cgh.set_args(in, out, 5);
		cgh.parallel_for(sycl::range<1>(rtc_n), k);
	}).wait();
	q.memcpy(back.data(), out, rtc_n * sizeof(int32_t)).wait();
	sycl::free(in, q);
	sycl::free(out, q);
	for (size_t i = 0; i < rtc_n; i++)
		if (back[i] != (int32_t)i * 5 + 1) {
			printf("  %s: out[%zu] = %d, expected %d\n", what, i, back[i], (int32_t)i * 5 + 1);
			return false;
		}
	return true;
}

static void rtc(sycl::queue &q, bool run)
{
	sycl::device d = q.get_device();
	const sycl::context ctx = q.get_context();
	announce("rtc: can_build");
	step("rtc can_build (SPIR-V, OpenCL C and SYCL)", can_build(d));

	announce("rtc: SPIR-V");
	try {
		const std::string path = exe_dir + "/../share/rtc_kernels.spv";
		const std::vector<std::byte> spv = read_file(path);
		if (spv.empty()) {
			printf("  cannot read %s\n", path.c_str());
			step("rtc SPIR-V", false);
		} else {
			auto src = syclex::create_kernel_bundle_from_source(ctx, syclex::source_language::spirv, spv);
			auto exe = syclex::build(src);
			sycl::kernel k = exe.ext_oneapi_get_kernel("rtc_spv_scale");
			printf("  %zu bytes of SPIR-V, kernel rtc_spv_scale\n", spv.size());
			step(run ? "rtc SPIR-V (built and run)" : "rtc SPIR-V (built)", !run || run_scale(q, k, "spirv"));
		}
	} catch (const sycl::exception &e) {
		printf("  exception: %s\n", e.what());
		step("rtc SPIR-V", false);
	}

	announce("rtc: OpenCL C");
	try {
		auto src = syclex::create_kernel_bundle_from_source(ctx, syclex::source_language::opencl, opencl_source);
		std::string log;
		auto exe = syclex::build(src, syclex::properties{syclex::save_log{&log}});
		sycl::kernel k = exe.ext_oneapi_get_kernel("rtc_cl_scale");
		step(run ? "rtc OpenCL C (built by ocloc and run)" : "rtc OpenCL C (built by ocloc)",
		     !run || run_scale(q, k, "opencl"));
	} catch (const sycl::exception &e) {
		printf("  exception: %s\n", e.what());
		step("rtc OpenCL C", false);
	}

	announce("rtc: SYCL");
	std::string sycl_log;
	try {
		std::vector<std::string> opts;
		if (const char *sr = getenv("SYCL_RTC_SYSROOT"); sr && *sr) {
			opts.push_back("-isysroot");
			opts.push_back(sr);
			printf("  -isysroot %s\n", sr);
		}
		auto src = syclex::create_kernel_bundle_from_source(ctx, syclex::source_language::sycl, sycl_source);
		auto exe = syclex::build(src, syclex::properties{syclex::build_options{opts}, syclex::save_log{&sycl_log}});
		sycl::kernel k = exe.ext_oneapi_get_kernel("rtc_sycl_iota");
		bool ok = true;
		if (run) {
			constexpr size_t n = 1024;
			int32_t *out = sycl::malloc_shared<int32_t>(n, q);
			q.submit([&](sycl::handler &cgh) {
				cgh.set_args(7, out);
				cgh.parallel_for(sycl::nd_range<1>{{n}, {64}}, k);
			}).wait();
			for (size_t i = 0; i < n && ok; i++)
				if (out[i] != 7 + 2 * (int32_t)i) {
					printf("  sycl: out[%zu] = %d, expected %d\n", i, out[i], 7 + 2 * (int32_t)i);
					ok = false;
				}
			sycl::free(out, q);
		}
		step(run ? "rtc SYCL (built by sycl-jit and run)" : "rtc SYCL (built by sycl-jit)", ok);
	} catch (const sycl::exception &e) {
		std::string w = e.what();
		if (w.size() > 3000)
			w = w.substr(0, 3000) + " ...";
		printf("  exception: %s\n", w.c_str());
		if (!sycl_log.empty())
			printf("  build log:\n%.3000s\n", sycl_log.c_str());
		step("rtc SYCL", false);
	}
}

// ---- dpl ----

template <typename T> static std::vector<T> to_host(sycl::queue &q, const T *d, size_t n)
{
	std::vector<T> h(n);
	q.memcpy(h.data(), d, n * sizeof(T)).wait();
	return h;
}

static void dpl_run(sycl::queue &q)
{
	auto pol = oneapi::dpl::execution::make_device_policy(q);
	constexpr size_t n = 1 << 20;
	std::vector<int32_t> hi(n);
	std::vector<float> hf(n);
	uint32_t x = 12345;
	for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		x = x * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
		hi[i] = (int32_t)(x >> 1) - (1 << 30);
		hf[i] = (float)(x >> 8) / 65536.0f;
	}
	int32_t *di = sycl::malloc_device<int32_t>(n, q), *dj = sycl::malloc_device<int32_t>(n, q);
	float *df = sycl::malloc_device<float>(n, q), *dg = sycl::malloc_device<float>(n, q);
	int64_t *dl = sycl::malloc_device<int64_t>(n, q);
	if (!di || !dj || !df || !dg || !dl) {
		step("dpl USM allocation", false);
		return;
	}
	auto guarded = [&](const char *name, auto fn) {
		announce(name);
		try {
			step(name, fn());
		} catch (const std::exception &e) {
			printf("  exception: %s\n", e.what());
			step(name, false);
		}
	};
	guarded("dpl sort (int32, 1M)", [&] {
		q.memcpy(di, hi.data(), n * sizeof(int32_t)).wait();
		oneapi::dpl::sort(pol, di, di + n);
		std::vector<int32_t> r = to_host(q, di, n), e = hi;
		std::sort(e.begin(), e.end());
		return r == e;
	});
	guarded("dpl sort with a comparator (float, descending)", [&] {
		q.memcpy(df, hf.data(), n * sizeof(float)).wait();
		oneapi::dpl::sort(pol, df, df + n, std::greater<float>());
		std::vector<float> r = to_host(q, df, n), e = hf;
		std::sort(e.begin(), e.end(), std::greater<float>());
		return r == e;
	});
	guarded("dpl reduce (int64)", [&] {
		std::vector<int64_t> h(n);
		for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
			h[i] = (int64_t)hi[i];
		q.memcpy(dl, h.data(), n * sizeof(int64_t)).wait();
		const int64_t r = oneapi::dpl::reduce(pol, dl, dl + n, (int64_t)0);
		int64_t e = 0;
		for (int64_t v : h)
			e += v;
		printf("  sum %lld (expected %lld)\n", (long long)r, (long long)e);
		return r == e;
	});
	guarded("dpl transform_reduce (dot product of small integers)", [&] {
		std::vector<float> a(n), b(n);
		for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			a[i] = (float)(i % 7);
			b[i] = (float)(i % 5);
		}
		q.memcpy(df, a.data(), n * sizeof(float)).wait();
		q.memcpy(dg, b.data(), n * sizeof(float)).wait();
		// every partial sum is an integer below 2^24 per work-item block; compare in double on the host
		const double r = oneapi::dpl::transform_reduce(pol, df, df + n, dg, 0.0);
		double e = 0;
		for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
			e += (double)a[i] * b[i];
		printf("  dot %.0f (expected %.0f)\n", r, e);
		return r == e;
	});
	guarded("dpl inclusive_scan (int32)", [&] {
		std::vector<int32_t> h(n);
		for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
			h[i] = (int32_t)(i % 13) - 6;
		q.memcpy(di, h.data(), n * sizeof(int32_t)).wait();
		oneapi::dpl::inclusive_scan(pol, di, di + n, dj);
		std::vector<int32_t> r = to_host(q, dj, n), e(n);
		std::inclusive_scan(h.begin(), h.end(), e.begin());
		return r == e;
	});
	guarded("dpl count_if and find_if", [&] {
		q.memcpy(di, hi.data(), n * sizeof(int32_t)).wait();
		const auto c = oneapi::dpl::count_if(pol, di, di + n, [](int32_t v) { return v % 3 == 0; });
		const auto e = std::count_if(hi.begin(), hi.end(), [](int32_t v) { return v % 3 == 0; });
		const int32_t target = hi[n / 2 + 17];
		const auto f = oneapi::dpl::find_if(pol, di, di + n, [=](int32_t v) { return v == target; });
		const auto ef = std::find(hi.begin(), hi.end(), target);
		printf("  count %lld (expected %lld), found at %lld (expected %lld)\n", (long long)c, (long long)e,
		       (long long)(f - di), (long long)(ef - hi.begin()));
		return c == e && f - di == ef - hi.begin();
	});
	guarded("dpl copy_if (stable, positives)", [&] {
		q.memcpy(di, hi.data(), n * sizeof(int32_t)).wait();
		int32_t *end = oneapi::dpl::copy_if(pol, di, di + n, dj, [](int32_t v) { return v > 0; });
		const size_t m = (size_t)(end - dj);
		std::vector<int32_t> r = to_host(q, dj, m), e;
		std::copy_if(hi.begin(), hi.end(), std::back_inserter(e), [](int32_t v) { return v > 0; });
		printf("  %zu copied (expected %zu)\n", m, e.size());
		return r == e;
	});
	sycl::free(di, q);
	sycl::free(dj, q);
	sycl::free(df, q);
	sycl::free(dg, q);
	sycl::free(dl, q);
}

static void dpl_build(sycl::queue &q)
{
	announce("dpl kernel build");
	auto bundle = sycl::get_kernel_bundle<sycl::bundle_state::executable>(q.get_context(), {q.get_device()});
	const size_t kernels = bundle.get_kernel_ids().size();
	printf("  %zu kernels (oneDPL's, instantiated by this program)\n", kernels);
	step("dpl kernel build (every kernel of the program for the device)", kernels > 0);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	exe_dir = argv[0];
	const size_t slash = exe_dir.rfind('/');
	exe_dir = slash == std::string::npos ? "." : exe_dir.substr(0, slash);
	auto want = [&](const char *a) {
		if (argc < 2)
			return strcmp(a, "rtc") == 0 || strcmp(a, "dpl") == 0;
		for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++)
			if (!strcmp(argv[i], a))
				return true;
		return false;
	};
	try {
		sycl::queue q{sycl::gpu_selector_v};
		const sycl::device d = q.get_device();
		printf("queue device: %s (%s)\n", d.get_info<sycl::info::device::name>().c_str(),
		       d.get_backend() == sycl::backend::ext_oneapi_level_zero ? "level_zero" : "other");
		if (want("rtc") || want("rtc-build"))
			rtc(q, want("rtc"));
		if (want("dpl-build"))
			dpl_build(q);
		if (want("dpl"))
			dpl_run(q);
	} catch (const sycl::exception &e) {
		printf("FAIL exception: %s\n", e.what());
		failures++;
	}
	printf("%s: %d failure(s)\n", failures ? "FAIL" : "PASS", failures);
	return failures ? 1 : 0;
}

__kernel void rtc_spv_scale(__global const int *in, __global int *out, int k)
{
	size_t i = get_global_id(0);
	out[i] = in[i] * k + 1;
}

// vk_dbuf_empty_set: ANV's EXT_descriptor_buffer offsets after a set layout without bindings (issue #9, mesa 0109).
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
//
// anv_cmd_buffer_set_descriptor_buffer_offsets() flags only the stages of the set layout it is given. A set layout
// without bindings has no stages, so a new offset given with it is stored in the bind state but no stage is flagged
// and genX(flush_binding_mode) does not reload push_constants.buffer.sets[] (the per-set offsets shaders read from
// push constants). A later call with a set layout that has stages and the *same* offset is "no change", so the shader
// keeps reading the set at the offset of the call before. The Metal plugin's descriptor-buffer model did exactly that
// (an empty stage plan got the page cursor as its offset, the next real region started there): Safari's icon gradient
// in RenderBox read an older region's descriptors when table-pc converted both stages (issue #9).
//
// One compute command buffer, one descriptor buffer with two regions of set layout S (src + dst storage buffers):
// R1: src = X (holds 111), R2: src = Y (holds 222); both dst = the result buffer.
//   1. offsets(layout B: set 0 = S, R1), push slot 0, dispatch      -> result[0] = 111
//   2. offsets(layout A: set 0 = an empty set layout, R2)            (no dispatch)
//   3. offsets(layout B, R2), push slot 1, dispatch                  -> result[1] must be 222 (ANV without 0109: 111)
//   4. offsets(layout B, R1), push slot 2, dispatch                  -> result[2] = 111 (control: a real change)
//   5. offsets(layout B, R2), push slot 3, dispatch                  -> result[3] = 222 (control)
// The graphics bind point has the same code path (the stage of an empty layout is none of VS/FS); compute is the
// smallest way to show it. Exit status 0 = right, 1 = wrong values, 2 = setup failure.
//
//   build: user/tests/vulkan/build.sh
//   run:   user/tests/vulkan/vk_dbuf_empty_set [path/to/libvulkan_intel.dylib]
//
// The shader (glslangValidator -V --target-env vulkan1.2):
//   #version 450
//   layout(local_size_x = 1) in;
//   layout(set = 0, binding = 0) readonly buffer Src { uint v; } src;
//   layout(set = 0, binding = 1) buffer Dst { uint r[]; } dst;
//   layout(push_constant) uniform PC { uint slot; } pc;
//   void main() { dst.r[pc.slot] = src.v; }

#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

static const uint32_t b_spv[] = {
	0x07230203,0x00010500,0x0008000b,0x0000001d,0x00000000,0x00020011,0x00000001,0x0006000b,
	0x00000001,0x4c534c47,0x6474732e,0x3035342e,0x00000000,0x0003000e,0x00000000,0x00000001,
	0x0008000f,0x00000005,0x00000004,0x6e69616d,0x00000000,0x0000000a,0x0000000f,0x00000015,
	0x00060010,0x00000004,0x00000011,0x00000001,0x00000001,0x00000001,0x00030003,0x00000002,
	0x000001c2,0x00040005,0x00000004,0x6e69616d,0x00000000,0x00030005,0x00000008,0x00747344,
	0x00040006,0x00000008,0x00000000,0x00000072,0x00030005,0x0000000a,0x00747364,0x00030005,
	0x0000000d,0x00004350,0x00050006,0x0000000d,0x00000000,0x746f6c73,0x00000000,0x00030005,
	0x0000000f,0x00006370,0x00030005,0x00000013,0x00637253,0x00040006,0x00000013,0x00000000,
	0x00000076,0x00030005,0x00000015,0x00637273,0x00040047,0x00000007,0x00000006,0x00000004,
	0x00030047,0x00000008,0x00000002,0x00050048,0x00000008,0x00000000,0x00000023,0x00000000,
	0x00040047,0x0000000a,0x00000021,0x00000001,0x00040047,0x0000000a,0x00000022,0x00000000,
	0x00030047,0x0000000d,0x00000002,0x00050048,0x0000000d,0x00000000,0x00000023,0x00000000,
	0x00030047,0x00000013,0x00000002,0x00040048,0x00000013,0x00000000,0x00000018,0x00050048,
	0x00000013,0x00000000,0x00000023,0x00000000,0x00030047,0x00000015,0x00000018,0x00040047,
	0x00000015,0x00000021,0x00000000,0x00040047,0x00000015,0x00000022,0x00000000,0x00040047,
	0x0000001c,0x0000000b,0x00000019,0x00020013,0x00000002,0x00030021,0x00000003,0x00000002,

	0x0000000a,0x0000000c,0x00040015,0x0000000b,0x00000020,0x00000001,0x0004002b,0x0000000b,
	0x0000000c,0x00000000,0x0003001e,0x0000000d,0x00000006,0x00040020,0x0000000e,0x00000009,
	0x0000000d,0x0004003b,0x0000000e,0x0000000f,0x00000009,0x00040020,0x00000010,0x00000009,

	0x00000004,0x00000000,0x00000003,0x000200f8,0x00000005,0x00050041,0x00000010,0x00000011,

	0x00000017,0x00000015,0x0000000c,0x0004003d,0x00000006,0x00000018,0x00000017,0x00060041,
	0x00000016,0x00000019,0x0000000a,0x0000000c,0x00000012,0x0003003e,0x00000019,0x00000018,
	0x000100fd,0x00010038
};

static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa;
static PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr gdpa;
static VkDevice device;

#define CHECK(call)                                                                       \
	do {                                                                              \
		VkResult r_ = (call);                                                     \
		if (r_ != VK_SUCCESS) {                                                   \
			printf("%s: VkResult %d\n", #call, r_);                           \
			exit(2);                                                          \
		}                                                                         \
	} while (0)
#define DFN(name) PFN_##name name = (PFN_##name)gdpa(device, #name)

typedef struct {
	VkBuffer buf;
	VkDeviceMemory mem;
	VkDeviceAddress addr;
	void *map;
} hbuf;

static VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp;

// a host-visible, coherent, device-addressable buffer of `size` bytes, mapped
static hbuf make_buffer(VkDeviceSize size, VkBufferUsageFlags usage)
{
	DFN(vkCreateBuffer);
	DFN(vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements);
	DFN(vkAllocateMemory);
	DFN(vkBindBufferMemory);
	DFN(vkMapMemory);
	DFN(vkGetBufferDeviceAddress);
	hbuf b = {0};
	VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = size,
				  .usage = usage | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT};
	CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(device, &bci, NULL, &b.buf));
	VkMemoryRequirements req;
	vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(device, b.buf, &req);
	const VkMemoryPropertyFlags want = VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT;
	uint32_t type = UINT32_MAX;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryTypeCount && type == UINT32_MAX; i++)
		if ((req.memoryTypeBits & (1u << i)) && (mp.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & want) == want)
			type = i;
	if (type == UINT32_MAX) {
		printf("no host-visible coherent memory type in 0x%x\n", req.memoryTypeBits);
		exit(2);
	}
	VkMemoryAllocateFlagsInfo fi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_FLAGS_INFO,
					.flags = VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT};
	VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .pNext = &fi,
				    .allocationSize = req.size, .memoryTypeIndex = type};
	CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(device, &mai, NULL, &b.mem));
	CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(device, b.buf, b.mem, 0));
	CHECK(vkMapMemory(device, b.mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &b.map));
	memset(b.map, 0, size);
	VkBufferDeviceAddressInfo ai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_INFO, .buffer = b.buf};
	b.addr = vkGetBufferDeviceAddress(device, &ai);
	return b;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	const char *path = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "../../../mesa/build/src/intel/vulkan/libvulkan_intel.dylib";
	void *lib = dlopen(path, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
	if (!lib) {
		printf("dlopen: %s\n", dlerror());
		return 2;
	}
	gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(lib, "vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr");
	if (!gipa) {
		printf("no vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr\n");
		return 2;
	}
	VkInstance instance = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
	PFN_vkCreateInstance vkCreateInstance = (PFN_vkCreateInstance)gipa(NULL, "vkCreateInstance");
	VkApplicationInfo app = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, .pApplicationName = "vk_dbuf_empty_set",
				 .apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3};
	VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, .pApplicationInfo = &app};
	CHECK(vkCreateInstance(&ici, NULL, &instance));
	PFN_vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices =
		(PFN_vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices)gipa(instance, "vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices");
	PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2 vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2 =
		(PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2)gipa(instance, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2");
	PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties =
		(PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties)gipa(instance, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties");
	PFN_vkCreateDevice vkCreateDevice = (PFN_vkCreateDevice)gipa(instance, "vkCreateDevice");
	gdpa = (PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr)gipa(instance, "vkGetDeviceProcAddr");

	uint32_t n = 1;
	VkPhysicalDevice pd;
	CHECK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &n, &pd));
	if (!n) {
		printf("no physical device\n");
		return 2;
	}
	VkPhysicalDeviceDescriptorBufferPropertiesEXT dbp = {
		.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_PROPERTIES_EXT};
	VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &dbp};
	vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(pd, &p2);
	vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(pd, &mp);
	printf("%s, descriptorBufferOffsetAlignment %" PRIu64 ", storageBufferDescriptorSize %zu\n",
	       p2.properties.deviceName, dbp.descriptorBufferOffsetAlignment, dbp.storageBufferDescriptorSize);

	VkPhysicalDeviceDescriptorBufferFeaturesEXT dbf = {
		.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_FEATURES_EXT, .descriptorBuffer = VK_TRUE};
	VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features f12 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES,
						.pNext = &dbf, .bufferDeviceAddress = VK_TRUE};
	const char *ext[] = {VK_EXT_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_EXTENSION_NAME};
	float prio = 1.0f;
	VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO, .queueFamilyIndex = 0,
				       .queueCount = 1, .pQueuePriorities = &prio};
	VkDeviceCreateInfo dci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO, .pNext = &f12, .queueCreateInfoCount = 1,
				  .pQueueCreateInfos = &qci, .enabledExtensionCount = 1, .ppEnabledExtensionNames = ext};
	CHECK(vkCreateDevice(pd, &dci, NULL, &device));

	DFN(vkGetDeviceQueue);
	DFN(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout);
	DFN(vkGetDescriptorSetLayoutSizeEXT);
	DFN(vkGetDescriptorSetLayoutBindingOffsetEXT);
	DFN(vkGetDescriptorEXT);
	DFN(vkCreatePipelineLayout);
	DFN(vkCreateShaderModule);
	DFN(vkCreateComputePipelines);
	DFN(vkCreateCommandPool);
	DFN(vkAllocateCommandBuffers);
	DFN(vkBeginCommandBuffer);
	DFN(vkEndCommandBuffer);
	DFN(vkCmdBindPipeline);
	DFN(vkCmdBindDescriptorBuffersEXT);
	DFN(vkCmdSetDescriptorBufferOffsetsEXT);
	DFN(vkCmdPushConstants);
	DFN(vkCmdDispatch);
	DFN(vkCmdPipelineBarrier);
	DFN(vkCreateFence);
	DFN(vkQueueSubmit);
	DFN(vkWaitForFences);
	DFN(vkDeviceWaitIdle);
	VkQueue queue;
	vkGetDeviceQueue(device, 0, 0, &queue);

	// set layout S (src, dst) and the empty set layout E, both for descriptor buffers
	const VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding sb[2] = {
		{0, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, NULL},
		{1, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, NULL}};
	VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo slci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
						.flags = VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT,
						.bindingCount = 2, .pBindings = sb};
	VkDescriptorSetLayout S, E;
	CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(device, &slci, NULL, &S));
	slci.bindingCount = 0;
	slci.pBindings = NULL;
	CHECK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(device, &slci, NULL, &E));

	VkPushConstantRange pcr = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, 4};
	VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo plci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .setLayoutCount = 1,
					   .pSetLayouts = &S, .pushConstantRangeCount = 1, .pPushConstantRanges = &pcr};
	VkPipelineLayout LB, LA;
	CHECK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(device, &plci, NULL, &LB));
	plci.pSetLayouts = &E;
	CHECK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(device, &plci, NULL, &LA));

	VkShaderModuleCreateInfo smci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = sizeof b_spv,
					 .pCode = b_spv};
	VkShaderModule sm;
	CHECK(vkCreateShaderModule(device, &smci, NULL, &sm));
	VkComputePipelineCreateInfo cpci = {
		.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO,
		.flags = VK_PIPELINE_CREATE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT,
		.stage = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT,
			  .module = sm, .pName = "main"},
		.layout = LB};
	VkPipeline pipe;
	CHECK(vkCreateComputePipelines(device, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &cpci, NULL, &pipe));

	// buffers: X = 111, Y = 222, the result, and the descriptor buffer with regions R1 and R2
	hbuf X = make_buffer(256, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT);
	hbuf Y = make_buffer(256, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT);
	hbuf R = make_buffer(256, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT);
	*(uint32_t *)X.map = 111;
	*(uint32_t *)Y.map = 222;
	VkDeviceSize ssize = 0, o0 = 0, o1 = 0;
	vkGetDescriptorSetLayoutSizeEXT(device, S, &ssize);
	vkGetDescriptorSetLayoutBindingOffsetEXT(device, S, 0, &o0);
	vkGetDescriptorSetLayoutBindingOffsetEXT(device, S, 1, &o1);
	const VkDeviceSize al = dbp.descriptorBufferOffsetAlignment ? dbp.descriptorBufferOffsetAlignment : 64;
	const VkDeviceSize stride = (ssize + al - 1) / al * al;
	hbuf D = make_buffer(4 * stride, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT);
	const VkDeviceSize r1 = 0, r2 = stride;
	const struct { VkDeviceSize at; const hbuf *src; } region[2] = {{r1, &X}, {r2, &Y}};
	for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
		VkDescriptorAddressInfoEXT a = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_ADDRESS_INFO_EXT,
						.address = region[k].src->addr, .range = 256};
		VkDescriptorGetInfoEXT gi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_GET_INFO_EXT,
					     .type = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, .data.pStorageBuffer = &a};
		vkGetDescriptorEXT(device, &gi, dbp.storageBufferDescriptorSize, (uint8_t *)D.map + region[k].at + o0);
		a.address = R.addr;
		vkGetDescriptorEXT(device, &gi, dbp.storageBufferDescriptorSize, (uint8_t *)D.map + region[k].at + o1);
	}
	printf("set layout S: %" PRIu64 " bytes (src at %" PRIu64 ", dst at %" PRIu64 "), R1 at %" PRIu64
	       ", R2 at %" PRIu64 "\n", ssize, o0, o1, r1, r2);

	VkCommandPoolCreateInfo cpi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .queueFamilyIndex = 0};
	VkCommandPool pool;
	CHECK(vkCreateCommandPool(device, &cpi, NULL, &pool));
	VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo cbai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO, .commandPool = pool,
					    .level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY, .commandBufferCount = 1};
	VkCommandBuffer cb;
	CHECK(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device, &cbai, &cb));
	VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbbi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO,
					 .flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT};
	CHECK(vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbbi));
	vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pipe);
	VkDescriptorBufferBindingInfoEXT bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BINDING_INFO_EXT,
					       .address = D.addr,
					       .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT};
	vkCmdBindDescriptorBuffersEXT(cb, 1, &bi);
	const uint32_t zero = 0;
	struct { VkPipelineLayout layout; VkDeviceSize off; int32_t slot; } step[5] = {
		{LB, r1, 0}, {LA, r2, -1}, {LB, r2, 1}, {LB, r1, 2}, {LB, r2, 3}};
	for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) {
		vkCmdSetDescriptorBufferOffsetsEXT(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, step[s].layout, 0, 1, &zero,
						   &step[s].off);
		if (step[s].slot < 0)
			continue;
		const uint32_t slot = (uint32_t)step[s].slot;
		vkCmdPushConstants(cb, LB, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, 4, &slot);
		vkCmdDispatch(cb, 1, 1, 1);
	}
	VkMemoryBarrier mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT,
			      .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT};
	vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, NULL, 0,
			     NULL);
	CHECK(vkEndCommandBuffer(cb));
	VkFenceCreateInfo fci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO};
	VkFence fence;
	CHECK(vkCreateFence(device, &fci, NULL, &fence));
	VkSubmitInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO, .commandBufferCount = 1, .pCommandBuffers = &cb};
	CHECK(vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &si, fence));
	CHECK(vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull));
	CHECK(vkDeviceWaitIdle(device));

	const uint32_t *res = R.map, want[4] = {111, 222, 111, 222};
	const char *what[4] = {"R1", "R2 after an empty-layout call at R2", "R1 (control)", "R2 (control)"};
	int bad = 0;
	for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
		printf("  result[%d] = %3u, want %u (%s)%s\n", k, res[k], want[k], what[k],
		       res[k] == want[k] ? "" : "  <-- WRONG");
		bad += res[k] != want[k];
	}
	printf(bad ? "FAIL: the set offset given with an empty set layout was not reloaded (mesa patch 0109)\n"
		   : "PASS\n");
	return bad ? 1 : 0;
}
