// vk_smoke: loads Mesa's libvulkan_intel.dylib directly (no Vulkan loader) and runs the smallest Vulkan flow on the
// B580: instance, physical device, device, host-visible memory, a buffer, an empty command buffer submitted with a fence.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
//
//   build: tests/build.sh
//   run:   XEMAC_FAKE=1 [XEMAC_TRACE=1] tests/vk_smoke [path/to/libvulkan_intel.dylib [queue family]]

#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa;

#define CHECK(call)                                                                       \
	do {                                                                              \
		VkResult r_ = (call);                                                     \
		printf("%-60s %s\n", #call, r_ == VK_SUCCESS ? "ok" : "FAILED");          \
		if (r_ != VK_SUCCESS) {                                                   \
			printf("  -> VkResult %d\n", r_);                                 \
			exit(1);                                                          \
		}                                                                         \
	} while (0)

#define IFN(name) PFN_##name name = (PFN_##name)gipa(instance, #name)
#define DFN(name) PFN_##name name = (PFN_##name)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(device, #name)

static const char *heap_flags(VkMemoryHeapFlags f)
{
	return f & VK_MEMORY_HEAP_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT ? "DEVICE_LOCAL" : "-";
}

static void type_flags(VkMemoryPropertyFlags f, char *buf)
{
	buf[0] = 0;
	if (f & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) strcat(buf, "DEVICE_LOCAL ");
	if (f & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT) strcat(buf, "HOST_VISIBLE ");
	if (f & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT) strcat(buf, "HOST_COHERENT ");
	if (f & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_CACHED_BIT) strcat(buf, "HOST_CACHED ");
	if (!buf[0]) strcat(buf, "-");
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	const char *path = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "../../../mesa/build/src/intel/vulkan/libvulkan_intel.dylib";
	void *lib = dlopen(path, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
	if (!lib) {
		printf("dlopen: %s\n", dlerror());
		return 1;
	}
	gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(lib, "vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr");
	if (!gipa) {
		printf("no vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr\n");
		return 1;
	}
	VkInstance instance = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
	IFN(vkCreateInstance);
	IFN(vkEnumerateInstanceVersion);
	uint32_t api = 0;
	vkEnumerateInstanceVersion(&api);
	printf("ICD instance version %u.%u.%u\n", VK_VERSION_MAJOR(api), VK_VERSION_MINOR(api), VK_VERSION_PATCH(api));

	VkApplicationInfo app = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, .pApplicationName = "vk_smoke",
				 .apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3};
	VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, .pApplicationInfo = &app};
	CHECK(vkCreateInstance(&ici, NULL, &instance));

	IFN(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices);
	IFN(vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties);
	IFN(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties);
	IFN(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties);
	IFN(vkCreateDevice);
	IFN(vkGetDeviceProcAddr);
	IFN(vkDestroyInstance);

	uint32_t n = 0;
	CHECK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &n, NULL));
	printf("physical devices: %u\n", n);
	if (!n)
		return 1;
	VkPhysicalDevice pd;
	n = 1;
	CHECK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &n, &pd));

	VkPhysicalDeviceProperties p;
	vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(pd, &p);
	printf("  name        %s\n  ids         %04x:%04x type %d\n  api         %u.%u.%u driver 0x%x\n",
	       p.deviceName, p.vendorID, p.deviceID, p.deviceType, VK_VERSION_MAJOR(p.apiVersion),
	       VK_VERSION_MINOR(p.apiVersion), VK_VERSION_PATCH(p.apiVersion), p.driverVersion);
	printf("  limits      maxImageDimension2D %u, maxComputeWorkGroupInvocations %u, timestampPeriod %.3f ns\n",
	       p.limits.maxImageDimension2D, p.limits.maxComputeWorkGroupInvocations, p.limits.timestampPeriod);

	VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp;
	vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(pd, &mp);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryHeapCount; i++)
		printf("  heap %u      %" PRIu64 " MB %s\n", i, mp.memoryHeaps[i].size >> 20,
		       heap_flags(mp.memoryHeaps[i].flags));
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryTypeCount; i++) {
		char buf[96];
		type_flags(mp.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags, buf);
		printf("  type %u      heap %u %s\n", i, mp.memoryTypes[i].heapIndex, buf);
	}

	VkQueueFamilyProperties qf[8];
	n = 8;
	vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(pd, &n, qf);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
		printf("  queue fam %u flags 0x%x count %u timestampValidBits %u\n", i, qf[i].queueFlags,
		       qf[i].queueCount, qf[i].timestampValidBits);

	uint32_t family = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 0;
	printf("using queue family %u\n", family);
	float prio = 1.0f;
	VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO, .queueFamilyIndex = family,
				       .queueCount = 1, .pQueuePriorities = &prio};
	VkDeviceCreateInfo dci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO, .queueCreateInfoCount = 1,
				  .pQueueCreateInfos = &qci};
	VkDevice device;
	CHECK(vkCreateDevice(pd, &dci, NULL, &device));

	DFN(vkGetDeviceQueue);
	DFN(vkAllocateMemory);
	DFN(vkMapMemory);
	DFN(vkUnmapMemory);
	DFN(vkFreeMemory);
	DFN(vkCreateBuffer);
	DFN(vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements);
	DFN(vkBindBufferMemory);
	DFN(vkDestroyBuffer);
	DFN(vkCreateCommandPool);
	DFN(vkAllocateCommandBuffers);
	DFN(vkBeginCommandBuffer);
	DFN(vkEndCommandBuffer);
	DFN(vkCmdFillBuffer);
	DFN(vkResetFences);
	DFN(vkCreateFence);
	DFN(vkQueueSubmit);
	DFN(vkWaitForFences);
	DFN(vkGetFenceStatus);
	DFN(vkDestroyFence);
	DFN(vkDestroyCommandPool);
	DFN(vkDeviceWaitIdle);
	DFN(vkDestroyDevice);

	VkQueue queue;
	vkGetDeviceQueue(device, family, 0, &queue);

	uint32_t host_type = UINT32_MAX;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryTypeCount && host_type == UINT32_MAX; i++)
		if (mp.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT)
			host_type = i;
	VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = 1 << 20,
				    .memoryTypeIndex = host_type};
	VkDeviceMemory mem;
	CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(device, &mai, NULL, &mem));
	uint32_t *map;
	CHECK(vkMapMemory(device, mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&map));
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++)
		map[i] = i * 2654435761u;
	uint32_t bad = 0;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++)
		bad += map[i] != i * 2654435761u;
	printf("  mapped 1 MB of memory type %u at %p, pattern check: %s\n", host_type, (void *)map,
	       bad ? "MISMATCH" : "ok");
	vkUnmapMemory(device, mem);

	VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = 65536,
				  .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT};
	VkBuffer buf;
	CHECK(vkCreateBuffer(device, &bci, NULL, &buf));
	VkMemoryRequirements req;
	vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(device, buf, &req);
	printf("  buffer requirements: size %" PRIu64 " alignment %" PRIu64 " types 0x%x\n", req.size, req.alignment,
	       req.memoryTypeBits);
	CHECK(vkBindBufferMemory(device, buf, mem, 0));

	VkCommandPoolCreateInfo cpci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .queueFamilyIndex = family};
	VkCommandPool pool;
	CHECK(vkCreateCommandPool(device, &cpci, NULL, &pool));
	VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo cbai = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO, .commandPool = pool,
					    .level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY, .commandBufferCount = 1};
	VkCommandBuffer cb;
	CHECK(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device, &cbai, &cb));
	VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbbi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO};
	CHECK(vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbbi));
	CHECK(vkEndCommandBuffer(cb));

	VkFenceCreateInfo fci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO};
	VkFence fence;
	CHECK(vkCreateFence(device, &fci, NULL, &fence));
	VkSubmitInfo si = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO, .commandBufferCount = 1, .pCommandBuffers = &cb};
	CHECK(vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &si, fence));
	CHECK(vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, 1000000000ull));
	CHECK(vkGetFenceStatus(device, fence));
	CHECK(vkDeviceWaitIdle(device));

	// Second submission with real work: vkCmdFillBuffer goes through blorp and the shader compiler (or MI commands).
	// The fake device does not execute batches, so the buffer contents are not checked.
	VkCommandBuffer cb2;
	CHECK(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device, &cbai, &cb2));
	CHECK(vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb2, &cbbi));
	vkCmdFillBuffer(cb2, buf, 0, 65536, 0xdeadbeef);
	CHECK(vkEndCommandBuffer(cb2));
	CHECK(vkResetFences(device, 1, &fence));
	si.pCommandBuffers = &cb2;
	CHECK(vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &si, fence));
	CHECK(vkWaitForFences(device, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, 1000000000ull));
	if (!getenv("XEMAC_FAKE")) {
		CHECK(vkMapMemory(device, mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&map));   // the first map was released above
		uint32_t good = 0;
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 65536 / 4; i++) good += ((volatile uint32_t *)map)[i] == 0xdeadbeef;
		printf("  vkCmdFillBuffer result: %u/16384 dwords are 0xdeadbeef -> %s\n", good,
			good == 16384 ? "THE GPU EXECUTED VULKAN WORK" : "not written");
	}

	vkDestroyFence(device, fence, NULL);
	vkDestroyCommandPool(device, pool, NULL);
	vkDestroyBuffer(device, buf, NULL);
	vkFreeMemory(device, mem, NULL);
	vkDestroyDevice(device, NULL);
	vkDestroyInstance(instance, NULL);
	printf("done\n");
	return 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/vulkan/vk_videocaps.c
================================================
// vk_videocaps: loads Mesa's libvulkan_intel.dylib directly and prints the video decode capabilities it reports for
// H.264 High, H.265 Main, AV1 Main and VP9 profile 0 (8-bit 4:2:0), then the encode extensions and the encode
// capabilities for H.264 High, H.265 Main/Main10 and AV1 Main. Needs ANV_DEBUG=video-decode (add video-encode for the
// encode part) and, on the B580, sysctl debug.intelxe.video=1 before it starts.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
//
//   run: ANV_DEBUG=video-decode,video-encode tests/vk_videocaps [path/to/libvulkan_intel.dylib]

#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa;
#define IFN(name) PFN_##name name = (PFN_##name)gipa(instance, #name)

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	void *lib = dlopen(argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "libvulkan_intel.dylib", RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
	if (!lib || !(gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(lib, "vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr"))) {
		printf("cannot load the ICD: %s\n", dlerror());
		return 1;
	}
	VkInstance instance = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
	IFN(vkCreateInstance);
	VkApplicationInfo app = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, .pApplicationName = "vk_videocaps",
				 .apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3};
	VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, .pApplicationInfo = &app};
	if (vkCreateInstance(&ici, NULL, &instance)) return 1;
	IFN(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices);
	IFN(vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR);
	IFN(vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatPropertiesKHR);
	VkPhysicalDevice pd;
	uint32_t n = 1;
	if (vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(instance, &n, &pd) || !n) return 1;
	if (!vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR) { printf("no VK_KHR_video_queue\n"); return 1; }
	{	// the decode extensions the device exposes (H.265 only with has_huc), and the video queue family
		IFN(vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties);
		IFN(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties);
		VkExtensionProperties ext[400];
		uint32_t ne = 400;
		vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(pd, NULL, &ne, ext);
		printf("decode extensions:");
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ne; i++)
			if (strstr(ext[i].extensionName, "video_decode")) printf(" %s", ext[i].extensionName);
		VkQueueFamilyProperties qf[8];
		uint32_t nq = 8;
		vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(pd, &nq, qf);
		printf("\nencode extensions:");
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ne; i++)
			if (strstr(ext[i].extensionName, "video_encode")) printf(" %s", ext[i].extensionName);
		printf("\nqueue families:");
		VkQueueFamilyProperties2 qf2[8];
		VkQueueFamilyVideoPropertiesKHR qv[8];
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
			qv[i] = (VkQueueFamilyVideoPropertiesKHR){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUEUE_FAMILY_VIDEO_PROPERTIES_KHR};
			qf2[i] = (VkQueueFamilyProperties2){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUEUE_FAMILY_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &qv[i]};
		}
		IFN(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties2);
		uint32_t nq2 = 8;
		if (vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties2) vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties2(pd, &nq2, qf2);
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nq; i++)
			printf(" [%u] flags 0x%x x%u codecs 0x%x", i, qf[i].queueFlags, qf[i].queueCount,
			       i < nq2 ? qv[i].videoCodecOperations : 0);
		printf("\n");
	}

	VkVideoDecodeH264ProfileInfoKHR h264 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_H264_PROFILE_INFO_KHR,
		.stdProfileIdc = STD_VIDEO_H264_PROFILE_IDC_HIGH, .pictureLayout = VK_VIDEO_DECODE_H264_PICTURE_LAYOUT_PROGRESSIVE_KHR};
	VkVideoDecodeH265ProfileInfoKHR h265 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_H265_PROFILE_INFO_KHR,
		.stdProfileIdc = STD_VIDEO_H265_PROFILE_IDC_MAIN};
	VkVideoDecodeAV1ProfileInfoKHR av1 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_AV1_PROFILE_INFO_KHR,
		.stdProfile = STD_VIDEO_AV1_PROFILE_MAIN};
	VkVideoDecodeVP9ProfileInfoKHR vp9 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_VP9_PROFILE_INFO_KHR,
		.stdProfile = STD_VIDEO_VP9_PROFILE_0};
	struct { const char *name; VkVideoCodecOperationFlagBitsKHR op; const void *ext; } codecs[] = {
		{"H.264 High", VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_H264_BIT_KHR, &h264},
		{"H.265 Main", VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_H265_BIT_KHR, &h265},
		{"AV1 Main", VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_AV1_BIT_KHR, &av1},
		{"VP9 Profile 0", VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_DECODE_VP9_BIT_KHR, &vp9},
	};
	for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(codecs) / sizeof(codecs[0]); i++) {
		VkVideoProfileInfoKHR prof = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_PROFILE_INFO_KHR, .pNext = codecs[i].ext,
			.videoCodecOperation = codecs[i].op, .chromaSubsampling = VK_VIDEO_CHROMA_SUBSAMPLING_420_BIT_KHR,
			.lumaBitDepth = VK_VIDEO_COMPONENT_BIT_DEPTH_8_BIT_KHR, .chromaBitDepth = VK_VIDEO_COMPONENT_BIT_DEPTH_8_BIT_KHR};
		VkVideoDecodeCapabilitiesKHR dec = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_CAPABILITIES_KHR};
		VkVideoCapabilitiesKHR caps = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPABILITIES_KHR, .pNext = &dec};
		// codec-specific capability structs (required by the spec in the chain)
		VkVideoDecodeH264CapabilitiesKHR c264 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_H264_CAPABILITIES_KHR};
		VkVideoDecodeH265CapabilitiesKHR c265 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_H265_CAPABILITIES_KHR};
		VkVideoDecodeAV1CapabilitiesKHR cav1 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_AV1_CAPABILITIES_KHR};
		VkVideoDecodeVP9CapabilitiesKHR cvp9 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_DECODE_VP9_CAPABILITIES_KHR};
		dec.pNext = i == 0 ? (void *)&c264 : i == 1 ? (void *)&c265 : i == 2 ? (void *)&cav1 : (void *)&cvp9;
		VkResult r = vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR(pd, &prof, &caps);
		if (r) { printf("%-14s not supported (VkResult %d)\n", codecs[i].name, r); continue; }
		printf("%-14s max %ux%u, min %ux%u, DPB slots %u, active refs %u, decode flags 0x%x\n", codecs[i].name,
		       caps.maxCodedExtent.width, caps.maxCodedExtent.height, caps.minCodedExtent.width, caps.minCodedExtent.height,
		       caps.maxDpbSlots, caps.maxActiveReferencePictures, dec.flags);
		VkVideoProfileListInfoKHR list = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_PROFILE_LIST_INFO_KHR, .profileCount = 1, .pProfiles = &prof};
		VkPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatInfoKHR fi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VIDEO_FORMAT_INFO_KHR, .pNext = &list,
			.imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_DST_BIT_KHR};
		uint32_t nf = 0;
		if (!vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatPropertiesKHR(pd, &fi, &nf, NULL) && nf) {
			VkVideoFormatPropertiesKHR fp[8];
			for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 8; k++) fp[k] = (VkVideoFormatPropertiesKHR){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_FORMAT_PROPERTIES_KHR};
			if (nf > 8) nf = 8;
			vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatPropertiesKHR(pd, &fi, &nf, fp);
			printf("               output formats:");
			for (uint32_t k = 0; k < nf; k++) printf(" %d", fp[k].format);
			printf("\n");
		}
	}
	// encode: H.264 High, H.265 Main, H.265 Main10 (P010), AV1 Main
	VkVideoEncodeH264ProfileInfoKHR e264 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_ENCODE_H264_PROFILE_INFO_KHR,
		.stdProfileIdc = STD_VIDEO_H264_PROFILE_IDC_HIGH};
	VkVideoEncodeH265ProfileInfoKHR e265 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_ENCODE_H265_PROFILE_INFO_KHR,
		.stdProfileIdc = STD_VIDEO_H265_PROFILE_IDC_MAIN};
	VkVideoEncodeH265ProfileInfoKHR e265_10 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_ENCODE_H265_PROFILE_INFO_KHR,
		.stdProfileIdc = STD_VIDEO_H265_PROFILE_IDC_MAIN_10};
	VkVideoEncodeAV1ProfileInfoKHR eav1 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_ENCODE_AV1_PROFILE_INFO_KHR,
		.stdProfile = STD_VIDEO_AV1_PROFILE_MAIN};
	struct { const char *name; VkVideoCodecOperationFlagBitsKHR op; const void *ext; VkVideoComponentBitDepthFlagsKHR depth; } ecodecs[] = {
		{"enc H.264 High", VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_ENCODE_H264_BIT_KHR, &e264, VK_VIDEO_COMPONENT_BIT_DEPTH_8_BIT_KHR},
		{"enc H.265 Main", VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_ENCODE_H265_BIT_KHR, &e265, VK_VIDEO_COMPONENT_BIT_DEPTH_8_BIT_KHR},
		{"enc H.265 M10", VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_ENCODE_H265_BIT_KHR, &e265_10, VK_VIDEO_COMPONENT_BIT_DEPTH_10_BIT_KHR},
		{"enc AV1 Main", VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_ENCODE_AV1_BIT_KHR, &eav1, VK_VIDEO_COMPONENT_BIT_DEPTH_8_BIT_KHR},
	};
	for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof(ecodecs) / sizeof(ecodecs[0]); i++) {
		VkVideoProfileInfoKHR prof = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_PROFILE_INFO_KHR, .pNext = ecodecs[i].ext,
			.videoCodecOperation = ecodecs[i].op, .chromaSubsampling = VK_VIDEO_CHROMA_SUBSAMPLING_420_BIT_KHR,
			.lumaBitDepth = ecodecs[i].depth, .chromaBitDepth = ecodecs[i].depth};
		VkVideoEncodeCapabilitiesKHR enc = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_ENCODE_CAPABILITIES_KHR};
		VkVideoCapabilitiesKHR caps = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPABILITIES_KHR, .pNext = &enc};
		VkVideoEncodeH264CapabilitiesKHR c264 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_ENCODE_H264_CAPABILITIES_KHR};
		VkVideoEncodeH265CapabilitiesKHR c265 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_ENCODE_H265_CAPABILITIES_KHR};
		VkVideoEncodeAV1CapabilitiesKHR cav1 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_ENCODE_AV1_CAPABILITIES_KHR};
		enc.pNext = ecodecs[i].op == VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_ENCODE_H264_BIT_KHR ? (void *)&c264 :
			    ecodecs[i].op == VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_ENCODE_H265_BIT_KHR ? (void *)&c265 : (void *)&cav1;
		VkResult r = vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoCapabilitiesKHR(pd, &prof, &caps);
		if (r) { printf("%-14s not supported (VkResult %d)\n", ecodecs[i].name, r); continue; }
		printf("%-14s max %ux%u, min %ux%u, DPB slots %u, active refs %u\n", ecodecs[i].name,
		       caps.maxCodedExtent.width, caps.maxCodedExtent.height, caps.minCodedExtent.width, caps.minCodedExtent.height,
		       caps.maxDpbSlots, caps.maxActiveReferencePictures);
		printf("               rc modes 0x%x, max layers %u, max bitrate %llu, quality levels %u, feedback 0x%x, flags 0x%x\n",
		       enc.rateControlModes, enc.maxRateControlLayers, (unsigned long long)enc.maxBitrate, enc.maxQualityLevels,
		       enc.supportedEncodeFeedbackFlags, enc.flags);
		if (ecodecs[i].op == VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_ENCODE_H264_BIT_KHR)
			printf("               h264 max level %d, slices %u, P refs %u, B refs %u/%u, QP %d..%d\n", c264.maxLevelIdc,
			       c264.maxSliceCount, c264.maxPPictureL0ReferenceCount, c264.maxBPictureL0ReferenceCount,
			       c264.maxL1ReferenceCount, c264.minQp, c264.maxQp);
		else if (ecodecs[i].op == VK_VIDEO_CODEC_OPERATION_ENCODE_H265_BIT_KHR)
			printf("               h265 max level %d, slice segs %u, P refs %u, B refs %u/%u, QP %d..%d, CTB 0x%x\n",
			       c265.maxLevelIdc, c265.maxSliceSegmentCount, c265.maxPPictureL0ReferenceCount,
			       c265.maxBPictureL0ReferenceCount, c265.maxL1ReferenceCount, c265.minQp, c265.maxQp, c265.ctbSizes);
		VkVideoProfileListInfoKHR list = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_PROFILE_LIST_INFO_KHR, .profileCount = 1, .pProfiles = &prof};
		VkPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatInfoKHR fi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VIDEO_FORMAT_INFO_KHR, .pNext = &list,
			.imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_ENCODE_SRC_BIT_KHR};
		uint32_t nf = 0;
		if (!vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatPropertiesKHR(pd, &fi, &nf, NULL) && nf) {
			VkVideoFormatPropertiesKHR fp[8];
			for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 8; k++) fp[k] = (VkVideoFormatPropertiesKHR){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_VIDEO_FORMAT_PROPERTIES_KHR};
			if (nf > 8) nf = 8;
			vkGetPhysicalDeviceVideoFormatPropertiesKHR(pd, &fi, &nf, fp);
			printf("               input formats:");
			for (uint32_t k = 0; k < nf; k++) printf(" %d", fp[k].format);
			printf("\n");
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/vulkan/vkcaps.c

// vkcaps: what the installed ANV (libvulkan_intel.dylib, loaded directly as an ICD) offers against what DXVK and
// vkd3d-proton ask for. Measurement only. clang -arch x86_64 -O1 -I<mesa>/include -o vkcaps vkcaps.c
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa;
#define IP(i, n) ((PFN_##n)gipa(i, #n))

static const char *want_dev[] = {
    // DXVK 2.x/3.x required
    "VK_KHR_swapchain", "VK_EXT_robustness2", "VK_EXT_transform_feedback", "VK_EXT_extended_dynamic_state3",
    "VK_KHR_pipeline_library", "VK_EXT_graphics_pipeline_library", "VK_EXT_custom_border_color", "VK_EXT_depth_clip_enable",
    "VK_EXT_vertex_attribute_divisor", "VK_KHR_maintenance5", "VK_EXT_shader_demote_to_helper_invocation",
    "VK_EXT_descriptor_buffer", "VK_EXT_memory_priority", "VK_EXT_memory_budget", "VK_KHR_present_id", "VK_KHR_present_wait",
    "VK_EXT_swapchain_maintenance1", "VK_EXT_line_rasterization", "VK_EXT_conservative_rasterization",
    "VK_EXT_non_seamless_cube_map", "VK_EXT_attachment_feedback_loop_layout", "VK_EXT_shader_module_identifier",
    "VK_KHR_external_memory_fd", "VK_KHR_external_semaphore_fd", "VK_EXT_external_memory_host",
    // vkd3d-proton
    "VK_KHR_buffer_device_address", "VK_EXT_mutable_descriptor_type", "VK_KHR_timeline_semaphore", "VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering",
    "VK_KHR_synchronization2", "VK_KHR_shader_float16_int8", "VK_EXT_shader_viewport_index_layer", "VK_KHR_fragment_shading_rate",
    "VK_EXT_mesh_shader", "VK_KHR_ray_tracing_pipeline", "VK_KHR_ray_query", "VK_KHR_acceleration_structure",
    "VK_EXT_image_view_min_lod", "VK_KHR_shader_integer_dot_product", "VK_KHR_maintenance4", "VK_EXT_device_generated_commands",
    "VK_KHR_cooperative_matrix", "VK_EXT_shader_object", "VK_KHR_present_id2", "VK_KHR_present_wait2", NULL };

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    const char *lib = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib";
    void *h = dlopen(lib, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
    if (!h) { printf("dlopen %s: %s\n", lib, dlerror()); return 1; }
    gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(h, "vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr");
    if (!gipa) { printf("no vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr\n"); return 1; }
    uint32_t n = 0;
    PFN_vkEnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties eie = IP(NULL, vkEnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties);
    eie(NULL, &n, NULL); VkExtensionProperties *ie = calloc(n, sizeof *ie); eie(NULL, &n, ie);
    printf("instance extensions (%u):", n); for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) printf(" %s", ie[i].extensionName); printf("\n");
    VkApplicationInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, NULL, "vkcaps", 1, NULL, 0, VK_API_VERSION_1_4 };
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, NULL, 0, &ai, 0, NULL, 0, NULL };
    VkInstance inst; VkResult r = IP(NULL, vkCreateInstance)(&ici, NULL, &inst);
    if (r) { printf("vkCreateInstance %d\n", r); return 1; }
    uint32_t pc = 0; IP(inst, vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices)(inst, &pc, NULL);
    VkPhysicalDevice pd[4]; pc = pc > 4 ? 4 : pc; IP(inst, vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices)(inst, &pc, pd);
    if (!pc) { printf("no physical device\n"); return 1; }
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties pp; IP(inst, vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties)(pd[0], &pp);
    printf("device: %s, API %u.%u.%u, driver 0x%x\n", pp.deviceName, VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(pp.apiVersion),
           VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(pp.apiVersion), VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(pp.apiVersion), pp.driverVersion);
    PFN_vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties ede = IP(inst, vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties);
    ede(pd[0], NULL, &n, NULL); VkExtensionProperties *de = calloc(n, sizeof *de); ede(pd[0], NULL, &n, de);
    printf("device extensions: %u\n", n);
    for (const char **w = want_dev; *w; w++) {
        int have = 0; for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!strcmp(de[i].extensionName, *w)) have = 1;
        printf("  %-48s %s\n", *w, have ? "yes" : "NO");
    }
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures f; IP(inst, vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures)(pd[0], &f);
    printf("features: geometryShader %u tessellationShader %u sparseBinding %u sparseResidencyBuffer %u sparseResidencyImage2D %u "
           "sparseResidencyImage3D %u sparseResidencyAliased %u shaderResourceResidency %u multiDrawIndirect %u depthBounds %u "
           "pipelineStatisticsQuery %u shaderFloat64 %u shaderInt64 %u textureCompressionBC %u variableMultisampleRate %u\n",
           f.geometryShader, f.tessellationShader, f.sparseBinding, f.sparseResidencyBuffer, f.sparseResidencyImage2D,
           f.sparseResidencyImage3D, f.sparseResidencyAliased, f.shaderResourceResidency, f.multiDrawIndirect, f.depthBounds,
           f.pipelineStatisticsQuery, f.shaderFloat64, f.shaderInt64, f.textureCompressionBC, f.variableMultisampleRate);
    printf("all device extensions:"); for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) printf(" %s", de[i].extensionName); printf("\n");
    return 0;
}



================================================
FILE: user/tests/vulkan/vkfence_lat.c
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vkfence_lat: completion latency of a tiny Vulkan submission, ANV loaded directly as an ICD (like vkcaps.c), to compare
// ANV's user-fence completion (ANV_UFENCE=1, mesa/patches/0104) against the plain syncobj wait. Each iteration submits
// one tiny command buffer and waits for it; it prints p50/p90/p99/min/max of vkQueueSubmit -> wait returned, and of the
// vkQueueSubmit call alone, in microseconds. Measurement only.
//   clang -arch x86_64 -O2 -I<mesa>/include -o vkfence_lat vkfence_lat.c
//   ./vkfence_lat [libvulkan_intel.dylib] [mode] [iterations] [queue family]
// modes:
//   empty     an empty command buffer, vkWaitForFences (infinite timeout)
//   fill      vkCmdFillBuffer of 4 bytes (the iteration number) into host-visible VRAM + a barrier to HOST, fence wait;
//             after the wait the CPU checks the value (counts mismatches: memory ordering of the fast path)
//   fillsys   the same into host-visible system memory
//   poll      fill, then vkGetFenceStatus in a loop instead of a blocking wait
//   timeline  fill signalling a timeline semaphore (value = iteration), vkWaitSemaphores
//   behind    two submissions in flight, timeline: wait for the older while the newer runs (DXVK's fence thread)
// The default library is the installed one; queue family 0 is the render queue on ANV.
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#define VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa;
static PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr gdpa;
static VkInstance inst;
static VkDevice dev;
#define IP(n) ((PFN_##n)gipa(inst, #n))
#define DP(n) ((PFN_##n)gdpa(dev, #n))
#define CHECK(x) do { VkResult r_ = (x); if (r_ != VK_SUCCESS) { printf("%s:%d %s = %d\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #x, r_); exit(1); } } while (0)

static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb;
static double us(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return (double)(b - a) * tb.numer / tb.denom / 1000.0; }
static int cmpd(const void *a, const void *b) { double x = *(const double *)a, y = *(const double *)b; return x < y ? -1 : x > y; }
static void stats(const char *what, double *v, int n) {
    qsort(v, n, sizeof *v, cmpd);
    printf("  %-26s p50 %7.1f  p90 %7.1f  p99 %7.1f  min %7.1f  max %8.1f us\n", what, v[n / 2], v[n * 9 / 10], v[n * 99 / 100],
           v[0], v[n - 1]);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    const char *lib = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib";
    const char *mode = argc > 2 ? argv[2] : "fill";
    const int iters = argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : 2000;
    const uint32_t family = argc > 4 ? (uint32_t)atoi(argv[4]) : 0;
    const int warm = 50;
    mach_timebase_info(&tb);
    if (iters < 10) { printf("iterations >= 10\n"); return 1; }
    void *h = dlopen(lib, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
    if (!h) { printf("dlopen %s: %s\n", lib, dlerror()); return 1; }
    gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(h, "vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr");
    if (!gipa) { printf("no vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr\n"); return 1; }

    VkApplicationInfo ai = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, NULL, "vkfence_lat", 1, NULL, 0, VK_API_VERSION_1_3};
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, NULL, 0, &ai, 0, NULL, 0, NULL};
    CHECK(((PFN_vkCreateInstance)gipa(NULL, "vkCreateInstance"))(&ici, NULL, &inst));
    uint32_t pc = 1; VkPhysicalDevice pd;
    VkResult er = IP(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices)(inst, &pc, &pd);
    if ((er != VK_SUCCESS && er != VK_INCOMPLETE) || !pc) { printf("no physical device\n"); return 1; }
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties pp; IP(vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties)(pd, &pp);
    uint32_t nf = 0; IP(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties)(pd, &nf, NULL);
    VkQueueFamilyProperties qf[16]; nf = nf > 16 ? 16 : nf; IP(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties)(pd, &nf, qf);
    printf("queue families:");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nf; i++)
        printf(" %u:%s%s%s%s", i, qf[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT ? "G" : "", qf[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT ? "C" : "",
               qf[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_TRANSFER_BIT ? "T" : "", qf[i].queueFlags & 0x60 ? "V" : "");
    printf("\n");
    if (family >= nf) { printf("queue family %u of %u\n", family, nf); return 1; }

    VkPhysicalDeviceTimelineSemaphoreFeatures tsf = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TIMELINE_SEMAPHORE_FEATURES, NULL, VK_TRUE};
    float prio = 1.0f;
    VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO, NULL, 0, family, 1, &prio};
    VkDeviceCreateInfo dci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO, &tsf, 0, 1, &qci, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL};
    CHECK(IP(vkCreateDevice)(pd, &dci, NULL, &dev));
    gdpa = (PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr)gipa(inst, "vkGetDeviceProcAddr");
    VkQueue q; DP(vkGetDeviceQueue)(dev, family, 0, &q);

    // the target of the fill: host-visible + coherent, device-local (BAR VRAM) unless fillsys
    const int sys = !strcmp(mode, "fillsys");
    VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp; IP(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties)(pd, &mp);
    VkBufferCreateInfo bci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, NULL, 0, 4096, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT,
                              VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE, 0, NULL};
    VkBuffer buf; CHECK(DP(vkCreateBuffer)(dev, &bci, NULL, &buf));
    VkMemoryRequirements mr; DP(vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements)(dev, buf, &mr);
    const VkMemoryPropertyFlags want = VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT |
                                       (sys ? 0 : VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
    uint32_t mt = UINT32_MAX;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < mp.memoryTypeCount && mt == UINT32_MAX; i++) {
        const VkMemoryPropertyFlags f = mp.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags;
        if ((mr.memoryTypeBits & (1u << i)) && (f & want) == want && (!sys || !(f & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT)))
            mt = i;
    }
    if (mt == UINT32_MAX) { printf("no memory type for %s\n", sys ? "system memory" : "host-visible VRAM"); return 1; }
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo mai = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, NULL, mr.size, mt};
    VkDeviceMemory mem; CHECK(DP(vkAllocateMemory)(dev, &mai, NULL, &mem));
    CHECK(DP(vkBindBufferMemory)(dev, buf, mem, 0));
    volatile uint32_t *map; CHECK(DP(vkMapMemory)(dev, mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&map));
    map[0] = 0xffffffffu; map[1] = 0xffffffffu;

    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo cpci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO, NULL,
                                    VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT, family};
    VkCommandPool pool; CHECK(DP(vkCreateCommandPool)(dev, &cpci, NULL, &pool));
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo cbai = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO, NULL, pool,
                                        VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY, 2};
    VkCommandBuffer cb[2]; CHECK(DP(vkAllocateCommandBuffers)(dev, &cbai, cb));
    PFN_vkBeginCommandBuffer begin = DP(vkBeginCommandBuffer);
    PFN_vkEndCommandBuffer end = DP(vkEndCommandBuffer);
    PFN_vkCmdFillBuffer fill = DP(vkCmdFillBuffer);
    PFN_vkCmdPipelineBarrier barrier = DP(vkCmdPipelineBarrier);
    PFN_vkQueueSubmit submit = DP(vkQueueSubmit);
    PFN_vkWaitForFences waitf = DP(vkWaitForFences);
    PFN_vkResetFences resetf = DP(vkResetFences);
    PFN_vkGetFenceStatus statusf = DP(vkGetFenceStatus);
    PFN_vkWaitSemaphores waits = DP(vkWaitSemaphores);
    PFN_vkResetCommandBuffer resetcb = DP(vkResetCommandBuffer);

    VkFenceCreateInfo fci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO, NULL, 0};
    VkFence fence; CHECK(DP(vkCreateFence)(dev, &fci, NULL, &fence));
    VkSemaphoreTypeCreateInfo stci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_TYPE_CREATE_INFO, NULL, VK_SEMAPHORE_TYPE_TIMELINE, 0};
    VkSemaphoreCreateInfo sci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO, &stci, 0};
    VkSemaphore tl; CHECK(DP(vkCreateSemaphore)(dev, &sci, NULL, &tl));

    const int empty = !strcmp(mode, "empty"), poll = !strcmp(mode, "poll"), timeline = !strcmp(mode, "timeline"),
              behind = !strcmp(mode, "behind");
    if (!empty && !poll && !timeline && !behind && strcmp(mode, "fill") && !sys) { printf("unknown mode %s\n", mode); return 1; }
    const char *uf = getenv("ANV_UFENCE"), *spin = getenv("ANV_UFENCE_SPIN_US");
    printf("vkfence_lat: %s, %s, family %u, mode %s, %d iterations, ANV_UFENCE=%s ANV_UFENCE_SPIN_US=%s\n", pp.deviceName, lib,
           family, mode, iters, uf ? uf : "(unset)", spin ? spin : "(unset)");

    // record: fill the iteration number (each command buffer is re-recorded with its value) + barrier to HOST
    const VkMemoryBarrier mb = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, NULL, VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT};
    const VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbbi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO, NULL,
                                           VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT, NULL};
#define RECORD(c, value, slot) do { \
        CHECK(resetcb((c), 0)); CHECK(begin((c), &cbbi)); \
        if (!empty) { fill((c), buf, (slot) * 4, 4, (value)); \
            barrier((c), VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, NULL, 0, NULL); } \
        CHECK(end((c))); } while (0)

    double *lat = calloc(iters, sizeof *lat), *sub = calloc(iters, sizeof *sub);
    int mismatches = 0;
    uint64_t value = 0;
    if (behind) {
        // keep one submission ahead: submit k+1, then wait for k (older), as a fence thread does
        RECORD(cb[1], 1, 1);
        VkTimelineSemaphoreSubmitInfo ts = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_TIMELINE_SEMAPHORE_SUBMIT_INFO, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &value};
        VkSubmitInfo si = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO, &ts, 0, NULL, NULL, 1, &cb[1], 1, &tl};
        value = 1; CHECK(submit(q, 1, &si, VK_NULL_HANDLE));
        uint64_t t_prev = mach_absolute_time();
        for (int i = 0; i < iters + warm; i++) {
            const uint64_t v = value + 1; const VkCommandBuffer c = cb[v & 1];
            RECORD(c, (uint32_t)v, (uint32_t)(v & 1));
            value = v;
            si.pCommandBuffers = &cb[v & 1];
            const uint64_t t0 = mach_absolute_time();
            CHECK(submit(q, 1, &si, VK_NULL_HANDLE));
            const uint64_t t1 = mach_absolute_time();
            const uint64_t older = v - 1;
            VkSemaphoreWaitInfo wi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_INFO, NULL, 0, 1, &tl, &older};
            CHECK(waits(dev, &wi, UINT64_MAX));
            const uint64_t t2 = mach_absolute_time();
            if (map[older & 1] != (uint32_t)older) mismatches++;
            if (i >= warm) { lat[i - warm] = us(t_prev, t2); sub[i - warm] = us(t0, t1); }
            t_prev = t0;   // the older one was submitted one iteration ago
        }
        VkSemaphoreWaitInfo wi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_INFO, NULL, 0, 1, &tl, &value};
        CHECK(waits(dev, &wi, UINT64_MAX));
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < iters + warm; i++) {
            const uint32_t v = (uint32_t)i + 1;
            RECORD(cb[0], v, 0);
            value++;
            VkTimelineSemaphoreSubmitInfo ts = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_TIMELINE_SEMAPHORE_SUBMIT_INFO, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &value};
            VkSubmitInfo si = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO, timeline ? &ts : NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, 1, &cb[0],
                               timeline ? 1 : 0, timeline ? &tl : NULL};
            const uint64_t t0 = mach_absolute_time();
            CHECK(submit(q, 1, &si, timeline ? VK_NULL_HANDLE : fence));
            const uint64_t t1 = mach_absolute_time();
            if (timeline) {
                VkSemaphoreWaitInfo wi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_WAIT_INFO, NULL, 0, 1, &tl, &value};
                CHECK(waits(dev, &wi, UINT64_MAX));
            } else if (poll) {
                VkResult r;
                while ((r = statusf(dev, fence)) == VK_NOT_READY) ;
                CHECK(r);
            } else {
                CHECK(waitf(dev, 1, &fence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX));
            }
            const uint64_t t2 = mach_absolute_time();
            if (!empty && map[0] != v) mismatches++;
            if (!timeline) CHECK(resetf(dev, 1, &fence));
            if (i >= warm) { lat[i - warm] = us(t0, t2); sub[i - warm] = us(t0, t1); }
        }
    }
    stats(behind ? "older submit -> wait ret" : "submit -> wait returned", lat, iters);
    stats("vkQueueSubmit call", sub, iters);
    printf("  value mismatches after the wait: %d%s\n", mismatches, empty ? " (not checked: empty)" : "");
    DP(vkDeviceWaitIdle)(dev);
    DP(vkDestroySemaphore)(dev, tl, NULL);
    DP(vkDestroyFence)(dev, fence, NULL);
    DP(vkDestroyCommandPool)(dev, pool, NULL);
    DP(vkUnmapMemory)(dev, mem);
    DP(vkFreeMemory)(dev, mem, NULL);
    DP(vkDestroyBuffer)(dev, buf, NULL);
    DP(vkDestroyDevice)(dev, NULL);
    IP(vkDestroyInstance)(inst, NULL);
    return mismatches ? 2 : 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/vulkan/vkfence_lat_night.sh

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# vkfence_lat_night.sh <dir>: the user-fence completion A/B (mesa/patches/0104) on the hackintosh, with the staged ANV
# loaded directly by vkfence_lat (nothing installed). <dir> holds libvulkan_intel.dylib and vkfence_lat (x86_64, built
# on the build Mac). Each run is 2000 tiny submissions (well under 60 s); ANV_UFENCE alternates 0/1/0/1 so a drift in
# clocks shows up as a difference between the two runs of one setting. Output: one block per run, plus the kext's
# direct-submission switch (jobs with a user fence leave direct submission).
D=${1:-$HOME/anv-out}
L=$D/libvulkan_intel.dylib
B=$D/vkfence_lat
[ -x "$B" ] && [ -f "$L" ] || { echo "need $B and $L"; exit 1; }
echo "debug.intelxe.direct=$(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.direct 2>/dev/null || echo '?')  $(date)"
for mode in fill timeline behind empty fillsys; do
	for k in 0 1 0 1; do
		ANV_UFENCE=$k "$B" "$L" "$mode" 2000 || echo "  exit $? (2 = value mismatches)"
	done
done
# the poll budget: 0 = only the check before the kernel wait, 25 us, the default 100 us
for s in 0 25 100; do ANV_UFENCE=1 ANV_UFENCE_SPIN_US=$s "$B" "$L" fill 2000; done
# a compute queue (family 1 on ANV with the B580's CCS: check the printed family list if this errors)
for k in 0 1; do ANV_UFENCE=$k "$B" "$L" fill 2000 1; done

FILE: user/tests/vulkan/vkwin.c
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vkwin: how much of the BAR window (CPU-visible VRAM) an ANV VkDevice and the Metal plugin's descriptor pools take.
// Reads the window use from debug.intelxe.stats ("used N MB (window W MB)") around each step; WindowServer allocates
// meanwhile, so each step is measured a few times and the smallest change is reported.
//   ./vkwin            device, then the plugin's main descriptor pool (nvmtl_desc_pool_open: 4096 sets of 33 storage
//                      buffers, 128 sampled images, 32 samplers, 128 storage images, 1 dynamic UBO), its bindless heap
//                      (131072 sampled images + 2048 samplers, UPDATE_AFTER_BIND) and a fetch pool, then all destroyed.
// The descriptor types stand in for the plugin's mutable ones (ANV sizes a mutable sampled/storage image or texel
// buffer descriptor as one 64-byte surface state, the same as these). Uses ~100 MB of the window for a moment.
// Test only.   clang -arch x86_64 -O2 -I../../mesa/include -o vkwin vkwin.c
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/sysctl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>

static long windowMB(void) {
	char buf[4096];
	size_t l = sizeof(buf);
	if (sysctlbyname("debug.intelxe.stats", buf, &l, NULL, 0)) return -1;
	char *p = strstr(buf, "(window ");
	return p ? strtol(p + 8, NULL, 10) : -1;
}

static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa;
static VkInstance inst;
static VkDevice dev;
#define IP(name) PFN_##name name = (PFN_##name)gipa(inst, #name)

int main(void) {
	void *lib = dlopen("/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib", RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
	if (!lib) { fprintf(stderr, "dlopen: %s\n", dlerror()); return 1; }
	gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(lib, "vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr");
	if (!gipa) { fprintf(stderr, "no vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr\n"); return 1; }
	PFN_vkCreateInstance createInstance = (PFN_vkCreateInstance)gipa(NULL, "vkCreateInstance");
	VkApplicationInfo ai = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, NULL, "vkwin", 1, NULL, 0, VK_API_VERSION_1_3};
	VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, NULL, 0, &ai, 0, NULL, 0, NULL};
	long w0 = windowMB();
	if (createInstance(&ici, NULL, &inst)) { fprintf(stderr, "vkCreateInstance\n"); return 1; }
	IP(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices);
	IP(vkCreateDevice);
	IP(vkGetDeviceProcAddr);
	uint32_t n = 1;
	VkPhysicalDevice pd;
	if (vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(inst, &n, &pd) || !n) { fprintf(stderr, "no physical device\n"); return 1; }
	float prio = 1;
	VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO, NULL, 0, 0, 1, &prio};
	VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features f12 = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES};
	f12.descriptorBindingSampledImageUpdateAfterBind = VK_TRUE;
	f12.descriptorBindingPartiallyBound = VK_TRUE;
	f12.descriptorBindingUpdateUnusedWhilePending = VK_TRUE;
	VkDeviceCreateInfo dci = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO, &f12, 0, 1, &qci, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL};
	long w1 = windowMB();
	if (vkCreateDevice(pd, &dci, NULL, &dev)) { fprintf(stderr, "vkCreateDevice\n"); return 1; }
	usleep(200000);
	long w2 = windowMB();
	printf("window before %ld MB; VkDevice: %+ld MB (instance %+ld)\n", w0, w2 - w1, w1 - w0);
	PFN_vkCreateDescriptorPool createPool = (PFN_vkCreateDescriptorPool)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, "vkCreateDescriptorPool");
	PFN_vkDestroyDescriptorPool destroyPool = (PFN_vkDestroyDescriptorPool)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, "vkDestroyDescriptorPool");
	PFN_vkDestroyDevice destroyDevice = (PFN_vkDestroyDevice)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(dev, "vkDestroyDevice");
	const uint32_t S = 4096;
	VkDescriptorPoolSize mainSizes[5] = {{VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC, S}, {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 33 * S},
		{VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE, 128 * S}, {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER, 32 * S}, {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_IMAGE, 128 * S}};
	VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo mainCi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, NULL,
		VK_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_FREE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_BIT, S, 5, mainSizes};
	VkDescriptorPoolSize heapSizes[2] = {{VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE, 131072}, {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER, 2048}};
	VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo heapCi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, NULL,
		VK_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_UPDATE_AFTER_BIND_BIT, 1, 2, heapSizes};
	VkDescriptorPoolSize fetchSize = {VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT, 8 * 1024};
	VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo fetchCi = {VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, NULL,
		VK_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_FREE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_BIT, 1024, 1, &fetchSize};
	struct { const char *name; VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo *ci; } steps[] = {
		{"main descriptor pool (4096 sets)", &mainCi}, {"bindless heap pool", &heapCi}, {"fetch pool (1024 sets)", &fetchCi}};
	VkDescriptorPool pools[3][3] = {{0}};
	for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++) {
		long best = 1 << 30;
		VkResult r = VK_SUCCESS;
		for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {   // three pools of the kind, each measured on its own
			long a = windowMB();
			r = createPool(dev, steps[s].ci, NULL, &pools[s][k]);
			long b = windowMB();
			if (r) break;
			if (b - a < best) best = b - a;
		}
		if (r) printf("%s: vkCreateDescriptorPool -> %d\n", steps[s].name, r);
		else printf("%s: %+ld MB each (smallest of 3)\n", steps[s].name, best);
	}
	long w3 = windowMB();
	for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++)
		for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
			if (pools[s][k]) destroyPool(dev, pools[s][k], NULL);
	usleep(100000);
	long w4 = windowMB();
	destroyDevice(dev, NULL);
	usleep(200000);
	long w5 = windowMB();
	printf("all pools %ld MB -> destroyed %ld MB -> device destroyed %ld MB (started at %ld)\n", w3, w4, w5, w0);
	return 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vkscene check pass: mode 0 = texel (0,0) of texture[cell] (nonuniform index), 1 = magenta (must lose the depth
// test), 2 = white (must win it)
#version 450
#extension GL_EXT_nonuniform_qualifier : require
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler smp;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform texture2D tex[];
layout(push_constant) uniform PC { layout(offset = 80) int mode; layout(offset = 84) float depth; } pc;
layout(location = 0) flat in uint vCell;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;
void main() {
    if (pc.mode == 1) o = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
    else if (pc.mode == 2) o = vec4(1.0);
    else o = texelFetch(sampler2D(tex[nonuniformEXT(vCell)], smp), ivec2(0, 0), 0);
}

FILE: user/tests/vulkan/vkscene/check.vert
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vkscene check pass: mode 0/1 = an 8x8 grid of cells (instance = cell = texture index), mode 2 = one triangle in
// cell 0 whose long edge cuts pixels (the MSAA resolve must blend there). Depth from the push constants.
#version 450
layout(push_constant) uniform PC { layout(offset = 80) int mode; layout(offset = 84) float depth; } pc;
layout(location = 0) flat out uint vCell;
void main() {
    uint c = gl_InstanceIndex;
    vCell = c;
    if (pc.mode == 2) {
        // pixels of a 256x256 target: (0,0), (31.3,0), (0,31.3); NDC = px / 128 - 1
        vec2 p[3] = vec2[](vec2(0.0, 0.0), vec2(31.3, 0.0), vec2(0.0, 31.3));
        gl_Position = vec4(p[gl_VertexIndex] / 128.0 - 1.0, pc.depth, 1.0);
        return;
    }
    vec2 q[6] = vec2[](vec2(0, 0), vec2(1, 0), vec2(0, 1), vec2(1, 0), vec2(1, 1), vec2(0, 1));
    vec2 cell = vec2(float(c % 8u), float(c / 8u));
    gl_Position = vec4((cell + q[gl_VertexIndex]) / 4.0 - 1.0, pc.depth, 1.0);
}

FILE: user/tests/vulkan/vkscene/gen.sh
================================================
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# gen.sh: compiles the vkscene shaders to SPIR-V (Vulkan 1.3) into spv.h, which is checked in so the build needs no
# shader compiler. Needs glslangValidator (Homebrew's glslang). Run after editing a shader.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
{ echo "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT"; echo "// generated by gen.sh from scene.vert, scene.frag, check.vert, check.frag: do not edit"
  echo "#pragma once"; echo "#include <stdint.h>"; } > "$T/spv.h"
for s in scene.vert scene.frag check.vert check.frag; do
    n=${s/./_}_spv
    glslangValidator -V --target-env vulkan1.3 --vn "$n" -o "$T/$n.h" "$s" >/dev/null
    glslangValidator -V --target-env vulkan1.3 -o "$T/$n.spv" "$s" >/dev/null
    if command -v spirv-val >/dev/null; then spirv-val --target-env vulkan1.3 "$T/$n.spv"; fi
    grep -v -e '^[[:space:]]*//' -e 'pragma once' "$T/$n.h" | sed 's/^const uint32_t/static const uint32_t/' >> "$T/spv.h"
done
mv "$T/spv.h" spv.h
echo "spv.h: $(grep -c 'static const uint32_t' spv.h) modules"

FILE: user/tests/vulkan/vkscene/scene.frag
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vkscene: a bindless texture array (descriptor indexing: runtime array, variable count, partially bound, update
// after bind) indexed per instance with nonuniformEXT
#version 450
#extension GL_EXT_nonuniform_qualifier : require
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler smp;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1) uniform texture2D tex[];
layout(push_constant) uniform PC { mat4 viewproj; vec4 light; } pc;
layout(location = 0) in vec3 vN;
layout(location = 1) in vec2 vUV;
layout(location = 2) flat in uint vTex;
layout(location = 3) in vec4 vTint;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 o;
void main() {
    float d = max(dot(normalize(vN), normalize(pc.light.xyz)), 0.0) * 0.75 + 0.25;
    vec4 c = texture(sampler2D(tex[nonuniformEXT(vTex)], smp), vUV);
    o = vec4(c.rgb * vTint.rgb * d, 1.0);
}

FILE: user/tests/vulkan/vkscene/scene.vert
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vkscene: instanced cubes; per-instance data from a storage buffer (set 1, dynamic offset per frame in flight)
#version 450
layout(location = 0) in vec3 pos;
layout(location = 1) in vec3 nrm;
layout(location = 2) in vec2 uv;
struct Inst { mat4 model; vec4 tint; uint tex; uint pad0, pad1, pad2; };
layout(std430, set = 1, binding = 0) readonly buffer Insts { Inst inst[]; };
layout(push_constant) uniform PC { mat4 viewproj; vec4 light; } pc;
layout(location = 0) out vec3 vN;
layout(location = 1) out vec2 vUV;
layout(location = 2) flat out uint vTex;
layout(location = 3) out vec4 vTint;
void main() {
    Inst i = inst[gl_InstanceIndex];
    gl_Position = pc.viewproj * (i.model * vec4(pos, 1.0));
    vN = mat3(i.model) * nrm;
    vUV = uv;
    vTex = i.tex;
    vTint = i.tint;
}

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# bench.sh <exe> <seconds> <iters list> <icd list> [extra args]: runs inside the GUI session (WineRun.app), one result line per run
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
cd "$INTELXE_HOME/wine"; export WINEPREFIX="$INTELXE_HOME/wine/prefix-bench"  # benches never touch the Steam prefix
EXE=$1; SEC=$2; ITERS=$3; ICDS=$4; shift 4
for icd in $ICDS; do
	for it in $ITERS; do
		ICD=$icd WINEDEBUG=-all ./wenv.sh wine "$EXE" "$SEC" "$it" "$@" > "run-$icd-$it.log" 2>&1
		echo "[$icd] $(grep -E '^(GPU0|adapter)' run-$icd-$it.log | head -1 | cut -c1-90) :: $(grep RESULT run-$icd-$it.log || tail -2 run-$icd-$it.log | tr '\n' ' ')"
		./wenv.sh wineserver -w
	done
done

FILE: user/tests/wine/install-dxvk-vkd3d.sh
================================================
#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Installs DXVK 3.1.1 and vkd3d-proton 3.1 into $WINEPREFIX (default $INTELXE_HOME/wine/prefix), the way their setup scripts do:
# DLLs into system32 (64-bit) / syswow64 (32-bit) and native DllOverrides in the prefix registry. Run under wenv.sh.
#   --undo  puts Wine's builtin DLLs back (wineboot -u restores the files, the overrides are deleted)
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
set -e
B="$INTELXE_HOME/wine"; P="${WINEPREFIX:-$B/prefix}"
DX="$B/dxvk/dxvk-3.1.1"; VK="$B/vkd3d/vkd3d-proton-3.1"
DLLS_DXVK="d3d8 d3d9 d3d10core d3d11 dxgi"; DLLS_VKD3D="d3d12 d3d12core"
if [ "$1" = --undo ]; then
	for d in $DLLS_DXVK $DLLS_VKD3D; do wine reg delete 'HKCU\Software\Wine\DllOverrides' /v $d /f >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done
	wineboot -u; exit 0
fi
for d in $DLLS_DXVK; do
	cp "$DX/x64/$d.dll" "$P/drive_c/windows/system32/$d.dll"
	cp "$DX/x32/$d.dll" "$P/drive_c/windows/syswow64/$d.dll"
	wine reg add 'HKCU\Software\Wine\DllOverrides' /v $d /d native /f >/dev/null
done
for d in $DLLS_VKD3D; do
	cp "$VK/x64/$d.dll" "$P/drive_c/windows/system32/$d.dll"
	cp "$VK/x86/$d.dll" "$P/drive_c/windows/syswow64/$d.dll"
	wine reg add 'HKCU\Software\Wine\DllOverrides' /v $d /d native /f >/dev/null
done
echo "DXVK + vkd3d-proton installed in $P"

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# matrix.sh: the FPS matrix (runs inside the GUI session via WineRun.app). Lines: <label> <RESULT line or failure tail>
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
cd "$INTELXE_HOME/wine"; export WINEPREFIX="$INTELXE_HOME/wine/prefix-bench"  # benches never touch the Steam prefix
SEC=${SEC:-10}; RES="1920 1080"
run() { # label icd overrides exe iters
	label=$1 icd=$2 ovr=$3 exe=$4 it=$5
	rm -f "fps-$label.txt"
	ICD=$icd WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml=;$ovr" MESA_VK_WSI_FPS_LOG="$INTELXE_HOME/wine/fps-$label.txt" WINEDEBUG=-all \
		./wenv.sh wine "$exe" "$SEC" "$it" $RES > "m-$label.log" 2>&1
	shown=$(tail -2 "fps-$label.txt" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
	echo "$label :: $(grep -E '^(GPU0|adapter)' m-$label.log | head -1 | cut -c1-80) :: $(grep RESULT m-$label.log || tail -3 m-$label.log | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-200) :: wsi[$shown]"
	./wenv.sh wineserver -w
}
for it in ${ITERS:-16 512}; do
	run vk-anv-$it anv "" vkbench.exe $it
	run vk-mvk-$it mvk "" vkbench.exe $it
	run d3d11-dxvk-anv-$it anv "" d3d11bench.exe $it
	[ -n "$FULL" ] && run d3d11-dxvk-mvk-$it mvk "" d3d11bench.exe $it
	[ -n "$FULL" ] && run d3d11-wined3d-$it anv "d3d11,dxgi,d3d10core=b" d3d11bench.exe $it
	run d3d12-vkd3dproton-anv-$it anv "" d3d12bench.exe $it
	[ -n "$FULL" ] && run d3d12-winevkd3d-mvk-$it mvk "d3d12,d3d12core,dxgi=b" d3d12bench.exe $it
done
echo MATRIX-DONE

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# wenv.sh: environment for Wine -> winevulkan -> native Mesa ANV (B580). Source it, or: wenv.sh <cmd...>
#   ICD=mvk  -> use the bundled MoltenVK instead (comparison runs)
INTELXE_HOME=${INTELXE_HOME:-$HOME/b580}   # where the B580 tools and test builds live on the test machine
W="$INTELXE_HOME/wine/dist/Wine Devel.app/Contents/Resources/wine"
export PATH="$W/bin:$PATH"
export WINEPREFIX="${WINEPREFIX:-$INTELXE_HOME/wine/prefix}"
export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:--all}"
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="${WINEDLLOVERRIDES:-mscoree,mshtml=}"
if [ "${ICD:-anv}" = mvk ]; then
	export VK_DRIVER_FILES="$W/share/vulkan/icd.d/MoltenVK_icd.json"
else
	export VK_DRIVER_FILES=/usr/local/share/vulkan/icd.d/intel_icd.x86_64.json
fi
export WINE="$W/bin/wine"
[ $# -gt 0 ] && exec "$@"

FILE: user/tests/wine/taskport/tptest.c

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
/* tptest: can this process move its task/thread control port in a mach message? (argv[1]: self|special|thread|threadspecial) */
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	const char *m = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "special";
	mach_port_t rcv, port = MACH_PORT_NULL;
	mach_port_allocate(mach_task_self(), MACH_PORT_RIGHT_RECEIVE, &rcv);
	mach_port_insert_right(mach_task_self(), rcv, rcv, MACH_MSG_TYPE_MAKE_SEND);
	kern_return_t kr = 0;
	if (!strcmp(m, "self")) port = mach_task_self();
	else if (!strcmp(m, "special")) kr = task_get_special_port(mach_task_self(), TASK_KERNEL_PORT, &port);
	else if (!strcmp(m, "thread")) port = mach_thread_self();
	else if (!strcmp(m, "threadspecial")) kr = thread_get_special_port(mach_thread_self(), THREAD_KERNEL_PORT, &port);
	printf("%s: kr=%d port=0x%x self=0x%x\n", m, kr, port, mach_task_self()); fflush(stdout);
	struct { mach_msg_header_t h; mach_msg_body_t b; mach_msg_port_descriptor_t p; } msg = {0};
	msg.h.msgh_bits = MACH_MSGH_BITS(MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND, 0) | MACH_MSGH_BITS_COMPLEX;
	msg.h.msgh_size = sizeof(msg); msg.h.msgh_remote_port = rcv;
	msg.b.msgh_descriptor_count = 1; msg.p.name = port; msg.p.disposition = MACH_MSG_TYPE_COPY_SEND; msg.p.type = MACH_MSG_PORT_DESCRIPTOR;
	kr = mach_msg_send(&msg.h);
	printf("send kr=0x%x\n", kr); fflush(stdout);
	struct { mach_msg_header_t h; mach_msg_body_t b; mach_msg_port_descriptor_t p; mach_msg_trailer_t t; } r = {0};
	kr = mach_msg(&r.h, MACH_RCV_MSG | MACH_RCV_TIMEOUT, 0, sizeof(r), rcv, 100, MACH_PORT_NULL);
	printf("recv kr=0x%x got port 0x%x\n", kr, r.p.name);
	if (!kr) {
		/* use it like wineserver would: read our own memory through the received right */
		vm_offset_t data; mach_msg_type_number_t cnt;
		static const char probe[] = "hello-task-port";
		kr = vm_read(r.p.name, (vm_address_t)probe, sizeof(probe), &data, &cnt);
		printf("vm_read via received port kr=0x%x %s\n", kr, kr ? "" : (char *)data);
	}
	printf("alive\n");
	return 0;
}

FILE: user/tests/wine/tests/bench.frag

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
#version 450
layout(location=0) in vec2 uv;
layout(location=0) out vec4 color;
layout(push_constant) uniform PC { float t; int iters; } pc;
void main() {
    vec2 p = uv;
    vec3 c = vec3(0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < pc.iters; i++) {
        p = fract(p * 1.37 + sin(p.yx * 3.1 + pc.t));
        c += vec3(p, p.x * p.y) * 0.02;
    }
    color = vec4(fract(c + vec3(uv, 0.5)), 1.0);
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
/* d3d11bench.exe: D3D11 flip-model swapchain + full-window pixel shader loop (same math as vkbench).
 * Usage: d3d11bench.exe [seconds=10] [iters=16] [width=1280] [height=720] [sync=0]
 */
#define COBJMACROS
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#include <d3d11.h>
#include <dxgi1_4.h>
#include <d3dcompiler.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static const char hlsl[] =
	"cbuffer C : register(b0) { float t; int iters; float2 pad; };\n"
	"struct V { float4 pos : SV_Position; float2 uv : TEXCOORD0; };\n"
	"V vs(uint id : SV_VertexID) { V o; float2 p = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2); o.uv = p;\n"
	"  o.pos = float4(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0); return o; }\n"
	"float4 ps(V i) : SV_Target { float2 p = i.uv; float3 c = 0;\n"
	"  for (int k = 0; k < iters; k++) { p = frac(p * 1.37 + sin(p.yx * 3.1 + t)); c += float3(p, p.x * p.y) * 0.02; }\n"
	"  return float4(frac(c + float3(i.uv, 0.5)), 1.0); }\n";

static volatile int quit;
static LRESULT CALLBACK wndproc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l)
{
	if (m == WM_CLOSE || m == WM_DESTROY || (m == WM_KEYDOWN && w == VK_ESCAPE)) { quit = 1; return 0; }
	return DefWindowProcA(h, m, w, l);
}
static double now(void)
{
	static LARGE_INTEGER f; LARGE_INTEGER c;
	if (!f.QuadPart) QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
	QueryPerformanceCounter(&c);
	return (double)c.QuadPart / (double)f.QuadPart;
}
#define CK(x) do { HRESULT h_ = (x); if (FAILED(h_)) { printf("FAIL %s -> 0x%08lx (line %d)\n", #x, (unsigned long)h_, __LINE__); ExitProcess(1); } } while (0)

typedef HRESULT (WINAPI *PFN_D3DCompile)(const void *, SIZE_T, const char *, const D3D_SHADER_MACRO *, ID3DInclude *, const char *, const char *, UINT, UINT, ID3DBlob **, ID3DBlob **);

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	int seconds = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 10, iters = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 16;
	int W = argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : 1280, H = argc > 4 ? atoi(argv[4]) : 720, sync = argc > 5 ? atoi(argv[5]) : 0;
	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);

	WNDCLASSA wc = {CS_OWNDC, wndproc, 0, 0, GetModuleHandleA(NULL), NULL, LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_ARROW), NULL, NULL, "d3d11bench"};
	RegisterClassA(&wc);
	RECT rc = {0, 0, W, H}; AdjustWindowRect(&rc, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, FALSE);
	HWND hwnd = CreateWindowA("d3d11bench", "d3d11bench", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_VISIBLE, 40, 40, rc.right - rc.left, rc.bottom - rc.top, NULL, NULL, wc.hInstance, NULL);
	MSG msg; while (PeekMessageA(&msg, NULL, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageA(&msg); }

	IDXGIFactory2 *fac; CK(CreateDXGIFactory1(&IID_IDXGIFactory2, (void **)&fac));
	IDXGIAdapter1 *ad; CK(IDXGIFactory2_EnumAdapters1(fac, 0, &ad));
	DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 desc; IDXGIAdapter1_GetDesc1(ad, &desc);
	printf("adapter: %ls | %04x:%04x | VRAM %llu MB\n", desc.Description, desc.VendorId, desc.DeviceId, (unsigned long long)desc.DedicatedVideoMemory >> 20);

	ID3D11Device *dev; ID3D11DeviceContext *ctx; D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL fl, fls[] = {D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_1, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0};
	CK(D3D11CreateDevice((IDXGIAdapter *)ad, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_UNKNOWN, NULL, 0, fls, 2, D3D11_SDK_VERSION, &dev, &fl, &ctx));
	printf("feature level 0x%x\n", fl);

	DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 sd = {W, H, DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, FALSE, {1, 0}, DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT, 3,
		DXGI_SCALING_STRETCH, DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD, DXGI_ALPHA_MODE_UNSPECIFIED, DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_ALLOW_TEARING};
	IDXGISwapChain1 *sc; CK(IDXGIFactory2_CreateSwapChainForHwnd(fac, (IUnknown *)dev, hwnd, &sd, NULL, NULL, &sc));
	ID3D11Texture2D *bb; CK(IDXGISwapChain1_GetBuffer(sc, 0, &IID_ID3D11Texture2D, (void **)&bb));
	ID3D11RenderTargetView *rtv; CK(ID3D11Device_CreateRenderTargetView(dev, (ID3D11Resource *)bb, NULL, &rtv));

	HMODULE dc = LoadLibraryA("d3dcompiler_47.dll");
	PFN_D3DCompile comp = (PFN_D3DCompile)(void *)GetProcAddress(dc, "D3DCompile");
	ID3DBlob *vsb, *psb, *err = NULL;
	if (FAILED(comp(hlsl, sizeof(hlsl) - 1, "b", NULL, NULL, "vs", "vs_5_0", 0, 0, &vsb, &err))) { printf("vs: %s\n", err ? (char *)ID3D10Blob_GetBufferPointer(err) : "?"); return 1; }
	if (FAILED(comp(hlsl, sizeof(hlsl) - 1, "b", NULL, NULL, "ps", "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &psb, &err))) { printf("ps: %s\n", err ? (char *)ID3D10Blob_GetBufferPointer(err) : "?"); return 1; }
	ID3D11VertexShader *vs; ID3D11PixelShader *ps;
	CK(ID3D11Device_CreateVertexShader(dev, ID3D10Blob_GetBufferPointer(vsb), ID3D10Blob_GetBufferSize(vsb), NULL, &vs));
	CK(ID3D11Device_CreatePixelShader(dev, ID3D10Blob_GetBufferPointer(psb), ID3D10Blob_GetBufferSize(psb), NULL, &ps));
	D3D11_BUFFER_DESC cbd = {16, D3D11_USAGE_DYNAMIC, D3D11_BIND_CONSTANT_BUFFER, D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_WRITE, 0, 0};
	ID3D11Buffer *cb; CK(ID3D11Device_CreateBuffer(dev, &cbd, NULL, &cb));
	/* the full-window triangle is counter-clockwise in D3D's y-up clip space: D3D11's default rasterizer state
	 * (CULL_BACK, FrontCounterClockwise FALSE) would cull it, so disable culling like the D3D12 and Vulkan benches */
	D3D11_RASTERIZER_DESC rsd = {D3D11_FILL_SOLID, D3D11_CULL_NONE, FALSE, 0, 0.0f, 0.0f, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE};
	ID3D11RasterizerState *rs; CK(ID3D11Device_CreateRasterizerState(dev, &rsd, &rs));
	ID3D11DeviceContext_RSSetState(ctx, rs);
	D3D11_VIEWPORT vp = {0, 0, (float)W, (float)H, 0, 1};

	if (argc > 6 && !strcmp(argv[6], "check")) {
		/* correctness probe: draw into a 64x64 offscreen target with several loop counts, read the centre pixel back */
		D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC td = {64, 64, 1, 1, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, {1, 0}, D3D11_USAGE_DEFAULT, D3D11_BIND_RENDER_TARGET, 0, 0};
		ID3D11Texture2D *off, *stg; ID3D11RenderTargetView *orv;
		CK(ID3D11Device_CreateTexture2D(dev, &td, NULL, &off));
		td.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_STAGING; td.BindFlags = 0; td.CPUAccessFlags = D3D11_CPU_ACCESS_READ;
		CK(ID3D11Device_CreateTexture2D(dev, &td, NULL, &stg));
		CK(ID3D11Device_CreateRenderTargetView(dev, (ID3D11Resource *)off, NULL, &orv));
		D3D11_VIEWPORT ov = {0, 0, 64, 64, 0, 1};
		{
			/* 1: clear only -> tests ClearRenderTargetView + CopyResource + staging Map */
			const float cc[4] = {0.25f, 0.5f, 0.75f, 1.0f};
			ID3D11DeviceContext_ClearRenderTargetView(ctx, orv, cc);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_CopyResource(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)stg, (ID3D11Resource *)off);
			D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE m;
			CK(ID3D11DeviceContext_Map(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)stg, 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, &m));
			unsigned char *px = (unsigned char *)m.pData + 32 * m.RowPitch + 32 * 4;
			printf("CHECK clear(64,128,191,255) -> %u %u %u %u (rowpitch %u)\n", px[0], px[1], px[2], px[3], m.RowPitch);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_Unmap(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)stg, 0);
			/* 2: UpdateSubresource on the staging-less default texture */
			unsigned int pat[64 * 64]; for (int i = 0; i < 64 * 64; i++) pat[i] = 0x11223344u;
			ID3D11DeviceContext_UpdateSubresource(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)off, 0, NULL, pat, 64 * 4, 0);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_CopyResource(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)stg, (ID3D11Resource *)off);
			CK(ID3D11DeviceContext_Map(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)stg, 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, &m));
			px = (unsigned char *)m.pData + 32 * m.RowPitch + 32 * 4;
			printf("CHECK upload(44 33 22 11) -> %02x %02x %02x %02x\n", px[0], px[1], px[2], px[3]);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_Unmap(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)stg, 0);
		}
		int its[] = {0, 1, 2, 5, 64};
		for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
			D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE m;
			CK(ID3D11DeviceContext_Map(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)cb, 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &m));
			struct { float t; int it; float pad[2]; } c = {0.25f, its[k], {0, 0}};
			memcpy(m.pData, &c, sizeof(c));
			ID3D11DeviceContext_Unmap(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)cb, 0);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_OMSetRenderTargets(ctx, 1, &orv, NULL);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_RSSetViewports(ctx, 1, &ov);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_IASetPrimitiveTopology(ctx, D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_VSSetShader(ctx, vs, NULL, 0);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_PSSetShader(ctx, ps, NULL, 0);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_PSSetConstantBuffers(ctx, 0, 1, &cb);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_Draw(ctx, 3, 0);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_CopyResource(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)stg, (ID3D11Resource *)off);
			CK(ID3D11DeviceContext_Map(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)stg, 0, D3D11_MAP_READ, 0, &m));
			unsigned char *px = (unsigned char *)m.pData + 32 * m.RowPitch + 32 * 4;
			unsigned char *p0 = (unsigned char *)m.pData + 5 * m.RowPitch + 7 * 4;
			printf("CHECK iters=%d centre rgba %u %u %u %u | (7,5) %u %u %u %u\n", its[k], px[0], px[1], px[2], px[3], p0[0], p0[1], p0[2], p0[3]);
			ID3D11DeviceContext_Unmap(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)stg, 0);
		}
		return 0;
	}
	double t0 = now(), tl = t0, best = 0, sum = 0; long frames = 0, flast = 0; int nsec = 0;
	while (!quit && now() - t0 < seconds) {
		while (PeekMessageA(&msg, NULL, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageA(&msg); }
		D3D11_MAPPED_SUBRESOURCE m;
		CK(ID3D11DeviceContext_Map(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)cb, 0, D3D11_MAP_WRITE_DISCARD, 0, &m));
		struct { float t; int it; float pad[2]; } c = {(float)(now() - t0), iters, {0, 0}};
		memcpy(m.pData, &c, sizeof(c));
		ID3D11DeviceContext_Unmap(ctx, (ID3D11Resource *)cb, 0);
		ID3D11DeviceContext_OMSetRenderTargets(ctx, 1, &rtv, NULL);
		ID3D11DeviceContext_RSSetViewports(ctx, 1, &vp);
		ID3D11DeviceContext_IASetPrimitiveTopology(ctx, D3D11_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
		ID3D11DeviceContext_VSSetShader(ctx, vs, NULL, 0);
		ID3D11DeviceContext_PSSetShader(ctx, ps, NULL, 0);
		ID3D11DeviceContext_PSSetConstantBuffers(ctx, 0, 1, &cb);
		ID3D11DeviceContext_Draw(ctx, 3, 0);
		HRESULT hr = IDXGISwapChain1_Present(sc, sync, sync ? 0 : DXGI_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING);
		if (FAILED(hr)) { printf("Present -> 0x%08lx\n", (unsigned long)hr); break; }
		frames++;
		double t = now();
		if (t - tl >= 1.0) {
			double fps = (frames - flast) / (t - tl);
			printf("fps %.1f\n", fps);
			if (nsec > 0) { sum += fps; if (fps > best) best = fps; }
			nsec++; tl = t; flast = frames;
		}
	}
	printf("RESULT d3d11 iters=%d %dx%d sync=%d avg_fps=%.1f (steady %d s) best=%.1f frames=%ld\n", iters, W, H, sync,
	       nsec > 1 ? sum / (nsec - 1) : 0.0, nsec > 1 ? nsec - 1 : 0, best, frames);
	return 0;
}

/* d3d12bench.exe: D3D12 flip-model swapchain + full-window pixel shader loop (same math as vkbench / d3d11bench).
 * Usage: d3d12bench.exe [seconds=10] [iters=16] [width=1280] [height=720] [sync=0]
 */
#define COBJMACROS
#define WIDL_C_INLINE_WRAPPERS

#include <d3dcompiler.h>

	"cbuffer C : register(b0) { float t; int iters; };\n"
	"struct V { float4 pos : SV_Position; float2 uv : TEXCOORD0; };\n"

	"  o.pos = float4(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0); return o; }\n"
	"float4 ps(V i) : SV_Target { float2 p = i.uv; float3 c = 0;\n"
	"  for (int k = 0; k < iters; k++) { p = frac(p * 1.37 + sin(p.yx * 3.1 + t)); c += float3(p, p.x * p.y) * 0.02; }\n"
	"  return float4(frac(c + float3(i.uv, 0.5)), 1.0); }\n";

{
	if (m == WM_CLOSE || m == WM_DESTROY || (m == WM_KEYDOWN && w == VK_ESCAPE)) { quit = 1; return 0; }
	return DefWindowProcA(h, m, w, l);
}

{
	static LARGE_INTEGER f; LARGE_INTEGER c;
	if (!f.QuadPart) QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
	QueryPerformanceCounter(&c);
	return (double)c.QuadPart / (double)f.QuadPart;
}
#define CK(x) do { HRESULT h_ = (x); if (FAILED(h_)) { printf("FAIL %s -> 0x%08lx (line %d)\n", #x, (unsigned long)h_, __LINE__); ExitProcess(1); } } while (0)
typedef HRESULT (WINAPI *PFN_D3DCompile)(const void *, SIZE_T, const char *, const D3D_SHADER_MACRO *, ID3DInclude *, const char *, const char *, UINT, UINT, ID3DBlob **, ID3DBlob **);

enum { NB = 3 };

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	int seconds = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 10, iters = argc > 2 ? atoi(argv[2]) : 16;
	int W = argc > 3 ? atoi(argv[3]) : 1280, H = argc > 4 ? atoi(argv[4]) : 720, sync = argc > 5 ? atoi(argv[5]) : 0;
	setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);

	WNDCLASSA wc = {CS_OWNDC, wndproc, 0, 0, GetModuleHandleA(NULL), NULL, LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_ARROW), NULL, NULL, "d3d12bench"};
	RegisterClassA(&wc);
	RECT rc = {0, 0, W, H}; AdjustWindowRect(&rc, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, FALSE);
	HWND hwnd = CreateWindowA("d3d12bench", "d3d12bench", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_VISIBLE, 40, 40, rc.right - rc.left, rc.bottom - rc.top, NULL, NULL, wc.hInstance, NULL);
	MSG msg; while (PeekMessageA(&msg, NULL, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageA(&msg); }

	IDXGIFactory4 *fac; CK(CreateDXGIFactory2(0, &IID_IDXGIFactory4, (void **)&fac));
	IDXGIAdapter1 *ad; CK(IDXGIFactory4_EnumAdapters1(fac, 0, &ad));
	DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 desc; IDXGIAdapter1_GetDesc1(ad, &desc);
	printf("adapter: %ls | %04x:%04x | VRAM %llu MB\n", desc.Description, desc.VendorId, desc.DeviceId, (unsigned long long)desc.DedicatedVideoMemory >> 20);

	ID3D12Device *dev; CK(D3D12CreateDevice((IUnknown *)ad, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_12_0, &IID_ID3D12Device, (void **)&dev));
	D3D12_FEATURE_DATA_D3D12_OPTIONS o = {0};
	ID3D12Device_CheckFeatureSupport(dev, D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS, &o, sizeof(o));
	D3D12_FEATURE_DATA_SHADER_MODEL sm = {D3D_SHADER_MODEL_6_7};
	ID3D12Device_CheckFeatureSupport(dev, D3D12_FEATURE_SHADER_MODEL, &sm, sizeof(sm));
	D3D12_FEATURE_DATA_D3D12_OPTIONS5 o5 = {0};
	ID3D12Device_CheckFeatureSupport(dev, D3D12_FEATURE_D3D12_OPTIONS5, &o5, sizeof(o5));
	printf("resource binding tier %d, tiled tier %d, shader model 0x%x, raytracing tier %d\n", o.ResourceBindingTier, o.TiledResourcesTier, sm.HighestShaderModel, o5.RaytracingTier);

	D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC qd = {D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT};
	ID3D12CommandQueue *q; CK(ID3D12Device_CreateCommandQueue(dev, &qd, &IID_ID3D12CommandQueue, (void **)&q));
	DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 sd = {W, H, DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, FALSE, {1, 0}, DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT, NB,
		DXGI_SCALING_STRETCH, DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD, DXGI_ALPHA_MODE_UNSPECIFIED, DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_ALLOW_TEARING};
	IDXGISwapChain1 *sc1; CK(IDXGIFactory4_CreateSwapChainForHwnd(fac, (IUnknown *)q, hwnd, &sd, NULL, NULL, &sc1));
	IDXGISwapChain3 *sc; CK(IDXGISwapChain1_QueryInterface(sc1, &IID_IDXGISwapChain3, (void **)&sc));

	D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC hd = {D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV, NB, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, 0};
	ID3D12DescriptorHeap *rtvh; CK(ID3D12Device_CreateDescriptorHeap(dev, &hd, &IID_ID3D12DescriptorHeap, (void **)&rtvh));
	UINT rtvsz = ID3D12Device_GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(dev, D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV);
	D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtv0;
	rtv0 = ID3D12DescriptorHeap_GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(rtvh);
	ID3D12Resource *bufs[NB];
	for (int i = 0; i < NB; i++) {
		CK(IDXGISwapChain3_GetBuffer(sc, i, &IID_ID3D12Resource, (void **)&bufs[i]));
		D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h = {rtv0.ptr + i * rtvsz};
		ID3D12Device_CreateRenderTargetView(dev, bufs[i], NULL, h);
	}

	D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER rp = {D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_32BIT_CONSTANTS};
	rp.Constants.ShaderRegister = 0; rp.Constants.Num32BitValues = 2; rp.ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL;
	D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rsd = {1, &rp, 0, NULL, D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE};
	ID3DBlob *rsb, *err = NULL;
	CK(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rsd, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &rsb, &err));
	ID3D12RootSignature *rs; CK(ID3D12Device_CreateRootSignature(dev, 0, ID3D10Blob_GetBufferPointer(rsb), ID3D10Blob_GetBufferSize(rsb), &IID_ID3D12RootSignature, (void **)&rs));

	HMODULE dc = LoadLibraryA("d3dcompiler_47.dll");
	PFN_D3DCompile comp = (PFN_D3DCompile)(void *)GetProcAddress(dc, "D3DCompile");
	ID3DBlob *vsb, *psb;
	if (FAILED(comp(hlsl, sizeof(hlsl) - 1, "b", NULL, NULL, "vs", "vs_5_0", 0, 0, &vsb, &err))) { printf("vs compile failed\n"); return 1; }
	if (FAILED(comp(hlsl, sizeof(hlsl) - 1, "b", NULL, NULL, "ps", "ps_5_0", 0, 0, &psb, &err))) { printf("ps compile failed\n"); return 1; }

	D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC pd = {0};
	pd.pRootSignature = rs;
	pd.VS.pShaderBytecode = ID3D10Blob_GetBufferPointer(vsb); pd.VS.BytecodeLength = ID3D10Blob_GetBufferSize(vsb);
	pd.PS.pShaderBytecode = ID3D10Blob_GetBufferPointer(psb); pd.PS.BytecodeLength = ID3D10Blob_GetBufferSize(psb);
	pd.BlendState.RenderTarget[0].RenderTargetWriteMask = D3D12_COLOR_WRITE_ENABLE_ALL;
	pd.SampleMask = UINT_MAX;
	pd.RasterizerState.FillMode = D3D12_FILL_MODE_SOLID; pd.RasterizerState.CullMode = D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE; pd.RasterizerState.DepthClipEnable = TRUE;
	pd.PrimitiveTopologyType = D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE;
	pd.NumRenderTargets = 1; pd.RTVFormats[0] = DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM; pd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
	ID3D12PipelineState *pso; CK(ID3D12Device_CreateGraphicsPipelineState(dev, &pd, &IID_ID3D12PipelineState, (void **)&pso));

	ID3D12CommandAllocator *ca[NB]; ID3D12GraphicsCommandList *cl;
	for (int i = 0; i < NB; i++) CK(ID3D12Device_CreateCommandAllocator(dev, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, &IID_ID3D12CommandAllocator, (void **)&ca[i]));
	CK(ID3D12Device_CreateCommandList(dev, 0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, ca[0], pso, &IID_ID3D12GraphicsCommandList, (void **)&cl));
	ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_Close(cl);
	ID3D12Fence *fence; CK(ID3D12Device_CreateFence(dev, 0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, &IID_ID3D12Fence, (void **)&fence));
	HANDLE ev = CreateEventA(NULL, FALSE, FALSE, NULL);
	UINT64 fv[NB] = {0}, next = 1;

	D3D12_VIEWPORT vp = {0, 0, (float)W, (float)H, 0, 1}; D3D12_RECT sr = {0, 0, W, H};
	double t0 = now(), tl = t0, best = 0, sum = 0; long frames = 0, flast = 0; int nsec = 0;
	while (!quit && now() - t0 < seconds) {
		while (PeekMessageA(&msg, NULL, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) { TranslateMessage(&msg); DispatchMessageA(&msg); }
		UINT bi = IDXGISwapChain3_GetCurrentBackBufferIndex(sc);
		if (ID3D12Fence_GetCompletedValue(fence) < fv[bi]) { ID3D12Fence_SetEventOnCompletion(fence, fv[bi], ev); WaitForSingleObject(ev, INFINITE); }
		CK(ID3D12CommandAllocator_Reset(ca[bi]));
		CK(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_Reset(cl, ca[bi], pso));
		D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b = {D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION};
		b.Transition.pResource = bufs[bi]; b.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
		b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT; b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_ResourceBarrier(cl, 1, &b);
		D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE h = {rtv0.ptr + bi * rtvsz};
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_OMSetRenderTargets(cl, 1, &h, FALSE, NULL);
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_SetGraphicsRootSignature(cl, rs);
		struct { float t; int it; } c = {(float)(now() - t0), iters};
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_SetGraphicsRoot32BitConstants(cl, 0, 2, &c, 0);
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_RSSetViewports(cl, 1, &vp);
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_RSSetScissorRects(cl, 1, &sr);
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_IASetPrimitiveTopology(cl, D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_DrawInstanced(cl, 3, 1, 0, 0);
		b.Transition.StateBefore = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET; b.Transition.StateAfter = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT;
		ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_ResourceBarrier(cl, 1, &b);
		CK(ID3D12GraphicsCommandList_Close(cl));
		ID3D12CommandList *lists[] = {(ID3D12CommandList *)cl};
		ID3D12CommandQueue_ExecuteCommandLists(q, 1, lists);
		HRESULT hr = IDXGISwapChain3_Present(sc, sync, sync ? 0 : DXGI_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING);
		if (FAILED(hr)) { printf("Present -> 0x%08lx\n", (unsigned long)hr); break; }
		fv[bi] = next; CK(ID3D12CommandQueue_Signal(q, fence, next++));
		frames++;
		double t = now();
		if (t - tl >= 1.0) {
			double fps = (frames - flast) / (t - tl);
			printf("fps %.1f\n", fps);
			if (nsec > 0) { sum += fps; if (fps > best) best = fps; }
			nsec++; tl = t; flast = frames;
		}
	}
	CK(ID3D12CommandQueue_Signal(q, fence, next));
	ID3D12Fence_SetEventOnCompletion(fence, next, ev); WaitForSingleObject(ev, 5000);
	printf("RESULT d3d12 iters=%d %dx%d sync=%d avg_fps=%.1f (steady %d s) best=%.1f frames=%ld\n", iters, W, H, sync,
	       nsec > 1 ? sum / (nsec - 1) : 0.0, nsec > 1 ? nsec - 1 : 0, best, frames);
	return 0;
}
