// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// gpubench: raw Vulkan compute throughput on the B580 (no Metal plugin in between): FP32 FMA rate, compute and
// vkCmdCopyBuffer VRAM bandwidth, timed with GPU timestamps. Through the Khronos loader (/usr/local/lib).
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include "fma_spv.h"
#include "copy_spv.h"
static PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa; static PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr gdpa; static VkInstance inst; static VkDevice dev;
#define I(n) PFN_##n n = (PFN_##n)gipa(inst, #n)
#define D(n) PFN_##n n = (PFN_##n)gdpa(dev, #n)
#define CK(x) do { VkResult r_ = (x); if (r_) { printf("FAIL %s = %d\n", #x, r_); exit(1); } } while (0)
int main(void) {
   void *lib = dlopen("/usr/local/lib/libvulkan.1.dylib", RTLD_NOW); if (!lib) { printf("no loader\n"); return 1; }
   gipa = (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(lib, "vkGetInstanceProcAddr");
   I(vkCreateInstance);
   VkApplicationInfo ai = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, .apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3 };
   VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, .pApplicationInfo = &ai };
   CK(vkCreateInstance(&ici, NULL, &inst));
   I(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices); I(vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties); I(vkCreateDevice); I(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties);
   uint32_t n = 1; VkPhysicalDevice pd; vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(inst, &n, &pd);
   VkPhysicalDeviceProperties pp; vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(pd, &pp);
   VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties mp; vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(pd, &mp);
   gdpa = (PFN_vkGetDeviceProcAddr)gipa(inst, "vkGetDeviceProcAddr");
   float pr = 1; VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo q = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO, .queueCount = 1, .pQueuePriorities = &pr };
   VkDeviceCreateInfo dci = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO, .queueCreateInfoCount = 1, .pQueueCreateInfos = &q };
   CK(vkCreateDevice(pd, &dci, NULL, &dev));
   D(vkGetDeviceQueue); D(vkCreateBuffer); D(vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements); D(vkAllocateMemory); D(vkBindBufferMemory);
   D(vkCreateShaderModule); D(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout); D(vkCreatePipelineLayout); D(vkCreateComputePipelines);
   D(vkCreateDescriptorPool); D(vkAllocateDescriptorSets); D(vkUpdateDescriptorSets); D(vkCreateCommandPool);
   D(vkAllocateCommandBuffers); D(vkBeginCommandBuffer); D(vkEndCommandBuffer); D(vkCmdBindPipeline); D(vkCmdBindDescriptorSets);
   D(vkCmdPushConstants); D(vkCmdDispatch); D(vkCmdWriteTimestamp); D(vkCmdResetQueryPool); D(vkCreateQueryPool);
   D(vkGetQueryPoolResults); D(vkQueueSubmit); D(vkQueueWaitIdle); D(vkCmdCopyBuffer); D(vkCmdPipelineBarrier);
   VkQueue queue; vkGetDeviceQueue(dev, 0, 0, &queue);
   printf("device %s\n", pp.deviceName);
   const VkDeviceSize SZ = 512ull << 20;
   VkBuffer buf[2]; VkDeviceMemory mem[2];
   for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = SZ,
         .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT };
      CK(vkCreateBuffer(dev, &bi, NULL, &buf[i]));
      VkMemoryRequirements mr; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(dev, buf[i], &mr);
      uint32_t t = 0; for (; t < mp.memoryTypeCount; t++) if ((mr.memoryTypeBits >> t & 1) && mp.memoryTypes[t].propertyFlags == VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) break;
      VkMemoryAllocateInfo ma = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO, .allocationSize = mr.size, .memoryTypeIndex = t };
      CK(vkAllocateMemory(dev, &ma, NULL, &mem[i])); CK(vkBindBufferMemory(dev, buf[i], mem[i], 0));
   }
   VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b[2] = { { 0, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT }, { 1, VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT } };
   VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo dl = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .bindingCount = 2, .pBindings = b };
   VkDescriptorSetLayout dsl; CK(vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(dev, &dl, NULL, &dsl));
   VkPushConstantRange pcr = { VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, 8 };
   VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo pl = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .setLayoutCount = 1, .pSetLayouts = &dsl, .pushConstantRangeCount = 1, .pPushConstantRanges = &pcr };
   VkPipelineLayout lay; CK(vkCreatePipelineLayout(dev, &pl, NULL, &lay));
   VkPipeline pipe[2]; const uint32_t *code[2] = { (const uint32_t *)fma_spv, (const uint32_t *)copy_spv }; size_t clen[2] = { fma_spv_len, copy_spv_len };
   for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      VkShaderModuleCreateInfo sm = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = clen[i], .pCode = code[i] };
      VkShaderModule m; CK(vkCreateShaderModule(dev, &sm, NULL, &m));
      VkComputePipelineCreateInfo cp = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO, .layout = lay,
         .stage = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO, .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, .module = m, .pName = "main" } };
      CK(vkCreateComputePipelines(dev, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &cp, NULL, &pipe[i]));
   }
   VkDescriptorPoolSize ps = { VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, 2 };
   VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo dpc = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .maxSets = 1, .poolSizeCount = 1, .pPoolSizes = &ps };
   VkDescriptorPool dp; CK(vkCreateDescriptorPool(dev, &dpc, NULL, &dp));
   VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo dsa = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO, .descriptorPool = dp, .descriptorSetCount = 1, .pSetLayouts = &dsl };
   VkDescriptorSet ds; CK(vkAllocateDescriptorSets(dev, &dsa, &ds));
   VkDescriptorBufferInfo dbi[2] = { { buf[0], 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE }, { buf[1], 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE } };
   VkWriteDescriptorSet w[2] = { { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = ds, .dstBinding = 0, .descriptorCount = 1, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, .pBufferInfo = &dbi[0] },
                                 { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstSet = ds, .dstBinding = 1, .descriptorCount = 1, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER, .pBufferInfo = &dbi[1] } };
   vkUpdateDescriptorSets(dev, 2, w, 0, NULL);
   VkCommandPoolCreateInfo cpi = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO };
   VkCommandPool pool; CK(vkCreateCommandPool(dev, &cpi, NULL, &pool));
   VkQueryPoolCreateInfo qpi = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP, .queryCount = 8 };
   VkQueryPool qp; CK(vkCreateQueryPool(dev, &qpi, NULL, &qp));
   const uint32_t fma_threads = 4u << 20, iters = 256;   // 4M threads x 256 x 8 vec4 FMAs
   for (int rep = 0; rep < 3; rep++) {
      VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO, .commandPool = pool, .commandBufferCount = 1 };
      VkCommandBuffer cb; CK(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(dev, &ca, &cb));
      VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bb = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
      CK(vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &bb));
      vkCmdResetQueryPool(cb, qp, 0, 8);
      vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, lay, 0, 1, &ds, 0, NULL);
      VkMemoryBarrier mb = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER, .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT };
      vkCmdWriteTimestamp(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, qp, 0);
      vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pipe[0]);
      struct { uint32_t it; float k; } pc = { iters, 0.999f };
      vkCmdPushConstants(cb, lay, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, 8, &pc);
      vkCmdDispatch(cb, fma_threads / 256, 1, 1);
      vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, NULL, 0, NULL);
      vkCmdWriteTimestamp(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, qp, 1);
      vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pipe[1]);
      vkCmdDispatch(cb, (uint32_t)(SZ / 16 / 256), 1, 1);
      vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, NULL, 0, NULL);
      vkCmdWriteTimestamp(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, qp, 2);
      VkBufferCopy bc = { 0, 0, SZ };
      vkCmdCopyBuffer(cb, buf[1], buf[0], 1, &bc);
      vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, NULL, 0, NULL);
      vkCmdWriteTimestamp(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, qp, 3);
      CK(vkEndCommandBuffer(cb));
      VkSubmitInfo si = { .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO, .commandBufferCount = 1, .pCommandBuffers = &cb };
      CK(vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &si, VK_NULL_HANDLE)); CK(vkQueueWaitIdle(queue));
      uint64_t ts[4]; CK(vkGetQueryPoolResults(dev, qp, 0, 4, sizeof ts, ts, 8, VK_QUERY_RESULT_64_BIT | VK_QUERY_RESULT_WAIT_BIT));
      const double tp = pp.limits.timestampPeriod;
      double t_fma = (ts[1] - ts[0]) * tp * 1e-9, t_cc = (ts[2] - ts[1]) * tp * 1e-9, t_cp = (ts[3] - ts[2]) * tp * 1e-9;
      double flops = (double)fma_threads * iters * 8 * 4 * 2;
      printf("rep %d: FMA %.0f GFLOPS (%.2f ms); compute copy %.0f GB/s (%.2f ms, %u MB read + written); vkCmdCopyBuffer %.0f GB/s (%.2f ms)\n",
             rep, flops / t_fma / 1e9, t_fma * 1e3, 2.0 * SZ / t_cc / 1e9, t_cc * 1e3, (unsigned)(SZ >> 20), 2.0 * SZ / t_cp / 1e9, t_cp * 1e3);
   }
   return 0;
}

FILE: user/tools/install-plugin-lib.sh

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# install.sh: libC3 = libC with plugin sc6dn (speccst6 + b580-webkit-armed.patch + b580-webkit-devnull.patch: /dev/null by dup where a sandbox refuses it;
# the arm state from IOAccelDisplayPipeCapabilities
# where WebKit sandboxes NMXAutoArm; NVMTLDriver eba1965f, translator aa356713; speccst6 was recover1 +
# function constants as specialization constants) as /Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle - NMXAccel nmx-ssv2's
# fallback when the system copy (/System/Library/Extensions/NVMTLDriver.bundle, ssv-install.sh) is absent - and REMOVES
# /Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriver.bundle, which would shadow the system copy (Metal's bundle lookup takes the first
# NVMTLDriver.bundle it finds, /Library/GPUBundles before /System/Library/Extensions, and WebKit's GPU process cannot
# load it from /Library). Companions stay in /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl (Mesa there: d8860b17).
# Refuses files that differ from SHA256SUMS or carry no code signature. Takes effect for processes started afterwards.
#   install.sh           back up /Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriver.bundle and NVMTLDriverLib.bundle (what exists) to
#                        ./previous/ (once), install NVMTLDriverLib.bundle, remove NVMTLDriver.bundle
#   install.sh --undo    put ./previous/ back exactly (NVMTLDriver.bundle restored; NVMTLDriverLib.bundle restored or removed)
set -euo pipefail
L=/Library/GPUBundles; P=$L/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle; X=$L/NVMTLDriver.bundle
H=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd); B=$H/previous
sig() { "$H/sigcheck" "$1" >/dev/null || { "$H/sigcheck" "$1"; echo "REFUSED: $1 is not signed"; exit 1; }; }
sigs() { local m; for m in "$1/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" "$1/Contents/MacOS/libnvmtl_translate.dylib" $(find "$1/Contents/MacOS/air-runtime" -name '*.dylib'); do sig "$m"; done; }
put() { sigs "$1"; sudo rm -rf "$2.new" "$2.old"; sudo ditto "$1" "$2.new"; sudo chown -R root:wheel "$2.new"
        { [ ! -e "$2" ] || sudo mv "$2" "$2.old"; }; sudo mv "$2.new" "$2"; sudo rm -rf "$2.old"; }
if [ "${1:-}" = --undo ]; then
    [ -d "$B" ] || { echo "no $B"; exit 1; }
    if [ -d "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle" ]; then put "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle" "$X"; echo "restored $X"; fi
    if [ -d "$B/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle" ]; then put "$B/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle" "$P"; echo "restored $P"
    else sudo rm -rf "$P"; echo "removed $P (there was none before)"; fi
    exit 0
fi
(cd "$H" && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS >/dev/null) || { echo "REFUSED: files differ from SHA256SUMS"; exit 1; }
if [ ! -f "$B/.taken" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$B"
    [ ! -d "$X" ] || { sudo ditto "$X" "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle"; sudo chown -R "$(id -un)" "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle"; }
    [ ! -d "$P" ] || { sudo ditto "$P" "$B/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle"; sudo chown -R "$(id -un)" "$B/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle"; }
    touch "$B/.taken"
fi
put "$H/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle" "$P"
sudo rm -rf "$X"
echo "installed $P ($(shasum -a 256 "$P/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" | cut -c1-12)); removed $X (backup in $B)"

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# install.sh: sv8 plugin = sv7 without the per-frame seed-bump lock (phase 4 marks only; the post-mark seed recorded as its own). sv7 = sv6 + phase 4 (debug.intelxe.surfvram >= 3: WindowServer composites skip their readback; needs the sv7 NMXAccel + IntelXe.kext). sv6 = sv5 + VRAM-shared surface writes scheduled at submission (no waitUntilScheduled wait for the GPU). sv5 = sv4 + SCHEDCENSUS (/tmp/nvmtl-schedcensus: why commits are scheduled late). sv4 = sv3 + /tmp/nvmtl-no-scanout-readback. sv3 = sv2 + WindowServer import-only at level 2, the switch re-read every second, non-blocking SURFACE_DIRTY at submission), user-space half (Mesa is sv2's, unchanged). Everything stays OFF until
# debug.intelxe.surfvram is 1 (apps) or 2 (apps + WindowServer; re-read every second, new surface textures follow it); at 0 the plugin and Mesa behave as
# fix32 / venc2 (svimg, gpt_bench surf and mtl_tests pass with the switch at 0).
#   NVMTLDriver.bundle     fix32 (src/nullmoth-vis/plugin) + sv2-plugin-vs-fix32.patch: item 7 on ANV (import / make the
#                          surface's VRAM backing through Mesa 0014, implicit sync of every read and write of it, marked
#                          newest at submission instead of copied out)
#   libvulkan_intel.dylib  src/mesa-venc-rel (installed venc2 base) + patches/mesa/0013 + 0014, same meson options, ad-hoc signed
# Refuses files that differ from SHA256SUMS or carry no code signature. No WindowServer restart: apps pick both up when they
# next start (WindowServer keeps its copies until relogin/reboot; with the switch at 1 it does not use VRAM sharing anyway).
#   install.sh plugin | mesa | all      back up the installed file(s) to ./previous/, then install
#   install.sh --undo plugin | mesa | all
set -euo pipefail
P=/Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriver.bundle
M=/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib
H=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
B=$H/previous
sig() { "$H/sigcheck" "$1" >/dev/null || { "$H/sigcheck" "$1"; echo "REFUSED: $1 is not signed"; exit 1; }; }
bundle() { local m; for m in "$1/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" "$1/Contents/MacOS/libnvmtl_translate.dylib" $(find "$1/Contents/MacOS/air-runtime" -name '*.dylib'); do sig "$m"; done
           sudo rm -rf "$P.new" "$P.old"; sudo ditto "$1" "$P.new"; sudo chown -R root:wheel "$P.new"; sudo mv "$P" "$P.old"; sudo mv "$P.new" "$P"; sudo rm -rf "$P.old"; }
mesa() { sig "$1"; sudo cp "$1" "$M.new" && sudo chown root:wheel "$M.new" && sudo chmod 755 "$M.new" && sudo mv -f "$M.new" "$M"; }
what=${2:-${1:-}}
if [ "${1:-}" = --undo ]; then
  case "$what" in plugin|all) bundle "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle"; echo "plugin restored";; esac
  case "$what" in mesa|all) mesa "$B/libvulkan_intel.dylib"; echo "mesa restored";; esac
  exit 0
fi
(cd "$H" && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS >/dev/null) || { echo "REFUSED: files differ from SHA256SUMS"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$B"
case "$what" in
  plugin|all) [ -d "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle" ] || { sudo ditto "$P" "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle"; sudo chown -R "$(id -un)" "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle"; }
              bundle "$H/NVMTLDriver.bundle"; shasum -a 256 "$P/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver";;
esac
case "$what" in
  mesa|all) [ -f "$B/libvulkan_intel.dylib" ] || cp "$M" "$B/libvulkan_intel.dylib"
            mesa "$H/libvulkan_intel.dylib"; shasum -a 256 "$M";;
esac
case "$what" in plugin|mesa|all) ;; *) echo "usage: install.sh [--undo] plugin|mesa|all"; exit 1;; esac

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# install.sh: fix32 = fix31 + fix32-vs-fix31.patch (fix31 = fix29b + fix29c-vs-fix29b.patch + fix31-vs-fix29c.patch):
#  the plugin's descriptor set layout has one binding per binding number (0..640; unused numbers descriptorCount 0), so
#  pMutableDescriptorTypeLists[i] belongs to binding number i. ANV reads that array by binding number (radv/nvk and the
#  spec by pBindings index): with the old sparse layout the storage textures at 480-607 were past the list array and ANV
#  sized them for any type, a sampler state each, so every pool held a fifth of its sets (256 -> 51). Now a pool holds
#  what it was made for (256 -> 255); one command buffer of 3000 dispatches: 4 pools / 122 MB of the BAR window instead of
#  7 / 352 MB, 40 ms instead of 116 ms (mtl_pools grow 3000).
# fix31: descriptor pools grow with the need (256 sets first) and no silent drops (an unrecordable draw ends the command
#  buffer with MTLCommandBufferErrorOutOfMemory/Internal; NVMTL_SUBMIT_PARTIAL=1 = old), plus fix29c's staged IOSurface
#  host copies and SURFCENSUS.
# Only the NVMTLDriver.bundle changes. Refuses unsigned or altered files (SHA256SUMS, sigcheck). No WindowServer restart:
# apps load it when they next start, WindowServer at the next login/boot.
#   install.sh           back up the installed bundle (fix31) to ./previous/, then install
#   install.sh --undo    put ./previous/ back (fix31; ~/b580/fix31/install.sh --undo goes on to fix29b)
set -euo pipefail
P=/Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriver.bundle
H=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
B=$H/previous
bundle() { local m; for m in "$1/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" "$1/Contents/MacOS/libnvmtl_translate.dylib" $(find "$1/Contents/MacOS/air-runtime" -name '*.dylib'); do
             "$H/sigcheck" "$m" >/dev/null || { "$H/sigcheck" "$m"; echo "REFUSED: $m is not signed"; exit 1; }; done
           sudo rm -rf "$P.new" "$P.old"; sudo ditto "$1" "$P.new"; sudo chown -R root:wheel "$P.new"; sudo mv "$P" "$P.old"; sudo mv "$P.new" "$P"; sudo rm -rf "$P.old"; }
case "${1:-}" in
  --undo) [ -d "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle" ] || { echo "no $B"; exit 1; }
          bundle "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle"; echo "restored $B"; shasum -a 256 "$P/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver"; exit 0 ;;
esac
(cd "$H" && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS >/dev/null) || { echo "REFUSED: files differ from SHA256SUMS"; exit 1; }
if [ ! -d "$B" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$B"; sudo ditto "$P" "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle"; sudo chown -R "$(id -un)" "$B/NVMTLDriver.bundle"
fi
bundle "$H/NVMTLDriver.bundle"
shasum -a 256 "$P/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver"

FILE: user/tools/sigcheck.c

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// sigcheck FILE...: is each Mach-O (thin or fat, every slice) code-signed? Checks for LC_CODE_SIGNATURE and that it points
// at an embedded-signature SuperBlob holding a CodeDirectory, the minimum dyld needs ("Code has to be at least ad-hoc
// signed"). No Apple tools needed, so install scripts can run it on the B580 machine. Exit 0 only if all are signed.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <mach-o/loader.h>
#include <mach-o/fat.h>
#include <libkern/OSByteOrder.h>
static int slice(FILE *f, long base, const char *path) {
	struct mach_header_64 h;
	if (fseek(f, base, SEEK_SET) || fread(&h, sizeof h, 1, f) != 1 || h.magic != MH_MAGIC_64) { printf("%s: not a 64-bit Mach-O\n", path); return 1; }
	long off = base + sizeof h;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < h.ncmds; i++) {
		struct load_command lc;
		if (fseek(f, off, SEEK_SET) || fread(&lc, sizeof lc, 1, f) != 1) break;
		if (lc.cmd == LC_CODE_SIGNATURE) {
			struct linkedit_data_command cs; uint32_t sb[3], idx[2];
			if (fseek(f, off, SEEK_SET) || fread(&cs, sizeof cs, 1, f) != 1) break;
			if (fseek(f, base + cs.dataoff, SEEK_SET) || fread(sb, sizeof sb, 1, f) != 1) break;
			if (OSSwapBigToHostInt32(sb[0]) != 0xfade0cc0) { printf("%s: LC_CODE_SIGNATURE without an embedded signature\n", path); return 1; }
			uint32_t n = OSSwapBigToHostInt32(sb[2]);
			for (uint32_t k = 0; k < n; k++) {
				uint32_t magic;
				if (fseek(f, base + cs.dataoff + 12 + 8 * k, SEEK_SET) || fread(idx, sizeof idx, 1, f) != 1) break;
				if (fseek(f, base + cs.dataoff + OSSwapBigToHostInt32(idx[1]), SEEK_SET) || fread(&magic, 4, 1, f) != 1) break;
				if (OSSwapBigToHostInt32(magic) == 0xfade0c02) { printf("%s: signed (CodeDirectory present)\n", path); return 0; }
			}
			printf("%s: signature has no CodeDirectory\n", path); return 1;
		}
		off += lc.cmdsize;
	}
	printf("%s: NOT SIGNED (no LC_CODE_SIGNATURE)\n", path);
	return 1;
}
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	int bad = 0;
	for (int a = 1; a < argc; a++) {
		FILE *f = fopen(argv[a], "rb"); uint32_t m;
		if (!f || fread(&m, 4, 1, f) != 1) { printf("%s: cannot read\n", argv[a]); bad++; if (f) fclose(f); continue; }
		if (OSSwapBigToHostInt32(m) == FAT_MAGIC) {
			struct fat_header fh; fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET); fread(&fh, sizeof fh, 1, f);
			for (uint32_t i = 0; i < OSSwapBigToHostInt32(fh.nfat_arch); i++) {
				struct fat_arch fa; fseek(f, sizeof fh + i * sizeof fa, SEEK_SET); fread(&fa, sizeof fa, 1, f);
				bad += slice(f, OSSwapBigToHostInt32(fa.offset), argv[a]);
			}
		} else bad += slice(f, 0, argv[a]);
		fclose(f);
	}
	return bad ? 1 : 0;
}

FILE: user/tools/ssv-install.sh

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# ssv-install.sh: the OPTIONAL system-volume component of the IntelXe Metal plugin, so WebKit's GPU process (Safari WebGL)
# can load it. The default install (/Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriver.bundle) stays as it is.
#
# Why: com.apple.WebKit.GPUProcess.sb lets that process map code only from /System/Library/{Extensions,...}, /usr/lib and
# the cryptexes; the kernel logs "deny(1) file-map-executable /Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriver.bundle/...", Metal gets no
# device and Safari's WebGL contexts have no backend. Apple's own Metal drivers are bundles in /System/Library/Extensions
# that carry their libraries inside: ./system-layout/NVMTLDriver.bundle is that layout (Mesa and the translator in
# Contents/Frameworks/nvmtl, found there by the plugin itself).
#
# How: as OpenCore Legacy Patcher's root patches on macOS 11+ - mount the system volume (not its sealed snapshot)
# writable, copy, bless a new boot snapshot; uninstall = boot the last sealed (Apple) snapshot again.
#
#   ssv-install.sh [--preflight]   read-only checks (the default; no root needed for most of it)
#   sudo ssv-install.sh --apply    install ./system-layout/NVMTLDriver.bundle into the system volume, new boot snapshot
#   sudo ssv-install.sh --uninstall   revert to the last sealed snapshot (removes EVERY root change, ours and any other)
#   ssv-install.sh --check         after a macOS update: is the component missing from the booted snapshot?
# Every change needs a reboot to take effect. Nothing is done without --apply / --uninstall.
# ssv6: ssv5 with Mesa 5b2fba33 (d8860b17 = be1cb088 + 0044 HEVC RDOQ, then + 0045 H.264 BRC slice states, 0051 blorp
# compute clear bounds, 0046 AV1 BRC GOP model, 0047 AV1 two PAK passes); bundle re-signed ad-hoc for the new Frameworks
# hash (plugin code unchanged: eba1965f unsigned-layout build of sc6dn = speccst6 + the two webkit patches), and translator aa356713 in Contents/Frameworks/nvmtl. With the component installed the
# /Library copy is /Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle (NMXAccel nmx-ssv2's fallback); NVMTLDriver.bundle in
# /Library would shadow the system copy (Metal takes the first bundle of that name, /Library/GPUBundles first). The Vulkan loader and the ICD json are
# not needed: the plugin opens Mesa directly and uses them only when that fails.
# Not checkable from here: OpenCore must boot with Misc/Security/SecureBootModel = Disabled (Apple Secure Boot refuses a
# broken seal); the repo's USB and DAILY configs have it, with csr-active-config AwgAAA== (0x803).
set -uo pipefail
H=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
SRC=$H/system-layout/NVMTLDriver.bundle
NAME=NVMTLDriver.bundle
MARK=/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/ssv-component.plist   # data volume: survives snapshots and updates
MNT=/System/Volumes/Update/mnt1                       # where OCLP mounts the system volume
# The package's install.sh --apply makes USELIB when the system-volume copy is from another release (NMXAccel then loads
# the /Library copy) and records that it did in USELIB_REC (0.1.5 and earlier: created-use-library in its last backup).
# --apply removes both once the copy it installed is this package's, so the next boot uses it; a USELIB the user made
# is left alone.
USELIB=/Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriver.use-library
BK="/Library/Application Support/intel-gpu-macos-driver"
USELIB_REC="$BK/use-library-by-install"
MODE=${1:---preflight}
red() { printf '\033[31m%s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }; ok() { printf '  ok    %s\n' "$*"; }; bad() { printf '  FAIL  %s\n' "$*"; FAILS=$((FAILS + 1)); }
warn() { printf '  warn  %s\n' "$*"; }
FAILS=0

uselib_ours() {   # the same test as install.sh's: USELIB is there and install.sh made it (its record is not older)
    [ -e "$USELIB" ] || return 1
    local r="" lb
    if [ -e "$USELIB_REC" ]; then r=$USELIB_REC
    else lb=$(cat "$BK/last-backup" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$lb" ] && [ -e "$lb/created-use-library" ] && r=$lb/created-use-library; fi
    [ -n "$r" ] && ! [ "$USELIB" -nt "$r" ]
}
# after the copy: remove USELIB when install.sh made it and the copy now on the system volume ($1) is this package's,
# with the Mesa of the /Library part (preflight refused another); otherwise say what stays
uselib_after_apply() {
    [ -e "$USELIB" ] || return 0
    local L=/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib
    if ! cmp -s "$1/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" "$SRC/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" ||
       ! cmp -s "$1/Contents/Frameworks/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib" "$L"; then
        warn "$USELIB kept: the copy on the system volume does not match this package and the /Library part"
    elif uselib_ours; then
        rm -f "$USELIB" "$USELIB_REC" && ok "removed $USELIB (install.sh --apply made it for the older copy): after the restart Metal loads the system-volume copy"
    else
        warn "$USELIB kept: it was not made by install.sh. While it is there NMXAccel loads the /Library copy; to use the system-volume copy: sudo rm $USELIB, then restart"
    fi
}
root_device() {   # the booted snapshot's device (diskXsYs1) and its system volume (diskXsY)
    SNAPDEV=$(diskutil info / | awk -F': *' '/Device Node/{print $2; exit}'); SNAPDEV=${SNAPDEV#/dev/}
    SYSDEV=$(printf '%s' "$SNAPDEV" | sed -E 's/s[0-9]+$//')
}
preflight() {
    echo "== preflight ($(sw_vers -productVersion) $(sw_vers -buildVersion), $(uname -m))"
    [ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || bad "not x86_64"
    # SIP: CSR_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_ROOT (0x800) is what lets a modified system volume boot
    local csr; csr=$(nvram csr-active-config 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
    local v=0; if [ -n "$csr" ]; then v=$(printf '%s' "$csr" | perl -ne 's/%([0-9a-f]{2})/chr(hex $1)/ge; my @b=unpack("C4",$_."\0\0\0\0"); print $b[0]|($b[1]<<8)|($b[2]<<16)|($b[3]<<24)'); fi
    printf '        csr-active-config 0x%x (%s)\n' "$v" "$(csrutil status 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
    [ $((v & 0x800)) -ne 0 ] && ok "authenticated-root disabled (0x800)" || bad "authenticated-root is ENABLED (csr 0x800 not set): a modified system volume would not boot"
    # AMFI: our ad-hoc signed code in a system path, loaded by Apple processes with library validation
    local ba; ba=$(sysctl -n kern.bootargs 2>/dev/null)
    case "$ba" in *amfi_get_out_of_my_way=1*|*amfi_get_out_of_my_way=0x1*|*amfi=0x80*|*amfi=128*) ok "AMFI relaxed in boot-args ($ba)";;
        *) bad "boot-args have no amfi_get_out_of_my_way=1 / amfi=0x80: Apple processes would refuse the ad-hoc signed plugin";; esac
    # FileVault: OCLP refuses root patching with it on (the system volume cannot be mounted writable then)
    fdesetup status 2>/dev/null | grep -q "FileVault is On" && bad "FileVault is on" || ok "FileVault off"
    # the boot volume, its snapshot, the rollback point
    root_device
    local sealed; sealed=$(diskutil info / | awk -F': *' '/Sealed/{print $2; exit}')
    echo "        booted snapshot device $SNAPDEV, system volume $SYSDEV, sealed: ${sealed:-?}"
    [ -n "$SNAPDEV" ] && [ "$SNAPDEV" != "$SYSDEV" ] && ok "booted from a snapshot of $SYSDEV" || bad "cannot find the system volume behind / ($SNAPDEV)"
    case "$sealed" in Yes*) ok "the booted snapshot is Apple's sealed one (the rollback point is the one booted now)";;
        Broken*) warn "the booted snapshot is already modified (another root patch?): --uninstall reverts those changes too";;
        *) warn "seal state unknown";; esac
    echo "        snapshots of /:"; diskutil apfs listSnapshots / 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Name:|XID:|Purgeable" | sed 's/^/          /'
    bless --info --getBoot 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/        bless boot: /'
    # space: the bundle (~40 MB) plus a snapshot's metadata
    local free; free=$(df -k / | awk 'NR==2{print int($4/1024)}')
    [ "${free:-0}" -ge 1024 ] && ok "free space ${free} MB in the container" || bad "less than 1 GB free (${free} MB)"
    # the component itself
    [ -d "$SRC" ] && ok "component present: $SRC" || bad "no $SRC"
    if [ -d "$SRC" ]; then
        (cd "$H" && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS 2>/dev/null | grep "system-layout" | grep -v ': OK$') && bad "system-layout files differ from SHA256SUMS" || ok "system-layout matches SHA256SUMS"
        for m in "$SRC/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" "$SRC/Contents/MacOS/libnvmtl_translate.dylib" "$SRC"/Contents/Frameworks/nvmtl/*.dylib; do
            "$H/sigcheck" "$m" >/dev/null 2>&1 || bad "not signed: $m"; done
        ok "code signatures present"
        # the two Mesa copies (system-layout Frameworks and /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl) must be the same file
        local lm sm; lm=$(shasum -a 256 /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-64)
        sm=$(shasum -a 256 "$SRC/Contents/Frameworks/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib" | cut -c1-64)
        [ "$lm" = "$sm" ] && ok "/Library Mesa = system-layout Mesa (${sm:0:12})" || bad "/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib (${lm:0:12}) differs from the system-layout Mesa (${sm:0:12}): install the /Library part first"
    fi
    # the kernel side: NMXAccel (nmx-ssv) probes /System/Library/Extensions/NVMTLDriver.bundle/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver
    # at start and publishes where Metal loads the plugin from (NMXMetalPluginFrom)
    local mp from; mp=$(ioreg -r -c NMXAccel -d 1 -w0 2>/dev/null | awk -F'= ' '/"MetalPluginName"/{print $2; exit}')
    from=$(ioreg -r -c NMXAccel -d 1 -w0 2>/dev/null | awk -F'= ' '/"NMXMetalPluginFrom"/{print $2; exit}')
    echo "        NMXAccel MetalPluginName = $mp, NMXMetalPluginFrom = ${from:-(absent)}"
    if [ -z "$from" ]; then bad "this NMXAccel does not probe /System/Library/Extensions (no NMXMetalPluginFrom): Metal would keep loading the /Library copy"
    else ok "NMXAccel probes /System/Library/Extensions at start (now: $from; after --apply and a reboot it reads \"system volume\")"; fi
    # Metal's bundle lookup (IOGPU +[IOGPUMetalDevice registerAcceleratorService:]) takes the FIRST <name>.bundle it finds,
    # /Library/GPUBundles before /System/Library/Extensions, and does not fall back when it cannot load it: with both
    # present every process (WindowServer too) loads the /Library copy and WebKit's GPU process fails on it
    # ("CFBundle: Error loading /Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriver.bundle ... dlopen", 2026-10-30 03:16)
    [ -e /Library/GPUBundles/$NAME ] && bad "/Library/GPUBundles/$NAME exists: it would shadow the system copy (install the /Library copy as NVMTLDriverLib.bundle first)"
    [ -d /Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle ] && ok "/Library fallback NVMTLDriverLib.bundle present" || warn "no /Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle: NMXAccel (nmx-ssv2) has no fallback if the system copy goes"
    # already installed?
    [ -e "/System/Library/Extensions/$NAME" ] && warn "/System/Library/Extensions/$NAME exists in the booted snapshot" || ok "not installed in the booted snapshot"
    echo "== preflight: $FAILS failure(s)"
    return $FAILS
}
apply() {
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || { red "--apply needs root (sudo)"; exit 1; }
    preflight || { red "preflight failed: nothing changed"; exit 1; }
    root_device
    echo "== rollback point (write it down): the last sealed snapshot of $SYSDEV; revert with:"
    echo "     sudo $0 --uninstall      (= mount $SYSDEV at $MNT; bless --mount $MNT --bootefi --last-sealed-snapshot; reboot)"
    mkdir -p "$MNT"
    mount -o nobrowse -t apfs "/dev/$SYSDEV" "$MNT" || { red "mount of /dev/$SYSDEV failed: nothing changed"; exit 1; }
    trap 'umount "$MNT" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
    local dst="$MNT/System/Library/Extensions/$NAME"
    rm -rf "$dst.new" && ditto "$SRC" "$dst.new" || { red "copy failed"; rm -rf "$dst.new"; exit 1; }
    chown -R root:wheel "$dst.new"; find "$dst.new" -type d -exec chmod 755 {} +; find "$dst.new" -type f -exec chmod 644 {} +
    find "$dst.new" -type f \( -path '*/Contents/MacOS/*' -o -name '*.dylib' \) -exec chmod 755 {} +
    rm -rf "$dst.old"; [ -e "$dst" ] && mv "$dst" "$dst.old"; mv "$dst.new" "$dst"; rm -rf "$dst.old"
    # caches: a GPU bundle is dlopen'd by Metal by path; it is in no kernel collection and not in the dyld shared cache, so
    # nothing is rebuilt (OCLP runs kmutil only when it adds kexts)
    bless --folder "$MNT/System/Library/CoreServices" --bootefi --create-snapshot || { red "bless --create-snapshot FAILED: the change is NOT bootable as a snapshot; run --uninstall"; exit 1; }
    /usr/bin/defaults write "${MARK%.plist}" build "$(sw_vers -buildVersion)"
    /usr/bin/defaults write "${MARK%.plist}" sha "$(shasum -a 256 "$SRC/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" | cut -c1-64)"
    /usr/bin/defaults write "${MARK%.plist}" date "$(date +%FT%T)"
    # its Mesa: install.sh --status tells "installed, waiting for the restart" from "another release" by it
    /usr/bin/defaults write "${MARK%.plist}" mesa "$(shasum -a 256 "$dst/Contents/Frameworks/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib" | cut -c1-64)"
    chmod 644 "$MARK"   # defaults writes it 0600 as root; --check runs as the user
    uselib_after_apply "$dst"
    echo "== installed: $dst, new boot snapshot blessed; reboot to use it. Marker $MARK"
}
uninstall() {
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || { red "--uninstall needs root (sudo)"; exit 1; }
    # Before the system copy goes, a /Library copy must be there under BOTH names NMXAccel may fall back to:
    # NVMTLDriverLib (nmx-ssv2) and NVMTLDriver (earlier NMXAccel builds). After the revert nothing is shadowed any more.
    local L=/Library/GPUBundles
    if [ ! -d "$L/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle" ]; then
        [ -d "$L/NVMTLDriver.bundle" ] || { red "no /Library fallback (neither NVMTLDriverLib.bundle nor NVMTLDriver.bundle): refusing to remove the system copy"; exit 1; }
        ditto "$L/NVMTLDriver.bundle" "$L/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle" && chown -R root:wheel "$L/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle"
    fi
    if [ ! -d "$L/NVMTLDriver.bundle" ]; then ditto "$L/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle" "$L/NVMTLDriver.bundle" && chown -R root:wheel "$L/NVMTLDriver.bundle"; fi
    echo "== /Library fallback: NVMTLDriverLib.bundle and NVMTLDriver.bundle ($(shasum -a 256 "$L/NVMTLDriver.bundle/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" | cut -c1-12))"
    root_device
    mkdir -p "$MNT"
    mount -o nobrowse -t apfs "/dev/$SYSDEV" "$MNT" || { red "mount of /dev/$SYSDEV failed"; exit 1; }
    trap 'umount "$MNT" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
    bless --mount "$MNT" --bootefi --last-sealed-snapshot || { red "bless --last-sealed-snapshot FAILED"; exit 1; }
    rm -f "$MARK"
    echo "== the last sealed snapshot is blessed: reboot to boot it (every root change is gone, ours and any other)"
}
check() {   # after a macOS update the new sealed snapshot does not have the component
    if [ ! -f "$MARK" ]; then echo "component not installed (no $MARK)"; return 0; fi
    local b; b=$(/usr/bin/defaults read "${MARK%.plist}" build 2>/dev/null)
    if [ ! -e "/System/Library/Extensions/$NAME" ]; then
        echo "NEEDS RE-APPLY: installed for build $b, now $(sw_vers -buildVersion) and /System/Library/Extensions/$NAME is gone (a macOS update replaced the snapshot): sudo $0 --apply"
        return 2
    fi
    local cur; cur=$(shasum -a 256 "/System/Library/Extensions/$NAME/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver" | cut -c1-64)
    local want; want=$(/usr/bin/defaults read "${MARK%.plist}" sha 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$cur" = "$want" ] || { echo "component present but not the one recorded (${cur:0:12} vs ${want:0:12})"; return 3; }
    local from; from=$(ioreg -r -c NMXAccel -d 1 -w0 2>/dev/null | awk -F'= ' '/"NMXMetalPluginFrom"/{print $2; exit}')
    echo "component present, build $b, plugin ${cur:0:12}; NMXAccel loads Metal's plugin from: ${from:-?}"
    if [ -e "$USELIB" ]; then
        if uselib_ours; then echo "NOT USED: $USELIB (install.sh made it for an older copy) makes NMXAccel load the /Library copy: sudo $0 --apply installs this package's copy and removes it"
        else echo "NOT USED: $USELIB (made by hand) makes NMXAccel load the /Library copy: sudo rm $USELIB, then restart"; fi
        return 5
    fi
    if [ -e "/Library/GPUBundles/$NAME" ]; then echo "SHADOWED: /Library/GPUBundles/$NAME exists - Metal loads it before the system copy (WebKit's GPU process cannot)"; return 4; fi
}
case "$MODE" in
    --preflight) preflight;;
    --apply) apply;;
    --uninstall) uninstall;;
    --check) check;;
    *) echo "usage: $0 [--preflight|--apply|--uninstall|--check]"; exit 2;;
esac

FILE: user/tools/ssv-watch/README.md
================================================
# ssv-watch: re-apply the IntelXe system-volume component after a macOS update

`ssv-install.sh --apply` puts `NVMTLDriver.bundle` (plugin, Mesa, translator) into `/System/Library/Extensions` so
WebKit's GPU process (Safari WebGL) can load it. A macOS update replaces the sealed system snapshot and the component is
gone. NMXAccel then falls back to `/Library/GPUBundles/NVMTLDriverLib.bundle`: the desktop keeps Metal, only Safari
WebGL is lost. ssv-watch notices that at login and offers to put the component back, the way OpenCore Legacy Patcher
offers its root patches after an update. It never writes to the system volume without the user's click.

## Design

| Part | Runs as | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.ssv-watch.plist` | LaunchAgent (`/Library/LaunchAgents`, Aqua sessions, `RunAtLoad`) | starts the agent at every login |
| `ssv-watch-agent.sh` | the logged-in user | read-only check; dialog; on "Yeniden kur" starts the helper through macOS's administrator prompt; offers a restart |
| `ssv-watch-helper.sh` | root, only after the click and the admin password | verifies the package and the system again, `ssv-install.sh --preflight`, then `--apply` |
| `ssv-watch-lib.sh` | both | fixed paths and the checks |

No daemon, no socket, no setuid, no sudoers entry: nothing runs as root unless the user clicks and authenticates. The
elevated command is a constant in the agent:
`/usr/bin/env -i PATH=... /bin/bash -p '/Library/Application Support/IntelXe/ssv-watch/ssv-watch-helper.sh' apply`.
The helper takes exactly one verb (`apply` or `dry-run`), refuses to run as root from anywhere but the installed path,
checks that it and its library are root-owned and not group/other-writable before sourcing, ignores the environment
(`env -i`, `bash -p`), and passes no string from the user or the system into a shell command. Dialog texts go to
`osascript` as arguments, never into the script source.

### Installed layout

```
/Library/Application Support/IntelXe/            root:wheel 755
    ssv/                                      the package (only files listed in its SHA256SUMS), 755/644
    ssv-watch/ssv-watch-agent.sh              755
    ssv-watch/ssv-watch-helper.sh             755
    ssv-watch/ssv-watch-lib.sh                644
    ssv-watch/ssv-watch.conf                  644: pinned SHA256SUMS hash, plugin hash, Darwin major, tested builds
/Library/LaunchAgents/io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.ssv-watch.plist   root:wheel 644
/Library/Logs/IntelXe/                           root:wheel 755
    ssv-watch.log                             root:wheel 644: the helper (every check, full ssv-install.sh output)
    ssv-watch-agent.<user>.log                <user> 644: the agent
~/Library/Application Support/IntelXe/ssv-watch/suppressed     the user's "Bir daha sorma" keys
```

## What is checked

At login the agent reads the marker `/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/ssv-component.plist` (written by `ssv-install.sh --apply`):

| State | Condition | Action |
|---|---|---|
| none | no marker (component never installed, or `--uninstall`) | nothing |
| ok | system copy present, plugin hash = marker, build = marker | nothing |
| missing | marker, but `/System/Library/Extensions/NVMTLDriver.bundle` absent | ask |
| hash | system copy present, plugin hash differs from the marker | ask |
| build | copy intact but the macOS build changed (e.g. a security response) | ask |
| pending | re-applied on this build after this boot (marker newer than `kern.boottime`) | one notification: restart pending |

Before offering anything, and again as root before applying:

* **Package**: SHA256SUMS hash equals the one pinned at install time; every listed file matches; no unlisted files, no
  symlinks, no `..` or absolute paths; `ssv-install.sh`, `sigcheck` and the plugin are listed; everything under
  `/Library/Application Support/IntelXe` root-owned and not group/other-writable; the package's plugin hash equals the
  marker's (the staged package is the one that was installed). Code signatures: `ssv-install.sh --preflight` runs `sigcheck`.
* **This macOS still takes the component** (hard failures: a clear message, no install button):
  same Darwin major as the package; NMXAccel loaded and probing `/System/Library/Extensions` (`NMXMetalPluginFrom`);
  WindowServer has B580 Metal device clients (the same plugin, from the `/Library` copy, works on this build); WebKit's
  `com.apple.WebKit.GPUProcess.sb` still allows `file-map-executable` from `/System/Library/Extensions`.
  A build that is not in `TESTED_BUILDS` but passes all of this gets a note in the dialog.
* **`ssv-install.sh --preflight`** (SIP 0x800, AMFI boot-arg, FileVault, snapshot, free space, signatures, NMXAccel,
  shadowing copy). Only if it passes does the helper run `--apply`, then checks that the marker now names this build and
  this plugin.

## The dialogs (Turkish, as the user sees them)

The dialogs are in Turkish for now (English: "Reinstall", "Later", "Don't ask again", "installed", "Restart").

1. Offer: "Yeniden kur" (default) / "Daha sonra" / "Bir daha sorma". Unanswered for 30 min = "Daha sonra".
   "Bir daha sorma" is remembered for this state, this build and this plugin; a later update asks again.
   `ssv-watch-agent.sh --reset` forgets every such answer.
2. Incompatible or unverifiable: what failed, "Sistem birimine dokunulmadı", "Tamam" / "Bir daha sorma".
3. After "Yeniden kur": macOS's administrator prompt; then "kuruldu" with "Yeniden başlat" / "Daha sonra" (restart via
   loginwindow, with its own confirmation), or "kurulmadı" with the helper's reason and the log path.

## Install / remove

```
sudo ./install-service.sh install --package <package-dir>   # the package installed now
sudo ./install-service.sh update-package --package DIR       # after installing a newer package by hand
sudo ./install-service.sh uninstall [--keep-package]
./install-service.sh status
```

`install` checks `./SHA256SUMS` (these files), the package (as above, minus ownership), copies only the listed files,
pins the hashes, writes the LaunchAgent and loads it for the sudo user (`--no-load`: at the next login).

## Testing without touching the system (`--test`)

```
./ssv-watch-agent.sh --test SCENARIO [--answer reinstall|later|never] [--package DIR]
```

Scenarios: `ok`, `missing`, `hash`, `build`, `major`, `noaccel`, `sandbox`, `pending`, `nomarker`. The check is pointed
at a private `mktemp -d` dir (a non-existent or fake `NVMTLDriver.bundle`, a simulated build, a fake sandbox profile);
the real `/System` is only read. "Yeniden kur" runs `ssv-watch-helper.sh dry-run` as the user (no password prompt): the
same package, compatibility and `ssv-install.sh --preflight` checks, then it reports what `--apply` would have run.
Test mode refuses to run as root, and the helper honours the test environment only for a non-root `dry-run`, so no test
can reach `--apply`, `mount` or `bless`. Restart is skipped. Logs and state stay in the temp dir (printed at the end).

`--answer` skips the dialogs (for ssh). Without it the real dialogs appear: run it from Terminal in the GUI session.

`ssv-watch-agent.sh --check` prints the state and every check without a dialog (exit 0 nothing to do, 1 action needed,
2 incompatible, 3 restart pending).

FILE: user/tools/ssv-watch/install-service.sh
================================================
#!/bin/bash -p
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# install-service.sh: install / update / remove ssv-watch (see README.md).
#   sudo ./install-service.sh install --package DIR [--no-load]
#        DIR = the ssv-install.sh package that is installed now (e.g. ~/b580/ssv8). Copies ONLY the files listed in its
#        SHA256SUMS (after checking them) to /Library/Application Support/IntelXe/ssv (root:wheel, 755/644), the agent,
#        helper and library to .../IntelXe/ssv-watch, pins the package's SHA256SUMS in ssv-watch.conf, installs
#        /Library/LaunchAgents/io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.ssv-watch.plist and (unless --no-load) loads it for the sudo user.
#   sudo ./install-service.sh update-package --package DIR    re-stage a new package (after a manual ssv-install.sh --apply)
#   sudo ./install-service.sh uninstall [--keep-package]      unload and remove everything except the logs
#   ./install-service.sh status                               files, owners, the pinned package, the agent's --check
# Writes nothing to the system volume; the component itself stays as it is.
umask 022
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; export PATH
IFS=$' \t\n'
unset CDPATH ENV BASH_ENV
H=$(cd "$(/usr/bin/dirname "$0")" && pwd -P)
. "$H/ssv-watch-lib.sh"
die() { echo "install-service: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
VERB=${1:-}; [ $# -gt 0 ] && shift
SRC=""; NOLOAD=""; KEEPPKG=""
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
        --package) SRC=${2:-}; shift;;
        --no-load) NOLOAD=1;;
        --keep-package) KEEPPKG=1;;
        *) die "unknown option $1";;
    esac; shift
done
need_root() { [ "$(/usr/bin/id -u)" = 0 ] || die "$VERB needs root: sudo $0 $VERB ..."; }
user_uid() { [ -n "${SUDO_USER:-}" ] && [ "$SUDO_USER" != root ] && /usr/bin/id -u "$SUDO_USER" 2>/dev/null; }

verify_own() {   # the agent, helper, library and plist next to this script, against ./SHA256SUMS
    [ -f "$H/SHA256SUMS" ] || die "no $H/SHA256SUMS"
    (cd "$H" && /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS >/dev/null 2>&1) || die "ssv-watch files differ from $H/SHA256SUMS"
    local f; for f in ssv-watch-agent.sh ssv-watch-helper.sh ssv-watch-lib.sh "$SSVW_LABEL.plist"; do
        /usr/bin/grep -q "  $f\$" "$H/SHA256SUMS" || die "$f not in $H/SHA256SUMS"; done
}
# the source package: the same checks the helper makes, minus ownership (it is the user's copy)
verify_src() {
    [ -n "$SRC" ] || die "--package DIR is required"
    SRC=$(cd "$SRC" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || die "no package dir"
    local save_pkg=$SSVW_PKG save_strict=$SSVW_STRICT
    SSVW_PKG=$SRC; SSVW_STRICT=0; CONF_SUMS=""; CONF_PLUGIN=""
    ssvw_read_marker
    ssvw_pkg_check; local rc=$?
    SSVW_PKG=$save_pkg; SSVW_STRICT=$save_strict
    if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
        case "$PKG_FAIL" in
            *"kurulu olan bileşen değil"*) echo "WARNING: $SRC is not the installed component (marker plugin ${MK_SHA:0:12}, package ${PKG_SHA:0:12})."
                                         echo "         ssv-watch will refuse to re-apply until the installed one and the staged one agree.";;
            *) printf '%s' "$PKG_FAIL" >&2; die "package $SRC refused";;
        esac
        [ "$(printf "%s" "$PKG_FAIL" | /usr/bin/grep -c .)" -le 1 ] || { printf "%s" "$PKG_FAIL" >&2; die "package $SRC refused"; }
    fi
    echo "package $SRC verified: plugin ${PKG_SHA:0:12}, $(/usr/bin/wc -l <"$SRC/SHA256SUMS" | /usr/bin/tr -d ' ') files"
}
mkroot() { /usr/bin/install -d -o root -g wheel -m 755 "$1" || die "mkdir $1"; }
put() {   # put SRC DST: root:wheel, 755 if the source is executable by its owner, else 644, no ACLs or flags
    local m=644; [ -x "$1" ] && m=755
    /usr/bin/install -o root -g wheel -m $m "$1" "$2" || die "copy $1"
}
stage_package() {
    local new="$SSVW_PKG.new" old="$SSVW_PKG.old" f
    /bin/rm -rf "$new" "$old"; mkroot "$SSVW_ROOT"; mkroot "$new"
    while IFS= read -r f; do
        f=${f#\*}
        mkroot "$new/$(/usr/bin/dirname "$f")"
        put "$SRC/$f" "$new/$f"
    done < <(/usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[0-9a-f]{64}  //' "$SRC/SHA256SUMS")
    put "$SRC/SHA256SUMS" "$new/SHA256SUMS"
    /usr/bin/find "$new" -type d -exec /bin/chmod 755 {} +
    /bin/chmod -RN "$new" 2>/dev/null; /usr/bin/chflags -R 0 "$new" 2>/dev/null
    (cd "$new" && /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS >/dev/null 2>&1) || { /bin/rm -rf "$new"; die "staged copy does not match SHA256SUMS"; }
    [ ! -e "$SSVW_PKG" ] || /bin/mv "$SSVW_PKG" "$old"
    /bin/mv "$new" "$SSVW_PKG" && /bin/rm -rf "$old"
    echo "staged $SSVW_PKG"
}
write_conf() {
    local tested="" t="$SSVW_DIR/ssv-watch.conf.new"
    [ -n "$MK_SHA" ] && [ "$MK_SHA" = "$PKG_SHA" ] && tested=$MK_BUILD
    local major; major=$(ssvw_major "${MK_BUILD:-$SSVW_CUR_BUILD}")
    {
        echo "# ssv-watch.conf: written by install-service.sh $(/bin/date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'); parsed, not sourced"
        echo "PKG_SUMS_SHA256=$(ssvw_sha "$SSVW_PKG/SHA256SUMS")"
        echo "PKG_PLUGIN_SHA256=$(ssvw_sha "$SSVW_PKG/system-layout/NVMTLDriver.bundle/Contents/MacOS/NVMTLDriver")"
        echo "PKG_DARWIN_MAJOR=$major"
        echo "TESTED_BUILDS=$tested"
    } >"$t" && /usr/sbin/chown root:wheel "$t" && /bin/chmod 644 "$t" && /bin/mv "$t" "$SSVW_CONF" || die "conf"
    echo "pinned in $SSVW_CONF:"; /usr/bin/sed 's/^/    /' "$SSVW_CONF"
}
logs() {
    mkroot "$SSVW_LOGDIR"
    [ -e "$SSVW_LOGDIR/ssv-watch.log" ] || { /usr/bin/touch "$SSVW_LOGDIR/ssv-watch.log"; /usr/sbin/chown root:wheel "$SSVW_LOGDIR/ssv-watch.log"; /bin/chmod 644 "$SSVW_LOGDIR/ssv-watch.log"; }
    if user_uid >/dev/null; then   # the agent's log: owned by that user, in a directory only root can write
        local f="$SSVW_LOGDIR/ssv-watch-agent.$SUDO_USER.log"
        [ -L "$f" ] && /bin/rm -f "$f"
        /usr/bin/touch "$f" && /usr/sbin/chown "$SUDO_USER" "$f" && /bin/chmod 644 "$f"
    fi
}
load_for_user() {
    local uid; uid=$(user_uid) || { echo "no sudo user: the agent loads at the next login"; return; }
    /bin/launchctl print "gui/$uid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$SUDO_USER has no GUI session: the agent loads at the next login"; return; }
    /bin/launchctl bootout "gui/$uid/$SSVW_LABEL" 2>/dev/null
    /bin/launchctl bootstrap "gui/$uid" "$SSVW_PLIST" && echo "loaded for $SUDO_USER (it checks now; silent while the component is in place)"
}
unload_all() {
    local u uid; for u in $(/usr/bin/stat -f %Su /dev/console) ${SUDO_USER:-}; do
        uid=$(/usr/bin/id -u "$u" 2>/dev/null) || continue; [ "$uid" != 0 ] || continue
        /bin/launchctl bootout "gui/$uid/$SSVW_LABEL" 2>/dev/null && echo "unloaded for $u"; done
}

case "$VERB" in
    install)
        need_root; verify_own; verify_src
        stage_package
        mkroot "$SSVW_DIR"
        put "$H/ssv-watch-agent.sh" "$SSVW_DIR/ssv-watch-agent.sh"; /bin/chmod 755 "$SSVW_DIR/ssv-watch-agent.sh"
        put "$H/ssv-watch-helper.sh" "$SSVW_HELPER"; /bin/chmod 755 "$SSVW_HELPER"
        put "$H/ssv-watch-lib.sh" "$SSVW_DIR/ssv-watch-lib.sh"; /bin/chmod 644 "$SSVW_DIR/ssv-watch-lib.sh"
        write_conf; logs
        /usr/bin/plutil -lint "$H/$SSVW_LABEL.plist" >/dev/null || die "plist"
        /usr/bin/install -o root -g wheel -m 644 "$H/$SSVW_LABEL.plist" "$SSVW_PLIST" || die "plist copy"
        echo "installed $SSVW_PLIST"
        [ -n "$NOLOAD" ] && echo "--no-load: the agent starts at the next login" || load_for_user;;
    update-package)
        need_root; [ -d "$SSVW_DIR" ] || die "ssv-watch is not installed"; verify_src; stage_package; write_conf;;
    uninstall)
        need_root; unload_all
        /bin/rm -f "$SSVW_PLIST"; /bin/rm -rf "$SSVW_DIR"
        [ -n "$KEEPPKG" ] || /bin/rm -rf "$SSVW_PKG"
        /bin/rmdir "$SSVW_ROOT" 2>/dev/null
        echo "removed (logs kept in $SSVW_LOGDIR; the system-volume component itself is untouched)";;
    status)
        /bin/ls -ld "$SSVW_ROOT" "$SSVW_PKG" "$SSVW_DIR" "$SSVW_PLIST" "$SSVW_LOGDIR" 2>&1
        [ ! -f "$SSVW_CONF" ] || /usr/bin/sed 's/^/    /' "$SSVW_CONF"
        uid=$(/usr/bin/id -u); [ "$uid" = 0 ] && uid=$(user_uid)
        [ -z "$uid" ] || /bin/launchctl print "gui/$uid/$SSVW_LABEL" 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -E '^\s*(state|last exit code|runs) ' | /usr/bin/sed 's/^/    /'
        if [ "$(/usr/bin/id -u)" != 0 ] && [ -f "$SSVW_DIR/ssv-watch-agent.sh" ]; then /bin/bash "$SSVW_DIR/ssv-watch-agent.sh" --check; fi;;
    *) /usr/bin/sed -n '3,12p' "$0"; exit 2;;
esac

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# ssv-watch-agent.sh: the user-session half of ssv-watch (LaunchAgent io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.ssv-watch, at every login).
# A macOS update replaces the sealed system snapshot and drops the optional system-volume component
# (/System/Library/Extensions/NVMTLDriver.bundle, ssv-install.sh). The desktop keeps Metal through the /Library copy;
# Safari WebGL is lost. This agent notices that, as OpenCore Legacy Patcher does after an update, and asks:
#   "Yeniden kur"     -> macOS's administrator prompt -> ssv-watch-helper.sh apply (root) -> offer a restart
#   "Daha sonra"      -> ask again at the next login
#   "Bir daha sorma"  -> never ask again for this macOS build and this component (--reset forgets it)
# It writes nothing outside the user's own files; the system volume is written only by the helper, after the click.
#
#   ssv-watch-agent.sh                 launchd entry (check, dialog, re-apply on click)
#   ssv-watch-agent.sh --check         state and compatibility, no dialog, no change (exit 0 nothing to do, 1 action
#                                      needed, 2 needed but incompatible/unverifiable, 3 restart pending)
#   ssv-watch-agent.sh --reset         forget every "Bir daha sorma"
#   ssv-watch-agent.sh --test SCENARIO [--answer reinstall|later|never|ui] [--package DIR]
#       simulate SCENARIO (ok missing hash build major noaccel sandbox pending nomarker) against a private temp dir:
#       /System is only read, the helper runs as dry-run without a password prompt, no restart. --answer skips the
#       dialogs (for ssh); without it the real dialogs appear (run it in the GUI session).
umask 022
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; export PATH
HERE=$(cd "$(/usr/bin/dirname "$0")" && pwd -P)
. "$HERE/ssv-watch-lib.sh"
[ "$(/usr/bin/id -u)" != 0 ] || { echo "ssv-watch-agent runs in the user session, not as root" >&2; exit 2; }

MODE=run; SCEN=""; ANSWER=""; TPKG=""
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
        --check) MODE=check;;
        --reset) MODE=reset;;
        --test) MODE=test; SCEN=${2:-}; shift;;
        --answer) ANSWER=${2:-}; shift
                  case "$ANSWER" in reinstall|later|never|ui) ;; *) echo "--answer reinstall|later|never|ui" >&2; exit 2;; esac;;
        --package) TPKG=${2:-}; shift;;
        *) /usr/bin/sed -n '2,/^umask/p' "$0" | /usr/bin/grep '^#' >&2; exit 2;;
    esac
    shift
done
[ "$ANSWER" != ui ] || ANSWER=""
{ [ -z "$ANSWER" ] && [ -z "$TPKG" ]; } || [ "$MODE" = test ] || { echo "--answer and --package are for --test only" >&2; exit 2; }

STATEDIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/IntelXe/ssv-watch"
if [ "$MODE" = test ]; then
    TDIR=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ssv-watch-test.XXXXXX") || exit 1
    [ -z "$TPKG" ] || TPKG=$(cd "$TPKG" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || { echo "no package dir" >&2; exit 2; }
    ssvw_test_init "$SCEN" "$TDIR" "$TPKG"
    STATEDIR="$TDIR/state"
fi
/bin/mkdir -p "$STATEDIR" || exit 1
SUPPRESS="$STATEDIR/suppressed"
ssvw_log_init agent

if [ "$MODE" = reset ]; then /bin/rm -f "$SUPPRESS"; echo "ssv-watch: forgot every \"Bir daha sorma\""; exit 0; fi

# one agent per user at a time (two logins, a manual run during the launchd one)
/usr/bin/shlock -f "$STATEDIR/agent.lock" -p $$ || { ssvw_log "another agent is running"; exit 0; }
trap '/bin/rm -f "$STATEDIR/agent.lock"' EXIT

# --- the user interface: osascript in this (Aqua) session; every text goes in as an argument, never into the script ---
osa() { /usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin HOME="$HOME" LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 /usr/bin/osascript "$@"; }
dialog() {   # dialog TITLE MESSAGE DEFAULT BUTTON... -> prints the button, "timeout" or "error N"
    osa - "$@" <<'OSA'
on run argv
	set ttl to item 1 of argv
	set msg to item 2 of argv
	set dflt to item 3 of argv
	set btns to items 4 thru -1 of argv
	try
		activate
		set r to display dialog msg with title ttl buttons btns default button dflt with icon caution giving up after 1800
	on error number n
		return "error " & n
	end try
	if gave up of r then return "timeout"
	return button returned of r
end run
OSA
}
notify() { osa - "$1" <<'OSA' >/dev/null 2>&1
on run argv
	display notification (item 1 of argv) with title "IntelXe Metal"
end run
OSA
}
ask() {   # ask TITLE MESSAGE DEFAULT BUTTON... ; --answer maps to the button in test mode
    local a
    if [ -n "$ANSWER" ]; then
        case "$ANSWER" in reinstall) a="Yeniden kur";; later) a="Daha sonra";; never) a="Bir daha sorma";; esac
        case " $* " in *" $a "*) ;; *) a=$3;; esac   # a dialog without that button: its default
        ssvw_log "dialog \"$1\" (auto-answer: $a)"; printf '%s\n' "$2" | /usr/bin/sed 's/^/    > /' >&2
        printf '%s' "$a"; return
    fi
    a=$(dialog "$@"); ssvw_log "dialog \"$1\" -> $a"; printf '%s' "$a"
}
# The privileged step. The command line is a constant: no path, build or text from anywhere else goes into it.
elevate_apply() {
    osa - "Bilgisayarı yeniden başlatmadan önce IntelXe Metal bileşenini (Safari WebGL) sistem birimine yeniden kurmak için yönetici parolası gerekiyor." <<'OSA'
on run argv
	try
		return do shell script "/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin /bin/bash -p '/Library/Application Support/IntelXe/ssv-watch/ssv-watch-helper.sh' apply; echo \"EXIT=$?\"" with prompt (item 1 of argv) with administrator privileges without altering line endings
	on error m number n
		return "RC=" & n & linefeed & m
	end try
end run
OSA
}
run_helper() {
    if [ -n "$SSVW_TEST" ]; then   # test: the dry-run, as this user, no password prompt, nothing written outside $TDIR
        /usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin HOME="$HOME" TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" INTELXE_SSVW_TEST=1 \
            INTELXE_SSVW_SIM="$SSVW_SIM" INTELXE_SSVW_TDIR="$SSVW_TDIR" INTELXE_SSVW_PKG="$TPKG" /bin/bash "$HERE/ssv-watch-helper.sh" dry-run
        return
    fi
    elevate_apply
}
restart() {
    if [ -n "$SSVW_TEST" ]; then ssvw_log "TEST: restart skipped"; return; fi
    # loginwindow's own restart (with its confirmation, apps may ask to save); if refused, say how
    osa -e 'tell application "loginwindow" to «event aevtrrst»' >/dev/null 2>&1 && return
    ask "IntelXe Metal" "Yeniden başlatma başlatılamadı. Lütfen Apple menüsünden Yeniden Başlat'ı seçin." "Tamam" "Tamam" >/dev/null
}
suppressed() { [ -f "$SUPPRESS" ] && /usr/bin/grep -qxF "$1" "$SUPPRESS"; }
suppress() { printf '%s\n' "$1" >>"$SUPPRESS"; ssvw_log "suppressed: $1"; }

# --- the check ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[ "$MODE" != run ] || /bin/sleep 20   # after login items, so the dialog is not buried
ssvw_load_conf; CONFRC=$?
ssvw_state
ssvw_log "state $STATE: marker build ${MK_BUILD:-?} (${MK_DATE:-?}) plugin ${MK_SHA:0:12}, now $SSVW_CUR_VERS ($SSVW_CUR_BUILD), system copy ${SLE_SHA:-absent}${SSVW_TEST:+, TEST $SSVW_SIM}"
case "$STATE" in
    none|ok) [ "$MODE" = run ] || echo "ssv-watch: $STATE (nothing to do)"; exit 0;;
    badmarker) ssvw_log "marker $SSVW_MARK unreadable: ignoring"; [ "$MODE" = run ] || echo "ssv-watch: marker unreadable"; exit 0;;
    pending)
        [ "$MODE" = check ] && { echo "ssv-watch: re-applied on this build, restart pending"; exit 3; }
        key="pending $(ssvw_boottime)"
        if ! suppressed "$key"; then
            if [ -n "$ANSWER" ]; then ssvw_log "notification: restart pending"; else notify "Bileşen yeniden kuruldu; etkinleşmesi için yeniden başlatma bekleniyor."; fi
            suppress "$key"
        fi
        exit 0;;
esac
[ $CONFRC -ne 2 ] || ssvw_log "ssv-watch.conf is not root-owned or is writable: the package check will fail"
[ $CONFRC -ne 1 ] || [ "$SSVW_STRICT" != 1 ] || ssvw_log "no ssv-watch.conf: service not installed?"
ssvw_pkg_check; PKGRC=$?
ssvw_compat; COMPRC=$?
ssvw_log "package: ${PKG_FAIL:-ok}; compat ok: $(printf '%s' "$COMPAT_OK" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' ')"
[ -z "$COMPAT_WARN$COMPAT_FAIL" ] || ssvw_log "compat: $(printf '%s' "$COMPAT_FAIL$COMPAT_WARN" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' ')"

case "$STATE" in
    missing) WHY="Bir macOS güncellemesi sistem birimindeki IntelXe Metal bileşenini (NVMTLDriver.bundle) kaldırmış görünüyor.";;
    hash) WHY="Sistem birimindeki NVMTLDriver.bundle kurulan sürüm değil (kayıtlı ${MK_SHA:0:12}, bulunan ${SLE_SHA:0:12}).";;
    build) WHY="macOS build'i değişti ($MK_BUILD -> $SSVW_CUR_BUILD); bileşen yerinde ama bu build için kurulmadı.";;
esac
VERS="Kurulduğu build: $MK_BUILD. Şimdiki: macOS $SSVW_CUR_VERS ($SSVW_CUR_BUILD)."
KEEP="Masaüstü hızlandırması /Library'deki kopyayla sürüyor; yalnızca Safari WebGL etkileniyor."
KEEP2=$KEEP; case "$COMPAT_FAIL" in *WindowServer*|*NMXAccel*) KEEP2="";; esac
if [ "$MODE" = check ]; then
    echo "ssv-watch: $STATE - $WHY"; echo "  $VERS"
    printf '%s' "$COMPAT_OK" | /usr/bin/sed 's/^/  ok   /'; printf '%s' "$COMPAT_WARN" | /usr/bin/sed 's/^/  warn /'
    printf '%s%s' "$PKG_FAIL" "$COMPAT_FAIL" | /usr/bin/sed 's/^/  FAIL /'
    [ "$TESTED" = yes ] || echo "  note this build is not among the tested ones ($(echo $CONF_TESTED $MK_BUILD))"
    [ $PKGRC -eq 0 ] && [ $COMPRC -eq 0 ] && exit 1 || exit 2
fi

KEY="$STATE $SSVW_CUR_BUILD $MK_SHA"
if suppressed "$KEY"; then ssvw_log "not asking: \"Bir daha sorma\" for $KEY"; exit 0; fi
if [ $PKGRC -ne 0 ] || [ $COMPRC -ne 0 ]; then
    a=$(ask "IntelXe Metal: yeniden kurulamıyor" "$WHY
$VERS

Ancak bileşen bu durumda kurulamaz:
$PKG_FAIL$COMPAT_FAIL
Sistem birimine dokunulmadı. Bu macOS için yeni bir paket gerekiyor (ssv-install.sh, sonra install-service.sh update-package). $KEEP2" "Tamam" "Bir daha sorma" "Tamam")
    [ "$a" != "Bir daha sorma" ] || suppress "$KEY"
    exit 0
fi
NOTE=""
[ "$TESTED" = yes ] || NOTE="
Not: bu paket $SSVW_CUR_BUILD üzerinde denenmedi (denenen: $(echo $CONF_TESTED $MK_BUILD)). Denetimler geçti:
$COMPAT_OK"
a=$(ask "IntelXe Metal: Safari WebGL bileşeni" "$WHY
$VERS
$KEEP
$NOTE
Yeniden kurulsun mu? Yönetici parolası istenecek; önce ön denetim çalışır, sonra yeniden başlatma gerekir." \
    "Yeniden kur" "Bir daha sorma" "Daha sonra" "Yeniden kur")
case "$a" in
    "Bir daha sorma") suppress "$KEY"; exit 0;;
    "Yeniden kur") ;;
    *) ssvw_log "later ($a)"; exit 0;;
esac

[ -n "$ANSWER" ] || notify "Ön denetim ve kurulum çalışıyor…"
R=$(run_helper)
ssvw_log "helper: $(printf '%s' "$R" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|')"
RC=$(printf '%s\n' "$R" | /usr/bin/sed -n 's/^RC=\(-\{0,1\}[0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | /usr/bin/head -1)
MSG=$(printf '%s\n' "$R" | /usr/bin/grep -v -e '^RC=' -e '^EXIT=')
LOGHINT="Kayıt: $SSVW_LOGDIR/ssv-watch.log"; [ -z "$SSVW_TEST" ] || LOGHINT="Kayıt: $SSVW_TDIR"
case "$RC" in
    0)
        a=$(ask "IntelXe Metal: kuruldu" "$MSG

Şimdi yeniden başlatılsın mı?${SSVW_TEST:+ (TEST: yeniden başlatılmaz)}" "Yeniden başlat" "Daha sonra" "Yeniden başlat")
        [ "$a" != "Yeniden başlat" ] || restart;;
    -128) ssvw_log "administrator prompt cancelled";;
    *) ask "IntelXe Metal: kurulmadı" "${MSG:-Beklenmeyen sonuç (RC=${RC:-?}).}

$LOGHINT" "Tamam" "Tamam" >/dev/null;;
esac
[ -z "$SSVW_TEST" ] || echo "ssv-watch test: logs and state in $SSVW_TDIR" >&2
exit 0

FILE: user/tools/ssv-watch/ssv-watch-helper.sh
================================================
#!/bin/bash -p
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# ssv-watch-helper.sh VERB: the only part of ssv-watch that runs as root. The agent starts it, after the user clicked
# "Yeniden kur", through macOS's own administrator prompt (osascript "do shell script ... with administrator privileges")
# with a constant command line: env -i, absolute paths, one fixed verb. Nothing listens and nothing runs as root otherwise.
#
#   apply     (root, from the installed location only) verify the staged package (pinned SHA256SUMS, every file, root
#             ownership, no extra files), check that this macOS still takes the component, run the package's
#             ssv-install.sh --preflight and, only if that passes, ssv-install.sh --apply. Log: /Library/Logs/IntelXe/ssv-watch.log
#   dry-run   all of the above except --apply (read-only; also as a normal user, and in the agent's test mode)
#
# Output (stdout): "RC=<n>" then a few lines for the user. 0 done, 10 package/integrity, 11 incompatible with this
# macOS, 12 preflight failed, 13 apply failed, 14 busy, 20 nothing to do, 2 usage. The exit status is the same number.
umask 022
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; export PATH
IFS=$' \t\n'
unset CDPATH ENV BASH_ENV
SELF_DIR=$(cd "$(/usr/bin/dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)
cd / || exit 1
FIXED_DIR="/Library/Application Support/IntelXe/ssv-watch"
usage() { echo "RC=2"; echo "usage: ssv-watch-helper.sh apply|dry-run"; exit 2; }
[ $# -eq 1 ] || usage
VERB=$1
case "$VERB" in apply|dry-run) ;; *) usage;; esac

if [ "$(/usr/bin/id -u)" = 0 ]; then
    # as root only the installed copy runs, and only with the installed, root-owned library
    [ "$0" = "$FIXED_DIR/ssv-watch-helper.sh" ] || { echo "RC=2"; echo "as root run only $FIXED_DIR/ssv-watch-helper.sh"; exit 2; }
    LIB="$FIXED_DIR/ssv-watch-lib.sh"
    for x in "$FIXED_DIR" "$LIB" "$0"; do
        [ ! -L "$x" ] && [ "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %u "$x" 2>/dev/null)" = 0 ] || { echo "RC=10"; echo "not root-owned: $x"; exit 10; }
        case "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %Lp "$x")" in *[2367][0-7]|*[2367]) echo "RC=10"; echo "writable by group/others: $x"; exit 10;; esac
    done
    . "$LIB" || { echo "RC=10"; echo "cannot load $LIB"; exit 10; }
else
    [ "$VERB" = dry-run ] || { echo "RC=2"; echo "apply needs root (the agent asks for the administrator password)"; exit 2; }
    LIB="$SELF_DIR/ssv-watch-lib.sh"
    . "$LIB" || { echo "RC=10"; echo "cannot load $LIB"; exit 10; }
    # the agent's test mode passes its scenario in the environment; honoured for a non-root dry-run only
    if [ "${INTELXE_SSVW_TEST:-}" = 1 ]; then ssvw_test_init "${INTELXE_SSVW_SIM:-}" "${INTELXE_SSVW_TDIR:-}" "${INTELXE_SSVW_PKG:-}"; fi
fi

ssvw_log_init helper
OUT=""
finish() {   # finish RC line...
    local rc=$1; shift
    OUT="RC=$rc"; local l; for l in "$@"; do [ -n "$l" ] && OUT="$OUT
$l"; done
    ssvw_log "result: $(printf '%s' "$OUT" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|')"
    printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
    [ -z "${LOCKED:-}" ] || /bin/rm -f "$SSVW_LOCK"
    exit "$rc"
}
ssvw_log "== $VERB, uid $(/usr/bin/id -u), macOS $SSVW_CUR_VERS ($SSVW_CUR_BUILD)${SSVW_TEST:+, TEST $SSVW_SIM}"
if [ "$(/usr/bin/id -u)" = 0 ]; then
    /usr/bin/shlock -f "$SSVW_LOCK" -p $$ || finish 14 "Başka bir ssv-watch işlemi sürüyor; daha sonra tekrar deneyin."
    LOCKED=1
fi

ssvw_load_conf; case $? in
    1) [ "$SSVW_STRICT" = 1 ] && finish 10 "ssv-watch.conf yok: servis kurulu değil ($SSVW_CONF).";;
    2) finish 10 "ssv-watch.conf root'a ait değil ya da yazılabilir.";;
esac
ssvw_state
ssvw_log "state $STATE: marker build ${MK_BUILD:-?} plugin ${MK_SHA:0:12}, now $SSVW_CUR_BUILD, system copy ${SLE_SHA:0:12}${SLE_SHA:+ }at $SSVW_SLE"
case "$STATE" in
    none) finish 20 "Bileşen kurulu değil (işaretçi yok): yapılacak bir şey yok.";;
    badmarker) finish 10 "İşaretçi okunamadı: $SSVW_MARK";;
    ok) finish 20 "Bileşen zaten yerinde ve kayıtla aynı: yapılacak bir şey yok.";;
    pending) finish 20 "Bileşen bu açılıştan sonra zaten yeniden kuruldu: yeniden başlatma bekleniyor.";;
esac

ssvw_pkg_check || finish 10 "Paket doğrulanamadı; sistem birimine dokunulmadı:" "$PKG_FAIL"
ssvw_log "package $SSVW_PKG verified (plugin ${PKG_SHA:0:12})"
ssvw_compat; ssvw_log "compat ok: $(printf '%s' "$COMPAT_OK" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' ')"
[ -z "$COMPAT_WARN" ] || ssvw_log "compat warn: $(printf '%s' "$COMPAT_WARN" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' ')"
[ -z "$COMPAT_FAIL" ] || finish 11 "Bu macOS ($SSVW_CUR_VERS, $SSVW_CUR_BUILD) bu paketle uyumsuz; sistem birimine dokunulmadı:" "$COMPAT_FAIL"
[ "$TESTED" = yes ] || ssvw_log "build $SSVW_CUR_BUILD is not among the tested builds ($CONF_TESTED $MK_BUILD)"

INSTALL="$SSVW_PKG/ssv-install.sh"
ssvw_log "running $INSTALL --preflight"
PF=$(/bin/bash "$INSTALL" --preflight 2>&1); rc=$?
[ -z "$SSVW_LOG" ] || printf '%s\n' "$PF" | /usr/bin/sed 's/^/    | /' >>"$SSVW_LOG"
[ -z "$SSVW_ECHO" ] || printf '%s\n' "$PF" | /usr/bin/sed 's/^/    | /' >&2
[ $rc -eq 0 ] || finish 12 "Ön denetim (ssv-install.sh --preflight) başarısız; sistem birimine dokunulmadı:" \
    "$(printf '%s\n' "$PF" | /usr/bin/grep 'FAIL' | /usr/bin/head -5)"

if [ "$VERB" = dry-run ]; then
    finish 0 "DRY-RUN: paket, uyumluluk ve ön denetim geçti. Gerçek kurulumda çalışacak olan: \"$INSTALL\" --apply (sistem birimine dokunulmadı)."
fi

ssvw_log "running $INSTALL --apply"
AP=$(/bin/bash "$INSTALL" --apply 2>&1); rc=$?
[ -z "$SSVW_LOG" ] || printf '%s\n' "$AP" | /usr/bin/sed 's/^/    | /' >>"$SSVW_LOG"
[ $rc -eq 0 ] || finish 13 "Kurulum başarısız (ssv-install.sh --apply, çıkış $rc). Ayrıntı: $SSVW_LOG" \
    "$(printf '%s\n' "$AP" | /usr/bin/tail -3)"
ssvw_read_marker
[ "$MK_BUILD" = "$SSVW_CUR_BUILD" ] && [ "$MK_SHA" = "$PKG_SHA" ] || \
    finish 13 "ssv-install.sh bitti ama işaretçi beklenen değil (build $MK_BUILD, eklenti ${MK_SHA:0:12}). Ayrıntı: $SSVW_LOG"
finish 0 "Bileşen kuruldu ve yeni açılış snapshot'ı hazırlandı. Safari WebGL için bilgisayarı yeniden başlatın."
