// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// hevcparse_test <stream.265> [golden.txt]: the direct path's HEVC parser (vtdirect_hevc.c) over a recorded Annex B
// stream, without a GPU. The stream is cut into access units and handed over as the length-prefixed samples an MP4
// carries (parameter sets in-band). Prints, in the format of tests/hevc/mkgolden.py (made from FFmpeg 9.0.2: its
// trace_headers bitstream filter and libavcodec's own HEVC decoder; the format is described there):
//   vps / sps / sps-st / sps-lt / sps-scaling / pps / pps-scaling   the parameter sets as they go into the Std structures
//   pic <type> poc=.. ... bef=.. aft=.. lt=.. dpb=..                each picture's POC, RPS, NumBitsForSTRefPicSetInSlice,
//                                                                   slice header length and the references it is decoded
//                                                                   with (what the Vulkan Video decode gets)
//   skip <type> poc=..                                              a RASL picture that is not decoded
// With a golden file it compares line by line and exits 1 at the first difference.
// Build (here, no FFmpeg): cc -O1 -Wall -I<mesa>/include hevcparse_test.c ../vtdirect_hevc.c -o hevcparse_test
#include "../vtdirect_hevc.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { const uint8_t *p; size_t n; } Nal;

static FILE *golden; static int lineno, bad;
static void emit(const char *l) {
	lineno++;
	if (!golden) { printf("%s\n", l); return; }
	char g[65536];
	if (!fgets(g, sizeof g, golden)) { if (!bad) printf("line %d: golden ends; got: %s\n", lineno, l); bad = 1; return; }
	g[strcspn(g, "\n")] = 0;
	if (strcmp(g, l) && !bad) { printf("line %d differs\n  want: %s\n  got:  %s\n", lineno, g, l); bad = 1; }
}

typedef struct { char *b; size_t n, o; } Str;
static void add(Str *s, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
#include <stdarg.h>
static void add(Str *s, const char *fmt, ...) {
	va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
	if (s->o < s->n) s->o += (size_t)vsnprintf(s->b + s->o, s->n - s->o, fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	if (s->o >= s->n) s->o = s->n - 1;
}

static void lists(Str *o, const StdVideoH265ScalingLists *sl) {
	for (int size = 0; size < 4; size++)
		for (int m = 0; m < 6; m += size == 3 ? 3 : 1) {
			const uint8_t *l = size == 0 ? sl->ScalingList4x4[m] : size == 1 ? sl->ScalingList8x8[m] : size == 2 ? sl->ScalingList16x16[m] : sl->ScalingList32x32[m / 3];
			add(o, " %d.%d=", size, m);
			if (size == 2) add(o, "%u:", sl->ScalingListDCCoef16x16[m]);
			if (size == 3) add(o, "%u:", sl->ScalingListDCCoef32x32[m / 3]);
			for (int i = 0; i < (size ? 64 : 16); i++) add(o, "%s%u", i ? "," : "", l[i]);
		}
}

static void print_vps(const HevcDVps *v) {
	char b[512]; Str o = { b, sizeof b, 0 };
	const StdVideoH265VideoParameterSet *d = &v->std;
	const int k = d->vps_max_sub_layers_minus1;
	add(&o, "vps id=%d sub_layers=%d nesting=%d profile=%d tier=%d level=%d dpb=%u/%u/%u", d->vps_video_parameter_set_id, k + 1,
	    d->flags.vps_temporal_id_nesting_flag, v->profile, v->ptl.flags.general_tier_flag, v->level_idc,
	    v->dpbm.max_dec_pic_buffering_minus1[k], v->dpbm.max_num_reorder_pics[k], v->dpbm.max_latency_increase_plus1[k]);
	emit(b);
}

static void print_sps(const HevcDSps *p) {
	static char b[16384]; Str o = { b, sizeof b, 0 };
	const StdVideoH265SequenceParameterSet *d = &p->std;
	const int k = d->sps_max_sub_layers_minus1, id = d->sps_seq_parameter_set_id;
	add(&o, "sps id=%d vps=%d sub_layers=%d profile=%d tier=%d level=%d chroma=%d w=%u h=%u conf=%u,%u,%u,%u bd=%d/%d lpoc=%d dpb=%u/%u/%u",
	    id, d->sps_video_parameter_set_id, k + 1, p->profile, p->ptl.flags.general_tier_flag, p->level_idc, d->chroma_format_idc,
	    d->pic_width_in_luma_samples, d->pic_height_in_luma_samples, p->conf[0], p->conf[1], p->conf[2], p->conf[3],
	    d->bit_depth_luma_minus8 + 8, d->bit_depth_chroma_minus8 + 8, d->log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4 + 4,
	    p->dpbm.max_dec_pic_buffering_minus1[k], p->dpbm.max_num_reorder_pics[k], p->dpbm.max_latency_increase_plus1[k]);
	add(&o, " cb=%d/%d tb=%d/%d thd=%d/%d scaling=%d/%d amp=%d sao=%d", d->log2_min_luma_coding_block_size_minus3 + 3,
	    d->log2_diff_max_min_luma_coding_block_size, d->log2_min_luma_transform_block_size_minus2 + 2,
	    d->log2_diff_max_min_luma_transform_block_size, d->max_transform_hierarchy_depth_inter, d->max_transform_hierarchy_depth_intra,
	    d->flags.scaling_list_enabled_flag, p->scaling_coded, d->flags.amp_enabled_flag, d->flags.sample_adaptive_offset_enabled_flag);
	if (p->pcm_coded) add(&o, " pcm=1:%d/%d/%d/%d/%d", d->pcm_sample_bit_depth_luma_minus1 + 1, d->pcm_sample_bit_depth_chroma_minus1 + 1,
	                      d->log2_min_pcm_luma_coding_block_size_minus3 + 3, d->log2_diff_max_min_pcm_luma_coding_block_size,
	                      d->flags.pcm_loop_filter_disabled_flag);
	else add(&o, " pcm=0");
	add(&o, " strps=%d lt=%d/%d tmvp=%d sis=%d vui=%d range=%d rext=%d", d->num_short_term_ref_pic_sets, d->flags.long_term_ref_pics_present_flag,
	    d->num_long_term_ref_pics_sps, d->flags.sps_temporal_mvp_enabled_flag, d->flags.strong_intra_smoothing_enabled_flag,
	    d->flags.vui_parameters_present_flag, p->full_range, d->flags.sps_range_extension_flag);
	emit(b);
	for (int i = 0; i < d->num_short_term_ref_pic_sets; i++) {
		const HevcDRps *r = &p->rps[i];
		o.o = 0;
		add(&o, "sps-st id=%d i=%d inter=%d d=", id, i, p->st[i].flags.inter_ref_pic_set_prediction_flag);
		for (int j = 0; j < r->num_negative + r->num_positive; j++) add(&o, "%s%d%s", j ? "," : "", r->delta[j], r->used >> j & 1 ? "*" : "");
		if (!(r->num_negative + r->num_positive)) add(&o, "-");
		emit(b);
	}
	if (d->num_long_term_ref_pics_sps) {
		o.o = 0;
		add(&o, "sps-lt id=%d ", id);
		for (int i = 0; i < d->num_long_term_ref_pics_sps; i++)
			add(&o, "%s%u%s", i ? "," : "", p->lt.lt_ref_pic_poc_lsb_sps[i], p->lt.used_by_curr_pic_lt_sps_flag >> i & 1 ? "*" : "");
		emit(b);
	}
	if (p->scaling_coded) { o.o = 0; add(&o, "sps-scaling id=%d", id); lists(&o, &p->scaling); emit(b); }
}

static void print_pps(const HevcDPps *p) {
	static char b[16384]; Str o = { b, sizeof b, 0 };
	const StdVideoH265PictureParameterSet *d = &p->std;
	add(&o, "pps id=%d sps=%d dep=%d ofp=%d xbits=%d sdh=%d cabac_init=%d l0=%d l1=%d qp=%d cip=%d tskip=%d cuqpd=%d/%d cb=%d cr=%d sqp=%d",
	    d->pps_pic_parameter_set_id, p->sps_id, d->flags.dependent_slice_segments_enabled_flag, d->flags.output_flag_present_flag,
	    d->num_extra_slice_header_bits, d->flags.sign_data_hiding_enabled_flag, d->flags.cabac_init_present_flag,
	    d->num_ref_idx_l0_default_active_minus1, d->num_ref_idx_l1_default_active_minus1, d->init_qp_minus26,
	    d->flags.constrained_intra_pred_flag, d->flags.transform_skip_enabled_flag, d->flags.cu_qp_delta_enabled_flag,
	    d->diff_cu_qp_delta_depth, d->pps_cb_qp_offset, d->pps_cr_qp_offset, d->flags.pps_slice_chroma_qp_offsets_present_flag);
	add(&o, " wp=%d wb=%d tqb=%d tiles=%d wpp=%d cols=", d->flags.weighted_pred_flag, d->flags.weighted_bipred_flag,
	    d->flags.transquant_bypass_enabled_flag, d->flags.tiles_enabled_flag, d->flags.entropy_coding_sync_enabled_flag);
	for (int i = 0; i < p->ncols; i++) add(&o, "%s%u", i ? "," : "", p->col[i]);
	add(&o, " rows=");
	for (int i = 0; i < p->nrows; i++) add(&o, "%s%u", i ? "," : "", p->row[i]);
	add(&o, " lfat=%d lfas=%d dbk=%d/%d/%d/%d/%d lmod=%d pml=%d she=%d scaling=%d rext=%d", d->flags.loop_filter_across_tiles_enabled_flag,
	    d->flags.pps_loop_filter_across_slices_enabled_flag, d->flags.deblocking_filter_control_present_flag,
	    d->flags.deblocking_filter_override_enabled_flag, d->flags.pps_deblocking_filter_disabled_flag, d->pps_beta_offset_div2,
	    d->pps_tc_offset_div2, d->flags.lists_modification_present_flag, d->log2_parallel_merge_level_minus2,
	    d->flags.slice_segment_header_extension_present_flag, d->flags.pps_scaling_list_data_present_flag, d->flags.pps_range_extension_flag);
	emit(b);
	if (d->flags.pps_scaling_list_data_present_flag) { o.o = 0; add(&o, "pps-scaling id=%d", d->pps_pic_parameter_set_id); lists(&o, &p->scaling); emit(b); }
}

static void print_pic(const HevcDPicture *pic) {
	char b[2048]; Str o = { b, sizeof b, 0 };
	add(&o, "pic %s poc=%d tid=%d slices=%u st=", hevcd_nal_type_name(pic->nal_type), pic->poc, pic->tid, pic->nslices);
	if (pic->st_mode == 0) add(&o, "-"); else if (pic->st_mode == 1) add(&o, "sps:%d", pic->st_idx); else add(&o, "sh");
	add(&o, " rpsbits=%u refdpoc=%u hdr=%d", pic->std.NumBitsForSTRefPicSetInSlice, pic->std.NumDeltaPocsOfRefRpsIdx, pic->hdr_bits);
	static const char *name[3] = { "bef", "aft", "lt" };
	for (int l = 0; l < 3; l++) {
		add(&o, " %s=", name[l]);
		for (int i = 0; i < pic->nlist[l]; i++) add(&o, "%s%s%d", i ? "," : "", pic->found[l][i] ? "" : "?", pic->list[l][i]);
		if (!pic->nlist[l]) add(&o, "-");
	}
	// the references, sorted by POC
	HevcDRef r[HEVCD_MAX_REFS]; memcpy(r, pic->refs, sizeof r);
	for (int i = 1; i < pic->nrefs; i++) for (int j = i; j > 0 && r[j].poc < r[j - 1].poc; j--) { HevcDRef t = r[j]; r[j] = r[j - 1]; r[j - 1] = t; }
	add(&o, " dpb=");
	for (int i = 0; i < pic->nrefs; i++) add(&o, "%s%d:%c", i ? "," : "", r[i].poc, r[i].long_term ? 'L' : 'S');
	if (!pic->nrefs) add(&o, "-");
	if (pic->missing) add(&o, " missing");
	emit(b);
}

// a sample: the NAL units with 4-byte lengths
static uint8_t *pack(const Nal *nals, int n, size_t *size) {
	size_t t = 0; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) t += 4 + nals[i].n;
	uint8_t *b = malloc(t ? t : 1), *w = b;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		w[0] = (uint8_t)(nals[i].n >> 24); w[1] = (uint8_t)(nals[i].n >> 16); w[2] = (uint8_t)(nals[i].n >> 8); w[3] = (uint8_t)nals[i].n;
		memcpy(w + 4, nals[i].p, nals[i].n); w += 4 + nals[i].n;
	}
	*size = t;
	return b;
}

static int type_of(const Nal *n) { return n->p[0] >> 1 & 0x3f; }
static int layer_of(const Nal *n) { return (n->p[0] & 1) << 5 | n->p[1] >> 3; }

static int run_au(HevcDState *s, const Nal *au, int n) {
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {   // the parameter sets one by one first, to print each as it comes (through an hvcC:
		const int t = type_of(&au[i]);   // that path does not touch the decoder's end-of-sequence state)
		if ((t != 32 && t != 33 && t != 34) || layer_of(&au[i])) continue;
		uint8_t *c = calloc(1, 23 + 5 + au[i].n);
		c[0] = 1; c[21] = 3; c[22] = 1; c[23] = (uint8_t)t; c[24] = 0; c[25] = 1;
		c[26] = (uint8_t)(au[i].n >> 8); c[27] = (uint8_t)au[i].n; memcpy(c + 28, au[i].p, au[i].n);
		const int r = hevcd_parse_hvcc(s, c, 28 + au[i].n);
		free(c);
		if (r < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "parameter set skipped (as libavcodec skips it): %s\n", hevcd_why(s)); continue; }
		if (t == 32) print_vps(s->vps[s->last_vps]);
		else if (t == 33) print_sps(s->sps[s->last_sps]);
		else print_pps(s->pps[s->last_pps]);
	}
	size_t sz; uint8_t *b = pack(au, n, &sz);
	const size_t need = hevcd_bitstream_size(s, b, sz);
	uint8_t *out = malloc(need ? need : 1);
	HevcDPicture pic;
	const int r = hevcd_parse_sample(s, b, sz, out, need, &pic);
	if (r == HEVCD_PICTURE) {
		if (pic.size != need) { printf("bitstream size %zu, expected %zu\n", pic.size, need); bad = 1; }
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pic.nslices; i++)
			if (pic.slice_offsets[i] + 3 > pic.size || out[pic.slice_offsets[i]] || out[pic.slice_offsets[i] + 1] || out[pic.slice_offsets[i] + 2] != 1) {
				printf("slice %u: no start code at %u\n", i, pic.slice_offsets[i]); bad = 1;
			}
		// the DPB slots Vulkan gets: below maxDpbSlots (ANV: 16), one per picture. libavcodec's Vulkan hwaccel passes its
		// DPB array index (0..31) instead, 16 on RPS_B/C/E (a 16-picture DPB, the new picture taken before the RPS frees
		// the old ones): ANV writes past its 16-entry slot table and the process aborts (B580, 13 Nov)
		uint32_t used = 0;
		for (int i = -1; i < pic.nrefs; i++) {
			const int sl = i < 0 ? pic.slot : pic.refs[i].slot;
			if (sl < 0 || sl >= HEVCD_SLOTS || (used >> sl & 1)) { printf("poc %d: slot %d out of range or used twice\n", pic.poc, sl); bad = 1; break; }
			used |= 1u << sl;
		}
		print_pic(&pic);
		hevcd_finish_picture(s, &pic);
	} else if (r == HEVCD_NO_PICTURE && s->skipped) {
		char l[128]; snprintf(l, sizeof l, "skip %s poc=%d", hevcd_nal_type_name(pic.nal_type), pic.poc); emit(l);
	} else if (r < 0) printf("sample: %d %s\n", r, hevcd_why(s));
	free(b); free(out);
	return r < 0 ? r : 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: hevcparse_test <stream.265> [golden.txt]\n"); return 2; }
	FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
	if (!f) { perror(argv[1]); return 2; }
	fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END); const long fl = ftell(f); fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
	uint8_t *d = malloc((size_t)fl + 4);
	if (fread(d, 1, (size_t)fl, f) != (size_t)fl) { perror("read"); return 2; }
	fclose(f);
	if (argc > 2 && !(golden = fopen(argv[2], "r"))) { perror(argv[2]); return 2; }
	// NAL units of the Annex B stream (trailing zero bytes belong to the next start code)
	Nal *nals = malloc(sizeof(Nal) * ((size_t)fl / 3 + 2)); int nn = 0;
	size_t i = 0, start = 0; int in = 0;
	while (i + 3 <= (size_t)fl) {
		if (d[i] == 0 && d[i + 1] == 0 && d[i + 2] == 1) {
			if (in) { size_t e = i; while (e > start && d[e - 1] == 0) e--; if (e - start >= 2) nals[nn++] = (Nal){ d + start, e - start }; }
			start = i + 3; in = 1; i += 3;
		} else i++;
	}
	if (in && (size_t)fl > start + 1) nals[nn++] = (Nal){ d + start, (size_t)fl - start };
	// access units (7.4.2.4.4): a new one at a slice segment with first_slice_segment_in_pic_flag, or at a VPS / SPS /
	// PPS / AUD / prefix SEI / reserved 41..44 / unspecified 48..55 after the last slice segment of one; EOS / EOB after a
	// slice segment end it
	HevcDState *s = calloc(1, sizeof *s);
	hevcd_init(s, 4);
	s->check = 1;
	int au0 = 0, has_slice = 0, aus = 0, rc = 0, ended = 0;
	for (int k = 0; k <= nn && !rc; k++) {
		const int t = k < nn ? type_of(&nals[k]) : -1;
		const int vcl = (t >= 0 && t <= 31) && (t <= 9 || (t >= 16 && t <= 21));
		const int first = vcl && nals[k].n > 2 && (nals[k].p[2] & 0x80);
		const int starter = t == 32 || t == 33 || t == 34 || t == 35 || t == 39 || (t >= 41 && t <= 44) || (t >= 48 && t <= 55);
		const int boundary = k == nn || ended || (has_slice && ((vcl && first) || starter));
		if (boundary && k > au0) { rc = run_au(s, nals + au0, k - au0); au0 = k; has_slice = 0; aus++; ended = 0; }
		if (vcl) has_slice = 1;
		if ((t == 36 || t == 37) && has_slice) ended = 1;   // (one before any slice belongs to the next picture's unit)
	}
	if (golden && !bad) { char g[256]; if (fgets(g, sizeof g, golden)) { printf("line %d: golden has more: %s", lineno + 1, g); bad = 1; } }
	fprintf(stderr, "%s: %d access units, %d lines%s%s\n", argv[1], aus, lineno, golden ? (bad ? ", DIFFERS from " : ", identical to ") : "", golden ? argv[2] : "");
	hevcd_free(s); free(s); free(nals); free(d);
	return rc ? 3 : bad;
}

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# hevcslot-ab.sh <kit>: on the B580 machine, the libavcodec path (INTELXEDEC_DIRECT=0) over the conformance streams on
# which libavcodec's DPB array index (FFmpeg 9.0.2's Vulkan slotIndex) reaches the driver's slot count, with the
# libraries of the kit staged one set at a time (nothing installed):
#   installed  the installed libavcodec/libavutil and libvulkan_intel.dylib. 13 Nov B580: RPS_B/C/E SIGABRT
#              (__stack_chk_fail under anv_h265_decode_video: slot 16 past ANV's 16-entry stack array); HCBP2/HCMP1
#              right (slots 17-19 wrote past dpb_slots[17] without hitting the canary); MR3_TANDBERG_B WRONG (90 of
#              300: FFmpeg's long-term lookup among the first 16 DPB entries gave a reference at entry 16 slot 0)
#   ffmpeg     libs-ffmpeg/: FFmpeg with the DPB slot patch (compact slots, the long-term lookup fixed) and the
#              exec fence patch, the installed ANV. Expected: all 7 right (13 Nov, slot patch only: 7 of 7)
#   anv        libs-anv/: the installed FFmpeg, ANV with mesa/patches/0106 (slot indices are keys up to 255 for
#              H.264/H.265; nothing refused, the command buffer always ends VK_SUCCESS). Expected: no abort, no hang;
#              RPS_B/C/E, HCBP2, HCMP1, RPS_A right; MR3_TANDBERG_B WRONG as installed (FFmpeg's slot 0 collision,
#              not a driver matter). 13 Nov with the first 0106 (refusing the decode): all five hung (exit 137)
#   both       libs-both/: both. Expected: all 7 right
#   fence      libs-fence/: the first 0106 (refuses the decode: vkEndCommandBuffer fails) with FFmpeg carrying only the
#              exec fence patch (old slot numbers). Shows that the 13 Nov hang was FFmpeg's reset fence: expected no
#              hang (no exit 137), the refused pictures lost, so RPS_B/C/E, HCBP2, HCMP1 WRONG; RPS_A right; MR3 WRONG
# A set is staged with DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, exported here inside bash (a DYLD_* variable put in front of a protected
# binary such as perl, env or sh is dropped when it starts): dyld then takes a library of the same leaf name from that
# folder first, for the plug-in's linked libavcodec/libavutil and for its dlopen of
# /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib alike. Each run's loaded copies are listed (DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES) in
# out/<set>/<stream>.libs, so the log shows which libraries ran.
# Streams (with their software references <dir>/ref/<name>.md5, sorted, vtdec --md5's format):
#   conf-hevc/RPS_B_qualcomm_5, RPS_C_ericsson_5, RPS_E_qualcomm_5: the only JCT-VC HEVC_v1 streams whose index reaches
#     16 (on 4 / 1 / 14 pictures; ANV has 16 H.265 slots), RPS_A_docomo_5 as a control (at most 5);
#   conf-h264slot/HCBP2_HHI_A, HCMP1_HHI_A: JVT streams whose H.264 index reaches 19 (on 14 pictures each; ANV has 17
#     H.264 slots, dpb_slots[17] on the stack), MR3_TANDBERG_B as a control (at most 16).
# HEVCSLOT_SETS picks the sets (default all five, in the order above). Output lines: "^S <set> <stream>: ..." and
# "^SUMMARY".
K=${1:?usage: hevcslot-ab.sh <kit>}
cd "$K" || exit 2
tmo() {
  local s=$1; shift
  "$@" & local p=$!
  ( trap 'kill $sp 2>/dev/null; exit 0' TERM; sleep "$s" & sp=$!; wait $sp; kill -9 $p 2>/dev/null ) > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  local w=$!
  wait $p; local r=$?
  kill $w 2>/dev/null; wait $w 2>/dev/null
  return $r
}
export NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_NO_INTELXEDEC=1 INTELXEDEC_DIRECT=0
O=${HEVCSLOT_OUT:-$PWD/out-hevcslot}; mkdir -p "$O"; : > "$O/summary.txt"
L=$PWD/libintelxeav1dec.dylib V=$PWD/vtdec
STREAMS="conf-hevc/RPS_B_qualcomm_5 conf-hevc/RPS_C_ericsson_5 conf-hevc/RPS_E_qualcomm_5 conf-hevc/RPS_A_docomo_5
  conf-h264slot/HCBP2_HHI_A conf-h264slot/HCMP1_HHI_A conf-h264slot/MR3_TANDBERG_B"
echo "stats before: $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'GuC context resets [0-9]+; GT resets [0-9]+')"
for set in ${HEVCSLOT_SETS:-installed ffmpeg anv both fence}; do
  case $set in installed) dir=;; ffmpeg|anv|both|fence) dir=$PWD/libs-$set;; *) echo "unknown set $set"; continue;; esac
  mkdir -p "$O/$set"
  for p in $STREAMS; do
    b=${p##*/} c=$p.mp4 ref=$(dirname "$p")/ref/${p##*/}.md5 t=$O/$set/${p##*/}
    [ -f "$c" ] || { echo "S $set $b: missing $c"; continue; }
    (
      if [ -n "$dir" ]; then export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$dir"; fi
      export DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES=1
      tmo 120 "$V" "$c" 1000000 --lib "$L" --md5 --quiet > "$t.txt" 2> "$t.err"
    )
    r=$?
    grep -oE '/[^ ]*(libvulkan_intel|libavcodec\.63|libavutil\.61)\.dylib' "$t.err" | sort -u > "$t.libs"
    grep -E '^ ?frame ' "$t.txt" | awk '{print $NF}' | sort > "$t.md5"
    n=$(wc -l < "$t.md5" | tr -d ' ')
    if [ -f "$ref" ]; then
      miss=$(comm -23 "$ref" "$t.md5" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); extra=$(comm -13 "$ref" "$t.md5" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
      if [ "$miss" = 0 ] && [ "$extra" = 0 ]; then v=right; elif [ "$miss" = 0 ]; then v="right (+$extra)"
      else v="WRONG ($miss of $(wc -l < "$ref" | tr -d ' ') missing, $extra others)"; fi
    else v="no reference"; fi
    case $r in 134) why=" (SIGABRT)";; 137) why=" (killed: time box)";; 139) why=" (SIGSEGV)";; *) why=;; esac
    echo "S $set $b: exit $r$why, $n pictures, $v; ANV $(grep libvulkan_intel "$t.libs" | head -1), libavcodec $(grep libavcodec "$t.libs" | head -1)" | tee -a "$O/summary.txt"
  done
done
echo "stats after: $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'GuC context resets [0-9]+; GT resets [0-9]+')"
echo "SUMMARY $(grep -c ': exit 0, .*, right' "$O/summary.txt") of $(grep -c '^S ' "$O/summary.txt") runs right; aborted $(grep -c 'SIGABRT' "$O/summary.txt")"

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# night-vtdirect.sh: the night phases of the direct Vulkan Video decode path against libavcodec (sourced by a night
# runner, night-b.sh style: it provides O (the output folder), say (a log line) and tmo (bash's time box: never
# perl/env/sh around DYLD_* variables), and calls phase_vtdirect / phase_vtdirect_hevc / phase_vtdirect_av1 /
# phase_vtdirect_vp9). The kit is what
# tests/vtdirect-kit.sh made (decoder test build loaded by vtdec --lib; nothing installed), copied to VTDIRECT_KIT
# (default ~/b580/vtdirect).
#   phase_vtdirect:      H.264 (VTDIRECT_CODECS=h264): the JVT conformance streams and the mediakit H.264 clips
#   phase_vtdirect_hevc: HEVC (VTDIRECT_CODECS=hevc): the JCT-VC conformance streams and the mediakit HEVC 8/10-bit clips
#   phase_vtdirect_av1:  AV1 (VTDIRECT_CODECS=av1): libaom's test vectors, FFmpeg's FATE AV1 samples, the recorded SVT-AV1
#                        streams (film grain, superres, tiles, switch frames, ...) and the mediakit AV1 8/10-bit clips
#   phase_vtdirect_vp9:  VP9 (VTDIRECT_CODECS=vp9): libvpx's test vectors (with software references), the recorded
#                        libvpx streams (seg-mapnodata: libavcodec's hwaccel expected WRONG there, the direct path
#                        right) and the mediakit VP9 8/10-bit clips
# Each: the kit's sums, a sanity decode, vtdirect-ab.sh (identity, then timing), the GPU reset counters before and after.
vtdirect_run() {   # vtdirect_run <codec> <result folder name> <sanity clip> <frames>
  local K=${VTDIRECT_KIT:-$HOME/b580/vtdirect} R="$O/$2" c=$1
  mkdir -p "$R"
  ( cd "$K" && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS > "$R/sums.txt" 2>&1 ); say "V$c: sums $(grep -c ': OK' "$R/sums.txt") OK, $(grep -vc ': OK' "$R/sums.txt") not"
  say "V$c: stats before: $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | grep -oE 'GuC context resets [0-9]+; GT resets [0-9]+')"
  ( cd "$K" && xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine . 2>/dev/null
    export NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 INTELXEDEC_DIRECT=$c
    tmo 60 ./vtdec "$3" "$4" --lib ./libintelxeav1dec.dylib --md5 --quiet > "$R/sanity.txt" 2>&1 )
  say "V$c: sanity: $(grep -E '^DECODER|^RESULT' "$R/sanity.txt" | cut -c1-240 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  ( export VTDIRECT_OUT="$R/out" VTDIRECT_CODECS=$c; tmo 2400 bash "$K/vtdirect-ab.sh" "$K" > "$R/ab.log" 2>&1 )
  say "V$c: $(grep '^SUMMARY identity:' "$R/ab.log") $(grep '^SUMMARY reference:' "$R/ab.log") | timing rows $(grep -c '^T ' "$R/out/timing.txt" 2>/dev/null)"
  grep -E '^ID .*(DIFFER|WRONG)|^SUMMARY' "$R/ab.log" | head -60 | sed 's/^/    /' >> "$O/log.txt"
  say "V$c: stats after: $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.stats | grep -oE 'GuC context resets [0-9]+; GT resets [0-9]+')"
}
phase_vtdirect() { vtdirect_run h264 vtdirect conf/MR2_TANDBERG_E.mp4 300; }
phase_vtdirect_hevc() { vtdirect_run hevc vtdirect-hevc clips/dec/dec_hevc8_1080p30.mp4 120; }
phase_vtdirect_av1() {   # the sanity clip: the mediakit's 1080p30 8-bit one, else the one the kit generated
  local K=${VTDIRECT_KIT:-$HOME/b580/vtdirect} c=clips/dec/dec_av1_8_1080p30.mp4
  [ -f "$K/$c" ] || c=$(cd "$K" && ls clips/dec/dec_av1_*.mp4 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  vtdirect_run av1 vtdirect-av1 "${c:-conf-av1/svt-grain10.mp4}" 120
}
phase_vtdirect_vp9() {   # the sanity clip: the mediakit's 1080p30 8-bit one, else the one the kit generated
  local K=${VTDIRECT_KIT:-$HOME/b580/vtdirect} c=clips/dec/dec_vp9_8_1080p30.mp4
  [ -f "$K/$c" ] || c=$(cd "$K" && ls clips/dec/dec_vp9_*.mp4 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  vtdirect_run vp9 vtdirect-vp9 "${c:-conf-vp9/lv-arf.mp4}" 120
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// pickdev.h: the Metal device of the IntelXe plugin (class NVMTLDevice), or the system's first device without it.
#pragma once
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
static id<MTLDevice> mtl_pick_intelxe(void) {
    NSArray<id<MTLDevice>> *all = MTLCopyAllDevices();
    for (id<MTLDevice> d in all)
        if ([NSStringFromClass([d class]) isEqualToString:@"NVMTLDevice"]) return d;
    return all.firstObject;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// sbprobe: what a decoder in a sandboxed video service can reach: NMXAccel's 'B580' client, and ANV (vkCreateInstance,
// physical devices, the video queue family).
#include <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
int main(void) {
	io_service_t s = IOServiceGetMatchingService(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("NMXAccel"));
	io_connect_t c = 0;
	kern_return_t kr = s ? IOServiceOpen(s, mach_task_self(), 0x42353830u, &c) : -1;
	printf("NMXAccel %s, IOServiceOpen('B580') -> 0x%x\n", s ? "found" : "not found", kr);
	if (c) IOServiceClose(c);
	void *h = dlopen("/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib", RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
	PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa = h ? (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)dlsym(h, "vk_icdGetInstanceProcAddr") : NULL;
	printf("ANV %s\n", gipa ? "loaded" : dlerror());
	if (!gipa) return 1;
	PFN_vkCreateInstance ci = (PFN_vkCreateInstance)gipa(NULL, "vkCreateInstance");
	VkApplicationInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, NULL, "sbprobe", 1, NULL, 0, VK_API_VERSION_1_3 };
	VkInstanceCreateInfo ici = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, NULL, 0, &ai };
	VkInstance inst; VkResult r = ci(&ici, NULL, &inst);
	printf("vkCreateInstance -> %d\n", r);
	if (r) return 1;
	PFN_vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices ep = (PFN_vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices)gipa(inst, "vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices");
	uint32_t n = 4; VkPhysicalDevice pd[4]; r = ep(inst, &n, pd);
	printf("physical devices: %u (%d)\n", n, r);
	if (n) { PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties q = (PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties)gipa(inst, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties");
		uint32_t nq = 8; VkQueueFamilyProperties qp[8]; q(pd[0], &nq, qp);
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nq; i++) printf("  family %u flags 0x%x x%u\n", i, qp[i].queueFlags, qp[i].queueCount); }
	return 0;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vcbench DIR SECONDS one|new|flush none|nv12|bgra|420f|420v [async 0|1]: decode throughput of the VideoToolbox decoders the
// way Video Codec Test drives them. DIR holds 0.<ext> ... N-1.<ext> (AVCC samples) and desc.<ext> (an ImageDescription
// with an avcC / hvcC atom), as in that app's Resources/h264_4k etc. A Metal device is created first, so the Metal
// plug-in registers the B580 decoders in this process.
//   one   one session, each loop: decode every sample, WaitForAsynchronousFrames
//   new   a new session per loop;  flush  FinishDelayedFrames + Wait per loop
//   420f/420v: the pixel buffer attributes that app asks for (its choice follows the format's FullRangeVideo)
// Environment: VCB_THREADS=n sessions in parallel (the app runs one per thread), VCB_PS=1 the format description from the
// parameter sets (as the app makes it: FullRangeVideo from the VUI), VCB_NOOUT=1 DoNotOutputFrame (decode only),
// VCB_SW=1 Apple's software decoder, VCB_SUM=1 a checksum of every output picture (hardware vs software), VCB_DUMP=<dir>
// every output picture's visible planes to <dir>/<pts>.yuv (with VCB_SUM: to find where two decoders differ, cmp -l).
// Build: clang -arch x86_64 -mmacosx-version-min=15.0 -fobjc-arc -O1 vcbench.m -framework Foundation -framework VideoToolbox \
//        -framework CoreMedia -framework CoreVideo -framework Metal -o vcbench
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <VideoToolbox/VideoToolbox.h>
#import <CoreMedia/CoreMedia.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>

static _Atomic long g_out, g_err;
static int g_sum;
static const char *g_dump;
static void cb(void *a, void *b, OSStatus st, VTDecodeInfoFlags f, CVImageBufferRef img, CMTime pts, CMTime dur) {
	if (st) g_err++; else g_out++;
	if (g_sum && img && !st) {
		CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress(img, kCVPixelBufferLock_ReadOnly);
		uint64_t hsh = 1469598103934665603ull;
		FILE *df = NULL;
		if (g_dump) { char fn[1024]; snprintf(fn, sizeof fn, "%s/%lld.yuv", g_dump, pts.value); df = fopen(fn, "wb"); }
		for (size_t p = 0; p < CVPixelBufferGetPlaneCount(img); p++) {
			const uint8_t *base = CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddressOfPlane(img, p);
			size_t bpr = CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRowOfPlane(img, p), rows = CVPixelBufferGetHeightOfPlane(img, p), wb = CVPixelBufferGetWidthOfPlane(img, p) * (p ? 2 : 1);
			for (size_t y = 0; y < rows; y++) for (size_t x = 0; x < wb; x++) { hsh ^= base[y * bpr + x]; hsh *= 1099511628211ull; }
			if (df) for (size_t y = 0; y < rows; y++) fwrite(base + y * bpr, 1, wb, df);
		}
		if (df) fclose(df);
		OSType pf = CVPixelBufferGetPixelFormatType(img);
		CFTypeRef m = CVBufferCopyAttachment(img, kCVImageBufferYCbCrMatrixKey, NULL);
		printf("frame pts %lld fmt %.4s %zux%zu sum %016llx\n", pts.value, (char *)&(OSType){ CFSwapInt32HostToBig(pf) },
		       CVPixelBufferGetWidth(img), CVPixelBufferGetHeight(img), hsh);
		if (m) CFRelease(m);
		CVPixelBufferUnlockBaseAddress(img, kCVPixelBufferLock_ReadOnly);
	}
}
static double now(void) { return CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent(); }

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	@autoreleasepool {
		if (argc < 5) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: vcbench DIR SECONDS one|new|flush none|nv12|bgra [async 0|1]\n"); return 2; }
		id<MTLDevice> dev = getenv("VCB_NOMETAL") ? nil : MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice(); printf("metal %s\n", dev ? dev.name.UTF8String : "-");
		// the codec comes from the folder's name (h264_2k, h265_4k): "." is resolved first
		char rp[PATH_MAX];
		NSString *dir = @(realpath(argv[1], rp) ? rp : argv[1]); double secs = atof(argv[2]); const char *mode = argv[3], *fmt = argv[4];
		int async = argc > 5 ? atoi(argv[5]) : 1;
		NSString *ext = [dir hasSuffix:@"5_4k"] || [dir hasSuffix:@"5_2k"] || [dir containsString:@"h265"] ? @"h265" : @"h264";
		NSData *desc = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:[dir stringByAppendingFormat:@"/desc.%@", ext]];
		if (desc.length < 0x24) { fprintf(stderr, "no desc.%s in %s\n", ext.UTF8String, dir.UTF8String); return 1; }
		const uint8_t *d = desc.bytes; size_t dn = desc.length;
		FourCharCode codec = (FourCharCode)d[4] | (FourCharCode)d[5] << 8 | (FourCharCode)d[6] << 16 | (FourCharCode)d[7] << 24;
		int32_t w = d[0x20] | d[0x21] << 8, h = d[0x22] | d[0x23] << 8;
		// the atoms after the 86-byte ImageDescription header: big-endian size + type
		NSMutableDictionary *atoms = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
		for (size_t o = 86; o + 8 <= dn;) {
			uint32_t sz = (uint32_t)d[o] << 24 | (uint32_t)d[o + 1] << 16 | (uint32_t)d[o + 2] << 8 | d[o + 3];
			if (sz < 8 || o + sz > dn) break;
			NSString *t = [[NSString alloc] initWithBytes:d + o + 4 length:4 encoding:NSASCIIStringEncoding];
			atoms[t] = [NSData dataWithBytes:d + o + 8 length:sz - 8];
			o += sz;
		}
		printf("codec %.4s %dx%d atoms %s\n", (char *)&(FourCharCode){ CFSwapInt32HostToBig(codec) }, w, h, [[atoms.allKeys componentsJoinedByString:@","] UTF8String]);
		NSDictionary *ext2 = @{ (id)kCMFormatDescriptionExtension_SampleDescriptionExtensionAtoms: atoms };
		CMVideoFormatDescriptionRef fd = NULL;
		OSStatus r = CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate(NULL, codec, w, h, (__bridge CFDictionaryRef)ext2, &fd);
		if (r) { printf("fd %d\n", r); return 1; }
		if (getenv("VCB_PS") && codec == 'avc1' && atoms[@"avcC"]) {   // like the app: from the parameter sets
			const uint8_t *a = [atoms[@"avcC"] bytes];
			size_t o = 5; int nsps = a[o++] & 31; const uint8_t *ps[8]; size_t pl[8]; int n = 0;
			for (int k = 0; k < nsps; k++) { size_t l = a[o] << 8 | a[o + 1]; ps[n] = a + o + 2; pl[n++] = l; o += 2 + l; }
			int npps = a[o++]; for (int k = 0; k < npps; k++) { size_t l = a[o] << 8 | a[o + 1]; ps[n] = a + o + 2; pl[n++] = l; o += 2 + l; }
			CMVideoFormatDescriptionRef fd2 = NULL;
			OSStatus r2 = CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromH264ParameterSets(NULL, (size_t)n, ps, pl, 4, &fd2);
			printf("from parameter sets: %d\n", (int)r2);
			if (!r2) { fd = fd2; CFShow(CMFormatDescriptionGetExtensions(fd)); }
		}
		if (getenv("VCB_PS") && codec == 'hvc1' && atoms[@"hvcC"]) {
			const uint8_t *a = [atoms[@"hvcC"] bytes]; size_t an = [atoms[@"hvcC"] length];
			size_t o = 22; int narr = a[o++]; const uint8_t *ps[16]; size_t pl[16]; int n = 0;
			for (int k = 0; k < narr && o < an; k++) { o++; int cnt = a[o] << 8 | a[o + 1]; o += 2;
				for (int m = 0; m < cnt; m++) { size_t l = a[o] << 8 | a[o + 1]; if (n < 16) { ps[n] = a + o + 2; pl[n++] = l; } o += 2 + l; } }
			CMVideoFormatDescriptionRef fd2 = NULL;
			OSStatus r2 = CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromHEVCParameterSets(NULL, (size_t)n, ps, pl, 4, NULL, &fd2);
			printf("from parameter sets: %d\n", (int)r2);
			if (!r2) { fd = fd2; CFShow(CMFormatDescriptionGetExtensions(fd)); }
		}
		NSMutableArray<NSData *> *frames = [NSMutableArray array];
		for (int i = 0;; i++) {
			NSData *f = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:[dir stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%d.%@", i, ext]];
			if (!f) break;
			[frames addObject:f];
		}
		NSMutableArray *samples = [NSMutableArray array];
		for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < frames.count; i++) {
			CMBlockBufferRef bb = NULL;
			CMBlockBufferCreateWithMemoryBlock(NULL, (void *)frames[i].bytes, frames[i].length, kCFAllocatorNull, NULL, 0, frames[i].length, 0, &bb);
			CMSampleTimingInfo ti = { CMTimeMake(1, 60), CMTimeMake((int64_t)i, 60), kCMTimeInvalid };
			size_t sz = frames[i].length;
			CMSampleBufferRef sb = NULL;
			CMSampleBufferCreateReady(NULL, bb, fd, 1, 1, &ti, 1, &sz, &sb);
			[samples addObject:(__bridge_transfer id)sb];
			CFRelease(bb);
		}
		int nthreads = getenv("VCB_THREADS") ? atoi(getenv("VCB_THREADS")) : 1;
		__block double tstart = now();
		dispatch_group_t g = dispatch_group_create();
		for (int ti = 0; ti < nthreads; ti++) {
			dispatch_group_async(g, dispatch_get_global_queue(QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED, 0), ^{ @autoreleasepool {
				OSStatus r;
		g_sum = getenv("VCB_SUM") != NULL;
		g_dump = getenv("VCB_DUMP");
		NSDictionary *spec = getenv("VCB_SW") ? @{ (id)kVTVideoDecoderSpecification_EnableHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder: @NO }
		                                      : @{ (id)kVTVideoDecoderSpecification_RequireHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder: @YES };
		NSDictionary *attrs = nil;
		if (!strcmp(fmt, "nv12")) attrs = @{ (id)kCVPixelBufferPixelFormatTypeKey: @(kCVPixelFormatType_420YpCbCr8BiPlanarVideoRange) };
		if (!strcmp(fmt, "420f") || !strcmp(fmt, "420v")) attrs = @{ (id)kCVPixelBufferPixelFormatTypeKey: @(fmt[3] == 'f' ? kCVPixelFormatType_420YpCbCr8BiPlanarFullRange : kCVPixelFormatType_420YpCbCr8BiPlanarVideoRange),
			(id)kCVPixelBufferWidthKey: @(w), (id)kCVPixelBufferHeightKey: @(h), (id)kCVPixelBufferMetalCompatibilityKey: @YES, (id)kCVPixelBufferIOSurfacePropertiesKey: @{} };
		if (!strcmp(fmt, "bgra")) attrs = @{ (id)kCVPixelBufferPixelFormatTypeKey: @(kCVPixelFormatType_32BGRA) };
		VTDecompressionOutputCallbackRecord rec = { cb, NULL };
		VTDecompressionSessionRef s = NULL;
		double t_create = 0; int creates = 0;
#define CREATE() do { double t0 = now(); r = VTDecompressionSessionCreate(NULL, fd, (__bridge CFDictionaryRef)spec, (__bridge CFDictionaryRef)attrs, &rec, &s); t_create += now() - t0; creates++; if (r) { printf("create %d\n", r); return; } } while (0)
		CREATE();
		CFBooleanRef hw = NULL;
		VTSessionCopyProperty(s, kVTDecompressionPropertyKey_UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder, NULL, &hw);
		printf("hardware %d\n", hw == kCFBooleanTrue);
		VTDecodeFrameFlags fl = async ? kVTDecodeFrame_EnableAsynchronousDecompression : 0;
		if (getenv("VCB_NOOUT")) fl |= kVTDecodeFrame_DoNotOutputFrame;
		if (getenv("VCB_NOOUT")) printf("DoNotOutputFrame\n");
		double t0 = now(), t_wait = 0; long loops = 0;
		while (now() - t0 < secs) {
			if (!strcmp(mode, "new") && loops) { VTDecompressionSessionInvalidate(s); CFRelease(s); CREATE(); }
			for (id sb in samples) {
				r = VTDecompressionSessionDecodeFrame(s, (__bridge CMSampleBufferRef)sb, fl, NULL, NULL);
				if (r) { g_err++; }
			}
			double tw = now();
			if (!strcmp(mode, "flush")) VTDecompressionSessionFinishDelayedFrames(s);
			VTDecompressionSessionWaitForAsynchronousFrames(s);
			t_wait += now() - tw;
			loops++;
		}
		double el = now() - t0;
		printf("%s %s async %d: %ld frames in %.2f s = %.0f fps, errors %ld, loops %ld, wait per loop %.2f ms, creates %d (%.2f ms each)\n",
		       mode, fmt, async, (long)g_out, el, g_out / el, (long)g_err, loops, t_wait / loops * 1e3, creates, t_create / creates * 1e3);
		VTDecompressionSessionInvalidate(s); CFRelease(s);
			}});
		}
		dispatch_group_wait(g, DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER);
		double tel = now() - tstart;
		printf("TOTAL threads %d: %ld frames in %.2f s = %.0f fps, errors %ld\n", nthreads, (long)g_out, tel, g_out / tel, (long)g_err);
	}
	return 0;
}

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# venc-ab.sh <dir>: the encoder upload A/B on the B580 machine, with a libintelxevenc.dylib and vtencq from encoder/build.sh
# in <dir> (nothing installed; libavcodec/libavutil and the AV1 decoder are the installed ones in /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl).
# For every codec at 1080p and 2160p:
#   q:     quality and identity, pool buffers filled per frame as a client does: --upload copy,import (PSNR, checksums)
#   speed: encoder throughput, --ring 8 --nodecode: copy,import,copy,import (order effect) and import:4, import:8
#          (libavcodec's encode depth through INTELXEVENC_ASYNC)
# HEVC also in Main10 (P010). Every vtencq run is short (seconds); run the whole script in the background:
#   nohup sh venc-ab.sh <dir> > venc-ab.log 2>&1 &
# then: grep -E '^(copy|import)|^UPLOAD|^RESULT|^vtencq|^==' venc-ab.log
set -u
D=${1:?usage: venc-ab.sh <dir with libintelxevenc.dylib and vtencq>}
L=$D/libintelxevenc.dylib Q=$D/vtencq
DEC=/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libintelxeav1dec.dylib
export NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1   # the Metal plug-in, if anything loads it, keeps INTELXEVENC_* then
run() { echo "== $*"; "$Q" --lib "$L" "$@"; echo "== exit $?"; }
for size in 1920x1080 3840x2160; do
  for c in hevc h264 av1 hevc10; do
    codec=$c extra=""
    [ "$c" = hevc10 ] && codec=hevc extra="--10bit"
    [ "$c" = av1 ] && extra="--declib $DEC --decoder any"
    nq=120 ns=600; [ "$size" = 3840x2160 ] && nq=60 ns=300
    run --codec "$codec" $extra --size "$size" --frames "$nq" --upload copy,import
    run --codec "$codec" $extra --size "$size" --frames "$ns" --ring 8 --nodecode --patterns noise,scroll \
        --upload copy,import,copy,import,import:4,import:8
  done
done
echo "== done"

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vp9parse_test <stream.ivf> [golden.txt]: the direct path's VP9 parser (vtdirect_vp9.c) over a recorded stream,
// without a GPU. Each IVF frame is handed over as the sample an MP4 / WebM carries (a frame or a superframe). Prints,
// in the format of tests/vp9/mkgolden.py (made from FFmpeg 9.0.2's trace_headers and the same rules written again in
// Python; the format is described there):
//   frame / refs / lf / seg / lavc   a decoded frame: its Std picture information, the DPB slot, the references, where
//                                    its headers are in the sample; "lavc" where libavcodec's hwaccel passes other
//                                    segmentation values (see vtdirect_vp9.h)
//   show ...                         a show_existing_frame
//   tu ...                           the sample: its frames and the one shown
// With a golden file it compares line by line and exits 1 at the first difference.
//   vp9parse_test --fuzz <seed> <iterations> <stream>: the samples damaged at random (bytes changed, cut, replaced),
//   parsed again and again: no crash, no read outside the sample (build with -fsanitize=address,undefined), and
//   whatever the parser hands out stays in range (frame offsets in the sample, DPB slots, references).
// Build (here, no FFmpeg): cc -O1 -Wall -I<mesa>/include vp9parse_test.c ../vtdirect_vp9.c -o vp9parse_test
#include "../vtdirect_vp9.h"
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static FILE *golden; static int lineno, bad;
static void emit(const char *l) {
	lineno++;
	if (!golden) { printf("%s\n", l); return; }
	char g[8192];
	if (!fgets(g, sizeof g, golden)) { if (!bad) printf("line %d: golden ends; got: %s\n", lineno, l); bad = 1; return; }
	g[strcspn(g, "\n")] = 0;
	if (strcmp(g, l) && !bad) { printf("line %d differs\n  want: %s\n  got:  %s\n", lineno, g, l); bad = 1; }
}

typedef struct { char *b; size_t n, o; } Str;
static void add(Str *s, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
static void add(Str *s, const char *fmt, ...) {
	va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt);
	if (s->o < s->n) s->o += (size_t)vsnprintf(s->b + s->o, s->n - s->o, fmt, ap);
	va_end(ap);
	if (s->o >= s->n) s->o = s->n - 1;
}
#define LINE(...) do { char b_[4096]; Str o_ = { b_, sizeof b_, 0 }; add(&o_, __VA_ARGS__); emit(b_); } while (0)

static void bytes(Str *o, const uint8_t *v, int n) { for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) add(o, "%s%u", i ? "," : "", v[i]); }

static void print_frame(int tu, int k, const Vp9dFrame *f) {
	if (f->show_existing) {
		LINE("show tu=%d k=%d slot=%d dpb=%d size=%dx%d missing=%d", tu, k, f->show_slot, f->dpb, f->width, f->height, f->missing);
		return;
	}
	if (f->error && !f->missing) { LINE("frame tu=%d k=%d error", tu, k); return; }
	const StdVideoDecodeVP9PictureInfo *p = &f->std;
	const StdVideoDecodeVP9PictureInfoFlags *fl = &p->flags;
	LINE("frame tu=%d k=%d type=%d show=%u intra=%u er=%u prof=%d size=%dx%d bd=%d refresh=%02x dpb=%d hb=%d hdr=%u/%u at=%u:%u "
	     "ctx=%u reset=%u rctx=%u par=%u hp=%u prev=%u sb=%x interp=%d q=%u/%d/%d/%d tiles=%u/%u color=%u/%u/%d missing=%d",
	     tu, k, p->frame_type, fl->show_frame, fl->intra_only, fl->error_resilient_mode, p->profile, f->width, f->height,
	     f->bit_depth, f->refresh, f->dpb, f->hdr_bits, f->uncomp_size, f->comp_size, f->offset, f->size, p->frame_context_idx,
	     p->reset_frame_context, fl->refresh_frame_context, fl->frame_parallel_decoding_mode, fl->allow_high_precision_mv,
	     fl->UsePrevFrameMvs, p->ref_frame_sign_bias_mask, p->interpolation_filter, p->base_q_idx, p->delta_q_y_dc, p->delta_q_uv_dc,
	     p->delta_q_uv_ac, p->tile_cols_log2, p->tile_rows_log2, f->color.flags.color_range, f->color.BitDepth, f->color.color_space,
	     f->missing);
	{
		char b[512]; Str o = { b, sizeof b, 0 };
		add(&o, " refs idx=%d,%d,%d names=%d,%d,%d list=", f->ref_frame_idx[0], f->ref_frame_idx[1], f->ref_frame_idx[2],
		    f->name_dpb[0], f->name_dpb[1], f->name_dpb[2]);
		for (int i = 0; i < f->nrefs; i++) add(&o, "%s%d@%d:%dx%d", i ? "," : "", f->refs[i].dpb, f->refs[i].slot, f->refs[i].width, f->refs[i].height);
		if (!f->nrefs) add(&o, "-");
		emit(b);
	}
	const StdVideoVP9LoopFilter *l = &f->lf;
	LINE(" lf level=%u sharp=%u en=%u upd=%u uref=%x umode=%x ref=%d,%d,%d,%d mode=%d,%d", l->loop_filter_level, l->loop_filter_sharpness,
	     l->flags.loop_filter_delta_enabled, l->flags.loop_filter_delta_update, l->update_ref_delta, l->update_mode_delta,
	     l->loop_filter_ref_deltas[0], l->loop_filter_ref_deltas[1], l->loop_filter_ref_deltas[2], l->loop_filter_ref_deltas[3],
	     l->loop_filter_mode_deltas[0], l->loop_filter_mode_deltas[1]);
	if (fl->segmentation_enabled) {
		const StdVideoVP9Segmentation *s = &f->seg;
		char b[1024]; Str o = { b, sizeof b, 0 };
		add(&o, " seg map=%u temp=%u data=%u abs=%u tree=", s->flags.segmentation_update_map, s->flags.segmentation_temporal_update,
		    s->flags.segmentation_update_data, s->flags.segmentation_abs_or_delta_update);
		bytes(&o, s->segmentation_tree_probs, 7); add(&o, " pred="); bytes(&o, s->segmentation_pred_prob, 3); add(&o, " feat=");
		for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) add(&o, "%s%x:%d/%d/%d/%d", i ? "," : "", s->FeatureEnabled[i], s->FeatureData[i][0], s->FeatureData[i][1],
		                                s->FeatureData[i][2], s->FeatureData[i][3]);
		emit(b);
		if (f->lavc_differs) {
			o.o = 0;
			add(&o, " lavc abs=%d tree=", f->lavc_abs); bytes(&o, f->lavc_tree, 7); add(&o, " pred="); bytes(&o, f->lavc_pred, 3);
			emit(b);
		}
	}
}

static uint8_t *slurp(const char *path, size_t *n) {
	FILE *fp = fopen(path, "rb");
	if (!fp) return NULL;
	fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_END); const long sz = ftell(fp); fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_SET);
	uint8_t *d = malloc(sz > 0 ? (size_t)sz : 1);
	*n = fread(d, 1, (size_t)(sz > 0 ? sz : 0), fp);
	fclose(fp);
	return d;
}

typedef struct { uint8_t *p; size_t n; } Sample;
static int samples_of(const uint8_t *d, size_t n, Sample **out) {
	int cnt = 0, cap = 0;
	*out = NULL;
	if (n < 32 || memcmp(d, "DKIF", 4)) return 0;
	size_t pos = d[6] | d[7] << 8;
	while (pos + 12 <= n) {
		const size_t sz = (size_t)d[pos] | (size_t)d[pos + 1] << 8 | (size_t)d[pos + 2] << 16 | (size_t)d[pos + 3] << 24;
		pos += 12;
		if (sz > n - pos) break;
		if (cnt == cap) { cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 64; *out = realloc(*out, (size_t)cap * sizeof **out); }
		(*out)[cnt].p = malloc(sz ? sz : 1); memcpy((*out)[cnt].p, d + pos, sz); (*out)[cnt].n = sz; cnt++;
		pos += sz;
	}
	return cnt;
}

static int check_invariants(const Vp9dSample *out, size_t n) {
	if (out->nframes < 1 || out->nframes > VP9D_MAX_FRAMES || out->shown >= out->nframes) return 1;
	for (int k = 0; k < out->nframes; k++) {
		const Vp9dFrame *f = &out->f[k];
		if (f->offset > n || f->size > n - f->offset) return 2;
		if (f->show_existing) { if (f->dpb >= VP9D_SLOTS || f->show_slot > 7) return 3; continue; }
		if (f->error) continue;
		if (f->dpb < 0 || f->dpb >= VP9D_SLOTS || f->nrefs > 3) return 4;
		if (f->uncomp_size == 0 || f->comp_size == 0 || (uint64_t)f->uncomp_size + f->comp_size > f->size) return 5;
		for (int i = 0; i < f->nrefs; i++) if (f->refs[i].dpb < 0 || f->refs[i].dpb >= VP9D_SLOTS || f->refs[i].dpb == f->dpb) return 6;
		for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) if (f->name_dpb[i] < -1 || f->name_dpb[i] >= VP9D_SLOTS) return 7;
		const int intra = f->std.frame_type == STD_VIDEO_VP9_FRAME_TYPE_KEY || f->std.flags.intra_only;
		if (!intra) for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {   // every name of an inter frame is among its references
			int found = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < f->nrefs; j++) if (f->refs[j].dpb == f->name_dpb[i]) found = 1;
			if (!found) return 8;
		}
		if (f->width < 1 || f->height < 1 || f->width > 65536 || f->height > 65536) return 9;
		if (f->std.pColorConfig != &f->color || f->std.pLoopFilter != &f->lf || f->std.pSegmentation != &f->seg) return 10;
	}
	return 0;
}

static uint64_t rng;
static uint32_t rnd(void) { rng ^= rng << 13; rng ^= rng >> 7; rng ^= rng << 17; return (uint32_t)(rng >> 11); }

static int fuzz(Sample *sm, int cnt, uint64_t seed, int iters) {
	rng = seed * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull + 1;
	static Vp9dSample out;
	long pictures = 0, errors = 0, unsupported = 0;
	for (int it = 0; it < iters; it++) {
		static Vp9dState s; vp9d_init(&s, it & 1 ? -1 : 0);
		for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
			size_t n = sm[i].n;
			uint8_t *d = malloc(n + 64);
			memcpy(d, sm[i].p, n);
			const int what = (int)(rnd() % 8);
			if (what < 4 && n) { for (int k = 0, m = 1 + (int)(rnd() % 8); k < m; k++) d[rnd() % n] ^= (uint8_t)(1u << (rnd() % 8)); }
			else if (what == 4 && n) n = rnd() % n;   // cut
			else if (what == 5 && n > 4) { const size_t at = rnd() % n; d[at] = (uint8_t)rnd(); }
			else if (what == 6 && n > 1) d[n - 1] = (uint8_t)(0xc0 | (rnd() & 0x1f));   // a superframe marker
			uint8_t *e = malloc(n ? n : 1);   // exactly n bytes: ASan sees any read past the sample
			memcpy(e, d, n);
			free(d);
			const int r = vp9d_parse_sample(&s, e, n, &out);
			if (r == VP9D_PICTURE) { pictures++; const int c = check_invariants(&out, n); if (c) { printf("fuzz: iteration %d sample %d: invariant %d broken\n", it, i, c); free(e); return 1; } }
			else if (r == VP9D_ERROR) errors++;
			else if (r == VP9D_UNSUPPORTED) unsupported++;
			for (int k = 0; k < out.nframes && r == VP9D_PICTURE; k++)   // as vtdirect.c: a frame it could not decode
				if (!out.f[k].show_existing && !out.f[k].error && (rnd() % 16) == 0) vp9d_lost(&s, out.f[k].gen);
			if ((rnd() % 64) == 0) vp9d_flush(&s);
			free(e);
		}
	}
	printf("fuzz: %d iterations of %d samples: %ld with pictures, %ld damaged, %ld unsupported, no invariant broken\n", iters, cnt, pictures, errors, unsupported);
	return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	if (argc >= 5 && !strcmp(argv[1], "--fuzz")) {
		size_t n; uint8_t *d = slurp(argv[4], &n);
		if (!d) { perror(argv[4]); return 2; }
		Sample *sm; const int cnt = samples_of(d, n, &sm);
		return fuzz(sm, cnt, strtoull(argv[2], NULL, 10), atoi(argv[3]));
	}
	if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: vp9parse_test <stream.ivf> [golden.txt] | --fuzz <seed> <iterations> <stream.ivf>\n"); return 2; }
	size_t n; uint8_t *d = slurp(argv[1], &n);
	if (!d) { perror(argv[1]); return 2; }
	if (argc > 2 && !(golden = fopen(argv[2], "r"))) { perror(argv[2]); return 2; }
	Sample *sm; const int cnt = samples_of(d, n, &sm);
	if (!cnt) { fprintf(stderr, "%s: not an IVF file with frames\n", argv[1]); return 2; }
	static Vp9dState s; vp9d_init(&s, -1);
	s.check = 1;
	static Vp9dSample out;
	for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
		const int r = vp9d_parse_sample(&s, sm[i].p, sm[i].n, &out);
		if (r == VP9D_UNSUPPORTED || (r == VP9D_ERROR && !out.nframes)) {
			char l[256]; snprintf(l, sizeof l, "tu %d sample: %d %s", i, r, vp9d_why(&s));
			if (golden) { if (!bad) printf("%s\n", l); bad = 1; } else printf("%s\n", l);
			if (r == VP9D_UNSUPPORTED) break;
			continue;
		}
		for (int k = 0; k < out.nframes; k++) print_frame(i, k, &out.f[k]);
		LINE("tu %d frames=%d shown=%d extra=%d sf=%d", i, out.nframes, out.shown, out.extra_shown, out.superframe);
	}
	if (golden) {
		char g[256];
		if (!bad && fgets(g, sizeof g, golden)) { printf("line %d: output ends; golden has: %s", lineno + 1, g); bad = 1; }
		if (!bad) printf("%s: %d lines identical to %s\n", argv[1], lineno, argv[2]);
	}
	return bad;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vtdec <movie> [frames] [--register <decoder binary>] [--lib <libintelxeav1dec.dylib>] [--md5] [--async] [--quiet]:
// decode a movie's video track through VTDecompressionSession (hardware decoder required), report which decoder ran
// (hardware or not), frames, a checksum per frame, the time and the CPU it took.
// --register: register the given decoder binary's IntelXeAV1_CreateInstance for av01 in this process (stage S1(a)).
// --lib: register a test build's decoders (AV1, H.264, HEVC, VP9) in this process, nothing installed; at the end its
//        statistics line (IntelXeDec_LastStats: which path decoded, fps, CPU and wall ms per DecodeFrame, latency).
// --md5: a line per output picture: "frame N pts P WxH fmt F Y[0]=y md5 M" (the visible planes; H.264 / HEVC come in
//        decode order, so two runs compare line by line). --async: kVTDecodeFrame_EnableAsynchronousDecompression (as
//        AVFoundation decodes; the default waits for each picture). frames: how many samples (default 60).
// The last line: "RESULT frames N errors E samples S wall_ms W ms_per_frame M cpu_pct C" (wall and CPU from the first
// sample to the last picture, the whole process: VideoToolbox, the decoder, the checksums if --md5).
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <AVFoundation/AVFoundation.h>
#import <VideoToolbox/VideoToolbox.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <sys/resource.h>
#include <CommonCrypto/CommonDigest.h>
extern OSStatus VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo(FourCharCode, CFDictionaryRef, void *);
static int frames, bad, md5, quiet;
static void cb(void *ref, void *src, OSStatus st, VTDecodeInfoFlags f, CVImageBufferRef img, CMTime pts, CMTime dur) {
	if (st || !img) { if (st || !(f & kVTDecodeInfo_FrameDropped)) { bad++; if (bad < 4 && !quiet) printf("  frame error %d\n", (int)st); } return; }
	frames++;
	if (md5 || (frames <= 2 && !quiet)) {
		CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress(img, kCVPixelBufferLock_ReadOnly);
		unsigned char h[16]; CC_MD5_CTX c; CC_MD5_Init(&c);
		const OSType pf = CVPixelBufferGetPixelFormatType(img);
		const int ten = pf == 'x420' || pf == 'xf20';
		for (size_t p = 0; p < CVPixelBufferGetPlaneCount(img); p++) {
			const uint8_t *b = CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddressOfPlane(img, p); const size_t bpr = CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRowOfPlane(img, p);
			const size_t w = CVPixelBufferGetWidthOfPlane(img, p) * (p ? 2 : 1) * (ten ? 2 : 1);
			for (size_t y = 0; y < CVPixelBufferGetHeightOfPlane(img, p); y++) CC_MD5_Update(&c, b + y * bpr, (CC_LONG)w);
		}
		CC_MD5_Final(h, &c);
		const uint8_t *y0 = CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddressOfPlane(img, 0);
		printf("%s frame %d pts %lld %zux%zu fmt %.4s Y[0]=%u md5 ", md5 ? "" : " ", frames, CMTIME_IS_VALID(pts) ? pts.value : -1,
		       CVPixelBufferGetWidth(img), CVPixelBufferGetHeight(img), (char *)&(uint32_t){ CFSwapInt32HostToBig(pf) }, y0 ? y0[0] : 0);
		for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) printf("%02x", h[i]);
		printf("\n");
		CVPixelBufferUnlockBaseAddress(img, kCVPixelBufferLock_ReadOnly);
	}
}
static uint64_t cpu_ns(void) {
	struct rusage ru; getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF, &ru);
	return (uint64_t)(ru.ru_utime.tv_sec + ru.ru_stime.tv_sec) * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)(ru.ru_utime.tv_usec + ru.ru_stime.tv_usec) * 1000ull;
}
static void reg(void *h, const char *sym, FourCharCode codec, NSString *cid) {
	void *f = h ? dlsym(h, sym) : NULL;
	NSDictionary *info = @{ @"CMClassImplementationID": cid, @"VTIsHardwareAccelerated": @YES, @"VTRating": @1000 };
	const OSStatus r = f ? VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo(codec, (__bridge CFDictionaryRef)info, f) : -1;
	if (!quiet) printf("register %s (%.4s): %d\n", sym, (char *)&(uint32_t){ CFSwapInt32HostToBig(codec) }, (int)r);
}
#include "pickdev.h"
int main(int argc, char **argv) { @autoreleasepool {
	if (getenv("VT_INTELXE_METAL")) { id<MTLDevice> d = mtl_pick_intelxe(); printf("metal: %s\n", d ? d.name.UTF8String : "none"); }
	if (argc < 2) { printf("usage: vtdec <movie> [frames] [--register bin] [--lib libintelxeav1dec.dylib] [--md5] [--async] [--quiet]\n"); return 2; }
	int max = 60, async = 0; const char *registered = NULL, *lib = NULL;
	for (int a = 2; a < argc; a++) {
		if (!strcmp(argv[a], "--register") && a + 1 < argc) registered = argv[++a];
		else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "--lib") && a + 1 < argc) lib = argv[++a];
		else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "--md5")) md5 = 1;
		else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "--async")) async = 1;
		else if (!strcmp(argv[a], "--quiet")) quiet = 1;
		else max = atoi(argv[a]);
	}
	if (registered) {
		void *h = dlopen(registered, RTLD_NOW); void *f = h ? dlsym(h, "IntelXeAV1_CreateInstance") : NULL;
		NSDictionary *info = @{ @"CMClassImplementationID": @"io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.videodecoder.av1", @"VTIsHardwareAccelerated": @YES, @"VTRating": @1000 };
		printf("register %s: %d\n", registered, f ? (int)VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo('av01', (__bridge CFDictionaryRef)info, f) : -1);
	}
	// VideoToolbox looks 'vp09' decoders up only after VTRegisterSupplementalVideoDecoderIfAvailable('vp09') (as the
	// Metal plug-in does before it registers ours; vtdirect-ab.sh keeps the plug-in's registration out). Without --lib
	// it also makes Apple's own VP9 decoder available (a third decoder to compare with, VTDEC_NOSPEC=1 where it is software).
	void (*sup)(uint32_t) = (void (*)(uint32_t))dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "VTRegisterSupplementalVideoDecoderIfAvailable");
	if (sup) sup('vp09');
	int (*last_stats)(char *, size_t) = NULL;
	if (lib) {
		void *h = dlopen(lib, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
		if (!h) { printf("dlopen %s: %s\n", lib, dlerror()); return 1; }
		reg(h, "IntelXeAV1_CreateInstance", 'av01', @"io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.videodecoder.av1");
		reg(h, "IntelXeH264Dec_CreateInstance", 'avc1', @"io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.videodecoder.h264");
		reg(h, "IntelXeHEVCDec_CreateInstance", 'hvc1', @"io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.videodecoder.hevc");
		reg(h, "IntelXeHEVCDec_CreateInstance", 'hev1', @"io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.videodecoder.hevc");
		reg(h, "IntelXeVP9Dec_CreateInstance", 'vp09', @"io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.videodecoder.vp9");
		last_stats = (int (*)(char *, size_t))dlsym(h, "IntelXeDec_LastStats");   // builds from 13 Nov on
	}
	if (!quiet) printf("VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported('av01') = %d\n", VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported('av01'));
	AVURLAsset *asset = [AVURLAsset URLAssetWithURL:[NSURL fileURLWithPath:@(argv[1])] options:nil];
	__block AVAssetTrack *track = nil; dispatch_semaphore_t loaded = dispatch_semaphore_create(0);
	[asset loadTracksWithMediaType:AVMediaTypeVideo completionHandler:^(NSArray<AVAssetTrack *> *tracks, NSError *error) {
		track = tracks.firstObject; dispatch_semaphore_signal(loaded); }];
	dispatch_semaphore_wait(loaded, DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER);
	if (!track) { printf("no video track\n"); return 1; }
	NSError *e = nil;
	AVAssetReader *r = [AVAssetReader assetReaderWithAsset:asset error:&e];
	AVAssetReaderTrackOutput *out = [AVAssetReaderTrackOutput assetReaderTrackOutputWithTrack:track outputSettings:nil];
	[r addOutput:out]; [r startReading];
	VTDecompressionSessionRef s = NULL; CMVideoFormatDescriptionRef fd = NULL;
	uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW), c0 = cpu_ns(); int sent = 0;
	for (CMSampleBufferRef sb; sent < max && (sb = [out copyNextSampleBuffer]); CFRelease(sb)) {
		if (!CMSampleBufferGetNumSamples(sb) || !CMSampleBufferGetFormatDescription(sb)) continue;
		if (!s) {
			fd = (CMVideoFormatDescriptionRef)CMSampleBufferGetFormatDescription(sb);
			NSDictionary *spec = getenv("VTDEC_NOSPEC") ? nil : @{ (id)kVTVideoDecoderSpecification_RequireHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder: @YES };
			if (getenv("VTDEC_FD")) printf("format: %s\n", [[(__bridge id)fd description] UTF8String]);
			VTDecompressionOutputCallbackRecord rec = { (VTDecompressionOutputCallback)cb, NULL };
			OSStatus st = VTDecompressionSessionCreate(NULL, fd, (__bridge CFDictionaryRef)spec, NULL, &rec, &s);
			CFBooleanRef hw = NULL;
			if (!st) VTSessionCopyProperty(s, kVTDecompressionPropertyKey_UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder, NULL, &hw);
			printf("session (%.4s, hardware required) -> %d, using hardware %s\n", (char *)&(uint32_t){ CFSwapInt32HostToBig(CMFormatDescriptionGetMediaSubType(fd)) },
			       (int)st, hw == kCFBooleanTrue ? "yes" : "no");
			if (st) return 1;
			t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); c0 = cpu_ns();   // from the first sample: the session's start is not counted
		}
		if (!CMSampleBufferGetNumSamples(sb)) continue;
		VTDecompressionSessionDecodeFrame(s, sb, async ? kVTDecodeFrame_EnableAsynchronousDecompression : 0, NULL, NULL); sent++;
	}
	if (s) VTDecompressionSessionWaitForAsynchronousFrames(s);
	const uint64_t t1 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW), c1 = cpu_ns();
	if (s) { VTDecompressionSessionInvalidate(s); CFRelease(s); }
	const double wall = (t1 - t0) / 1e6;
	if (!quiet) printf("%d samples sent, %d frames out, %d errors, %.1f ms\n", sent, frames, bad, wall);
	if (last_stats) {
		char line[1024] = "";
		last_stats(line, sizeof line);
		printf("DECODER %s\n", line[0] ? line : "(none: the --lib decoder did not run; another decoder took the stream)");
	}
	printf("RESULT frames %d errors %d samples %d wall_ms %.1f ms_per_frame %.3f cpu_pct %.0f\n", frames, bad, sent, wall,
	       frames ? wall / frames : 0.0, wall > 0 ? 100.0 * (c1 - c0) / 1e6 / wall : 0.0);
	return 0; } }

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# vtdirect-ab.sh <kit> [clip.mp4 ...]: the direct Vulkan Video path (INTELXEDEC_DIRECT=h264 / hevc / av1 / vp9) against the
# libavcodec path, on the B580 machine, with a test build loaded in-process by vtdec --lib (nothing installed; libavcodec
# and libavutil are the installed ones, which this change does not touch). <kit> is what vtdirect-kit.sh made:
# libintelxeav1dec.dylib, vtdec, conf/*.mp4 (the JVT H.264 conformance streams the direct path covers, remuxed),
# conf-hevc/*.mp4 (the JCT-VC HEVC ones), conf-av1/*.mp4 (libaom's test vectors, FFmpeg's FATE AV1 samples and the
# recorded SVT-AV1 streams of tests/av1), conf-vp9/*.mp4 (libvpx's test vectors and the recorded libvpx streams of
# tests/vp9, software references in conf-vp9/ref/), and clips/: the mediakit's H.264, HEVC, AV1 and VP9 clips
# (dec/dec_h264_*.mp4, dec/dec_hevc8_*.mp4, dec/dec_hevc10_*.mp4, dec/dec_av1_8_*.mp4, dec/dec_av1_10_*.mp4,
# dec/dec_vp9_8_*.mp4, dec/dec_vp9_10_*.mp4, reference md5s in ref/), or the clips given here.
#   VTDIRECT_CODECS: the codecs to run, "h264 hevc av1 vp9" by default (a night phase runs one). A clip is H.264, HEVC,
#             AV1 or VP9 by its name (dec_h264_*, dec_hevc*, dec_av1_*, dec_vp9_*, gen_*, under conf/, conf-hevc/,
#             conf-av1/ or conf-vp9/), a clip given here by its sample description ('hvc1' / 'hev1': HEVC, 'av01': AV1,
#             'vp09': VP9).
#   clips:    the kit's clips/, else $MEDIAKIT/clips, else ~/b580/mediakit/clips; with none of those for a codec, a 1080p60
#             clip made by ffmpeg (libx264 High / libx265 Main) if this machine has one, else the three largest
#             conformance streams the direct path decodes (small pictures: the timing then says so). Never no timing at
#             all: no clip, or no run that printed a RESULT line, is "SUMMARY FAILED timing" and exit 4 / 5.
#   identity: vtdec --md5 on both paths, every picture's checksum compared in output (decode) order; for the mediakit
#             clips also sorted by presentation time against the software reference (libavcodec on the CPU); for the
#             conformance streams with one (conf-hevc/ref/<name>.md5, sorted) both paths against it as multisets
#             (13 Nov: identical paths are not right paths: 12 streams the kit had remuxed without their mid-stream
#             parameter sets decoded the same wrong pictures on both);
#   timing:   vtdec --async --quiet on the clips above, libavcodec / direct alternated three times (the first session
#             of a process pays for the device): RESULT (wall ms per picture, the process's CPU %) and the decoder's own
#             line (fps, CPU ms of the thread that calls DecodeFrame, until-emitted latency); each run's output kept as
#             out/<clip>.<path>.run<i>.timing.txt, the T lines in out/timing.txt (made empty first: it always exists).
# Every vtdec run is time-boxed (tmo: a bash timer, not perl/env: those would drop DYLD_* if a run ever needs it).
# bash 3.2 (macOS's /bin/bash): no associative arrays.
# Output lines to grep: "^ID " (one per clip: identical / DIFFER), "^T " (timing), "^SUMMARY".
K=${1:?usage: vtdirect-ab.sh <kit> [clip.mp4 ...]}; shift
args=(); for c in "$@"; do case "$c" in /*) args+=("$c");; *) args+=("$PWD/$c");; esac; done   # before the cd
cd "$K" || exit 2
# (the timer's sleep is killed with it and holds no pipe: inside $(...) a stray sleep kept the substitution open)
tmo() {
  local s=$1; shift
  "$@" & local p=$!
  ( trap 'kill $sp 2>/dev/null; exit 0' TERM; sleep "$s" & sp=$!; wait $sp; kill -9 $p 2>/dev/null ) > /dev/null 2>&1 &
  local w=$!
  wait $p; local r=$?
  kill $w 2>/dev/null; wait $w 2>/dev/null
  return $r
}
# the Metal plug-in, if VideoToolbox loads it here, keeps INTELXEDEC_* and stays out of the decoder registration
export NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1 NVMTL_NO_INTELXEDEC=1
# VTDIRECT_LIBS=<dir>: libavcodec/libavutil from there instead of the installed ones (exported here, inside bash: a
# DYLD_* variable set before a protected binary such as bash itself is dropped when it starts)
[ -n "${VTDIRECT_LIBS:-}" ] && export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$VTDIRECT_LIBS"
L=$PWD/libintelxeav1dec.dylib V=$PWD/vtdec
O=${VTDIRECT_OUT:-$PWD/out}; mkdir -p "$O"
# the timing table exists from the start, whatever happens later (the 13 Nov night: it was only made by the timing
# loop, which had no clip, and the summary's awk failed on the missing file)
: > "$O/timing.txt"; : > "$O/identity.txt"
CODECS=${VTDIRECT_CODECS:-h264 hevc av1 vp9}
shopt -s nullglob
# the mediakit clips: MEDIAKIT, else the kit's own copy (vtdirect-kit.sh puts them in clips/), else ~/b580/mediakit.
if [ -n "${MEDIAKIT:-}" ]; then MK=$MEDIAKIT
elif [ -n "$(echo clips/dec/dec_h264_*.mp4 clips/dec/dec_hevc*.mp4 clips/dec/dec_av1_*.mp4 clips/dec/dec_vp9_*.mp4)" ]; then MK=$PWD
else MK=$HOME/b580/mediakit; fi
if "$V" /dev/null 1 --lib "$L" --quiet 2>&1 | grep -q '^dlopen'; then   # the build must load (its FFmpeg libraries)
  echo "SUMMARY vtdec cannot load the decoder build:"; "$V" /dev/null 1 --lib "$L" 2>&1 | head -2; exit 3
fi
codec_of() {   # h264 / hevc / av1 / vp9 for a clip
  case "${1##*/}" in dec_h264_*|gen_h264_*) echo h264; return;; dec_hevc*|gen_hevc*) echo hevc; return;; dec_av1_*|gen_av1_*) echo av1; return;; dec_vp9_*|gen_vp9_*) echo vp9; return;; esac
  case "$1" in */conf-hevc/*|conf-hevc/*) echo hevc; return;; */conf-av1/*|conf-av1/*) echo av1; return;; */conf-vp9/*|conf-vp9/*) echo vp9; return;; */conf/*|conf/*) echo h264; return;; esac
  if LC_ALL=C grep -q -a 'av01' "$1" 2>/dev/null; then echo av1
  elif LC_ALL=C grep -q -a 'vp09' "$1" 2>/dev/null; then echo vp9
  elif LC_ALL=C grep -q -a -E 'hvc1|hev1' "$1" 2>/dev/null; then echo hevc; else echo h264; fi
}
mk_of() {
  case $1 in
    h264) echo "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_h264_*.mp4;;
    hevc) echo "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_hevc8_*.mp4 "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_hevc10_*.mp4;;
    av1) for c in "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_av1_8_*.mp4 "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_av1_10_*.mp4; do case "$c" in *_4320p*) ;; *) echo "$c";; esac; done;;
    vp9) for c in "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_vp9_8_*.mp4 "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_vp9_10_*.mp4; do case "$c" in *_4320p*) ;; *) echo "$c";; esac; done;;
  esac
}
conf_of() { case $1 in h264) echo conf/*.mp4;; hevc) echo conf-hevc/*.mp4;; av1) echo conf-av1/*.mp4;; vp9) echo conf-vp9/*.mp4;; esac; }
# the conformance streams the kit adds that the direct path must hand to libavcodec (H.264: at the start; AV1: frames of
# another size, mid-stream, with the samples since the key frame replayed): not for timing
FALLBACK_RE='/(CVFI1_SVA_C|CAMA1_TOSHIBA_B|MR4_TANDBERG_C|svt-resize|av1-1-b8-03-size(up|down)|switch_frame)\.mp4$'
clips=() tclips=()
for codec in $CODECS; do
  mkc=($(mk_of $codec)) confs=($(conf_of $codec)) gen=() t=()
  if [ ${#args[@]} -gt 0 ]; then for c in "${args[@]}"; do [ "$(codec_of "$c")" = $codec ] && t+=("$c"); done; tsrc="the clips given"
  elif [ ${#mkc[@]} -gt 0 ]; then t=("${mkc[@]}"); tsrc="the mediakit clips of $MK"
  else
    ff=${VTDIRECT_FFMPEG:-$(command -v ffmpeg)} g=$O/gen_${codec}_1080p60.mp4
    case $codec in
      h264) enc="-c:v libx264 -profile:v high -preset veryfast -bf 2";; hevc) enc="-c:v libx265 -tag:v hvc1 -preset veryfast -bf 2";;
      av1) enc="-c:v libsvtav1 -preset 10";; vp9) enc="-c:v libvpx-vp9 -deadline realtime -cpu-used 8 -b:v 8M";;
    esac
    if [ -n "$ff" ] && tmo 300 "$ff" -hide_banner -v error -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1920x1080:rate=60:duration=10 \
         $enc -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 120 -y "$g" < /dev/null && [ -s "$g" ]; then
      gen=("$g"); t=("$g"); tsrc="no mediakit clips in $MK: a 1080p60 clip generated by $ff"
    else   # the largest by size, not those the direct path hands to libavcodec
      [ ${#confs[@]} -gt 0 ] && while read -r f; do t+=("$f"); done < <(ls -S "${confs[@]}" | grep -vE "$FALLBACK_RE" | head -3)
      tsrc="NO mediakit clips in $MK and no ffmpeg encoder here: the three largest conformance streams (small pictures, not representative)"
    fi
  fi
  echo "SUMMARY timing clips $codec ($tsrc): ${t[*]##*/}"
  [ ${#t[@]} -gt 0 ] && tclips+=("${t[@]}")
  if [ ${#args[@]} -gt 0 ]; then for c in "${args[@]}"; do [ "$(codec_of "$c")" = $codec ] && clips+=("$c"); done
  else for c in "${confs[@]}" "${mkc[@]}" "${gen[@]}"; do clips+=("$c"); done; fi
done
same=0 differ=0 both_failed=0 nref=0 ref_avc=0 ref_direct=0
for c in "${clips[@]}"; do
  [ -f "$c" ] || continue
  b=$(basename "$c" .mp4) codec=$(codec_of "$c")
  for p in avc direct; do
    d=0; [ $p = direct ] && d=$codec
    INTELXEDEC_DIRECT=$d tmo 120 "$V" "$c" 1000000 --lib "$L" --md5 --quiet > "$O/$b.$p.txt" 2>&1
    echo "exit $?" >> "$O/$b.$p.txt"
  done
  grep -E '^ ?frame ' "$O/$b.avc.txt" | awk '{print $NF}' > "$O/$b.avc.md5"
  grep -E '^ ?frame ' "$O/$b.direct.txt" | awk '{print $NF}' > "$O/$b.direct.md5"
  na=$(wc -l < "$O/$b.avc.md5" | tr -d ' '); nd=$(wc -l < "$O/$b.direct.md5" | tr -d ' ')
  path=$(grep -m1 '^DECODER' "$O/$b.direct.txt" | grep -oE 'path=[^ ]+|skipped=[^ ]+|fallback=.*' | tr '\n' ' ')
  if [ "$na" = 0 ] && [ "$nd" = 0 ]; then both_failed=$((both_failed + 1)); st="no pictures on either path"
  elif cmp -s "$O/$b.avc.md5" "$O/$b.direct.md5"; then same=$((same + 1)); st="identical"
  else differ=$((differ + 1)); st="DIFFER (first at picture $(paste -d' ' "$O/$b.avc.md5" "$O/$b.direct.md5" | awk '$1 != $2 {print NR; exit}'))"; fi
  cref="$(dirname "$c")/ref/$b.md5"
  if [ -f "$cref" ]; then   # a conformance stream's software reference (vtdirect-kit.sh): sorted, compared as multisets
    for p in avc direct; do
      sort "$O/$b.$p.md5" > "$O/$b.$p.sorted"
      miss=$(comm -23 "$cref" "$O/$b.$p.sorted" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); extra=$(comm -13 "$cref" "$O/$b.$p.sorted" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
      if [ "$miss" = 0 ] && [ "$extra" = 0 ]; then r=right
      # pictures the reference does not output (pic_output_flag 0, no_output_of_prior_pics): a VideoToolbox decoder
      # answers every sample with its picture (Apple's too: BUMPING_A, NoOutPrior_A/B, OPFLAG_B/C, 13 Nov)
      elif [ "$miss" = 0 ]; then r="right (+$extra not output by the reference)"
      else r="WRONG ($miss of its $(wc -l < "$cref" | tr -d ' ') pictures missing, $extra others)"; fi
      eval "r_$p=\$r"
    done
    st="$st; vs the software reference: libavcodec $r_avc, direct $r_direct"
    case "$r_avc" in right*) ref_avc=$((ref_avc + 1));; esac; case "$r_direct" in right*) ref_direct=$((ref_direct + 1));; esac
    nref=$((nref + 1))
  fi
  ref="$MK/clips/ref/$b.md5"
  if [ -f "$ref" ]; then   # the reference is in presentation order: sort by pts
    grep -E '^ ?frame ' "$O/$b.direct.txt" | awk '{print $4, $NF}' | sort -n | awk '{print $2}' > "$O/$b.direct.pts.md5"
    bad=$(paste -d' ' "$O/$b.direct.pts.md5" "$ref" | awk '$1 != $2 {n++} END {print n+0}')
    st="$st, direct vs software reference: $bad of $(wc -l < "$ref" | tr -d ' ') differ"
  fi
  echo "ID $codec $b: libavcodec $na pictures, direct $nd: $st [$path]" | tee -a "$O/identity.txt"
done
for codec in $CODECS; do
  awk -v c=$codec '$2 == c { n++; if (/: identical/) s++; else if (/DIFFER/) d++; else f++ }
    END { printf "SUMMARY identity %s: %d identical, %d differ, %d decoded by neither\n", c, s, d, f }' "$O/identity.txt" 2>/dev/null ||
    echo "SUMMARY identity $codec: 0 identical, 0 differ, 0 decoded by neither"
done
echo "SUMMARY identity: $same identical, $differ differ, $both_failed decoded by neither"
[ $nref -gt 0 ] && echo "SUMMARY reference: of $nref conformance streams with a software reference, libavcodec right on $ref_avc, direct on $ref_direct"
# timing: each clip, each path three times, alternated
[ ${#tclips[@]} -eq 0 ] && { echo "SUMMARY FAILED timing: no clip to time (no mediakit clips, no ffmpeg, no conformance streams)"; exit 4; }
for c in "${tclips[@]}"; do
  [ -f "$c" ] || { echo "SUMMARY FAILED timing: $c is missing"; continue; }
  b=$(basename "$c" .mp4) codec=$(codec_of "$c")
  for i in 1 2 3; do
    for p in avc direct; do
      d=0; [ $p = direct ] && d=$codec
      t=$O/$b.$p.run$i.timing.txt
      INTELXEDEC_DIRECT=$d tmo 120 "$V" "$c" 1000000 --lib "$L" --async --quiet > "$t" 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> "$t"
      echo "T $b $p run$i $(grep -m1 '^RESULT' "$t" | cut -d' ' -f2-) | $(grep -m1 '^DECODER' "$t" | grep -oE '(path|fps|decode_ms|cpu_ms|copy_submit_ms|latency_ms|parse_ms|record_ms|submit_ms)=[^ ]+' | tr '\n' ' ')$(grep -q '^RESULT' "$t" || echo "NO RESULT ($(tail -1 "$t"); see ${t##*/})")" | tee -a "$O/timing.txt"
    done
  done
done
nres=$(grep -c ' ms_per_frame ' "$O/timing.txt"); nrun=$(grep -c '^T ' "$O/timing.txt")
if [ "$nres" = 0 ]; then echo "SUMMARY FAILED timing: none of $nrun runs printed a RESULT line (see $O/*.timing.txt)"; exit 5; fi
[ "$nres" != "$nrun" ] && echo "SUMMARY timing: only $nres of $nrun runs printed a RESULT line (the medians use those)"
# per clip and path, the median of the runs: ms per picture (wall), process CPU %, the decoding thread's CPU ms per
# DecodeFrame, the decoder's fps
awk '$1 == "T" && / ms_per_frame / {
  k = $2 " " $3; n[k]++
  for (i = 5; i <= NF; i++) {
    if ($i == "ms_per_frame") m[k, n[k]] = $(i + 1)
    if ($i == "cpu_pct") c[k, n[k]] = $(i + 1)
    if ($i ~ /^cpu_ms=/) { split($i, a, "="); t[k, n[k]] = a[2] }
    if ($i ~ /^fps=/) { split($i, a, "="); f[k, n[k]] = a[2] }
  }
}
function med(arr, k, cnt,   i, j, v, x) { for (i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) v[i] = arr[k, i] + 0
  for (i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) for (j = i + 1; j <= cnt; j++) if (v[j] < v[i]) { x = v[i]; v[i] = v[j]; v[j] = x }
  return v[int((cnt + 1) / 2)] }
END { for (k in n) printf "SUMMARY timing %s: ms_per_frame %.3f cpu_pct %.0f decode_thread_cpu_ms %.3f decoder_fps %.1f (median of %d)\n",
        k, med(m, k, n[k]), med(c, k, n[k]), med(t, k, n[k]), med(f, k, n[k]), n[k] }' "$O/timing.txt" | sort
echo "SUMMARY done"

FILE: videotoolbox/tests/vtdirect-kit.sh
