#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# vtdirect-kit.sh <out> <H.264 conformance dir> [ffmpeg]: the folder the night A/B (vtdirect-ab.sh) runs from on the B580
# machine: the decoder test build and vtdec (build.sh), vtdirect-ab.sh, and
#   conf/: the JVT H.264 conformance streams of <H.264 conformance dir> (tests/h264/run.sh --conformance downloads them)
#          remuxed into MP4 (ffmpeg -c copy), those the direct path covers (its parser agrees with libavcodec on them
#          here) and three it hands to libavcodec at the start (fields, MBAFF, frame_num gaps);
#   conf-hevc/: with HEVC_CONF=<dir> (tests/hevc/run.sh --conformance downloads the JCT-VC streams there, <name>.bit),
#          the HEVC conformance streams the direct path covers (hevcparse_test parses them to the end; with
#          HEVC_GOLDEN=1 only those whose golden file mkgolden.py makes and the parser matches) as MP4 (none to
#          hand to libavcodec: the one HEVC_v1 stream the path does not cover, TSUNEQBD_A_MAIN10_Technicolor_2 with
#          luma and chroma bit depths that differ, libavcodec does not decode either). The parameter sets stay in band:
#          FFmpeg's MP4 muxer drops every in-band VPS/SPS/PPS from an 'hvc1' track (the sample entry is to hold them
#          all), so the 13 streams of the kit that send other parameter sets mid-stream (INITQP_*, SLIST_*, TILES_*,
#          DELTAQP_*, DBLK_A/B, TSKIP_A: mostly a PPS per picture) lost them, and both paths decoded those pictures with
#          the first PPS (the 13 Nov B580 run: 12 of them wrong on both paths, 5 of those reported as DIFFER). Muxed as
#          'hev1' (which keeps them), then the sample entry renamed 'hvc1' (hevc/inband-hvc1.py): VideoToolbox has no
#          'hev1' decoder of its own (Apple's: kVTCouldNotFindVideoDecoderErr), and an 'hvc1' track with the parameter
#          sets also in band decodes as published with Apple's decoder too (checked 13 Nov on an Apple-silicon Mac:
#          INITQP_A, SLIST_B/D, TILES_B, DELTAQP_A, TSKIP_A, RPS_B, MAXBINS_C every picture right).
#          A stream whose packets come out with one timestamp (MAXBINS_C_TI_5: all 0, a track of zero duration that
#          AVFoundation reads no sample from) is muxed again with the packets numbered in decode order (setts).
#          conf-hevc/ref/<name>.md5: the software reference, libavcodec's HEVC decoder on the CPU over the .bit, one MD5
#          per picture of the NV12 / P010 planes (vtdec --md5's format), sorted (vtdec lists decode order); the picture
#          is the visible size taken at the top left of the decoded one, as VideoToolbox decoders hand it over (Apple's
#          and ours: CONFWIN_A_Sony_1's left/top conformance window offsets are not applied to the pixels). Made only
#          where libavcodec's whole output matches the yuv MD5 published in <name>.zip (or the zip has none): 13 Nov,
#          142 of 144; not SAODBLK_A/B_MainConcept_4, where both B580 paths and Apple's decoder agree with each other
#          and not with libavcodec. vtdirect-ab.sh compares both paths with it;
#   conf-av1/: the recorded SVT-AV1 streams of tests/av1 and, with AV1_CONF=<dir> (tests/av1/run.sh --conformance
#          downloads libaom's test vectors and FFmpeg's FATE AV1 samples there), those the direct path's parser takes to
#          the end (with AV1_GOLDEN=1 only those whose golden file mkgolden.py makes and the parser matches), as MP4
#          ('av01', av1C); left out: monochrome and spatial-layer streams (the plug-in refuses them at StartSession on
#          both paths) and svt-sframe (a 16384x8704 maximum frame size: libavcodec's pictures would be that large);
#          kept: the streams with frames of another size, which the direct path hands to libavcodec mid-stream;
#   conf-vp9/: the recorded libvpx streams of tests/vp9 (seg-mapnodata: the segment map without the data, which
#          libavcodec's Vulkan hwaccel decodes with stale probabilities) and, with VP9_CONF=<dir> (tests/vp9/run.sh
#          --conformance downloads libvpx's test vectors there with their published per-frame MD5s), those the direct
#          path's parser takes to the end (with VP9_GOLDEN=1 only those whose golden file mkgolden.py makes and the
#          parser matches), as MP4 ('vp09', vpcC; -copyinkf: vp90-2-16-intra-only starts without a key frame; the
#          packets numbered with a duration each and no edit list: FFmpeg's MP4 muxer gave WebM packets without
#          durations an edit list that ends before the last sample, which AVAssetReader then does not read - the 13 Nov
#          kit lost the last picture of vp90-2-10-show-existing-frame and vp90-2-20-big_superframe-01/02 on both paths,
#          and the only one of vp90-2-15-segkey); left out: profiles 1 / 3 and 12-bit (the plug-in refuses them at
#          StartSession on both paths), frames wider or taller than 16384 (vp90-2-13-largescaling, 20400x120: refused
#          as larger than the B580 decodes) and samples that show more than one frame (vp90-2-22-svc_1280x720_3: three
#          spatial layers per superframe, a VideoToolbox decoder answers a sample with one picture); kept: the resize
#          streams (the direct path decodes them in one session; libavcodec makes a new one at each size change).
#          conf-vp9/ref/<name>.md5: the software reference, libvpx's decoder (libvpx-vp9 through ffmpeg), one MD5 per
#          picture of the NV12 / P010 planes (sorted), made only where its yuv output equals libvpx's published MD5 for
#          every frame (conformance) or libavcodec's software decode (recorded streams). (libvpx rather than libavcodec:
#          libavcodec's software VP9 decoder differs from the published MD5 after the key frame that grows
#          vp90-2-14-resize-fp-tiles-* to their largest size, 11 streams);
#   clips/: what the timing part decodes: the mediakit's H.264, HEVC and AV1 clips ($MEDIAKIT, default ~/b580/mediakit:
#          clips/dec/dec_h264_*.mp4, dec_hevc8_*, dec_hevc10_*, dec_av1_8_*, dec_av1_10_*, dec_vp9_8_* and dec_vp9_10_* but not the 4320p ones, and their reference md5s
#          clips/ref/<clip>.md5), carried in the kit because the machine need not have the mediakit (13 Nov: it had none,
#          the timing never ran); with no mediakit here, 1080p60 clips made by ffmpeg (libx264 High, libx265 Main)
#          (libsvtav1 for AV1, libvpx-vp9 for VP9) instead; with neither, the kit is not made.
# SHA256SUMS last. Copy the folder to the machine as it is.
#   FFMPEG_INSTALL=... MESA_INCLUDE=... [MEDIAKIT=...] [HEVC_CONF=...] [AV1_CONF=...] [VP9_CONF=...] vtdirect-kit.sh <out> <conformance dir> [ffmpeg]
set -eu
HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
OUT=${1:?usage: vtdirect-kit.sh <out> <conformance dir> [ffmpeg]}; CONF=${2:?conformance dir}; FF=${3:-ffmpeg}
mkdir -p "$OUT/conf" "$OUT/conf-hevc" "$OUT/conf-av1" "$OUT/conf-vp9/ref"
OUT=$(cd "$OUT" && pwd)
OUT="$OUT" sh "$HERE/../build.sh"
rm -f "$OUT/libavcodec.63.dylib" "$OUT/libavutil.61.dylib"   # the installed ones are used (this change does not touch FFmpeg)
cp "$HERE/vtdirect-ab.sh" "$OUT/"
MK=${MEDIAKIT:-$HOME/b580/mediakit}; mkdir -p "$OUT/clips/dec" "$OUT/clips/ref"; m=0 mh=0 ma=0 mv=0
for c in "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_h264_*.mp4 "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_hevc8_*.mp4 "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_hevc10_*.mp4 "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_av1_8_*.mp4 "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_av1_10_*.mp4 \
         "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_vp9_8_*.mp4 "$MK"/clips/dec/dec_vp9_10_*.mp4; do
  [ -f "$c" ] || continue
  b=$(basename "$c" .mp4)
  case "$b" in *_4320p*) continue;; dec_hevc*) mh=$((mh + 1));; dec_av1*) ma=$((ma + 1));; dec_vp9*) mv=$((mv + 1));; *) m=$((m + 1));; esac
  cp "$c" "$OUT/clips/dec/"
  if [ -f "$MK/clips/ref/$b.md5" ]; then cp "$MK/clips/ref/$b.md5" "$OUT/clips/ref/"; fi
done
gen() {   # gen <name> <ffmpeg encoder options...>: a 1080p60 clip when the mediakit has none
  n=$1; shift
  echo "vtdirect-kit: no $n clips in $MK/clips/dec: generating a 1080p60 clip with $FF" >&2
  "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1920x1080:rate=60:duration=10 "$@" \
    -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 120 -y "$OUT/clips/dec/dec_${n}_gen1080p60.mp4" < /dev/null
}
if [ $m = 0 ]; then gen h264 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -preset veryfast -bf 2; m=1; fi
if [ $mh = 0 ]; then gen hevc8 -c:v libx265 -tag:v hvc1 -preset veryfast -bf 2; mh=1; fi
if [ $ma = 0 ]; then gen av1_8 -c:v libsvtav1 -preset 10; ma=1; fi
if [ $mv = 0 ]; then gen vp9_8 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -deadline realtime -cpu-used 8 -b:v 8M; mv=1; fi
T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
cc -O1 -I"$MESA_INCLUDE" "$HERE/h264parse_test.c" "$HERE/../vtdirect_h264.c" -o "$T/p"
n=0
for f in "$CONF"/*; do
  b=$(basename "$f"); b=${b%.*}
  if "$T/p" "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1; then :; else
    case "$b" in
      CVFI1_SVA_C|CAMA1_TOSHIBA_B|MR4_TANDBERG_C) ;;   # not covered: libavcodec from StartSession on
      *) continue;;
    esac
  fi
  "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -i "$f" -c copy -y "$OUT/conf/$b.mp4" && n=$((n + 1))
done
nh=0 nr=0 nbad=0
if [ -n "${HEVC_CONF:-}" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$OUT/conf-hevc/ref"
  FP=$(dirname "$(command -v "$FF")")/ffprobe; [ -x "$FP" ] || FP=$(command -v ffprobe || true)
  cc -O1 -I"$MESA_INCLUDE" "$HERE/hevcparse_test.c" "$HERE/../vtdirect_hevc.c" -o "$T/ph"
  for f in "$HEVC_CONF"/*.bit; do
    b=$(basename "$f" .bit)
    "$T/ph" "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1 || continue
    if [ "${HEVC_GOLDEN:-0}" = 1 ]; then
      python3 "$HERE/hevc/mkgolden.py" "$f" "$FF" > "$T/g" 2> /dev/null || continue
      "$T/ph" "$f" "$T/g" > /dev/null 2>&1 || continue
    fi
    m4=$OUT/conf-hevc/$b.mp4
    if ! "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -i "$f" -c copy -tag:v hev1 -y "$m4" < /dev/null; then rm -f "$m4"; continue; fi
    if [ -n "$FP" ] && [ "$("$FP" -v error -show_entries packet=pts -of csv=p=0 "$m4" | sort -u | wc -l)" -lt 2 ] &&
       [ "$("$FP" -v error -show_entries packet=pts -of csv=p=0 "$m4" | wc -l)" -gt 1 ]; then
      "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -i "$f" -c copy -tag:v hev1 -bsf:v setts=ts=N -time_base 1/25 -y "$m4" < /dev/null || { rm -f "$m4"; continue; }
    fi
    python3 -I "$HERE/hevc/inband-hvc1.py" "$m4" || { rm -f "$m4"; continue; }
    nh=$((nh + 1))
    # the software reference, if libavcodec decodes the stream as published
    pub=$( [ -f "$HEVC_CONF/$b.zip" ] && python3 -I "$HERE/hevc/published-md5.py" "$HEVC_CONF/$b.zip" || true)
    own=$("$FF" -hide_banner -v error -threads 1 -i "$f" -f rawvideo - < /dev/null 2> /dev/null | /sbin/md5 -q || true)
    case " $pub " in "  "|*" $own "*) ;; *) nbad=$((nbad + 1)); echo "vtdirect-kit: $b: no software reference (libavcodec's yuv MD5 $own, published $pub)" >&2; continue;; esac
    # P010 for a 10-bit stream, NV12 otherwise (the kit's streams are 4:2:0, 8 or 10 bits); the visible size at the
    # top left of the decoded picture
    if "$FF" -hide_banner -i "$f" 2>&1 | grep -q 'yuv420p10'; then pf=p010le; else pf=nv12; fi
    vf=format=$pf
    if [ -n "$FP" ]; then wh=$("$FP" -v error -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0:s=x "$f" | head -1 | tr x :); vf=crop=$wh:0:0,$vf; fi
    if "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -threads 1 -apply_cropping 0 -i "$f" -vf "$vf" -fps_mode passthrough -f framemd5 - < /dev/null > "$T/r" 2> /dev/null; then
      grep -v '^#' "$T/r" | awk -F', *' '{print $NF}' | sort > "$OUT/conf-hevc/ref/$b.md5"; nr=$((nr + 1))
    else echo "vtdirect-kit: $b: the software reference failed" >&2; fi
  done
fi
na=0
cc -O1 -I"$MESA_INCLUDE" "$HERE/av1parse_test.c" "$HERE/../vtdirect_av1.c" -o "$T/pa"
for f in "$HERE"/av1/*.ivf ${AV1_CONF:+"$AV1_CONF"/*.ivf "$AV1_CONF"/*.mkv}; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  b=$(basename "$f"); b=${b%.*}
  case "$b" in svt-sframe|*monochrome*|*svc-L2T*) continue;; esac
  p=$f   # the parser and mkgolden.py read IVF: a Matroska stream is remuxed for them
  case "$f" in *.mkv) "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -i "$f" -c copy -f ivf -y "$T/x.ivf" < /dev/null || continue; p=$T/x.ivf;; esac
  "$T/pa" "$p" > "$T/o" 2>&1 || continue
  grep -q 'sample: -1 ' "$T/o" && continue   # not covered from the start (the plug-in or libavcodec decodes it)
  if [ "${AV1_GOLDEN:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    python3 "$HERE/av1/mkgolden.py" "$p" "$FF" > "$T/g" 2> /dev/null || continue
    "$T/pa" "$p" "$T/g" > /dev/null 2>&1 || continue
  fi
  if "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -i "$f" -c copy -y "$OUT/conf-av1/$b.mp4" < /dev/null; then na=$((na + 1))
  else rm -f "$OUT/conf-av1/$b.mp4"; fi
done
nv=0 nvr=0 nvbad=0
cc -O1 -I"$MESA_INCLUDE" "$HERE/vp9parse_test.c" "$HERE/../vtdirect_vp9.c" -o "$T/pv"
for f in "$HERE"/vp9/*.ivf ${VP9_CONF:+"$VP9_CONF"/*.webm "$VP9_CONF"/*.ivf}; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  b=$(basename "$f"); b=${b%.*}
  p=$f   # the parser and mkgolden.py read IVF: a WebM stream is remuxed for them
  case "$f" in *.webm) "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -i "$f" -c copy -copyinkf -f ivf -y "$T/x.ivf" < /dev/null || continue; p=$T/x.ivf;; esac
  "$T/pv" "$p" > "$T/o" 2>&1 || continue
  grep -q 'sample: -1 ' "$T/o" && continue        # profile 1 / 3, 12-bit: refused at StartSession
  grep -qE 'extra=[1-9]' "$T/o" && continue        # several pictures per sample (spatial layers)
  grep -oE 'size=[0-9]+x[0-9]+' "$T/o" | tr 'x=' '  ' | awk '$2 > 16384 || $3 > 16384 {b = 1} END {exit !b}' && continue   # larger than the B580 decodes
  if [ "${VP9_GOLDEN:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    python3 "$HERE/vp9/mkgolden.py" "$p" "$FF" > "$T/g" 2> /dev/null || continue
    "$T/pv" "$p" "$T/g" > /dev/null 2>&1 || continue
  fi
  if ! "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -i "$f" -c copy -copyinkf -bsf:v setts=ts=N:duration=1 -time_base 1/30 -use_editlist 0 \
         -y "$OUT/conf-vp9/$b.mp4" < /dev/null; then rm -f "$OUT/conf-vp9/$b.mp4"; continue; fi
  nv=$((nv + 1))
  # the software reference: libvpx's decoder, checked against the published per-frame MD5s (or, for the recorded
  # streams, against libavcodec's software decoder); every picture at its own size (the resize streams change it)
  if grep -q 'bd=10' "$T/o"; then pf=yuv420p10le npf=p010le; else pf=yuv420p npf=nv12; fi
  own=$("$FF" -hide_banner -v error -threads 1 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -i "$p" -noautoscale -pix_fmt $pf -f framemd5 - < /dev/null 2> /dev/null | grep -v '^#' | awk -F', *' '{print $NF}')
  if [ -f "$f.md5" ]; then pub=$(awk '{print $1}' "$f.md5")
  else pub=$("$FF" -hide_banner -v error -threads 1 -c:v vp9 -i "$p" -noautoscale -pix_fmt $pf -f framemd5 - < /dev/null 2> /dev/null | grep -v '^#' | awk -F', *' '{print $NF}'); fi
  if [ -z "$own" ] || [ "$own" != "$pub" ]; then nvbad=$((nvbad + 1)); echo "vtdirect-kit: $b: no software reference (libvpx's decode differs from the published MD5 / libavcodec's)" >&2; continue; fi
  if "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -threads 1 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -i "$p" -noautoscale -vf format=$npf -fps_mode passthrough -f framemd5 - < /dev/null > "$T/r" 2> /dev/null; then
    grep -v '^#' "$T/r" | awk -F', *' '{print $NF}' | sort > "$OUT/conf-vp9/ref/$b.md5"; nvr=$((nvr + 1))
  else echo "vtdirect-kit: $b: the software reference failed" >&2; fi
done
( cd "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 > SHA256SUMS )
echo "kit: $OUT ($n H.264, $nh HEVC, $na AV1 and $nv VP9 conformance streams, $nr HEVC and $nvr VP9 software references ($nbad / $nvbad without: the reference decoder differs from the published MD5), $m H.264, $mh HEVC, $ma AV1 and $mv VP9 timing clips)"

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// vtq: what VideoToolbox offers for a codec in this process: the decoder list entries, hardware support, and the AV1
// capability dictionary (private).   vtq [fourcc=av01]
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <VideoToolbox/VideoToolbox.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
extern OSStatus VTCopyVideoDecoderList(CFDictionaryRef, CFArrayRef *);
extern const CFStringRef kVTVideoDecoderList_CodecType, kVTVideoDecoderList_DisplayName, kVTVideoDecoderList_DecoderID;
#include "pickdev.h"
int main(int argc, char **argv) { @autoreleasepool {
	if (getenv("VT_INTELXE_METAL")) { id<MTLDevice> d = mtl_pick_intelxe(); printf("metal: %s\n", d ? d.name.UTF8String : "none"); }
	const char *cc = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "av01";
	const FourCharCode c = (FourCharCode)((cc[0] << 24) | (cc[1] << 16) | (cc[2] << 8) | cc[3]);
	extern void VTRegisterVideoDecoderBundleDirectory(CFURLRef);
	if (argc > 2) { VTRegisterVideoDecoderBundleDirectory((__bridge CFURLRef)[NSURL fileURLWithPath:@(argv[2])]); printf("registered bundle directory %s\n", argv[2]); }
	CFArrayRef list = NULL;
	VTCopyVideoDecoderList(NULL, &list);
	int n = 0;
	for (NSDictionary *d in (__bridge NSArray *)list) {
		NSNumber *t = d[(__bridge NSString *)kVTVideoDecoderList_CodecType];
		if (t.unsignedIntValue != c) continue;
		n++;
		printf("decoder: %s | id %s | hw %s\n", [d[(__bridge NSString *)kVTVideoDecoderList_DisplayName] UTF8String],
		       [d[(__bridge NSString *)kVTVideoDecoderList_DecoderID] UTF8String], [[d[@"IsHardwareAccelerated"] description] UTF8String]);
	}
	printf("%d decoder(s) for '%s' of %ld in all\n", n, cc, list ? (long)CFArrayGetCount(list) : 0L);
	printf("VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported('%s') = %d\n", cc, VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported(c));
	CFDictionaryRef (*caps)(void) = dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "VTCopyAV1DecoderCapabilitiesDictionary");
	if (caps) { CFDictionaryRef d = caps(); printf("VTCopyAV1DecoderCapabilitiesDictionary: %s\n", d ? [[(__bridge NSDictionary *)d description] UTF8String] : "NULL"); }
	if (list) CFRelease(list);
	return 0; } }

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# mkstreams.sh: the recorded AV1 streams of this folder (how they were made; they are committed, so the tests do not
# need an encoder). Sources are FFmpeg's testsrc2 / mandelbrot patterns; the encoder is SVT-AV1 4.2 through FFmpeg
# 9.0.2 (libsvtav1), IVF output. Then mkgolden.py for each.
#   mkstreams.sh [ffmpeg]
set -eu
FF=${1:-ffmpeg}
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
src() { "$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -f lavfi -i "$1" -frames:v "$2" -pix_fmt "$3" -strict -1 -f yuv4mpegpipe -y "$4"; }
src testsrc2=size=176x144:rate=30 48 yuv420p "$T/qcif.y4m"
src testsrc2=size=176x144:rate=30 30 yuv420p10le "$T/qcif10.y4m"
src mandelbrot=size=352x288:rate=30 24 yuv420p "$T/cif.y4m"
src testsrc2=size=200x120:rate=30 24 yuv420p "$T/odd.y4m"
svt() { in=$1 out=$2; shift 2; "$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$in" -c:v libsvtav1 -svtav1-params "$*" -f ivf -y "$out" 2>/dev/null; }
# random access, 4 temporal layers: hidden alt-ref frames, show_existing_frame, skip mode, compound references
svt "$T/qcif.y4m" svt-ra.ivf "preset=6:keyint=24:hierarchical-levels=3:enable-tf=1:irefresh-type=2:scm=0"
# open GOP (forward key frames): a hidden key frame shown later with show_existing_frame (it refreshes every slot)
svt "$T/qcif.y4m" svt-fwdkf.ivf "preset=8:keyint=16:hierarchical-levels=2:irefresh-type=1:scm=0"
# 10-bit with film grain (grain parameters loaded from a reference: update_grain = 0), loop restoration
svt "$T/qcif10.y4m" svt-grain10.ivf "preset=6:keyint=30:film-grain=12:enable-restoration=1:scm=0"
# 2x2 tiles, 352x288 (non-uniform last tile), quantisation matrices, segmentation (variance AQ), CDEF
svt "$T/cif.y4m" svt-tiles.ivf "preset=7:keyint=12:tile-columns=1:tile-rows=1:enable-qm=1:aq-mode=1:scm=0"
# super-resolution (coded width 3/4 of the upscaled one on inter frames, 10/8 on key frames)
svt "$T/qcif.y4m" svt-superres.ivf "preset=8:keyint=24:superres-mode=1:superres-denom=12:superres-kf-denom=10:scm=0"
# low delay with switch frames (error resilient, frame sizes, ref_order_hint coded)
svt "$T/qcif.y4m" svt-sframe.ivf "preset=8:keyint=48:pred-struct=1:sframe-dist=8:sframe-mode=1:scm=0"
# screen content tools on: intra block copy and palettes; 200x120 (partial superblocks)
svt "$T/odd.y4m" svt-scm.ivf "preset=8:keyint=12:scm=1:enable-intrabc=1"
# lossless (coded lossless: no loop filter / CDEF / restoration, 4x4 transforms)
svt "$T/odd.y4m" svt-lossless.ivf "preset=10:keyint=8:lossless=1:scm=0"
# reference scaling: frames smaller than the sequence's maximum size (the direct path hands such streams to libavcodec)
svt "$T/qcif.y4m" svt-resize.ivf "preset=8:keyint=24:resize-mode=1:resize-denom=12:resize-kf-denom=8:scm=0"
# a still picture (reduced_still_picture_header)
"$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$T/cif.y4m" -frames:v 1 -c:v libsvtav1 -svtav1-params "avif=1:preset=8" -f ivf -y svt-still.ivf 2>/dev/null
for f in *.ivf; do python3 mkgolden.py "$f" "$FF" > "${f%.ivf}.txt"; done

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# run.sh [--conformance DIR] [--sanitize]: builds tests/av1parse_test for this Mac (no GPU, no FFmpeg libraries) and
# checks the direct path's AV1 parser against the recorded streams here (golden files from FFmpeg 9.0.2, mkgolden.py).
#   MESA_INCLUDE=<mesa>/include (the Vulkan Video Std headers)
# --conformance DIR: also libaom's AV1 test vectors and FFmpeg's FATE AV1 samples (conformance.list: name and SHA-256),
# downloaded into DIR when missing (they are not in this repository), checked, a Matroska one remuxed to IVF, and
# compared with golden files made there and then (needs ffmpeg 9.x with trace_headers and libdav1d). A stream the direct
# path does not cover (not Main 4:2:0 8/10-bit, several spatial layers, ...) stops at its sequence header and is
# counted apart; one whose golden file cannot be made (mkgolden.py fails) is counted apart too, with its reason.
# --sanitize: the test built with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, and every stream also fuzzed
# (av1parse_test --fuzz: damaged samples, 200 rounds per recorded stream, 20 per conformance stream).
set -u -o pipefail
HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
: "${MESA_INCLUDE:?MESA_INCLUDE=<mesa>/include}"
CONF="" SAN=0
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in --conformance) CONF=${2:?--conformance DIR}; shift 2;; --sanitize) SAN=1; shift;; *) echo "usage: run.sh [--conformance DIR] [--sanitize]"; exit 2;; esac
done
B=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/av1parse_test.$$
FL=""; [ $SAN = 1 ] && FL="-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined"
cc -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra $FL -I"$MESA_INCLUDE" "$HERE/../av1parse_test.c" "$HERE/../../vtdirect_av1.c" -o "$B" || exit 2
trap 'rm -rf "$B" "$B.dSYM" "$B.g" "$B.e" "$B.e.list" "$B.ivf"' EXIT
fail=0
for f in "$HERE"/*.ivf; do
  "$B" "$f" "${f%.ivf}.txt" || fail=1
  if [ $SAN = 1 ]; then "$B" --fuzz 1 200 "$f" | sed "s|^|$(basename "$f"): |" || fail=1; fi
done
if [ -n "$CONF" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$CONF"
  grep -v '^#' "$HERE/conformance.list" | while read -r src n sum; do
    case $src in aom) url=https://storage.googleapis.com/aom-test-data/$n;; fate) url=https://fate-suite.ffmpeg.org/av1/$n;; *) continue;; esac
    if [ ! -s "$CONF/$n" ]; then curl -sfL --max-time 300 -o "$CONF/$n" "$url" || { echo "DOWNLOAD $n: failed"; rm -f "$CONF/$n"; continue; }; fi
    [ "$(shasum -a 256 "$CONF/$n" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { echo "SHA256 $n: differs from conformance.list"; continue; }
    f=$CONF/$n
    case "$n" in *.ivf) ;; *) ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$f" -c copy -f ivf -y "$B.ivf" < /dev/null || { echo "NOGOLDEN $n: remux failed"; continue; }; f=$B.ivf;; esac
    if ! python3 "$HERE/mkgolden.py" "$f" > "$B.g" 2> "$B.e"; then
      echo "NOGOLDEN $n: $(head -c 300 "$B.e" | tr '\n' ' ')"; continue
    fi
    r=$("$B" "$f" "$B.g" 2>&1)
    case "$r" in
      *"identical to"*) echo "SAME $n";;
      *"sample: -1 "*) echo "UNSUPPORTED $n: $(echo "$r" | sed -n 's/.*sample: -1 \(.*\)/\1/p' | head -1)";;
      *) echo "DIFFERS $n"; echo "$r" | head -4;;
    esac
    if [ $SAN = 1 ]; then "$B" --fuzz 2 20 "$f" > "$B.e" 2>&1 || { echo "FUZZ $n: $(tail -3 "$B.e" | tr '\n' ' ')"; }; fi
  done > "$B.e.list"
  cat "$B.e.list"
  same=$(grep -c '^SAME ' "$B.e.list"); unsup=$(grep -c '^UNSUPPORTED ' "$B.e.list"); diff=$(grep -c '^DIFFERS ' "$B.e.list")
  nogold=$(grep -c '^NOGOLDEN ' "$B.e.list"); other=$(grep -cE '^(DOWNLOAD|SHA256|FUZZ) ' "$B.e.list")
  [ "$diff" = 0 ] && [ "$other" = 0 ] || fail=1
  echo "conformance: $same identical to the golden files, $unsup not covered (libavcodec decodes them), $nogold without a golden file, $diff differ, $other download/hash/fuzz failures"
fi
exit $fail

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""mkgolden.py <stream.264> [ffmpeg]: the reference output of h264parse_test for a recorded Annex B stream, made by
libavcodec's own H.264 decoder (FFmpeg 9.0.2, the version the plug-ins ship): the parameter sets from the trace_headers
bitstream filter (the syntax elements as read, scaling lists rebuilt from their delta_scale values), each picture's
type, frame_num and POCs from -debug pict, and the reference pictures it is decoded with from -debug mmco (the
short- and long-term lists libavcodec prints when it builds the picture's reference lists: the DPB before the
picture, which is what its Vulkan hwaccel passes to vkCmdDecodeVideoKHR). Writes to stdout."""
import re
import subprocess
import sys

stream = sys.argv[1]
ffmpeg = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'ffmpeg'


def run(args):
    return subprocess.run([ffmpeg, '-hide_banner', '-nostdin'] + args, capture_output=True, text=True).stderr.splitlines()


def scaling_from_deltas(deltas, size):
    """scaling_list(): the list values (bitstream order) and useDefaultScalingMatrixFlag from the delta_scale values"""
    out, last, nxt, use_default, it = [], 8, 8, False, iter(deltas)
    for j in range(size):
        if nxt:
            nxt = (last + next(it) + 256) % 256
            if j == 0 and nxt == 0:
                use_default = True
        out.append(nxt if nxt else last)
        last = out[-1]
    return out, use_default


def scaling_text(fields, lists, present_flag, nlists):
    if not fields.get(present_flag, 0):
        return ' scaling=-'
    present = default = 0
    parts = []
    for i in range(nlists):
        if i not in lists:
            continue
        present |= 1 << i
        vals, use_def = scaling_from_deltas(lists[i], 16 if i < 6 else 64)
        if use_def:
            default |= 1 << i
        else:
            parts.append(' L%d=%s' % (i, ','.join(map(str, vals))))
    return ' scaling=%x/%x%s' % (present, default, ''.join(parts))


# --- parameter sets and access units, in stream order (trace_headers)
line_re = re.compile(r'^\[trace_headers @ [^\]]+\] (\d+)\s+(\S+)\s+\S+ = (-?\d+)$')
title_re = re.compile(r'^\[trace_headers @ [^\]]+\] (.+)$')
units = []          # per packet: list of ('sps'|'pps', text) and ('slice', None)
cur, fields, lists, cur_list = None, {}, {}, None
sps_chroma = {}


def close_section():
    global cur, fields, lists
    if cur == 'sps':
        f = fields
        sid = f['seq_parameter_set_id']
        sps_chroma[sid] = f.get('chroma_format_idc', 1)
        poc_type = f['pic_order_cnt_type']
        txt = ('sps id=%d profile=%d level=%d chroma=%d lfn=%d poc_type=%d lpoc=%d refs=%d w=%d h=%d fmo=%d d8=%d crop=%d,%d,%d,%d'
               % (sid, f['profile_idc'], f['level_idc'], f.get('chroma_format_idc', 1), f['log2_max_frame_num_minus4'], poc_type,
                  f.get('log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4', 0) if poc_type == 0 else 0, f['max_num_ref_frames'],
                  f['pic_width_in_mbs_minus1'], f['pic_height_in_map_units_minus1'], f['frame_mbs_only_flag'],
                  f['direct_8x8_inference_flag'], f.get('frame_crop_left_offset', 0), f.get('frame_crop_right_offset', 0),
                  f.get('frame_crop_top_offset', 0), f.get('frame_crop_bottom_offset', 0)))
        txt += scaling_text(f, lists, 'seq_scaling_matrix_present_flag', 12)
        units[-1].append(('sps', txt))
    elif cur == 'pps':
        f = fields
        cqp = f['chroma_qp_index_offset']
        txt = ('pps id=%d sps=%d cabac=%d l0=%d l1=%d wp=%d wb=%d qp=%d qs=%d cqp=%d dbk=%d cip=%d rpc=%d t8=%d cqp2=%d'
               % (f['pic_parameter_set_id'], f['seq_parameter_set_id'], f['entropy_coding_mode_flag'],
                  f['num_ref_idx_l0_default_active_minus1'], f['num_ref_idx_l1_default_active_minus1'], f['weighted_pred_flag'],
                  f['weighted_bipred_idc'], f['pic_init_qp_minus26'], f['pic_init_qs_minus26'], cqp,
                  f['deblocking_filter_control_present_flag'], f['constrained_intra_pred_flag'], f['redundant_pic_cnt_present_flag'],
                  f.get('transform_8x8_mode_flag', 0), f.get('second_chroma_qp_index_offset', cqp)))
        txt += scaling_text(f, lists, 'pic_scaling_matrix_present_flag', 12)
        units[-1].append(('pps', txt))
    elif cur == 'slice':
        if fields.get('redundant_pic_cnt', 0) == 0:
            units[-1].append(('slice', None))
    cur, fields, lists = None, {}, {}


in_packets = False
for l in run(['-i', stream, '-c', 'copy', '-bsf:v', 'trace_headers', '-f', 'null', '-']):
    m = line_re.match(l)
    if m:
        if not in_packets or cur is None:
            continue
        name, val = m.group(2), int(m.group(3))
        lm = re.match(r'(seq|pic)_scaling_list_present_flag\[(\d+)\]', name)
        if lm:
            cur_list = int(lm.group(2)) if val else None
            if val:
                lists[cur_list] = []
        elif name.startswith('delta_scale'):
            lists[cur_list].append(val)
        else:
            fields.setdefault(name, val)
        continue
    t = title_re.match(l)
    if not t:
        continue
    title = t.group(1)
    if title.startswith('Packet:'):
        close_section()
        in_packets = True
        units.append([])
    elif title == 'Extradata':
        close_section()
        in_packets = False
    elif in_packets:
        close_section()
        if title == 'Sequence Parameter Set':
            cur = 'sps'
        elif title == 'Picture Parameter Set':
            cur = 'pps'
        elif 'Slice' in title:
            cur = 'slice'
        else:
            cur = 'other'
close_section()

# --- pictures (the decoder that ran last: ffmpeg's find_stream_info probes with a decoder of its own)
dbg = run(['-threads', '1', '-debug', 'pict+mmco', '-i', stream, '-f', 'null', '-'])
ctx_re = re.compile(r'^\[h264 @ (0x[0-9a-f]+)\] (.*)$')
last_ctx = None
for l in dbg:
    m = ctx_re.match(l)
    if m and m.group(2).startswith('slice:'):
        last_ctx = m.group(1)
pics = []
short, long_, mode = [], [], None
slice_re = re.compile(r'slice:(\d+) (\S) mb:\d+ (\S)( fix)?( IDR)? frame:(\d+) poc:(-?\d+)/(-?\d+)')
for l in dbg:
    m = ctx_re.match(l)
    if not m or m.group(1) != last_ctx:
        continue
    body = m.group(2)
    if body == 'short term list:':
        mode, short = 'S', []
        continue
    if body == 'long term list:':
        mode, long_ = 'L', []
        continue
    e = re.match(r'^(\d+) fn:(-?\d+) poc:(-?\d+)', body)
    if e and mode:
        (short if mode == 'S' else long_).append((int(e.group(1)), int(e.group(2)), int(e.group(3))))
        continue
    mode = None
    s = slice_re.search(body)
    if s:
        if s.group(1) == '1':
            refs = ' '.join('%d:%d' % (fn, poc) for _, fn, poc in short)
            lrefs = ' '.join('%d:%d' % (i, poc) for i, _, poc in long_)
            pics.append(['pic %s%s frame=%s poc=%s/%s' % (s.group(3), s.group(5) or '', s.group(6), s.group(7), s.group(8)), 1,
                         ' S' + (' ' + refs if refs else '') + ' L' + (' ' + lrefs if lrefs else '')])
        else:
            pics[-1][1] += 1

pi = 0
for u in units:
    has_slice = False
    for kind, txt in u:
        if kind == 'slice':
            has_slice = True
        else:
            print(txt)
    if has_slice:
        p = pics[pi]
        pi += 1
        print('%s slices=%d%s' % (p[0], p[1], p[2]))
if pi != len(pics):
    sys.exit('mkgolden: %d pictures from -debug pict, %d access units with slices' % (len(pics), pi))



================================================
FILE: videotoolbox/tests/h264/mkstreams.sh
================================================
#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# mkstreams.sh: the recorded H.264 streams of this folder (how they were made; they are committed, so the tests do not
# need x264). Sources are FFmpeg's testsrc2 pattern; encoders x264 0.165 and, for apple-vt, Apple's VideoToolbox H.264
# encoder through FFmpeg (made on an M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.1). Then mkgolden.py for each (FFmpeg 9.0.2).
#   mkstreams.sh [ffmpeg] [x264]
set -eu
FF=${1:-ffmpeg} X=${2:-x264}
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
src() { "$FF" -hide_banner -v error -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=size=$1:rate=30" -frames:v "$2" -f yuv4mpegpipe -y "$3"; }
T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
src 176x144 60 "$T/qcif.y4m"
src 64x64 300 "$T/tiny.y4m"
# High: 3 B frames in a pyramid (MMCO 1 for the B references), 4 references, weighted P, an IDR every 15 frames
"$X" --quiet --crf 30 --profile high --bframes 3 --b-pyramid normal --ref 4 --weightp 2 --keyint 15 --min-keyint 15 --scenecut 0 -o bpyramid.264 "$T/qcif.y4m"
# Baseline: CAVLC, no B frames (POC type 2), 3 references, 3 slices per picture
"$X" --quiet --crf 30 --profile baseline --ref 3 --slices 3 --keyint 25 -o baseline-slices.264 "$T/qcif.y4m"
# High: custom 8x8 intra/inter scaling lists in the PPS, temporal direct, implicit weighted B, a strict pyramid, 5 references
"$X" --quiet --crf 30 --profile high --bframes 3 --b-pyramid strict --direct temporal --weightb --ref 5 --keyint 30 \
  --cqm8i "$(python3 -c "print(','.join(str(6+(i%8)+(i//8)*2) for i in range(64)))")" \
  --cqm8p "$(python3 -c "print(','.join(str(9+(i%8)+(i//8)) for i in range(64)))")" -o cqm-temporal.264 "$T/qcif.y4m"
# Main: frame_num and POC LSB wrap-around (no IDR after the first, 300 pictures), one B frame, 2 references
"$X" --quiet --crf 30 --profile main --bframes 1 --ref 2 --keyint infinite -o wrap.264 "$T/tiny.y4m"
# Main: CAVLC, one reference, one B frame, an IDR every 4 pictures (idr_pic_id changes)
"$X" --quiet --crf 30 --profile main --no-cabac --bframes 1 --ref 1 --keyint 4 --min-keyint 4 --scenecut 0 -o idr4-cavlc.264 "$T/qcif.y4m"
# Apple's encoder: High with frame reordering
"$FF" -hide_banner -v error -i "$T/qcif.y4m" -c:v h264_videotoolbox -profile:v high -b:v 150k -g 30 -bf 2 -f h264 -y apple-vt.264
for f in *.264; do python3 mkgolden.py "$f" "$FF" > "${f%.264}.txt"; done



================================================
FILE: videotoolbox/tests/h264/run.sh
================================================
#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# run.sh [--conformance DIR]: builds tests/h264parse_test for this Mac (no GPU, no FFmpeg libraries) and checks the
# direct path's H.264 parser against the recorded streams here (golden files from libavcodec, mkgolden.py).
#   MESA_INCLUDE=<mesa>/include (the Vulkan Video Std headers)
# --conformance DIR: also the JVT conformance streams of FFmpeg's FATE suite (conformance.list), downloaded into DIR
# from https://fate-suite.ffmpeg.org/h264-conformance/ when missing (they are not in this repository) and compared
# with golden files made there and then (needs ffmpeg 9.x with the trace_headers filter). A stream the direct path
# does not cover (fields/MBAFF, 4:2:2/4:4:4/10-bit, frame_num gaps) stops at its first picture and is counted apart.
set -u
HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
: "${MESA_INCLUDE:?MESA_INCLUDE=<mesa>/include}"
B=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/h264parse_test.$$
cc -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -I"$MESA_INCLUDE" "$HERE/../h264parse_test.c" "$HERE/../../vtdirect_h264.c" -o "$B" || exit 2
trap 'rm -rf "$B" "$B.dSYM" "$B.g"' EXIT
fail=0
for f in "$HERE"/*.264; do "$B" "$f" "${f%.264}.txt" || fail=1; done
if [ "${1:-}" = --conformance ]; then
  D=${2:?--conformance DIR}; mkdir -p "$D"
  same=0 unsup=0 diff=0
  while read -r n; do
    o=$(echo "$n" | tr / _)
    [ -s "$D/$o" ] || curl -sf --max-time 120 -o "$D/$o" "https://fate-suite.ffmpeg.org/h264-conformance/$n" || { echo "$n: download failed"; continue; }
    python3 "$HERE/mkgolden.py" "$D/$o" > "$B.g" 2>/dev/null
    r=$("$B" "$D/$o" "$B.g" 2>&1)
    case "$r" in
      *"identical to"*) same=$((same + 1));;
      *"sample: -1 "*) unsup=$((unsup + 1)); echo "$n: not covered: $(echo "$r" | sed -n 's/.*sample: -1 \(.*\)/\1/p' | head -1)";;
      *) diff=$((diff + 1)); fail=1; echo "$n: DIFFERS"; echo "$r" | head -4;;
    esac
  done < "$HERE/conformance.list"
  echo "conformance: $same identical to libavcodec, $unsup not covered (libavcodec decodes them), $diff differ"
fi
exit $fail

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""dpbslots.py [--slots N] [--expect-old-over] <golden.txt | stream.bit> ...: the DPB slot numbers FFmpeg's Vulkan HEVC
hwaccel passes to the driver, replayed on this Mac (no GPU), before and after
ffmpeg-9.0.2-vulkan-decode-dpb-slots-below-maxDpbSlots.patch.

Before: the slotIndex of a picture was its index in libavcodec's DPB array (HEVCLayerContext.DPB, 32 entries). The
replay follows hevcdec.c's hevc_frame_start() and refs.c over a golden file of mkgolden.py (made here from a .bit with
FFmpeg 9.x if a .bit is given): a new sequence (IDR / BLA) outputs every waiting picture, an IDR drops the references,
alloc_frame() takes the lowest free entry for the new picture, ff_hevc_frame_rps() keeps the references the golden
file lists and frees the rest that do not wait for output, then ff_hevc_output_frames() bumps while more pictures wait
than sps_max_num_reorder_pics or the DPB holds more than sps_max_dec_pic_buffering; start_frame came after that, with
the entry taken before the release and the bumping. On a 16-picture DPB the index reaches 16 (the 13 Nov B580 crash:
RPS_B/C/E_qualcomm/ericsson, ANV's 16 slots).

After: each reference keeps the slot it was decoded into and the new picture takes the lowest slot none of the
references holds (vk_hevc_assign_slots). Checked for every picture: the slot is below N (--slots, default 16: ANV's
maxDpbSlots for H.265 decode), no two references share one, a reference's slot never changes.

Assumes pic_output_flag 1 (warns when a PPS has output_flag_present_flag) and no end of sequence NAL units (the golden
format has none). Exit 0 when every stream passes; 1 when one fails (or, with --expect-old-over, when the old
numbering of a stream never reached N: the replay is then not the one that explains the crash)."""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))


def golden_lines(path):
    if not path.endswith(('.bit', '.bin', '.265')):
        return open(path).read().splitlines()
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile('w+') as g:
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(HERE, 'mkgolden.py'), path], stdout=g, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        g.seek(0)
        return g.read().splitlines()


def kv(line):
    return dict(f.split('=', 1) for f in line.split()[1:] if '=' in f)


def replay(lines, nslots):
    sps = {}            # id -> (max_dec_pic_buffering, num_reorder_pics)
    cur_sps = None
    warnings, errors = [], []
    dpb = [None] * 32   # entry: dict(poc, out, ref, slot)
    old_max, old_over, new_max, npic = -1, 0, -1, 0
    first = True
    for line in lines:
        word = line.split(' ', 1)[0]
        if word == 'sps':
            f = kv(line)
            d = [int(x) for x in f['dpb'].split('/')]
            sps[f['id']] = (d[0] + 1, d[1])
            if cur_sps is not None and sps[f['id']] != cur_sps:
                warnings.append('a second SPS with other DPB sizes: the replay uses the last one')
            cur_sps = sps[f['id']]
            continue
        if word == 'pps':
            if kv(line).get('ofp') == '1':
                warnings.append('output_flag_present_flag 1: pic_output_flag taken as 1')
            continue
        if word != 'pic':
            continue
        name = line.split()[1]
        f = kv(line)
        poc = int(f['poc'])
        held = set() if f['dpb'] == '-' else {int(x.split(':')[0]) for x in f['dpb'].split(',')}
        max_dec, reorder = cur_sps
        idr, bla = name.startswith('IDR'), name.startswith('BLA')

        def free_unused():
            for i, e in enumerate(dpb):
                if e and not e['out'] and not e['ref']:
                    dpb[i] = None

        if (idr or bla) and not first:      # new_sequence: output (or discard) every waiting picture
            for e in dpb:
                if e:
                    e['out'] = False
            free_unused()
        if idr:                             # ff_hevc_clear_refs()
            for e in dpb:
                if e:
                    e['ref'] = False
            free_unused()
        first = False
        idx = dpb.index(None)               # alloc_frame()
        cur = dpb[idx] = dict(poc=poc, out=True, ref=True, slot=None)
        for e in dpb:                       # ff_hevc_frame_rps()
            if e and e is not cur:
                e['ref'] = e['poc'] in held
        missing = held - {e['poc'] for e in dpb if e and e is not cur}
        if missing:
            warnings.append('POC %d: references %s not in the replayed DPB' % (poc, sorted(missing)))
        free_unused()
        while True:                         # ff_hevc_output_frames()
            waiting = [e for e in dpb if e and e['out']]
            used = sum(1 for e in dpb if e)
            if waiting and (len(waiting) > reorder or used > max_dec):
                e = min(waiting, key=lambda x: x['poc'])
                e['out'] = False
                if not e['ref']:
                    dpb[dpb.index(e)] = None
                continue
            break
        # start_frame: the old slot number (the DPB index) and the new one
        npic += 1
        old_max = max(old_max, idx)
        old_over += idx >= nslots
        refs = [e for e in dpb if e and e is not cur and e['ref']]
        taken = set()
        for e in refs:
            if e['slot'] is None:
                errors.append('POC %d: reference POC %d was never given a slot' % (poc, e['poc']))
                continue
            if e['slot'] in taken:
                errors.append('POC %d: slot %d held by two references' % (poc, e['slot']))
            taken.add(e['slot'])
        s = next((i for i in range(nslots) if i not in taken), None)
        if s is None:
            errors.append('POC %d: no free slot (%d references)' % (poc, len(refs)))
            s = nslots
        cur['slot'] = s
        new_max = max(new_max, s)
    return dict(pictures=npic, old_max=old_max, old_over=old_over, new_max=new_max, warnings=warnings,
                errors=errors)


def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    nslots, expect_over = 16, False
    while args and args[0].startswith('--'):
        a = args.pop(0)
        if a == '--slots':
            nslots = int(args.pop(0))
        elif a == '--expect-old-over':
            expect_over = True
        else:
            sys.exit(__doc__)
    if not args:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    bad = 0
    for path in args:
        name = os.path.basename(path).rsplit('.', 1)[0]
        r = replay(golden_lines(path), nslots)
        ok = not r['errors'] and r['new_max'] < nslots and r['pictures'] > 0
        if expect_over and r['old_over'] == 0:
            ok = False
        print('%s %s: %d pictures; DPB index as slot (before): max %d, %d at or above %d; '
              'compact slots (after): max %d%s' % (
                  'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL', name, r['pictures'], r['old_max'], r['old_over'], nslots, r['new_max'],
                  ''.join('; ' + e for e in r['errors'][:3])))
        for w in sorted(set(r['warnings']))[:3]:
            print('  warning: ' + w)
        bad += not ok
    sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

FILE: videotoolbox/tests/hevc/inband-hvc1.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""inband-hvc1.py <file.mp4>: renames the HEVC sample entry of an MP4 that FFmpeg wrote with -tag:v hev1 to 'hvc1', in
place, nothing else changed. FFmpeg's MP4 muxer drops every in-band VPS/SPS/PPS from an 'hvc1' track (the sample entry
is to hold them all), so a conformance stream that sends other parameter sets mid-stream (a PPS per picture: INITQP_*,
SLIST_*, TILES_*, DELTAQP_*) loses them; 'hev1' keeps them, but VideoToolbox finds no decoder for 'hev1' (Apple's:
kVTCouldNotFindVideoDecoderErr). An 'hvc1' entry with the parameter sets also in band is what the decoders under test
(and Apple's) take, so the kit's streams decode as published with any of them. Walks the boxes (moov/trak/mdia/minf/
stbl/stsd); exit 1 if there is no 'hev1' entry."""
import struct
import sys

CONTAINERS = {b'moov', b'trak', b'mdia', b'minf', b'stbl'}


def walk(f, start, end):
    """the offset of the first 'hev1' sample entry between start and end, or None"""
    pos = start
    while pos + 8 <= end:
        f.seek(pos)
        size, kind = struct.unpack('>I4s', f.read(8))
        hdr = 8
        if size == 1:
            size = struct.unpack('>Q', f.read(8))[0]; hdr = 16
        elif size == 0:
            size = end - pos
        if size < hdr or pos + size > end:
            return None
        if kind in CONTAINERS:
            r = walk(f, pos + hdr, pos + size)
            if r is not None:
                return r
        elif kind == b'stsd':   # FullBox: version/flags, entry_count, then the sample entries (boxes)
            f.seek(pos + hdr + 4)
            n = struct.unpack('>I', f.read(4))[0]
            e = pos + hdr + 8
            for _ in range(n):
                f.seek(e)
                esize, ekind = struct.unpack('>I4s', f.read(8))
                if ekind == b'hev1':
                    return e + 4
                if esize < 8:
                    break
                e += esize
        pos += size
    return None


with open(sys.argv[1], 'r+b') as f:
    f.seek(0, 2)
    at = walk(f, 0, f.tell())
    if at is None:
        sys.exit(f'{sys.argv[1]}: no hev1 sample entry')
    f.seek(at)
    f.write(b'hvc1')

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# mkstreams.sh: the recorded HEVC streams of this folder (how they were made; they are committed, so the tests do not
# need x265). Sources are FFmpeg's testsrc2 pattern; encoders libx265 (x265 4.3, through FFmpeg 9.0.2) and, for
# apple-vt*, Apple's VideoToolbox HEVC encoder through FFmpeg (made on an M1 Pro, macOS 27). Then mkgolden.py for each.
#   mkstreams.sh [ffmpeg]
set -eu
FF=${1:-ffmpeg}
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
src() { "$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=size=$1:rate=30" -frames:v "$2" -pix_fmt "$3" -strict -1 -f yuv4mpegpipe -y "$4"; }
src 176x144 60 yuv420p "$T/qcif.y4m"
src 176x144 60 yuv420p10le "$T/qcif10.y4m"
src 64x64 300 yuv420p "$T/tiny.y4m"
x265() { in=$1 out=$2; shift 2; "$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$in" -c:v libx265 -x265-params "log-level=none:$*" -f hevc -y "$out"; }
# Main, open GOP: CRA pictures with RASL leading pictures, 3 B frames in a pyramid, default scaling lists, WPP
x265 "$T/qcif.y4m" x265-opengop.265 "keyint=24:min-keyint=24:scenecut=0:open-gop=1:bframes=3:b-pyramid=1:ref=3:scaling-list=default:wpp=1"
# Main, closed GOP (IDR_W_RADL with RADL pictures), 3 slices (x265 needs WPP for them), weighted P, 4 references, SAO off, AMP on
x265 "$T/qcif.y4m" x265-slices.265 "keyint=20:min-keyint=20:scenecut=0:open-gop=0:radl=2:bframes=2:slices=3:weightp=1:ref=4:wpp=1:sao=0:amp=1"
# Main 10: 4 B frames, B references, weighted B, temporal MVP off, the SPS's RPS candidates (no RPS in the headers)
x265 "$T/qcif10.y4m" x265-main10.265 "keyint=30:min-keyint=30:scenecut=0:bframes=4:b-pyramid=1:weightb=1:ref=3:tmvp=0:profile=main10"
# Main: POC LSB wrap-around (300 pictures after one IDR, log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb 8), 2 temporal sub-layers
x265 "$T/tiny.y4m" x265-wrap.265 "keyint=-1:scenecut=0:bframes=1:ref=2:temporal-layers=2"
# Apple's encoder, 8 and 10 bits, with frame reordering
"$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$T/qcif.y4m" -c:v hevc_videotoolbox -profile:v main -b:v 150k -g 30 -bf 2 -f hevc -y apple-vt.265
"$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$T/qcif10.y4m" -c:v hevc_videotoolbox -profile:v main10 -pix_fmt p010le -b:v 150k -g 30 -bf 2 -f hevc -y apple-vt-main10.265
for f in *.265; do python3 mkgolden.py "$f" "$FF" > "${f%.265}.txt"; done

FILE: videotoolbox/tests/hevc/published-md5.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""published-md5.py <zip>: the MD5s of the decoded pictures a JCT-VC conformance zip publishes (its *_yuv.md5, *.md5 or
*md5*.txt files; *_bin.md5 files and lines that name the bitstream, .bit / .bin without "yuv", are the bitstream's own
and skipped), on one line, the yuv ones first; nothing if it publishes none. Reads the zip as data (python3 -I)."""
import re
import sys
import zipfile

found = []
with zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]) as z:
    for name in z.namelist():
        low = name.lower()
        if '__macosx' in low or 'md5' not in low or '_bin' in low:   # (SLIST_D_Sony_9_bin.md5: the bitstream's)
            continue
        for line in z.read(name).decode('latin-1').splitlines():
            if re.search(r'\.(bit|bin)\b', line, re.I) and 'yuv' not in line.lower():
                continue
            m = re.search(r'\b([0-9a-fA-F]{32})\b', line)
            if m:
                found.append((0 if 'yuv' in low or 'yuv' in line.lower() else 1, m.group(1).lower()))
print(' '.join(h for _, h in sorted(found)))

FILE: videotoolbox/tests/hevc/run.sh
================================================
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# run.sh [--conformance DIR]: builds tests/hevcparse_test for this Mac (no GPU, no FFmpeg libraries) and checks the
# direct path's HEVC parser against the recorded streams here (golden files from FFmpeg 9.0.2, mkgolden.py).
#   MESA_INCLUDE=<mesa>/include (the Vulkan Video Std headers)
# --conformance DIR: also the JCT-VC HEVC_v1 conformance bitstreams (conformance.list: the official ITU-T zips with
# their SHA-256), downloaded into DIR when missing (they are not in this repository), checked, the bitstream taken out
# as DIR/<name>.bit, and compared with golden files made there and then (needs ffmpeg 9.x: trace_headers and
# libavcodec's HEVC decoder). A stream the direct path does not cover (not Main/Main 10 4:2:0, range extensions, ...)
# stops at its first picture and is counted apart; one whose golden file cannot be made (mkgolden.py fails: the
# trace_headers filter stops at a parameter set it cannot read, or the POCs differ from libavcodec's) is counted apart
# too, with mkgolden's reason.
set -u -o pipefail
HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
: "${MESA_INCLUDE:?MESA_INCLUDE=<mesa>/include}"
B=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/hevcparse_test.$$
cc -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -I"$MESA_INCLUDE" "$HERE/../hevcparse_test.c" "$HERE/../../vtdirect_hevc.c" -o "$B" || exit 2
trap 'rm -rf "$B" "$B.dSYM" "$B.g" "$B.e" "$B.e.list"' EXIT
fail=0
for f in "$HERE"/*.265; do "$B" "$f" "${f%.265}.txt" || fail=1; done
if [ "${1:-}" = --conformance ]; then
  D=${2:?--conformance DIR}; mkdir -p "$D"
  URL=https://www.itu.int/wftp3/av-arch/jctvc-site/bitstream_exchange/draft_conformance/HEVC_v1
  grep -v '^#' "$HERE/conformance.list" | while read -r z sum; do
    n=${z%.zip}
    if [ ! -s "$D/$n.bit" ]; then
      [ -s "$D/$z" ] || curl -sfL --max-time 300 -o "$D/$z" "$URL/$z" || { echo "$n: download failed"; continue; }
      [ "$(shasum -a 256 "$D/$z" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { echo "$n: SHA-256 differs from conformance.list"; rm -f "$D/$z"; continue; }
      # the zip's one bitstream (.bit / .bin), read as data (python -I: nothing is imported from DIR)
      python3 -I -c 'import sys, zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]); m = [i for i in z.namelist() if i.lower().endswith((".bit", ".bin")) and "__MACOSX" not in i]
assert len(m) == 1, m
open(sys.argv[2], "wb").write(z.read(m[0]))' "$D/$z" "$D/$n.bit" || { echo "$n: no bitstream in $z"; continue; }
    fi
    if ! python3 "$HERE/mkgolden.py" "$D/$n.bit" > "$B.g" 2> "$B.e"; then
      echo "NOGOLDEN $n: $(head -c 300 "$B.e" | tr '\n' ' ')"; continue
    fi
    r=$("$B" "$D/$n.bit" "$B.g" 2>&1)
    case "$r" in
      *"identical to"*) echo "SAME $n";;
      *"sample: -1 "*) echo "UNSUPPORTED $n: $(echo "$r" | sed -n 's/.*sample: -1 \(.*\)/\1/p' | head -1)";;
      *) echo "DIFFERS $n"; echo "$r" | head -4;;
    esac
  done > "$B.e.list"
  cat "$B.e.list"
  same=$(grep -c '^SAME ' "$B.e.list"); unsup=$(grep -c '^UNSUPPORTED ' "$B.e.list"); diff=$(grep -c '^DIFFERS ' "$B.e.list")
  nogold=$(grep -c '^NOGOLDEN ' "$B.e.list")
  rm -f "$B.e.list"
  [ "$diff" = 0 ] || fail=1
  echo "conformance: $same identical to libavcodec, $unsup not covered (libavcodec decodes them), $nogold without a golden file, $diff differ"
fi
exit $fail

FILE: videotoolbox/tests/vp9/mkgolden.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""mkgolden.py <stream.ivf> [ffmpeg]: the reference output of vp9parse_test for a recorded VP9 stream, made from FFmpeg
9.0.2 (the version the plug-ins ship) without our C code: every syntax element of every frame's uncompressed header as
FFmpeg's trace_headers bitstream filter prints it (CBS, with its bit position), the samples as the IVF file holds them,
the superframe index read here from the samples' bytes (as vp9_superframe_split reads it), and, derived here from the
VP9 specification the way libavcodec's VP9 decoder and Vulkan hwaccel derive them (vp9.c, vulkan_vp9.c,
cbs_vp9_syntax_template.c), everything Vulkan Video gets for each frame: the loop filter deltas and segmentation
features carried from frame to frame, the reference slots' sizes and pictures, the DPB slot of each picture (the
lowest one no reference slot holds), the references and reference names, UsePrevFrameMvs, the Std enums, and where the
compressed header and the tiles start. Where vulkan_vp9.c passes CBS's stale segmentation values (abs_or_delta_update
of a frame that does not update the data; the tree / prediction probabilities of a frame that codes the map but not
the data) the golden has the specification's and a "lavc" line with libavcodec's. The number of shown frames is
checked against libvpx (libvpx-vp9 through ffmpeg, a decoder that is not libavcodec's; it outputs one picture per
sample, so the samples that show a frame are counted); on a mismatch the golden is
still written, the difference goes to stderr and the exit status is 1. Writes to stdout.

Lines (the same as vp9parse_test prints):
  frame tu= k= type= show= intra= er= prof= size=WxH bd= refresh=<hex> dpb= hb=<header bits before the trailing bits>
      hdr=<uncompressed header bytes>/<compressed header bytes> at=<offset>:<size of the frame in the sample> ctx= reset=
      rctx= par= hp= prev=<UsePrevFrameMvs> sb=<ref_frame_sign_bias_mask> interp=<Std enum> q=<base>/<y dc>/<uv dc>/<uv ac>
      tiles=<cols log2>/<rows log2> color=<range>/<BitDepth>/<color_space> missing=
   refs idx=<ref_frame_idx> names=<referenceNameSlotIndices> list=<dpb>@<slot>:<w>x<h>,... (or -)
   lf level= sharp= en= upd= uref=<mask> umode=<mask> ref=<4 deltas> mode=<2 deltas>
   seg map= temp= data= abs= tree=<7> pred=<3> feat=<FeatureEnabled hex>:<FeatureData x4>,... x8   (segmented frames)
   lavc abs= tree= pred=          libavcodec's values, where they differ and matter
  show tu= k= slot= dpb= size= missing=    a show_existing_frame
  tu <n> frames= shown= extra= sf=<superframe index>"""
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

stream = sys.argv[1]
ffmpeg = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'ffmpeg'
problems = []


def run(args):
    p = subprocess.run([ffmpeg, '-hide_banner', '-nostdin'] + args, capture_output=True)
    return p.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace'), p.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace').splitlines()


# --- the samples: IVF frames
data = open(stream, 'rb').read()
if data[:4] != b'DKIF':
    sys.exit('%s: not an IVF file' % stream)
samples = []
pos = struct.unpack('<H', data[6:8])[0]
while pos + 12 <= len(data):
    sz = struct.unpack('<I', data[pos:pos + 4])[0]
    pos += 12
    if sz > len(data) - pos:
        break
    samples.append(data[pos:pos + sz])
    pos += sz


def split(sample):
    """[(offset, size)] of the frames of a sample (Annex B; vp9_superframe_split's checks), superframe flag"""
    m = sample[-1]
    if m & 0xe0 == 0xc0:
        length, count = 1 + ((m >> 3) & 3), 1 + (m & 7)
        isz = 2 + count * length
        if len(sample) >= isz and sample[len(sample) - isz] == m:
            out, total = [], 0
            for i in range(count):
                at = len(sample) - isz + 1 + i * length
                v = int.from_bytes(sample[at:at + length], 'little')
                total += v
                if v == 0 or total > len(sample) - isz:
                    raise ValueError('invalid superframe index')
                out.append((total - v, v))
            return out, 1
    return [(0, len(sample))], 0


# --- trace_headers: per packet, per frame, the elements
_, err = run(['-i', stream, '-c', 'copy', '-copyinkf', '-bsf:v', 'trace_headers', '-f', 'null', '-'])
LINE = re.compile(r'^\[trace_headers @ [0-9a-fx]+\] (.*)$')
ELEM = re.compile(r'^(\d+)\s+(\S+)\s+(?:([01]+)\s+)?=\s+(-?\d+)$')
packets = []   # [[frame: {'v': {name: value}, 'end': bits}]]
cur = None
for l in err:
    m = LINE.match(l)
    if not m:
        continue
    c = m.group(1).strip()
    if c.startswith('Packet:'):
        cur = []; packets.append(cur); continue
    if cur is None:
        continue
    if c == 'Frame':
        cur.append({'v': {}, 'hb': 0, 'end': 0}); continue
    if c == 'Superframe Index':
        cur.append(None); continue   # the index's own elements are not a frame's
    e = ELEM.match(c)
    if e and cur and cur[-1] is not None:
        f = cur[-1]
        p, name, bits, val = int(e.group(1)), e.group(2), e.group(3), int(e.group(4))
        f['v'][name] = val
        n = len(bits) if bits else 0
        f['end'] = max(f['end'], p + n)
        if name != 'zero_bit':
            f['hb'] = max(f['hb'], p + n)
for p in packets:
    p[:] = [f for f in p if f is not None]
if len(packets) != len(samples):
    problems.append('trace_headers saw %d packets, the file has %d samples' % (len(packets), len(samples)))

# --- the shown frames, from libvpx (not libavcodec's decoder)
out, _ = run(['-c:v', 'libvpx-vp9', '-i', stream, '-f', 'framecrc', '-'])
libvpx_frames = len([l for l in out.splitlines() if l and not l.startswith('#')])

# --- the state the uncompressed header carries (CBS's context, vp9.c's) and the reference slots
REMAP = [1, 0, 2, 3]   # raw interpolation filter -> StdVideoVP9InterpolationFilter (EIGHTTAP_SMOOTH, EIGHTTAP, SHARP, BILINEAR)
st = {
    'lf_ref': [1, 0, -1, -1], 'lf_mode': [0, 0], 'fen': [[0] * 4 for _ in range(8)], 'fval': [[0] * 4 for _ in range(8)], 'abs': 0,
    'tree': [0] * 7, 'pred': [0] * 3, 'cbs_tree': [0] * 7, 'cbs_pred': [0] * 3,
    'cs': 0, 'range': 0, 'bd': 0, 'last_invisible': 0, 'have_last': 0, 'last_w': 0, 'last_h': 0,
}
refs = [{'valid': 0, 'w': 0, 'h': 0, 'bd': 0, 'pic': 0, 'dpb': -1, 'pw': 0, 'ph': 0} for _ in range(8)]
outl = []
shown_total = 0


def past_independence():
    st['lf_ref'] = [1, 0, -1, -1]; st['lf_mode'] = [0, 0]
    st['fen'] = [[0] * 4 for _ in range(8)]; st['fval'] = [[0] * 4 for _ in range(8)]; st['abs'] = 0


def csv(v):
    return ','.join(str(x) for x in v)


for tu, sample in enumerate(samples):
    frames, sf = split(sample)
    tr = packets[tu] if tu < len(packets) else []
    if len(tr) != len(frames):
        problems.append('tu %d: trace_headers has %d frames, the superframe index %d' % (tu, len(tr), len(frames)))
    shown, extra = -1, 0
    for k, (off, size) in enumerate(frames):
        v = tr[k]['v'] if k < len(tr) else {}
        g = lambda name, d=0: v.get(name, d)
        if g('show_existing_frame'):
            slot = g('frame_to_show_map_idx')
            r = refs[slot]
            outl.append('show tu=%d k=%d slot=%d dpb=%d size=%dx%d missing=%d' % (
                tu, k, slot, r['dpb'] if r['pic'] else -1, r['pw'], r['ph'], 0 if r['pic'] else 1))
            if shown < 0:
                shown = k
            else:
                extra += 1
            continue
        profile = g('profile_high_bit') << 1 | g('profile_low_bit')
        ftype, show, er = g('frame_type'), g('show_frame'), g('error_resilient_mode')
        intra_only = g('intra_only')
        intra = ftype == 0 or intra_only
        refresh = 0xff if ftype == 0 else g('refresh_frame_flags')
        idx = [0, 0, 0] if intra else [g('ref_frame_idx[%d]' % i) for i in range(3)]
        new_color = False
        if ftype == 0 or (intra_only and profile > 0):
            bd = 8 if profile < 2 else (12 if g('ten_or_twelve_bit') else 10)
            cs, rng = g('color_space'), g('color_range')
            new_color = True
        elif intra_only:
            bd, cs, rng = 8, 1, 0
            new_color = True
        else:
            bd = st['bd'] or 8
        if intra:
            w, h = g('frame_width_minus_1') + 1, g('frame_height_minus_1') + 1
        else:
            found = [i for i in range(3) if g('found_ref[%d]' % i)]
            if found:
                r = refs[idx[found[0]]]
                w, h = r['w'], r['h']
                if r['valid']:
                    bd = r['bd']
            else:
                w, h = g('frame_width_minus_1') + 1, g('frame_height_minus_1') + 1
        # the header: its bits, the compressed header after it
        hb = tr[k]['hb'] if k < len(tr) else 0
        uncomp = (tr[k]['end'] + 7) // 8 if k < len(tr) else 0
        comp = g('header_size_in_bytes')
        if comp == 0 or comp > size - uncomp or sample[off + uncomp] & 0x80:
            problems.append('tu %d frame %d: a compressed header vp9.c refuses' % (tu, k))
        # the carried state
        last_invisible = st['last_invisible']
        st['last_invisible'] = 0 if show else 1
        if intra or er:
            past_independence()
        if g('loop_filter_delta_update'):
            for i in range(4):
                if g('update_ref_delta[%d]' % i):
                    st['lf_ref'][i] = g('loop_filter_ref_deltas[%d]' % i)
            for i in range(2):
                if g('update_mode_delta[%d]' % i):
                    st['lf_mode'][i] = g('loop_filter_mode_deltas[%d]' % i)
        seg_en, upd_map, upd_data = g('segmentation_enabled'), g('segmentation_update_map'), g('segmentation_update_data')
        temporal = g('segmentation_temporal_update') if upd_map else 0
        tree = [g('segmentation_tree_probs[%d].prob' % i, 255) if g('segmentation_tree_probs[%d].prob_coded' % i) else 255 for i in range(7)]
        pred = [g('segmentation_pred_prob[%d].prob' % i, 255) if temporal and g('segmentation_pred_prob[%d].prob_coded' % i) else 255 for i in range(3)]
        if seg_en and upd_data:
            st['abs'] = g('segmentation_abs_or_delta_update')
            for i in range(8):
                for j in range(4):
                    st['fen'][i][j] = g('feature_enabled[%d][%d]' % (i, j))
                    val = g('feature_value[%d][%d]' % (i, j)) if st['fen'][i][j] else 0
                    st['fval'][i][j] = -val if g('feature_sign[%d][%d]' % (i, j)) and st['fen'][i][j] else val
            if upd_map:
                st['cbs_tree'], st['cbs_pred'] = list(tree), list(pred)
        if seg_en and upd_map:
            st['tree'], st['pred'] = list(tree), list(pred)
        if new_color:
            st['cs'], st['range'], st['bd'] = cs, rng, bd
        missing = 0 if intra else int(any(not refs[i]['pic'] for i in idx))
        use_prev = int(not er and not last_invisible and (intra or (st['have_last'] and st['last_w'] == w and st['last_h'] == h)))
        for i in range(8):
            if refresh >> i & 1:
                refs[i].update(valid=1, w=w, h=h, bd=bd)
        sb = g('ref_frame_sign_bias[1]') << 1 | g('ref_frame_sign_bias[2]') << 2 | g('ref_frame_sign_bias[3]') << 3
        interp = 4 if g('is_filter_switchable') else REMAP[g('raw_interpolation_filter_type')]
        dpb, names, lst = -1, [-1, -1, -1], []
        if not missing:
            busy = {r['dpb'] for r in refs if r['pic']}
            dpb = min(i for i in range(32) if i not in busy)
            for i in range(3):
                r = refs[idx[i]]
                if not r['pic']:
                    continue
                names[i] = r['dpb']
                if r['dpb'] not in [x[0] for x in lst]:
                    lst.append((r['dpb'], idx[i], r['pw'], r['ph']))
            for i in range(8):
                if refresh >> i & 1:
                    refs[i].update(pic=1, dpb=dpb, pw=w, ph=h)
            st['have_last'], st['last_w'], st['last_h'] = 1, w, h
        dq = [g('%s.delta_q' % n) if g('%s.delta_coded' % n) else 0 for n in ('delta_q_y_dc', 'delta_q_uv_dc', 'delta_q_uv_ac')]
        outl.append('frame tu=%d k=%d type=%d show=%d intra=%d er=%d prof=%d size=%dx%d bd=%d refresh=%02x dpb=%d hb=%d hdr=%d/%d at=%d:%d '
                    'ctx=%d reset=%d rctx=%d par=%d hp=%d prev=%d sb=%x interp=%d q=%d/%d/%d/%d tiles=%d/%d color=%d/%d/%d missing=%d' % (
                        tu, k, ftype, show, intra_only, er, profile, w, h, bd, refresh, dpb, hb, uncomp, comp, off, size,
                        g('frame_context_idx'), g('reset_frame_context'), g('refresh_frame_context'),
                        g('frame_parallel_decoding_mode', 1 if er else 0), g('allow_high_precision_mv'), use_prev, sb, interp,
                        g('base_q_idx'), dq[0], dq[1], dq[2], g('tile_cols_log2'), g('tile_rows_log2'), st['range'], st['bd'], st['cs'], missing))
        outl.append(' refs idx=%s names=%s list=%s' % (csv(idx), csv(names),
                                                       ','.join('%d@%d:%dx%d' % x for x in lst) if lst else '-'))
        uref = sum(g('update_ref_delta[%d]' % i) << i for i in range(4)) if g('loop_filter_delta_update') else 0
        umode = sum(g('update_mode_delta[%d]' % i) << i for i in range(2)) if g('loop_filter_delta_update') else 0
        outl.append(' lf level=%d sharp=%d en=%d upd=%d uref=%x umode=%x ref=%s mode=%s' % (
            g('loop_filter_level'), g('loop_filter_sharpness'), g('loop_filter_delta_enabled'), g('loop_filter_delta_update'),
            uref, umode, csv(st['lf_ref']), csv(st['lf_mode'])))
        if seg_en:
            fe = [sum(st['fen'][i][j] << j for j in range(4)) for i in range(8)]
            outl.append(' seg map=%d temp=%d data=%d abs=%d tree=%s pred=%s feat=%s' % (
                upd_map, temporal, upd_data, st['abs'], csv(st['tree']), csv(st['pred']),
                ','.join('%x:%s' % (fe[i], '/'.join(str(x) for x in st['fval'][i])) for i in range(8))))
            lavc_abs = g('segmentation_abs_or_delta_update') if upd_data else 0
            ql = any(e & 3 for e in fe)
            if (upd_map and (st['cbs_tree'] != st['tree'] or st['cbs_pred'] != st['pred'])) or (ql and lavc_abs != st['abs']):
                outl.append(' lavc abs=%d tree=%s pred=%s' % (lavc_abs, csv(st['cbs_tree']), csv(st['cbs_pred'])))
        if show:
            if shown < 0:
                shown = k
            else:
                extra += 1
    if shown >= 0:   # libvpx hands out one picture per sample (the last shown frame of a superframe: SVC layers)
        shown_total += 1
    outl.append('tu %d frames=%d shown=%d extra=%d sf=%d' % (tu, len(frames), shown, extra, sf))

if shown_total != libvpx_frames:
    problems.append('%d shown frames here, libvpx decodes %d' % (shown_total, libvpx_frames))
sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(outl) + '\n')
for p in problems:
    sys.stderr.write('mkgolden: %s\n' % p)
sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)



================================================
FILE: videotoolbox/tests/vp9/mkstreams.sh
================================================
#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# mkstreams.sh: the recorded VP9 streams of this folder (how they were made; they are committed, so the tests do not
# need an encoder). Sources are FFmpeg's testsrc2 / mandelbrot patterns; the encoder is libvpx 1.15 through FFmpeg
# 9.0.2 (libvpx-vp9), IVF output. Then mkgolden.py for each.
#   mkstreams.sh [ffmpeg]
set -eu
FF=${1:-ffmpeg}
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
src() { "$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -f lavfi -i "$1" -frames:v "$2" -pix_fmt "$3" -strict -1 -f yuv4mpegpipe -y "$4"; }
src testsrc2=size=176x144:rate=30 48 yuv420p "$T/qcif.y4m"
src testsrc2=size=176x144:rate=30 30 yuv420p10le "$T/qcif10.y4m"
src mandelbrot=size=352x288:rate=30 60 yuv420p "$T/cif.y4m"
src testsrc2=size=201x121:rate=30 24 yuv420p "$T/odd.y4m"
src testsrc2=size=1024x144:rate=30 12 yuv420p "$T/wide.y4m"
vpx() { in=$1 out=$2; shift 2; "$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$in" -c:v libvpx-vp9 "$@" -f ivf -y "$out"; }
# two passes (libvpx makes alt-ref frames only with first-pass statistics)
vpx2() { in=$1 out=$2; shift 2
  "$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$in" -c:v libvpx-vp9 "$@" -pass 1 -passlogfile "$T/pass" -f null - &&
  "$FF" -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$in" -c:v libvpx-vp9 "$@" -pass 2 -passlogfile "$T/pass" -f ivf -y "$out"; }
# good quality with alt-refs: hidden ARF frames in superframes, golden / alt-ref references, sign bias, frame contexts
vpx2 "$T/qcif.y4m" lv-arf.ivf -b:v 300k -auto-alt-ref 1 -lag-in-frames 16 -arnr-maxframes 5 -g 24 -cpu-used 2
# real time with cyclic refresh (aq-mode 3): segmentation map and data on every frame, temporal map prediction
vpx "$T/cif.y4m" lv-aq3-rt.ivf -b:v 300k -aq-mode 3 -deadline realtime -cpu-used 8 -lag-in-frames 0 -g 30
# the same with the data left out where it is unchanged (segedit.py): libavcodec's Vulkan hwaccel passes stale
# segmentation probabilities on these frames ("lavc" lines); libavcodec's software decoder and libvpx decode it
# exactly as lv-aq3-rt.ivf
python3 segedit.py lv-aq3-rt.ivf seg-mapnodata.ivf
# error resilient, variance AQ (segmentation features from the key frame), sharpness, frame-parallel decoding mode
vpx "$T/qcif.y4m" lv-er-aq1.ivf -b:v 200k -error-resilient 1 -aq-mode 1 -sharpness 5 -frame-parallel 1 -lag-in-frames 0 -g 16
# 4 tile columns, 2 tile rows (1024x144: 16 superblocks wide), frame-parallel off
vpx "$T/wide.y4m" lv-tiles.ivf -b:v 600k -tile-columns 2 -tile-rows 1 -frame-parallel 0 -g 12 -cpu-used 4
# Profile 2, 10-bit, with alt-refs
vpx2 "$T/qcif10.y4m" lv-10bit.ivf -b:v 300k -profile:v 2 -auto-alt-ref 1 -lag-in-frames 8 -g 30
# lossless (base_q_idx 0, no deltas), 201x121 (odd sizes, partial superblocks)
vpx "$T/odd.y4m" lv-lossless-odd.ivf -lossless 1 -g 8
for f in *.ivf; do python3 mkgolden.py "$f" "$FF" > "${f%.ivf}.txt"; done

FILE: videotoolbox/tests/vp9/run.sh

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# run.sh [--conformance DIR] [--sanitize]: builds tests/vp9parse_test for this Mac (no GPU, no FFmpeg libraries) and
# checks the direct path's VP9 parser against the recorded streams here (golden files from FFmpeg 9.0.2, mkgolden.py).
#   MESA_INCLUDE=<mesa>/include (the Vulkan Video Std headers)
# --conformance DIR: also libvpx's VP9 test vectors (conformance.list: name, SHA-256 of the stream and of its published
# per-frame MD5 file), downloaded into DIR when missing (they are not in this repository), checked, remuxed to IVF
# (-copyinkf: vp90-2-16-intra-only starts without a key frame) and compared with golden files made there and then
# (needs ffmpeg 9.x with trace_headers and libvpx). A stream the direct path does not cover (profile 1 / 3, 12-bit)
# stops at its first frame and is counted apart; one whose golden file cannot be made is counted apart too.
# --sanitize: the test built with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, and every stream also fuzzed
# (vp9parse_test --fuzz: damaged samples, 200 rounds per recorded stream, 20 per conformance stream).
set -u -o pipefail
HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
: "${MESA_INCLUDE:?MESA_INCLUDE=<mesa>/include}"
CONF="" SAN=0
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in --conformance) CONF=${2:?--conformance DIR}; shift 2;; --sanitize) SAN=1; shift;; *) echo "usage: run.sh [--conformance DIR] [--sanitize]"; exit 2;; esac
done
B=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vp9parse_test.$$
FL=""; [ $SAN = 1 ] && FL="-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined"
cc -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra $FL -I"$MESA_INCLUDE" "$HERE/../vp9parse_test.c" "$HERE/../../vtdirect_vp9.c" -o "$B" || exit 2
trap 'rm -rf "$B" "$B.dSYM" "$B.g" "$B.e" "$B.e.list" "$B.ivf"' EXIT
fail=0
for f in "$HERE"/*.ivf; do
  "$B" "$f" "${f%.ivf}.txt" || fail=1
  if [ $SAN = 1 ]; then "$B" --fuzz 1 200 "$f" | sed "s|^|$(basename "$f"): |" || fail=1; fi
done
if [ -n "$CONF" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$CONF"
  url=https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/test_data/libvpx
  grep -v '^#' "$HERE/conformance.list" | while read -r n sum msum; do
    for x in "$n" "$n.md5"; do
      if [ ! -s "$CONF/$x" ]; then curl -sfL --max-time 300 -o "$CONF/$x" "$url/$x" || { echo "DOWNLOAD $x: failed"; rm -f "$CONF/$x"; }; fi
    done
    [ -s "$CONF/$n" ] && [ -s "$CONF/$n.md5" ] || continue
    [ "$(shasum -a 256 "$CONF/$n" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { echo "SHA256 $n: differs from conformance.list"; continue; }
    [ "$(shasum -a 256 "$CONF/$n.md5" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$msum" ] || { echo "SHA256 $n.md5: differs from conformance.list"; continue; }
    f=$CONF/$n
    case "$n" in *.ivf) ;; *) ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostdin -v error -i "$f" -c copy -copyinkf -f ivf -y "$B.ivf" < /dev/null || { echo "NOGOLDEN $n: remux failed"; continue; }; f=$B.ivf;; esac
    r=$("$B" "$f" 2>&1)
    case "$r" in *"sample: -1 "*) echo "UNSUPPORTED $n: $(echo "$r" | sed -n 's/.*sample: -1 \(.*\)/\1/p' | head -1)"; continue;; esac
    if ! python3 "$HERE/mkgolden.py" "$f" > "$B.g" 2> "$B.e"; then
      echo "NOGOLDEN $n: $(head -c 300 "$B.e" | tr '\n' ' ')"; continue
    fi
    r=$("$B" "$f" "$B.g" 2>&1)
    case "$r" in
      *"identical to"*) echo "SAME $n";;
      *) echo "DIFFERS $n"; echo "$r" | head -4;;
    esac
    if [ $SAN = 1 ]; then "$B" --fuzz 2 20 "$f" > "$B.e" 2>&1 || { echo "FUZZ $n: $(tail -3 "$B.e" | tr '\n' ' ')"; }; fi
  done > "$B.e.list"
  cat "$B.e.list"
  same=$(grep -c '^SAME ' "$B.e.list"); unsup=$(grep -c '^UNSUPPORTED ' "$B.e.list"); diff=$(grep -c '^DIFFERS ' "$B.e.list")
  nogold=$(grep -c '^NOGOLDEN ' "$B.e.list"); other=$(grep -cE '^(DOWNLOAD|SHA256|FUZZ) ' "$B.e.list")
  [ "$diff" = 0 ] && [ "$other" = 0 ] || fail=1
  echo "conformance: $same identical to the golden files, $unsup not covered (libavcodec decodes them), $nogold without a golden file, $diff differ, $other download/hash/fuzz failures"
fi
exit $fail
