// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The About page: version (the repository's VERSION), what the app does, the licences and the credits as the macOS
// About window has them, the project's links, and the app's two settings (language, appearance).
using System.Reflection;
using IntelXe.Core;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media.Imaging;

namespace IntelXe.App.Pages;

public sealed partial class AboutPage : Page
{
    public static string Version =>
        typeof(App).Assembly.GetCustomAttribute<AssemblyInformationalVersionAttribute>()?.InformationalVersion ?? "–";

    static readonly (string Name, string? Url, string Key)[] Credits =
    [
        ("nullmoth (NullMoth Systems)", "https://github.com/nullmoth/nvidia-macos-driver", "Credit_Nullmoth"),
        ("metal2vulkan, Anees Iqbal", "https://github.com/steelbrain/metal2vulkan", "Credit_Metal2vulkan"),
        ("Linux xe and i915 (Intel)", null, "Credit_Linux"),
        ("Mesa", "https://mesa3d.org", "Credit_Mesa"),
        ("Emil J. Tywoniak (widlarizer/mesa)", "https://github.com/widlarizer/mesa", "Credit_Widlarizer"),
        ("FFmpeg", null, "Credit_Ffmpeg"),
    ];

    public AboutPage()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Loaded += (_, _) => Build();
    }

    void Build()
    {
        var (scroll, column) = Ui.PageColumn();

        var head = new StackPanel { Spacing = 6, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center, Margin = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 4) };
        head.Children.Add(new Image { Source = new BitmapImage(new Uri("ms-appx:///Assets/AppIcon.png")), Width = 96, Height = 96 });
        var name = Ui.Text("IntelXe Manager", "TitleTextBlockStyle");
        name.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
        head.Children.Add(name);
        var version = Ui.Text(L.Format("About_Version", Version), secondary: true);
        version.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
        head.Children.Add(version);
        var what = Ui.Text(L.Get("About_What"));
        what.TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Center;
        what.MaxWidth = 520;
        head.Children.Add(what);
        var link = Ui.Link("github.com/" + Project.Repository, new Uri(Project.RepositoryUrl));
        link.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
        head.Children.Add(link);
        column.Children.Add(head);

        column.Children.Add(Ui.Section(Glyphs.Link, L.Get("About_Links"),
            Ui.Row(L.Get("About_Site"), Ui.Link(Project.SiteUrl.Replace("https://", "").TrimEnd('/'), new Uri(Project.SiteUrl))),
            Ui.Row(L.Get("About_Guide"), Ui.Link(L.Get("About_Guide_Windows"), new Uri(Project.WindowsGuideUrl))),
            Ui.Row(L.Get("About_Releases"), Ui.Link(L.Get("About_Releases_Link"), new Uri(Project.ReleasesUrl)))));

        var credits = new StackPanel { Spacing = 8 };
        foreach (var c in Credits)
        {
            var item = new StackPanel { Spacing = 0 };
            if (c.Url is not null)
            {
                var l = Ui.Link(c.Name, new Uri(c.Url));
                l.Padding = new Thickness(0);
                item.Children.Add(l);
            }
            else item.Children.Add(Ui.Text(c.Name, "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
            item.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get(c.Key), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
            credits.Children.Add(item);
        }
        column.Children.Add(Ui.Section(Glyphs.Document, L.Get("About_License"),
            Ui.Text(L.Get("About_License_Text"), secondary: true),
            Ui.Link(L.Get("About_Licensing_Link"), new Uri(Project.LicensingUrl))));
        column.Children.Add(Ui.Section(Glyphs.Heart, L.Get("About_Credits"), credits,
            Ui.Text(L.Get("About_Trademarks"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true)));

        column.Children.Add(Ui.Section(Glyphs.Settings, L.Get("About_App"), AppSettings()));
        Host.Children.Clear();
        Host.Children.Add(scroll);
    }

    static UIElement AppSettings()
    {
        var language = new ComboBox { MinWidth = 180 };
        foreach (var (tag, key) in new[] { ("", "Setting_System"), ("en-US", "Setting_English"), ("tr-TR", "Setting_Turkish") })
            language.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = key == "Setting_English" ? "English" : key == "Setting_Turkish" ? "Türkçe" : L.Get(key), Tag = tag });
        language.SelectedIndex = App.Settings.Language switch { "en-US" => 1, "tr-TR" => 2, _ => 0 };
        language.SelectionChanged += (_, _) =>
        {
            var tag = (language.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Tag as string ?? "";
            if (tag == App.Settings.Language) return;
            App.Settings.Language = tag;
            App.Settings.Save();
            L.SetLanguage(tag);
            App.Window?.ApplyLanguage();
        };

        var theme = new ComboBox { MinWidth = 180 };
        foreach (var (tag, key) in new[] { ("", "Setting_System"), ("light", "Setting_Light"), ("dark", "Setting_Dark") })
            theme.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = L.Get(key), Tag = tag });
        theme.SelectedIndex = App.Settings.Theme switch { "light" => 1, "dark" => 2, _ => 0 };
        theme.SelectionChanged += (_, _) =>
        {
            var tag = (theme.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Tag as string ?? "";
            App.Settings.Theme = tag;
            App.Settings.Save();
            App.Window?.ApplyTheme(tag);
        };
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(language, L.Get("Setting_Language"));
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(theme, L.Get("Setting_Appearance"));
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 10 };
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("Setting_Language"), language));
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("Setting_Appearance"), theme));
        return p;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The BIOS page: the firmware settings this PC needs for macOS with the driver, and the Windows traps to clear first,
// worded with this board maker's menu names (Core/Bios/bios-steps.json). Each item is marked done, to do, or cannot
// tell, from what the Overview read from Windows; each names its sources. The page reads only: it changes no firmware
// setting and not BitLocker. "Save as a page..." writes the steps as one HTML file to open on a phone or print.
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Bios;
using Microsoft.UI.Text;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media;

namespace IntelXe.App.Pages;

public sealed partial class BiosPage : Page
{
    /// the vendor chosen in the box, else the board's; kept while the app runs
    static string? chosenVendor = App.Options.BiosVendor;
    static string? savedTo;
    static string? saveError;
    static bool exported;

    public BiosPage()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Loaded += (_, _) => { AppState.Current.Changed += OnChanged; ActualThemeChanged += OnTheme; Build(); };
        Unloaded += (_, _) => { AppState.Current.Changed -= OnChanged; ActualThemeChanged -= OnTheme; };
    }

    void OnChanged() => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(Build);
    void OnTheme(FrameworkElement sender, object args) => Build();

    static string Lang => BiosSteps.Lang(L.Language);
    static BiosData? DataOrNull { get { try { return BiosSteps.Embedded; } catch (Exception) { return null; } } }

    void Build()
    {
        var state = AppState.Current;
        var (scroll, column) = Ui.PageColumn();
        column.Children.Add(Ui.PageHeader(L.Get("Nav_Bios"), L.Get("Bios_Caption")));
        if (DataOrNull is not { } data)
        {
            column.Children.Add(new InfoBar { Severity = InfoBarSeverity.Error, IsOpen = true, IsClosable = false, Title = L.Get("Bios_NoData") });
        }
        else if (state.Facts is not { } f)
        {
            column.Children.Add(Ui.Card(Ui.Horizontal(10, new ProgressRing { IsActive = true, Width = 18, Height = 18 }, Ui.Text(L.Get("Overview_Reading"), secondary: true))));
        }
        else
        {
            var vendor = chosenVendor ?? BiosSteps.VendorOf(data, f.BoardMaker);
            var steps = BiosSteps.Evaluate(data, f);
            if (App.Options.BiosHtml is { Length: > 0 } path && !exported)
            {
                exported = true;
                Save(path, data, steps, f, vendor);
            }
            column.Children.Add(Head(data, f, steps, vendor));
            foreach (var group in data.Groups)
            {
                var mine = steps.Where(s => s.Item.Group == group.Id).ToList();
                if (mine.Count == 0) continue;
                var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Text(group.Caption.In(Lang), "BodyTextBlockStyle", secondary: true) };
                foreach (var s in mine) items.Add(Row(data, f, s, vendor));
                column.Children.Add(Ui.Section(group.Id == "windows" ? Glyphs.Shield : Glyphs.Firmware, group.Title.In(Lang), items.ToArray()));
            }
            var note = Ui.Text(L.Get("Bios_ReadOnly"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true);
            note.Margin = new Thickness(4, 14, 0, 0);
            column.Children.Add(note);
        }
        Host.Children.Clear();
        Host.Children.Add(scroll);
    }

    UIElement Head(BiosData data, PcFacts f, IReadOnlyList<BiosStep> steps, string vendorId)
    {
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 10 };
        var board = $"{f.BoardMaker} {f.BoardModel}".Trim();
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("Check_Board"), board.Length > 0 ? board : L.Get("Value_NotReported")));

        var detected = BiosSteps.VendorOf(data, f.BoardMaker);
        var box = new ComboBox { MinWidth = 220 };
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(box, L.Get("Bios_Menus"));
        foreach (var v in data.Vendors)
        {
            var name = v.Id == "generic" ? L.Get("Bios_Vendor_Other") : v.Name;
            if (v.Id == detected) name = L.Format("Bios_Vendor_Detected", name);
            box.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = name, Tag = v.Id });
        }
        box.SelectedIndex = Math.Max(0, data.Vendors.FindIndex(v => v.Id == vendorId));
        box.SelectionChanged += (_, _) =>
        {
            if (box.SelectedItem is ComboBoxItem { Tag: string id } && id != vendorId) { chosenVendor = id; Build(); }
        };
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("Bios_Menus"), box));

        var vendor = BiosSteps.Vendor(data, vendorId);
        var keys = new List<string> { L.Format("Bios_Key_Setup", vendor.SetupKey) };
        if (vendor.AdvancedKey.Length > 0) keys.Add(L.Format("Bios_Key_Advanced", vendor.AdvancedKey));
        keys.Add(L.Format("Bios_Key_Save", vendor.SaveKey));
        keys.Add(L.Format("Bios_Key_BootMenu", vendor.BootMenuKey));
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(string.Join(" · ", keys), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(vendor.Note.In(Lang), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));

        var (todo, done, unknown) = BiosSteps.Count(steps);
        var badges = Ui.Horizontal(8,
            Ui.Badge(L.Format("Bios_Count_ToDo", todo), todo > 0 ? CheckState.Warning : CheckState.Good),
            Ui.Badge(L.Format("Bios_Count_Done", done), CheckState.Good),
            Ui.Badge(L.Format("Bios_Count_Unknown", unknown), CheckState.Neutral));
        p.Children.Add(badges);

        var save = Ui.Button(L.Get("Bios_Save"), async (_, _) => await SaveWithPicker(data, steps, f, vendorId), accent: true, glyph: Glyphs.Document);
        var buttons = Ui.Horizontal(10, save);
        if (savedTo is not null)
        {
            var open = Ui.Button(L.Get("Bios_Open"), (_, _) => Ui.OpenUri(new Uri(savedTo)), glyph: Glyphs.Open);
            buttons.Children.Add(open);
        }
        p.Children.Add(buttons);
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Bios_Save_Detail"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        if (savedTo is not null) p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Format("Bios_Saved", savedTo), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        if (saveError is not null) p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(saveError, "CaptionTextBlockStyle"));
        return Ui.Section(Glyphs.Pc, L.Get("Bios_ThisBoard"), p);
    }

    static string StateText(BiosState s) => s switch
    {
        BiosState.Done => L.Get("Bios_State_Done"), BiosState.ToDo => L.Get("Bios_State_ToDo"), _ => L.Get("Bios_State_Unknown"),
    };

    static CheckState StateColour(BiosState s, BiosLevel level) => s switch
    {
        BiosState.Done => CheckState.Good,
        BiosState.ToDo => level == BiosLevel.Required ? CheckState.Bad : CheckState.Warning,
        _ => CheckState.Neutral,
    };

    static string LevelText(BiosLevel l) => l switch
    {
        BiosLevel.Required => L.Get("Bios_Level_Required"), BiosLevel.Recommended => L.Get("Bios_Level_Recommended"), _ => L.Get("Bios_Level_Optional"),
    };

    UIElement Row(BiosData data, PcFacts f, BiosStep s, string vendor)
    {
        var item = s.Item;
        var colour = StateColour(s.State, item.Level);
        var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 10 };
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        var icon = Ui.Icon(Ui.StateGlyph(colour), 16, Ui.Brush(colour));
        icon.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
        icon.Margin = new Thickness(0, 3, 0, 0);
        g.Children.Add(icon);

        var body = new StackPanel { Spacing = 3 };
        var title = new TextBlock { TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, IsTextSelectionEnabled = true };
        title.Inlines.Add(new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Documents.Run { Text = item.Title.In(Lang), FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold });
        title.Inlines.Add(new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Documents.Run { Text = "  " + LevelText(item.Level), FontSize = 12, Foreground = (Brush)Application.Current.Resources["TextFillColorSecondaryBrush"] });
        body.Children.Add(title);
        body.Children.Add(Ui.Text("→ " + item.Want.In(Lang), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
        var path = item.PathFor(vendor, Lang);
        if (path.Length > 0)
        {
            var t = Ui.Text(L.Format("Bios_Where", path), "CaptionTextBlockStyle");
            t.FontFamily = new FontFamily("Cascadia Mono, Consolas, Segoe UI");
            body.Children.Add(t);
        }
        body.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Format("Bios_Seen", s.Seen.In(data, Lang)), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        body.Children.Add(Ui.Text(item.Why.In(Lang), "BodyTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        if (item.Missing is { } m) body.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Format("Bios_Missing", m.In(Lang)), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        var links = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 2 };
        links.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Bios_Sources"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true, wrap: false));
        foreach (var id in item.Sources)
            if (data.Sources.TryGetValue(BiosSteps.SourceFor(id, f), out var src))
            {
                var link = Ui.Link(src.Short.In(Lang), new Uri(src.Url));
                link.FontSize = 12;
                ToolTipService.SetToolTip(link, src.Title);
                links.Children.Add(link);
            }
        body.Children.Add(new ScrollViewer { Content = links, HorizontalScrollMode = ScrollMode.Auto, HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Hidden, VerticalScrollMode = ScrollMode.Disabled });
        Grid.SetColumn(body, 1);
        g.Children.Add(body);

        var badge = Ui.Badge(StateText(s.State), colour);
        badge.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
        Grid.SetColumn(badge, 2);
        g.Children.Add(badge);
        var b = new Border { Child = g, Padding = new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 8), BorderThickness = new Thickness(0, 1, 0, 0),
            BorderBrush = (Brush)Application.Current.Resources["CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush"] };
        return b;
    }

    async Task SaveWithPicker(BiosData data, IReadOnlyList<BiosStep> steps, PcFacts f, string vendor)
    {
        try
        {
            var picker = new Windows.Storage.Pickers.FileSavePicker { SuggestedFileName = L.Get("Bios_FileName"), DefaultFileExtension = ".html" };
            picker.FileTypeChoices.Add(L.Get("Bios_FileType"), [".html"]);
            picker.SuggestedStartLocation = Windows.Storage.Pickers.PickerLocationId.Desktop;
            WinRT.Interop.InitializeWithWindow.Initialize(picker, WinRT.Interop.WindowNative.GetWindowHandle(App.Window));
            var file = await picker.PickSaveFileAsync();
            if (file is null) return;
            Save(file.Path, data, steps, f, vendor);
        }
        catch (Exception e) { saveError = e.Message; }
        Build();
    }

    static void Save(string path, BiosData data, IReadOnlyList<BiosStep> steps, PcFacts f, string vendor)
    {
        try
        {
            File.WriteAllText(path, BiosHtml.Render(data, steps, f, vendor, Lang, DateTime.Now), new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false));
            savedTo = Path.GetFullPath(path);
            saveError = null;
        }
        catch (Exception e) { saveError = e.Message; }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The "Build the EFI" page: an OpenCore EFI for this PC, made by the builder beside the app (windows/efibuild in the
// embedded Python, driving a pinned OpCore Simplify without questions; docs/design/DESIGN-efi-build.md):
// 1. scan this PC (Hardware Sniffer and the ACPI tables the build needs, through the elevated helper: one UAC prompt);
// 2. the macOS version (26 Tahoe, default; 15 Sequoia); 3. build (as the user; the program's screens and the rule that
// answered each question are shown as they come; it can be cancelled); 4. the result: every recorded answer, the
// builder's changes, ocvalidate's verdict, the app's own engine on stage 2, the firmware steps and what comes after the
// install, PlatformInfo with the identity masked; 5. save the EFI folder, or use it for the USB installer stick.
// The SMBIOS serial number, MLB, UUID and ROM stay in config.plist: the builder and the app remove them from everything
// shown, and the window masks them. This page writes only into the app's own data folder and into a new EFI folder
// inside a folder the user chooses.
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media;

namespace IntelXe.App.Pages;

public sealed partial class BuildPage : Page
{
    static BuildSession S => BuildSession.Current;

    public BuildPage()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Loaded += (_, _) => { S.Changed += OnChanged; ActualThemeChanged += OnTheme; S.Load(); Build(); };
        Unloaded += (_, _) => { S.Changed -= OnChanged; ActualThemeChanged -= OnTheme; };
    }

    void OnChanged() => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(Build);
    void OnTheme(FrameworkElement sender, object args) => Build();

    bool Busy => S.Scanning || S.Building;

    void Build()
    {
        var (scroll, column) = Ui.PageColumn();
        column.Children.Add(Ui.PageHeader(L.Get("Nav_Build"), L.Get("Build_Caption")));
        if (!S.Builder.IsAvailable)
            column.Children.Add(new InfoBar
            {
                Severity = InfoBarSeverity.Warning, IsOpen = true, IsClosable = false,
                Title = L.Get("Build_Unavailable"), Message = L.Format("Build_Unavailable_Detail", S.Builder.Unavailable),
            });
        column.Children.Add(ScanSection());
        column.Children.Add(VersionSection());
        column.Children.Add(RunSection());
        if (S.Result is { } r) column.Children.Add(ResultSection(r));
        if (S.Result is { Ok: true }) column.Children.Add(SaveSection());
        var note = Ui.Text(S.Builder.IsAvailable ? L.Format("Build_Footer", S.Builder.Versions) : L.Get("Build_Footer_NoBuilder"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true);
        note.Margin = new Thickness(4, 14, 0, 0);
        column.Children.Add(note);
        Host.Children.Clear();
        Host.Children.Add(scroll);
    }

    // ---- 1. scan ----
    UIElement ScanSection()
    {
        var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Caption(L.Get("Build_Scan_Caption"), L.Get("Build_Scan_Detail")) };
        if (S.Scanning)
        {
            items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, new ProgressRing { IsActive = true, Width = 20, Height = 20 }, Ui.Text(L.Get("Build_Scanning"), secondary: true)));
        }
        else if (S.Scan is { } scan)
        {
            items.Add(Note(L.Format("Build_Scan_Done", scan.Tables.Count), CheckState.Good));
            items.Add(Ui.Text(string.Join(", ", scan.Tables), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        }
        if (S.ScanError is { } err) items.Add(Note(L.Format("Build_Scan_Failed", err), CheckState.Bad));
        var b = Ui.Button(L.Get(S.Scan is null ? "Build_Scan_Button" : "Build_Scan_Again"), async (_, _) => await S.ScanAsync(), accent: S.Scan is null, glyph: Glyphs.Pc);
        b.IsEnabled = S.Builder.IsAvailable && !Busy;
        items.Add(b);
        items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Build_Scan_Uac"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        return Ui.Section(Glyphs.Pc, L.Get("Build_Scan"), items.ToArray());
    }

    // ---- 2. macOS ----
    UIElement VersionSection()
    {
        var radios = new RadioButtons { MaxColumns = 1 };
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(radios, L.Get("Build_Version"));
        radios.Items.Add(new RadioButton { Content = L.Get("Build_Version_26"), Tag = "26", IsEnabled = !Busy });
        radios.Items.Add(new RadioButton { Content = L.Get("Build_Version_15"), Tag = "15", IsEnabled = !Busy });
        radios.SelectedIndex = S.MacOS == "15" ? 1 : 0;
        radios.SelectionChanged += (_, _) => { if (radios.SelectedItem is RadioButton { Tag: string v } && v != S.MacOS) { S.MacOS = v; Build(); } };
        return Ui.Section(Glyphs.List, L.Get("Build_Version"), Ui.Caption(L.Get("Build_Version_Caption")), radios);
    }

    // ---- 3. build ----
    UIElement RunSection()
    {
        var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Caption(L.Get("Build_Run_Caption"), L.Get("Build_Run_Detail")) };
        if (S.Scan is null) items.Add(Note(L.Get("Build_Run_NeedScan"), CheckState.Neutral));
        if (S.Building)
        {
            items.Add(new ProgressBar { IsIndeterminate = true });
            string[] lines;
            lock (S.Progress) lines = [.. S.Progress.TakeLast(14)];
            if (lines.Length > 0) items.Add(Mono(string.Join("\n", lines)));
            items.Add(Ui.Button(L.Get("Build_Cancel"), (_, _) => S.CancelBuild()));
        }
        else
        {
            var b = Ui.Button(L.Get(S.Result is { Ok: true } ? "Build_Run_Again" : "Build_Run_Button"), async (_, _) => await S.BuildAsync(),
                accent: S.Scan is not null && S.Result is not { Ok: true }, glyph: Glyphs.Settings);
            b.IsEnabled = S.Builder.IsAvailable && S.Scan is not null && !Busy;
            items.Add(b);
        }
        return Ui.Section(Glyphs.Settings, L.Get("Build_Run"), items.ToArray());
    }

    // ---- 4. the result ----
    UIElement ResultSection(EfiBuildResult r)
    {
        var items = new List<UIElement>
        {
            r.Ok ? Note(L.Format("Build_Ok", r.MacOS, r.OpenCore, r.Smbios), CheckState.Good) : Note(L.Format("Build_Failed", r.Error ?? ""), CheckState.Bad),
        };
        if (r.Ok)
        {
            // ocvalidate of the same OpenCore release
            var oc = r.OcValidate;
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Build_OcValidate"), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
            items.Add(Note(oc.Error is not null ? L.Format("Build_OcValidate_Error", oc.Error)
                : oc.Ok ? (oc.Found == 0 ? L.Get("Build_OcValidate_Clean") : L.Format("Build_OcValidate_Accepted", oc.Found))
                : L.Format("Build_OcValidate_Issues", oc.Issues.Count), oc.Ok ? CheckState.Good : CheckState.Bad));
            foreach (var (finding, why) in oc.Accepted) items.Add(Bullet(finding, why));
            foreach (var issue in oc.Issues) items.Add(Bullet(issue, null));

            // the app's own engine (IntelXe-EFI.ps1's) on the same rules
            if (S.Stage2Left is { } left)
                items.Add(left.Count == 0 ? Note(L.Get("Build_Stage2_Agrees"), CheckState.Good)
                    : Note(L.Format("Build_Stage2_Differs", string.Join("; ", left)), CheckState.Warning));
        }
        foreach (var f in r.Failures) items.Add(Bullet(f, null));

        if (r.Decisions.Count > 0)
        {
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Format("Build_Answers", r.Decisions.Count), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Build_Answers_Caption"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
            var list = new StackPanel { Spacing = 8 };
            foreach (var d in r.Decisions)
                list.Children.Add(Bullet(L.Format("Build_Answer_Line", d.Screen, d.Question, d.Answer), L.Format("Build_Answer_Why", d.Rule, d.Why)));
            items.Add(new Expander { Header = L.Get("Build_Answers_Show"), Content = list, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch });
        }
        if (r.Changes.Count > 0)
        {
            var list = new StackPanel { Spacing = 8 };
            foreach (var c in r.Changes) list.Children.Add(Bullet($"{c.Step}: {c.Change}", c.Why.Length > 0 ? c.Why : null));
            items.Add(new Expander { Header = L.Format("Build_Changes", r.Changes.Count), Content = list, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch });
        }
        if (r.Firmware.Count > 0)
        {
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Build_Firmware"), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
            foreach (var f in r.Firmware) items.Add(Bullet(f, null));
            items.Add(Ui.Button(L.Get("Build_Open_Bios"), (_, _) => App.Window?.Open("bios"), glyph: Glyphs.Firmware));
        }
        if (r.AfterInstall.Count > 0)
        {
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Build_AfterInstall"), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
            foreach (var a in r.AfterInstall) items.Add(Bullet(a, null));
        }
        if (S.Platform.Count > 0)
        {
            var rows = new StackPanel { Spacing = 4 };
            foreach (var (key, value) in S.Platform) rows.Children.Add(Ui.Row(key, value));
            rows.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Build_Platform_Masked"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
            items.Add(new Expander { Header = L.Get("Build_Platform"), Content = rows, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch });
        }
        var buttons = Ui.Horizontal(10);
        if (r.LogPath.Length > 0 && File.Exists(r.LogPath))
            buttons.Children.Add(Ui.Button(L.Get("Build_Open_Log"), (_, _) => Shell(r.LogPath), glyph: Glyphs.Document));
        if (r.EfiDir.Length > 0 && Directory.Exists(r.EfiDir))
            buttons.Children.Add(Ui.Button(L.Get("Build_Open_Folder"), (_, _) => Shell(r.EfiDir), glyph: Glyphs.Folder));
        if (buttons.Children.Count > 0) items.Add(buttons);
        items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Build_English"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        return Ui.Section(r.Ok ? Glyphs.Ok : Glyphs.Warning, L.Get("Build_Result"), items.ToArray());
    }

    // ---- 5. save ----
    UIElement SaveSection()
    {
        var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Caption(L.Get("Build_Save_Caption"), L.Get("Build_Save_Detail")) };
        if (S.Saved is { } saved) items.Add(Note(L.Format("Build_Saved", saved), CheckState.Good));
        if (S.SaveError is { } err) items.Add(Note(err, CheckState.Bad));
        var save = Ui.Button(L.Get("Build_Save_Button"), async (_, _) => await Save(), glyph: Glyphs.Folder);
        save.IsEnabled = !Busy;
        var stick = Ui.Button(L.Get("Build_Use_Stick"), (_, _) => App.Window?.Open("stick"), accent: true, glyph: Glyphs.Drive);
        stick.IsEnabled = !Busy;
        items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, stick, save));
        items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Build_Save_Next"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        return Ui.Section(Glyphs.Folder, L.Get("Build_Save"), items.ToArray());
    }

    async Task Save()
    {
        if (S.Result is not { Ok: true }) return;
        var r = S.Result;
        try
        {
            var picker = new Windows.Storage.Pickers.FolderPicker();
            picker.FileTypeFilter.Add("*");
            WinRT.Interop.InitializeWithWindow.Initialize(picker, WinRT.Interop.WindowNative.GetWindowHandle(App.Window));
            var folder = await picker.PickSingleFolderAsync();
            if (folder is null) return;
            S.Saved = await Task.Run(() => EfiBuildStore.SaveTo(r.EfiDir, folder.Path));
            S.SaveError = null;
        }
        catch (Exception e) { S.Saved = null; S.SaveError = e.Message; }
        Build();
    }

    static void Shell(string path)
    {
        try { System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo(path) { UseShellExecute = true }); } catch (Exception) { }
    }

    // ---- pieces ----
    static UIElement Note(string text, CheckState state)
    {
        var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 8 };
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        var icon = Ui.Icon(state == CheckState.Neutral ? Glyphs.Info : Ui.StateGlyph(state), 14, Ui.Brush(state));
        icon.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
        icon.Margin = new Thickness(0, 3, 0, 0);
        g.Children.Add(icon);
        var t = Ui.Text(text);
        Grid.SetColumn(t, 1);
        g.Children.Add(t);
        return g;
    }

    /// A line and, under it, its reason in the caption style.
    static UIElement Bullet(string text, string? why)
    {
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 1, Margin = new Thickness(4, 0, 0, 0) };
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Text("• " + text));
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(why))
        {
            var w = Ui.Text(why, "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true);
            w.Margin = new Thickness(12, 0, 0, 0);
            p.Children.Add(w);
        }
        return p;
    }

    static Border Mono(string text)
    {
        var t = new TextBlock
        {
            Text = text, FontFamily = new FontFamily("Cascadia Mono, Consolas"), FontSize = 12, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
            IsTextSelectionEnabled = true, Margin = new Thickness(10, 8, 10, 8),
        };
        return new Border
        {
            Child = t, CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(4), BorderThickness = new Thickness(1),
            Background = (Brush)Application.Current.Resources["CardBackgroundFillColorSecondaryBrush"],
            BorderBrush = (Brush)Application.Current.Resources["CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush"],
        };
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The Overview page: this PC as the driver sees it, read-only. The header says where it stands (Views.swift
// StatusHeader), four cards give it at a glance, "This PC" lists each requirement with its state and one line on what
// it means, and the EFI partitions are listed as IntelXe-EFI.ps1 finds them, without mounting anything.
using IntelXe.Core;
using Microsoft.UI.Text;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;

namespace IntelXe.App.Pages;

public sealed partial class OverviewPage : Page
{
    public OverviewPage()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Loaded += (_, _) => { AppState.Current.Changed += OnChanged; ActualThemeChanged += OnTheme; Build(); };
        Unloaded += (_, _) => { AppState.Current.Changed -= OnChanged; ActualThemeChanged -= OnTheme; };
    }

    void OnChanged() => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(Build);
    void OnTheme(FrameworkElement sender, object args) => Build();

    void Build()
    {
        var state = AppState.Current;
        var (scroll, column) = Ui.PageColumn();
        column.Children.Add(Header(state));
        if (state.Facts is { } f)
        {
            column.Children.Add(Ui.Section(Glyphs.Grid, L.Get("Section_AtAGlance"), Glance(f, state.Checks)));
            column.Children.Add(ThisPc(state.Checks));
            column.Children.Add(Partitions(f));
            var note = Ui.Text(L.Get("Overview_ReadOnly"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true);
            note.Margin = new Thickness(4, 14, 0, 0);
            column.Children.Add(note);
        }
        Host.Children.Clear();
        Host.Children.Add(scroll);
    }

    static CheckState StateOf(IReadOnlyList<Check> checks, string id) => checks.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == id)?.State ?? CheckState.Neutral;
    static string ValueOf(IReadOnlyList<Check> checks, string id) => checks.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == id) is { } c ? L.Resolve(c.Value) : "";

    UIElement Header(AppState state)
    {
        var overall = state.Facts is null ? CheckState.Neutral : PcChecks.Overall(state.Checks);
        var card = state.Facts?.Card;
        string title = state.Facts is null ? L.Get("Checking") : card is null ? L.Get("Card_None") : SupportedCards.Find(card.Id)!.Name;
        string line = state.Facts is null ? L.Get("Overview_Reading") : overall switch
        {
            CheckState.Good => L.Get("Header_Good"),
            CheckState.Warning => L.Get("Header_Warning"),
            _ => L.Get("Header_Bad"),
        };

        var tile = new Border
        {
            Width = 56, Height = 56, CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(12),
            Background = Ui.Brush(overall, 0.14),
            Child = Ui.Icon(Glyphs.Chip, 28, Ui.Brush(overall)),
        };
        var texts = new StackPanel { Spacing = 2, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        var t = Ui.Text(title, "SubtitleTextBlockStyle", wrap: false);
        texts.Children.Add(t);
        texts.Children.Add(Ui.Text(line, "BodyTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));

        var right = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 10, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
        if (state.Facts is not null)
        {
            int bad = state.Checks.Count(c => c.State == CheckState.Bad), warn = state.Checks.Count(c => c.State == CheckState.Warning);
            string badge = bad > 0 ? L.Format("Badge_Problems", bad) : warn > 0 ? L.Format("Badge_Warnings", warn) : L.Get("Summary_Met");
            right.Children.Add(Ui.Badge(badge, overall));
        }
        if (state.Probing) right.Children.Add(new ProgressRing { IsActive = true, Width = 20, Height = 20 });
        var refresh = new Button { Content = Ui.Icon(Glyphs.Refresh, 14), IsEnabled = !state.Probing, Padding = new Thickness(8) };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(refresh, L.Get("Refresh"));
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(refresh, L.Get("Refresh"));
        refresh.Click += async (_, _) => await AppState.Current.RefreshAsync();
        right.Children.Add(refresh);

        var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 14 };
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.Children.Add(tile);
        Grid.SetColumn(texts, 1); g.Children.Add(texts);
        Grid.SetColumn(right, 2); g.Children.Add(right);
        return Ui.Card(g);
    }

    /// One figure: a title, a value, a line under it, on a card tinted by its state (Views.swift OverviewCard).
    static Border GlanceCard(string glyph, string title, string value, string detail, CheckState state)
    {
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 4 };
        var head = Ui.Horizontal(6, Ui.Icon(glyph, 14, Ui.Brush(state)), Ui.Text(title, "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        p.Children.Add(head);
        var v = Ui.Text(value, "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle", wrap: false);
        v.FontSize = 18;
        p.Children.Add(v);
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(detail, "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        var card = Ui.TintedCard(p, state);
        card.MinHeight = 96;
        return card;
    }

    static UIElement Glance(PcFacts f, IReadOnlyList<Check> checks)
    {
        var card = f.Card;
        string cardDetail = card?.Id is null ? L.Get("Glance_Card_None")
            : card.DriverVersion != "" ? L.Format("Glance_Card_Detail", card.Id.VendorDevice, card.DriverVersion) : card.Id.VendorDevice;
        var cpuFamily = CpuInfo.Family(f.CpuName);
        string cpuDetail = L.Get(f.HybridCpu ? "Glance_HybridPM_Needed" : "Glance_HybridPM_NotNeeded");
        if (cpuFamily.Vendor == CpuVendor.Intel && !cpuFamily.Describe().IsEmpty) cpuDetail = L.Resolve(cpuFamily.Describe()) + " · " + cpuDetail;
        var firmware = new[] { StateOf(checks, "firmware"), StateOf(checks, "secureboot"), StateOf(checks, "rebar") };
        var firmwareState = firmware.Contains(CheckState.Bad) ? CheckState.Bad : firmware.Contains(CheckState.Warning) ? CheckState.Warning
            : f.Firmware == FirmwareMode.Uefi ? CheckState.Good : CheckState.Neutral;
        string esps = f.Esps.Count == 0 ? "" : string.Join(" · ", f.Esps.Select(e => e.OpenCore switch
        {
            OpenCoreState.Found => L.Format("Glance_Esp_OpenCore", e.Disk),
            OpenCoreState.NotFound => L.Format("Glance_Esp_NoOpenCore", e.Disk),
            _ => L.Format("Glance_Esp_NotRead", e.Disk),
        }));

        var cards = new UIElement[]
        {
            GlanceCard(Glyphs.Chip, L.Get("Check_Card"), card is null ? L.Get("Glance_None") : SupportedCards.Find(card.Id)!.Name, cardDetail, StateOf(checks, "card")),
            GlanceCard(Glyphs.Settings, L.Get("Check_Cpu"), CpuInfo.CleanName(f.CpuName) is { Length: > 0 } n ? n : "–", cpuDetail, StateOf(checks, "cpu")),
            GlanceCard(Glyphs.Firmware, L.Get("Glance_Firmware"),
                L.Format("Glance_Firmware_Value", ValueOf(checks, "firmware"), ValueOf(checks, "secureboot")),
                L.Format("Glance_Firmware_Detail", ValueOf(checks, "rebar")), firmwareState),
            GlanceCard(Glyphs.Drive, L.Get("Check_Esp"), f.Esps.Count == 0 ? L.Get("Esp_None") : L.Format("Esp_Count", f.Esps.Count), esps, StateOf(checks, "esp")),
        };
        var grid = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 12, RowSpacing = 12 };
        grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition());
        grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition());
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition());
        grid.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition());
        for (int i = 0; i < cards.Length; i++)
        {
            Grid.SetColumn((FrameworkElement)cards[i], i % 2);
            Grid.SetRow((FrameworkElement)cards[i], i / 2);
            grid.Children.Add(cards[i]);
        }
        return grid;
    }

    /// "This PC": the requirements, under a line that says whether they are met (the macOS app's "This Mac").
    static UIElement ThisPc(IReadOnlyList<Check> checks)
    {
        bool met = checks.All(c => c.State != CheckState.Bad);
        var list = new StackPanel { Spacing = 12 };
        foreach (var c in checks) list.Children.Add(Ui.CheckRow(c));
        var state = met ? CheckState.Good : CheckState.Bad;
        var header = Ui.Horizontal(8, Ui.Icon(met ? Glyphs.Ok : Glyphs.Bad, 16, Ui.Brush(state)),
            new TextBlock { Text = L.Get(met ? "Summary_Met" : "Summary_NotMet"), Foreground = Ui.Brush(state), FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold });
        var expander = new Expander
        {
            Header = header, Content = list, IsExpanded = true,
            HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
        };
        return Ui.Section(Glyphs.Pc, L.Get("Section_ThisPc"), expander);
    }

    /// The EFI system partitions: disk, bus, size, where Windows has them, and whether they hold OpenCore.
    static UIElement Partitions(PcFacts f)
    {
        var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Caption(L.Get("Esp_Caption"), L.Get("Esp_Detail")) };
        if (f.EspError is not null) items.Add(Ui.Text(f.EspError, secondary: true));
        else if (f.Esps.Count == 0) items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Esp_None"), secondary: true));
        foreach (var e in f.Esps)
        {
            var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 12 };
            g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
            g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            g.Children.Add(Ui.Icon(Glyphs.Drive, 18));
            var texts = new StackPanel { Spacing = 1 };
            texts.Children.Add(Ui.Text(e.Bus == "" ? $"{e.Disk} · {e.SizeText}" : $"{e.Disk} ({e.Bus}) · {e.SizeText}"));
            var where = new List<string> { L.Format("Esp_Where", e.DiskNumber, e.PartitionNumber) };
            if (e.IsSystem) where.Add(L.Get("Esp_System"));
            where.Add(e.Letter != "" ? L.Format("Esp_Mounted", e.Letter) : L.Get("Esp_NotMounted"));
            texts.Children.Add(Ui.Text(string.Join(" · ", where), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
            Grid.SetColumn(texts, 1); g.Children.Add(texts);
            var (text, state) = e.OpenCore switch
            {
                OpenCoreState.Found => (L.Get("Esp_OpenCore_Found"), CheckState.Good),
                OpenCoreState.NotFound => (L.Get("Esp_OpenCore_NotFound"), CheckState.Neutral),
                _ => (L.Get("Esp_OpenCore_NeedsMount"), CheckState.Neutral),
            };
            var badge = Ui.Badge(text, state);
            Grid.SetColumn(badge, 2); g.Children.Add(badge);
            items.Add(g);
        }
        return Ui.Section(Glyphs.Drive, L.Get("Check_Esp"), items.ToArray());
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The Report page: tools/report/collect-windows.ps1, shipped beside the app, writes the diagnostics zip on the Desktop;
// the page shows its progress and output, then the zip in Explorer, and opens the issue forms with the report ID filled
// in (as app/Sources/Report.swift on macOS). The script changes nothing; nothing is uploaded, by it or by the app.
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Report;
using Microsoft.UI.Dispatching;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media;
using Windows.ApplicationModel.DataTransfer;

namespace IntelXe.App.Pages;

public sealed partial class ReportPage : Page
{
    static bool acpi, bootLogs;

    /// The boot logs option on, for the EFI page's link to it (before it opens this page).
    internal static void WithBootLogs() => bootLogs = true;
    static string? lastError;
    TextBox? output;
    TextBlock? elapsed;
    DispatcherQueueTimer? timer;
    ReportRunner Runner => AppState.Current.Report;

    public ReportPage()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Loaded += (_, _) =>
        {
            Runner.OutputChanged += OnOutput;
            Runner.Finished += OnFinished;
            timer = DispatcherQueue.CreateTimer();
            timer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
            timer.Tick += (_, _) => UpdateElapsed();
            timer.Start();
            Build();
        };
        Unloaded += (_, _) => { Runner.OutputChanged -= OnOutput; Runner.Finished -= OnFinished; timer?.Stop(); };
    }

    void OnOutput() => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(() =>
    {
        if (output is null) return;
        lock (Runner.Output) output.Text = Runner.Output.ToString();
        output.SelectionStart = output.Text.Length;
    });

    void OnFinished(ReportResult? result, string? error) => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(() =>
    {
        lastError = error;
        if (result is not null)
        {
            AppState.Current.LastReport = result;
            Reveal(result.File);
        }
        Build();
    });

    void UpdateElapsed()
    {
        if (elapsed is not null && Runner.Running)
            elapsed.Text = L.Format("Report_Seconds", (int)(DateTime.Now - Runner.StartedAt).TotalSeconds);
    }

    static void Reveal(string file)
    {
        try { System.Diagnostics.Process.Start("explorer.exe", $"/select,\"{file}\""); } catch (Exception) { }
    }

    void Build()
    {
        var (scroll, column) = Ui.PageColumn();
        column.Children.Add(Ui.PageHeader(L.Get("Nav_Report")));
        column.Children.Add(Ui.Section(Glyphs.Report, L.Get("Report_Section"), ReportBody()));
        if (AppState.Current.LastReport is { } r) column.Children.Add(Ui.Section(Glyphs.Document, L.Get("Report_Last"), Last(r)));
        else column.Children.Add(Ui.Section(Glyphs.Feedback, L.Get("Report_Forms"), Forms()));
        foreach (var section in ProbeSections()) column.Children.Add(section);   // ReportPage.Probe.cs
        column.Children.Add(XeProbeSection());   // ReportPage.XeProbe.cs
        Host.Children.Clear();
        Host.Children.Add(scroll);
    }

    UIElement ReportBody()
    {
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 12 };
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Caption(L.Get("Report_Caption"), L.Get("Report_Detail")));
        var toggle = new ToggleSwitch { IsOn = acpi, OnContent = "", OffContent = "", MinWidth = 0, Width = 40, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right, IsEnabled = !Runner.Running };
        toggle.Toggled += (_, _) => acpi = toggle.IsOn;
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(toggle, L.Get("Report_Acpi"));
        var acpiRow = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 12 };
        acpiRow.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        acpiRow.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        var acpiText = new StackPanel { Spacing = 2 };
        acpiText.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Report_Acpi")));
        acpiText.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Report_Acpi_Caption"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        acpiRow.Children.Add(acpiText);
        Grid.SetColumn(toggle, 1); acpiRow.Children.Add(toggle);
        p.Children.Add(acpiRow);
        p.Children.Add(BootLogsRow());

        if (Runner.Running)
        {
            p.Children.Add(new ProgressBar { IsIndeterminate = true });
            elapsed = Ui.Text("", "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true);
            p.Children.Add(Ui.Horizontal(12, Ui.Text(L.Get("Report_Collecting")), elapsed));
            UpdateElapsed();
        }
        else
        {
            var create = Ui.Button(L.Get("Report_Create"), (_, _) => { lastError = null; Runner.Start(acpi, bootLogs); Build(); }, accent: true);
            var row = Ui.Horizontal(12, create);
            row.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right;
            p.Children.Add(row);
            if (ReportRunner.FindScript() is null) { create.IsEnabled = false; p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Report_NoScript"), secondary: true)); }
        }
        if (lastError is not null)
            p.Children.Add(new InfoBar { Severity = InfoBarSeverity.Warning, IsOpen = true, IsClosable = false, Message = lastError });

        string text;
        lock (Runner.Output) text = Runner.Output.ToString();
        if (Runner.Running || text.Length > 0)
        {
            output = new TextBox
            {
                Text = text, IsReadOnly = true, AcceptsReturn = true, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap,
                FontFamily = new FontFamily("Cascadia Mono, Consolas"), FontSize = 12, MinHeight = 120, MaxHeight = 260,
            };
            ScrollViewer.SetVerticalScrollBarVisibility(output, ScrollBarVisibility.Auto);
            var expander = new Expander
            {
                Header = L.Get("Report_Output"), Content = output, IsExpanded = Runner.Running || lastError is not null,
                HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
            };
            p.Children.Add(expander);
        }
        else output = null;
        return p;
    }

    /// The boot logs option (-BootLogs): OpenCore's logs and the panics it saved, from USB sticks and the EFI partitions,
    /// which the script reads as administrator (Windows asks for permission when the report starts).
    UIElement BootLogsRow()
    {
        var toggle = new ToggleSwitch { IsOn = bootLogs, OnContent = "", OffContent = "", MinWidth = 0, Width = 40, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right, IsEnabled = !Runner.Running };
        toggle.Toggled += (_, _) => bootLogs = toggle.IsOn;
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(toggle, L.Get("Report_BootLogs"));
        var row = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 12 };
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        var text = new StackPanel { Spacing = 2 };
        text.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Report_BootLogs")));
        text.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Report_BootLogs_Caption"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        row.Children.Add(text);
        Grid.SetColumn(toggle, 1); row.Children.Add(toggle);
        return row;
    }

    static UIElement Last(ReportResult r)
    {
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 12 };
        bool desktop = string.Equals(Path.GetDirectoryName(r.File), ReportRunner.Desktop, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Caption(desktop ? L.Format("Report_Done", r.Id) : L.Format("Report_Done_Folder", r.Id, Path.GetFileName(Path.GetDirectoryName(r.File)) ?? "")));
        var id = Ui.Text(r.Id);
        id.FontFamily = new FontFamily("Cascadia Mono, Consolas");
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("Report_Id"), id));
        var show = Ui.Button(L.Get("Report_Show"), (_, _) => Reveal(r.File), glyph: Glyphs.Folder);
        var copy = Ui.Button(L.Get("Report_Copy"), (_, _) =>
        {
            var data = new DataPackage();
            data.SetText(r.Id);
            Clipboard.SetContent(data);
        }, glyph: Glyphs.Copy);
        var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 8 };
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.Children.Add(Ui.Horizontal(8, show, copy));
        var links = Ui.Horizontal(4, Ui.Link(L.Get("Report_Bug"), Project.BugFormUrl(r.Id)), Ui.Link(L.Get("Report_NewGpu"), Project.NewGpuFormUrl(r.Id)));
        Grid.SetColumn(links, 2); g.Children.Add(links);
        p.Children.Add(g);
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Report_Attach"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        return p;
    }

    static UIElement Forms()
    {
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 8 };
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("Report_Form_Bug"), Ui.Link(L.Get("Report_Bug"), Project.BugFormUrl(null))));
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("Report_Form_NewGpu"), Ui.Link(L.Get("Report_NewGpu"), Project.NewGpuFormUrl(null))));
        p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Report_First"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        return p;
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.App/Pages/ReportPage.XeProbe.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The Report page's XeProbe section: a macOS report bundle collected with --probe (xe-report-XR-XXXXXXXX.tar.gz, or the
// folder it unpacks to), read in memory without unpacking it (Core/Report/XeProbeReport.cs): the device, its family and
// GuC, each stage's verdict, the previous boot's NVRAM breadcrumb, the watchdog's panics, the runs IntelXe Manager made
// on macOS and the probe's log. Nothing is uploaded.
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Report;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;

namespace IntelXe.App.Pages;

public sealed partial class ReportPage
{
    sealed class XeProbeState
    {
        public bool Reading;
        public XeProbeReport? Report;
        public string? Error;
    }

    static readonly XeProbeState X = new();

    UIElement XeProbeSection()
    {
        var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Caption(L.Get("XeProbe_Caption"), L.Get("XeProbe_Detail")) };
        var open = Ui.Button(L.Get("XeProbe_Open"), async (_, _) => await OpenXeProbe(folder: false), glyph: Glyphs.Open);
        open.IsEnabled = !X.Reading;
        var openFolder = Ui.Button(L.Get("XeProbe_OpenFolder"), async (_, _) => await OpenXeProbe(folder: true), glyph: Glyphs.Folder);
        openFolder.IsEnabled = !X.Reading;
        items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, open, openFolder));
        if (X.Reading)
        {
            items.Add(new ProgressRing { IsActive = true, Width = 20, Height = 20, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left });
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("XeProbe_Reading"), secondary: true));
        }
        if (X.Error is not null)
            items.Add(new InfoBar { Severity = InfoBarSeverity.Warning, IsOpen = true, IsClosable = false, Message = X.Error });
        if (X.Report is { } r && !X.Reading) items.AddRange(XeProbeBody(r));
        return Ui.Section(Glyphs.Chip, L.Get("XeProbe_Section"), items.ToArray());
    }

    async Task OpenXeProbe(bool folder)
    {
        string? path;
        try
        {
            var hwnd = WinRT.Interop.WindowNative.GetWindowHandle(App.Window);
            if (folder)
            {
                var picker = new Windows.Storage.Pickers.FolderPicker();
                picker.FileTypeFilter.Add("*");
                WinRT.Interop.InitializeWithWindow.Initialize(picker, hwnd);
                path = (await picker.PickSingleFolderAsync())?.Path;
            }
            else
            {
                var picker = new Windows.Storage.Pickers.FileOpenPicker();
                picker.FileTypeFilter.Add(".gz");   // .tar.gz: the picker filters by the last extension
                picker.FileTypeFilter.Add(".tgz");
                WinRT.Interop.InitializeWithWindow.Initialize(picker, hwnd);
                path = (await picker.PickSingleFileAsync())?.Path;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e) { X.Error = e.Message; Build(); return; }
        if (path is null) return;
        X.Reading = true;
        X.Error = null;
        X.Report = null;
        Build();
        try { X.Report = await Task.Run(() => XeProbeReports.Read(path)); }
        catch (XeProbeReportException e) { X.Error = L.Resolve(e.Reason); }
        catch (Exception e) { X.Error = e.Message; }
        finally { X.Reading = false; Build(); }
    }

    static IEnumerable<UIElement> XeProbeBody(XeProbeReport r)
    {
        var items = new List<UIElement>();
        var summary = string.Join("; ", XeProbeReports.Summary(r).Select(L.Resolve));
        var overall = !r.HasProbe || r.Results is null || !r.Attached ? CheckState.Neutral
            : r.Results.Stages.Any(s => s.Verdict is XeProbeVerdict.Failed or XeProbeVerdict.Stalled) || r.Panics.Any(p => p.Line is not null) ? CheckState.Bad
            : r.Results.Stages.Any(s => s.Verdict is XeProbeVerdict.Refused or XeProbeVerdict.Running) ? CheckState.Warning
            : r.Results.Stages.Any(s => s.Verdict == XeProbeVerdict.Passed) ? CheckState.Good : CheckState.Neutral;
        items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Format("XeProbe_Report", r.Id, Path.GetFileName(r.Source)), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
        items.Add(ProbeNote(summary, overall));
        if (!r.HasProbe) return items;

        // the device, its family and GuC
        if (r.Device is { } device)
            items.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("XeProbe_Device"), r.Family is { } family ? L.Format("XeProbe_Device_Value", device, family) : L.Format("XeProbe_Device_Unknown", device)));
        if (r.Info is { } info)
        {
            var guc = info.GucImage is null ? L.Get("XeProbe_Guc_None")
                : info.GucBuiltIn is { } v ? L.Format("XeProbe_Guc_Value", info.GucImage, v)
                : L.Format("XeProbe_Guc_NotBuiltIn", info.GucImage);
            if (info.Images.Count > 0) guc += " · " + L.Format("XeProbe_Guc_Images", string.Join(", ", info.Images));
            items.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("XeProbe_Guc"), guc));
        }

        // the stages
        if (r.Results is { Stages.Count: > 0 } results)
        {
            var list = new StackPanel { Spacing = 6 };
            foreach (var s in results.Stages) list.Children.Add(XeProbeStageRow(s));
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("XeProbe_Stages"), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
            items.Add(list);
        }

        // the previous boot's breadcrumb, the watchdog's panics
        if (r.Breadcrumb is { } crumb)
            items.Add(Ui.Row(L.Get("XeProbe_Breadcrumb"), crumb.Stage is { } n && crumb.Step is { } step
                ? L.Format("XeProbe_Breadcrumb_Value", n, crumb.StageName ?? "", step)
                : crumb.Text));
        if (r.Panics.Count > 0)
        {
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("XeProbe_Panics"), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
            foreach (var p in r.Panics)
                items.Add(p.Line is { } line ? ProbeNote(Path.GetFileName(p.File) + "\n" + line, CheckState.Bad)
                    : ProbeNote(L.Format(p.Found ? "XeProbe_Panic_NoLine" : "XeProbe_Panic_Missing", p.File), CheckState.Neutral));
        }

        // IntelXe Manager's runs on macOS
        if (r.History.Count > 0)
        {
            var runs = new StackPanel { Spacing = 4 };
            foreach (var run in r.History)
            {
                var what = run.RunTo is { } to ? L.Format("XeProbe_Run_All", to) : L.Format("XeProbe_Run_Stage", run.What);
                var when = run.When is { } t ? t.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm 'UTC'", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : run.WhenText;
                runs.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Format("XeProbe_Run_Line", when, what, run.Exit, string.Join("; ", XeProbeReports.Summary(run.Results).Select(L.Resolve))),
                    "CaptionTextBlockStyle"));
            }
            items.Add(new Expander
            {
                Header = L.Format("XeProbe_History", r.History.Count, r.HistoryBoots), Content = runs,
                HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
            });
        }

        // the log
        if (r.Log.Length > 0)
        {
            var text = new ScrollViewer { Content = ProbeMono(r.Log), MaxHeight = 320, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto };
            items.Add(new Expander
            {
                Header = L.Get("XeProbe_Log"), Content = text,
                HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch, HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch,
            });
        }

        if (r.Notes.Count > 0)
        {
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("XeProbe_Notes"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
            items.Add(ProbeMono(string.Join("\n", r.Notes.Select(L.Resolve))));
        }
        return items;
    }

    /// "3  guc  [failed]  15002 ms" and the stage's detail below.
    static UIElement XeProbeStageRow(XeProbeStage s)
    {
        var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 12 };
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(120) });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        var name = Ui.Text($"{s.Number}  {s.Name}", wrap: false);
        name.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
        g.Children.Add(name);
        var badge = Ui.Badge(L.Resolve(XeProbeReports.VerdictText(s.Verdict)), XeProbeReports.VerdictState(s.Verdict));
        Grid.SetColumn(badge, 1);
        g.Children.Add(badge);
        var ms = Ui.Text(L.Format("XeProbe_Ms", s.Ms), secondary: true);
        ms.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
        Grid.SetColumn(ms, 2);
        g.Children.Add(ms);
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 2 };
        p.Children.Add(g);
        if (s.Detail.Length > 0) p.Children.Add(Ui.Text(s.Detail, "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        return p;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The "Set up" page: one guided flow from this Windows PC to a macOS install, over the app's other pages
// (Core/Setup/SetupWizard.cs): 1. this PC (the Overview's facts, what stops the install first); 2. the firmware (BIOS)
// settings, confirmed by the user; 3. the OpenCore EFI built for this PC (the Build page); 4. the macOS installer USB
// stick with that EFI (the USB installer page); 5. after macOS is installed: stage 3 on macOS (IntelXe Manager for Mac),
// stage 4 from macOS or from Windows (the EFI page, on the stick's or the disk's EFI). The step list shows each step as
// done, next or blocked. The progress is kept in the app's settings file. This page writes nothing but that file: every
// step that changes a disk happens on its own page, behind that page's confirmation.
using System.Globalization;
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Setup;
using Microsoft.UI.Text;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;

namespace IntelXe.App.Pages;

public sealed partial class SetupPage : Page
{
    static BuildSession B => BuildSession.Current;
    static SetupProgress P => Settings.Current.Setup;

    public SetupPage()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Loaded += (_, _) =>
        {
            AppState.Current.Changed += OnChanged;
            B.Changed += OnChanged;
            ActualThemeChanged += OnTheme;
            B.Load();
            Build();
        };
        Unloaded += (_, _) => { AppState.Current.Changed -= OnChanged; B.Changed -= OnChanged; ActualThemeChanged -= OnTheme; };
    }

    void OnChanged() => DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(Build);
    void OnTheme(FrameworkElement sender, object args) => Build();

    static void Save(SetupProgress next)
    {
        Settings.Current.Setup = next;
        Settings.Current.Save();
    }

    void Build()
    {
        var states = SetupWizard.Evaluate(P, B.SetupInputs());
        var (scroll, column) = Ui.PageColumn();
        column.Children.Add(Ui.PageHeader(L.Get("Nav_Setup"), L.Get("Setup_Caption")));
        column.Children.Add(StepList(states));
        column.Children.Add(ThisPc(states));
        column.Children.Add(Bios(states));
        column.Children.Add(BuildEfi(states));
        column.Children.Add(Stick(states));
        column.Children.Add(AfterInstall(states));
        var start = Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_StartOver"), async (_, _) => await StartOver(), glyph: Glyphs.Undo);
        start.Margin = new Thickness(0, 16, 0, 0);
        column.Children.Add(start);
        var note = Ui.Text(L.Get("Setup_Footer"), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true);
        note.Margin = new Thickness(4, 14, 0, 0);
        column.Children.Add(note);
        Host.Children.Clear();
        Host.Children.Add(scroll);
    }

    static string Title(SetupStep s) => s switch
    {
        SetupStep.ThisPc => L.Get("Setup_Step_Pc"),
        SetupStep.Bios => L.Get("Setup_Step_Bios"),
        SetupStep.BuildEfi => L.Get("Setup_Step_Efi"),
        SetupStep.Stick => L.Get("Setup_Step_Stick"),
        _ => L.Get("Setup_Step_After"),
    };

    static string StateText(StepState s) => s switch
    {
        StepState.Done => L.Get("Setup_State_Done"),
        StepState.Next => L.Get("Setup_State_Next"),
        _ => L.Get("Setup_State_Blocked"),
    };

    static CheckState Color(StepState s) => s switch { StepState.Done => CheckState.Good, StepState.Next => CheckState.Warning, _ => CheckState.Neutral };

    static StepStatus Of(IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> states, SetupStep step) => states.First(s => s.Step == step);

    // ---- the step list ----
    UIElement StepList(IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> states)
    {
        var list = new StackPanel { Spacing = 10 };
        foreach (var s in states)
        {
            var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 12 };
            g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
            g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
            var icon = Ui.Icon(s.State switch { StepState.Done => Glyphs.Ok, StepState.Next => Glyphs.Open, _ => Glyphs.Neutral }, 18, Ui.Brush(Color(s.State)));
            icon.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
            Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(icon, StateText(s.State));
            g.Children.Add(icon);
            var texts = new StackPanel { Spacing = 1 };
            var title = Ui.Text(L.Format("Setup_Step_Line", (int)s.Step + 1, Title(s.Step)));
            if (s.State == StepState.Next) title.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold;
            texts.Children.Add(title);
            if (s.State == StepState.Blocked && !s.Reason.IsEmpty) texts.Children.Add(Ui.Text(L.Resolve(s.Reason), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
            Grid.SetColumn(texts, 1);
            g.Children.Add(texts);
            var badge = Ui.Badge(StateText(s.State), Color(s.State));
            Grid.SetColumn(badge, 2);
            g.Children.Add(badge);
            list.Children.Add(g);
        }
        return Ui.Section(Glyphs.List, L.Get("Setup_Steps"), list);
    }

    /// A step's section: its number and title, its state, then its content.
    static UIElement StepSection(StepStatus s, string glyph, List<UIElement> items)
    {
        var badge = Ui.Badge(StateText(s.State), Color(s.State));
        badge.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
        items.Insert(0, badge);
        if (s.State == StepState.Blocked && !s.Reason.IsEmpty) items.Insert(1, Note(L.Resolve(s.Reason), CheckState.Neutral));
        return Ui.Section(glyph, L.Format("Setup_Step_Line", (int)s.Step + 1, Title(s.Step)), items.ToArray());
    }

    // ---- 1. this PC ----
    UIElement ThisPc(IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> states)
    {
        var s = Of(states, SetupStep.ThisPc);
        var state = AppState.Current;
        var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Caption(L.Get("Setup_Pc_Caption")) };
        if (state.Facts is null)
            items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, new ProgressRing { IsActive = true, Width = 20, Height = 20 }, Ui.Text(L.Get("Overview_Reading"), secondary: true)));
        else
        {
            foreach (var b in SetupWizard.Blocking(state.Facts, state.Checks)) items.Add(Note(L.Resolve(b), CheckState.Bad));
            foreach (var c in SetupWizard.Ordered(state.Checks)) items.Add(Ui.CheckRow(c));
        }
        var refresh = Ui.Button(L.Get("Refresh"), async (_, _) => await AppState.Current.RefreshAsync(), glyph: Glyphs.Refresh);
        refresh.IsEnabled = !state.Probing;
        items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_Open_Overview"), (_, _) => App.Window?.Open("overview"), glyph: Glyphs.Grid), refresh));
        return StepSection(s, Glyphs.Pc, items);
    }

    // ---- 2. BIOS ----
    UIElement Bios(IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> states)
    {
        var s = Of(states, SetupStep.Bios);
        var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Caption(L.Get("Setup_Bios_Caption"), L.Get("Setup_Bios_Detail")) };
        var open = Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_Open_Bios"), (_, _) => App.Window?.Open("bios"), glyph: Glyphs.Firmware);
        if (s.IsDone)
        {
            items.Add(Note(L.Format("Setup_Bios_Done", When(P.BiosConfirmed)), CheckState.Good));
            items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, open, Again(SetupStep.Bios)));
        }
        else
        {
            var done = Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_Bios_Confirm"), (_, _) => { Save(SetupWizard.ConfirmBios(P, DateTime.Now)); Build(); }, accent: true, glyph: Glyphs.Ok);
            done.IsEnabled = SetupWizard.CanAct(states, SetupStep.Bios);
            items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, open, done));
        }
        return StepSection(s, Glyphs.Firmware, items);
    }

    // ---- 3. the EFI ----
    UIElement BuildEfi(IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> states)
    {
        var s = Of(states, SetupStep.BuildEfi);
        var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Caption(L.Get("Setup_Efi_Caption"), L.Get("Setup_Efi_Detail")) };
        var open = Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_Open_Build"), (_, _) => App.Window?.Open("build"), accent: s.State == StepState.Next, glyph: Glyphs.Settings);
        if (s.IsDone)
        {
            items.Add(Note(L.Format("Setup_Efi_Done", P.EfiMacOS, When(P.EfiBuilt)), CheckState.Good));
            items.Add(Ui.Text(BuildSession.BuiltEfiDir() ?? "", "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
            items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, open, Again(SetupStep.BuildEfi)));
        }
        else
        {
            if (B.Building) items.Add(Note(L.Get("Setup_Efi_Building"), CheckState.Neutral));
            items.Add(open);
        }
        return StepSection(s, Glyphs.Settings, items);
    }

    // ---- 4. the stick ----
    UIElement Stick(IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> states)
    {
        var s = Of(states, SetupStep.Stick);
        var items = new List<UIElement> { Ui.Caption(L.Get("Setup_Stick_Caption"), L.Get("Setup_Stick_Detail")) };
        var open = Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_Open_Stick"), (_, _) => App.Window?.Open("stick"), accent: s.State == StepState.Next, glyph: Glyphs.Drive);
        if (s.IsDone)
        {
            items.Add(Note(L.Get(P.StickWith == SetupWizard.Manual ? "Setup_Stick_DoneManual" : "Setup_Stick_Done"), CheckState.Good));
            items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, open, Again(SetupStep.Stick)));
        }
        else
        {
            var manual = Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_Stick_Manual"), (_, _) => { Save(SetupWizard.MarkStickManual(P)); Build(); });
            manual.IsEnabled = SetupWizard.CanAct(states, SetupStep.Stick);
            items.Add(Ui.Horizontal(10, open, manual));
        }
        return StepSection(s, Glyphs.Drive, items);
    }

    // ---- 5. after the install ----
    UIElement AfterInstall(IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> states)
    {
        var s = Of(states, SetupStep.AfterInstall);
        var items = new List<UIElement>
        {
            Ui.Caption(L.Get("Setup_After_Caption")),
            Ui.Text(L.Get("Setup_After_Boot")),
            Ui.Text(L.Get("Setup_After_Stage3")),
            Ui.Text(L.Get("Setup_After_Stage4")),
        };
        if (B.Result is { Ok: true, AfterInstall.Count: > 0 } r)
        {
            items.Add(Ui.Text(L.Get("Setup_After_FromBuild"), "BodyStrongTextBlockStyle"));
            foreach (var line in r.AfterInstall) items.Add(Ui.Text("• " + line, "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        }
        var buttons = Ui.Horizontal(10,
            Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_Open_Efi"), (_, _) => App.Window?.Open("efi"), glyph: Glyphs.Puzzle),
            Ui.Link(L.Get("Setup_Open_Guide"), new Uri(Project.InstallGuideUrl)));
        if (s.IsDone) items.Add(Note(L.Format("Setup_After_Done", When(P.AfterInstallDone)), CheckState.Good));
        else
        {
            var done = Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_After_Mark"), (_, _) => { Save(SetupWizard.MarkAfterInstall(P, DateTime.Now)); Build(); }, glyph: Glyphs.Ok);
            done.IsEnabled = SetupWizard.CanAct(states, SetupStep.AfterInstall);
            buttons.Children.Add(done);
        }
        items.Add(buttons);
        return StepSection(s, Glyphs.Heart, items);
    }

    /// "Do this step again": its record and every later one's go; nothing on disk changes.
    Button Again(SetupStep step) => Ui.Button(L.Get("Setup_Again"), (_, _) => { Save(SetupWizard.Reopen(P, step)); Build(); }, glyph: Glyphs.Undo);

    async Task StartOver()
    {
        var d = new ContentDialog
        {
            Title = L.Get("Setup_StartOver"), Content = Ui.Text(L.Get("Setup_StartOver_Detail")), XamlRoot = XamlRoot, RequestedTheme = Ui.Root.ActualTheme,
            PrimaryButtonText = L.Get("Setup_StartOver"), CloseButtonText = L.Get("Efi_Cancel"), DefaultButton = ContentDialogButton.Close,
        };
        if (await d.ShowAsync() != ContentDialogResult.Primary) return;
        Save(SetupWizard.Reopen(P, SetupStep.ThisPc));
        Build();
    }

    static string When(string iso) =>
        DateTime.TryParse(iso, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, DateTimeStyles.None, out var t) ? t.ToString("g", CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture) : iso;

    static UIElement Note(string text, CheckState state)
    {
        var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 8 };
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        var icon = Ui.Icon(state == CheckState.Neutral ? Glyphs.Info : Ui.StateGlyph(state), 14, Ui.Brush(state));
        icon.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
        icon.Margin = new Thickness(0, 3, 0, 0);
        g.Children.Add(icon);
        var t = Ui.Text(text);
        Grid.SetColumn(t, 1);
        g.Children.Add(t);
        return g;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXe.Core.Report;

namespace IntelXe.App;

/// What the pages share: this PC's facts (read once at start and on Refresh), the EFI planner and the package its files
/// come from, the last report.
public sealed class AppState
{
    public static AppState Current { get; } = new();

    public PcFacts? Facts { get; private set; }
    public IReadOnlyList<Check> Checks { get; private set; } = [];
    public bool Probing { get; private set; }
    public event Action? Changed;

    /// The EFI rules built into the app (efi-rules.json), run by IntelXe-EFI.ps1's engine; PendingEfiPlanner when they
    /// cannot be loaded.
    public IEfiPlanner Planner { get; set; } = MakePlanner();

    static IEfiPlanner MakePlanner()
    {
        try
        {
            _ = EfiRules.Embedded;
            return new WindowsEfiPlanner(App.Options.HelperForFolders);
        }
        catch (Exception e) { return new PendingEfiPlanner(e.Message); }
    }

    /// The package (the unpacked -efi.zip) the EFI page takes IntelXe.kext, SSDT-ARCOFF.aml and HybridPM.kext from, and
    /// why the last choice was not one.
    public EfiPackageInfo? Package { get; private set; }
    public string? PackageError { get; private set; }
    bool packageLooked;

    /// Where a chosen -efi.zip is unpacked.
    public static string PackageCache => Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "IntelXe Manager", "packages");

    /// The package given on the command line or chosen last time, else one beside the app; once.
    public void FindPackage()
    {
        if (packageLooked) return;
        packageLooked = true;
        foreach (var p in new[] { App.Options.Package, Settings.Current.Package })
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(p) && (File.Exists(p) || Directory.Exists(p)) && UsePackage(p, save: false)) return;
        if (EfiPackage.FindBeside(AppContext.BaseDirectory) is { } beside) UsePackage(beside, save: false);
    }

    /// A folder (the unpacked -efi.zip or the folder holding it) or the zip itself. False, with PackageError, when it is
    /// not a package.
    public bool UsePackage(string path, bool save = true)
    {
        try
        {
            string? dir = File.Exists(path) && path.EndsWith(".zip", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? EfiPackage.Unzip(path, PackageCache)
                : EfiPackage.FindIn(path);
            if (dir is null) { PackageError = L.Format("Pkg_NotAPackage", path); return false; }
            Package = EfiPackage.Inspect(dir);
            PackageError = null;
            if (save) { Settings.Current.Package = path; Settings.Current.Save(); }
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            PackageError = e.Message;
            return false;
        }
        finally { Changed?.Invoke(); }
    }

    public ReportResult? LastReport { get; set; }
    public ReportRunner Report { get; } = new();

    public async Task RefreshAsync()
    {
        if (Probing) return;
        Probing = true;
        Changed?.Invoke();
        try
        {
            var facts = await Task.Run(SystemProbe.Probe);
            Facts = facts;
            Checks = PcChecks.Evaluate(facts);
        }
        finally
        {
            Probing = false;
            Changed?.Invoke();
        }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The few extra facts the BIOS page judges by, read like the rest of SystemProbe: without administrator rights,
// changing nothing. The storage controllers' names (RAID / Intel RST / VMD), whether the firmware publishes an ACPI DMAR
// table (VT-d on), whether Windows sees virtualization enabled in the firmware, and the core and thread counts.
using System.Management;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using IntelXe.Core;

namespace IntelXe.App;

static partial class BiosProbe
{
    static string Str(object? v) => v?.ToString()?.Trim() ?? "";

    public static void Probe(PcFacts f)
    {
        try { f.StorageControllers = StorageControllers(); } catch (Exception) { }
        try { f.DmarTable = HasAcpiTable("DMAR"); } catch (Exception) { }
        try
        {
            using var s = new ManagementObjectSearcher(@"root\CIMV2", "SELECT NumberOfCores, NumberOfLogicalProcessors, VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled FROM Win32_Processor");
            int cores = 0, threads = 0;
            bool? virt = null;
            foreach (var o in s.Get())
            {
                cores += Convert.ToInt32(o["NumberOfCores"] ?? 0);
                threads += Convert.ToInt32(o["NumberOfLogicalProcessors"] ?? 0);
                if (o["VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled"] is bool b) virt = (virt ?? true) && b;
            }
            if (cores > 0) { f.Cores = cores; f.Threads = threads; }
            f.VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled = virt;
        }
        catch (Exception) { }
    }

    /// The names of the present storage controllers: SCSI/RAID adapters (Intel RST and VMD show up there), IDE/SATA
    /// controllers (AHCI) and NVMe controllers.
    static List<string> StorageControllers()
    {
        var names = new List<string>();
        using var s = new ManagementObjectSearcher(@"root\CIMV2", "SELECT Name, PNPClass FROM Win32_PnPEntity WHERE PNPClass = 'SCSIAdapter' OR PNPClass = 'HDC'");
        foreach (var o in s.Get())
        {
            var n = Str(o["Name"]);
            if (n.Length > 0 && !names.Contains(n)) names.Add(n);
        }
        return names;
    }

    [LibraryImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    private static partial uint EnumSystemFirmwareTables(uint provider, byte[]? buffer, uint size);

    const uint Acpi = 0x41435049;   // 'ACPI'

    /// Whether the firmware's ACPI tables include this one (EnumSystemFirmwareTables lists their signatures; no rights
    /// needed). Null when they cannot be listed.
    static bool? HasAcpiTable(string signature)
    {
        uint size = EnumSystemFirmwareTables(Acpi, null, 0);
        if (size == 0) return null;
        var buf = new byte[size];
        if (EnumSystemFirmwareTables(Acpi, buf, size) != size) return null;
        for (int i = 0; i + 4 <= buf.Length; i += 4)
            if (System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetString(buf, i, 4) == signature) return true;
        return false;
    }
}
