// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The Windows side of building the OpenCore EFI: the elevated helper's "sniff" verb (SniffHelperMain: this exe with
// "--efi-helper sniff --scan DIR --out FILE", started through "runas"), starting it (SniffRunner), and the build's state
// that the Build and Set up pages share (BuildSession): the builder (PythonEfiBuilder over the engine beside the exe),
// the last scan, the macOS version, the build's progress and result, the saved copy. Scans and builds go to
// %LOCALAPPDATA%\IntelXe Manager\efibuild; the builder's download cache is its own (%LOCALAPPDATA%\IntelXe\efibuild).
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;
using IntelXe.Core.Setup;

namespace IntelXe.App;

/// "IntelXeManager.exe --efi-helper sniff --scan DIR --out FILE": Hardware Sniffer and the ACPI tables, with
/// administrator rights, through the engine beside this exe (checked against its manifest first).
static class SniffHelperMain
{
    public static int Run(string[] args)
    {
        SniffAnswer a;
        string? output = null;
        try
        {
            var q = SniffRequest.Parse(args);
            output = q.Out;
            a = !HelperMain.IsAdministrator()
                ? new SniffAnswer { Ok = false, Error = "reading the ACPI tables needs administrator rights (the app starts the scan with them)" }
                : SniffHelper.RunAsync(q, EngineLayout.Beside(AppContext.BaseDirectory), new SystemProcessRunner()).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            a = new SniffAnswer { Ok = false, Error = e.Message };
            int i = Array.IndexOf(args, "--out");
            if (i >= 0 && i + 1 < args.Length) output = args[i + 1];
        }
        try
        {
            if (output is null) Console.Out.Write(a.ToJson());
            else HelperMain.Answer(output, a.ToJson());
        }
        catch (Exception) { return 3; }
        return a.Ok ? 0 : 1;
    }
}

/// The app's side of the scan: the helper through "runas" (the UAC prompt), its answer from a file of the app's.
static class SniffRunner
{
    public static async Task<SniffAnswer> RunElevatedAsync(SniffRequest q, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        var dir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "IntelXe Manager", "helper");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
        var output = Path.Combine(dir, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".json");
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo(Environment.ProcessPath ?? Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "IntelXeManager.exe"),
            CommandLine.Join((q with { Out = output }).ToArgs()))
        {
            UseShellExecute = true, Verb = "runas", WorkingDirectory = AppContext.BaseDirectory, WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Hidden,
        };
        try
        {
            Process p;
            try { p = Process.Start(psi) ?? throw new EfiBuildException("the helper did not start"); }
            catch (Win32Exception e) when (e.NativeErrorCode == 1223) { throw new EfiBuildException(L.Get("Build_Elevation_Cancelled")); }
            using (p) await p.WaitForExitAsync(cancel);
            if (!File.Exists(output)) throw new EfiBuildException(L.Get("Build_Helper_NoAnswer"));
            return SniffAnswer.FromJson(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(output, cancel));
        }
        finally
        {
            try { File.Delete(output); } catch (Exception) { }
        }
    }
}

/// What the Build page shows and the Set up page reads; it outlives the pages (navigating away keeps a build running).
sealed class BuildSession
{
    public static BuildSession Current { get; } = new();

    public static string DataRoot => Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "IntelXe Manager", "efibuild");

    public IEfiBuilder Builder { get; } = new PythonEfiBuilder(EngineLayout.Beside(AppContext.BaseDirectory), new SystemProcessRunner(), SniffRunner.RunElevatedAsync);
    public EfiBuildStore Store { get; } = new(DataRoot);

    public HardwareScan? Scan { get; private set; }
    public string? ScanError { get; private set; }
    public bool Scanning { get; private set; }

    public string MacOS { get; set; } = "26";

    public bool Building { get; private set; }
    public List<string> Progress { get; } = [];
    public EfiBuildResult? Result { get; private set; }
    /// the app's own engine on the built EFI: the stage-2 lines it would still change (empty: it agrees)
    public IReadOnlyList<string>? Stage2Left { get; private set; }
    public IReadOnlyList<(string Key, string Value)> Platform { get; private set; } = [];
    public string? Saved { get; set; }
    public string? SaveError { get; set; }
    CancellationTokenSource? cancel;
    bool loaded;

    public event Action? Changed;
    void Notify() => Changed?.Invoke();

    static SetupProgress Setup => Settings.Current.Setup;

    /// The last scan and build of an earlier session, from settings.json, when their folders are still there.
    public void Load()
    {
        if (loaded) return;
        loaded = true;
        var s = Setup;
        if (s.LastScan.Length > 0 && File.Exists(Path.Combine(s.LastScan, "Report.json")) && Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(s.LastScan, "ACPI")))
            Scan = new HardwareScan(Path.Combine(s.LastScan, "Report.json"), Path.Combine(s.LastScan, "ACPI"),
                [.. Directory.EnumerateFiles(Path.Combine(s.LastScan, "ACPI")).Select(f => Path.GetFileName(f)!).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal)]);
        if (BuiltOutDir() is { } outDir && File.Exists(EfiBuildCommand.ResultPath(outDir)))
        {
            try
            {
                var efi = EfiBuildStore.EfiOf(outDir);
                var secrets = SmbiosMask.ReadSecrets(Path.Combine(efi, "OC", "config.plist"));
                Result = EfiBuildResultParser.Parse(File.ReadAllText(EfiBuildCommand.ResultPath(outDir)), t => SmbiosMask.Redact(t, secrets),
                    EfiBuildCommand.LogPath(outDir), EfiBuildCommand.ResultPath(outDir), efi);
                Platform = SmbiosMask.PlatformSummary(Path.Combine(efi, "OC", "config.plist"));
                MacOS = s.EfiMacOS.Length > 0 ? s.EfiMacOS : MacOS;
            }
            catch (Exception) { Result = null; }
        }
    }

    /// The output folder of the last successful build when its EFI is still there.
    public static string? BuiltOutDir()
    {
        var dir = Setup.EfiOutDir;
        if (dir.Length == 0) return null;
        try { EfiBuildStore.EfiOf(dir); return dir; }
        catch (Exception) { return null; }
    }

    /// Its EFI folder (holding BOOT and OC), or null.
    public static string? BuiltEfiDir()
    {
        try { return BuiltOutDir() is { } d ? EfiBuildStore.EfiOf(d) : null; }
        catch (Exception) { return null; }
    }

    public async Task ScanAsync()
    {
        if (Scanning || Building) return;
        Scanning = true;
        ScanError = null;
        Notify();
        try
        {
            var dir = Store.NewScanDir(DateTime.Now);
            var progress = new Progress<string>(_ => { });
            Scan = await Builder.ScanAsync(dir, progress, CancellationToken.None);
            // the earlier scans are not needed any more (each holds this PC's report and tables)
            foreach (var old in Directory.EnumerateDirectories(Store.ScansDir).Where(d => !string.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(d), Path.GetFullPath(dir), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(old, "Report.json")) || Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(old, "ACPI")))
                    try { Directory.Delete(old, true); } catch (Exception) { }
            Setup.LastScan = dir;
            Settings.Current.Save();
        }
        catch (Exception e) { ScanError = e.Message; }
        finally
        {
            Scanning = false;
            Notify();
        }
    }

    public async Task BuildAsync()
    {
        if (Building || Scanning || Scan is null) return;
        Building = true;
        Result = null;
        Stage2Left = null;
        Platform = [];
        Saved = null;
        SaveError = null;
        lock (Progress) Progress.Clear();
        cancel = new CancellationTokenSource();
        Notify();
        var outDir = Store.NewBuildDir(DateTime.Now);
        try
        {
            // reported on this (UI) thread
            var progress = new Progress<string>(line => { lock (Progress) { Progress.Add(line); if (Progress.Count > 200) Progress.RemoveAt(0); } Notify(); });
            var r = await Builder.BuildAsync(new EfiBuildRequest(Scan.ReportPath, Scan.AcpiDir, outDir, MacOS), progress, cancel.Token);
            Result = r;
            if (r.Ok && r.EfiDir.Length > 0)
            {
                var config = Path.Combine(r.EfiDir, "OC", "config.plist");
                Platform = SmbiosMask.PlatformSummary(config);
                try { Stage2Left = await Task.Run(() => EfiBuildStore.Stage2Left(r.EfiDir, safari: true)); }
                catch (Exception e) { Stage2Left = [e.Message]; }
                Settings.Current.Setup = SetupWizard.RecordEfi(Setup, outDir, MacOS, DateTime.Now);
                Settings.Current.Save();
                Store.PruneBuilds(outDir);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { Result = EfiBuildResult.Failed(L.Get("Build_Cancelled")); }
        catch (Exception e) { Result = EfiBuildResult.Failed(e.Message); }
        finally
        {
            Building = false;
            cancel?.Dispose();
            cancel = null;
            Notify();
        }
    }

    public void CancelBuild() => cancel?.Cancel();

    /// The stick page wrote a stick with this EFI folder: the setup's stick step is done when it is the built EFI.
    public static void RecordStick(string? efiWritten)
    {
        if (BuiltEfiDir() is not { } built) return;
        var next = SetupWizard.RecordStick(Setup, efiWritten, built);
        if (ReferenceEquals(next, Setup)) return;
        Settings.Current.Setup = next;
        Settings.Current.Save();
    }

    /// The wizard's inputs from what the app knows now.
    public SetupInputs SetupInputs()
    {
        var state = AppState.Current;
        return new SetupInputs(state.Facts is not null, SetupWizard.Blocking(state.Facts, state.Checks), Builder.IsAvailable,
            Builder.IsAvailable ? Text.Empty : Text.Of("Setup_Blocked_NoBuilder"), BuiltOutDir() is not null);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The Windows side of the EFI changes: the elevated helper's process (HelperMain, MountvolMounter), the planner the EFI
// page uses (WindowsEfiPlanner: an EFI folder in this process, an EFI partition through the helper started with
// "runas"), and the package the files come from.
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Management;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security.Principal;
using System.Text;
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXeEfi;

namespace IntelXe.App;

/// "IntelXeManager.exe --efi-helper status|plan|apply ...": parses the request, refuses a partition without
/// administrator rights, runs it (EfiHelper.Run with mountvol) and writes the answer to --out (or to the standard output).
static class HelperMain
{
    public static int Run(string[] args)
    {
        EfiHelperResult r;
        string? output = null;
        try
        {
            var q = EfiHelperRequest.Parse(args);
            output = q.Out;
            r = q.Target is EfiTarget.Partition && !IsAdministrator()
                ? new EfiHelperResult { Ok = false, Error = "mounting an EFI partition needs administrator rights (the app starts the helper with them)" }
                : EfiHelper.Run(q, new MountvolMounter());
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            r = new EfiHelperResult { Ok = false, Error = EfiHelper.Message(e) };
            int i = Array.IndexOf(args, "--out");
            if (i >= 0 && i + 1 < args.Length) output = args[i + 1];
        }
        try
        {
            if (output is null) Console.Out.Write(r.ToJson());
            else Answer(output, r.ToJson());
        }
        catch (Exception) { return 3; }
        return r.Ok ? 0 : 1;
    }

    /// The answer, as a new file (never over an existing one) in a folder that is not a link elsewhere: the folder is
    /// the user's, and this process may have administrator rights.
    internal static void Answer(string path, string json)
    {
        using var f = NewFile(path);
        var bytes = new UTF8Encoding(false).GetBytes(json);
        f.Write(bytes);
    }

    /// A new file (never an existing one) in a folder that is not a link elsewhere, readable by the app while open.
    internal static FileStream NewFile(string path)
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(path))!);
        for (var d = dir; d is not null; d = d.Parent)
            if (d.Exists && (d.Attributes & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0) throw new IOException(d.FullName + " is a link");
        return new FileStream(path, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.Read | FileShare.Delete);
    }

    public static bool IsAdministrator()
    {
        using var id = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent();
        return new WindowsPrincipal(id).IsInRole(WindowsBuiltInRole.Administrator);
    }
}

/// Mounting an EFI system partition as IntelXe-EFI.ps1's Mount-Esp and Dismount-Esp do: found by disk and partition
/// number (MSFT_Partition), refused unless its GPT type is the EFI system partition's, mounted with mountvol at a free
/// letter (S:, T:, ... as Get-FreeLetter picks them) or at the letter asked for; unmounted with mountvol /D only when the
/// letter still holds the volume this mounted. A partition that already has a letter is used there and left mounted.
sealed class MountvolMounter : IEspMounter
{
    static readonly string[] Letters = ["S", "T", "U", "V", "W", "X", "Y", "Z", "R", "Q", "P", "O", "N", "M"];
    string volume = "";

    public MountedEsp Mount(uint disk, uint partition, string? letter)
    {
        using var searcher = new ManagementObjectSearcher(new ManagementScope(@"root\Microsoft\Windows\Storage"),
            new ObjectQuery($"SELECT DiskNumber, PartitionNumber, GptType, DriveLetter, AccessPaths FROM MSFT_Partition WHERE DiskNumber = {disk} AND PartitionNumber = {partition}"));
        ManagementBaseObject? p = null;
        foreach (var o in searcher.Get()) { p = o; break; }
        if (p is null) throw new EfiException($"no partition {partition} on disk {disk}");
        if (!EspPartition.IsEspType(p["GptType"]?.ToString())) throw new EfiException($"disk {disk} partition {partition} is not an EFI system partition: not mounted");
        var paths = p["AccessPaths"] as string[] ?? [];
        volume = paths.FirstOrDefault(a => a.StartsWith(@"\\?\Volume{", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ?? "";
        if (p["DriveLetter"] is char c && c != '\0') return new MountedEsp($"{char.ToUpperInvariant(c)}:", $"{char.ToUpperInvariant(c)}:\\", false);
        if (volume.Length == 0) throw new EfiException($"disk {disk} partition {partition} has no volume path to mount");

        var used = Environment.GetLogicalDrives().Select(d => d[..1].ToUpperInvariant()).ToHashSet();
        string? at = letter is not null && !used.Contains(letter[..1].ToUpperInvariant()) ? letter[..1].ToUpperInvariant() : Letters.FirstOrDefault(l => !used.Contains(l));
        if (at is null) throw new EfiException("no free drive letter between M: and Z:");
        Mountvol($"{at}:", volume);
        if (!string.Equals(VolumeAt($"{at}:\\"), volume, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new EfiException($"mountvol did not mount the EFI partition at {at}:");
        return new MountedEsp($"{at}:", $"{at}:\\", true);
    }

    public void Unmount(MountedEsp esp)
    {
        if (!esp.MountedHere) return;
        if (!string.Equals(VolumeAt(esp.Letter + "\\"), volume, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new EfiException($"{esp.Letter} no longer holds the EFI partition this mounted: unmount it yourself with mountvol {esp.Letter} /D");
        Mountvol(esp.Letter, "/D");
    }

    static void Mountvol(string letter, string what)
    {
        var exe = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.System), "mountvol.exe");
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo(exe) { UseShellExecute = false, CreateNoWindow = true, RedirectStandardOutput = true, RedirectStandardError = true };
        psi.ArgumentList.Add(letter);
        psi.ArgumentList.Add(what);
        using var p = Process.Start(psi) ?? throw new EfiException("mountvol did not start");
        var text = p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd() + p.StandardError.ReadToEnd();
        if (!p.WaitForExit(30_000)) { try { p.Kill(); } catch (Exception) { } throw new EfiException("mountvol did not finish"); }
        if (p.ExitCode != 0) throw new EfiException("mountvol failed: " + text.Trim());
    }

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    static extern bool GetVolumeNameForVolumeMountPointW(string mountPoint, StringBuilder name, int size);

    static string VolumeAt(string root)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder(64);
        return GetVolumeNameForVolumeMountPointW(root, sb, sb.Capacity) ? sb.ToString() : "";
    }
}

/// The EFI page's planner: an EFI folder in this process (FolderEfiPlanner, the user's rights), an EFI partition through
/// the elevated helper, which Windows asks permission for each time (for a plan, for a change). --helper-for-folders
/// sends folders through the helper too (to test that path without an EFI partition).
sealed class WindowsEfiPlanner(bool helperForFolders) : IEfiPlanner
{
    readonly FolderEfiPlanner local = new();

    public bool IsAvailable => true;
    public string RulesVersion => local.RulesVersion;

    bool Local(EfiTarget t) => t is EfiTarget.Folder && !helperForFolders;

    public async Task<EfiStatus> ReadStatusAsync(EfiTarget target, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default) =>
        Local(target) ? await local.ReadStatusAsync(target, options, cancel)
            : (await Elevated(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Status, target, EfiChange.Settings, options), cancel)).ToStatus();

    public async Task<EfiPlan> PlanAsync(EfiTarget target, EfiChange change, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default) =>
        Local(target) ? await local.PlanAsync(target, change, options, cancel)
            : (await Elevated(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Plan, target, change, options), cancel)).ToPlan(target);

    public async Task<EfiResult> ApplyAsync(EfiPlan plan, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        if (Local(plan.Target)) return await local.ApplyAsync(plan, options, cancel);
        var r = await Elevated(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Apply, plan.Target, plan.Change, options, plan.Letter, plan.Hash), cancel);
        return new EfiResult([.. r.Lines ?? [], .. r.Warning is null ? Array.Empty<string>() : ["warning  " + r.Warning]]);
    }

    /// The same exe with --efi-helper, through "runas" (the UAC prompt); its answer comes back in a file of the app's.
    static async Task<EfiHelperResult> Elevated(EfiHelperRequest q, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        var dir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "IntelXe Manager", "helper");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
        var output = Path.Combine(dir, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".json");
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo(Environment.ProcessPath ?? Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "IntelXeManager.exe"),
            CommandLine.Join((q with { Out = output }).ToArgs()))
        {
            UseShellExecute = true, Verb = "runas", WorkingDirectory = AppContext.BaseDirectory, WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Hidden,
        };
        try
        {
            Process p;
            try { p = Process.Start(psi) ?? throw new EfiException("the helper did not start"); }
            catch (Win32Exception e) when (e.NativeErrorCode == 1223) { throw new EfiUnavailableException(L.Get("Efi_Elevation_Cancelled")); }
            using (p) await p.WaitForExitAsync(cancel);
            if (!File.Exists(output)) throw new EfiException(L.Get("Efi_Helper_NoAnswer"));
            var r = EfiHelperResult.FromJson(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(output, cancel));
            if (!r.Ok) throw new EfiException(r.Error ?? "the helper failed");
            return r;
        }
        finally
        {
            try { File.Delete(output); } catch (Exception) { }
        }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// What both erase dialogs (the installer stick and the probe stick) add to the typed name and size: a stick that holds an
// EFI (StickRules.HoldsEfi: an EFI system partition, or a volume with OpenCore or another EFI boot loader, such as the
// recovery stick that starts a PC) gets a warning of its own and a box the user must tick, and the helper is told it was
// ticked (--erase-efi; without it the helper refuses the disk). A probe stick gets a note that its reports go with it.
using IntelXe.Core.Stick;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;

namespace IntelXe.App;

static class EraseWarnings
{
    /// Adds the EFI warning and its box to the dialog's panel; the box, or null when the disk holds no EFI.
    public static CheckBox? AddEfi(Panel p, StickDisk disk, Action changed)
    {
        if (!StickRules.HoldsEfi(disk)) return null;
        p.Children.Add(new InfoBar
        {
            Severity = InfoBarSeverity.Error, IsOpen = true, IsClosable = false,
            Title = L.Get("Erase_Efi_Title"), Message = L.Get("Erase_Efi_Detail"),
        });
        var box = new CheckBox { Content = L.Get("Erase_Efi_Confirm"), IsChecked = false };
        box.Checked += (_, _) => changed();
        box.Unchecked += (_, _) => changed();
        p.Children.Add(box);
        return box;
    }

    /// Adds the note that a probe stick's reports are erased with it.
    public static void AddProbe(Panel p, StickDisk disk)
    {
        if (!StickRules.IsProbeStick(disk)) return;
        p.Children.Add(new InfoBar
        {
            Severity = InfoBarSeverity.Warning, IsOpen = true, IsClosable = false,
            Title = L.Get("Erase_Probe_Title"), Message = L.Get("Erase_Probe_Detail"),
        });
    }

    /// Whether the EFI box (if any) is ticked.
    public static bool Confirmed(CheckBox? efi) => efi is null || efi.IsChecked == true;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Globalization;
using IntelXe.Core;
using Microsoft.Windows.ApplicationModel.Resources;

namespace IntelXe.App;

/// The app's strings, from Strings/<language>/Resources.resw (resources.pri beside the exe), in the language chosen on
/// the About page: English or Turkish, or the one of Windows. The Turkish texts are the macOS app's wherever the same
/// text appears there (app/Resources/tr.lproj).
public static class L
{
    static readonly ResourceManager? manager;
    static readonly ResourceMap? map;
    static ResourceContext? context;

    public static string Language { get; private set; } = "en-US";

    static L()
    {
        try
        {
            manager = new ResourceManager();
            map = manager.MainResourceMap.GetSubtree("Resources");
        }
        catch (Exception) { manager = null; map = null; }
    }

    /// "en-US", "tr-TR", or null / "" for the language of Windows (Turkish when Windows prefers it, else English).
    public static void SetLanguage(string? language)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(language))
            language = CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture.TwoLetterISOLanguageName == "tr" ? "tr-TR" : "en-US";
        Language = language == "tr-TR" ? "tr-TR" : "en-US";
        var culture = new CultureInfo(Language);
        CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = culture;
        CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture = culture;
        if (manager is null) return;
        context = manager.CreateResourceContext();
        context.QualifierValues["Language"] = Language;
    }

    public static string Get(string key)
    {
        try
        {
            var value = (context is null ? map?.GetValue(key) : map?.GetValue(key, context))?.ValueAsString;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) return value;
        }
        catch (Exception) { }
        return key;
    }

    public static string Format(string key, params object[] args) =>
        string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, Get(key), args.Select(a => a is Text t ? Resolve(t) : a).ToArray());

    /// A Core text in the language shown.
    public static string Resolve(Text text) =>
        text.Key is null ? text.Verbatim ?? "" : text.Args.Length == 0 ? Get(text.Key) : Format(text.Key, text.Args);
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace IntelXe.App;

/// The few Windows functions the app calls directly; all of them only read.
static partial class Native
{
    [LibraryImport("user32.dll")]
    internal static partial uint GetDpiForWindow(IntPtr hwnd);

    /// FIRMWARE_TYPE: 1 BIOS (legacy), 2 UEFI.
    [LibraryImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    internal static partial bool GetFirmwareType(out int firmwareType);

    [LibraryImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    internal static partial bool GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx(int relationship, IntPtr buffer, ref uint length);

    [LibraryImport("advapi32.dll", StringMarshalling = StringMarshalling.Utf16)]
    private static partial int RegGetValueW(IntPtr key, string subKey, string value, uint flags, out uint type, byte[]? data, ref uint size);

    static readonly IntPtr LocalMachine = new(unchecked((int)0x80000002));
    const uint AnyType = 0x0000ffff;   // RRF_RT_ANY

    /// A value of HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE as raw bytes, whatever its type: .NET's RegistryKey.GetValue does not return
    /// REG_RESOURCE_LIST (the card's AllocConfig). Null when it is not there or cannot be read.
    internal static byte[]? ReadMachineValue(string subKey, string value)
    {
        uint size = 0;
        if (RegGetValueW(LocalMachine, subKey, value, AnyType, out _, null, ref size) != 0 || size == 0) return null;
        var data = new byte[size];
        if (RegGetValueW(LocalMachine, subKey, value, AnyType, out _, data, ref size) != 0) return null;
        return size == data.Length ? data : data[..(int)size];
    }

    const int RelationProcessorCore = 0;

    /// Cores by efficiency class (PROCESSOR_RELATIONSHIP.EfficiencyClass): on a hybrid CPU the P-cores have the higher
    /// class. (performance, efficiency); null when Windows does not tell.
    internal static (int Performance, int Efficiency)? CoreClasses()
    {
        uint length = 0;
        GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx(RelationProcessorCore, IntPtr.Zero, ref length);
        if (length == 0) return null;
        var buffer = Marshal.AllocHGlobal((int)length);
        try
        {
            if (!GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx(RelationProcessorCore, buffer, ref length)) return null;
            var classes = new List<byte>();
            for (uint offset = 0; offset < length;)
            {
                var item = buffer + (int)offset;
                int relationship = Marshal.ReadInt32(item);
                int size = Marshal.ReadInt32(item, 4);
                if (size <= 0) break;
                if (relationship == RelationProcessorCore) classes.Add(Marshal.ReadByte(item, 9));   // Flags at 8, EfficiencyClass at 9
                offset += (uint)size;
            }
            if (classes.Count == 0) return null;
            byte top = classes.Max();
            int performance = classes.Count(c => c == top);
            return (performance, classes.Count - performance);
        }
        finally { Marshal.FreeHGlobal(buffer); }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The Windows side of the Xe probe stick: the disk opened raw (PhysicalDisk: every volume on it locked and dismounted with
// FSCTL_LOCK_VOLUME and FSCTL_DISMOUNT_VOLUME, then \\.\PhysicalDriveN with FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING |
// FILE_FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH, written and read in sector-aligned buffers, IOCTL_DISK_UPDATE_PROPERTIES after the flush), the
// helper's process ("IntelXeManager.exe --probe-helper ...", ProbeHelperMain) started elevated through StickRunner as the
// installer stick's is, and the probe sticks among the drives (ProbeSticks). The disks are read by WmiStickSystem, the
// same code (and rules, StickRules) as the installer stick page.
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Management;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
using IntelXe.Core.ProbeStick;
using IntelXe.Core.Stick;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

namespace IntelXe.App;

/// The disks (WmiStickSystem) and one opened raw for the probe writer.
sealed class WindowsProbeSystem : IProbeSystem
{
    readonly WmiStickSystem wmi = new();
    public IReadOnlyList<StickDisk> ListDisks() => wmi.ListDisks();
    public StickDisk? Inspect(uint number) => wmi.Inspect(number);

    public IRawDisk Open(StickDisk disk)
    {
        // the disk about to be opened is the one the writer checked (serial and size, compared as a salted hash)
        var salt = StickIdentity.NewSalt();
        if (wmi.Inspect(disk.Number) is not { } now || now.Token(salt) != disk.Token(salt))
            throw new ProbeException($"disk {disk.Number} changed: nothing written");
        return PhysicalDisk.Open(disk.Number, VolumesOf(disk.Number));
    }

    /// The volume paths (\\?\Volume{GUID}\) of the disk's partitions.
    static List<string> VolumesOf(uint disk)
    {
        var list = new List<string>();
        using var s = new ManagementObjectSearcher(new ManagementScope(@"root\Microsoft\Windows\Storage"),
            new ObjectQuery($"SELECT AccessPaths FROM MSFT_Partition WHERE DiskNumber = {disk}"));
        foreach (var p in s.Get().Cast<ManagementObject>())
            foreach (var a in p["AccessPaths"] as string[] ?? [])
                if (a.StartsWith(@"\\?\Volume{", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && !list.Contains(a, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) list.Add(a);
        return list;
    }
}

/// \\.\PhysicalDriveN for raw writing, with its volumes locked and dismounted until it is disposed.
sealed partial class PhysicalDisk : IRawDisk
{
    const uint GenericRead = 0x80000000, GenericWrite = 0x40000000, ShareRead = 1, ShareWrite = 2, OpenExisting = 3;
    const uint NoBuffering = 0x20000000, WriteThrough = 0x80000000;
    const uint FsctlLockVolume = 0x00090018, FsctlDismountVolume = 0x00090020, FsctlUnlockVolume = 0x0009001C;
    const uint IoctlDiskGetDriveGeometryEx = 0x000700A0, IoctlDiskUpdateProperties = 0x00070140;
    const int Alignment = 4096;

    [LibraryImport("kernel32.dll", EntryPoint = "CreateFileW", SetLastError = true, StringMarshalling = StringMarshalling.Utf16)]
    private static partial SafeFileHandle CreateFile(string name, uint access, uint share, IntPtr security, uint disposition, uint flags, IntPtr template);

    [LibraryImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static unsafe partial bool DeviceIoControl(SafeFileHandle h, uint code, void* input, uint inputSize, void* output, uint outputSize, out uint returned, IntPtr overlapped);

    [LibraryImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static partial bool SetFilePointerEx(SafeFileHandle h, long distance, out long newPointer, uint method);

    [LibraryImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static unsafe partial bool WriteFile(SafeFileHandle h, byte* buffer, uint count, out uint written, IntPtr overlapped);

    [LibraryImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static unsafe partial bool ReadFile(SafeFileHandle h, byte* buffer, uint count, out uint read, IntPtr overlapped);

    [LibraryImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static partial bool FlushFileBuffers(SafeFileHandle h);

    readonly SafeFileHandle disk;
    readonly List<SafeFileHandle> volumes;
    readonly unsafe byte* buffer;
    readonly int bufferSize = ProbeWriter.Block;
    bool disposed;

    public long Length { get; }
    public int SectorSize { get; }

    unsafe PhysicalDisk(SafeFileHandle disk, List<SafeFileHandle> volumes, long length, int sector)
    {
        this.disk = disk;
        this.volumes = volumes;
        Length = length;
        SectorSize = sector;
        buffer = (byte*)NativeMemory.AlignedAlloc((nuint)bufferSize, Alignment);
    }

    static Exception Error(string what) => new ProbeException($"{what}: {new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error()).Message}");

    public static unsafe PhysicalDisk Open(uint number, IReadOnlyList<string> volumePaths)
    {
        var locked = new List<SafeFileHandle>();
        try
        {
            foreach (var path in volumePaths)
            {
                var v = CreateFile(@"\\.\" + path.TrimEnd('\\')[4..], GenericRead | GenericWrite, ShareRead | ShareWrite, IntPtr.Zero, OpenExisting, 0, IntPtr.Zero);
                if (v.IsInvalid) { v.Dispose(); continue; }   // a volume that is gone needs no lock
                bool ok = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < 10 && !ok; i++)
                {
                    ok = DeviceIoControl(v, FsctlLockVolume, null, 0, null, 0, out _, IntPtr.Zero);
                    if (!ok) Thread.Sleep(500);
                }
                if (!ok)
                {
                    v.Dispose();
                    throw new ProbeException("a program has files open on the stick (Explorer, an editor, a virus scanner); close it and write again: nothing written");
                }
                locked.Add(v);
                if (!DeviceIoControl(v, FsctlDismountVolume, null, 0, null, 0, out _, IntPtr.Zero)) throw Error("dismounting a volume of the stick failed: nothing written");
            }

            var h = CreateFile($@"\\.\PhysicalDrive{number.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}", GenericRead | GenericWrite, ShareRead | ShareWrite,
                IntPtr.Zero, OpenExisting, NoBuffering | WriteThrough, IntPtr.Zero);
            if (h.IsInvalid) { h.Dispose(); throw Error($"opening disk {number} failed: nothing written"); }
            byte* geometry = stackalloc byte[256];
            if (!DeviceIoControl(h, IoctlDiskGetDriveGeometryEx, null, 0, geometry, 256, out var got, IntPtr.Zero) || got < 32)
            {
                h.Dispose();
                throw Error($"reading disk {number}'s geometry failed: nothing written");
            }
            int sector = *(int*)(geometry + 20);   // DISK_GEOMETRY.BytesPerSector
            long size = *(long*)(geometry + 24);    // DISK_GEOMETRY_EX.DiskSize
            if (sector is not (512 or 1024 or 2048 or 4096)) { h.Dispose(); throw new ProbeException($"disk {number} reports {sector}-byte sectors: nothing written"); }
            return new PhysicalDisk(h, locked, size, sector);
        }
        catch
        {
            foreach (var v in locked) v.Dispose();
            throw;
        }
    }

    void Seek(long offset)
    {
        if (!SetFilePointerEx(disk, offset, out _, 0)) throw Error($"seeking to {offset} failed");
    }

    public unsafe void Write(long offset, ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
    {
        if (offset % SectorSize != 0 || data.Length % SectorSize != 0) throw new ProbeException($"unaligned write at {offset}");
        for (int done = 0; done < data.Length;)
        {
            int n = Math.Min(bufferSize, data.Length - done);
            data.Slice(done, n).CopyTo(new Span<byte>(buffer, n));
            Seek(offset + done);
            if (!WriteFile(disk, buffer, (uint)n, out var written, IntPtr.Zero) || written != n) throw Error($"writing at {offset + done} failed");
            done += n;
        }
    }

    public unsafe int Read(long offset, Span<byte> target)
    {
        if (offset % SectorSize != 0 || target.Length % SectorSize != 0) throw new ProbeException($"unaligned read at {offset}");
        int done = 0;
        while (done < target.Length)
        {
            int n = Math.Min(bufferSize, target.Length - done);
            Seek(offset + done);
            if (!ReadFile(disk, buffer, (uint)n, out var read, IntPtr.Zero)) throw Error($"reading at {offset + done} failed");
            if (read == 0) break;
            new Span<byte>(buffer, (int)read).CopyTo(target[done..]);
            done += (int)read;
        }
        return done;
    }

    public unsafe void Flush()
    {
        if (!FlushFileBuffers(disk)) throw Error("flushing the disk failed");
        flushed = true;
    }

    bool flushed;

    public unsafe void Dispose()
    {
        if (disposed) return;
        disposed = true;
        // Windows reads the new partition table only now, after the read-back: told at the flush (13 Nov), it mounted the
        // stick's new FAT32 volume and wrote to it (FSInfo, FAT, System Volume Information) while the writer read the
        // image back, which then differed in 13 sectors
        if (flushed) DeviceIoControl(disk, IoctlDiskUpdateProperties, null, 0, null, 0, out _, IntPtr.Zero);
        disk.Dispose();
        foreach (var v in volumes)
        {
            DeviceIoControl(v, FsctlUnlockVolume, null, 0, null, 0, out _, IntPtr.Zero);
            v.Dispose();
        }
        NativeMemory.AlignedFree(buffer);
    }
}

/// "IntelXeManager.exe --probe-helper check|write ...": the work and its answer file. Write needs administrator rights
/// (the app starts it with "runas").
static class ProbeHelperMain
{
    public static int Run(string[] args)
    {
        StickHelperResult r;
        string? output = null;
        FileStream? progressFile = null;
        try
        {
            var q = ProbeHelperRequest.Parse(args);
            output = q.Out;
            if (q.Progress is { Length: > 0 } pp) progressFile = HelperMain.NewFile(pp);
            void Progress(string stage, double f)
            {
                if (progressFile is null) return;
                try
                {
                    var b = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(stage + " " + f.ToString("0.000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                    progressFile.SetLength(0);
                    progressFile.Write(b);
                    progressFile.Flush();
                }
                catch (Exception) { }
            }
            r = q.Verb == ProbeVerb.Write && !HelperMain.IsAdministrator()
                ? new StickHelperResult { Ok = false, Error = "writing a disk needs administrator rights (the app starts the helper with them): nothing written" }
                : ProbeWriter.Run(q, new WindowsProbeSystem(), Progress, [AppContext.BaseDirectory[..2]]);
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            r = new StickHelperResult { Ok = false, Error = e.Message };
            int i = Array.IndexOf(args, "--out");
            if (i >= 0 && i + 1 < args.Length) output = args[i + 1];
        }
        finally { progressFile?.Dispose(); }
        try
        {
            if (output is null) Console.Out.Write(r.ToJson());
            else HelperMain.Answer(output, r.ToJson());
        }
        catch (Exception) { return 3; }
        return r.Ok ? 0 : 1;
    }

    /// The window's side: the helper through "runas", its progress while it works.
    public static Task<StickHelperResult> RunElevatedAsync(ProbeHelperRequest q, Action<string, double>? progress) =>
        StickRunner.RunElevatedAsync((output, progressFile) => (q with { Out = output, Progress = progressFile }).ToArgs(), progress);
}

/// The probe sticks among this PC's drives: a FAT volume labelled XEPROBE with the marker file.
static class ProbeSticks
{
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Find()
    {
        var volumes = new List<(string, string?)>();
        foreach (var d in DriveInfo.GetDrives())
        {
            try
            {
                if ((d.DriveType is DriveType.Removable or DriveType.Fixed) && d.IsReady) volumes.Add((d.RootDirectory.FullName, d.VolumeLabel));
            }
            catch (Exception) { }
        }
        return ProbeReports.FindSticks(volumes);
    }

    public static void Reveal(string file)
    {
        try { System.Diagnostics.Process.Start("explorer.exe", $"/select,\"{file}\""); } catch (Exception) { }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXe.Core.Report;

namespace IntelXe.App;

/// Runs tools/report/collect-windows.ps1 (shipped beside the app in tools\) in Windows PowerShell and collects its output.
/// The script only reads, writes one zip on the Desktop and uploads nothing; neither does the app. With boot logs it also
/// reads the EFI partitions, which only an administrator can mount: the app then starts it with "runas" (StartElevated).
public sealed class ReportRunner
{
    public bool Running { get; private set; }
    public DateTime StartedAt { get; private set; }
    public StringBuilder Output { get; } = new();
    public event Action? OutputChanged;
    public event Action<ReportResult?, string?>? Finished;

    /// The script beside the app (tools\collect-windows.ps1), or, when the app runs from a build in the repository, the
    /// repository's tools\report\collect-windows.ps1.
    public static string? FindScript()
    {
        var beside = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "tools", "collect-windows.ps1");
        if (File.Exists(beside)) return beside;
        for (var d = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory); d is not null; d = d.Parent)
        {
            var inRepo = Path.Combine(d.FullName, "tools", "report", "collect-windows.ps1");
            if (File.Exists(inRepo)) return inRepo;
        }
        return null;
    }

    static string PowerShell =>
        Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.System), "WindowsPowerShell", "v1.0", "powershell.exe");

    public static string Desktop => Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.DesktopDirectory);

    /// The Desktop, as on macOS, unless --report-out names another folder.
    public static string OutputFolder => App.Options.ReportOut is { Length: > 0 } d && Directory.Exists(d) ? Path.GetFullPath(d) : Desktop;

    public void Start(bool acpi, bool bootLogs = false)
    {
        if (Running) return;
        var script = FindScript();
        Output.Clear();
        if (script is null)
        {
            Finished?.Invoke(null, L.Get("Report_NoScript"));
            return;
        }
        if (bootLogs && !HelperMain.IsAdministrator())
        {
            StartElevated(script, acpi);
            return;
        }
        var info = new ProcessStartInfo(PowerShell)
        {
            UseShellExecute = false,
            CreateNoWindow = true,
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true,
            WorkingDirectory = OutputFolder,
            // Windows PowerShell writes in the console's OEM code page
            StandardOutputEncoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.OEMCodePage),
            StandardErrorEncoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.OEMCodePage),
        };
        foreach (var a in ReportRun.PowerShellArguments(script, OutputFolder, acpi, bootLogs)) info.ArgumentList.Add(a);
        var process = new Process { StartInfo = info, EnableRaisingEvents = true };
        void Add(string? line)
        {
            if (line is null) return;
            lock (Output) Output.AppendLine(line);
            OutputChanged?.Invoke();
        }
        process.OutputDataReceived += (_, e) => Add(e.Data);
        process.ErrorDataReceived += (_, e) => Add(e.Data);
        process.Exited += (_, _) =>
        {
            process.WaitForExit();   // the last lines of the redirected output
            Running = false;
            string text;
            lock (Output) text = Output.ToString();
            var result = ReportRun.Parse(text.Split('\n'));
            Finished?.Invoke(result, result is null ? L.Get("Report_NoneWritten") : null);
            process.Dispose();
        };
        try
        {
            Running = true;
            StartedAt = DateTime.Now;
            process.Start();
            process.BeginOutputReadLine();
            process.BeginErrorReadLine();
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Running = false;
            Finished?.Invoke(null, e.Message);
        }
    }

    /// The report with -BootLogs as administrator: Windows PowerShell through "runas" (the UAC prompt), its output written
    /// to a file of the app's (ReportRun.ElevatedArguments) and shown when the run has ended; nothing comes while it runs.
    void StartElevated(string script, bool acpi)
    {
        var dir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "IntelXe Manager", "report");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
        var log = Path.Combine(dir, Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".txt");
        var info = new ProcessStartInfo(PowerShell, CommandLine.Join(ReportRun.ElevatedArguments(script, OutputFolder, acpi, bootLogs: true, log)))
        {
            UseShellExecute = true, Verb = "runas", WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Hidden, WorkingDirectory = OutputFolder,
        };
        Running = true;
        StartedAt = DateTime.Now;
        lock (Output) Output.AppendLine(L.Get("Report_Elevated_Running"));
        OutputChanged?.Invoke();
        _ = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            string? error = null;
            try
            {
                using var p = Process.Start(info) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("PowerShell did not start");
                await p.WaitForExitAsync();
            }
            catch (Win32Exception e) when (e.NativeErrorCode == 1223) { error = L.Get("Report_Elevation_Cancelled"); }
            catch (Exception e) { error = e.Message; }
            var text = "";
            try { if (File.Exists(log)) text = File.ReadAllText(log); } catch (Exception) { }
            try { File.Delete(log); } catch (Exception) { }
            lock (Output) { Output.Clear(); Output.Append(text); }
            Running = false;
            OutputChanged?.Invoke();
            var result = error is null ? ReportRun.Parse(text.Split('\n')) : null;
            Finished?.Invoke(result, error ?? (result is null ? L.Get("Report_NoneWritten") : null));
        });
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Text.Json;

namespace IntelXe.App;

/// The app's own choices, kept in %LOCALAPPDATA%\IntelXe Manager\settings.json (nothing in the registry).
public sealed class Settings
{
    /// "" for the language of Windows, "en-US" or "tr-TR"
    public string Language { get; set; } = "";
    /// "" for the system's, "light" or "dark"
    public string Theme { get; set; } = "";
    /// the package the EFI page took its files from last (a folder or an -efi.zip); "" for none
    public string Package { get; set; } = "";
    /// the Set up page's progress (IntelXe.Core.Setup.SetupWizard) and the Build page's last scan and build
    public IntelXe.Core.Setup.SetupProgress Setup { get; set; } = new();

    static readonly string File = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "IntelXe Manager", "settings.json");

    public static Settings Current { get; } = Load();

    static Settings Load()
    {
        try { return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Settings>(System.IO.File.ReadAllText(File)) ?? new Settings(); }
        catch (Exception) { return new Settings(); }
    }

    public void Save()
    {
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(File)!);
            System.IO.File.WriteAllText(File, JsonSerializer.Serialize(this));
        }
        catch (Exception) { }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The Windows side of the installer stick: reading the disks (WmiStickSystem, Windows' storage API through WMI:
// MSFT_Disk, MSFT_Partition, Win32_DiskDrive), erasing the chosen one into one FAT32 partition, the helper's process
// ("IntelXeManager.exe --stick-helper ...", StickHelperMain) and starting it elevated with "runas" (StickRunner), as the
// EFI page does with --efi-helper. Reading needs no rights; only "write" needs administrator rights, and only the
// helper has them. Serial numbers are read into StickDisk.IdentitySource for the identity hash and go nowhere else.
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Management;
using System.Text;
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Stick;

namespace IntelXe.App;

sealed class WmiStickSystem : IStickSystem
{
    const string Storage = @"root\Microsoft\Windows\Storage";
    static readonly System.Management.EnumerationOptions Limits = new() { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20), ReturnImmediately = false };

    static List<ManagementObject> Query(string scope, string wql)
    {
        using var s = new ManagementObjectSearcher(new ManagementScope(scope), new ObjectQuery(wql), Limits);
        return s.Get().Cast<ManagementObject>().ToList();
    }

    static string Str(object? v) => v?.ToString()?.Trim() ?? "";

    public IReadOnlyList<StickDisk> ListDisks() =>
        Query(Storage, "SELECT * FROM MSFT_Disk").Select(ToDisk).OrderBy(d => d.Number).ToList();

    public StickDisk? Inspect(uint number) =>
        Query(Storage, $"SELECT * FROM MSFT_Disk WHERE Number = {number}").Select(ToDisk).FirstOrDefault();

    static StickDisk ToDisk(ManagementObject o)
    {
        uint n = Convert.ToUInt32(o["Number"], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        var serial = Str(o["SerialNumber"]);
        if (serial.Length == 0) serial = Str(o["UniqueId"]);
        return new StickDisk
        {
            Number = n,
            FriendlyName = Str(o["FriendlyName"]),
            Size = Convert.ToUInt64(o["Size"] ?? 0UL, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            BusType = Convert.ToInt32(o["BusType"] ?? 0, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            IsBoot = o["IsBoot"] is true,
            IsSystem = o["IsSystem"] is true,
            IsReadOnly = o["IsReadOnly"] is true,
            IsOffline = o["IsOffline"] is true,
            Removable = Removable(n),
            VirtualFile = Convert.ToInt32(o["BusType"] ?? 0, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) == StickRules.FileBackedVirtualBus ? Str(o["Location"]) : "",
            PartitionStyle = Convert.ToInt32(o["PartitionStyle"] ?? 0, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) switch { 1 => "MBR", 2 => "GPT", _ => "RAW" },
            Partitions = Partitions(n),
            IdentitySource = serial,
        };
    }

    /// Win32_DiskDrive (Index = disk number): "Removable Media", or capability 7 (supports removable media).
    static bool? Removable(uint n)
    {
        try
        {
            foreach (var d in Query(@"root\CIMV2", $"SELECT MediaType, Capabilities FROM Win32_DiskDrive WHERE Index = {n}"))
                return Str(d["MediaType"]).Contains("Removable", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                       || (d["Capabilities"] as ushort[] ?? []).Contains((ushort)7);
        }
        catch (Exception) { }
        return null;
    }

    /// The disk's partitions: their types, letters, and whether one holds Windows, an EFI boot loader (OpenCore or
    /// EFI\BOOT\BOOTx64.efi) or the probe stick (looked at through its letter or volume path; an EFI system partition is
    /// never opened, it counts as an EFI by its type; nothing is mounted).
    static List<StickPartition> Partitions(uint disk)
    {
        var list = new List<StickPartition>();
        foreach (var p in Query(Storage, $"SELECT PartitionNumber, GptType, MbrType, DriveLetter, AccessPaths FROM MSFT_Partition WHERE DiskNumber = {disk}"))
        {
            var gpt = Str(p["GptType"]);
            int mbr = p["MbrType"] is null ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(p["MbrType"], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            string letter = p["DriveLetter"] is char c && c != '\0' ? $"{char.ToUpperInvariant(c)}:" : "";
            bool windows = false, oc = false, boot = false, probe = false;
            if (!EspPartition.IsEspType(gpt) && mbr != 0xEF)
            {
                var roots = new List<string>();
                if (letter.Length > 0) roots.Add(letter + "\\");
                roots.AddRange((p["AccessPaths"] as string[] ?? []).Where(a => a.StartsWith(@"\\?\Volume{", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));
                foreach (var root in roots)
                    try
                    {
                        windows |= File.Exists(Path.Combine(root, "Windows", "System32", "ntoskrnl.exe"));
                        probe |= File.Exists(Path.Combine(root, Core.ProbeStick.ProbeImage.Marker));
                        oc |= File.Exists(Path.Combine(root, "EFI", "OC", "OpenCore.efi"));
                        boot |= File.Exists(Path.Combine(root, "EFI", "BOOT", "BOOTx64.efi"));
                    }
                    catch (Exception) { }
            }
            // a probe stick's BOOTx64.efi is its own GRUB, not an EFI someone keeps
            list.Add(new StickPartition(Convert.ToUInt32(p["PartitionNumber"], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), gpt, mbr, letter, "", windows,
                HoldsEfi: StickRules.VolumeHoldsEfi(oc, boot, probe), ProbeStick: probe));
        }
        return list;
    }

    // ---- erasing: only through the elevated helper, after StickWriter's checks ----------------------------------------

    const string BasicData = "{ebd0a0a2-b9e5-4433-87c0-68b6b72699c7}";

    public string EraseAndFormat(StickDisk disk, ulong partitionSize, string label)
    {
        var o = Query(Storage, $"SELECT * FROM MSFT_Disk WHERE Number = {disk.Number}").FirstOrDefault()
                ?? throw new StickException($"disk {disk.Number} is gone: nothing written");
        // the object about to be cleared is the disk the writer checked (serial and size, compared as a salted hash)
        var salt = StickIdentity.NewSalt();
        if (ToDisk(o).Token(salt) != disk.Token(salt)) throw new StickException($"disk {disk.Number} changed: nothing written");

        if (Convert.ToInt32(o["PartitionStyle"] ?? 0, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) != 0)
            Call(o, "Clear", ("RemoveData", true), ("RemoveOEM", true), ("ZeroOutEntireDisk", false));
        o.Get();
        // Clear leaves some disks initialized (a USB stick that was GPT stayed GPT, empty, on 13 Nov: Initialize then
        // answers 41001 "already initialized"); a GPT disk with nothing on it needs no Initialize
        int style = Convert.ToInt32(o["PartitionStyle"] ?? 0, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        if (style == 0) Call(o, "Initialize", ("PartitionStyle", (ushort)2));   // GPT; Windows adds its 16 MB reserved partition
        else if (style != 2) throw new StickException($"disk {disk.Number} is still MBR after clearing it: nothing more written");
        o.Get();
        // what is left after the GPT and the reserved partition, in whole MiB
        ulong free = Convert.ToUInt64(o["LargestFreeExtent"] ?? 0UL, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) & ~((1UL << 20) - 1);
        ulong size = Math.Min(partitionSize, free);
        if (size < (512UL << 20)) throw new StickException($"only {StickRules.SizeText(free)} free on disk {disk.Number} after initializing it");
        var created = Call(o, "CreatePartition", ("Size", size), ("AssignDriveLetter", true), ("GptType", BasicData));
        var partition = created["CreatedPartition"] as ManagementBaseObject ?? throw new StickException("Windows made no partition");
        uint number = Convert.ToUInt32(partition["PartitionNumber"], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        var part = Query(Storage, $"SELECT * FROM MSFT_Partition WHERE DiskNumber = {disk.Number} AND PartitionNumber = {number}").First();
        var volume = part.GetRelated("MSFT_Volume").Cast<ManagementObject>().FirstOrDefault() ?? throw new StickException("the new partition has no volume");
        Call(volume, "Format", ("FileSystem", "FAT32"), ("FileSystemLabel", label), ("Full", false), ("Force", true));

        string letter = "";
        for (int i = 0; i < 20 && letter.Length == 0; i++)
        {
            part.Get();
            if (part["DriveLetter"] is char c && c != '\0') letter = $"{char.ToUpperInvariant(c)}:";
            else if (i == 0) Call(part, "AddAccessPath", ("AssignDriveLetter", true));
            else Thread.Sleep(500);
        }
        if (letter.Length == 0) throw new StickException("the new FAT32 partition got no drive letter");
        return letter + "\\";
    }

    /// Calls a Storage Management method; a ReturnValue other than 0 throws with Windows' message.
    static ManagementBaseObject Call(ManagementObject o, string method, params (string Name, object Value)[] args)
    {
        using var input = o.GetMethodParameters(method);
        foreach (var (name, value) in args) input[name] = value;
        var output = o.InvokeMethod(method, input, null);
        uint rc = Convert.ToUInt32(output?["ReturnValue"] ?? 1u, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        if (rc != 0)
        {
            string detail = "";
            if (output?["ExtendedStatus"] is ManagementBaseObject ext) detail = Str(ext["Message"]);
            throw new StickException($"{method} failed ({rc}){(detail.Length > 0 ? ": " + detail : "")}");
        }
        return output!;
    }
}

/// "IntelXeManager.exe --stick-helper list|check|write|download ...": the work and its answer file. Write needs
/// administrator rights (the app starts it with "runas"); the other verbs do not.
static class StickHelperMain
{
    public static int Run(string[] args)
    {
        StickHelperResult r;
        string? output = null;
        FileStream? progressFile = null;
        try
        {
            var q = StickHelperRequest.Parse(args);
            output = q.Out;
            if (q.Progress is { Length: > 0 } pp) progressFile = HelperMain.NewFile(pp);
            void Progress(string stage, double f)
            {
                if (progressFile is null) return;
                try
                {
                    var b = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(stage + " " + f.ToString("0.000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
                    progressFile.SetLength(0);
                    progressFile.Write(b);
                    progressFile.Flush();
                }
                catch (Exception) { }
            }
            var sys = new WmiStickSystem();
            r = q.Verb switch
            {
                StickVerb.List => StickWriter.List(sys, new StickPolicy(0, q.TestVhdx), q.Salt),
                StickVerb.Download => Download(q, Progress),
                StickVerb.Write when !HelperMain.IsAdministrator() => new StickHelperResult { Ok = false, Error = "erasing a disk needs administrator rights (the app starts the helper with them): nothing written" },
                _ => StickWriter.Run(q, sys, Progress, [AppContext.BaseDirectory[..2]]),
            };
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            r = new StickHelperResult { Ok = false, Error = e.Message };
            int i = Array.IndexOf(args, "--out");
            if (i >= 0 && i + 1 < args.Length) output = args[i + 1];
        }
        finally { progressFile?.Dispose(); }
        try
        {
            if (output is null) Console.Out.Write(r.ToJson());
            else HelperMain.Answer(output, r.ToJson());
        }
        catch (Exception) { return 3; }
        return r.Ok ? 0 : 1;
    }

    static StickHelperResult Download(StickHelperRequest q, Action<string, double> progress)
    {
        var v = RecoveryData.Embedded.Find(q.Version!);
        using var client = new RecoveryClient();
        var files = client.DownloadAsync(v, q.Image, new Progress<RecoveryProgress>(p => progress(p.Stage, p.Total > 0 ? (double)p.Bytes / p.Total : 0))).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        return new StickHelperResult
        {
            Ok = true,
            Lines = [$"{v.Name}: product {files.Product}, {files.Size} bytes, every piece matches Apple's signed chunklist", files.Image, files.ChunklistFile],
        };
    }
}

/// The app's side: the helper started through "runas" (the UAC prompt), its progress read from a file while it works,
/// its answer from another.
static class StickRunner
{
    public static Task<StickHelperResult> RunElevatedAsync(StickHelperRequest q, Action<string, double>? progress, CancellationToken cancel = default) =>
        RunElevatedAsync((output, progressFile) => (q with { Out = output, Progress = progressFile }).ToArgs(), progress, cancel);

    /// Any helper (--stick-helper, --probe-helper): args gets the answer and progress files' paths.
    public static async Task<StickHelperResult> RunElevatedAsync(Func<string, string, IReadOnlyList<string>> args, Action<string, double>? progress, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        var dir = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "IntelXe Manager", "helper");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
        var id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        var output = Path.Combine(dir, id + ".json");
        var progressPath = Path.Combine(dir, id + ".progress");
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo(Environment.ProcessPath ?? Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "IntelXeManager.exe"),
            Core.Efi.CommandLine.Join(args(output, progressPath)))
        {
            UseShellExecute = true, Verb = "runas", WorkingDirectory = AppContext.BaseDirectory, WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Hidden,
        };
        try
        {
            Process p;
            try { p = Process.Start(psi) ?? throw new StickException("the helper did not start"); }
            catch (Win32Exception e) when (e.NativeErrorCode == 1223) { throw new StickException(L.Get("Stick_Elevation_Cancelled")); }
            using (p)
                while (!p.HasExited)
                {
                    try { await p.WaitForExitAsync(cancel).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(400), cancel); }
                    catch (TimeoutException) { }
                    if (progress is not null && ReadProgress(progressPath) is { } pr) progress(pr.Stage, pr.Fraction);
                }
            if (!File.Exists(output)) throw new StickException(L.Get("Stick_Helper_NoAnswer"));
            return StickHelperResult.FromJson(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(output, cancel));
        }
        finally
        {
            try { File.Delete(output); } catch (Exception) { }
            try { File.Delete(progressPath); } catch (Exception) { }
        }
    }

    static (string Stage, double Fraction)? ReadProgress(string path)
    {
        try
        {
            using var f = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete);
            var text = new StreamReader(f).ReadToEnd().Trim().Split(' ');
            if (text.Length == 2 && double.TryParse(text[1], NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var v)) return (text[0], v);
        }
        catch (Exception) { }
        return null;
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.App/Services/SystemProbe.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Reads what the Overview shows, through WMI/CIM, the registry and Windows APIs. Read-only: nothing is mounted, written
// or changed, and no administrator rights are asked for. Serial numbers, UUIDs, MAC addresses and the product key are
// never queried (the WMI queries name their properties); a volume's GUID path is used to look inside an EFI partition
// but is not kept.
using System.Management;
using System.Security.Principal;
using IntelXe.Core;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace IntelXe.App;

public static class SystemProbe
{
    static readonly System.Management.EnumerationOptions Limits = new() { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15), ReturnImmediately = false };

    static IEnumerable<ManagementBaseObject> Query(string scope, string wql)
    {
        using var searcher = new ManagementObjectSearcher(new ManagementScope(scope), new ObjectQuery(wql), Limits);
        foreach (var o in searcher.Get()) yield return o;
    }

    static string Str(object? v) => v?.ToString()?.Trim() ?? "";

    static void Try(Action a) { try { a(); } catch (Exception) { } }

    public static PcFacts Probe()
    {
        var f = new PcFacts();
        Try(() => ProbeGpus(f));
        Try(() =>
        {
            foreach (var o in Query(@"root\CIMV2", "SELECT Name FROM Win32_Processor")) { f.CpuName = Str(o["Name"]); break; }
        });
        Try(() =>
        {
            if (Native.CoreClasses() is { } c) { f.PerformanceCores = c.Performance; f.EfficiencyCores = c.Efficiency; }
        });
        Try(() =>
        {
            foreach (var o in Query(@"root\CIMV2", "SELECT Manufacturer, Product FROM Win32_BaseBoard"))
            {
                f.BoardMaker = Str(o["Manufacturer"]); f.BoardModel = Str(o["Product"]); break;
            }
        });
        Try(() =>
        {
            if (Native.GetFirmwareType(out int t)) f.Firmware = t switch { 1 => FirmwareMode.Legacy, 2 => FirmwareMode.Uefi, _ => FirmwareMode.Unknown };
        });
        Try(() => f.SecureBoot = ReadSecureBoot(f.Firmware));
        Try(() => f.Windows = ReadWindows());
        Try(() => f.BitLocker = ReadBitLocker());
        Try(() =>
        {
            using var id = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent();
            f.IsAdministrator = new WindowsPrincipal(id).IsInRole(WindowsBuiltInRole.Administrator);
        });
        try { f.Esps.AddRange(ReadEsps()); }
        catch (Exception e) { f.EspError = e.Message; }
        BiosProbe.Probe(f);
        return f;
    }

    // ---- GPUs: the display adapters, their PCI IDs and Windows driver, and the supported card's BARs and location ----
    static void ProbeGpus(PcFacts f)
    {
        var drivers = new Dictionary<string, (string Name, string Version)>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        Try(() =>
        {
            foreach (var o in Query(@"root\CIMV2", "SELECT Name, PNPDeviceID, DriverVersion FROM Win32_VideoController"))
                drivers[Str(o["PNPDeviceID"])] = (Str(o["Name"]), Str(o["DriverVersion"]));
        });
        // every present display-class device, also one without a working driver
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var o in Query(@"root\CIMV2", "SELECT Name, DeviceID FROM Win32_PnPEntity WHERE PNPClass = 'Display'"))
        {
            var id = Str(o["DeviceID"]);
            if (!seen.Add(id)) continue;
            var pci = PciId.Parse(id);
            drivers.TryGetValue(id, out var d);
            string location = SupportedCards.Find(pci) is not null ? LocationPath(o as ManagementObject) : "";
            f.Gpus.Add(new GpuInfo(d.Name is { Length: > 0 } ? d.Name : Str(o["Name"]), pci, d.Version ?? "", location));
            if (f.Bar is null && SupportedCards.Find(pci) is not null) f.Bar = ReadBars(id);
        }
        foreach (var (id, d) in drivers)
            if (seen.Add(id)) f.Gpus.Add(new GpuInfo(d.Name, PciId.Parse(id), d.Version));
    }

    /// DEVPKEY_Device_LocationPaths' ACPI(...) line, as Device Manager shows it (Win32_PnPEntity.GetDeviceProperties).
    static string LocationPath(ManagementObject? device)
    {
        if (device is null) return "";
        try
        {
            using var input = device.GetMethodParameters("GetDeviceProperties");
            input["devicePropertyKeys"] = new[] { "DEVPKEY_Device_LocationPaths" };
            using var output = device.InvokeMethod("GetDeviceProperties", input, null);
            if (output?["deviceProperties"] is ManagementBaseObject[] props)
                foreach (var p in props)
                    if (p["Data"] is string[] lines)
                        foreach (var line in lines)
                            if (line.StartsWith("ACPI(", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return line;
        }
        catch (Exception) { }
        return "";
    }

    /// The card's memory ranges from Enum\<instance>\Control\AllocConfig (a REG_RESOURCE_LIST), as collect-windows.ps1.
    static BarSummary? ReadBars(string instanceId) =>
        ResourceList.Summarize(Native.ReadMachineValue(@"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\" + instanceId + @"\Control", "AllocConfig"));

    // ---- firmware, Windows, BitLocker ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    static SecureBootState ReadSecureBoot(FirmwareMode firmware)
    {
        using var key = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(@"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecureBoot\State");
        if (key?.GetValue("UEFISecureBootEnabled") is int v) return v == 1 ? SecureBootState.On : SecureBootState.Off;
        return firmware == FirmwareMode.Legacy ? SecureBootState.NotSupported : SecureBootState.Unknown;
    }

    static WindowsInfo? ReadWindows()
    {
        using var key = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(@"SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion");
        if (key is null) return null;
        int.TryParse(Str(key.GetValue("CurrentBuildNumber")), out int build);
        int ubr = key.GetValue("UBR") is int u ? u : 0;
        return new WindowsInfo(Str(key.GetValue("ProductName")), Str(key.GetValue("DisplayVersion")), build, ubr);
    }

    /// The system drive's BitLocker state: Win32_EncryptableVolume when the app runs as administrator, else the shell's
    /// System.Volume.BitLockerProtection (what Explorer shows), which needs no rights. Only read.
    static BitLockerState ReadBitLocker()
    {
        var drive = (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SystemDrive") ?? "C:").TrimEnd('\\');
        try
        {
            foreach (var o in Query(@"root\CIMV2\Security\MicrosoftVolumeEncryption",
                         $"SELECT ProtectionStatus FROM Win32_EncryptableVolume WHERE DriveLetter = '{drive}'"))
                if (o["ProtectionStatus"] is uint status) return BitLocker.FromProtectionStatus(status);
        }
        catch (Exception) { }   // access denied without administrator rights

        object? value = null;
        var thread = new Thread(() =>
        {
            try
            {
                var type = Type.GetTypeFromProgID("Shell.Application");
                if (type is null) return;
                dynamic shell = Activator.CreateInstance(type)!;
                dynamic folder = shell.NameSpace(drive + "\\");
                value = folder?.Self?.ExtendedProperty("System.Volume.BitLockerProtection");
            }
            catch (Exception) { }
        });
        thread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.STA);
        thread.Start();
        thread.Join(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        return BitLocker.FromShellProperty(value);
    }

    // ---- EFI system partitions: the same detection as IntelXe-EFI.ps1's Get-EspList (GPT type), nothing mounted ------
    static IEnumerable<EspPartition> ReadEsps()
    {
        const string storage = @"root\Microsoft\Windows\Storage";
        var disks = new Dictionary<uint, (string Name, string Bus)>();
        foreach (var o in Query(storage, "SELECT Number, FriendlyName, BusType FROM MSFT_Disk"))
            disks[Convert.ToUInt32(o["Number"])] = (Str(o["FriendlyName"]), EspPartition.BusName(Convert.ToInt32(o["BusType"] ?? 0)));
        var list = new List<EspPartition>();
        foreach (var o in Query(storage, "SELECT DiskNumber, PartitionNumber, Size, GptType, DriveLetter, AccessPaths, IsSystem FROM MSFT_Partition"))
        {
            if (!EspPartition.IsEspType(Str(o["GptType"]))) continue;
            uint disk = Convert.ToUInt32(o["DiskNumber"]);
            char letter = o["DriveLetter"] is char c && c != '\0' ? c : '\0';
            var paths = o["AccessPaths"] as string[] ?? [];
            var root = letter != '\0' ? $"{letter}:\\" : paths.FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith(@"\\?\Volume{", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            disks.TryGetValue(disk, out var d);
            list.Add(new EspPartition(d.Name is { Length: > 0 } ? d.Name : "?", d.Bus ?? "", disk, Convert.ToUInt32(o["PartitionNumber"]),
                Convert.ToUInt64(o["Size"]), letter != '\0' ? $"{letter}:" : "", o["IsSystem"] is true, LookForOpenCore(root)));
        }
        return list.OrderBy(e => e.DiskNumber).ThenBy(e => e.PartitionNumber);
    }

    /// OpenCore when EFI\OC\OpenCore.efi is on the partition; NeedsMount when Windows does not let the app look (an EFI
    /// partition without a drive letter is closed to programs that are not administrators; only the EFI page's elevated
    /// helper mounts one).
    static OpenCoreState LookForOpenCore(string? root)
    {
        if (root is null) return OpenCoreState.NeedsMount;
        try
        {
            _ = Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(root).Take(1).ToList();   // throws when the volume cannot be read
            return EspPartition.Detect(rel => File.Exists(Path.Combine(root, rel)));
        }
        catch (Exception) { return OpenCoreState.NeedsMount; }
    }
}
