// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The shared pieces of the pages' look, as app/Sources/Style.swift has them on macOS: a section header with an accent
// icon, a caption with its detail behind an (i) button, a coloured status badge, a card tinted by its state, a check row.
using System.Diagnostics;
using IntelXe.Core;
using Microsoft.UI;
using Microsoft.UI.Text;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Primitives;
using Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media;
using Windows.UI;

namespace IntelXe.App;

public static class Glyphs
{
    public const string Grid = "", Drive = "", Report = "", Info = "", Refresh = "",
        Chip = "", Pc = "", Firmware = "", Settings = "", Puzzle = "", Undo = "",
        Document = "", Feedback = "", Link = "", Folder = "", Copy = "", Heart = "",
        Ok = "", Warning = "", Bad = "", Neutral = "", Shield = "", List = "", Open = "";
    public const string Download = "\uE896";
}

public static class Ui
{
    public static FrameworkElement Root => (FrameworkElement)App.Window!.Content;

    public static Color StateColor(CheckState s)
    {
        var key = s switch
        {
            CheckState.Good => "StatusGoodColor",
            CheckState.Warning => "StatusWarningColor",
            CheckState.Bad => "StatusBadColor",
            _ => "StatusNeutralColor",
        };
        var theme = Root.ActualTheme == ElementTheme.Dark ? "Dark" : "Light";
        var dicts = Application.Current.Resources.ThemeDictionaries;
        if (dicts.TryGetValue(theme, out var d) && d is ResourceDictionary rd && rd.TryGetValue(key, out var c) && c is Color color) return color;
        return Colors.Gray;
    }

    public static SolidColorBrush Brush(CheckState s, double opacity = 1) => new(StateColor(s)) { Opacity = opacity };

    static Style Style(string key) => (Style)Application.Current.Resources[key];

    public static FontIcon Icon(string glyph, double size = 16, Brush? brush = null, string? style = null)
    {
        var i = new FontIcon { Glyph = glyph, FontSize = size };
        if (style is not null) i.Style = Style(style);
        if (brush is not null) i.Foreground = brush;
        return i;
    }

    public static string StateGlyph(CheckState s) => s switch
    {
        CheckState.Good => Glyphs.Ok, CheckState.Warning => Glyphs.Warning, CheckState.Bad => Glyphs.Bad, _ => Glyphs.Neutral,
    };

    public static TextBlock Text(string text, string? style = null, bool secondary = false, bool wrap = true)
    {
        var t = new TextBlock { Text = text, TextWrapping = wrap ? TextWrapping.Wrap : TextWrapping.NoWrap, IsTextSelectionEnabled = true };
        if (!wrap) t.TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis;
        // the secondary colour comes with a style (SecondaryBodyTextStyle for BodyTextBlockStyle, and so on: App.xaml)
        if (secondary) style = style switch { null => "SecondaryTextStyle", "BodyTextBlockStyle" => "SecondaryBodyTextStyle", "CaptionTextBlockStyle" => "SecondaryCaptionTextStyle", _ => style };
        if (style is not null) t.Style = Style(style);
        return t;
    }

    /// The page's title and its one-line caption.
    public static StackPanel PageHeader(string title, string? caption = null)
    {
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 2, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 8) };
        p.Children.Add(Text(title, "PageTitleStyle"));
        if (caption is not null) p.Children.Add(Text(caption, "BodyTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        return p;
    }

    /// A section: the accent icon and title above, the content in a card below (the macOS app's Section2 in a grouped form).
    public static StackPanel Section(string glyph, string title, params UIElement[] content)
    {
        var header = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 8, Margin = new Thickness(4, 16, 0, 6) };
        header.Children.Add(Icon(glyph, 16, style: "AccentIconStyle"));
        header.Children.Add(Text(title, "SectionTitleStyle"));
        var body = new StackPanel { Spacing = 10 };
        foreach (var c in content) body.Children.Add(c);
        var p = new StackPanel();
        p.Children.Add(header);
        p.Children.Add(Card(body));
        return p;
    }

    /// The grouped card of a section: Windows' card fill and stroke.
    public static Border Card(UIElement child) => new() { Child = child, Style = Style("CardStyle") };

    /// A card filled with a light wash of its state's colour, with an edge that stays visible on the light theme
    /// (Style.swift TintedCard).
    public static Border TintedCard(UIElement child, CheckState state) => new()
    {
        Child = child,
        Padding = new Thickness(14, 12, 14, 12),
        CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(8),
        Background = Brush(state, 0.10),
        BorderBrush = Brush(state, 0.32),
        BorderThickness = new Thickness(1),
    };

    /// A capsule with a dot and a short state, in the state's colour (Style.swift StatusBadge).
    public static Border Badge(string text, CheckState state)
    {
        var p = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 6 };
        p.Children.Add(new Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Shapes.Ellipse { Width = 8, Height = 8, Fill = Brush(state), VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center });
        p.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = text, FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold, Foreground = Brush(state), VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center });
        return new Border { Child = p, Padding = new Thickness(10, 5, 12, 5), CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(14), Background = Brush(state, 0.16), VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center };
    }

    /// One short secondary line, and the long explanation behind an (i) button (Style.swift Caption).
    public static UIElement Caption(string text, string? detail = null)
    {
        var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 6 };
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.Children.Add(Text(text, "BodyTextBlockStyle", secondary: true));
        if (detail is not null)
        {
            var b = InfoButton(detail);
            Grid.SetColumn(b, 1);
            g.Children.Add(b);
        }
        return g;
    }

    public static Button InfoButton(string detail)
    {
        var b = new Button
        {
            Content = Icon(Glyphs.Info, 14, style: "SecondaryIconStyle"),
            Padding = new Thickness(4),
            Background = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Transparent),
            BorderThickness = new Thickness(0),
            VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top,
            Flyout = new Flyout { Content = new TextBlock { Text = detail, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, MaxWidth = 340, IsTextSelectionEnabled = true } },
        };
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(b, L.Get("More_Information"));
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(b, L.Get("More_Information"));
        return b;
    }

    /// A row: title on the left, value on the right (LabeledContent).
    public static Grid Row(string title, UIElement value)
    {
        var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 16 };
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        var label = Text(title);
        label.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
        g.Children.Add(label);
        if (value is FrameworkElement fe) { fe.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right; fe.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center; }
        Grid.SetColumn((FrameworkElement)value, 1);
        g.Children.Add(value);
        return g;
    }

    public static Grid Row(string title, string value)
    {
        var t = Text(value, secondary: true);
        t.TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Right;
        return Row(title, t);
    }

    /// A check: state icon, title, value on the right, and its one-line explanation under it (Views.swift CheckRow).
    public static StackPanel CheckRow(Check check)
    {
        var g = new Grid { ColumnSpacing = 10 };
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = GridLength.Auto });
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(new ColumnDefinition { Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
        var icon = Icon(StateGlyph(check.State), 16, Brush(check.State));
        Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetName(icon, StateName(check.State));
        g.Children.Add(icon);
        var title = Text(L.Resolve(check.Title));
        Grid.SetColumn(title, 1);
        g.Children.Add(title);
        var value = Text(L.Resolve(check.Value), secondary: true);
        value.TextAlignment = TextAlignment.Right;
        value.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right;
        Grid.SetColumn(value, 2);
        g.Children.Add(value);
        var p = new StackPanel { Spacing = 2 };
        p.Children.Add(g);
        if (!check.Help.IsEmpty)
        {
            var help = Text(L.Resolve(check.Help), "CaptionTextBlockStyle", secondary: true);
            help.Margin = new Thickness(26, 0, 0, 0);
            p.Children.Add(help);
        }
        return p;
    }

    public static string StateName(CheckState s) => s switch
    {
        CheckState.Good => L.Get("State_Ok"), CheckState.Warning => L.Get("State_Warning"), CheckState.Bad => L.Get("State_Problem"), _ => "",
    };

    public static Button Button(string text, RoutedEventHandler click, bool accent = false, string? glyph = null)
    {
        object content = text;
        if (glyph is not null)
        {
            var sp = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = 8 };
            sp.Children.Add(Icon(glyph, 14));
            sp.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = text });
            content = sp;
        }
        var b = new Button { Content = content };
        if (accent) b.Style = (Style)Application.Current.Resources["AccentButtonStyle"];
        b.Click += click;
        return b;
    }

    public static HyperlinkButton Link(string text, Uri uri)
    {
        var b = new HyperlinkButton { Content = text, Padding = new Thickness(4, 2, 4, 2) };
        b.Click += (_, _) => OpenUri(uri);
        ToolTipService.SetToolTip(b, uri.AbsoluteUri);
        return b;
    }

    public static void OpenUri(Uri uri)
    {
        try { Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(uri.AbsoluteUri) { UseShellExecute = true }); } catch (Exception) { }
    }

    public static StackPanel Horizontal(double spacing, params UIElement[] items)
    {
        var p = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, Spacing = spacing };
        foreach (var i in items) p.Children.Add(i);
        return p;
    }

    /// A page's scrolling column, as wide as the window allows up to a readable width.
    public static (ScrollViewer Scroll, StackPanel Column) PageColumn()
    {
        var column = new StackPanel { MaxWidth = 960, Padding = new Thickness(28, 20, 28, 28), HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Stretch };
        var scroll = new ScrollViewer { Content = column, HorizontalScrollMode = ScrollMode.Disabled, VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto };
        if (App.Options.Scroll is int offset)
            scroll.SizeChanged += (_, _) => scroll.ChangeView(null, offset, null, true);
        return (scroll, column);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace IntelXe.Core;

/// The card's ACPI path, which stage 4 needs for SSDT-ARCOFF.aml. The same conversions as IntelXe-EFI.ps1
/// (EfiFolder.ConvertLocationPath / NormalizeCard) and efi.sh, for the Overview; the EFI page's plans use the engine's.
public static class AcpiPath
{
    public const string Shipped = @"\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP";

    static string Unpad(string s) { var t = s.TrimEnd('_'); return t.Length == 0 ? s : t; }

    /// Device Manager's "Location paths" line, ACPI(_SB_)#ACPI(PC00)#ACPI(PEG1)#ACPI(PEGP)#PCI(0100)#PCI(0000), as the ACPI
    /// path of the bridge two PCI levels above the GPU (\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP); "none" when that bridge has no ACPI name;
    /// null when the line is not such a path.
    public static string? FromLocationPath(string? line)
    {
        if (line is null) return null;
        var parts = line.Trim().Split('#');
        var names = new List<string>();
        bool pci = false;
        foreach (var raw in parts)
        {
            var q = raw.Trim();
            var m = Regex.Match(q, @"^ACPI\(([A-Za-z0-9_]{1,4})\)$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
            if (m.Success) { if (pci) return null; names.Add(m.Groups[1].Value.ToUpperInvariant()); continue; }
            if (Regex.IsMatch(q, @"^(PCI|PCIROOT)\([0-9A-Fa-f]+\)$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)) { pci = true; continue; }
            return null;
        }
        if (names.Count == 0 || parts.Length < 3) return null;
        int up = parts.Length - 3;   // the GPU is the last part, its switch's downstream port the one before
        if (up >= names.Count) return "none";
        var path = new List<string>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= up; i++) path.Add(Unpad(names[i]));
        if (path.Count < 2) return null;
        return "\\" + string.Join(".", path);
    }

    /// \_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP, \_SB_.PC00.PEG1.PEGP (Linux) or a Location paths line, as \_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP; null when it is
    /// neither.
    public static string? Normalize(string? input)
    {
        if (input is null || input.Trim().Length == 0) return null;
        var s = input.Trim();
        if (s.StartsWith("ACPI(", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            var r = FromLocationPath(s);
            return r == "none" ? null : r;
        }
        if (!Regex.IsMatch(s, @"^\\?[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,4}(\.[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,4})+$")) return null;
        var segs = s.TrimStart('\\').ToUpperInvariant().Split('.').Select(Unpad);
        return "\\" + string.Join(".", segs);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core;

public enum CheckState { Good, Warning, Bad, Neutral }

/// One line of the Overview's "This PC" list: what it is, its value, its state and one line on what it means.
public sealed record Check(string Id, Text Title, Text Value, CheckState State, Text Help);

/// How the Overview judges this PC. The limits and wording come from the guide (site/guide/hardware.html, windows.html)
/// and release/README-INSTALL.md stage 1: an Intel CPU, a B580 (tested) or B570 (untested), the firmware in UEFI mode
/// with CSM off, Above 4G decoding and Resizable BAR on; OpenCore does not start under Secure Boot unless signed.
public static class PcChecks
{
    public static IReadOnlyList<Check> Evaluate(PcFacts f)
    {
        var list = new List<Check> { CardCheck(f), CpuCheck(f), HybridCheck(f) };
        list.Add(new Check("board", Text.Of("Check_Board"),
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(f.BoardModel) ? Text.Of("Value_NotReported") : Text.Raw($"{f.BoardMaker} {f.BoardModel}".Trim()),
            CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("Board_Help")));
        list.Add(FirmwareCheck(f));
        list.Add(SecureBootCheck(f));
        list.Add(RebarCheck(f));
        list.Add(new Check("windows", Text.Of("Check_Windows"),
            f.Windows is null ? Text.Of("Value_Unknown") : f.Windows.BuildText == "" ? Text.Raw(f.Windows.NameAndVersion)
                : Text.Of("Windows_Value", f.Windows.NameAndVersion, f.Windows.BuildText),
            f.Windows is null ? CheckState.Neutral : CheckState.Good, Text.Empty));
        list.Add(BitLockerCheck(f));
        list.Add(EspCheck(f));
        return list;
    }

    static Check CardCheck(PcFacts f)
    {
        var title = Text.Of("Check_Card");
        if (f.Card is { Id: not null } gpu)
        {
            var card = SupportedCards.Find(gpu.Id)!;
            var value = Text.Raw($"{card.Name} ({gpu.Id.VendorDevice})");
            return card.Tested
                ? new Check("card", title, value, CheckState.Good, Text.Empty)
                : new Check("card", title, value, CheckState.Warning, Text.Of("Card_Help_Untested"));
        }
        if (f.OtherIntelGpu is { Id: not null } other)
            return new Check("card", title, Text.Of("Card_None"), CheckState.Bad, Text.Of("Card_Help_Other", $"{other.Name} ({other.Id.VendorDevice})"));
        return new Check("card", title, Text.Of("Card_None"), CheckState.Bad, Text.Of("Card_Help_None"));
    }

    static Check CpuCheck(PcFacts f)
    {
        var name = CpuInfo.CleanName(f.CpuName);
        if (name == "") return new Check("cpu", Text.Of("Check_Cpu"), Text.Of("Value_NotReported"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("Cpu_Help_Unknown"));
        var family = CpuInfo.Family(f.CpuName);
        Text help = family.Vendor == CpuVendor.Intel ? family.Describe() : Text.Empty;
        if (f.PerformanceCores is int p && f.EfficiencyCores is int e && e > 0)
            help = help.IsEmpty ? Text.Of("Cpu_Cores", p, e) : Text.Of("Cpu_FamilyCores", help, p, e);
        return family.Vendor switch
        {
            CpuVendor.Intel => new Check("cpu", Text.Of("Check_Cpu"), Text.Raw(name), CheckState.Good, help),
            CpuVendor.Amd => new Check("cpu", Text.Of("Check_Cpu"), Text.Raw(name), CheckState.Warning, Text.Of("Cpu_Help_Amd")),
            _ => new Check("cpu", Text.Of("Check_Cpu"), Text.Raw(name), CheckState.Warning, Text.Of("Cpu_Help_Other")),
        };
    }

    static Check HybridCheck(PcFacts f) =>
        f.HybridCpu
            ? new Check("hybridpm", Text.Of("Check_HybridPM"), Text.Of("HybridPM_Needed"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("HybridPM_Help_Needed"))
            : new Check("hybridpm", Text.Of("Check_HybridPM"), Text.Of("HybridPM_NotNeeded"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("HybridPM_Help_NotNeeded"));

    static Check FirmwareCheck(PcFacts f) => f.Firmware switch
    {
        FirmwareMode.Uefi => new Check("firmware", Text.Of("Check_Firmware"), Text.Of("Firmware_Uefi"), CheckState.Good, Text.Empty),
        FirmwareMode.Legacy => new Check("firmware", Text.Of("Check_Firmware"), Text.Of("Firmware_Legacy"), CheckState.Bad, Text.Of("Firmware_Help_Legacy")),
        _ => new Check("firmware", Text.Of("Check_Firmware"), Text.Of("Value_Unknown"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Empty),
    };

    static Check SecureBootCheck(PcFacts f) => f.SecureBoot switch
    {
        SecureBootState.Off => new Check("secureboot", Text.Of("Check_SecureBoot"), Text.Of("State_Off"), CheckState.Good, Text.Empty),
        SecureBootState.On => new Check("secureboot", Text.Of("Check_SecureBoot"), Text.Of("State_On"), CheckState.Warning, Text.Of("SecureBoot_Help_On")),
        SecureBootState.NotSupported => new Check("secureboot", Text.Of("Check_SecureBoot"), Text.Of("SecureBoot_NotSupported"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Empty),
        _ => new Check("secureboot", Text.Of("Check_SecureBoot"), Text.Of("Value_Unknown"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Empty),
    };

    static Check RebarCheck(PcFacts f)
    {
        if (f.Bar is null)
            return new Check("rebar", Text.Of("Check_Rebar"), Text.Of("Value_CouldNotRead"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("Rebar_Help_Unknown"));
        if (f.Bar.ResizableBar)
            return new Check("rebar", Text.Of("Check_Rebar"), Text.Of("Rebar_On", f.Bar.LargestMb), CheckState.Good,
                f.Bar.Above4G ? Text.Of("Rebar_Help_Above4G") : Text.Empty);
        return new Check("rebar", Text.Of("Check_Rebar"), Text.Of("Rebar_Off", f.Bar.LargestMb), CheckState.Warning, Text.Of("Rebar_Help_Off"));
    }

    static Check BitLockerCheck(PcFacts f)
    {
        var title = Text.Of("Check_BitLocker");
        return f.BitLocker switch
        {
            BitLockerState.Off => new Check("bitlocker", title, Text.Of("State_Off"), CheckState.Good, Text.Empty),
            BitLockerState.Unknown => new Check("bitlocker", title, Text.Of("Value_CouldNotRead"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("BitLocker_Help_Unknown")),
            BitLockerState.WaitingForActivation => new Check("bitlocker", title, Text.Of("BitLocker_Waiting"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("BitLocker_Help_Waiting")),
            var s => new Check("bitlocker", title, Text.Of("BitLocker_" + s), CheckState.Warning, Text.Of("BitLocker_Help_On")),
        };
    }

    static Check EspCheck(PcFacts f)
    {
        var title = Text.Of("Check_Esp");
        if (f.EspError is not null) return new Check("esp", title, Text.Of("Value_CouldNotRead"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Raw(f.EspError));
        int n = f.Esps.Count, oc = f.Esps.Count(e => e.OpenCore == OpenCoreState.Found), unread = f.Esps.Count(e => e.OpenCore == OpenCoreState.NeedsMount);
        if (n == 0) return new Check("esp", title, Text.Of("Esp_None"), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("Esp_Help_None"));
        if (oc > 0) return new Check("esp", title, Text.Of("Esp_CountOc", n, oc), CheckState.Good, Text.Empty);
        if (unread > 0) return new Check("esp", title, Text.Of("Esp_CountUnread", n, unread), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("Esp_Help_Unread"));
        return new Check("esp", title, Text.Of("Esp_Count", n), CheckState.Neutral, Text.Of("Esp_Help_NoOpenCore"));
    }

    /// The worst state in the list (Neutral counts as Good).
    public static CheckState Overall(IEnumerable<Check> checks)
    {
        var states = checks.Select(c => c.State).ToList();
        if (states.Contains(CheckState.Bad)) return CheckState.Bad;
        if (states.Contains(CheckState.Warning)) return CheckState.Warning;
        return CheckState.Good;
    }

    /// Every string key the checks can use, for the tests that hold the string tables to them.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Keys { get; } =
    [
        "Check_Card", "Check_Cpu", "Check_HybridPM", "Check_Board", "Check_Firmware", "Check_SecureBoot", "Check_Rebar",
        "Check_Windows", "Check_BitLocker", "Check_Esp",
        "Value_Unknown", "Value_NotReported", "Value_CouldNotRead", "State_On", "State_Off",
        "Card_None", "Card_Help_None", "Card_Help_Untested", "Card_Help_Other",
        "Cpu_Help_Unknown", "Cpu_Help_Amd", "Cpu_Help_Other", "Cpu_Cores", "Cpu_FamilyCores", "Cpu_Gen", "Cpu_WithCodename",
        "HybridPM_Needed", "HybridPM_NotNeeded", "HybridPM_Help_Needed", "HybridPM_Help_NotNeeded",
        "Board_Help", "Firmware_Uefi", "Firmware_Legacy", "Firmware_Help_Legacy",
        "SecureBoot_Help_On", "SecureBoot_NotSupported",
        "Rebar_On", "Rebar_Off", "Rebar_Help_Off", "Rebar_Help_Unknown", "Rebar_Help_Above4G",
        "Windows_Value",
        "BitLocker_On", "BitLocker_Encrypting", "BitLocker_Decrypting", "BitLocker_Paused", "BitLocker_Locked", "BitLocker_Waiting",
        "BitLocker_Help_On", "BitLocker_Help_Unknown", "BitLocker_Help_Waiting",
        "Esp_None", "Esp_Count", "Esp_CountOc", "Esp_CountUnread", "Esp_Help_None", "Esp_Help_Unread", "Esp_Help_NoOpenCore",
    ];
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace IntelXe.Core;

public enum CpuVendor { Unknown, Intel, Amd, Other }

/// What the EFI rules and the Overview need from the CPU's name (Win32_Processor.Name, e.g.
/// "13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K" or "Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K"): its vendor, its family, and whether it is a
/// hybrid Alder Lake / Raptor Lake part that HybridPM.kext is for.
public sealed record CpuFamily(CpuVendor Vendor, int? Generation, string? Codename, bool CoreUltra)
{
    /// "14th gen Core (Raptor Lake Refresh)", "Core Ultra (Arrow Lake)", "AMD"; "" when nothing is known.
    public string Label
    {
        get
        {
            if (Vendor == CpuVendor.Amd) return "AMD";
            if (Vendor != CpuVendor.Intel) return "";
            string name = CoreUltra ? "Core Ultra" : Generation is int g ? Ordinal(g) + " gen Core" : "Intel";
            return Codename is null ? name : $"{name} ({Codename})";
        }
    }

    /// The label for the window, in its language: "Cpu_Gen" (14th gen Core) or Core Ultra, with the codename after it.
    public Text Describe()
    {
        if (Vendor == CpuVendor.Amd) return Text.Raw("AMD");
        if (Vendor != CpuVendor.Intel) return Text.Empty;
        Text name = CoreUltra ? Text.Raw("Core Ultra") : Generation is int g ? Text.Of("Cpu_Gen", g) : Text.Raw("Intel");
        return Codename is null ? name : Text.Of("Cpu_WithCodename", name, Codename);
    }

    static string Ordinal(int n) => n + (n % 100 is 11 or 12 or 13 ? "th" : (n % 10) switch { 1 => "st", 2 => "nd", 3 => "rd", _ => "th" });
}

public static class CpuInfo
{
    // The same rule as efi.sh, IntelXe-EFI.ps1 (EfiFolder.HybridCpu) and the macOS app (Health.swift hybridCPU):
    // i3/i5/i7/i9-12xxx..14xxx, without Core Ultra (HybridPM leaves it alone) and the desktop models with P-cores only.
    static readonly Regex HybridName = new(@"i[3579]-1[2-4]([0-9][0-9][0-9]|[0-9][0-9][UP])", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
    static readonly Regex PCoresOnly = new(@"Ultra|i3-1[234]100|i3-12300|i5-12400|i5-12490|i5-12500(?!H)|i5-12600(?![KH])", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    /// A 12th-14th gen Core with efficiency cores, by its name: HybridPM.kext applies to it.
    public static bool IsHybrid(string? name) =>
        !string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && HybridName.IsMatch(name) && !PCoresOnly.IsMatch(name);

    /// The name without the trademark signs, the "CPU @ 3.60GHz" tail and the "13th Gen" prefix Windows adds:
    /// "Intel Core i7-13700K".
    public static string CleanName(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return "";
        var s = Regex.Replace(name, @"\((R|TM|tm|r)\)|®|™", "");
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"\s+CPU\b", " ");
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"\s*@\s*[0-9.]+\s*GHz", "", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"^\s*\d{1,2}th Gen\s+", "", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"(\s+\d+-Core)?(\s+Processor)?\s*$", "", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
        s = Regex.Replace(s, @"\s{2,}", " ").Trim();
        return s;
    }

    public static CpuVendor Vendor(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name)) return CpuVendor.Unknown;
        if (Regex.IsMatch(name, @"\bAMD\b|\bRyzen\b|\bEPYC\b|\bThreadripper\b|\bAthlon\b", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)) return CpuVendor.Amd;
        if (Regex.IsMatch(name, @"\bIntel\b|Core\(TM\)|\bCore\b|\bXeon\b|\bPentium\b|\bCeleron\b", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)) return CpuVendor.Intel;
        return CpuVendor.Other;
    }

    /// The family by the model number: Core iN-GGxxx (10th gen on), Core iN-Gxxx (before) or Core Ultra N SSS.
    public static CpuFamily Family(string? name)
    {
        var vendor = Vendor(name);
        if (vendor != CpuVendor.Intel || name is null) return new CpuFamily(vendor, null, null, false);
        var ultra = Regex.Match(name, @"Ultra\s*[3579]\s+(\d)(\d)(\d)([A-Z]*)", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
        if (ultra.Success)
        {
            int series = ultra.Groups[1].Value[0] - '0';
            string suffix = ultra.Groups[4].Value;
            string? code = series switch
            {
                1 => "Meteor Lake",
                2 => suffix.StartsWith('V') ? "Lunar Lake" : "Arrow Lake",
                3 => "Panther Lake",
                _ => null,
            };
            return new CpuFamily(vendor, null, code, true);
        }
        var core = Regex.Match(name, @"i[3579]-(\d{4,5})", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
        if (!core.Success) return new CpuFamily(vendor, null, null, false);
        // 10th gen and later start with 1 and their generation (i7-10700, i7-1165G7, i5-1335U, i7-14700K); before them
        // one digit (i7-9700K, i7-8750H)
        string digits = core.Groups[1].Value;
        int gen = digits[0] == '1' ? int.Parse(digits[..2]) : digits[0] - '0';
        string? codename = gen switch
        {
            14 => "Raptor Lake Refresh",
            13 => "Raptor Lake",
            12 => "Alder Lake",
            11 => "Rocket Lake / Tiger Lake",
            10 => "Comet Lake",
            9 or 8 => "Coffee Lake",
            7 => "Kaby Lake",
            6 => "Skylake",
            _ => null,
        };
        return new CpuFamily(vendor, gen, codename, false);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Globalization;

namespace IntelXe.Core;

/// Whether an EFI system partition holds OpenCore, as far as the app could tell without mounting it.
public enum OpenCoreState
{
    /// EFI\OC\OpenCore.efi is there
    Found,
    /// the partition could be read and has no EFI\OC\OpenCore.efi
    NotFound,
    /// Windows did not let the app read it: it has no drive letter, and reading it needs mounting (administrator)
    NeedsMount,
}

/// An EFI system partition (GPT type C12A7328-F81F-11D2-BA4B-00A0C93EC93B), the way IntelXe-EFI.ps1's Get-EspList lists
/// it: its disk's name and bus, disk and partition number, size, drive letter, and whether Windows booted from it (IsSystem). The
/// volume's GUID path is used to look inside but never shown (it is a unique ID).
public sealed record EspPartition(string Disk, string Bus, uint DiskNumber, uint PartitionNumber, ulong Size, string Letter,
    bool IsSystem, OpenCoreState OpenCore)
{
    public const string GptType = "{c12a7328-f81f-11d2-ba4b-00a0c93ec93b}";

    public static bool IsEspType(string? gptType) => string.Equals(gptType?.Trim(), GptType, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public string SizeText => FormatSize(Size);

    /// The size the way IntelXe-EFI.ps1 (Util.Size) writes it: whole GB from 1 GB up, else whole MB (decimal units).
    public static string FormatSize(ulong bytes) =>
        bytes >= 1_000_000_000UL
            ? Math.Round(bytes / 1e9).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " GB"
            : Math.Round(bytes / 1e6).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " MB";

    /// MSFT_Disk.BusType as Get-Disk names it.
    public static string BusName(int busType) => busType switch
    {
        1 => "SCSI", 2 => "ATAPI", 3 => "ATA", 4 => "1394", 5 => "SSA", 6 => "Fibre Channel", 7 => "USB", 8 => "RAID",
        9 => "iSCSI", 10 => "SAS", 11 => "SATA", 12 => "SD", 13 => "MMC", 14 => "Virtual", 15 => "File Backed Virtual",
        16 => "Storage Spaces", 17 => "NVMe", 18 => "SCM", 19 => "UFS",
        _ => "",
    };

    /// What a list of files at the partition's root and in EFI\OC says: OpenCore when EFI\OC\OpenCore.efi is there.
    public static OpenCoreState Detect(Func<string, bool> fileExists) =>
        fileExists(@"EFI\OC\OpenCore.efi") ? OpenCoreState.Found : OpenCoreState.NotFound;
}

<!-- The models and rules of the Windows app: plain .NET, no Windows APIs, so that its tests run on macOS and Linux too. -->
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <RootNamespace>IntelXe.Core</RootNamespace>
    <!-- the EFI engine, taken from windows/IntelXe-EFI.ps1 at build time (ExtractEfiEngine below) -->
    <EfiScript>$(RepoRoot)windows/IntelXe-EFI.ps1</EfiScript>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- the one list of supported cards (tools/parity/devices.py checks every copy against it) -->
    <EmbeddedResource Include="$(RepoRoot)data/platforms.json" LogicalName="IntelXe.Core.platforms.json" Link="data/platforms.json" />
    <!-- the EFI rules: the same file efi.sh and IntelXe-EFI.ps1 read (release/release.sh checks the shipped copies) -->
    <EmbeddedResource Include="$(RepoRoot)release/templates/efi-rules.json" LogicalName="IntelXe.Core.efi-rules.json" Link="data/efi-rules.json" />
    <!-- the BIOS page's settings per board maker, and the macOS versions the stick page downloads -->
    <EmbeddedResource Include="Bios/bios-steps.json" LogicalName="IntelXe.Core.bios-steps.json" />
    <EmbeddedResource Include="Stick/macos-recovery.json" LogicalName="IntelXe.Core.macos-recovery.json" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- The C# engine of IntelXe-EFI.ps1 (between "// BEGIN ENGINE" and "// END ENGINE": Rules, EfiFolder, Plist, Aml,
       namespace IntelXeEfi) is compiled into the Core as it is, so that the script and the app run one engine. It stays
       C# 5 inside the script, which Windows PowerShell 5.1 compiles with Add-Type; the script stays one file. -->
  <UsingTask TaskName="IntelXeExtractEngine" TaskFactory="RoslynCodeTaskFactory" AssemblyFile="$(MSBuildToolsPath)/Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Core.dll">
    <ParameterGroup>
      <Script ParameterType="System.String" Required="true" />
      <Output ParameterType="System.String" Required="true" />
    </ParameterGroup>
    <Task>
      <Code Type="Fragment" Language="cs"><![CDATA[
        string text = System.IO.File.ReadAllText(Script).Replace("\r\n", "\n");
        const string begin = "// BEGIN ENGINE\n", end = "// END ENGINE";
        int b = text.IndexOf(begin, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
        int e = b < 0 ? -1 : text.IndexOf(end, b, System.StringComparison.Ordinal);
        if (b < 0 || e < 0 || text.IndexOf(begin, e, System.StringComparison.Ordinal) >= 0)
        {
            Log.LogError("{0}: no single '// BEGIN ENGINE' ... '// END ENGINE' block", Script);
            return false;
        }
        string source = "// <auto-generated>\n// The engine of windows/IntelXe-EFI.ps1, copied from the script at build time: edit it there.\n// </auto-generated>\n#pragma warning disable\n"
            + text.Substring(b + begin.Length, e - b - begin.Length);
        if (!System.IO.File.Exists(Output) || System.IO.File.ReadAllText(Output) != source)
        {
            System.IO.Directory.CreateDirectory(System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(Output));
            System.IO.File.WriteAllText(Output, source, new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false));
        }
      ]]></Code>
    </Task>
  </UsingTask>
  <Target Name="ExtractEfiEngine" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile;BeforeBuild">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <EfiEngineSource>$(IntermediateOutputPath)IntelXeEfiEngine.g.cs</EfiEngineSource>
    </PropertyGroup>
    <IntelXeExtractEngine Script="$(EfiScript)" Output="$(EfiEngineSource)" />
    <ItemGroup>
      <Compile Include="$(EfiEngineSource)" />
      <FileWrites Include="$(EfiEngineSource)" />
    </ItemGroup>
  </Target>
</Project>

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core;

/// A display adapter as Windows lists it (Win32_VideoController): its name, PCI IDs, Windows driver version and the
/// "Location paths" line Device Manager shows (for the ACPI path stage 4 needs).
public sealed record GpuInfo(string Name, PciId? Id, string DriverVersion = "", string LocationPath = "");

/// What the Overview knows about this PC. The app fills it from WMI/CIM, the registry and Windows APIs, reading only;
/// Core judges it (PcChecks). No serial numbers, UUIDs, MAC addresses or product keys are ever put in here.
public sealed class PcFacts
{
    public List<GpuInfo> Gpus { get; init; } = [];
    public string CpuName { get; set; } = "";
    /// performance and efficiency cores by the cores' efficiency class (GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx); null when unknown
    public int? PerformanceCores { get; set; }
    public int? EfficiencyCores { get; set; }
    public string BoardMaker { get; set; } = "";
    public string BoardModel { get; set; } = "";
    public FirmwareMode Firmware { get; set; }
    public SecureBootState SecureBoot { get; set; }
    /// the supported card's BARs; null when they could not be read
    public BarSummary? Bar { get; set; }
    public WindowsInfo? Windows { get; set; }
    public BitLockerState BitLocker { get; set; }
    public List<EspPartition> Esps { get; init; } = [];
    /// why the EFI partitions could not be listed; null when they were
    public string? EspError { get; set; }
    public bool IsAdministrator { get; set; }

    // ---- for the BIOS page (BiosSteps), read-only like the rest ----
    /// the storage controllers' names (SCSI/RAID, NVMe and IDE/SATA classes); null when they could not be read
    public List<string>? StorageControllers { get; set; }
    /// whether the firmware publishes an ACPI DMAR table (VT-d on); null when the tables could not be read
    public bool? DmarTable { get; set; }
    /// Win32_Processor.VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled; null when not reported
    public bool? VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled { get; set; }
    /// Win32_Processor.NumberOfCores and NumberOfLogicalProcessors; null when not reported
    public int? Cores { get; set; }
    public int? Threads { get; set; }

    /// The integrated graphics Windows lists: an Intel display adapter that is not a supported card and not a discrete
    /// Arc (A- or B-series, "Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics").
    public IEnumerable<GpuInfo> IntegratedGpus => Gpus.Where(g => g.Id?.Vendor == PciId.Intel && SupportedCards.Find(g.Id) is null
        && !System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(g.Name, @"Arc\S*\s+(\(TM\)\s*)?[AB]\d{3}", System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase));

    /// The first supported card; null without one.
    public GpuInfo? Card => Gpus.FirstOrDefault(g => SupportedCards.Find(g.Id) is not null);

    /// The first other Intel GPU (an Arc the driver does not support yet, or integrated graphics).
    public GpuInfo? OtherIntelGpu => Gpus.FirstOrDefault(g => g.Id?.Vendor == PciId.Intel && SupportedCards.Find(g.Id) is null);

    public bool HybridCpu => CpuInfo.IsHybrid(CpuName);
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/PciId.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace IntelXe.Core;

/// A PCI function's IDs as Windows names the device: PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_E20B&SUBSYS_10208086&REV_00\...
public sealed record PciId(ushort Vendor, ushort Device, ushort? SubsystemVendor = null, ushort? Subsystem = null, byte? Revision = null)
{
    public const ushort Intel = 0x8086;

    static readonly Regex Pattern = new(@"^PCI\\VEN_([0-9A-F]{4})&DEV_([0-9A-F]{4})(?:&SUBSYS_([0-9A-F]{8}))?(?:&REV_([0-9A-F]{2}))?",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    /// The IDs in a PnP instance or hardware ID; null when it is not a PCI device.
    public static PciId? Parse(string? instanceId)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(instanceId)) return null;
        var m = Pattern.Match(instanceId.Trim());
        if (!m.Success) return null;
        ushort Hex16(string s) => ushort.Parse(s, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        ushort? subVendor = null, sub = null;
        if (m.Groups[3].Success)
        {
            // SUBSYS_ is the subsystem ID followed by the subsystem vendor ID
            sub = Hex16(m.Groups[3].Value[..4]);
            subVendor = Hex16(m.Groups[3].Value[4..]);
        }
        byte? rev = m.Groups[4].Success ? byte.Parse(m.Groups[4].Value, NumberStyles.HexNumber, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : null;
        return new PciId(Hex16(m.Groups[1].Value), Hex16(m.Groups[2].Value), subVendor, sub, rev);
    }

    /// vendor:device in lower case, as the guide's tables write it (8086:e20b).
    public string VendorDevice => $"{Vendor:x4}:{Device:x4}";
    public override string ToString() => VendorDevice;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core;

public sealed record MemoryRange(ulong Start, ulong Size)
{
    public bool Above4G => Start >= 1UL << 32;
}

/// The card's BARs as Windows assigned them, and what they say about Resizable BAR and Above 4G decoding.
public sealed record BarSummary(IReadOnlyList<MemoryRange> Ranges)
{
    const ulong Mb = 1UL << 20;
    public ulong Largest => Ranges.Count == 0 ? 0 : Ranges.Max(r => r.Size);
    public ulong LargestMb => Largest / Mb;
    /// One BAR above 256 MB: the firmware resized it (Resizable BAR on).
    public bool ResizableBar => Largest > 256 * Mb;
    /// A range above 4 GB: Above 4G decoding is on.
    public bool Above4G => Ranges.Any(r => r.Above4G);
}

/// A REG_RESOURCE_LIST as Windows keeps it in Enum\<device>\Control\AllocConfig, read the same way as
/// tools/report/collect-windows.ps1 (Get-AllocRanges): WMI's Win32_DeviceMemoryAddress lists only ranges below 4 GB, so it
/// never shows a resized VRAM BAR.
public static class ResourceList
{
    /// The memory ranges in it (CM_PARTIAL_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTORs of type 3, memory, and 7, large memory). Descriptors are
    /// 20 bytes on x64; a large range's length is shifted by 8, 16 or 32 bits (flags 0x200/0x400/0x800).
    public static IReadOnlyList<MemoryRange> MemoryRanges(byte[]? v)
    {
        var list = new List<MemoryRange>();
        if (v is null || v.Length < 4) return list;
        uint full = BitConverter.ToUInt32(v, 0);
        int o = 4;
        for (uint f = 0; f < full && o + 16 <= v.Length; f++)
        {
            o += 8;   // interface type, bus number
            uint count = BitConverter.ToUInt32(v, o + 4);   // version, revision (2 x 16 bits), count
            o += 8;
            for (uint i = 0; i < count && o + 20 <= v.Length; i++)
            {
                byte type = v[o];
                ushort flags = BitConverter.ToUInt16(v, o + 2);
                if (type is 3 or 7)
                {
                    ulong start = BitConverter.ToUInt64(v, o + 4);
                    ulong length = BitConverter.ToUInt32(v, o + 12);
                    if (type == 7)
                    {
                        if ((flags & 0x200) != 0) length <<= 8;
                        else if ((flags & 0x400) != 0) length <<= 16;
                        else if ((flags & 0x800) != 0) length <<= 32;
                    }
                    list.Add(new MemoryRange(start, length));
                }
                o += 20;
            }
        }
        return list;
    }

    public static BarSummary? Summarize(byte[]? v)
    {
        var r = MemoryRanges(v);
        return r.Count == 0 ? null : new BarSummary(r);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core;

public enum FirmwareMode { Unknown, Uefi, Legacy }

public enum SecureBootState { Unknown, On, Off, NotSupported }

public enum BitLockerState { Unknown, Off, On, Encrypting, Decrypting, Paused, Locked, WaitingForActivation }

public static class BitLocker
{
    /// The shell's System.Volume.BitLockerProtection property of a drive (what Explorer reads, no administrator rights
    /// needed): 1 on, 2 off, 3 encrypting, 4 decrypting, 5 and 7 encryption or decryption paused, 6 on and locked, 8
    /// encrypted but waiting for activation (device encryption whose key is not protected yet); anything else (0, empty:
    /// no BitLocker on this edition or volume) is unknown.
    public static BitLockerState FromShellProperty(object? value)
    {
        int n;
        try { n = value is null ? -1 : Convert.ToInt32(value, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture); }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is FormatException or InvalidCastException or OverflowException) { return BitLockerState.Unknown; }
        return n switch
        {
            1 => BitLockerState.On,
            2 => BitLockerState.Off,
            3 => BitLockerState.Encrypting,
            4 => BitLockerState.Decrypting,
            5 or 7 => BitLockerState.Paused,
            6 => BitLockerState.Locked,
            8 => BitLockerState.WaitingForActivation,
            _ => BitLockerState.Unknown,
        };
    }

    /// Win32_EncryptableVolume.ProtectionStatus (administrator only): 0 off, 1 on, 2 unknown.
    public static BitLockerState FromProtectionStatus(uint status) => status switch
    {
        0 => BitLockerState.Off,
        1 => BitLockerState.On,
        _ => BitLockerState.Unknown,
    };
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace IntelXe.Core;

/// A card the driver attaches to, from data/platforms.json "supported".
public sealed record SupportedCard(ushort Device, string Name, string Model, bool Tested)
{
    public string VendorDevice => $"8086:{Device:x4}";
}

/// What a GPU in this PC is to the driver.
public enum CardSupport { Supported, SupportedUntested, OtherIntel, NotIntel }

/// The supported cards, read from data/platforms.json (embedded in this assembly at build time), the one list that every
/// copy in the repository is checked against (tools/parity/devices.py).
public static class SupportedCards
{
    static IReadOnlyList<SupportedCard>? all;

    public static IReadOnlyList<SupportedCard> All => all ??= Load();

    static IReadOnlyList<SupportedCard> Load()
    {
        using var stream = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream("IntelXe.Core.platforms.json")
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("platforms.json is not embedded in IntelXe.Core");
        return Parse(stream);
    }

    /// The "supported" devices of a platforms.json.
    public static IReadOnlyList<SupportedCard> Parse(Stream json)
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
        var list = new List<SupportedCard>();
        foreach (var d in doc.RootElement.GetProperty("supported").GetProperty("devices").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var id = d.GetProperty("id").GetString() ?? "";
            list.Add(new SupportedCard(Convert.ToUInt16(id, 16), "Intel Arc " + d.GetProperty("name").GetString(),
                d.GetProperty("model").GetString() ?? "", d.TryGetProperty("tested", out var t) && t.GetBoolean()));
        }
        return list;
    }

    public static SupportedCard? Find(PciId? id) =>
        id is { Vendor: PciId.Intel } ? All.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Device == id.Device) : null;

    public static CardSupport Classify(PciId? id)
    {
        if (id is null || id.Vendor != PciId.Intel) return CardSupport.NotIntel;
        var card = Find(id);
        if (card is null) return CardSupport.OtherIntel;
        return card.Tested ? CardSupport.Supported : CardSupport.SupportedUntested;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core;

/// A piece of text for the window: a key in the app's string tables (Strings/*/Resources.resw) with its arguments, or a
/// verbatim string (a device name as Windows reports it). Core never translates; the app resolves keys in the language
/// it shows. An argument may itself be a Text.
public readonly record struct Text(string? Key, string? Verbatim, object[] Args)
{
    public static Text Of(string key, params object[] args) => new(key, null, args);
    public static Text Raw(string text) => new(null, text, []);
    public static readonly Text Empty = new(null, "", []);
    public bool IsEmpty => Key is null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(Verbatim);
    public override string ToString() => Key is null ? Verbatim ?? "" : Key + (Args.Length > 0 ? "(" + string.Join(", ", Args) + ")" : "");
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core;

/// Windows' version from HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion (ProductName, EditionID, DisplayVersion,
/// CurrentBuildNumber, UBR). Nothing about the product key is read.
public sealed record WindowsInfo(string ProductName, string DisplayVersion, int Build, int Ubr)
{
    /// ProductName still says "Windows 10" on Windows 11; the build number tells them apart (22000 and later is 11).
    public string Name
    {
        get
        {
            var name = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ProductName) ? "Windows" : ProductName.Trim();
            if (Build >= 22000 && name.StartsWith("Windows 10", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) name = "Windows 11" + name[10..];
            return name;
        }
    }

    /// "Windows 11 Pro 25H2"
    public string NameAndVersion => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DisplayVersion) ? Name : Name + " " + DisplayVersion.Trim();

    /// "26200.7171"; "" when the build is not known
    public string BuildText => Build <= 0 ? "" : Ubr > 0 ? $"{Build}.{Ubr}" : $"{Build}";

    public bool IsWindows11 => Build >= 22000;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The BIOS steps as one printable HTML page, to open on a phone or print before going into the firmware setup: no
// scripts, no external files (styles inline, a CSP that loads nothing), light and dark, narrow screens and paper.
// Every text from Windows (the board's name, controller names) is escaped.
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Bios;

public static class BiosHtml
{
    const string Csp = "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'";

    /// Escapes the five characters HTML gives meaning to; the rest stays as UTF-8 text (Turkish letters too).
    public static string E(string s) => s.Replace("&", "&amp;").Replace("<", "&lt;").Replace(">", "&gt;").Replace("\"", "&quot;").Replace("'", "&#39;");

    /// The page for these steps, in "en" or "tr", with the board's menu names (vendor id).
    public static string Render(BiosData data, IReadOnlyList<BiosStep> steps, PcFacts? facts, string vendorId, string lang, DateTime made)
    {
        string T(string key) => data.PageText(key, lang);
        var vendor = BiosSteps.Vendor(data, vendorId);
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.Append("<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"").Append(lang).Append("\">\n<head>\n<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n")
          .Append("<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n")
          .Append("<meta http-equiv=\"Content-Security-Policy\" content=\"").Append(Csp).Append("\">\n")
          .Append("<title>").Append(E(T("title"))).Append("</title>\n<style>\n").Append(Style).Append("</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<main>\n");

        sb.Append("<h1>").Append(E(T("title"))).Append("</h1>\n<p class=\"lead\">").Append(E(T("subtitle"))).Append("</p>\n");

        // the PC and the keys
        sb.Append("<dl class=\"facts\">\n");
        if (facts is not null)
        {
            var board = $"{facts.BoardMaker} {facts.BoardModel}".Trim();
            if (board.Length > 0) sb.Append("<dt>").Append(E(T("board"))).Append("</dt><dd>").Append(E(board)).Append("</dd>\n");
            var cpu = CpuInfo.CleanName(facts.CpuName);
            if (cpu.Length > 0) sb.Append("<dt>").Append(E(T("cpu"))).Append("</dt><dd>").Append(E(cpu)).Append("</dd>\n");
        }
        sb.Append("<dt>").Append(E(T("menus"))).Append("</dt><dd>").Append(E(vendor.Name.Length > 0 ? vendor.Name : T("menus-generic"))).Append("</dd>\n");
        sb.Append("<dt>").Append(E(T("setup-key"))).Append("</dt><dd><kbd>").Append(E(vendor.SetupKey)).Append("</kbd></dd>\n");
        if (vendor.AdvancedKey.Length > 0) sb.Append("<dt>").Append(E(T("advanced-key"))).Append("</dt><dd><kbd>").Append(E(vendor.AdvancedKey)).Append("</kbd></dd>\n");
        sb.Append("<dt>").Append(E(T("save-key"))).Append("</dt><dd><kbd>").Append(E(vendor.SaveKey)).Append("</kbd></dd>\n");
        sb.Append("<dt>").Append(E(T("boot-key"))).Append("</dt><dd><kbd>").Append(E(vendor.BootMenuKey)).Append("</kbd></dd>\n");
        sb.Append("</dl>\n<p class=\"note\">").Append(E(vendor.Note.In(lang))).Append("</p>\n");

        var (todo, done, unknown) = BiosSteps.Count(steps);
        sb.Append("<p class=\"summary\">").Append(E(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, T("summary"), todo, done, unknown))).Append("</p>\n");

        int n = 0;
        foreach (var group in data.Groups)
        {
            var mine = steps.Where(s => s.Item.Group == group.Id).ToList();
            if (mine.Count == 0) continue;
            sb.Append("<section>\n<h2>").Append(E(group.Title.In(lang))).Append("</h2>\n<p class=\"caption\">").Append(E(group.Caption.In(lang))).Append("</p>\n<ol start=\"").Append(n + 1).Append("\">\n");
            foreach (var s in mine)
            {
                n++;
                var item = s.Item;
                string state = s.State switch { BiosState.Done => "done", BiosState.ToDo => "todo", _ => "unknown" };
                string level = item.Level switch { BiosLevel.Required => "required", BiosLevel.Recommended => "recommended", _ => "optional" };
                sb.Append("<li class=\"item ").Append(state).Append("\">\n<div class=\"head\"><span class=\"chip ").Append(state).Append("\">")
                  .Append(E(T("state-" + state))).Append("</span> <strong>").Append(E(item.Title.In(lang))).Append("</strong> <span class=\"level\">")
                  .Append(E(T("level-" + level))).Append("</span></div>\n");
                sb.Append("<div class=\"want\">&rarr; ").Append(E(item.Want.In(lang))).Append("</div>\n");
                var path = item.PathFor(vendor.Id, lang);
                if (path.Length > 0) sb.Append("<div><span class=\"k\">").Append(E(T("where"))).Append(":</span> <code>").Append(E(path)).Append("</code></div>\n");
                sb.Append("<div><span class=\"k\">").Append(E(T("seen"))).Append(":</span> ").Append(E(s.Seen.In(data, lang))).Append("</div>\n");
                sb.Append("<p>").Append(E(item.Why.In(lang))).Append("</p>\n");
                if (item.Missing is { } m) sb.Append("<p class=\"missing\"><span class=\"k\">").Append(E(T("missing"))).Append(":</span> ").Append(E(m.In(lang))).Append("</p>\n");
                var links = item.Sources.Select(id => data.Sources.TryGetValue(BiosSteps.SourceFor(id, facts), out var src) ? src : null).Where(x => x is not null).ToList();
                if (links.Count > 0)
                {
                    sb.Append("<p class=\"sources\"><span class=\"k\">").Append(E(T("sources"))).Append(":</span> ");
                    sb.Append(string.Join(" · ", links.Select(src => "<a href=\"" + E(src!.Url) + "\" title=\"" + E(src.Title) + "\">" + E(src.Short.In(lang)) + "</a>")));
                    sb.Append("</p>\n");
                }
                sb.Append("</li>\n");
            }
            sb.Append("</ol>\n</section>\n");
        }
        sb.Append("<footer>").Append(E(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, T("footer"), made.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)))).Append("</footer>\n");
        sb.Append("</main>\n</body>\n</html>\n");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    const string Style = """

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Bios/BiosSteps.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The BIOS page's data and judgement: bios-steps.json (embedded at build time) lists the Windows traps and firmware
// settings macOS with this driver needs, each with its sources, its menu path per board maker and the fact that tells
// whether it is done. Evaluate() takes what the Overview read from Windows (PcFacts) and gives each item a state: done,
// to do, or cannot tell (Windows does not see most firmware settings). Nothing here changes a setting.
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Bios;

public enum BiosState { ToDo, Done, CannotTell }

public enum BiosLevel { Required, Recommended, Optional }

/// A text in English and Turkish ("en", "tr"); English when the other is missing.
public sealed class LocalText
{
    [JsonPropertyName("en")] public string En { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("tr")] public string Tr { get; set; } = "";

    public string In(string lang) => lang == "tr" && Tr.Length > 0 ? Tr : En;
}

/// A menu path: the same in both languages (the firmware's own menu names), or a text in each.
[JsonConverter(typeof(MenuPathConverter))]
public sealed class MenuPath
{
    public string? Same { get; init; }
    public LocalText? Text { get; init; }
    public string In(string lang) => Same ?? Text?.In(lang) ?? "";
}

sealed class MenuPathConverter : JsonConverter<MenuPath>
{
    public override MenuPath Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options) =>
        reader.TokenType == JsonTokenType.String
            ? new MenuPath { Same = reader.GetString() }
            : new MenuPath { Text = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<LocalText>(ref reader, options) };

    public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer, MenuPath value, JsonSerializerOptions options)
    {
        if (value.Same is not null) writer.WriteStringValue(value.Same);
        else JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, value.Text, options);
    }
}

public sealed class BiosSource
{
    [JsonPropertyName("url")] public string Url { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("title")] public string Title { get; set; } = "";
    /// the link's text on the page ("Guide: hardware", "Dortania: BIOS settings")
    [JsonPropertyName("short")] public LocalText Short { get; set; } = new();
    /// the repository file the source is (for the tests: it must exist, with its anchor)
    [JsonPropertyName("file")] public string? File { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("anchor")] public string? Anchor { get; set; }
}

public sealed class BiosVendor
{
    [JsonPropertyName("id")] public string Id { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("name")] public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    /// upper-case prefixes of Win32_BaseBoard.Manufacturer ("ASUSTeK COMPUTER INC.", "Micro-Star International Co., Ltd.")
    [JsonPropertyName("match")] public List<string> Match { get; set; } = [];
    [JsonPropertyName("setup_key")] public string SetupKey { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("boot_menu_key")] public string BootMenuKey { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("advanced_key")] public string AdvancedKey { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("save_key")] public string SaveKey { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("note")] public LocalText Note { get; set; } = new();
}

public sealed class BiosGroup
{
    [JsonPropertyName("id")] public string Id { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("title")] public LocalText Title { get; set; } = new();
    [JsonPropertyName("caption")] public LocalText Caption { get; set; } = new();
}

public sealed class BiosItem
{
    [JsonPropertyName("id")] public string Id { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("group")] public string Group { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("level")] public string LevelName { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("fact")] public string Fact { get; set; } = "none";
    /// "intel": only for Intel CPUs (hidden on an AMD CPU)
    [JsonPropertyName("cpu")] public string? Cpu { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("sources")] public List<string> Sources { get; set; } = [];
    [JsonPropertyName("title")] public LocalText Title { get; set; } = new();
    [JsonPropertyName("want")] public LocalText Want { get; set; } = new();
    [JsonPropertyName("why")] public LocalText Why { get; set; } = new();
    [JsonPropertyName("missing")] public LocalText? Missing { get; set; }
    /// vendor id -> path; "generic" for the others
    [JsonPropertyName("paths")] public Dictionary<string, MenuPath> Paths { get; set; } = [];

    public BiosLevel Level => LevelName switch
    {
        "required" => BiosLevel.Required,
        "recommended" => BiosLevel.Recommended,
        "optional" => BiosLevel.Optional,
        _ => throw new InvalidDataException($"bios-steps.json: item {Id} has no level required|recommended|optional"),
    };

    /// The path on this vendor's firmware, else the generic hint.
    public string PathFor(string vendor, string lang) =>
        (Paths.TryGetValue(vendor, out var p) ? p : Paths.TryGetValue("generic", out var g) ? g : null)?.In(lang) ?? "";
}

public sealed class BiosData
{
    [JsonPropertyName("about")] public string About { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("sources")] public Dictionary<string, BiosSource> Sources { get; set; } = [];
    [JsonPropertyName("vendors")] public List<BiosVendor> Vendors { get; set; } = [];
    [JsonPropertyName("groups")] public List<BiosGroup> Groups { get; set; } = [];
    [JsonPropertyName("seen")] public Dictionary<string, LocalText> Seen { get; set; } = [];
    [JsonPropertyName("page")] public Dictionary<string, LocalText> Page { get; set; } = [];
    [JsonPropertyName("items")] public List<BiosItem> Items { get; set; } = [];

    public string PageText(string key, string lang) => Page.TryGetValue(key, out var t) ? t.In(lang) : key;
}

/// What Windows shows about one item: a key of "seen" and its arguments.
public sealed record BiosSeen(string Key, params object[] Args)
{
    public string In(BiosData data, string lang) =>
        data.Seen.TryGetValue(Key, out var t) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, t.In(lang), Args) : Key;
}

/// One item for this PC: the item, its state, what Windows shows, and its path on this board's firmware.
public sealed record BiosStep(BiosItem Item, BiosState State, BiosSeen Seen);

public static class BiosSteps
{
    /// The facts the items can name; "none" for a setting Windows cannot see.
    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> Facts =
    [
        "none", "bitlocker", "windows-uefi", "storage-ahci", "secure-boot", "csm", "above4g", "rebar", "igpu", "vtd", "vtx",
        "hyperthreading", "nx",
    ];

    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> VendorIds = ["asus", "msi", "gigabyte", "asrock", "generic"];

    static BiosData? embedded;

    /// bios-steps.json as built into the Core.
    public static BiosData Embedded => embedded ??= Load(typeof(BiosSteps).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("IntelXe.Core.bios-steps.json")
        ?? throw new InvalidDataException("bios-steps.json is not built into the Core"));

    public static BiosData Load(Stream json) =>
        JsonSerializer.Deserialize<BiosData>(json) ?? throw new InvalidDataException("bios-steps.json is empty");

    /// "en" or "tr" for a UI language ("tr-TR" and the like).
    public static string Lang(string? uiLanguage) => uiLanguage?.StartsWith("tr", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true ? "tr" : "en";

    /// The board maker's vendor id by Win32_BaseBoard.Manufacturer: asus, msi, gigabyte, asrock, or generic.
    public static string VendorOf(BiosData data, string? maker)
    {
        var m = (maker ?? "").Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        if (m.Length == 0) return "generic";
        foreach (var v in data.Vendors)
            if (v.Match.Any(x => m.StartsWith(x, StringComparison.Ordinal))) return v.Id;
        return "generic";
    }

    public static BiosVendor Vendor(BiosData data, string id) =>
        data.Vendors.FirstOrDefault(v => v.Id == id) ?? data.Vendors.First(v => v.Id == "generic");

    /// The Dortania BIOS page for this CPU: the Coffee Lake page for 8th and 9th gen, else the Comet Lake page (the
    /// guide uses it for 10th to 14th gen, which Dortania has no own desktop page for).
    public static string SourceFor(string sourceId, PcFacts? f) =>
        sourceId == "dortania-bios" && f is not null && CpuInfo.Family(f.CpuName).Generation is 8 or 9 ? "dortania-bios-coffee" : sourceId;

    /// Every item that applies to this PC, in the file's order (the Windows traps first), with its state.
    public static IReadOnlyList<BiosStep> Evaluate(BiosData data, PcFacts f)
    {
        bool amd = CpuInfo.Vendor(f.CpuName) == CpuVendor.Amd;
        var list = new List<BiosStep>();
        foreach (var group in data.Groups)
            foreach (var item in data.Items.Where(i => i.Group == group.Id))
            {
                if (item.Cpu == "intel" && amd) continue;
                var (state, seen) = Judge(item.Fact, f);
                list.Add(new BiosStep(item, state, seen));
            }
        return list;
    }

    static (BiosState, BiosSeen) Judge(string fact, PcFacts f)
    {
        switch (fact)
        {
            case "bitlocker":
                return f.BitLocker switch
                {
                    BitLockerState.Off => (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("bitlocker-off")),
                    BitLockerState.WaitingForActivation => (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("bitlocker-waiting")),
                    BitLockerState.Unknown => (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("bitlocker-unknown")),
                    // suspended protection reads as Paused only while encryption is paused; On stays "to do": the
                    // app cannot tell a suspended protector from Explorer's value
                    _ => (BiosState.ToDo, new BiosSeen("bitlocker-on")),
                };
            case "windows-uefi":
                return f.Firmware switch
                {
                    FirmwareMode.Uefi => (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("uefi")),
                    FirmwareMode.Legacy => (BiosState.ToDo, new BiosSeen("legacy")),
                    _ => (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("firmware-unknown")),
                };
            case "storage-ahci":
                if (f.StorageControllers is null) return (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("storage-unknown"));
                var raid = f.StorageControllers.Where(IsRaidController).ToList();
                return raid.Count > 0
                    ? (BiosState.ToDo, new BiosSeen("storage-raid", string.Join(", ", raid)))
                    : (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("storage-ahci", string.Join(", ", f.StorageControllers.Distinct())));
            case "secure-boot":
                return f.SecureBoot switch
                {
                    SecureBootState.Off => (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("secureboot-off")),
                    SecureBootState.On => (BiosState.ToDo, new BiosSeen("secureboot-on")),
                    SecureBootState.NotSupported => (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("secureboot-legacy")),
                    _ => (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("secureboot-unknown")),
                };
            case "csm":
                // Windows cannot read CSM; but legacy mode needs it on, and Secure Boot only runs with it off
                if (f.Firmware == FirmwareMode.Legacy) return (BiosState.ToDo, new BiosSeen("csm-legacy"));
                if (f.Firmware == FirmwareMode.Uefi && f.SecureBoot == SecureBootState.On) return (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("csm-off"));
                return f.Firmware == FirmwareMode.Uefi ? (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("csm-unknown")) : (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("firmware-unknown"));
            case "above4g":
                if (f.Bar is null) return (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("bar-unknown"));
                return f.Bar.Above4G ? (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("above4g-on")) : (BiosState.ToDo, new BiosSeen("above4g-off"));
            case "rebar":
                if (f.Bar is null) return (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("bar-unknown"));
                return f.Bar.ResizableBar ? (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("rebar-on", f.Bar.LargestMb)) : (BiosState.ToDo, new BiosSeen("rebar-off", f.Bar.LargestMb));
            case "igpu":
                var igpu = f.IntegratedGpus.Select(g => g.Name).ToList();
                return igpu.Count > 0 ? (BiosState.ToDo, new BiosSeen("igpu-on", string.Join(", ", igpu))) : (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("igpu-off"));
            case "vtd":
                return f.DmarTable switch
                {
                    true => (BiosState.ToDo, new BiosSeen("vtd-on")),
                    false => (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("vtd-off")),
                    null => (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("vtd-unknown")),
                };
            case "vtx":
                // false is not "off": Windows reports false while Hyper-V or VBS runs
                return f.VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled == true ? (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("vtx-on")) : (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("vtx-unknown"));
            case "hyperthreading":
                if (f.Cores is not int c || f.Threads is not int t || c <= 0) return (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("ht-notread"));
                return t > c ? (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("ht-on", c, t)) : (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("ht-unknown", c));
            case "nx":
                return f.Windows is null ? (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("none")) : (BiosState.Done, new BiosSeen("nx"));
            case "none":
                return (BiosState.CannotTell, new BiosSeen("none"));
            default:
                throw new InvalidDataException("bios-steps.json names an unknown fact: " + fact);
        }
    }

    /// A storage controller in RAID mode, Intel RST or VMD, by its name ("Intel(R) RST VMD Controller 9A0B",
    /// "Intel(R) Chipset SATA/PCIe RST Premium Controller", "Volume Management Device NVMe RAID Controller").
    public static bool IsRaidController(string name) =>
        System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(name, @"\bRAID\b|\bRST\b|\bVMD\b|Volume Management Device|Rapid Storage|Optane",
            System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);

    /// "3 to do, 5 done, 9 to check in the firmware."
    public static (int ToDo, int Done, int CannotTell) Count(IEnumerable<BiosStep> steps)
    {
        var l = steps.ToList();
        return (l.Count(s => s.State == BiosState.ToDo), l.Count(s => s.State == BiosState.Done), l.Count(s => s.State == BiosState.CannotTell));
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Efi/BootLogging.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core.Efi;

/// Boot logging on an EFI, as its status says (boot_logging of IntelXe-EFI.ps1 -Status and efi.sh --status): on (the
/// bootlog change has nothing left to do), off (bootlog-off has nothing left to do), partly on, Misc > Debug missing (no
/// change can be made), or not known (the EFI was not read, or could not be).
public enum BootLogState { Unknown, Missing, Off, Partial, On }

/// The EFI page's boot logging section: what it shows and which of its two changes it offers.
///
/// Turning it off is its own change (EfiChange.BootLogOff), never undo: undo puts back the newest backup's whole
/// config.plist, which is the boot logging change's only while nothing was changed after it (stage 4 after the logs were
/// turned on, or an edit in another tool, would be undone instead, or lost). The off change touches only the log file
/// bit of Misc > Debug > Target, AppleDebug and ApplePanic, and has its own backup that undo can take back.
public static class BootLogging
{
    public static BootLogState State(EfiStatus? status) => status?["boot_logging"] switch
    {
        "on" => BootLogState.On,
        "off" => BootLogState.Off,
        "partial" => BootLogState.Partial,
        "missing" => BootLogState.Missing,
        _ => BootLogState.Unknown,
    };

    /// "Turn on" unless it is on, or cannot be (no Misc > Debug). Not known: offered, and the plan says what it would do.
    public static bool CanTurnOn(BootLogState s) => s is BootLogState.Unknown or BootLogState.Off or BootLogState.Partial;

    /// "Turn off" unless it is off, or cannot be.
    public static bool CanTurnOff(BootLogState s) => s is BootLogState.Unknown or BootLogState.On or BootLogState.Partial;

    /// The key of the state's text in the app's string tables.
    public static string Key(BootLogState s) => s switch
    {
        BootLogState.On => "Efi_BootLog_On",
        BootLogState.Off => "Efi_BootLog_Off",
        BootLogState.Partial => "Efi_BootLog_Partial",
        BootLogState.Missing => "Efi_BootLog_Missing",
        _ => "Efi_BootLog_Unknown",
    };

    /// The keys Key can give (the string tables must have them all).
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Keys { get; } = Enum.GetValues<BootLogState>().Select(Key).ToList();
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Efi/EfiHelper.cs
