// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The elevated helper's side, without Windows APIs: its command line, what it does (mount, read or plan or change,
// unmount) and its answer. The app starts its own exe with "--efi-helper" through "runas" for an EFI partition: only
// that process has administrator rights, and only for one mount + plan, or mount + backup + change + unmount. A change
// is given the plan's SHA-256 (--expect) and refuses when the EFI no longer gives that plan. The mounting itself is
// IEspMounter (mountvol in the app; a fake in the tests).
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using IntelXeEfi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Efi;

/// An EFI partition mounted for the helper: its drive letter ("S:"), the folder that holds its EFI folder ("S:\"), and
/// whether the helper mounted it (then it unmounts it again; one that had a letter already stays as it was).
public sealed record MountedEsp(string Letter, string Root, bool MountedHere);

/// Mounting an EFI partition by its disk and partition number: at the letter asked for (the one the plan was made at),
/// or a free one; it must refuse a partition that is not an EFI system partition.
public interface IEspMounter
{
    MountedEsp Mount(uint disk, uint partition, string? letter);
    void Unmount(MountedEsp esp);
}

public enum EfiHelperVerb { Status, Plan, Apply }

/// One helper run: the verb, the EFI (a folder, or a partition with the letter of the plan), the change, the plan's hash
/// for Apply, the options, and the file the answer goes to.
public sealed record EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb Verb, EfiTarget Target, EfiChange Change, EfiOptions Options,
    string? Letter = null, string? Expect = null, string? Out = null)
{
    public const string Switch = "--efi-helper";

    public IReadOnlyList<string> ToArgs()
    {
        var a = new List<string> { Switch, Verb.ToString().ToLowerInvariant() };
        if (Verb != EfiHelperVerb.Status) a.AddRange(["--change", Change.Kind()]);
        switch (Target)
        {
            case EfiTarget.Folder f: a.AddRange(["--folder", f.Path]); break;
            case EfiTarget.Partition p:
                a.AddRange(["--disk", p.DiskNumber.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "--partition", p.PartitionNumber.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)]);
                break;
        }
        void Add(string name, string? value) { if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) a.AddRange([name, value]); }
        Add("--letter", Letter);
        Add("--expect", Expect);
        Add("--package", Options.PackageDir);
        Add("--card", Options.CardAcpiPath);
        Add("--detected", Options.CardDetected);
        Add("--cpu", Options.Cpu);
        Add("--backup-root", Options.BackupRoot);
        Add("--probe-device", Options.ProbeDevice);
        if (Options.BootPathRecorded) a.Add("--boot-path-recorded");
        Add("--out", Out);
        return a;
    }

    /// The helper's command line (args[0] is --efi-helper); an error names what is wrong.
    public static EfiHelperRequest Parse(IReadOnlyList<string> args)
    {
        if (args.Count < 2 || args[0] != Switch) throw new EfiException("the helper's command line starts with " + Switch + " status|plan|apply");
        var verb = args[1] switch
        {
            "status" => EfiHelperVerb.Status,
            "plan" => EfiHelperVerb.Plan,
            "apply" => EfiHelperVerb.Apply,
            _ => throw new EfiException("no helper verb " + args[1] + " (status, plan, apply)"),
        };
        var values = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        bool bootPath = false;
        string[] known = ["--change", "--folder", "--disk", "--partition", "--letter", "--expect", "--package", "--card", "--detected", "--cpu", "--backup-root", "--probe-device", "--out"];
        for (int i = 2; i < args.Count; i++)
        {
            if (args[i] == "--boot-path-recorded") { bootPath = true; continue; }
            if (!known.Contains(args[i]) || i + 1 >= args.Count) throw new EfiException("the helper does not take " + args[i] + (i + 1 >= args.Count ? " without a value" : ""));
            if (!values.TryAdd(args[i], args[i + 1])) throw new EfiException("the helper takes " + args[i] + " once");
            i++;
        }
        string? V(string k) => values.TryGetValue(k, out var v) ? v : null;
        EfiTarget target;
        if (V("--folder") is { } folder)
        {
            if (V("--disk") is not null || V("--partition") is not null) throw new EfiException("the helper takes --folder or --disk and --partition, not both");
            target = new EfiTarget.Folder(folder);
        }
        else if (uint.TryParse(V("--disk"), NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var disk)
                 && uint.TryParse(V("--partition"), NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var part))
            target = new EfiTarget.Partition(disk, part);
        else throw new EfiException("the helper needs --folder, or --disk and --partition (numbers)");
        var change = EfiChange.Settings;
        if (verb != EfiHelperVerb.Status)
            change = EfiChanges.FromKind(V("--change")) ?? throw new EfiException("the helper needs --change settings|safari|settings-safari|driver|bootlog|bootlog-off|xeprobe|xeprobe-off|undo");
        if (verb == EfiHelperVerb.Apply && string.IsNullOrEmpty(V("--expect"))) throw new EfiException("nothing changed: the helper needs the plan's SHA-256 (--expect)");
        var letter = V("--letter");
        if (letter is not null && !IsLetter(letter)) throw new EfiException("not a drive letter: " + letter);
        var options = new EfiOptions(V("--package") ?? "", V("--card") ?? "", V("--detected") ?? "", V("--cpu") ?? "", bootPath, V("--backup-root"), V("--probe-device") ?? "");
        return new EfiHelperRequest(verb, target, change, options, letter?.ToUpperInvariant(), V("--expect"), V("--out"));
    }

    public static bool IsLetter(string s) => s.Length == 2 && char.IsAsciiLetter(s[0]) && s[1] == ':';
}

/// The helper's answer, written as JSON to the request's --out file: what it read, planned or did, or why it could not.
public sealed class EfiHelperResult
{
    [JsonPropertyName("ok")] public bool Ok { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("error")] public string? Error { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("letter")] public string? Letter { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("status")] public Dictionary<string, string>? Status { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("plan")] public PlanData? Plan { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("lines")] public List<string>? Lines { get; set; }
    /// What went wrong after the work was done (the partition could not be unmounted): the answer stands, with this.
    [JsonPropertyName("warning")] public string? Warning { get; set; }

    public sealed class PlanData
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("change")] public string Change { get; set; } = "";
        [JsonPropertyName("text")] public string Text { get; set; } = "";
        [JsonPropertyName("lines")] public List<string> Lines { get; set; } = [];
        [JsonPropertyName("notes")] public List<string> Notes { get; set; } = [];
        [JsonPropertyName("hash")] public string Hash { get; set; } = "";
        [JsonPropertyName("has_changes")] public bool HasChanges { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("backup_dir")] public string BackupDir { get; set; } = "";
    }

    static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Json = new() { WriteIndented = true, DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull };

    public string ToJson() => JsonSerializer.Serialize(this, Json);
    public static EfiHelperResult FromJson(string json) => JsonSerializer.Deserialize<EfiHelperResult>(json, Json)
        ?? throw new EfiException("the helper's answer is empty");

    public EfiPlan ToPlan(EfiTarget target)
    {
        var p = Plan ?? throw new EfiException("the helper's answer has no plan");
        var change = EfiChanges.FromKind(p.Change) ?? throw new EfiException("the helper's answer names no change");
        return new EfiPlan(target, change, p.Text, p.Lines, p.Notes, p.Hash, p.HasChanges, p.BackupDir, Letter);
    }

    public EfiStatus ToStatus() => new(Status?.GetValueOrDefault("efi_readable") == "yes", Status ?? new Dictionary<string, string>());
}

public static class EfiHelper
{
    /// Does what the request says: for a partition, mount it (at the plan's letter for a change), work on its EFI folder,
    /// and unmount it again whatever happened (when this run mounted it).
    public static EfiHelperResult Run(EfiHelperRequest q, IEspMounter? mounter, Rules? rules = null)
    {
        var r = new EfiHelperResult();
        try
        {
            MountedEsp? esp = null;
            string efi;
            if (q.Target is EfiTarget.Folder f) efi = f.Path;
            else
            {
                var p = (EfiTarget.Partition)q.Target;
                if (mounter is null) throw new EfiException("this helper cannot mount an EFI partition");
                esp = mounter.Mount(p.DiskNumber, p.PartitionNumber, q.Letter);
                r.Letter = esp.Letter;
                efi = esp.Root;
            }
            try
            {
                // the plan names the EFI by its path: a change must see it at the same letter
                if (esp is not null && q.Verb == EfiHelperVerb.Apply && q.Letter is not null && !string.Equals(esp.Letter, q.Letter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    throw new EfiException($"the EFI partition was mounted at {esp.Letter}, not at {q.Letter} as for the plan: nothing changed. Show the plan again");
                switch (q.Verb)
                {
                    case EfiHelperVerb.Status:
                        r.Status = new Dictionary<string, string>(EfiWork.Status(efi, q.Options, rules).Values);
                        break;
                    case EfiHelperVerb.Plan:
                        var plan = EfiWork.Plan(q.Target, efi, q.Change, q.Options, rules, esp?.Letter);
                        r.Plan = new EfiHelperResult.PlanData
                        {
                            Change = plan.Change.Kind(), Text = plan.Text, Lines = [.. plan.Lines], Notes = [.. plan.Notes],
                            Hash = plan.Hash, HasChanges = plan.HasChanges, BackupDir = plan.BackupDir,
                        };
                        break;
                    case EfiHelperVerb.Apply:
                        r.Lines = [.. EfiWork.Apply(efi, q.Change, q.Expect ?? "", q.Options, rules).Lines];
                        break;
                }
                r.Ok = true;
            }
            finally
            {
                // a change that was made stays reported as made when only the unmounting fails
                if (esp is { MountedHere: true })
                    try { mounter!.Unmount(esp); }
                    catch (Exception e) { r.Warning = $"the EFI partition stays mounted at {esp.Letter}: {Message(e)}"; }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            r.Ok = false;
            r.Error = Message(e);
        }
        return r;
    }

    /// The engine's own message, not a wrapper's.
    public static string Message(Exception e)
    {
        while (e is AggregateException { InnerException: { } inner }) e = inner;
        return e.Message;
    }
}

/// A Windows command line from separate arguments, quoted so that the C runtime's and .NET's parsers give them back as
/// they were (backslashes before a quote doubled; a path ending in a backslash keeps it).
public static class CommandLine
{
    public static string Join(IEnumerable<string> args) => string.Join(" ", args.Select(Quote));

    public static string Quote(string arg)
    {
        if (arg.Length > 0 && arg.IndexOfAny([' ', '\t', '\n', '\v', '"']) < 0) return arg;
        var sb = new StringBuilder("\"");
        int slashes = 0;
        foreach (char c in arg)
        {
            if (c == '\\') { slashes++; continue; }
            if (c == '"') { sb.Append('\\', 2 * slashes + 1).Append('"'); slashes = 0; continue; }
            sb.Append('\\', slashes).Append(c);
            slashes = 0;
        }
        sb.Append('\\', 2 * slashes).Append('"');
        return sb.ToString();
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using IntelXeEfi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Efi;

/// What the app knows about a package: its folder (the unpacked intel-gpu-macos-driver-VERSION-efi.zip), the version of
/// its IntelXe.kext and HybridPM.kext, and its files against its SHA256SUMS as the engine checks them before a change
/// ("ok", "no SHA256SUMS", or what differs; every file of the two kexts and the table must be listed and match).
public sealed record EfiPackageInfo(string Dir, string? Problem, string Checksums, string KextVersion, string HybridPMVersion)
{
    public bool Usable => Problem is null && (Checksums == "ok" || Checksums == "no SHA256SUMS");
}

/// Finding the package: a folder the user picks (the unpacked -efi.zip, or a folder holding it), the zip itself
/// (unpacked into the app's cache), or one beside the app.
public static class EfiPackage
{
    /// Does DIR hold EFI/OC/Kexts/IntelXe.kext's executable (by the rules' names)?
    public static bool IsPackage(string dir, Rules? rules = null)
    {
        var r = rules ?? EfiRules.Embedded;
        try
        {
            return File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir, "EFI", "OC", Util.Native(r.Str("kext.folder")), r.Str("kext.bundle"), Util.Native(r.Str("kext.executable"))));
        }
        catch (Exception) { return false; }
    }

    /// DIR when it is a package, else the one package folder right inside it (the zip's top folder); null otherwise.
    public static string? FindIn(string dir, Rules? rules = null)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(dir)) return null;
        if (IsPackage(dir, rules)) return Path.GetFullPath(dir);
        var inside = Directory.GetDirectories(dir).Where(d => IsPackage(d, rules)).ToList();
        return inside.Count == 1 ? Path.GetFullPath(inside[0]) : null;
    }

    /// A package beside the app: the app's folder, the folder above it (the app inside the unpacked -efi.zip), or a
    /// package folder in either.
    public static string? FindBeside(string appDir, Rules? rules = null)
    {
        var parent = Directory.GetParent(Path.GetFullPath(appDir).TrimEnd('\\', '/'))?.FullName;
        foreach (var d in new[] { appDir, parent })
            if (d is not null && FindIn(d, rules) is { } p) return p;
        return null;
    }

    /// The -efi.zip unpacked into CACHE/<the zip's SHA-256>/ (once; a half-unpacked folder is unpacked again), and the
    /// package in it. Every entry must stay inside that folder.
    public static string Unzip(string zip, string cache, Rules? rules = null)
    {
        string sha;
        using (var s = File.OpenRead(zip)) sha = Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(s));
        var dest = Path.Combine(cache, sha[..16]);
        var done = Path.Combine(dest, ".unpacked");
        if (!File.Exists(done))
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(dest)) Util.Delete(dest);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dest);
            var root = Path.GetFullPath(dest) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
            using var archive = ZipFile.OpenRead(zip);
            foreach (var e in archive.Entries)
            {
                var to = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(dest, e.FullName.Replace('\\', '/').Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar)));
                if (!to.StartsWith(root, StringComparison.Ordinal)) throw new EfiException("the zip names a file outside its folder: " + e.FullName);
                if (e.FullName.EndsWith('/')) { Directory.CreateDirectory(to); continue; }
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(to)!);
                e.ExtractToFile(to, false);
            }
            File.WriteAllText(done, zip + "\n");
        }
        return FindIn(dest, rules) ?? throw new EfiException("no EFI/OC/Kexts/IntelXe.kext in " + Path.GetFileName(zip) + ": not an intel-gpu-macos-driver -efi.zip");
    }

    /// The package's state, by the engine (EfiFolder.CheckSums, KextVersion): the package folder itself is taken as the
    /// "EFI" here, nothing is written.
    public static EfiPackageInfo Inspect(string dir, Rules? rules = null)
    {
        var r = rules ?? EfiRules.Embedded;
        try
        {
            var f = new EfiFolder(dir, dir, Path.GetTempPath(), r);
            if (f.PackageProblem is { } problem) return new EfiPackageInfo(dir, problem, "no package", "", "");
            return new EfiPackageInfo(f.PackageDir, null, f.CheckSums(), EfiFolder.KextVersion(f.PackageKext),
                f.HpmPackage ? EfiFolder.KextVersion(f.PackageHpm) : "");
        }
        catch (Exception e) { return new EfiPackageInfo(dir, e.Message, "no package", "", ""); }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Text.Json;
using IntelXeEfi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Efi;

/// efi-rules.json (release/templates/; docs/design/DESIGN-efi-rules.md), embedded in the Core at build time as
/// data/platforms.json is. Read with System.Text.Json into the plain tree the engine's Rules class takes: the same tree
/// IntelXe-EFI.ps1 makes with ConvertFrom-Json (ConvertTo-RulesTree): dictionaries in the file's order, lists, strings,
/// long integers and booleans. A fraction or a null is refused, as the script refuses them.
public static class EfiRules
{
    static readonly Lazy<Rules> embedded = new(() =>
    {
        using var s = typeof(EfiRules).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("IntelXe.Core.efi-rules.json")
            ?? throw new EfiException("efi-rules.json is not embedded in IntelXe.Core");
        using var r = new StreamReader(s);
        return Parse(r.ReadToEnd(), "efi-rules.json (built in)");
    });

    /// The rules this build carries.
    public static Rules Embedded => embedded.Value;

    /// The rules' revision ("revision"), for messages and reports.
    public static long Revision(Rules r) => r.Int("revision");

    public static Rules Load(string path) => Parse(File.ReadAllText(path), path);

    public static Rules Parse(string json, string source)
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
        return Rules.FromTree(Tree(doc.RootElement, "rules"), source);
    }

    /// Any JSON value as the engine's tree (also the test vectors').
    public static object Tree(JsonElement e, string at)
    {
        switch (e.ValueKind)
        {
            case JsonValueKind.Object:
                var d = new Dictionary<string, object>();
                foreach (var p in e.EnumerateObject()) d[p.Name] = Tree(p.Value, at + "." + p.Name);
                return d;
            case JsonValueKind.Array:
                var l = new List<object>();
                int i = 0;
                foreach (var x in e.EnumerateArray()) l.Add(Tree(x, at + "." + i++));
                return l;
            case JsonValueKind.String: return e.GetString()!;
            case JsonValueKind.True: return true;
            case JsonValueKind.False: return false;
            case JsonValueKind.Number when e.TryGetInt64(out long n): return n;
        }
        throw new EfiException("JSON: " + at + " is not a string, an integer, a boolean, an object or a list");
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using IntelXeEfi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Efi;

/// Status, plan and change of one EFI folder through the engine of IntelXe-EFI.ps1 (EfiFolder): the same lines, notes,
/// plan hash, backups and undo as the script, because it is the same code. No Windows APIs; the folder may be on a USB
/// stick or on an EFI partition mounted by the caller.
public static class EfiWork
{
    /// The engine on this EFI folder with these options (EfiFolder takes the EFI folder, the folder or drive above it).
    public static EfiFolder Open(string efiPath, EfiOptions o, Rules? rules = null)
    {
        var f = new EfiFolder(efiPath, o.PackageDir, o.BackupRoot ?? "", rules ?? EfiRules.Embedded);
        if (o.CardAcpiPath.Trim().Length > 0) f.SetCard(o.CardAcpiPath);
        f.CardDetected = o.CardDetected;
        f.Cpu = o.Cpu;
        f.BootPathRecorded = o.BootPathRecorded;
        f.ProbeDevice = o.ProbeDevice;
        return f;
    }

    public static EfiStatus Status(string efiPath, EfiOptions o, Rules? rules = null)
    {
        var values = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var line in Open(efiPath, o, rules).Status())
        {
            int i = line.IndexOf('=');
            if (i > 0) values[line[..i]] = line[(i + 1)..];
        }
        return new EfiStatus(values.GetValueOrDefault("efi_readable") == "yes", values);
    }

    public static EfiPlan Plan(EfiTarget target, string efiPath, EfiChange change, EfiOptions o, Rules? rules = null, string? letter = null)
    {
        var f = Open(efiPath, o, rules);
        return From(target, change, f.MakePlan(change.Kind()), f.BackupDir, letter);
    }

    public static EfiPlan From(EfiTarget target, EfiChange change, Plan p, string backupDir, string? letter = null) =>
        new(target, change, p.Text, p.Lines.ToArray(), p.Notes.ToArray(), p.Hash, p.HasChanges, backupDir, letter);

    /// The change (undo too) when the plan is still the one with this hash: EfiFolder.Run, which backs up the whole EFI
    /// folder first and refuses a package whose files differ from its SHA256SUMS.
    public static EfiResult Apply(string efiPath, EfiChange change, string expectedHash, EfiOptions o, Rules? rules = null)
    {
        var lines = new List<string>();
        Open(efiPath, o, rules).Run(change.Kind(), expectedHash, lines.Add);
        return new EfiResult(lines);
    }
}

/// The planner for EFI folders, in this process: a USB stick's EFI folder or a copy needs no administrator rights. An EFI
/// partition needs mounting, which the app's elevated helper does (EfiHelper).
public sealed class FolderEfiPlanner(Rules? rules = null) : IEfiPlanner
{
    readonly Rules rules = rules ?? EfiRules.Embedded;

    public bool IsAvailable => true;
    public string RulesVersion => "efi-rules " + EfiRules.Revision(rules);

    static string Folder(EfiTarget t) => t is EfiTarget.Folder f
        ? f.Path
        : throw new EfiUnavailableException("an EFI partition is mounted by the elevated helper, not in this process");

    public Task<EfiStatus> ReadStatusAsync(EfiTarget target, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default) =>
        Task.Run(() => EfiWork.Status(Folder(target), options, rules), cancel);

    public Task<EfiPlan> PlanAsync(EfiTarget target, EfiChange change, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default) =>
        Task.Run(() => EfiWork.Plan(target, Folder(target), change, options, rules), cancel);

    public Task<EfiResult> ApplyAsync(EfiPlan plan, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default) =>
        Task.Run(() => EfiWork.Apply(Folder(plan.Target), plan.Change, plan.Hash, options, rules), cancel);
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core.Efi;

/// The changes the EFI page offers: stage 2 (the settings), the Safari setting (alone or with stage 2, one backup and one
/// restart), stage 4 (the driver's files), undo, and opt-in boot logging (OpenCore's log and macOS panics saved on the
/// EFI) with its own change that turns it off again. The same as IntelXe-EFI.ps1 -Plan settings|safari|settings-safari|
/// driver|bootlog|bootlog-off|undo and efi.sh. XeProbe/XeProbeOff: the boot-arg xeprobe=0xDEVICE for the staged probe of a GPU
/// not supported yet (docs/PROBE-MODE.md; EfiOptions.ProbeDevice) and its removal; the macOS app offers them, this one
/// plans them for the shared vectors and the helper.
public enum EfiChange { Settings, Safari, SettingsSafari, Driver, Undo, BootLog, BootLogOff, XeProbe, XeProbeOff }

public static class EfiChanges
{
    /// The plan's name in the engine, the script and efi-rules.json's backup_kinds.
    public static string Kind(this EfiChange c) => c switch
    {
        EfiChange.Settings => "settings",
        EfiChange.Safari => "safari",
        EfiChange.SettingsSafari => "settings-safari",
        EfiChange.Driver => "driver",
        EfiChange.BootLog => "bootlog",
        EfiChange.BootLogOff => "bootlog-off",
        EfiChange.XeProbe => "xeprobe",
        EfiChange.XeProbeOff => "xeprobe-off",
        _ => "undo",
    };

    public static EfiChange? FromKind(string? kind) => kind switch
    {
        "settings" => EfiChange.Settings,
        "safari" => EfiChange.Safari,
        "settings-safari" => EfiChange.SettingsSafari,
        "driver" => EfiChange.Driver,
        "bootlog" => EfiChange.BootLog,
        "bootlog-off" => EfiChange.BootLogOff,
        "xeprobe" => EfiChange.XeProbe,
        "xeprobe-off" => EfiChange.XeProbeOff,
        "undo" => EfiChange.Undo,
        _ => null,
    };
}

/// The EFI to work on: an EFI folder (a USB stick's, or a copy), or an EFI system partition by disk and partition number
/// (mounted for each read or change, by the elevated helper).
public abstract record EfiTarget
{
    public sealed record Folder(string Path) : EfiTarget;
    public sealed record Partition(uint DiskNumber, uint PartitionNumber) : EfiTarget;
}

/// What a plan or a change takes besides the EFI: the package (the unpacked -efi.zip; stage 2 does not need one), the
/// card's ACPI path as the user confirmed it ("" when not confirmed: no SSDT-ARCOFF.aml; "none" for a port without an
/// ACPI name), what Windows reports for the card (for the notes only), the CPU's name (HybridPM.kext), whether OpenCore
/// records its boot path (Windows cannot tell: false), another backup folder (null: where IntelXe-EFI.ps1 puts them), and
/// the GPU XeProbe is to attach to (its PCI device id, "0x64a0"; only the xeprobe change reads it).
public sealed record EfiOptions(
    string PackageDir = "",
    string CardAcpiPath = "",
    string CardDetected = "",
    string Cpu = "",
    bool BootPathRecorded = false,
    string? BackupRoot = null,
    string ProbeDevice = "");

/// What a planner read from an EFI: "key=value" facts as IntelXe-EFI.ps1 -Status and efi.sh --status print them
/// (opencore, kext_file, kext_entry, hybridpm_needed, ...).
public sealed record EfiStatus(bool Readable, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Values, string? Message = null)
{
    public string this[string key] => Values.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v : "";
}

/// A plan: the text the engine shows (its "EFI:" line, the steps, the notes), its steps and notes, and its SHA-256, which
/// a change must be given back so that nothing is written when the EFI changed between the plan the user read and the
/// confirmation. Letter: the drive letter an EFI partition was mounted at for the plan (the plan names it, so the change
/// mounts it there again); BackupDir: where the backups of this EFI go.
public sealed record EfiPlan(EfiTarget Target, EfiChange Change, string Text, IReadOnlyList<string> Lines, IReadOnlyList<string> Notes,
    string Hash, bool HasChanges, string BackupDir, string? Letter = null);

/// What a change did: the engine's lines (the plan again, each file written, where the backup is).
public sealed record EfiResult(IReadOnlyList<string> Lines);

/// The outcome of a planner call that could not be done, with a message for the user.
public sealed class EfiUnavailableException(string message) : Exception(message);

/// The seam between the EFI page and the EFI rules. The page only calls this interface.
public interface IEfiPlanner
{
    /// True when this planner can read and change an EFI.
    bool IsAvailable { get; }

    /// The version of the shared rules it runs, or a short note on why there is none.
    string RulesVersion { get; }

    Task<EfiStatus> ReadStatusAsync(EfiTarget target, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default);

    /// The plan of one change; nothing is written.
    Task<EfiPlan> PlanAsync(EfiTarget target, EfiChange change, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default);

    /// Backs up the whole EFI folder and makes the change (undo: puts the newest backup back), only when the EFI still
    /// gives a plan with the hash of the one shown.
    Task<EfiResult> ApplyAsync(EfiPlan plan, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default);
}

/// A planner that has nothing to work with and says why (the page shows the message).
public sealed class PendingEfiPlanner(string? why = null) : IEfiPlanner
{
    /// The message every call gives (a key in the app's string tables).
    public const string MessageKey = "Efi_Pending";

    public string Message { get; } = why ?? "no EFI rules";
    public bool IsAvailable => false;
    public string RulesVersion => "none";

    public Task<EfiStatus> ReadStatusAsync(EfiTarget target, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default) =>
        Task.FromResult(new EfiStatus(false, new Dictionary<string, string>(), Message));

    public Task<EfiPlan> PlanAsync(EfiTarget target, EfiChange change, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default) =>
        Task.FromException<EfiPlan>(new EfiUnavailableException(Message));

    public Task<EfiResult> ApplyAsync(EfiPlan plan, EfiOptions options, CancellationToken cancel = default) =>
        Task.FromException<EfiResult>(new EfiUnavailableException(Message));
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/EfiBuild/EfiBuildCommand.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The builder's command lines (windows/efibuild/intelxe_efibuild/__main__.py):
//
//   python.exe -I -B -u -X utf8 efibuild.py [--cache DIR] build --report R --acpi A --out O --macos 26|15
//              [--smbios MODEL] [--no-safari] --result O\result.json --verbose
//   python.exe -I -B -u -X utf8 efibuild.py [--cache DIR] sniff --out DIR
//
// -I keeps the user's environment, user site and current folder out of Python (efibuild.py puts only its own folder on
// sys.path), -B writes no __pycache__ beside the engine (its manifest would then have extra files), -u streams the
// output, -X utf8 makes it UTF-8 whatever the Windows code page (-I ignores PYTHONIOENCODING). The arguments go to the
// process as a list (ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList), never through a shell.
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

/// A process to start: the program, its arguments one by one, the folder it starts in.
public sealed record ProcessSpec(string FileName, IReadOnlyList<string> Args, string WorkingDirectory);

public static partial class EfiBuildCommand
{
    public static readonly string[] MacOSVersions = ["26", "15"];

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^[A-Za-z]{3,16}\d{1,2},\d{1,2}$")]
    private static partial Regex MacModel();

    /// The builder's exit codes: 0 every step passed, 1 the build stopped (the result JSON says why), 2 a pin or input
    /// error (before a result).
    public const int ExitOk = 0, ExitStopped = 1, ExitPinError = 2;

    static List<string> Prefix(EngineLayout engine)
    {
        var a = new List<string> { "-I", "-B", "-u", "-X", "utf8", engine.Script };
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(engine.CacheDir)) a.AddRange(["--cache", engine.CacheDir]);
        return a;
    }

    /// The result JSON's place in the output folder.
    public static string ResultPath(string outDir) => Path.Combine(outDir, "result.json");

    /// The build log's place (the builder's default: OUT\build-log.txt).
    public static string LogPath(string outDir) => Path.Combine(outDir, "build-log.txt");

    /// The build's command line; throws EfiBuildException for a request the builder would refuse.
    public static ProcessSpec Build(EngineLayout engine, EfiBuildRequest q)
    {
        Check(q);
        var a = Prefix(engine);
        a.AddRange(["build", "--report", Path.GetFullPath(q.ReportPath), "--acpi", Path.GetFullPath(q.AcpiDir),
            "--out", Path.GetFullPath(q.OutDir), "--macos", q.MacOS]);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(q.Smbios)) a.AddRange(["--smbios", q.Smbios]);
        if (!q.Safari) a.Add("--no-safari");
        a.AddRange(["--result", ResultPath(Path.GetFullPath(q.OutDir)), "--verbose"]);
        return new ProcessSpec(engine.Python, a, engine.EfiBuildDir);
    }

    /// The scan's command line (run by the elevated helper).
    public static ProcessSpec Sniff(EngineLayout engine, string outDir)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(outDir)) throw new EfiBuildException("the scan needs a folder");
        var a = Prefix(engine);
        a.AddRange(["sniff", "--out", Path.GetFullPath(outDir)]);
        return new ProcessSpec(engine.Python, a, engine.EfiBuildDir);
    }

    public static void Check(EfiBuildRequest q)
    {
        if (!MacOSVersions.Contains(q.MacOS)) throw new EfiBuildException($"macOS {q.MacOS} is not one the builder makes (26 or 15)");
        if (q.Smbios is { Length: > 0 } m && !MacModel().IsMatch(m)) throw new EfiBuildException($"not a Mac model: {m}");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q.ReportPath) || !File.Exists(q.ReportPath)) throw new EfiBuildException($"no hardware report {q.ReportPath}");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q.AcpiDir) || !Directory.Exists(q.AcpiDir)) throw new EfiBuildException($"no ACPI folder {q.AcpiDir}");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q.OutDir)) throw new EfiBuildException("the build needs an output folder");
        if (Directory.Exists(q.OutDir) && Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(q.OutDir).Any()
            && !File.Exists(Path.Combine(q.OutDir, EfiBuildStore.Marker)))
            throw new EfiBuildException($"{q.OutDir} is not empty and was not made by the builder: choose an empty folder");
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The seam between the app and the OpenCore EFI builder (windows/efibuild, Python, driving a pinned OpCore Simplify):
// docs/design/DESIGN-efi-build.md section 5. ScanAsync reads this PC (Hardware Sniffer's report and the ACPI tables the
// build needs, through the elevated helper); BuildAsync builds an EFI from them as the user. The app only calls
// IEfiBuilder; PythonEfiBuilder is the one implementation, tested with a fake Python.
namespace IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

/// What a scan left: Hardware Sniffer's Report.json and the folder of the ACPI tables the build reads (DSDT, SSDT, APIC,
/// DMAR only).
public sealed record HardwareScan(string ReportPath, string AcpiDir, IReadOnlyList<string> Tables);

/// One build: the scan's report and tables, an output folder (empty, or an earlier build's), the macOS version ("26"
/// Tahoe, the default, or "15" Sequoia), another Mac model than the policy's (null: MacBookPro16,2), and the Safari
/// setting with stage 2 (true, as the setup assistant's first step).
public sealed record EfiBuildRequest(string ReportPath, string AcpiDir, string OutDir,
    string MacOS = "26", string? Smbios = null, bool Safari = true);

/// One question OpCore Simplify asked and the rule that answered it.
public sealed record EfiBuildDecision(string Rule, string Screen, string Question, string Answer, string Why);

/// One change the builder made after OpCore Simplify (stage 1 as the test machine installed, stage 2, the Safari
/// setting): the step, what changed, and why ("" when the result gives no reason).
public sealed record EfiBuildChange(string Step, string Change, string Why);

/// ocvalidate's verdict on the built config.plist: whether it passed, how many issues it counted, the ones accepted on
/// purpose (with the reason) and the others. Error: it could not run (the build then failed).
public sealed record OcValidateResult(bool Ok, int Found, IReadOnlyList<(string Finding, string Why)> Accepted,
    IReadOnlyList<string> Issues, string? Error = null)
{
    public static readonly OcValidateResult None = new(false, 0, [], [], null);
}

/// What a build did, from the builder's result JSON (every string already free of SMBIOS values: the builder removes
/// them, and PythonEfiBuilder removes them again with the values read from the built config.plist).
public sealed record EfiBuildResult(bool Ok, string? Error, string OpenCore, string Smbios, string MacOS,
    IReadOnlyList<EfiBuildDecision> Decisions, IReadOnlyList<EfiBuildChange> Changes, IReadOnlyList<string> Firmware,
    IReadOnlyList<string> AfterInstall, IReadOnlyList<string> Failures, IReadOnlyList<string> Notes,
    OcValidateResult OcValidate, IReadOnlyList<string> Cards, string Cpu, string LogPath, string ResultJsonPath, string EfiDir)
{
    /// A build that did not get as far as a result: only the error.
    public static EfiBuildResult Failed(string error, string logPath = "", string resultPath = "") =>
        new(false, error, "", "", "", [], [], [], [], [], [], OcValidateResult.None, [], "", logPath, resultPath, "");
}

/// The builder cannot run here (no engine beside the app, a changed file in it, no administrator rights for the scan):
/// the message says why.
public sealed class EfiBuildException(string message) : Exception(message);

public interface IEfiBuilder
{
    /// The engine folder is there (python.exe, efibuild.py, its manifest). The manifest itself is checked before every
    /// scan and build.
    bool IsAvailable { get; }

    /// Why it is not available ("" when it is).
    string Unavailable { get; }

    /// "OpCore Simplify 9aed67e, Hardware Sniffer ff3b9ed, OpenCore 1.0.8, Python 3.12.10".
    string Versions { get; }

    /// Hardware Sniffer's report and the ACPI tables of this PC into outDir (Report.json, ACPI\). Needs administrator
    /// rights: it goes through the elevated helper.
    Task<HardwareScan> ScanAsync(string outDir, IProgress<string> progress, CancellationToken cancel);

    /// Builds the EFI into request.OutDir\EFI, applies stage 2 and checks it with ocvalidate. A build that stops returns
    /// a result with Ok false and the reason; cancelling kills the builder's process tree and throws
    /// OperationCanceledException.
    Task<EfiBuildResult> BuildAsync(EfiBuildRequest request, IProgress<string> progress, CancellationToken cancel);
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/EfiBuild/EfiBuildResultParser.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The builder's result JSON (efibuild.py build --result FILE; DESIGN-efi-build.md section 3, "The result"): ok, error,
// policy, facts, decisions[], notices[], changes[], firmware[], after_install[], downloads[], acpi_tables[], upstream,
// opencore, checks {ok, failures[], notes[], checks {ocvalidate {ok, found, accepted[], issues[], error}}}. Read
// tolerantly: a missing part is empty, never an exception, so that a build that stopped early still shows its error.
using System.Text.Json;

namespace IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

public static class EfiBuildResultParser
{
    /// The result in json, with every string passed through redact (the SMBIOS values removed). Throws
    /// EfiBuildException when it is not the builder's result.
    public static EfiBuildResult Parse(string json, Func<string, string>? redact = null, string logPath = "", string resultPath = "", string efiDir = "")
    {
        redact ??= s => s;
        JsonDocument doc;
        try { doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json); }
        catch (JsonException e) { throw new EfiBuildException("the builder's result is not JSON: " + e.Message); }
        using (doc)
        {
            var r = doc.RootElement;
            if (r.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object || !r.TryGetProperty("ok", out var okEl) || okEl.ValueKind is not (JsonValueKind.True or JsonValueKind.False))
                throw new EfiBuildException("the builder's result has no \"ok\"");
            string S(JsonElement e, string name) => redact(Str(e, name));
            IReadOnlyList<string> L(JsonElement e, string name) => Strings(e, name).Select(redact).ToList();

            var policy = Obj(r, "policy");
            var facts = Obj(r, "facts");
            var checks = Obj(r, "checks");
            var oc = Obj(Obj(checks, "checks"), "ocvalidate");

            var decisions = Items(r, "decisions").Select(d => new EfiBuildDecision(S(d, "rule"), S(d, "screen"), S(d, "question"), S(d, "answer"), S(d, "why"))).ToList();
            var changes = Items(r, "changes").Select(c => new EfiBuildChange(S(c, "step"),
                Str(c, "change") is { Length: > 0 } ? S(c, "change") : S(c, "note"), S(c, "why"))).ToList();
            var ocv = oc.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
                ? new OcValidateResult(Bool(oc, "ok"), Int(oc, "found"),
                    Items(oc, "accepted").Select(a => (S(a, "finding"), S(a, "why"))).ToList(), L(oc, "issues"),
                    Str(oc, "error") is { Length: > 0 } ? S(oc, "error") : null)
                : OcValidateResult.None;
            bool ok = okEl.GetBoolean();
            string? error = Str(r, "error") is { Length: > 0 } ? S(r, "error") : null;
            if (!ok && error is null) error = "the build did not finish";

            return new EfiBuildResult(ok, error, S(r, "opencore"), S(policy, "smbios"), S(policy, "macos"),
                decisions, changes, L(r, "firmware"), L(r, "after_install"), L(checks, "failures"), L(checks, "notes"),
                ocv, L(facts, "cards"), S(facts, "cpu"), logPath, resultPath, efiDir);
        }
    }

    static JsonElement Obj(JsonElement e, string name) =>
        e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && e.TryGetProperty(name, out var v) && v.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object ? v : default;

    static IEnumerable<JsonElement> Items(JsonElement e, string name) =>
        e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && e.TryGetProperty(name, out var v) && v.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array
            ? v.EnumerateArray().Where(x => x.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object).ToList()
            : [];

    static IEnumerable<string> Strings(JsonElement e, string name) =>
        e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && e.TryGetProperty(name, out var v) && v.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array
            ? v.EnumerateArray().Where(x => x.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String).Select(x => x.GetString() ?? "").ToList()
            : [];

    static string Str(JsonElement e, string name) =>
        e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && e.TryGetProperty(name, out var v)
            ? v.ValueKind switch { JsonValueKind.String => v.GetString() ?? "", JsonValueKind.Number => v.GetRawText(), _ => "" }
            : "";

    static bool Bool(JsonElement e, string name) =>
        e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && e.TryGetProperty(name, out var v) && v.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.True;

    static int Int(JsonElement e, string name) =>
        e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && e.TryGetProperty(name, out var v) && v.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number && v.TryGetInt32(out var n) ? n : 0;
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/EfiBuild/EfiBuildStore.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Where scans and builds go (under %LOCALAPPDATA%\IntelXe Manager\efibuild in the app, never beside the exe), saving a
// built EFI to a folder the user chooses, the built EFI as the stick page's IEfiSource, and the check that the app's own
// EFI engine (IntelXe-EFI.ps1's, in C#) finds stage 2 complete in what the Python builder made.
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXe.Core.Stick;

namespace IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

public sealed class EfiBuildStore(string root)
{
    /// The file the builder leaves in an output folder it made (windows/efibuild engine.py MARKER): only such a folder is
    /// replaced or deleted.
    public const string Marker = ".intelxe-efibuild";

    public string Root { get; } = root;
    public string ScansDir => Path.Combine(Root, "scans");
    public string BuildsDir => Path.Combine(Root, "builds");

    static string Stamp(DateTime now) => now.ToString("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    /// A new, not yet existing folder for a scan (the elevated helper refuses one that exists).
    public string NewScanDir(DateTime now) => Unique(ScansDir, Stamp(now));

    /// A new, not yet existing output folder for a build.
    public string NewBuildDir(DateTime now) => Unique(BuildsDir, Stamp(now));

    static string Unique(string parent, string name)
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(parent, name);
        for (int i = 2; Directory.Exists(path) || File.Exists(path); i++) path = Path.Combine(parent, $"{name}-{i}");
        return path;
    }

    /// Deletes the other builds the builder made (they hold generated serial numbers), keeping the ones named; returns
    /// how many went. A folder without the marker is never touched.
    public int PruneBuilds(params string?[] keep)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(BuildsDir)) return 0;
        var keepFull = keep.Where(k => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(k)).Select(k => Path.GetFullPath(k!).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar)).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        int n = 0;
        foreach (var dir in Directory.EnumerateDirectories(BuildsDir))
        {
            if (keepFull.Contains(Path.GetFullPath(dir).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar))) continue;
            if (!File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir, Marker))) continue;
            if ((new DirectoryInfo(dir).Attributes & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0) continue;
            try { Directory.Delete(dir, true); n++; } catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
        return n;
    }

    /// The EFI folder of a build's output folder (OUT\EFI holding BOOT and OC), checked; throws EfiSourceException.
    public static string EfiOf(string outDir) => EfiFolderCheck.Resolve(Path.Combine(outDir, "EFI"));

    /// Copies a built EFI folder to destParent\EFI and reads every file back. Refuses when destParent\EFI exists (an
    /// EFI is never overwritten here) or lies inside the build. Returns the new EFI folder.
    public static string SaveTo(string efiDir, string destParent)
    {
        var src = EfiFolderCheck.Resolve(efiDir);
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(destParent) || !Directory.Exists(destParent)) throw new EfiBuildException($"no folder {destParent}");
        var dest = Path.Combine(Path.GetFullPath(destParent), "EFI");
        if (Directory.Exists(dest) || File.Exists(dest)) throw new EfiBuildException($"{dest} exists already: choose another folder (an EFI folder is not overwritten)");
        var srcFull = Path.GetFullPath(src).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
        if ((dest + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar).StartsWith(srcFull, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) throw new EfiBuildException("the EFI cannot be saved inside itself");
        var tmp = Path.Combine(Path.GetFullPath(destParent), ".EFI-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]);
        try
        {
            Copy(src, tmp);
            foreach (var f in Directory.EnumerateFiles(src, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                var rel = Path.GetRelativePath(src, f);
                var copy = Path.Combine(tmp, rel);
                if (!File.Exists(copy) || EngineLayout.Sha256(copy) != EngineLayout.Sha256(f)) throw new EfiBuildException($"{rel} did not copy correctly");
            }
            Directory.Move(tmp, dest);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(tmp)) try { Directory.Delete(tmp, true); } catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
        return dest;
    }

    static void Copy(string src, string dst)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dst);
        foreach (var f in Directory.EnumerateFiles(src)) File.Copy(f, Path.Combine(dst, Path.GetFileName(f)));
        foreach (var d in Directory.EnumerateDirectories(src)) Copy(d, Path.Combine(dst, Path.GetFileName(d)));
    }

    /// The app's own engine on the built EFI: stage 2 (and the Safari setting when the build made it) must have nothing
    /// left to change. A difference means the Python and C# readers of efi-rules.json disagree. Returns the plan's lines
    /// when it would change something (empty when it agrees).
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Stage2Left(string efiDir, bool safari)
    {
        var change = safari ? EfiChange.SettingsSafari : EfiChange.Settings;
        var plan = EfiWork.Plan(new EfiTarget.Folder(efiDir), efiDir, change, new EfiOptions());
        return plan.HasChanges ? plan.Lines : [];
    }
}

/// The EFI the app built (Build the EFI page), for the stick page: the build's output folder's EFI\, checked to hold
/// OpenCore when the stick is written.
public sealed class BuiltEfiSource(string outDir, string describe) : IEfiSource
{
    public string Describe => describe;

    public Task<string> PrepareAsync(CancellationToken cancel = default) => Task.FromResult(EfiBuildStore.EfiOf(outDir));
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/EfiBuild/EngineLayout.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The builder's folder beside the app (windows/app/build.ps1 puts it there):
//
//   engine\python\            python.org's embeddable Python (signed python.exe), wmi, pywin32, certifi
//   engine\efibuild\          windows/efibuild: efibuild.py, intelxe_efibuild\, downloads.lock.json, upstream\
//   engine\efibuild\upstream\OpCore-Simplify-<commit>\, Hardware-Sniffer-<commit>\   the pinned, checked trees
//   engine\engine.lock.json   what build.ps1 fetched (Python and the wheels, with their SHA-256)
//   engine\MANIFEST.sha256    "sha256  relative/path" of every other file under engine\
//
// The manifest is checked before every scan and build: a changed, missing or extra file refuses the engine (an extra
// json.py next to efibuild.py would be imported by it), so the elevated scan never runs code that build.ps1 did not put
// there.
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

public sealed record EngineLayout(string Root, string? CacheDir = null)
{
    public const string ManifestName = "MANIFEST.sha256";

    /// The engine beside the app's exe.
    public static EngineLayout Beside(string appDir, string? cacheDir = null) => new(Path.Combine(appDir, "engine"), cacheDir);

    public string Python => Path.Combine(Root, "python", OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? "python.exe" : "python");
    public string EfiBuildDir => Path.Combine(Root, "efibuild");
    public string Script => Path.Combine(EfiBuildDir, "efibuild.py");
    public string Manifest => Path.Combine(Root, ManifestName);

    /// "" when python, efibuild.py and the manifest are there, else what is missing.
    public string Missing()
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(Root)) return $"no builder folder {Root}";
        foreach (var f in new[] { Python, Script, Manifest })
            if (!File.Exists(f)) return $"the builder folder has no {Path.GetRelativePath(Root, f)}";
        return "";
    }

    /// The problems of the engine against its manifest: changed, missing and extra files. Empty when it matches.
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Verify()
    {
        var problems = new List<string>();
        if (!File.Exists(Manifest)) return [$"no {ManifestName}"];
        var listed = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var raw in File.ReadAllLines(Manifest))
        {
            var line = raw.TrimEnd('\r');
            if (line.Length == 0) continue;
            if (line.Length < 67 || line[64] != ' ' || line[65] != ' ' || !line[..64].All(Uri.IsHexDigit))
            {
                problems.Add($"{ManifestName}: not a \"sha256  path\" line: {line}");
                continue;
            }
            var rel = line[66..];
            if (rel.Contains("..") || Path.IsPathRooted(rel)) { problems.Add($"{ManifestName}: unsafe path {rel}"); continue; }
            listed[rel] = line[..64].ToLowerInvariant();
        }
        if (listed.Count == 0) problems.Add($"{ManifestName} lists no file");
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(Root, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            var rel = Path.GetRelativePath(Root, path).Replace('\\', '/');
            if (string.Equals(rel, ManifestName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
            if (!listed.TryGetValue(rel, out var want)) { problems.Add($"extra file {rel}"); continue; }
            seen.Add(rel);
            if (Sha256(path) != want) problems.Add($"changed file {rel}");
        }
        foreach (var rel in listed.Keys.Where(k => !seen.Contains(k)).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal)) problems.Add($"missing file {rel}");
        return problems;
    }

    /// The manifest text of a folder, as build.ps1 writes it (sorted by path, forward slashes, LF).
    public static string ManifestText(string root) =>
        string.Concat(Directory.EnumerateFiles(root, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
            .Select(p => Path.GetRelativePath(root, p).Replace('\\', '/'))
            .Where(rel => !string.Equals(rel, ManifestName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Order(StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .Select(rel => $"{Sha256(Path.Combine(root, rel))}  {rel}\n"));

    public static string Sha256(string path)
    {
        using var f = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(f));
    }

    /// "OpCore Simplify 9aed67e, Hardware Sniffer ff3b9ed, OpenCore 1.0.8, Python 3.12.10" from the engine's own files;
    /// what cannot be read is left out.
    public string Versions()
    {
        var parts = new List<string>();
        try
        {
            using var pinned = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(EfiBuildDir, "upstream", "PINNED.json")));
            foreach (var p in pinned.RootElement.GetProperty("projects").EnumerateObject())
                if (p.Value.TryGetProperty("commit", out var c) && c.GetString() is { Length: >= 7 } commit)
                    parts.Add($"{p.Name.Replace('-', ' ')} {commit[..7]}");
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or JsonException or KeyNotFoundException or InvalidOperationException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        try
        {
            using var lockDoc = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(EfiBuildDir, "downloads.lock.json")));
            if (lockDoc.RootElement.GetProperty("products").GetProperty("OpenCorePkg").GetProperty("version").GetString() is { Length: > 0 } oc)
                parts.Add("OpenCore " + oc);
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or JsonException or KeyNotFoundException or InvalidOperationException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        try
        {
            using var engine = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(Root, "engine.lock.json")));
            if (engine.RootElement.GetProperty("python").GetProperty("version").GetString() is { Length: > 0 } py)
                parts.Add("Python " + py);
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or JsonException or KeyNotFoundException or InvalidOperationException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        return string.Join(", ", parts);
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/EfiBuild/ProcessRunner.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Starting the builder's Python: without a console window, its output read line by line as UTF-8, and on cancel the
// whole process tree killed (OpCore Simplify starts iasl, macserial and ocvalidate). An interface so that the tests run
// the builder's logic against a fake Python.
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text;

namespace IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

public interface IProcessRunner
{
    /// Runs the process to its end and returns its exit code; each line of its standard output and error goes to the
    /// callbacks as it comes. Cancelling kills the process tree and throws OperationCanceledException.
    Task<int> RunAsync(ProcessSpec spec, Action<string> stdout, Action<string> stderr, CancellationToken cancel);
}

public sealed class SystemProcessRunner : IProcessRunner
{
    public async Task<int> RunAsync(ProcessSpec spec, Action<string> stdout, Action<string> stderr, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        cancel.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo(spec.FileName)
        {
            UseShellExecute = false,
            CreateNoWindow = true,
            RedirectStandardInput = true,
            RedirectStandardOutput = true,
            RedirectStandardError = true,
            StandardOutputEncoding = new UTF8Encoding(false),
            StandardErrorEncoding = new UTF8Encoding(false),
            WorkingDirectory = spec.WorkingDirectory,
        };
        foreach (var a in spec.Args) psi.ArgumentList.Add(a);
        using var p = new Process { StartInfo = psi, EnableRaisingEvents = true };
        var outDone = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var errDone = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        p.OutputDataReceived += (_, e) => { if (e.Data is null) outDone.TrySetResult(); else stdout(e.Data); };
        p.ErrorDataReceived += (_, e) => { if (e.Data is null) errDone.TrySetResult(); else stderr(e.Data); };
        if (!p.Start()) throw new EfiBuildException($"{spec.FileName} did not start");
        // nothing is ever typed: a question the builder did not expect reads end of input and stops it
        p.StandardInput.Close();
        p.BeginOutputReadLine();
        p.BeginErrorReadLine();
        try
        {
            await p.WaitForExitAsync(cancel);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            try { p.Kill(entireProcessTree: true); } catch (Exception e) when (e is InvalidOperationException or System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception or NotSupportedException) { }
            try { await p.WaitForExitAsync(CancellationToken.None).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10), CancellationToken.None); } catch (TimeoutException) { }
            throw;
        }
        await Task.WhenAll(outDone.Task, errDone.Task).WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10), CancellationToken.None).ContinueWith(_ => { }, TaskScheduler.Default);
        return p.ExitCode;
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/EfiBuild/PythonEfiBuilder.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// IEfiBuilder over windows/efibuild in the embedded Python beside the app (EngineLayout). The build runs as the user:
// efibuild.py build ... --result OUT\result.json --verbose as a child process without a console; its progress lines
// (the program's screens and each answer with its rule) go to the window, its result JSON is read when it ends.
// Exit code 0 is success, 1 a build that stopped (the result says why), 2 a pin or input error (its "error:" line says
// why). The scan needs administrator rights, so it goes through the elevated helper (the delegate the app gives).
namespace IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

public sealed class PythonEfiBuilder(EngineLayout engine, IProcessRunner runner,
    Func<SniffRequest, CancellationToken, Task<SniffAnswer>> elevatedSniff) : IEfiBuilder
{
    public EngineLayout Engine { get; } = engine;

    public bool IsAvailable => Engine.Missing().Length == 0;
    public string Unavailable => Engine.Missing();
    public string Versions => IsAvailable ? Engine.Versions() : "";

    void CheckEngine()
    {
        if (Engine.Missing() is { Length: > 0 } missing) throw new EfiBuildException(missing);
        if (Engine.Verify() is { Count: > 0 } problems)
            throw new EfiBuildException("the builder beside the app changed: " + string.Join("; ", problems.Take(5)));
    }

    public async Task<HardwareScan> ScanAsync(string outDir, IProgress<string> progress, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        await Task.Run(CheckEngine, cancel);
        var answer = await elevatedSniff(new SniffRequest(Path.GetFullPath(outDir)), cancel);
        foreach (var line in answer.Lines.Where(ProgressFilter.Shows)) progress.Report(ProgressFilter.Clean(line));
        var scan = answer.ToScan();
        // the helper kept only these; the report and a DSDT must be there for the build
        if (!File.Exists(scan.ReportPath)) throw new EfiBuildException("the scan left no Report.json");
        var (kept, _) = AcpiTables.KeepOnlyBuildTables(scan.AcpiDir);
        if (!kept.Any(t => AcpiTables.Signature(Path.Combine(scan.AcpiDir, t)) == "DSDT")) throw new EfiBuildException("the scan left no DSDT");
        return scan with { Tables = kept };
    }

    public async Task<EfiBuildResult> BuildAsync(EfiBuildRequest request, IProgress<string> progress, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        var outDir = Path.GetFullPath(request.OutDir);
        var resultPath = EfiBuildCommand.ResultPath(outDir);
        var logPath = EfiBuildCommand.LogPath(outDir);
        ProcessSpec spec;
        try
        {
            await Task.Run(CheckEngine, cancel);
            spec = EfiBuildCommand.Build(Engine, request with { OutDir = outDir });
        }
        catch (EfiBuildException e) { return EfiBuildResult.Failed(e.Message); }

        // the builder writes result.json at its end: one left from an earlier build in this folder must not be read
        if (File.Exists(resultPath) && File.Exists(Path.Combine(outDir, EfiBuildStore.Marker))) File.Delete(resultPath);
        var tail = new Queue<string>();
        void Err(string line)
        {
            lock (tail) { tail.Enqueue(line); if (tail.Count > 40) tail.Dequeue(); }
            if (ProgressFilter.Shows(line)) progress.Report(ProgressFilter.Clean(line));
        }
        void Out(string line) { lock (tail) { tail.Enqueue(line); if (tail.Count > 40) tail.Dequeue(); } }

        int code = await runner.RunAsync(spec, Out, Err, cancel);   // throws OperationCanceledException on cancel

        string[] last;
        lock (tail) last = [.. tail];
        // the identity the build generated, in every form: removed from everything shown, whatever the builder did
        var efi = Path.Combine(outDir, "EFI");
        var secrets = SmbiosMask.ReadSecrets(Path.Combine(efi, "OC", "config.plist"));
        string Redact(string s) => SmbiosMask.Redact(s, secrets);

        if (File.Exists(resultPath) && code is EfiBuildCommand.ExitOk or EfiBuildCommand.ExitStopped)
        {
            EfiBuildResult r;
            try { r = EfiBuildResultParser.Parse(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(resultPath, cancel), Redact, logPath, resultPath, Directory.Exists(efi) ? efi : ""); }
            catch (EfiBuildException e) { return EfiBuildResult.Failed(Redact(e.Message), logPath, resultPath); }
            if (code == EfiBuildCommand.ExitOk && !r.Ok) return r with { Ok = false, Error = r.Error ?? "the builder exited 0 with a result that is not ok" };
            if (code != EfiBuildCommand.ExitOk && r.Ok) return r with { Ok = false, Error = $"the builder ended with code {code}" };
            return r;
        }
        var error = last.LastOrDefault(l => l.StartsWith("error:", StringComparison.Ordinal))?[6..].Trim()
                    ?? $"the builder ended with code {code} without a result: {string.Join(" / ", last.Where(l => l.Trim().Length > 0).TakeLast(4))}";
        return EfiBuildResult.Failed(Redact(error), File.Exists(logPath) ? logPath : "", "");
    }
}

/// Which of the builder's --verbose lines the window shows while it works: the screens ("== Select macOS Version"), the
/// rule that answered ("   [macos: ...]") and errors. The program's own text (menus, lists of devices) stays in the
/// build log, which the builder writes with the SMBIOS values removed.
public static class ProgressFilter
{
    public static bool Shows(string line)
    {
        var t = line.TrimStart();
        return t.StartsWith("== ", StringComparison.Ordinal) || (t.StartsWith('[') && t.EndsWith(']') && t.Contains(": ")) || t.StartsWith("error:", StringComparison.Ordinal);
    }

    public static string Clean(string line)
    {
        var t = line.Trim();
        if (t.StartsWith("== ", StringComparison.Ordinal)) return t[3..].Trim();
        if (t.StartsWith('[') && t.EndsWith(']')) return "  " + t[1..^1];
        return t;
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/EfiBuild/SmbiosMask.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The SMBIOS identity a build generates (serial number, MLB, UUID, ROM: macserial of the pinned OpenCore, through OpCore
// Simplify) stays in the generated config.plist only: never logged, shown or sent. The builder already removes every
// form of it from its log and result (windows/efibuild/intelxe_efibuild/validate.py, read_secrets/redact); the app does
// it again with the values it reads from config.plist before anything reaches the window, and masks them wherever it
// shows config values.
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Xml;
using System.Xml.Linq;

namespace IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

public static partial class SmbiosMask
{
    public const string Redacted = "<redacted>";

    /// What the window shows in place of a masked value.
    public const string Masked = "••••••••";

    [GeneratedRegex(@"(Serial|UUID)|^(MLB|ROM)$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex SecretKeyRegex();

    /// A PlatformInfo key whose value identifies the machine (SystemSerialNumber, MLB, SystemUUID, ROM,
    /// BoardSerialNumber, ChassisSerialNumber, SmUUID, ...).
    public static bool IsSecretKey(string key) => SecretKeyRegex().IsMatch(key);

    /// The value as the window may show it: masked when its key identifies the machine.
    public static string Display(string key, string value) => IsSecretKey(key) && value.Length > 0 ? Masked : value;

    /// Every form in which the identity in config.plist's PlatformInfo could be printed: a string as it is, in lower and
    /// upper case (and a UUID without its dashes); data as hex (both cases, also with colons) and base64. Longest first,
    /// at least 6 characters. Empty when the file cannot be read.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> ReadSecrets(string configPath)
    {
        var forms = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var (_, key, type, text) in PlatformValues(configPath))
        {
            if (!IsSecretKey(key)) continue;
            if (type == "data")
            {
                byte[] bytes;
                try { bytes = Convert.FromBase64String(Regex.Replace(text, @"\s+", "")); }
                catch (FormatException) { continue; }
                if (bytes.Length == 0) continue;
                var hex = Convert.ToHexStringLower(bytes);
                forms.UnionWith([hex, hex.ToUpperInvariant(), Convert.ToBase64String(bytes),
                    string.Join(":", bytes.Select(b => b.ToString("x2"))), string.Join(":", bytes.Select(b => b.ToString("X2")))]);
            }
            else if (type == "string" && text.Length >= 6)
            {
                forms.UnionWith([text, text.ToLowerInvariant(), text.ToUpperInvariant()]);
                if (text.Contains('-')) { var bare = text.Replace("-", ""); forms.UnionWith([bare, bare.ToLowerInvariant(), bare.ToUpperInvariant()]); }
            }
        }
        return forms.Where(f => f.Length >= 6).OrderByDescending(f => f.Length).ThenBy(f => f, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();
    }

    /// The text with every secret replaced by <redacted>.
    public static string Redact(string text, IReadOnlyList<string> secrets)
    {
        foreach (var s in secrets) text = text.Replace(s, Redacted, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        return text;
    }

    /// The secrets that appear in a text (a test that nothing leaked).
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Find(string text, IReadOnlyList<string> secrets) =>
        secrets.Where(s => text.Contains(s, StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToList();

    /// PlatformInfo > Generic as the window shows it: the Mac model as it is, the identity masked, in config order.
    public static IReadOnlyList<(string Key, string Value)> PlatformSummary(string configPath) =>
        PlatformValues(configPath)
            .Where(v => v.Section == "Generic" && v.Type is "string" or "data" or "integer" or "true" or "false")
            .Select(v => (v.Key, Display(v.Key, v.Type is "true" or "false" ? v.Type : v.Text)))
            .ToList();

    /// One scalar of PlatformInfo's dictionaries: its dictionary (Generic, DataHub, PlatformNVRAM, SMBIOS), key, plist
    /// type and text (data stays base64).
    readonly record struct Scalar(string Section, string Key, string Type, string Text);

    static IEnumerable<Scalar> PlatformValues(string configPath)
    {
        XElement? root;
        try
        {
            var settings = new XmlReaderSettings { DtdProcessing = DtdProcessing.Ignore, XmlResolver = null };
            using var reader = XmlReader.Create(configPath, settings);
            root = XDocument.Load(reader).Root?.Element("dict");
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or XmlException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { yield break; }
        if (root is null) yield break;
        var platform = Pairs(root).FirstOrDefault(p => p.Key == "PlatformInfo").Value;
        if (platform is null || platform.Name != "dict") yield break;
        foreach (var (section, sub) in Pairs(platform))
        {
            if (sub.Name != "dict") continue;
            foreach (var (key, value) in Pairs(sub))
                if (value.Name != "dict" && value.Name != "array")
                    yield return new Scalar(section, key, value.Name.LocalName, value.Value.Trim());
        }
    }

    static IEnumerable<(string Key, XElement Value)> Pairs(XElement dict)
    {
        string? key = null;
        foreach (var e in dict.Elements())
        {
            if (e.Name == "key") { key = e.Value; continue; }
            if (key is not null) yield return (key, e);
            key = null;
        }
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/EfiBuild/SniffHelper.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The elevated helper's "sniff" verb (DESIGN-efi-build.md section 5): the app starts its own exe through "runas" as
//
//   IntelXeManager.exe --efi-helper sniff --scan DIR --out ANSWER.json
//
// and the helper runs the engine beside the exe (never one named on the command line), after checking it against its
// manifest: efibuild.py sniff --out DIR, which runs the pinned Hardware Sniffer (WMI) and the pinned acpidump.exe (the
// ACPI tables need administrator rights). Of the dump only the tables the build reads are kept (DSDT, SSDT, APIC, DMAR):
// the builder keeps only those, and the helper deletes any other table it finds afterwards, so MSDM (the Windows
// product key), SLIC and the rest never stay on disk. The scan folder must not exist yet and no folder above it may be a
// link: the helper has administrator rights and the folder is the user's.
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

public sealed record SniffRequest(string ScanDir, string? Out = null)
{
    public const string Verb = "sniff";

    public IReadOnlyList<string> ToArgs()
    {
        var a = new List<string> { EfiHelperRequest.Switch, Verb, "--scan", ScanDir };
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Out)) a.AddRange(["--out", Out]);
        return a;
    }

    /// True for "--efi-helper sniff ...".
    public static bool Is(IReadOnlyList<string> args) => args.Count >= 2 && args[0] == EfiHelperRequest.Switch && args[1] == Verb;

    public static SniffRequest Parse(IReadOnlyList<string> args)
    {
        if (!Is(args)) throw new EfiBuildException($"the scan's command line starts with {EfiHelperRequest.Switch} {Verb}");
        string? scan = null, output = null;
        for (int i = 2; i < args.Count; i++)
        {
            if (i + 1 >= args.Count) throw new EfiBuildException($"the scan does not take {args[i]} without a value");
            switch (args[i])
            {
                case "--scan" when scan is null: scan = args[++i]; break;
                case "--out" when output is null: output = args[++i]; break;
                default: throw new EfiBuildException($"the scan does not take {args[i]}" + (args[i] is "--scan" or "--out" ? " twice" : ""));
            }
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(scan) || !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(scan)) throw new EfiBuildException("the scan needs --scan with a full path");
        return new SniffRequest(scan, output);
    }
}

/// The helper's answer, as JSON in the --out file.
public sealed class SniffAnswer
{
    [JsonPropertyName("ok")] public bool Ok { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("error")] public string? Error { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("report")] public string? Report { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("acpi")] public string? Acpi { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("tables")] public List<string> Tables { get; set; } = [];
    /// Tables the helper deleted because the build does not read them (by signature).
    [JsonPropertyName("removed")] public List<string> Removed { get; set; } = [];
    /// The engine's output, for the window (Hardware Sniffer's progress lines; it prints no serial numbers).
    [JsonPropertyName("lines")] public List<string> Lines { get; set; } = [];

    static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Json = new() { WriteIndented = true, DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull };

    public string ToJson() => JsonSerializer.Serialize(this, Json);
    public static SniffAnswer FromJson(string json) => JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SniffAnswer>(json, Json) ?? throw new EfiBuildException("the scan's answer is empty");

    public HardwareScan ToScan() =>
        Ok && Report is not null && Acpi is not null ? new HardwareScan(Report, Acpi, Tables) : throw new EfiBuildException(Error ?? "the scan failed");
}

public static class AcpiTables
{
    /// The signatures OpCore Simplify reads (windows/efibuild sniff.KEEP_TABLES).
    public static readonly string[] Kept = ["DSDT", "SSDT", "APIC", "DMAR"];

    /// A table's signature: its first four bytes ("" for a shorter file).
    public static string Signature(string path)
    {
        var b = new byte[4];
        using var f = File.OpenRead(path);
        return f.ReadAtLeast(b, 4, throwOnEndOfStream: false) == 4 ? Encoding.ASCII.GetString(b) : "";
    }

    /// Deletes every file in dir that is not a kept table (by signature, not by name) and every subfolder; returns the
    /// kept and the removed names.
    public static (List<string> Kept, List<string> Removed) KeepOnlyBuildTables(string dir)
    {
        var kept = new List<string>();
        var removed = new List<string>();
        foreach (var sub in Directory.EnumerateDirectories(dir))
        {
            removed.Add(Path.GetFileName(sub) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar);
            Directory.Delete(sub, true);
        }
        foreach (var f in Directory.EnumerateFiles(dir).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal))
        {
            var name = Path.GetFileName(f);
            if (Kept.Contains(Signature(f), StringComparer.Ordinal)) kept.Add(name);
            else { File.Delete(f); removed.Add(name); }
        }
        return (kept, removed);
    }
}

public static class SniffHelper
{
    /// The scan: refuses a scan folder that exists or lies under a link, checks the engine, runs efibuild.py sniff,
    /// keeps only the build's tables. folderIsLink tells whether a folder is a link (reparse point on Windows).
    public static async Task<SniffAnswer> RunAsync(SniffRequest q, EngineLayout engine, IProcessRunner runner,
        Func<DirectoryInfo, bool>? folderIsLink = null, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        var a = new SniffAnswer();
        folderIsLink ??= d => (d.Attributes & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0;
        try
        {
            var scan = Path.GetFullPath(q.ScanDir);
            if (Directory.Exists(scan) || File.Exists(scan)) throw new EfiBuildException($"{scan} exists already: the scan writes only into a new folder");
            for (var d = new DirectoryInfo(scan).Parent; d is not null; d = d.Parent)
                if (d.Exists && folderIsLink(d)) throw new EfiBuildException($"{d.FullName} is a link: nothing scanned");
            if (engine.Missing() is { Length: > 0 } missing) throw new EfiBuildException(missing);
            if (engine.Verify() is { Count: > 0 } problems) throw new EfiBuildException("the builder beside the app changed: " + string.Join("; ", problems.Take(5)));

            var lines = new List<string>();
            void Line(string s) { lock (lines) { if (lines.Count < 400) lines.Add(s); } }
            int code = await runner.RunAsync(EfiBuildCommand.Sniff(engine, scan), Line, Line, cancel);
            a.Lines = lines;
            if (code != 0)
                throw new EfiBuildException(lines.LastOrDefault(l => l.StartsWith("error:", StringComparison.Ordinal))?[6..].Trim()
                                            ?? $"the scan ended with code {code}: {string.Join(" / ", lines.TakeLast(3))}");
            var report = Path.Combine(scan, "Report.json");
            var acpi = Path.Combine(scan, "ACPI");
            if (!File.Exists(report)) throw new EfiBuildException("the scan wrote no Report.json");
            if (!Directory.Exists(acpi)) throw new EfiBuildException("the scan wrote no ACPI tables");
            var (kept, removed) = AcpiTables.KeepOnlyBuildTables(acpi);
            if (!kept.Any(t => AcpiTables.Signature(Path.Combine(acpi, t)) == "DSDT")) throw new EfiBuildException("the ACPI dump has no DSDT");
            a.Report = report;
            a.Acpi = acpi;
            a.Tables = kept;
            a.Removed = removed;
            a.Ok = true;
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { throw; }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is EfiBuildException or IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            a.Ok = false;
            a.Error = e.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            // whatever happened: no table the build does not read stays in the scan folder
            var acpi = Path.Combine(Path.GetFullPath(q.ScanDir), "ACPI");
            if (!a.Ok && Directory.Exists(acpi))
                try { AcpiTables.KeepOnlyBuildTables(acpi); } catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
        return a;
    }
}
