FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Localisation/ReswFile.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Xml.Linq;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Localisation;

/// A .resw string table (Strings/<language>/Resources.resw): its keys and values, and the checks that keep the
/// languages in step: the same keys, and the same {n} placeholders in each value.
public static class ReswFile
{
    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Read(string path) => Parse(XDocument.Load(path));

    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Parse(XDocument doc)
    {
        var map = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var data in doc.Root?.Elements("data") ?? [])
        {
            var name = (string?)data.Attribute("name");
            if (name is null) continue;
            if (map.ContainsKey(name)) throw new InvalidDataException($"key '{name}' appears twice");
            map[name] = (string?)data.Element("value") ?? "";
        }
        return map;
    }

    static readonly Regex Placeholder = new(@"\{(\d+)(?:[,:][^}]*)?\}");

    /// The {n} placeholders of a value, in order of their number.
    public static IReadOnlyList<int> Placeholders(string value) =>
        Placeholder.Matches(value).Select(m => int.Parse(m.Groups[1].Value)).Distinct().Order().ToList();

    /// The differences between two tables: keys only in one, values with other placeholders, empty values.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Compare(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> a, string aName, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> b, string bName)
    {
        var problems = new List<string>();
        foreach (var k in a.Keys.Except(b.Keys).Order()) problems.Add($"{k}: only in {aName}");
        foreach (var k in b.Keys.Except(a.Keys).Order()) problems.Add($"{k}: only in {bName}");
        foreach (var k in a.Keys.Intersect(b.Keys).Order())
        {
            if (!Placeholders(a[k]).SequenceEqual(Placeholders(b[k])))
                problems.Add($"{k}: placeholders {{{string.Join(",", Placeholders(a[k]))}}} in {aName}, {{{string.Join(",", Placeholders(b[k]))}}} in {bName}");
            if (a[k].Trim() == "") problems.Add($"{k}: empty in {aName}");
            if (b[k].Trim() == "") problems.Add($"{k}: empty in {bName}");
        }
        return problems;
    }

    // L.Get("Key"), L.Format("Key", ...) and {loc:L Key=Key} in the app's sources
    static readonly Regex[] Uses =
    [
        new(@"\bL\.(?:Get|Format)\(\s*""([A-Za-z0-9_]+)"""),
        new(@"\{\w+:L\s+Key=([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*\}"),
    ];

    /// The keys the app's .cs and .xaml files name literally.
    public static IReadOnlySet<string> KeysUsedIn(IEnumerable<string> files)
    {
        var used = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var file in files)
        {
            var text = File.ReadAllText(file);
            foreach (var re in Uses)
                foreach (Match m in re.Matches(text)) used.Add(m.Groups[1].Value);
        }
        return used;
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/ProbeStick/ProbeImage.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The Xe probe stick's image (tools/probe-stick/build.sh: xe-probe-stick-VERSION.img and .img.sha256), as the app
// finds and checks it before writing: beside the app (or in its probe-stick folder, or the one under %LOCALAPPDATA%), or
// a file the user picked. It must look like the stick (an MBR with one FAT32 partition labelled XEPROBE) and match the
// SHA-256 in the .sha256 beside it; without one the app does not write it (write-stick.sh writes it unchecked, with a
// note; a release always ships the .sha256).
using System.Globalization;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace IntelXe.Core.ProbeStick;

public sealed class ProbeException(string message) : Exception(message);

/// A checked image: its size, SHA-256 (lower-case hex, as sha256sum prints it) and version ("" when its name has none).
public sealed record ProbeImageInfo(string Path, long Size, string Sha256, string Version);

public static partial class ProbeImage
{
    /// The FAT label of the stick's partition and the file that marks it (tools/probe-stick/image/build-inside.sh).
    public const string Label = "XEPROBE";
    public const string Marker = "xe-probe-stick.marker";
    public const string FilePattern = "xe-probe-stick-*.img";
    /// The stick's image is about 208 MB; anything above this is not one.
    public const long MaxSize = 4L << 30;

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^xe-probe-stick-(\d+(?:\.\d+){0,3})\.img$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)]
    private static partial Regex NameRe();

    /// "0.1.0" from xe-probe-stick-0.1.0.img; "" for another name.
    public static string VersionOf(string path) => NameRe().Match(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path)) is { Success: true } m ? m.Groups[1].Value : "";

    /// The folders the app looks in, in order: beside the exe, its probe-stick folder, the download folder.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Folders(string appFolder, string localAppData) =>
        [appFolder, System.IO.Path.Combine(appFolder, "probe-stick"), System.IO.Path.Combine(localAppData, "IntelXe Manager", "probe-stick")];

    /// The images in those folders that have a .sha256 beside them, the newest version first.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Find(IEnumerable<string> folders)
    {
        var found = new List<string>();
        foreach (var dir in folders)
        {
            try
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(dir)) continue;
                foreach (var f in Directory.EnumerateFiles(dir, FilePattern))
                    if (VersionOf(f).Length > 0 && File.Exists(f + ".sha256") && !found.Contains(System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(f), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        found.Add(System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(f));
            }
            catch (IOException) { }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
        return [.. found.OrderByDescending(f => System.Version.TryParse(Pad(VersionOf(f)), out var v) ? v : new System.Version(0, 0))];
    }

    static string Pad(string v) => v.Contains('.') ? v : v + ".0";

    /// The SHA-256 the .sha256 beside the image names: sha256sum's "HASH  NAME" (or "HASH *NAME"); with several lines, the
    /// one naming this file; a single bare hash is taken too.
    public static string ExpectedHash(string imagePath)
    {
        var file = imagePath + ".sha256";
        if (!File.Exists(file)) throw new ProbeException($"no {System.IO.Path.GetFileName(file)} beside the image: it cannot be checked, so it is not written");
        var info = new FileInfo(file);
        if (info.Length > 64 * 1024) throw new ProbeException($"{info.Name} is not a SHA-256 file");
        var lines = File.ReadAllLines(file).Select(l => l.Trim()).Where(l => l.Length > 0 && !l.StartsWith('#')).ToList();
        string name = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(imagePath);
        var entries = lines.Select(l => l.Split((char[]?)null, 2, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))
            .Where(p => IsHex64(p[0]))
            .Select(p => (Hash: p[0], Name: p.Length > 1 ? p[1].TrimStart('*').Trim() : ""))
            .ToList();
        // one line: its hash, whatever name it gives (a renamed image; write-stick.sh reads the first field only)
        string? hash = entries.Count == 1 ? entries[0].Hash
            : entries.FirstOrDefault(e => string.Equals(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(e.Name), name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).Hash;
        return hash?.ToLowerInvariant() ?? throw new ProbeException($"{info.Name} holds no SHA-256 for {name}");
    }

    static bool IsHex64(string s) => s.Length == 64 && s.All(Uri.IsHexDigit);

    /// Whether the bytes are the stick's layout: an MBR whose first partition is FAT32 and starts inside the image, with a
    /// FAT32 boot sector labelled XEPROBE there. Throws with the reason.
    public static void CheckLayout(Stream s)
    {
        long length = s.Length;
        if (length < (1 << 20) || length > MaxSize) throw new ProbeException($"{length} bytes: not a probe stick image (about 200 MB)");
        if (length % 512 != 0) throw new ProbeException("its size is not a whole number of 512-byte sectors: not a disk image");
        var mbr = new byte[512];
        s.Position = 0;
        s.ReadExactly(mbr);
        if (mbr[510] != 0x55 || mbr[511] != 0xAA) throw new ProbeException("no MBR: not a probe stick image");
        byte type = mbr[446 + 4];
        long start = BitConverter.ToUInt32(mbr, 446 + 8);
        if (type is not (0x0B or 0x0C)) throw new ProbeException($"its first partition is not FAT32 (type 0x{type:X2}): not a probe stick image");
        if (start == 0 || (start + 1) * 512 > length) throw new ProbeException("its first partition starts outside the image");
        var boot = new byte[512];
        s.Position = start * 512;
        s.ReadExactly(boot);
        if (boot[510] != 0x55 || boot[511] != 0xAA || Encoding.ASCII.GetString(boot, 82, 8) != "FAT32   ")
            throw new ProbeException("its partition holds no FAT32 file system: not a probe stick image");
        var label = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(boot, 71, 11).TrimEnd();
        if (label != Label) throw new ProbeException($"its partition is labelled \"{label}\", not {Label}: not a probe stick image");
    }

    /// The image checked: its layout, then its SHA-256 against the .sha256 beside it. progress: 0..1 while hashing.
    public static ProbeImageInfo Verify(string path, Action<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(path)) throw new ProbeException($"no image {path}");
        var want = ExpectedHash(path);
        using var f = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read, 1 << 20, FileOptions.SequentialScan);
        CheckLayout(f);
        f.Position = 0;
        var got = Hash(f, f.Length, progress, cancel);
        if (got != want) throw new ProbeException($"{System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path)} does not match its .sha256 (SHA-256 {got[..12]}…, expected {want[..12]}…): download it again");
        return new ProbeImageInfo(System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(path), f.Length, got, VersionOf(path));
    }

    /// SHA-256 of the next length bytes of the stream, lower-case hex.
    public static string Hash(Stream s, long length, Action<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        using var h = IncrementalHash.CreateHash(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
        var buf = new byte[4 << 20];
        long done = 0;
        while (done < length)
        {
            cancel.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            int n = s.Read(buf, 0, (int)Math.Min(buf.Length, length - done));
            if (n <= 0) throw new ProbeException($"the image ended after {done} of {length} bytes");
            h.AppendData(buf, 0, n);
            done += n;
            progress?.Invoke((double)done / length);
        }
        return Convert.ToHexStringLower(h.GetHashAndReset());
    }

    public static string SizeText(long bytes) => (bytes / 1e6).ToString("0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " MB";
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/ProbeStick/ProbeReports.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The reports on a probe stick, as the Report page shows them: the stick's FAT32 volume (label XEPROBE, with the marker
// file) holds REPORTS\xe-stick-XR-XXXXXXXX.tar.gz with its .txt summary and a .sha256 of both, or, when the stick's
// privacy check failed, only xe-stick-XR-XXXXXXXX-privacy-check-failed.txt (tools/probe-stick/rootfs/usr/lib/xe-stick/
// scan.sh). Each report is checked without unpacking it to disk: the .sha256 against the .tar.gz and the .txt, and the
// SEAL.sha256 inside against every file of the archive (System.Formats.Tar over a GZipStream), every file listed and
// nothing besides.
using System.Formats.Tar;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using IntelXe.Core.Report;

namespace IntelXe.Core.ProbeStick;

public enum ProbeReportState { Sealed, Broken, PrivacyCheckFailed }

public sealed class ProbeReport
{
    public required string Id { get; init; }
    public required string Name { get; init; }
    /// The .tar.gz; null for a privacy-check-failed note.
    public string? Archive { get; init; }
    /// The .txt summary, or the privacy-check-failed note.
    public string? SummaryFile { get; init; }
    public string SummaryText { get; init; } = "";
    public long Size { get; init; }
    public DateTime Written { get; init; }
    public ProbeReportState State { get; init; }
    /// The files SEAL.sha256 lists, each found and matching.
    public int SealedFiles { get; init; }
    /// What is wrong, in English; empty for a sealed report.
    public IReadOnlyList<string> Problems { get; init; } = [];
    /// GitHub takes attachments up to 25 MB; the stick keeps its reports below that.
    public bool TooLargeForGitHub => Size > 25L * 1000 * 1000;
}

public static partial class ProbeReports
{
    public const string ReportsFolder = "REPORTS";
    /// Read at most this much of a summary into the page.
    const int SummaryLimit = 256 * 1024;
    /// A report's archive is under 25 MB; its contents, unpacked in memory one file at a time, stay below this.
    const long UnpackedLimit = 4L << 30;

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^xe-stick-(XR-[0-9A-Fa-f]{8})\.tar\.gz$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)]
    private static partial Regex ArchiveRe();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^xe-stick-(XR-[0-9A-Fa-f]{8})-privacy-check-failed\.txt$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)]
    private static partial Regex PrivacyRe();

    /// Whether a volume is a probe stick: labelled XEPROBE and holding the marker file at its root.
    public static bool IsProbeStick(string root, string? label) =>
        string.Equals(label?.Trim(), ProbeImage.Label, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && File.Exists(Path.Combine(root, ProbeImage.Marker));

    /// The probe sticks among the volumes (root, label).
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> FindSticks(IEnumerable<(string Root, string? Label)> volumes) =>
        [.. volumes.Where(v => { try { return IsProbeStick(v.Root, v.Label); } catch (IOException) { return false; } catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { return false; } })
                   .Select(v => v.Root)];

    /// The stick's reports, newest first, each checked.
    public static IReadOnlyList<ProbeReport> Read(string stickRoot, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        var dir = Path.Combine(stickRoot, ReportsFolder);
        if (!Directory.Exists(dir)) return [];
        var list = new List<ProbeReport>();
        foreach (var f in Directory.EnumerateFiles(dir))
        {
            cancel.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            var name = Path.GetFileName(f);
            if (ArchiveRe().Match(name) is { Success: true } m) list.Add(Check(f, m.Groups[1].Value.ToUpperInvariant(), cancel));
            else if (PrivacyRe().Match(name) is { Success: true } pm)
                list.Add(new ProbeReport
                {
                    Id = pm.Groups[1].Value.ToUpperInvariant(), Name = name[..^4], SummaryFile = f, SummaryText = ReadText(f),
                    Size = new FileInfo(f).Length, Written = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(f), State = ProbeReportState.PrivacyCheckFailed,
                });
        }
        return [.. list.OrderByDescending(r => r.Written).ThenBy(r => r.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal)];
    }

    /// One report: its .sha256 and the SEAL.sha256 inside.
    public static ProbeReport Check(string archive, string id, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        var problems = new List<string>();
        var dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(archive)!;
        var name = Path.GetFileName(archive)[..^".tar.gz".Length];
        var summary = Path.Combine(dir, name + ".txt");
        var hashFile = Path.Combine(dir, name + ".sha256");
        if (!ReportRun.IsReportId(id)) problems.Add($"{id} is not a report ID");

        // the .sha256 the stick wrote beside them: sha256sum of the .tar.gz and the .txt
        if (!File.Exists(hashFile)) problems.Add($"{name}.sha256 is missing");
        else
        {
            var sums = ParseSums(ReadText(hashFile), problems, name + ".sha256");
            foreach (var (file, required) in new[] { (name + ".tar.gz", true), (name + ".txt", false) })
            {
                var path = Path.Combine(dir, file);
                if (!sums.TryGetValue(file, out var want)) { if (required) problems.Add($"{name}.sha256 does not list {file}"); continue; }
                if (!File.Exists(path)) { problems.Add($"{file} is missing"); continue; }
                using var s = File.OpenRead(path);
                if (ProbeImage.Hash(s, s.Length, null, cancel) != want) problems.Add($"{file} does not match {name}.sha256");
            }
        }
        if (!File.Exists(summary)) problems.Add($"{name}.txt (the summary) is missing");

        int sealedFiles = 0;
        try { sealedFiles = CheckSeal(archive, name, problems, cancel); }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is InvalidDataException or IOException or FormatException or ArgumentException)
        {
            problems.Add($"the archive cannot be read: {e.Message}");
        }

        return new ProbeReport
        {
            Id = id, Name = name, Archive = archive, SummaryFile = File.Exists(summary) ? summary : null,
            SummaryText = File.Exists(summary) ? ReadText(summary) : "", Size = new FileInfo(archive).Length,
            Written = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(archive), SealedFiles = sealedFiles, Problems = problems,
            State = problems.Count == 0 ? ProbeReportState.Sealed : ProbeReportState.Broken,
        };
    }

    /// Every file in the archive (under the one folder NAME/) hashed as it streams by; then SEAL.sha256's lines checked
    /// against them: each listed file present and matching, no file that is not listed. Returns the files that matched.
    static int CheckSeal(string archive, string name, List<string> problems, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        var hashes = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        string? seal = null;
        long unpacked = 0;
        using (var file = File.OpenRead(archive))
        using (var gz = new GZipStream(file, CompressionMode.Decompress))
        using (var tar = new TarReader(gz))
        {
            var buf = new byte[1 << 20];
            TarEntry? e;
            while ((e = tar.GetNextEntry()) is not null)
            {
                cancel.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                var path = e.Name.Replace('\\', '/');
                if (path.StartsWith("./", StringComparison.Ordinal)) path = path[2..];
                if (path.TrimEnd('/') == name && e.EntryType is TarEntryType.Directory) continue;
                if (!path.StartsWith(name + "/", StringComparison.Ordinal) || path.Split('/').Contains(".."))
                {
                    problems.Add($"the archive holds {path}, outside {name}/");
                    continue;
                }
                var rel = path[(name.Length + 1)..];
                if (e.EntryType is TarEntryType.Directory) continue;
                if (e.EntryType is not (TarEntryType.RegularFile or TarEntryType.V7RegularFile))
                {
                    problems.Add($"the archive holds {rel} as a {e.EntryType}, not a file");
                    continue;
                }
                unpacked += e.Length;
                if (unpacked > UnpackedLimit) throw new InvalidDataException("it unpacks to more than 4 GB");
                using var h = IncrementalHash.CreateHash(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
                var data = e.DataStream;
                MemoryStream? keep = rel == "SEAL.sha256" ? new MemoryStream() : null;
                if (data is not null)
                {
                    int n;
                    while ((n = data.Read(buf, 0, buf.Length)) > 0) { h.AppendData(buf, 0, n); keep?.Write(buf, 0, n); }
                }
                if (keep is not null) seal = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(keep.ToArray());
                else if (!hashes.TryAdd(rel, Convert.ToHexStringLower(h.GetHashAndReset()))) problems.Add($"the archive holds {rel} twice");
            }
        }
        if (seal is null) { problems.Add("the archive holds no SEAL.sha256"); return 0; }
        var listed = ParseSums(seal, problems, "SEAL.sha256");
        int ok = 0;
        foreach (var (rel, want) in listed)
        {
            if (!hashes.TryGetValue(rel, out var got)) problems.Add($"SEAL.sha256 lists {rel}, which is not in the archive");
            else if (got != want) problems.Add($"{rel} does not match SEAL.sha256");
            else ok++;
        }
        foreach (var rel in hashes.Keys.Where(k => !listed.ContainsKey(k)).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal))
            problems.Add($"{rel} is in the archive but not in SEAL.sha256");
        return ok;
    }

    /// sha256sum's lines ("HASH  NAME", or "HASH *NAME"): name to lower-case hash.
    static Dictionary<string, string> ParseSums(string text, List<string> problems, string what)
    {
        var d = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var raw in text.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = raw.TrimEnd('\r');
            if (line.Length == 0) continue;
            int sp = line.IndexOf(' ');
            var hash = sp < 0 ? line : line[..sp];
            var file = sp < 0 ? "" : line[(sp + 1)..].TrimStart(' ', '*');
            if (hash.Length != 64 || !hash.All(Uri.IsHexDigit) || file.Length == 0) { problems.Add($"{what} has a line that is not a SHA-256 and a name"); continue; }
            if (!d.TryAdd(file, hash.ToLowerInvariant())) problems.Add($"{what} lists {file} twice");
        }
        return d;
    }

    static string ReadText(string path)
    {
        using var f = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite);
        var buf = new byte[(int)Math.Min(f.Length, SummaryLimit)];
        f.ReadExactly(buf);
        return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(buf).Replace("\r\n", "\n");
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/ProbeStick/ProbeWriter.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Writing the Xe probe stick's image raw to a USB disk, without Windows APIs: the elevated helper's command line, and the
// order of the work. The app starts its own exe with "--probe-helper write ..." through "runas", as the installer stick
// does with --stick-helper; only that process has administrator rights, for one disk. It checks the image (layout and
// SHA-256), reads the disk again and refuses it by the shared StickRules, compares it with the one the user chose (serial
// and size, as a salted hash), refuses a disk holding an EFI unless the user confirmed that (--erase-efi), reads it once
// more right before writing, then (IProbeSystem: Windows in the app, a file in the tests) locks and dismounts its volumes
// and writes \\.\PhysicalDriveN in aligned 4 MiB blocks: every block but the first, the disk's last MiB zeroed (a GPT's
// backup header from the stick's earlier life would contradict the image's MBR), the first block last (until then no
// partition table points at a half-written file system). Then it flushes, has Windows read the new partition table,
// reads the image's length back and compares its SHA-256.
using System.Globalization;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using IntelXe.Core.Stick;

namespace IntelXe.Core.ProbeStick;

public enum ProbeVerb { Check, Write }

/// One helper run. Check: everything Write does before writing, and nothing after.
public sealed record ProbeHelperRequest(ProbeVerb Verb, uint Disk, ulong Size, string Id, string Salt, string Image,
    bool EraseEfi = false, bool AllowLarge = false, string? TestVhdx = null, string? Out = null, string? Progress = null)
{
    public const string Switch = "--probe-helper";

    public IReadOnlyList<string> ToArgs()
    {
        var a = new List<string>
        {
            Switch, Verb.ToString().ToLowerInvariant(), "--disk", Disk.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            "--size", Size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "--id", Id, "--salt", Salt, "--image", Image,
        };
        if (EraseEfi) a.Add("--erase-efi");
        if (AllowLarge) a.Add("--allow-large");
        void Add(string name, string? value) { if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) a.AddRange([name, value]); }
        Add("--test-vhdx", TestVhdx);
        Add("--progress", Progress);
        Add("--out", Out);
        return a;
    }

    public static ProbeHelperRequest Parse(IReadOnlyList<string> args)
    {
        if (args.Count < 2 || args[0] != Switch) throw new ProbeException("the helper's command line starts with " + Switch + " check|write");
        var verb = args[1] switch
        {
            "check" => ProbeVerb.Check, "write" => ProbeVerb.Write,
            _ => throw new ProbeException("no helper verb " + args[1] + " (check, write)"),
        };
        var v = HelperArgs.Parse(args, 2, ["--disk", "--size", "--id", "--salt", "--image", "--test-vhdx", "--out", "--progress"],
            ["--erase-efi", "--allow-large"], m => new ProbeException(m));
        string? V(string k) => v.TryGetValue(k, out var s) ? s : null;
        if (!uint.TryParse(V("--disk"), NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var disk)) throw new ProbeException("the helper needs --disk N");
        if (!ulong.TryParse(V("--size"), NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var size)) throw new ProbeException("the helper needs --size BYTES");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(V("--id")) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(V("--salt"))) throw new ProbeException("nothing written: the helper needs the disk's identity (--id, --salt)");
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(V("--image"))) throw new ProbeException("the helper needs --image FILE");
        return new ProbeHelperRequest(verb, disk, size, V("--id")!, V("--salt")!, V("--image")!, v.ContainsKey("--erase-efi"), v.ContainsKey("--allow-large"),
            V("--test-vhdx"), V("--out"), V("--progress"));
    }
}

/// A whole disk opened for raw writing. Offsets and lengths are whole sectors (Windows' unbuffered I/O requires it;
/// the file stand-in checks it too).
public interface IRawDisk : IDisposable
{
    /// The disk's size in bytes.
    long Length { get; }
    int SectorSize { get; }
    void Write(long offset, ReadOnlySpan<byte> data);
    /// Reads buffer.Length bytes (or up to the disk's end) at offset; returns how many.
    int Read(long offset, Span<byte> buffer);
    /// Writes everything through to the disk and has Windows read its new partition table (IOCTL_DISK_UPDATE_PROPERTIES).
    void Flush();
}

/// What the probe writer needs from Windows: the disks, and one opened raw with its volumes locked and dismounted.
public interface IProbeSystem : IStickDisks
{
    /// Locks and dismounts every volume of the disk (checked by the caller just before), and opens it for raw writing
    /// and reading. Disposing the disk closes it and releases the volumes.
    IRawDisk Open(StickDisk disk);
}

public static class ProbeWriter
{
    public const int Block = 4 << 20;
    /// The disk's last MiB is zeroed: where a GPT keeps its backup header.
    public const int Tail = 1 << 20;

    /// Check or Write. progress: a stage (verify-image, write, read-back, done) and a fraction 0..1. protectedLetters:
    /// drives that must not be written besides the rules' (where the app is).
    public static StickHelperResult Run(ProbeHelperRequest q, IProbeSystem sys, Action<string, double>? progress = null,
        IReadOnlyList<string>? protectedLetters = null, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        var r = new StickHelperResult();
        try
        {
            progress?.Invoke("verify-image", 0);
            var image = ProbeImage.Verify(q.Image, f => progress?.Invoke("verify-image", f), cancel);
            r.Lines.Add($"image {Path.GetFileName(image.Path)}: {ProbeImage.SizeText(image.Size)}, the stick's layout, SHA-256 matches its .sha256 ({image.Sha256[..16]}…)");

            var letters = new List<string>(protectedLetters ?? []);
            if (image.Path is { Length: >= 2 } p && p[1] == ':') letters.Add(p[..2]);
            var policy = new StickPolicy((ulong)image.Size, q.TestVhdx, letters, q.AllowLarge);

            var disk = StickWriter.Reinspect(sys, q.Disk, q.Size, q.Id, q.Salt, policy, q.EraseEfi, r);
            if (disk is null) return r;
            r.Lines.Add($"disk {disk.Number}: {disk.FriendlyName} {StickRules.SizeText(disk.Size)} {disk.BusName}, the one chosen, nothing refuses it"
                + (StickRules.HoldsEfi(disk) ? "; it holds an EFI, and erasing it was confirmed" : ""));
            if (q.Verb == ProbeVerb.Check)
            {
                r.Lines.Add("check only: nothing written");
                r.Ok = true;
                return r;
            }

            // read it once more right before writing
            disk = StickWriter.Reinspect(sys, q.Disk, q.Size, q.Id, q.Salt, policy, q.EraseEfi, r);
            if (disk is null) return r;
            progress?.Invoke("write", 0);
            using (var dev = sys.Open(disk))
            {
                r.Written = true;
                Write(image, dev, f => progress?.Invoke("write", f), cancel);
                r.Lines.Add($"wrote {ProbeImage.SizeText(image.Size)} to disk {disk.Number} in {Block >> 20} MiB blocks (sector {dev.SectorSize} bytes), the first block last; the disk's last MiB zeroed");
                progress?.Invoke("read-back", 0);
                var back = ReadBack(dev, image.Size, f => progress?.Invoke("read-back", f), cancel);
                if (back != image.Sha256) throw new ProbeException($"the read-back differs from the image (SHA-256 {back[..12]}…): try another stick");
                r.Lines.Add($"read back: the first {image.Size} bytes of the disk match the image (SHA-256 {back[..16]}…)");
            }
            progress?.Invoke("done", 1);
            r.Ok = true;
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            r.Ok = false;
            r.Error = e is AggregateException { InnerException: { } inner } ? inner.Message : e.Message;
        }
        return r;
    }

    /// The image onto the disk: blocks 1.. first, then the disk's last MiB zeroed, then block 0; then Flush.
    public static void Write(ProbeImageInfo image, IRawDisk dev, Action<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        int sector = dev.SectorSize;
        if (sector <= 0 || Block % sector != 0 || Tail % sector != 0) throw new ProbeException($"the disk's sector size {sector} is not supported");
        long padded = (image.Size + sector - 1) / sector * sector;
        if (dev.Length < padded) throw new ProbeException($"the disk ({dev.Length} bytes) is smaller than the image");
        using var src = new FileStream(image.Path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read, 1 << 20, FileOptions.SequentialScan);
        if (src.Length != image.Size) throw new ProbeException("the image changed after it was checked");
        var buf = new byte[Block];
        long blocks = (padded + Block - 1) / Block;
        long done = 0;
        byte[]? first = null;
        using var hash = IncrementalHash.CreateHash(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
        for (long b = 0; b < blocks; b++)
        {
            cancel.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            long offset = b * Block;
            int want = (int)Math.Min(Block, padded - offset);
            Array.Clear(buf, 0, want);
            int got = 0, n;
            while (got < want && (n = src.Read(buf, got, (int)Math.Min(want, image.Size - offset) - got)) > 0) got += n;
            if (got != Math.Min(want, image.Size - offset)) throw new ProbeException("the image ended early while writing");
            hash.AppendData(buf, 0, got);
            if (b == 0) { first = buf[..want]; continue; }   // the partition table goes on last
            dev.Write(offset, buf.AsSpan(0, want));
            done += want;
            progress?.Invoke((double)done / padded);
        }
        // the bytes written are the bytes checked: a file changed between the check and here is not left on the disk
        if (Convert.ToHexStringLower(hash.GetHashAndReset()) != image.Sha256) throw new ProbeException("the image changed after it was checked: the stick is not usable, write it again");

        long tailStart = Math.Max(padded, (dev.Length - Tail) / sector * sector);
        if (tailStart < dev.Length)
        {
            var zeros = new byte[(int)Math.Min(Tail, dev.Length - tailStart) / sector * sector];
            if (zeros.Length > 0) dev.Write(tailStart, zeros);
        }
        dev.Write(0, first!);
        progress?.Invoke(1);
        dev.Flush();
    }

    /// SHA-256 of the disk's first length bytes, read in whole sectors.
    public static string ReadBack(IRawDisk dev, long length, Action<double>? progress = null, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        int sector = dev.SectorSize;
        long padded = (length + sector - 1) / sector * sector;
        var buf = new byte[Block];
        using var hash = IncrementalHash.CreateHash(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
        for (long offset = 0; offset < padded; offset += Block)
        {
            cancel.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            int want = (int)Math.Min(Block, padded - offset);
            int got = dev.Read(offset, buf.AsSpan(0, want));
            if (got != want) throw new ProbeException($"the disk ended after {offset + got} bytes while reading it back");
            hash.AppendData(buf, 0, (int)Math.Min(want, length - offset));
            progress?.Invoke((double)Math.Min(offset + want, length) / length);
        }
        return Convert.ToHexStringLower(hash.GetHashAndReset());
    }
}

/// A file standing in for a disk (the tests; a VHD's file is not written this way): a fixed length, and only whole
/// sectors at sector-aligned offsets, as Windows' unbuffered I/O on \\.\PhysicalDriveN allows.
public sealed class FileRawDisk(string path, int sectorSize = 512) : IRawDisk
{
    readonly FileStream f = new(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.Read);
    public long Length => f.Length;
    public int SectorSize => sectorSize;
    public int Writes { get; private set; }
    public List<long> WriteOffsets { get; } = [];
    public bool Flushed { get; private set; }

    void Aligned(long offset, int length)
    {
        if (offset % sectorSize != 0 || length % sectorSize != 0) throw new IOException($"unaligned access at {offset}, {length} bytes (sector {sectorSize})");
    }

    public void Write(long offset, ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
    {
        Aligned(offset, data.Length);
        if (offset + data.Length > f.Length) throw new IOException("write past the disk's end");
        f.Position = offset;
        f.Write(data);
        Writes++;
        WriteOffsets.Add(offset);
    }

    public int Read(long offset, Span<byte> buffer)
    {
        Aligned(offset, buffer.Length);
        f.Position = offset;
        int total = 0, n;
        while (total < buffer.Length && (n = f.Read(buffer[total..])) > 0) total += n;
        return total;
    }

    public void Flush() { f.Flush(true); Flushed = true; }
    public void Dispose() => f.Dispose();
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Release/Ed25519.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Ed25519 signature verification (RFC 8032, section 5.1.7), for the release's signed list of hashes. .NET has no
// Ed25519, and the app takes no cryptography package for one check of one signature per download: this is the RFC's
// arithmetic on System.Numerics.BigInteger (a few milliseconds; the inputs are public, so it need not be constant time).
// It accepts what CryptoKit (release/signing.swift, the macOS app) and BoringSSL accept: a public key that decodes to a
// point, S below the group order, and [S]B - [k]A encoding to exactly the signature's R (cofactorless, compared as bytes).
// Tested with RFC 8032's vectors and with signatures CryptoKit made (IntelXe.Core.Tests, ReleaseSigningTests).
using System.Numerics;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Release;

public static class Ed25519
{
    static readonly BigInteger P = BigInteger.Pow(2, 255) - 19;
    static readonly BigInteger L = BigInteger.Pow(2, 252) + BigInteger.Parse("27742317777372353535851937790883648493");
    static readonly BigInteger D = Mod(-121665 * Inv(121666));
    static readonly BigInteger D2 = Mod(2 * D);
    static readonly BigInteger SqrtM1 = BigInteger.ModPow(2, (P - 1) / 4, P);
    static readonly Point B = BasePoint();

    /// Whether signature (64 bytes) is publicKey's (32 bytes) signature of message. False for any malformed input.
    public static bool Verify(ReadOnlySpan<byte> publicKey, ReadOnlySpan<byte> message, ReadOnlySpan<byte> signature)
    {
        if (publicKey.Length != 32 || signature.Length != 64) return false;
        if (Decode(publicKey) is not { } a) return false;
        var s = new BigInteger(signature[32..], isUnsigned: true, isBigEndian: false);
        if (s >= L) return false;
        var buf = new byte[64 + message.Length];
        signature[..32].CopyTo(buf);
        publicKey.CopyTo(buf.AsSpan(32));
        message.CopyTo(buf.AsSpan(64));
        var k = new BigInteger(SHA512.HashData(buf), isUnsigned: true, isBigEndian: false) % L;
        // [S]B + [k](-A) must be R
        var r = Add(Multiply(B, s), Multiply(Negate(a), k));
        return Encode(r).AsSpan().SequenceEqual(signature[..32]);
    }

    // ---- the field and the curve: extended coordinates (X:Y:Z:T), x = X/Z, y = Y/Z, x*y = T/Z ----

    readonly record struct Point(BigInteger X, BigInteger Y, BigInteger Z, BigInteger T);

    static BigInteger Mod(BigInteger v) { var m = v % P; return m.Sign < 0 ? m + P : m; }
    static BigInteger Inv(BigInteger v) => BigInteger.ModPow(Mod(v), P - 2, P);

    static readonly Point Zero = new(0, 1, 1, 0);

    /// RFC 8032 5.1.4: the complete addition law of the twisted Edwards curve with a = -1 (also used for doubling).
    static Point Add(Point p, Point q)
    {
        var a = Mod((p.Y - p.X) * (q.Y - q.X));
        var b = Mod((p.Y + p.X) * (q.Y + q.X));
        var c = Mod(p.T * D2 * q.T);
        var d = Mod(2 * p.Z * q.Z);
        BigInteger e = b - a, f = d - c, g = d + c, h = b + a;
        return new Point(Mod(e * f), Mod(g * h), Mod(f * g), Mod(e * h));
    }

    static Point Negate(Point p) => new(Mod(-p.X), p.Y, p.Z, Mod(-p.T));

    static Point Multiply(Point p, BigInteger n)
    {
        var r = Zero;
        for (int i = (int)n.GetBitLength() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            r = Add(r, r);
            if (!(n >> i).IsEven) r = Add(r, p);
        }
        return r;
    }

    static byte[] Encode(Point p)
    {
        var zi = Inv(p.Z);
        var x = Mod(p.X * zi);
        var y = Mod(p.Y * zi);
        var b = new byte[32];
        y.TryWriteBytes(b, out _, isUnsigned: true, isBigEndian: false);
        if (!x.IsEven) b[31] |= 0x80;
        return b;
    }

    /// RFC 8032 5.1.3; null when the bytes are not a point (y not below p, no square root, or x = 0 with its sign bit set).
    static Point? Decode(ReadOnlySpan<byte> s)
    {
        var bytes = s.ToArray();
        bool sign = (bytes[31] & 0x80) != 0;
        bytes[31] &= 0x7F;
        var y = new BigInteger(bytes, isUnsigned: true, isBigEndian: false);
        if (y >= P) return null;
        var x = RecoverX(y, sign);
        return x is { } xv ? new Point(xv, y, 1, Mod(xv * y)) : null;
    }

    static BigInteger? RecoverX(BigInteger y, bool sign)
    {
        var y2 = Mod(y * y);
        var u = Mod(y2 - 1);
        var v = Mod(D * y2 + 1);
        // x = u v^3 (u v^7)^((p-5)/8)
        var v3 = Mod(v * v * v);
        var x = Mod(u * v3 * BigInteger.ModPow(Mod(u * v3 * v3 * v), (P - 5) / 8, P));
        var vx2 = Mod(v * x * x);
        if (vx2 != u)
        {
            if (vx2 != Mod(-u)) return null;
            x = Mod(x * SqrtM1);
        }
        if (x.IsZero && sign) return null;
        if (!x.IsEven != sign) x = P - x;
        return x;
    }

    static Point BasePoint()
    {
        var y = Mod(4 * Inv(5));
        var x = RecoverX(y, false)!.Value;
        return new Point(x, y, 1, Mod(x * y));
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The project's releases as GitHub's REST API lists them (GET /repos/OWNER/REPO/releases): the fields the app reads, as
// the macOS app's Release and ReleaseAsset do (app/Sources/Model.swift). Unknown fields are ignored.
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Release;

public sealed record GitHubAsset(
    [property: JsonPropertyName("name")] string Name,
    [property: JsonPropertyName("browser_download_url")] string Url,
    [property: JsonPropertyName("size")] long Size,
    [property: JsonPropertyName("state")] string? State = null);

public sealed record GitHubRelease(
    [property: JsonPropertyName("tag_name")] string Tag,
    [property: JsonPropertyName("html_url")] string? HtmlUrl,
    [property: JsonPropertyName("draft")] bool Draft,
    [property: JsonPropertyName("prerelease")] bool Prerelease,
    [property: JsonPropertyName("assets")] IReadOnlyList<GitHubAsset> Assets)
{
    /// The API's address of the newest releases of the project (one page; the newest come first).
    public static Uri ListUrl(string repository = Project.Repository, int perPage = 30) =>
        new($"https://api.github.com/repos/{repository}/releases?per_page={perPage}");

    /// "0.1.5" from the tag v0.1.5; null for a tag that is not vX.Y.Z (as the macOS app's Version).
    public System.Version? Version =>
        Tag.StartsWith('v') && System.Version.TryParse(Tag[1..], out var v) && v.Build >= 0 && v.Revision < 0 ? v : null;

    /// The version as the release's file names carry it ("0.1.5").
    public string VersionText => Version?.ToString(3) ?? "";

    /// An uploaded asset of exactly this name, or null.
    public GitHubAsset? Asset(string name) =>
        Assets.FirstOrDefault(a => a.Name == name && (a.State is null or "uploaded"));

    /// The release's list of hashes, intel-gpu-macos-driver-VERSION.sha256.
    public GitHubAsset? HashList => Asset($"intel-gpu-macos-driver-{VersionText}.sha256");

    /// Its signature: .sha256.sigs (one line per key, during a key change) when the release has it, else .sha256.sig,
    /// as the macOS app reads them.
    public GitHubAsset? HashListSignature => Asset($"intel-gpu-macos-driver-{VersionText}.sha256.sigs") ?? Asset($"intel-gpu-macos-driver-{VersionText}.sha256.sig");

    static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Options = new() { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = false };

    /// The API's answer: a JSON array of releases. Throws JsonException on anything else.
    public static IReadOnlyList<GitHubRelease> ParseList(string json) =>
        JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<GitHubRelease>>(json, Options) is { } list
            ? [.. list.Where(r => r is { Tag: not null, Assets: not null })]
            : throw new JsonException("not a list of releases");
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Release/ReleaseSigning.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Release signatures, as the macOS app checks them (app/Sources/Signing.swift): a release's list of hashes
// (intel-gpu-macos-driver-VERSION.sha256) is signed with the project's Ed25519 key (release/signing.swift,
// VERSION.sha256.sig beside it; VERSION.sha256.sigs with one line per key during a key change: docs/RELEASE-KEYS.md).
// The app takes a downloaded release file only when that list is signed by a key below and the file's SHA-256 is in it,
// so a file that only came from the same GitHub page (an account taken over, an asset replaced) is refused.
namespace IntelXe.Core.Release;

public static class ReleaseSigning
{
    /// Ed25519 public keys whose signatures the app accepts (base64 of the raw 32 bytes): the same list as the macOS app's
    /// releaseSigningKeys (a test holds the two together). A new key goes here in a release signed with an old one before
    /// the old one is retired (docs/RELEASE-KEYS.md). release/release-keys.sh edits both lists together: keep this on one
    /// line.
    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> Keys = ["PZGslAxn39LtMGgkWHbn9MzK8nc+IeM2TrvJpbifZXA="];

    /// Whether signature (the .sig file's text: base64, one line; or the .sigs file's: one signature per line) holds a
    /// signature of list by one of keys (Keys when null).
    public static bool SignatureValid(ReadOnlySpan<byte> list, string signature, IReadOnlyList<string>? keys = null)
    {
        var raw = new List<byte[]>();
        foreach (var k in keys ?? Keys)
            if (FromBase64(k) is { Length: 32 } b) raw.Add(b);
        foreach (var line in signature.Split('\n'))
        {
            if (FromBase64(line.Trim()) is not { Length: 64 } sig) continue;
            foreach (var key in raw)
                if (Ed25519.Verify(key, list, sig)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static byte[]? FromBase64(string s)
    {
        if (s.Length == 0) return null;
        try { return Convert.FromBase64String(s); }
        catch (FormatException) { return null; }
    }

    /// The SHA-256 a `shasum -a 256` list gives for this file name (lower-case hex), or null: lines "HASH  NAME" or
    /// "HASH *NAME", the name compared exactly.
    public static string? ListedHash(string list, string name)
    {
        foreach (var raw in list.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = raw.TrimEnd('\r');
            int sp = line.IndexOf(' ');
            if (sp != 64) continue;
            var hash = line[..64];
            if (!hash.All(Uri.IsHexDigit)) continue;
            var rest = line[65..];
            if (rest.StartsWith(' ') || rest.StartsWith('*')) rest = rest[1..];
            if (rest == name) return hash.ToLowerInvariant();
        }
        return null;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core.Report;

/// What tools/report/collect-windows.ps1 printed at its end: "Report ID: XR-1A2B3C4D" and "File:      C:\...\xe-report-XR-1A2B3C4D.zip".
public sealed record ReportResult(string Id, string File);

public static class ReportRun
{
    /// The report ID and file from the script's output; null when it wrote no report.
    public static ReportResult? Parse(IEnumerable<string> lines)
    {
        string? id = null, file = null;
        foreach (var raw in lines)
        {
            var line = raw.Trim();
            if (line.StartsWith("Report ID:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) id = line["Report ID:".Length..].Trim();
            else if (line.StartsWith("File:", StringComparison.Ordinal)) file = line["File:".Length..].Trim();
        }
        if (id is null || file is null || !IsReportId(id)) return null;
        return new ReportResult(id, file);
    }

    /// XR- and eight hex digits, as the collectors make them.
    public static bool IsReportId(string id) =>
        id.Length == 11 && id.StartsWith("XR-", StringComparison.Ordinal) && id[3..].All(Uri.IsHexDigit);

    /// The arguments for Windows PowerShell 5.1 (part of Windows): this one run bypasses the execution policy, as the
    /// guide tells users to run it by hand.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> PowerShellArguments(string script, string outDir, bool acpi, bool bootLogs = false)
    {
        var args = new List<string> { "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", script, "-OutDir", outDir };
        if (acpi) args.Add("-Acpi");
        if (bootLogs) args.Add("-BootLogs");
        return args;
    }

    /// The same run as administrator, for -BootLogs on the EFI partitions (mounting one needs it): started with "runas",
    /// which cannot pass its output back through a pipe, so -Command runs the script with every stream it prints (Write-Host
    /// included) written to outputFile, which the app reads when the run has ended. Paths are single-quoted PowerShell
    /// strings.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> ElevatedArguments(string script, string outDir, bool acpi, bool bootLogs, string outputFile)
    {
        static string Q(string s) => "'" + s.Replace("'", "''") + "'";
        var command = "& " + Q(script) + " -OutDir " + Q(outDir) + (acpi ? " -Acpi" : "") + (bootLogs ? " -BootLogs" : "")
            + " *>&1 | Out-File -FilePath " + Q(outputFile) + " -Encoding UTF8";
        return ["-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", command];
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Setup/SetupWizard.cs
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The "Set up" page's guided flow from a Windows PC to a macOS install (the steps of release/README-INSTALL.md, in the
// app): 1. this PC, 2. the firmware (BIOS) settings, 3. the OpenCore EFI built for this PC, 4. the macOS installer USB
// stick with that EFI, 5. after macOS is installed (stage 3 on macOS, stage 4 from either side). Each step is done, the
// next one, or blocked (by an earlier step or by its own reason); a done step stays done. What the user did is kept in
// the app's settings file (SetupProgress); everything else is read again each time (this PC's facts, whether the built
// EFI is still there). The wizard itself changes nothing on disk: the destructive steps stay on their pages, behind
// their own confirmations.
namespace IntelXe.Core.Setup;

public enum SetupStep { ThisPc, Bios, BuildEfi, Stick, AfterInstall }

public enum StepState { Done, Next, Blocked }

/// One step as the page shows it: its state and, when blocked, why (a Text the app translates).
public sealed record StepStatus(SetupStep Step, StepState State, Text Reason)
{
    public bool IsDone => State == StepState.Done;
}

/// What the user did, kept in settings.json ("Setup"). Plain properties for System.Text.Json.
public sealed class SetupProgress
{
    /// The user confirmed the BIOS steps ("I did these"), and when (ISO 8601).
    public string BiosConfirmed { get; set; } = "";

    /// The last EFI built on the Build page: its output folder (holding EFI\), the macOS version it is for, when.
    public string EfiOutDir { get; set; } = "";
    public string EfiMacOS { get; set; } = "";
    public string EfiBuilt { get; set; } = "";

    /// The installer stick was written with the EFI built at EfiBuilt (the stick page records it; "" for none), or the
    /// user said they made the stick another way ("manual").
    public string StickWith { get; set; } = "";

    /// The user marked the last step done.
    public string AfterInstallDone { get; set; } = "";

    /// The folder of the last scan of this PC (Report.json, ACPI\), for a build after the app was closed. Not a step.
    public string LastScan { get; set; } = "";

    public SetupProgress Clone() => (SetupProgress)MemberwiseClone();
}

/// What the wizard reads besides the progress: whether this PC's facts were read, the problems that stop the whole
/// install (no supported card, a CPU the builder refuses), whether the builder is there, whether the built EFI is still
/// on disk.
public sealed record SetupInputs(bool FactsRead, IReadOnlyList<Text> Blocking, bool BuilderAvailable, Text BuilderMissing, bool BuiltEfiExists);

public static class SetupWizard
{
    public const string Manual = "manual";

    /// Every string key the wizard can give the page, for the tests that hold the string tables to them.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Keys { get; } = ["Setup_Blocked_Waiting", "Setup_Blocked_NoBuilder", "Setup_Block_Card", "Setup_Block_Cpu"];

    public static readonly SetupStep[] Steps = [SetupStep.ThisPc, SetupStep.Bios, SetupStep.BuildEfi, SetupStep.Stick, SetupStep.AfterInstall];

    /// Whether a step's own record says it is done.
    static bool OwnDone(SetupStep step, SetupProgress p, SetupInputs i) => step switch
    {
        SetupStep.ThisPc => i.FactsRead && i.Blocking.Count == 0,
        SetupStep.Bios => p.BiosConfirmed.Length > 0,
        SetupStep.BuildEfi => p.EfiBuilt.Length > 0 && i.BuiltEfiExists,
        SetupStep.Stick => p.StickWith.Length > 0 && (p.StickWith == Manual || p.StickWith == p.EfiBuilt),
        _ => p.AfterInstallDone.Length > 0,
    };

    /// Why a step cannot be done now on its own account (empty when nothing stops it).
    static Text OwnBlock(SetupStep step, SetupInputs i) => step switch
    {
        SetupStep.ThisPc when i.Blocking.Count > 0 => i.Blocking[0],
        SetupStep.BuildEfi when !i.BuilderAvailable => i.BuilderMissing.IsEmpty ? Text.Of("Setup_Blocked_NoBuilder") : i.BuilderMissing,
        _ => Text.Empty,
    };

    /// Every step's state: done steps stay done; the first step that is not done is next (or blocked by its own reason);
    /// every later one that is not done is blocked by the first one.
    public static IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> Evaluate(SetupProgress p, SetupInputs i)
    {
        var list = new List<StepStatus>();
        SetupStep? first = null;
        foreach (var s in Steps)
        {
            if (OwnDone(s, p, i)) { list.Add(new StepStatus(s, StepState.Done, Text.Empty)); continue; }
            if (first is null)
            {
                first = s;
                var own = OwnBlock(s, i);
                list.Add(own.IsEmpty ? new StepStatus(s, StepState.Next, Text.Empty) : new StepStatus(s, StepState.Blocked, own));
                continue;
            }
            var block = OwnBlock(s, i);
            list.Add(new StepStatus(s, StepState.Blocked, block.IsEmpty ? Text.Of("Setup_Blocked_Waiting", (int)first.Value + 1) : block));
        }
        return list;
    }

    /// The step the page opens on: the first one not done (the last step when all are).
    public static SetupStep Current(IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> states) =>
        states.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.IsDone)?.Step ?? SetupStep.AfterInstall;

    /// Whether the user may mark a step done (or record it) now: every step before it is done.
    public static bool CanAct(IReadOnlyList<StepStatus> states, SetupStep step) =>
        states.TakeWhile(s => s.Step != step).All(s => s.IsDone) && states.First(s => s.Step == step).State != StepState.Blocked;

    // ---- what the user does ----

    public static SetupProgress ConfirmBios(SetupProgress p, DateTime now)
    {
        var n = p.Clone();
        n.BiosConfirmed = Iso(now);
        return n;
    }

    /// A new EFI was built: the stick made with an earlier one no longer counts (its EFI is not this one), unless the
    /// user made the stick another way.
    public static SetupProgress RecordEfi(SetupProgress p, string outDir, string macOS, DateTime now)
    {
        var n = p.Clone();
        n.EfiOutDir = outDir;
        n.EfiMacOS = macOS;
        n.EfiBuilt = Iso(now);
        if (n.StickWith != Manual) n.StickWith = "";
        return n;
    }

    /// The stick page wrote a stick with an EFI folder: it counts when that folder is the built EFI.
    public static SetupProgress RecordStick(SetupProgress p, string? efiWritten, string builtEfiDir)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(efiWritten) || p.EfiBuilt.Length == 0 || builtEfiDir.Length == 0) return p;
        if (!string.Equals(Normal(efiWritten), Normal(builtEfiDir), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return p;
        var n = p.Clone();
        n.StickWith = p.EfiBuilt;
        return n;
    }

    /// "I made the stick myself": the step counts as done whatever EFI it carries.
    public static SetupProgress MarkStickManual(SetupProgress p)
    {
        var n = p.Clone();
        n.StickWith = Manual;
        return n;
    }

    public static SetupProgress MarkAfterInstall(SetupProgress p, DateTime now)
    {
        var n = p.Clone();
        n.AfterInstallDone = Iso(now);
        return n;
    }

    /// Undoes one step's record and every later one's (the page's "Do this step again").
    public static SetupProgress Reopen(SetupProgress p, SetupStep step)
    {
        var n = p.Clone();
        if (step <= SetupStep.Bios) n.BiosConfirmed = "";
        if (step <= SetupStep.BuildEfi) { n.EfiOutDir = ""; n.EfiMacOS = ""; n.EfiBuilt = ""; }
        if (step <= SetupStep.Stick) n.StickWith = "";
        n.AfterInstallDone = "";
        return n;
    }

    static string Iso(DateTime t) => t.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    static string Normal(string path) => Path.GetFullPath(path).TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar);

    /// The facts that stop the install before anything else: no supported card (the "card" check is a problem), or a CPU
    /// that is not Intel (the builder makes EFIs for Intel CPUs only, as the driver is tested on Intel only).
    public static IReadOnlyList<Text> Blocking(PcFacts? facts, IReadOnlyList<Check> checks)
    {
        var list = new List<Text>();
        if (checks.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Id == "card") is { State: CheckState.Bad }) list.Add(Text.Of("Setup_Block_Card"));
        if (facts is not null && CpuInfo.CleanName(facts.CpuName) != "" && CpuInfo.Family(facts.CpuName).Vendor != CpuVendor.Intel)
            list.Add(Text.Of("Setup_Block_Cpu"));
        return list;
    }

    /// The Overview's checks for step 1: problems first, then warnings, then the rest, each in the Overview's order.
    public static IReadOnlyList<Check> Ordered(IReadOnlyList<Check> checks) =>
        checks.Select((c, i) => (c, i)).OrderBy(x => x.c.State switch { CheckState.Bad => 0, CheckState.Warning => 1, _ => 2 }).ThenBy(x => x.i).Select(x => x.c).ToList();
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Stick/Chunklist.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Apple's chunklist: the list of SHA-256 hashes of a recovery image's pieces, signed with Apple's EFI ROM key, as
// OpenCorePkg's Utilities/macrecovery/macrecovery.py reads it (BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2019, vit9696; this is our
// own C# from its description of the format, not a copy):
//
//   header (0x24 bytes, little endian): "CNKL", header size 0x24, file version 1, chunk method 1, signature method
//   (1 = RSA-2048 signature, 2 = a bare SHA-256 without a signature), a pad byte, chunk count, chunk offset (0x24) and
//   signature offset (0x24 + 0x24 * count);
//   chunks (0x24 bytes each): the piece's size (uint32) and its SHA-256;
//   signature: 256 bytes, an RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 signature of the header and the chunks, stored little endian.
//
// A chunklist without a signature (method 2) is refused, as macrecovery.py does ("Chunklist missing digital
// signature"): its hashes could come from anyone. Every piece of the image is checked against its hash, and the image
// must end where the last piece ends.
using System.Buffers.Binary;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Stick;

public sealed class ChunklistException(string message) : Exception(message);

public sealed record Chunk(uint Size, byte[] Sha256);

public sealed class Chunklist
{
    public const int HeaderSize = 0x24, ChunkSize = 0x24, SignatureSize = 256;
    public IReadOnlyList<Chunk> Chunks { get; }
    /// the SHA-256 of the header and the chunks, which the signature covers
    public byte[] Digest { get; }
    public int SignatureMethod { get; }

    /// The image's size: the sum of its pieces.
    public long ImageSize => Chunks.Sum(c => (long)c.Size);

    Chunklist(IReadOnlyList<Chunk> chunks, byte[] digest, int method)
    {
        Chunks = chunks;
        Digest = digest;
        SignatureMethod = method;
    }

    /// Apple's EFI ROM public key 1 (RSA-2048, exponent 65537), the key macrecovery.py checks recovery chunklists with.
    public static readonly RSAParameters AppleKey = new()
    {
        Modulus = Convert.FromHexString(
            "C3E748CAD9CD384329E10E25A91E43E1A762FF529ADE578C935BDDF9B13F2179D4855E6FC89E9E29CA12517D17DFA1EDCE0BEBF0EA7B461FFE61D94E2BDF72C1" +
            "96F89ACD3536B644064014DAE25A15DB6BB0852ECBD120916318D1CCDEA3C84C92ED743FC176D0BACA920D3FCF3158AFF731F88CE0623182A8ED67E650515F75" +
            "745909F07D415F55FC15A35654D118C55A462D37A3ACDA08612F3F3F6571761EFCCBCC299AEE99B3A4FD6212CCFFF5EF37A2C334E871191F7E1C31960E010A54" +
            "E86FA3F62E6D6905E1CD57732410A3EB0C6B4DEFDABE9F59BF1618758C751CD56CEF851D1C0EAA1C558E37AC108DA9089863D20E2E7E4BF475EC66FE6B3EFDCF"),
        Exponent = [0x01, 0x00, 0x01],
    };

    /// Reads a chunklist and checks its signature with Apple's key (or the key given, for tests). Throws
    /// ChunklistException for anything that is not a signed chunklist of this format.
    public static Chunklist Parse(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, RSAParameters? key = null)
    {
        if (data.Length < HeaderSize) throw new ChunklistException("the chunklist is shorter than its header");
        var h = data[..HeaderSize];
        if (!h[..4].SequenceEqual("CNKL"u8)) throw new ChunklistException("not a chunklist (no CNKL magic)");
        uint headerSize = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32LittleEndian(h[4..]);
        byte version = h[8], chunkMethod = h[9], sigMethod = h[10];
        ulong count = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt64LittleEndian(h[12..]);
        ulong chunkOffset = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt64LittleEndian(h[20..]);
        ulong sigOffset = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt64LittleEndian(h[28..]);
        if (headerSize != HeaderSize) throw new ChunklistException($"unexpected header size {headerSize}");
        if (version != 1) throw new ChunklistException($"unexpected chunklist version {version}");
        if (chunkMethod != 1) throw new ChunklistException($"unexpected chunk method {chunkMethod}");
        if (sigMethod == 2) throw new ChunklistException("the chunklist is not signed (signature method 2): refused");
        if (sigMethod != 1) throw new ChunklistException($"unknown signature method {sigMethod}: refused");
        if (count == 0 || count > 1_000_000) throw new ChunklistException($"unexpected chunk count {count}");
        if (chunkOffset != HeaderSize) throw new ChunklistException($"unexpected chunk offset {chunkOffset}");
        if (sigOffset != chunkOffset + ChunkSize * count) throw new ChunklistException("the signature offset does not follow the chunks");
        if ((ulong)data.Length != sigOffset + SignatureSize)
            throw new ChunklistException($"the chunklist is {data.Length} bytes, not {sigOffset + SignatureSize}");

        var chunks = new List<Chunk>((int)count);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)count; i++)
        {
            var c = data.Slice(HeaderSize + i * ChunkSize, ChunkSize);
            uint size = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32LittleEndian(c);
            if (size == 0) throw new ChunklistException($"chunk {i + 1} has size 0");
            chunks.Add(new Chunk(size, c[4..].ToArray()));
        }
        var digest = SHA256.HashData(data[..(int)sigOffset]);
        var signature = data.Slice((int)sigOffset, SignatureSize).ToArray();
        Array.Reverse(signature);   // stored little endian; RSA takes it big endian
        using var rsa = RSA.Create();
        rsa.ImportParameters(key ?? AppleKey);
        if (!rsa.VerifyHash(digest, signature, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, RSASignaturePadding.Pkcs1))
            throw new ChunklistException("the chunklist's signature does not verify with Apple's key: refused");
        return new Chunklist(chunks, digest, sigMethod);
    }

    /// Checks pieces as they arrive (a download) or are read (a file): Feed bytes in any sizes; each piece is hashed
    /// when it is complete and a bad one throws at once. Finish() throws when the image is shorter.
    public sealed class Verifier(Chunklist list)
    {
        int index;
        uint filled;
        IncrementalHash hash = IncrementalHash.CreateHash(HashAlgorithmName.SHA256);
        public long Bytes { get; private set; }
        public int ChunksVerified => index;
        public int ChunkCount => list.Chunks.Count;

        public void Feed(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data)
        {
            while (data.Length > 0)
            {
                if (index >= list.Chunks.Count) throw new ChunklistException("the image is longer than its chunklist: refused");
                var chunk = list.Chunks[index];
                int take = (int)Math.Min((uint)data.Length, chunk.Size - filled);
                hash.AppendData(data[..take]);
                filled += (uint)take;
                Bytes += take;
                data = data[take..];
                if (filled == chunk.Size)
                {
                    if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(hash.GetHashAndReset(), chunk.Sha256))
                        throw new ChunklistException($"chunk {index + 1} of {list.Chunks.Count} does not match Apple's hash: refused");
                    index++;
                    filled = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        public void Finish()
        {
            if (index != list.Chunks.Count || filled != 0)
                throw new ChunklistException($"the image ends after {Bytes} bytes, in chunk {index + 1} of {list.Chunks.Count}: refused");
        }
    }

    /// Checks a whole image file; progress gets the bytes checked so far.
    public void VerifyFile(string path, Action<long>? progress = null, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        var v = new Verifier(this);
        using var f = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read, 1 << 20, FileOptions.SequentialScan);
        if (f.Length != ImageSize) throw new ChunklistException($"{Path.GetFileName(path)} is {f.Length} bytes, the chunklist says {ImageSize}: refused");
        var buf = new byte[1 << 20];
        int n;
        while ((n = f.Read(buf, 0, buf.Length)) > 0)
        {
            cancel.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            v.Feed(buf.AsSpan(0, n));
            progress?.Invoke(v.Bytes);
        }
        v.Finish();
    }

    /// Builds a signed chunklist for an image with the given private key (only for tests: Apple signs the real ones).
    public static byte[] Build(byte[] image, int chunkSize, RSA key, byte signatureMethod = 1)
    {
        var chunks = new List<(uint Size, byte[] Hash)>();
        for (int o = 0; o < image.Length; o += chunkSize)
        {
            int len = Math.Min(chunkSize, image.Length - o);
            chunks.Add(((uint)len, SHA256.HashData(image.AsSpan(o, len))));
        }
        int sigOffset = HeaderSize + ChunkSize * chunks.Count;
        var body = new byte[sigOffset];
        "CNKL"u8.CopyTo(body);
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt32LittleEndian(body.AsSpan(4), HeaderSize);
        body[8] = 1; body[9] = 1; body[10] = signatureMethod;
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt64LittleEndian(body.AsSpan(12), (ulong)chunks.Count);
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt64LittleEndian(body.AsSpan(20), HeaderSize);
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt64LittleEndian(body.AsSpan(28), (ulong)sigOffset);
        for (int i = 0; i < chunks.Count; i++)
        {
            BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt32LittleEndian(body.AsSpan(HeaderSize + i * ChunkSize), chunks[i].Size);
            chunks[i].Hash.CopyTo(body.AsSpan(HeaderSize + i * ChunkSize + 4));
        }
        byte[] tail;
        if (signatureMethod == 2) tail = SHA256.HashData(body);
        else
        {
            tail = key.SignHash(SHA256.HashData(body), HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, RSASignaturePadding.Pkcs1);
            Array.Reverse(tail);
        }
        return [.. body, .. tail];
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Where the stick's OpenCore EFI folder comes from. Today: a folder the user chooses (FolderEfiSource). A generated EFI
// (windows/efibuild) plugs in here as another IEfiSource: it hands the stick page a folder that holds BOOT and OC.
namespace IntelXe.Core.Stick;

public interface IEfiSource
{
    /// what the page shows: the folder, or what made it
    string Describe { get; }

    /// The EFI folder to copy to the stick's root as EFI\ (it holds BOOT\BOOTx64.efi and OC\OpenCore.efi). Throws
    /// EfiSourceException with the reason when there is none.
    Task<string> PrepareAsync(CancellationToken cancel = default);
}

public sealed class EfiSourceException(string message) : Exception(message);

/// An EFI folder chosen by the user: the folder named EFI, or a folder that holds one.
public sealed class FolderEfiSource(string path) : IEfiSource
{
    public string Describe => path;

    public Task<string> PrepareAsync(CancellationToken cancel = default) => Task.FromResult(EfiFolderCheck.Resolve(path));
}

public static class EfiFolderCheck
{
    public static readonly string[] RequiredFiles = [Path.Combine("BOOT", "BOOTx64.efi"), Path.Combine("OC", "OpenCore.efi"), Path.Combine("OC", "config.plist")];

    /// The EFI folder at path (path itself, or path\EFI), checked to hold OpenCore; throws EfiSourceException.
    public static string Resolve(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) || !Directory.Exists(path)) throw new EfiSourceException("no folder " + path);
        var dir = Path.GetFullPath(path);
        if (!Exists(dir, "OC") && Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(dir, "EFI"))) dir = Path.Combine(dir, "EFI");
        var missing = RequiredFiles.Where(f => !FileExists(dir, f)).ToList();
        if (missing.Count > 0) throw new EfiSourceException($"{dir} is not an OpenCore EFI folder: no {string.Join(", ", missing)}");
        return dir;
    }

    static bool Exists(string dir, string sub) => Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(dir, sub));

    // case-insensitive, as FAT32 and Windows are (the tests also run on case-sensitive file systems)
    static bool FileExists(string dir, string rel)
    {
        var cur = dir;
        foreach (var part in rel.Split(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar))
        {
            var next = Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(cur).FirstOrDefault(e => string.Equals(Path.GetFileName(e), part, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            if (next is null) return false;
            cur = next;
        }
        return File.Exists(cur);
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Stick/Recovery.cs
