// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Downloading macOS recovery (BaseSystem.dmg and its chunklist) from Apple's recovery server, by the protocol of
// OpenCorePkg's Utilities/macrecovery/macrecovery.py (BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2019, vit9696), written again in C#:
//
//   1. GET http://osrecovery.apple.com/ ; the answer's Set-Cookie carries "session=...".
//   2. POST http://osrecovery.apple.com/InstallationPayload/RecoveryImage with that cookie, Content-Type text/plain and
//      the lines cid=<16 hex> sn=<MLB> bid=<board ID> k=<64 hex> fg=<64 hex> os=default|latest (joined by \n). The
//      MLB is the tool's default all-zero one: no real serial number is ever sent. The answer is "KEY: value" lines:
//      AP (product), AU/AT (image URL and token), CU/CT (chunklist URL and token), AH/CH (hashes the tool ignores).
//   3. GET each URL with the cookie AssetToken=<token>.
//
// All requests carry User-Agent InternetRecovery/1.0 and Connection: close, as the tool's do. The server speaks plain
// HTTP; what makes the download trustworthy is the chunklist: it must carry Apple's signature (Chunklist.Parse), it is
// fetched and checked before the image, and every piece of the image is checked against it while it arrives. A bad
// piece stops the download and leaves no image behind.
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using IntelXe.Core.Bios;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Stick;

public sealed class RecoveryException(string message) : Exception(message);

public sealed class RecoveryVersion
{
    [JsonPropertyName("id")] public string Id { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("major")] public int Major { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("name")] public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("board")] public string Board { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("os")] public string Os { get; set; } = "default";
    [JsonPropertyName("board_newest")] public string BoardNewest { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("primary")] public bool Primary { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("status")] public LocalText Status { get; set; } = new();
    [JsonPropertyName("guide")] public string Guide { get; set; } = "";
}

public sealed class RecoveryData
{
    [JsonPropertyName("about")] public string About { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("source")] public string Source { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("mlb")] public string Mlb { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("versions")] public List<RecoveryVersion> Versions { get; set; } = [];

    static RecoveryData? embedded;

    public static RecoveryData Embedded => embedded ??= JsonSerializer.Deserialize<RecoveryData>(
        typeof(RecoveryData).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("IntelXe.Core.macos-recovery.json")
        ?? throw new InvalidDataException("macos-recovery.json is not built into the Core")) ?? throw new InvalidDataException("macos-recovery.json is empty");

    public RecoveryVersion Find(string id) => Versions.FirstOrDefault(v => v.Id == id) ?? throw new RecoveryException("no macOS version " + id);
}

/// What the recovery server answered for one board: the product and the two files with their tokens.
public sealed record RecoveryImageInfo(string Product, Uri ImageUrl, string ImageToken, Uri ChunklistUrl, string ChunklistToken)
{
    /// "BaseSystem.dmg" / "BaseSystem.chunklist" (the server's names, checked)
    public string ImageName => Path.GetFileName(ImageUrl.AbsolutePath);
    public string ChunklistName => Path.GetFileName(ChunklistUrl.AbsolutePath);
}

public static class RecoveryProtocol
{
    public const string Host = "osrecovery.apple.com";
    public static readonly Uri SessionUrl = new("http://osrecovery.apple.com/");
    public static readonly Uri ImageInfoUrl = new("http://osrecovery.apple.com/InstallationPayload/RecoveryImage");
    public const string UserAgent = "InternetRecovery/1.0";
    public const string ZeroMlb = "00000000000000000";

    static readonly string[] Required = ["AP", "AU", "AT", "CU", "CT"];
    static readonly Regex FileName = new(@"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}\.(dmg|chunklist)$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
    static readonly Regex Board = new(@"^Mac-[0-9A-F]{8}([0-9A-F]{8})?$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    public static string RandomHex(int length)
    {
        var bytes = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes((length + 1) / 2);
        return Convert.ToHexString(bytes)[..length];
    }

    static void Common(HttpRequestMessage r)
    {
        r.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("User-Agent", UserAgent);
        r.Headers.ConnectionClose = true;
    }

    public static HttpRequestMessage SessionRequest()
    {
        var r = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, SessionUrl);
        Common(r);
        return r;
    }

    /// The "session=..." cookie from the answer's Set-Cookie headers.
    public static string ParseSession(IEnumerable<string> setCookies)
    {
        foreach (var header in setCookies)
            foreach (var part in header.Split(';', StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries))
                if (part.StartsWith("session=", StringComparison.Ordinal) && part.Length > "session=".Length) return part;
        throw new RecoveryException("Apple's recovery server gave no session");
    }

    /// The POST body, in the tool's order: cid, sn, bid, k, fg, os. The MLB is always the all-zero one.
    public static string ImageInfoBody(string board, string os, Func<int, string>? randomHex = null)
    {
        if (!Board.IsMatch(board)) throw new RecoveryException("not a board ID: " + board);
        if (os is not ("default" or "latest")) throw new RecoveryException("os is default or latest, not " + os);
        randomHex ??= RandomHex;
        return string.Join("\n",
            "cid=" + randomHex(16), "sn=" + ZeroMlb, "bid=" + board, "k=" + randomHex(64), "fg=" + randomHex(64), "os=" + os);
    }

    public static HttpRequestMessage ImageInfoRequest(string session, string body)
    {
        var r = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, ImageInfoUrl) { Content = new ByteArrayContent(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(body)) };
        r.Content.Headers.ContentType = new MediaTypeHeaderValue("text/plain");
        r.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Cookie", session);
        Common(r);
        return r;
    }

    /// The server's "KEY: value" answer. Refuses an answer without the files, URLs that are not Apple's over HTTP(S),
    /// and file names other than NAME.dmg + NAME.chunklist.
    public static RecoveryImageInfo ParseImageInfo(string text)
    {
        var info = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var raw in text.Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = raw.TrimEnd('\r');
            int i = line.IndexOf(": ", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (i <= 0) continue;
            info.TryAdd(line[..i], line[(i + 2)..].Trim());
        }
        foreach (var k in Required)
            if (!info.TryGetValue(k, out var v) || v.Length == 0) throw new RecoveryException($"Apple's answer has no {k}");
        var image = AppleUrl(info["AU"]);
        var chunklist = AppleUrl(info["CU"]);
        var r = new RecoveryImageInfo(info["AP"], image, info["AT"], chunklist, info["CT"]);
        if (!FileName.IsMatch(r.ImageName) || !r.ImageName.EndsWith(".dmg", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new RecoveryException("unexpected image name " + r.ImageName);
        if (!FileName.IsMatch(r.ChunklistName) || Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(r.ChunklistName) != Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(r.ImageName)
            || !r.ChunklistName.EndsWith(".chunklist", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            throw new RecoveryException("unexpected chunklist name " + r.ChunklistName);
        return r;
    }

    static Uri AppleUrl(string s)
    {
        if (!Uri.TryCreate(s, UriKind.Absolute, out var u) || u.Scheme is not ("http" or "https")
            || !(u.Host == "apple.com" || u.Host.EndsWith(".apple.com", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            throw new RecoveryException("not an Apple download URL: " + s);
        return u;
    }

    public static HttpRequestMessage AssetRequest(Uri url, string token)
    {
        var r = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, url);
        r.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Cookie", "AssetToken=" + token);
        Common(r);
        return r;
    }
}

/// Progress of a download: the stage, the bytes so far and in all, the pieces checked so far and in all.
public sealed record RecoveryProgress(string Stage, long Bytes, long Total, int Chunks, int ChunkCount);

/// A recovery download in a folder: FOLDER\com.apple.recovery.boot\BaseSystem.dmg and .chunklist, checked.
public sealed record RecoveryFiles(string Folder, string Image, string ChunklistFile, string Product, long Size)
{
    public const string BootFolder = "com.apple.recovery.boot";
    public const string Marker = "intelxe-verified.json";

    /// The files of an earlier download in this folder, when its chunklist still verifies with Apple's key and the
    /// image has the size it says (the pieces are checked again before the stick is written); null otherwise.
    public static RecoveryFiles? Find(string folder, RSAParameters? key = null)
    {
        try
        {
            var boot = Path.Combine(folder, BootFolder);
            var marker = Path.Combine(folder, Marker);
            if (!File.Exists(marker)) return null;
            var m = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, string>>(File.ReadAllText(marker));
            if (m is null || !m.TryGetValue("image", out var imageName) || !m.TryGetValue("chunklist", out var listName)) return null;
            var image = Path.Combine(boot, Path.GetFileName(imageName));
            var list = Path.Combine(boot, Path.GetFileName(listName));
            if (!File.Exists(image) || !File.Exists(list)) return null;
            var cl = Chunklist.Parse(File.ReadAllBytes(list), key);
            if (new FileInfo(image).Length != cl.ImageSize) return null;
            return new RecoveryFiles(folder, image, list, m.GetValueOrDefault("product", ""), cl.ImageSize);
        }
        catch (Exception e) when (e is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or ChunklistException or JsonException) { return null; }
    }
}

/// The client: asks for a version's files and downloads them, checking every piece.
public sealed class RecoveryClient : IDisposable
{
    readonly HttpClient http;
    readonly RSAParameters? key;

    /// handler: a fake in the tests; key: the chunklist key (Apple's when null).
    public RecoveryClient(HttpMessageHandler? handler = null, RSAParameters? key = null)
    {
        http = new HttpClient(handler ?? new SocketsHttpHandler { UseCookies = false, AutomaticDecompression = DecompressionMethods.None })
        {
            Timeout = Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan,
        };
        this.key = key;
    }

    public void Dispose() => http.Dispose();

    static async Task<HttpResponseMessage> Send(HttpClient http, HttpRequestMessage r, CancellationToken cancel, HttpCompletionOption opt = HttpCompletionOption.ResponseContentRead)
    {
        using var timeout = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancel);
        if (opt == HttpCompletionOption.ResponseContentRead) timeout.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60));
        var resp = await http.SendAsync(r, opt, timeout.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (!resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            var code = (int)resp.StatusCode;
            resp.Dispose();
            throw new RecoveryException($"{r.RequestUri?.Host} answered HTTP {code}");
        }
        return resp;
    }

    public async Task<RecoveryImageInfo> GetInfoAsync(RecoveryVersion v, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        string session;
        using (var s = await Send(http, RecoveryProtocol.SessionRequest(), cancel).ConfigureAwait(false))
            session = RecoveryProtocol.ParseSession(s.Headers.TryGetValues("Set-Cookie", out var c) ? c : []);
        using var r = await Send(http, RecoveryProtocol.ImageInfoRequest(session, RecoveryProtocol.ImageInfoBody(v.Board, v.Os)), cancel).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return RecoveryProtocol.ParseImageInfo(await r.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancel).ConfigureAwait(false));
    }

    /// Downloads a version into FOLDER\com.apple.recovery.boot: the chunklist first (refused unless Apple signed it),
    /// then the image, each piece checked as it arrives, into a .part file that becomes the image only when every piece
    /// matched. The marker file records the download.
    public async Task<RecoveryFiles> DownloadAsync(RecoveryVersion v, string folder, IProgress<RecoveryProgress>? progress = null, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        progress?.Report(new RecoveryProgress("ask", 0, 0, 0, 0));
        var info = await GetInfoAsync(v, cancel).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var boot = Path.Combine(folder, RecoveryFiles.BootFolder);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(boot);
        var marker = Path.Combine(folder, RecoveryFiles.Marker);
        File.Delete(marker);

        progress?.Report(new RecoveryProgress("chunklist", 0, 0, 0, 0));
        byte[] listBytes;
        using (var r = await Send(http, RecoveryProtocol.AssetRequest(info.ChunklistUrl, info.ChunklistToken), cancel).ConfigureAwait(false))
            listBytes = await r.Content.ReadAsByteArrayAsync(cancel).ConfigureAwait(false);
        if (listBytes.Length > 4 << 20) throw new RecoveryException("the chunklist is too large");
        var list = Chunklist.Parse(listBytes, key);
        var listPath = Path.Combine(boot, info.ChunklistName);
        await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(listPath, listBytes, cancel).ConfigureAwait(false);

        var image = Path.Combine(boot, info.ImageName);
        var part = image + ".part";
        File.Delete(image);
        var verifier = new Chunklist.Verifier(list);
        try
        {
            using var r = await Send(http, RecoveryProtocol.AssetRequest(info.ImageUrl, info.ImageToken), cancel, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (r.Content.Headers.ContentLength is long len && len != list.ImageSize)
                throw new RecoveryException($"the image is {len} bytes, the chunklist says {list.ImageSize}: refused");
            await using (var src = await r.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(cancel).ConfigureAwait(false))
            await using (var dst = new FileStream(part, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, 1 << 20))
            {
                var buf = new byte[1 << 20];
                long last = 0;
                int n;
                while ((n = await ReadWithTimeout(src, buf, cancel).ConfigureAwait(false)) > 0)
                {
                    verifier.Feed(buf.AsSpan(0, n));
                    await dst.WriteAsync(buf.AsMemory(0, n), cancel).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    if (verifier.Bytes - last >= 4 << 20 || verifier.Bytes == list.ImageSize)
                    {
                        last = verifier.Bytes;
                        progress?.Report(new RecoveryProgress("image", verifier.Bytes, list.ImageSize, verifier.ChunksVerified, verifier.ChunkCount));
                    }
                }
                verifier.Finish();
                await dst.FlushAsync(cancel).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            File.Move(part, image, overwrite: true);
        }
        catch
        {
            try { File.Delete(part); } catch (Exception) { }
            throw;
        }
        var m = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["version"] = v.Id, ["board"] = v.Board, ["product"] = info.Product, ["image"] = info.ImageName, ["chunklist"] = info.ChunklistName,
            ["size"] = list.ImageSize.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), ["chunks"] = list.Chunks.Count.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            ["date"] = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("u", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
        };
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(marker, JsonSerializer.Serialize(m, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }), cancel).ConfigureAwait(false);
        progress?.Report(new RecoveryProgress("done", list.ImageSize, list.ImageSize, list.Chunks.Count, list.Chunks.Count));
        return new RecoveryFiles(folder, image, listPath, info.Product, list.ImageSize);
    }

    /// A read that gives up after 60 s without data (a stalled connection), not after a fixed total time.
    static async Task<int> ReadWithTimeout(Stream s, byte[] buf, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        using var t = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancel);
        t.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60));
        try { return await s.ReadAsync(buf, t.Token).ConfigureAwait(false); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!cancel.IsCancellationRequested) { throw new RecoveryException("the download stalled for 60 s"); }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The disks a stick may be written to, and the rules that refuse the others: one set for the macOS installer stick
// (Stick/) and the Xe probe stick (ProbeStick/). The app reads a disk (MSFT_Disk, MSFT_Partition, Win32_DiskDrive) into a
// StickDisk; StickRules says why it must not be erased. Only USB disks are listed; a USB disk is still refused when it is
// the boot or system disk, not removable, read-only, offline, too small, larger than 128 GB (unless the user says they
// mean it), or holds an operating system or the files being copied. The rules that write-stick.sh shares (bus,
// removable, system, size) give the answers of tools/probe-stick/stick-disk-vectors.json, by code (StickRefusal.Code).
// A disk that holds an EFI (an EFI system partition, or a volume with EFI\OC\OpenCore.efi or EFI\BOOT\BOOTx64.efi) is
// not refused, but erasing it needs its own confirmation (HoldsEfi; the helpers' --erase-efi). The disk is
// re-identified by its serial number and size right before it is erased (StickIdentity): the serial is used only
// inside that hash and never shown or logged.
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Stick;

/// A partition of a disk, as far as the rules need it. HoldsEfi: its volume has EFI\OC\OpenCore.efi, or an
/// EFI\BOOT\BOOTx64.efi that is not a probe stick's (an EFI system partition counts by its type, unopened). ProbeStick:
/// its volume is a probe stick (label XEPROBE, the marker file), whose reports in REPORTS\ the erase would lose.
public sealed record StickPartition(uint Number, string GptType, int MbrType, string Letter, string FileSystem, bool HoldsWindows,
    bool HoldsEfi = false, bool ProbeStick = false);

/// A disk as the stick page sees it. Not a record: its ToString must not print the serial number.
public sealed class StickDisk
{
    public uint Number { get; init; }
    public string FriendlyName { get; init; } = "";
    public ulong Size { get; init; }
    /// MSFT_Disk.BusType: 7 USB, 15 file-backed virtual (a VHD/VHDX), 17 NVMe ...
    public int BusType { get; init; }
    public bool IsBoot { get; init; }
    public bool IsSystem { get; init; }
    public bool IsReadOnly { get; init; }
    public bool IsOffline { get; init; }
    /// Win32_DiskDrive: media type "Removable Media" or capability 7 (supports removable media); null when unknown
    public bool? Removable { get; init; }
    /// the backing file of a file-backed virtual disk (MSFT_Disk.Location); "" otherwise
    public string VirtualFile { get; init; } = "";
    /// "GPT", "MBR", "RAW" or ""
    public string PartitionStyle { get; init; } = "";
    public IReadOnlyList<StickPartition> Partitions { get; init; } = [];
    /// The serial number (or the unique ID when there is none): for StickIdentity only. Never shown or logged.
    public string IdentitySource { private get; init; } = "";

    public string BusName => EspPartition.BusName(BusType);

    /// "SanDisk Ultra 16 GB": what the user types to confirm.
    public string ConfirmText => $"{FriendlyName.Trim()} {StickRules.SizeText(Size)}";

    public string Token(string salt) => StickIdentity.Token(IdentitySource, Size, salt);
    public bool HasIdentity => IdentitySource.Trim().Length > 0;

    public override string ToString() => $"disk {Number} {FriendlyName} {StickRules.SizeText(Size)} {BusName}";
}

public static class StickIdentity
{
    /// SHA-256 of a per-run salt, the serial and the size: the helper compares it with the disk it finds, so that the
    /// serial never goes on a command line.
    public static string Token(string serial, ulong size, string salt) =>
        Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(salt + "\n" + serial.Trim() + "\n" + size.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))));

    public static string NewSalt() => Convert.ToHexString(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16));
}

/// What a check allows beyond a USB stick: only for the tests, a VHD/VHDX file named on the command line
/// (--test-vhdx PATH), which Windows reports as a file-backed virtual disk, never as USB. AllowLarge: the user said they
/// mean a disk larger than 128 GB (write-stick.sh's --allow-large).
public sealed record StickPolicy(ulong MinimumSize, string? TestVirtualFile = null, IReadOnlyList<string>? ProtectedLetters = null, bool AllowLarge = false);

/// One reason to refuse a disk: its code (the shared ones are write-stick.sh's: partition, virtual, not-usb,
/// not-removable, system, too-small, too-large; the others are Windows': read-only, offline, os, files-here, no-identity)
/// and its English text.
public sealed record StickRefusal(string Code, string Text);

public static class StickRules
{
    public const int UsbBus = 7, VirtualBus = 14, FileBackedVirtualBus = 15;

    /// Larger than this, a disk is refused unless the policy allows large disks: more likely a backup disk than a stick
    /// (write-stick.sh's MAXGB).
    public const ulong LargeDisk = 128_000_000_000UL;

    // partitions that mean an operating system lives on the disk (not the Microsoft reserved partition: Windows puts
    // one on every disk it initializes as GPT, a stick written here too)
    static readonly Dictionary<string, string> OsGptTypes = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        ["{7c3457ef-0000-11aa-aa11-00306543ecac}"] = "an APFS container (macOS)",
        ["{426f6f74-0000-11aa-aa11-00306543ecac}"] = "an Apple boot partition (macOS)",
        ["{de94bba4-06d1-4d40-a16a-bfd50179d6ac}"] = "a Windows recovery partition",
        ["{4f68bce3-e8cd-4db1-96e7-fbcaf984b709}"] = "a Linux root partition",
        ["{0fc63daf-8483-4772-8e79-3d69d8477de4}"] = "a Linux file system",
        ["{e6d6d379-f507-44c2-a23c-238f2a3df928}"] = "a Linux LVM volume",
    };

    static readonly Dictionary<int, string> OsMbrTypes = new()
    {
        [0x27] = "a Windows recovery partition",
        [0x83] = "a Linux file system",
        [0x8E] = "a Linux LVM volume",
    };

    /// The size the way the page shows it: decimal GB with one decimal from 1 GB, else whole MB.
    public static string SizeText(ulong bytes) =>
        bytes >= 1_000_000_000UL
            ? (bytes / 1e9).ToString("0.0", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " GB"
            : Math.Round(bytes / 1e6).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " MB";

    /// Whether the page lists the disk at all: USB disks, and the test VHDX when it is asked for.
    public static bool Listed(StickDisk d, StickPolicy p) => d.BusType == UsbBus || IsTestDisk(d, p);

    static bool IsTestDisk(StickDisk d, StickPolicy p) =>
        p.TestVirtualFile is { Length: > 0 } f && d.BusType == FileBackedVirtualBus && d.VirtualFile.Length > 0
        && string.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(d.VirtualFile), Path.GetFullPath(f), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        && (f.EndsWith(".vhdx", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || f.EndsWith(".vhd", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

    /// Why the disk must not be erased; empty when it may be. Each reason is English, for the helper's answer and the
    /// page (which shows them as they are).
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Refusals(StickDisk d, StickPolicy p) => [.. Check(d, p).Select(r => r.Text).Distinct()];

    /// The codes of the reasons, each once: what stick-disk-vectors.json holds.
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> RefusalCodes(StickDisk d, StickPolicy p) => [.. Check(d, p).Select(r => r.Code).Distinct()];

    public static IReadOnlyList<StickRefusal> Check(StickDisk d, StickPolicy p)
    {
        var r = new List<StickRefusal>();
        void Add(string code, string text) => r.Add(new StickRefusal(code, text));
        bool test = IsTestDisk(d, p);
        if (!test && d.BusType is VirtualBus or FileBackedVirtualBus)
            Add("virtual", $"not a USB disk (bus: {BusText(d)}): a virtual disk (VHD/VHDX)");
        else if (d.BusType != UsbBus && !test)
            Add("not-usb", $"not a USB disk (bus: {BusText(d)})");
        if (d.IsBoot) Add("system", "Windows booted from it (boot disk)");
        if (d.IsSystem) Add("system", "it holds the system (EFI) partition Windows started from");
        if (d.IsReadOnly) Add("read-only", "it is read-only");
        if (d.IsOffline) Add("offline", "it is offline");
        if (!test && d.Removable != true) Add("not-removable", d.Removable is null ? "Windows does not say it is removable" : "not a removable disk");
        if (d.Size < p.MinimumSize) Add("too-small", $"too small: {SizeText(d.Size)}, needs at least {SizeText(p.MinimumSize)}");
        if (!p.AllowLarge && d.Size > LargeDisk)
            Add("too-large", $"larger than {SizeText(LargeDisk)} ({SizeText(d.Size)}): more likely a backup disk than a stick (allow a larger disk if you mean it)");
        foreach (var part in d.Partitions)
        {
            if (part.HoldsWindows) Add("system", $"partition {part.Number} holds Windows");
            if (OsGptTypes.TryGetValue(part.GptType.Trim(), out var what)) Add("os", $"partition {part.Number} is {what}");
            if (OsMbrTypes.TryGetValue(part.MbrType, out var mbr)) Add("os", $"partition {part.Number} is {mbr}");
            if (part.Letter.Length > 0 && p.ProtectedLetters?.Any(l => string.Equals(l.TrimEnd(':', '\\'), part.Letter.TrimEnd(':', '\\'), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) == true)
                Add("files-here", $"it holds {part.Letter.TrimEnd(':', '\\')}:, where files to copy are");
        }
        if (!d.HasIdentity) Add("no-identity", "Windows reports no serial number or unique ID, so the disk cannot be identified again before erasing");
        return r;
    }

    static string BusText(StickDisk d) => d.BusName.Length > 0 ? d.BusName : d.BusType.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    /// Whether erasing the disk loses an EFI: an EFI system partition (by its GPT or MBR type; never opened), or a volume
    /// that holds OpenCore or another EFI boot loader. Not a refusal (an EFI stick is often the one to rewrite), but the
    /// page asks for it to be confirmed on its own, and the helpers refuse such a disk without --erase-efi.
    public static bool HoldsEfi(StickDisk d) =>
        d.Partitions.Any(p => EspPartition.IsEspType(p.GptType) || p.MbrType == 0xEF || p.HoldsEfi);

    /// Whether a volume holds an EFI by what is on it: OpenCore (EFI\OC\OpenCore.efi), or EFI\BOOT\BOOTx64.efi that is
    /// not a probe stick's own GRUB (the volume has xe-probe-stick.marker). The same rule as write-stick.sh's efi_rules,
    /// held together by stick-disk-vectors.json's efiVectors.
    public static bool VolumeHoldsEfi(bool openCore, bool bootLoader, bool probeStick) => openCore || (bootLoader && !probeStick);

    /// Whether the disk is a probe stick now (its reports would be lost).
    public static bool IsProbeStick(StickDisk d) => d.Partitions.Any(p => p.ProbeStick);

    /// The helpers' refusal of an EFI disk that was not confirmed; null when there is nothing to confirm.
    public static string? EfiNotConfirmed(StickDisk d, bool eraseEfi) =>
        HoldsEfi(d) && !eraseEfi
            ? $"disk {d.Number} holds an EFI (an EFI system partition or OpenCore), and erasing it was not confirmed: nothing written"
            : null;

    /// The FAT32 partition's size: the whole disk up to 16 GiB. Windows formats FAT32 only up to 32 GB, and the
    /// recovery image and an EFI need about 1.2 GB; Dortania's Windows guide asks for a stick of at least 4 GB.
    public const ulong MaxPartition = 16UL << 30;

    /// The smallest disk that takes the image, an EFI and room for the file system: the image plus 256 MB.
    public static ulong MinimumFor(long imageSize) => (ulong)Math.Max(0, imageSize) + (256UL << 20);
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core/Stick/StickWriter.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Writing the macOS installer stick, without Windows APIs: the elevated helper's command line and answer, and the order
// of the work. The app starts its own exe with "--stick-helper write ..." through "runas" (as the EFI page does with
// --efi-helper); only that process has administrator rights, for one disk. It checks the recovery files against
// Apple's chunklist, reads the disk again and refuses it by StickRules, compares it with the one the user chose (serial
// and size, as a salted hash), reads it once more right before erasing, then erases it into one FAT32 partition
// (IStickSystem: Windows' storage API in the app, a fake in the tests), copies com.apple.recovery.boot\ and the chosen
// EFI folder, and reads the copies back against the chunklist and the EFI's hashes.
//
// GPT, not MBR: the stick is only ever started by UEFI firmware (macOS needs CSM off, so the PC boots UEFI only), UEFI
// reads a FAT32 partition on GPT as well as on MBR, and GPT is what Dortania's Windows guide makes ("convert gpt";
// it notes that MBR sticks failed to boot with one of the tools it used). One FAT32 partition of up to 16 GiB, because
// Windows formats FAT32 only up to 32 GB.
using System.Globalization;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Stick;

public sealed class StickException(string message) : Exception(message);

public enum StickVerb { List, Check, Write, Download }

/// One helper run. List: the disks the page offers (with their identity tokens for Salt). Check: everything Write does
/// before erasing, and nothing after. Write: erase and write. Download: the recovery files (no administrator rights).
/// EraseEfi: the user confirmed that the disk holds an EFI and that it is erased (StickRules.HoldsEfi); AllowLarge: a
/// disk larger than 128 GB is meant. Both are switches without a value.
public sealed record StickHelperRequest(StickVerb Verb, uint Disk = 0, string Id = "", string Salt = "", ulong Size = 0, string Image = "",
    string? Efi = null, string? TestVhdx = null, string? Version = null, string? Out = null, string? Progress = null,
    bool EraseEfi = false, bool AllowLarge = false)
{
    public const string Switch = "--stick-helper";
    public const string Label = "MACOS";

    public IReadOnlyList<string> ToArgs()
    {
        var a = new List<string> { Switch, Verb.ToString().ToLowerInvariant() };
        void Add(string name, string? value) { if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) a.AddRange([name, value]); }
        if (Verb is StickVerb.Check or StickVerb.Write)
        {
            a.AddRange(["--disk", Disk.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), "--size", Size.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)]);
            Add("--id", Id);
            Add("--image", Image);
            Add("--efi", Efi);
            if (EraseEfi) a.Add("--erase-efi");
            if (AllowLarge) a.Add("--allow-large");
        }
        if (Verb is StickVerb.List or StickVerb.Check or StickVerb.Write) Add("--salt", Salt);
        if (Verb == StickVerb.Download) { Add("--version", Version); Add("--image", Image); }
        Add("--test-vhdx", TestVhdx);
        Add("--progress", Progress);
        Add("--out", Out);
        return a;
    }

    public static StickHelperRequest Parse(IReadOnlyList<string> args)
    {
        if (args.Count < 2 || args[0] != Switch) throw new StickException("the helper's command line starts with " + Switch + " list|check|write|download");
        var verb = args[1] switch
        {
            "list" => StickVerb.List, "check" => StickVerb.Check, "write" => StickVerb.Write, "download" => StickVerb.Download,
            _ => throw new StickException("no helper verb " + args[1] + " (list, check, write, download)"),
        };
        string[] known = ["--disk", "--id", "--salt", "--size", "--image", "--efi", "--test-vhdx", "--version", "--out", "--progress"];
        var v = HelperArgs.Parse(args, 2, known, ["--erase-efi", "--allow-large"], m => new StickException(m));
        string? V(string k) => v.TryGetValue(k, out var s) ? s : null;
        var q = new StickHelperRequest(verb, Salt: V("--salt") ?? "", Image: V("--image") ?? "", Efi: V("--efi"), TestVhdx: V("--test-vhdx"),
            Version: V("--version"), Out: V("--out"), Progress: V("--progress"), EraseEfi: v.ContainsKey("--erase-efi"), AllowLarge: v.ContainsKey("--allow-large"));
        if (verb is StickVerb.Check or StickVerb.Write)
        {
            if (!uint.TryParse(V("--disk"), NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var disk)) throw new StickException("the helper needs --disk N");
            if (!ulong.TryParse(V("--size"), NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var size)) throw new StickException("the helper needs --size BYTES");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(V("--id")) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(q.Salt)) throw new StickException("nothing written: the helper needs the disk's identity (--id, --salt)");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(q.Image)) throw new StickException("the helper needs --image FOLDER (the recovery download)");
            q = q with { Disk = disk, Size = size, Id = V("--id")! };
        }
        if (verb == StickVerb.Download && (string.IsNullOrEmpty(q.Version) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(q.Image)))
            throw new StickException("the helper needs --version ID and --image FOLDER");
        return q;
    }
}

/// A disk in the helper's list answer: what the page shows, the refusals, and the identity token for the request's salt.
public sealed class StickDiskInfo
{
    [JsonPropertyName("number")] public uint Number { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("name")] public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("size")] public ulong Size { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("bus")] public string Bus { get; set; } = "";
    [JsonPropertyName("refusals")] public List<string> Refusals { get; set; } = [];
    [JsonPropertyName("id")] public string? Id { get; set; }
}

public sealed class StickHelperResult
{
    [JsonPropertyName("ok")] public bool Ok { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("error")] public string? Error { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("refusals")] public List<string>? Refusals { get; set; }
    [JsonPropertyName("lines")] public List<string> Lines { get; set; } = [];
    [JsonPropertyName("disks")] public List<StickDiskInfo>? Disks { get; set; }
    /// whether anything on the disk was changed (false for a refusal, a check, a failure before erasing)
    [JsonPropertyName("written")] public bool Written { get; set; }

    static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Json = new() { WriteIndented = true, DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull };
    public string ToJson() => JsonSerializer.Serialize(this, Json);
    public static StickHelperResult FromJson(string json) => JsonSerializer.Deserialize<StickHelperResult>(json, Json) ?? throw new StickException("the helper's answer is empty");
}

/// A helper's "--name value" pairs and value-less switches; each once.
public static class HelperArgs
{
    public static Dictionary<string, string> Parse(IReadOnlyList<string> args, int start, IReadOnlyCollection<string> withValue,
        IReadOnlyCollection<string> switches, Func<string, Exception> error)
    {
        var v = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        for (int i = start; i < args.Count; i++)
        {
            var name = args[i];
            string value;
            if (switches.Contains(name)) value = "";
            else if (withValue.Contains(name) && i + 1 < args.Count) value = args[++i];
            else throw error("the helper does not take " + name + (withValue.Contains(name) ? " without a value" : ""));
            if (!v.TryAdd(name, value)) throw error("the helper takes " + name + " once");
        }
        return v;
    }
}

/// The disks as Windows reports them: the list, and one disk read again.
public interface IStickDisks
{
    IReadOnlyList<StickDisk> ListDisks();
    /// The disk as it is now; null when there is no such disk.
    StickDisk? Inspect(uint number);
}

/// What the writer needs from Windows: the disks, and erasing one into a single FAT32 partition.
public interface IStickSystem : IStickDisks
{
    /// Erases the disk (checked by the caller just before), makes it GPT with one FAT32 partition of partitionSize
    /// bytes labelled label, and returns the partition's root ("E:\").
    string EraseAndFormat(StickDisk disk, ulong partitionSize, string label);
}

public static class StickWriter
{
    /// The disks to list, with their refusals and tokens.
    public static StickHelperResult List(IStickSystem sys, StickPolicy policy, string salt)
    {
        var r = new StickHelperResult { Ok = true, Disks = [] };
        foreach (var d in sys.ListDisks().Where(d => StickRules.Listed(d, policy)).OrderBy(d => d.Number))
            r.Disks.Add(new StickDiskInfo
            {
                Number = d.Number, Name = d.FriendlyName, Size = d.Size, Bus = d.BusName, Refusals = [.. StickRules.Refusals(d, policy)],
                Id = salt.Length > 0 && d.HasIdentity ? d.Token(salt) : null,
            });
        return r;
    }

    /// Check or Write. progress: a stage name and a fraction 0..1. protectedLetters: drives that must not be erased
    /// besides the rules' (where the app and the files are).
    public static StickHelperResult Run(StickHelperRequest q, IStickSystem sys, Action<string, double>? progress = null,
        IReadOnlyList<string>? protectedLetters = null, System.Security.Cryptography.RSAParameters? key = null, CancellationToken cancel = default)
    {
        var r = new StickHelperResult();
        try
        {
            if (q.Verb is not (StickVerb.Check or StickVerb.Write)) throw new StickException("Run takes check or write");

            // the files first: nothing is erased for files that would not boot
            var files = RecoveryFiles.Find(q.Image, key) ?? throw new StickException($"no checked recovery download in {q.Image}: download it again");
            var list = Chunklist.Parse(File.ReadAllBytes(files.ChunklistFile), key);
            progress?.Invoke("verify-source", 0);
            list.VerifyFile(files.Image, b => progress?.Invoke("verify-source", (double)b / list.ImageSize), cancel);
            r.Lines.Add($"recovery image {Path.GetFileName(files.Image)}: {list.Chunks.Count} pieces match Apple's signed chunklist");
            string? efi = q.Efi is { Length: > 0 } ? EfiFolderCheck.Resolve(q.Efi) : null;
            if (efi is not null) r.Lines.Add("EFI folder " + efi + ": OpenCore found");

            var letters = new List<string>(protectedLetters ?? []);
            foreach (var p in new[] { q.Image, efi })
                if (p is { Length: >= 2 } && p[1] == ':') letters.Add(p[..2]);
            var policy = new StickPolicy(StickRules.MinimumFor(list.ImageSize + (efi is null ? 0 : DirSize(efi))), q.TestVhdx, letters, q.AllowLarge);

            var disk = Checked(sys, q, policy, r);
            if (disk is null) return r;
            r.Lines.Add($"disk {disk.Number}: {disk.FriendlyName} {StickRules.SizeText(disk.Size)} {disk.BusName}, the one chosen, nothing refuses it");
            if (q.Verb == StickVerb.Check)
            {
                r.Lines.Add("check only: nothing written");
                r.Ok = true;
                return r;
            }

            // read it once more right before erasing
            disk = Checked(sys, q, policy, r);
            if (disk is null) return r;
            ulong partSize = Math.Min(disk.Size - (8UL << 20), StickRules.MaxPartition);
            progress?.Invoke("erase", 0);
            r.Written = true;
            var root = sys.EraseAndFormat(disk, partSize, StickHelperRequest.Label);
            r.Lines.Add($"disk {disk.Number} erased: GPT, one FAT32 partition of up to {StickRules.SizeText(partSize)} at {root}");

            var boot = Path.Combine(root, RecoveryFiles.BootFolder);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(boot);
            var dstList = Path.Combine(boot, Path.GetFileName(files.ChunklistFile));
            var dstImage = Path.Combine(boot, Path.GetFileName(files.Image));
            Copy(files.ChunklistFile, dstList, null, cancel);
            Copy(files.Image, dstImage, b => progress?.Invoke("copy-image", (double)b / list.ImageSize), cancel);
            r.Lines.Add($"copied {RecoveryFiles.BootFolder}\\{Path.GetFileName(files.Image)} and {Path.GetFileName(files.ChunklistFile)}");
            if (efi is not null)
            {
                progress?.Invoke("copy-efi", 0);
                CopyTree(efi, Path.Combine(root, "EFI"), cancel);
                r.Lines.Add("copied the EFI folder to EFI\\");
            }

            // read back what was written
            progress?.Invoke("verify-stick", 0);
            if (!File.ReadAllBytes(dstList).AsSpan().SequenceEqual(File.ReadAllBytes(files.ChunklistFile))) throw new StickException("the chunklist on the stick differs from the download");
            list.VerifyFile(dstImage, b => progress?.Invoke("verify-stick", (double)b / list.ImageSize), cancel);
            r.Lines.Add("read back: the image on the stick matches Apple's chunklist");
            if (efi is not null)
            {
                int n = CompareTree(efi, Path.Combine(root, "EFI"));
                r.Lines.Add($"read back: {n} EFI files match");
            }
            progress?.Invoke("done", 1);
            r.Ok = true;
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            r.Ok = false;
            r.Error = e is AggregateException { InnerException: { } inner } ? inner.Message : e.Message;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static StickDisk? Checked(IStickSystem sys, StickHelperRequest q, StickPolicy policy, StickHelperResult r) =>
        Reinspect(sys, q.Disk, q.Size, q.Id, q.Salt, policy, q.EraseEfi, r);

    /// The disk, read now: refused by the rules, not the one chosen (serial and size), or holding an EFI that the user
    /// did not confirm to erase, gives null with the reasons in r. Shared by the installer and probe stick helpers.
    public static StickDisk? Reinspect(IStickDisks sys, uint number, ulong size, string id, string salt, StickPolicy policy, bool eraseEfi, StickHelperResult r)
    {
        var disk = sys.Inspect(number);
        if (disk is null) { r.Error = $"no disk {number}: nothing written"; return null; }
        var refusals = StickRules.Refusals(disk, policy);
        if (refusals.Count > 0)
        {
            r.Refusals = [.. refusals];
            r.Error = $"disk {number} refused, nothing written: " + string.Join("; ", refusals);
            return null;
        }
        if (disk.Size != size || !CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(disk.Token(salt)), Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(id)))
        {
            r.Error = $"disk {number} is not the disk that was chosen (another serial number or size): nothing written. Choose the stick again";
            return null;
        }
        if (StickRules.EfiNotConfirmed(disk, eraseEfi) is { } efi)
        {
            r.Refusals = [efi];
            r.Error = efi;
            return null;
        }
        return disk;
    }

    static long DirSize(string dir) => new DirectoryInfo(dir).EnumerateFiles("*", SearchOption.AllDirectories).Sum(f => f.Length);

    static void Copy(string src, string dst, Action<long>? progress, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        using var i = new FileStream(src, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read, 1 << 20, FileOptions.SequentialScan);
        using var o = new FileStream(dst, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, 1 << 20, FileOptions.WriteThrough);
        var buf = new byte[4 << 20];
        long done = 0;
        int n;
        while ((n = i.Read(buf, 0, buf.Length)) > 0)
        {
            cancel.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            o.Write(buf, 0, n);
            done += n;
            progress?.Invoke(done);
        }
        o.Flush(true);
    }

    static void CopyTree(string src, string dst, CancellationToken cancel)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dst);
        foreach (var d in Directory.EnumerateDirectories(src, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(dst, Path.GetRelativePath(src, d)));
        foreach (var f in Directory.EnumerateFiles(src, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            Copy(f, Path.Combine(dst, Path.GetRelativePath(src, f)), null, cancel);
    }

    static int CompareTree(string src, string dst)
    {
        int n = 0;
        foreach (var f in Directory.EnumerateFiles(src, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            var other = Path.Combine(dst, Path.GetRelativePath(src, f));
            if (!File.Exists(other) || !SHA256.HashData(File.ReadAllBytes(f)).AsSpan().SequenceEqual(SHA256.HashData(File.ReadAllBytes(other))))
                throw new StickException("the EFI copy differs at " + Path.GetRelativePath(src, f));
            n++;
        }
        return n;
    }
}

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

    static BiosData Data => BiosSteps.Embedded;

    // ---- the file: every item complete in both languages, cited, with a path for every vendor ----

    [Fact]
    public void EveryItemIsCompleteInBothLanguages()
    {
        Assert.NotEmpty(Data.Items);
        Assert.Equal(Data.Items.Count, Data.Items.Select(i => i.Id).Distinct().Count());
        foreach (var i in Data.Items)
        {
            foreach (var t in new[] { i.Title, i.Want, i.Why }.Concat(i.Missing is null ? [] : [i.Missing]))
            {
                Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t.En), $"{i.Id}: English text missing");
                Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t.Tr), $"{i.Id}: Turkish text missing");
            }
            Assert.Contains(i.Group, Data.Groups.Select(g => g.Id));
            _ = i.Level;   // throws for an unknown level
            Assert.Contains(i.Fact, BiosSteps.Facts);
            Assert.True(i.Cpu is null or "intel", $"{i.Id}: cpu is intel or absent");
        }
        foreach (var g in Data.Groups) Assert.True(g.Title.En.Length > 0 && g.Title.Tr.Length > 0 && g.Caption.Tr.Length > 0);

            Assert.Contains("2026-11-12 10:00", html);
            Assert.Contains("prefers-color-scheme: dark", html);
            Assert.Contains("@media print", html);

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The EFI page's boot logging section without the page: its state from the status, which change it offers, and the
// on/off flow through the planner the page uses, on the stage 1 sample (whose Misc > Debug logs to a file already, with
// DisplayLevel 0x80000002: partly on). Off is its own change, not undo: with another change made after boot logging,
// undo would take back that one instead.
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXe.Core.Localisation;
using IntelXeEfi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public sealed class BootLoggingTests : IDisposable
{
    readonly string root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "ixebootlog-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]);
    string Efi => Path.Combine(root, "efi");
    string Config => Path.Combine(Efi, "EFI", "OC", "config.plist");
    EfiOptions Options => new("", "", "", "Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9900K CPU @ 3.60GHz", false, Path.Combine(root, "backups"));
    readonly FolderEfiPlanner planner = new();
    EfiTarget Target => new EfiTarget.Folder(Efi);

    public BootLoggingTests()
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(Efi, "EFI", "OC"));
        File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(Efi, "EFI", "OC", "OpenCore.efi"), []);
        File.Copy(Paths.RepoFile("windows", "test", "stage1", "config.plist"), Config);
    }

    public void Dispose() { if (Directory.Exists(root)) Util.Delete(root); }

    static EfiStatus Status(string? value) =>
        new(true, value is null ? new Dictionary<string, string>() : new Dictionary<string, string> { ["boot_logging"] = value });

    [Fact]
    public void TheStateFromTheStatus()
    {
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.On, BootLogging.State(Status("on")));
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Off, BootLogging.State(Status("off")));
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Partial, BootLogging.State(Status("partial")));
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Missing, BootLogging.State(Status("missing")));
        // not read, unreadable (the engine gives ""), or a value from a newer engine
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Unknown, BootLogging.State(null));
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Unknown, BootLogging.State(Status(null)));
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Unknown, BootLogging.State(Status("")));
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Unknown, BootLogging.State(Status("sometimes")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WhichChangeIsOffered()
    {
        Assert.True(BootLogging.CanTurnOn(BootLogState.Off) && !BootLogging.CanTurnOff(BootLogState.Off));
        Assert.True(!BootLogging.CanTurnOn(BootLogState.On) && BootLogging.CanTurnOff(BootLogState.On));
        Assert.True(BootLogging.CanTurnOn(BootLogState.Partial) && BootLogging.CanTurnOff(BootLogState.Partial));
        Assert.True(!BootLogging.CanTurnOn(BootLogState.Missing) && !BootLogging.CanTurnOff(BootLogState.Missing));
        // the EFI not read yet: both, and the plan says what each would do
        Assert.True(BootLogging.CanTurnOn(BootLogState.Unknown) && BootLogging.CanTurnOff(BootLogState.Unknown));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BothStringTablesHaveTheStates()
    {
        Assert.Equal(5, BootLogging.Keys.Distinct().Count());
        foreach (var lang in new[] { "en-US", "tr-TR" })
        {
            var table = ReswFile.Read(Paths.AppFile("Strings", lang, "Resources.resw"));
            Assert.DoesNotContain(BootLogging.Keys, k => !table.ContainsKey(k));
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheChangesKinds()
    {
        Assert.Equal("bootlog-off", EfiChange.BootLogOff.Kind());
        Assert.Equal(EfiChange.BootLogOff, EfiChanges.FromKind("bootlog-off"));
        Assert.Equal(EfiChange.BootLog, EfiChanges.FromKind("bootlog"));
        // and through the elevated helper's command line (an EFI partition)
        var q = new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Apply, new EfiTarget.Partition(1, 1), EfiChange.BootLogOff, Options, "S:", new string('0', 64));
        Assert.Equal(EfiChange.BootLogOff, EfiHelperRequest.Parse(q.ToArgs()).Change);
    }

    async Task<BootLogState> State() => BootLogging.State(await planner.ReadStatusAsync(Target, Options));

    async Task<EfiPlan> Make(EfiChange change)
    {
        var plan = await planner.PlanAsync(Target, change, Options);
        Assert.True(plan.HasChanges, change + ": " + plan.Text);
        EngineTextTests.AssertKnown(plan, await planner.ApplyAsync(plan, Options));
        return plan;
    }

    string Debug(string key) => Plist.Raw(Plist.Load(Config).Get("Misc", "Debug", key));

    [Fact]
    public async Task OnThenOff()
    {
        // the sample: the file bit, AppleDebug and ApplePanic on, DisplayLevel without DEBUG_INFO
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Partial, await State());
        var on = await Make(EfiChange.BootLog);
        Assert.Contains(on.Notes, n => n.StartsWith("boot logging slows every boot", StringComparison.Ordinal));
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.On, await State());
        Assert.False((await planner.PlanAsync(Target, EfiChange.BootLog, Options)).HasChanges);

        var off = await Make(EfiChange.BootLogOff);
        Assert.Empty(off.Notes);
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Off, await State());
        Assert.Equal(("3", "false", "false", "2147483714"), (Debug("Target"), Debug("AppleDebug"), Debug("ApplePanic"), Debug("DisplayLevel")));
        Assert.Equal("boot logging off", (await planner.ReadStatusAsync(Target, Options))["backup_kind"]);
        Assert.False((await planner.PlanAsync(Target, EfiChange.BootLogOff, Options)).HasChanges);

        // the off change has its own backup: undo puts boot logging back on
        await Make(EfiChange.Undo);
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.On, await State());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task OffIsNotUndoWhenAnotherChangeCameAfter()
    {
        await Make(EfiChange.BootLog);
        await Make(EfiChange.Settings);   // stage 2 after the logs were turned on
        var status = await planner.ReadStatusAsync(Target, Options);
        Assert.Equal(("on", "0", "settings"), (status["boot_logging"], status["settings_changes"], status["backup_kind"]));
        // undo would take back stage 2, not boot logging
        var undo = await planner.PlanAsync(Target, EfiChange.Undo, Options);
        Assert.Contains("(settings, ", undo.Lines[0]);
        // the off change leaves stage 2 as it is
        await Make(EfiChange.BootLogOff);
        status = await planner.ReadStatusAsync(Target, Options);
        Assert.Equal(("off", "0"), (status["boot_logging"], status["settings_changes"]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task NoMiscDebug()
    {
        var pl = Plist.Load(Config);
        pl.Remove(["Misc", "Debug"]);
        File.WriteAllBytes(Config, pl.ToBytes());
        Assert.Equal(BootLogState.Missing, await State());
        foreach (var c in new[] { EfiChange.BootLog, EfiChange.BootLogOff })
        {
            var plan = await planner.PlanAsync(Target, c, Options);
            Assert.False(plan.HasChanges);
            Assert.Equal(["config.plist has no Misc > Debug: not changed"], plan.Notes);
        }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using IntelXe.Core;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class CardAndPciTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void SupportedCardsComeFromPlatformsJson()
    {
        var all = SupportedCards.All;
        Assert.Contains(all, c => c.Device == 0xE20B && c.Name == "Intel Arc B580" && c.Tested);
        Assert.Contains(all, c => c.Device == 0xE20C && c.Name == "Intel Arc B570" && !c.Tested);
        Assert.Contains(all, c => c.Device == 0xE211 && c.Name == "Intel Arc Pro B60" && c.Model == "Intel Arc Pro B60 Graphics" && !c.Tested);
        Assert.Contains(all, c => c.Device == 0xE212 && c.Name == "Intel Arc Pro B50" && c.Model == "Intel Arc Pro B50 Graphics" && !c.Tested);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(all, c => c.Device is >= 0xE220 and <= 0xE223);   // BMG-G31 (Pro B70): tester boot-arg only
        Assert.All(all, c => Assert.StartsWith("8086:", c.VendorDevice));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(@"PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_E20B&SUBSYS_10208086&REV_00\6&1A2B3C4D&0&00000019", 0x8086, 0xE20B, 0x8086, 0x1020, 0)]
    [InlineData(@"pci\ven_8086&dev_e20c&subsys_00001849&rev_01", 0x8086, 0xE20C, 0x1849, 0x0000, 1)]
    public void ParsesInstanceIds(string id, int vendor, int device, int subVendor, int sub, int rev)
    {
        var p = PciId.Parse(id)!;
        Assert.Equal(vendor, p.Vendor);
        Assert.Equal(device, p.Device);
        Assert.Equal(subVendor, (int)p.SubsystemVendor!);
        Assert.Equal(sub, (int)p.Subsystem!);
        Assert.Equal(rev, (int)p.Revision!);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FormatsVendorDeviceInLowerCase() =>
        Assert.Equal("8086:e20b", PciId.Parse(@"PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_E20B")!.VendorDevice);

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(null)]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData(@"ROOT\BasicDisplay\0000")]
    [InlineData(@"USB\VID_8087&PID_0033")]
    public void NonPciIsNull(string? id) => Assert.Null(PciId.Parse(id));

    [Fact]
    public void ClassifiesCards()
    {
        Assert.Equal(CardSupport.Supported, SupportedCards.Classify(new PciId(0x8086, 0xE20B)));
        Assert.Equal(CardSupport.SupportedUntested, SupportedCards.Classify(new PciId(0x8086, 0xE20C)));
        Assert.Equal(CardSupport.SupportedUntested, SupportedCards.Classify(new PciId(0x8086, 0xE211)));   // Arc Pro B60
        Assert.Equal(CardSupport.SupportedUntested, SupportedCards.Classify(new PciId(0x8086, 0xE212)));   // Arc Pro B50
        Assert.Equal(CardSupport.OtherIntel, SupportedCards.Classify(new PciId(0x8086, 0xE223)));          // Arc Pro B70 (G31)
        Assert.Equal(CardSupport.OtherIntel, SupportedCards.Classify(new PciId(0x8086, 0x56A0)));   // Arc A770
        Assert.Equal(CardSupport.NotIntel, SupportedCards.Classify(new PciId(0x10DE, 0x2684)));
        Assert.Equal(CardSupport.NotIntel, SupportedCards.Classify(null));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IssueFormsCarryTheReportId()
    {
        Assert.Equal("https://github.com/yusufklncc/intel-gpu-macos-driver/issues/new?template=1-bug.yml&report=XR-1A2B3C4D",
            Project.BugFormUrl("XR-1A2B3C4D").AbsoluteUri);
        Assert.Equal("https://github.com/yusufklncc/intel-gpu-macos-driver/issues/new?template=2-new-hardware.yml&reports=XR-00FF00FF",
            Project.NewGpuFormUrl("XR-00FF00FF").AbsoluteUri);
        Assert.Equal("https://github.com/yusufklncc/intel-gpu-macos-driver/issues/new?template=1-bug.yml", Project.BugFormUrl(null).AbsoluteUri);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IssueFormFieldsExistInTheTemplates()
    {
        var dir = Paths.RepoFile(".github", "ISSUE_TEMPLATE");
        Assert.Contains("id: report\n", File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(dir, "1-bug.yml")).Replace("\r\n", "\n"));
        Assert.Contains("id: reports\n", File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(dir, "2-new-hardware.yml")).Replace("\r\n", "\n"));
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class ChecksTests
{
    static PcFacts TestMachine() => new()
    {
        Gpus = [new GpuInfo("Intel(R) UHD Graphics 770", PciId.Parse(@"PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_A780")),
                new GpuInfo("Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics", PciId.Parse(@"PCI\VEN_8086&DEV_E20B&SUBSYS_10208086&REV_00"))],
        CpuName = "Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K", PerformanceCores = 8, EfficiencyCores = 12,
        BoardMaker = "Board maker", BoardModel = "Z790 board",
        Firmware = FirmwareMode.Uefi, SecureBoot = SecureBootState.Off,
        Bar = new BarSummary([new MemoryRange(0x40_0000_0000, 16UL << 30)]),
        Windows = new WindowsInfo("Windows 10 Pro", "25H2", 26200, 7171),
        BitLocker = BitLockerState.Off,
        Esps = [new EspPartition("Disk A", "NVMe", 0, 1, 104_857_600, "", true, OpenCoreState.NeedsMount)],
    };

    static Check Get(IReadOnlyList<Check> list, string id) => list.Single(c => c.Id == id);

    [Fact]
    public void TheTestMachineMeetsTheRequirements()
    {
        var list = PcChecks.Evaluate(TestMachine());
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Good, PcChecks.Overall(list));
        Assert.Equal("Intel Arc B580 (8086:e20b)", Get(list, "card").Value.Verbatim);
        Assert.Equal("HybridPM_Needed", Get(list, "hybridpm").Value.Key);
        Assert.Equal("Rebar_On", Get(list, "rebar").Value.Key);
        Assert.Equal("Esp_CountUnread", Get(list, "esp").Value.Key);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NoSupportedCardIsAProblem()
    {
        var f = TestMachine();
        f.Gpus.RemoveAt(1);
        var card = Get(PcChecks.Evaluate(f), "card");
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Bad, card.State);
        Assert.Equal("Card_Help_Other", card.Help.Key);
        f.Gpus.Clear();
        Assert.Equal("Card_Help_None", Get(PcChecks.Evaluate(f), "card").Help.Key);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheB570IsAWarning()
    {
        var f = TestMachine();
        f.Gpus[1] = new GpuInfo("Intel(R) Arc(TM) B570 Graphics", new PciId(0x8086, 0xE20C));
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Warning, Get(PcChecks.Evaluate(f), "card").State);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FirmwareLimitsComeFromTheGuide()
    {
        var f = TestMachine();
        f.Firmware = FirmwareMode.Legacy; f.SecureBoot = SecureBootState.On; f.BitLocker = BitLockerState.On;
        f.Bar = new BarSummary([new MemoryRange(0x8000_0000, 256UL << 20)]);
        var list = PcChecks.Evaluate(f);
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Bad, Get(list, "firmware").State);
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Warning, Get(list, "secureboot").State);
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Warning, Get(list, "rebar").State);
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Warning, Get(list, "bitlocker").State);
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Bad, PcChecks.Overall(list));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UnknownsAreNeutral()
    {
        var list = PcChecks.Evaluate(new PcFacts { Gpus = [new GpuInfo("B580", new PciId(0x8086, 0xE20B))] });
        Assert.All(list.Where(c => c.Id != "card"), c => Assert.Equal(CheckState.Neutral, c.State));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AmdIsAWarning()
    {
        var f = TestMachine();
        f.CpuName = "AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor";
        var list = PcChecks.Evaluate(f);
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Warning, Get(list, "cpu").State);
        Assert.Equal("HybridPM_NotNeeded", Get(list, "hybridpm").Value.Key);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EveryKeyTheChecksUseIsListed()
    {
        // all states, so that every branch runs
        var keys = new HashSet<string>();
        void Collect(PcFacts f)
        {
            void Add(Text t)
            {
                if (t.Key is not null) keys.Add(t.Key);
                foreach (var a in t.Args) if (a is Text inner) Add(inner);
            }
            foreach (var c in PcChecks.Evaluate(f))
                foreach (var t in new[] { c.Title, c.Value, c.Help }) Add(t);
        }
        foreach (var fw in Enum.GetValues<FirmwareMode>())
        foreach (var sb in Enum.GetValues<SecureBootState>())
        foreach (var bl in Enum.GetValues<BitLockerState>())
        {
            var f = TestMachine(); f.Firmware = fw; f.SecureBoot = sb; f.BitLocker = bl;
            Collect(f);
        }
        var g = TestMachine(); g.Gpus.Clear(); g.CpuName = ""; g.Bar = null; g.Windows = null; g.BoardModel = ""; g.Esps.Clear(); Collect(g);
        g = TestMachine(); g.Gpus.RemoveAt(1); g.CpuName = "AMD Ryzen 9 7950X"; g.Bar = new BarSummary([new MemoryRange(0, 256UL << 20)]); Collect(g);
        g = TestMachine(); g.CpuName = "Some CPU"; g.Esps[0] = g.Esps[0] with { OpenCore = OpenCoreState.Found }; Collect(g);
        g = TestMachine(); g.Gpus[1] = g.Gpus[1] with { Id = new PciId(0x8086, 0xE20C) }; g.CpuName = "Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9900K"; g.PerformanceCores = null;
        g.Esps[0] = g.Esps[0] with { OpenCore = OpenCoreState.NotFound }; Collect(g);
        Assert.Empty(keys.Except(PcChecks.Keys));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ThePendingPlannerWritesNothing()
    {
        IEfiPlanner p = new PendingEfiPlanner("no rules here");
        Assert.False(p.IsAvailable);
        var status = await p.ReadStatusAsync(new EfiTarget.Folder(@"E:\EFI"), new EfiOptions());
        Assert.False(status.Readable);
        var e = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<EfiUnavailableException>(() => p.PlanAsync(new EfiTarget.Partition(0, 1), EfiChange.Settings, new EfiOptions()));
        Assert.Contains("no rules here", e.Message);
        var plan = new EfiPlan(new EfiTarget.Partition(0, 1), EfiChange.Driver, "", [], [], "hash", true, "");
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<EfiUnavailableException>(() => p.ApplyAsync(plan, new EfiOptions()));
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The SMBIOS identity kept out of the window (SmbiosMask), the scan and build folders, saving a built EFI, the built EFI
// as the stick page's IEfiSource, and the app's own engine checking stage 2 in a built EFI.
using IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;
using IntelXe.Core.Stick;
using IntelXeEfi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class EfiBuildStoreTests
{
    // ---- masking ----

    [Fact]
    public void TheIdentityInEveryForm()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var efi = FakeConfig.WriteEfi(t.Path);
        var s = SmbiosMask.ReadSecrets(Path.Combine(efi, "OC", "config.plist"));
        var rom = FakeConfig.Rom;
        foreach (var form in new[]
                 {
                     FakeConfig.Serial, FakeConfig.Serial.ToLowerInvariant(), FakeConfig.Mlb, FakeConfig.Uuid, FakeConfig.Uuid.ToLowerInvariant(),
                     FakeConfig.Uuid.Replace("-", ""), Convert.ToHexStringLower(rom), Convert.ToHexString(rom), Convert.ToBase64String(rom),
                     string.Join(":", rom.Select(b => b.ToString("x2"))), string.Join(":", rom.Select(b => b.ToString("X2"))),
                 })
            Assert.Contains(form, s);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("MacBookPro16,2", s);
        Assert.True(s.Zip(s.Skip(1)).All(p => p.First.Length >= p.Second.Length), "longest first, so a longer form is replaced whole");

        var text = $"sn {FakeConfig.Serial}, uuid {FakeConfig.Uuid.ToLowerInvariant()}, rom {string.Join(":", rom.Select(b => b.ToString("X2")))}";
        var red = SmbiosMask.Redact(text, s);
        Assert.Equal("sn <redacted>, uuid <redacted>, rom <redacted>", red);
        Assert.Empty(SmbiosMask.Find(red, s));
        Assert.True(SmbiosMask.Find(text, s).Count >= 3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ConfigValuesAreMaskedInTheWindow()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var efi = FakeConfig.WriteEfi(t.Path);
        var summary = SmbiosMask.PlatformSummary(Path.Combine(efi, "OC", "config.plist"));
        Assert.Equal(["MLB", "ROM", "SystemProductName", "SystemSerialNumber", "SystemUUID", "SpoofVendor"], summary.Select(x => x.Key));
        Assert.Equal("MacBookPro16,2", summary.Single(x => x.Key == "SystemProductName").Value);
        Assert.Equal("true", summary.Single(x => x.Key == "SpoofVendor").Value);
        foreach (var k in new[] { "MLB", "ROM", "SystemSerialNumber", "SystemUUID" })
            Assert.Equal(SmbiosMask.Masked, summary.Single(x => x.Key == k).Value);
        var all = string.Join("\n", summary.Select(x => x.Value));
        Assert.Empty(SmbiosMask.Find(all, SmbiosMask.ReadSecrets(Path.Combine(efi, "OC", "config.plist"))));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("SystemSerialNumber", true)]
    [InlineData("MLB", true)]
    [InlineData("ROM", true)]
    [InlineData("SystemUUID", true)]
    [InlineData("BoardSerialNumber", true)]
    [InlineData("ChassisSerialNumber", true)]
    [InlineData("SmUUID", true)]
    [InlineData("SystemProductName", false)]
    [InlineData("ProcessorType", false)]
    [InlineData("ROMSize", false)]
    public void WhichKeysAreMasked(string key, bool secret)
    {
        Assert.Equal(secret, SmbiosMask.IsSecretKey(key));
        Assert.Equal(secret ? SmbiosMask.Masked : "x", SmbiosMask.Display(key, "x"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NoConfigNoSecrets()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        Assert.Empty(SmbiosMask.ReadSecrets(t.Sub("none.plist")));
        FakeEngine.Write(t.Sub("bad.plist"), "<plist><dict><key>PlatformInfo");
        Assert.Empty(SmbiosMask.ReadSecrets(t.Sub("bad.plist")));
        Assert.Empty(SmbiosMask.PlatformSummary(t.Sub("bad.plist")));

        var sample = SmbiosMask.PlatformSummary(Paths.RepoFile("efi", "sample-z790", "config.plist"));
        Assert.Equal(SmbiosMask.Masked, sample.Single(x => x.Key == "SystemSerialNumber").Value);
    }

    [Fact]

        Directory.CreateDirectory(a);
        Assert.Equal(Path.Combine(t.Path, "builds", "20261113-010203-2"), store.NewBuildDir(now));
        Assert.Equal(Path.Combine(t.Path, "scans", "20261113-010203"), store.NewScanDir(now));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OnlyTheBuildersOldBuildsAreDeleted()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var store = new EfiBuildStore(t.Path);
        string Build(string name, bool marker)
        {
            var d = Path.Combine(store.BuildsDir, name);
            FakeConfig.WriteEfi(d);
            if (marker) FakeEngine.Write(Path.Combine(d, EfiBuildStore.Marker), "made by windows/efibuild");
            return d;
        }
        var old1 = Build("1", true);
        var keep = Build("2", true);
        var current = Build("3", true);
        var mine = Build("4", false);
        Assert.Equal(1, store.PruneBuilds(current, keep));
        Assert.False(Directory.Exists(old1));
        Assert.True(Directory.Exists(keep) && Directory.Exists(current) && Directory.Exists(mine));
        Assert.Equal(0, new EfiBuildStore(t.Sub("nothing")).PruneBuilds());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SavingTheBuiltEfi()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();

        Assert.Equal(t.Sub("usb", "EFI"), saved);
        Assert.Equal(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(efi, "OC", "config.plist")), File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(saved, "OC", "config.plist")));
        Assert.Equal(saved, EfiFolderCheck.Resolve(t.Sub("usb")));
        // never over an EFI folder, never into itself, never without a folder
        Assert.Contains("exists already", Assert.Throws<EfiBuildException>(() => EfiBuildStore.SaveTo(efi, t.Sub("usb"))).Message);
        Assert.Throws<EfiBuildException>(() => EfiBuildStore.SaveTo(efi, efi));
        Assert.Throws<EfiBuildException>(() => EfiBuildStore.SaveTo(efi, t.Sub("none")));
        Assert.Throws<EfiSourceException>(() => EfiBuildStore.SaveTo(t.Sub("usb", "nothing"), t.Path));
        Assert.Single(Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(t.Sub("usb")));   // no temporary folder left
    }

    {

        File.Copy(Paths.RepoFile("efi", "sample-z790", "config.plist"), config, overwrite: true);
        Assert.Empty(EfiBuildStore.Stage2Left(efi, safari: true));
        Assert.Empty(EfiBuildStore.Stage2Left(efi, safari: false));
        // as OpCore Simplify leaves it, before stage 2
        var pl = Plist.Load(config);
        pl.Set(["Booter", "Quirks", "ResizeAppleGpuBars"], PValue.Int(-1));
        File.WriteAllBytes(config, pl.ToBytes());
        Assert.Contains(EfiBuildStore.Stage2Left(efi, safari: true), l => l.Contains("ResizeAppleGpuBars"));
    }
