// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The elevated helper's logic with the mounting abstracted (a fake IEspMounter that "mounts" a folder), the package
// (folder, zip, SHA256SUMS) and the command line. Nothing here mounts anything.
using System.IO.Compression;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXeEfi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public sealed class EfiHelperTests : IDisposable
{
    readonly string root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "ixehelper-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]);
    string Efi => Path.Combine(root, "esp");
    string Pkg => Path.Combine(root, "intel-gpu-macos-driver-9.9.9-efi");
    string Backups => Path.Combine(root, "backups");
    string Config => Path.Combine(Efi, "EFI", "OC", "config.plist");

    public EfiHelperTests()
    {
        // an EFI as stage 1 leaves it (windows/test/stage1/config.plist: efi/sample-z790 set back), and a package
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(Efi, "EFI", "OC", "Kexts"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(Efi, "EFI", "OC", "ACPI"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(Efi, "EFI", "BOOT"));
        File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(Efi, "EFI", "OC", "OpenCore.efi"), []);
        File.Copy(Paths.RepoFile("windows", "test", "stage1", "config.plist"), Config);
        var kext = Path.Combine(Pkg, "EFI", "OC", "Kexts", "IntelXe.kext", "Contents");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(kext, "MacOS"));
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(kext, "MacOS", "IntelXe"), "stand-in IntelXe executable\n");
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(kext, "Info.plist"), "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<plist version=\"1.0\">\n<dict>\n\t<key>CFBundleVersion</key>\n\t<string>9.9.9</string>\n</dict>\n</plist>\n");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(Pkg, "EFI", "OC", "ACPI"));
        File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(Pkg, "EFI", "OC", "ACPI", "SSDT-ARCOFF.aml"), File.ReadAllBytes(Paths.RepoFile("windows", "test", "stage1", "SSDT-ARCOFF-0.1.3.aml")));
        WriteSums();
    }

    void WriteSums()
    {
        var files = Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(Pkg, "EFI"), "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
            .Select(f => f[(Pkg.Length + 1)..].Replace('\\', '/')).OrderBy(f => f, StringComparer.Ordinal);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(Pkg, "SHA256SUMS"), string.Concat(files.Select(f => Util.Sha256File(Path.Combine(Pkg, Util.Native(f))) + "  " + f + "\n")));
    }

    public void Dispose() { if (Directory.Exists(root)) Util.Delete(root); }

    /// "Mounts" disk 1 partition 1 by handing out the fake EFI's folder; refuses any other partition, as the real one
    /// refuses a partition that is not an EFI system partition.
    sealed class FakeMounter(string folder, string letter = "S:", bool hadLetter = false) : IEspMounter
    {
        public int Mounts, Unmounts;
        public string? Asked;
        public MountedEsp Mount(uint disk, uint partition, string? want)
        {
            if (disk != 1 || partition != 1) throw new EfiException($"disk {disk} partition {partition} is not an EFI system partition");
            Mounts++;
            Asked = want;
            return new MountedEsp(want ?? letter, folder, !hadLetter);
        }
        public void Unmount(MountedEsp esp) { Assert.True(esp.MountedHere); Unmounts++; }
    }

    EfiOptions Options => new(Pkg, "", "", "Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9900K CPU @ 3.60GHz", false, Backups);
    static readonly EfiTarget.Partition Esp = new(1, 1);

    EfiHelperResult Run(EfiHelperRequest q, IEspMounter m) =>
        // through the command line and the JSON answer, as the app and the helper exchange them
        EfiHelperResult.FromJson(EfiHelper.Run(EfiHelperRequest.Parse(q.ToArgs()), m).ToJson());

    [Fact]
    public void PlanThenApplyOnAMountedPartition()
    {
        var m = new FakeMounter(Efi);
        var plan = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Plan, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options), m);
        Assert.True(plan.Ok, plan.Error);
        Assert.Equal("S:", plan.Letter);
        Assert.Equal((1, 1), (m.Mounts, m.Unmounts));
        var p = plan.ToPlan(Esp);
        Assert.True(p.HasChanges);
        Assert.Equal("S:", p.Letter);
        Assert.Contains("ResizeAppleGpuBars", p.Text);
        Assert.Equal(EfiWork.Plan(Esp, Efi, EfiChange.Settings, Options).Hash, p.Hash);

        var before = File.ReadAllBytes(Config);
        var done = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Apply, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options, p.Letter, p.Hash), m);
        Assert.True(done.Ok, done.Error);
        Assert.Equal("S:", m.Asked);
        Assert.Equal((2, 2), (m.Mounts, m.Unmounts));
        Assert.NotEqual(before, File.ReadAllBytes(Config));
        Assert.Contains(done.Lines!, l => l.StartsWith("== backup of the whole EFI folder: "));
        Assert.Equal("10", Plist.Raw(Plist.Load(Config).Get("Booter", "Quirks", "ResizeAppleGpuBars")));

        // and undo, with its own plan
        var undo = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Plan, Esp, EfiChange.Undo, Options), m).ToPlan(Esp);
        Assert.True(undo.HasChanges);
        Assert.Contains(undo.Lines, l => l.StartsWith("restore  EFI/OC/config.plist"));
        var back = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Apply, Esp, EfiChange.Undo, Options, undo.Letter, undo.Hash), m);
        Assert.True(back.Ok, back.Error);
        Assert.Equal(before, File.ReadAllBytes(Config));
        Assert.Equal((4, 4), (m.Mounts, m.Unmounts));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ARefusedChangeWritesNothingAndStillUnmounts()
    {
        var m = new FakeMounter(Efi);
        var before = File.ReadAllBytes(Config);
        var r = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Apply, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options, "S:", new string('0', 64)), m);
        Assert.False(r.Ok);
        Assert.Contains("changed since the plan was shown", r.Error);
        Assert.Equal((1, 1), (m.Mounts, m.Unmounts));
        Assert.Equal(before, File.ReadAllBytes(Config));
        Assert.False(Directory.Exists(Backups));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheEfiChangedBetweenPlanAndChange()
    {
        var m = new FakeMounter(Efi);
        var p = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Plan, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options), m).ToPlan(Esp);
        var pl = Plist.Load(Config);
        pl.Set(["Kernel", "Quirks", "DisableIoMapper"], PValue.Bool(true));   // someone else made one of the steps
        File.WriteAllBytes(Config, pl.ToBytes());
        var edited = File.ReadAllBytes(Config);
        var r = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Apply, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options, p.Letter, p.Hash), m);
        Assert.False(r.Ok);
        Assert.Contains("changed since the plan was shown", r.Error);
        Assert.Equal(edited, File.ReadAllBytes(Config));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AChangeMustSeeThePartitionAtThePlansLetter()
    {
        var p = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Plan, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options), new FakeMounter(Efi)).ToPlan(Esp);
        // the partition already has another letter now (the user mounted it): the plan named S:
        var m = new FakeMounter(Efi, "T:", hadLetter: true);
        var ignoresWish = new LetterMounter(m, "T:");
        var r = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Apply, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options, p.Letter, p.Hash), ignoresWish);
        Assert.False(r.Ok);
        Assert.Contains("not at S:", r.Error);
        Assert.Equal(0, m.Unmounts);   // it had a letter before: left mounted
    }

    sealed class LetterMounter(FakeMounter inner, string letter) : IEspMounter
    {
        public MountedEsp Mount(uint disk, uint partition, string? want) => inner.Mount(disk, partition, null) with { Letter = letter };
        public void Unmount(MountedEsp esp) => inner.Unmount(esp);
    }

    sealed class StuckMounter(FakeMounter inner) : IEspMounter
    {
        public MountedEsp Mount(uint disk, uint partition, string? want) => inner.Mount(disk, partition, want);
        public void Unmount(MountedEsp esp) => throw new EfiException("mountvol failed: in use");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AChangeThatWasMadeStaysReportedWhenUnmountingFails()
    {
        var m = new StuckMounter(new FakeMounter(Efi));
        var p = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Plan, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options), m);
        Assert.True(p.Ok, p.Error);
        Assert.Contains("stays mounted at S:", p.Warning);
        var done = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Apply, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options, "S:", p.ToPlan(Esp).Hash), m);
        Assert.True(done.Ok, done.Error);
        Assert.Contains("in use", done.Warning);
        Assert.Equal("10", Plist.Raw(Plist.Load(Config).Get("Booter", "Quirks", "ResizeAppleGpuBars")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NotAnEspIsRefused()
    {
        var r = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Plan, new EfiTarget.Partition(0, 3), EfiChange.Settings, Options), new FakeMounter(Efi));
        Assert.False(r.Ok);
        Assert.Contains("not an EFI system partition", r.Error);
        var none = EfiHelper.Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Plan, Esp, EfiChange.Settings, Options), null);
        Assert.False(none.Ok);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AFolderNeedsNoMounting()
    {
        var folder = new EfiTarget.Folder(Path.Combine(Efi, "EFI"));
        var status = Run(new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Status, folder, EfiChange.Settings, Options), new FakeMounter("/nowhere"));
        Assert.True(status.Ok, status.Error);
        var s = status.ToStatus();
        Assert.True(s.Readable);
        Assert.Equal("yes", s["opencore"]);
        Assert.Equal("ok", s["package_checksums"]);
        Assert.Equal("none", s["backup"]);
        Assert.Null(status.Letter);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheCommandLine()
    {
        var q = new EfiHelperRequest(EfiHelperVerb.Apply, Esp, EfiChange.SettingsSafari,
            new EfiOptions(@"C:\Users\x\IntelXe Manager\pkg\", @"\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP", "none", "13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F", true, null),
            "s:", "ab12", @"C:\out dir\r.json");
        var back = EfiHelperRequest.Parse(q.ToArgs());
        Assert.Equal(q with { Letter = "S:" }, back);
        Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiHelperRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "apply", "--change", "settings", "--disk", "1", "--partition", "1"]));   // no --expect
        Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiHelperRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "plan", "--change", "settings"]));   // no EFI
        Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiHelperRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "plan", "--change", "settings", "--folder", "x", "--disk", "1", "--partition", "1"]));
        Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiHelperRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "plan", "--change", "nonsense", "--folder", "x"]));
        Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiHelperRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "plan", "--change", "settings", "--folder", "x", "--letter", "SS"]));
        Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiHelperRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "mount", "--folder", "x"]));
        Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiHelperRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "plan", "--change", "settings", "--folder", "x", "--rm", "y"]));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("plain", "plain")]

    // ---- the package -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [Fact]
    public void ThePackageFolderAndItsSums()
    {
        Assert.Equal(Pkg, EfiPackage.FindIn(Pkg));
        Assert.Equal(Pkg, EfiPackage.FindIn(root));   // the folder holding the unpacked zip's top folder
        Assert.Null(EfiPackage.FindIn(Efi));
        Assert.Equal(Pkg, EfiPackage.FindBeside(Path.Combine(Pkg, "IntelXeManager")));
        var info = EfiPackage.Inspect(Pkg);
        Assert.Equal(("ok", "9.9.9", true), (info.Checksums, info.KextVersion, info.Usable));
        File.AppendAllText(Path.Combine(Pkg, "EFI", "OC", "Kexts", "IntelXe.kext", "Contents", "MacOS", "IntelXe"), "changed\n");
        info = EfiPackage.Inspect(Pkg);
        Assert.Equal("differs from SHA256SUMS: EFI/OC/Kexts/IntelXe.kext/Contents/MacOS/IntelXe", info.Checksums);
        Assert.False(info.Usable);
        // and the change refuses it, before anything is written
        var p = EfiWork.Plan(new EfiTarget.Folder(Efi), Efi, EfiChange.Driver, Options);
        var e = Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiWork.Apply(Efi, EfiChange.Driver, p.Hash, Options));
        Assert.Contains("differ from its SHA256SUMS", e.Message);
        Assert.False(Directory.Exists(Backups));
        File.Delete(Path.Combine(Pkg, "SHA256SUMS"));
        Assert.Equal("no SHA256SUMS", EfiPackage.Inspect(Pkg).Checksums);
        Assert.NotNull(EfiPackage.Inspect(Efi).Problem);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheZip()
    {
        var zip = Path.Combine(root, "intel-gpu-macos-driver-9.9.9-efi.zip");
        ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory(Pkg, zip, CompressionLevel.Fastest, includeBaseDirectory: true);
        var cache = Path.Combine(root, "cache");
        var dir = EfiPackage.Unzip(zip, cache);
        Assert.StartsWith(cache, dir);
        Assert.Equal("ok", EfiPackage.Inspect(dir).Checksums);
        Assert.Equal(dir, EfiPackage.Unzip(zip, cache));   // once

        var evil = Path.Combine(root, "evil.zip");
        using (var a = ZipFile.Open(evil, ZipArchiveMode.Create))
            using (var w = new StreamWriter(a.CreateEntry("../outside.txt").Open())) w.Write("x");
        Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiPackage.Unzip(evil, cache));
        Assert.False(File.Exists(Path.Combine(cache, "outside.txt")));
        var empty = Path.Combine(root, "empty.zip");
        using (ZipFile.Open(empty, ZipArchiveMode.Create)) { }
        Assert.Throws<EfiException>(() => EfiPackage.Unzip(empty, cache));
    }

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core.Tests/EfiVectorTests.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The shared test vectors of the EFI rules (release/efi-rules-vectors.json; the format is in
// docs/design/DESIGN-efi-rules.md section 5) against the Core's planner: the same vectors release/test-efi-vectors.sh
// runs against efi.sh and windows/test/Test-EfiVectors.ps1 against IntelXe-EFI.ps1. For each vector: the package and
// the EFI folder it describes, config.plist as stage 1 leaves it with the vector's edits, the facts as Windows gives
// them (the card's Location path, which the user confirms, when its instance id is one of the rules' cards), the plan's
// steps and notes, the change made through FolderEfiPlanner with the plan's hash, the values, files and list of changes
// it must leave, and undo back to the state before.
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXeEfi;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public sealed class EfiVectorTests
{
    // ---- the vectors file ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    sealed class VectorFile
    {
        public required Dictionary<string, object> Root;
        public required Rules Rules;
        public required byte[] Stage1;
        public Dictionary<string, object> Tables => (Dictionary<string, object>)Root["tables"];
        public IEnumerable<Dictionary<string, object>> Vectors => List(Root, "vectors").Cast<Dictionary<string, object>>();
    }

    static readonly Lazy<VectorFile> file = new(() =>
    {
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Paths.RepoFile("release", "efi-rules-vectors.json")));
        var root = (Dictionary<string, object>)EfiRules.Tree(doc.RootElement, "vectors");
        Assert.Equal("intelxe-efi-rules-vectors", root["format"]);
        Assert.Equal(1L, root["format_version"]);
        var stage1 = Plist.Load(Paths.RepoFile(((string)root["config"]).Split('/')));
        foreach (var e in List(root, "stage1")) Edit(stage1, (Dictionary<string, object>)e);
        return new VectorFile { Root = root, Rules = EfiRules.Embedded, Stage1 = stage1.ToBytes() };
    });

    public static TheoryData<string> Names()
    {
        var d = new TheoryData<string>();
        foreach (var v in file.Value.Vectors) d.Add((string)v["name"]);
        return d;
    }

    static List<object> List(Dictionary<string, object>? d, string key) =>
        d is not null && d.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? (List<object>)v : [];
    static object? Key(Dictionary<string, object>? d, string key) => d is not null && d.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v : null;

    static byte[] Hex(string hex) => Convert.FromHexString(hex);

    static PValue Value(string type, object value) => type switch
    {
        "integer" => PValue.Int((long)value),
        "bool" => PValue.Bool((bool)value),
        "string" => PValue.Str((string)value),
        "data" => PValue.Data(Convert.FromBase64String((string)value)),
        "dict" => Rules.Value(value),
        _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("vectors: no value type " + type),
    };

    static void Edit(Plist pl, Dictionary<string, object> e)
    {
        var path = ((string)e["path"]).Split('.');
        switch ((string)e["op"])
        {
            case "set": pl.Set(path, Value((string)e["type"], e["value"])); break;
            case "remove": pl.Remove(path); break;
            case "append": pl.Append(path, Value((string)e["type"], e["value"])); break;
            case "insert": pl.Insert(path, (int)(long)e["index"], Value((string)e["type"], e["value"])); break;
            default: throw new InvalidOperationException("vectors: no edit " + e["op"]);
        }
    }

    static string Oc(string dir, string rel) => Path.Combine(dir, "EFI", "OC", Util.Native(rel));

    /// A fixture: the file it describes at DIR/EFI/OC/<its file>.
    static void Fixture(string dir, Dictionary<string, object> fx, string pkg)
    {
        var rel = (string)fx["file"];
        if (rel == "SHA256SUMS") return;   // the package's sums: Sums(), last
        var d = Oc(dir, rel);
        Util.Delete(d);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(d)!);
        switch ((string)fx["type"])
        {
            case "kext":
                var exe = Path.Combine(d, Util.Native((string)fx["executable"]));
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(exe)!);
                File.WriteAllText(exe, (string)fx["text"] + "\n");
                var keys = new StringBuilder();
                if ((string)fx["bundle_id"] != "") keys.Append($"\t<key>CFBundleIdentifier</key>\n\t<string>{fx["bundle_id"]}</string>\n");
                if ((string)fx["version"] != "") keys.Append($"\t<key>CFBundleVersion</key>\n\t<string>{fx["version"]}</string>\n");
                File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(d, "Contents", "Info.plist"),
                    $"<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<plist version=\"1.0\">\n<dict>\n{keys}</dict>\n</plist>\n");
                break;
            case "table": File.WriteAllBytes(d, Hex((string)file.Value.Tables[(string)fx["table"]])); break;
            case "dir": Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(d, "Contents", "MacOS")); break;
            case "package":
                Util.CopyTree(Oc(pkg, rel), d);
                if (Key(fx, "append") is string more)
                    foreach (var x in Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(d, "Contents", "MacOS"))) File.AppendAllText(x, more + "\n");
                break;
            case "none": break;
            default: throw new InvalidOperationException("vectors: no fixture type " + fx["type"]);
        }
    }

    static void Sums(string dir)
    {
        var efi = Path.Combine(dir, "EFI");
        var files = Directory.GetFiles(efi, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
            .Select(f => f[(dir.Length + 1)..].Replace('\\', '/')).OrderBy(f => f, StringComparer.Ordinal);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(dir, "SHA256SUMS"),
            string.Join("\n", files.Select(rel => Util.Sha256File(Path.Combine(dir, Util.Native(rel))) + "  " + rel)) + "\n");
    }

    /// Every file under DIR but config.plist, with its SHA-256: two trees hold the same when these are the same.
    static string Tree(string dir) => string.Join("\n", Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
        .Where(f => Path.GetFileName(f) != "config.plist")
        .Select(f => f[dir.Length..].Replace('\\', '/') + " " + Util.Sha256File(f)).OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.Ordinal));

    // ---- a plan's step in the vectors' form, any tree as one comparable string (keys sorted) ------------------------
    static object ValueTree(PValue v) => v.Type switch
    {
        "dict" => v.Entries.ToDictionary(kv => kv.Key, kv => ValueTree(kv.Value)),
        "bool" => v.Text == "true",
        "integer" => long.Parse(v.Text),
        _ => v.Text,
    };

    static Dictionary<string, object> FromOp(Op op)
    {
        var d = new Dictionary<string, object> { ["op"] = op.Kind };
        switch (op.Kind)
        {
            case "copy": d["to"] = op.Rel; d["from"] = op.Bytes is not null ? "adapted" : "package"; break;
            case "set" or "append" or "insert":
                d["path"] = string.Join(".", op.Path);
                if (op.Kind == "insert") d["index"] = (long)op.Index;
                d["type"] = op.Value.Type;
                d["value"] = ValueTree(op.Value);
                break;
            case "mkdict" or "mkarray": d["path"] = string.Join(".", op.Path); break;
        }
        return d;
    }

    static string Canon(object? v) => v switch
    {
        null => "null",
        string s => "s\"" + s.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("\"", "\\\"") + "\"",
        bool b => "b" + b,
        long or int => "i" + v,
        IDictionary<string, object> d => "{" + string.Join(",", d.Keys.OrderBy(k => k, StringComparer.Ordinal).Select(k => Canon(k) + "=" + Canon(d[k]))) + "}",
        System.Collections.IEnumerable l => "[" + string.Join(",", l.Cast<object>().Select(Canon)) + "]",
        _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("vectors: cannot compare a " + v.GetType().Name),
    };

    // ---- the facts as Windows gives them -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    static string InstanceId(string pci)
    {
        var p = pci.Split(':');
        return $@"PCI\VEN_{p[0].ToUpperInvariant()}&DEV_{p[1].ToUpperInvariant()}&SUBSYS_00000000&REV_00\4&0&0&0008";
    }

    /// Device Manager's Location path: the port's ACPI names, then one PCI part per level down to the GPU ("none": the
    /// port is a PCI part too).
    static string LocationPath(string port, long levels)
    {
        var parts = new List<string>();
        long pci = levels;
        if (port == "none") { parts.AddRange(["ACPI(_SB_)", "ACPI(PC00)"]); pci = levels + 1; }
        else parts.AddRange(port.TrimStart('\\').Split('.').Select(s => $"ACPI({s.PadRight(4, '_')})"));
        for (int i = 0; i < pci; i++) parts.Add("PCI(0000)");
        return string.Join("#", parts);
    }

    /// The status values a vector lists ({"key": "value"}) that the planner's status gives otherwise, as " key=got;".
    static async Task<string> StatusDiff(object? want, IEfiPlanner planner, EfiTarget target, EfiOptions options)
    {
        if (want is not Dictionary<string, object> w) return "";
        var got = await planner.ReadStatusAsync(target, options);
        return string.Concat(w.Where(kv => got[kv.Key] != (string)kv.Value).Select(kv => $" status {kv.Key}={got[kv.Key]};"));
    }

    // ---- one vector ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(Names))]
    public async Task Vector(string name)
    {
        var vf = file.Value;
        var rules = vf.Rules;
        var V = vf.Vectors.Single(v => (string)v["name"] == name);
        var root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "ixevec-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]);
        try
        {
            string P0 = Path.Combine(root, "pkg0"), P = Path.Combine(root, "pkg"), F = Path.Combine(root, "efi"), Bk = Path.Combine(root, "backups");
            foreach (var fx in List(vf.Root, "package")) Fixture(P0, (Dictionary<string, object>)fx, "");
            var cfg = Oc(F, "config.plist");
            foreach (var d in new[] { "Kexts", "ACPI" }) Directory.CreateDirectory(Oc(F, d));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(F, "EFI", "BOOT"));
            File.WriteAllBytes(Oc(F, "OpenCore.efi"), []);
            Util.CopyTree(P0, P);
            bool sums = true;
            foreach (Dictionary<string, object> fx in List(V, "package"))
            {
                if ((string)fx["file"] == "SHA256SUMS" && (string)fx["type"] == "none") sums = false;
                Fixture(P, fx, "");
            }
            if (sums) Sums(P);
            var pl = Plist.Parse(vf.Stage1, "stage 1");
            foreach (Dictionary<string, object> e in List(V, "edits")) Edit(pl, e);
            File.WriteAllBytes(cfg, pl.ToBytes());
            foreach (Dictionary<string, object> fx in List(V, "efi")) Fixture(F, fx, P);
            var before = Plist.Canonical(Plist.Load(cfg).Root);
            var beforeTree = Tree(F);

            // the facts
            var facts = (Dictionary<string, object>)V["facts"];
            long levels = rules.Int("cards.port_levels_above_gpu");
            string loc = "", detected = "";
            if (Key(facts, "card") is Dictionary<string, object> card && rules.IsCardInstance(InstanceId((string)card["pci"])))
            {
                loc = LocationPath((string)card["port"], levels);               // what Device Manager shows, confirmed
                detected = EfiFolder.ConvertLocationPath(loc, levels) ?? "";     // what the app reads from Windows
            }
            var options = new EfiOptions(P, loc, detected, (string)facts["cpu"], (bool)facts["boot_path_recorded"], Bk,
                Key(facts, "probe_device") as string ?? "");
            var change = EfiChanges.FromKind((string)V["plan"]) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("vectors: plan " + V["plan"]);
            var x = (Dictionary<string, object>)V["expect"];
            var planner = new FolderEfiPlanner(rules);
            var target = new EfiTarget.Folder(F);

            // the status values before (through the planner, as the EFI page reads them)
            Assert.Equal("", await StatusDiff(Key(x, "status"), planner, target, options));

            // the plan: its steps (the engine's) and the planner's notes and hash
            var made = EfiWork.Open(F, options, rules).MakePlan(change.Kind());
            var plan = await planner.PlanAsync(target, change, options);
            Assert.Equal(made.Hash, plan.Hash);
            Assert.Equal(made.Text, plan.Text);
            Assert.Equal(Canon(List(x, "ops")), Canon(made.Ops.Select(FromOp).ToList()));
            var notes = List(x, "notes").Cast<string>().ToList();
            Assert.True(plan.Notes.Count == notes.Count && plan.Notes.Zip(notes).All(n => n.First.Contains(n.Second)),
                $"the notes: {string.Join(" | ", plan.Notes)}; the vector: {string.Join(" | ", notes)}");
            Assert.Equal(made.HasChanges, plan.HasChanges);

            // make it, and what it must leave
            if (List(x, "ops").Count == 0) { EngineTextTests.AssertKnown(plan, null); return; }
            EngineTextTests.AssertKnown(plan, await planner.ApplyAsync(plan, options));
            var why = new StringBuilder();
            var after = (Dictionary<string, object>?)Key(x, "after");
            var done = Plist.Load(cfg);
            foreach (Dictionary<string, object> a in List(after, "config"))
            {
                var e = done.Get(((string)a["path"]).Split('.'));
                if (Key(a, "absent") is not null) { if (e is not null) why.Append($" {a["path"]} is there;"); }
                else if (Plist.Raw(e) != Value((string)a["type"], a["value"]).Raw) why.Append($" {a["path"]}={Plist.Raw(e)};");
            }
            foreach (Dictionary<string, object> a in List(after, "files"))
            {
                var f = Oc(F, (string)a["file"]);
                if (Key(a, "state") is "package")
                {
                    var src = Oc(P, (string)a["file"]);
                    bool same = Directory.Exists(src) ? Directory.Exists(f) && Tree(src) == Tree(f) : Util.SameFile(src, f);
                    if (!same) why.Append($" {a["file"]} is not the package's;");
                }
                else if (Key(a, "state") is "absent") { if (Util.Exists(f)) why.Append($" {a["file"]} is there;"); }
                else if (Key(a, "sha256") is string sha) { if (!File.Exists(f) || Util.Sha256File(f) != sha) why.Append($" {a["file"]}'s SHA-256;"); }
                else if (Key(a, "table") is string t) { if (!Util.SameBytes(File.ReadAllBytes(f), Hex((string)vf.Tables[t]))) why.Append($" {a["file"]} is not {t};"); }
            }
            if (List(after, "changed").Count > 0)
            {
                var b = EfiWork.Open(F, options, rules).LastBackup();
                var listed = b is null ? "" : File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(b, "changed")).TrimEnd('\n').Replace('\n', ' ');
                if (listed != string.Join(" ", List(after, "changed").Cast<string>())) why.Append($" the backup lists {listed};");
            }
            why.Append(await StatusDiff(Key(after, "status"), planner, target, options));
            Assert.True(why.Length == 0, "applied:" + why);

            // undo: back to the state before
            if (Key(x, "undo") is not true) return;
            var undo = await planner.PlanAsync(target, EfiChange.Undo, options);
            Assert.True(undo.HasChanges);
            EngineTextTests.AssertKnown(undo, await planner.ApplyAsync(undo, options));
            Assert.Equal(before, Plist.Canonical(Plist.Load(cfg).Root));
            Assert.Equal(beforeTree, Tree(F));
        }
        finally
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(root)) Util.Delete(root);
        }
    }

    [Fact]

    }

    }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The engine's lines in the app's words (EngineText, D13 of docs/design/DESIGN-efi-rules.md): every note, step and output
// line the engine's source (windows/IntelXe-EFI.ps1, between "// BEGIN ENGINE" and "// END ENGINE") can write has a
// template, each template is the one its own text finds, every key is in both string tables, and a line no template
// knows stays as the engine wrote it.
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXe.Core.Localisation;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class EngineTextTests
{
    static string Engine()
    {
        var text = File.ReadAllText(Paths.RepoFile("windows", "IntelXe-EFI.ps1")).Replace("\r\n", "\n");
        int b = text.IndexOf("// BEGIN ENGINE\n", StringComparison.Ordinal), e = text.IndexOf("// END ENGINE", StringComparison.Ordinal);
        Assert.True(b >= 0 && e > b);
        return text[b..e];
    }

    /// The arguments of each call "name(" in the source, as written.
    static IEnumerable<string> Calls(string source, string name)
    {
        foreach (Match m in Regex.Matches(source, @"(?<![\w.])" + Regex.Escape(name) + @"\("))
        {
            int depth = 1, i = m.Index + m.Length, start = i;
            for (; i < source.Length && depth > 0; i++)
            {
                char c = source[i];
                if (c == '"') i = SkipString(source, i);
                else if (c == '\'') i = source.IndexOf('\'', i + (source[i + 1] == '\\' ? 3 : 2));
                else if (c == '(') depth++;
                else if (c == ')') depth--;
            }
            yield return source[start..(i - 1)];
        }
    }

    /// The index of a string literal's closing quote (regular or verbatim).
    static int SkipString(string s, int open)
    {
        bool verbatim = open > 0 && s[open - 1] == '@';
        for (int i = open + 1; i < s.Length; i++)
        {
            if (!verbatim && s[i] == '\\') { i++; continue; }
            if (s[i] == '"') { if (verbatim && i + 1 < s.Length && s[i + 1] == '"') { i++; continue; } return i; }
        }
        throw new InvalidDataException("an unterminated string in the engine");
    }

    static readonly Dictionary<string, string[]> Variables = new()
    {
        // PlanFiles: the SSDT's verb, (ss == "absent" ? "copy" : "replace").PadRight(8)
        ["verb"] = ["copy".PadRight(8), "replace".PadRight(8)],
    };

    /// What a call's argument can write: its string literals as they are, each other operand of the top-level "+" as
    /// "X" (a variable named in Variables as each of its values). Null when no literal is at the top level (a value
    /// taken from elsewhere: a rule's note, a line of the plan's text).
    static IEnumerable<string> Samples(string expr)
    {
        var parts = new List<string>();
        int depth = 0, start = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < expr.Length; i++)
        {
            char c = expr[i];
            if (c == '"') i = SkipString(expr, i);
            else if (c == '(') depth++;
            else if (c == ')') depth--;
            else if (c == '+' && depth == 0) { parts.Add(expr[start..i].Trim()); start = i + 1; }
        }
        parts.Add(expr[start..].Trim());
        var outs = new List<StringBuilder> { new() };
        bool literal = false;
        foreach (var p in parts)
        {
            if (Regex.IsMatch(p, @"^@?""") && SkipString(p, p.IndexOf('"')) == p.Length - 1)
            {
                literal = true;
                var s = p.StartsWith('@') ? p[2..^1].Replace("\"\"", "\"") : Regex.Unescape(p[1..^1]);
                foreach (var o in outs) o.Append(s);
            }
            else if (Variables.TryGetValue(p, out var values))
                outs = outs.SelectMany(o => values.Select(v => new StringBuilder(o.ToString()).Append(v))).ToList();
            else foreach (var o in outs) o.Append('X');
        }
        return literal ? outs.Select(o => o.ToString()) : [];
    }

    static List<string> Unknown(EngineLine kind, IEnumerable<string> exprs, out int count)
    {
        var unknown = new List<string>();
        count = 0;
        foreach (var e in exprs)
            foreach (var s in Samples(e))
            {
                count++;
                if (!EngineText.IsKnown(kind, s)) unknown.Add(s);
            }
        return unknown;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EveryNoteTheEngineCanWriteHasATemplate()
    {
        var engine = Engine();
        var calls = Calls(engine, "p.Notes.Add").ToList();
        Assert.True(calls.Count >= 12, $"{calls.Count} notes in the engine");
        Assert.Empty(Unknown(EngineLine.Note, calls, out int n));
        Assert.True(n >= 11);
        // the notes that are not written there: a "require" or "note" item's note in the rules (PlanItems)
        Assert.Equal(["R.Str(it + \"note\")", "R.Str(it + \"note\")"], calls.Where(c => !Samples(c).Any()).Select(c => c.Trim()));
        var rules = EfiRules.Load(Paths.RepoFile("release", "templates", "efi-rules.json"));
        int ruleNotes = 0;
        foreach (var list in RuleLists)
            for (int i = 0; i < rules.List(list).Count; i++)
                if (rules.StrOr($"{list}.{i}.note") is { Length: > 0 } note)
                {
                    ruleNotes++;
                    Assert.True(EngineText.IsKnown(EngineLine.Note, note), note);
                    // one template, no more: the most specific one is the only one whose text it is
                    Assert.Single(EngineText.Notes, t => Regex.IsMatch(note, "^" + Regex.Replace(Regex.Escape(t.Engine), @"\\\{\d+(\\\*)?}", ".*") + "$"));
                }
        Assert.True(ruleNotes >= 4, $"{ruleNotes} notes in the rules");
    }

    /// The rules' lists of items (PlanItems): stage 2, the Safari setting, boot logging on and off.
    static readonly string[] RuleLists = ["settings", "safari", "bootlog", "bootlog-off", "xeprobe", "xeprobe-off"];

    [Fact]
    public void EveryRuleListIsCovered()
    {
        // a new list in efi-rules.json needs its notes and "why" texts here (and their keys in both string tables)
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Paths.RepoFile("release", "templates", "efi-rules.json")));
        var lists = doc.RootElement.EnumerateObject()
            .Where(p => p.Value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array && p.Value.EnumerateArray().Any(e => e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && e.TryGetProperty("kind", out _)))
            .Select(p => p.Name).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        Assert.Equal(RuleLists.Order(StringComparer.Ordinal), lists);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EveryStepAndOutputLineHasATemplate()
    {
        var engine = Engine();
        Assert.Empty(Unknown(EngineLine.Step, Calls(engine, "p.Lines.Add"), out int steps));
        Assert.True(steps >= 25, $"{steps} step lines");
        Assert.Empty(Unknown(EngineLine.Result, Calls(engine, "say"), out int said));
        Assert.True(said >= 6, $"{said} output lines");
        // the plan's text, which a change's output repeats
        foreach (var l in new[] { "EFI: the folder X (EFI, FAT32, 200 MB)", "nothing to change", "note     the package has no SHA256SUMS: its files are not checked" })
            Assert.True(EngineText.IsKnown(EngineLine.Result, l), l);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ThePhrasesInsideLinesHaveTemplates()
    {
        var rules = EfiRules.Load(Paths.RepoFile("release", "templates", "efi-rules.json"));
        var phrases = new List<string>();
        foreach (var list in RuleLists)
            for (int i = 0; i < rules.List(list).Count; i++)
                if (rules.StrOr($"{list}.{i}.why") is { Length: > 0 } why) phrases.Add(why);
        foreach (var kind in new[] { "driver", "settings", "safari", "settings-safari", "bootlog", "bootlog-off", "xeprobe", "xeprobe-off" }) phrases.Add(rules.Str("backup_kinds." + kind));
        // what Aml.Adapt says when a table cannot be adapted, and what Windows reports for the card (PlanFiles' "seen")
        var engine = Engine();
        foreach (Match m in Regex.Matches(engine, @"\b(?:why|seen) = ([^;]+);"))
            phrases.AddRange(Samples(m.Groups[1].Value).Select(s => s.Trim()).Where(s => s.Length > 0));
        Assert.True(phrases.Count >= 19, string.Join(" | ", phrases));
        var unknown = phrases.Where(p => !EngineText.Fragments.Any(f => Regex.IsMatch(p, "^" + Regex.Escape(f.Engine).Replace(@"\{0}", ".*") + "$"))).ToList();
        Assert.Empty(unknown);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EachTemplateIsTheOneItsOwnTextFinds()
    {
        foreach (var (kind, set) in new[] { (EngineLine.Step, EngineText.Steps), (EngineLine.Note, EngineText.Notes), (EngineLine.Result, EngineText.Results), (EngineLine.Error, EngineText.Errors) })
            foreach (var t in set)
            {
                var line = Regex.Replace(t.Engine, @"\{(\d+)\*?\}", m => "v" + m.Groups[1].Value);
                var m = EngineText.Match(kind, line);
                Assert.True(m is not null && m.Value.Template == t, $"{line}: found {m?.Template.Engine ?? "nothing"}");
            }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void BothStringTablesHaveEveryKey()
    {
        foreach (var lang in new[] { "en-US", "tr-TR" })
        {
            var table = ReswFile.Read(Paths.AppFile("Strings", lang, "Resources.resw"));
            Assert.DoesNotContain(EngineText.Keys, k => !table.ContainsKey(k));
            // a key's placeholders are its templates' (the values may leave none out: each part is shown)
            foreach (var t in EngineText.Steps.Concat(EngineText.Notes).Concat(EngineText.Results).Concat(EngineText.Errors).Concat(EngineText.Fragments))
                if (t.Key is not null)
                {
                    var want = Regex.Matches(t.Engine, @"\{(\d+)\*?\}").Select(m => int.Parse(m.Groups[1].Value)).Distinct().Order();
                    Assert.True(want.SequenceEqual(ReswFile.Placeholders(table[t.Key])), $"{lang} {t.Key}: {table[t.Key]}");
                }
        }
    }

    static Func<Text, string> Resolver(string lang)
    {
        var table = ReswFile.Read(Paths.AppFile("Strings", lang, "Resources.resw"));
        string R(Text t) => t.Key is null ? t.Verbatim ?? ""
            : string.Format(table[t.Key], t.Args.Select(a => a is Text x ? R(x) : a).ToArray());
        return R;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LinesInTurkish()
    {
        var tr = Resolver("tr-TR");
        Assert.Equal("ayar     Booter > Quirks > ResizeAppleGpuBars: 0 -> 10 (B580'in VRAM'ine 1 GB'lık pencere)",
            EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Step, "config   Booter > Quirks > ResizeAppleGpuBars: 0 -> 10 (a 1 GB window on the B580's VRAM)", tr));
        Assert.Equal("değiştir EFI/OC/ACPI/SSDT-ARCOFF.aml (\\_SB.PC00.PEG2.PEGP adını taşır: bu kartın portu)",
            EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Step, "replace  EFI/OC/ACPI/SSDT-ARCOFF.aml (names \\_SB.PC00.PEG2.PEGP, this card's port)", tr));
        Assert.Equal("kaynak   C:\\b\\001-x (IntelXe dosyaları, 2026-11-12 10:00:00)",
            EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Step, "from     C:\\b\\001-x (IntelXe files, 2026-11-12 10:00:00)", tr));
        Assert.Equal("ayar     Misc > Debug > Target: 0x3 -> 0x43 (günlük açık, bir dosyaya: OpenCore'un açıldığı EFI biriminin kökünde opencore-<tarih>.txt)",
            EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Step, "config   Misc > Debug > Target: 0x3 -> 0x43 (logging on, to a file: opencore-<date>.txt in the root of the EFI volume OpenCore starts from)", tr));
        Assert.Equal("kaynak   C:\\b\\002-x (açılış günlüğü, 2026-11-13 10:00:00)",
            EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Step, "from     C:\\b\\002-x (boot logging, 2026-11-13 10:00:00)", tr));
        Assert.StartsWith("Açılış günlüğü her açılışı yavaşlatır: ", EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Note,
            "boot logging slows every boot: OpenCore rewrites its whole 256 KB log file after every line, which adds seconds from an internal SSD and can add tens of seconds or more from a USB stick. Turn it off again once the logs are collected", tr));
        Assert.Equal("ayar     Misc > Debug > Target: 0x43 -> 0x3 (günlük dosyası yok: OpenCore her açılışta opencore-<tarih>.txt yazmayı bırakır; öteki günlük hedefleri kalır)",
            EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Step, "config   Misc > Debug > Target: 0x43 -> 0x3 (no log file: OpenCore stops writing opencore-<date>.txt at every boot; its other log targets stay)", tr));
        Assert.Equal("kaynak   C:\\b\\003-x (açılış günlüğü kapalı, 2026-11-13 11:00:00)",
            EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Step, "from     C:\\b\\003-x (boot logging off, 2026-11-13 11:00:00)", tr));
        Assert.Equal("  tamam geri kondu EFI/OC/config.plist", EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Result, "  ok    restored EFI/OC/config.plist", tr));
        Assert.Equal("  tamam EFI/OC/Kexts/IntelXe.kext", EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Result, "  ok    EFI/OC/Kexts/IntelXe.kext", tr));
        Assert.Equal("not      Pakette SHA256SUMS yok: dosyaları denetlenmiyor.",
            EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Result, "note     the package has no SHA256SUMS: its files are not checked", tr));
        var note = EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Note,
            "not added: SSDT-ARCOFF.aml. Add it only after macOS is installed and install.sh --apply has run (stage 3), and only for your card's ACPI path: the package's table is for \\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP (for another path it is adapted to that one). Check it in Device Manager (the B580 > Properties > Details > Location paths), then confirm it (-CardAcpiPath, or the SSDT-ARCOFF box in the window); stage 4, step 2 of README-INSTALL.md. Windows reports the card's port here as \\_SB.PC00.PEG2.PEGP.", tr);
        Assert.StartsWith("Eklenmedi: SSDT-ARCOFF.aml. ", note);
        Assert.EndsWith("Windows bu kartın portunu burada \\_SB.PC00.PEG2.PEGP olarak bildiriyor.", note);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("-CardAcpiPath", note);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheEnglishTableWordsThemForTheApp()
    {
        var en = Resolver("en-US");
        var note = EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Note,
            "not added: SSDT-ARCOFF.aml. Add it only after macOS is installed and install.sh --apply has run (stage 3), and only for your card's ACPI path: the package's table is for \\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP (for another path it is adapted to that one). Check it in Device Manager (the B580 > Properties > Details > Location paths), then confirm it (-CardAcpiPath, or the SSDT-ARCOFF box in the window); stage 4, step 2 of README-INSTALL.md.", en);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("-CardAcpiPath", note);
        Assert.Contains("tick the box", note);
        Assert.Equal("config   Misc > Security > SecureBootModel: Default -> Disabled (Apple Secure Boot refuses a system volume with a changed seal: needed for the system-volume copy, Safari on the GPU)",
            EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Step, "config   Misc > Security > SecureBootModel: Default -> Disabled (Apple Secure Boot refuses a system volume with a changed seal: needed for the system-volume copy, Safari on the GPU)", en));
        Assert.DoesNotContain("PowerShell", EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Error,
            "cannot write to M:\\EFI\\OC. An EFI partition mounted with mountvol can be written only by an administrator: start PowerShell as administrator (or use the window's \"Restart as administrator\")", en));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AnUnknownLineStaysAsTheEngineWroteIt()
    {
        var tr = Resolver("tr-TR");
        foreach (var kind in Enum.GetValues<EngineLine>())
        {
            Assert.False(EngineText.IsKnown(kind, "a line from a newer engine"));
            Assert.Equal("a line from a newer engine", EngineText.Show(kind, "a line from a newer engine", tr));
        }
        // a known template with a phrase it does not know keeps that phrase in English
        Assert.Equal("ayar     X > Y: 1 -> 2 (a newer reason)", EngineText.Show(EngineLine.Step, "config   X > Y: 1 -> 2 (a newer reason)", tr));
    }

    /// Every line and note of the plans and changes the shared vectors make (EfiVectorTests calls this).
    internal static void AssertKnown(EfiPlan plan, EfiResult? result)
    {
        foreach (var l in plan.Lines) Assert.True(EngineText.IsKnown(EngineLine.Step, l), "step: " + l);
        foreach (var n in plan.Notes) Assert.True(EngineText.IsKnown(EngineLine.Note, n), "note: " + n);
        Assert.True(EngineText.IsKnown(EngineLine.Result, plan.Text.Split('\n')[0]), plan.Text.Split('\n')[0]);
        foreach (var l in result?.Lines ?? []) Assert.True(EngineText.IsKnown(EngineLine.Result, l), "output: " + l);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Efi;
using IntelXe.Core.Localisation;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class LocalisationTests
{
    static string Strings(string language) => Paths.AppFile("Strings", language, "Resources.resw");

    [Fact]
    public void EnglishAndTurkishHaveTheSameKeysAndPlaceholders()
    {
        var en = ReswFile.Read(Strings("en-US"));
        var tr = ReswFile.Read(Strings("tr-TR"));
        Assert.NotEmpty(en);
        Assert.Empty(ReswFile.Compare(en, "en-US", tr, "tr-TR"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EveryKeyTheAppUsesExists()
    {
        var en = ReswFile.Read(Strings("en-US"));
        var app = Paths.AppFile();
        var files = Directory.EnumerateFiles(app, "*.*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
            .Where(f => (f.EndsWith(".cs") || f.EndsWith(".xaml")) && !f.Contains($"{Path.DirectorySeparatorChar}obj{Path.DirectorySeparatorChar}")
                        && !f.Contains($"{Path.DirectorySeparatorChar}bin{Path.DirectorySeparatorChar}"));
        var used = ReswFile.KeysUsedIn(files);
        Assert.NotEmpty(used);
        Assert.Empty(used.Where(k => !en.ContainsKey(k)).Order());
        Assert.Empty(PcChecks.Keys.Where(k => !en.ContainsKey(k)).ToList());
        Assert.True(en.ContainsKey(PendingEfiPlanner.MessageKey));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheTurkishTableIsTranslated()
    {
        var en = ReswFile.Read(Strings("en-US"));
        var tr = ReswFile.Read(Strings("tr-TR"));
        // names, numbers and formats may stay as they are; most text must not
        var same = en.Keys.Count(k => tr.TryGetValue(k, out var t) && t == en[k]);
        Assert.True(same < en.Count / 4, $"{same} of {en.Count} Turkish strings are the English ones");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ComparesPlaceholders()
    {
        Assert.Equal([0, 1], ReswFile.Placeholders("{1} of {0}, {0}"));
        var a = new Dictionary<string, string> { ["A"] = "x {0}", ["B"] = "y" };
        var b = new Dictionary<string, string> { ["A"] = "x", ["C"] = "z" };
        Assert.Equal(3, ReswFile.Compare(a, "a", b, "b").Count);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
using IntelXe.Core;
using IntelXe.Core.Report;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class ParsingTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData("ACPI(_SB_)#ACPI(PC00)#ACPI(PEG1)#ACPI(PEGP)#PCI(0100)#PCI(0000)", @"\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP")]
    [InlineData("ACPI(_SB_)#ACPI(PC00)#ACPI(RP05)#PCI(0000)#PCI(0000)", @"\_SB.PC00.RP05")]
    [InlineData("ACPI(_SB_)#ACPI(PC00)#PCI(0100)#PCI(0000)#PCI(0000)", "none")]
    [InlineData("PCIROOT(0)#PCI(0100)#PCI(0000)", null)]
    [InlineData("ACPI(_SB_)#PCI(0100)#ACPI(PEGP)", null)]
    [InlineData("not a path", null)]
    public void ConvertsLocationPaths(string line, string? path) => Assert.Equal(path, AcpiPath.FromLocationPath(line));

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(@"\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP", @"\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP")]
    [InlineData(@"\_SB_.PC00.PEG1.PEGP", @"\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP")]
    [InlineData(@"_sb.pc00.peg1.pegp", @"\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP")]
    [InlineData("ACPI(_SB_)#ACPI(PC00)#ACPI(PEG1)#ACPI(PEGP)#PCI(0100)#PCI(0000)", @"\_SB.PC00.PEG1.PEGP")]
    [InlineData("PEGP", null)]
    [InlineData("", null)]
    public void NormalizesAcpiPaths(string input, string? path) => Assert.Equal(path, AcpiPath.Normalize(input));

    /// A REG_RESOURCE_LIST with one full descriptor: a 16 MB memory range below 4 GB, a port range, and a 16 GB large
    /// memory range at 0x40_0000_0000 (length stored shifted by 16 bits, flag 0x400), as a B580 with Resizable BAR has.
    static byte[] ResourceListBytes(ulong largeLength, ushort largeFlag)
    {
        var b = new List<byte>();
        b.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(1u));                 // full descriptors
        b.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(5u));                 // interface type: PCI
        b.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(3u));                 // bus number
        b.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)1));          // version
        b.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes((ushort)1));          // revision
        b.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(3u));                 // partial descriptors
        void Descriptor(byte type, ushort flags, ulong start, uint length)
        {
            b.Add(type); b.Add(1); b.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(flags));
            b.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(start)); b.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(length));
            b.AddRange(new byte[4]);                            // the rest of the 16-byte union
        }
        Descriptor(3, 0, 0x8200_0000, 16u << 20);
        Descriptor(1, 0, 0x4000, 0x100);
        Descriptor(7, largeFlag, 0x40_0000_0000, (uint)largeLength);
        return b.ToArray();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReadsResizedBars()
    {
        var bar = ResourceList.Summarize(ResourceListBytes((16UL << 30) >> 16, 0x400))!;
        Assert.Equal(2, bar.Ranges.Count);
        Assert.Equal(16384UL, bar.LargestMb);
        Assert.True(bar.ResizableBar);
        Assert.True(bar.Above4G);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReadsSmallBars()
    {
        var bar = ResourceList.Summarize(ResourceListBytes((256UL << 20) >> 8, 0x200))!;
        Assert.Equal(256UL, bar.LargestMb);
        Assert.False(bar.ResizableBar);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EmptyResourceListIsUnknown()
    {
        Assert.Null(ResourceList.Summarize(null));
        Assert.Null(ResourceList.Summarize([1, 2]));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("Windows 10 Pro", "25H2", 26200, 7171, "Windows 11 Pro 25H2", "26200.7171")]
    [InlineData("Windows 10 Home", "22H2", 19045, 0, "Windows 10 Home 22H2", "19045")]
    [InlineData("", "", 0, 0, "Windows", "")]
    public void NamesWindows(string product, string display, int build, int ubr, string name, string buildText)
    {
        var w = new WindowsInfo(product, display, build, ubr);
        Assert.Equal(name, w.NameAndVersion);
        Assert.Equal(buildText, w.BuildText);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(1, BitLockerState.On)]
    [InlineData(2, BitLockerState.Off)]
    [InlineData(3, BitLockerState.Encrypting)]
    [InlineData(6, BitLockerState.Locked)]
    [InlineData(8, BitLockerState.WaitingForActivation)]
    [InlineData(0, BitLockerState.Unknown)]
    [InlineData(null, BitLockerState.Unknown)]
    public void ReadsBitLockerShellState(int? value, BitLockerState state) => Assert.Equal(state, BitLocker.FromShellProperty(value));

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(104_857_600UL, "105 MB")]
    [InlineData(209_715_200UL, "210 MB")]
    [InlineData(32_000_000_000UL, "32 GB")]
    public void FormatsSizesAsTheEfiTool(ulong bytes, string text) => Assert.Equal(text, EspPartition.FormatSize(bytes));

    [Fact]
    public void RecognisesTheEspType()
    {
        Assert.True(EspPartition.IsEspType("{C12A7328-F81F-11D2-BA4B-00A0C93EC93B}"));
        Assert.False(EspPartition.IsEspType("{ebd0a0a2-b9e5-4433-87c0-68b6b72699c7}"));
        Assert.Equal(OpenCoreState.Found, EspPartition.Detect(p => p == @"EFI\OC\OpenCore.efi"));
        Assert.Equal(OpenCoreState.NotFound, EspPartition.Detect(_ => false));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ParsesTheReportScriptsEnd()
    {
        var r = ReportRun.Parse(["Intel GPU: collecting...", "", "Report ID: XR-1A2B3C4D", @"File:      C:\Users\x\Desktop\xe-report-XR-1A2B3C4D.zip", "Took 52 s."])!;
        Assert.Equal("XR-1A2B3C4D", r.Id);
        Assert.Equal(@"C:\Users\x\Desktop\xe-report-XR-1A2B3C4D.zip", r.File);
        Assert.Null(ReportRun.Parse(["No report was written."]));
        Assert.Null(ReportRun.Parse(["Report ID: nonsense", "File: x"]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RunsTheReportWithBootLogsAsAdministrator()
    {
        var plain = ReportRun.PowerShellArguments(@"C:\app\tools\collect-windows.ps1", @"C:\Users\x\Desktop", acpi: false, bootLogs: true);
        Assert.Equal("-BootLogs", plain[^1]);
        var args = ReportRun.ElevatedArguments(@"C:\app's\tools\collect-windows.ps1", @"C:\Users\x\Desktop", acpi: true, bootLogs: true, @"C:\Users\x\AppData\Local\IntelXe Manager\report\1.txt");
        Assert.Equal(["-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command",
            @"& 'C:\app''s\tools\collect-windows.ps1' -OutDir 'C:\Users\x\Desktop' -Acpi -BootLogs *>&1 | Out-File -FilePath 'C:\Users\x\AppData\Local\IntelXe Manager\report\1.txt' -Encoding UTF8"], args);
        // "runas" takes one string (ShellExecute): the command is one quoted word in it
        Assert.EndsWith(" -Command \"" + args[^1] + "\"", IntelXe.Core.Efi.CommandLine.Join(args));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RunsTheReportWithItsOptions()
    {
        var args = ReportRun.PowerShellArguments(@"C:\app\tools\collect-windows.ps1", @"C:\Users\x\Desktop", acpi: true);
        Assert.Equal(["-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", @"C:\app\tools\collect-windows.ps1", "-OutDir", @"C:\Users\x\Desktop", "-Acpi"], args);
        // the script's parameters (tools/report/collect-windows.ps1)
        var script = File.ReadAllText(Paths.RepoFile("tools", "report", "collect-windows.ps1"));
        Assert.Contains("param([string]$OutDir", script);
        Assert.Contains("[switch]$Acpi", script);
        Assert.Contains("[switch]$BootLogs", script);
        Assert.Contains("Write-Host \"Report ID: $ID\"", script);
        Assert.Contains("Write-Host \"File:      $zip\"", script);
    }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

/// Files of the repository, found upwards from the test's output folder.
static class Paths
{
    static string Root()
    {
        for (var d = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory); d is not null; d = d.Parent)
            if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(d.FullName, "VERSION")) && Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(d.FullName, "windows", "app")))
                return d.FullName;
        throw new DirectoryNotFoundException("the repository root (VERSION, windows/app) above " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }

    public static string RepoFile(params string[] parts) => Path.Combine([Root(), .. parts]);
    public static string AppFile(params string[] parts) => Path.Combine([Root(), "windows", "app", "IntelXe.App", .. parts]);
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core.Tests/RecoveryTests.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The recovery protocol and the chunklist. Fixtures/recovery/ holds what Apple's recovery server answered on
// 2026-11-12 for the two board IDs (the asset tokens replaced by REDACTED-ASSET-TOKEN) and the two real chunklists it
// pointed to (BaseSystem.chunklist of macOS 26 and 15: Apple's signature over the image's piece hashes). The images
// themselves are too big for the repository: the download path is tested with images made here, signed with a key made
// here, and with a fake HTTP server.
using System.Net;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using IntelXe.Core.Stick;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class RecoveryTests
{
    static string Fixture(string name) => Paths.RepoFile("windows", "app", "IntelXe.Core.Tests", "Fixtures", "recovery", name);

    // ---- the versions ----

    [Fact]
    public void TheVersionsAreTahoeFirstThenSequoia()
    {
        var d = RecoveryData.Embedded;
        Assert.Equal(["tahoe", "sequoia"], d.Versions.Select(v => v.Id));
        Assert.Equal("00000000000000000", d.Mlb);
        Assert.Equal(RecoveryProtocol.ZeroMlb, d.Mlb);
        var tahoe = d.Find("tahoe");
        Assert.True(tahoe.Primary);
        Assert.Equal(("Mac-CFF7D910A743CAAF", "latest", 26), (tahoe.Board, tahoe.Os, tahoe.Major));   // macrecovery recovery_urls.txt
        var sequoia = d.Find("sequoia");
        Assert.False(sequoia.Primary);
        Assert.Equal(("Mac-7BA5B2D9E42DDD94", "default", 15), (sequoia.Board, sequoia.Os, sequoia.Major));
        Assert.StartsWith("26.", tahoe.BoardNewest);   // boards.json: the newest macOS the board gets
        Assert.StartsWith("15.", sequoia.BoardNewest);
        foreach (var v in d.Versions)
        {
            Assert.True(v.Status.En.Length > 0 && v.Status.Tr.Length > 0);
            Assert.True(File.Exists(Paths.RepoFile("site", "guide", Path.GetFileName(new Uri(v.Guide).AbsolutePath))), v.Guide);
        }
    }

    // ---- the requests ----

    [Fact]
    public void BuildsTheImageRequestAsMacrecoveryDoes()
    {
        int calls = 0;
        string Hex(int n) => new string((char)('A' + calls++), n);
        var body = RecoveryProtocol.ImageInfoBody("Mac-CFF7D910A743CAAF", "latest", Hex);
        Assert.Equal("cid=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA\nsn=00000000000000000\nbid=Mac-CFF7D910A743CAAF\nk=" + new string('B', 64) + "\nfg=" + new string('C', 64) + "\nos=latest", body);
        var r = RecoveryProtocol.ImageInfoRequest("session=ABC", body);
        Assert.Equal(HttpMethod.Post, r.Method);
        Assert.Equal("http://osrecovery.apple.com/InstallationPayload/RecoveryImage", r.RequestUri!.AbsoluteUri);
        Assert.Equal("text/plain", r.Content!.Headers.ContentType!.ToString());
        Assert.Equal("session=ABC", string.Join(";", r.Headers.GetValues("Cookie")));
        Assert.Equal("InternetRecovery/1.0", string.Join(" ", r.Headers.GetValues("User-Agent")));
        Assert.True(r.Headers.ConnectionClose);
        var real = RecoveryProtocol.ImageInfoBody("Mac-7BA5B2D9E42DDD94", "default");
        Assert.Matches(@"^cid=[0-9A-F]{16}\nsn=0{17}\nbid=Mac-7BA5B2D9E42DDD94\nk=[0-9A-F]{64}\nfg=[0-9A-F]{64}\nos=default$", real);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("Mac-XYZ", "latest")]
    [InlineData("Mac-CFF7D910A743CAAF\nsn=F5K105303J9K3F71M", "latest")]
    [InlineData("Mac-CFF7D910A743CAAF", "newest")]
    public void RefusesOtherBoardsAndOsTypes(string board, string os) =>
        Assert.Throws<RecoveryException>(() => RecoveryProtocol.ImageInfoBody(board, os));

    [Fact]
    public void ReadsTheSessionCookie()
    {
        Assert.Equal("session=abc123", RecoveryProtocol.ParseSession(["session=abc123; Domain=osrecovery.apple.com; Path=/; HttpOnly"]));
        Assert.Equal("session=x", RecoveryProtocol.ParseSession(["other=1; Path=/", "Path=/; session=x"]));
        Assert.Throws<RecoveryException>(() => RecoveryProtocol.ParseSession(["other=1"]));
        Assert.Throws<RecoveryException>(() => RecoveryProtocol.ParseSession([]));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("tahoe", "140-93589")]
    [InlineData("sequoia", "696-28424")]
    public void ParsesTheRecordedAnswers(string version, string product)
    {
        var info = RecoveryProtocol.ParseImageInfo(File.ReadAllText(Fixture(version + "-answer.txt")));
        Assert.Equal(product, info.Product);
        Assert.Equal("BaseSystem.dmg", info.ImageName);
        Assert.Equal("BaseSystem.chunklist", info.ChunklistName);
        Assert.Equal("oscdn.apple.com", info.ImageUrl.Host);
        Assert.Equal("REDACTED-ASSET-TOKEN", info.ImageToken);
        var a = RecoveryProtocol.AssetRequest(info.ChunklistUrl, info.ChunklistToken);
        Assert.Equal("AssetToken=REDACTED-ASSET-TOKEN", string.Join(";", a.Headers.GetValues("Cookie")));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("AP: 1\nAU: http://oscdn.apple.com/a/BaseSystem.dmg\nAT: t\nCU: http://oscdn.apple.com/a/BaseSystem.chunklist\n")]   // no CT
    [InlineData("AP: 1\nAU: http://evil.example/a/BaseSystem.dmg\nAT: t\nCU: http://oscdn.apple.com/a/BaseSystem.chunklist\nCT: t")]
    [InlineData("AP: 1\nAU: http://oscdn.apple.com.evil.example/BaseSystem.dmg\nAT: t\nCU: http://oscdn.apple.com/a/BaseSystem.chunklist\nCT: t")]
    [InlineData("AP: 1\nAU: file:///C:/x/BaseSystem.dmg\nAT: t\nCU: http://oscdn.apple.com/a/BaseSystem.chunklist\nCT: t")]
    [InlineData("AP: 1\nAU: http://oscdn.apple.com/a/..%5C..%5Cevil.dmg\nAT: t\nCU: http://oscdn.apple.com/a/BaseSystem.chunklist\nCT: t")]
    [InlineData("AP: 1\nAU: http://oscdn.apple.com/a/BaseSystem.dmg\nAT: t\nCU: http://oscdn.apple.com/a/Other.chunklist\nCT: t")]
    [InlineData("<html>403 Forbidden</html>")]
    public void RefusesBadAnswers(string text) => Assert.Throws<RecoveryException>(() => RecoveryProtocol.ParseImageInfo(text));

    // ---- the chunklist ----

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("tahoe", 92, 960_530_321L)]
    [InlineData("sequoia", 85, 884_317_790L)]
    public void ApplesRealChunklistsVerify(string version, int chunks, long size)
    {
        var list = Chunklist.Parse(File.ReadAllBytes(Fixture(version + "-BaseSystem.chunklist")));
        Assert.Equal(chunks, list.Chunks.Count);
        Assert.Equal(size, list.ImageSize);
        Assert.Equal(1, list.SignatureMethod);
        Assert.All(list.Chunks.SkipLast(1), c => Assert.Equal(10u << 20, c.Size));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AChangedByteBreaksApplesSignature()
    {
        var bytes = File.ReadAllBytes(Fixture("tahoe-BaseSystem.chunklist"));
        foreach (int at in new[] { 0x30, 0x24 + 36 * 50 + 10, bytes.Length - 1 })
        {
            var copy = (byte[])bytes.Clone();
            copy[at] ^= 0x01;
            Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(() => Chunklist.Parse(copy));
        }
        Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(() => Chunklist.Parse(bytes.AsSpan(0, bytes.Length - 1)));
        Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(() => Chunklist.Parse([.. bytes, 0]));
        // signed by another key
        using var other = RSA.Create(2048);
        Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(() => Chunklist.Parse(bytes, other.ExportParameters(false)));
    }

    static (byte[] Image, byte[] List, RSA Key) Signed(int size = 300_000, int chunk = 65536, byte method = 1)
    {
        var image = new byte[size];
        new Random(7).NextBytes(image);
        var key = RSA.Create(2048);
        return (image, Chunklist.Build(image, chunk, key, method), key);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RefusesAnUnsignedChunklist()
    {
        var (_, list, key) = Signed(method: 2);
        var e = Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(() => Chunklist.Parse(list, key.ExportParameters(false)));
        Assert.Contains("not signed", e.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ChecksEveryPiece()
    {
        var (image, listBytes, key) = Signed();
        var list = Chunklist.Parse(listBytes, key.ExportParameters(false));
        Assert.Equal(5, list.Chunks.Count);
        Assert.Equal(image.Length, list.ImageSize);

        // fed in odd sizes: fine
        var v = new Chunklist.Verifier(list);
        for (int o = 0; o < image.Length; o += 7777) v.Feed(image.AsSpan(o, Math.Min(7777, image.Length - o)));
        v.Finish();
        Assert.Equal(5, v.ChunksVerified);

        // one changed byte in piece 3: refused at that piece
        var bad = (byte[])image.Clone();
        bad[65536 * 2 + 100] ^= 0xFF;
        var v2 = new Chunklist.Verifier(list);
        var e = Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(() => v2.Feed(bad));
        Assert.Contains("chunk 3 of 5", e.Message);

        // short and long images
        var v3 = new Chunklist.Verifier(list);
        v3.Feed(image.AsSpan(0, image.Length - 1));
        Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(v3.Finish);
        var v4 = new Chunklist.Verifier(list);
        Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(() => v4.Feed([.. image, 0]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ChecksAFile()
    {
        var (image, listBytes, key) = Signed();
        var list = Chunklist.Parse(listBytes, key.ExportParameters(false));
        var dir = Directory.CreateTempSubdirectory("ixe-cl-").FullName;
        try
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(dir, "BaseSystem.dmg");
            File.WriteAllBytes(path, image);
            long seen = 0;
            list.VerifyFile(path, b => seen = b);
            Assert.Equal(image.Length, seen);
            image[^1] ^= 1;
            File.WriteAllBytes(path, image);
            Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(() => list.VerifyFile(path));
            File.WriteAllBytes(path, image[..^1]);
            Assert.Throws<ChunklistException>(() => list.VerifyFile(path));
        }
        finally { Directory.Delete(dir, true); }
    }

    // ---- the client against a fake server ----

    sealed class FakeApple(byte[] image, byte[] list, Func<byte[], byte[]>? serveImage = null) : HttpMessageHandler
    {
        public readonly List<(HttpMethod Method, string Url, string Cookie, string Body)> Requests = [];

        protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage r, CancellationToken cancel)
        {
            string cookie = r.Headers.TryGetValues("Cookie", out var c) ? string.Join(";", c) : "";
            string body = r.Content is null ? "" : await r.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancel);
            Requests.Add((r.Method, r.RequestUri!.AbsoluteUri, cookie, body));
            Assert.Equal("InternetRecovery/1.0", string.Join(" ", r.Headers.GetValues("User-Agent")));
            var url = r.RequestUri.AbsoluteUri;
            if (url == "http://osrecovery.apple.com/")
            {
                var resp = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = new ByteArrayContent([]) };
                resp.Headers.Add("Set-Cookie", "session=S1; Domain=osrecovery.apple.com; Path=/; HttpOnly");
                return resp;
            }
            if (url.EndsWith("/RecoveryImage", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                if (cookie != "session=S1") return new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.Forbidden);
                return new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
                {
                    Content = new StringContent("AP: 000-00000\nAU: http://oscdn.apple.com/x/RecoveryImage/BaseSystem.dmg\nAH: 00\nAT: IMG\n" +
                                                "CU: http://oscdn.apple.com/x/RecoveryImage/BaseSystem.chunklist\nCH: 00\nCT: LIST\n"),
                };
            }
            if (url.EndsWith("BaseSystem.chunklist", StringComparison.Ordinal) && cookie == "AssetToken=LIST")
                return new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = new ByteArrayContent(list) };
            if (url.EndsWith("BaseSystem.dmg", StringComparison.Ordinal) && cookie == "AssetToken=IMG")
                return new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK) { Content = new ByteArrayContent(serveImage?.Invoke(image) ?? image) };
            return new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        }
    }

    static RecoveryVersion Tahoe => RecoveryData.Embedded.Find("tahoe");

    [Fact]
    public async Task DownloadsAndChecks()
    {
        var (image, list, key) = Signed();
        var fake = new FakeApple(image, list);
        var dir = Directory.CreateTempSubdirectory("ixe-dl-").FullName;
        try
        {
            using var client = new RecoveryClient(fake, key.ExportParameters(false));
            var stages = new List<string>();
            var files = await client.DownloadAsync(Tahoe, dir, new SyncProgress(p => stages.Add(p.Stage)));
            Assert.Equal(Path.Combine(dir, "com.apple.recovery.boot", "BaseSystem.dmg"), files.Image);
            Assert.Equal(image, File.ReadAllBytes(files.Image));
            Assert.Equal(list, File.ReadAllBytes(files.ChunklistFile));
            Assert.Equal("000-00000", files.Product);
            Assert.Contains("done", stages);
            // the protocol's order: session, image info (with the zero MLB and the Tahoe board), chunklist, then image
            Assert.Equal(4, fake.Requests.Count);
            Assert.Equal(HttpMethod.Get, fake.Requests[0].Method);
            Assert.Contains("sn=00000000000000000\nbid=Mac-CFF7D910A743CAAF", fake.Requests[1].Body);
            Assert.EndsWith("\nos=latest", fake.Requests[1].Body);
            Assert.EndsWith("BaseSystem.chunklist", fake.Requests[2].Url);
            Assert.EndsWith("BaseSystem.dmg", fake.Requests[3].Url);
            // found again later, checked against the chunklist's signature and size
            var again = RecoveryFiles.Find(dir, key.ExportParameters(false));
            Assert.NotNull(again);
            Assert.Equal(image.Length, again!.Size);
            Assert.Null(RecoveryFiles.Find(dir));   // Apple's key does not verify our test list
        }
        finally { Directory.Delete(dir, true); }
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ABadPieceLeavesNoImage()
    {
        var (image, list, key) = Signed();
        var fake = new FakeApple(image, list, img => { var b = (byte[])img.Clone(); b[200_000] ^= 1; return b; });
        var dir = Directory.CreateTempSubdirectory("ixe-dl-").FullName;
        try
        {
            using var client = new RecoveryClient(fake, key.ExportParameters(false));
            var e = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<ChunklistException>(() => client.DownloadAsync(Tahoe, dir));
            Assert.Contains("chunk 4 of 5", e.Message);
            var boot = Path.Combine(dir, "com.apple.recovery.boot");
            Assert.False(File.Exists(Path.Combine(boot, "BaseSystem.dmg")));
            Assert.False(File.Exists(Path.Combine(boot, "BaseSystem.dmg.part")));
            Assert.Null(RecoveryFiles.Find(dir, key.ExportParameters(false)));
        }
        finally { Directory.Delete(dir, true); }
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AnUnsignedChunklistStopsBeforeTheImage()
    {
        var (image, list, key) = Signed(method: 2);
        var fake = new FakeApple(image, list);
        var dir = Directory.CreateTempSubdirectory("ixe-dl-").FullName;
        try
        {
            using var client = new RecoveryClient(fake, key.ExportParameters(false));
            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<ChunklistException>(() => client.DownloadAsync(Tahoe, dir));
            Assert.DoesNotContain(fake.Requests, r => r.Url.EndsWith(".dmg", StringComparison.Ordinal));
        }
        finally { Directory.Delete(dir, true); }
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AForbiddenAnswerIsAnError()
    {
        var handler = new StatusHandler(HttpStatusCode.Forbidden);
        using var client = new RecoveryClient(handler);
        var e = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<RecoveryException>(() => client.GetInfoAsync(Tahoe));
        Assert.Contains("403", e.Message);
    }

    sealed class StatusHandler(HttpStatusCode code) : HttpMessageHandler
    {
        protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage r, CancellationToken c) => Task.FromResult(new HttpResponseMessage(code));
    }

    sealed class SyncProgress(Action<RecoveryProgress> a) : IProgress<RecoveryProgress>
    {
        public void Report(RecoveryProgress value) => a(value);
    }
}
