// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The "Set up" page's steps (Core/Setup/SetupWizard.cs): done / next / blocked from the progress kept in settings.json and
// what the app reads each time; what each user action records; what blocks the whole install.
using System.Text.Json;
using IntelXe.Core.Setup;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class SetupWizardTests
{
    static readonly DateTime Now = new(2026, 11, 13, 9, 30, 0);

    static SetupInputs Inputs(bool facts = true, bool builder = true, bool efiExists = true, params Text[] blocking) =>
        new(facts, blocking, builder, builder ? Text.Empty : Text.Raw("no builder folder"), efiExists);

    static StepState[] States(SetupProgress p, SetupInputs i) => SetupWizard.Evaluate(p, i).Select(s => s.State).ToArray();

    const StepState D = StepState.Done, N = StepState.Next, B = StepState.Blocked;

    [Fact]
    public void AtTheStartOnlyThisPcIsNext()
    {
        var s = SetupWizard.Evaluate(new SetupProgress(), Inputs(facts: false));
        Assert.Equal([N, B, B, B, B], s.Select(x => x.State));
        Assert.Equal(Text.Of("Setup_Blocked_Waiting", 1).ToString(), s[1].Reason.ToString());
        Assert.Equal(SetupStep.ThisPc, SetupWizard.Current(s));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WithTheFactsTheBiosStepsAreNext()
    {
        var s = SetupWizard.Evaluate(new SetupProgress(), Inputs());
        Assert.Equal([D, N, B, B, B], s.Select(x => x.State));
        Assert.Equal("Setup_Blocked_Waiting(2)", s[2].Reason.ToString());
        Assert.True(SetupWizard.CanAct(s, SetupStep.Bios));
        Assert.False(SetupWizard.CanAct(s, SetupStep.BuildEfi));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ABlockingProblemStopsEverything()
    {
        var s = SetupWizard.Evaluate(new SetupProgress(), Inputs(blocking: Text.Of("Setup_Block_Card")));
        Assert.Equal([B, B, B, B, B], s.Select(x => x.State));
        Assert.Equal("Setup_Block_Card", s[0].Reason.Key);
        Assert.Equal("Setup_Blocked_Waiting(1)", s[4].Reason.ToString());
        Assert.False(SetupWizard.CanAct(s, SetupStep.ThisPc));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheWholeWay()
    {
        var p = new SetupProgress();
        p = SetupWizard.ConfirmBios(p, Now);
        Assert.Equal("2026-11-13T09:30:00", p.BiosConfirmed);
        Assert.Equal([D, D, N, B, B], States(p, Inputs()));

        p = SetupWizard.RecordEfi(p, "C:/b/1", "26", Now);
        Assert.Equal([D, D, D, N, B], States(p, Inputs()));

        p = SetupWizard.RecordStick(p, "C:/b/1/EFI", "C:/b/1/EFI/");
        Assert.Equal([D, D, D, D, N], States(p, Inputs()));

        p = SetupWizard.MarkAfterInstall(p, Now);
        var all = SetupWizard.Evaluate(p, Inputs());
        Assert.All(all, x => Assert.Equal(D, x.State));
        Assert.Equal(SetupStep.AfterInstall, SetupWizard.Current(all));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WithoutTheBuilderTheEfiStepSaysWhy()
    {
        var p = SetupWizard.ConfirmBios(new SetupProgress(), Now);
        var s = SetupWizard.Evaluate(p, Inputs(builder: false));
        Assert.Equal([D, D, B, B, B], s.Select(x => x.State));
        Assert.Equal("no builder folder", s[2].Reason.Verbatim);
        Assert.Equal("Setup_Blocked_Waiting(3)", s[3].Reason.ToString());
        Assert.False(SetupWizard.CanAct(s, SetupStep.BuildEfi));
        Assert.Equal("Setup_Blocked_NoBuilder", SetupWizard.Evaluate(p, new SetupInputs(true, [], false, Text.Empty, false))[2].Reason.Key);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ABuiltEfiThatIsGoneIsNotDone()
    {
        var p = SetupWizard.RecordEfi(SetupWizard.ConfirmBios(new SetupProgress(), Now), "C:/b/1", "26", Now);
        Assert.Equal([D, D, N, B, B], States(p, Inputs(efiExists: false)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AStickWithAnotherEfiDoesNotCount()
    {
        var p = SetupWizard.RecordEfi(SetupWizard.ConfirmBios(new SetupProgress(), Now), "C:/b/1", "26", Now);
        Assert.Same(p, SetupWizard.RecordStick(p, "D:/my/EFI", "C:/b/1/EFI"));
        Assert.Same(p, SetupWizard.RecordStick(p, null, "C:/b/1/EFI"));
        var fresh = new SetupProgress();
        Assert.Same(fresh, SetupWizard.RecordStick(fresh, "C:/b/1/EFI", "C:/b/1/EFI"));
        Assert.Equal(N, States(p, Inputs())[3]);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ANewEfiNeedsANewStick()
    {
        var p = SetupWizard.RecordEfi(SetupWizard.ConfirmBios(new SetupProgress(), Now), "C:/b/1", "26", Now);
        p = SetupWizard.RecordStick(p, "C:/b/1/EFI", "C:/b/1/EFI");
        Assert.Equal(D, States(p, Inputs())[3]);
        p = SetupWizard.RecordEfi(p, "C:/b/2", "15", Now.AddMinutes(5));
        Assert.Equal("", p.StickWith);
        Assert.Equal(N, States(p, Inputs())[3]);
        // a stick the user made another way stays made
        p = SetupWizard.MarkStickManual(p);
        p = SetupWizard.RecordEfi(p, "C:/b/3", "26", Now.AddMinutes(9));
        Assert.Equal(SetupWizard.Manual, p.StickWith);
        Assert.Equal(D, States(p, Inputs())[3]);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DoingAStepAgainUndoesTheLaterOnes()
    {
        var p = SetupWizard.MarkAfterInstall(SetupWizard.RecordStick(SetupWizard.RecordEfi(SetupWizard.ConfirmBios(new SetupProgress(), Now), "C:/b/1", "26", Now), "C:/b/1/EFI", "C:/b/1/EFI"), Now);
        var q = SetupWizard.Reopen(p, SetupStep.BuildEfi);
        Assert.Equal(p.BiosConfirmed, q.BiosConfirmed);
        Assert.Equal("", q.EfiBuilt);
        Assert.Equal("", q.EfiOutDir);
        Assert.Equal("", q.StickWith);
        Assert.Equal("", q.AfterInstallDone);
        Assert.Equal([D, D, N, B, B], States(q, Inputs()));
        Assert.Equal([D, N, B, B, B], States(SetupWizard.Reopen(p, SetupStep.ThisPc), Inputs()));
        Assert.Equal("C:/b/1", p.EfiOutDir);   // the old record is not changed
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheProgressSurvivesTheSettingsFile()
    {
        var p = SetupWizard.RecordEfi(SetupWizard.ConfirmBios(new SetupProgress(), Now), @"C:\Users\x\AppData\Local\IntelXe Manager\efibuild\builds\1", "26", Now);
        var back = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SetupProgress>(JsonSerializer.Serialize(p))!;
        Assert.Equal(p.EfiOutDir, back.EfiOutDir);
        Assert.Equal(p.BiosConfirmed, back.BiosConfirmed);
        Assert.Equal(States(p, Inputs()), States(back, Inputs()));
        // a settings file from before the wizard has no "Setup": the defaults
        Assert.Equal([D, N, B, B, B], States(JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SetupProgress>("{}")!, Inputs()));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void WhatBlocksTheInstall()
    {
        var b580 = new GpuInfo("Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics", new PciId(0x8086, 0xE20B));
        var good = new PcFacts { Gpus = [b580], CpuName = "Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K" };
        Assert.Empty(SetupWizard.Blocking(good, PcChecks.Evaluate(good)));

        var amd = new PcFacts { Gpus = [b580], CpuName = "AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor" };
        Assert.Equal(["Setup_Block_Cpu"], SetupWizard.Blocking(amd, PcChecks.Evaluate(amd)).Select(t => t.Key));

        var noCard = new PcFacts { Gpus = [new GpuInfo("Intel(R) UHD Graphics 770", new PciId(0x8086, 0xA780))], CpuName = "Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12400" };
        Assert.Equal(["Setup_Block_Card"], SetupWizard.Blocking(noCard, PcChecks.Evaluate(noCard)).Select(t => t.Key));

        // a CPU Windows did not name blocks nothing (the builder decides from its own report)
        var unknown = new PcFacts { Gpus = [b580] };
        Assert.Empty(SetupWizard.Blocking(unknown, PcChecks.Evaluate(unknown)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheWizardsTextsAreInBothTables()
    {
        foreach (var lang in new[] { "en-US", "tr-TR" })
        {
            var table = Localisation.ReswFile.Read(Paths.AppFile("Strings", lang, "Resources.resw"));
            Assert.All(SetupWizard.Keys, k => Assert.True(table.ContainsKey(k), k));
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ProblemsFirst()
    {
        var f = new PcFacts { Gpus = [new GpuInfo("B580", new PciId(0x8086, 0xE20B))], CpuName = "Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K",
            Firmware = FirmwareMode.Legacy, SecureBoot = SecureBootState.On };
        var checks = PcChecks.Evaluate(f);
        var ordered = SetupWizard.Ordered(checks);
        Assert.Equal(checks.Count, ordered.Count);
        Assert.Equal("firmware", ordered[0].Id);
        Assert.Equal(CheckState.Warning, ordered[1].State);
        Assert.Equal(ordered.Select(c => c.State == CheckState.Bad ? 0 : c.State == CheckState.Warning ? 1 : 2), ordered.Select(c => c.State == CheckState.Bad ? 0 : c.State == CheckState.Warning ? 1 : 2).Order());
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core.Tests/SniffTests.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The elevated helper's scan (Core/EfiBuild/SniffHelper.cs) with a fake Python: its command line, the folder rules, the
// engine check, and the ACPI tables: only DSDT, SSDT, APIC and DMAR stay; MSDM (the Windows product key), SLIC and the
// rest are deleted, also when the scan fails.
using System.Text;
using IntelXe.Core.EfiBuild;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class SniffTests
{
    static void Table(string dir, string name, string signature) =>
        FakeEngine.Write(Path.Combine(dir, name), signature + new string('\0', 32));

    /// What efibuild.py sniff leaves: Report.json and ACPI\ (a builder that kept too much, to show the helper's own check).
    static FakeRunner Sniffer(int code = 0, bool tables = true, bool msdm = true, string? error = null) => new((s, stdout, stderr, _) =>
    {
        Assert.Equal("sniff", s.Args[6]);
        var outDir = FakeRunner.Arg(s, "--out");
        stderr("== Hardware Sniffer");
        if (tables)
        {
            var acpi = Path.Combine(outDir, "ACPI");
            Table(acpi, "dsdt.dat", "DSDT");
            Table(acpi, "ssdt1.dat", "SSDT");
            Table(acpi, "apic.dat", "APIC");
            Table(acpi, "dmar.dat", "DMAR");
            if (msdm) { Table(acpi, "msdm.dat", "MSDM"); Table(acpi, "slic.dat", "SLIC"); Table(acpi, "facp.dat", "FACP"); }
        }
        if (code == 0) FakeEngine.Write(Path.Combine(outDir, "Report.json"), "{}");
        if (error is not null) stderr("error: " + error);
        stdout("report: " + Path.Combine(outDir, "Report.json"));
        return Task.FromResult(code);
    });

    [Fact]
    public void TheHelpersCommandLine()
    {
        var full = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "scan 1"));
        var q = new SniffRequest(full, Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "a.json"));
        Assert.Equal(["--efi-helper", "sniff", "--scan", full, "--out", q.Out!], q.ToArgs());
        Assert.True(SniffRequest.Is(q.ToArgs()));
        Assert.False(SniffRequest.Is(["--efi-helper", "status"]));
        Assert.Equal(q, SniffRequest.Parse(q.ToArgs()));
        Assert.Throws<EfiBuildException>(() => SniffRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "sniff", "--scan", "relative"]));
        Assert.Throws<EfiBuildException>(() => SniffRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "sniff"]));
        Assert.Throws<EfiBuildException>(() => SniffRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "sniff", "--scan", full, "--scan", full]));
        Assert.Throws<EfiBuildException>(() => SniffRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "sniff", "--scan", full, "--python", "x.exe"]));
        Assert.Throws<EfiBuildException>(() => SniffRequest.Parse(["--efi-helper", "sniff", "--scan"]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OnlyTheBuildsTablesStay()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var acpi = t.Sub("ACPI");
        Table(acpi, "DSDT.aml", "DSDT");
        Table(acpi, "ssdt2.aml", "SSDT");
        Table(acpi, "apic.aml", "APIC");
        Table(acpi, "dmar.aml", "DMAR");
        Table(acpi, "msdm.aml", "MSDM");
        Table(acpi, "ssdt-named-msdm.aml", "MSDM");   // by signature, not by name
        Table(acpi, "slic.aml", "SLIC");
        FakeEngine.Write(Path.Combine(acpi, "short.aml"), "DS");
        FakeEngine.Write(Path.Combine(acpi, "sub", "x.aml"), "DSDT");
        var (kept, removed) = AcpiTables.KeepOnlyBuildTables(acpi);
        Assert.Equal(["DSDT.aml", "apic.aml", "dmar.aml", "ssdt2.aml"], kept);
        Assert.Equal(5, removed.Count);
        Assert.Equal(kept.Order(), Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(acpi).Select(Path.GetFileName).Order());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AScan()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var e = FakeEngine.Make(t.Sub("engine"));
        var runner = Sniffer();
        var a = await SniffHelper.RunAsync(new SniffRequest(t.Sub("scans", "1")), e, runner, _ => false);
        Assert.True(a.Ok, a.Error);
        Assert.Equal(t.Sub("scans", "1", "Report.json"), a.Report);
        Assert.Equal(["apic.dat", "dmar.dat", "dsdt.dat", "ssdt1.dat"], a.Tables);
        Assert.Equal(["facp.dat", "msdm.dat", "slic.dat"], a.Removed.Order());
        Assert.False(File.Exists(t.Sub("scans", "1", "ACPI", "msdm.dat")));
        Assert.Contains("== Hardware Sniffer", a.Lines);
        var back = SniffAnswer.FromJson(a.ToJson());
        Assert.Equal(a.Tables, back.ToScan().Tables);
        Assert.Equal(a.Acpi, back.ToScan().AcpiDir);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AFailedScanLeavesNoOtherTable()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var e = FakeEngine.Make(t.Sub("engine"));
        var a = await SniffHelper.RunAsync(new SniffRequest(t.Sub("scan")), e, Sniffer(code: 1), _ => false);
        Assert.False(a.Ok);
        Assert.Contains("code 1", a.Error);
        Assert.False(File.Exists(t.Sub("scan", "ACPI", "msdm.dat")));
        Assert.True(File.Exists(t.Sub("scan", "ACPI", "dsdt.dat")));
        Assert.Throws<EfiBuildException>(() => a.ToScan());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task TheBuildersErrorLine()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var e = FakeEngine.Make(t.Sub("engine"));
        var a = await SniffHelper.RunAsync(new SniffRequest(t.Sub("scan")), e, Sniffer(code: 2, tables: false, error: "no DSDT in the ACPI dump (run as administrator)"), _ => false);
        Assert.Equal("no DSDT in the ACPI dump (run as administrator)", a.Error);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AScanWithoutADsdtFails()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var e = FakeEngine.Make(t.Sub("engine"));
        var runner = new FakeRunner((s, _, _, _) =>
        {
            var o = FakeRunner.Arg(s, "--out");
            FakeEngine.Write(Path.Combine(o, "Report.json"), "{}");
            Table(Path.Combine(o, "ACPI"), "msdm.dat", "MSDM");
            return Task.FromResult(0);
        });
        var a = await SniffHelper.RunAsync(new SniffRequest(t.Sub("scan")), e, runner, _ => false);
        Assert.False(a.Ok);
        Assert.Contains("no DSDT", a.Error);
        Assert.Empty(Directory.EnumerateFiles(t.Sub("scan", "ACPI")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task TheFolderRules()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var e = FakeEngine.Make(t.Sub("engine"));
        var runner = Sniffer();
        Directory.CreateDirectory(t.Sub("exists"));
        var a = await SniffHelper.RunAsync(new SniffRequest(t.Sub("exists")), e, runner, _ => false);
        Assert.Contains("exists already", a.Error);
        // a link anywhere above the new folder, existing or not yet
        a = await SniffHelper.RunAsync(new SniffRequest(t.Sub("new", "scan")), e, runner, d => d.FullName.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar) == t.Path);
        Assert.Contains("is a link", a.Error);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(t.Sub("linked"));
        a = await SniffHelper.RunAsync(new SniffRequest(t.Sub("linked", "scan")), e, runner, d => d.Name == "linked");
        Assert.Contains("is a link", a.Error);
        Assert.Empty(runner.Started);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AChangedEngineIsNotRunWithAdministratorRights()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var e = FakeEngine.Make(t.Sub("engine"));
        FakeEngine.Write(Path.Combine(e.EfiBuildDir, "intelxe_efibuild", "sniff.py"), "import os  # planted");
        var runner = Sniffer();
        var a = await SniffHelper.RunAsync(new SniffRequest(t.Sub("scan")), e, runner, _ => false);
        Assert.False(a.Ok);
        Assert.Contains("extra file efibuild/intelxe_efibuild/sniff.py", a.Error);
        Assert.Empty(runner.Started);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task TheBuildersScanGoesThroughTheElevatedHelper()
    {
        using var t = new TempDir();
        var e = FakeEngine.Make(t.Sub("engine"));
        SniffRequest? asked = null;
        var b = new PythonEfiBuilder(e, new FakeRunner((_, _, _, _) => Task.FromResult(0)), async (q, cancel) =>
        {
            asked = q;
            return await SniffHelper.RunAsync(q, e, Sniffer(), _ => false, cancel);
        });
        var progress = new ListProgress();
        var scan = await b.ScanAsync(t.Sub("scan"), progress, CancellationToken.None);
        Assert.Equal(t.Sub("scan"), asked!.ScanDir);
        Assert.Equal(t.Sub("scan", "ACPI"), scan.AcpiDir);
        Assert.Equal(4, scan.Tables.Count);
        Assert.Equal(["Hardware Sniffer"], progress.Lines);

        var failing = new PythonEfiBuilder(e, new FakeRunner((_, _, _, _) => Task.FromResult(0)),
            (_, _) => Task.FromResult(new SniffAnswer { Ok = false, Error = "the scan was not allowed" }));
        Assert.Equal("the scan was not allowed",
            (await Assert.ThrowsAsync<EfiBuildException>(() => failing.ScanAsync(t.Sub("scan2"), progress, CancellationToken.None))).Message);
    }
}

FILE: windows/app/IntelXe.Core.Tests/StickTests.cs

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The stick writer with Windows faked: the disks, and erasing (a temporary folder stands in for the new FAT32
// partition). The refusal tests use a system whose EraseAndFormat fails the test if it is ever called.
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using IntelXe.Core.Stick;

namespace IntelXe.Core.Tests;

public class StickTests
{
    const string Salt = "00112233445566778899AABBCCDDEEFF";

    static StickDisk Usb(uint n = 3, ulong size = 16_008_609_792, string serial = "4C530001230000123456", bool? removable = true,
        IReadOnlyList<StickPartition>? parts = null, int bus = StickRules.UsbBus, string file = "") => new()
    {
        Number = n, FriendlyName = "SanDisk Ultra", Size = size, BusType = bus, Removable = removable, IdentitySource = serial,
        PartitionStyle = "MBR", Partitions = parts ?? [new StickPartition(1, "", 0x0C, "E:", "FAT32", false)], VirtualFile = file,
    };

    static StickDisk Nvme(uint n, bool boot) => new()
    {
        Number = n, FriendlyName = "WD_BLACK SN850X 2000GB", Size = 2_000_398_934_016, BusType = 17, IsBoot = boot, IsSystem = boot,
        Removable = false, IdentitySource = "E823_8FA6_BF53_0001_001B_448B_4A1E_0000.", PartitionStyle = "GPT",
        Partitions = boot
            ? [new StickPartition(1, "{c12a7328-f81f-11d2-ba4b-00a0c93ec93b}", 0, "", "FAT32", false),
               new StickPartition(2, "{e3c9e316-0b5c-4db8-817d-f92df00215ae}", 0, "", "", false),
               new StickPartition(3, "{ebd0a0a2-b9e5-4433-87c0-68b6b72699c7}", 0, "C:", "NTFS", true)]
            : [new StickPartition(1, "{c12a7328-f81f-11d2-ba4b-00a0c93ec93b}", 0, "", "FAT32", false),
               new StickPartition(2, "{7c3457ef-0000-11aa-aa11-00306543ecac}", 0, "", "", false)],
    };

    static readonly StickPolicy Policy = new(StickRules.MinimumFor(960_530_321));

    // ---- the rules ----

    [Fact]
    public void AnEmptyUsbStickIsAllowed() => Assert.Empty(StickRules.Refusals(Usb(), Policy));

    [Fact]
    public void RefusesTheInternalDisks()
    {
        var boot = StickRules.Refusals(Nvme(0, true), Policy);
        Assert.Contains(boot, r => r.StartsWith("not a USB disk (bus: NVMe)"));
        Assert.Contains("Windows booted from it (boot disk)", boot);
        Assert.Contains(boot, r => r.Contains("system (EFI) partition"));
        Assert.Contains("not a removable disk", boot);
        Assert.Contains("partition 3 holds Windows", boot);
        var mac = StickRules.Refusals(Nvme(1, false), Policy);
        Assert.Contains("partition 2 is an APFS container (macOS)", mac);
        Assert.False(StickRules.Listed(Nvme(0, true), Policy));
        Assert.False(StickRules.Listed(Nvme(1, false), Policy));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("fixed")]
    [InlineData("unknown")]
    [InlineData("readonly")]
    [InlineData("offline")]
    [InlineData("small")]
    [InlineData("windows")]
    [InlineData("linux")]
    [InlineData("noserial")]
    [InlineData("protected")]
    public void RefusesUsbDisksThatMustNotBeErased(string what)
    {
        var d = what switch
        {
            "fixed" => Usb(removable: false),
            "unknown" => Usb(removable: null),
            "readonly" => new StickDisk { Number = 3, FriendlyName = "x", Size = 16_000_000_000, BusType = 7, Removable = true, IsReadOnly = true, IdentitySource = "s" },
            "offline" => new StickDisk { Number = 3, FriendlyName = "x", Size = 16_000_000_000, BusType = 7, Removable = true, IsOffline = true, IdentitySource = "s" },
            "small" => Usb(size: 1_000_000_000),
            "windows" => Usb(parts: [new StickPartition(1, "", 7, "F:", "NTFS", true)]),
            "linux" => Usb(parts: [new StickPartition(1, "{4f68bce3-e8cd-4db1-96e7-fbcaf984b709}", 0, "", "", false)]),
            "noserial" => Usb(serial: " "),
            _ => Usb(),
        };
        var policy = what == "protected" ? Policy with { ProtectedLetters = ["E:"] } : Policy;
        Assert.NotEmpty(StickRules.Refusals(d, policy));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AVhdxCountsOnlyWhenNamedOnTheCommandLine()
    {
        var vhdx = Usb(bus: StickRules.FileBackedVirtualBus, removable: false, file: Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "stick-test.vhdx"));
        Assert.False(StickRules.Listed(vhdx, Policy));
        Assert.Contains(StickRules.Refusals(vhdx, Policy), r => r.StartsWith("not a USB disk"));
        var test = Policy with { TestVirtualFile = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "STICK-TEST.vhdx") };
        Assert.True(StickRules.Listed(vhdx, test));
        Assert.Empty(StickRules.Refusals(vhdx, test));
        // another file, or a disk that is not file-backed, is not the test disk
        Assert.NotEmpty(StickRules.Refusals(vhdx, Policy with { TestVirtualFile = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "other.vhdx") }));
        Assert.NotEmpty(StickRules.Refusals(Nvme(1, false), test));
        Assert.NotEmpty(StickRules.Refusals(Usb(bus: 17, removable: false, file: test.TestVirtualFile!), test));
        // the switch does not lift the other rules
        var bootVhdx = new StickDisk { Number = 5, FriendlyName = "v", Size = 2UL << 30, BusType = 15, VirtualFile = test.TestVirtualFile!, IsBoot = true, IdentitySource = "x" };
        Assert.Contains("Windows booted from it (boot disk)", StickRules.Refusals(bootVhdx, test));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheIdentityNeverShowsTheSerial()
    {
        var d = Usb();
        Assert.DoesNotContain("4C530001230000123456", d.ToString());
        Assert.DoesNotContain("4C530001230000123456", d.Token(Salt));
        Assert.Equal(d.Token(Salt), Usb().Token(Salt));
        Assert.NotEqual(d.Token(Salt), Usb(serial: "4C530001230000123457").Token(Salt));
        Assert.NotEqual(d.Token(Salt), Usb(size: 16_008_609_793).Token(Salt));
        Assert.NotEqual(d.Token(Salt), d.Token(StickIdentity.NewSalt()));
        Assert.Equal("SanDisk Ultra 16.0 GB", d.ConfirmText);
        var list = StickWriter.List(new FakeSystem([Nvme(0, true), Usb()]), Policy, Salt);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("4C530001230000123456", list.ToJson());
        Assert.Single(list.Disks!);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(16_008_609_792UL, "16.0 GB")]
    [InlineData(2_147_483_648UL, "2.1 GB")]
    [InlineData(512_000_000UL, "512 MB")]
    public void SizeText(ulong bytes, string text) => Assert.Equal(text, StickRules.SizeText(bytes));

    // ---- the helper's command line ----

    [Fact]
    public void TheCommandLineRoundTrips()
    {
        var q = new StickHelperRequest(StickVerb.Write, 3, "AB", Salt, 16_008_609_792, @"C:\cache\tahoe", @"D:\EFI", @"C:\t\stick-test.vhdx", Out: @"C:\o.json", Progress: @"C:\p.txt");
        var back = StickHelperRequest.Parse(q.ToArgs());
        Assert.Equal(q, back);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(q.ToArgs(), a => a.Contains("4C53", StringComparison.Ordinal));
        Assert.Equal(StickVerb.List, StickHelperRequest.Parse(["--stick-helper", "list", "--salt", Salt, "--out", "x"]).Verb);
        Assert.Equal("tahoe", StickHelperRequest.Parse(["--stick-helper", "download", "--version", "tahoe", "--image", "d"]).Version);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("--stick-helper")]
    [InlineData("--stick-helper erase --disk 3")]
    [InlineData("--stick-helper write --disk 3 --size 1 --image x")]                 // no identity
    [InlineData("--stick-helper write --disk x --id a --salt b --size 1 --image x")]
    [InlineData("--stick-helper write --disk 3 --id a --salt b --size 1")]          // no image
    [InlineData("--stick-helper write --disk 3 --disk 4 --id a --salt b --size 1 --image x")]
    [InlineData("--stick-helper write --disk 3 --id a --salt b --size 1 --image x --force yes")]
    [InlineData("--stick-helper download --version tahoe")]
    public void RefusesBadCommandLines(string line) =>
        Assert.Throws<StickException>(() => StickHelperRequest.Parse(line.Split(' ')));

    // ---- the writer ----

    sealed class FakeSystem(List<StickDisk> disks, string? root = null) : IStickSystem
    {
        public int Erased;
        public Func<StickDisk, StickDisk>? OnSecondLook;
        int looks;
        public IReadOnlyList<StickDisk> ListDisks() => disks;
        public StickDisk? Inspect(uint number)
        {
            var d = disks.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Number == number);
            if (d is not null && ++looks == 2 && OnSecondLook is not null) d = OnSecondLook(d);
            return d;
        }
        public string EraseAndFormat(StickDisk disk, ulong partitionSize, string label)
        {
            Assert.NotNull(root);   // a refusal test must never get here
            Erased++;
            Assert.Equal("MACOS", label);
            Assert.True(partitionSize <= StickRules.MaxPartition);
            foreach (var e in Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(root!)) { if (Directory.Exists(e)) Directory.Delete(e, true); else File.Delete(e); }
            return root!;
        }
    }

    sealed class Workspace : IDisposable
    {
        public readonly string Dir = Directory.CreateTempSubdirectory("ixe-stick-").FullName;
        public string Image => Path.Combine(Dir, "cache");
        public string Root => Path.Combine(Dir, "stick");
        public string Efi => Path.Combine(Dir, "myefi", "EFI");
        public readonly RSA Key = RSA.Create(2048);
        public byte[] ImageBytes = new byte[200_000];

        public Workspace()
        {
            new Random(3).NextBytes(ImageBytes);
            var boot = Path.Combine(Image, RecoveryFiles.BootFolder);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(boot);
            File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(boot, "BaseSystem.dmg"), ImageBytes);
            File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(boot, "BaseSystem.chunklist"), Chunklist.Build(ImageBytes, 65536, Key));
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(Image, RecoveryFiles.Marker), "{\"image\":\"BaseSystem.dmg\",\"chunklist\":\"BaseSystem.chunklist\",\"product\":\"000-00000\"}");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Root);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(Efi, "BOOT"));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(Efi, "OC", "Kexts", "Lilu.kext"));
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(Efi, "BOOT", "BOOTx64.efi"), "boot");
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(Efi, "OC", "OpenCore.efi"), "oc");
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(Efi, "OC", "config.plist"), "<plist/>");
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(Efi, "OC", "Kexts", "Lilu.kext", "Info.plist"), "<plist/>");
        }

        public RSAParameters Public => Key.ExportParameters(false);
        public void Dispose() { Key.Dispose(); Directory.Delete(Dir, true); }
    }

    static StickHelperRequest Write(StickDisk d, Workspace w, bool efi = true, StickVerb verb = StickVerb.Write) =>
        new(verb, d.Number, d.Token(Salt), Salt, d.Size, w.Image, efi ? Path.GetDirectoryName(w.Efi) : null);

    [Fact]
    public void WritesTheStickAndReadsItBack()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        var d = Usb();
        var sys = new FakeSystem([Nvme(0, true), d], w.Root);
        var stages = new List<string>();
        var r = StickWriter.Run(Write(d, w), sys, (s, _) => stages.Add(s), key: w.Public);
        Assert.True(r.Ok, r.Error);
        Assert.True(r.Written);
        Assert.Equal(1, sys.Erased);
        Assert.Equal(w.ImageBytes, File.ReadAllBytes(Path.Combine(w.Root, "com.apple.recovery.boot", "BaseSystem.dmg")));
        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(w.Root, "com.apple.recovery.boot", "BaseSystem.chunklist")));
        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(w.Root, "EFI", "OC", "Kexts", "Lilu.kext", "Info.plist")));
        Assert.Contains(r.Lines, l => l.StartsWith("read back: the image on the stick matches"));
        Assert.Contains(r.Lines, l => l == "read back: 4 EFI files match");
        Assert.Equal("done", stages[^1]);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AnEfiStickIsErasedOnlyOnceConfirmed()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        var d = Usb(parts: [new StickPartition(1, "{c12a7328-f81f-11d2-ba4b-00a0c93ec93b}", 0, "", "FAT32", false)]);
        var refused = StickWriter.Run(Write(d, w), new FakeSystem([d]), key: w.Public);
        Assert.False(refused.Ok);
        Assert.False(refused.Written);
        Assert.Contains("holds an EFI", refused.Error);
        var sys = new FakeSystem([d], w.Root);
        var r = StickWriter.Run(Write(d, w) with { EraseEfi = true }, sys, key: w.Public);
        Assert.True(r.Ok, r.Error);
        Assert.Equal(1, sys.Erased);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ACheckWritesNothing()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        var d = Usb();
        var r = StickWriter.Run(Write(d, w, verb: StickVerb.Check), new FakeSystem([d]), key: w.Public);
        Assert.True(r.Ok, r.Error);
        Assert.False(r.Written);
        Assert.Contains("check only: nothing written", r.Lines);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RefusesTheBootDiskBeforeAnyWrite()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        foreach (var disk in new[] { Nvme(0, true), Nvme(1, false) })
        {
            // even with a matching identity, as if the user had picked it
            var r = StickWriter.Run(Write(disk, w), new FakeSystem([disk]), key: w.Public);
            Assert.False(r.Ok);
            Assert.False(r.Written);
            Assert.NotEmpty(r.Refusals!);
            Assert.Contains("nothing written", r.Error);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RefusesAnotherDiskAtTheSameNumber()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        var chosen = Usb();
        var swapped = Usb(serial: "OTHER-STICK");
        var r = StickWriter.Run(Write(chosen, w), new FakeSystem([swapped]), key: w.Public);
        Assert.False(r.Ok);
        Assert.False(r.Written);
        Assert.Contains("not the disk that was chosen", r.Error);
        var resized = Usb(size: 32_000_000_000);
        Assert.False(StickWriter.Run(Write(chosen, w), new FakeSystem([resized]), key: w.Public).Ok);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LooksAgainRightBeforeErasing()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        var d = Usb();
        // the stick is pulled and another one put in between the check and the erase
        var sys = new FakeSystem([d]) { OnSecondLook = _ => Usb(serial: "SWAPPED") };
        var r = StickWriter.Run(Write(d, w), sys, key: w.Public);
        Assert.False(r.Ok);
        Assert.False(r.Written);
        Assert.Contains("not the disk that was chosen", r.Error);
        // or it became a disk that holds Windows
        var sys2 = new FakeSystem([d]) { OnSecondLook = x => Usb(parts: [new StickPartition(1, "", 7, "F:", "NTFS", true)]) };
        var r2 = StickWriter.Run(Write(d, w), sys2, key: w.Public);
        Assert.False(r2.Written);
        Assert.NotEmpty(r2.Refusals!);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RefusesAChangedImageBeforeErasing()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        var d = Usb();
        var bytes = (byte[])w.ImageBytes.Clone();
        bytes[100] ^= 1;
        File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(w.Image, "com.apple.recovery.boot", "BaseSystem.dmg"), bytes);
        var r = StickWriter.Run(Write(d, w), new FakeSystem([d]), key: w.Public);
        Assert.False(r.Ok);
        Assert.False(r.Written);
        Assert.Contains("chunk 1", r.Error);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void RefusesAFolderThatIsNotAnEfi()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        File.Delete(Path.Combine(w.Efi, "OC", "OpenCore.efi"));
        var d = Usb();
        var r = StickWriter.Run(Write(d, w), new FakeSystem([d]), key: w.Public);
        Assert.False(r.Ok);
        Assert.False(r.Written);
        Assert.Contains("not an OpenCore EFI folder", r.Error);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task TheFolderSourceFindsTheEfi()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        Assert.Equal(w.Efi, await new FolderEfiSource(Path.GetDirectoryName(w.Efi)!).PrepareAsync());
        Assert.Equal(w.Efi, await new FolderEfiSource(w.Efi).PrepareAsync());
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<EfiSourceException>(() => new FolderEfiSource(w.Image).PrepareAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TheVhdxTestSwitchIsCarriedToTheRules()
    {
        using var w = new Workspace();
        var file = Path.Combine(w.Dir, "stick-test.vhdx");
        var vhdx = Usb(bus: StickRules.FileBackedVirtualBus, removable: false, file: file);
        var without = StickWriter.Run(Write(vhdx, w, efi: false), new FakeSystem([vhdx]), key: w.Public);
        Assert.False(without.Written);
        var with = StickWriter.Run(Write(vhdx, w, efi: false) with { TestVhdx = file }, new FakeSystem([vhdx], w.Root), key: w.Public);
        Assert.True(with.Ok, with.Error);
    }
}

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# make.sh: remakes this folder's fixtures for ProbeDownloadTests (macOS: release/signing.swift uses CryptoKit).
#   - xe-probe-stick-0.1.0.img.zip: a 2 MiB image with the stick's layout (an MBR, a FAT32 boot sector labelled XEPROBE,
#     a pattern), zipped by tools/probe-stick/zip-image.py as release/package.sh zips the real one;
#   - intel-gpu-macos-driver-0.1.5.sha256: a release's list of hashes (shasum -a 256 lines) naming it, and its
#     .sha256.sig, signed by a key made here (test-key.txt holds its public key; the private key is thrown away);
#   - releases.json, releases-none.json: GitHub's answer to GET /repos/OWNER/REPO/releases, in the API's shape, for
#     releases with and without the image (a pre-release and a draft that have one must be passed over).
set -eu
HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
R=$(cd "$HERE/../../../../.." && pwd)
T=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
python3 -I - "$T/xe-probe-stick-0.1.0.img" <<'PY'
import hashlib, os, struct, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
b = bytearray(2 << 20)
b[446] = 0x80; b[446 + 4] = 0x0C
struct.pack_into("<II", b, 446 + 8, 2048, len(b) // 512 - 2048)
b[510:512] = b"\x55\xaa"
bs = 2048 * 512
b[bs:bs + 3] = b"\xeb\x58\x90"
struct.pack_into("<H", b, bs + 11, 512)
b[bs + 71:bs + 82] = b"XEPROBE    "
b[bs + 82:bs + 90] = b"FAT32   "
b[bs + 510:bs + 512] = b"\x55\xaa"
for i in range(bs + 4096, len(b), 4096): b[i:i + 16] = hashlib.sha256(str(i).encode()).digest()[:16]
open(p, "wb").write(b)
open(p + ".sha256", "w").write(hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() + "  " + os.path.basename(p) + "\n")
PY
python3 -I "$R/tools/probe-stick/zip-image.py" zip "$T/xe-probe-stick-0.1.0.img" "$HERE" --version 0.1.0
N=intel-gpu-macos-driver-0.1.5
for f in "$N-tahoe.zip" "$N-sequoia.zip" "$N-efi.zip"; do printf '%s\n' "$f" > "$T/$f"; done
(cd "$T" && shasum -a 256 "$N-tahoe.zip" "$N-sequoia.zip" "$N-efi.zip") > "$HERE/$N.sha256"
(cd "$HERE" && shasum -a 256 xe-probe-stick-0.1.0.img.zip) >> "$HERE/$N.sha256"

    }
def release(tag, names, draft=False, pre=False, rid=0):

        "url": f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/releases/{rid}", "assets_url": f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/releases/{rid}/assets",

        "assets": [asset(tag, x) for x in names],
        "tarball_url": f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/tarball/{tag}", "zipball_url": f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/zipball/{tag}",
        "body": "notes",

def pkg(v, probe=None):
    N = f"intel-gpu-macos-driver-{v}"

FILE: windows/efibuild/intelxe_efibuild/__init__.py

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""intelxe_efibuild: builds an OpenCore EFI from a Hardware Sniffer report without questions.

It runs OpCore Simplify (BSD-3-Clause, fetched at the commit in upstream/PINNED.json) with every question answered by
a recorded rule (answers.py), downloads only what downloads.lock.json pins, applies stage 2 of the install guide from
release/templates/efi-rules.json (rules.py) and checks the result with ocvalidate from the pinned OpenCore release
(validate.py). docs/design/DESIGN-efi-build.md describes it.
"""

FORMAT_VERSION = 1



================================================
FILE: windows/efibuild/intelxe_efibuild/__main__.py
================================================
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Command line of the EFI builder.

  efibuild.py build --report Report.json --acpi ACPI_DIR --out OUT_DIR [--macos 26|15] [--iasl PATH]
                    [--smbios MODEL] [--no-safari] [--log build-log.txt] [--result result.json]
      Build an OpenCore EFI into OUT_DIR/EFI (OUT_DIR must be empty or an earlier build's), apply stage 2 and check it
      with ocvalidate. Exit 0 only when every step passed; the result JSON says what was decided and why.
  efibuild.py validate --efi OUT_DIR [--report Report.json] [--after-stage4]
      ocvalidate (from the pinned OpenCore release) and the stage-2/stage-4 checks on an existing build.
  efibuild.py upstream --fetch | --manifest NAME
      Fetch and check the pinned OpCore Simplify and Hardware Sniffer, or (maintainer) write a manifest.
  efibuild.py lock --report ... --acpi ... --out ... (maintainer)
      Run a build that resolves what OpCore Simplify would download today and records it in downloads.lock.json.
  efibuild.py vectors
      Run the stage-2 and Safari vectors of release/efi-rules-vectors.json through rules.py.
  efibuild.py sniff --out DIR  (Windows, administrator)
      Run the pinned Hardware Sniffer with the pinned acpidump.exe: DIR/Report.json and DIR/ACPI/ for a build.
"""
import argparse
import json
import sys

from . import pins
from . import upstream


def _cmd_upstream(args):
    if args.manifest:
        digest, count = upstream.write_manifest(args.manifest, args.cache)
        print("{}: {} files, manifest_sha256 {}".format(args.manifest, count, digest))
        return 0
    for name in upstream.pinned():
        print("{}: {}".format(name, upstream.verify(name, upstream.fetch(name, args.cache))))
    return 0


def _cmd_build(args, lock_mode=False):
    from . import engine  # noqa: PLC0415 - imports the rest only for a build
    policy = engine.Policy(macos=args.macos, smbios=args.smbios, safari=not args.no_safari)
    result = engine.build(args.report, args.acpi, args.out, policy=policy, iasl=args.iasl, cache_root=args.cache,
                          log_path=args.log, lock_mode=lock_mode, echo=sys.stderr if args.verbose else None)
    if args.result:
        with open(args.result, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(result, f, indent=2)
    print("")
    print("result: {}".format("ok" if result["ok"] else "FAILED: " + result.get("error", "")))
    return 0 if result["ok"] else 1


def _cmd_validate(args):
    from . import validate  # noqa: PLC0415
    report_json = None
    if args.report:
        with open(args.report, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            report_json = json.load(f)
    report = validate.validate(args.efi, cache_root=args.cache, report=report_json, after_stage4=args.after_stage4)
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
    return 0 if report["ok"] else 1


def _cmd_sniff(args):
    from . import sniff  # noqa: PLC0415
    try:
        report, acpi, kept = sniff.sniff(args.out, args.cache)
    except sniff.SniffError as e:
        print("error: {}".format(e), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print("report: {}\nacpi: {} ({})".format(report, acpi, ", ".join(kept)))
    return 0


def _cmd_vectors(args):
    from . import rules  # noqa: PLC0415
    failures, count = rules.run_vectors()
    for f in failures:
        print("FAIL " + f)
    print("{} of {} stage-2/Safari vectors pass".format(count - len(failures), count))
    return 1 if failures else 0


def main(argv=None):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="efibuild.py", description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    p.add_argument("--cache", help="download cache (default: %%LOCALAPPDATA%%\\IntelXe\\efibuild or ~/.cache/intelxe-efibuild)")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    for name in ("build", "lock"):
        b = sub.add_parser(name)
        b.add_argument("--report", required=True, help="Hardware Sniffer Report.json")
        b.add_argument("--acpi", required=True, help="folder of ACPI tables (acpidump -b output: dsdt.dat, ssdt*.dat or .aml)")
        b.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="output folder; EFI/ is written inside it")
        b.add_argument("--macos", default="26", choices=("26", "15"), help="macOS 26 Tahoe (default) or 15 Sequoia")
        b.add_argument("--smbios", default=None, help="Mac model (default: the rule in policy.py)")
        b.add_argument("--no-safari", action="store_true", help="leave Misc > Security > SecureBootModel as built")
        b.add_argument("--iasl", default=None, help="iasl to disassemble the tables (Windows default: the pinned ACPICA iasl.exe)")
        b.add_argument("--log", default=None, help="build log (default: OUT/build-log.txt)")
        b.add_argument("--result", default=None, help="write the result as JSON here")
        b.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true", help="show OpCore Simplify's output and the answers as they come")

    v = sub.add_parser("validate")
    v.add_argument("--efi", required=True, help="a build's output folder (holding EFI/OC/config.plist)")
    v.add_argument("--report", help="the Report.json it was built from (enables the card and CPU checks)")
    v.add_argument("--after-stage4", action="store_true", help="the EFI after stage 4 was made in it (tests)")

    u = sub.add_parser("upstream")
    g = u.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    g.add_argument("--fetch", action="store_true")
    g.add_argument("--manifest", choices=("OpCore-Simplify", "Hardware-Sniffer"))

    sub.add_parser("vectors")

    sn = sub.add_parser("sniff")
    sn.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="folder for Report.json and ACPI/ (Windows, as administrator)")

    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.cmd == "upstream":
            return _cmd_upstream(args)
        if args.cmd == "build":
            return _cmd_build(args)
        if args.cmd == "lock":
            return _cmd_build(args, lock_mode=True)
        if args.cmd == "validate":
            return _cmd_validate(args)
        if args.cmd == "vectors":
            return _cmd_vectors(args)
        if args.cmd == "sniff":
            return _cmd_sniff(args)
    except pins.PinError as e:
        print("error: {}".format(e), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return 2



================================================
FILE: windows/efibuild/intelxe_efibuild/answers.py
================================================
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""The answers to OpCore Simplify's questions, one rule per question.

OpCore Simplify is a console program: every question goes through Utils.request_input. The engine replaces that function
with Answerer.ask, which looks the question up here by the screen it is on (the title of the last Utils.head) and the
prompt's text. A rule gives the answer and the reason, and both are recorded in the build log. A question that no rule
matches, or one asked again after it was answered (the program refused the answer), stops the build: guessing is how an
EFI ends up booting to a black screen. "Press Enter" prompts are notices; they are answered only on the screens where a
notice is expected, and a notice on any other screen (a failed download, tables that could not be read) stops the build.

Each rule is (id, screen regex, prompt regex, function). The function gets the Answerer and returns (answer, why), or
raises Stop. The table at the end is what docs/design/DESIGN-efi-build.md lists.
"""
import re

ANSI = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]")


class Stop(RuntimeError):
    """A build that cannot go on: an unanswered question, a refused answer, a rule that says no."""


def clean(text):
    return ANSI.sub("", text or "")


# ---- the main menu ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main_menu(a):
    """1 (read the report, which asks the rest), then 5 when the Mac model is not the policy's, then 6 (build); after
    the build the engine is done. The menu prints the chosen macOS and SMBIOS above it; both are checked."""
    text = a.context
    if not a.state.get("report_selected"):
        a.state["report_selected"] = True
        return "1", "select the hardware report; the program then asks for the macOS version, GPUs, kexts and tables"
    if a.state.get("built"):
        raise a.Done()
    macos = re.search(r"macOS Version:\s+(.+?)\s+\((\d+)\.\d+\.\d+\)", text)
    smbios = re.search(r"SMBIOS:\s+(\S+)", text)
    if not macos or macos.group(2) != a.policy.darwin:
        raise Stop("OpCore Simplify chose {} instead of {}".format(macos.group(1) if macos else "no macOS", a.policy.macos_name))
    if "Requires OpenCore Legacy Patcher" in text:
        raise Stop("this PC needs OpenCore Legacy Patcher root patches for {} (OpCore Simplify says so on its main menu). "
                   "The driver's stage 2 relaxes SIP and AMFI only as far as it needs; a system patched by OpenCore Legacy "
                   "Patcher is not a configuration it is tested with.".format(a.policy.macos_name))
    if smbios and smbios.group(1) != a.policy.smbios and not a.state.get("smbios_done"):
        a.state["smbios_done"] = True
        a.facts["smbios_offered"] = smbios.group(1)
        return "5", "OpCore Simplify chose {}; the policy's Mac model is {}".format(smbios.group(1), a.policy.smbios)
    if smbios and smbios.group(1) != a.policy.smbios:
        raise Stop("the Mac model is still {} after choosing {}".format(smbios.group(1), a.policy.smbios))
    a.state["build_started"] = True
    a.facts["smbios"] = smbios.group(1) if smbios else ""
    return "6", "build the EFI: macOS {}, {}".format(macos.group(1), smbios.group(1) if smbios else "?")


def report_path(a):
    if a.state.get("report_given"):
        raise Stop("OpCore Simplify did not accept the report:\n" + a.context[-2000:])
    a.state["report_given"] = True
    return a.inputs["report"], "the Hardware Sniffer report given to the builder"


def acpi_path(a):
    if a.state.get("acpi_given"):
        raise Stop("OpCore Simplify could not read the ACPI tables (it asks for them again):\n" + "\n".join(a.notices[-2:])[-2000:])
    a.state["acpi_given"] = True
    return a.inputs["acpi"], "the ACPI tables dumped with the report"


def macos_version(a):
    """The policy's macOS (26 by default, 15 on request), only when OpCore Simplify lists it without OCLP."""
    offered = {}
    for n, name, oclp in re.findall(r"^\s*(\d+)\. (macOS [^\n(]+?)\s*(\(Requires OpenCore Legacy Patcher\))?\s*$", a.context, re.M):
        offered[n] = (name, bool(oclp))
    want = a.policy.darwin
    if want not in offered:
        raise Stop("OpCore Simplify does not offer {} for this PC (it offers {}).".format(
            a.policy.macos_name, ", ".join(v[0] for v in offered.values()) or "nothing"))
    if offered[want][1]:
        raise Stop("{} needs OpenCore Legacy Patcher on this PC, which this builder does not do.".format(a.policy.macos_name))
    return want, "{} (Darwin {}): the policy's macOS{}".format(a.policy.macos_name, want,
                                                             "" if a.policy.macos == "26" else ", chosen instead of the default 26")


def build_for_uefi(a):
    return "yes", "OpenCore is built for UEFI boot; the firmware must boot in UEFI mode with CSM off (install guide, stage 1)"


def gpu_combination(a):
    """The combination that is exactly the supported Arc card(s): the installer runs on the card's firmware output, and
    an integrated GPU is turned off for macOS (the test machine ran without one)."""
    cards = set(a.facts.get("cards", []))
    choices = {}
    for n, line in re.findall(r"^(\d+)\. (.+)$", a.context, re.M):
        choices[n] = set(x.strip() for x in line.split(" + "))
    pick = [n for n, devices in choices.items() if devices == cards]
    if len(pick) != 1:
        raise Stop("no GPU combination of exactly {} among:\n{}".format(", ".join(sorted(cards)), a.context[-1500:]))
    others = sorted(set().union(*choices.values()) - cards)
    return pick[0], "{} alone{}".format(" + ".join(sorted(cards)), "; turned off for macOS: " + ", ".join(others) if others else "")


def first_device(a):
    """Wi-Fi or Bluetooth: macOS works best with one; the first one Hardware Sniffer listed."""
    kind = re.match(r"Select a (.+?) device", a.prompt).group(1)
    first = re.search(r"^1\. (.+)$", a.context, re.M)
    return "1", "the first {} device listed ({}); the others are turned off for macOS".format(kind, first.group(1).strip() if first else "?")


def tahoe_audio(a):
    if not re.search(r"^1\. AppleALC \+ SimpleHDA", a.context, re.M):
        raise Stop("the audio menu changed:\n" + a.context[-800:])
    return "1", "AppleALC + SimpleHDA: audio without OpenCore Legacy Patcher root patches (option 2 needs them)"


def broadcom_wifi(a):
    if not re.search(r"^1\. SimpleBCM", a.context, re.M):
        raise Stop("the Broadcom Wi-Fi menu changed:\n" + a.context[-800:])
    return "1", "SimpleBCM: native Wi-Fi without root patches (IOSkywalkFamily needs OpenCore Legacy Patcher)"


def intel_wifi(a):
    """The kext that needs no OCLP root patch: the laobamac AirportItlwm fork where it is offered, else itlwm.
    Plain AirportItlwm needs root patches on macOS 15 and later."""
    for name, why in (("laobamac AirportItlwm", "native Wi-Fi on macOS 15.2+ and 26 without root patches"),
                      ("itlwm", "no root patches (Wi-Fi through the HeliPort app)")):
        m = re.search(r"^(\d+)\. {}\b".format(re.escape(name)), a.context, re.M)
        if m:
            return m.group(1), "{}: {}".format(name, why)
    raise Stop("the Intel Wi-Fi menu lists neither the laobamac AirportItlwm nor itlwm:\n" + a.context[-800:])


def amd_gpu_kext(a):
    return "", "the default kext OpCore Simplify recommends for this AMD GPU"


def force_load(a):
    return "no", "kexts are not forced onto a macOS they do not support"


def codec_layout(a):
    m = re.search(r"default: (\d+)", a.prompt)
    return "", "the default layout{}".format(" ({})".format(m.group(1)) if m else "")


def wifi_profiles(a):
    return "no", "saved Wi-Fi passwords are never copied into the EFI"


def oclp_warning(a):
    raise Stop("OpCore Simplify says this PC needs OpenCore Legacy Patcher for {}; this builder does not build such an "
               "EFI (the driver is tested on an unpatched system).".format(a.policy.macos_name))


def smbios_menu(a):
    """Pick the policy's Mac model in OpCore Simplify's SMBIOS list: show all models when it is not among the
    compatible ones (a MacBookPro model on a desktop), select it, then go back."""
    want = a.policy.smbios
    rows = re.findall(r"^\[(\*| )\]\s*(\d+)\.\s+(\S+)", a.context, re.M)
    for mark, n, name in rows:
        if name == want:
            if mark == "*":
                return "b", "{} is selected".format(want)
            return n, "{}: {}".format(want, a.policy.smbios_why)
    if re.search(r"^A\. Show all models", a.context, re.M) and not a.state.get("smbios_all"):
        a.state["smbios_all"] = True
        return "a", "{} is not in the list of compatible models; show all".format(want)
    raise Stop("OpCore Simplify does not list the Mac model {}".format(want))


def notice(a):
    return "", "notice"


def stop_notice(why):
    def rule(a):
        raise Stop(why + ":\n" + a.context[-2000:])
    return rule


def result_screen(a):
    a.state["built"] = True
    return "", "the EFI is built"


# (id, screen, prompt, rule). Screens are the titles OpCore Simplify prints with Utils.head; first match wins.
RULES = [
    ("main-menu", r"^OpCore Simplify$", r"^Select an option:", main_menu),

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Maintainer tool: fill downloads.lock.json from a build ("efibuild.py lock ...").

In lock mode OpCore Simplify resolves its downloads itself, as it would without the builder (Dortania's build list,
GitHub release pages, the URLs in its datasets), and the builder pins what the build actually used:

- a product that OpCore Simplify takes from Dortania's nightly build list is pinned to the newest GitHub release of
  the same repository instead (acidanthera/Lilu 1.7.x rather than a build of Lilu's latest commit), with the SHA-256
  GitHub publishes for the asset; OpenCorePkg likewise, so ocvalidate and macserial come from an OpenCore release;
- a file fetched from a branch (OcBinaryData's master.zip, patch lists on refs/heads) is pinned to the branch's
  current commit;
- every pinned file is downloaded once and its SHA-256 compared (or, where GitHub publishes none, recorded);
- ocvalidate and macserial for Windows, macOS and Linux are pinned by their SHA-256 inside the OpenCorePkg zip.

A normal build then uses only the lock. Review the diff of downloads.lock.json before committing it.
"""
import io
import json
import os
import re
import zipfile

from . import pins

DORTANIA = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dortania/build-repo/builds/latest.json"
API = "https://api.github.com/repos/"
TOOLS = {
    "ocvalidate": {"Darwin": "Utilities/ocvalidate/ocvalidate", "Windows": "Utilities/ocvalidate/ocvalidate.exe",
                   "Linux": "Utilities/ocvalidate/ocvalidate.linux"},
    "macserial": {"Darwin": "Utilities/macserial/macserial", "Windows": "Utilities/macserial/macserial.exe",
                  "Linux": "Utilities/macserial/macserial.linux"},
}

_dortania = None


def _api(path):
    headers = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
    token = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("GH_TOKEN")
    if token:
        headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + token
    return json.loads(pins.http_get(API + path, headers=headers))


def _dortania_repo(name):
    global _dortania
    if _dortania is None:
        _dortania = json.loads(pins.http_get(DORTANIA))
    try:
        url = _dortania[name]["versions"][0]["commit"]["url"]
    except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError):
        return None
    m = re.match(r"https://github\.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/commit/", url)
    return (m.group(1), m.group(2)) if m else None


def _latest_release_asset(owner, repo):
    rel = _api("{}/{}/releases/latest".format(owner, repo))
    zips = [a for a in rel.get("assets", []) if a["name"].endswith(".zip")]
    pick = [a for a in zips if "RELEASE" in a["name"].upper()] or [a for a in zips if "DEBUG" not in a["name"].upper()]
    if len(pick) != 1:
        return None
    a = pick[0]
    digest = (a.get("digest") or "").partition("sha256:")[2] or None
    return {"url": a["browser_download_url"], "sha256": digest, "version": rel["tag_name"], "id": str(a["id"]),
            "source": "github release {}/{} {}".format(owner, repo, rel["tag_name"])}


def resolve_products(products):
    """OpCore Simplify's products, with Dortania nightlies swapped for the repository's latest release."""
    out = {}
    for name, p in products.items():
        p = dict(p)
        if "dortania/build-repo" in (p.get("url") or ""):
            repo = _dortania_repo(name)
            rel = _latest_release_asset(*repo) if repo else None
            if rel:
                p.update(rel)
            else:
                p["source"] = "dortania build " + p.get("url", "")
        else:
            p.setdefault("source", "as OpCore Simplify resolves it")
        out[name] = p
    return out


def _branch_head(owner, repo, branch):
    return _api("{}/{}/commits/{}".format(owner, repo, branch))["sha"]


def pin_file(lock, url):
    """Pin a branch URL to the branch's current commit; None for URLs that are not files on a branch."""
    m = re.match(r"https://github\.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/archive/refs/heads/([^/]+)\.zip$", url)
    if m:
        owner, repo, branch = m.groups()
        sha = _branch_head(owner, repo, branch)
        pinned = "https://github.com/{}/{}/archive/{}.zip".format(owner, repo, sha)
        data = pins.http_get(pinned)
        entry = {"url": pinned, "sha256": pins.sha256_bytes(data), "commit": sha, "top_folder": "{}-{}".format(repo, branch),
                 "source": "{}/{} {} at {}".format(owner, repo, branch, sha)}
        lock.files[url] = entry
        return entry["url"], entry["sha256"], entry
    m = (re.match(r"https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/refs/heads/([^/]+)/(.+)$", url) or
         re.match(r"https://github\.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/raw/refs/heads/([^/]+)/(.+)$", url))
    if m:
        owner, repo, branch, path = m.groups()
        sha = _branch_head(owner, repo, branch)
        pinned = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{}/{}/{}/{}".format(owner, repo, sha, path)
        data = pins.http_get(pinned)
        entry = {"url": pinned, "sha256": pins.sha256_bytes(data), "commit": sha,
                 "source": "{}/{} {} at {}".format(owner, repo, branch, sha)}
        lock.files[url] = entry
        return entry["url"], entry["sha256"], entry
    return None


def pin_download(lock, used, url, cache):
    """A product download in lock mode: fetched, checked against the SHA-256 its source gives (if any), kept in the
    cache by digest and written into the lock. OpenCorePkg also pins its tools, which the same build needs."""
    name, p = next(((n, q) for n, q in used.items() if q.get("url") == url), (None, None))
    if name is None:
        return None
    data = pins.http_get(url)
    got = pins.sha256_bytes(data)
    if p.get("sha256") and p["sha256"].lower() != got:
        raise pins.PinError("{}: {} has SHA-256 {}, its source says {}".format(name, url, got, p["sha256"]))
    with open(cache.path(got), "wb") as f:
        f.write(data)
    entry = {"url": url, "sha256": got, "id": str(p.get("id", "")), "source": p.get("source", ""),
             "sha256_from": "the source" if p.get("sha256") else "computed when pinned"}
    if p.get("version"):
        entry["version"] = p["version"]
    lock.products[name] = entry
    if name == "OpenCorePkg":
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as z:
            for tool, members in TOOLS.items():
                lock.tools[tool] = {os_name: {"member": m, "sha256": pins.sha256_bytes(z.read(m))}
                                    for os_name, m in members.items()}
    return url, got, entry


def record(lock, used, cache):
    """Keep only the products this build used (and the lock's earlier ones), and write the lock."""
    missing = [n for n in used if n not in lock.products]
    if missing:
        raise pins.PinError("used but not downloaded, so not pinned: " + ", ".join(missing))
    lock.save()

FILE: windows/efibuild/intelxe_efibuild/pins.py
================================================
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Pinned downloads: every file the build fetches is named in downloads.lock.json with its SHA-256.

A download goes to the cache under its SHA-256 and is used only when its bytes have that digest, each time it is read.
A URL that the lock does not name is refused: the build never fetches "the latest" of anything.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import ssl
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))   # windows/efibuild
LOCK_PATH = os.path.join(HERE, "downloads.lock.json")
PINNED_PATH = os.path.join(HERE, "upstream", "PINNED.json")
USER_AGENT = "intelxe-efibuild"
TIMEOUT = 60


class PinError(RuntimeError):
    """A download that is not pinned, or whose bytes do not match the pin."""


def sha256_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def sha256_bytes(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def load_json(path):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def default_cache():
    """%LOCALAPPDATA%\\IntelXe\\efibuild on Windows, ~/.cache/intelxe-efibuild elsewhere; INTELXE_EFIBUILD_CACHE wins."""
    if os.environ.get("INTELXE_EFIBUILD_CACHE"):
        return os.environ["INTELXE_EFIBUILD_CACHE"]
    if os.name == "nt" and os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA"):
        return os.path.join(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"], "IntelXe", "efibuild")
    return os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".cache", "intelxe-efibuild")


def _ssl_context():
    context = ssl.create_default_context()
    try:
        import certifi  # optional: the embedded Python on Windows carries it
        context.load_verify_locations(cafile=certifi.where())
    except ImportError:
        pass
    return context


def http_get(url, timeout=TIMEOUT, tries=4, headers=None):
    """The body of an https URL, retried on network errors. Only https is accepted."""
    if not url.startswith("https://"):
        raise PinError("only https downloads are allowed: " + url)
    last = None
    for attempt in range(tries):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=dict({"User-Agent": USER_AGENT}, **(headers or {})))
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout, context=_ssl_context()) as r:
                return r.read()
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ConnectionError, OSError) as e:
            if isinstance(e, urllib.error.HTTPError) and e.code in (403, 404, 410):
                raise PinError("{} answered {}".format(url, e.code)) from e
            last = e
            time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
    raise PinError("could not download {}: {}".format(url, last))


class Cache:
    """Files by SHA-256 under <root>/sha256/<digest>."""

    def __init__(self, root=None):
        self.root = root or default_cache()
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(self.root, "sha256"), exist_ok=True)

    def path(self, digest):
        return os.path.join(self.root, "sha256", digest.lower())

    def fetch(self, url, digest):
        """A local path holding the bytes of url, checked against digest (now, not only when downloaded)."""
        if not (isinstance(digest, str) and len(digest) == 64):
            raise PinError("no SHA-256 pinned for " + url)
        digest = digest.lower()
        path = self.path(digest)
        if os.path.isfile(path) and not os.path.islink(path) and sha256_file(path) == digest:
            return path
        data = http_get(url)
        got = sha256_bytes(data)
        if got != digest:
            raise PinError("{}: SHA-256 {} is not the pinned {}".format(url, got, digest))
        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=os.path.dirname(path))
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as f:
            f.write(data)
        os.replace(tmp, path)
        return path

    def read(self, url, digest):
        path = self.fetch(url, digest)
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            data = f.read()
        if sha256_bytes(data) != digest.lower():
            raise PinError("the cached copy of {} changed".format(url))
        return data


class Lock:
    """downloads.lock.json: products (what OpCore Simplify downloads by product name), files (other URLs it fetches,
    mapped to pinned URLs) and tools (ocvalidate and macserial inside the pinned OpenCorePkg zip)."""

    def __init__(self, path=LOCK_PATH):
        self.path = path
        self.data = load_json(path) if os.path.exists(path) else {
            "SPDX-License-Identifier": "MIT", "format": "intelxe-efibuild-lock", "format_version": 1,
            "products": {}, "files": {}, "tools": {}}
        if self.data.get("format") != "intelxe-efibuild-lock" or self.data.get("format_version") != 1:
            raise PinError("{} is not an intelxe-efibuild-lock version 1".format(path))

    @property
    def products(self):
        return self.data["products"]

    @property
    def files(self):
        return self.data["files"]

    @property
    def tools(self):
        return self.data["tools"]

    def pin_for_url(self, url):
        """(url, sha256, entry) to fetch for a URL the engine asks for, or None when it is not pinned."""
        for entry in self.products.values():
            if entry.get("url") == url:
                return entry["url"], entry["sha256"], entry
        entry = self.files.get(url)
        if entry:
            return entry["url"], entry["sha256"], entry
        for entry in self.files.values():
            if entry.get("url") == url:
                return entry["url"], entry["sha256"], entry
        return None

    def save(self):
        self.data["products"] = dict(sorted(self.products.items()))
        self.data["files"] = dict(sorted(self.files.items()))
        order = ("SPDX-License-Identifier", "format", "format_version", "about", "products", "files", "tools", "windows_tools")
        self.data = dict(sorted(self.data.items(), key=lambda kv: order.index(kv[0]) if kv[0] in order else len(order)))
        with open(self.path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
            json.dump(self.data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
            f.write("\n")


def copy_verified(src, dst, digest):
    shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
    if sha256_file(dst) != digest.lower():
        os.remove(dst)
        raise PinError("copy of {} does not match its pin".format(os.path.basename(src)))

FILE: windows/efibuild/intelxe_efibuild/policy.py
================================================
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""The install guide's own rules for the EFI OpCore Simplify built, before stage 2 (rules.py) is applied.

Stage 1 of release/README-INSTALL.md (site/guide/macos.html) installs macOS with a plain OpenCore EFI on the card's
firmware output, as on the test machine (efi/sample-z790/README.md, "For the macOS installer"):

- nothing GPU-specific for the card (no IntelXe.kext, SSDT-ARCOFF.aml, DeviceProperties or WhateverGreen): the engine
  keeps the card away from OpCore Simplify's GPU handling, validate.py checks the result;
- ResizeAppleGpuBars = 10 and ReconnectGraphicsOnConnect = false: stage 2 of the rules sets both;
- CpuTopologyRebuild.kext off and its ctrsmt= boot-arg removed for the install, as the test machine installed macOS
  (with -v it warns of random boot failures, and the test machine saw them); after the setup assistant it goes back on
  with ctrsmt=off (the notes say so);
- OpenCore records the EFI it booted from (Misc > Security > ExposeSensitiveData bit 0, the rules' boot_path), so that
  efi.sh and IntelXe Manager find this EFI for stages 2 to 4 on macOS.

Each change is returned with its reason for the build log.
"""
import plistlib
import re


NVRAM = "7C436110-AB2A-4BBB-A880-FE41995C9F82"


def apply(config_path, report, facts, policy, rules):
    with open(config_path, "rb") as f:
        config = plistlib.load(f)
    changes = []

    def change(what, why):
        changes.append({"step": "stage 1 (install guide)", "change": what, "why": why})

    # CpuTopologyRebuild: off for the install, as on the test machine
    for k in (config.get("Kernel") or {}).get("Add") or []:
        if k.get("BundlePath") == "CpuTopologyRebuild.kext" and k.get("Enabled"):
            k["Enabled"] = False
            change("Kernel > Add: CpuTopologyRebuild.kext off",
                   "the test machine installed macOS without it; it warns of random boot failures with -v (efi/sample-z790/README.md)")
    if not any(k.get("BundlePath") == "CpuTopologyRebuild.kext" and k.get("Enabled") for k in (config.get("Kernel") or {}).get("Add") or []):
        for p in (config.get("Kernel") or {}).get("Patch") or []:
            if str(p.get("Comment", "")).startswith("force HT enabled") and p.get("Enabled"):
                p["Enabled"] = False
                change("Kernel > Patch: '{}' off".format(p["Comment"]),
                       "OpCore Simplify adds it with CpuTopologyRebuild (its patches_ht.plist); the test machine has neither")
    args = ((config.get("NVRAM") or {}).get("Add") or {}).get(NVRAM, {}).get("boot-args")
    if isinstance(args, str) and re.search(r"(^| )ctrsmt=\S*", args):
        new = " ".join(a for a in args.split() if not a.startswith("ctrsmt="))
        config["NVRAM"]["Add"][NVRAM]["boot-args"] = new
        change("boot-args: ctrsmt= removed ('{}' -> '{}')".format(args, new), "it belongs to CpuTopologyRebuild, which is off for the install")

    # OpenCore records which EFI it booted from
    sec = (config.get("Misc") or {}).get("Security")
    bits = int(rules["boot_path"]["bits"], 0)
    if isinstance(sec, dict):
        cur = sec.get("ExposeSensitiveData")
        if isinstance(cur, int) and not isinstance(cur, bool) and cur & bits != bits:
            sec["ExposeSensitiveData"] = cur | bits
            change("Misc > Security > ExposeSensitiveData: {} -> {}".format(cur, cur | bits),
                   "OpenCore then records the EFI it booted from; efi.sh and IntelXe Manager use it in stages 2 to 4")

    with open(config_path, "wb") as f:
        plistlib.dump(config, f, sort_keys=False)
    return changes


def firmware_steps(report, facts):
    """The firmware settings the guide asks for (stage 1, step 1), and the ones this report adds."""
    steps = ["Above 4G Decoding: on", "Resizable BAR: on (the build sets ResizeAppleGpuBars = 10 for it)",
             "CSM: off (UEFI boot only)", "Secure Boot: off"]
    if facts.get("igpus"):
        steps.append("Integrated graphics ({}): off, or at least not the primary display; the monitor goes on the "
                     "Arc card's DisplayPort".format(", ".join(facts["igpus"])))
    else:
        steps.append("Primary display: the PCIe card; the monitor goes on the Arc card's DisplayPort")
    if (report.get("BIOS") or {}).get("Firmware Type") not in (None, "UEFI"):
        steps.append("Boot mode: UEFI (the report says {})".format(report["BIOS"]["Firmware Type"]))
    return steps


def after_install_notes(config_path):
    notes = ["After the setup assistant: stage 3 (install the driver on macOS), then stage 4 (IntelXe.kext, "
             "SSDT-ARCOFF.aml and, on a 12th-14th gen hybrid CPU, HybridPM.kext) with IntelXe Manager or efi.sh, "
             "before the next restart (release/README-INSTALL.md)."]
    with open(config_path, "rb") as f:
        config = plistlib.load(f)
    kexts = [k.get("BundlePath") for k in (config.get("Kernel") or {}).get("Add") or []]
    if "CpuTopologyRebuild.kext" in kexts:
        notes.append("Then CpuTopologyRebuild.kext back on with the boot-arg ctrsmt=off, and -v removed, as on the "
                     "test machine (efi/sample-z790/README.md).")
    if "UTBDefault.kext" in kexts:
        notes.append("USB: UTBDefault.kext is a stand-in; map the ports (USBToolBox on Windows) and replace it with "
                     "your UTBMap.kext.")
    return notes

FILE: windows/efibuild/intelxe_efibuild/rules.py
