# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
<#
.SYNOPSIS
Test-EfiVectors.ps1 [-Vectors FILE]: the shared test vectors of the EFI rules (release\efi-rules-vectors.json; the
format is in docs\design\DESIGN-efi-rules.md section 5) against windows\IntelXe-EFI.ps1: its rules loader
(ConvertFrom-Json, Get-EfiRules) and its engine, in this PowerShell, in a throwaway folder.

.DESCRIPTION
For each vector: the package and the EFI folder it describes, config.plist as stage 1 leaves it with the vector's
edits, the facts as Windows gives them (the card's Location path, which the user confirms, when its instance id is one
of the rules' cards; the CPU's name; the boot path is never recorded on Windows, but a vector may say it is), then the
status values it lists (-Status), the plan's steps and notes, the change made with the plan's hash, the values, files,
list of changes and status values it must leave, and undo back to the state before. Then each CPU name (HybridCpu) and each PCI device (IsCardInstance).
release/test-efi-vectors.sh runs the same vectors against efi.sh on macOS. Test-IntelXe-EFI.ps1 runs this script.
Needs nothing that only Windows has: it also runs in PowerShell 7 on macOS.

  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows\test\Test-EfiVectors.ps1      (Windows PowerShell 5.1)
  pwsh -File windows\test\Test-EfiVectors.ps1                                    (PowerShell 7)
#>
param([string]$Vectors = '')

$Here = $PSScriptRoot
$Repo = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $Here)
$ToolPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $Here) 'IntelXe-EFI.ps1'
if ($Vectors -eq '') { $Vectors = Join-Path (Join-Path $Repo 'release') 'efi-rules-vectors.json' }
$VectorsPath = $Vectors

# Dot-sourcing defines the tool's parameters here too ($Plan, $Efi, $Package, ...): this script uses none of those names.
. $ToolPath   # the engine, Get-EfiRules, ConvertTo-RulesTree, New-EfiFolder; dot-sourced, its command line does not run
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$script:fails = 0
$script:count = 0
function Check([bool]$ok, [string]$what) {
    if ($ok) { Write-Host "ok    $what" } else { Write-Host "FAIL  $what"; $script:fails++ }
}
function Key($d, [string]$k) { if ($null -ne $d -and $d.ContainsKey($k)) { return , $d[$k] } return $null }   # the value itself
function Items($d, [string]$k) { if ($null -ne $d -and $d.ContainsKey($k)) { return $d[$k] } }               # a list's items, one by one
function Count($l) { if ($null -eq $l) { return 0 } return $l.Count }
function Native([string]$rel) { return [IntelXeEfi.Util]::Native($rel) }
function Oc([string]$dir, [string]$rel) { return Join-Path (Join-Path (Join-Path $dir 'EFI') 'OC') (Native $rel) }
# The status values a vector lists ({"key": "value"}) that the engine's Status() gives otherwise, as " key=got;".
function Get-StatusDiff($want, $f) {
    if ($null -eq $want) { return '' }
    $got = @{}
    foreach ($l in $f.Status()) { $i = $l.IndexOf('='); if ($i -gt 0) { $got[$l.Substring(0, $i)] = $l.Substring($i + 1) } }
    $why = ''
    foreach ($k in $want.Keys) { if ([string]$got[$k] -cne [string]$want[$k]) { $why += " $k=$($got[$k]);" } }
    return $why
}
function Get-HexBytes([string]$hex) {
    $b = New-Object byte[] ($hex.Length / 2)
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $b.Length; $i++) { $b[$i] = [Convert]::ToByte($hex.Substring(2 * $i, 2), 16) }
    return , $b
}

# A value of the vectors' JSON as a config.plist value of the type it names.
function Get-PValue([string]$type, $value) {
    switch ($type) {
        'integer' { return [IntelXeEfi.PValue]::Int([long]$value) }
        'bool' { return [IntelXeEfi.PValue]::Bool([bool]$value) }
        'string' { return [IntelXeEfi.PValue]::Str([string]$value) }
        'data' { return [IntelXeEfi.PValue]::Data([Convert]::FromBase64String([string]$value)) }
        'dict' { return [IntelXeEfi.Rules]::Value($value) }
    }
    throw "vectors: no value type $type"
}
# one edit (a step, or remove) on a loaded config.plist
function Invoke-Edit($pl, $e) {
    [string[]]$path = ([string]$e['path']).Split('.')
    switch ($e['op']) {
        'set' { $pl.Set($path, (Get-PValue $e['type'] $e['value'])) }
        'remove' { $pl.Remove($path) }
        'append' { $pl.Append($path, (Get-PValue $e['type'] $e['value'])) }
        'insert' { $pl.Insert($path, [int]$e['index'], (Get-PValue $e['type'] $e['value'])) }
        default { throw "vectors: no edit $($e['op'])" }
    }
}

# A fixture: the file it describes at DIR\EFI\OC\<its file> (a stand-in kext, a table, a folder, a copy of the package's)
function New-Fixture([string]$dir, $fx, [string]$pkg) {
    $rel = [string]$fx['file']
    if ($rel -eq 'SHA256SUMS') { return }   # the package's sums: Write-Sums, last
    $d = Oc $dir $rel
    [IntelXeEfi.Util]::Delete($d)
    $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Split-Path -Parent $d))
    switch ($fx['type']) {
        'kext' {
            $exe = Join-Path $d (Native $fx['executable'])
            $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Split-Path -Parent $exe))
            [IO.File]::WriteAllText($exe, [string]$fx['text'] + "`n")
            $keys = ''
            if ($fx['bundle_id'] -ne '') { $keys += "`t<key>CFBundleIdentifier</key>`n`t<string>$($fx['bundle_id'])</string>`n" }
            if ($fx['version'] -ne '') { $keys += "`t<key>CFBundleVersion</key>`n`t<string>$($fx['version'])</string>`n" }
            [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path (Join-Path $d 'Contents') 'Info.plist'), "<?xml version=`"1.0`" encoding=`"UTF-8`"?>`n<plist version=`"1.0`">`n<dict>`n$keys</dict>`n</plist>`n")
        }
        'table' { [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($d, (Get-HexBytes $script:tables[$fx['table']])) }
        'dir' { $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Join-Path (Join-Path $d 'Contents') 'MacOS')) }
        'package' {
            [IntelXeEfi.Util]::CopyTree((Oc $pkg $rel), $d)
            $more = Key $fx 'append'
            if ($null -ne $more) { foreach ($x in [IO.Directory]::GetFiles((Join-Path (Join-Path $d 'Contents') 'MacOS'))) { [IO.File]::AppendAllText($x, [string]$more + "`n") } }
        }
        'none' { }
        default { throw "vectors: no fixture type $($fx['type'])" }
    }
}
function Write-Sums([string]$dir) {
    $lines = @()
    $efi = Join-Path $dir 'EFI'
    $files = @([IO.Directory]::GetFiles($efi, '*', [IO.SearchOption]::AllDirectories) | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring($dir.Length + 1).Replace('\', '/') } | Sort-Object -CaseSensitive)
    foreach ($rel in $files) { $lines += [IntelXeEfi.Util]::Sha256File((Join-Path $dir (Native $rel))) + '  ' + $rel }
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $dir 'SHA256SUMS'), ($lines -join "`n") + "`n")
}
# Every file under DIR but config.plist, with its SHA-256: two trees hold the same when these are the same.
function Get-Tree([string]$dir) {
    $out = @()
    foreach ($f in @([IO.Directory]::GetFiles($dir, '*', [IO.SearchOption]::AllDirectories))) {
        if ([IO.Path]::GetFileName($f) -eq 'config.plist') { continue }
        $out += $f.Substring($dir.Length).Replace('\', '/') + ' ' + [IntelXeEfi.Util]::Sha256File($f)
    }
    return ((@($out | Sort-Object -CaseSensitive)) -join "`n")
}

# A plan's step in the vectors' form, and any tree as one comparable string (keys sorted).
function Get-ValueTree($v) {
    switch ($v.Type) {
        'dict' {
            $d = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary[string,object]'
            foreach ($kv in $v.Entries) { $d.Add($kv.Key, (Get-ValueTree $kv.Value)) }
            return , $d
        }
        'bool' { return ($v.Text -eq 'true') }
        'integer' { return [long]$v.Text }
        default { return $v.Text }
    }
}
function ConvertFrom-Op($op) {
    $d = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary[string,object]'
    $d.Add('op', $op.Kind)
    switch ($op.Kind) {
        'copy' { $d.Add('to', $op.Rel); $d.Add('from', $(if ($null -ne $op.Bytes) { 'adapted' } else { 'package' })) }
        { $_ -eq 'set' -or $_ -eq 'append' -or $_ -eq 'insert' } {
            $d.Add('path', ($op.Path -join '.'))
            if ($op.Kind -eq 'insert') { $d.Add('index', [long]$op.Index) }
            $d.Add('type', $op.Value.Type)
            $d.Add('value', (Get-ValueTree $op.Value))
        }
        { $_ -eq 'mkdict' -or $_ -eq 'mkarray' } { $d.Add('path', ($op.Path -join '.')) }
    }
    return , $d
}
function Get-Canon($v) {
    if ($null -eq $v) { return 'null' }
    if ($v -is [string]) { return 's"' + $v.Replace('\', '\\').Replace('"', '\"') + '"' }
    if ($v -is [bool]) { return 'b' + $v }
    if ($v -is [long] -or $v -is [int]) { return 'i' + $v }
    if ($v -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) {
        $keys = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[string]'
        foreach ($k in $v.Keys) { $keys.Add([string]$k) }
        $keys.Sort([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
        $parts = @()
        foreach ($k in $keys) { $parts += (Get-Canon $k) + '=' + (Get-Canon $v[$k]) }
        return '{' + ($parts -join ',') + '}'
    }
    if ($v -is [System.Collections.IList]) {
        $parts = @()
        foreach ($x in $v) { $parts += Get-Canon $x }
        return '[' + ($parts -join ',') + ']'
    }
    throw "vectors: cannot compare a $($v.GetType().Name)"
}

# The facts as Windows gives them: a PCI device's instance id, and the card's Location path in Device Manager (the
# port's ACPI names, then one PCI part per level down to the GPU; "none": the port is a PCI part too)
function Get-InstanceId([string]$pci) {
    $p = $pci.Split(':')
    return "PCI\VEN_$($p[0].ToUpperInvariant())&DEV_$($p[1].ToUpperInvariant())&SUBSYS_00000000&REV_00\4&0&0&0008"
}
function Get-LocationPath([string]$port, [long]$levels) {
    $parts = @()
    $pci = $levels
    if ($port -eq 'none') { $parts = @('ACPI(_SB_)', 'ACPI(PC00)'); $pci = $levels + 1 }
    else { foreach ($s in $port.TrimStart('\').Split('.')) { $parts += "ACPI($($s.PadRight(4, '_')))" } }
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $pci; $i++) { $parts += 'PCI(0000)' }
    return $parts -join '#'
}

$Tmp = [IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
$Root = Join-Path $Tmp ('ixevec-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8))
$quiet = [Action[string]] { param($line) }
try {
    $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($Root)
    $rules = Get-EfiRules
    $levels = $rules.Int('cards.port_levels_above_gpu')
    $vt = (ConvertTo-RulesTree ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($VectorsPath, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8) | ConvertFrom-Json) 'vectors').PSObject.BaseObject
    if ($vt['format'] -ne 'intelxe-efi-rules-vectors' -or $vt['format_version'] -ne 1) { throw "$VectorsPath is not intelxe-efi-rules-vectors 1" }
    Write-Host "== $($PSVersionTable.PSEdition) PowerShell $($PSVersionTable.PSVersion); $VectorsPath; the rules $($rules.Source)"
    $script:tables = $vt['tables']

    # the package every vector starts from, and config.plist as stage 1 leaves it
    $P0 = Join-Path $Root 'pkg0'
    foreach ($fx in $vt['package']) { New-Fixture $P0 $fx '' }
    $stage1 = [IntelXeEfi.Plist]::Load((Join-Path $Repo (Native $vt['config'])))
    foreach ($e in $vt['stage1']) { Invoke-Edit $stage1 $e }
    $stage1Bytes = $stage1.ToBytes()

    $n = 0
    foreach ($V in $vt['vectors']) {
        $n++
        $name = $V['name']
        $W = Join-Path $Root ('v' + $n)
        $P = Join-Path $W 'pkg'
        $F = Join-Path $W 'efi'
        $Bk = Join-Path $W 'backups'
        $Cfg = Oc $F 'config.plist'
        foreach ($d in 'Kexts', 'ACPI') { $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Oc $F $d)) }
        $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory((Join-Path (Join-Path $F 'EFI') 'BOOT'))
        [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Oc $F 'OpenCore.efi'), [byte[]]@())
        [IntelXeEfi.Util]::CopyTree($P0, $P)
        $sums = $true
        foreach ($fx in (Items $V 'package')) {
            if ($fx['file'] -eq 'SHA256SUMS' -and $fx['type'] -eq 'none') { $sums = $false }
            New-Fixture $P $fx ''
        }
        if ($sums) { Write-Sums $P }
        $pl = [IntelXeEfi.Plist]::Parse($stage1Bytes, 'stage 1')
        foreach ($e in (Items $V 'edits')) { Invoke-Edit $pl $e }
        [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($Cfg, $pl.ToBytes())
        foreach ($fx in (Items $V 'efi')) { New-Fixture $F $fx $P }
        $before = [IntelXeEfi.Plist]::Canonical([IntelXeEfi.Plist]::Load($Cfg).Root)
        $beforeTree = Get-Tree $F

        # the facts
        $facts = $V['facts']
        $card = Key $facts 'card'
        $loc = ''
        $detected = ''
        if ($null -ne $card -and $rules.IsCardInstance((Get-InstanceId $card['pci']))) {
            $loc = Get-LocationPath $card['port'] $levels                         # what Device Manager shows
            $detected = [IntelXeEfi.EfiFolder]::ConvertLocationPath($loc, $levels)   # "Read from Windows"
        }
        $kind = $V['plan']
        function Open-Efi { $f = New-EfiFolder $F $P $Bk $loc $detected ([string]$facts['cpu']); $f.BootPathRecorded = [bool]$facts['boot_path_recorded']; $f.ProbeDevice = [string](Key $facts 'probe_device'); return $f }
        $script:count++
        $x = $V['expect']

        # the status values before
        if ($null -ne (Key $x 'status')) {
            $why = Get-StatusDiff (Key $x 'status') (Open-Efi)
            Check ($why -eq '') "$($name): the status before$(if ($why -ne '') { ':' + $why })"
        }

        # the plan: its steps and notes
        $made = (Open-Efi).MakePlan($kind)
        $got = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
        foreach ($op in $made.Ops) { $got.Add((ConvertFrom-Op $op)) }
        $same = (Get-Canon $got) -ceq (Get-Canon $x['ops'])
        Check $same "$($name): the plan's $(Count $x['ops']) steps"
        if (-not $same) { Write-Host "      the script: $(Get-Canon $got)"; Write-Host "      the vector: $(Get-Canon $x['ops'])"; Write-Host "      $($made.Text.Replace("`n", "`n      "))" }
        $notes = @($made.Notes)
        $want = @($x['notes'])
        $good = $notes.Count -eq (Count $x['notes'])
        for ($i = 0; $good -and $i -lt $notes.Count; $i++) { if (-not $notes[$i].Contains([string]$want[$i])) { $good = $false } }
        Check $good "$($name): the $(Count $x['notes']) note(s)"
        if (-not $good) { foreach ($l in $notes) { Write-Host "        $l" } }

        # make it, and what it must leave
        if ((Count $x['ops']) -eq 0) { continue }
        try { (Open-Efi).Run($kind, $made.Hash, $quiet) } catch { Check $false "$($name): the change failed: $(Get-ErrorText $_)"; continue }
        $why = ''
        $after = Key $x 'after'
        $done = [IntelXeEfi.Plist]::Load($Cfg)
        foreach ($a in (Items $after 'config')) {
            [string[]]$path = ([string]$a['path']).Split('.')
            $e = $done.Get($path)
            if ($null -ne (Key $a 'absent')) { if ($null -ne $e) { $why += " $($a['path']) is there;" } }
            else {
                $raw = [IntelXeEfi.Plist]::Raw($e)
                $wantRaw = (Get-PValue $a['type'] $a['value']).Raw
                if ($raw -cne $wantRaw) { $why += " $($a['path'])=$raw;" }
            }
        }
        foreach ($a in (Items $after 'files')) {
            $file = Oc $F $a['file']
            $state = Key $a 'state'
            if ($state -eq 'package') {
                $src = Oc $P $a['file']
                $same = if ([IO.Directory]::Exists($src)) { [IO.Directory]::Exists($file) -and (Get-Tree $src) -ceq (Get-Tree $file) } else { [IntelXeEfi.Util]::SameFile($src, $file) }
                if (-not $same) { $why += " $($a['file']) is not the package's;" }
            }
            elseif ($state -eq 'absent') { if ([IntelXeEfi.Util]::Exists($file)) { $why += " $($a['file']) is there;" } }
            elseif ($null -ne (Key $a 'sha256')) { if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($file) -or [IntelXeEfi.Util]::Sha256File($file) -ne $a['sha256']) { $why += " $($a['file'])'s SHA-256;" } }
            elseif ($null -ne (Key $a 'table')) { if (-not [IntelXeEfi.Util]::SameBytes([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file), (Get-HexBytes $script:tables[$a['table']]))) { $why += " $($a['file']) is not $($a['table']);" } }
        }
        if ((Count (Key $after 'changed')) -gt 0) {
            $b = (Open-Efi).LastBackup()
            $list = ''
            if ($null -ne $b) { $list = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $b 'changed')).TrimEnd("`n").Replace("`n", ' ') }
            if ($list -cne (@($after['changed']) -join ' ')) { $why += " the backup lists $list;" }
        }
        $s = Get-StatusDiff (Key $after 'status') (Open-Efi)
        if ($s -ne '') { $why += " status$s" }
        Check ($why -eq '') "$($name): applied, the values, files, list of changes and status$(if ($why -ne '') { ':' + $why })"

        # undo: back to the state before
        if (-not $x['undo']) { continue }
        $u = (Open-Efi).MakePlan('undo')
        (Open-Efi).Run('undo', $u.Hash, $quiet)
        $now = [IntelXeEfi.Plist]::Canonical([IntelXeEfi.Plist]::Load($Cfg).Root)
        Check ($now -ceq $before -and (Get-Tree $F) -ceq $beforeTree) "$($name): undo, config.plist and the files as before"
    }

    # which CPUs need HybridPM.kext, which PCI devices are cards
    $bad = 0
    foreach ($c in $vt['cpus']) {
        if ([IntelXeEfi.EfiFolder]::HybridCpu($rules, $c['cpu']) -ne [bool]$c['hybridpm']) { $bad++; Write-Host "      '$($c['cpu'])': the vectors say $($c['hybridpm'])" }
    }
    Check ($bad -eq 0) "the $(Count $vt['cpus']) CPU names: HybridPM.kext for the ones the vectors say"
    $bad = 0
    foreach ($c in $vt['cards']) {
        if ($rules.IsCardInstance((Get-InstanceId $c['pci'])) -ne [bool]$c['card']) { $bad++; Write-Host "      PCI $($c['pci']): the vectors say card=$($c['card'])" }
    }
    Check ($bad -eq 0) "the $(Count $vt['cards']) PCI devices: the cards are the ones the vectors say"
} catch {
    Write-Host "FAIL  the test stopped: $(Get-ErrorText $_)"
    Write-Host $_.ScriptStackTrace
    $script:fails++
} finally {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Root) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Root -Recurse -Force }
}
Write-Host "== $($script:count) vectors, $($script:fails) failure(s)"
exit $script:fails

# zink-gl: OpenGL on the Intel Arc card through Mesa's zink

An optional component. Applications that open their OpenGL context through GLFW/EGL (LWJGL 3 Java games such as
Minecraft Java 1.13 and later) render through Mesa's zink straight to Vulkan (the driver's ANV) instead of Apple's
OpenGL → Metal → plugin → Vulkan. Apple's OpenGL, ANV and the kexts are not touched; no process loads these libraries
unless it asks for them. It needs the driver installed and `intelxe_surfvram=2` (without it every frame is copied).

Measured on the test machine (macOS 26.7.1, Minecraft 1.21.1 with Sodium and Iris, windowed, the same spot, 6 November
2026): with the BSL shader pack (HIGH) **zink 197–205 fps**, the same card on Windows (Intel's OpenGL) 214–218 fps;
without a shader pack zink 1400–1500 fps, Windows 700–1000. An earlier measurement without Sodium (2560×1440 full
screen, render distance 16): zink 741 fps, Apple's OpenGL 160 fps, Windows 450–479 fps.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `sudo ./install.sh` | `/Library/IntelXe/GL`, the Vulkan loader (`/usr/local/lib`) and the ICD manifest; backs up what it replaces to `./previous/` |
| `./install.sh --test` | offscreen self-test: a GL core context through zink on the B580 |
| `sudo ./install.sh --global on` | every LWJGL 3 application uses zink (`JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS`, set by a LaunchAgent at login) |
| `sudo ./install.sh --global off` | those applications go back to Apple's OpenGL |
| `./zink-gl-version.sh 1.21.1 --write` | one Minecraft version only: a separate `1.21.1-zink` version |
| `sudo ./install.sh --undo` | the state before the install |
| `sudo ./install.sh --status` | what is installed and switched on |
| `./cglzink-app.sh add /Applications/X.app` | experimental (0.1.4): a native CGL/NSOpenGL application through zink, as "X (zink).app" in `~/Applications` (below) |

`--global on` affects applications started afterwards; running ones must be restarted. Java prints "Picked up
JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS" at each start; that is expected. To keep one application on Apple's OpenGL, start it with
`JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS` empty.

## Limits

- Native macOS applications that use CGL/NSOpenGL directly still go through Apple's OpenGL, unless started through
  `cglzink-app.sh` (below).
- Opaque windows rely on Core Animation's private `contentsOpaque`; a macOS update can break it.
- Tested on macOS 26.7.1 only: in the game at the spot above, windowed and full screen, with a shader pack through
  Iris. Not tested: scaled (HiDPI) display modes, screen recording while it runs, several windows, Minecraft 26.3,
  macOS 15.
- `--global on` survives restarts (the LaunchAgent sets `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS` at each login), but an application that
  macOS reopens by itself at login ("Reopen windows when logging back in") can start a few seconds before the
  LaunchAgent and then runs on Apple's OpenGL. Quit it and start it again; Java prints "Picked up JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS"
  when zink is on.

## Native OpenGL applications (CGL / NSOpenGL), experimental

`libcglzink.dylib` (sources in `cgl/`, details in `cgl/README.md`) sends an application's CGL and NSOpenGL contexts to
zink instead of Apple's OpenGL. It is opt-in per application:

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `./cglzink-app.sh list` | applications that link or import Apple's OpenGL |
| `./cglzink-app.sh add /Applications/X.app` | makes `~/Applications/X (zink).app`: open it for zink, `X` itself for Apple's OpenGL |
| `./cglzink-app.sh remove X` | deletes `X (zink).app` |
| `./cglzink-app.sh run X` | starts X once through zink from Terminal, with the layer's log there |

`X (zink).app` starts the real application through LaunchServices with `DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES` for that launch only (log:
`~/Library/Logs/cglzink/X.log`). If X is already running, quit it first. This works for signed and Apple applications
because the driver's setup turns AMFI off (`amfi_get_out_of_my_way=0x1`); with AMFI on, macOS drops `DYLD_*` variables
for hardened applications. Drawing into IOSurface textures and CGL pbuffers works by copies (since 12 Nov, not yet run
on the B580); see `cgl/README.md`.

**Every application at once (experimental, off by default):** `sudo ./install.sh --global-gl on`. With AMFI off,
`launchctl setenv` passes `DYLD_*` to the applications the session starts later, so a LaunchAgent puts the small
`libcglzink-boot.dylib` into `DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES` at login. It is plain C (no AppKit) and decides in each process:
only application bundles take part, not Apple's (Chess excepted), browsers, Electron/Chromium apps, video players or
IntelXe Manager; `/Library/IntelXe/GL/cglzink-global.txt` refuses (`-bundle.id`) or allows (`+bundle.id`) one. A taking
part application loads `libcglzink.dylib`, the others go straight to Apple's OpenGL. `sudo ./install.sh --global-gl off`
undoes it (IntelXe Manager's Zink page has both, and its list of applications); do that before deleting `/Library/IntelXe/GL` by hand, as an inserted library that is missing stops every
application from starting (the LaunchAgent sets the variable only while both libraries are there, and `--undo` turns it
off first).

## Measuring zink's GPU work per frame

`bench/` (not in the package): `zgbench`, a deferred-renderer-shaped GL frame with an image hash, and `zinkgap-kit.sh`,
which A/Bs the opt-in knobs of `../docs/design/DESIGN-zink-gpu-gap.md` on the B580 from a staged directory
(`bench/stage.sh OUT`; nothing installed is changed; `ZG_ANV=<libvulkan_intel.dylib>` also stages an ANV build for
zink, which the kit passes through `VK_DRIVER_FILES`). Knobs that need no build: `anv_state_cache_perf_fix=true|false`,
`ZINK_DEBUG=rp`, `ZINK_DESCRIPTORS=lazy`; `ZINK_BAR_BUFFERS=sysmem|all` needs a zink built with
`../mesa/patches/0107`. Results of the first B580 night (13 Nov) and what became default are in section 6 of the
design note: `anv_state_cache_perf_fix` for zink (`../mesa/patches/0108`, ANV, -11% to -36% GPU time per frame on the
bench, opt-out `anv_state_cache_perf_fix=false`) and libcglzink's `CGLZINK_SURF_WRITEBACK=dirty`. The kit exports
`NVMTL_PROCESS_ENV=1`: without it the Metal plugin, loaded in every window process, unsets `INTEL_*`/`MESA_*`/`ANV_*`
before ANV reads them. Minecraft A/B: `bench/zinkgap-kit.sh mc rtfix` (or `rtoff` once `0108` is installed) writes
the knob into `/tmp/mesa-options-java` for the next start.

## Contents and sources

| File in the package | What | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `lib/libEGL.1.dylib` | Mesa EGL with a macOS platform (window = CALayer, kopper + `VK_EXT_metal_surface`) | Mesa `f01e9b07a91` + `src/mesa-zink.diff` |
| `lib/libgallium-27.0.0-devel.dylib` | zink; Vulkan through `/usr/local/lib/libvulkan.1.dylib` | same tree |
| `lib/libGLzink.dylib` | LWJGL's OpenGL library (`OSMesaGetProcAddress` → `eglGetProcAddress`) | `src/glshim.c` |
| `lib/libglfw.3.dylib` | GLFW 3.4: desktop OpenGL contexts through EGL | GLFW 3.4 + `src/glfw-3.4-0001-*.patch` |
| `vulkan/libvulkan.1.4.363.dylib` | Khronos Vulkan loader, unmodified | Vulkan-Loader `vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0`, as in `user/vulkan-loader/README.md` |
| `vulkan/icd.d/intel_icd.x86_64.json` | ICD manifest → `/Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib` | `user/vulkan-loader/` |
| `bin/zink-gl-selftest` | the `--test` program | `src/egltri.c` |
| `lib/libcglzink.dylib` | CGL/NSOpenGL contexts through zink (optional) | `cgl/` (`cgl/build.sh x86_64 OUT`) |
| `lib/libcglzink-boot.dylib` | the experimental switch for every application (`--global-gl`): loads `libcglzink.dylib` where it may (optional) | `cgl/boot.c` (same build) |
| `lib/IntelXeGL` | what the LaunchAgents of `--global` and `--global-gl` run (`launchctl setenv`, only while the files it is given exist), so macOS names it in Login Items instead of `sh` or `launchctl` (optional) | `cgl/intelxegl.c` (same build) |

`src/mesa-zink.diff` is the difference of the built tree from upstream in everything this build compiles: all of it
outside `src/intel/`, which a build without Intel drivers (`-Dvulkan-drivers= -Dgallium-drivers=zink -Dtools=`) does not
configure. The tree also held ANV changes from before the IntelXe rename (`b580_drm.h`, `DRM_IOCTL_B580_*`); they are not
in these binaries and are left out of the diff (ANV's current changes: `mesa/intelxe.diff`). It applies to `f01e9b07a91`
with `git apply` or `patch -p1`. Its patches are in `mesa/patches` (`0071`, `0072`, `0073` are the zink part). zink talks to ANV only through the Vulkan API, so it does not have to come
from the same Mesa commit as the installed ANV.

Building: Mesa with `mesa/darwin-x86_64.ini` and
`-Dbuildtype=release -Db_ndebug=true '-Dc_args=-Xclang -fno-split-cold-code' '-Dcpp_args=-Xclang -fno-split-cold-code'
-Dplatforms=macos -Dvulkan-drivers= -Dgallium-drivers=zink -Dvulkan-layers= -Dtools= -Dopengl=true -Dgles1=disabled
-Dgles2=disabled -Dglx=disabled -Degl=enabled -Dgbm=disabled -Dllvm=disabled -Dzstd=disabled -Dvalgrind=disabled
-Dlibunwind=disabled -Dlmsensors=disabled -Dperfetto=false -Dbuild-tests=false -Dxmlconfig=disabled -Dexpat=disabled
-Dspirv-tools=disabled -Dvideo-codecs= -Dgallium-va=disabled -Dvulkan-loader-rpath=/usr/local/lib`; GLFW as its patch's
message says. Everything is x86_64 and ad-hoc signed.

Licences: Mesa MIT, GLFW zlib (`src/GLFW-LICENSE.md`), Vulkan-Loader Apache-2.0 (`src/Vulkan-Loader-LICENSE.txt`), our
scripts and `src/glshim.c`, `src/egltri.c` MIT.

---

**Türkçe özet:** İsteğe bağlı bir bileşen. Bağlamını GLFW/EGL ile açan uygulamalar (Minecraft gibi LWJGL 3 oyunları),
Apple'ın OpenGL'i yerine Mesa'nın zink'iyle doğrudan Vulkan'a gidiyor; Minecraft 1.21.1'de BSL shader paketiyle zink'te
197–205 fps, aynı kartla Windows'ta 214–218 fps; shader paketi olmadan zink'te 1400–1500, Windows'ta 700–1000 fps.
`sudo ./install.sh` kurar, `sudo ./install.sh --global on` bütün LWJGL 3 uygulamaları için açar, `--global off`
kapatır, `--undo` kaldırır. Sürücünün kurulu ve `intelxe_surfvram=2` ayarının açık olması gerekiyor. CGL/NSOpenGL'i
doğrudan kullanan yerel uygulamalar yine Apple'ın OpenGL'ini kullanır. macOS'un girişte kendiliğinden yeniden açtığı
bir uygulama ayardan önce başlayıp Apple'ın OpenGL'inde kalabilir: kapatıp yeniden açın. Deneysel: CGL/NSOpenGL kullanan
yerel bir uygulama `./cglzink-app.sh add /Applications/X.app` ile `~/Applications/X (zink).app` olarak Zink'e geçer; X'in
kendisi Apple'ın OpenGL'inde kalır, `./cglzink-app.sh remove X` kaldırır. Bütün uygulamalar için deneysel anahtar:
`sudo ./install.sh --global-gl on` (varsayılan kapalı): AMFI kapalıyken oturuma `DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES` ile küçük
`libcglzink-boot.dylib` girer; yalnız uygulama paketlerinde devreye girer, Apple'ın (Satranç hariç), tarayıcıların,
Electron uygulamalarının ve video oynatıcıların dışında; `/Library/IntelXe/GL/cglzink-global.txt` bir uygulamayı
reddeder (`-paket.kimliği`) ya da ekler (`+paket.kimliği`). Kapatmak: `sudo ./install.sh --global-gl off`;
`/Library/IntelXe/GL`'yi elle silmeden önce kapatın.

FILE: zink-gl/cglzink-app.sh
================================================
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# cglzink-app.sh: one native OpenGL application (CGL / NSOpenGL) through zink instead of Apple's OpenGL, opt-in per
# application. Experimental. Needs `sudo ./install.sh` from this package (it puts libcglzink.dylib beside zink).
#
#   ./cglzink-app.sh list                    applications that look like OpenGL users (/Applications, ~/Applications)
#   ./cglzink-app.sh add  /Applications/X.app    makes "~/Applications/X (zink).app": open that one for zink, X for Apple's GL
#   ./cglzink-app.sh remove X                 deletes "X (zink).app"
#   ./cglzink-app.sh status                   the "(zink)" applications made so far
#   ./cglzink-app.sh run  /Applications/X.app [args]   starts X once through zink in this terminal, the layer's log here
#
# "X (zink).app" starts the real X through LaunchServices with DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES set for that launch only; X keeps its
# own name, icon, documents and settings. If X is already running, quit it first: a running application is only brought
# to the front. Nothing system-wide is changed. (With AMFI off, launchctl setenv would pass DYLD_* to every application
# started later; such a switch is not offered until the gains are measured: it loads the layer into every process.)
# Off: open X itself, or remove "X (zink).app". The layer's log of the last start: ~/Library/Logs/cglzink/X.log
set -euo pipefail
GL=${CGLZINK_GL_DIR:-/Library/IntelXe/GL}            # the overrides are for tests
LIB=$GL/libcglzink.dylib
APPS=${CGLZINK_APPS_DIR:-$HOME/Applications}
LOGS="$HOME/Library/Logs/cglzink"
LSREGISTER=/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Frameworks/LaunchServices.framework/Support/lsregister

usage() { sed -n '5,10p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit 2; }
plist() { /usr/bin/plutil -extract "$2" raw -o - "$1/Contents/Info.plist" 2>/dev/null || true; }
app_path() {   # an .app path, or a name found in /Applications, ~/Applications, /System/Applications
    local a=${1%/} d
    [ -d "$a" ] && { (cd "$a" && pwd); return; }
    for d in /Applications "$APPS" /System/Applications /Applications/Utilities; do
        [ -d "$d/$a.app" ] && { echo "$d/$a.app"; return; }; [ -d "$d/$a" ] && { echo "$d/$a"; return; }
    done
    echo "no application $1" >&2; exit 1
}
check_lib() {
    [ -f "$LIB" ] && [ -f "$GL/libEGL.1.dylib" ] && return
    echo "missing $LIB or $GL/libEGL.1.dylib: run 'sudo ./install.sh' from this package first"; exit 1
}
# The bundle's own Mach-O files (main executable, top-level frameworks and dylibs) that link Apple's OpenGL (the load
# commands, in the first 256 KB), import NSOpenGL or CGL, or SDL, which opens OpenGL with dlopen. Chromium/Electron bundles name it for ANGLE but
# draw with Metal: left out.
uses_gl() {
    local f
    for f in "$1/Contents/Frameworks/Electron Framework.framework" "$1/Contents/Frameworks/Chromium Embedded Framework.framework"; do
        [ -d "$f" ] && return
    done
    for f in "$1"/Contents/MacOS/* "$1"/Contents/Frameworks/*.dylib "$1"/Contents/Frameworks/*.framework/Versions/A/*; do
        [ -f "$f" ] && [ -x "$f" ] || continue
        case "$f" in *SDL*) echo yes; return ;; esac
        if /usr/bin/head -c 262144 "$f" | /usr/bin/grep -a -q -m1 -e 'OpenGL.framework' -e 'libGL.dylib'; then echo yes; return; fi
        # a main executable below 32 MB: also what it imports (NSOpenGL classes, CGL calls), at the end of the file
        case "$f" in */Contents/MacOS/*)
            [ "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %z "$f")" -lt 33554432 ] &&
                /usr/bin/grep -a -q -m1 -e '_OBJC_CLASS_$_NSOpenGL' -e '_CGLChoosePixelFormat' -e '_CGLCreateContext' "$f" &&
                { echo yes; return; } ;;
        esac
    done
}

list() {
    local a n
    for a in /Applications/*.app /Applications/*/*.app "$APPS"/*.app /System/Applications/Chess.app; do
        [ -d "$a" ] || continue
        case "$a" in *" (zink).app") continue ;; esac
        [ -n "$(uses_gl "$a")" ] || continue
        n=$(basename "$a" .app)
        if [ -d "$APPS/$n (zink).app" ]; then echo "  $a   (has $n (zink).app)"; else echo "  $a"; fi
    done
    echo "These link or import Apple's OpenGL; whether they draw with it (not with Metal) shows only when they run."
}

add() {
    check_lib
    local a n id exe w icon q
    a=$(app_path "$1"); n=$(basename "$a" .app); id=$(plist "$a" CFBundleIdentifier); exe=$(plist "$a" CFBundleExecutable)
    [ -n "$exe" ] || { echo "$a has no CFBundleExecutable"; exit 1; }
    [ -n "$(uses_gl "$a")" ] || echo "note: nothing in $a names OpenGL; it may draw with Metal, and then this changes nothing"
    w="$APPS/$n (zink).app"
    q=$(printf %q "$a")
    mkdir -p "$APPS" "$LOGS"
    rm -rf "$w.new"; mkdir -p "$w.new/Contents/MacOS" "$w.new/Contents/Resources"
    icon=$(plist "$a" CFBundleIconFile)
    if [ -n "$icon" ]; then
        case "$icon" in *.icns) ;; *) icon=$icon.icns ;; esac
        if [ -f "$a/Contents/Resources/$icon" ]; then cp "$a/Contents/Resources/$icon" "$w.new/Contents/Resources/AppIcon.icns"; else icon=; fi
    fi
    cat > "$w.new/Contents/Info.plist" <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>cglzink-launch</string>
	<key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.cglzink.$(echo "${id:-$n}" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9.\n' '-')</string>
	<key>CFBundleName</key><string>$n (zink)</string>
	<key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
	<key>CFBundleIconFile</key><string>${icon:+AppIcon}</string>
	<key>LSUIElement</key><true/>
	<key>IntelXeTarget</key><string>$a</string>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF
    # The launcher checks the layer at every start: DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES naming a missing file would stop the application.
    cat > "$w.new/Contents/MacOS/cglzink-launch" <<EOF
#!/bin/bash
# made by cglzink-app.sh: starts $n with its OpenGL through zink (DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES for this launch only)
APP=$q
EXE="\$APP/Contents/MacOS/$exe"
LOG="$LOGS/$n.log"
if /bin/ps -axo comm= | /usr/bin/grep -Fxq -- "\$EXE"; then
    /usr/bin/osascript -e 'display dialog "$n is already running on Apple'"'"'s OpenGL. Quit it, then open $n (zink) again." buttons {"OK"} default button 1 with icon caution' >/dev/null 2>&1
    exit 0
fi
if [ -f '$LIB' ] && [ -f '$GL/libEGL.1.dylib' ]; then
    mkdir -p "$LOGS"; : > "\$LOG"
    exec /usr/bin/open -a "\$APP" --stderr "\$LOG" --env 'DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=$LIB' --env CGLZINK_LOG=1 --args "\$@"
fi
exec /usr/bin/open -a "\$APP" --args "\$@"
EOF
    chmod 755 "$w.new/Contents/MacOS/cglzink-launch"
    /usr/bin/codesign -s - -f "$w.new" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    rm -rf "$w"; mv "$w.new" "$w"
    "$LSREGISTER" -f "$w" 2>/dev/null || true
    echo "made $w"
    echo "open \"$n (zink)\" for zink, \"$n\" for Apple's OpenGL. Log of the last start: $LOGS/$n.log"
}

remove() {
    local n=${1%/}; n=$(basename "$n" .app); n=${n% (zink)}
    local w="$APPS/$n (zink).app"
    [ -d "$w" ] || { echo "no $w"; exit 1; }
    "$LSREGISTER" -u "$w" 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -rf "$w"; echo "removed $w; $n opens on Apple's OpenGL as before"
}

status() {
    if [ -f "$LIB" ]; then echo "layer: $LIB"; else echo "layer: not installed (sudo ./install.sh)"; fi
    local w found=0
    for w in "$APPS"/*" (zink).app"; do
        [ -d "$w" ] || continue
        found=1; echo "  $(basename "$w") -> $(plist "$w" IntelXeTarget)"
    done
    [ $found = 1 ] || echo "  no (zink) applications"
}

run() {
    check_lib
    local a=$1 exe; shift
    if [ -d "$a" ] || [[ "$a" != */* ]]; then a=$(app_path "$a"); exe="$a/Contents/MacOS/$(plist "$a" CFBundleExecutable)"; else exe=$a; fi
    echo "starting $exe through zink; the layer's log follows (Ctrl-C quits the application)"
    CGLZINK_LOG=${CGLZINK_LOG:-1} DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES=$LIB exec "$exe" "$@"
}

case "${1:-}" in
    list) list ;;
    add) [ $# -ge 2 ] || usage; add "$2" ;;
    remove) [ $# -ge 2 ] || usage; remove "$2" ;;
    status) status ;;
    run) [ $# -ge 2 ] || usage; shift; run "$@" ;;
    *) usage ;;
esac

FILE: zink-gl/install.sh
================================================
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# install.sh (zink-gl): OpenGL through Mesa's zink on the Intel Arc B580, for applications that open their OpenGL
# context through GLFW / EGL (LWJGL 3 games such as Minecraft Java). Apple's OpenGL, Mesa ANV and the kexts are not
# touched; nothing here is loaded by a process that does not ask for these libraries.
#
#   sudo ./install.sh              install (backs up what it replaces to ./previous/, once)
#   sudo ./install.sh --undo       put back what was there before
#   ./install.sh --test            offscreen self-test (EGL pbuffer, GL core through zink on the B580, ~1 s)
#   sudo ./install.sh --global on  every LWJGL 3 application of every user uses zink (JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS, set by a
#                                  LaunchAgent at login; applies to applications started after the next login, or
#                                  right away for the logged-in user)
#   sudo ./install.sh --global off back to Apple's OpenGL for them
#   ./install.sh --status
#   ./cglzink-app.sh ...           native CGL/NSOpenGL applications through zink, one at a time (experimental; see there)
#   sudo ./install.sh --global-gl on|off   EXPERIMENTAL: every native OpenGL application through zink (cglzink): a
#                                  LaunchAgent puts libcglzink-boot into DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES of the login session;
#                                  it takes part only in application bundles that are not Apple's (Chess excepted),
#                                  browsers, Electron apps or video players; /Library/IntelXe/GL/cglzink-global.txt
#                                  ("-bundle.id" / "+bundle.id") refuses or allows one. Turn it off before deleting
#                                  /Library/IntelXe/GL by hand: an inserted library that is missing stops every launch.
#
# Installs:
#   /Library/IntelXe/GL/                   libEGL (Mesa EGL, macOS platform), libgallium (zink), libGLzink (LWJGL's
#                                          OpenGL library), libglfw.3 (GLFW 3.4 + the zink EGL patch), and when the
#                                          package has it libcglzink (CGL/NSOpenGL applications, loaded only by
#                                          cglzink-app.sh's launchers)
#   /Library/IntelXe/GL/libvulkan.1.dylib, intel_icd.x86_64.json: the loader and manifest again, for sandboxed applications
#   /usr/local/lib/libvulkan.1.4.363.dylib the Khronos Vulkan loader (+ libvulkan.1.dylib, libvulkan.dylib links),
#                                          which zink and ordinary Vulkan applications use to find the B580
#   /usr/local/share/vulkan/icd.d/intel_icd.x86_64.json  -> /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib
set -euo pipefail
H=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
B=$H/previous
GL=/Library/IntelXe/GL
VL=/usr/local/lib VLIB=libvulkan.1.4.363.dylib
ICDD=/usr/local/share/vulkan/icd.d ICD=intel_icd.x86_64.json
LA=/Library/LaunchAgents/io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.zink-gl.plist
LIBS="libEGL.1.dylib libgallium-27.0.0-devel.dylib libGLzink.dylib libglfw.3.dylib"
OPTLIBS="libcglzink.dylib libcglzink-boot.dylib IntelXeGL"   # installed when the package has them
HELPER=$GL/IntelXeGL   # what the LaunchAgents run, so macOS names it (not "sh" or "launchctl") in its notices
LAGL=/Library/LaunchAgents/io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.cglzink-global.plist
BOOT=$GL/libcglzink-boot.dylib
JOPTS="-Dorg.lwjgl.glfw.libname=$GL/libglfw.3.dylib -Dorg.lwjgl.opengl.libname=$GL/libGLzink.dylib"

root() { [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || { echo "needs root: sudo $0 $*"; exit 1; }; }
sums() { (cd "$H" && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS >/dev/null) || { echo "REFUSED: files differ from SHA256SUMS"; exit 1; }; }
sig() { "$H/sigcheck" "$1" >/dev/null || { "$H/sigcheck" "$1"; echo "REFUSED: $1 is not signed"; exit 1; }; }
console_user() { stat -f %Su /dev/console 2>/dev/null || true; }

status() {
    echo "zink-gl:"
    [ -d $GL ] && echo "  $GL: $(cd $GL && ls *.dylib | tr '\n' ' ')" || echo "  $GL: not installed"
    [ -e $VL/$VLIB ] && echo "  Vulkan loader: $VL/$VLIB" || echo "  Vulkan loader: not installed"
    [ -e $ICDD/$ICD ] && echo "  ICD: $ICDD/$ICD -> $(sed -n 's/.*"library_path": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' $ICDD/$ICD)" || echo "  ICD: none"
    if [ -e $LA ]; then echo "  global: on ($LA)"; else echo "  global: off"; fi
    if [ -e $GL/libcglzink.dylib ]; then echo "  cglzink: installed; per application with ./cglzink-app.sh"; fi
    if [ -e $LAGL ]; then echo "  cglzink for every OpenGL application: on ($LAGL, experimental)"; else echo "  cglzink for every OpenGL application: off"; fi
    local u; u=$(console_user)
    if [ -n "$u" ] && [ "$u" != root ]; then
        if [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then echo "  JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS for $u: $(launchctl asuser "$(id -u "$u")" launchctl getenv JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS 2>/dev/null || true)"
        else echo "  JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS for $u: (sudo $0 --status shows it)"; fi
    fi
    echo "  surfvram: $(sysctl -n debug.intelxe.surfvram 2>/dev/null || echo '?') (2 = no present copy)"
}

global() {
    root "--global $1"
    local u; u=$(console_user)
    case "$1" in
    on)
        [ -d $GL ] || { echo "install first: sudo $0"; exit 1; }
        cat > $LA.new <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Label</key><string>io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.zink-gl</string>
	<key>ProgramArguments</key>
	<array>$(if [ -x $HELPER ]; then echo "<string>$HELPER</string>"; else echo "<string>/bin/launchctl</string>"; fi)<string>setenv</string><string>JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS</string><string>$JOPTS</string></array>
	<key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF
        chown root:wheel $LA.new; chmod 644 $LA.new; mv $LA.new $LA
        if [ -n "$u" ] && [ "$u" != root ]; then
            launchctl asuser "$(id -u "$u")" launchctl setenv JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS "$JOPTS"
            echo "on: LWJGL 3 applications started from now on by $u (and by every user after login) use zink."
        else echo "on: from the next login."; fi
        echo "Applications started before this keep Apple's OpenGL until they are restarted." ;;
    off)
        rm -f $LA
        if [ -n "$u" ] && [ "$u" != root ]; then launchctl asuser "$(id -u "$u")" launchctl unsetenv JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS; fi
        echo "off: LWJGL applications started from now on use Apple's OpenGL." ;;
    *) echo "usage: $0 --global on|off"; exit 2 ;;
    esac
}

# --global-gl on|off: libcglzink-boot in DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES of the login session. The LaunchAgent sets it only while
# both libraries are there (a missing inserted library would stop every application from starting); off unsets it
# for the logged-in user at once.
global_gl() {
    root "--global-gl $1"
    local u; u=$(console_user)
    case "$1" in
    on)
        [ -f $BOOT ] && [ -f $GL/libcglzink.dylib ] || { echo "this installation has no libcglzink-boot.dylib: install a package that has it first"; exit 1; }
        cat > $LAGL.new <<PLIST
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Label</key><string>io.github.yusufklncc.intelxe.cglzink-global</string>
	<key>ProgramArguments</key>
$(if [ -x $HELPER ]; then echo "	<array><string>$HELPER</string><string>setenv</string><string>DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES</string><string>$BOOT</string><string>$BOOT</string><string>$GL/libcglzink.dylib</string></array>"
  else echo "	<array><string>/bin/sh</string><string>-c</string><string>[ -f $BOOT ] &amp;&amp; [ -f $GL/libcglzink.dylib ] &amp;&amp; exec /bin/launchctl setenv DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES $BOOT</string></array>"; fi)
	<key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
</dict>
</plist>
PLIST
        chown root:wheel $LAGL.new; chmod 644 $LAGL.new; mv $LAGL.new $LAGL
        if [ -n "$u" ] && [ "$u" != root ]; then
            launchctl asuser "$(id -u "$u")" launchctl setenv DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES $BOOT
            echo "on (experimental): OpenGL applications $u starts from now on draw through zink, where cglzink-global's rules allow."
        else echo "on (experimental): from the next login."; fi
        echo "Off: sudo $0 --global-gl off. Running applications keep what they had until they are restarted." ;;
    off)
        rm -f $LAGL
        if [ -n "$u" ] && [ "$u" != root ]; then
            case "$(launchctl asuser "$(id -u "$u")" launchctl getenv DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES 2>/dev/null)" in
                *libcglzink-boot*) launchctl asuser "$(id -u "$u")" launchctl unsetenv DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES ;;
            esac
        fi
        echo "off: OpenGL applications started from now on use Apple's OpenGL (cglzink-app.sh launchers still work)." ;;
    *) echo "usage: $0 --global-gl on|off"; exit 2 ;;
    esac
}

# place SRC DST: replace DST (file or directory) with a root-owned copy of SRC
place() { rm -rf "$2.new"; ditto "$1" "$2.new"; chown -R root:wheel "$2.new"; chmod -R go-w "$2.new"; rm -rf "$2"; mv "$2.new" "$2"; }

install_all() {
    root
    sums
    [ -f /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib ] || { echo "REFUSED: the driver is not installed (no /Library/GPUBundles/nvmtl/libvulkan_intel.dylib)"; exit 1; }
    local f; for f in $LIBS; do sig "$H/lib/$f"; done; sig "$H/vulkan/$VLIB"
    # the global switch is on but this package lacks its library: replacing the folder would leave the session inserting
    # a missing library, which stops every application from starting
    if [ -e $LAGL ] && [ ! -f "$H/lib/libcglzink-boot.dylib" ]; then echo "REFUSED: cglzink's global switch is on and this package has no libcglzink-boot.dylib: sudo $0 --global-gl off first"; exit 1; fi
    for f in $OPTLIBS; do [ -f "$H/lib/$f" ] && sig "$H/lib/$f"; done
    if [ ! -d "$B" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$B"
        if [ -d $GL ]; then ditto $GL "$B/GL"; else touch "$B/no-GL"; fi
        if [ -e $VL/$VLIB ]; then cp -p $VL/$VLIB "$B/$VLIB"; else touch "$B/no-loader"; fi
        if [ -e $ICDD/$ICD ]; then cp -p $ICDD/$ICD "$B/$ICD"; else touch "$B/no-icd"; fi
        echo "backup: $B"
    fi
    mkdir -p /Library/IntelXe "$H/.stage"
    rm -rf "$H/.stage/GL"; mkdir "$H/.stage/GL"
    for f in $LIBS; do cp "$H/lib/$f" "$H/.stage/GL/"; done
    for f in $OPTLIBS; do [ -f "$H/lib/$f" ] && cp "$H/lib/$f" "$H/.stage/GL/"; done
    ln -s libEGL.1.dylib "$H/.stage/GL/libEGL.dylib"
    # also beside zink: a sandboxed application cannot read /usr/local
    install -m 755 "$H/vulkan/$VLIB" "$H/.stage/GL/libvulkan.1.dylib"
    install -m 644 "$H/vulkan/icd.d/$ICD" "$H/.stage/GL/$ICD"
    place "$H/.stage/GL" $GL; rm -rf "$H/.stage"
    mkdir -p $VL $ICDD
    install -o root -g wheel -m 755 "$H/vulkan/$VLIB" $VL/$VLIB
    ln -sf $VLIB $VL/libvulkan.1.dylib; ln -sf libvulkan.1.dylib $VL/libvulkan.dylib
    install -o root -g wheel -m 644 "$H/vulkan/icd.d/$ICD" $ICDD/$ICD
    # switches turned on by an older package: their LaunchAgents run the helper from now on
    if [ -x $HELPER ]; then
        [ -e $LA ] && ! grep -q "$HELPER" $LA && global on >/dev/null || true
        [ -e $LAGL ] && ! grep -q "$HELPER" $LAGL && global_gl on >/dev/null || true
    fi
    status
    echo "installed. Try: $0 --test; then sudo $0 --global on (all LWJGL 3 apps) or ./zink-gl-version.sh (one game)."
}

undo() {
    root
    [ -d "$B" ] || { echo "nothing to undo (not installed from this folder)"; exit 1; }
    [ -e $LA ] && global off
    [ -e $LAGL ] && global_gl off   # first: the libraries it inserts go below
    if [ -d "$B/GL" ]; then place "$B/GL" $GL; else rm -rf $GL; rmdir /Library/IntelXe 2>/dev/null || true; fi
    if [ -e "$B/$VLIB" ]; then install -o root -g wheel -m 755 "$B/$VLIB" $VL/$VLIB
    else rm -f $VL/$VLIB $VL/libvulkan.1.dylib $VL/libvulkan.dylib; fi
    if [ -e "$B/$ICD" ]; then install -o root -g wheel -m 644 "$B/$ICD" $ICDD/$ICD; else rm -f $ICDD/$ICD; fi
    rm -rf "$B"
    status
}

case "${1:-}" in
    "") install_all ;;
    --undo) undo ;;
    --test) sums; exec /usr/bin/perl -e 'alarm shift; exec @ARGV' 30 "$H/bin/zink-gl-selftest" 200 native ;;
    --global) global "${2:-}" ;;
    --global-gl) global_gl "${2:-}" ;;
    --status) status ;;
    *) sed -n '5,20p' "$0"; exit 2 ;;
esac

FILE: zink-gl/zink-gl-version.sh
================================================
#!/bin/bash
# zink-gl-version.sh <version> [game dir] [--write]
# Makes a launcher version "<version>-zink" that inherits <version> (the standard "inheritsFrom" mechanism Fabric and
# OptiFine profiles use) and only adds the two Java arguments that send LWJGL's GLFW and OpenGL to /Library/IntelXe/GL.
# The original version, its jar and the launcher's global Java arguments stay untouched: pick "<version>-zink" in the
# launcher to play with zink, "<version>" for Apple's OpenGL. Minecraft 1.13 and newer (the "arguments" JSON format,
# LWJGL 3 + GLFW). Without --write it only prints what it would write.
#   game dir: default ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft
#   remove:   delete <game dir>/versions/<version>-zink
set -euo pipefail
V=${1:?usage: zink-gl-version.sh <version> [game dir] [--write]}
D="$HOME/Library/Application Support/minecraft"; W=0
shift; for a in "$@"; do if [ "$a" = --write ]; then W=1; else D=$a; fi; done
L=/Library/IntelXe/GL
P="$D/versions/$V/$V.json"
[ -f "$P" ] || { echo "no $P: start $V once from the launcher first (it downloads it)"; exit 1; }
for f in libglfw.3.dylib libGLzink.dylib libEGL.1.dylib; do [ -f "$L/$f" ] || echo "warning: $L/$f is missing (install.sh not run yet)"; done
get() { /usr/bin/plutil -extract "$1" raw -o - "$P" 2>/dev/null || true; }
MC=$(get mainClass); TY=$(get type); TI=$(get time); RT=$(get releaseTime)
[ -n "$MC" ] || { echo "$P has no mainClass"; exit 1; }
/usr/bin/plutil -extract arguments.jvm json -o - "$P" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$V uses the old argument format (before 1.13): not supported"; exit 1; }
N="$V-zink"; O="$D/versions/$N/$N.json"
J=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "id": "$N",
  "inheritsFrom": "$V",
  "jar": "$V",
  "type": "${TY:-release}",
  "time": "$TI",
  "releaseTime": "$RT",
  "mainClass": "$MC",
  "arguments": {
    "game": [],
    "jvm": [
      "-Dorg.lwjgl.glfw.libname=$L/libglfw.3.dylib",
      "-Dorg.lwjgl.opengl.libname=$L/libGLzink.dylib"
    ]
  }
}
EOF
)
if [ $W = 0 ]; then echo "would write $O:"; echo "$J"; echo "(run again with --write to write it)"; exit 0; fi
[ ! -e "$O" ] || cp "$O" "$O.before-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$O")"; printf '%s\n' "$J" > "$O"
[ "$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract id raw -o - "$O")" = "$N" ] && echo "wrote $O: choose \"$N\" in the launcher"

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# stage.sh OUT: the B580 measurement kit of docs/design/DESIGN-zink-gpu-gap.md in OUT (on the build Mac; nothing is installed):
#   OUT/lib/  libEGL.1.dylib + libgallium-27.0.0-devel.dylib from a zink Mesa build (ZG_MESA_BUILD, with the
#             ZINK_BAR_BUFFERS patch mesa/patches/0107), libglfw.3.dylib of the package (ZG_PKG_LIB), libcglzink.dylib
#             (cgl/build.sh output ZG_CGL), the same rpaths as the package (@loader_path; gallium: /usr/local/lib)
#   OUT/lib/anv/  only with ZG_ANV=<libvulkan_intel.dylib>: that ANV build (e.g. the released source + mesa/patches/0108)
#             and an ICD manifest beside it; the kit then gives zink this ANV through VK_DRIVER_FILES (the Metal plugin
#             keeps the installed one: it opens its driver by path)
#   OUT/bin/  zgbench (x86_64), layertest + libfakeegl.dylib (cgl/test), zinkgap-kit.sh
#   OUT/SHA256SUMS
# Every binary is ad-hoc signed, as the package's are. The kit loads only OUT/lib (zgbench dlopens OUT/lib's GLFW,
# which loads the libEGL next to it, which loads the libgallium next to it), so no DYLD_* variable is needed for zink.
set -euo pipefail
O=${1:?usage: stage.sh OUTDIR}
D=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
MB=${ZG_MESA_BUILD:-$HOME/hackintosh/work/zinkgap-mesa/build}
PKG=${ZG_PKG_LIB:-$HOME/hackintosh/work/zink014/lib}
CGL=${ZG_CGL:-$HOME/hackintosh/work/zinkgap-x86}
mkdir -p "$O/lib" "$O/bin"
cp -f "$MB/src/egl/libEGL.1.dylib" "$MB/src/gallium/targets/dri/libgallium-27.0.0-devel.dylib" "$O/lib/"
cp -f "$PKG/libglfw.3.dylib" "$O/lib/"
cp -f "$CGL/libcglzink.dylib" "$O/lib/"
cp -f "$CGL/layertest" "$CGL/libfakeegl.dylib" "$O/bin/"
rm -rf "$O/lib/anv"
if [ -n "${ZG_ANV:-}" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$O/lib/anv"
    cp -f "$ZG_ANV" "$O/lib/anv/libvulkan_intel.dylib"
    # a library_path with a slash is relative to the manifest (Khronos loader)
    printf '{\n    "file_format_version": "1.0.1",\n    "ICD": {\n        "library_path": "./libvulkan_intel.dylib",\n        "library_arch": "64",\n        "api_version": "1.4.363",\n        "is_portability_driver": false\n    }\n}\n' > "$O/lib/anv/intel_icd.json"
fi
# the package's rpaths: libEGL finds libgallium next to it, libgallium the Vulkan loader in /usr/local/lib
install_name_tool -delete_rpath @loader_path/../gallium/targets/dri "$O/lib/libEGL.1.dylib" 2>/dev/null || true
install_name_tool -add_rpath @loader_path "$O/lib/libEGL.1.dylib" 2>/dev/null || true
otool -l "$O/lib/libgallium-27.0.0-devel.dylib" | grep -q "path /usr/local/lib " ||
    install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib "$O/lib/libgallium-27.0.0-devel.dylib"
clang -arch x86_64 -mmacosx-version-min=15.0 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-deprecated-declarations \
    -Wno-four-char-constants "$D/zgbench.c" -framework OpenGL -framework IOSurface -framework CoreFoundation -o "$O/bin/zgbench"
cp -f "$D/zinkgap-kit.sh" "$O/bin/" && chmod +x "$O/bin/zinkgap-kit.sh"
for f in "$O"/lib/*.dylib "$O"/lib/anv/*.dylib "$O/bin/zgbench" "$O/bin/layertest" "$O/bin/libfakeegl.dylib"; do
    if [ -e "$f" ]; then codesign -s - -f "$f" 2>/dev/null; fi; done
otool -l "$O/lib/libEGL.1.dylib" | grep -A2 LC_RPATH | grep -q "@loader_path" || { echo "stage: libEGL rpath not set"; exit 1; }
(cd "$O" && find lib bin -type f | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 > SHA256SUMS)
cat "$O/SHA256SUMS"

FILE: zink-gl/cgl/README.md
================================================
# cglzink: native OpenGL applications drawing through zink (experimental)

`libcglzink.dylib`, loaded with `DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES` into a chosen application, fills the dispatch table of each of its CGL
contexts with thunks that call Mesa's zink through EGL. Apple's CGL objects stay; only what they point at changes. It is
the CGL/NSOpenGL counterpart of the GLFW route in `../README.md`: the application's GL calls skip Apple's OpenGL → Metal →
plugin path. Nothing loads it unless the user starts an application through `../cglzink-app.sh`, or turns on the
experimental switch for every application (`sudo ../install.sh --global-gl on`, off by default), with which
`libcglzink-boot.dylib` (`boot.c`) loads it into the applications that take part (`../README.md`).

History: prototype in the hackintosh research tree (`tools/b580/cgl-zink`, `tools/b580/cgl-thunks`; commits 0640304,
cb58869, ea35ef0, aca50fc, 57e1f0c, 5 Nov 2026), imported unchanged in this folder's first commit.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `cglzink.m` | the layer: adopting contexts, lifetime, current context and threads, present, view → layer, swap interval, IOSurface |
| `boot.c` | `libcglzink-boot.dylib`, the switch for every application: plain C, in every process of the session; decides once per process (application bundles only, not Apple's except Chess, not browsers, Electron/Chromium, video players or IntelXe Manager; `/Library/IntelXe/GL/cglzink-global.txt`), then loads `libcglzink.dylib` with `dlopen` |
| `cglzink_hooks.h` | the table of CGL entry points `libcglzink.dylib` exports for the boot library (dyld ignores the `__interpose` section of a `dlopen`ed image) |
| `appleview.h` | what a context says about itself: Apple's version, GLSL version and extensions for its profile |
| `appleext.h` | Apple's own GL extensions zink lacks (`APPLE_vertex_array_object`, `APPLE_fence`, `APPLE_element_array`, ...) from core functions |
| `gen/` | the thunk generator and the measured symbol → entry map (`gen/README.md`) |
| `test/fakeegl.c` | test stand-in for EGL: a hidden Apple context per EGL context, Mesa's binding rules. Says nothing about zink |
| `test/layertest.m`, `test/run.sh` | pixel hashes on Apple's GL and through the layer, which must agree; the same through the boot library (it must take part with `CGLZINK_GLOBAL_ANY=1` and stay out otherwise, as `layertest` is no application bundle) |
| `build.sh ARCH OUT` | builds the two libraries, the EGL stand-in and `layertest` (x86_64 for the B580, arm64 for tests on Apple silicon), ad-hoc signed |

```
./build.sh x86_64 /tmp/cz      # libcglzink.dylib and libcglzink-boot.dylib for the package (lib/ of ZINK_DIR)
./build.sh arm64 /tmp/czt && LAYERTEST_VIEW=1 test/run.sh /tmp/czt   # plumbing tests on the build Mac
```

Settings: `CGLZINK_OFF=1` (nothing is adopted), `CGLZINK_LOG=1`, `CGLZINK_EGL=<path>` (default `/Library/IntelXe/GL/libEGL.1.dylib`),
`CGLZINK_FPS=<seconds>` (presents per second on stderr, for applications without a counter), `CGLZINK_APPLE=1` (nothing is
adopted but the counter runs: the same measurement on Apple's GL).
`CGLZINK_SURF_WRITEBACK` (`../../docs/design/DESIGN-zink-gpu-gap.md`): unset or `dirty` (the default since 13 Nov)
copies an IOSurface texture back only when the context drew into a framebuffer holding one (or uploaded a texture) since
the last copy, and `CGLSetOffScreen` memory only after a draw; `flush` copies at every `glFlush`, `glFinish` and
present (the behaviour before); `present` (opt-in) skips the copy at `glFlush` (a reader in another process that
syncs on `glFlush` then sees the previous frame), together with `dirty` unless `flush` is also given. On the B580
(`../bench/zinkgap-kit.sh cgl`, an IOSurface target with 3 mid-frame flushes, same pixels in every mode): 120 fps with
`flush`, 391 with `dirty`, 791-814 with `present`.
The boot library reads `CGLZINK_GLOBAL_OFF=1` (never take part), `CGLZINK_GLOBAL_ANY=1` (take part outside an
application bundle too: the tests), `CGLZINK_LIB=<path>` (another `libcglzink.dylib`) and `CGLZINK_LOG=1` (why it took
part or not).
When EGL does not open, or a context cannot be made, that context stays on Apple's OpenGL.

## What it covers

- CGL: `CGLCreateContext`, `CGLDestroyContext`/`CGLReleaseContext` (by reference count), `CGLSetCurrentContext`,
  `CGLLockContext`/`CGLUnlockContext`, `CGLFlushDrawable`, `CGLSetParameter` (swap interval), `CGLClearDrawable`,
  `CGLUpdateContext`, `CGLTexImageIOSurface2D` (a copy), all 975 dispatch entries (906 straight to zink, 25 rebuilt in
  `appleext.h`, the rest Apple-only hints that do nothing).
- NSOpenGLContext: `initWithFormat:shareContext:`, `initWithCGLContextObj:`, `makeCurrentContext`, `clearCurrentContext`,
  `setView:`, `update`, `flushBuffer`, `clearDrawable`. NSOpenGLView works through these.
- Legacy (2.1 → zink 4.6 compatibility) and core (3.2 / 4.1 → zink core) profiles; shared contexts (both on zink, or both
  stay on Apple's GL); a context used by two threads under `CGLLockContext` (the CVDisplayLink pattern).
- The application sees Apple's GL for its profile, not zink's 4.6: `GL_VERSION`, `GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION`,
  `GL_MAJOR/MINOR_VERSION` from Apple's own context (4.1 / 4.10 core, 2.1 / 1.20 legacy), and Apple's extensions without
  those zink lacks (`glGetString`, `glGetStringi`, `GL_NUM_EXTENSIONS`). OpenGL.framework exports nothing past 4.1, so an
  application told 4.6 took 4.4 paths through NULL pointers (GZDoom 4.14: `glBufferStorage`). `GL_VENDOR` names Intel.
- Retina: the surface is in pixels only when the view asks for it (`wantsBestResolutionOpenGLSurface`), as with Apple.
- The swap interval is Apple's context's own value (the application's, or Apple's default 1).
- Contexts Core Animation makes for a `CAOpenGLLayer`/`NSOpenGLLayer` (and the application's subclasses) stay on Apple's GL.

## What it does not

- MSAA: the B580 machine offers 78 multisampled EGL configs (up to 8 samples) and the layer asks for them; not yet
  checked in a window. Without one, a context asking for samples gets none (said once).
- `CGLTexImageIOSurface2D` copies the plane into the texture at the call (right for video textures,
  `CVOpenGLTextureCache`). A texture that is then attached to a framebuffer (`glFramebufferTexture2D`) is drawn into:
  its pixels are copied back into the IOSurface at every `glFlush`, `glFinish` and present (since 12 Nov; checked by
  `test/run.sh`'s "iosurface draw" case through the stand-in EGL, not yet on the B580). Copies both ways cost a
  read-back per flush; a change another process makes to the surface reaches the texture only when it is bound again.
  At most 64 IOSurface textures per process are tracked. `GL_YCBCR_422_APPLE` is refused.
- `CGLSetPBuffer` draws into an EGL pbuffer of the pbuffer's size; `CGLTexImagePBuffer` copies its pixels into the
  asking context's texture at the call (level 0 and face 0 only). Since 12 Nov, not yet run on the B580
  (`LAYERTEST_PBUFFER=1 ./layertest`; Apple's GL on Apple silicon no longer creates pbuffers, so compare on the B580).
- `CGLSetOffScreen` draws into an EGL pbuffer whose pixels are read into the application's memory at each `glFlush`,
  `glFinish` and `CGLFlushDrawable` (BGRA, OpenGL's row order; since 12 Nov, `LAYERTEST_OFFSCREEN=1 ./layertest` on the
  B580 compares the layout with Apple's software renderer). `kCGLCPSurfaceBackingSize` with `kCGLCESurfaceBackingSize`
  on fixes the layer's drawable size, scaled to the view by Core Animation (since 12 Nov, not yet seen in a window).
- `CGLCopyContext`, `kCGLCPSurfaceOpacity` 0, full screen CGL: said once, left to Apple's GL (so they show nothing
  through zink).
- `setView:` puts a layer over the view's own: what the application draws into the view with AppKit stays under it.
- `GL_RENDERER` is zink's (it names the Intel device). Version, GLSL version and extensions are Apple's (below).
- A context two threads use without locking: the second thread's calls are dropped after 100 ms (said once).
- Injection needs `DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES` to reach the process: true on this driver's setup (AMFI off) also for hardened
  and Apple applications. With AMFI off `launchctl setenv` passes `DYLD_*` too; the experimental switch for every
  application uses that (`../README.md`, or IntelXe Manager's Zink page with its list of applications). It is off by
  default; on the B580 (11 Nov 2026) Chess drew through it and TextEdit, Calculator, System Settings, Safari and
  1Password stayed on Apple's OpenGL.

Tested on the build Mac (macOS 27, arm64 and x86_64 under Rosetta) through the stand-in only: every hash equal to Apple's
GL, with and without zink's missing names. On the B580 the prototype ran Chess.app (5 Nov); this version ran GZDoom 4.14
(MAP01, uncapped: ~1910 fps, against ~1600 on Apple's GL; 9-10 Nov). The boot library (10 Nov), through the stand-in:
with `CGLZINK_GLOBAL_ANY=1` the layer adopts the contexts and the hashes equal Apple's; without it `layertest` stays
out. On the B580 (11 Nov 2026) with `install.sh --global-gl on`: as above.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// appleext.h (included by cglzink.m): Apple's own GL extensions that zink does not have, made from core functions.
//
// zink resolves 906 of the 975 entries of Apple's table (B580, 5 Nov 2026). Of the rest, applications written for the
// Mac call some without checking the extension string, because every Mac had them: GL_APPLE_vertex_array_object above
// all (the only VAO a 2.1 context on macOS has), GL_APPLE_fence, GL_APPLE_flush_render, GL_APPLE_element_array. Those
// get an implementation here; Apple's hints (texture range, vertex array range, buffer flushing) stay no-ops, which is
// correct: zink keeps the data coherent without them.

static void *core(const char *name) { return egl.GetProcAddress(name); }

// GL_APPLE_fence on GL 3.2 sync objects. Fence names are global to the process here, not per share group: they are
// only handed out by glGenFencesAPPLE, so two contexts never meet the same name.
static struct {
    pthread_mutex_t lock;
    GLsync *sync;
    unsigned char *used;
    GLuint size, next;
} fences = { PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER, NULL, NULL, 0, 1 };
static GLsync (*p_FenceSync)(GLenum, GLbitfield);
static GLenum (*p_ClientWaitSync)(GLsync, GLbitfield, GLuint64);
static void (*p_DeleteSync)(GLsync);
static void (*p_Finish)(void);

static GLsync *fence_slot(GLuint name, int create) {
    if (!name) return NULL;
    if (name >= fences.size) {
        if (!create) return NULL;
        GLuint size = fences.size ? fences.size : 64;
        while (size <= name) size *= 2;
        fences.sync = realloc(fences.sync, size * sizeof *fences.sync);
        fences.used = realloc(fences.used, size);
        memset(fences.sync + fences.size, 0, (size - fences.size) * sizeof *fences.sync);
        memset(fences.used + fences.size, 0, size - fences.size);
        fences.size = size;
    }
    if (!fences.used[name] && !create) return NULL;
    fences.used[name] = 1;
    return &fences.sync[name];
}

static void x_GenFencesAPPLE(GLsizei n, GLuint *out) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&fences.lock);
    for (GLsizei i = 0; i < n; i++) { out[i] = fences.next++; fence_slot(out[i], 1); }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&fences.lock);
}

static void x_DeleteFencesAPPLE(GLsizei n, const GLuint *names) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&fences.lock);
    for (GLsizei i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        GLsync *s = fence_slot(names[i], 0);
        if (!s) continue;
        if (*s) p_DeleteSync(*s);
        *s = NULL;
        fences.used[names[i]] = 0;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&fences.lock);
}

static void x_SetFenceAPPLE(GLuint name) {
    GLsync made = p_FenceSync(GL_SYNC_GPU_COMMANDS_COMPLETE, 0);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&fences.lock);
    GLsync *s = fence_slot(name, 1);
    GLsync old = s ? *s : NULL;
    if (s) *s = made;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&fences.lock);
    if (old) p_DeleteSync(old);
    if (!s && made) p_DeleteSync(made);
}

static GLsync fence_of(GLuint name) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&fences.lock);
    GLsync *s = fence_slot(name, 0);
    GLsync sync = s ? *s : NULL;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&fences.lock);
    return sync;
}

// A name that was generated but never set is not a fence yet (the spec's wording, from NV_fence)
static GLboolean x_IsFenceAPPLE(GLuint name) { return fence_of(name) != NULL; }

static GLboolean x_TestFenceAPPLE(GLuint name) {
    GLsync sync = fence_of(name);
    if (!sync) return GL_TRUE;
    // Flushing, so that an application polling this does not wait forever for work never sent
    GLenum r = p_ClientWaitSync(sync, GL_SYNC_FLUSH_COMMANDS_BIT, 0);
    return r == GL_ALREADY_SIGNALED || r == GL_CONDITION_SATISFIED;
}

static void x_FinishFenceAPPLE(GLuint name) {
    GLsync sync = fence_of(name);
    if (!sync) return;
    while (p_ClientWaitSync(sync, GL_SYNC_FLUSH_COMMANDS_BIT, 1000000000ull) == GL_TIMEOUT_EXPIRED) {}
}

// Per object: what Apple tracks per texture or buffer is not known here, so all work so far is waited for.
static GLboolean x_TestObjectAPPLE(GLenum object, GLuint name) { p_Finish(); return GL_TRUE; }
static void x_FinishObjectAPPLE(GLenum object, GLint name) { p_Finish(); }

// GL_APPLE_flush_render: glSwapAPPLE presents the current context as CGLFlushDrawable does.
static void x_SwapAPPLE(void) { present(t_current); }

// GL_APPLE_element_array: the element pointer is per context.
static void (*p_DrawElements)(GLenum, GLsizei, GLenum, const GLvoid *);
static void (*p_DrawRangeElements)(GLenum, GLuint, GLuint, GLsizei, GLenum, const GLvoid *);

static size_t element_size(GLenum type) { return type == GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE ? 1 : type == GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT ? 2 : 4; }

static void x_ElementPointerAPPLE(GLenum type, const GLvoid *pointer) {
    if (!t_current) return;
    t_current->element_type = type;
    t_current->element_pointer = pointer;
}

static const GLvoid *element_at(GLint first) {
    return (const char *)t_current->element_pointer + (size_t)first * element_size(t_current->element_type);
}

static void x_DrawElementArrayAPPLE(GLenum mode, GLint first, GLsizei count) {
    if (t_current) p_DrawElements(mode, count, t_current->element_type, element_at(first));
}

static void x_DrawRangeElementArrayAPPLE(GLenum mode, GLuint start, GLuint end, GLint first, GLsizei count) {
    if (t_current) p_DrawRangeElements(mode, start, end, count, t_current->element_type, element_at(first));
}

static void x_MultiDrawElementArrayAPPLE(GLenum mode, const GLint *first, const GLsizei *count, GLsizei n) {
    for (GLsizei i = 0; t_current && i < n; i++) p_DrawElements(mode, count[i], t_current->element_type, element_at(first[i]));
}

static void x_MultiDrawRangeElementArrayAPPLE(GLenum mode, GLuint start, GLuint end, const GLint *first, const GLsizei *count, GLsizei n) {
    for (GLsizei i = 0; t_current && i < n; i++)
        p_DrawRangeElements(mode, start, end, count[i], t_current->element_type, element_at(first[i]));
}

// GL_APPLE_object_purgeable: nothing is ever purged, so the contents are always kept.
static GLenum x_ObjectPurgeableAPPLE(GLenum type, GLuint name, GLenum option) { return 0x8A1A; /* GL_VOLATILE_APPLE */ }
static GLenum x_ObjectUnpurgeableAPPLE(GLenum type, GLuint name, GLenum option) { return 0x8A1B; /* GL_RETAINED_APPLE */ }
static void x_GetObjectParameterivAPPLE(GLenum type, GLuint name, GLenum pname, GLint *params) { if (params) *params = GL_FALSE; }
// GL_APPLE_texture_range: no client storage pointer
static void x_GetTexParameterPointervAPPLE(GLenum target, GLenum pname, GLvoid **params) { if (params) *params = NULL; }

// GL_EXT_debug_marker on KHR_debug
static void (*p_PushDebugGroup)(GLenum, GLuint, GLsizei, const GLchar *);
static void (*p_PopDebugGroup)(void);
static void (*p_DebugMessageInsert)(GLenum, GLenum, GLuint, GLenum, GLsizei, const GLchar *);
static void x_PushGroupMarkerEXT(GLsizei length, const GLchar *marker) { p_PushDebugGroup(0x824A, 0, length ? length : -1, marker ? marker : ""); }
static void x_PopGroupMarkerEXT(void) { p_PopDebugGroup(); }
static void x_InsertEventMarkerEXT(GLsizei length, const GLchar *marker) {
    p_DebugMessageInsert(0x824A /* APPLICATION */, 0x8268 /* MARKER */, 0, 0x826B /* NOTIFICATION */, length ? length : -1, marker ? marker : "");
}

// GL_EXT_geometry_shader4's one face of a cube map, as a plain attachment of that face
static void (*p_FramebufferTexture2D)(GLenum, GLenum, GLenum, GLuint, GLint);
static void x_FramebufferTextureFaceEXT(GLenum target, GLenum attachment, GLuint texture, GLint level, GLenum face) {
    p_FramebufferTexture2D(target, attachment, face, texture, level);
}

// The replacement for an entry zink does not resolve, or NULL.
static void *apple_extension(const char *name) {
    static const struct { const char *apple, *core; } same[] = {
        // the same functions under core names; APPLE_vertex_array_object objects behave as core VAOs in a compatibility context
        { "glGenVertexArraysAPPLE", "glGenVertexArrays" }, { "glDeleteVertexArraysAPPLE", "glDeleteVertexArrays" },
        { "glBindVertexArrayAPPLE", "glBindVertexArray" }, { "glIsVertexArrayAPPLE", "glIsVertexArray" },
        { "glFlushRenderAPPLE", "glFlush" }, { "glFinishRenderAPPLE", "glFinish" },
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof same / sizeof *same; i++)
        if (!strcmp(name, same[i].apple)) return core(same[i].core);
#define NEED(p, n) (p || (*(void **)&p = core(n)))
    static const struct { const char *name; void *fn; } made[] = {
        { "glGenFencesAPPLE", x_GenFencesAPPLE }, { "glDeleteFencesAPPLE", x_DeleteFencesAPPLE },
        { "glSetFenceAPPLE", x_SetFenceAPPLE }, { "glIsFenceAPPLE", x_IsFenceAPPLE },
        { "glTestFenceAPPLE", x_TestFenceAPPLE }, { "glFinishFenceAPPLE", x_FinishFenceAPPLE },
        { "glTestObjectAPPLE", x_TestObjectAPPLE }, { "glFinishObjectAPPLE", x_FinishObjectAPPLE },
        { "glSwapAPPLE", x_SwapAPPLE },
        { "glElementPointerAPPLE", x_ElementPointerAPPLE }, { "glDrawElementArrayAPPLE", x_DrawElementArrayAPPLE },
        { "glDrawRangeElementArrayAPPLE", x_DrawRangeElementArrayAPPLE },
        { "glMultiDrawElementArrayAPPLE", x_MultiDrawElementArrayAPPLE },
        { "glMultiDrawRangeElementArrayAPPLE", x_MultiDrawRangeElementArrayAPPLE },
        { "glObjectPurgeableAPPLE", x_ObjectPurgeableAPPLE }, { "glObjectUnpurgeableAPPLE", x_ObjectUnpurgeableAPPLE },
        { "glGetObjectParameterivAPPLE", x_GetObjectParameterivAPPLE },
        { "glGetTexParameterPointervAPPLE", x_GetTexParameterPointervAPPLE },
        { "glPushGroupMarkerEXT", x_PushGroupMarkerEXT }, { "glPopGroupMarkerEXT", x_PopGroupMarkerEXT },
        { "glInsertEventMarkerEXT", x_InsertEventMarkerEXT },
        { "glFramebufferTextureFaceEXT", x_FramebufferTextureFaceEXT },
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof made / sizeof *made; i++) {
        if (strcmp(name, made[i].name)) continue;
        // the core functions each one needs; without them the entry stays empty
        if (strstr(name, "Fence") || strstr(name, "TestObject") || strstr(name, "FinishObject")) {
            if (!NEED(p_FenceSync, "glFenceSync") || !NEED(p_ClientWaitSync, "glClientWaitSync") ||
                !NEED(p_DeleteSync, "glDeleteSync") || !NEED(p_Finish, "glFinish")) return NULL;
        } else if (strstr(name, "ElementArray")) {
            if (!NEED(p_DrawElements, "glDrawElements") || !NEED(p_DrawRangeElements, "glDrawRangeElements")) return NULL;
        } else if (strstr(name, "Marker")) {
            if (!NEED(p_PushDebugGroup, "glPushDebugGroup") || !NEED(p_PopDebugGroup, "glPopDebugGroup") ||
                !NEED(p_DebugMessageInsert, "glDebugMessageInsert")) return NULL;
        } else if (strstr(name, "FramebufferTextureFace")) {
            if (!NEED(p_FramebufferTexture2D, "glFramebufferTexture2D")) return NULL;
        }
        return made[i].fn;
    }
#undef NEED
    return NULL;
}

FILE: zink-gl/cgl/appleview.h
