// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// appleview.h (included by cglzink.m): what an application asks about its context is answered as Apple's GL answers it.
//
// An application on macOS resolves GL functions from OpenGL.framework, which exports up to 4.1 and Apple's extensions. zink
// says 4.6 with GL_ARB_buffer_storage and the rest: GZDoom 4.14 then took its 4.4 path and called glBufferStorage through
// a NULL pointer (B580, 9 Nov 2026). So, per context, from Apple's own context of the same profile:
//   GL_VERSION, GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION   Apple's strings (4.1 / 4.10 core, 2.1 / 1.20 legacy)
//   GL_MAJOR_VERSION, GL_MINOR_VERSION        read from that version
//   GL_EXTENSIONS (string and glGetStringi), GL_NUM_EXTENSIONS
//                                             Apple's list, without what zink lacks, with what appleext.h makes
//   GL_VENDOR                                 zink's if it names Intel, else "Intel Inc." (applications pick paths by it)
//   GL_RENDERER                               zink's (it names the Intel device)
// Nothing here exports gl* symbols, and neither do Mesa's libraries: dlsym finds no 4.2+ function either.

typedef struct AppleView {
    char *version, *glsl;
    int major, minor;
    char **apple;              // Apple's extensions for this profile
    int napple;
    char **ext;                // what the application is told: built at the first query, with the context bound
    int next;
    char *joined;
    int built;
} AppleView;

static const GLubyte *(*z_GetString)(GLenum);
static const GLubyte *(*z_GetStringi)(GLenum, GLuint);
static void (*z_GetIntegerv)(GLenum, GLint *);
static void (*z_GetInteger64v)(GLenum, GLint64 *);
static pthread_mutex_t g_view_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static void view_add(char ***list, int *n, const char *name) {
    if (!(*n & 63)) *list = realloc(*list, (*n + 64) * sizeof **list);
    (*list)[(*n)++] = strdup(name);
}

static void view_split(char ***list, int *n, const char *joined) {
    char *copy = strdup(joined ? joined : ""), *save = NULL;
    for (char *t = strtok_r(copy, " ", &save); t; t = strtok_r(NULL, " ", &save)) view_add(list, n, t);
    free(copy);
}

// From Apple's context (not current: its entries take the context, as CGLMacro.h uses them), before its table is replaced.
static AppleView *view_from_apple(CGLContextObj cgl, int core) {
    AppleView *v = calloc(1, sizeof *v);
    GLIContext r = cgl->rend;
    const char *version = (const char *)cgl->disp.get_string(r, GL_VERSION);
    const char *glsl = (const char *)cgl->disp.get_string(r, GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION);
    v->version = strdup(version ? version : core ? "4.1 zink" : "2.1 zink");
    v->glsl = strdup(glsl ? glsl : core ? "4.10" : "1.20");
    if (sscanf(v->version, "%d.%d", &v->major, &v->minor) != 2) { v->major = core ? 4 : 2; v->minor = 1; }
    if (core) {
        GLint n = 0;
        cgl->disp.get_integerv(r, GL_NUM_EXTENSIONS, &n);
        for (GLint i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const char *e = (const char *)cgl->disp.get_stringi(r, GL_EXTENSIONS, (GLuint)i);
            if (e) view_add(&v->apple, &v->napple, e);
        }
    } else {
        view_split(&v->apple, &v->napple, (const char *)cgl->disp.get_string(r, GL_EXTENSIONS));
    }
    return v;
}

// An extension of Apple's that appleext.h makes from core functions: kept when its function was made.
static int view_made(const char *e) {
    static const struct { const char *ext, *fn; } made[] = {
        { "GL_APPLE_vertex_array_object", "glBindVertexArrayAPPLE" }, { "GL_APPLE_fence", "glSetFenceAPPLE" },
        { "GL_APPLE_element_array", "glDrawElementArrayAPPLE" }, { "GL_APPLE_flush_render", "glSwapAPPLE" },
        { "GL_APPLE_object_purgeable", "glObjectPurgeableAPPLE" }, { "GL_EXT_debug_marker", "glPushGroupMarkerEXT" },
        { "GL_APPLE_flush_buffer_range", NULL },   // its two functions are hints; the data is right without them
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof made / sizeof *made; i++) {
        if (strcmp(e, made[i].ext)) continue;
        if (!made[i].fn) return 1;
        for (int k = 0; k < CGLT_N; k++)
            if (cglt_names[k] && !strcmp(cglt_names[k], made[i].fn)) return cglt_backend[k] != (void *)missing_entry;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void view_build(AppleView *v) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_view_lock);
    if (!v->built) {
        char **zink = NULL;
        int nzink = 0;
        GLint n = 0;
        z_GetIntegerv(GL_NUM_EXTENSIONS, &n);
        for (GLint i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const char *e = (const char *)z_GetStringi(GL_EXTENSIONS, (GLuint)i);
            if (e) view_add(&zink, &nzink, e);
        }
        if (!nzink) view_split(&zink, &nzink, (const char *)z_GetString(GL_EXTENSIONS));
        size_t length = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < v->napple; i++) {
            int keep = view_made(v->apple[i]);
            for (int k = 0; k < nzink && !keep; k++) keep = !strcmp(zink[k], v->apple[i]);
            if (keep) { view_add(&v->ext, &v->next, v->apple[i]); length += strlen(v->apple[i]) + 1; }
        }
        v->joined = calloc(1, length);
        for (int i = 0; i < v->next; i++) { strcat(v->joined, v->ext[i]); strcat(v->joined, " "); }
        LOG("extensions: Apple %d, zink %d, told %d", v->napple, nzink, v->next);
        for (int k = 0; k < nzink; k++) free(zink[k]);
        free(zink);
        v->built = 1;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_view_lock);
}

static AppleView *current_view(void);

static const GLubyte *x_GetString(GLenum name) {
    AppleView *v = current_view();
    if (v) {
        switch (name) {
        case GL_VERSION: return (const GLubyte *)v->version;
        case GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION: return (const GLubyte *)v->glsl;
        case GL_VENDOR: {
            const char *vendor = (const char *)z_GetString(GL_VENDOR);
            return (const GLubyte *)(vendor && strstr(vendor, "Intel") ? vendor : "Intel Inc.");
        }
        case GL_EXTENSIONS: {
            const GLubyte *zink = z_GetString(GL_EXTENSIONS);   // NULL and GL_INVALID_ENUM in a core context, as Apple's
            if (!zink) return NULL;
            view_build(v);
            return (const GLubyte *)v->joined;
        }
        }
    }
    return z_GetString(name);
}

static const GLubyte *x_GetStringi(GLenum name, GLuint index) {
    AppleView *v = current_view();
    if (v && name == GL_EXTENSIONS) {
        view_build(v);
        if (index < (GLuint)v->next) return (const GLubyte *)v->ext[index];
        return z_GetStringi(name, 0xFFFFFFFFu);   // past the end: GL_INVALID_VALUE from zink
    }
    return z_GetStringi(name, index);
}

static int view_integer(AppleView *v, GLenum pname, GLint64 *out) {
    switch (pname) {
    case GL_MAJOR_VERSION: *out = v->major; return 1;
    case GL_MINOR_VERSION: *out = v->minor; return 1;
    case GL_NUM_EXTENSIONS: view_build(v); *out = v->next; return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void x_GetIntegerv(GLenum pname, GLint *params) {
    z_GetIntegerv(pname, params);
    if (__builtin_expect(pname != GL_MAJOR_VERSION && pname != GL_MINOR_VERSION && pname != GL_NUM_EXTENSIONS, 1)) return;
    AppleView *v = current_view();
    GLint64 value;
    if (v && params && view_integer(v, pname, &value)) *params = (GLint)value;
}

static void x_GetInteger64v(GLenum pname, GLint64 *params) {
    z_GetInteger64v(pname, params);
    AppleView *v = current_view();
    GLint64 value;
    if (v && params && view_integer(v, pname, &value)) *params = value;
}

// After the table is resolved: the four query entries go through the view.
static void view_install(void) {
    static const struct { const char *name; void **original; void *wrapper; } q[] = {
        { "glGetString", (void **)&z_GetString, (void *)x_GetString },
        { "glGetStringi", (void **)&z_GetStringi, (void *)x_GetStringi },
        { "glGetIntegerv", (void **)&z_GetIntegerv, (void *)x_GetIntegerv },
        { "glGetInteger64v", (void **)&z_GetInteger64v, (void *)x_GetInteger64v },
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof q / sizeof *q; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < CGLT_N; k++)
            if (cglt_names[k] && !strcmp(cglt_names[k], q[i].name) && cglt_backend[k] != (void *)missing_entry) {
                *q[i].original = cglt_backend[k];
                cglt_backend[k] = q[i].wrapper;
            }
    // all four or none: the strings and the numbers must agree
    if (!z_GetString || !z_GetStringi || !z_GetIntegerv || !z_GetInteger64v) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof q / sizeof *q; i++)
            for (int k = 0; k < CGLT_N; k++)
                if (cglt_backend[k] == q[i].wrapper) cglt_backend[k] = *q[i].original;
        LOG("version and extension queries are zink's own (a query entry is missing)");
    }
}

FILE: zink-gl/cgl/boot.c

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// libcglzink-boot.dylib: the experimental "every OpenGL application through zink" switch. zink-gl/install.sh
// --global-gl on makes a LaunchAgent put it into DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES of the login session (launchctl setenv), which
// macOS honours on the B580 machines because the driver boots with amfi_get_out_of_my_way=0x1. It is then in every
// process the session starts, so it is small and decides at once:
//   - it is plain C (CoreFoundation for the bundle id, OpenGL for the entry points it interposes), never AppKit;
//   - it takes part only in an application bundle (the executable under .app/Contents/MacOS/) that is not Apple's
//     (except the ones allowed below), not a browser, Electron/Chromium app or video player, and not refused in
//     /Library/IntelXe/GL/cglzink-global.txt ("-bundle.id" refuses, "+bundle.id" allows one of Apple's or a listed one);
//   - then it loads libcglzink.dylib with dlopen and hands the CGL calls to its table (cglzink_hooks.h); otherwise
//     every call goes straight to Apple's OpenGL;
//   - it removes DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES from the process's environment, so the processes it starts itself do not
//     inherit it (those launchd starts get it again from the session, and decide for themselves).
// libcglzink calls Apple's CGL from inside these calls; dyld applies this library's interposing to libcglzink too, so
// a per-thread depth sends those nested calls to Apple's functions instead of back into libcglzink.
// Tests and diagnosis: CGLZINK_GLOBAL_OFF=1 (never take part), CGLZINK_GLOBAL_ANY=1 (also outside an application
// bundle: test/run.sh), CGLZINK_LIB=<path> (another libcglzink), CGLZINK_LOG=1 (why it took part or not, on stderr).
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <OpenGL/OpenGL.h>
#include <OpenGL/CGLIOSurface.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <mach-o/dyld.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include "cglzink_hooks.h"

static const struct cglzink_hooks *H;   // set once, in the constructor, before the application runs
static __thread int depth;

#define BLOG(...) do { if (getenv("CGLZINK_LOG")) { fprintf(stderr, "cglzink-boot: " __VA_ARGS__); fputc('\n', stderr); } } while (0)

// Apple's applications that draw with OpenGL and work through zink (tested on the B580); every other com.apple.* stays
static const char *const kAppleAllowed[] = { "com.apple.Chess" };
// never: browsers and Chromium/Electron (they draw with Metal or into IOSurfaces), video players (CAOpenGLLayer),
// the system's interface (it must not depend on an experimental layer)
static const char *const kRefused[] = {
    "org.mozilla.firefox", "com.google.Chrome", "com.microsoft.edgemac", "com.brave.Browser", "company.thebrowser.Browser",
    "com.operasoftware.Opera", "com.vivaldi.Vivaldi", "com.colliderli.iina", "io.mpv", "org.videolan.vlc",
    "io.github.yusufklncc.IntelXeManager",
};

static int listed(const char *id, const char *const *list, size_t n) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!strcmp(id, list[i])) return 1;
    return 0;
}

// /Library/IntelXe/GL/cglzink-global.txt: one "+id" or "-id" per line, # comments. 1 allowed, -1 refused, 0 not listed.
static int config_says(const char *id) {
    FILE *f = fopen("/Library/IntelXe/GL/cglzink-global.txt", "r");
    if (!f) return 0;
    char line[256];
    int r = 0;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        line[strcspn(line, "\r\n# \t")] = 0;
        if ((line[0] == '+' || line[0] == '-') && !strcmp(line + 1, id)) r = line[0] == '+' ? 1 : -1;
    }
    fclose(f);
    return r;
}

static int electron_like(const char *exe) {
    // .../X.app/Contents/MacOS/X -> .../X.app/Contents/Frameworks/{Electron Framework,Chromium Embedded Framework}.framework
    char base[PATH_MAX];
    const char *m = strstr(exe, ".app/Contents/MacOS/");
    if (!m || (size_t)(m - exe) + 14 >= sizeof base) return 0;
    size_t n = (size_t)(m - exe) + 14;   // up to and including "Contents/"
    memcpy(base, exe, n);
    base[n] = 0;
    static const char *const fw[] = { "Frameworks/Electron Framework.framework", "Frameworks/Chromium Embedded Framework.framework" };
    struct stat st;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        char p[PATH_MAX];
        if (snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s%s", base, fw[i]) < (int)sizeof p && stat(p, &st) == 0) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int should_take_part(void) {
    if (getenv("CGLZINK_GLOBAL_OFF") || getenv("CGLZINK_OFF")) { BLOG("off (environment)"); return 0; }
    char exe[PATH_MAX];
    uint32_t size = sizeof exe;
    if (_NSGetExecutablePath(exe, &size) != 0) return 0;
    const int any = getenv("CGLZINK_GLOBAL_ANY") != NULL;
    if (!strstr(exe, ".app/Contents/MacOS/") && !any) return 0;   // not an application: quietly out
    char id[256] = "";
    CFBundleRef b = CFBundleGetMainBundle();
    CFStringRef s = b ? CFBundleGetIdentifier(b) : NULL;
    if (s) CFStringGetCString(s, id, sizeof id, kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
    if (!id[0] && !any) { BLOG("%s: no bundle id", exe); return 0; }
    const int conf = id[0] ? config_says(id) : 0;
    if (conf < 0) { BLOG("%s: refused in cglzink-global.txt", id); return 0; }
    if (conf == 0) {
        if (listed(id, kRefused, sizeof kRefused / sizeof *kRefused)) { BLOG("%s: on the built-in refusal list", id); return 0; }
        if (!strncmp(id, "com.apple.", 10) && !listed(id, kAppleAllowed, sizeof kAppleAllowed / sizeof *kAppleAllowed)) {
            BLOG("%s: Apple's, not on the allowed list", id); return 0;
        }
        if (electron_like(exe)) { BLOG("%s: Electron/Chromium", id); return 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

__attribute__((constructor)) static void boot(void) {
    // the processes this one starts do not inherit the insertion from it
    const char *ins = getenv("DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES");
    if (ins && strstr(ins, "libcglzink-boot")) unsetenv("DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES");
    if (!should_take_part()) return;
    const char *lib = getenv("CGLZINK_LIB");
    if (!lib) lib = "/Library/IntelXe/GL/libcglzink.dylib";
    void *h = dlopen(lib, RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
    if (!h) { BLOG("cannot load %s: %s", lib, dlerror()); return; }
    const struct cglzink_hooks *t = (const struct cglzink_hooks *)dlsym(h, "cglzink_hooks");
    if (!t || t->version != CGLZINK_HOOKS_VERSION || t->size < sizeof *t) {
        BLOG("%s has no matching cglzink_hooks (version %u)", lib, t ? t->version : 0);
        return;   // libcglzink stays loaded but unused: its own constructor only watches for AppKit
    }
    H = t;
    BLOG("taking part through %s", lib);
}

// Every interposed call: libcglzink's version on the outermost level when it is loaded, Apple's otherwise.
#define HOOK(ret, name, params, args) \
    static ret b_##name params { \
        if (H && !depth) { depth++; ret hook_result_ = H->name args; depth--; return hook_result_; } \
        return CGL##name args; \
    }
HOOK(CGLError, CreateContext, (CGLPixelFormatObj p, CGLContextObj s, CGLContextObj *o), (p, s, o))
HOOK(CGLError, DestroyContext, (CGLContextObj c), (c))
HOOK(CGLError, SetCurrentContext, (CGLContextObj c), (c))
HOOK(CGLError, LockContext, (CGLContextObj c), (c))
HOOK(CGLError, UnlockContext, (CGLContextObj c), (c))
HOOK(CGLError, FlushDrawable, (CGLContextObj c), (c))
HOOK(CGLError, SetParameter, (CGLContextObj c, CGLContextParameter n, const GLint *v), (c, n, v))
HOOK(CGLError, TexImageIOSurface2D, (CGLContextObj c, GLenum t, GLenum i, GLsizei w, GLsizei h, GLenum f, GLenum ty,
    IOSurfaceRef s, GLuint pl), (c, t, i, w, h, f, ty, s, pl))
HOOK(CGLError, ClearDrawable, (CGLContextObj c), (c))
HOOK(CGLError, UpdateContext, (CGLContextObj c), (c))
HOOK(CGLError, SetPBuffer, (CGLContextObj c, CGLPBufferObj p, GLenum f, GLint l, GLint s), (c, p, f, l, s))
HOOK(CGLError, SetOffScreen, (CGLContextObj c, GLsizei w, GLsizei h, GLint r, void *b), (c, w, h, r, b))
HOOK(CGLError, CopyContext, (CGLContextObj s, CGLContextObj d, GLbitfield m), (s, d, m))
HOOK(CGLError, TexImagePBuffer, (CGLContextObj c, CGLPBufferObj p, GLenum s), (c, p, s))
static void b_ReleaseContext(CGLContextObj c) {
    if (H && !depth) { depth++; H->ReleaseContext(c); depth--; return; }
    CGLReleaseContext(c);
}

#define INTERPOSE(name) \
    __attribute__((used, section("__DATA,__interpose"))) static struct { const void *a, *b; } \
    interpose_##name = { (const void *)b_##name, (const void *)CGL##name }
INTERPOSE(CreateContext);
INTERPOSE(DestroyContext);
INTERPOSE(ReleaseContext);
INTERPOSE(SetCurrentContext);
INTERPOSE(LockContext);
INTERPOSE(UnlockContext);
INTERPOSE(FlushDrawable);
INTERPOSE(SetParameter);
INTERPOSE(TexImageIOSurface2D);
INTERPOSE(ClearDrawable);
INTERPOSE(UpdateContext);
INTERPOSE(SetPBuffer);
INTERPOSE(SetOffScreen);
INTERPOSE(CopyContext);
INTERPOSE(TexImagePBuffer);

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# build.sh ARCH OUTDIR: libcglzink.dylib, libcglzink-boot.dylib, IntelXeGL (the LaunchAgents' helper), and for the tests the stand-in EGL and layertest (test/run.sh runs them).
# ARCH x86_64 for the B580 machine; arm64 for tests on an Apple silicon Mac. Builds on the build Mac (needs the SDK:
# gen/gen.py reads gliDispatch.h), not on the B580 machine.
set -euo pipefail
A=${1:?usage: build.sh x86_64|arm64 OUTDIR}; O=${2:?usage: build.sh ARCH OUTDIR}
D=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd); mkdir -p "$O"
/usr/bin/python3 -I "$D/gen/gen.py" "$O/gen" >/dev/null
cp "$D/gen/backend_names.h" "$O/gen/"
F=(-arch "$A" -mmacosx-version-min=15.0 -O2 -Wall -Wno-deprecated-declarations -Wno-unused-function -I"$O/gen" -I"$D")
clang "${F[@]}" -dynamiclib "$D/cglzink.m" -framework OpenGL -framework AppKit -framework QuartzCore -framework IOSurface \
    -install_name /Library/IntelXe/GL/libcglzink.dylib -o "$O/libcglzink.dylib"
# the "every OpenGL application" switch's boot library: C, CoreFoundation and OpenGL only (it is in every process)
clang "${F[@]}" -dynamiclib "$D/boot.c" -framework CoreFoundation -framework OpenGL \
    -install_name /Library/IntelXe/GL/libcglzink-boot.dylib -o "$O/libcglzink-boot.dylib"
# what the LaunchAgents run (macOS names it in its "can run in the background" notice)
clang "${F[@]}" "$D/intelxegl.c" -o "$O/IntelXeGL"
clang "${F[@]}" -w -dynamiclib "$D/test/fakeegl.c" -framework OpenGL -o "$O/libfakeegl.dylib"
clang "${F[@]}" -w "$D/test/layertest.m" -framework OpenGL -framework AppKit -framework QuartzCore -framework IOSurface -o "$O/layertest"
# ad-hoc signatures: the x86_64 linker does not sign by itself, and install.sh refuses unsigned libraries
for f in "$O/libcglzink.dylib" "$O/libcglzink-boot.dylib" "$O/IntelXeGL" "$O/libfakeegl.dylib" "$O/layertest"; do codesign -s - -f "$f" 2>/dev/null; done
for f in "$O/libcglzink.dylib" "$O/libcglzink-boot.dylib"; do lipo -archs "$f"; done

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// The table libcglzink.dylib exports for libcglzink-boot.dylib (the "every OpenGL application" switch). Inserted into a
// process (DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES), libcglzink interposes Apple's CGL entry points itself; loaded by the boot library with
// dlopen it cannot (dyld applies the __interpose tuples of inserted images only), so the boot library interposes them
// and calls these. Bump CGLZINK_HOOKS_VERSION when a member changes.
#ifndef CGLZINK_HOOKS_H
#define CGLZINK_HOOKS_H
#include <OpenGL/OpenGL.h>
#include <OpenGL/CGLIOSurface.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define CGLZINK_HOOKS_VERSION 2   // 2: TexImagePBuffer

struct cglzink_hooks {
    uint32_t version, size;
    CGLError (*CreateContext)(CGLPixelFormatObj, CGLContextObj, CGLContextObj *);
    CGLError (*DestroyContext)(CGLContextObj);
    void (*ReleaseContext)(CGLContextObj);
    CGLError (*SetCurrentContext)(CGLContextObj);
    CGLError (*LockContext)(CGLContextObj);
    CGLError (*UnlockContext)(CGLContextObj);
    CGLError (*FlushDrawable)(CGLContextObj);
    CGLError (*SetParameter)(CGLContextObj, CGLContextParameter, const GLint *);
    CGLError (*TexImageIOSurface2D)(CGLContextObj, GLenum, GLenum, GLsizei, GLsizei, GLenum, GLenum, IOSurfaceRef, GLuint);
    CGLError (*ClearDrawable)(CGLContextObj);
    CGLError (*UpdateContext)(CGLContextObj);
    CGLError (*SetPBuffer)(CGLContextObj, CGLPBufferObj, GLenum, GLint, GLint);
    CGLError (*SetOffScreen)(CGLContextObj, GLsizei, GLsizei, GLint, void *);
    CGLError (*CopyContext)(CGLContextObj, CGLContextObj, GLbitfield);
    CGLError (*TexImagePBuffer)(CGLContextObj, CGLPBufferObj, GLenum);
};

#endif

FILE: zink-gl/cgl/intelxegl.c
================================================
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// IntelXeGL: what the zink-gl LaunchAgents run at login, so that macOS's "can run in the background" notice and the
// Login Items list name IntelXe's OpenGL component instead of "sh" or "launchctl" (macOS shows the executable's name).
//
//   IntelXeGL setenv NAME VALUE [FILE...]   launchctl setenv NAME VALUE, only when every FILE exists
//
// install.sh --global (JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS) and --global-gl (DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, only while libcglzink-boot and
// libcglzink are both there: an inserted library that is missing stops every application from starting) use it.
#include <spawn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>

extern char **environ;

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    if (argc < 4 || strcmp(argv[1], "setenv") != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: IntelXeGL setenv NAME VALUE [FILE...]\n");
        return 2;
    }
    for (int i = 4; i < argc; i++) {
        struct stat st;
        if (stat(argv[i], &st) != 0 || !S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "IntelXeGL: %s is missing; %s not set\n", argv[i], argv[2]);
            return 0;
        }
    }
    char *args[] = { "launchctl", "setenv", argv[2], argv[3], NULL };
    pid_t pid;
    int rc = posix_spawn(&pid, "/bin/launchctl", NULL, NULL, args, environ);
    if (rc != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "IntelXeGL: cannot run launchctl: %s\n", strerror(rc));
        return 1;
    }
    int status = 0;
    if (waitpid(pid, &status, 0) < 0) return 1;
    return WIFEXITED(status) ? WEXITSTATUS(status) : 1;
}

FILE: zink-gl/cgl/gen/README.md
================================================
# CGL dispatch thunks (generator for `../cglzink.m`)

`gl*` calls go through the current CGL context's table (`CGLContextObj->disp`, declared in the SDK's `gliDispatch.h`). These
files make a table whose entries drop the `GLIContext` argument and call a backend such as zink. `../build.sh` runs `gen.py`;
`map.tsv` and `backend_names.h` are measured once and kept here. Research notes: hackintosh tree,
`docs/reports/b580-zink-cgl-research-20261105.md`.

- `gen.py OUT`: from the SDK's `gliDispatch.h` and libGL's exports: `thunks.h` (used by the build), `fake_backend.h` (the
  test stand-in), `map.c`, `check.c`.
- `thunks.h` also holds, under `#ifdef CGLT_MARK`, a marking wrapper per entry (`cglt_mark_table`: runs `CGLT_MARK(i)`,
  then the entry it replaced, `cglt_marked[i]`); `../cglzink.m` puts the pixel-writing entries behind them for
  `CGLZINK_SURF_WRITEBACK=dirty` (the default; not with `flush`).
- `map.c` → `map.tsv`: measured with a numbered trap in every entry: which symbol reaches which entry (1254 of 1275 symbols
  reach 964 entries; arm64 and x86_64 identical).
- `names.py map.tsv thunks.h > backend_names.h`: the GL name a backend resolves for each entry (the core name preferred).
- `check.c`: renders a shader, texture and FBO directly and through the thunks and compares the pixels.
  Build: `clang -arch x86_64 -O1 -w check.c -framework OpenGL -o check`.

Rebuild `map.tsv` and `backend_names.h` only after a macOS update changes the table (`check.c` says "table size differs").



================================================
FILE: zink-gl/cgl/gen/gen.py
================================================
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""gen.py OUTDIR: from the SDK's gliDispatch.h and libGL's exports generate
  map.c       measures which gl* symbol goes to which dispatch entry (a numbered trap in every entry, call every symbol)
  thunks.h    one thunk per entry: same signature as the table (GLIContext first), calls backend[i] without the GLIContext
  check.c     a test backend: backend[i] puts the context back and calls Apple's original entry, then a real rendering
  fake_backend.h  the same backend for ../cgl-zink/fakeegl.c
The GL names a backend (zink) needs come from map.tsv, which map.c writes."""
import os, re, subprocess, sys
out = sys.argv[1]; os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
sdk = subprocess.check_output(['xcrun', '--show-sdk-path'], text=True).strip()
h = open(f'{sdk}/System/Library/Frameworks/OpenGL.framework/Headers/gliDispatch.h').read()
body = h[h.index('typedef struct __GLIFunctionDispatchRec'):]; body = body[body.index('{') + 1:body.index('} GLIFunctionDispatch')]
body = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', body, flags=re.S); body = re.sub(r'//[^\n]*', '', body)
entries = []
for m in re.finditer(r'([A-Za-z_][\w \*]*?)\s*\(\s*\*\s*(\w+)\s*\)\s*\((.*?)\)\s*;', body, re.S):
    ret, name, args = ' '.join(m.group(1).split()), m.group(2), ' '.join(m.group(3).split())
    parts = [a.strip() for a in args.split(',')]
    assert parts[0].startswith('GLIContext'), name
    rest = []
    for i, a in enumerate(parts[1:]):
        if a == 'void': continue
        am = re.match(r'^(.*?)(\w+)\s*(\[[^\]]*\])?$', a)
        t, n, arr = am.group(1).strip(), am.group(2), am.group(3) or ''
        if not t: t, n = n, f'a{i}'                      # a parameter with no name
        rest.append((t + (' *' if arr else ''), n))
    entries.append((ret, name, rest))
n = len(entries)
print(f'{n} entries')
exports = subprocess.check_output(['dyld_info', '-exports', '/System/Library/Frameworks/OpenGL.framework/Versions/A/Libraries/libGL.dylib'], text=True)
syms = sorted({l.split()[1][1:] for l in exports.splitlines() if re.search(r'\s_gl[A-Z]', l)})
print(f'{len(syms)} gl symbols')
com = '#define GL_SILENCE_DEPRECATION\n#include <OpenGL/OpenGL.h>\n#include <OpenGL/CGLContext.h>\n#include <dlfcn.h>\n#include <stdio.h>\n#include <string.h>\n#include <stdint.h>\n'
with open(f'{out}/map.c', 'w') as f:
    f.write(com + '#include <setjmp.h>\n#include <signal.h>\nstatic volatile int hit; static sigjmp_buf jb;\n')
    f.write('static void onsig(int s) { siglongjmp(jb, 1); }\n')
    for i in range(n): f.write(f'static uintptr_t t{i}(void) {{ hit = {i}; return 0; }}\n')
    f.write('static void *traps[] = {' + ','.join(f't{i}' for i in range(n)) + '};\n')
    f.write('static const char *names[] = {' + ','.join(f'"{e[1]}"' for e in entries) + '};\n')
    f.write('static const char *syms[] = {' + ','.join(f'"{s}"' for s in syms) + '};\n')
    f.write('''int main(void) {
    CGLPixelFormatAttribute a[] = { kCGLPFAAccelerated, 0 }; CGLPixelFormatObj pf; GLint np; CGLChoosePixelFormat(a, &pf, &np);
    CGLContextObj c; CGLCreateContext(pf, 0, &c); CGLSetCurrentContext(c);
    if (sizeof c->disp != sizeof traps) { fprintf(stderr, "table %zu, generated %zu\\n", sizeof c->disp, sizeof traps); return 2; }
    GLIFunctionDispatch saved = c->disp; memcpy(&c->disp, traps, sizeof traps);
    signal(SIGSEGV, onsig); signal(SIGBUS, onsig); signal(SIGILL, onsig);
    int mapped = 0, other = 0, crash = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof syms / sizeof *syms; i++) {
        void (*f)(uintptr_t, uintptr_t, uintptr_t, uintptr_t) = (void (*)(uintptr_t, uintptr_t, uintptr_t, uintptr_t))dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, syms[i]);
        hit = -1;
        if (!f) { printf("%s\\tNOSYM\\n", syms[i]); other++; continue; }
        if (sigsetjmp(jb, 1)) { printf("%s\\tCRASH\\n", syms[i]); crash++; continue; }
        f(0, 0, 0, 0);
        if (hit >= 0) { printf("%s\\t%d\\t%s\\n", syms[i], hit, names[hit]); mapped++; } else { printf("%s\\tNOTABLE\\n", syms[i]); other++; }
    }
    c->disp = saved;
    fprintf(stderr, "symbols %zu: through the table %d, not through it %d, crashed %d\\n", sizeof syms / sizeof *syms, mapped, other, crash);
    return 0; }
''')
# GLhandleARB needs no conversion: Mesa built on macOS has it pointer-sized too (include/GL/glext.h, __APPLE__: unsigned long).
with open(f'{out}/thunks.h', 'w') as f:
    f.write('// generated by gen.py from gliDispatch.h: do not edit\n')
    f.write(f'#define CGLT_N {n}\nextern void *cglt_backend[CGLT_N];\n')
    for i, (ret, name, rest) in enumerate(entries):
        decl = ''.join(f', {t} {a}' for t, a in rest)
        types = ', '.join(t for t, a in rest) or 'void'
        call = ', '.join(a for t, a in rest)
        f.write(f'static {ret} cglt_{name}(GLIContext c_{decl}) {{ CGLT_ENTER(c_); {"return " if ret != "void" else ""}(({ret} (*)({types}))cglt_backend[{i}])({call}); }}\n')
    f.write('static void *cglt_table[CGLT_N] = {' + ','.join(f'(void *)cglt_{e[1]}' for e in entries) + '};\n')
    # Marking wrappers (only with CGLT_MARK defined): a backend entry put behind one runs CGLT_MARK(i) first, then the
    # entry it replaced (cglt_marked[i]). The layer uses them to note "this context drew" without touching other entries.
    f.write('#ifdef CGLT_MARK\nstatic void *cglt_marked[CGLT_N];\n')
    for i, (ret, name, rest) in enumerate(entries):
        decl = ', '.join(f'{t} {a}' for t, a in rest) or 'void'
        types = ', '.join(t for t, a in rest) or 'void'
        call = ', '.join(a for t, a in rest)
        f.write(f'static {ret} cglt_m_{name}({decl}) {{ CGLT_MARK({i}); {"return " if ret != "void" else ""}(({ret} (*)({types}))cglt_marked[{i}])({call}); }}\n')
    f.write('static void *cglt_mark_table[CGLT_N] = {' + ','.join(f'(void *)cglt_m_{e[1]}' for e in entries) + '};\n#endif\n')
def back_function(table, rend, ret, name, rest):
    """A backend function as a real GL would have it: no context; it calls Apple's entry of `table`."""
    decl = ', '.join(f'{t} {a}' for t, a in rest) or 'void'
    call = ''.join(f', {a}' for t, a in rest)
    return f'static {ret} back_{name}({decl}) {{ {"return " if ret != "void" else ""}{table}.{name}({rend}{call}); }}'
with open(f'{out}/fake_backend.h', 'w') as f:
    f.write('// generated by gen.py: test backend, the GL functions of Apple\'s context g_fake_table/g_fake_rend\n')
    for ret, name, rest in entries:
        f.write(back_function('(*g_fake_table)', 'g_fake_rend', ret, name, rest) + '\n')
    f.write('static void *fake_backs[] = {' + ','.join(f'(void *)back_{e[1]}' for e in entries) + '};\n')
with open(f'{out}/check.c', 'w') as f:
    f.write(com + '''#include <OpenGL/gl3.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
static GLIContext g_rend; static GLIFunctionDispatch g_orig; static uint64_t g_calls;
#define CGLT_ENTER(c) do { g_calls++; } while (0)
#include "thunks.h"
void *cglt_backend[CGLT_N];
''')
    for i, (ret, name, rest) in enumerate(entries):
        f.write(back_function('g_orig', 'g_rend', ret, name, rest) + '\n')
    f.write('static void *backs[CGLT_N] = {' + ','.join(f'(void *)back_{e[1]}' for e in entries) + '};\n')
    f.write(r'''
static const char *VS = "#version 410 core\nout vec2 uv; void main(){ vec2 p[3]=vec2[](vec2(-1,-1),vec2(3,-1),vec2(-1,3)); gl_Position=vec4(p[gl_VertexID],0,1); uv=p[gl_VertexID]; }\n";
static const char *FS = "#version 410 core\nin vec2 uv; uniform vec4 k; uniform sampler2D t; layout(location=0) out vec4 o; void main(){ o = k*vec4(uv*0.5+0.5, 0.25, 1) + 0.5*texture(t, uv*0.5+0.5); }\n";
static uint64_t render(GLubyte *px) {
    GLuint v = glCreateShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER), f = glCreateShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER), p = glCreateProgram(); GLint ok = 0; char log[512];
    glShaderSource(v, 1, &VS, 0); glCompileShader(v); glGetShaderiv(v, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &ok); if (!ok) { glGetShaderInfoLog(v, 512, 0, log); printf("vs: %s\n", log); }
    glShaderSource(f, 1, &FS, 0); glCompileShader(f); glGetShaderiv(f, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &ok); if (!ok) { glGetShaderInfoLog(f, 512, 0, log); printf("fs: %s\n", log); }
    glAttachShader(p, v); glAttachShader(p, f); glLinkProgram(p); glGetProgramiv(p, GL_LINK_STATUS, &ok); if (!ok) printf("link failed\n");
    GLuint tex, fbo, rb, vao; GLubyte tp[16] = { 255,0,0,255, 0,255,0,255, 0,0,255,255, 255,255,255,255 };
    glGenTextures(1, &tex); glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, tex); glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA8, 2, 2, 0, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, tp);
    glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR); glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    glGenRenderbuffers(1, &rb); glBindRenderbuffer(GL_RENDERBUFFER, rb); glRenderbufferStorage(GL_RENDERBUFFER, GL_RGBA8, 64, 64);
    glGenFramebuffers(1, &fbo); glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, fbo); glFramebufferRenderbuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, GL_RENDERBUFFER, rb);
    if (glCheckFramebufferStatus(GL_FRAMEBUFFER) != GL_FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE) printf("fbo incomplete\n");
    glGenVertexArrays(1, &vao); glBindVertexArray(vao); glViewport(0, 0, 64, 64); glClearColor(0.1f, 0.2f, 0.3f, 1); glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    glUseProgram(p); glUniform4f(glGetUniformLocation(p, "k"), 1.0f, 0.5f, 0.75f, 1.0f); glUniform1i(glGetUniformLocation(p, "t"), 0);
    glDrawArrays(GL_TRIANGLES, 0, 3); glFinish();
    glReadPixels(0, 0, 64, 64, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, px);
    GLenum e = glGetError(); if (e) printf("glGetError 0x%x\n", e);
    uint64_t s = 1469598103934665603ull; for (int i = 0; i < 64 * 64 * 4; i++) s = (s ^ px[i]) * 1099511628211ull; return s;
}
int main(void) {
    CGLPixelFormatAttribute a[] = { kCGLPFAAccelerated, kCGLPFAOpenGLProfile, (CGLPixelFormatAttribute)kCGLOGLPVersion_GL4_Core, 0 };
    CGLPixelFormatObj pf; GLint np; CGLChoosePixelFormat(a, &pf, &np); CGLContextObj c; CGLCreateContext(pf, 0, &c); CGLSetCurrentContext(c);
    printf("%s | %s\n", glGetString(GL_RENDERER), glGetString(GL_VERSION));
    if (sizeof cglt_table != sizeof c->disp) { printf("table size differs\n"); return 2; }
    static GLubyte p0[64 * 64 * 4], p1[64 * 64 * 4];
    uint64_t s0 = render(p0);
    g_rend = c->rend; g_orig = c->disp; memcpy(cglt_backend, backs, sizeof backs); memcpy(&c->disp, cglt_table, sizeof cglt_table);
    uint64_t s1 = render(p1);
    printf("direct  %016llx\nthunks  %016llx (%llu calls through the thunks)\ncentre  %u %u %u %u\n%s\n", s0, s1, g_calls, p1[32*64*4+32*4], p1[32*64*4+32*4+1], p1[32*64*4+32*4+2], p1[32*64*4+32*4+3],
           s0 == s1 && g_calls > 20 ? "RESULT: identical image through the generated thunks" : "RESULT: DIFFERENT");
    c->disp = g_orig; return s0 != s1;
}
''')

FILE: zink-gl/cgl/gen/names.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""names.py map.tsv thunks.h > backend_names.h: for every dispatch entry the GL name a backend (zink, eglGetProcAddress) should
resolve. Several symbols can share an entry (glUseProgram, glUseProgramObjectARB): the core name is preferred."""
import re, sys
by = {}
for l in open(sys.argv[1]):
    p = l.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
    if len(p) == 3: by.setdefault(int(p[1]), []).append(p[0])
def rank(s):
    suf = re.search(r'(ARB|EXT|APPLE|ATI|NV|SGIS|IBM)$', s)
    return (1 if suf else 0, len(s), s)
n = int(re.search(r'#define CGLT_N (\d+)', open(sys.argv[2]).read()).group(1))
print('// generated by names.py from map.tsv (measured against libGL): NULL = no symbol reaches this entry')
print('static const char *cglt_names[%d] = {' % n)
for i in range(n):
    c = sorted(by.get(i, []), key=rank)
    print('  ' + (f'"{c[0]}",' if c else 'NULL,') + (f' // also {" ".join(c[1:])}' if len(c) > 1 else ''))
print('};')

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// A test stand-in for Mesa's EGL, for a machine without zink. Each "EGL context" is a hidden Apple context (not current to
// CGL), and the GL functions it hands out call that context's own entries directly. So the layer's plumbing runs for
// real, and pixels can be compared with Apple's GL. Nothing here says anything about zink. Window surfaces only count.
//
// As Mesa's EGL: the current context is per thread, and a context current on one thread cannot be made current on another
// (EGL_BAD_ACCESS). FAKEEGL_ZINK_NAMES=1 refuses the 58 table names zink did not resolve on the B580 (5 Nov 2026), so
// that the layer's replacements for Apple's extensions run. FAKEEGL_ZINK_STRINGS=1 reports zink's version and extensions.
#define GL_SILENCE_DEPRECATION
#include <OpenGL/OpenGL.h>
#include <OpenGL/CGLContext.h>
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
typedef void *EGLDisplay, *EGLConfig, *EGLContext, *EGLSurface;
typedef int EGLint;
static __thread GLIFunctionDispatch *g_fake_table;
static __thread GLIContext g_fake_rend;
static __thread CGLContextObj t_bound;
static __thread EGLint t_error = 0x3000;
#include "fake_backend.h"
#include "backend_names.h"
#define V __attribute__((visibility("default")))
static long g_swaps, g_windows, g_binds, g_gets, g_refused, g_intervals, g_busy;
static int g_interval = -1;
// which thread has which context current
static struct { CGLContextObj c; pthread_t owner; } g_owners[64];
static pthread_mutex_t g_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static const char *zink_lacks[] = {
    "glBindVertexArrayAPPLE", "glBufferParameteriAPPLE", "glDeleteFencesAPPLE", "glDeleteVertexArraysAPPLE", "glDisableVertexAttribAPPLE",
    "glDrawElementArrayAPPLE", "glDrawRangeElementArrayAPPLE", "glElementPointerAPPLE", "glEnableVertexAttribAPPLE", "glFinishFenceAPPLE",
    "glFinishObjectAPPLE", "glFinishRenderAPPLE", "glFlushMappedBufferRangeAPPLE", "glFlushRenderAPPLE", "glFlushVertexArrayRangeAPPLE",
    "glFramebufferTextureFaceEXT", "glGenFencesAPPLE", "glGenVertexArraysAPPLE", "glGetObjectParameterivAPPLE", "glGetTexParameterPointervAPPLE",
    "glGetUniformBufferSizeEXT", "glGetUniformOffsetEXT", "glInsertEventMarkerEXT", "glIsFenceAPPLE", "glIsVertexArrayAPPLE",
    "glIsVertexAttribEnabledAPPLE", "glLabelObjectWithResponsibleProcessAPPLE", "glMapVertexAttrib1dAPPLE", "glMapVertexAttrib1fAPPLE", "glMapVertexAttrib2dAPPLE",
    "glMapVertexAttrib2fAPPLE", "glMultiDrawElementArrayAPPLE", "glMultiDrawElementsIndirectAPPLE", "glMultiDrawRangeElementArrayAPPLE", "glObjectPurgeableAPPLE",
    "glObjectUnpurgeableAPPLE", "glPointSizePointerAPPLE", "glPopGroupMarkerEXT", "glPushGroupMarkerEXT", "glSetFenceAPPLE",
    "glSwapAPPLE", "glTestFenceAPPLE", "glTestObjectAPPLE", "glTextureRangeAPPLE", "glUniformBufferEXT",
    "glVertexArrayParameteriAPPLE", "glVertexArrayRangeAPPLE", "glVertexBlendARB", "glVertexPointSizefAPPLE", "glWeightPointerARB",
    "glWeightbvARB", "glWeightdvARB", "glWeightfvARB", "glWeightivARB", "glWeightsvARB",
    "glWeightubvARB", "glWeightuivARB", "glWeightusvARB",
};
__attribute__((destructor)) static void report(void) {
    fprintf(stderr, "fakeegl: %ld makecurrent (%ld refused: current elsewhere), %ld window surfaces, %ld swaps, %ld swap intervals (last %d), "
            "%ld entries resolved, %ld refused as zink would\n", g_binds, g_busy, g_windows, g_swaps, g_intervals, g_interval, g_gets, g_refused);
}
V EGLDisplay eglGetDisplay(void *n) { return (void *)1; }
V unsigned eglInitialize(EGLDisplay d, EGLint *a, EGLint *b) { *a = 1; *b = 5; return 1; }
V unsigned eglBindAPI(unsigned a) { return 1; }
V unsigned eglChooseConfig(EGLDisplay d, const EGLint *w, EGLConfig *c, EGLint n, EGLint *o) { *c = (void *)1; *o = 1; return 1; }
V EGLContext eglCreateContext(EGLDisplay d, EGLConfig c, EGLContext share, const EGLint *a) {
    int major = 2, minor = 1, core = 0;
    for (; a && *a != 0x3038; a += 2) { if (a[0] == 0x3098) major = a[1]; if (a[0] == 0x30FB) minor = a[1]; if (a[0] == 0x30FD) core = a[1] == 1; }
    CGLPixelFormatAttribute at[] = { kCGLPFAAccelerated, kCGLPFAOpenGLProfile,
        (CGLPixelFormatAttribute)(!core ? kCGLOGLPVersion_Legacy : major >= 4 ? kCGLOGLPVersion_GL4_Core : kCGLOGLPVersion_GL3_Core), 0 };
    CGLPixelFormatObj pf; GLint np;
    if (CGLChoosePixelFormat(at, &pf, &np) || !pf) return NULL;
    CGLContextObj made = NULL;
    CGLCreateContext(pf, share, &made);
    CGLReleasePixelFormat(pf);
    return made;
}
static int owner_slot(CGLContextObj c) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) if (g_owners[i].c == c) return i;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) if (!g_owners[i].c) { g_owners[i].c = c; g_owners[i].owner = NULL; return i; }
    return -1;
}
V unsigned eglDestroyContext(EGLDisplay d, EGLContext c) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    int i = owner_slot(c);
    if (i >= 0) g_owners[i].c = NULL;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    if (t_bound == c) { t_bound = NULL; g_fake_table = NULL; g_fake_rend = NULL; }
    CGLDestroyContext(c);
    return 1;
}
V EGLSurface eglCreateWindowSurface(EGLDisplay d, EGLConfig c, void *w, const EGLint *a) { g_windows++; return (void *)2; }
V EGLSurface eglCreatePbufferSurface(EGLDisplay d, EGLConfig c, const EGLint *a) { return (void *)3; }
V unsigned eglDestroySurface(EGLDisplay d, EGLSurface s) { return 1; }
V unsigned eglMakeCurrent(EGLDisplay d, EGLSurface r, EGLSurface s, EGLContext c) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    g_binds++;
    int i = c ? owner_slot(c) : -1;
    if (i >= 0 && g_owners[i].owner && !pthread_equal(g_owners[i].owner, pthread_self())) {
        g_busy++;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
        t_error = 0x3002;   // EGL_BAD_ACCESS; the thread keeps what it had
        return 0;
    }
    if (t_bound) { int j = owner_slot(t_bound); if (j >= 0) g_owners[j].owner = NULL; }
    if (i >= 0) g_owners[i].owner = pthread_self();
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    t_bound = c;
    g_fake_table = c ? &((CGLContextObj)c)->disp : NULL;
    g_fake_rend = c ? ((CGLContextObj)c)->rend : NULL;
    return 1;
}
V unsigned eglSwapBuffers(EGLDisplay d, EGLSurface s) { g_swaps++; return 1; }
V unsigned eglSwapInterval(EGLDisplay d, EGLint i) { g_intervals++; g_interval = i; return 1; }
V EGLint eglGetError(void) { EGLint e = t_error; t_error = 0x3000; return e; }
// FAKEEGL_ZINK_STRINGS: the version and extensions say what zink says (4.6, GLSL 4.60, one extension Apple does not have,
// GL_ARB_buffer_storage), so that the layer must give the application Apple's again.
#define GL_NUM_EXTENSIONS_ 0x821D
#define GL_MAJOR_VERSION_ 0x821B
#define GL_MINOR_VERSION_ 0x821C
static int fake_core(void) { const char *v = (const char *)g_fake_table->get_string(g_fake_rend, GL_VERSION); return v && v[0] >= '3'; }
static __thread char t_list[32768];
static __thread const char *t_items[1024];
static int fake_extensions(void) {   // Apple's list for the context's profile, then the extra one
    int n = 0;
    t_list[0] = 0;
    if (fake_core()) {
        GLint count = 0; g_fake_table->get_integerv(g_fake_rend, GL_NUM_EXTENSIONS_, &count);
        for (GLint i = 0; i < count && n < 1023; i++) t_items[n++] = (const char *)g_fake_table->get_stringi(g_fake_rend, GL_EXTENSIONS, i);
    } else {
        strlcpy(t_list, (const char *)g_fake_table->get_string(g_fake_rend, GL_EXTENSIONS), sizeof t_list);
        char *save = NULL;
        for (char *t = strtok_r(t_list, " ", &save); t && n < 1023; t = strtok_r(NULL, " ", &save)) t_items[n++] = t;
    }
    t_items[n++] = "GL_ARB_buffer_storage";
    return n;
}
static const GLubyte *zs_GetString(GLenum name) {
    static __thread char joined[32768];
    if (name == GL_VERSION) return (const GLubyte *)(fake_core() ? "4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 27.0.0-devel" : "4.6 (Compatibility Profile) Mesa 27.0.0-devel");
    if (name == GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION) return (const GLubyte *)"4.60";
    if (name == GL_EXTENSIONS && !fake_core()) {
        int n = fake_extensions();
        joined[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { strlcat(joined, t_items[i], sizeof joined); strlcat(joined, " ", sizeof joined); }
        return (const GLubyte *)joined;
    }
    return g_fake_table->get_string(g_fake_rend, name);
}
static const GLubyte *zs_GetStringi(GLenum name, GLuint index) {
    if (name != GL_EXTENSIONS) return g_fake_table->get_stringi(g_fake_rend, name, index);
    int n = fake_extensions();
    return index < (GLuint)n ? (const GLubyte *)t_items[index] : NULL;
}
static void zs_GetIntegerv(GLenum pname, GLint *v) {
    if (pname == GL_NUM_EXTENSIONS_) { *v = fake_extensions(); return; }
    if (pname == GL_MAJOR_VERSION_) { *v = 4; return; }
    if (pname == GL_MINOR_VERSION_) { *v = 6; return; }
    g_fake_table->get_integerv(g_fake_rend, pname, v);
}
// FAKEEGL_TINT: the clear colour comes out wrong, which shows that the application's GL calls really arrive here.
static void tinted_clear_color(GLfloat r, GLfloat g, GLfloat b, GLfloat a) { g_fake_table->clear_color(g_fake_rend, 1 - r, g, b, a); }
V void *eglGetProcAddress(const char *name) {
    if (getenv("FAKEEGL_TINT") && !strcmp(name, "glClearColor")) return (void *)tinted_clear_color;
    if (getenv("FAKEEGL_ZINK_STRINGS")) {
        if (!strcmp(name, "glGetString")) return (void *)zs_GetString;
        if (!strcmp(name, "glGetStringi")) return (void *)zs_GetStringi;
        if (!strcmp(name, "glGetIntegerv")) return (void *)zs_GetIntegerv;
    }
    if (getenv("FAKEEGL_ZINK_NAMES"))
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof zink_lacks / sizeof *zink_lacks; i++) if (!strcmp(zink_lacks[i], name)) { g_refused++; return NULL; }
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof cglt_names / sizeof *cglt_names); i++)
        if (cglt_names[i] && !strcmp(cglt_names[i], name)) { g_gets++; return fake_backs[i]; }
    // core names the layer's replacements use that are not table names here
    return NULL;
}

FILE: zink-gl/cgl/test/run.sh

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# run.sh OUTDIR: layertest on Apple's GL, then through libcglzink with the stand-in EGL (fakeegl.c), then with the stand-in
# refusing what zink does not resolve, then also reporting zink's version and extensions (4.6, GL_ARB_buffer_storage).
# What layertest prints (stdout: pixel hashes, versions, extensions) must be the same in every run; the layer's and the
# stand-in's reports go to stderr. No GPU of ours needed: this checks the layer's plumbing, not zink.
# LAYERTEST_VIEW=1 in the environment adds a view in a window that is never shown.
set -uo pipefail
O=${1:?usage: run.sh OUTDIR (from build.sh)}
cd "$O" || exit 1
./layertest > apple.txt 2> apple.err
CGLZINK_LOG=1 CGLZINK_EGL="$O/libfakeegl.dylib" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$O/libcglzink.dylib" ./layertest > layer.txt 2> layer.err
CGLZINK_LOG=1 FAKEEGL_ZINK_NAMES=1 CGLZINK_EGL="$O/libfakeegl.dylib" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$O/libcglzink.dylib" ./layertest > zinknames.txt 2> zinknames.err
CGLZINK_LOG=1 FAKEEGL_ZINK_NAMES=1 FAKEEGL_ZINK_STRINGS=1 CGLZINK_EGL="$O/libfakeegl.dylib" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$O/libcglzink.dylib" ./layertest > zinkstrings.txt 2> zinkstrings.err
# CGLZINK_SURF_WRITEBACK: dirty (the default, also the runs above) and flush (a copy at every flush) must give Apple's
# pixels; =present skips the copy at glFlush, so only the IOSurface lines may differ there (a reader that syncs on
# glFlush sees the previous frame: why it is opt-in)
CGLZINK_LOG=1 CGLZINK_SURF_WRITEBACK=flush CGLZINK_EGL="$O/libfakeegl.dylib" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$O/libcglzink.dylib" ./layertest > flush.txt 2> flush.err
CGLZINK_LOG=1 CGLZINK_SURF_WRITEBACK=dirty CGLZINK_EGL="$O/libfakeegl.dylib" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$O/libcglzink.dylib" ./layertest > dirty.txt 2> dirty.err
CGLZINK_LOG=1 CGLZINK_SURF_WRITEBACK=present CGLZINK_EGL="$O/libfakeegl.dylib" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$O/libcglzink.dylib" ./layertest > present.txt 2> present.err
CGLZINK_OFF=1 DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$O/libcglzink.dylib" ./layertest > off.txt 2> off.err
# the "every OpenGL application" switch: libcglzink-boot inserted, libcglzink loaded by it (layertest is no application
# bundle: CGLZINK_GLOBAL_ANY lets the boot library take part anyway); then refused by the environment
CGLZINK_LOG=1 CGLZINK_GLOBAL_ANY=1 CGLZINK_LIB="$O/libcglzink.dylib" CGLZINK_EGL="$O/libfakeegl.dylib" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$O/libcglzink-boot.dylib" ./layertest > boot.txt 2> boot.err
CGLZINK_LOG=1 CGLZINK_LIB="$O/libcglzink.dylib" CGLZINK_EGL="$O/libfakeegl.dylib" DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES="$O/libcglzink-boot.dylib" ./layertest > bootout.txt 2> bootout.err
cat apple.txt
r=0
for f in layer dirty flush zinknames zinkstrings off boot bootout; do
    if cmp -s apple.txt $f.txt; then echo "$f: same as Apple's GL"; else echo "$f: DIFFERENT"; diff apple.txt $f.txt; r=1; fi
done
if diff <(grep -v '^iosurface \(re\)\{0,1\}draw' apple.txt) <(grep -v '^iosurface \(re\)\{0,1\}draw' present.txt) >/dev/null; then
    echo "present: same as Apple's GL outside the IOSurface lines ($(grep -c '^iosurface \(re\)\{0,1\}draw' present.txt) lines left out)"
else echo "present: DIFFERENT outside the IOSurface lines"; r=1; fi
grep -h -E "^(layertest|fakeegl)|EGL [0-9]|used on two|swap interval|layer scale|stays|went|is gone|extensions:|told" layer.err zinknames.err zinkstrings.err | sort | uniq -c
# the boot library must have taken part (the layer adopted contexts) only in the first of its two runs
if grep -q "taking part" boot.err && grep -q "adopted" boot.err; then echo "boot: took part, contexts adopted"; else echo "boot: did NOT take part"; r=1; fi
if grep -q "taking part\|adopted" bootout.err; then echo "bootout: took part outside an application bundle"; r=1; else echo "bootout: stayed out (not an application)"; fi
exit $r

/* Offscreen EGL (surfaceless platform) GL 3.2 core test: triangle into a pbuffer, read back, time N frames. */
#include <EGL/egl.h>
#include <EGL/eglext.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>

typedef unsigned int GLenum; typedef unsigned int GLuint; typedef int GLint; typedef int GLsizei;
typedef float GLfloat; typedef unsigned char GLubyte; typedef char GLchar; typedef long GLsizeiptr; typedef unsigned int GLbitfield;
#define GL_TRIANGLES 4
#define GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT 0x4000
#define GL_ARRAY_BUFFER 0x8892
#define GL_STATIC_DRAW 0x88E4
#define GL_FLOAT 0x1406
#define GL_FALSE 0
#define GL_VERTEX_SHADER 0x8B31
#define GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER 0x8B30
#define GL_COMPILE_STATUS 0x8B81
#define GL_LINK_STATUS 0x8B82
#define GL_RGBA 0x1908
#define GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE 0x1401
#define GL_VENDOR 0x1F00
#define GL_RENDERER 0x1F01
#define GL_VERSION 0x1F02
#define GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION 0x8B8C

#define F(ret, name, args) static ret (*name) args;
#define GLFUNCS \
 F(const GLubyte*, glGetString, (GLenum)) F(void, glClearColor, (GLfloat,GLfloat,GLfloat,GLfloat)) F(void, glClear, (GLbitfield)) \
 F(void, glViewport, (GLint,GLint,GLsizei,GLsizei)) F(void, glGenVertexArrays, (GLsizei,GLuint*)) F(void, glBindVertexArray, (GLuint)) \
 F(void, glGenBuffers, (GLsizei,GLuint*)) F(void, glBindBuffer, (GLenum,GLuint)) F(void, glBufferData, (GLenum,GLsizeiptr,const void*,GLenum)) \
 F(void, glVertexAttribPointer, (GLuint,GLint,GLenum,unsigned char,GLsizei,const void*)) F(void, glEnableVertexAttribArray, (GLuint)) \
 F(GLuint, glCreateShader, (GLenum)) F(void, glShaderSource, (GLuint,GLsizei,const GLchar*const*,const GLint*)) F(void, glCompileShader, (GLuint)) \
 F(void, glGetShaderiv, (GLuint,GLenum,GLint*)) F(void, glGetShaderInfoLog, (GLuint,GLsizei,GLsizei*,GLchar*)) F(GLuint, glCreateProgram, (void)) \
 F(void, glAttachShader, (GLuint,GLuint)) F(void, glLinkProgram, (GLuint)) F(void, glGetProgramiv, (GLuint,GLenum,GLint*)) F(void, glUseProgram, (GLuint)) \
 F(void, glDrawArrays, (GLenum,GLint,GLsizei)) F(void, glFinish, (void)) F(void, glReadPixels, (GLint,GLint,GLsizei,GLsizei,GLenum,GLenum,void*)) \
 F(GLenum, glGetError, (void)) F(GLint, glGetUniformLocation, (GLuint,const GLchar*)) F(void, glUniform1f, (GLint,GLfloat)) F(void, glBindFramebuffer, (GLenum,GLuint))
GLFUNCS
#undef F

static double now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec + t.tv_nsec * 1e-9; }

static GLuint shader(GLenum type, const char *src) {
   GLuint s = glCreateShader(type); glShaderSource(s, 1, &src, NULL); glCompileShader(s);
   GLint ok = 0; glGetShaderiv(s, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &ok);
   if (!ok) { char log[2048]; glGetShaderInfoLog(s, sizeof log, NULL, log); fprintf(stderr, "shader: %s\n", log); exit(1); }
   return s;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
   int frames = argc > 1 ? atoi(argv[1]) : 1000;
   const int W = 1920, H = 1080;
   PFNEGLGETPLATFORMDISPLAYEXTPROC gpd = (void *)eglGetProcAddress("eglGetPlatformDisplayEXT");
   int native = argc > 2 && !strcmp(argv[2], "native");
   EGLDisplay dpy = (gpd && !native) ? gpd(EGL_PLATFORM_SURFACELESS_MESA, NULL, NULL) : eglGetDisplay(EGL_DEFAULT_DISPLAY);
   printf("display: %s\n", (gpd && !native) ? "surfaceless" : "EGL_DEFAULT_DISPLAY (native platform)");
   EGLint maj, min;
   if (!eglInitialize(dpy, &maj, &min)) { fprintf(stderr, "eglInitialize failed 0x%x\n", eglGetError()); return 1; }
   printf("EGL %d.%d %s / %s\n", maj, min, eglQueryString(dpy, EGL_VENDOR), eglQueryString(dpy, EGL_VERSION));
   if (!eglBindAPI(EGL_OPENGL_API)) { fprintf(stderr, "bind api\n"); return 1; }
   EGLint ca[] = { EGL_SURFACE_TYPE, EGL_PBUFFER_BIT, EGL_RENDERABLE_TYPE, EGL_OPENGL_BIT, EGL_RED_SIZE, 8, EGL_GREEN_SIZE, 8, EGL_BLUE_SIZE, 8, EGL_ALPHA_SIZE, 8, EGL_DEPTH_SIZE, 24, EGL_NONE };
   EGLConfig cfg; EGLint n = 0;
   if (!eglChooseConfig(dpy, ca, &cfg, 1, &n) || n < 1) { fprintf(stderr, "no config 0x%x\n", eglGetError()); return 1; }
   EGLint cx[] = { EGL_CONTEXT_MAJOR_VERSION, 3, EGL_CONTEXT_MINOR_VERSION, 2, EGL_CONTEXT_OPENGL_PROFILE_MASK, EGL_CONTEXT_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE_BIT,
                   EGL_CONTEXT_OPENGL_FORWARD_COMPATIBLE, EGL_TRUE, EGL_NONE };
   EGLContext ctx = eglCreateContext(dpy, cfg, EGL_NO_CONTEXT, cx);
   if (!ctx) { fprintf(stderr, "context 0x%x\n", eglGetError()); return 1; }
   EGLint pa[] = { EGL_WIDTH, W, EGL_HEIGHT, H, EGL_NONE };
   EGLSurface pb = eglCreatePbufferSurface(dpy, cfg, pa);
   if (!pb) { fprintf(stderr, "pbuffer 0x%x\n", eglGetError()); return 1; }
   if (!eglMakeCurrent(dpy, pb, pb, ctx)) { fprintf(stderr, "make current 0x%x\n", eglGetError()); return 1; }
   void *(*gpa)(const char *) = (void *(*)(const char *))eglGetProcAddress;
   if (getenv("EGLTRI_SHIM")) { void *h = dlopen(getenv("EGLTRI_SHIM"), RTLD_NOW); gpa = h ? (void *(*)(const char *))dlsym(h, "OSMesaGetProcAddress") : NULL; if (!gpa) { fprintf(stderr, "shim\n"); return 1; } printf("GL via shim OSMesaGetProcAddress\n"); }
#define F(ret, name, args) name = (ret (*) args)gpa(#name); if (!name) { fprintf(stderr, "missing %s\n", #name); return 1; }
   GLFUNCS
#undef F
   printf("GL_VENDOR   %s\nGL_RENDERER %s\nGL_VERSION  %s\nGLSL        %s\n", glGetString(GL_VENDOR), glGetString(GL_RENDERER), glGetString(GL_VERSION), glGetString(GL_SHADING_LANGUAGE_VERSION));
   const char *vs = "#version 150\nin vec2 p; uniform float t; void main(){ float c=cos(t), s=sin(t); gl_Position=vec4(c*p.x-s*p.y, s*p.x+c*p.y, 0, 1); }\n";
   const char *fs = "#version 150\nout vec4 o; void main(){ o = vec4(1.0, 0.5, 0.0, 1.0); }\n";
   GLuint prog = glCreateProgram(); glAttachShader(prog, shader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER, vs)); glAttachShader(prog, shader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, fs)); glLinkProgram(prog);
   GLint ok = 0; glGetProgramiv(prog, GL_LINK_STATUS, &ok); if (!ok) { fprintf(stderr, "link\n"); return 1; }
   glUseProgram(prog); GLint ut = glGetUniformLocation(prog, "t");
   GLuint vao, vbo; glGenVertexArrays(1, &vao); glBindVertexArray(vao); glGenBuffers(1, &vbo); glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, vbo);
   float v[] = { -0.8f, -0.8f, 0.8f, -0.8f, 0.0f, 0.8f }; glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, sizeof v, v, GL_STATIC_DRAW);
   glVertexAttribPointer(0, 2, GL_FLOAT, GL_FALSE, 0, 0); glEnableVertexAttribArray(0);
   glViewport(0, 0, W, H); glClearColor(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.5f, 1.0f);
   glBindFramebuffer(0x8D40, 0); glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT); glUniform1f(ut, 0.0f); glDrawArrays(GL_TRIANGLES, 0, 3); glFinish();
   unsigned char px[2][4];
   glReadPixels(W / 2, H / 2, 1, 1, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, px[0]);
   glReadPixels(2, 2, 1, 1, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, px[1]);
   printf("center %u,%u,%u,%u (want 255,128,0,255)  corner %u,%u,%u,%u (want 0,0,128,255)  glGetError 0x%x\n",
          px[0][0], px[0][1], px[0][2], px[0][3], px[1][0], px[1][1], px[1][2], px[1][3], glGetError());
   double t0 = now();
   for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) { glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT); glUniform1f(ut, i * 0.01f); glDrawArrays(GL_TRIANGLES, 0, 3); if ((i & 63) == 63) glFinish(); }
   glFinish();
   double dt = now() - t0;
   printf("%d frames 1080p clear+tri: %.3f s, %.0f fps\n", frames, dt, frames / dt);
   eglMakeCurrent(dpy, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_CONTEXT);
   eglDestroySurface(dpy, pb); eglDestroyContext(dpy, ctx); eglTerminate(dpy);
   printf("OK\n");
   return 0;
}

FILE: zink-gl/src/glfw-3.4-0001-cocoa-egl-desktop-OpenGL-through-EGL-zink.patch
================================================
From 3baa7725e2ffdea3650ee63d034fe740cb1ca629 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: yusufklncc <78423442+yusufklncc@users.noreply.github.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 19:39:02 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] cocoa, egl: desktop OpenGL through EGL (Mesa zink) on macOS

A build of GLFW 3.4 for Mesa's zink on macOS (the macOS EGL platform):

- window.c: with _GLFW_ZINK_EGL, a desktop OpenGL context that asks for the
  native context API (CGL/NSGL; Minecraft does) is made with EGL instead.
  GLFW_ZINK_EGL=0 in the environment keeps the native API.
- egl_context.c: GLFW_EGL_LIBRARY in the environment names the EGL library to
  load before the built-in names (_GLFW_EGL_LIBRARY, here
  "@loader_path/libEGL.1.dylib": the libEGL next to this library).

Build: cmake -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=x86_64
  '-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-D_GLFW_ZINK_EGL -D_GLFW_EGL_LIBRARY=\"@loader_path/libEGL.1.dylib\"'

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

FILE: zink-gl/src/glshim.c
================================================
/* libGLzink: an "OpenGL library" for LWJGL (-Dorg.lwjgl.opengl.libname). LWJGL resolves every GL function
 * through OSMesaGetProcAddress when the library exports it; this one forwards to Mesa's eglGetProcAddress. */
#include <EGL/egl.h>
__attribute__((visibility("default"))) void *OSMesaGetProcAddress(const char *name) { return (void *)eglGetProcAddress(name); }

name: Something is broken
description: Boot stops, black screen, an app crashes, video or sleep fails, or something else does not work.
title: "[Bug] <what happens>"
labels: [bug]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        **First make a report.** On macOS, run `sh collect-macos.sh` from [`tools/report`](../tree/main/tools/report). It takes about a minute and prints a report ID like `XR-1A2B3C4D`. Then drag the file it wrote (`xe-report-XR-….tar.gz`) into the "What happens" box below.

        It collects your hardware, the driver's state, logs and the OpenCore config, with serial numbers, names, MAC addresses and Wi-Fi names removed. Nothing is uploaded until you attach the file.

        For display or boot problems, a Linux live-USB report (`collect-linux.sh`) or a Windows one (`collect-windows.ps1`) from the same machine helps a lot.
  - type: input
    id: report
    attributes:
      label: Report ID
      description: Looks like XR-1A2B3C4D. If you made several (macOS, Linux, Windows), list all of them, separated by commas.
      placeholder: XR-
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: dropdown
    id: stage
    attributes:
      label: Where does it go wrong?
      options:
        - "Boot: before or in the OpenCore picker"
        - "Boot: after picking macOS (Apple logo, restart, kernel panic)"
        - "Kext load: IntelXe.kext or IntelXeFB.kext does not load, or the GPU is not found"
        - "Display: black screen, no desktop, wrong resolution or refresh rate, flicker"
        - "Desktop: slow, glitches, frozen or restarting WindowServer"
        - "Metal or OpenGL apps: an app crashes, hangs or draws wrong"
        - "Vulkan or games"
        - "Video: playback, VideoToolbox decode or encode"
        - "Sleep and wake (display sleep or system sleep)"
        - Something else
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: what
    attributes:
      label: What happens
      description: What you see, and the last line on screen if it stops. A photo of the screen helps. Attach the report file here.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: steps
    attributes:
      label: How to make it happen
      description: The steps, if you know them. "It happens at every boot" is a fine answer.
  - type: input
    id: app
    attributes:
      label: App or game (if it is one)
      placeholder: name and version
  - type: textarea
    id: changed
    attributes:
      label: Did you change anything yourself?
      description: Extra boot-args, kexts, SSDTs or settings that are not in the install outline, or someone else's EFI. "No" is a fine answer.
  - type: checkboxes
    id: attached
    attributes:
      label: Report file
      options:
        - label: I attached the report file (xe-report-XR-….tar.gz or .zip) whose ID is above.
          required: true

FILE: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/2-new-hardware.yml
================================================
name: Support for my Intel GPU
description: Your Intel GPU is not supported yet (another Arc card, or a laptop or desktop with Intel graphics).
title: "[Hardware] <GPU name, e.g. Arc A770 or Core Ultra 7 155H>"
labels: [hardware]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        Thank you. Bringing up a new GPU needs a lot of detail about it, and we would rather ask once. Please make **both** reports below on the same machine, with the monitor you use connected (on a laptop, its own panel). The scripts are in [`tools/report`](../tree/main/tools/report); each takes a minute or two, changes nothing and removes serial numbers, names, MAC addresses and Wi-Fi names. Drag both files into the box at the end.

        1. **Linux** (a live USB is enough, Ubuntu 25.04+ or Fedora 41+): install the optional tools, then run it with root, `--acpi` and `--bench`:
           ```sh
           sudo apt install intel-gpu-tools vainfo clinfo vulkan-tools mesa-utils
           sudo sh collect-linux.sh --acpi --bench
           ```
           This is the important one: it records what Linux's own driver finds and programs on your GPU. `--acpi` adds only the DSDT and SSDT tables, never the ones with your Windows licence. Copy the file off the live USB before you reboot.
        2. **macOS** (if it boots on this machine, with any graphics): `sh collect-macos.sh --probe --acpi` (on macOS 26 and later `--acpi` finds no tables, as macOS no longer publishes them; the Linux report has them).

        A Windows report is welcome too if you dual-boot: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File collect-windows.ps1 -Acpi`.
  - type: input
    id: reports
    attributes:
      label: Report IDs
      description: The IDs the scripts printed (XR-…), separated by commas.
      placeholder: XR-…, XR-…
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: gpu
    attributes:
      label: GPU and machine
      description: The GPU, and for a laptop or mini PC its make and model.
      placeholder: Arc A750 in a desktop / Lenovo Yoga with Core Ultra 7 155H
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: dropdown
    id: macos
    attributes:
      label: macOS on this machine today
      options:
        - It does not boot, or I have not tried
        - It boots without graphics acceleration
        - It boots with another GPU, this one unused
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: notes
    attributes:
      label: Anything else, and the report files
      description: Your OpenCore setup if macOS runs, other GPUs in the machine, what you would use it for. Drag the report files here.

# Publishes site/ (the project page) to GitHub Pages when it changes on main.
name: Pages
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ["site/**", ".github/workflows/pages.yml"]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: site
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

FILE: .github/workflows/windows-app.yml

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Builds IntelXe Manager for Windows (windows/app) and runs its Core tests (the shared EFI rule vectors among them) on
# a Windows runner; the self-contained zip and its .sha256 are kept as a build artifact (release/package.sh takes them
# as WINAPP_ZIP). The Core compiles IntelXe-EFI.ps1's engine and
# embeds efi-rules.json, so a change to either runs it too; build.ps1 puts windows/efibuild beside the app (engine\). It
# publishes nothing and makes no release.
name: Windows app
on:
  push:
    paths: ["windows/app/**", "windows/efibuild/**", "windows/IntelXe-EFI.ps1", "windows/test/stage1/**", "release/templates/efi-rules.json", "release/efi-rules-vectors.json", "efi/sample-z790/config.plist", "data/platforms.json", "tools/report/collect-windows.ps1", ".github/workflows/windows-app.yml"]
  pull_request:
    paths: ["windows/app/**", "windows/efibuild/**", "windows/IntelXe-EFI.ps1", "windows/test/stage1/**", "release/templates/efi-rules.json", "release/efi-rules-vectors.json", "efi/sample-z790/config.plist", "data/platforms.json", "tools/report/collect-windows.ps1", ".github/workflows/windows-app.yml"]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "10.0.x"
      - name: Build, test and publish
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./windows/app/build.ps1
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: IntelXeManager-win-x64
          path: |
            windows/app/out/*.zip
            windows/app/out/*.zip.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
